Tu-in Josef ngaihbaangin a mel hoih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tawlkhat khit ciangin a topa’ zi in Josef zawl mit a, “Kei tawh hong lumkhawm in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in nialin a topa’ zi kiangah, “En in, kei hong nei ahih manin ka topa in inn sungah bangmah lunghihmawhna nei lo a, ama neih khempeuh ka khut sungah hong koih khin hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih inn sungah kei sangin amah lianzaw lo hi. Nang, ama zi na hih manin, nang lobuang kei kiang panin amah in a kep tuam bangmah om lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin bangci-in hih gitlohna lianpi bawlin Pasian’ tungah khial ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in ni khat khit ni khat Josef a zol hangin, amah tawh lupkhop ding hitaleh omkhop ding hitaleh amah in tua nu’ thu ngai lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin ni khat, amah a nasep sem dingin inn sungah pai a, inn sungah innsung mite khat zong a om loh laitakin,"},"12":{"text":"tua nu in a puan-in amah man a, “Kei tawh hong lumkhawm hoh in,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in tua nu’ khut sungah a puan nusia-in tai-in tua inn panin a paikhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua nu in, amah in a khut sungah puan nusia-in inn panin a taikhiatna a muh ciangin,"},"14":{"text":"ama innsung mite samin amaute kiangah, “En un, amah in eite hong no dingin Hebru mi khat eite’ lakah hong paipih hi. Kei tawh a lumkhawm dingin amah hong sungtang a, nakpitakin kei ka kiko hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka aw sangsakin ka kikona a zak ciangin amah in ka kiangah a puan nusia a, tai-in inn panin paikhia hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef’ topa inn-ah hong ciah mateng amah in a kiangah a puan koih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua nu in ama kiangah tua thu mah gen a, “Kote kianga nong paipih Hebru mi nasempa keimah a no dingin hong sungtang hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin ka aw sangsakin ka kiko phetin amah in a puan kei kiangah nusia-in inn panin taikhia hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na nasempa in kei hong bawlna dan hih bang hi,” ci-in a zi in ama kianga a genna a topa in a zak ciangin nak heh mahmah hi."},"20":{"text":"Josef’ topa in amah manin kumpipa’ thongkiate a kikhumna thong sungah amah koih a, tua thong sungah amah om hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Josef ompihin ama tungah itna kip lak a, thong kem pa’ muhna-ah amah maipha a pia hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:9"},"22":{"text":"Thong kem pa in thong sunga thongkia mi khempeuh Josef’ et dingin ap a, tua lai-a a kisem khempeuh ama hih ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in amah ompih ahih manin Josef’ etna sunga om peuhmah thong kem pa in don lo hi. Ama hih peuhmah Topa in daupaisak hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawh tawlkhat khit ciangin, Egypt kumpipa’ an piapa le a anhuan pa in Egypt kumpipa ahi amau’ topa hehsak uh hi.","title":"Josef in Thongkiate’ Mang Khiatsak"},"2":{"text":"An piapi pa le anhuan pipa ahi, ama nuai-a mangte nih tungah Faro heh a,"},"3":{"text":"Josef a kikhumna thong sung, inncing mangpa’ inn sungah amah in amaute a koih hi."},"4":{"text":"Inncing mangpa in amaute Josef kemsak a, amah in amaute’ na sem hi. Kikhumna sungah amaute tawlkhat om uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Zan khat amau tegel in mang man uh hi. Thong sunga a om an piapa le anhuan pa, amau’ mang a tuam tuak, a mang khiatna zong a tuam tuak mah ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingsang ciangin amaute kiangah Josef pai-in amaute a muh ciangin, amaute na lungkham uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a topa’ inn sunga amah tawh a kikhumin a om Faro’ nuai-a mangte amah in dong a, “Bang hangin tuni-in maimial na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in ama kiangah, “Mang ka man uh a, tuate a khiathei ding om lo hi,” na ci uh hi. Josef in amaute kiangah, “Mang khiat theihnate Pasian’ hong piak hi lo ahi hiam? Kei kiangah hong gen un, hong thum ing,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin an piapi pa in Josef kiangah a mang gen a, “Ka mangin ka mai-ah leenggui khat om a,"},"10":{"text":"tua leenggui tungah hiang thum om hi. A sel phetin pakkhia pah a, a bomte leenggah suakin min pah hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka khut sungah Faro’ hai ka tawi hi. Keimah in leenggahte loin Faro’ hai sungah ka suk a, Faro’ khut tungah a hai ka pia hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef in ama kiangah, “A khiatna hih bang ahi hi. Hiang thumte, ni thum ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni thum sungin Faro in nang hong khah ding a, na za-ah nang hong koih kik ding hi. Ama an piapa na hih lai-a mah bangin ama khut tungah Faro’ hai na pia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei hong phawk in. Nang tungah thu hong hoih ciangin kei tungah hehpihna hong bawl in, kong thum hi. Faro’ tungah kei’ thu genin, hih inn panin kei hong lakhia in."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Hebru mite’ gam panin kei hong kigukhia a, hih lai-ah zong amaute in thong mial sungah kei hong koih nadingin bangmah ka gamta kei hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"An huanpipa in a khiatna a hoihlam hi, ci-in a muh ciangin, amah in Josef kiangah, “Kei zong mang khat ka man hi: Ka lu tungah mohlawh thum om a,"},"17":{"text":"a lawh tungnung pen sungah an huansa namkim Faro a dingin om hi. Ahih hangin ka lu tunga lawh sung panin vasate in ne uh hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Josef in dawngin, “A khiatna hih bang ahi hi: Lawh thumte, ni thum ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ni thum sungin Faro in nang hong lakhia-in na lu hong tan ding a, sing tung khatah nang hong khai ding hi. Vasate in na sa ne ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"A ni thum ni, Faro’ suah ni hunin, amah in a nasemte khempeuh a dingin pawi khat kham a, an piapi pa le an huanpipa lakhia hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in an piapi pa an piak nasepah koihkik a, amah in Faro’ khut sungah a hai pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin Josef’ khiat mah bangin an huanpipa a khailum hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin an piapi pa in Josef phawk nawn lo a, amah mangngilh ta hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawh kum nih bit khit ciangin Faro in mang man a, amah Nail gun gei-ah ding hi.","title":"Josef in Faro’ Mang Khiatsak"},"2":{"text":"Nail gun sung panin bawngpi a zol a thau sagih hong paikhia a, amaute in phai lopate ne uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute’ khit ciangin Nail gun sung pan mahin a gulhgawng a gawng bawngpi dang sagih hong paikhia a, Nail gun gei-a bawngpi dangte kiangah ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin a gulhgawng bawngpi gawng sagihte in a zol a thau bawngpi sagihte netum uh hi. Tua ciangin Faro khang lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin ihmu-in a nih veina mang man hi. A taksa a hoih buhvui sagih kung khat tungah vui hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate’ khit ciangin nisuahna huih in a theemsak a hawm vui sagih hong pokhia hi."},"7":{"text":"A vui hawmte in a taksa a dim vui sagihte valhtum uh hi. Tua ciangin Faro khang lo a, tua pen a mang na hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin a lungkham hi. Amah in mi sawlin Egypt mitphial siamte khempeuh le a mipil khempeuh samsak hi. Faro in amaute’ kiangah a mang gen a, ahih hangin Faro’ tungah a khiatna a gen thei kuamah om lo hi.","ref":"Dan 2:2"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin an piapi pa in Faro’ kiangah, “Tuni-in ka khialhnate ka phawkkik hi."},"10":{"text":"Faro, ama nasemte tungah heh a, kei le an huanpipa, inncing mangpa’ inn sungah hong khum lai-in"},"11":{"text":"amah le keimah in zan khat sungin mang ka man uh a, a mangte in a khiatna tuam ciat nei hi."},"12":{"text":"Inncing mangpa’ nasem ahi Hebru mi tangval khat tua lai-ah kote tawh om hi. Ama kiangah ka gen uh ciangin, amah in ka mangte uh hong khiatsak a, ka mang uh tawh a kizui tuakin a khiatna hong gen hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in kote tungah a khiatna hong gen bangin hong tung hi. Kei pen ka za-ah hong kikoih kik a, anhuan pa kikhailum hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in mi sawlin Josef samsak a, amaute in manlang takin thongmial sung panin amah a paikhiatpih uh hi. Amah in a mul kiatin a puan a khek khit ciangin, Faro’ mai-ah hong pai hi."},"15":{"text":"Faro in Josef kiangah, “Mang khat ka man a, a khiatna a gen thei kuamah om lo hi. Nang in mang na zak ciangin a khiatna gen thei, ci-in hong kigenna ka za hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Josef in Faro dawngin, “Kei’ pilna tawh mang a khiathei ka hi kei hi. Pasian in Faro’ tungah a hoihlamin dawnna hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in Josef kiangah, “Ka mangin Nail gun gei-ah ka ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A thau a zol bawngpi sagih Nail gun panin hong paikhia a, phai lopate ne uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuate’ khit ciangin a hehpihhuai a gulhgawng, Egypt gam sung khempeuhah tua bang ka muh ngei loh bawngpi dang sagih hong pai hi."},"20":{"text":"A gawng a gulhgawng bawngpite in a masa a thau bawngpi sagihte netum uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in tuate a nek khit uh ciangin, a nek khitlam uh kuamah in thei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen a tunga mah bangin gulhgawng lai veve uh hi. Tua ciangin ka khang lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka mang mahin kung khat tungah a dim a hoih buhvui sagih a vuikhia zong ka mu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuate’ khit ciangin nisuahna huihpi in a keusak a hawm, a theem vui sagih hong po a,"},"24":{"text":"a vui hawmte in a vui hoih sagihte valhtum uh hi. Mitphial siamte kiangah ka gen a, ahih hangin kei kiangah hong gentel thei khat beek om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef in Faro’ kiangah, “Faro’ mang tegel pen khat ahi hi. Pasian in ama bawl ding, Faro’ tungah hong kilangsak khin hi."},"26":{"text":"A hoih bawngpi sagihte, kum sagih hi a, a hoih buhvui sagihte zong kum sagih mah ahi hi. A mang khiatna a kibang ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuate’ khit ciangin a hong paikhia, a gawng a gulhgawng bawngpi sagihte, kum sagih hi a, nisuahna huihpi in a theemsak buhvui sagihte zong kialpi kum sagih mah ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Faro’ kianga kong gen bangin Pasian in ama hih ding, Faro’ tungah hong lak khin ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Egypt gam sung khempeuhah kum sagih sung hauhna hong tung ding a,"},"30":{"text":"ahih hangin tua khit ciangin kialpi kum sagih sung hong tungin, hauhna ngeisa khempeuh Egypt gam sungah kimangngilh ding hi. Kialpi in gam sung netum ding a,"},"31":{"text":"nasia mahmah ding ahih manin, tua hong tung ding kialpi’ huhau-in gam sungah hauhna kithei lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Faro’ mang nih a phakna pen tua thu Pasian’ sehsa hi, a cihnopna hi a, Pasian in tomno sungin hong tungsak ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Faro in thu ngaihsun siam mipil khat tengkhia inla, Egypt gam sung a uk dingin amah koih in."},"34":{"text":"Faro in gam sungah vaihawm ulian seh inla, a kihauh kum sagih sungin Egypt gam leitang pana piang sung panin nga-ah khat la in."},"35":{"text":"Hong tung ding kum hoih sunga an khempeuh amaute khawmsak inla, khuapite sungah an nek dingin Faro’ ukna nuai-ah antangte kholin, amaute kemsak in."},"36":{"text":"Kialpi hangin gam sung a siatloh nadingin Egypt gam sungah a hong tung ding kum sagih kialpi dal nadingin a kikoihcing an hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Hih a thugen pen Faro le a nasemte khempeuh in hoihsa uh hi.","title":"Egypt A Ukin Josef Kikoih"},"38":{"text":"Faro in a nasemte kiangah, “Ama sungah Pasian Kha a omna, hih bang midang mu ding ihi hiam?” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro in Josef kiangah, “Pasian in hihte khempeuh nang hong lak khin ahih manin, nang bangin thu ngaihsun siam le a pil midang om lo hi."},"40":{"text":"Nang pen ka inn sungah ulian na hi ding a, nangma thupiak bangin ka mite khempeuh gamta ding uh hi. Kumpi tokhom tawh kisai-in kei pen nang sangin ka lian zaw ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:10"},"41":{"text":"Faro in Josef’ kiangah, “Egypt gam khempeuh a uk dingin nang kong koih khinzo hi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in a min gelhna zungbuh ama khut tung panin suahkhia-in Josef’ khutah bulh a, puan hoih mahmah tawh amah zemin, a ngawngah kham khainiang khat oksak hi.","ref":"Dan 5:29"},"43":{"text":"Ama leeng nihna tungah Josef tuangsak a, ama mai-ah uliante kiko a, “Khukdin’ un!” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Egypt gam khempeuh a ukin amah koih hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua tham loin Faro in Josef kiangah, “Kei pen Faro ka hi hi. Nangma thukim lohin Egypt gam sung khempeuhah kuamah in a khut a khe nangawn uh liik lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Faro in Josef’ min Zafenath-paneah a phuak hi. Amah in On khua siampipa Potifera’ tanu Asenath tawh kitengsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin Egypt gam sungah Josef zin kawikawi hi."},"46":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa Faro’ nasemin a tum hunin Josef kum sawmthum pha hi. Faro’ omna panin Josef paikhia a, Egypt gam sung khempeuhah zin hi."},"47":{"text":"A kihauh kum sagih sungin leitang in tampi piangsak a,"},"48":{"text":"Egypt gamah tampi a om laitakin amah in tua kum sagih sunga ante khempeuh khawm a, khuapite sungah an khol hi. A kiima lote panin khuapi simah amah in an khol hi."},"49":{"text":"A teh ding a khawl dong zahin Josef in tuipi gei sehnel zahin antang tampi khol hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kiteh khin zo lo hi."},"50":{"text":"Kialpi kum hong tun ma-in Josef in On khua siampipa Potifera’ tanu Asenath tawh tapa nih nei hi."},"51":{"text":"Josef in a ta masa Manasseh a phuak hi. Amah in, “Pasian in ka haksatna khempeuh le ka pa’ innkuan khempeuh a mangngilhin hong bawl hi,” ci hi."},"52":{"text":"A nihna pen amah in Efraim a phuak hi. “Ka thuakna gam sungah kei a pungin hong bawl hi,” ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Egypt gam sunga a om kum sagih sung hauhna hun bei ta hi."},"54":{"text":"Josef’ gensa bangin kum sagih kialpi hong kipan hi. Gamdang khempeuhah kialpi tung a, ahih hangin Egypt gam sung tengah an om hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:11"},"55":{"text":"Egypt gam khempeuh a kial ciangin, an ngenin mite Faro’ tungah kiko uh hi. Note’ tunga ama hong cih bangin gamta un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joh 2:5"},"56":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin gam khempeuhah kialpi a tunkim ciangin Josef in ankholna innte khempeuh hongin, Egypt mite tungah a zuak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt gamah kialpi nasia mahmah hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua tham loin, leitung khempeuhah kialpi nasia ahih manin, antang lei dingin Josef’ kiangah leitung mi khempeuh hong pai uh hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt-ah an a omna thu Jakob in a theih ciangin a tate kiangah, “Bang hangin khatlekhat ki-enen mawk na hi uh hiam?","title":"Antaw dingin Josef’ Sanggamte Egypt-ah Pai"},"2":{"text":"Egypt-ah an om hi, ci-in ka za hi. Eite si loin i nuntak nadingin paisuk unla, ei a’ ding an va lei un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:12"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Egypt-ah an lei dingin Josef’ sanggamte sawm paisuk uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin Jakob in Josef’ sanggampa Benjamin, a sanggamte tawh paisak lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama tungah siatna tung kha ding, ci-in lau hi."},"5":{"text":"Kanaan gam sungah kial tung ahih manin a hong pai dangte tawh Israel’ tapate an lei dingin hong paikhawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Josef pen tua gam a ukpa hi a, gammi khempeuh tungah an a zuakpa amah ahi hi. Josef’ sanggamte hong pai-in, a maitang uh leilam ngatin ama mai-ah hong kun uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Josef in a sanggamte a muh ciangin thei a, ahih hangin amah in midang bangin bawlin amaute tungah khauh pau hi. “Koi pana hong pai na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “An lei dingin Kanaan gam panin hong pai hi ung,” ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Josef in a sanggamte thei a, ahih hangin a sanggamte in amah thei lo uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Josef in a mangin amaute a mat khitna a phawk hi. Amah in amaute kiangah, “Note, thukan na hi uh a, hih gam thaneemna a en dingin hong pai na hi uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 37:5-10"},"10":{"text":"Amaute in Josef kiangah, “Hi lo hi, topa aw; an lei dingin na nasemte a hong pai hi ung."},"11":{"text":"Kote khempeuh mi khat’ ta ka hi uh hi. Kote, a thutak ka hi uh a, na nasemte thukan hi lo uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in amaute kiangah, “Hi lo hi, hih gam ginat lohna a en dingin hong pai na hi uh hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in, “Ko, nangma nasemte, sanggam pasal sawm le nih ka hi uh a, Kanaan gam sungah mi khat’ ta ka hi uh hi. A moi pen tu laitakin ka pa uh tawh om a, khat pen om nawn lo hi,” a ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin Josef in amaute kiangah, “Note’ tunga kong gen bangin a man mah ahi hi. Note, thukan na hi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih thu tawh note hong kithei ding hi: Faro a nungta ahih mah bangin na sanggam moi pen uh hih lai-ah hong pai kei leh hih lai mun panin note na paikhia thei nawn kei ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Note’ sungah thuman om hiam, ci-in a kimuh nading, na thugente uh a kitel nadingin note thong sungah na om laitakun note khat kisawl unla, na sanggampa uh hong paipihsak un. Tua ahih kei leh Faro a nungta ahih mah bangin note, thukan na hi taktak uh hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in thong sungah ni thum sung amaute a koih hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Josef in amaute kiangah, “Keimah in Pasian zahtak ka hih manin hih bangin gamta un. Tua hileh na nungta ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Note, thuman mi na hih uhleh thong sungah na sanggamte uh khat omsak lai unla, a dangte pai-in na innkuan uh a gilkialte a dingin an pua unla,"},"20":{"text":"na sanggam moi pen uh kei kiangah hong paipih un. Tua ciangin na kam gente uh kitel ding a, note na si kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute tua bangmahin gamta uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute khatlekhat in, “A taktakin i sanggampa tawh kisai-in eite i mawh hi. Amah in eite kiangah hong thum napi-in eite in a thu i ngaih loh ciangin amah a lungkhamna i mu hi. Tua thu hangin hih bang lungkhamna eite tungah hong tung hi,” kici uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Reuben in amaute dawng a, “Tangvalpa tungah khial kei un, ci-in note tungah hong gen hi lo ka hi hiam? Tua ciangin amaute kiangah hong paikikin amaute hopih hi. Amah in amau’ kiang panin Simeon la-in amau’ muhna-ah amah a hen hi."},"25":{"text":"Amau’ ipte antang tawh dipsakin, a van sung uhah amau’ sum ciat koih kikin, lampi-a a nek ding uh an a piak nading Josef in thu a pia hi. Tua bangmahin amau a dingin kihihsak hi.","title":"Josef’ Sanggamte Kanaan-ah Ciahkik"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a late uh antang suanin a paikhia uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute khat in a giahna panun a la gan-an pia dingin a van a suah le, a van gongah a sum mu hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in a sanggamte kiangah, “Ka sum kikoih kik hi. Hih lai-ah ka van gongah na om!” a ci hi. Hih thu hangin amaute lungsi uh a, lingin amaute khatlekhat ki-en uh a, “Pasian in eite hih bangin hong bawl a bangci thu ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Kanaan gamah a pa uh Jakob kiang a tun uh ciangin, amaute’ tunga thupiang khempeuh gen uh a,"},"30":{"text":"“Mipa, tua gam topa kote’ tungah hong khauh pau-in, tua gam thukanin kote hong ngaihsun hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahih hangin kote in ama kiangah, ‘Kote thuman mi ka hi uh a, kote thukan ka hi kei uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Kote pen ka pa uh’ tapa, sanggam pasal sawm le nih ka hi uh hi. Khat pen om nawn lo a, tu laitakin a moipen Kanaan gamah ka pa uh tawh om hi,’ ka ci uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua gam topa in kote kiangah, ‘Note thuman mi na hihna uh hih tawh ka thei ding hi: Na sanggamte uh khat kei kiangah nusia unla, na innkuan gilkialte a dingin antang la unla, ciahkik un."},"34":{"text":"Na sanggam moi pen uh kei kiangah hong paipih un. Tua hileh note thukan hi loin thuman mi na hihna uh ka thei ding a, note kiangah na sanggampa uh hong khahin, hih gam sungah omin na na sem thei ding uh hi,’ hong ci hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Amau’ vante a suah ciangun, a milipun a sumte uh a van sung ciat uhah na om hi. Amaute le a pa un amaute’ sum kihente a muh uh ciangin, lungkham uh hi."},"36":{"text":"A pa uh Jakob in amaute kiangah, “Ka tate tawh kei nong kikhensak zo uh hi: Josef om nawn lo, Simeon om nawn lo, tu-in note in Benjamin na la ding uh hi. Hihte khempeuh kei’ tungah hong tung khin hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin Reuben in a pa kiangah, “Na kiangah amah kong paipih kik kei leh ka tapa nihte that in. Kei hong ap in, nang kiangah amah kong ciahpih kik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in, “A sanggampa si a, amah bek om ahih manin ka tapa in note hong zuisuk lo ding hi. Note’ pai nading na khualzinna uhah ama tungah siatna tung kha zenzen le, khangham khit nungin dahlua-in ka si ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in gam sungah kialpi hong nasia semsem hi.","title":"Josef’ Sanggamte Benjamin tawh Egypt-ah Paikik"},"2":{"text":"Egypt gam panin a puak uh antang amaute in a gaih khit uh ciangin, a pa un amaute kiangah, “Paikik unla, eite a’ ding an tawmkhat va lei un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Judah in ama kiangah, “Mipa in thupi takin kote hong hilhkhol a, ‘Na sanggampa uh tawh nong ton kei uhleh ka mai na mu kei ding uh hi,’ hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka sanggampa uh hong zuisak lecin kote paisukin nang a’ ding an ka va lei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah nong zuihsak kei leh kote ka paisuk kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mipa in kote kiangah, ‘Na sanggampa uh tawh nong ton kei uhleh ka mai na mu kei ding uh hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel in, “Mipa kiangah sanggam dang khat nei ung, ci-in genin bang hangin kei hong hici bawlsiat na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in dawngin, “Mipa in kote’ thu le ka sanggamte uh thu limtakin hong dong a, ‘Na pa uh a nungta lai hiam? Keimah in nang kiangah amah hong ciahpihkik loin na mai-ah kong koihkik kei leh, tua mawhna kei hong thuaksak tawntung in."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh zekai lo hi lehang tu-in nihvei i tungkik khinta ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pa uh Israel in amaute kiangah, “A tuaci bang ding ahihleh hih bangin gamta un: Gam sunga singgah limci pente pua unla, mipa’ tungah letsongin lingsi tawm, khuaizu tawm, singnai, myrrh paknamtui, pistakhio gah, le almond gahte puak suk un."},"12":{"text":"Na sum uh a zah nih pua un. Na van gong uhah a kikoihkik sumte puakik un, a kikhial hi kha ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na sanggampa uh zong samin ding unla, mipa kiangah paikik un."},"14":{"text":"Amah in na sanggampa uh le Benjamin hong ciahsakkik theihna dingin Vanglian Pasian in mipa’ mai-ah note hehpihna hong pia tahen. Ka tate tawh ka kikhen leh a kikhen ka hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in letsong la-in, sum a zah nih pua-in, Benjamin zong tonpih uh hi. Amaute dingin Egypt-ah paisuk uh a, Josef’ mai-ah a ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Josef in amaute tawh Benjamin a muh ciangin, amah in a innsung nasempa’ kiangah, “Mite inn sungah paipih inla, gan khat go-in bawl in. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite in sun ciangin kei tawh an ne ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Josef’ sawl bangin mipa in sem a, Josef’ inn-ah mite paipih hi."},"18":{"text":"Josef’ inn-ah kipaipih ahih manin lau uh a, amaute in, “Eite sila-in hong bawlin i late a mat theih nading, eite’ tungah thu hong zongin eite hong hih theih nadingin, a masa lai-a i van sunga sum kikoihte’ hangin eite hong kipaipih hi,” a ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Josef’ innsung nasempa’ kiangah amaute paito uh a, inn kongkhakah amah tawh kiho-in,"},"20":{"text":"“Aw, topa aw, an lei dingin khatvei kong pai uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka giahna mun uh ka tun uh ciangin ka vante uh ka hong uh a, ka sumte uh a cingin ka van sung ciat uhah na omkik hi. Ka van sung uhah kua in sum koih ahi hiam ka thei kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in dawng a, “Nuam takin om unla lau kei un. Tua ciangin amah in amaute’ kiangah Simeon paikhiatpih hi."},"24":{"text":"Mipa in Josef’ inn-ah amaute paipihin, amaute tui pia-in, amaute in a khe uh sil khinin, amah in amaute’ late gan-an a piak khit ciangin,"},"25":{"text":"amaute in tua lai-ah Josef tawh an ne ding uh ci-in za uh ahih manin sunin Josef hong pai ciangin a piak ding uh letsong bawlkhol uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Inn-ah Josef hong pai ciangin amau’ puak letsongte innsung ama kiangah paipih uh a, ama mai leilakah kun uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in amau’ omzia dong a, “Na gen uh puteek, na pa uh a dam hiam? Amaute in a lu uh kun uh a, zahtakna a bawl uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah khuadak to a, a nu’ tapa Benjamin mu a, “Hih pa, kei kianga nong gen uh na sanggam moi pen uh ahi hiam? Pasian in nang hong hehpih hen, ka ta!” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin a lungsimah a sanggampa ngai lua ahih manin Josef manlangin paikhia a, a kah nading mun a zong hi. Tua banga nekkhawm ding pen Egypt mite a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama mai-ah amaute a suakmasa a suah hun tawh kizui leh a moipen a khangnona tawh kizui-in tu uh hi. Hih bangin na gamtat manun na khial uh hi,’ va ci in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in amaute a phak ciangin amaute kiangah hih thute a gen hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin ka topa in thu hih bang hong gen na hi hiam? Na nasemte, tua banga gamta ding hi dek peuhmah lo hi."},"8":{"text":"En in, ka van gong uha ka muh uh sumte, Kanaan gam panin nang kiangah kong puak kik uh hi. Tua ahih teh na topa’ inn panin ngun hitaleh kham hitaleh bangci guk ding ka hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Na nasemte’ sung pan tua hai a kimuhna penpen kithat hen; kote zong ka topa’ sila ka hi ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in, “Na cih bang uh hi ta hen: A kimuhna penpen pa ka sila hi ding a, no a dangteng mawh na baang kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin a milipin a van uh leilakah ngasuk uh a, a milipin a van uh suah hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in zong a, a hampen panin kipanin a moipen tawh tawp a, Benjamin’ van sungah a hai kimu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a puan uh balkekin, a late uh a van suan ciatin, khuapi-ah hong kileh kik uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Judah le a sanggamte, Josef’ inn-ah a tun ciangin, amah tua lai mahah na omlai hi. Ama mai leilakah amaute kun uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Josef in amaute kiangah, “Note’ gamtatna a bangci gamtat ahi hiam? Kei bang ahi mi in thu ka theihna thei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Judah in, “Ka topa tungah hong bangci gen ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang thu gen ding ka hi uh hiam? Tua ahih kei leh ko bangci kiphel theih ding ka hi uh hiam? Pasian in na nasemte’ mawhna mukhia hi. En in, kote le hai a kimuhna pa zong, ka topa’ sila ka hi uh hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in, “Tua bangin hi dek lo ding hi. Hai a kimuhna mipa bek ka sila hi ding hi. No a dangte ahihleh, na pa’ kiang uhah nuamtakin ciah un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama kiangah Judah hong paito-in, “Ka topa aw, hong thum ing. Na nasempa, nang tungah kam khat thu hong gensak inla, na nasempa tungah na hehna hong sosak kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen Faro mahmah tawh a kibang na hi hi.","title":"Judah in Benjamin Ngen"},"19":{"text":"Ka topa in a nasemte nong dong a, ‘Pa hitaleh sanggam pasal dang hitaleh na nei uh hiam?’ nong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Kote in ka topa uh kiangah, ‘Kote in a teek pa khat le a teek zawhin a neih sanggam pasal moilai khat ka nei uh hi. Ama sanggampa si a, a nu’ tate sung pan amah bek omlai hi. A pa in amah it mahmah hi,’ kong ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin nangmah in na nasemte kiangah, ‘Ka mit tawh amah ka muh theih nadingin kei kiangah amah hong tonpih suk un,’ nong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Kote in ka topa uh kiangah, ‘Tangvalpa in a pa nusia thei lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pa nusia leh a pa si ding hi,’ kong ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin nangmah in na nasemte kiangah, ‘Note tawh na sanggam uh a moipen hong paisuk khop kei leh ka mai nong mu nawn kei ding uh hi,’ nong ci hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin na nasem ka pa uh kiangah ka ciahkik uh ciangin ka topa’ thugente ama kiangah ka gen uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka pa un, ‘Paikikin eite a’ ding an tawm va lei un,’ hong cih ciangin"},"26":{"text":"kote in, ‘Ka paisuk kei ding uh hi. Ka sanggam moipen uh ko tawh hong paikhawm leh ka paisuk bek ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sanggam moipen uh ko tawh hong pai kei leh mipa’ mai ka mu kei ding uh hi,’ ka ci uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin na nasem ka pa un kote kiangah, ‘Ka zi in kei tawh tapa nih a neih na thei uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Khat in kei hong nusia khin a, amah kibalzan khin taktak hi, ka ci hi. Tua hun a kipan amah ka mu nawn kei hi."},"29":{"text":"Hih a khat zong kei kiang panin na lak uh a, ama tungah siatna a tun leh, dahna tawh ka sam kangte Leinuai-ah na paipih suk ding uh hi,’ hong ci hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, na nasem ka pa uh kiangah ka ciah uh ciangin, tangvalpa kote tawh hong ciah kei leh, ama lungsim khempeuh tangvalpa’ tungah om ahih manin,"},"31":{"text":"kote tawh tangvalpa a ciah lohna a muh ciangin amah si ding hi. Na nasemte in na nasem ka pa uh’ sam kangte dahna tawh Leinuai-ah ka paipih ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasem keimah pen tangvalpa a dingin ka pa’ tungah a kikham ka hi a, ‘Nang kiangah amah kong ciahpih kik kei leh tua mawhsakna nangma muhna-ah ka nuntak tawntungin ka thuak ding hi,’ ka ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kong thum hi. Ka topa’ sila dingin tangvalpa’ tangin na nasempa hong omsak inla, a sanggamte tawh tangvalpa ciahkiksak in."},"34":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tangvalpa kei tawh hong ton kei leh ka pa kiangah bangci ciahkik thei ding ka hi hiam? Ka pa’ tungah a tung ding siatna ka thuakzo kei ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama kianga dingte khempeuh’ mai-ah Josef ki-ipzo nawn lo a, “Ka kiang panin mi khempeuh paikhia un,” ci-in a kiko hi. Tua ahih manin Josef a sanggamte tungah amah a kipulak ciangin kuamah dang om lo hi.","title":"A Sanggamte tungah Josef Kilaak Tawm","ref":"Sawl 7:13"},"2":{"text":"Amah a gingin kapkhia ahih manin Egypt mite in za a, Faro’ innkuante in zong za uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Josef in a sanggamte kiangah, “Kei, Josef ka hi hi. I pa a nungta lai hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a sanggamte maizum uh ahih manin amah dawng thei lo uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Josef in a sanggamte kiangah, “Ka nai-ah hong pai un, hong thum ing,” a ci hi. Amaute a nai-ah hong pai uh hi. Amah in, “Kei pen Egypt-ah nong zuak uh na sanggampa uh Josef ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih lai-ah kei nong zuak manun tu-in lungkham kei un. Nomau tungah kiheh tawm kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh nuntakna a hu dingin note’ mai-ah Pasian in kei hong sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh gam sungah kum nih sung kialpi tungzo hi. Lo khawh loh, an lak loh ding kum nga omlai hi."},"7":{"text":"Note a dingin leitungah a omlai mi a hingsak ding le note a dingin a suakta mi tampi a kem dingin note’ mai-ah Pasian in kei hong sawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hih lai-ah a hong sawl mi pen note na hi kei uh a, Pasian ahi hi. Amah in Faro’ khutnuai-ah a ulian penin kei hong bawlin, ama innsung khempeuh’ topa le Egypt gam khempeuh a ukpa-in kei hong bawlkhin hi."},"9":{"text":"“Manlangin i pa kiangah va ciahto unla ama kiangah, ‘Na tapa Josef in hih bangin ci hi: Pasian in Egypt gam khempeuh’ topa-in kei hong bawl khin hi. Ka kiangah hong paisuk hen, zekai kei hen."},"10":{"text":"Goshen leitangah na teng ding a, nang le na tate’ tate le na tuuhonte le na bawnghonte le na neih khempeuh tawh, nang pen kei tawh a kinai-in na om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hong tung ding kialpi kum nga omlai ahih manin tua lai-ah nang kong vak ding hi. Tua hi kei le nang le na innkuanpihte le na neih khempeuh in zawnna na ngah ding uh hi, ci hi,’ va ci un.","ref":"Sawl 7:14"},"12":{"text":"“Note’ kianga thu hong gen pen keima kam ahihna tu-in note’ mitin nong mu uh a, ka sanggampa Benjamin’ mit in zong hong mu hi."},"13":{"text":"Egypt-ah keima liatna khempeuh le note’ muhsa khempeuh, i pa’ kiangah na gen ding uh hi. Manlang unla, hih lai-ah i pa hong paisukpih un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sanggampa Benjamin ngawng kawi-in a kap hi. Benjamin in zong amah ngawng kawi-in a kap hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kah kawmin a sanggamte khempeuh ngawng kawi-in a nam hi. Tua khit ciangin a sanggamte in amah hopih uh hi."},"16":{"text":"“Josef’ sanggamte hong pai,” cihna thu Faro’ inn sungah a kizak ciangin, tua thu in Faro le a nasemte lungdamsak mahmah hi."},"17":{"text":"Faro in Josef kiangah, “Na sanggamte kiangah, ‘Hih bangin gamta un: Na ganhingte uh van suan unla, Kanaan gamah ciahkik un."},"18":{"text":"I pa le na innkuanpihte uh va la unla, kei kiangah hong pai un. Egypt gam a hoihpen mun note kong pia ding a, note in gam hoih sunga piangte na ne ding uh hi,’ ci in."},"19":{"text":"Amaute zong thu pia inla, ‘Hih bangin gamta un: Na tate le na zite uh a dingin Egypt panin leeng la unla, i pa hong paipih un."},"20":{"text":"Egypt gam khempeuh a hoih penna nomau-a’ ahih ciangin na vante uh ngaihsutin nei kei un,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel’ tapate tua bangmahin gamta uh hi. Josef in Faro’ thupiak mah bangin amaute leeng pia a, lampi-a a nek ding uh an zong a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in amaute khempeuh tungah puan hoih silh khat ciat a pia hi. Ahih hangin Benjamin’ tungah ngun shekel zathum le puan hoih silh nga a pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in a pa kiangah a nuai-ate a khak hi: Egypt na hoihte a pua la sawm; antang, anlum, le lampi-a a pa’ nek ding an a pua lapi sawm a puak hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a sanggamte sawlkhia a, amaute a paikhiat ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Lampi-ah kitawng kei un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute Egypt panin paito uh a, a pa uh Jakob kiang Kanaan gamah ciah uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute in ama kiangah, “Josef nungta lai a, amah pen Egypt gam khempeuh a ukpa na hi hi,” hong ci uh hi. Amah in amaute’ thugen um lo ahih ciangin a lung si hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute’ tunga Josef’ gen kammalte ama kiangah a gen ciang leh Josef in amah puak nadinga a khak leengte a muh ciangin, a pa uh Jakob’ lungsim hingkik hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel in, “Phazo hi. Ka tapa Josef nungta lai hi. Ka sih ma-in pai-in amah ka mu ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel, a neih khempeuh tawh a khualzin kipanin Beersheba tung a, a pa Isaac’ Pasian tungah biakpiakna a bawl hi.","title":"Egypt-ah Jakob le A Innkuante Pai"},"2":{"text":"Pasian in Israel tungah zanin thu gen a, “Jakob, Jakob,” ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah om ing,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Kei pen na pa’ Pasian ahi, Pasian ka hi hi. Egypt-ah paisuk ding lau kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh minam lian khatin tua lai-ah nang kong bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Egypt-ah nang tawh kong paisuk ding a, tua ciangin zong keimah in nang kong paipihto kik ding hi. Josef’ khut sungah na si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Beersheba panin Jakob ding khia hi. Israel’ tapate in a pa uh Jakob, a tate uh, le a zite uh, amah puak nadinga Faro in a khak leeng sungah a pua uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in zong Kanaan gam sunga a lam uh a ganhingte uh le a nate uh la-in, Jakob le ama suanlekhakte ahi,","ref":"Sawl 7:15"},"7":{"text":"a tapate, ama tapate’ tapate, a tanute, a tapate’ tanute tawh Egypt-ah a pai uh hi. Amah in a suanlekhakte khempeuh Egypt-ah a paipih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in hihte pen Israel’ suanlekhak, Egypt-ah a pai Jakob le a tate’ min ahi hi. Jakob’ ta u pen Reuben"},"9":{"text":"le Reuben’ tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, le Karmi ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Simeon’ tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar, le Kanaan numei’ tapa Shaul ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Levi’ tapate: Gershon, Kohath, le Merari ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah’ tapate: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, le Zerah ahi hi. (Ahih hangin Er le Onan Kanaan gamah si hi.) Perez’ tapate: Hezron le Hamul ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Issakhar’ tapate: Tola, Puvah, Job, le Shimron ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Zebulun’ tapate: Sered, Elon, le Jahleel ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"(Hihte pen Paddanaram-ah Leah tawh a neih Jakob’ suante hi a, a tanu Dinah tawh zong ahi hi. Numei le pasal a vekpi-in sawmthum le thum ahi hi.)"},"16":{"text":"Gad’ tapate: Zifion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, le Areli ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Asher’ tapate: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, le a sanggamnu uh Serah ahi hi. Beriah’ tapate: Heber le Malkhiel ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"(Hihte pen Laban in a tanu Leah tungah a piak Zilpah’ tapate ahi hi. Amah in Jakob tawh hihte nei a, mi sawm le guk ahi hi.)"},"19":{"text":"Jakob’ zi Rachel’ tapate: Josef le Benjamin ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Josef in Egypt gamah On khua siampipa Potifera’ tanu Asenath tawh Manasseh le Efraim nei hi.","ref":"Pian 41:50-52"},"21":{"text":"Benjamin’ tapate: Bela, Bekher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, le Ard ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"(Hihte pen Rachel tawh a neih Jakob’ suante hi a, a vekpi-in mi sawm le li ahi hi.)"},"23":{"text":"Dan’ tapa Hushim ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Naftali’ tapate: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, le Shillem ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"(Hihte pen Laban in a tanu Rachel’ tungah a piak Bilhah in Jakob tawh a neih tapate hi a, a vekpi-in mi sagih ahi hi.)"},"26":{"text":"Egypt gamah a pai Jakob-a’ ahi ama suanlekhak, Jakob’ tate’ zite a kisim loin, a vekpi-in mi sawmguk le guk ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Josef in Egypt gamah a neih a tapate nih ahi hi. Egypt gamah a pai Jakob’ innkuan khempeuh sawmsagih ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:14"},"28":{"text":"Jakob in ama mai Goshen-ah amah lam a lak dingin Josef kiangah Judah ma sawl hi. Amaute Goshen gamah hong pai uh hi.","title":"Jakob le A Innkuante Egypt-ah"},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef in a leengte kithawisakin Goshen-ah a pa Israel a dawn dingin a paito hi. A pa a muh phetin ngawng kawi-in tawlkhat sung a kap hi."},"30":{"text":"Israel in Josef kiangah, “Na maitang mu khinin nang na nuntak lai thei ka hih manin tu-in ka si zongin phamawh nawn lo hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Josef in a sanggamte le a pa’ innkuanpihte kiangah, “Kei paito-in Faro’ kiangah ka va gen ding a, ama tungah, ‘Kanaan gam a om ka sanggamte le ka pa’ innkuanpihte kei kiangah hong pai hi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute pen tuucing ahih manin gan kemte ahi uh hi. Amaute in a tuuhonte uh le a bawnghonte uh le a neih khempeuh uh hong paipih uh hi,’ ka va ci ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Faro in note hong samin note kiangah, ‘Na nasep uh bang ahi hiam?’ hong cih ciangin,"},"34":{"text":"Goshen leitangah na ten theih nadingun note in, ‘Kote hitaleh ka pate uh hitaleh ko na nasemte pen ka neu lai uh a kipan tuhun dongin gankemte ka hi uh hi,’ na ci ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite a dingin tuucing peuhmah a kihhuai ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Josef pai-in Faro’ kiangah, “Ka pa le ka sanggamte a tuuhon uh le a bawnghon uh le a neih khempeuh uh tawh Kanaan gam panin hong pai uh a, amaute tu-in Goshen gamah om uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"2":{"text":"A sanggamte’ lak panin amah in mi nga la-in Faro’ kiangah va paipih hi."},"3":{"text":"Faro in a sanggamte kiangah, “Na nasep uh bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in Faro’ kiangah, “Ka pate uh mah bangin na nasem kote pen gankemte ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in Faro kiangah, “Hih gamah tawlkhat a om dingin kong pai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Kanaan gamah kialpi nasia lua ahih manin tua lai-ah na nasemte’ tuuhonte a’ ding lonona om nawn lo hi. Tu-in kong thum uh hi. Goshen gamah na nasemte hong tengsak in,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in Josef kiangah, “Na pa le na sanggamte na kiangah hong tung khin hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt leitang khempeuh nangma thu ahi hi. Na pa le na sanggamte lei hoihna penah tengsak in. Goshen leitangah amaute tengsak in. Amaute’ lakah a hih thei mi na muh leh ka ganhingte a kem dingin koih in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef in a pa Jakob tumpihin Faro’ mai-ah koih a, Jakob in Faro thupha a pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Faro in Jakob kiangah, “Na nuntak kum bangzah pha ta ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jakob in Faro kiangah, “Tawlkhat sung ka nuntak hun pen kum za le kum sawmthum ahi hi. Ka nuntak hun tom sungah siatna bekbek om a, ka pate tawlkhat a omsung uh a nuntak hunte ban nai lo hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jakob in Faro thupha pia-in tua lai panin a paikhia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro’ thupiaksa bangin Josef in leitang a hoihpen, Rameses leitang, Egypt gam sungah neihsa pia-in a pa le a sanggamte a tengsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Josef in a pa, a sanggamte, le a pa’ innkuante khempeuh a ne ding zah tawh kizui-in an a pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in kialpi nasia mahmah ahih manin gam khempeuhah an om nawn lo a, kialpi hangin Egypt mite le Kanaan mite vulgawp uh hi.","title":"Kialpi Sunga Josef’ Vaihawmna"},"14":{"text":"Amaute in antang a leina hangin, Egypt gam sung le Kanaan gam sunga sum khempeuh Josef in ngah khin hi. Josef in Faro’ inn-ah tua sumte paipih hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gam sung le Kanaan gam sunga sum a bei khit ciangin Egypt mite khempeuh Josef kiangah hong pai-in, “Kote an hong pia in. Bang hangin na muhna-ah si ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sum uh beita hi,” a ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Josef in dawngin, “Na ganhingte uh hong pia un. Na sum uh bei ahihleh na ganhingte uh khekna-in an kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Josef kiangah a ganhingte uh paipih uh hi. Josef in sakolte, tuuhonte, bawnghonte, le late a khekna-in amaute an a pia hi. A ganhingte uh khekna-in Josef in tua kum sung amaute an a pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua kum a bei, a kum kik ciangin amaute Josef kiangah hong pai-in, “Ka sum uh a bei khitna ka topa uh tungah kong im kei ding uh hi. Ganhing honte ka topa a’ ahi hi. Ka pumpi uh le ka leitang uh cih simloh ka topa’ muhna-ah bangmah dang om nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hangin kote si-in ka leitang uh nangma muhna-ah maimawk ding ahi hiam? Kote le ka leitang uh an tawh hong lei in. Kote, Faro’ sila ka hi ding uh a, ka leitang uh zong ama a’ hi ding hi. Leitang mawkval loin, kote si loin ka hin theih nadingun khaici hong pia in,” a ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Josef in Egypt gam khempeuh Faro a dingin a lei hi. Kialpi nasia lua ahih manin Egypt mi khempeuh in a lote uh a zuak uh hi. Leitang khempeuh Faro-a’ suak khin hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte ahihleh, Egypt mongkhat panin a mongkhat dongin amah in sila-in bawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Siampite’ leitang bek amah in lei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh siampite in Faro’ tung panin a kiciangtan zah an ngah uh a, amaute tungah Faro in a piak tawh amaute nungtazo uh ahih ciangin amaute in a leitang uh zuak lo uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef in mite kiangah, “En un, tuni-in note le na leitang uh Faro a dingin kong lei hi. Tu-in hih lai-ah no a dingin khaici om a, note in leitang tungah na vawh ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Anlak ciangin Faro’ tungah nga-ah khat na pia ding uh a, nga-ah li pen lo-ah khaici ding, note le na innkuanpihte uh le na tate uh’ an dingin na tang ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in, “Nang in ka nuntakna uh nong honkhia khinzo hi. Ka topa uh lungdam hen; kote pen Faro’ sila ka hi ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro in nga-ah khat nei ding hi cihna, tuni donga a om, Egypt leitang tawh kisai-in Josef in ngeina kip khatin a bawl hi. Siampite’ leitang bek Faro-a’ suak lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Egypt gam sung Goshen leitangah Israel-te teng uh hi. Tua lai-ah amaute in neihsa ngah uh a, pungin tampi tak pha uh hi.","title":"Jakob in a Tawpkhakna-ah A Deih"},"28":{"text":"Egypt gamah Jakob kum sawm le sagih nungta lai ahih manin ama khan kum za le kum sawmli le sagih ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel a sih ding hun a nai ciangin, amah in a tapa Josef samin ama kiangah, “Tu-in na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah leh, ka phei nuai-ah na khut hong koih inla, thumantak le citakin kei nong bawl ding thu hong ciam in. Egypt-ah kei hong vui kei inla,"},"30":{"text":"ka pate tawh hong sial khawm in. Egypt panin kei hong puakhia in la, amau’ kivuina munah kei hong vui in,” a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, “Na gen bangin ka gamta ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 49:29-32; 50:6"},"31":{"text":"Amah in, “Kei’ tungah hong kiciam in,” a ci hi. Amah zong a pa’ tungah a kiciam hi. Tua ciangin Israel lungdamin a lupna lukhungah amahmah a kunsuk hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawh a sawt loin, “Na pa a ci na hi,” ci-in Josef kiangah kigen ahih ciangin amah in a tapa nihte Manasseh le Efraim a paipih hi.","title":"Jakob in Efraim le Manasseh Thupha Pia"},"2":{"text":"Jakob kiangah, “Na tapa Josef na kiangah hong pai hi,” ci-in kigen hi. Tua ciangin kei kong ciahkik ding hi, ci hi, va cihsak un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 47:29-31"},"6":{"text":"Faro in dawngin, “Paito inla, nang hong kiciamsak bangin na pa va vui in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a pa a vui dingin Josef paito hi. Tua mun pen Jordan gun galkhat ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute a thupiak bangin ama tapate in ama a dingin bawlsak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ama tapate in Kanaan gamah amah pua-in, kivui nading mun a neih dingin Abraham in Hit mi Efron’ tung panin a lo tawh a leikhop, Mamre nisuahna lamah a om, Makpelah mun lo sunga leihawm sungah a vui uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:16"},"14":{"text":"Josef in a pa a vui khit ciangin, a sanggamte le a pa a vui dingin amah a zui khempeuhte tawh Egypt-ah a ciahkik hi."},"15":{"text":"Josef’ sanggamte in a pa uh a sih khit ciangin, “Josef in eite hong mudahin ama tunga siatna i bawl khempeuh hong thukkik kha ding hi,” ci uh hi.","title":"Josef in A Sanggamte tungah Kip gen pha kik"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Josef kiangah thu puak uh a, “I pa in a sih ma-in thu hong pia a,"},"17":{"text":"‘Josef kiangah hih bangin ci un: Na sanggamte’ thupalsatna le a khialhna na maisak in, kong thum hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang’ tungah amaute in siatna hong bawl uh hi,’ ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang’ tungah kong thum uh hi. I pa’ Pasian’ nasemte’ thupalsatna hong maisak in,” a ci uh hi. Amaute in ama kiangah tua bangin thu a gen ciangun Josef a kap hi."},"18":{"text":"A sanggamte zong pai-in ama mai-ah puk uh a, “En in, kote, nangma nasemte ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin Josef in amaute kiangah, “Lau kei un. Ahih hangin Pasian in tuhuna mah bangin mi tampite a nuntak theihna a pian nadingin a hoih dingin a ngaihsut ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin lau kei un. Amah in tua bangin kip gen pha kikin amaute a hehnem hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Josef, amah le a pa’ innkuante tawh Egypt-ah teng uh a, Josef kum za le kum sawm nungta hi.","title":"Josef’ Sihna"},"23":{"text":"Josef in khang thumna ahi Efraim’ tate mu hi. Manasseh’ tapa Makhir’ tate zong Josef’ innsung mahah suak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Josef in a sanggamte kiangah, “Kei a si ding ka hi ta hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in note hong kem ding a, hih leitang panin amah in Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tunga a ciamsa leitangah note hong paikhiatpih to ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef in Israel tapate’ kiciamna bawlin, “Pasian in note hong kem ding a, note in hih lai panin ka guhte na pua to ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 13:19; Josh 24:32; Heb 11:12"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kum za le kum sawm a pha-in Josef a si hi. Amaute in a muat loh nadingin zatui tawh amah bawl uh a, Egypt-ah hankuang sung khatah amah kikoih hi."}}}}},"2":{"info":{"name":"Paikhiatna","shortname":"Pai","abbr":[],"desc":"Paikhiatna cih kammal pen gam khat pan gamdang khat a zuan dingin “pai khia” cihna hi a, hih laibu sungah a kigelh thute pen Israel mite' tangthu sungah a thupi mahmah, sila ahihna uh Egypt gam panin Israel mite a paikhiatna thu ahi hi. Hih laibu sunga om thu khen lian thum pha hi. 1. Hebru mite sal pan a suahtakna leh Sinai Mual ciang a lam paina uh. 2. Pasian in Sinai Mual-ah a mite tawh a thuciamna — amaute' zuih dingin gamtat hoihna ding, gam sung ki-ukna ding, leh biakna ngeinate a piakna. 3. Israel mite in Pasian a biakna ding inn leh a sung nazat dingte leh siampite tawh kisai ngeina leh Pasian biakna ding ngeina thute. Hih a tunga thute banah, Pasian in sal a suak ama mite honkhia-in, mai lamah lametna a nei minamin a bawlna thute kigen hi. Hih laibu sungah a mi thupi pen Moses hi a, Egypt gam panin ama mite a paikhatpih dingin Pasian in a teelpa ahi hi. Hih laibu sungah a kithei kim pen thu in a lian sawmnih sungah a kigelh Thupiak Sawmte ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob tawh Egypt-ah a hong pai, amau’ innkuan ciat tawh ahi Israel’ tapate’ minte:","title":"Egypt-ah Israel-te’ Thuakna"},"2":{"text":"Reuben, Simeon, Levi, le Judah,"},"3":{"text":"Issakhar, Zebulun, le Benjamin,"},"4":{"text":"Dan le Naftali, Gad le Asher ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 46:8-27"},"5":{"text":"Jakob’ suanlekhakte khempeuh mi sawmsagih hi a, Josef pen Egypt-ah na om khinzo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef le a sanggamte le tua khangmi khempeuh si uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin Israel’ suanlekhakte pungin nakpitakin khang uh hi. Eite tungah gal hong om leh amaute in i galte pawlin eite hong do-in hih gam panin taikhia kha ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin nasepna tawh amaute a gimsak dingin amaute tungah nasem ukte koih uh hi. Egypt mite in Israel mite kihta uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Israel mite a gim mahmahin na semsak uh a,"},"14":{"text":"buan le leiseek tawh nasepna le lo sungah nasep namkim khempeuh tawh amau’ nuntakna haksasak uh hi. Israel mite’ sepna khempeuhah amaute in a gim mahmahin semsak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Egypt kumpipa in Hebru mi nau a domsakte, khat’ min Shifrah, adang khat’ min Puah a kicite kiangah,"},"16":{"text":"“Hebru numeite nau domin, nausuahna tutphah tungah a tut ciangun, tapa ahihleh a naungek na that ding uh a, ahi zongin tanu ahih leh na nungtasak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin naudomte in Pasian zahtak uh hi. Egypt kumpipa in amaute a thupiak bangin gamta lo uh a, nau pasalte nungtasak uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Egypt kumpipa in naudomte samin amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin hih bangin gamta a, nau pasalte nungtasak na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Naudomte in Faro’ kiangah, “Hebru numeite le Egypt numeite a kibatlohna hang ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute thadim uh a, amau’ kiangah naudomte a tun ma-in amaute na suak khin pahpah uh hi,” na ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in naudomte limbawl hi. Mite khangin pawlcing semsem uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Naudomte in Pasian zahtak uh ahih manin amah in amaute tungah suanlekhak a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in a mipihte khempeuh thu pia a, “Hebru mite sung panin tapa a suak khempeuh Nail gun sungah na khia ding uh a, ahi zongin tanu khempeuh na nungtasak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:19"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Levi’ suante khat in Levi numei khat mah zi-in la hi.","title":"Moses’ Suahna"},"2":{"text":"Tua numei gai-in tapa khat nei a, nau hoih khat hi, ci-in a muh ciangin, kha thum sung a seel hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:20; Heb 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Amah in naungek a seel zawh nawn loh ciangin ama a dingin pumpeeng tawh kibawl lawh khat phansak a, tua lawh pen buan le kultal tui tawh a zut hi. Tua sungah naungek sialin gun gei-a phaikungte lakah a koih hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah bang a kicih hiam cih a thei dingin a gamla panin mun khatah a sanggamnu a ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Faro’ tanu a kisil dingin gun-ah hong pai a, a nasem numeite gun gei-ah a vak lai takun amah in phaikungte lakah a lawh mu a, tua lawh a la dingin a nasem numei khat a sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in a hon ciangin naungek mu hi. Naungek kap ahih manin tua nu in hehpihhuai sa a, “Hih naungek, Hebru mite’ ta khat ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sanggamnu in Faro tanu kiangah, “Keimah pai-in Hebru numeite lak panin nang a dingin naupang hong khoisak dingin naucing khat ka va sapsak ding hiam?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Faro’ tanu in ama kiangah, “Va pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin numeino pai-in naupang’ nu va sam hi."},"9":{"text":"Faro’ tanu in ama kiangah, “Hih naupang la inla, kei a dingin hong khoisak in; na thaman kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin nupi in naupang la-in a khoi hi."},"10":{"text":"Naupang khang a, amah in Faro tanu’ kiangah paipih a, amah pen tua nu’ tapa a suak hi. Amah in a min Moses a phuak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “Tui sung panin amah ka kai khia hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:21"},"11":{"text":"Ni khat, Moses a khan khit ciangin, ama mipihte kiangah pai-in amau’ gimnate va mu hi. Amah in a gamta khial mipa kiangah, “Bang hangin na lawm sat na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in dawngin, “Kote’ tungah ulian ding le thukhen dingin kua in nang hong koih ahi hiam? Na sanggampa Aaron pen na kamsangpa hi ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Nang kong thupiak khempeuh na gen ding hi. Ama leitang panin Israel mite a paikhiatsak nadingin Faro’ tungah na sanggampa Aaron in gen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in Faro’ lungsim ka khauhsak ding a, Egypt gamah ka limte le ka na lamdangte tampi ka bawl khit hangin","ref":"Sawl 7:36"},"4":{"text":"Faro in nang’ thu hong ngai lo ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah in Egypt tungah gimna ka tungsak ding a, thukhen nasepna lianpite tawh Egypt gam panin Israel mi ahi ka mihonte ka paikhiatpih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keimah in Egypt tungah gimna tungsakin amaute’ lak panin Israel mite ka paikhiatpih ciangin Egypt mite in Topa ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses le Aaron zong Topa’ sawl bangmahin gamta uh a, Topa in amaute a thupiak bangin amaute in sem uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in amaute in Faro’ tungah thu a gen laitakun Moses kum sawmgiat pha a, Aaron kum sawmgiat le thum a pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron’ kiangah,","title":"Aaron’ Ciangkhut"},"9":{"text":"“Faro in note kiangah, ‘Note a thutak na hihna uh nalamdang khat tawh hong lak un,’ hong cih ciangin nangmah in Aaron kiangah, ‘Gulpi khat a suah theih nadingin na ciangkhut la inla, Faro’ mai-ah khia suk in,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ kiangah Moses le Aaron pai-in Topa’ thupiak bangin gamta uh hi. Aaron in Faro le a uliante’ mai-ah a ciangkhut lawn suk a, gulpi khat a suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in a mipilte le a aisan siamte a sam hi. Egypt mitphial siamte in zong amau’ siamna tawh tua bang teek mahin a bawl thei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a milip in a ciangkhut uh khia suk ciat uh a, tuate gulpi vive a suak hi. Ahih hangin Aaron’ ciangkhut in amau’ ciangkhutte a valhtum hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ gensa bangin Faro’ lungsim khauh lai a, amah in amaute’ thu ngai lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Faro’ lungsim khauh mahmah a, amah in mite paisak nuam lo hi.","title":"Sisan Gimna"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih manin zingsangin Nail gun-ah a pai ciangin amah tawh a kimu dingin nang zong pai in. Gulpi a suak na ciangkhut pen mah tawi in la, gun gei-ah amah ngak in."},"16":{"text":"Amah tawh na kimuh ciangin ama kiangah, ‘Sehnel gam sungah ama mite in amah a biak theih nadingin a mite na paisak nading a gen dingin Hebru-te’ Pasian, Topa in nang’ kiangah kei hong sawl khin hi. Ahi zongin tu ciang dong ama thu na mang kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa in, “Keima sep ding thute a muh ciangin kei kua ka hi hiam cih hong thei ding hi,” ci hi. En in, hih ka ciangkhut tawh gun tui ka sat ding a, tuite, sisan hong suak ding hi.","ref":"Mang 16:4"},"18":{"text":"Ngasate si ding a, gun tui uihgawp ding ahih manin Egypt mite in dawn thei lo ding uh hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Aaron kiangah hih bangin gen in: ‘Na ciangkhut la inla, sisan a suah theih nadingin Egypt tuite, amau’ gunte, amau’ luite, amau’ bualte’ tung le amau’ tuili khempeuhte’ tungah na khut zan in. Egypt gam sunga sing beel le suang beel khempeuh sung nangawnah sisan om ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in Topa’ thupiak bangin hih uh hi. Faro le ama uliante’ muhin amah in ciangkhut vik to-in Nail gun sunga om tui sat a, Nail gun sunga om tui khempeuh sisan a suak hi."},"21":{"text":"Nail gun sunga ngasate si hi. Nail gun uih a, Egypt mite in Nail gun pana tui dawn thei lo uh hi. Egypt gam sung khempeuhah sisan om hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin Egypt mitphial siamte in amau’ siamna tawh tua bangmah bawl thei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ lungsim a khauh ngei mahin khauh a, Topa’ gensa bangin amah in amaute’ thu ngai lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Faro kihei-in a inn sungah pai a, amah in a lungsim nangawnah tua thu ngaihsutin nei nawn lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute in Nail gun tui dawn thei lo uh ahih manin Egypt mite khempeuh in Nail gun kiim tengah tui dawn ding a to uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in gun a sat zawh ni sagih pha ta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses tungah, “Faro’ kiangah pai-in ama tungah, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingin ka mite paisak in.","title":"Uiphuk Gimna"},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute na paisak kei leh, en in, na gam khempeuh uiphukte tawh ka gimsak ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nail gun pen uiphukte tawh kidim ding a, tuate pen na innsung, na lupna inndei sung, na lupna tung, na nasemte le na mipihte’ innsung, na meikhukte le na annel mekna kuang sung uhah hong pai ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Uiphukte, nang’ tung le na nasemte khempeuh tungah hong pai ding hi,” ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Aaron kiangah hih bangin gen in: ‘Gunte, luite, le tuilite tungah na ciangkhut zan inla, Egypt leitang tungah uiphukte paisak in,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Aaron in Egypt tuite tungah a khut zan a, uiphukte hong pai-in Egypt leitang a tuam hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin mitphial siamte in amau’ siamna tawh tua bangmah bawl thei uh a, Egypt leitang tungah uiphukte omsak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in Moses le Aaron samin, “Kei le ka mite’ kiang panin uiphukte a lakkhiat nadingin Topa’ tungah thum in. Topa’ tungah biakna a pia dingin mite ka paisak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Faro’ kiangah, “Nail gun sung cih simloh, nangma kiang le na innte panin uiphukte a bei nadingin nang le na nasemte le na mite a dingin ka thum theih nadingin a hun khat seh in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in, “Zing ciang,” ci hi. Moses in, “ Topa ahi kote’ Pasian tawh a kibang kuamah om lo hi, ci-in na theih nadingin nangma cih bang hi tahen."},"11":{"text":"Nang le na innte le na nasemte le na mite’ kiang panin uiphukte paikhia ding uh a, Nail gun sung bekah omlai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ kiang panin Moses le Aaron a paikhia uh hi. Faro’ tungah a tunsak uiphukte a beisak nadingin Topa’ tungah Moses in thu a ngen hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Moses’ nget bangin hih a, innte le huang sung le lote panin uiphukte a si hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in a lomlomin tuate khawm uh a, gam sung teng uih hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin nopna a omkik lam Faro in a muh ciangin, amah in a lungsim khauhsak a, Topa’ gensa bangin amau’ thu ngai lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses tungah, “Aaron’ kiangah hih bangin gen in: ‘Egypt gam sung khempeuhah thokang a om nadingin na ciangkhut zanin leivui sat in,’ ci in,” a ci hi.","title":"Thokang Gimna"},"17":{"text":"Amaute in tua bangmahin hih uh hi. Aaron in a ciangkhut tawh leivui sat a, mihing tung le ganhing tungah thokang hong om hi. Egypt gam sung khempeuhah leivui teng thokang suak hi."},"18":{"text":"Mitphial siamte in amau’ siamna tawh thokang piansak ding sin uh a, ahih hangin amaute in hih thei lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mihing le ganhing tungah thokangte om hi."},"19":{"text":"Mitphial siamte in Faro’ kiangah, “Hih pen Pasian’ nasepna ahi hi,” ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Faro’ lungsim khauh a, Topa’ gensa bangin amah in amaute’ thu ngai lo hi.","ref":"Luk 11:20"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Zingsangin tho baihin gun-ah Faro hong pai ding ngakin ama kiangah, ‘ Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak in.","title":"Tho Gimna"},"21":{"text":"Tua bang hi loin, ka mite na paisak kei leh, en in, nang le na nasemte le na mite’ tung le na innte sungah tho honpite kong sawl ding hi. Egypt mite’ innte le tuate’ dinna leitang zong tho honpite tawh kidim ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua ni ciangin kei pen hih leitang tungah Topa ka hihna na theih nadingin tho honpite a om loh nadingin ka mite a tenna Goshen leitang keimah in ka tuam koih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin keima mite le nangma mite a kilamdanna khat ka bawl ding hi. Zing ciangin hih lim hong om ding hi,” ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in tua bangmahin hih ahih manin Faro’ innsung le ama nasemte’ inn sungah tho honpi hong pai a, thote’ hangin Egypt gam sung khempeuh leitang kisia hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in Moses le Aaron sam a, “Pai un; hih gam sungah na Pasian tung uhah biakna pia un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahih hangin Moses in, “Tua bangin hih ding kituak lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite a dingin a deihhuai lo biaknate kote in Topa ka Pasian uh tungah ka pia ding uh hi. Egypt mite a dingin a deihhuai lo biaknate amau’ muhna-ah pia le ung, amaute in suang tawh kote hong deng ding uh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"Kote, ni thum paina sehnel gamah pai-in ama hong thupiak ding bangin Topa ka Pasian uh tungah biakna ka va pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro in, “Sehnel gamah Topa na Pasian uh tungah biakna a pia dingin note kong paisak ding hi. Ahi zongin gamlapi-ah na pai kei ding uh hi. Kei a dingin zong hong thumsak un,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in, “En in, nang kiang panin kei paikhia-in Faro’ kiang pan, a nasemte’ kiang pan, le a mite’ kiang panin tho honpite zing ciangin a paikhiat theih nadingin Topa’ tungah thu ka ngen ding hi. Ahi zongin Topa’ tungah biakna a pia dingin mite paisak lohna tawh Faro hong zuautat kik nawn kei in,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ kiang panin Moses paikhia-in Topa’ tungah thu a ngen hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa in Moses’ nget bangin pia a, Faro’ kiang, a nasemte’ kiang, le a mite’ kiang panin tho honpite lakhia a, khat zong om nawn lo hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin Faro in hih hunin zong a lungsim khauhsak lai a, mite paisak lo hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses tungah, “Faro’ kiangah pai-in ama kiangah, ‘ Topa, Hebru-te’ Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: “Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingin ka mite paisak in.","title":"Ganhing Sihna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in amaute paisak ding nialin amaute na let lai leh,"},"3":{"text":"lo sunga om ganhing, sakolte, late, kalaohte, bawnghonte, le tuuhonte tungah a nasia mahmah gimna ka tungsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel mite a’ khempeuh khat beek a sih loh nadingin Israel-te’ ganhingte le Egypt-te’ ganhingte’ kikalah Topa in a kilamdanna khat ka bawl ding hi,” ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in a hun khat seh a, “Zing ciangin Topa in hih gam sungah hih na hong sem ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A zing ciangin Topa in hih na sem hi. Egypt mite’ ganhing khempeuh si a, ahih hangin Israel mite’ ganhing khat zong si lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Faro in a en dingin mi sawl a, Israel-te’ ganhing khat zong na si lo hi. Ahih hangin Faro’ lungsim khauh lai a, amah in mite paisak lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron’ kiangah, “Meiphualpi panin khut dimin vut la unla, Faro’ muhin vantung lamah Moses in lawn hen.","title":"Meimatum Gimna"},"9":{"text":"Tua vutte, Egypt gam khempeuhah leivui neel bangin kithehthang ding a, Egypt gam sung khempeuhah mihing le ganhing tungah meimatum suakin kilawhgawp ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in meiphualpi panin vutte la-in Faro’ mai-ah ding uh a, Moses in vantung lamah tuate lawn a, tuate in mihing le ganhing tungah meimatum piangsakin kilawhgawp hi.","ref":"Mang 16:2"},"11":{"text":"Mitphial siamte in meimatum veina hangin Moses demzo nawn lo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mitphial siamte le Egypt mite khempeuh in meimatum vei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Faro’ lungsim khauhsak a, Topa in Moses’ tunga a gensa bangin amah in amaute’ thu ngai lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Zingsangin tho baih inla, Faro’ mai-ah dingin ama kiangah, ‘Hebru mite’ Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak in.","title":"Gialpi Gimna"},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung khempeuhah kei tawh a kibang khat beek om lo hi, ci-in na theih nadingin hih hunin na inn sungtawng dong le na nasemte le na mite’ tungah ka gimnate khempeuh kong tungsak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tu-in keimah in ka khut zanin natna tawh nang le na mite hong vatgawpin, leitung panin note hong kibeisak thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin leitung khempeuhah keima min a kipulak theih nadingin note tungah ka vangliatna lah ding deihna-in kong nungtasak lai hi.","ref":"Rom 9:17"},"17":{"text":"Ka mite tungah nang kiliansak lai-in amaute na paisak kei hi."},"18":{"text":"En in, zing ciang tubang hunin Egypt gam a kisat a kipanin tuhun dongin tua bang a kimu ngei lo, a tam mahmah gialpi ka kiasak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi sawl inla, na ganhingte le gamlak a na neihte khempeuh a muanhuai bukna-ah koih in. Bang hang hiam cih leh inn-ah a kipaipih lo, gamlak a om mihing le ganhing tungah gialpi kia ding a, amaute si ding uh hi,” ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro’ nasemte’ lak panin Topa’ thu a zahtak mi in ama silate le a ganhingte inn-ah taisak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa’ thu a don lo mi in ama silate le a ganhingte gamlakah nusia hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Egypt gam sung khempeuh a mihing le ganhing le gamlak kungte khempeuh tungah gialpi a kiat theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a ciangkhut a zan hi. Topa in van gingsakin gialpi kiasak a, leitungah keek kia suk hi. Topa in Egypt gam sungah gialpi zusak hi."},"24":{"text":"Egypt gam minam khat a suah khit a kipanin tua bang a om ngei lo, a tam mahmah gialpi le gialpi lakah khua phia-in keek ging om tawntung hi.","ref":"Mang 8:7; 16:21"},"25":{"text":"Gialpi in Egypt gam sunga a om mihing le ganhing, na khempeuh denggawp hi. Gialpi in gamlak kung khempeuh denggawp a, gamlak singkung khempeuh dengtan hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel mite a omna Goshen gam bekah gialpi kia lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in mi sawlin Moses le Aaron samsakin amaute kiangah, “Tutungin ka khial hi. Topa man hi. Kei le ka mite ka khial uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa’ tungah thum un. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih vanging le gialpi kicingzo hi. Note kong paisak ding a, note na khawl nawn kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in ama kiangah, “Khuapi panin ka paikhiat khit phetin Topa’ lamah ka khut ka zan ding hi. Leitung pen Topa a’ hi, ci-in na theih nadingin vanging tawpin gialpi om nawn lo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahih hangin nang le na nasemte in ahihleh, Topa Pasian na zahtak nai lohna uh ka thei hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"(Anthul kungte le mangbuhham kisia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mangbuhhamte a vuih laitak hi a, anthul kungte a pak laitak ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahih hangin mangbuh le mangbuhmante sia lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate khangham nai lo hi.)"},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ kiang pan khuapi pualamah Moses paikhia a, Topa’ lamah a khut zanin thu a ngen hi. Vanging le gialpi tawp pah a, leitungah guah bua nawn lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahih hangin guah le gialpi le vanging a khawlna Faro in a muh ciangin amah khial lai a, amah le a nasemte in a lungsim uh khauhsak uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Moses tungtawnin a gensa bangin Faro’ lungsim khauh lai a, amah in Israel mite paisak lo hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses tungah, “Faro’ kiangah pai in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute’ lakah hih keima limte ka lah theih nading le keimah in Egypt mite ka mawlpihna le amaute’ lakah bang limte bawl khin cihna thu na tate le na tute’ zakna-ah na gen theih nading le, Topa ka hihna na theih nadingin ama lungsim le a nasemte’ lungsim ka khauhsak hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Kauphe Gimna","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ kiangah Moses le Aaron pai-in ama kiangah, “Hebru mite’ Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Ka mai-ah nang na kiniamkhiat nading bang tanvei nial ding na hi hiam? Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingin ka mite paisak in."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mite paisak ding na nial leh, zing ciangin na gam sungah kauphete kong paipih ding a,"},"5":{"text":"kuamah in leitang a muh theih loh nadingin tuate in lei maitang khempeuh tuam ding uh hi. Gialpi khit cianga nang a’ dinga a omlai sunte amaute in ne ding uh hi. Tuate in gamlak a a po nangma singkung khempeuh ne ding uh a,"},"6":{"text":"nangma innte le na nasemte khempeuh le Egypt mite’ inn khempeuhah dim ding uh hi. Na pu na pate uh leitang tungah a pian’ uh a kipan tuni donga tua bang a muh ngei lohte uh hi ding hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciangin amah kihei-in Faro’ kiang panin a paikhia hi."},"7":{"text":"Faro’ nasemte in ama kiangah, “Eite tungah hih mipa bang tanvei thangzak hong hi niloh ding ahi hiam? Amaute in amau’ Pasian, Topa a biak theih nadingun mite paisak in. Egypt a siatna theitel nai lo na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro kiangah Moses le Aaron kipaipih kik hi. Faro in amaute kiangah, “Pai un; Topa , na Pasian uh va bia un. Ahi zongin kua teng pai ding na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in, “Ka khangnote uh le ka khanghamte uh tawh ka paikhawm ding uh hi. Ka tapate uh, ka tanute uh, ka tuuhonte uh, le ka bawnghonte uh tawh ka pai ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa a dingin pawi khat ka kham ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Faro in amaute kiangah, “Note tawh na naupangte uh kong paisak taak leh note tawh Topa hong om ta ve! En un, note in ngimna hoih lo na nei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bang hi lo ding! Note’ lak panin pasalte pai unla, Topa va bia un. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen nomau’ ut ahi hi,” a ci hi. Faro’ omna panin amaute kihawlkhia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Egypt leitang tungah amaute hong omin, gialpi in a den baang kung khempeuh a ne ding kauphete sapna-in Egypt leitang tungah na khut zan khia in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Egypt leitang tungah a ciangkhut zan a, Topa in tua sun tawntung le tua zan tawntung leitang tungah nisuahna huih a nungsak hi. Zingsang ciangin nisuahna huih in kauphete hong tun khin hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua masiah kauphe hon tua banga a tam a om ngei lo, cikmah ciangin zong a omkik ngei lo ding, Egypt leitang tung khempeuhah kauphe hong om a, Egypt gam buppi-ah a dim uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate in lei maitang khempeuh tuam uh a, leitang mial hi. Tuate in leitang tunga kung khempeuh le gialpi’ den baang singkung gah khempeuh ne uh hi. Egypt leitang tung khempeuhah gamlak singkung hitaleh kungno hitaleh a hing khat beek om nawn lo hi.","ref":"Mang 9:2-3"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in Moses le Aaron nawh sap a, “ Topa na Pasian’ tung le nangma tungah ka khial khin hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka khialhna hong maisak in. Tu-a khatvei bek, kong thum hi; keima tung panin hih sihna a lakkhiat ding Topa na Pasian’ tungah thum in,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro kiang panin amah paikhia-in Topa’ tungah a thum hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in nitumna huihpi hat mahmah khat nungsak a, tua huih in kauphete laamto-in San Tuipi sung a denna hi. Egypt gam sungah kauphe khat zong om nawn lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Faro’ lungsim khauhsak a, amah in Israel mite paisak lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Mite in khuamial sung a zawt nading, Egypt leitang tungah khuamial a om theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in,” a ci hi.","title":"Khuamial Gimna"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a khut zan a, Egypt leitang tung khempeuh ni thum sung khua mial bikbek hi.","ref":"La 105:28; Mang 16:10"},"23":{"text":"Ni thum sung amau khatlekhat kimu thei lo uh a, ama omna panin kuamah paikhia thei lo hi. Ahih hangin Israel mite in amau’ tenna-ah khuavak nei uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in Moses samin, “Pai un, Topa va bia un; na tate uh zong note tawh hong pai thei ding hi. Na tuuhonte uh le na bawnghonte uh omsak lai un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahih hangin Moses in, “ Topa ka Pasian uh tungah ka piak theih nadingun biakpiakna le meihal biakna kote nong neihsak kul hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka ganhingte uh zong kote tawh a pai kul hi. Ganno khat zong kinusia lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ka Pasian uh ka biak nadingun tuate ka paipih ding uh hi. A mun ka tun matengun bang pen tawh Topa bia ding cih ka thei kei uh hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Faro’ lungsim khauhsak a, amah in amaute paisak lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro in ama kiangah, “Kei kiang panin kihem in. Nang kidawm in. Ka maitang hong mu kik nawn kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka maitang nong muh ni-in nang na si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Na cih bang hita hen! Na maitang kong mu kik nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Faro le Egypt tungah gimna khat ka tungsak lai ding a, tua khit ciangin hih lai mun panin amah in note hong paisak ding hi. Amah in note hong paisak ciangin note hong hawlkhia mang khin ding hi.","title":"Tacil Sih nading Kigenkhol"},"2":{"text":"Pasal peuhmah in a vengte kiang pan, numei peuhmah in zong a vengte’ kiang mah panin ngun le kham kizepnate a nget theih nadingun mite’ zakin thu gen in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in Egypt mite’ muhna-ah mite maipha pia hi. Tua tham loin, mipa Moses pen Egypt leitang tung, Faro’ nasemte’ muhna, le mite’ muhna-ah lian mahmah hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Faro’ kiangah, “ Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Zankim pawlin Egypt mite’ lakah ka pai ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi tokhom tunga tu Faro’ tacil a kipanin an gawina nunga a om nasem numei tacil dong le ganhing tacil khempeuh, Egypt gam sungah tacil khempeuh si ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Cikmahin tua bang a om ngei lo, cikmah ciangin zong a omkik ngei lo ding kahna lianpi Egypt leitang tung khempeuhah om ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin Egypt mite le Israel mite a kilamdangin Topa in bawl hi, ci-in na theih nadingun Israel mite, mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh, ui khat nangawn zong tau lo ding hi, ci hi” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Faro’ kiangah, “Na uliante khempeuh keima kiangah hong paisukin, keima kiangah hong kun ding uh a, ‘Nang le nangmah hong zui khempeuh paikhia un,’ hong ci ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin kei ka paikhia ding hi,” ci thuah lai hi. Tua ciangin Faro’ kiang panin amah a heh mahmahsa-in a paikhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Egypt tungah nalamdang tam ka bawl theih nadingin Faro in na thu hong ngai lo lai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in hih na lamdangte khempeuh Faro’ mai-ah a bawl uh hi. Topa in Faro’ lungsim khauhsak a, amah in Israel mite a leitang panin paikhiasak lo hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah,","title":"Paisan Pawi A Pianna"},"2":{"text":"“Tu kha pen note a dingin kum kipatna hi ding a, note a dingin kum khat sungah a kha masa hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mihon khempeuhte tungah gen in. Tu kha ni sawm ni-in innkuan khat a dingin tuuno ahih kei leh keelno khat, amau’ innkuan phazah tawh kituakin amaute in ganno khat ciat go ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ganno khat a ne ding innkuanmi a tawmluat leh amau’ innzom a vengte tawh a mi tawh kituakin a sa hawm ding uh hi. A mi tamna le a nekzah uh tawh kizui-in ganno man pia ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Na ganno uh a sitbaang lo hi ding a, kum khat a pha a pa hi ding hi. Tua pen tuu ahi a, keel ahi zongin, khat peuhpeuh hi thei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua gannote pen Israel mihonte khempeuh in a gawh ding hun nitak khuamui, tua kha ni sawm le li dong na kem ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a si kimkhat la-in a nekna uh inn kongkhak khuam nihte le a bangtungzawl nuh ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in tua zanin a sa hangkeu-in ne ding uh a, silngo sawh loh anlum le a kha mehteh tawh amaute in ne ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A sate mun khat peuhpeuh a sial ahi a, tui tawh huanin ahi zongin ne loin, a lu le a khete le a sungkuate tawh hangkeu-in, na ne ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Zingsang dong a khing na omsak kei ding uh a, zingsang cianga a khing omlai peuhmah na haltum ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih bang zia-in na ne ding uh hi: Na kawng uh gakin, na khedap uh na khe uhah bulhin, na ciangkhut uh na khut uhah na tawi ding uh a, na nawh nek ding uh hi. Tua pen Topa’ Paisan Pawi ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in tua zanin Egypt gam ka nawk ding a, Egypt leitang tungah mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh tacil khempeuh ka vatlum ding a, Egypt pasian-te khempeuh tungah thu ka khen ding hi. Kei pen Topa ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Note’ omna inn tunga sisan pen note a dingin lim hi ding hi. Sisan ka muh ciangin note kong paisan ding a, Egypt leitang ka vatgawp ciangin note hong susia ding gimna note’ tungah hong tung lo ding hi.","ref":"Siam 23:5; Gam 9:1-5; 28:16; Thkna 16:1-2"},"14":{"text":"“Hih pen note a dingin phawkna ni hi ding a, note in Topa’ tungah pawi bawlna ni-in na nei ding uh hi. Na khang tawntungun note in biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in, “Note in ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. A ni masa ni-in note in na inn panun silngo na hemkhia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khatpeuh in a ni masa ni panin a ni sagih ni dong silngo sawh a nek leh, Israel mi-in tua mipa kiseh nawn lo ding hi.","title":"Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi"},"16":{"text":"A ni masa ni le a ni sagih ni-in a siangtho biak kikhopna khat na nei ding uh a, tua ni nih sung na bangmah na sem kei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin na milipun an huanin na ne thei ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Note in silngo sawh loh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih ni teekteekin Egypt leitang panin na mihonte uh ka paikhiatpih hi. Tua ahih ciangin note in na khan tawntungun hih ni pen biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kha masa, tua kha sawm le li nitakin note in silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh a, tua kha ni sawmnih le khat nitak dong na ne ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ni sagih sung na innsung uhah silngo kimu lo ding hi. Mi khatpeuh, peemta hitaleh gammi hitaleh in silngo sawh a nek leh Israel mi-in tua mipa kiseh nawn lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Silngo a kisawh peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi. Na omna khempeuh uhah silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 23:15; 34:18; Siam 23:6-8; Gam 28:17-25; Thkna 16:3-8"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Israel upate khempeuh samin amaute kiangah, “Nomau a dingin na innkuan uh tawh a kituakin tuunote teel unla, Paisan Pawi bawl nading tuuno go un.","title":"Paisan Pawi Masa"},"22":{"text":"Puknah lomkhat la unla, kuang sunga om sisan sungah diahin, kuang sunga om sisan tawh bangtungzawl le kongkhak khuam nihte nuh un.
