Amah in eite’ innkuante hong khawi-in Egypt mite a thah lai-in Egypt gam sungah Israel innkuante paisan hi,’ na ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Mite in a lu uh kunin Pasian a bia uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses le Aaron a thupiak bangin mite a gamta uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama kumpi tokhom tunga a tu Faro’ tacil a kipanin thongmial sunga a om a kiman mite’ tacil le ganhing tacil khempeuh, zankim laitakin Topa in vatgawp hi.","title":"Gimna Nunung Tacil Sihna","ref":"Pai 4:22-23"},"30":{"text":"Tua zanin Faro le a nasemte khempeuh le Egypt mite khempeuh tho uh a, Egypt gam sungah kahna lianpi a om hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khat beek a sihlohna inn khat zong om lo hi."},"31":{"text":"Faro in Moses le Aaron zan sap a, “Ding un; keima mite’ lak panin note le Israel mite paikhia unla, na gensa bangun Topa va bia un."},"32":{"text":"Na gensa bangun na tuuhonte uh le na bawnghonte uh la unla, pai un. Kei zong thupha hong pia un,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua gam panin mite manlangin a sawlkhiat nading uhah Egypt mite nawh tat mahmah uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, “Eite khempeuh i si khin ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mite in silngo sawh nai loh a annel lom uh la-in, annel mekna amau’ kuangte puan tawh tunin a liangko uhah pua uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Moses in amaute tunga a gen bangin Israel mite zong gamta uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Egypt mite’ tung panin ngun le kham kizepnate le puante ngen uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Amau’ ngette a piak nadingun Topa in Egypt mite’ muhna-ah Israel mite maipha a pia hi. Tua bangin amaute in Egypt mite’ na a sut uh hi.","ref":"Pai 3:21-22"},"37":{"text":"Israel mite numei le naupang kisim loin pasal tul zaguk Rameses panin Sukkoth-ah khe-in pai uh hi.","title":"Israel mite in Egypt Nusia"},"38":{"text":"Minamdang tampi le tuuhon le bawnghon, ganhing tampi zong amau tawh pai uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Egypt panin a ken uh annel lom panin amaute in silngo sawh loh moh em uh hi. Tuate silngo a kisawh lohna pen Egypt gam panin amaute kinotkhia a, ze-ol tat thei loin amau’ annek ding zong kiging man lo uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Israel mite Egypt-ah kum zali le kum sawmthum sung om uh hi.","ref":"Pian 15:13; Gal 3:17"},"41":{"text":"Kum zali le kum sawmthum a cin ni teekteekin Egypt leitang panin Topa’ mihonpite paikhia uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Egypt leitang panin amaute a paikhiatpih nadingin hih pen Topa’ zan vilna ahi hi. Tua mah bangin Israel mite khempeuh in zong amau’ khang tawntungin Topa a dingin hih zan mah zan vilna-in a nei uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah, “Hih Paisan Pawi pen biakna ngeina kip khat hi ding a, gamdangmi kuamah in ne lo ding hi.","title":"Paisan Pawi Ngeinate Genbehna"},"44":{"text":"Ahih hangin sum tawh a kilei sila peuhmah in a vun na at khit uh ciangin ne thei ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Peemta hitaleh a kicial nasem hitaleh in ne thei lo ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Inn sungah kine ding a, inn pua-ah a sa na paikhiatpih kei ding uh hi. A guh na kuaitan kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Gam 9:12; Joh 19:36"},"47":{"text":"Israel mihon khempeuh in hih ding uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Khualmi khat note kiangah hong peem a, Topa a dingin Paisan Pawi a bawl leh, ama mipih pasal khempeuh a vun ki-atsak un. Tua khit ciangin amah a nai-ah hong pai-in bawl thei ding a, amah pen gammi khat tawh kibang ding hi. Ahih hangin vun ki-at lo mi kuamah in ne lo ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Gammi le note’ lakah hong peem khualmi a dingin ngeina khat bek om ding hi,” a ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua bangin Israel mite khempeuh gamta uh a, Topa in Moses le Aaron a thupiak bangin amaute in hih uh hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ni teekteekin Topa in Israel mite a honpi-un Egypt gam panin a paikhiatpih hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Tacil Apna"},"2":{"text":"“Keima tungah tacil khempeuh hong ap in. Israel mite’ lakah, mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh, naubu a hong masa pen peuhpeuh keima-a’ ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 3:13; Luk 2:23"},"3":{"text":"Moses in mite tungah, “Salsuahna Egypt gam panin na paikhiat uh hih ni phawk un. Silngo sawh anlum kine lo ding hi.","title":"Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi"},"4":{"text":"Abib kha, tuni-in note a paikhia na hi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in note tungah piak dinga na pate’ tungah a ciam, bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna leitang, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite’ leitangah Topa in note hong paipih ciangin hih kha sungin hih bangin na hih ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Note in silngo sawh loh anlum ni sagih sung na ne ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in Topa pahtawina pawi khat om ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Silngo sawh loh anlum ni sagih sung kine ding hi. Note’ tungah silngo sawh anlum kimu lo ding a, note’ huang sung khempeuhah silngo kimu lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ni-in na tate uh kiangah, ‘Egypt panin ka paikhiat lai-un Topa in ko a’ dinga hong hihsakna hang hi,’ ci-in na gen ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Na kam un Topa’ Thukham a gen tawntung theih nadingin hih pen na khut tung uhah lim, na taltang tung uhah phawkna khat hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a vangliatna tawh hih mun panin note hong paikhiatpih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note in a kiseh hunin kum khat pan kum khat, hih biakna ngeina kip na zui ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Amah in note le na pate uh tungah a ciam bangin, Topa in Kanaan leitangah note hong paipih hun ciang le note tungah tua gam hong piak ciangin,","title":"Tacil"},"12":{"text":"note in naubu a hong masa khempeuh Topa a dingin na tuam koih ding uh hi. Note’ tapate’ lak panin tacil peuhmah na tanh ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hong pai ding hunah na tapa in, ‘Hih pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?’ ci-in nang hong dot ciangin, nangmah in ama kiangah, ‘Salsuahna, Egypt panin Topa in vangliatna tawh kote hong paikhiatpih hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in kote paisak ding a nial tentan ciangin Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh, mihing tacil le ganhing tacil khempeuh Topa in that hi. Ahih hangin ka tapate uh sung pan tacil khempeuh ka tanh uh hi,’ na ci ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua pen na khut tunga om ciaptehna lim ahih kei leh na mitte’ kikal-a talsuante bang hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a vangliatna tawh Egypt panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Faro in mite a paisak ciangin, lampi tom pen hitaseleh, Pasian in Filistia gam tawnin amaute paipih lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in, “Amaute in gal a tuah ciangin mite kisikin Egypt-ah ciahkik kha ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Meii Khuam le Mei Khuam"},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian in San Tuipi lam manawhin sehnel gam lamah mite kot paipih hi. Israel mite gal a do dingin a kithawisa-in Egypt leitang panin a paito uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Moses in Josef’ guhte paipih hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama guhte a puak ding uh Josef in Israel mite thupi takin kiciamna bawlsak khin hi. “Pasian in note hong hotkhiat ciangin note in hih lai panin keima guhte na pua ding uh hi,” na ci khin hi.","ref":"Pian 50:25; Josh 24:32"},"20":{"text":"Sukkoth panin amaute pai lai uh a, sehnel gam nawl, Etham-ah giahphual sat uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute, sun hitaleh zan hitaleh khualzinin a pai theih nadingun sunin amaute lam a lak dingin meii khuam khat tawh, zanin amaute khuavak a pia dingin mei khuam khat tawh, amaute’ mai-ah Topa a pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Sunin meii khuam le zanin mei khuamte, mite’ mai-ah om tawntung hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"San Tuipi Kantanna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite kihei kikin Migdol le tuipi kikal, Pihahiroth mai, Baalzefon nisuahna lamah giahphual a sat ding gen in. Tuipi gei, tua galkhatah giahphual na sat ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in Israel mite’ thu tawh kisai genin, ‘Sehnel gam sungah amaute tangciak uh hi. Sehnel gam in amaute khuhcip khin hi,’ ci ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Keimah in Faro’ lungsim khauhsakin, amah in Israel-te hong delh ding a, Faro le a mihonpite khempeuh ka zawhna hangin minthanna ka ngah ding hi. Kei, Topa ka hihna thu Egypt mite in thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute zong tua bangmahin gamta uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mite tai khinzo hi, ci-in Egypt kumpipa kiangah a kigen ciangin, Faro le ama nasemte’ ngaihsutna kikheel a, amaute in, “Eite’ na hong sep nading panin Israel mite i paikhiatsak, hih banga i gamtat bang hi mawk ahi hiam?” ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in a leeng kithawisakin ama galkapte la-in,"},"7":{"text":"a kitengkhia leeng zaguk le Egypt leeng khempeuh a ukte tawh kuan khawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Egypt kumpipa Faro’ lungsim khauhsak a, Israel mite kithamuanna tawh a paikhiat lai takun a delh hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt mite ahi, Faro’ sakolte, leengte, ama sakol tung tuangte le a galkapte in amaute delh uh a, amaute giahphual satin tuipi gei-a a omna uh, Pihahiroth gei, Baalzefon nisuahna lam munah a pha uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Faro hong nai ciangin Israel mite khuadak to uh hi. En in, amaute’ nungah Egypt mite hong kuan hi. Amaute lau mahmah uh hi. Topa’ tungah Israel mite kiko uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in Moses kiangah, “Egypt-ah han a om loh manin sehnel gam sungah a si dingin kote hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? Egypt panin paikhiatpihna tawh kote’ tungah bang hong bawl na hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"‘Kote hong hici omsak inla, Egypt mite’ na hong semsak in,’ ci-in Egypt-ah nang’ tungah hong gen hi lo ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh sehnel gamah sih sangin Egypt mite’ na sep ding kote a dingin hoihzaw ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses in mite tungah, “Lau kei un, kiptakin om un. Israel mite mai nawtin a pai ding uh gen in."},"16":{"text":"Israel mite in lei keu tungtawnin tuipi a kantan theih nadingin na ciangkhut laamto inla, tuipi tungah na khut zanin tuipi khenkham in."},"17":{"text":"Amau’ nungah Egypt mite hong pai-in, keimah in Faro le a mihonpite khempeuh, a leengte, le a sakol tung tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthanna ka ngah nadingin keimah in Egypt mite’ lungsim ka khauhsak ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Faro le ama leengte le ama sakol tung tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthanna ka ngah khit ciangin Topa ka hihna thu Egypt mite in hong thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mihonpite’ mai-ah a pai Pasian’ vantungmi kikhinin amaute’ nungah a pai hi. Amaute’ mai panin meii khuam kikhinin amaute’ nungah ding a,"},"20":{"text":"Egypt honpite le Israel honpite’ kikalah a pai hi. Tua lai-ah meii le khuamial om a, zan tawntung khatlekhat kinai kha loin zingsang khua hong vak hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut zan hi. Topa in zan tawntung nisuahna huihpi hat tawh tuipi mutgawpin, tuipi pen lei keu-in bawl a, tuite a kikhen hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel mite, tuipi laizang lei keu tungah pai uh a, amau’ taklam le veilamah kawm bangin tuite om hi.","ref":"1Kor 10:1-2; Heb 11:29"},"23":{"text":"Egypt mite ahi, Faro’ sakol khempeuh, ama leengte, le ama sakol tung tuangte in delhin tuipi laizang amaute’ nungah pai uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Zingsang ciangin Topa in mei le meii khuam sung panin Egypt mihonpite en sukin, Egypt mihonpite phialgawp a,"},"25":{"text":"amau’ leengpeite gumsak ahih manin man bekbakin hawl uh hi. Tua ciangin Moses in mite’ thugente Topa’ tungah a gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Mite kiangah pai inla, tuni le zingciang sungteng amaute siangthosakin, amau’ puante amau mah sawpsakin,"},"11":{"text":"a ni thum ni-in a baihsa-in om un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ni thum ni-in Sinai Mual tungah mite khempeuh’ muhna-ah Topa hong paisuk ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangmah in mite a dingin dalna khat a kimkotah na koih ding a, ‘Mualtungah pai loin, a gamgi na lawnkhak loh nadingun kidawm un; mual a lawng peuhpeuh kithat ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Khut peuhmah in tua mi kithat ding pa lawngkha lo ding a, suang tawh kidenglum ahih kei leh kikaplum ding hi. Ganhing hitaleh mihing hitaleh kihing khawi lo ding hi,’ na ci ding hi. Peengkul sauveipi hong kitum ciangin amaute mualtungah hong paito ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 12:18-20"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mualtung panin mite kiangah Moses paisuk a, mite siangthosak hi. Amaute in a puante uh sawp uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in mite kiangah, “Ni thum ni ciangin a baihsa-in om un; numei tawh lumkhawm kei un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A ni thum ni zingsang ciangin van gingin khua phia a, mualtungah meii sahpi kai a, nakpitakin a ging peengkul kitum ahih manin giahphual a om mi khempeuh ling uh hi.","ref":"Mang 4:5"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in giahphual panin Pasian a dawn dingin mite paikhiatpih a, amaute a om nading mual bulah om uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Meikhu in Sinai Mual tuamcip hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mei sung tua mualtungah Topa a kumsuk hi. A khu, meiphualpi khu bangin kahto a, a mual buppi nakpitakin kiling hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:11-12"},"19":{"text":"Peengkul aw a nak gin’ semsem laitakin Moses pau a, Pasian in vanging sungah amah dawng hi."},"20":{"text":"Sinai Mual dawnah Topa hong paisuk hi. Topa in tua mual dawnah Moses sam a, Moses zong paito hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Amaute in Topa a en dingin hong kantanin amaute tampi tak si kha ding uh ahih manin paisuk inla, mite hilhkhol in."},"22":{"text":"Amaute’ tungah Topa hehlua kha ding ahih manin, Topa’ kiangah hong pai siampite zong amau mah kisiangthosak tawm hen,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in Topa’ tungah, “Sinai Mual dongah mite hong pai thei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmahmah in kote nong thuhilh a, ‘Mual kimkotah dalnate bawl inla, siangthosak in,’ nong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in ama kiangah, “Paisuk inla, Aaron hong paipihto in. Ahih hangin amaute’ tungah amah hehlua kha ding ahih manin Topa kiang dongah a pai dingin siampite le mite paisuaksak kei in,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mite kiangah Moses paisukin amaute kiangah a gen hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian in hih thute khempeuh gen a,","title":"Thupiak Sawmte (Thkna 5:1-21)"},"2":{"text":"“Kei pen salsuahna Egypt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Keimah longal pasian dang na bia kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“A kiseek milim hitaleh, tunga vantung hitaleh, nuai-a leisung hitaleh, leinuai-a om tui sungah hitaleh a om na khat peuhpeuh a sun khat peuhpeuh note a dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuate’ mai-ah na kun kei ding uh a, tuate na bia kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah note’ Topa Pasian, a aam Pasian ka hi a, kei hong mudahte’ tungah pate’ mawhna tate’ tungah khang thum khang lina dongin thuk-in,","ref":"Pai 34:17; Siam 19:4; 26:1; Thkna 4:15-18; 27:15"},"6":{"text":"ahih hangin kei hong itin ka thupiakte a zui mi a tul tampite tungah itna kip a lak pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Pai 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 7:9-10"},"7":{"text":"“ Topa note’ Pasian’ min a sia lamin na zang kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama min a zang khialte gim pia ding hi.","ref":"Siam 19:12"},"8":{"text":"“Sabbath ni a siangtho-a zat ding phawk un.","ref":"Pai 16:23-30; 31:12-14"},"9":{"text":"Ni guk sung nomau’ na semin na nasep ding khempeuh uh na hih ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin a ni sagih ni pen Topa note’ Pasian’ Sabbath ni ahi hi. Tua ni-in note, na tapate, na tanute, na nasempate, na nasemnute, na ganhing uh ahi a, peemtate in ahi zongin na bangmah na sem kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Siam 23:3"},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a ni guk sung tengin Topa in van le lei, tuipi le tuate sunga om khempeuh bawl a, a ni sagih ni tawlnga hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Sabbath ni thupha pia-in siangthosak hi.","ref":"Pian 2:1-3; Pai 31:17"},"12":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitang tungah na khan uh a sau theih nadingin na nu le na pa uh zahtak un.","ref":"Thkna 27:16; Mat 15:4; 19:19; Mrk 7:10; 10:19; Luk 18:20; Efe 6:2-3"},"13":{"text":"“Mi na that kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pian 9:6; Siam 24:17; Mat 5:21; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; James 2:11"},"14":{"text":"“Nulepa mawhna na bawl kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 20:10; Mat 5:27; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; James 2:11"},"15":{"text":"“Na na gu kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:11; Mat 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9"},"16":{"text":"“Na vengte uh langkhatah a man loin teci na pang kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:1; Mat 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20"},"17":{"text":"“Na vengte uh inn na deihgawh kei ding uh hi. Na vengte uh zi hitaleh, ama nasempa hitaleh, ama nasemnu hitaleh, ama bawngtal hitaleh, ama la hitaleh, na vengte a’ ahi na khat peuhpeuh na deihgawh kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Rom 7:7; 13:9"},"18":{"text":"Tu-in mite khempeuh in vangingte, peengkul aw, le mual meikhu thu a theihtel uh ciangin, lau-in a ling uh hi. Amaute a gamla-ah ding uh a,","title":"Mite’ Launa (Thkna 5:23-33)"},"19":{"text":"Moses kiangah, “Nangmah in kote kiangah thu hong gen in; kote in ka ngai ding uh hi. Ahi zongin kote si kha ding ka hih uh ciangin ko tungah Pasian hong gensak kei in,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"Heb 12:18-19"},"20":{"text":"Moses in mite kiangah, “Lau kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh note khialkha loin amah na kihtak theih nadingun note’ tungah a laktel dingin Pasian hong pai ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Pasian’ omna meii sah nai-ah Moses a pai laitakin mite a gamla-ah a ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Nangmah in Israel mite tungah hih bangin na gen ding hi: ‘Vantung panin note kong hopihna note mahmah in na thei khin uh hi.","title":"Biakna tau tawh kisai Thute"},"23":{"text":"Note in kei tawh nong biakkhop dingun ngun pasian-te le kham pasian-te na bawl kei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Note in keima a dingin lei tawh biakna tau khat bawl unla, tua tungah na meihal biaknate uh le thunuama na biaknate uh, na tuute uh le na bawngtalte uh pia un. Keima min a kiphawk nading munin ka bawlna peuhmahah note kiangah keimah hong pai-in note thupha kong pia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note in keima a dingin suang tawh biakna tau na bawl uhleh, a kiseek suang tawh na bawl kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na nazatte uh tawh na va suk uhleh a ninsak na hi uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:5-7; Josh 8:31"},"26":{"text":"Tua tungah na seelsim uh a kidawk khak loh nadingin ka biakna tau tung kahtoh nading kahlei a kulin na sang bawl kei ding uh hi,’ ci in."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tu-in hihte pen amaute’ tungah na piak ding biakna ngeina kipte ahi hi.","title":"Silate a Kibawlna (Thkna 15:12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Hebru mi sila khat na lei uh ciangin, amah in kum guk sung na hong sepsak ding a, a kum sagihna ciangin bangmah hong pia loin a suakta-in paikhia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah guakin hong pai ahihleh amah guak mahin paikhia ding a, zi neisa-in hong pai ahihleh amah tawh a zi zong paikhia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A topa in amah zi guan a, tua nu in amah tawh tapate ahi a, tanute ahi zongin a neih leh, a zi le a tate pen a topa a’ hi ding a, amah guakin paikhia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin sila in a kitel takin genin, ‘Ka topa, ka zi, le ka tate ka it hi; a suakta-in ka paikhia kei ding hi,’ a cih leh,"},"6":{"text":"tua ciangin a topa in thukhente kiangah amah paipih ding hi. Amah in kongkhakah ahi a, kongkhak khuam-ah ahi zongin amah paipih ding hi. A topa in phimpi khat tawh ama bil vuhsak ding a, amah in a nuntak tawntung ama na sepsak ding hi.","ref":"Siam 25:39-46"},"7":{"text":"“Mi khat in a tanu sila-in a zuak ciangin, tua nu pen sila pasalte bangin paikhia lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A topa in ama zi dingin a sehsa tua numei in amah a lungkimsak kei leh, amah in tua nu a pa kiang mahah zuakkik ding hi. Amah, tua nu tungah citakin gamta lo ahih manin, gamdang mi khat tungah tua nu a zuak theih nading thu nei lo ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khat in a tapa a dingin sila numei a lei leh, amah in tanu bangin tua nu bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in zi dang khat a lakthuah leh, a zi masa’ annek, a puansilh, ahih kei leh lupkhop nading thuneihna khiam lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in hih thu thumte tuanu a dingin a bawl kei leh, sum hong piak kul lo, bangmah a kul loin tua nu paikhia thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Mi khat satin a sisak mi peuhpeuh kithat ding hi.","title":"Ngongtatna a om ciangin Zuih ding Thute","ref":"Siam 24:17"},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in a thah sawm hi lo a, a thah khak ahihleh, amah a tai theih nadingin note a’ ding mun khat ka seh ding hi.","ref":"Gam 35:10-34; Thkna 19:1-13; Josh 20:1-9"},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin mi khat in midang khat thah ding tumin a thah leh, amah na thah theih nadingun note in ka biakna tau a belhna nangawn panin amah na la teitei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Ama pa hitaleh ama nu hitaleh a sat peuhmah kithat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Zuak ding ahi a, sila-in neih ding ahi zongin mi a gu mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:7"},"17":{"text":"“Ama pa hitaleh ama nu hitaleh a samsia mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.","ref":"Siam 20:9; Mat 15:4; Mrk 7:10"},"18":{"text":"“Mite kitawng a, a khat in adang khat suangtum khat tawh ahi a, ama khuttum tawh ahi zongin tumin, mipa a sih loh hangin lupna ngakin,"},"19":{"text":"tua ciangin mipa thozo-in ama ciangkhut tawh a vakkhiatkik zawh nakleh, amah a tum pa siang ding hi. Amah in ama hun bei sungteng tang ding bek ama tungah loh ding a, amah damsiangsak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Mi khat in molhtum khat tawh ama sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh satin a phualah a sih pah leh, amah gim kipia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahih hangin ni khat ahi a, ni nih ahi zongin sila a nuntak leh, amah gim piak ding hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh sila pen ama neihsa ahih manin sila a sih ciangin amah a sumh khin ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mite kitawngin numei naupaii khat liamsak a, tatolhin; ahi zongin siatna in a zuihbeh kei nakleh, tua nu’ pasal in ama tunga a cihzah tawh kituakin tua numei a liamsak mi kigam ding a, thukhente’ khenna bangin amah liau ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Siatna khatpeuh in a zuihbeh leh, tua ciangin nuntakna tang ding nuntakna,"},"24":{"text":"mit tang ding mit, ha tang ding ha, khut tang ding khut, khe tang ding khe,","ref":"Siam 24:19-20; Thkna 19:21; Mat 5:38"},"25":{"text":"meikang tang ding meikang, liamna tang ding liamna, siatna tang ding siatna pia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Mi khat in ama sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a mit satin a suksiatkhak leh amah in tua mit’ hangin sila suaktasakin paikhiasak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in a sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a ha a tupkhiat leh, amah in tua ha’ hangin sila suaktasakin paikhiasak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Bawngtal khat in pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a ki tawh a piklup ciangin, a bawngtal kidenglum ding a, a sa kine lo ding hi. Ahih hangin bawngtal nei pa siang ding hi.","title":"A Neite’ Zuih ding Thute"},"29":{"text":"Ahih hangin a hun beisa-ah bawngtal in mi si thei a, a nei pa kihilh napi-in a khumcip kei a, tua bawngtal in pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a thah leh, bawngtal kidenglum ding a, a nei pa zong kithat ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama tung pan tatkhiatna sum a kinget leh, ama nuntakna tatkhiat nadingin ama tungah a kingen zahzah amah in pia ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bawngtal in mi’ tapa ahi a, tanu ahi zongin a ki tawh a pik leh hih ngeina tawh kizui-in kigamta ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawngtal in sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh khat peuhpeuh a ki tawh a pik leh, a nei pa in amau’ topa’ tungah ngun shekel sawmthum pia ding a, bawngtal kidenglum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Mi khat in dum honsa-in a nusia ahi a, mi khat in dum a tawh ciangin siin loin om ahi zongin, bawngtal hitaleh la hitaleh dum sungah a kiat leh,"},"34":{"text":"dum nei pa in loh ding hi. Amah in a nei pa tungah sum pia ding a, ganhing luang pen ama a’ hi pah ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“Mi khat’ bawngtal in adang khat’ bawngtal liamsakin a sih leh, amaute in a hing pen zuak ding uh a, tua man hawm ding uh hi. A ganhing si pen zong amaute in hawm ding uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua bang hi lo a, bawngtal in mi si ngei hi, ci-in kithei napi a nei pa in a khumcip kei leh, amah in bawngtal tang ding bawngtal pia ding a, a si ganhing pen amah in tang ding hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khat in bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin gu a, a that a, a zuak zongin, amah in bawngtal khat tang dingin bawngtal nga, tuu khat tang dingin tuu li pia ding hi. Amah in ditkikna bawl ding hi. Amah in bangmah a neih kei leh, ama guktakna hangin amah kizuak ding hi. A kigu ganhing, bawngtal ahi a, la ahi a, tuu ahi zongin a hingin ama khut sungah a kimuh leh, amah in a zah nih pia ding hi. “Guta khat in inn vutlet a, kisatin amah a sih leh, tua sihna hangin mawhna om lo ding hi. Ahih hangin nisuah khit ahihleh tua sihna hangin mawhna om ding hi.","title":"Ditkikna Thute","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"“Mi khat in lo khatah ahi a, leenggui lo-ah ahi zongin gan tasak a, a ganhing khahin midang khat’ lo-ah a tat leh, amah in ama lo le ama leenggah lo panin a piangte tawh loh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Mei kuangin gam kang a, a kikhol an ahi a, a ding lai an ahi a, lo ahi zongin a kat leh, mei a kangsak pa in a cing takin loh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mi khat in a vengte kiangah sum ahi a, van ahi zongin kep ding ap a, tua mipa’ inn panin a kiguk leh, a gu pa a kimuh leh amah in a zah nih pia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A gu pa a kimuh kei leh a vengpa’ vante amah in gu hiam, gu lo hiam cih a kitel nadingin thukhente kiangah inn nei pa in kiciamna bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Thu neihna khat peuhpeuh, bawngtal ahi a, la ahi a, tuu ahi a, puansilh ahi zongin, a mang na khat peuhpeuh, mi khat in, ‘Hih pen kei a’ hi,’ a cihna thu-ah, alang nihte’ thu pen thukhente’ mai-ah tung ding hi. Thukhente in a mawhsak mipa in a vengpa tungah a zah nih pia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Mi khat in ama vengte tungah la ahi a, bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin, ganhing khat peuhpeuh kep dingin a piak a, kuama muh lohin tua ganhing a si a, a liam a, a kihawlkhia ahi zongin ahihleh,"},"11":{"text":"amah in a veng pa’ neihsa a gu kha hiam cih a kitheih nadingin amau tegel’ kikalah Topa tawh kiciamna om ding hi. A nei pa in tua kiciamna sang ding a, amah in loh lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin ama tung panin a kigu ahihleh, a nei pa tungah amah in loh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Gamsa in a balzan ahihleh, lahtel nadingin tua ganhing paipihsak in. A kibalzan ganhing amah in loh lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mi khat in a vengte’ gan khat peuhpeuh kawm a, a nei pa om loin a liam a, a si zongin, amah in a kicingin loh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A nei pa tawh a omkhawm ahihleh amah in loh lo ding hi. A kikawm ahihleh a kikawm bangin pai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mi khat in a kidong nai lo nungak khat zolin amah tawh a lupkhop leh, amah in tua nu’ man ding moman letsong pia ding a, ama zi suak ding hi.","title":"Gamtatna le Biakna tawh Kisai Thute"},"17":{"text":"A numei’ pa in ama tungah tua nu a piak nop kei leh zong, tua mipa in nungak moman letsong zah numei’ pa’ tungah sum pia veve ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 22:28-29"},"18":{"text":"“Numei aisan nu na hingkhawi kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:10-11"},"19":{"text":"“Ganhing tawh a mawh peuhmah kithat ding hi.","ref":"Siam 18:23; 20:15-16; Thkna 27:21"},"20":{"text":"“ Topa bek simloh pasian dang khat peuhpeuh tungah biakna a pia mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:2-7"},"21":{"text":"“Khualmi khatpeuh na bawlsia kei ding uh a, na nengniam kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note zong Egypt leitangah khual mite na hi ngei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Meigong numei ahi a, tagah ahi zongin na gimsak kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:9; Siam 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"23":{"text":"Note in amaute na gimsak uh a, amaute keima tungah hong kiko leh, keimah in amau’ kikona ka za taktak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka hehna so-in namsau tawh note kong that ding a, na zite uh meigong suakin, na tate uh tagah suak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Note tawh a om, a zawng keima mite khat peuhpeuh tungah sum leitawi na piak uhleh, ama tungah sum leitawi a piapa bangin na om kei ding uh a, ama tung panin a meet na dok kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 25:35-38; Thkna 15:7-11; 23:19-20"},"26":{"text":"Khapna ahi na vengpa’ puan silh lai na lak ngei khak leh nitum ma-in ama tungah na pia kik ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ama silh ding tua bek hi a, tua pen ama pumpi a dingin a puan neihsun ahi hi. Amah bang dang tawh lum ding ahi hiam? Amah kei tungah hong kiko leh ke’n ka za ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in hehpihna ka nei hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:10-13"},"28":{"text":"“Thukhente na simmawh kei ding uh a, na mite uh a ukpa zong na samsia kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:5"},"29":{"text":"“Na anlakna pan uh le sathau le leenggah na suknate uh panin a leetkhiate piak khiat ding na zekai kei ding uh hi. “Na tapa cilte uh keima tungah nong pia ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Na bawngtalte uh le na tuute uh panin zong tua bangmahin nong pia ding uh hi. Ni sagih sung a pi tawh om ding a, a ni giat ni-in kei tungah nong pia ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"“Note pen kei’ tungah hong ki-ap mite na hi ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin gamlakah gamsate in a balzan sa peuhmah note in na ne kei ding uh a, tua bang sate uite na lot ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 17:15"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Thuman lo na genkhia kei ding uh hi. Elna tawh teci pang dingin migilo pa tawh na kipawl kei ding uh hi.","title":"Thutanna le Diktatna","ref":"Pai 20:16; Siam 19:11-12; Thkna 5:20"},"2":{"text":"Siatna a bawl dingin mihon na zui kei ding uh hi. Thutang a hei khia dingin mihonpi nung zui-in thu neihna-ah teci na pang kei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama thu neihna-ah mizawng pa na langneih kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:15"},"4":{"text":"“Na langneih mite’ bawngtal ahi a, a la ahi zongin a gammang na tuah uhleh ama kiangah na hawlkik ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah a hong mudah pa’ la a van tawh a puk na muh leh a la tawh amah na nusia kei ding a, tua la phot toh ding na huh ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 22:1-4"},"6":{"text":"“Ama thu neihna-ah mizawng pa a thutang kimlai na lelsak kei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A man lopi a mi mawhsak ding panin kikem unla, a dikpa le thuman pa that kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a gilo mi ka khah kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Sumgolh na la kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh sumgolh in uliante’ mit tawsak a, thuman mite’ thu heikhiatsak hi.","ref":"Siam 19:15; Thkna 16:19"},"9":{"text":"“Khualmi na nengniam kei ding uh hi. Khualmi’ lungsim na thei uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note zong Egypt gamah khualmi na hi ngei uh hi.","ref":"Pai 22:21; Siam 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"10":{"text":"“Note in na leitang uhah kum guk sung khai tuhin a piangte na kaikhawm ding uh hi.","title":"Kum Sagihna le Ni Sagihna"},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin a kum sagihna ciangin, nomau’ mi a zawngte in a nek theih nadingin leitang tawlngasakin, lokhulin na omsak ding uh a, gamlak ganhingte in mizawngte’ nek loh teng ne thei ding uh hi. Na leenggui lote uh le na oliv lote uh zong tua bangmahin na hih ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 25:1-7"},"12":{"text":"“Ni guk sung na nasep uh na sem ding uh hi. Ahih hangin na bawngtal le na la in tawlngakna a neih theih nading le, na nasem numei’ tapa le khual mite in thathak a ngah theih nadingin a ni sagih ni-in na tawlnga ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 20:9-11; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Siam 23:3; Thkna 5:13-14"},"13":{"text":"Note’ tunga kong gente khempeuh thudon un; pasian dangte’ min genin nei kei unla, na kam sung panun zong tua bangte kizasak kei un."},"14":{"text":"“Kum khatin thumvei, keima a dingin pawi na bawl ding uh hi.","title":"A Kiseh Pawi Thumte (Pai 34:18-26 ; Thkna 16:1-17)"},"15":{"text":"Silngo sawh loh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Keimah in note kong thupiak bangin Abib kha sung a kisehsa hun ciangin ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua kha sungin Egypt panin note na paikhia uh hi. Khut hawmguak tawh keima mai-ah kuamah hong kilak lo ding hi.","ref":"Pai 12:14-20; Siam 23:6-8; Gam 28:17-25"},"16":{"text":"“Note in lo-a na tuh uh, na nasepna uh a gah masa, anlak pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Note in lo panin na nasepna uh a gah na kaihkhop uh kum bei ciangin an kaihkhopna pawi na bawl ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 23:15-21,39-43; Gam 28:26-31"},"17":{"text":"Topa Pasian ’ mai-ah pasal khempeuh kum khatin thumvei kilaak ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Note in silngo sawh anlum tawh keimah biakpiakna si na pia khawm kei ding uh a, a ganhing thau zong zingsang dong na omsak kei ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"“Note in na anpalte uh lakah a tung masa pen Topa na Pasian uh inn-ah na paipih ding uh hi. “Note in a pi’ nawizu tawh keelno na huan kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 34:26; Thkna 14:21; 26:2"},"20":{"text":"“En un, keimah in ka bawlsa munah note hong paipih ding le lamkalah note hong cing dingin note’ mai-ah vantungmi khat ka sawl hi.","title":"Topa’ Vantung mi in Israel-te Makaih"},"21":{"text":"Amah thudonin ama aw ngai unla, amah lehdo kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in note’ thu palsatna hong maisak lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keima min tawh nasem ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"“Ahih hangin note in ama aw limtakin ngai-in keima gen bangin na gamtat uhleh na galte uh’ tungah gal ka hi ding a, na langte uh’ tungah lang ka hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Note’ mai-ah ka vantungmi pai-in Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Kanaan mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite kiangah note hong paipihin, keimah in amaute ka phiat khiat ciangin,"},"24":{"text":"amau’ pasian-te’ mai-ah note kun loin, tuate bia loin, amau’ gamtat bangin na gamta kei ding uh a, note in amaute lawnthal mang kiuhkeuhin amau’ milim suang khuampite na satnen gawp ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Note in Topa na Pasian uh nong bia ding uh a, keimah in na an uh le na tui uh thupha ka pia ding hi. Keimah in note’ lak panin cinatna ka la khia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Note’ leitangah kuamah nausia om lo ding a, a ciing zong om lo ding hi. Note kong teeksihsak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Keimah hong kikihtakna note’ mai-ah paisakin note’ phutkhak ding mi khempeuh ka kitokgawpsak ding a, na galte khempeuh uh lehhei-in note’ kiang panin ka taisak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Note’ mai panin Hiv mite, Kanaan mite, le Hit mite a hawlkhia dingin note’ mai-ah tunpi ka sawlkhia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Leitung gamkhing suakin gamlak ganhingte note’ langkhatah tampi pha kha ding ahih manin note’ mai panin kum khat sungin amaute ka hawlkhia kei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Note khangin tampi pha-in leitang na luah matengun note’ mai panin tawm tawmin amaute ka hawlkhia ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Keimah in San Tuipi panin Filistia mite’ tuipi ciang le sehnel gam panin Eufratis gun ciang dongah na gamgite uh ka phut ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua gam a teng mite note’ khut sungah kong pia ding a, note in na mai uh panin amaute na hawlkhia ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute ahi a, amau’ pasian-te tawh ahi zongin thuciamna na bawl kei ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaute in kei’ tungah note hong khialsak kha ding ahih ciangin note’ leitang tungah amaute teng lo ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note in amau’ pasian-te na biak uhleh note’ tungah thangzak khat hong hi taktak ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Nang le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel upate sung pan sawmsagih tawh keima kiangah hong paito unla, a gamla panin kunin hong bia un.","title":"Thuciamna Kikipsak"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ nai-ah Moses bek hong pai ding hi. A dangte a nai-ah hong pai lo ding a, mihonte in mual ciang dong hong neh lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses hong pai-in Topa’ thugente khempeuh le biakna ngeinate khempeuh mite kiangah a gen hi. Mi khempeuh in aw kikhatin dawng uh a, “ Topa’ gensa thute khempeuh ka hih ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Topa’ thugente khempeuh a gelh hi. Zingsangin amah tho baih a, mual bulah biakna tau khat lamin, Israel minam sawm le nihte tawh kituakin khuam sawm le nih a phut hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in Israel mi tangvalte sawlin, tuate in meihal biakna le thunuama biakna bawngtalte Topa’ tungah pia uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in a sisan kimkhat la-in, kuangte sungah koih a, sisan kimkhat biakna tau tungah a theh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in thuciamna laibu la-in, mite’ zakin tua laibu a sim hi. Amaute in, “ Topa’ gensa khempeuh kote in ka hih ding uh a, kote ka thumang ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in sisan la-in mite’ tungah theh a, “Hih thute khempeuh tawh kizui-in Topa in note tawh a bawlsa thuciamna sisan en un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 26:28; Mrk 14:24; Luk 22:20; 1Kor 11:25; Heb 9:19-20; 10:29"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel upate sung pan sawmsagih paito uh a,"},"10":{"text":"amaute in Israel Pasian mu uh hi. Ama khe nuai-ah a sianthona van mel tawh a kibang, sapfaia suangmanpha tawh a kibawl suangphahpek bangpian om hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in Israel mi makaite gimna ngahsak lo hi. Amaute in Pasian mu uh a, tua ciangin an ne-in tui dawn uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Keima kiang mualtungah hong paito inla, tua lai-ah ngak in. Amaute a kihilh nadingin keima gelhsa, thukham le thupiakna tawh, suangpek nang tungah kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Sinai Mual tungah Moses"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ama nasempa Joshua tawh Moses kithawi uh a, Pasian’ mual tungah paito uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in upate kiangah, “Note’ kiangah kong paikik matengun hih lai-ah kote hong ngak un. En un, note tawh Aaron le Hur om hi. Thu nei peuhpeuh amaute’ kiangah paisak un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin mualtungah Moses paito a, meii in mual a tuam hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ minthanna vang pen Sinai Mual tungah kinga a, meii in ni guk sung tua mual a tuam hi. A ni sagih ni-in amah in meii lak panin Moses a sam hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in Topa’ vangliatna vang pen Israel mite’ muhna-ah mualvum dawn a kangtum meikuang tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Meii sungah Moses tum a, mualtungah paito hi. Moses sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung mualtungah a om hi.","ref":"Thkna 9:9"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Israel mite in Biakna Paipih ding (Pai 35:4-9)"},"2":{"text":"“Amaute in kei a dingin biakna hong paipih nadingin Israel mite’ kiangah gen in. A pia nuam mi peuhmah tung panin kei a dingin biakna na sang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute’ tung panin na san ding biakna hih bang ahi hi: Kham, ngun, sumngo,"},"4":{"text":"a dum, a dupsan, a ausan puante le a kopin a kikhuk khau tawh a kigan puan hoih, keelmul,"},"5":{"text":"a kisansak tuutal vunte, keelvunte, singkha sing,"},"6":{"text":"meivakte a’ ding sathau, nilh sathau ding le paknamtui dingin a namtui nate,"},"7":{"text":"siampipuan le awmdal a bulh dingin onik suangte ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute’ lakah kei ka om theih nadingin kei a dingin biakbuk khat amaute bawlsak in."},"9":{"text":"Biakbuk le a nazatte’ lim ding tawh kisai-in nang’ tungah kong lahte khempeuh tawh kituakin nangmah in na bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Amaute in singkha sing tawh singkuang khat bawl ding uh hi. A dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum hi ding hi.","title":"Thuciamna Singkuang (Pai 37:1-9)"},"11":{"text":"Nangmah in kham citak tawh tua singkuang na zut ding a, a sung le a pua na zut ding hi. A tung kimkotah a geihual kham tawh na bawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangmah in tua singkuang a dingin kham kual li sungin a singkuang khe li tungah tuate na bulh ding a, a pang khatah kual nih, a pang langkhatah a kual nih mah na bulh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangmah in singkha singzawl na sui ding a, tuate kham tawh na zut ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Singkuang puak nadingin singkuang panga kualte sungah a zawlte na khum ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Singkuang’ kualte sungah a zawlte omsuak ding a, tuate kilakhia lo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nang’ tunga kong piak ding thuciamna nangmah in singkuang sungah na koih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kham citak tawh hehpihna tokhom khat na bawl ding a, a dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum hi ding hi.","ref":"Rom 3:25; Heb 9:5"},"18":{"text":"Nangmah in kham tawh kherub nih na bawl ding a, hehpihna tokhom mong tuakah a kiseek tua kherub-te na omsak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Mong khatah kherub khat, a mong langkhatah kherub khat mah bawl in. Hehpihna tokhom tawh a kizomin a mong tuakah kherub na bawl ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Kherub-te in a khate uh a tungah zal ding uh a, amau’ khate tawh hehpihna tokhom liimsunin amaute khatlekhat kimaingat ding uh hi. Hehpihna tokhom lamah kherub-te’ mai nga ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Singkuang tungah hehpihna tokhom na koih ding a, singkuang sungah nang kong piak ding thuciamna na koih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hehpihna tokhom tung, thuciamna singkuang tunga om kherub nihte kikal panin nang kong hopih ding a, Israel mite a dingin nang’ tungah kong piak ding thute khempeuh nang’ tungah kong gen ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Nangmah in singkha sing tawh sabuai khat na bawl ding a, a dung pi thum, a vai pi khat le alang, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum hi ding hi.","title":"Ompihna Anlum Sabuai (Pai 37:10-16)"},"24":{"text":"Kham citak tawh na zut ding a, a kimkotah a geihual kham tawh na bawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Nangmah in khutpeek cia a zai zawl peek khat a kimkotah na bawl ding a, tua zawl peek kimkotah a geihual na bawl ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Nangmah in tua sabuai a dingin kham kual li na bawl ding a, tuate pen a kiu li, a khe lite-ah na gak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Sabuai puak nading zawlte a len dingin a zawl peek gei-ah a kualte om ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Nangmah in singkha sing zawlte bawlin kham tawh na zut ding a, hihte tawh sabuai kipua ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Paknamtui a dingin a kuangdaite le a pakante, tui phih nadingin a thawl gongbakte, le a kuang-ukte na bawl ding hi. Kham citak tawh tuate na bawl ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima mai sabuai tungah Ompihna Anlum na koih tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Siam 24:5-8"},"31":{"text":"“Kham citak tawh meivakkhuam khat na bawl ding hi. Meivakkhuam bul leh a kungte pen a kiseek nate tawh kibawl ding hi. A haite, a nunte le a paakte, tua tawh sakhat hi khawm ding uh hi.","title":"Kham Meivakkhuam (Pai 37:17-24)"},"32":{"text":"A pang panin hiang guk meengkhia ding a, a pang khatah meivakkhuam hiang thum meengkhia-in, a pang langkhatah meivakkhuam hiang thum mah meengkhia ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Hiang khat ciat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum le adang hiang khat ciat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum mah kibawl ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin hiang gukte meivakkhuam panin meengkhia ding hi."},"34":{"text":"A meivakkhuam tung mahmahah a nunte le a paakte tawh a om, almond bangin a kibawl hai li omin,"},"35":{"text":"meivakkhuam panin hiang guk a kopte’ bulah tua tawh sakhat ahi nun khat om ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Amau’ nunte le a hiangte, sakhat hi ding a, a vekpi-in kham citak a kiseek sakhat hi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Nangmah in ama a dingin meivak sagihte na bawl ding a, ama omna mai teng khua a vaksak dingin meivakte kikoih ding hi."},"38":{"text":"A taitehte le a kuangte kham citak hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Kham citak tawi sawmnih le tawi khat val a gik tawh hih nazatte khempeuh kibawl ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Mualtungah nang’ tunga hong kilak hih nate pen amau’ lim ding bangin na bawl ding thei in.","ref":"Sawl 7:44; Heb 8:5"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua tham loin a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan dalna puan sawm le a dum, a dupsan, le a ausan khau a kigan puan tawh biakbuk na bawl ding hi. Hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh tuate na bawl ding hi.","title":"Biakbuk (Pai 36:8-38)"},"2":{"text":"Dalna puan a dung pi sawmli le pi nih hi ding a, dalna puan a vai pi guk hi ding hi. Dalna puan khempeuh kikim ciat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Dalna puan ngate khatlekhat kikhuituah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A kikhuituah a masa dalna puan a nawlnung pen’ nawl dung sukah khaudum tawh a bilvangte na bawl ding hi. Tua bangmahin a kikhuituah a nihna dalna puan a nawlnung pen’ nawl dung suk mahah a bilvangte na bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Dalna puan khat tungah bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituah a nihna dalna puan nawlah bilvang sawmnga mah na bawl ding a, a bilvangte khatlekhat kitang ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Biakbuk pen bup khat a suah theih nadingin nangmah in kham kilhna sawmnga bawlin, tua kilhnate tawh dalna puan khatlekhat na kimatsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Biakbuk a tung khuh nadingin keelmul tawh puante zong na bawl ding a, puan sawm le khat na bawl ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua puan a dung pi sawmli le nga, a vai pi guk ciat hi ding a, puan sawm le khatte kikim ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua puan ngate amau le amau khuituahin, puan gukte zong amau le amau mah na khuituah ding a, a gukna puan pen puanbuk mai-ah na khep ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A kikhuituah puan khat nawlah a bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituah a nihna puan nawlnung pen nawlah a bilvang sawmnga mah na bawl ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua pen bup khat a suah theih nadingin nangmah in sumngo kilhna sawmnga bawlin, a bilvangte’ sungah tua kilhnate guangin, puanbuk na kimatsak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Puanbuk puan a val khia, puan alang a val pen, biakbuk nungah kaisuk ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Puanbuk puan a dunglam, pangkhatah pi khat le alang, a pang langkhatah pi khat le alang a val pen biakbuk a khuh dingin hih lampang le hua lampangte-ah kaisuk ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“A kisansak tuutal vunte le keelvunte tawh puanbuk khuhna khat na bawl ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Biakbuk a dingin a po to ding khuampeekte singkha sing na bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A khuampeek khat a tun pi sawm le nga hi ding a, a vai pi nih le letmat thum vive hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A bulh nadingin a khuampeek khatah a zang nih ciat om ding hi. Biakbuk khuampeek khempeuh tua bangin na bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Biakbuk khuampeekte na bawl ding hi: Leitaw lam panga dingin khuampeek sawmnih hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A khuampeek sawmnihte’ bulah bullen sawmli ngun tawh na bawl ding a, a zang nihte a dingin khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, a khuampeek dang khat bulah adang nihte a dingin bullen nih mah hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Biakbuk a pang nihna lam, leilu lam panga a khuampeek sawmnihte le"},"21":{"text":"ngun tawh kibawl a bullen sawmlite a dingin, khuampeek khatah bullen nih, adang khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih mah hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nitumna lam, biakbuk nung lama dingin khuampeek guk na bawl ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Biakbuk nunglam kiute a dingin khuampeek nih na bawl ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuate a bul lamah kikak ding a, ahih hangin a kual masa ah a dawn kimat ding hi. A nihin tua bang hi ding a, tuate in a kiu nihte piangsak ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngun tawh kibawl amau’ bullen sawm le gukte a’ ding a khuampeek giat pha ding a, khuampeek khatah bullen nih ciat om ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Singkha sing, zawlin na bawl ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Biakbuk pangkhat a khuampeek a’ ding zawl nga, biakbuk a pang langkhat a khuampeek a dingin zawl nga, nitumna lam biakbuk nung lam panga a khuampeekte a dingin zawl nga hi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"A zawl laita, a khuampeek kimciang a banto pen mong khat pan mong khat paisuak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A khuampeekte kham tawh zutin, a zawlte a len dingin amau’ kualte kham tawh na bawl ding a, a zawlte kham tawh na zut ding hi."},"30":{"text":"A lim ding geelna, mualtungah nang tungah hong kilak mah tawh kizui-in biakbuk na lam ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“A dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih kigan tawh dalna puan khat na bawl ding a, hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh kizem ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Ngun tawh kibawl bullen lite tungah a om, kham kibawl vankhaina nei-in, kham tawh a kizut singkha khuampi lite tungah na khai ding hi."},"33":{"text":"A kilhnate-ah dalna puan khai sukin, dalna puan sung tua lai munah thuciamna singkuang na koih ding a, dalna puan in siangtho pen mun panin siangtho mun khen ding hi.","ref":"Heb 6:19; 9:3-5"},"34":{"text":"Siangtho pen mun sunga om thuciamna singkuang tungah hehpihna tokhom na koih ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Dalna puan pualamah sabuai koihin, sabuai tawh a kisan biakbuk leitaw lampangah meivakkhuam na koih ding a, leilu lampangah sabuai na koih ding hi."},"36":{"text":"“Puanbuk kongkhak dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem kongpuankhai khat na bawl ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Kongpuankhai a dingin singkha khuampi nga bawlin kham tawh na zut ding hi. A vankhainate kham hi ding a, tuate a dingin sumngo bullen nga na bawl ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Biakna tau ding singkha sing tawh bawl in. Pi sagih le alang sau-in pi sagih le alang mah na zaisak ding hi. Biakna tau a ning kikim ding a, a tun pi li le alang hi ding hi.","title":"Meihal Biakna Tau (Pai 38:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"A kiu lite-ah ki na bawl ding hi. A kite pen a biakna tau tawh sakhat hi ding a, sumngo tawh na zut ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama a dingin vut koih nading beelte le kawbiate, kuangte, sikkate le vutluahna peekte na bawl ding a, a nazat khempeuh sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama a dingin siklen, a vang simsiam zong sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi. Siklen tung, a kiu lite-ah sumngo kual li na bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Siklen in biakna tau kimciang a batsuk theih nadingin biakna tau zawl nuai panin na bulh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Biakna tau a dingin singkha sing zawlte bawlin sumngo tawh tuate na zut ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A kipuak ciangin biakna tau pang nihte-ah a zawlte a om theihna dingin a kualte’ vang sungah a zawlte kikhum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Singpekte tawh kuak nei-in biakna tau na bawl ding a, mualtung a nang tungah hong kilaksa bangin kibawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Biakbuk tual na bawl ding hi. A tual in leitaw lam pangah pang khat a dingin pi za le sawmnga a sau, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhai suk dalna puan nei ding hi.","title":"Biakbuk Tual (Pai 38:9-20)"},"10":{"text":"A khuam sawmnih le a bullen sawmnih pen sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding a, ahih hangin khuampi tunga vankhainate le a gaknate pen ngun tawh a kibawl hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Leilu lampang a ding zong a sauna tua bangmah hi-in, a kikhai suk dalna puan pi za le sawmnga sau ding a, a khuam sawmnih le a bullen sawmnih pen sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi. Ahi zongin khuampi tunga vankhainate le a gaknate pen ngun tawh a kibawl hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna lam pangah buktual a vailam a dingin khuampi sawm le bullen sawmte tawh pi sawmsagih le nga a sau a kikhai suk dalna puan om ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A mailam, nisuahna lam buktual a vailam pi sawmsagih le nga hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kongpi pang khat-a ding a kikhaisuk dalna puan pi sawmnih le nih le alang hi ding a, khuampi thum le bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A pang langkhatah a kikhaisuk dalna puan pen pi sawmnih le nih le alang hi ding a, khuampi thum le bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Buktual a kongpi dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khau a kopin a kikhuk khau hoihte tawh a kigan, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem, pi sawmthum a sau kongpuankhai khat om ding a, tua in khuampi li le bullen li nei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Buktual kiima khuampi khempeuh ngun tawh kibawl gakna tawh kigak ding a, a vankhainate ngun hi-in a bullente sumngo hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Buktual a dung pi za le sawmnga, a vai pi sawmsagih le nga, a sanna pi sagih le alang hi-in, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhaisuk dalna puan le sumngo bullente tawh hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakbuk nazat ding peuhmahte le a khetphimte khempeuh le buktual a khetphimte khempeuh sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Meivak a kuangin a om tawntung theih nadingin mei a vak ding oliv gah a kisuzan, sathau siangtho, Israel mite in nang kiangah hong paipih nadingun thu na pia ding hi.","title":"Meivak Vilna (Siam 24:1-4)"},"21":{"text":"Kikhopna buk sung, thuciamna singkuang mai-a dalna puan pualamah, Aaron le ama tapate in nitak a kipan zingsang dong Topa’ mai-ah vil ding uh hi. Tua pen Israel mite in amau’ khang tawntungin a zuih ding uh ngeina kip khat hi ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua ciangin keima tungah siampi na a sem dingin Israel mite lak panin na sanggampa Aaron le a tapate Nadab le Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar, nangma kiangah la in.","title":"Siampipuante (Pai 39:1-31)"},"2":{"text":"Minthanna le hoihna tawh a kidim nadingin na sanggampa Aaron a’ ding biakna puan siangtho na bawl ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima siampi nasepna-ah amah a ap theih nadingun amaute in Aaron’ puante a bawl nading, hih theihna lungsim ka guatsa, siamna a nei mite khempeuh tungah gen in."},"4":{"text":"Amaute’ bawl ding puante: Awmdal khat, siampipuan khat, puantualpi khat, sikli nei-a a gial puantungsilh khat, dialpi khat le kawnggak khat ahi hi. Keima tungah siampi na a sem ding na sanggampa Aaron le ama tapate a dingin amaute in biakna puan siangthote bawl ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk tawh a kigan puan hoihte sang ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Amaute in siampipuan pen, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh bawl ding uh a, hoihtakin a kibawl hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A kizop khawm theih nadingin a mong nihte-ah a kimat liangkaihna puan nih nei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah a gak dingin hoihtakin a kigan tua tunga puan om pen, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte tawh kibawlin, a sepna zia le a nate a kibang hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in onik suang nih la-in tuate’ tungah Israel tapate’ min na gelh ding a,"},"10":{"text":"amau’ suahna tawh kizui-in amau’ min gukte suang khat tungah gelhin, a omlai gukte’ min a suang dang khat tungah na gelh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kizepna a bawlpa in min gelhna a bawl bangin Israel tapa sawm le nihte’ minte suang nihte tungah na gelh ding hi. Tuate pen kham a zepna tawh na um ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel tapate phawkna suang dingin siampipuan’ liangkaih puan tungah tua suang nihte na bulh ding hi. Aaron in ama liangko nihte tungah phawkphawk dingin Topa’ mai-ah amaute’ min pua ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kham tawh kibawl a kiphut kizepna le"},"14":{"text":"khau bangin a kihual, kham citak khainiang nih na bawl ding a, a kihual khainiangte pen a kiphutte’ tungah na bulh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Hoihtakin a kibawl thukhenna awmdal khat na bawl ding hi. Siampipuan a kibawl bangmahin na bawl ding hi. Kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puan hoih tawh na bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A ning kikimin thuap nih hi ding a, a dung letmat kua, a vai letmat kua mah hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua sungah suang gual li-in na bulh ding hi. Sardis suang, topaz suang, le karbankal suang gual khat pen a gual masa hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A gual nihna-ah emerald suang, sapfaia suang, le diamond suang hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A gual thumna-ah jakinth suang, agate suang, le amethyst suang hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A gual lina-ah beryl suang, onik suang, le jasper suang hi ding a, kham tawh zepna sungah tuate kibulh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel tapate’ min tawh kituakin amaute’ min a omna suang sawm le nih om ding hi. Tuate pen minam sawm le nihte a dingin amau’ min ciat kigelhin, min gelhna tawh kibang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Awmdal a dingin khau tawh a kibang, a kihual kham citak khainiang na bawl ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Awmdal a dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding a, awmdal mongah tua kualte na bulh ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Awmdal mong a kual nihte sungah kham khau nihte na khum ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Khau mong nihte zepna tawh na zom ding a, siampipuan’ liangkaih puan mai lamah tua bangin na zom ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Kham kual nih na bawl ding a, awmdal mong nih, siampipuan tawh a kizom a sunglamah na bulh ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kham kual nih na bawl ding a, siampipuan liangkaih nihte’ nuai a mailam, hoihtakin a kigan siampi puankhau a kizopna tung sanah na bulh ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan’ khau tungah a om theih nading le siampipuan tung panin awmdal a kol theih loh nadingin amaute in siampipuan’ kualah khaudum khatin a kual tawh gakkhawm ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ mai-ah phawk tawntung nadingin amaute a paipih dingin siangtho munah amah a pai ciangin, Aaron in ama lungtang tunga om thukhenna awmdal sungah Israel tapate’ min pua ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Thukhenna awmdal sungah Urim le Thummim na koih ding a, Topa’ mai-ah a pai ciangin Aaron’ lungtang tungah tuate om ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron in ama lungtang tungah Israel mite’ thukhenna Topa’ mai-ah pua tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Gam 27:21; Thkna 33:8; Ezr 2:63; Neh 7:65"},"31":{"text":"“Siampi puantualpi, puan dum bek tawh na bawl ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Puan ngawng bangin a kikeek loh nadingin a ngawng kimkotah a kigan tawh a kizim, lutang thawl a vang nei ding hi."},"33":{"text":"A mongah a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh a kizem mang kawlsing gah bawlin, a mong kiimah amaute’ kikalah kham siklong bawlin,"},"34":{"text":"puantualpi mong kimkotah kham long le mang kawlsing gah, kham long le mang kawlsing gah cih bangin na kihelhsak ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Aaron in biakna na a sep ciangin tua puan silh ding a, amah a sih khak loh nadingin Topa’ mai a siangtho munah a tum ciang le a pusuah ciangin a gingte kiza ding hi."},"36":{"text":"“Nangmah in kham citak tawh a peek khat na bawl ding a, min gelhna a kibawlte mah bangin tua tungah, ‘ Topa a’ ding siangtho,’ ci-in na gelh ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua pen, khaudum khat tawh dialpi tungah na gak ding a, dialpi mai lamah om ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua pen Aaron’ taltangah om ding a, Israel mite in letsong siangtho a piakna uh ahi, a siangtho biakpiakna-ah mawhna a om peuhmah Aaron in ama tungah pua ding hi. Topa’ mai-ah amaute a kisan’ theih nadingin ama taltang tungah tua a peek om tawntung ding hi."},"39":{"text":"“A puantungsilh ding pen khau hoih tawh siik li nei, a gialin na gan ding hi. Khau hoih tawh dialpi khat na bawl ding a, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem kawnggak khat na bawl ding hi."},"40":{"text":"“Aaron’ tapate a dingin puantungsilhte, kawnggakte, le lukhute na bawl ding a, minthanna le hoihna tawh a kidim nadingin tuate na bawl ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingun na sanggampa Aaron le a tapate na silhsak ding a, amaute sathau nilhin, nasem dingin kipsakin, na siangthosak ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A ci guakin a omna uh a tuam dingin amau a dingin puan hoihte tawh pheituamte na bawlsak ding a, tuate in kawng panin phei ciang ban ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang uh ahi a, siangtho munah nasem dingin biakna tau nai-ah a pai ciang uh ahi zongin, Aaron le ama tapate in tuate a silh ding uh hi. Tua hikeileh amaute in amau tung mahah mawhna a kisuan tawm suakin si ding uh hi. Hih pen amah le ama khit ciangin a suanlekhakte a dingin a om tawntung ngeina kip khat hi ding hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingun amaute na sianthosak nadingin amaute’ tungah na hih ding thute: Bawngtalno khat le a sitbaang lo tuutal nih,","title":"Aaron le A Tapate Apna (Siam 8:1-36)"},"2":{"text":"le silngo sawh loh anlum, sathau a kihel silngo sawh loh mohte, sathau tawh a kizut silngo sawh loh mohphengte la in. Tuate pen mangbuhnel tawh na bawl ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Lawh khat sungah tuate koihin tuate a lawhin paipihin, a bawngtal le a tuutal nih zong na paipih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Kikhopna buk kongkhakah Aaron le a tapate na paipih ding a, tui tawh amaute na sil ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah in puante la-in, puantungsilh le siampi puantualpi, siampipuan le awmdal, Aaron silhsakin, hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan gakna tawh amah na gak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama lu tungah dialpi khim sakin, dialpi tungah kumpi lukhu siangtho na khusak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah in nilh sathau la-in, ama lu tungah sungin amah na nilh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua ciangin nangmah in ama tapate paipihin, amaute, puantungsilh na silhsak ding a,"},"9":{"text":"kawnggakte tawh amaute gakin, amau’ lu tungah a lukhute uh na gak ding hi. Siampi nasepna pen a kip tawntung ngeina ahih manin amau a’ hi ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron le a tapate na kipsak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kikhopna buk mai-ah bawngtal na paipih ding hi. Aaron le a tapate in bawngtal lu tungah amau’ khut nga ding uh a,"},"11":{"text":"Topa’ mai, kikhopna buk kongkhakah nangmah in a bawngtal na go ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bawngtal sisan tawmkhat la-in na khutme tawh biakna tau kite na nuh ding a, si a omlai teng biakna tau bulah na sungkhia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A gilpi tuam a thau khempeuh le a sin tunga a utok le a kal nihte le a kal tuam a thau na la ding a, biakna tau tungah tuate na hal ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin bawngtal sa le a vun le a ekte, giahphual pua lamah mei tawh na hal ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tua ciangin nangmah in tuutalte khat la-in, Aaron le a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau’ khut nga ding uh a,"},"16":{"text":"nangmah in tuutal go-in, a si la-in biakna tau kimkotah na theh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin tuutal semnenin, a sungkua le a khete silin, a sabakte le a lu tawh tuate koihin,"},"18":{"text":"biakna tau tungah tuutal a bupin na hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah meihal biakna hi a, a gim namtui, Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.","ref":"Efe 5:2; Fil 4:18"},"19":{"text":"“Nangmah in tuutal adang khat na la ding hi. Aaron le a tapate in tua tuutal lu tungah amau’ khut nga ding uh a,"},"20":{"text":"nangmah in tuutal go-in, a si tawmkhat la-in Aaron’ taklam bil dawn le ama tapate’ taklam bil dawnte le amau’ taklam khutpi dawnte le amau’ taklam khepi dawnte nuhin, si a omlai teng biakna tau kiimah na theh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakna tau tunga a om si tawmkhat le nilh sathau la-in Aaron le ama puante tung le a tapate le a puante tungah na theh ding hi. Tua ciangin amah le a puante le a tapate le a puante a siangtho hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Nangmah in tuutal thau, a mei, a gilpi tuam a thau, a sin pan a utok, a kal nihte, a kal tuam a thau, le a taklam phei (bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen kipsakna tuutal ahi hi)"},"23":{"text":"le Topa’ mai-ah a om silngo sawh loh anlum lawh sung panin anlum khat, sathau tawh a kibawl anlum bek khat, le moh pheng khat na la ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh Aaron’ khutsung le a tapate’ khut sungah na koih ding a, Topa’ mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin amau’ khutsung panin tuate na la ding a, Topa’ mai-ah a gim namtui dingin biakna tau tungah mei tawh kihal biakna banah na hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Nangmah in Aaron a kikipsakna tuutal sa-iik la-in Topa’ mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding hi. Tua pen nangma tanh hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Kipsakna sa pen Aaron le ama tapate a’ ding ahih ciangin, kipsakna tuutal panin a kipia, a kivei siampite’ tanh a phei le vei-a piak sa-iikte na siangthosak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua pen Aaron le ama tapate a dingin Israel mite’ tung panin a kaih tawntung ding uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thunuama amau’ biakna panin Israel mite in a piak ding siampite’ tanh ahi hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah amau’ piak ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Aaron’ biakna puan siangthote pen ama sih khit ciangin a tapate’ tungah kipia ding a, amaute sathau kinilhin a kikipsak nading ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama za luahin siampi na a sem a tapa in siangtho munah nasem dingin kikhopna bukah a pai ciangin ni sagih sung tuate silh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“Nangmah in kipsakna tuutal la-in a siangtho biakna mun khatah a sa na huan ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in kikhopna buk kongkhakah tuutal sa le lawh sunga om anlum ne ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaute in amaute a kikipsak nading le a siangthosak dingin kilemna a kibawlna tua ante ne ding uh a, ahih hangin a pualam mi in tuate ne thei lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a siangtho biakna an ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Kipsakna sate khat peuhpeuh ahi a, anlum ahi zongin, zingsang ciang dong a omlai leh nangmah in a omlaite mei tawh na hal ding hi. Tuate pen biakna an siangtho ahih manin kine lo ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“Tua bangin nang kong thupiakte khempeuh tawh kituakin Aaron le ama tapate’ tungah na hih ding a, ni sagih sung tawntung amaute ki-apna na bawl ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Kilem nadingin mawhna hanga biakna-in ni simin bawngtal khat na pia ding hi. Siangthosak nadingin sathau na nilh ciang le kilemna na bawl ciangin biakna tau a dingin khialhna hanga biakna khat zong na pia ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Biakna tau a dingin ni sagih sung kilemna bawlin na siangthosak ding hi. Tua ciangin biakna tau a siangtho pen suak ding a, tua biakna tau a lawng peuhpeuh a siangtho suak ding hi."},"38":{"text":"“Tu-in biakna tau tungah na piak tawntung dingte hih bang ahi hi: Nisimin a kizomin kum khat a pha tuuno nihta hi ding hi.","title":"Nisim Biakna (Gam 28:1-8)"},"39":{"text":"Tuuno khat zingsang lamin na pia ding a, adang tuuno khat nitak lamin na pia ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuuno a masa tawh annel lawh khat le a oliv thau hai khat tawh a kihel leh tuibuah dingin leenggahzu hai khat hi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuuno adang khat nitakin na pia ding a, zingsang a mah bangin a gim namtui ding, Topa’ mai-ah mei tawh kihal biakna-in an tawh biakna le tuibuah tawh na pia khawm ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Nang tunga thu kong gen nading, nang tawh ka kituah nading mun, Topa’ mai kikhopna buk kongkhakah na khang tawntungun a kipia tawntung ding meihal biakna hi ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua lai-ah Israel mite tawh ka kituah ding a, keima vang in tua mun siangthosak ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Keimah in kikhopna buk le biakna tau ka siangthosak ding a, keima siampi na a sem dingin Aaron le a tapate zong ka siangthosak ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Israel mite lakah keimah tengin amau’ Pasian ka hi ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Amaute’ lakah keimah ka tenna hangin Egypt leitang panin amaute a paikhiatpih Topa amau’ Pasian ka hihna amaute in hong thei ding uh hi. Kei pen Topa amau’ Pasian ka hi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nangmah in paknamtui hal nading biakna tau khat, singkha sing tawh na bawl ding hi.","title":"Paknamtui Biakna Tau (Pai 37:25-28)"},"2":{"text":"A dung pi khat le alang, a vai zong pi khat le alang mah hi ding hi. A kikim sikli nei hi ding a, a sanna pi thum hi ding hi. A kite a tak tawh sakhat hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in kham citak tawh a tung le a pang kimkot le a kite na zut ding a, a kimkotah kham tawh a geihual na bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua biakna tau a dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding hi. A geihual nuai a kigal sai a pang tuakah tuate na bawl ding a, a puak nading zawlte a khum nading hi ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah in singkha sing tawh a zawlte na bawl ding a, kham tawh tuate na zut ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah tawh ka kituah nading mun, thuciamna tunga a om hehpihna tokhom mai, thuciamna singkuang kiangah a om dalna puan mai-ah biakna tau na koih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Aaron in tua tungah a namtui paknamtui hal ding hi. Amah in zingsang simin meivakte a puah ciangin hal ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aaron in nitakin zong meivakte a koih ciangin tuate hal ding a, na khang tawntungun Topa’ mai-ah a namtui hi tawntung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua tungah a siangtho lo paknamtui hitaleh, meihal biakna hitaleh, an tawh biakna hitaleh na pia kei ding hi. Tua tungah tuibuah na sung kei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aaron in kilem nadingin khialhna hanga biakna si a kite tungah kum khatin khatvei zut ding hi. Amah in na khang tawntungun kum khatin khatvei kilemna bawl ding hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah a siangtho pen ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Kilemna Sum"},"12":{"text":"“Israel mite a phazah na sim ciangin amau’ lakah gimna a tun loh nadingin, a milip in a kitatkhiatna uh Topa’ tungah pia ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi simna-ah a kihel mi peuhmah in biakinn shekel tawh kituakin shekel lang (shekel khatah gerah sawmnih om hi), Topa’ tungah biakna-in pia ding hi.","ref":"Pai 28:25-26; Mat 17:24"},"14":{"text":"Mi simna-ah a kihel, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah in Topa’ tungah biakna pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Note a’ ding kilemna bawl nadingin Topa biakna na piak uh ciangin a haute in shekel lang sangin a tamzaw pia lo ding a, a zawngte in a tawmzaw pia lo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nomau a dingin kilemna bawl nading, Topa’ mai-ah Israel mite ka phawkna a hisak dingin Israel mite tung panin kilemna sum na la ding a, kikhopna buk nasep nadingin na zang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Kisilna Kuang"},"18":{"text":"“Kisil nadingin sumngo kuang khat, le a ngak nading zong sumngo mah tawh bawl in. Nangmah in kikhopna buk le biakna tau kikalah na koih ding a, tua sungah tui na koih ding hi.","ref":"Pai 38:8"},"19":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in a khut uh le a khe uh tua tui tawh sil ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang uh ahi a, Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna hal dingin biakna tau nai-ah a pai ciang uh ahi zongin, amaute a sih loh nadingun amaute tui tawh kisil ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A sih khak loh nadingun a khut uh le a khe uh sil ding uh hi. Tua pen na khang tawntungun amaute tung a kipanin amau’ suanlekhakte tungah ngeina kip khat hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Nilh Sathau le Paknamtui"},"23":{"text":"“A hoihpen a namtui nate la in. Myrrh paknamtui shekel zanga le a namtui thaksing tuazah lang, shekel zanih le sawmnga a gik, le a khum a namtui paknamtui zanih le sawmnga,"},"24":{"text":"biakinn shekel tawh kituakin thaksing nam khat zanga, le oliv thau bung khat,"},"25":{"text":"nangmah in paknamtui bawlte’ bawl mah bangin a siangtho sathau nilh dingin hihte na gawm ding a, tua pen a siangtho sathau nilh hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Nangmah in tua tawh kikhopna buk le thuciamna singkuang,"},"27":{"text":"sabuai le a nazat khempeuh, meivakkhuam le a nazatte le paknamtui biakna tau,"},"28":{"text":"meihal biakna tau a nazat khempeuh tawh, kuang le a ngakna na zut ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuate a siangtho pen ahih theih nadingin na siangthosak ding a, tuate a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Amaute in keima tungah siampi na hong sep theih nadingun Aaron le a tapate nangmah in sathau nilhin amaute na siangthosak ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Nangmah in Israel mite kiangah, ‘Hih pen na khang tawntungun a siangtho keima sathau nilh hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Mi mawkmawkte’ pumpi tungah tua sathau kisung lo ding a, tua bangin a kigawm sathau dang na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen a siangtho hi a, note a dingin a siangtho hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua tawh a kibangin a bawl mi peuhmah ahi a, a pualam mi khatpeuh tuate a nilhsak mi peuhmah ahi zongin ama mite’ kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi, Topa in ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “A namtui nate, stakte, onikha, le galbanum, paknamtui citak tawh a namtui nate (a tamna a kikim ciatin) la inla,"},"35":{"text":"paknamtui bawlte’ hih bangin ci sawhin a nin baang lo, biakna paknamtui bawl in."},"36":{"text":"Nangmah in kimkhat a neu mahmahin na satnen ding a, nang tawh ka kituah nading kikhopna buk sunga thuciamna mai-ah pawlkhat na koih ding hi. Tua pen nangma a dingin a siangtho pen hi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"A kigawmpih ngei teng tawh na bawl ding paknamtui pen note a dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen note a dingin Topa’ tungah a siangtho hi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua tawh a kibangin paknamtui a bawl mi peuhmah ama mite’ kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 37:29"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Bezalel le Oholiab a Kisapna (Pai 35:30-36:1)"},"2":{"text":"“Thei in; Judah minam Hur’ tapa ahi Uri’ tapa Bezalel a minin ka sam khin hi."},"3":{"text":"Lim hoihte a geel ding; kham, ngun, sumngo tawh na a bawl ding; siamna nam khempeuhah nasep nading; bulh ding suangte seekna le singzep nasep a sem dingin vangliatna, siamna, pilna, theihna, le khutsiam nasep khempeuh tawh amah ka kidimsak hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"En in, amah tawh, Dan minam, Ahisamak’ tapa Oholiab ka seh khinzo hi. Amaute in nang kong thupiak khempeuh a bawl theih nadingun a hih thei mi khempeuh tungah siamna ka pia khinzo hi."},"7":{"text":"Amau’ sep dingte hih bang ahi hi: Kikhopna buk, le thuciamna singkuang le a tunga om hehpihna tokhom le buk sung na khempeuh,"},"8":{"text":"sabuai le a nazatte le a siangtho meivakkhuam le a nazatte khempeuh, paknamtui biakna tau,"},"9":{"text":"le meihal biakna tau a nazatte khempeuh tawh, kuang le a ngakna,"},"10":{"text":"le amau’ siampi nasep nadingin siampi Aaron’ puan siangthote le ama tapate’ puante ahi, hoihtakin a kigan puante,"},"11":{"text":"le siangtho mun a dingin nilh sathau le a namtui paknamtui ahi hi. Ka thupiakte khempeuh tawh kituakin nangmah in na bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Lim, Sabbath"},"13":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: ‘Keima Sabbath ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih pen Topa ahi keimah in note a hong siangthosak ka hihna na theih nadingun na khang tawntungun keimah le note’ kikalah lim khat hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note a dingin a siangtho ahi hi. Tua ni-in a tawlnga lo mi peuhmah kithat ding a, tua ni-in na a sem mi peuhmah ama mite’ kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni guk sungin nasep kizo ding hi. Ahih hangin a ni sagih ni pen a thupi-a tawlngakna Sabbath ni hi a, Topa’ tungah siangtho hi. Sabbath ni-in nasep khat peuhpeuh a sem mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.","ref":"Pai 20:8-11; 23:12; 34:21; 35:2; Siam 23:3; Thkna 5:12-14"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a tawntung thuciamna-in amau’ khang tawntungin Sabbath tangin, Israel mite in Sabbath kem ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ni guk sung teng Topa in van le lei bawlin, a ni sagih ni-in amah tawlnga a, a tha dimsakkik hi. Keimah le Israel mite’ kikalah hih Sabbath ni pen lim khat hi tawntung ding hi, ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 20:11"},"18":{"text":"Sinai Mual tungah thugenna a man khit ciangin Pasian’ khut tawh a kigelh suangpek ahi thuciamna suangpek nihte, amah in Moses a pia hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mualtung panin Moses hong tunsuk hakna mite in a theih uh ciangin, Aaron kiangah mite amau mah kikaikhawm tawmin ama kiangah, “Kithawi in; kote’ mai-ah a pai ding pasian hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih to Moses ahihleh bang suak khin cih i thei kei hi,” a ci uh hi.","title":"Kham Bawngno (Thkna 9:7-29)","ref":"Sawl 7:40"},"2":{"text":"Aaron in amaute kiangah, “Na zite, na tapate, le na tanute uh bil tungah a om kham bilbahte sutkhia unla, kei kiangah tuate hong paipih un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh in amau’ bil-a om kham bilbahte sutkhia-in Aaron’ kiangah tuate a paipih uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in amaute’ tung panin kham saangin, sumtui sunna sungah sungin, a kisung bawngno khat bawlsak a, tua ciangin mite in, “Israel mite aw, hih pen Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih to na pasian uh!” a ci uh hi.","ref":"1Kum 12:28; Sawl 7:41"},"5":{"text":"Aaron in hih thu a muh ciangin, amah in tua mai-ah biakna tau khat lam a, “Zing ciang pen Topa a’ ding pawi bawl ni hi ding hi,” ci-in zaksakna a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute zingsangin tho baih uh a, meihal biakna pia-in thunuama biakna zong a paipih uh hi. Pawi an ne-in mite tu uh a, zu khamin numei pasal kisawk ngeingai uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 10:7"},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Paisuk in; bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt leitang panin nangmah in na paikhiatpih toh mite amau kisiasak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thupiakna lampi panin amaute kiheikhia pak uh hi. Amau a dingin amaute in a kisung bawngno khat bawlin, tua bia-in a tungah biakna pia uh a, ‘Israel mite aw, hih pen Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih to na pasian uh ahi hi!’ ci uh hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Hih mite ka mu zo hi. En in, a lungkhauh mite ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in amaute tungah ka sinso-in amaute ka beisak theih nadingin kei guak hong omsak in. Ahi zongin nang ahihleh minam lian khatin kong bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin Moses in Topa ama Pasian tungah thum a, “ Topa aw, na vangliatna le na thahatna tawh Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih ahi nangma mite tungah bang hangin sinso ding na hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Bang hangin Egypt mite in, ‘Mualtungah amaute a that ding le leitung panin amaute a beisak dingin siatna ngaihsutna tawh amah in amaute paikhiatpih hi,’ ci ding uh ahi hiam? A kihtakhuai na hehna daisak inla, na lungsim kheelin na mite tungah hih siatna tungsak kei in."},"13":{"text":"Amaute’ tungah nangmahmah kiciamin, ‘Na suanlekhakte uh vantung aksi bangin tamsakin, keimah in ka ciamsa hih leitang khempeuh na suanlekhakte uh tungah ka pia ding a, amaute in luah tawntung ding uh hi,’ na cihna na nasemte Abraham, Isaac, le Israel phawk in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 17:8; 22:16-17"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in a lungsim kheel a, ama mite’ tungah a tunsak ding siatna tungsak nawn lo hi.","ref":"Gam 14:13-19"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses kihei-in, a khutsunga om thuciamna suangpek nih, a pang langnih tuakah a kigelh suangpeekte tawh mualtung panin a paisuk hi."},"16":{"text":"A peekte pen Pasian’ bawl hi a, a kigelh thute pen suangpek tungah Pasian’ gelh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Joshua in amaute’ kiko gamlumna a zak ciangin Moses kiangah, “Giahphual ah kido-a gamlumna om hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin Moses in, “Tu-a gamlumna pen zawhna kikona aw ahi a, lelhna kikona aw ahi zongin, tua bang pawl hi lo hi. Ahih hangin tu-a ka zak pen lasakna awging ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Giahphual nai-ah amah tungin bawngno le lamna a muh phetin, Moses heh mahmah a, amah in ama khutsung panin suangpeekte lawn a, mual bulah tuate a sukham hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in amaute’ bawlsa bawngno la-in mei tawh hal a, gawivui-in tui tungah theh a, Israel mite a tui dawnsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Moses in Aaron kiangah, “Amaute’ tungah khialhna lianpi khat na tunpih nadingin hih mite in nang’ tungah bang hong gen uh ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in, “Ka topa aw, heh lua kei in. Mite’ lungsim na theihsa ahih mah bangin amaute in siatna ngaihsun uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in keima kiangah, ‘Kote’ mai-ah a pai ding pasian hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih to Moses ahihleh, bang suak khin cih i thei kei hi,’ ci uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Keimah in amaute kiangah, ‘Kham a nei peuhpeuh in sutkhia un,’ ka ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in kei’ tungah hong pia uh a, keimah in mei sungah tuate ka lawn a, hih bawngno hong suak hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Mite a tatkhialhna Moses in a muh ciangin (bang hang hiam cih leh Aaron in amau’ maizum nadingin amau’ galte’ lakah amaute takhialsak hi),"},"26":{"text":"giahphual kongpi sungah Moses ding a, “ Topa’ lamah kua teng om na hi uh hiam? Kei’ kiangah hong pai un,” a ci hi.
