Levi mite khempeuh ama kiangah hong kikaikhawm uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in amaute kiangah, “Israel-te’ Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: ‘A milip in a namsau a pangah tawi-in kongpi khat pan kongpi khat, giahphual khempeuhah pai kawikawi-in, a milip in a sanggampa, a milip in a kikholhpih pa, a milip in a vengpa that hen,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"28":{"text":"Moses’ thugen bangin Levi mite gamta uh a, tua ni-in mihing tulthum bang si hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Note’ tungah thupha hong tun theih nadingin ama tapa le a sanggamte ciat supna thuakin Topa’ na sep nadingah tuni-in note na kikipsak tawm uh hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin Moses in mite kiangah, “Note in khialhna lianpi khat na bawl khin uh hi. Tu-in Topa’ kiangah kei ka pai ding a, note’ khialhna thu-ah kilemna ka va bawl thei kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ kiangah Moses paikikin, “Ala, hih mite in khialhna lianpi khat bawl khin uh a, amaute in amau a dingin kham pasian khat bawl khin uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in tu-in amau’ khialhna maisak in. Na maisak kei ding leh, hong thum ing, nangma gelhsa laibu panin keimah hong phiatmai in,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 69:28; Mang 3:5"},"33":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Kei’ tungah hong khial peuhmah, ka laibu panin ka phiat ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahih hangin tu-in pai in; nang’ tunga kong gensa munah mite paipih in. En in, na mai-ah ka vantungmi pai ding hi. Ahi zongin ka thukkik ni ciangin amau’ khialhna amau’ tungah ka thuk ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaute in Aaron’ bawlsa bawngno bia uh ahih manin Topa in mite’ tungah gimna a tungsak hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Hih mun nusia un; Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tungah, ‘Na suanlekhakte uh tungah ka pia ding hi,’ ci-a ka ciam leitangah nangmah le Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih toh mite tawh hih lai panin paito un.","title":"Paikhiat ding Thupiakna","ref":"Pian 12:7; Pian 26:3; Pian 28:13"},"2":{"text":"Note’ mai-ah vantungmi khat ka sawl ding a, Kanaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite ka hawlkhia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna leitangah paito un. Ahi zongin note hong sisak kha ding ka hih ciangin note’ lakah kei kong paito kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note mi lungkhauh na hi uh hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Mite in hih thusiate a zak uh ciangin amaute thuum uh a, kuamah kizem lo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Moses kiangah, “Israel mite’ tungah hih bangin gen in: ‘Note mi lungkhauh na hi uh hi. Note’ lakah tomno khat sung hong paito leng, note kong beisak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin note kong bawl nading ka theih nadingin note’ tung panin na kizepnate uh suahkhia un,’ ci in,” ci-in gen khinzo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite in Horeb Mual pan a kipanin amau’ kizepnate suahkhia uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite in giahphual a sat simin Moses in puanbuk la-in giahphual panin a gamla pekah lam thei zel hi. Amah in tua pen kikhopna buk, ci hi. Topa’ tungah thu a dong nuam mi peuhmah giahphual pualama om kikhopna bukah paikhia uh hi.","title":"Kikhopna Buk"},"8":{"text":"Puanbukah Moses a pai peuhpeuh ciangin mi khempeuh ding to-in, a milipin a puanbuk kong ciat uhah ding uh a, puanbuk sungah a tum khit mateng Moses’ nung en uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Puanbukah Moses a tum ciangin meii khuam hong kum sukin puanbuk kongkhakah ding a, Topa in Moses hopih hi."},"10":{"text":"Puanbuk kongkhakah meii khuam a ding a muh uh ciangin a milipin a puanbuk kong ciat uhah mi khempeuh dingto-in kun uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bangin, mi khat in a lawmpa a hopih bangin maitang kituahin Topa in Moses hopih zel hi. Giahphual ah Moses a ciahkik ciangin, Nun’ tapa, ama nasem tangval Joshua, puanbukah omlai hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Topa’ kiangah, “Thei in; nangmah in keima kiangah, ‘Hih mite paipihto in,’ nong ci hi. Ahih hangin kei tawh nong sawlkhop ding mi kei nong theisak nai kei hi. Ahi zongin nangmah in, ‘Na minin nang kong thei a, ka mai-ah maipha zong na mu khin hi,’ nong ci khin hi.","title":"Ompih ding Kamciamna"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang tungah kong thum hi; na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah leh keimah in nang hong thei-in, na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah theih nadingin tu-in nangma geelnate kei hong lak in. Hih minam pen nangma mite ahihna zong ngaihsun in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Nang tawh kong pai ding a, lungsim tawlngakna hun nang kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses in ama kiangah, “Nang nong paipih kei ding leh, hih lai panin kote hong paikhiatosak kei in."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah le nangma mite in nangma muhna-ah maipha ka ngahna uh bang ci-in kithei ding ahi hiam? Leitung a om mi khempeuh tungah keimah le nangma mite ka tungnunna uh pen kote tawh nang nong paikhopna hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Nangma gensa hih thu mahmah keimah in ka hih ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka muhna-ah nang in maipha na ngahzo a, na minin nang kong thei hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in, “Kong thum hi; na vangliatna kei hong lak in,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in, “Keima hoihna khempeuh na mai-ah ka paisak ding a, na mai-ah keima min, ‘ Topa ’ cihna ka pulak ding hi. Ka diknopna mite tungah ka dik ding a, ka hehpihnop mite ka hehpih ding hi.","ref":"Rom 9:15"},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in ka maitang na mu thei kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi in kei hong mu leh tuami nungta lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua banah Topa in, “En in; suang tungah na din nading keima kiangah mun khat om hi."},"22":{"text":"Keima minthanna vang a pai laitakin suanghawm sungah nang kong koih ding a, kei ka paikhiat mateng ka khut tawh nang kong hum ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in ka khut ka lakhia ding hi. Nangmah in ka nung na mu ding a, ahih hangin ka maitang na mu kei ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “A masa tawh a kibangin suangpek nih sui in. Na sukkhap a masa suangpeekte sunga om thute tuate tungah ka gelh kik ding hi.","title":"A Nihveina Suangpeekte (Thkna 10:1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Kithawi-in Sinai Mual tungah zingsangin hong paito inla, mual dawn tua munah keima kiangah hong kilak in."},"3":{"text":"Nang tawh kuamah hong paito khawmsak kei inla, mualtung tengah kuamah omsak kei in. Tua mual mai-ah tuuhon ahi a, bawnghon ahi zongin gamtasak kei in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a masa bangin suangpek nih a sui hi. Zingsang ciangin amah tho baihin, Topa in amah a thupiaksa bangin Sinai Mual tungah paito a, a khut sungah suangpek nih a tawi hi."},"5":{"text":"Meii sungah Topa kum sukin tua lai-ah Moses tawh ding a, Topa in ama min a pulak hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama mai-ah Topa pai-in, “Topa , Topa , hehpihna nei-in a dik Pasian; lungduai-in itna kip le thutakna tawh a dim;"},"7":{"text":"mi tul tampite a dingin itna kip a nei; mawhna, thu palsatna le khialhna maisakin; ahih hangin bangbang hitaleh mawhna a khahkhong ngei lo; pate’ mawhna tate’ tung le tute’ tung, khang thum khang lina dongin a thukpa,” ci-in a pulak hi.","ref":"Pai 20:5-6; Gam 14:18; Thkna 5:9-10; 7:9-10"},"8":{"text":"Moses in leilak lamah a lu kunin a bia hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in, “Tu-in na muhna-ah maipha ka muh leh, Topa aw, kong thum hi; lungkhauh mite ka hita uh zongin kote’ kiangah Topa hong pai in. Kote’ mawhna le kote’ khialhna hong maisak inla, nangma mi dingin kote hong sang in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “En in, keimah in thuciamna khat ka bawl hi. Nangma mi khempeuh’ muhna-ah, leitung khempeuh hitaleh minam khatpeuh sungah hitaleh cikmahin tua bang a kibawl ngei lo na lamdangte ka bawl ding a, note’ lakah a om mite khempeuh in Topa’ nasepna mu ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ tungah kong bawl ding na pen a kihtakhuai thu ahi hi.","title":"Thuciamna Kibawlthakkik (Pai 23:14-19 ; Thkna 7:1-5 ; 16:1-17)"},"11":{"text":"“Tuni-a kong thupiak zui in. En in, na mai-ah Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite ka hawlkhia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na paina leitangah a teng mite tawh thuciamna bawlkha kei inla, tua pen note a dingin thangzak a suahkhak loh nadingin nangmahmah kidawm in."},"13":{"text":"Nangmah in amau’ biakna taute phelin, amau’ biakna khuamte kuaitanin, amau’ Asherah milimte na phukpai ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 16:21"},"14":{"text":"”(Pasian dang na bia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa , ama min Aam a hi pa pen a aam Pasian ahi hi.)"},"15":{"text":"Nangmah in tua leitangah a teng mite tawh thuciamna bawlkha kei in. Amaute in amau’ pasian-te tawh paktatna bawlin amau’ pasian-te’ tungah biakna pia-in, khatpeuh in note hong sap ciangin, note in ama biakpiakna na ne kha ding uh a,"},"16":{"text":"note in amau’ tanute na tapate uh a dingin la-in, amau’ pasian-te tawh paktatna a bawl a tanute in amau’ pasian-te tawh na tapate uh paktatsak kha ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“A kisung pasian-te note a dingin bawlin na bia kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 20:4; Siam 19:4; Thkna 5:8; 27:15"},"18":{"text":"“Silngo sawh loh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Abib kha, a kisehsa hun sungteng, nang kong thupiak mah bangin ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Abib kha sungin Egypt panin note na paikhia uh hi.","ref":"Pai 12:14-20; Siam 23:6-8; Gam 28:16-25"},"19":{"text":"“Mihing le ganhing tacil a pa khempeuh keima-a’ ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 13:2"},"20":{"text":"La a tacilte tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi. Na tat kei uhleh a ngawng na kuaitan ding uh hi. Na tapa cilte khempeuh uh na tanh ding uh hi. Keima mai-ah a guakin kuamah hong kilak lo ding hi.","ref":"Pai 13:13"},"21":{"text":"“Ni guk sung na na sem ding uh a, ahi zongin a ni sagih ni-in na tawlnga ding uh hi. Lokhawh hun le anlak hun sungin zong na tawlnga ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 20:9-10; 23:12; 31:15; 35:2; Siam 23:3; Thkna 5:13-14"},"22":{"text":"“Nipikalte’ pawi, mangbuh a tung masa pawi, le kum bei ciangin an kaihkhop pawi na bawl ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 23:15-21,39-43; Gam 28:26-31"},"23":{"text":"“Pasal khempeuh Israel Pasian, Topa Pasian’ mai-ah kum khatin thumvei kilak ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ mai-ah minam dangte ka hawlkhia ding a, na gamgite uh nomau a dingin ka keek ding hi. Topa na Pasian uh’ mai-ah kum khatin thumvei a kilak dingin na paitoh sungun na leitang uh mi khat peuhpeuh in a hong deihgawh khak ding lunghihmawhna om lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Note in silngo tawh keimah biakpiakna si na pia khawm kei ding uh a, Paisan Pawi biakpiakna zong zingsang dong na omsak kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 12:10"},"26":{"text":"“Note in na anpalte uh lakah a tung masa pen Topa na Pasian uh’ inn-ah na paipih ding uh hi. “Note in keelno a pi’ nawizu tawh na huan kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 26:2; Thkna 14:21"},"27":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Hih thute gelh in. Hih thute tawh kizui-in nang le Israel tawh thuciamna khat ka bawlzo hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua lai-ah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa tawh Moses om a, tua hun sungteng anletui a ne kei hi. Amah in suangpek tungah thuciamna kammalte ahi thupiak sawmte a gelh hi."},"29":{"text":"A khut sungah thuciamna suangpek nih tawh Sinai Mual tung panin Moses hong paisuk ciangin, Pasian tawh amah kiho khin ahih manin a maitang vun a taan lamtak Moses in thei lo hi.","title":"Mualtung pan Moses Kumsuk"},"30":{"text":"Aaron le Israel mite khempeuh in Moses a muh ciangin, a maitang vun na taang a, ama mai-ah a pai ding uh amaute lau uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute kiangah Moses pai hi. Aaron le mihon makaite khempeuh ama kiangah hong paikik uh a, Moses in amaute hopih hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Israel mi khempeuh a nai-ah hong pai uh a, Topa in Sinai Mual-ah ama tunga a gen khempeuh thupiakna-in amaute tungah a pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses in amaute tawh thugen a man khit ciangin, amah in a maitangah kiliahna puan khat a koih hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa tawh a kiho dingin ama mai-ah Moses a tum peuhpeuh ciangin, amah a pusuah kik mateng a kiliahna puan la khia hi. Amah hong paikhia-in ama tungah a kipia thute Israel mite kiangah a gen ciangin,"},"35":{"text":"Israel mite in Moses’ maitang vun a taang mu uh hi. Amah tawh a kiho dingin a pai matengin Moses in kiliahna puan tawh a maitang a khuh kik hi.","ref":"2Kor 3:7-16"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Israel mihonpi khempeuh khawmin amaute kiangah, “Hihte pen note’ hih ding Topa’ hong thupiak ahi hi.","title":"Sabbath Ngeinate"},"2":{"text":"Ni guk sungin nasep kiman ding a, ahih hangin a ni sagih ni-in thupi-a tawlngakna Sabbath siangtho Topa’ tungah na nei ding uh hi. Tua ni-in na khat peuhpeuh a sem peuhmah kithat ding hi.","ref":"Pai 20:8-11; 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; Siam 23:3; Thkna 5:12-14"},"3":{"text":"Sabbath ni-in na tenna khempeuh uhah mei na cih kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Israel mihonpite khempeuh tungah, “ Topa’ hong thupiak hih bang ahi hi:","title":"tungah Biakna (Pai 25:1-9)"},"5":{"text":"Note in Topa’ tungah biakna na pia ding uh hi. A pia nuam peuhmah in Topa’ tungah biakna paipih un. Tuate in: Kham, ngun le sumngo,"},"6":{"text":"a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte, keelmul,"},"7":{"text":"a kisansak tuutal vunte le savunte; singkha sing,"},"8":{"text":"meivak a’ ding sathau, nilh sathau le a paknamtui dingin a namtui nate,"},"9":{"text":"siampipuan le awmdalah bulh dingin onik suang le suang dangte ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Note’ lak panin siamna a nei mi peuhmah hong paisak unla, Topa’ thupiaksa khempeuh bawlsak un. Tua a bawl dingte pen biakbuk,","title":"Biakbuk Nate (Pai 39:32-43)"},"11":{"text":"a puanbuk le a khuhna, a vankhainate le a khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, a bullente;"},"12":{"text":"singkuang a zawlte tawh, hehpihna tokhom le kongkhak dalna puan;"},"13":{"text":"sabuai a zawlte le a nazatte khempeuh tawh, Ompihna Anlum;"},"14":{"text":"khuavak dingin meivakkhuam zong, a nazatte le a meivakte tawh, meivak dingin sathau;"},"15":{"text":"paknamtui biakna tau, a zawlte tawh, nilh sathau le a namtui paknamtui le biakbuk kongah kongkhak a’ ding puankhai;"},"16":{"text":"meihal biakna tau, a sumngo siklen, a zawlte, a nazatte khempeuh, kuang le a ngakna tawh;"},"17":{"text":"buktual a a puankhaite, a khuampite le a bullente tawh, tual kongpi a’ ding puankhai;"},"18":{"text":"biakbuk khetphimte le huang khetphimte, le a khaute;"},"19":{"text":"siangtho munah zat dingin limtakin a kigan puante, amau’ siampi nasep nadingin siampi Aaron a’ ding puan siangtho le ama tapate’ puante ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mihonpi khempeuh Moses’ omna panin paikhia uh hi.","title":"Mite in Biakna hong Paipih"},"21":{"text":"Piak nopna lungsim a nei mi peuhmah hong pai tawm uh a, kikhopna buk le a nasep nading khempeuh le puan siangthote a zat dingin Topa a’ ding a piakte uh hong puak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin numei, pasal hong pai uh hi. Piak nopna lungsim a neite khempeuh in tukkilhte, bilbahte, min gelhna zungbuhte, le banbulhte ahi kham tawh a kibawl na namkim hong paipih uh a, a milip in Topa’ tungah kham tawh piakna ap uh hi."},"23":{"text":"A dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute, puan hoih, keelmul, a kisansak tuutal vunte, ahih kei leh savun hoihte ahi zongin a nei mi peuhmah in tuate hong paipih uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin a pia thei peuhmah in Topa’ tungah tua nate paipih uh a, nasep nadinga kimang thei ding singkha sing a nei mi peuhmah in zong hong paipih hi."},"25":{"text":"A hih thei numei khempeuh in a khut uh tawh khau khuk uh a, amau’ khuksa a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk khaute hong paipih uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Hih theih siamna a nei numei khempeuh in zong keelmul khuk uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Makaite in siampipuan le awmdal a bulh dingin onik suang le suang dangte,"},"28":{"text":"meivak ding, nilh sathau ding, le paknamtui dingin a namtui nate le sathau hong paipih uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Moses tunga a thupiaksa nasep nadingin na khat peuhpeuh a pia nuam numei pasal Israel mi khempeuh in utthu-a biakna-in Topa’ tungah hong paipih uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Moses in Israel mite kiangah, “Thei un; Topa in a minin Judah minam, Hur’ tapa Uri, Uri’ tapa Bezalel sam khin hi.","title":"Bezalel le Oholiab a Kisapna (Pai 31:1-11)"},"31":{"text":"Lim hoihte a geel ding; kham, ngun, sumngo tawh na a bawl ding; siamna nam khempeuh nasep nading, bulh ding suang seekna, le singzep nasep a sem dingin amah in vangliatna, siamna, pilna, theihna, le khutsiam nasep khempeuh tawh amah kidimsak hi.","merge":"33"},"34":{"text":"Topa in amah le Dan minam Ahisamak’ tapa Oholiab tungah midangte hilh siamna pia khin hi."},"35":{"text":"Amah in khutsiam nasep, geelsiam nasep; a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puanzep siam nasep; siamgat siamna, le geelsiam nasep ahi zongin nasep namkim a sem dingin amaute tungah siamna a guan hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bezalel le Oholiab le biakbuk lamna-ah nasep khat peuhpeuh sep nading zia a thei dingin Topa in siamna le pilna a guat mi peuhmah in Topa’ thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kituakin sem ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Moses in Bezalel le Oholiab le Topa in nasep siamna a guat mi, nasem a pai dingin a ut mi peuhmah a sam hi.","title":"Mite in Letsong Tampi hong Paipih"},"3":{"text":"Israel mite in biakbuk sep nadingin utthu-a a piak uh nate a paipih khempeuh uh amaute in Moses’ tung panin a sang uh hi. Amaute in zingsang simin utthu-a piakna ama tungah paipih uh ahih manin,"},"4":{"text":"biakbuk nasep a namkim a sem mi khempeuh amau’ nasepna ciat panin hong pai uh a,"},"5":{"text":"Moses kiangah, “ Topa in eite’ sep dingin a hong sawl nasep nadingin a kicing ding zahval, mite in tampi hong paipih uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in thu pia-in giahphual khempeuhah thu kizasak a, “Numei hitaleh pasal hitaleh kuamah in biakbuk-a dingin pia thuah nawn kei un,” kici hi. Tua ahih ciangin a piak ding uh mite kikho hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ piaksa nate pen nasepna khempeuh hih nadingin kicing a, valzaw lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Nasem mite’ lak panin a hih thei mi khempeuh in puan dal sawm tawh biakbuk bawl uh hi. Tuate pen a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih le a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh kibawlin hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh zem uh hi.","title":"Biakbuk Bawlna (Pai 26:1-37)"},"9":{"text":"Tua puan a dung pi sawmli le nih, a vai pi guk ciat hi a, a puan khempeuh kikim hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in puan dal ngate khatlekhat khuituahin, puan adang ngate zong khatlekhat mah khuituah uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in a kikhuituah masa puan a nawlnung pen nawl dung sukah khau dum tawh a bilvangte bawl uh a, tua mah bangin a kikhuituah nihna puan a nawlnung pen nawl dung sukah zong tuate mah a bawl uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in puan khat tungah bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituah a nihna puan nawlah bilvang sawmnga mah bawl uh a, a bilvangte khatlekhat kitang hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in kham kilhna sawmnga bawlin, tua kilhnate tawh a puan khatlekhat kimatsak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin biakbuk puan bupkhat a suak hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk a tung khuh nadingin keelmul tawh puan dal sawm le khat a bawl uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua puante a dung pi sawmli le nga, a vai pi guk ciat hi a, tua puan sawm le khatte kikim hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute in puan dal ngate khatlekhat khuituahin, a puan dang gukte zong khatlekhat mah a khuituah uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in a kikhuituah puan khat a nawlnung pen nawlah a bilvang sawmnga bawlin, puan dal a zom nawlah a bilvang sawmnga mah a bawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuate bup khat a suah theih nading, puanbuk a kimatsak dingin amaute in kilhna sawmnga sumngo tawh a bawl uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in puanbuk-a dingin a kisansak tuutal vunte le keel vunte tawh khuhna khat a bawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in biakbuk-a dingin singkha sing tawh a po to khawm ding khuampeekte a bawl uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A khuampeekte khat a tun pi sawm le pi nga hi a, a vai pi nih le letmat thum ciat ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A bulh nadingin khuampeek khat in zang nih ciat nei a, amaute in biakbuk khuam khempeuh a dingin a bawl uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk-a dingin khuampeekte hih bangin bawl uh hi: Leitaw lampang a dingin khuam sawmnih;"},"24":{"text":"a khuampeek sawmnihte’ bulah bullen sawmli ngun tawh, a zang nihte a dingin khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, le a khuampeek dang khat bulah a zang nihte a dingin bullen nih mah a bawl uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Biakbuk a pang nihna lam, leilu lampang a dingin amaute in khuampeek sawmnih"},"26":{"text":"le ngun tawh kibawl a bullen sawmli, khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, adang khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih mah a bawl uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Nitumna lam, biakbuk nung lama dingin amaute in khuampeek guk a bawl uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Biakbuk nung lam kiute a dingin a khuampeek nih zong a bawl uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuate a bul lamah kikak a, ahih hangin a kual masa ah a dawn kimat hi. A kiu nihte-a dingin tua bangin nih a bawl uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngun tawh kibawl amau’ bullente tawh khuampeek giat om hi: Bullen sawm le guk om a, khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih ciat a om hi."},"31":{"text":"Amaute in singkha singzawl, biakbuk pang khat-a khuampeekte-a’ dingin nga,"},"32":{"text":"biakbuk a pang langkhat a khuampeekte a dingin zawl nga, nitumna lam biakbuk nung lampang a khuampeekte a dingin zawl nga mah a bawl uh hi."},"33":{"text":"A khuampeekte’ kimciang takah mong khat panin mong khat dongin a zawl laita paisuaksak uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaute in kham tawh khuampeekte zutin, zawlte a len dingin kham tawh a kualte bawl uh a, kham tawh a zawlte a zut uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaute in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh dalna puan a bawl uh hi. Hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh amaute in tua dalna puan a zem uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua puan a dingin amaute in singkha khuampi li bawl uh a, kham tawh tua khuampite a zut uh hi. A vankhainate pen kham hi a, tua khuamte a dingin ngun bullen li a sung uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amaute in puanbuk kongkhak-a dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem, a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh kongpuankhai khat le,"},"38":{"text":"a khuampi ngate a vankhainate tawh a bawl uh hi. Amaute in tuate’ luzepnate kham tawh zutin, a gaknate kham hi a, ahih hangin a bullen ngate pen sumngo ahi hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel in singkha sing tawh singkuang bawl a, a dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum mah ahi hi.","title":"Singkuang Bawlna (Pai 25:10-22)"},"2":{"text":"Kham citak tawh a sung le a pua zutin, a kimkotah kham geihual khat a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"A kiu lite a dingin kham kual li, a pang khatah kual nih, a pang langkhat a dingin kual nih mah a sung hi."},"4":{"text":"Singkha singzawlte zong bawl a, kham tawh tuate zutin,"},"5":{"text":"singkuang puak nadingin singkuang panga kualte sungah a zawlte a khum hi."},"6":{"text":"Kham citak tawh hehpihna tokhom khat bawl a, a dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in sek tawh a kiseek kham tawh kherub nih, hehpihna tokhom mong tuakah a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Kherub khat mong khatah, kherub khat a mong langkhatah om a, a mong nihte-ah hehpihna tokhom tawh sakhatin kherub-te a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Kherub-te in a khate uh tua tokhom tungah zalin, amau’ khate tawh hehpihna tokhom liimsun uh a, amaute khatlekhat kimaingat uh hi. Hehpihna tokhom lamah kherub-te’ mai a nga hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in singkha sing tawh sabuai zong bawl a, a dung pi thum, a vai pi khat le alang, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum ahi hi.","title":"Sabuai Bawlna (Pai 25:23-30)"},"11":{"text":"Kham citak tawh zut a, a kimkotah kham tawh a geihual khat a bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Khut peek cia a pha zawl khat a kimkotah bawl a, a zawl kimkotah kham geihual khat a bawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua sabuai a dingin kham kual li sungin, a kiu li, a khe lite-ah a kualte a gak hi."},"14":{"text":"Sabuai puak nading zawlte a len dingin a zawl gei-ah a kualte om hi."},"15":{"text":"Sabuai puak nadingin singkha singzawlte bawl a, kham tawh tuate a zut hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in sabuai tunga om ding beellekuangte, paknamtui a dingin kuangdaite le pakante, tui buah nadingin kuang-ukte le thawl gongbakte, kham citak tawh a bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in kham citak tawh meivakkhuam zong a bawl hi. Meivakkhuam a bul le a kungte pen a kiseek nate tawh kibawl hi. A haite, a nunte, le a paakte, meivakkhuam tawh sakhat ahi hi.","title":"Meivakkhuam Bawlna (Pai 25:31-40)"},"18":{"text":"A pangte panin hiang guk meengkhia a, a pang khatah meivakkhuam hiang thum omin, a pang langkhatah meivakkhuam hiang thum mah a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Hiang khat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum, le adang hiang khat ciat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum mah kibawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin meivakkhuam panin a hiang gukte a meengkhia ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"A meivakkhuam tung mahmahah a nun le a pak tawh a om, almond gah bangin a kibawl hai li omin,"},"21":{"text":"meivakkhuam panin hiang guk a kopte’ bulah tua tawh sakhat ahi nun khat om hi."},"22":{"text":"Amau’ nunte le a hiangte pen tua tawh sakhat hi a, a buppi-in kham citak a kiseek sakhat ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"A meivak sagihte le a taitehte le a kuangte kham citak a bawl ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in kham citak tawi sawmnih le tawi khat a gik tawh tua meivakkhuam le a nazatte khempeuh a bawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in singkha sing tawh paknamtui biakna tau bawl a, a dung pi khat le alang, a vai pi khat le alang mah ahi hi. Tua pen a ning kikim a, a sanna pi thum hi a, a kite pen tua biakna tau tawh sakhat ahi hi.","title":"Paknamtui Biakna tau Bawlna (Pai 30:1-5)"},"26":{"text":"Amah in a tungzang, a kimkota a pangte le a kite kham citak tawh a zut hi. A kimkotah kham geihual khat"},"27":{"text":"le a puak nading zawlte a len dingin a pang tuak a geihual nuai takah kham kual nih a bawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in singkha sing tawh a zawlte bawlin, kham tawh tuate a zut hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in paknamtui bawlte’ gawm bangin a siangtho nilh sathau le a siangtho a namtui paknamtui zong a bawl hi.","title":"Nilh Sathau le Paknamtui Bawlna (Pai 30:22-38)","ref":"Pai 30:22-38"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah in meihal biakna tau zong singkha sing tawh bawl a, a dung pi sagih le alang, a vai pi sagih le alang mah ahi hi. A ning kikim a, a sanna pi li le alang ahi hi.","title":"Meihal Biakna tau Bawlna (Pai 27:1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Amah in tua tau a dingin a kiu lite-ah a kite a bawl hi. A kite, a tau tawh sakhat hi a, sumngo tawh a zut hi."},"3":{"text":"Biakna tau nazat khempeuh, beelte, kawbiate, kuangte, sikkate le vutluahna peekte a bawl hi. A nazat khempeuh sumngo tawh a bawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Biakna tau a dingin a zawl nuai-ah, a kimciang a ban suk, a vang simsiam, sumngo siklen khat a bawl hi."},"5":{"text":"A zawlte a len dingin sumngo siklen kiu lite’ tunga ding a kual li a sung hi."},"6":{"text":"Singkha sing tawh a zawlte bawl a, sumngo tawh tuate a zut hi."},"7":{"text":"A puak nadingin biakna tau pangte a om a kualte sungah a zawlte khum a, singpekte tawh biakna tau a kuakin a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in kikhopna buk kongkhakah na a sem numeite’ limlangte panin sumngo tawh kisilna kuang le a ngakna a bawl hi.","title":"Kisilna Kuang Bawlna (Pai 30:18)","ref":"Pai 30:18"},"9":{"text":"Amah in buktual a bawl hi. Leitaw lampang buktual a puan kikhaite pen a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih hi a, pi za le pi sawmnga a sau hi.","title":"Biakbuk Tual (Pai 27:9-19)"},"10":{"text":"A khuampite sawmnih hi a, a bullente zong sawmnih mah ahi hi. Sumngo tawh kibawl a, ahih hangin a vankhainate le a gaknate ngun ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Leilu lampang a ding zong tua bangmah ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna lampang a dingin puan kikhai sukte pi sawmsagih le pi nga hi a, a khuampite sawm hi-in, a bullente sawm mah hi a, a vankhainate le a gaknate ngun ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A mailam, nisuahna lama dingin pi sawmsagih le pi nga mah ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Kongpi pang khat-a ding puan kikhai sukte pen pi sawmnih le nih le alang hi a, khuampi thum le bullen thum tawh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A pang langkhat ading zong tua bangmah ahi hi. Buktual kongpi hih lam le hua lamah khuampi thum le bullen thum tawh a puan khaisukte pi sawmnih le nih le alang ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Buktual kimkota puan kikhai sukte khempeuh pen a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuampite a’ ding a bullente pen sumngo hi a, ahih hangin a vankhainate le a gaknate ngun ahi hi. A khuamluzepnate a kizutna zong ngun hi a, buktual a khuamte khempeuh ngun kibawl gakna tawh kigak hi."},"18":{"text":"Buktual kongpi puankhai pen a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem ahi hi. Buktual a kikhai sukte tawh kizui-in pi sawmthum sau-in, a vailam pi sagih le alang sang hi."},"19":{"text":"A khuampite li hi a, a bullen lite sumngo hi a, a vankhainate ngun hi a, a khuamluzepnate le a gaknate a kizutna ngun mah ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Biakbuk le buktual kimkota ding khetphimte khempeuh sumngo ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hihte pen siampi Aaron’ tapa Ithamar’ vaihawmna nuai-ah Levi mite’ sep ding Topa’ omna ahi biakbuk-a dingin Moses’ thupiakna tawh a kisim van malte ahi hi.","title":"Biakbuk Siknazatte"},"22":{"text":"Judah minam Hur’ tapa ahi Uri’ tapa Bezalel in Topa in Moses a thupiak khempeuh a bawl hi."},"23":{"text":"A khut siam, a geel siam, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte a zem, Dan minam, Ahisamak’ tapa Oholiab in zong amah a huh hi."},"24":{"text":"Nasep nadinga a kizang kham khempeuh, biakbuk lamna-a a kizang, a kipia khamte, biakinn shekel-in talen sawmnih le kua le shekel zasagih sawmthum ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi simna sungah a kihel mihonte tung panin a kingah ngunte, biakinn shekel-in talen zakhat le shekel tulkhat zasagih sawmsagih le nga ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi khat ciangin beka khat (biakinn shekel-in shekel lang) pai pia a, a pia mi, kum sawmnih a pha panin a tungsiah mi kisimna a a kisim peuhmah tul zaguk le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 30:11-16; Mat 17:24"},"27":{"text":"Ngun talen za khatte pen biakbuk khuam bullente le dalna puan khuam bullente dingin sun’ ding ahi hi. Talen za khatte bullen zakhat, bullen khat ciangin talen khat ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in shekel tulkhat zasagih sawmsagih le nga pen khuampi tunga vankhai nadingin bawl a, a khuamluzepnate zutin tuate a’ ding gakna a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"A kipia sumngo khempeuh, talen sawmsagih le shekel tulnih le zali ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Amah in tua tawh kikhopna buk kongkhakte a dingin khuam bullente, sumngo biakna tau le a sumngo siklen le biaknatau nazat khempeuh,"},"31":{"text":"buktual kimkota khuam bullente, buktual kongpi khuam bullente, biakbuk khetphimte khempeuh le buktual kimkota khetphim khempeuh a bawl hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, siangtho munah nasep nadingin amaute in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh limtakin a kigan puan a bawl uh hi. Amaute in Aaron a dingin biakna puan siangtho a bawl uh hi.","title":"Siampite’ Puan Bawlna (Pai 28:1-43)"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in siampipuan pen kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh a bawl uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Hoihtakin a kigeel, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte-ah zat dingin kham peek kiseekin khau-in kizen hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in siampipuan a dingin liangkaih puan bawl uh a, a mong nih tegel ah zom uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amah a gak dingin hoihtakin a kigan tua tunga puan om pen kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh kibawlin, a nate le a sepna zia a kibang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel tapate a phazah tawh kizui-in, onik suangte kitat a, kham tawh a kizepna sungah a minte kigelhin, min gelh siamte’ gelh bangin kibawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin Israel tapate phawkna suang dingin siampipuan’ liangkaih puan tungah a bulh uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh, siampipuan a kibawl puan bangin hoihtakin awmdal a bawl uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua awmdal a ning kikim a, thuap nihin kibawl a, a kikhep ciangin a dung letmat kua, a vai letmat kua mah a pha hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in tua sungah suang gual li bulh uh a, Sardis suang, topaz suang, le karbankal suang gual khat pen a gual masa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A gual nihna-ah emerald suang, sapfaia suang, le diamond suang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"A gual thumna-ah jakinth suang, agate suang, le amethyst suang ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A gual lina-ah beryl suang, onik suang, le jasper suang ahi hi. Kham tawh zepna sungah tua suangte khempeuh kikoih hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel tapate a phazah tawh kituakin amaute’ min a kigelhna suang sawm le nih om hi. Tua min gelhnate pen minam sawm le nih a huamin a kigelh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute in awmdal tungah khau tawh a kibang, a kihual kham citak khainiang a bawl uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Kham tawh a kibawl zepna nih le kham kual nih bawl uh a, awmdal mong nihte-ah kham kual nihte a koih uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in awmdal mongte-ah a om kual nihte pen kham khau nihte tawh a khih uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in zepna nihte tungah khau mong nihte zom uh a, tua bangin amaute in siampipuan’ liangkaih puan tung a mai lamah a bulh uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in kham kual nih bawl uh a, siampipuan tawh a kizom a sunglam nawl, awmdal mong nihte-ah a bulh uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute in kham kual nih bawl uh a, siampipuan’ liangkaih puan nihte’ nuai a mailam, ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh mang kawlsing gahte a bawl uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amaute in kham citak siklongte zong bawl uh a, kawnggak le phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul puante zong a bawl uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Amaute in kham citak tawh a siangtho kizepna peek khat bawl uh a, min gelhna a kibawl mah bangin tua tungah thu gelhin, “ Topa’ tungah siangtho,” ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amaute in a tunga dialpi tungah a gak dingin tua tungah khau dum khat a vawh uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bangin kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk nasep khempeuh kiman hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute man khin uh hi.","title":"Biakbuk Nate Kim (Pai 35:10-19)"},"33":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk, a puanbuk le a nazat khempeuh, a vankhainate, khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite le a bullente;"},"34":{"text":"a kisansak tuutal vunte le savun dangte tawh a kibawl khuhna le kong puankhai dalna puan;"},"35":{"text":"thuciamna singkuang, a zawlte le hehpihna tokhom tawh;"},"36":{"text":"sabuai le a nazat khempeuhte le Ompihna Anlum;"},"37":{"text":"kham citak meivakkhuam le meivak a kibulhsa tawh a meivakte le a nazatte khempeuh le meivak a ding sathau;"},"38":{"text":"kham biakna tau, nilh sathau le a namtui paknamtui le puanbuk kongkhak-a ding kongpuankhai;"},"39":{"text":"sumngo biakna tau le a sumngo siklen, a zawlte le a nazat khempeuh; kisilna kuang le a ngakna;"},"40":{"text":"buktual a puan kikhaite, a khuampite, a bullente le buktual kongpi-a ding kongpuankhai, a khaute le a khetphimte; le kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk nasepna-ah a nazat khempeuh;"},"41":{"text":"siampi nasep nadingin siangtho mun a zat ding hoihtakin a kibawl puante, siampi Aaron a’ ding biakna puan siangthote le ama tapate’ puante, Moses kiangah a paipih uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kituakin Israel mite in nasep khempeuh hih uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Moses in nasep khempeuh vel a, amaute in Topa’ thupiaksa bangin a bawl khitna a mu hi. Tua ciangin Moses in amaute thupha a pia hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Biakbuk Dinsakna le Apna"},"2":{"text":"“Kha masa a ni masa ni-in nangmah in kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk na lam ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua buk sungah thuciamna singkuang na koih ding a, dalna puan tawh singkuang na dal ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin sabuai tumpihin a om ding bangin na koih ding hi. Meivakkhuam zong tumpihin a meivakte na bulh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuciamna singkuang mai-ah paknamtui hal nadingin kham biakna tau na koih ding a, biakbuk kongkhak dingin kongpuankhai na khai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk kongkhak mai-ah meihal biakna tau koihin,"},"7":{"text":"kikhopna buk le biakna tau kikalah kisilna kuang na koih ding a, a sungah tui zong na koih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A kimkotah buktual na bawl ding a, buktual kongpi dingin kongpuankhai na khaito ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ciangin sathau la-in, biakbuk le a sunga om khempeuh na nuh ding a, biakbuk le a inn sungvan khempeuh na ap ding hi. Tua ciangin a siangtho biakna van a suak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in meihal biakna tau le a nazat khempeuh zong sathau nuhin biakna tau na ap ding a, tua biakna tau a siangtho pen hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kisilna kuang le a ngakna zong sathau nuhin na ap ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kikhopna buk kongkhakah Aaron le ama tapate paipihin, tui tawh amaute na sil ding a,"},"13":{"text":"amah in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingin puan siangthote Aaron silhsakin, amah sathau nilhin na ap ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama tapate zong paipihin puantungsilhte na silhsak ding a,"},"15":{"text":"amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingun amaute’ pa sathau na nilh bangin amaute zong sathau na nilh ding hi. Amau’ sathau kinilhna in amau’ khang tawntungin siampi hi paisuaksak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Moses in zong Topa in amah a thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kituakin a hih hi."},"17":{"text":"A kum nihna a kha masa, a ni masa ni-in biakbuk kilam hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in biakbuk lam hi. Amah in a bullente koihin, a khuampeekte phut a, a zawlte khumin, a khuampite a phut hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakbuk tungah a tungkhuhna zal a, Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin puanbuk a tung a khuh hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin amah in thuciamna suangpek la-in singkuang sungah koih a, singkuang tungah a zawlte koihin, singkuang tung sanah hehpihna tokhom a nga hi."},"21":{"text":"Biakbuk sungah singkuang paipihin, kongpuankhai dalna puan khai a, thuciamna singkuang a dal hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amah in biakbuk leilu lam pang, dalna puan pualam, kikhopna buk sungah sabuai koih a,"},"23":{"text":"Topa’ mai tua sabuai tungah a om ding bangin anlum a koih hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amah in biakbuk leitaw lam pang, sabuai tawh a kigalsai-in, kikhopna buk sungah meivakkhuam koih a,"},"25":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah meivakte a koih hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amah in kikhopna buk sung, dalna puan mai-ah kham biakna tau koih a,"},"27":{"text":"tua tungah a namtui paknamtui a hal hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in biakbuk kongkhak ding kongpuankhai a mun dingah a khai hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin amah in kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk kongkhakah meihal biakna tau koih a, tua tungah meihal biakna le an tawh biakna a pia hi."},"30":{"text":"Kikhopna buk le biakna tau kikalah kisilna kuang koih a, tua sungah kisil nading tui zong a koih hi."},"31":{"text":"Moses le Aaron le a tapate in amau’ khut le a khete uh tua tui tawh a sil uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang le biakna tau nai-ah a pai uh ciangin amaute kisil uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah in biakbuk le biakna tau kiimah a buktual bawl a, buktual kongpi kongpuankhai a khai hi. Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a nasep a man ta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin meii in kikhopna buk tuam a, biakbuk sungah Topa’ minthanna vang a dim hi.","title":"Biakbuk tungah Meii (Gam 9:15-23)","ref":"1Kum 8:10-11; Isa 6:4; Ezk 43:4-5; Mang 15:8"},"35":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kikhopna buk sungah Moses tum thei lo hi."},"36":{"text":"A khualzin sung tawntung uh biakbuk tung panin meii a kilakkhiat toh peuhpeuh ciangin Israel mite mailam nawtin pai uh a,"},"37":{"text":"ahih hangin meii a kilakkhiat kei leh a kilakkhiat ni mateng amaute paikhia lo uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a khualzin sung tawntung uh Israel mi khempeuh’ muhna-ah biakbuk tungah sunin Topa’ meii om a, zanin mei a om hi."}}}}},"3":{"info":{"name":"Siampi Laibu","shortname":"Sim","abbr":[],"desc":"Siampi Laibu sungah tanglai mite in Pasian a biakna ding zia, biakna pawi a tuamtuamte bawlna ding zia, leh thupiakna tawh kizui-in tua thute a sem khia ding siampite' thu kigelh hi. Hih laibu in a thu bulphuhpi in: Pasian a siangtho ahihna thu leh a siangtho Israel Pasian leh ama mite a kizopna uh a tatsat lohna dingin ama mite in Pasian a biakna ding ziate ahi hi. Hih laibu sung panin mikim in a theih thu pen 19:18 sungah om a, Jesuh in thupiak a lian nihna a cih hi a, “Nomau na ki-it uh bangin na vengte na it ding uh hi,” cihna ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses sam a, kikhopna buk panin amah hopihin hih bangin ci hi:","title":"Meihal Biakna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah gen inla, amaute tungah hih bangin ci in: Note khatpeuh in Topa’ tungah biakna na paipih uh ciangin, ganhing tawh na biakna pen bawnghon panin hitaleh tuuhon panin hitaleh na paipih ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ama biakna pen bawnghon panin meihal biakna ahihleh, amah in a sitbaang lo a pa khat pia ding a, Topa’ mai-ah a kisan’ theih nadingin kikhopna bukkongah pia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in meihal biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga ding a, ama a dingin kilemna bawl nadingin kisang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ mai-ah a bawngtal go ding hi. Aaron’ suan siampite in a si hong paipihin, kikhopna buk kong-a biakna tau kimkotah a si theh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in meihal biakna ganhing a vun hawkin semnen ding a,"},"7":{"text":"Aaron’ suan siampite in biakna tau tungah mei koihin, mei tungah a ngeina bangin sing koih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Aaron’ suan siampite in a sanente, a lutang le a thaute, biakna tau tunga om mei tunga sing tungah a ngeina bangin koih ding a,"},"9":{"text":"ahih hangin a sungkuate le a khete tui tawh sil ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in mei tawh kihal biakna, Topa a dingin a gim namtui, meihal biakna-in biakna tau tungah a vekpi-in hal ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Meihal biak nadingin ama letsong pen tuu hitaleh keel hitaleh a hon lak panin ahihleh, amah in a sitbaang lo a pa khat pia ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in Topa’ mai biakna tau tung leilu lampangah go ding a, Aaron’ suan siampite in biakna tau tung kimkotah a si theh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in semnen ding a, biakna tau tunga om mei tunga sing tungah a ngeina bangin siampipa in a lutang le a thau tawh koih khawm ding a,"},"13":{"text":"ahih hangin a sungkuate le a khete amah in tui tawh sil ding hi. Siampipa in a vekpi-in pia-in, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakpiakna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"“ Topa’ tungah ama biakna pen vasa tawh meihal biakna ahihleh, amah in vakhu tawh ahi zongin, kawl vakhuno tawh ahi zongin, a biakna hong paipih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in biakna tau-ah paipihin a lu heektat ding a, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Biakna tau pangah a si taakkhiasak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in a tangkhai le a multe bot khia-in, vut koihna, biakna tau pang nisuahna lamah lawnkhia ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in a khate-in balkek ding a, ahih hangin baltat lo ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in mei tunga om sing tung, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakna ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh in Topa’ tungah an tawh biakna hong paipih le, ama biakpiakna pen annel hi ding hi. Amah in tua annel tungah sathau sungin, paknamtui koihin,","title":"An tawh Biakna"},"2":{"text":"tua ciangin Aaron’ suan siampite kiangah paipih ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in annel khutdim le sathau, a paknamtui khempeuh tawh la ding a, siampipa in hih pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh biakna, phawkna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi."},"3":{"text":"An tawh biakna a valteng pen Aaron le a tapate a’ ding hi ding hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah mei tawh biakna sung panin a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Nangmah in biak nadingin meibung sunga ki-em an tawh biakna na paipih ciangin, silngo sawh loh, sathau tawh a kizut mohpheng hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Na biakna pen beelpei daii tunga ki-em an tawh biakna ahihleh, sathau tawh a kibawl annel hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Balnenin a tungah sathau na sung ding hi. Tua pen an tawh biakna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Na biakna pen sikbeel daii sunga kihuan an tawh biakna ahihleh, sathau tawh a kibawl annel hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah in hih nate tawh a kibawl an tawh biakna, Topa’ kiangah na paipih ding a, siampipa kiangah a kipaipih ciangin amah in biakna tau-ah paipih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Siampipa in an tawh biakna panin a phawkna biakna teng la-in, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh biakna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi."},"10":{"text":"An tawh biakna a valteng pen Aaron le a tapate a’ ding hi ding hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah mei tawh biakna sung panin a siangthopen ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"“ Topa’ tungah na paipih an tawh biakna pen silngo tawh kibawl lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh silngo hitaleh khuaizu hitaleh khat peuhpeuh Topa’ tungah meihal biakna-in na hal kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Anpal tawh biakna ahihleh Topa’ kiangah na paipih thei ding hi. Ahih hangin a gim namtui dingin biakna tau tungah kipia lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"An tawh na biaknate khempeuh ci na sawh ding hi. An tawh na biakna-ah na Pasian tawh na thuciamna ci sawh loin na om kei ding a, na biakna khempeuh ci na sawh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Anpal tawh Topa’ tungah biakna na piak leh, anpal tawh na biak nadingin a vui thak panin kila-in a kigawivui, mei-ah a kihangkeu na pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang in a tungah sathau sungin, paknamtui na buak ding hi. Tua pen an tawh biakna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Siampipa in phawk nadingin a kigawivui an pawlkhat le a sathau leh a paknamtui khempeuh hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa’ tungah meihal biakna ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khat’ biakna pen thunuama biakna ahih a, amah in a nu hitaleh a pa hitaleh bawnghon lak panin a piak leh, amah in Topa’ mai-ah a sitbaang lo pia ding hi.","title":"Thunuama Piakna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in kikhopna buk kongah go ding a, tua ciangin Aaron’ suan siampite in biakna tau kimkot tungah a si theh ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Thunuama biakna panin Topa’ tungah mei tawh biakna-in a gilpi tuam a thaute le a sungkuate’ tunga a om a thau khempeuh tawh,"},"4":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau le a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sintuamte pia ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Aaron’ suante in mei tunga om sing tunga meihal biakpiakna tau tung mahah hal ding uh hi. Tua pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“ Topa’ tungah thunuama a piak ding ama biakna pen tuu le keel honte sung panin a nu hitaleh a pa hitaleh ganhing khat ahihleh, amah in a sitbaang lo pia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in biak nadingin tuuno khat a piak leh, Topa’ mai-ah pia ding a,"},"8":{"text":"a biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in kikhopna buk mai-ah go ding hi. Tua ciangin Aaron’ suante in biakna tau kimkot tungah a si theh ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin thunuama biakna panin Topa’ tungah meihal biakna-in a thau, a nungguh ciangah a ki-attan a mei thau buppi le a gilpi tuam a thaute le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh tawh,"},"10":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sintuamte pia ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ama biakna keel ahihleh, amah in Topa’ mai-ah pia ding a,"},"13":{"text":"a lu tungah a khut nga-in kikhopna buk mai-ah go ding hi. Tua ciangin Aaron’ suante in biakna tau kimkot tungah a si theh ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in piak dingin a gilpi tuam a thau le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh tawh,"},"15":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sintuamte pia ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in a gim namtui dingin mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. A thau khempeuh Topa -a’ ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua pen na khang tawntungun na tenna khempeuh uhah note in a thau le sisan na nek loh nadingun a tawntungin ngeina kip hi ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Khialhna hanga Biakna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Hih lo ding ci-in Topa in a thupiakte khat peuhpeuh, mi khatpeuh in theih lohna hangin khial a, tuate khatpeuh a hihkhak leh,"},"3":{"text":"a khial pa pen sathau a kinilh siampipa ahih a, mite tungah tua bangin mawhna hong tut leh, ama gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin a sitbaang lo bawngtalno khat Topa’ mai-ah khialhna hanga biakna-in amah piasak un."},"4":{"text":"Amah in Topa’ mai kikhopna buk kongah a bawngtal paipihin, bawngtal lu tungah a khut nga ding a, Topa’ mai-ah a bawngtal go ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin sathau a kinilh siampipa in a bawngtal si tawmkhat la-in, kikhopna bukah paipih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in a si sungah a khutme diahin, biakbuk dalna puan mai Topa’ mai-ah a si kimkhat sagih vei theh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in kikhopna buk sung Topa’ mai-a om paknamtui biakna tau kite a si kimkhat nuhin, kikhopna bukkongah a om meihal biakna tau bulah bawngtal si a omlai teng sungkhia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in khialhna hanga biakna bawngtal thau khempeuh a gilpi tuam a thau le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh tawh,"},"9":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding a sintuamte"},"10":{"text":"(thunuama biakna bawngtal panin hihte a kilak mah bangin) la ding a, siampipa in meihal biakna tau tungah tuate hal ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin bawngtal vun le a sa khempeuh, a lutang, a khete, a sungkuate, le a ek tawh,"},"12":{"text":"a bawngtal buppi puakhia-in vut kibuakna, giahphual pualam mun siangtho khatah sing a kicih mei tungah amah in hal ding a, vut a kibuakna munah kihal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Israel mihonte khempeuh in theih lohna hangin khialhna khat gamta-in tua pen mihonte in a phawk kei a, hih lo ding, ci-in Topa in a thupiakte khat peuhpeuh amaute in hihin a mawh uhleh,"},"14":{"text":"amau’ gamtatnasa khialhna a kitheih ciangin, khialhna hanga biak nadingin mihonte in bawngtalno khat pia-in kikhopna buk mai-ah paipih ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihonte’ upate in Topa’ mai, bawngtal lu tungah amau’ khut nga ding uh a, Topa’ mai-ah tua bawngtal kigo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin sathau a kinilh siampipa in kikhopna bukah bawngtal si kimkhat paipih ding a,"},"17":{"text":"a si sungah a khutme diahin dalna puan mai Topa’ mai-ah sagih vei theh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ mai kikhopna buk sunga om biakna tau kite tungah a si kimkhat zut ding a, kikhopna bukkongah a om biakna tau bulah si a omlai teng sung ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a thau khempeuh la-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bangin a bawngtal hih ding hi. Amah in khialhna hanga biakna bawngtal a hihsa mah bangin hih zong hih ding hi. Siampipa in amau a’ dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amaute kimaisak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in giahphual pua-ah bawngtal puakhia ding a, a masa bawngtal a hal mah bangin a hal ding hi. Tua pen mihonpi a dingin khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"“Ukpa khat khialin, hih lo ding, ci-in Topa ama Pasian in a thupiakte khempeuh lakah khat peuhpeuh theih lohna hangin hihkha-in a mawh ciangin,"},"23":{"text":"ama gamtatnasa khialhna ama tungah a va kihilh leh, amah in biakna-in a sitbaang lo keel pa khat paipih ding a,"},"24":{"text":"keel lu tungah a khut nga-in, Topa’ mai, meihal biakna a kigawh nading munah go ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in a khutme tawh khialhna hanga biakna si tawm la-in meihal biakna tau kite nuhin meihal biakna tau bulah a si omlai teng sung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Thunuama biakna sathaute mah bangin amah in biakna tau tungah a thau khempeuh hal ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin siampipa in ama khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Hih lo ding, ci-in Topa’ thupiakte khat peuhpeuh mi mawkmawk khat in theih lohna hangin hihin a khialh a, a mawh leh,"},"28":{"text":"ama gamtatnasa a khialhna ama tungah a kihilh ciangin amah in a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin biak nading a sitbaang lo keel a nu khat paipih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in a khialhna hanga biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in, meihal biakna munah khialhna hanga biakna go ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Siampipa in a khutme tawh si tawm la-in meihal biakna tau kite nuh ding a, biakna tau bulah si a omlai teng sung ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Thunuama biakna panin a thaute a kilakkhiat mah bangin amah in a thau khempeuh lakhia ding a, Topa a’ ding a gim namtui dingin siampipa in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Siampipa in ama a dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.","ref":"Gam 15:27-28"},"32":{"text":"“Amah in khialhna hanga biakna-in a piak dingin tuuno khat a paipih leh, a sitbaang lo a nu khat hi ding a,"},"33":{"text":"khialhna hanga biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in, meihal biakna a kigawhna munah khialhna hanga biak nadingin go ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in khialhna hanga biakna si tawmkhat a khutme tawh la-in meihal biakna tau kite nuh ding a, biakna tau bulah a si omlai teng sung ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Thunuama biakpiakna panin tuuno thau a kilak khiat mah bangin amah in a thau khempeuh lakhia ding a, Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, biakna tau tungah siampipa in hal ding hi. Siampipa in ama gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh teci pang dingin a kisap ciangin a muhsa a theihsa thute gen loin a ip leh, amah in tua mawhna pua ding hi."},"2":{"text":"“Tua ahih kei leh mi khatpeuh in gamlak ganhing nin a sisa hitaleh inn ganhing nin a sisa hitaleh a bokvak a nin ganhing a sisa hitaleh, a muh lohin a nin khat peuhpeuh lawngkha-in amah a nin a suah leh, a mawh hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"“Tua ahih kei leh amah in mihing nitna hitaleh, mu loin a lawnkhak leh, a theih ciangin a mawh hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua ahih kei leh mi khatpeuh in a sia bawl ding hitaleh a pha bawl ding hitaleh mite a kiciam theih ngei kiciamna nam khat peuhpeuh ama kam tawh a theih lohin a kiciampak khak leh, a theih ciangin hihte khat peuhpeuhah a mawh hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Hihte khat peuhpeuhah mi khat a mawh ciangin, amah in a gamtatnasa a khialhna pulak ding a,"},"6":{"text":"mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuhon pan ahi a, keelhon pan ahi zongin a nu khat peuhpeuh tuu hitaleh keel hitaleh, a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin Topa’ tungah biakna paipih ding a, siampipa in a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ahih hangin amah in tuuno khat a piak zawh kei leh a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin Topa’ tungah biakna-in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin, khat khialhna hanga biakna, a khat meihal biak nadingin paipih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in siampipa tungah tuate paipih ding a, siampipa in khialhna hanga biak nading pen pia masa ding hi. Amah in a ngawng panin a lu heek ding a, ahih hangin heeksat lo ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in khialhna hanga biakna si tawmkhat biakna tau pangah theh ding a, biakna tau bulah a si omlai teng taaksak ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in ngeina kip om bangin meihal biak nadingin a khat pia ding hi. Siampipa in a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ahih hangin amah in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin a piak zawh kei leh, amah in a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin a biakna-in annel lawh khat, khialhna hanga biak nadingin paipih ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahih manin amah in tua sungah sathau khah lo ding a, paknamtui zong hel lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in siampipa kiangah paipih ding a, siampipa in phawkna-in khutdim khat la-in Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin siampipa in hihte khat peuhpeuh a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi. An tawh biakna-a mah bangin a omlai teng siampipa a’ ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Mawhna hanga Biakna"},"15":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh in theih lohna hangin thu palsatin Topa’ na a siangtho khat peuhpeuhah a khialh leh, a mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuhon sung panin a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in ngun shekel-in nangmah in a man sehin, amah in Topa’ kiangah paipih ding hi. Tua pen mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in a siangtho na a hih khialhna-ah lohkikna zong bawl ding a, seh nga-ah khat gawm behin siampipa tungah pia ding hi. Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna tuutal tawh ama a dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hih lo ding, ci-in Topa’ thupiakte khat peuhpeuh, mi khatpeuh in hihin a khialh leh, a theih lohna hang hitaleh zong, amah a mawh hi veve-in, ama mawhna mah pua ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuuhon lak pan a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, a manzah ding nangmah in seh inla, amah in mawhna hanga biak nadingin siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi. Theihlohna hanga ama gamtatnasa khialhna hangin siampipa in ama a’ ding kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua pen Topa’ tungah khial ahih manin mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"2":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh khialin, Topa’ thu palsatin, na kepsakna thu-ah ahi zongin, khapna nate’ thu-ah ahi zongin a vengpa khemin, ahih kei leh a na sutin, a vengpa nengniamin,"},"3":{"text":"tua ahih kei leh a mang na khat mu-in tua thu-ah zuau-in a man loin kiciam a, mite a khialh theih ngeina khat peuhpeuhah"},"4":{"text":"khialin a mawh ciangin amah in a suhte hitaleh, a netniamna tawh a ngahte hitaleh, amah a kikemsak na hitaleh, a mang na a muh hitaleh,"},"5":{"text":"a man loin a kiciamnasa na khat peuhpeuh hitaleh loh ding hi. Amah in a cingin lohin seh nga-ah khat piak beh ding a, a mawhna hanga biakna a piak ni-in a nei pa tungah pia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mawhna hanga a biak nading, tuuhon lak pan a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, Topa’ tungah a piak ding, a man ding nangma sehzah, amah in siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Siampipa in Topa’ mai-ah ama a’ ding kilemna bawlsak ding a, mi khat a mawh theih ngeina khat peuhpeuhte-ah amah kimaisak ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 5:5-8"},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Biakna Ngeina Dangte"},"9":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate thu pia inla, hih bangin ci in: Hih pen meihal biakna ngeina ahi hi. Meihal biakna pen biakna tau tunga meikhuk tungah zingsang mateng zan tawntung om ding a, tua biakna tau tungah mei kikuangsak den ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Siampipa in a saihadial puan silhin, a saihadial pheituam tengin, biakna tau tungah meihal biakna mei in a kattum vutte la-in biakna tau pangah koih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a puante suahin puan dang silh ding a, giahphual pualam a siangtho mun khatah a vutte puakhia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Biakna tau tunga mei kikuangsak den ding a, kimitsak lo ding hi. Siampipa in zingsang simin a tungah sing cihin, meihal biakna a ngeina bangin a tungah koihin, thunuama biakna thau a tungah hal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Biakna tau tungah mei kikuangsak tawntung ding a, kimitsak lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tua ciangin an tawh biakna ngeina hih bang ahi hi. Aaron’ suante in biakna tau mai, Topa’ mai-ah pia ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi khat in, biakna tau tungah a om an tawh biakna annel khutdim khat, a sathau le a paknamtui khempeuh tawh la-in, Topa a dingin a gim namtui, phawkna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in a omlai teng ne ding uh hi. A siangtho mun khatah silngo sawh loh in ne ding uh a, kikhopna buktual sung mun khat hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua pen silngo sawhin a ki-em hi lo ding hi. Meihal biakna hong kipiakna sung panin amau’ tanh dingin ka piaksa ahi hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna le mawhna hanga biakna bangin a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Na khang tawntung uha dingin thu hong kipiak mah bangin, Topa’ tungah meihal biakna a kipiakna panin Aaron’ suante lakah pasal peuhmah in tuate ne thei ding hi. Tuate a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"20":{"text":"“Aaron le a suante sathau a kinilh ni-in Topa’ tungah hih bangin biakna kipia ding hi: An tawh biakna ngeina bangin annel lawh khat, alang zingsangin, alang nitakin pia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua pen beelpei tung khatah sathau tawh kibawl ding hi. An tawh biakna mah bangin limtakin helsa leh balnensa-in na paipih ding a, Topa a’ ding a gim namtui dingin na pia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron’ suante sung panin amah a laih dingin sathau a kinilh siampipa in, thu a kipiaksa mah bangin Topa’ tungah pia ding a, a vekpi-in kihal ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Siampipa in an tawh a biakna peuhmah a vekpi-in kihal ding a, kine lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"25":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate tungah hih bangin gen in: Khialhna hanga biakna ngeina hih bang ahi hi. Meihal biakna a kigawhna mun Topa’ mai-ah khialhna hanga biakna kigo ding a, tua pen a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Khialhna hanga biakna a pia siampipa in kikhopna buktual sung a siangtho mun khatah ne ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A sa a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi. Puan tungah a si a kithehkhak ciangin, a siangtho mun khatah tua si a kithehkha pen kisawp ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kihuanna leibeel kisukham ding hi. Ahih hangin taaubeelin a kihuan ahihleh a beel kikiatin tui sungah kisawp siang sitset ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Siampite’ lak panin pasal peuhmah in ne thei ding uh hi. Tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahih hangin siangtho munah kilemna bawl nadingin kikhopna buk sungah a kipaipih si a kilak khiatna, khialhna hanga biakna sa kine lo ding a, mei tawh kihal ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mawhna hanga biakna ngeina, a siangtho pen hih bang ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Amaute in meihal biakna a gawhna mun uhah mawhna hanga biakna go ding uh a, biakna tau kimkotah a si kitheh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thau khempeuh, a meithau, a gilpi tuam a thau,"},"4":{"text":"a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sin tuamte kipia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ tungah meihal biakna-in siampipa in biakna tau tungah hal ding a, tua pen mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampite lakah pasal peuhmah in a siangtho mun khatah ne thei ding uh hi; tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mawhna hanga biakna pen khialhna hanga biakna tawh kibang a, tuate a’ ding a ngeina a kibang hi ding a, kilemna a bawlsak siampipa in tua biakna sa ngah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh’ meihal biakna a piaksak siampipa in ama piaksak tua meihal biakna a vun ngah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mei bung sunga a ki-em an tawh biakna peuhmah leh sikbeel daii ahi a, beelpei tungah ahi zongin a kibawl khempeuhte, a pia siampipa in ngah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"An tawh biakna khempeuh, sathau a kihel hitaleh a kihel lo hita leh, Aaron’ suan khempeuh in a kikimin hawm ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh in Topa’ tungah a piak theih ding, thunuama biakna ngeina hih bang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in lungdam kohna-in a piak leh, silngo sawh loh sathau tawh a kihel moh, silngo sawh loh mohpheng sathau tawh a kizut, annel moh sathau limtakin a kihelte, lungdam biakna tawh pia khawm ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in lungdam koh nadingin thunuama ama biakpiakna tawh silngo kisawh anlum mohte ama biakna-in paipih khawm ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in Topa biak nadingin tua biakna sung panin moh khat ciat pia ding a, thunuama biakna si a theh siampipa in tua moh ngah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Lungdam kohna-in thunuama ama biakpiakna a sa pen a piak ni-in kine ding a, a zingsang dong bangmah kisit lo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Ahih hangin ama biakpiakna pen thuciamna hanga biakpiakna ahi a, utthu-a biakpiakna ahi zongin ahihleh, amah in a biakpiakna a piak ni-in kine ding a, a omlai teng a zing ciangin kine ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin a ni thum ni-in biakpiakna sa a omlai teng mei tawh kihal ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in thunuama ama biakpiakna sa khat peuhpeuh a kinek leh, tua biakpiakna a piapa kisang lo ding a, tua pen ama a’ in zong kiciamteh lo ding hi. Tua sa a nin hi ding a, a ne pa in ama mawhna pua ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“A nin na khat peuhpeuh tawh a kisawhkha sa kine lo ding a, mei tawh kihal ding hi. Ahi zongin a siang mi khempeuh in a sa ne thei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A nin hi napi-in thunuama Topa’ tungah biakpiakna sa a ne pa ama mipihte’ lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in mihing nin hitaleh ganhing nin hitaleh a kihhuai a nin khat peuhpeuh hitaleh lawng a, tua khit ciangin thunuama Topa’ tungah biakpiakna sa a nek leh, ama mipihte’ lak panin tua mipa kihawlkhia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"23":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note in bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi a, keel ahi zongin a thau na ne kei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"A mawk sih ganhing thau leh gamsate in a balgawp ganhing thaute, nadangin kizang thei ding a, ahih hangin bangbang hileh na ne kei ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ganhing thau a ne mi peuhmah ama mipihte’ lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua tham loin note in na tenna uh mun khat peuhpeuhah vasa sisan hitaleh ganhing sisan hitaleh si peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Si khat peuhpeuh a ne mi peuhmah ama mipihte’ lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 9:4; Siam 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16,23; 15:23"},"28":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"29":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Topa’ tungah thunuama ama biakpiakna a piapa in Topa’ kiangah ama biakna paipih ding hi. a omlai a vun, a sa le a ek, amah in giahphual pualamah mei tawh a hal hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in meihal biakna tuutal pia a, Aaron le a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau’ khut nga uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Moses in tua tuutal go-in, biakna tau tung kimkotah a si theh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuutal a kisemnen ciangin, Moses in a lu le a ki-atnente le a thau a hal hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in a tuutal dang, kipsakna tuutal pia a, Aaron leh a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau’ khut nga uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in tuutal go a, a si tawmkhat la-in Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-in note tungah Topa hong kilang ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in zong kikhopna buk mai-ah Moses’ thupiak teng hong paipih uh a, mihonpite khempeuh a nai-ah hong pai-in Topa’ mai-ah ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in, “Note tungah Topa’ minthanna vang hong kilat theih nadingin Topa in hih bangin thu hong pia hi,” a cih khit ciangin"},"7":{"text":"Aaron’ kiangah, “ Topa’ thupiaksa bangin biakna tau mai-ah pai-in khialhna hanga biakna le meihal biakna pia inla, nangma a’ ding le mite a dingin kilemna bawl in. Mite’ biakna paipih inla, amaute a dingin kilemna bawlsak in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 7:27"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Aaron in biakna tau naihin, ama a’ mahmah ding ahi khialhna hanga biakna bawngno a go hi."},"9":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate in ama tungah a si pia uh a, amah in a si sungah a khutme diahin biakna tau kite nuh a, biakna tau bulah a si vallai teng a sungkhia hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin khialhna hanga biakna panin a thau le a kalte le a sintuamte biakna tau tungah a hal hi."},"11":{"text":"A sa le a vunte ahihleh giahphual pualamah mei tawh a hal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin a meihal biakna a go hi. A tapate in ama tungah a si pia uh a, amah in biakna tau tung kimkotah a theh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in meihal biakna ama tungah a nen nenin a lutang tawh pia uh a, amah in biakna tau tungah tuate a hal hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a sungkuate le a khete sawp a, biakna tau tungah meihal biakna tawh tuate a halkhawm hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin a masa-a khialhna hanga biakna mah bangin amah in mite’ biakna pia-in, mite a’ ding ahi khialhna hanga biakna keel la-in go a, khialhna hanga biak nadingin a pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin meihal biakna paipihin ngeina kip omsa bangin a pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in zingsang a meihal biakna banah biakna paipihin, tua sung panin a khutdim la-in, biakna tau tungah a hal hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses’ thupiak bangin amah in mite a dingin thunuama biakna bawngtal le tuutal zong a go hi. Mi khempeuh in a muh uh ciangin awng uh a, lei maingatin a kunsuk uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Aaron’ tapate Nadab le Abihu in amau’ paknamtui beel tuak la-in, a sungah mei koih uh a, a tungah paknamtui koihin, Topa in amau’ tungah tua banga thu a piak ngei loh a siang lo mei, Topa’ mai-ah a pia uh hi.","title":"Nadab le Abihu’ Khialhna"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ omna mun panin mei hong paikhia-in amaute kang a, Topa’ mai-ah a si uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Aaron’ kiangah, “ Topa in, ‘Ka kiang nai-a a omte kiangah keimah a siangtho-in ka kilak ding a, mi khempeuh’ mai-ah keimah hong kiminthangsak ding hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi. Aaron pau loin a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Aaron’ pa’ sanggampa Uzziel’ tapate Mishael le Elizafan samin amaute kiangah, “Hong pai unla biakbuk panin giahphual pualamah na sanggamte uh puakhia un,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in hong naihin, Moses’ sawl bangin giahphual pualamah amau’ puantungsilh mah uh tawh amaute a puakhia uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Aaron le a tapate Eleazar le Ithamar kiangah, “Na lu uha na sam uh phiahsak kei unla, na puante uh balkek kei un. Ahih hangin na mipih uh, Israel mihon buppi pen, Topa’ mei in a katlup mite’ hangin dahin kap thei ding uh hi.","title":"Siampite’ Nasep le Kaihte"},"7":{"text":"Kikhopna buk kong panin a pualamah paikhia kei un. Moses’ gen bangin amaute a gamta uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Aaron kiangah,"},"9":{"text":"“Nang hitaleh na tapate hitaleh kikhopna bukah na pai uh ciangin leenggahzu hitaleh khamtheih zu hitaleh ne kei un. Tua pen na suan na khakte uh tungah khang tawntungin ngeina kip khat hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in a siangtho le a mawkmawk, le a nin le a siang na khen ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungtawnin amaute’ tunga a gensa thukhamte khempeuh note in Israel mite a hilh ding na hi uh hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a omlai a tapate Eleazar le Ithamar kiangah, “ Topa’ tungah meihal biakna sung panin a vallai ahi an tawh biakna la unla, tua pen a siangtho pen ahih manin silngo sawh lohin biakna tau gei-ah ne un."},"13":{"text":"Tua an pen Topa’ tungah meihal biaknate lak panin nang le na tapate’ kaih ding ahih manin a siangtho mun khatah na ne ding uh hi. Tua bang ding mahin kei’ tungah thu hong kipia hi.","ref":"Siam 6:14-18"},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin a kivei a iik le a kipia a pheite pen nang le na tapate le na tanute in a siangtho mun khatpeuhah ne ding uh hi. Tua bang hinapi hih bang thute kei’ tungah hong tung veve hi. Khialhna hanga biakna tuni-in a ne hi leng, Topa’ muhna-ah sanhuai ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses in tua thu a zak ciangin a lungkim hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Ganhing a Siang le a Nin (Thkna 14:3-21)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite kiangah hih bangin gen un: Hihte pen leitung a om ganhing khempeuh lak panin na nek theih ding uh a nungta ganhing ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ganhingte lak panin a khecin a ka, eknel a hai peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin eknel haite lak pan hitaleh khecin kate lak pan hitaleh, note in na nek theih loh dingte uh: Kalaoh in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Sakikh ganhing in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Bilpi in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Vok pen khecin ka ahih hangin eknel hai lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Note in tuate’ sa na ne kei ding uh a, a sisate zong na lawng kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tui sunga omte sung panin nek theih dingte: Tuipi sung hitaleh gun sung hitaleh tui sungah a om phe le lip a neite peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin tuipi sung, gun sunga om phe le lip a nei lo, tui sunga a hontat ganhingte le tui sunga a nungta ganhingte pen note a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuate pen note a dingin a kihhuai hi ding hi. Note in tuate’ sa na ne kei ding uh a, a sisate zong na kih ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tui sunga a omte sung panin phe le lip a nei lo peuhmah note a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Vasate lak panin note in na kih ding uh, a kine lo ding, a kihhuaite: Muvanlai, mupi, luimu,"},"14":{"text":"mumeika, musan nam khempeuh,"},"15":{"text":"va-ak nam khempeuh,"},"16":{"text":"vasa-kalaoh, pengpelep, vatawt, musi nam khempeuh,"},"17":{"text":"keising, tuimu, gun vakang,"},"18":{"text":"gam vatawt, tui vatawt, musane,"},"19":{"text":"gun vapi, gun vazonei nam khempeuh, huihtun, le bak ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"“Khe li tawh a pai, kha a nei ganhing khempeuhte, note a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin khe li tawh a pai, kha a nei ganhingte khempeuh lak panin leitungah a tuan nadingun a khepek uh tawh kizom ngaltak tawn a neite na ne thei ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuate lak panin na nek theih dingte uh: Kauphe kitom nam khempeuh, kauphe zol nam khempeuh, khuangbai nam khempeuh, le kauphe kisau nam khempeuh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin khe li nei-in kha a nei ganhing dangte khempeuh note a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Hihte tawh note a nin na suak ding uh hi. A sisa a lawng peuhmahte a nitak mateng a nin hi ding a,"},"25":{"text":"a sisa themkhat a pua peuhmah in a puan sawpin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A khecin a ka ahih hangin eknel a hai lo ganhing peuhmah note a dingin a nin ahi hi. Tuate a lawng peuhmah a nin hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Khe li tawh a pai ganhingte khempeuh lak panin amau’ khebom tawh a paite khempeuh note a dingin a nin ahi hi. Tuate a sisa a lawngkha peuhmahte a nitak dong a nin hi ding a,"},"28":{"text":"a sisa a puapa in a puan sawpin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi. Tuate note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Leitungah a vak kawikawi, a pai thei ganhingte lak panin note a dingin a ninte: Savokphual, zusa, innhikpi nam khempeuh,"},"30":{"text":"tawlbawkpi, tang, tangteuh, le sehnel gam thankik ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"A hontat ganhing khempeuhte lak panin hihte pen note a dingin a nin ahi hi. Tuate a sisa a lawng peuhmah a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuate a sisa khat peuhpeuh a tukna nate, sing nazat, puan, savun, ippi le na khat peuhpeuhin a kizang beel khat peuhpeuh hitaleh a nin hi ding hi. Tuate pen tui sungah kidiah ding a, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi. Tua khit ciangin a siang hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuate khat peuhpeuh lei beel khat peuhpeuh sungah a kiat leh, tua sunga om khempeuh a nin hi ding a, note in tua beel na sukham ding uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua lei beel sungah a om a kine thei ding an tungah tua bang tui a tuk leh a nin hi ding hi. Tua bang beel sunga om dawn theih ding peuhmah a nin hi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua bang a sisa themkhat a tukna peuhmah a nin hi ding hi. Meibung hitaleh beelpei hitaleh kisuzan ding hi. Tuate a nin hi a, note a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuinak le tuibeem ahihleh a siang hi ding a, ahih hangin a sisate a lawng peuhmah a nin hi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"A kivawh ding khaici tungah tua a sisate themkhat a tuk leh, tua khaici a siang hi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahih hangin khaici tui kidiah a, tua a sisate themkhat tua khaici tungah a tuk leh, note a dingin tua khaici a nin ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"“Note’ nek theih ding ganhing khat peuhpeuh a sih leh a sisa a lawng pa pen a nitak mateng a nin hi ding a,"},"40":{"text":"a sisa a ne pa in ama puante sawpin a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi. A sisa a puapa in zong ama puante sawpin a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"“Leitungah a hontat ganhing peuhmah a kihhuai hi a, tuate kine lo ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A awmtal peuhmah leh khe li-a a pai peuhmah, ahih kei leh khe tampi a nei, leitungah a pai a hontat ganhing khempeuh, note in na ne kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a kihhuai ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A hontat ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh nomau mah a kihhuai-in na kibawltawm kei ding uh a, tuate tawh nomau na kininsak tawm kei ding uh hi. Na kinitsak tawm uhleh a nin na suak ding uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Kei pen Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi. Tua ahih ciangin note ki-ap unla, kei siangtho ka hih manin note zong siangtho un. Leitungah a bokvak a hontat ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh note na kininsak tawm kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:2; 1Pe 1:16"},"45":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ Pasian ahi dingin Egypt gam panin note a hong pai khiatpih pa pen keimah Topa ka hi hi. Tua ahih ciangin kei siangtho ka hih manin note na siangtho ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Hih pen a nin le a siang, a nungta ganhing nek theih ding le nek theih loh ding khen nadingin ganhing le vasa, tui sunga a pai a nungta ganhing khempeuh, le leitungah a hontat ganhing khempeuh tawh kisai-in ngeina ahi hi.","merge":"47"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Nausuah khit ciangin Nupite Siansuahna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Nupi khat gai-in ta pasal a neih leh ni sagih sung tua nu a nin hi ding a, a nin neih huna mah bangin amah a nin hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A ni giat ni-in a naungek vun dawn ki-at ding hi.","ref":"Pian 17:12; Luk 2:21"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin nupi in ama si luanna hangin a sian nadingin ni sawmthum le ni thum sung omlai ding hi. Amah in kisiansuahna ni a cin mateng a siangtho na khat peuhpeuh lawng loin, biakbuk sungah zong tum lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Ahih hangin amah in ta numei a neih leh, ama nin neih huna mah bangin nipikal nih sung a nin hi ding hi.
