Note in na khamtakun an na ne ding uh a, lungnuam takin na gam sung uhah na teng ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:13-15; 28:1-4"},"6":{"text":"“Keimah in gam sungah nopsakna hong pia-in, note lungnuam takin na lum ding uh a, bangmah in note hong lausak lo ding hi. Keimah in gam sung panin ganhing gilote ka hawlkhia ding a, galkidona in na gam uh hong nawk lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Note in na galte uh na delh ding uh a, note’ mai-ah namsau in amaute puksak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Note nga in zakhat zo-in, note zakhat in tul sawm na zo ding uh hi. Note’ mai-ah namsau in na galte uh puksak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Keimah in note ka hong pi ngaihsut ding a, note hong pungsakin, tampi kong phasak ding a, note tawh ka thuciamna ka kipsak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in sauveipi a kikhol anluite ne-in, a thak koih nadingin a lui na hahsiang masa ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Keimah in note lakah omna ka bawl ding a, keimah in note kong kih kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keimah, note’ lakah omin note’ Pasian ka hi ding a, note, keima mite na hi ding uh hi.","ref":"2Kor 6:16"},"13":{"text":"Note pen amau’ sila na hihloh nadingun Egypt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi. Keimah in note’ gimna hakkolte kuaitanin note a dingtangin kong paisak hi."},"14":{"text":"“Ahih hangin note in ka thu ngai loin, hih thupiaknate khempeuh na hih kei uh a,","title":"Thuman lohna Hangin Gimnate (Thkna 28:15-68)"},"15":{"text":"ka thukhamte nialin, ka biakna ngeina kipte kih a, ka thupiaknate khempeuh sem loin, ka thuciamna na palsat uhleh,"},"16":{"text":"keimah in note tungah hih bangin kong hih ding hi: Note’ tungah hong tung dingin keimah in thakhatthu a dipkuatna, zawngkhalna, le mite siasakin nuntakna a kiamsak ding cisa natna kong tungsak ding hi. Note’ lopawi zong a mawkna hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na galte un tuate ne ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Keimah in note kong maisiat ding a, na galte uh mai-ah lelhna na thuak ding uh hi. Note hong mudah mite in note hong uk ding a, kuamah in note hong delh lo napi-in na tai ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tua bang hinapi-in note in ka thu nong ngaih kei veve uhleh, keimah in na khialhna hangun a zah sagih vei-in note kong thuhilhkik ding a,"},"19":{"text":"keimah in na kiphatsakpih uh note’ vangliatna susia-in, van panin guah hong zusak loin, na leitang uh sik ka bangsak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na leitang un an piangsak loin, na gam sung uha kungte in amau’ gah gah lo ding ahih manin note’ thatang a mawkna-in a bei hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kei hong demin, keima thu na ngaih kei lai uhleh, keimah in note’ khialhna a zah sagih vei-in note’ tungah gimna kong tungsak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Keimah in note’ lakah gamsate hong khahin, amaute in na tate uh hong neksak ding uh a, na ganhingte uh susia-in, note mi tawmno khat hong suah ding a, note’ lampite zong gamkhing hong suak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Hih banga hihna tawh note hong kihei tuan loin, kei na hong demlai uhleh,"},"24":{"text":"kei zong note hong gawtin, kei mahmah in na khialhnate uh hangin a zah sagih vei-in kong sat ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Keimah in, thuciamna omsa bangin phulakna na a sem ding namsau khat note’ tungah kong tungsak ding hi. Na khuapi sung uhah note na kikaihkhop uhleh zong keimah in note’ lakah natna kong tungsak ding a, na galte uh khut sungah note hong kipia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Keimah in note’ nuntakna an ka suksiat ciangin, an kicing lo ahih manin nupi sawm in meibung khat sungah na anlum uh emkhawm ding a, na anlum uh a tawitehin hong piakhia kik ding hi. Note in na ne ding uh a, na khamzo kei ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tua bang hinapi-in note in keima thu ngai loin, kei na hong demlai uhleh,"},"28":{"text":"note ka hong heh ngawh bawl ding a, note’ khialhna hangin a zah sagih vei-in kong thuhilh ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Note na gil uh kial lua ding ahih manin na tapate uh le na tanute uh’ sa na ne ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Keimah in mual dawna na biaknate uh susia-in, na paknamtui biakna taute uh phukin, note’ milim’ siluang hawmte tungah na luanghawmte uh ka pai ding a, keimah in note kong kih ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Keimah in na khuapite uh siasakin, na biakna munte uh gamkhing ka suaksak ding a, nomau’ hong biakna a gim namtuite ka diik kei ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Keimah in leitang ka siasak ding a, tua tungah a teng na galte un lamdangsa ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Keimah in minam dangte lakah note kong thehthang ding a, keimah in namsau a paai panin dokin note kong delh ding hi. Na leitang uh gamkhing suak ding a, na khuapite uh a sia hi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin na galte uh leitangah na om tanvei uh, gamkhingin a om sungteng, leitang in tawlngak hun a ngah hi ding hi. Leitang tawlnga-in, a sabbath-te a tang hi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama tungah na ten laitakun na ngahsak loh uh tawlngakna ahi a sabbath-te, gamkhingin a om sungteng a tawlnga hi ding hi."},"36":{"text":"“Note’ sung panin galte’ leitangah a omlai mite tungah lungsim gimna ka tungsak ding hi. Nahthel ging in amaute taisak ding a, namsau mai-ah mi khat a tai bangin amaute tai ding uh a, kuamah in a delh lohpi-in amaute puk ding uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Kuamah in delh lo napi-in namsau mai pan a taikhia bangin khatlekhat na kiphupai ding uh a, na galte uh nanzawh nading vangliatna na nei kei ding uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Minam dangte lakah note na sia ding uh a, na galte uh’ leitang in note hong valhtum ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Note’ sung panin galte’ leitangah a omlaite amau’ mawhna hangin kiam ding uh a, amau’ pute pate a mawhna uh hangin a kiam bangun amau zong a kiam ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"“Ahih hangin kei tungah khemna tawh hong gamtatnasa uh le kei hong demna uh hangin amaute gawt bawlin, amau’ galte’ leitangah amaute ka paipihna hangin, amau’ mawhna le a pu a pate uh mawhna pulakin a lungsim uh niamkhiatin, amaute in a mawhna a kipuahphat uhleh,","merge":"41"},"42":{"text":"keimah in Jakob tawh ka thuciamna, Isaac tawh ka thuciamna, le Abraham tawh ka thuciamna ka phawk ding a, leitang zong ka phawk ding hi.","ref":"Pian 28:13-14; Pian 26:3-4; Pian 17:7-8"},"43":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in leitang nusia-in, amaute om loin gamkhingin a om sungteng leitang in a sabbath-te na ngah ding hi. Amaute in ka biakna ngeina kipte nialin, ka thukhamte mudah uh ahih manin, a mawhna uh a kipuahphat ding uh kisam hi."},"44":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin, a galte uh gam sungah amaute a om sungteng uh keimah in amaute nilkhia loin, amaute a susia maimang zah ding le amaute tawh ka thuciamna a pelhzah dingin amaute ka mudah kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Topa amau’ Pasian ka hi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in amaute ka ngaihsutna-in amau’ Pasian ka hih theih nadingin, minam dangte’ muhna-ah Egypt gam panin ka paikhiatpih amau’ pulepate tawh ka thuciamna ka phawk ding hi; kei pen Topa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Hihte pen Moses tungtawnin Sinai Mual tungah Topa in amah le Israel mite kikalah a bawl thukhamte le biakna ngeina kipte le thute ahi hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Ki-apnate tawh kisai Ngeinate"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Mi khat in a tuam vilvelin kiciamna a bawl ciangin, tua a kiciam mite pen nangmah in Topa -a’ in na seh dinga, a nuai-a kiseh bangin kitanh-in suaktakik thei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal kum sawmnih panin kum sawmguk a phate a man na sehna pen, biakinn shekel zangin pasal khat ciangin ngun shekel sawmnga hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Numei ahihleh shekel sawmthum hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kum nga pan kum sawmnih ciang a phate, pasal ahihleh shekel sawmnih hi ding a, numei ahihleh shekel sawm hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kha khat pan kum nga ciang a phate pen pasal ahihleh ngun shekel nga hi ding a, numei ahihleh ngun shekel thum hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Kum sawmguk pan a tungsiahte pen pasal ahihleh shekel sawm le nga hi ding a, numei ahihleh shekel sawm hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh zawnglua-in nangma sehzah a piakzawh kei leh, siampipa kiangah a mi hong kipaipih ding a, siampipa in ama man seh ding hi. A kiciam mipa a siamna tawh kizui-in siampipa in ama man seh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Mite in Topa’ tungah biakna-in a piakte pen ganhing ahihleh, mi khatpeuh in Topa’ tungah a piak tua bang ganhingte khempeuh a siangtho ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in na khat peuhpeuh, a hoihte a hoih lo tawh ahi zongin, a hoih lote a hoih tawh ahi zongin, laih lo, khek lo ding hi. Amah in ganhing khat ganhing adang khat tawh a khek leh, tua ganhing le a khekna ganhing a siangtho hi khawm ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua pen Topa’ tungah a kipia thei lo ganhing nin khat ahihleh, mipa in siampipa mai-ah a ganhing paipih ding a,"},"12":{"text":"siampipa in hoih hi, ci-in ahi zongin sia hi, ci-in ahi zongin a man zah seh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in tua ganhing a tatkik nop leh, a kisehna banah nga-ah khat behlap ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh in a siangtho dingin Topa’ tungah a inn a ap ciangin, siampipa in a hoihna le a hoih lohna tawh kizui-in a man seh ding a, siampipa’ sehna bangin kip ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A ap pa in ama inn a tatkik nop leh, a kisehna banah nga-ah khat sum tawh behlap ding a, tua inn ama a’ hi kik ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mi khat in a luah ama leitang phelkhat Topa’ tungah a ap leh, nangma sehna pen khaici vawh zah ding tawh kizui ding hi. Mangbuhham beem khat dim a pawina leitang pen ngun shekel sawmnga-in kiseh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in jubilee kum a kipanin a lo a ap leh, nangma sehna zahzah bit ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin jubilee kum khit ciangin amah in a lo a ap leh, siampipa in jubilee kumkik dong a omlai kumte tawh kizui-in a manzah sum seh ding a, nangma sehna zah panin kikhiam ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Lo a ap pa in a tatkik nop leh, a kisehna banah nga-ah khat sum tawh behlap ding a, tua lo ama a’ hisuak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in a lo a tanh nuam lo ahi a, amah in midang khat tungah a zuak ahi zongin ahihleh, tua pen amah in tanhkik thei nawn lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A lo pen, jubilee huna piak khiat ciangin, a ki-apsa lo mah bangin Topa’ tungah a siangtho hi ding a, siampipa in tua lo tang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Amah in luahna tawh a neih ahi lo, a leisa lo pen Topa’ tungah a ap leh,"},"23":{"text":"siampipa in jubilee kum ciang dong ding tua man seh ding a, tua ni-in a mipa in a kiseh zah, Topa’ tungah a siangtho-in pia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Jubilee kum ciangin a lo pen a kileinapa, gamhluahna tawh tua leitang a nei mipa tungah tungkik ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“A kisehna peuhmah biakinn shekel kizang ding hi; gerah sawmnih ciangin shekel khat hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Ahih hangin tacil pen Topa a’ hi khinzo ahih mah bangin, kuamah in ganhing tacilte ap thei lo ding hi; bawng hitaleh tuu hitaleh Topa -a’ ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ganhing nin ahihleh, nangma sehna bangin amah in lei kikin, tua banah seh nga-ah khat behlap ding hi. Tua hi lo a, a kitat kei leh, a kisehna bangin kizuak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Ahih hangin mi khat in a neih, Topa’ tungah a ap, a ki-apsa nate, mi hitaleh ganhing hitaleh, a luah ama lo hitaleh, kizuak lo ding, kitanh lo ding hi. A ki-ap na peuhmah Topa’ tungah a siangthopen ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:14"},"29":{"text":"Mite lak nangawn panin a kisusiamang dingin a ki-apsa mi peuhmah, kitanh lo ding a, kithat ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Leitang panin a piang khempeuh khaici hitaleh singgah hitaleh sawm-ah-khat Topa a’ hi a, Topa a dingin siangtho hi."},"31":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in sawm-ah-khat a piak na khat peuhpeuh a tat nop leh, amah in tua banah nga-ah khat behlap ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawnghon leh tuulekeel hon sawm-ah-khat khempeuh le a cing pa’ ciangkhut nuai-a a pai ganhing khempeuh sawm-ah-khat peuhmah Topa a dingin a siangtho hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Mi khat in pha hiam sia hiam ci-in kantel lo ding a, khek lo ding hi. A khek leh, tua leh a khekna pen a siangtho hi khawm ding hi. Tua pen kitanh lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 18:21; Thkna 14:22-29"},"34":{"text":"Hihte pen Sinai Mual tungah Topa in Israel mite a dingin Moses tungah a piak thute ahi hi."}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Gamlak Vakna","shortname":"Gam","abbr":[],"desc":"Gamlak Vakna laibu sungah Israel mite in Sinai Mual a nusiat uha kipan Pasian in amaute tungah piak dingin a ciamsa a nisuahna gamgi ciangdong a tun'dong uh kum sawmli dektak sung thu kigen hi. Hih laibu sungah a thupi pen in Israel mi a phazah a kisimna thu ahi hi. Sinai Mual panin a din'khiat ma-un Moses in mi phazah khat vei sim a, tua zawh khang khat bang ciangin Jordan Gun nisuahna lam Moab gamah khat vei sim leuleu hi. Mi phazah kisimna tua hun nih kikal sungin Kanaan gam leitaw lamah a om Kadeshbarnea gamah pai uh a, ahi zongin piak dingin a kiciamna gamah tua lam tawnin lut zo lo uh hi. Tua gamah kum tampi tak a vaitham khit uh ciangin Jordan Gun nisuahna lam gamah pai uh a, mi pawlkhatte tua gamah teng suakin, pawlkhatte gun kantanin Kanaan gamah a lut dingin kithawi uh hi. Gamlak Vakna laibu sungah thu haksa a tuahkhak uh ciangin lau-in a lungkia zelzel, Pasian langpangin, amaute a makai dingin Pasian in a seh Moses zong a langpang mite' thu kigen hi. Ama mite gina loin zong thumanglo hita se leh Pasian lungsim citakin amaute a kep teiteina thu, leh khat veivei a lungtom kha ahi zongin Pasian' tung leh ama mite' tungah Moses' lungsim khona thute kigelh hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaute, Egypt gam panin a paikhiat zawh uh a kum nihna, a kha nihna a ni masa ni-in, Sinai sehnel gam kikhopna puanbuk sungah Topa in Moses hopihin hih bangin ci hi:","title":"Sinai-ah Israel Mi Phazah A Kisimna"},"2":{"text":"“Nang le Aaron in Israel mihonte khempeuh a innkuankuan, a behbehin, pasal peuhmah a milipin a phazah sim un."},"3":{"text":"Israel sungah kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha, galdo dingin a kuan thei ding mi khempeuh a honhonin na sim ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A minam simin a beh sungah a lutang ahi mi khat ciat in hong huh ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"No hong huh dingte’ min: Reuben sung panin Shedeur’ tapa Elizur;"},"6":{"text":"Simeon sung panin Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel;"},"7":{"text":"Judah sung panin Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon;"},"8":{"text":"Issakhar sung panin Zuar’ tapa Nethanel;"},"9":{"text":"Zebulun sung panin Helon’ tapa Eliab;"},"10":{"text":"Josef tapate, Efraim sung panin Ammihud’ tapa Elishama, le Manasseh sung panin Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel;"},"11":{"text":"Benjamin sung panin Gideoni’ tapa Abidan;"},"12":{"text":"Dan sung panin Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer;"},"13":{"text":"Asher sung panin Okran’ tapa Pagiel;"},"14":{"text":"Gad sung panin Deuel’ tapa Eliasaf;"},"15":{"text":"Naftali sung panin Enan’ tapa Ahira ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Hihte pen mihon sung panin a kiteel, amau’ phung sung panin a makaite, Israel behte’ lutangte ahi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin Moses le Aaron in a min kilosa hih mite khawmin, a kha nihna a ni masa ni-in amaute in kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha peuhmah a milipin a innkuankuan, a behbehin amau le amau a kiciamteh mihon buppite khawm uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in Sinai sehnel gamah amaute a phazah a sim hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha pasal peuhmah, a milipin, a innkuankuan, a behbehin, galdo dingin a kuan thei khempeuh, Israel’ tacil Reuben suanlekhakte a kipanin a mi phazah a sim uh a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Reuben minam tul sawmli le tulguk le zanga a pha hi. Simeon minam tul sawmnga le tulkua le zathum a pha hi. Gad minam tul sawmli le tulnga le zaguk le sawmnga a pha hi. Judah minam tul sawmsagih le tulli le zaguk a pha hi. Issakhar minam tul sawmnga le tulli le zali a pha hi. Zebulun minam tul sawmnga le tulsagih le zali a pha hi. Efraim minam tul sawmli le zanga a pha hi. Manasseh minam tul sawmthum le tulnih le zanih a pha hi. Benjamin minam tul sawmthum le tulnga le zali a pha hi. Dan minam tul sawmguk le tulnih le zasagih a pha hi. Asher minam tul sawmli le tulkhat le zanga a pha hi. Naftali minam tul sawmnga le tulthum le zali a pha hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel mi a vekpi, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah, a beh behin, Israel sung pan galdo dingin a kuan thei pasal peuhmah: A vekpi-in tul zaguk le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga a pha hi.","merge":"46","ref":"Gam 26:1-51"},"47":{"text":"Ahih hangin Levi mite in amau’ nam min mah a tuamin pua uh ahih manin adangte tawh kisimkhawm lo hi.","title":"Biakbuk lamah Levi mite Kiseh"},"48":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"49":{"text":"“Levi minamte na sim kei ding a, Israel mite lakah amaute na simkhawm kei ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Ahih hangin Levi mite pen thuciamna biakbuk le a sung nazat khempeuh, le tua tawh a kisai na khempeuh a uk dingin seh in. Amaute pen biakbuk le a nazat khempeuh a pua dingte hi a, amaute in a biakbuk semin, a kimkotah phual sat ding uh hi."},"51":{"text":"Biakbuk a kikhin ding ciangin Levi mite in phel ding uh a, biakbuk a kilam ding ciangin Levi mite mah in lam ding uh hi. Midang khat peuhpeuh in tua nasep a sep leh tua mi kithat ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Israel mite in a milipun amau’ giahphual ciat leh a dialkhai gei ciat uhah a pawlpawlin a puanbuk uh lam ding uh hi."},"53":{"text":"Ahih hangin Israel mihonte tungah hehna a om loh nadingin thuciamna biakbuk kiimah Levi mite bek in phual sat ding uh a, Levi mite bek in thuciamna biakbuk kem ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"54":{"text":"Tua bangin Israel mite gamta uh a, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin amaute in a sem uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah hih bangin gen hi:","title":"Giahphualte le Minam Makaite"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite in amau’ dialkhai gei ciatah a beh dialkhaite tawh phual sat ding uh a, amaute in a pang simah kikhopna buk mai ngatin phual sat ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Nisuahna lampangah phual a sat dingte pen Judah’ giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite le a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Judah mite a makai pa pen Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmsagih le tulli le zaguk a pha hi. Issakhar mite a makai pa pen Zuar’ tapa Nethanel hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmnga le tulli le zali a pha hi. Zebulun mite a makai pa pen Helon’ tapa Eliab hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmnga le tulsagih le zali a pha hi. Judah’ phualah a pawlpawlin a omte a vekpi-in tul za le tul sawmgiat le tulguk le zali a pha hi. A kipaikhiat ciangin amau masa ding uh hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"A leitaw lampangah a pawlpawlin Reuben’ giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite le a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi. Reuben mite a makai pa pen Shedeur’ tapa Elizur hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmli le tulguk le zanga a pha hi. Simeon mite a makai pa pen Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmnga le tulkua le zathum a pha hi. Gad mite a makai pa pen Reuel’ tapa Eliasaf hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmli le tulnga le zaguk le sawmnga a pha hi. Reuben’ giahphual ah a pawlpawlin a omte a vekpi-in tul za le tul sawmnga le tulkhat le zali le sawmnga a pha hi. Amaute a nihna-ah paikhia ding uh hi.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin kikhopna buk pen, giahphualte’ laizangah a om Levi mite’ phual tawh kikhin khawm ding a, a phual sat hun mah bangun amau’ san ciatah a dialkhai uh tawh paikhia ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"A nitumna lampangah a pawlpawlin Efraim giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite le a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi. Efraim mite a makai pa pen Ammihud’ tapa Elishama hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmli le zanga a pha hi. Manasseh mite a makai pa pen Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmthum le tulnih le zanih a pha hi. Benjamin mite a makai pa pen Gideoni’ tapa Abidan hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmthum le tulnga le zali a pha hi. Efraim giahphual ah a pawlpawlin a omte a vekpi-in tul za le tulgiat le zakhat a pha hi. Amaute a thumna-ah paikhia ding uh hi.","merge":"24"},"25":{"text":"A leilu lampangah a pawlpawlin Dan giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite le a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi. Dan mite a makai pa pen Ammishaddai’ tapa Ahiezer hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmguk le tulnih le zasagih a pha hi. Asher mite a makai pa pen Okran’ tapa Pagiel hi a, ama pawl tul sawmli le tulkhat le zanga a pha hi. Naftali mite a makai pa pen Enan’ tapa Ahira hi a, ama pawl mi tul sawmnga le tulthum le zali a pha hi. Dan’ giahphual a om mi a vekpi-in tul za le tul sawmnga le tulsagih le zaguk a pha hi. Amaute a dialkhai tawh kizui-in a pai nunung ding uh ahi hi.","merge":"31"},"32":{"text":"Hihte pen Israel mite a beh zui-a kisim hi a, a pawlpawlin giahphual ah a om mi a vekpi-in tul zaguk le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga a pha hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin Israel mite lakah Levi mite kisimkhawm lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua bangin Israel mite gamta uh hi. Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin a beh tawh kizui-in a innkuankuanin amau’ dialkhaite’ gei-ah giahphual sat uh a, tua bangmahin paikhia uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte pen Sinai Mual tungah Topa in Moses tawh a thugen hun lai-a Aaron le Moses’ huna mite ahi hi.","title":"Levi mi Phazah le a Nasep uh"},"2":{"text":"Aaron’ tapate’ minte in: A ta upa Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar hi a,","ref":"Gam 26:60"},"3":{"text":"sathau a kinilh siampi, siampi za-ah na a sem dingin a kikipsak, Aaron’ tapate’ minte ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin Sinai sehnel gam Topa’ mai-ah mei siangtho lo a zat uh ciangin Topa’ mai-ah Nadab le Abihu si hi. Amaute in ta nei lo uh ahih ciangin Eleazar le Ithamar in a pa uh Aaron’ nuntak sungteng bek siampi na a sem uh ahi hi.","ref":"Siam 10:1-2; Gam 26:61"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"6":{"text":"“Levi minamte va paipih inla, amaute in siampi Aaron’ na a sep theih nadingun a mai-ah va koih in."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk-ah a sep uh ciangin amah le mihonpi a dingin kikhopna buk mai-ah na sem ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in kikhopna buk sung nazat khempeuh vaan ding uh a, biakbuk-ah a sep uh ciangin Israel mite a dingin na sem ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in Aaron le a tapate’ tungah Levi mite na pia ding a, amaute pen Israel mite lak panin keima tungah a kipiate hi ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in Aaron le a tapate na seh ding a, amaute in a siampi nasep uh don ding uh hi. Ahih hangin midang khatpeuh in siampi nasep a sep leh, tua mi kithat ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"12":{"text":"“En in, Israel mite lakah tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite ka la khin hi. Levi mite pen keima a’ hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tacil khempeuh keima-a’ ahi hi. Egypt gam sungah tacil khempeuh ka thah ni-in, Israel sungah tacil khempeuh, mihing tacil le ganhing tacil khempeuh, keima a dingin ka ap a, amaute pen keima a’ hi ding hi; kei pen Topa ka hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 13:2"},"14":{"text":"Topa in Sinai sehnel gam Moses kiangah,"},"15":{"text":"“Levi mite, a behbeh, a innkuankuanin, pasal kha khat a pha panin a tungsiah peuhmah na sim ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses thu a kipiak bangin amah in Topa’ thupiakna tawh kizui-in amaute a sim hi."},"17":{"text":"Levi’ tapate’ min in: Gershon, Kohath, le Merari ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Gershon’ tapate’ min in: Libni le Shimei ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate’ min in: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Merari’ tapate’ min in: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Hih mite pen Levi mite beh lutangte ahi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Gershon-te beh pen Libni mite le Shimei mite hi a, hihte pen Gershon-te beh ahi uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute, kha khat pan a tungsiah a pha pasal peuhmah tulsagih le zanga ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Gershon-te beh in nitumna lam biakbuk nungah giahphual sat ding uh a,"},"24":{"text":"tua Gershon mite sung pan a beh ukpi pen Lael’ tapa Eliasaf hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Gershon-te beh in kikhopna buk sungah a et dingte pen a biakbuk, puanbuk a tuamna tawh, kikhopna buk kongkhak puankhai,"},"26":{"text":"buktual a puan kikhaite, biakbuk kiima om buktual a kongkhak puankhai le biakna tau, le a khaute le hihte tawh a kizom nasep khempeuh ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Kohath-te beh pen Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite, le Uzziel mite hi a, hihte pen Kohath-te beh ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasal khempeuh kha khat pan a tungsiah, biakbuk nasep a sem peuhmah tulgiat le zaguk ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Kohath-te beh in biakbuk leitaw lampangah giahphual sat ding uh a,"},"30":{"text":"Kohath mite sung pan a beh ukpi pen Uzziel’ tapa Elizafan hi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amau’ et dingte pen thuciamna singkuang, a sabuai, a meivakkhuam, a biakna taute, siampite in nasepna-in a zat uh biakbuk nazatte’ kidalna puan le hihte tawh a kizom nasep khempeuh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar pen Levi mi makaite tungah a ukpi hi ding a, biakbuk a en mite’ nasepna vil ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Merari-te beh pen Mahli mite le Mushi mite hi a, hihte pen Merari-te beh ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaute kha khat panin a tungsiah pasal peuhmah tulguk le zanih ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Merari-te beh sung pan a beh ukpi pen Abihail’ tapa Zuriel hi ding a, amaute pen biakbuk leilu lampangah giahphual a sat dingte ahi uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Merari-te beh’ et dinga a kisehte pen biakbuk khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, khuam bullente, a nengneng teng le hihte tawh a kizom nasep khempeuh ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Buktual kimkota khuampite le a bullente tawh, khetphimte le a khaute zong ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Nisuahna lampang biakbuk mai, kikhopna buk mai-ah giahphual a sat ding mite pen Israel mite a dingin bang khat peuhpeuh sep nadingin biakbuk sungah thu a nei Moses le Aaron le a tapate hi a, midang khatpeuh in biakbuk sungah na a sep leh kithat ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in Topa’ thupiakna tawh a innkuankuanun a sim Levi mi pasal kha khat panin a tungsiah peuhmah tul sawmnih le tulnih a pha hi."},"40":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Israel mite sung pan pasal tacil khempeuh sim inla, kha khat panin a tungsiah peuhmah a min la in.","title":"Levi mite le Tacil Kitatna"},"41":{"text":"Israel mite lak panin tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite nong laksak ding a, Israel mite’ ganhing tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite’ ganhing nong laksak ding hi - kei pen Topa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Topa’ thupiak bangin Israel mite lakah tacil khempeuh a sim hi."},"43":{"text":"Kha khat panin a tungsiah tacil pasal a kisim peuhmah tul sawmnih leh tulnih le zanih le sawmsagih le thum ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"45":{"text":"“Israel mite lakah tacil khempeuh le a ganhingte uh tang dingin Levi mite le a ganhingte uh la in. Levi mite keima a’ hi ding hi; kei pen Topa ka hi hi."},"46":{"text":"Levi mi pasal khempeuh sangin Israel mi tacil khempeuh zanih le sawmsagih le thumin tamzaw ahih manin,"},"47":{"text":"tuate tat nadingin shekel khatah gerah sawmnih a pha, biakinn shekel zangin mi khat ciangin shekel nga pai la inla,"},"48":{"text":"tua a tamzaw teng a kitatna uh sumte Aaron le a tapate tungah pia in,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Levi mite banah a vallai mite tung panin kitatkhiatna sum la a,"},"50":{"text":"biakinn shekel zangin Israel mi tacilte tung panin sum shekel tul khat le zathum le sawmguk le nga a la hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciangin, Topa in Moses a thupiak mah bangin Topa’ thu tawh kizui-in kitatkhiatna sumte Aaron le a tapate tungah Moses in a pia hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Levi mite le a Ki-ap Nasepte"},"2":{"text":"“Levi mite lak panin Kohath mite amau’ innkuankuan le a behbehin,"},"3":{"text":"kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mi khempeuh sim in."},"4":{"text":"Kikhopna buk sungah Kohath mite in a siangthopen nate tawh kisai nasepte sem ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Giahphual a kisuan ding ciangin Aaron le a tapate tumin kidalna puan lakhia ding uh a, tua puan tawh thuciamna singkuang tun ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in savun tawh tuam ding uh a, tua tungah puan a dum tawh khuhin, a zawlte bulh ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ompihna Anlum sabuai tungah amaute in puan a dum phah ding uh a, tua tungah a kuangdaite, paknamtui pakante, kuang-ukte, le tuibuahna thawl gongbakte koih ding uh a, a kikoih tawntung anlum zong a tungah om ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a ausan puan tawh tuate khuh ding uh a, savun tawh khuh thuahin, a zawlte bulh ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Mei vakna meikhuam pen, a meivakte, a taitehte, a kuangte, le sathau piakna nazatte khempeuh tawh puan a dum khatin tun ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in a nazat khempeuh savun-in tunin a puak nading tal tungah koih ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Puan a dum khat tawh kham biakna tau khuh ding uh a, savun tawh tua mah tuam thuahin, a zawlte bulh ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk sungah a kizang nazat khempeuh la-in puan dum khat tawh tunin, savun tawh tuate tun thuah ding uh a, a puak nading tal tungah koih ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in a biakna tau panin a vutte luakkhia ding uh a, a tungah puan a dupsan khat phah ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua lai-ah nasep nadinga a kizang, biakna tau nazat khempeuh, a vutluahna peek, a tu-ka, a kawbia, le a kuang, biakna tau nazat khempeuh, a tungah koihin, tua tungah savun tawh tuam ding uh a, a zawlte bulh ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in biakbuk le biakbuk nazat khempeuh a tun khit uh giahphual a kisuan ciangin, tuate a pua dingin Kohath mite hong pai ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute in a siangtho nate lawngkha lo ding uh hi; lawng le-uh si ding uh hi. Hihte pen Kohath mite’ puak ding kikhopna buk nate ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in meivak tui, a namtui paknamtui, a kikoih tawntung an tawh biakna, nilh sathau, le biakbuk le a sunga om khempeuh, le a nazat khempeuh uk ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah,"},"18":{"text":"“Levi mite lakah Kohath minamte a sih loh nadingin hih un."},"19":{"text":"A siangthopen nate nai-ah amaute a pai ciangun si loin a hinna dingun hih un. Aaron le a tapate pai-in a nasep ding uh le a van puak ding ciat uhah amaute seh ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin a siangtho nate tomkhano sung bek nangawn a en dingin amaute tum lo ding uh hi; tum le-uh si ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"22":{"text":"“Gershon mite zong, amau’ innkuankuan le a behbehin sim in."},"23":{"text":"Kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mi khempeuh na sim ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Nasep le van puak ciangin Gershon-te beh’ nasep dingte:"},"25":{"text":"Biakbuk dalna puante, kikhopna buk a tuamna tawh, a tungzang a om a khuhna tuuvun, kikhopna buk kongkhak-a puankhai,"},"26":{"text":"buktual a puan kikhaite, biakbuk le biakna tau kimkotah a om buktual kongpi puankhaite, a khaute, le amau’ nasep nadinga nazat khempeuh pua ding uh a, amaute in tuate tawh a kizom nasep kisam khempeuh sem ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Gershon beh pasalte’ nasep ding, a puak ding le a hih dingte khempeuh uh Aaron le a tapate’ thupiakna bang hi ding a, a puak ding khempeuh uh amaute na ap ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Hih pen kikhopna buk sungah Gershon beh pasalte’ nasep hi a, amau’ nasepna pen siampi Aaron’ tapa Ithamar’ ukna nuai hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Merari mite zong amau’ innkuankuan le a behbehin,"},"30":{"text":"kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha mi khempeuh na sim ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Kikhopna buk sungah amau’ sep dingte in: Biakbuk khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, khuam bullente tawh,"},"32":{"text":"a kimkota om buktual a khuampite a bullente tawh, khetphimte, a khaute, a nazatte khempeuh le a nengnengte hi a, amaute’ puak dingin a kiseh nate a minin na lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Hih pen siampi Aaron’ tapa Ithamar’ khutnuai-ah Merari mite in kikhopna buk sungah a sep ding teng uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa’ thupiakna bangin Moses le Aaron le mihonte’ makaite in Levi mite sung panin beh thumte - Kohath-te beh, Gershon-te beh, le Merari-te beh sunga om pasal mi phazah sim uh hi. Kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha a behbehin a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Kohath mi pasal a behtangun tulnih le zasagih le sawmnga a pha hi. Gershon mi pasal a behtangun tulnih le zaguk le sawmthum a pha hi. Merari mi pasal a behtangun tulthum le zanih ahi hi. Moses le Aaron le Israel makaite in a sim, Levi mi a kisim peuhmah, van puak nasep le kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha, a vekpi-in tulgiat le zanga le sawmgiat a pha hi.","merge":"48"},"49":{"text":"Moses’ tungtawnin Topa’ thupiakna bangin a sep ding a puak ding ciat uh kiseh a, Topa’ thupiak bangin Moses in amaute a sim hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"A Siang lote Giahphual pan Kihawlkhia"},"2":{"text":"“Amaute in miphakte, ninneite le misi tawh kisukha-in a ninte khempeuh giahphual pua-ah a omsak nadingun Israel mite thu pia in."},"3":{"text":"A laizangah keima omna ahi amau’ giahphual a nitsak loh nadingun hih bangin a nin numei le pasal paikhiasakin, giahphual pua-ah na omsak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Israel mite in hih uh a, giahphual pua-ah amaute hawlkhia uh hi. Topa in Moses tungah a gen bangin Israel mite in hih uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Ditkikna Ngeina"},"6":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Topa’ tungah mite a khialh theihna ahi khialhna khat peuhpeuh, numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin gamta-in a mawh leh,"},"7":{"text":"a gamtatnasa a khialhna pulak ding hi. Amah in a tatkhialhna-ah a kicingin dinkik ding a, tua tungah nga-ah khat behlapin, a khialhna mi tungah pia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin a khialhna mi in tua khialhna hanga ditkikna a sang ding tanau a neih kei leh, a khial mi a dingin kilemna a bawlsakna ahi kilemna tuutal banah, khialhna hanga tua ditkikna pen siampipa a dingin Topa’ tungah tung ding hi.","ref":"Siam 6:1-7"},"9":{"text":"Amaute in siampipa tungah a paipih uh biakna peuhmah, Israel mite’ na a siangthote khempeuh, ama a’ hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khempeuh’ na a siangthote zong ama a’ hi ding a, mi khatpeuh in siampipa tungah a piak peuhmah ama a’ hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Upmawhna tawh kisai Ngeina"},"12":{"text":"“Israel mite kiangah hih bangin gen in: Mi khatpeuh’ zi vakvai-in a pasal a palhngulh a,"},"13":{"text":"pasal khat in tua nu luppihin, a pasal in tua thu a theih kei a, tua nu kininsak napi-in kuamah in phawk loin, a khialh laitakin tua nu kiman lo ahih manin a langah a pang ding teci a om loh hangin,"},"14":{"text":"a pasal in upmawhna lungsim nei-in, a kininsak tawm a zi a upmawh leh; tua ahih kei leh zong, a numei kininsak lo napi-in, a pasal in upmawhna lungsim nei-in, a zi a upmawh le;"},"15":{"text":"tua pa in siampipa kiangah a zi paipihin, tuanu a dingin a kisam biakna, mangbuhham lawh khat paipih ding hi. A tungah sathau sung loin, paknamtui zong koih lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna, mawhna phawkkik nadinga an tawh biakna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Siampipa in tua nu va paipihin, Topa’ mai-ah koih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Siampipa in lei beel khatin tui siangtho la ding a, biakbuk sual tunga om leivui tawmkhat la-in tua tui sungah khah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Siampipa in Topa’ mai-ah tua numei koih ding a, numei’ sam phelin, upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna ahi phawkkikna an tawh biakna tua numei tawisak ding hi. Siampipa in ama khut sungah tuisia tawi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in amah kiciamsakin, ‘Na pasal’ ukna nuai-ah na om sungin, kuamah in nang hong luppih loin, nitna lamah a kihel lo na hih leh, hih tuisia panin suakta in."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin na pasal’ ukna nuai-ah om napi-in nangmah vakvai a, nang le nang kininsakin, na pasal ahi lo midang khat in nang hong luppih leh,"},"21":{"text":"(siampipa in tua numei kiciamsak ding a, tua nu kiangah) Topa in na pheipi teemsakin na pumpi a pawmsak ciangin, na mite lakah hamsia le kiciamna-a zat dingin Topa in nang hong bawlin,"},"22":{"text":"hih tuisia in na gil sung zui hen la, na pumpi pawmsakin na pheipi teemsak hen,’ ci ding hi. Tua ciangin numei in, ‘Amen, Amen,’ ci ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tua ciangin siampipa in laibu khat sungah hih hamsiate gelhin tuisia sungah silkhia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua numei a nasak velval thei ding tuisia a dawnsak"},"25":{"text":"siampipa in numei’ khutsung panin upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna lakhia ding a, Topa’ mai-ah tua an vei-in biakna tau-ah paipih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Siampipa in phawk nadingin an tawh biakna khut dim khat la-in biakna tau tungah hal ding a, tua khit ciangin a tui pen a numei dawnsak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in a tui a dawnsak khit ciangin, tua nu amahmah kininsakin a pasal tungah thuman loin gamta ahihleh, tua tuisia pen ama sungah tumin nasak velval ding a, a pumpi pawmin a pheipi teem ding a, tua numei pen mite lakah hamsiatna-in kizang ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin amahmah a kininsak hi loin a siang ahihleh, tua nu suakta-in ta nei thei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Zi khat, a pasal’ ukna nuai-ah om napi-in vakvai-in amahmah a kinitsak ciang,"},"30":{"text":"ahih kei leh pasal khat in upmawhna lungsim nei-in a zi a upmawh ciangin, upmawhna thute-ah zat ding ngeina tu-a bang ahi hi. Siampipa in Topa’ mai-ah numei koih ding a, hih ngeina khempeuh numei’ tungah zang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Hih thu-ah pasal in mawhsakna thuak lo ding a, ahih hangin numei a mawh leh ama mawhna thuak ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Nazir mite’ Ngeina"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin, Topa a dingin amahmah a kituam koih nadingin Nazir kiciamna ahi, a tuam mahmah kiciamna a bawl ciangin,"},"3":{"text":"leenggahzu le khamtheihzu ne lo ding hi. Leenggahzu le khamtheihzu pan a kibawl tuithuk dawn lo ding a, leenggahtui khat peuhpeuh dawn loin, leenggah a hing hitaleh a keu hitaleh ne lo ding hi.","ref":"Luk 1:15"},"4":{"text":"Amah a kituam koih hun sungteng leenggui panin a piang bangmah ne lo ding a, a tang ahi a, a hawng nangawn ahi zongin ne lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tuam om dingin a kiciam hun sungteng ama lu tungah mulkiatna kitah lo ding hi. Topa a dingin a tuam om hun a cin mateng amah a siangtho hi ding a, a sam a sau-in hawi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa a dingin a tuam om hun sungteng mi siluang kiangah pai lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A nu, a pa, a sanggamnu, a sanggampa ahi zongin a sih leh tuate khat peuhpeuh hangin amah kininsak lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian a dingin a tuam omna ama lu tungah om hi."},"8":{"text":"A tuam om hun sungteng Topa a dingin a siangtho ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh ama gei-ah thakhatin si-in, amah in a ki-ap ama sam a nitsak leh, ni sagih sung ngakin tua ciangin kisiansuahin a sam met ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A ni giat ni-in amah in siampipa kiang kikhopna bukkongah vakhu nih ahih kei leh kawl vakhuno nih paipih ding a,"},"11":{"text":"siampipa in khialhna hanga biak nadingin khat pia-in, meihal biak nadingin a khat pia ding a, ama a dingin kilemna bawlsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh misi luang hangin amah khial hi. Amah in tua ni mahin a lutang apphakik ding a,"},"12":{"text":"a tuam om ding hun sungteng Topa a dingin amah tuam omin, mawhna hanga biak nadingin kum khat a pha tuuno a pa khat paipih ding hi. Ahih hangin ama tuam omna kininsak khin ahih manin a masa hun pen a mawkna hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“A tuam om hun a cin ciangin zuih ding Nazir ngeinate: Kikhopna buk kongah amah kipaipih ding a,"},"14":{"text":"amah in Topa’ tungah letsong ahi meihal biak nadingin kum khat a pha a sitbaang lo tuuno a pa khat, khialhna hanga biak nadingin kum khat a pha a sitbaang lo tuuno a nu khat, le thunuama biak nadingin a sitbaang lo tuutal khat,"},"15":{"text":"le silngo sawh loh anlum lawh khat, sathau tawh a kibawl annel mohte, le silngo sawh loh, sathau tawh a kizut mohphengte, le an tawh biaknate le leenggahzu tawh biaknate paipih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Siampipa in Topa’ mai-ah tuate paipihin a khialhna hanga biakna le a meihal biakna pia ding a,"},"17":{"text":"a tuutal pen Topa’ tungah thunuama biakna-in silngo sawh loh anlum lawh tawh piakhawm ding a, an tawh a biakna le leenggahzu tawh biakna zong siampipa in pia ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua Nazir mipa in a ki-ap a sam, kikhopna bukkongah met ding a, a ki-ap ama lutang panin a samte la-in thunuama biakpiakna nuai-ah a om mei sungah hal ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Siampipa in a kihuansa tuutal liang, le lawh sung panin silngo sawh loh moh khat, le silngo sawh loh mohpheng khat la-in, a ki-ap hun sunga a sam a met khit ciangin tua Nazir mipa’ khutah tuate koih ding a,"},"20":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah vei-a biak nadingin siampipa in tuate vei ding hi. Tuate pen a kivei a sa-iik le a kipia a phei tawh siampipa a dingin a siangtho ama tanh ahi hi. Tua khit ciangin Nazir mipa in leenggahzu ne thei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Hih pen kiciamna a la Nazir mipa a dingin ngeina ahi hi. Ama piakzawh zahzah a piak banah, Topa’ tungah ama piakna pen Nazir hihna tawh a kiciamna bang hi ding a, ama kiciamna mah bangin amah in Nazir hihna tawh tuam om nading ngeina zui-in a gamta ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 21:23-24"},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Siampi Thupha-piakna"},"23":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate tungah hih bangin gen in: Note in hih bangin Israel mite thupha na pia ding uh hi. Amaute tungah hih bangin na ci ding uh hi:"},"24":{"text":"Topa in note thupha hong pia-in hong kem tahen."},"25":{"text":"Topa in note tungah a maitang hong taangsakin note hong ompih tahen."},"26":{"text":"Topa in note tungah a maipha hong pia hen la, note tungah nopsakna hong pia ta hen,’ ci-in thupha pia uh hen."},"27":{"text":"“Amaute in tua bangin Israel mite tungah keima min lo ding uh a, keimah in amaute thupha ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in biakbuk dingsakin, tua biakbuk le a nazatte khempeuh sathau nuhin ap a, biakna tau le a nazatte khempeuh sathau nuhin a ap a man ni-in,","title":"Biakna tau Ap nadinga Piakte"},"2":{"text":"Israel makaite, a beh ukpite, minam makaite ahi a kisim mite a ukte in,"},"3":{"text":"buk a nei leeng guk le bawngtal sawm le nih Topa’ mai-ah paipih uh a, leeng khatah makai nih, mi khatah bawngtal khat ciatin sehin a biakna uh pia uh hi. Amaute in biakbuk mai-ah tuate pia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"5":{"text":"“Kikhopna buk nasepna-ah zat dingin amau’ tung panin tuate sang inla, a nasep ciat uh tawh kizui-in Levi mite pia in,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in leengte le bawngtalte saangin Levi mite a pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Amau’ nasep tawh kizui-in Gershon mite tungah leeng nih le bawngtal li pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Siampi Aaron’ tapa Ithamar’ ukna nuai-ah na a sem Merari mite tungah amau’ nasep tawh kizui-in leeng li le bawngtal giat pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kohath mite tungah bangmah pia lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh liangko-ah a puak ding uh a siangtho nate kep ding amaute tavuan kipia hi."},"10":{"text":"Biakna tau sathau a kinuh ni-in a ap nadingin makaite in a biakna uh biakna tau mai-ah pia uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Biakna tau ap nadingin makai khat in ni khat ciat a biakna uh pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"A ni masa ni-a biakna a piapa pen Judah minam, Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama piakte pen biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in shekel za le sawmthum a gik ngun kuangdai khat, shekel sawmsagih a gik ngun kuang khat, an tawh biak nadingin sathau tawh a kibawl annel a dim tuak tawh;"},"14":{"text":"shekel sawm a gik kham pakan khat, paknamtui a dim tawh;"},"15":{"text":"meihal biak nadingin bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, kum khat a pha tuuno a pa khat;"},"16":{"text":"khialhna hanga biak nadingin keel a pa khat,"},"17":{"text":"le thunuama biakpiak nadingin bawngtal nih, tuutal nga, keel a pa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa nga ahi hi. Hihte pen Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon’ piak ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni nih ni-in Issakhar mite a makai, Zuar’ tapa Nethanel in biakna pia hi."},"19":{"text":"A biak nadingin amah in biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in shekel za le sawmthum a gik ngun kuangdai khat, shekel sawmsagih a gik ngun kuang khat, an tawh biak nadingin sathau tawh a kibawl annel a dim tuak tawh;"},"20":{"text":"shekel sawm a gik kham pakan khat, paknamtui a dim tawh;"},"21":{"text":"meihal biak nadingin bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, kum khat a pha tuuno a pa khat;"},"22":{"text":"khialhna hanga biak nadingin keel a pa khat;"},"23":{"text":"le thunuama biakpiak nadingin bawngtal nih, tuutal nga, keel a pa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa nga ahi hi. Hihte pen Zuar’ tapa Nethanel’ piak ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Zebulun mite a makai, Helon’ tapa Eliab ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama piakte pen biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in shekel za le sawmthum a gik ngun kuangdai khat, shekel sawmsagih a gik ngun kuang khat, an tawh biak nadingin sathau tawh a kibawl annel a dim tuak tawh;"},"26":{"text":"shekel sawm a gik kham pakan khat, paknamtui a dim tawh;"},"27":{"text":"meihal biak nadingin bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, kum khat a pha tuuno a pa khat;"},"28":{"text":"khialhna hanga biak nadingin keel a pa khat;"},"29":{"text":"le thunuama biakpiak nadingin bawngtal nih, tuutal nga, keel a pa nga, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa nga ahi hi. Hihte pen Enan’ tapa Ahira’ piak ahi hi."},"84":{"text":"Biakna tau sathau a kinuh ni-in a piakte: Ngun kuangdai sawm le nih, ngun kuang sawm le nih,"},"85":{"text":"ngun kuangdai khat ciangin shekel za le sawmthum gikin ngun kuang khat ciangin shekel sawmsagih gik a, ngun kuangte khempeuh pen biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in shekel tulnih le zali gik hi."},"86":{"text":"Paknamtui tawh a kidim kham pakan sawm le nihte, biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in khat ciangin shekel sawm gik a, kham pakan khempeuh pen shekel za le sawmnih gik hi."},"87":{"text":"Meihal biak nadingin ganhing khempeuh pen bawngtal sawm le nih, kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sawm le nih, an-a biaknate tawh; le khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa sawm le nih,"},"88":{"text":"le thunuama biakpiakna-in ganhing khempeuh bawngtal sawmnih le li, tuutal sawmguk, keel a pa sawmguk, kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sawmguk ahi hi. Hihte pen biakna tau sathau a kinuh khit ciangin apna biakna ahi hi."},"89":{"text":"Topa tawh a kiho dingin kikhopna buk sungah Moses a pai ciangin, kherub nihte’ kikal, thuciamna singkuang tungah a om hehpihna tokhom tung san teng panin amah a hopih awging khat om a, tua awging in Moses a hopih hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Aaron in Meivakte Vak"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron tungah hih bangin gen in. Meivakte na koih ciangin, meivak sagihte in meivak khuam mai teng a taan dingin koih in, ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Aaron in tua bangmahin hih a, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin, meivak khuam mai teng a taan dingin meivakte a koih hi."},"4":{"text":"Meivakkhuam a kibawlna zia in: Kham a kiseek hi a, a bul pan a kipan a paakte dongin a kiseek ahi hi. Topa in Moses tungah a lahsa lim tawh kizui-in amah in meivakkhuam a bawl hi.","ref":"Pai 25:31-40; 37:17-24"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Levi mite a Ki-apna"},"6":{"text":"“Israel mite lak panin Levi mi teng lakhia inla, amaute siangsak in."},"7":{"text":"Amaute siansak nadingin hih bangin na hih ding hi: Siansuahna tui amaute tungah theh inla, a pumpi khempeuh uh mulkiatna tawh amau kiatsak inla, a puante uh sawpin amau mah na kisiang tawmsak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin bawngtalno khat le sathau le annel a kibawl an tawh biakna amaute na lasak ding a, nangmah in khialhna hanga biak nadingin bawngtalno adang khat na la ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kikhopna buk mai-ah Levi mite paipihin, Israel mihon buppi na khawm ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah Levi mite na paipih ciangin, Israel mite in Levi mite tungah a khut uh nga ding uh a,"},"11":{"text":"amaute in Topa’ na a sep theih nadingun Aaron in Israel mite sung panin Levi mite Topa’ mai-ah vei-a biakna-in a pia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi mite in bawngtalte’ lu tungah a khut uh nga ding uh hi. Levi mite a’ ding kilemna bawlsak nadingin khialhna hanga biakna-in khat, meihal biakna-in a khat, Topa’ tungah na pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate’ mai-ah Levi mite na koih ding a, Topa’ tungah amaute vei-a biakna-in na pia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua bangin Israel mite lak panin Levi mite na khenkhia ding a, Levi mite keima a’ hi ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute siangthosakin vei-a biakna-in na piak khit ciangin kikhopna bukah na a sem dingin Levi mite pai ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite’ lak panin kei’ tungah amaute hong kipia khin hi. Israel mite’ tacil khempeuh tang dingin keima a dingin amaute ka la khin hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite’ lakah tacil khempeuh mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh keima-a’ ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah tacil khempeuh ka thah ni-in keima a dingin amaute ka tuam koih a,","ref":"Pai 13:2"},"18":{"text":"Israel mite’ lak panin tacil khempeuh tang dingin Levi mite ka la khin hi."},"19":{"text":"Kikhopna bukah Israel mite a dingin na a sem ding le, biakbuk mai-ah Israel mite a paikhak ciangin Israel mite’ lakah gimna a tun loh nadingin Israel mite a dingin kilemna a bawl dingin Israel mite’ lak panin Aaron le a tapate’ tungah letsongin Levi mite ka pia khin hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bangin Moses le Aaron le Israel mihonpite khempeuh in Levi mite’ tungah a hih uh hi. Topa in Levi mite tawh kisai-in Moses’ tungah a thupiak khempeuh tawh kizui-in Israel mite in amaute tungah a hih uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel mite, khialhna panin amaute kisiangthosak tawm uh a, a puante uh sawp uh hi. Aaron in vei-a biakna-in Topa’ mai-ah amaute pia a, amaute siansak nadingin Aaron in amau a’ ding kilemna a bawlsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Aaron le a tapate’ omna kikhopna buk sungah na a sem dingin Levi mite a pai uh hi. Topa in Levi mite tawh kisai-in Moses a thupiak bangin amaute in Levi mite’ tungah a hih uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Levi mite’ Nasep Tanvei"},"24":{"text":"“Hih pen Levi mite tawh a kisai thu ahi hi. Kum sawmnih le kum nga pan a tungsiah a phate, kikhopna buk nasepna sungah na a sem dingin hong pai ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Kum sawmnga a phak uh a kipan nasepna panin amau kihemkhia-in na sem nawn lo ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahih hangin kikhopna buk sungah a sanggamte uh huh ding a, amaute in a na taktak sem lo ding uh hi. Tua bangin Levi mite’ nasep ding na seh ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaute Egypt gam panin a paikhiat zawh uh a kum nihna a kha masa sungin Sinai sehnel gamah Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Paisan Pawi Khamna"},"2":{"text":"“A kiseh hunin Paisan Pawi, Israel mite khamsak in."},"3":{"text":"A kiseh hun, tu kha ni sawm le li ni nitakin a thukhamte le a ngeina kip omte bangin na kham ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Paisan Pawi a kham nadingun Moses in Israel mite tungah a gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in a kha masa, a ni sawm le li ni nitakin Sinai sehnel gamah Paisan Pawi kham uh a, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin Israel mite a gamta uh hi.","ref":"Pai 12:1-13"},"6":{"text":"Misi luang a lawnna uh hangin a nin mi pawlkhat om uh a, tua ni-in amaute in Paisan Pawi kham thei lo uh ahih manin Moses le Aaron’ mai-ah pai uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mite in, “Misi luang lawnna hangin ka nin uh hi. Ahi ta zongin bang hangin a kiseh hunin Israel midangte tawh Topa biakna hong kipiasak khawm lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Moses in amaute kiangah, “Note’ thu tawh kisai, Topa’ thupiak ka zak dong na ngak dih un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"10":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note’ lakah mi khatpeuh ahi a, na suanlekhakte uh khatpeuh in ahi zongin misi luang lawnna hangin a nin ahi a, khualzinin gamlapi-ah a om ahi zongin, Topa a dingin Paisan Pawi kham veve ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A kha nihna a ni sawm le li ni nitakin amaute in kham ding uh a, amaute in silngo sawh loh anlum le a kha meh tawh ne ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in a zingsang dong bangmah siit lo ding uh a, a guh khat zong sutan lo ding uh hi. Paisan Pawi ngeinate tawh kizui-in amaute in a kham ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 12:46; Joh 19:36"},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin a siang mi khat khualzin lo napi-in Paisan Pawi a kham kei leh, amah in a kiseh hunin Topa biakna pia lo ahih manin a mite lak panin tua mipa kihawlkhia ding hi. Tua mi in ama khialhna mah thuak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Note’ lakah khualmi khat hong peemin, Topa a dingin Paisan Pawi a kham le Paisan Pawi thukhamte le a ngeina kipte bangin hih ding hi. Peemta le tualsung mite a dingin ngeina a kibang na neikhawm ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Biakbuk a kidinsak ni-in meii in thuciamna biakbuk tuam a, nitak a kipan a zingsang dong meikuang tawh kibangin biakbuk tung sanah a om hi.","title":"Biakbuk tungah Meii (Pai 40:34-38)"},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin omden hi. Sunin meii in tuam a, zanin mei tawh a kibang khat in tuam hi."},"17":{"text":"Puanbuk tung san panin meii a kilaktoh khit ciangin Israel mite ding khia uh a, meii a kiphuhna munah Israel mite in giahphual a sat uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in thu a piak ciangin Israel mite ding khia uh a, Topa in thu a piak ciangin amaute in giahphual a sat uh hi. Biakbuk tung sanah meii a khawl laiteng, amaute zong giahphual ah om uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakbuk tungah ni tampi sung meii a om khinta zongin Israel mite in Topa’ thupiakna zui-in ding khia tuan lo uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Biakbuk tungah ni tawmno sung bek meii om thei zel hi. Tua bang ciangin zong Topa’ thupiak bangin giahphual ah amaute tawmno sung mah omin, Topa’ thupiakna bangin amaute a ding khia uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Khat veivei nitak a kipan zingsang dong tua meii om hi. Zingsangin meii a kilaktoh ciangin amaute ding khia uh a, tua ahih kei leh, sun khat le zan khat a omlai le zong, meii a kilaktoh hun hunin amaute ding khia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ni nih ahi a, kha khat ahi a, a hun sauzaw ahi zongin biakbuk tung sanah meii a khawl laiteng giahphual ah Israel mite omin ding khia lo uh a, ahih hangin a kilaktoh peuh ciangin amaute ding khia uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa’ thupiakna tawh amaute in giahphual sat uh a, Topa’ thupiakna mah tawh amaute ding khia uh hi. Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin amaute in Topa’ thu a mang uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Ngun Peengkulte"},"2":{"text":"“Ngun peengkul nih bawl in. Tuate na bawl ciangin na seek ding a, mihonte khop nading le giahphual nusiat nadingin na zang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A nihin a kitum ciangin kikhopna bukkong nangma kiangah mihon khempeuh hong kikhawm ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin khat bek a kitum leh Israel minamte’ lutang ahi makaite nangma kiangah hong kikhawm ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Dinkhiat nading zaksakna na tum ciangin nisuahna lampang a giahphual-ate ding khia masa ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A nih veina na tum ciangin leitaw lampang a giahphual-ate ding khia ding hi. Amaute a dinkhiat ding peuhmah ciangun zaksakna kitum ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihonte a kikaihkhop ding ciangin na tum ding a, ahih hangin a gindan na kibangsak kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aaron’ tapa siampite in peengkulte tum ding uh hi. Peengkul zatna pen na khang tawntungun note a dingin a kip den ngeina khat hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na gam sung uhah, no hong nengniam na galte uh tawh na kido ding uh ciangin, Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah note hong kiphawk nadingin peengkulte tawh pataukohna aw na gingsak ding uh a, na langte panun note hong kihon ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na lungdam hun uh, a kiseh na pawi hunte uh, le kha kipat hunte-in, note in na meihal biaknate uh le thunuama na biakpiaknate uhah zong peengkulte na tum ding uh hi. Tuate pen na Pasian uh mai-ah phawkna-in kimang ding hi; kei pen Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"A kum nihna, a kha nihna, a ni sawmnih ni-in thuciamna biakbuk tung san panin meii kilakhia to a,","title":"Sinai panin Israel mite Dingkhia"},"12":{"text":"Sinai sehnel gam panin Israel mite phual khat pan phual khatah ding khia uh a, Paran gamlakah meii a khawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses’ tungtawnin Topa’ thupiakna tawh khualzin cilna kipan uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Judah mite’ giahphual dialkhai a neite a pawlpawlin ding khia masa uh hi. Tua mihonte, Amminadab’ tapa Nahshon in uk hi."},"15":{"text":"Issakhar minam honte, Zuar’ tapa Nethanel in uk hi."},"16":{"text":"Zebulun minam honte, Helon’ tapa Eliab in uk hi."},"17":{"text":"Biakbuk a kiphel khit ciangin, biakbuk a pua Gershon mite le Merari mite ding khia uh hi."},"18":{"text":"A zomah Reuben’ giahphual dialkhai a neite a pawlpawlin ding khia uh hi. Tua mihonte, Shedeur’ tapa Elizur in uk hi."},"19":{"text":"Simeon minam honpite, Zurishaddai’ tapa Shelumiel in uk hi."},"20":{"text":"Gad minam honpite, Deuel’ tapa Eliasaf in uk hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin a siangtho nate pua-in Kohath mite ding khia uh a, amaute a tun ma-in biakbuk na kidingsak khin hi."},"22":{"text":"A zomah Efraim mite’ giahphual dialkhai a neite a pawlpawlin ding khia uh hi. Tua mihonte, Ammihud’ tapa Elishama in uk hi."},"23":{"text":"Manasseh minam honte, Pedahzur’ tapa Gamaliel in uk hi."},"24":{"text":"Benjamin minam honte, Gideoni tapa Abidan in uk hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin adang khempeuh’ nungdalin Dan mite’ giahphual dialkhai a neite a pawlpawlin ding khia uh hi. Keimah langpangin a kikaikhawm hih a gilo mihonte khempeuh tungah hih thu ka hih taktak ding hi. Hih gamlakah amaute beimang ding uh a, amaute si ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Moses in gam vaan dingin a sawl mite hong ciahkikin a gam thu a sialamin gen uh ahih manin mihonte Topa a phunsansak,","title":"Thukan Gilo Sawmte’ Sihna"},"37":{"text":"a gam thu a sialamin a gen tua mite, Topa’ mai-ah gimna in sisak hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahih hangin gam vaan dingin a pai mite lak panin Nun’ tapa Joshua le Jefunneh’ tapa Kaleb-te hing lai uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Moses in Israel mite khempeuh tungah hih thute gen a, nakpitakin mite thum uh hi.","title":"Hormah-ah Israel-te’ Lelhna (Thkna 1:41-46)"},"40":{"text":"Amaute zingsangin tho baih uh a, gamlak mual dawnah paito-in, “Thei un, hih lai-ah i om hi. Topa’ ciamnasa munah i paito ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh i khial khin hi,” a ci uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahih hangin Moses in, “Bang hangin tu-in Topa’ thupiakna palsat na hi uh hiam, tangtung lo ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"42":{"text":"Na galte uh mai-ah note hong kisatpuk kha ding ahih manin kuanto kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ lakah Topa om lo hi."},"43":{"text":"Amalek mite le Kanaan mite na mai uhah om ahih ciangin namsau tawh note na puk ding uh hi. Topa zuihna panin nungkik na hih uh ciangin note tawh Topa hong om lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa’ thuciamna singkuang hitaleh Moses hitaleh giahphual panin ding khia lo napi-in gamlak mual dawnah kuantoh ding amaute in ngaihsun veve uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciangin mualtung gamah a teng Amalek mite le Kanaan mite hong paisuk uh a, amaute zo-in Hormah ciang dong nangawnah amaute a delh uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Biakpiakna tawh kisai Ngeinate"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note kong piak leitangah a teng dingin na tun uh ciangin"},"3":{"text":"bawnghon pan hitaleh tuuhon pan hitaleh thuciamna tunsak nadingin Topa’ tungah meihal biakna ahi a, biakpiakna ahi zongin na piak ciang uh hitaleh, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui bawl nadingin utthu-a biakna hitaleh, a kiseh pawi hunte-ah biakpiakna hitaleh na piak uh ciangin,"},"4":{"text":"biakna a paipih mipa in annel lawh khat sathau biing khat tawh a kibawl an tawh biakna Topa’ tungah pia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuuno khat tawh piak khawm dingin meihal biakna ahih kei leh biakpiakna tawh, tuibuah dingin leenggahzu thawl khat na bawngtal na bawl uh ciangin,"},"9":{"text":"mi khat in a bawngtal tawh annel lawh thum sathau biing thum tawh a kibawl an tawh biakna pia ding a,"},"10":{"text":"Topa’ tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh Topa’ mai-ah note le peemta mite na kibang ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Note le note’ lakah hong peem mi a dingin a kibang thukhat, ngeina kip khat om ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siam 24:22"},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"18":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note kong paipihna gamah tungin"},"19":{"text":"tua gam a piang ante na nek uh ciangin Topa’ tungah biakna na pia ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Na anlak uh a masa pen sung panin biakna-in moh khat na pia ding uh a, an cilna pana biakna-in na piak bangun na bawl ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Na khang tawntungun na anlak uh a masa pen Topa’ tungah biakna-in na pia ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Ahih hangin note khialin, Topa in Moses tungah a gensa hih thupiaknate khempeuh,"},"23":{"text":"Topa in a thupiak a kipanin na khang tawntungun, Moses tungtawnin Topa in note hong thupiakte khempeuh na zuih kei uhleh,"},"24":{"text":"theih lohna hangin mihonte’ phawk lohin a kikhial ahihleh, mihonte khempeuh in Topa’ tungah a gim namtui, meihal biak nadingin bawngtalno khat, ngeina kip om bangin an tawh biakna le a tuibuah tawh, le khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat pia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Siampipa in Israel mihonte khempeuh a dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amaute kimaisak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen tatkhialhna hi a, amaute in tua amau’ tatkhialhna hangin Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal amau’ biakna le khialhna hanga amau’ biakna uh Topa’ mai-ah paipih khin uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua tatkhialhna in amaute khempeuh huamkha ahih manin Israel mihonte khempeuh le amau’ lakah a peem khualmi zong kimaisak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Theihlohna hangin mi khat a khialh leh, khialhna hanga biak nadingin kum khat a pha keelnu khat pia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi khat, theih lohna hangin a khialh ciangin, amah a siankik theih nadingin siampipa in tua a khial mipa a dingin Topa’ mai-ah kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.","ref":"Siam 4:27-31"},"29":{"text":"Theihlohna hangin na khat peuhpeuh a hih kha, Israel mite’ lakah a om tualsung mipa le amaute’ lakah a peem khualmipa a dingin ngeina a kibang khat na nei ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"“Ahih hangin tualsung mi hitaleh peemta hitaleh, na khat peuhpeuh a hih teitei mipa in Topa a simmawh hi a, tua mipa kithat ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in Topa’ thu simmawhin, a thupiakna siasak ahih manin, tua mipa kithat ding a, ama mawhna amah in thuak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel mite gamlakah a om sungun, Sabbath ni-in sing a tom mi khat mu uh hi.","title":"Sabbath a Palsat mi a Kidenna"},"33":{"text":"Sing a tom laitak a mu mite in Aaron le Moses , le mihonte khempeuh kiangah amah paipih uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Amah bang kicih ding ci-in teltakin kigen lo ahih manin amaute in khumcip uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Tua mipa kithat ding hi. Mihonte khempeuh in giahphual pua-ah suang tawh amah deng ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Mihonte khempeuh in giahphual pua-ah amah paipih uh a, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin suang tawh amah a denglum uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Puan Mongteep"},"38":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah gen inla, a khang tawntungun a puan mongte uhah a teep bawlin, a puan mongteep tungah khau dum khat a khih dingun sawl in.","ref":"Thkna 22:12"},"39":{"text":"Tua pen, note in utluatna tawh na zuih theihzel uh ahi nomau’ lungsim le nomau’ mittang’ deihna zuikha loin, note in na et ding uh puanmongteep le Topa’ thupiakte khempeuh phawkin na sep nading uh ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note in ka thupiakte khempeuh phawkin na sem ding uh a, na Pasian uh tungah na siangtho ding uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Kei pen, note’ Pasian ahi dingin Egypt panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi; kei pen Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Levi mite sung pan Levi’ tapa Kohath, Kohath’ tapa Izhar, Izhar’ tapa Korah; le Reuben mite sung pan Reuben’ tapa Eliab, Eliab’ tapa Dathan; le Abiram; le Peleth’ tapa On;","title":"Korah, Dathan, le Abiram-te’ Lehdona","ref":"Jude 11"},"2":{"text":"hih mite in pawl kai uh hi. Israel mite sung panin mi’ theihkim, mihon sung panin a kiteel, mihonte a makai mi zanih le sawmnga tawh Moses’ mai-ah ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses le Aaron langpangin amaute kikaikhawmin amaute kiangah, “Khengval lua uh teh! Mihon khempeuhte a milipin siangtho uh a, amaute’ lakah Topa om hi. Bang hangin Topa’ mihonpite tungah nomau kiliansak tawm na hi uh hiam” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in tua thu a zak ciangin boksukin"},"5":{"text":"Korah le a pawlte khempeuh kiangah, “Zing ciangin Topa in a siangtho ahi mi, ama a’ ahi mi hong lakin, ama kiangah paisak ding a, amah in a teel ding mipa ama kiangah paisak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih bangin gamta un: Korah le a pawlte khempeuh in paknamtui beel la un."},"7":{"text":"Zing ciangin Topa’ mai-ah tua beelte sungah mei koihin, mei tungah paknamtui koih unla, tua ciangin Topa’ teel mi pen a siangtho hong hi ding hi. Levi’ tapate aw, khengvallua uh teh!” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Korah kiangah, “No Levi mite aw, tu-in za un."},"9":{"text":"Israel mite’ Pasian in ama kiangah hong paipih ding, Topa’ biakbuk sungah nasep sem ding, mihonte’ na a sem dingin amau’ mai-ah a ding dingin Israel mihonte’ kiang panin hong khenkhiatna,"},"10":{"text":"le nang le na sanggamte ahi Levi’ mite, ama kiangah hong paipihna hawmthawh lai na hi hiam? Siampi nasepna zong deih lai na hi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin nang le na pawlte khempeuh hih lai-ah na kikaihkhopna uh pen Topa langpanna ahi hi. Note in na phunsan uh Aaron pen bang mi hi mawk ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in mi sawlin Eliab’ tapa Dathan le Abiram samsak hi. Amaute in, “Kong pai kei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kote’ tungah nangmah ulianin kibawl tawmin, gamlakah kote hong that dingin bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gam panin nong paikhiatpihna thu hawmthawh lai na hi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Tua tham loin nangmah in bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gamah kote hong paipih loin, lote le leenggui lote zong nong luahsak kei hi. Hih mite’ mit khelkhia ding na hi hiam? Kong pai kei ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses heh mahmah ahih manin Topa’ kiangah, “Amau’ biakna thupi ngaihsut kei in. Amaute tungah bangmah ka gamta khial kei a, a la uh khat beek nangawn ka laksak kei hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Korah kiangah, “Nang le na pawlte, nang le amaute, Aaron tawh zing ciangin Topa’ mai-ah hong om un."},"17":{"text":"Note in na milipun na paknamtui beel ciat uh la-in, a sungah paknamtui koih unla, Topa’ mai-ah na paknamtui beel ciat uh, paknamtui beel zanih le sawmnga paipih un. Aaron le nangmah in zong na paknamtui beel tuak uh paipih un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a milipun a paknamtui beel ciat uh la uh a, tuate sungah mei koihin a tungah paknamtui koih uh a, kikhopna buk kongah Moses le Aaron tawh ding khawm uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Korah in amaute’ langkhat, kikhopna bukkongah mihonte khempeuh khawm hi. Topa’ minthanna mihon khempeuhte tungah hong kilang hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah,"},"21":{"text":"“Amaute tomno sungin ka beisak theih nadingin hih mihonte lak panin kihem un,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute boksuk uh a, “Pasian, mi khempeuhte’ tungah nuntakna a pia Pasian aw, mi khat’ khialhna hangin mihon khempeuhte’ tungah nang heh ding na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"24":{"text":"“Mihonte tungah hih bangin gen in: Korah, Dathan, le Abiram-te’ omna kiim panin paikhia un, ci in,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses dingin Dathan le Abiram kiangah pai a, Israel upate in zong amah a zui uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in mihonte kiangah, “Amaute’ khialhna khempeuh tawh note hong kiphiatkhia kha ding ahih manin, hih migilote’ puanbuk panin paikhia unla, amau’ na khat beek lawng kha kei un, hong thum ing,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Korah, Dathan, le Abiram-te’ omna kiim panin amaute a paikhia uh hi. Dathan le Abiram-te, a zite uh le a tapate uh le a taneute uh tawh hong pusuakin a puanbuk kong uhah dingkhawm uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in, “Hih na khempeuh a sem dingin Topa in kei hong sawl hi. Hih nasep pen keima utthu ahih lohna, hih thu tawh na thei ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Mi khempeuh a sih ngei bang danin hih mite si a, tua ahih kei leh mi khempeuh in a tuah ngeite a tuah leh, Topa in kei hong sawl loh ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in a thak khat hong piangsakin, leitang in a kam ka-in amaute’ neih khempeuh tawh hih mite valhtumin, a hingtangin Leinuai-ah a tumsuk uhleh, hih mite in Topa a simmawh ahihna thu na thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Hih thute a gen khit phetin amau’ nuai-ah lei kiphelkham hi."},"32":{"text":"Leitang a kam ka-in, Korah tawh a kipawl mi khempeuh le a innkuanpihte uh le a neihsa khempeuh uh valhtum hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute le a neihsa khempeuh uh a hingtangun Leinuai-ah tumsuk uh hi. Leitang in amaute khupnelhin mihonpite’ lak panin amaute bei uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaute’ kikona hangin a kiim uha om Israel mite khempeuh tai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, “Leitang in hong valhtum kha in teh!” ci uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ kiang panin mei hong paikhia a, paknamtui a pia mi zanih le sawmngate kangtum hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"37":{"text":"“Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in meikuang sung panin paknamtui beelte a lakkhiat ding gen inla, tua ciangin a gamlapi-ah mei thehthang in.
