Tua ahih ciangin biakna tau sitna kuangdai dingin seek un; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Topa’ mai-ah tuate pia uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua nate siangtho hi. Israel mite tungah tua bangin hih nate pen lim khat hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin siampi Eleazar in mei tawh a kangtum mite’ piak paknamtui sumngo beelte la-in biakna tau sitna-in a seek hi."},"40":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungtawnin Eleazar tungah a gen bangin Korah le a pawlte tawh a kibang kha lo dingin, siampi ahi lo, Aaron’ suanlekhakte ahi lo mi peuhmah, Topa’ mai-ah paknamtui hal dingin a pai loh nading, Israel mite tungah phawksakna khat ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahih hangin a zing ciangin Israel mihon khempeuh in Moses le Aaron phunsan uh a, “ Topa’ mite na that uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Moses le Aaron langpangin mihonte a kikhop uh ciangin, kikhopna buk lamah amaute a khuadak uh ciangin, meii in na tuam a, Topa’ minthanna vang kilang hi."},"43":{"text":"Kikhopna buk mai lamah Moses le Aaron pai a,"},"44":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"45":{"text":"“Tomno sungin amaute ka siatsak theih nadingin hih mihonte’ lak panin paikhia un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amau tegel zong boksuk uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Moses in Aaron kiangah, “Na paknamtui beel la-in, biakna tau pana mei a sungah koih inla, a tungah paknamtui koihin, mihonte’ lakah paipih mengmeng inla, amaute a dingin kilemna bawlsak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ kiang panin hehna hong paikhia khin a, gimna kipan khin hi,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses’ gen bangin Aaron in paknamtui beel la-in mihonte lakah a tai hi. Mite lakah gimna kipan khin takpi a, amah in paknamtui koihin mite a dingin kilemna a bawlsak hi."},"48":{"text":"A si le a hingte’ kikalah amah ding a, gimna a veng hi."},"49":{"text":"Tu-in Korah’ tungtangah a site simloh, hih gimna tawh a si mi tul sawm le tulli le zasagih ahi hi."},"50":{"text":"Gimna a ven’ ciangin kikhopna bukkong Moses kiangah Aaron a ciahkik hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Aaron’ Ciangkhut"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite tungah thu gen inla, amaute tung panin, beh khat ciangin ciangkhut khat, a beh tawh kizui-in a makaite khempeuh tung panin ciangkhut sawm le nih la in. A ciangkhut tungah amau’ min ciat gelh inla,"},"3":{"text":"Levi ciangkhut tungah Aaron’ min gelh in. Bang hang hiam cih leh beh lutang khatah ciangkhut khat hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kikhopna buk sung, thuciamna mai, nang tawh i kituahna munah tuate na koih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keimah in ka teel mipa’ ciangkhut hong sel ding hi. Amaute in nang hong phunsanna, Israel mite’ phunna tua bangin kei’ kiang panin ka beisak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in zong Israel mite tungah tua thu a gen hi. A makaite khempeuh in a beh tawh kizui-in makai khat ciangin khat pai, ciangkhut sawm le nih ama tungah pia uh a, Aaron’ ciangkhut zong amau’ ciangkhut lakah a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Moses in thuciamna puanbuk sung Topa’ mai-ah tua ciangkhutte a koih hi."},"8":{"text":"A zing ciangin thuciamna puanbuk sungah Moses a pai leh, Levi-te beh a’ ding Aaron’ ciangkhut selin nguumkhia a, paakin, almond min gah a gah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Topa’ mai panin Israel mite khempeuh kiangah ciangkhut khempeuh paikhiatpih hi. Amaute in en uh a, a ciangkhut ciat uh a la uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Amaute si kha ding ahih manin, amaute in kei hong phunsanna beisak theih nadingin a lehdo mite a dingin lim ahi dingin thuciamna mai-ah Aaron’ ciangkhut koihkik in,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 9:4"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa’ sawl bangin Moses in zong a hih hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel mite in Moses kiangah, “En in, kote a si ka hi ta uh a, kote khempeuh a mawkna ka hi ta uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A nai-ah a pai, Topa’ biakbuk nai-ah a pai peuhmah si ding hi. Kote khempeuh ka bei nading uh hita hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Aaron kiangah, “Nang le na tapate le na behte in biakbuk sung nasepnate tawh kisai-in khialhna a om leh mawhna na puakhawm ding uh hi. Ahi zongin nang le na tapate in na siampi nasepna uh tawh kisai-in khialhna a om leh no teng bek in mawhna na pua ding uh hi.","title":"Siampite le Levi mite’ Nasep"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong pawlin, thuciamna puanbuk mai-ah nang le na tapate na om laitakun note’ na hong sepsak theih nadingin na pate nam ahi Levi minam na sanggamte zong paipih in."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in note hong huhin puanbuk nasep khempeuh sem ding uh a, ahih hangin note le amaute si kha ding na hih ciangun biakbuk nazatte leh biakna tau-ah na hong seppih lo ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in note hong pawlin, kikhopna buk vaanin puanbuk nasep khempeuh sem ding uh a, note’ nasepte midang kuamah in hong seppih thei lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel mite tungah hehna a om nawn loh nadingin biakbuk nasep leh biakna tau nasep note in na sem ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"En un, Israel mite kiang panin na sanggam uh Levi mite ka la khin a, amaute pen kikhopna buk nasep a sem dingin Topa’ tungah a kipia, note’ tungah letsong ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang le na tapate in biakna tau tawh kisai nate le dalna puan sunga om nate khempeuhah na siampi nasep uh na sem ding uh hi. Na siampi nasep uh letsongin kong piak hi a, midangte in hong sep leh kithat ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Aaron kiangah, “En in, kei tungah hong kipia biakna a kikoih khempeuh, Israel mite in a ap nate khempeuh nang kong pia hi. Nangma tanh ding le na suanlekhakte’ kaih ahi tawntung dingin note tungah kong pia hi.","title":"Siampite’ Ngah Dingte"},"9":{"text":"Mei tawh hal dingte lak panin a kisit, a siangtho pen nangma ngah dingte in: Amaute in kei’ tungah hong piak amau’ biaknate khempeuh, an tawh amau’ biaknate khempeuh, khialhna hanga amau’ biaknate khempeuh, leh mawhna hanga amau’ biaknate khempeuh pen nang le na suanlekhakte a dingin a siangtho pen hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A siangtho pen mun khatah na ne ding uh hi. Pasal peuhmah in ne thei ding hi; note a dingin a siangtho ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Amau’ letsong biakna, Israel mite in vei-a biaknate khempeuh uh zong nomau-a’ ahi hi. Nang le na tapate le na tanute’ kaih tawntung dingin tuate kong pia hi. Na inn sunga om a siangtho mi peuhpeuh in ne thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Sathau limci pen khempeuh, le leenggahzu le an a limci pen khempeuh, Topa’ tungah amau’ piak anpalte, note’ tungah kong pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in Topa’ tungah a piak uh, amau’ leitangah a min masa gah khempeuh nomau a’ hi ding hi. Na inn sunga om a siangtho mi peuhpeuh in ne thei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Israel-te’ sungah a ki-ap na peuhmah nomau a’ hi ding hi.","ref":"Siam 27:28"},"15":{"text":"“Mihing le ganhing khempeuh sung panin Topa’ tungah mite in a piak tacil khempeuh, mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh, nomau a’ hi ding hi. Ahi zongin mihing tacil na tankhia ding uh a, ganhing nin tacil zong na tankhia ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuate a kitatna man (kha khat a phak ciangin tuate na tankhia ding uh hi) gerah sawmnih a pha biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in ngun shekel nga-in na seh ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin bawng tacil, ahih kei leh tuu tacil, ahih kei leh keel tacilte na tan kei ding uh hi; tuate a siangtho ahi hi. Biakna tau tungah tuate’ si na theh ding uh a, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna-in tuate’ thau na hal ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin a kivei sa-iik le a taklam phei nomau-a’ ahih mah bangin, tuate’ sate nomau a’ hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Israel mite in Topa’ tungah a piak a siangtho biaknate khempeuh, nang le na tapate le na tanute tungah kaih tawntung dingin kong pia hi. Tua pen nang le na suanlekhakte a dingin Topa’ mai-ah a tawntungin a kiphel thei lo, ci tawh thuciamna ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Aaron kiangah, “Nang in amau’ gam sungah gamhluah na nei kei ding a, amaute’ lakah tanh zong na nei kei ding hi. Kei pen Israel mite’ lakah nangma tanh le nangma luah ka hi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Kikhopna buk sungah amaute’ nasepna thaman dingin Israel sunga sawm-ah-khat khempeuh, Levi mite’ tungah gamh-in ka pia hi.","title":"Levi mite’ Ngah Dingte","ref":"Siam 27:30-33; Thkna 14:22-29"},"22":{"text":"Amaute in khialhna thuakin si kha ding uh ahih manin, tu a kipanin kikhopna buk sungah Israel midangte pai-in tua sawm-ah-khat nekpih lo ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin Levi mite in kikhopna buk nasep sem ding uh a, amaute in a tavuan uh pua ding uh hi. Tua pen amau’ khang tawntungin ngeina kip hi ding a, amaute in Israel mite’ lakah luah nei lo ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in biakna-in Topa’ tungah a piak uh Israel mite’ sawm-ah-khat pen Levi mite tungah luah dingin ka pia khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite lakah amaute in luah a neih loh ding uh ka gensa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Levi mite in zong Sawm-ah-khat mah Pia Sawn Ding"},"26":{"text":"“Levi mite kiangah hih bangin na gen lai ding hi: ‘Note’ luah dingin amaute’ tung panin kong piak sawm-ah-khat, Israel mite’ tung panin na lak uh ciangin, tua sung panin Topa’ tungah biakna, sawm-ah-khat sung pan sawm-ah-khat na pia sawn ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua na biaknate uh, ancilna pana an le leenggah sukna pana kipia mah bangin note-a’ in kiciamteh ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite’ tung panin na ngah uh sawm-ah-khat khempeuh tung panin Topa’ tungah biakna na pia ding uh hi. Tua bangin siampi Aaron’ tungah Topa a kibiakna na pia ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Note tungah hong kipia letsong lakah a limci pen, a siangtho pen paipihin Topa a’ ding biakna khempeuh na pia ding uh hi,’ ci-in gen in."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute kiangah, ‘Tuate sung panin a limci pen teng na piak khit uh ciangin, a omlai teng Levi mite a dingin ancilna panin a piangte le leenggah sukna panin a piangte a kipia mah bangin kiciamteh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Nang le na innkuanpihte in mun khat peuhpeuhah na ne thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen kikhopna buk sungah note’ nasepna thaman ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua sung panin a limci pen na piak nak-uhleh tua thu hangin mawhsakna na thuak kei ding uh hi. Israel mite’ na a siangthote na ninsak kei ding uh hi. Na nitsak uhleh na si ding uh hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Topa in Moses le Aaron’ kiangah,","title":"A Ninte Siansuahna"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa’ thupiak thukham le ngeina hih bang ahi hi: Poina a nei lo, sitbaanna a om lo, a tungah nasepna kol a kivawh ngei nai lo, bawngla a san khat nomau kiangah hong paipih nadingun Israel mite kiangah gen un."},"3":{"text":"Siampi Eleazar kiangah na pia ding uh a, giahphual pualamah kipaipihin ama mai-ah kigo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Siampi Eleazar in a khutme tawh a si tawmkhat la-in, kikhopna buk mai lamah a si sagihvei theh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama muhna-ah a bawngla kihal ding a, a vun, a sa, le a si, a ek tawh kihal ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampipa in taamtak sing le puknah le a ausan khaute la-in bawngla a kihalna sungah tuate khul ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in ama puante sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, tua khit ciangin giahphual ah hong pai ding hi. A nitak mateng siampipa a nin hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Bawngla a hal mipa in ama puante sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi a siang khat in bawngla vu khawmin, giahphual pualam a siang mun khatah tuate koih ding a, khialhna maisak nading, nitna siansak nading tui-ah zat dingin Israel mihonpite a dingin tuate kikem ding hi.","ref":"Heb 9:13"},"10":{"text":"Bawngla vute a khawm mipa in ama puante sawpin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi. Hih pen Israel mite le amaute lakah a peem khualmi tungah tawntung ngeina hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Misi luang khatpeuh a lawng pa ni sagih sung a nin hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A ni thum ni le a ni sagih ni-in amahmah tui tawh kisiangsakin, tua khit ciangin a siang hi ding hi. Ahih hangin a ni thum ni le a ni sagih ni-in amahmah a kisiansak kei leh, amah a siang suak thei lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Misi khatpeuh a lawng mi in amahmah a kisiansak tawm kei leh amahmah in Topa’ biakbuk a ninsak hi a, Israel sung panin tua mi kihawlkhia ding hi. Nitna hangin ama tungah tui kibuak lo ahih manin ama tungah nitna baang lai ahih ciangin a nin hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mi khat puanbuk sungah a sih ciangin puanbuk sungah a pai mi peuhmah le puanbuk sungah a om mi peuhmah ni sagih sung a nin hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A kisiincip lo a kihong beel peuhmah a nin ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Namsau tawh gamlakah a kithat mi ahi a, misi pumpi ahi a, mi guh ahi a, han ahi zongin a lawng mi peuhmah ni sagih sung a nin hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Amaute in a nin mipa a dingin a kihal khialhna hanga biakna vute la-in beel sung khatah tui luanglai tawh hel ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin a siang mi khat in puknah la-in a sungah diah ding a, puanbuk tung le a nazat khempeuh tung le tua lai-ah a om mi khempeuh tung le guh ahi a, a kithat mi ahi a, misi ahi a, han ahi zongin a lawng mipa tungah theh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A ni thum ni le a ni sagih ni-in a siang mipa in a nin mipa tungah theh ding a, tua bangin a ni sagih ni-in amah in mi ninpa siangsakin, amah in a puante sawpin, tui sungah kipumsil ding a, a nitak ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Ahih hangin a nin hi napi-in a kisiangsak lo mipa in Topa’ biakbuk ninsak ahih manin mihonpi panin tua mipa kihawlkhia ding hi. Nitna hangin ama tungah tui kibuak lo ahih manin amah a nin ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua pen amaute a dingin tawntung ngeina khat hi ding hi. Nitna hangin tui a theh mipa in ama puante sawp ding a, nitna hangin a kizang tui a lawng mipa a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A nin mipa in a lawn’ na khat peuhpeuh a nin hi ding a, tua na a lawng peuhpeuh zong a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite, a mihon buppi, a kha masa sungin Zin gamlak tung uh a, Kadesh munah phual sat uh hi. Tua lai-ah Miriam si a, tua lai mahah kivui hi.","title":"Suangpi pan Tui (Pai 17:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in mihonte a’ ding tui om lo ahih manin Moses le Aaron’ langah amaute kikhawmin kituah uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mite, Moses tawh kiselin, “ Topa’ mai-ah ka sanggamte uh a sih lai-in a si hizaw hoh ta le ung!"},"4":{"text":"Bang hangin hih lai-ah kote le ka ganhingte uh a si dingin Topa’ mihonte hih gamlakah hong paipih na hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Bang hangin hih mun sia-ah hong paipih dingin Egypt panin kote hong paitosak na hi hiam? An ahi a, thei ahi a, leenggui ahi a, mang kawlsing ahi zongin a omna mun ahih loh banah tui dawn ding nangawn zong om lo hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihonte omna panin kikhopna bukkongah Moses le Aaron pai-in boksuk uh hi. Topa’ minthanna vang amaute’ tungah hong kilangin"},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"8":{"text":"“Ciangkhut la-in, nang le na sanggampa Aaron in mihonte khawm un la, suangpi in amau’ muhin tui a piak ding sawl un. Tua bangin mihonte le amau’ ganhingte tui na ngahsak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in zong Topa’ thupiak bangin ciangkhut a la hi."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in suangpi mai-ah mihonte kaikhawmin amah in amaute kiangah, “Tu-in za un, a lehdo mite aw; hih suangpi panin note a’ ding tui hong phulkhiasak ding ka hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Moses in a khut laamto-in a ciangkhut tawh tua suangpi nihvei sat a, tui tampi phulkhia-in mihonte le amau’ ganhingte in a dawn uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah, “Israel mite’ mai-ah kei hong um lo, hong siangthosak lo na hih uh ciangin amaute ka piaksa leitangah hih mihonte na tunpih kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Hihte pen, Israel mite in Topa a phunsanna, amaute lakah amahmah a siangtho-a a kilahna mun, Meribah tui phuala thupiang ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 17:1-7"},"14":{"text":"Moses in Kadesh panin Edom kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawl a, “Na sanggam Israel-te in hih bangin ci hi: Kote’ tuahkhak kamsiatna khempeuh na thei hi.","title":"Edom mite in Israel-te Paisak lo"},"15":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh Egypt-ah na paisukin Egypt-ah sauveipi ka teng uh a, Egypt mite in kote le ka pu ka pate uh hong gimbawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ tungah ka kiko uh ciangin amah in ka aw uh hong za a, vantungmi khat hong sawlin, Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih a, tu-in nangma gam nawl Kadesh khuapi-ah ka om uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in kote na gam hong kantansak in. Lo ahi a, leenggui lo ahi zongin nawkkha loin, tuikhuk panin zong tui ka dawn kei ding uh hi. Kumpipa’ Lamlian dungah ka pai ding uh a, na gam sung ka khen’ matengun lam ka pial kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin Edom mite in ama kiangah, “Nong nawk kei ding uh hi; nong nawk uhleh note langpangin namsau tawh kong kuan ding uh hi,” na ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel mite in, “Lamlian tawnin ka paito ding uh hi. Kote le ka ganhingte un na tui uh ka dawn uhleh, a man kong pia ding uh hi. Khe tawh pai-in hong nawksak un; adang kong ngen kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin Edom mite in, “Nong nawk kei ding uh hi,” na ci uh hi. Amaute’ langkhatah galkap tampi tawh Edom mite kuan hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel mite, amau’ gam a nawksak ding tua bangin Edom mite in nial uh ahih ciangin amau’ kiang panin Israel mite paikhia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Kadesh panin Israel-te pai uh a, a hon buppi-in Hor Mual tung uh hi.","title":"Hor Mual-ah Aaron Si"},"23":{"text":"Edom gamgi Hor Mual-ah Topa in Moses le Aaron’ tungah,"},"24":{"text":"“Aaron in ama mite kiang zuan ta ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Meribah tui-ah no tegel in ka thupiak hong nial na hih manun, Israel mite tungah ka piak leitangah amah tum lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron le ama tapa Eleazar sam inla, Hor Mual-ah amaute paipih in."},"26":{"text":"Aaron’ tung panin a puante suahkhia inla, a tapa Eleazar silhsak in. Aaron in ama mite kiang zuan ta ding a, tua lai-ah si ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa’ thupiak bangin Moses zong gamta hi. Mihonte khempeuh’ muhin Hor Mual tungah amaute paito uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Moses in Aaron’ puante suahkhiatsakin a tapa Eleazar silhsak a, tua mual dawnah Aaron a si hi. Tua ciangin mualtung panin Moses le Eleazar paisuk uh hi.","ref":"Pai 29:29; Gam 33:38; Thkna 10:6"},"29":{"text":"Aaron si hi, ci-in mihonte khempeuh in a theih uh ciangin, Aaron’ hangin Israel mi khempeuh ni sawmthum sung a kap uh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanaan mi, Negeb gam a teng Arad gam kumpipa in Atharim lam tawnin Israel mite hong paina thu a zak ciangin amah in Israel-te do-in, amaute kimkhat salin a man hi.","title":"Kanaan-te in Israel-te Do","ref":"Gam 33:40"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te in Topa’ tungah kiciamna khat bawl uh a, “Ka khutsung uhah hih mite nong piak nakleh kote in amau’ khuapite ka susiamang ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in zong Israel-te’ cihna mangin Kanaan mite a pia hi. Israel-te in amau le a khuapite uh susiamang ahih ciangin tua mun pen Hormah kici hi."},"4":{"text":"Hor Mual panin amaute dingkhia-in Edom gam kiimah a pai dingin San Tuipi lamah pai uh a, lamkalah mite lungkia uh hi.","title":"Gul Guphate","ref":"Thkna 2:1"},"5":{"text":"Mite in Pasian le Moses gensia uh a, “Bang hangin sehnel gamah a si dingin Egypt panin kote hong paikhiatpih to na hi hiam? An le tui om lo a, bangmah a man lo hih an ka kih uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in mite’ lakah gul guphate khah a, tuate in mite tu-in Israel mi tampi a si hi.","ref":"1Kor 10:9"},"7":{"text":"Moses kiangah mite hong pai-in, “ Topa le nang hong gensia-in kampau kha ka hih manun ka khial uh hi. Kote’ kiang panin gulte a lakkhiat nadingin Topa’ tungah thum in,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mite a dingin Moses in thumsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Gul gupha tawh a kibang sumngo gul khat bawl inla, khuam khat tungah khai in. Gul in a tuk mi peuhmah in tua gul a et ciangin hing ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in sumngo gul khat bawl a, khuam khat tungah a khai hi. Gul in mi khatpeuh a tuk leh amah in tua sumngo gul enin hing pah hi.","ref":"2Kum 18:4; Joh 3:14"},"10":{"text":"Israel mite ding khia uh a, Oboth munah giahphual sat uh hi.","title":"Moab Kiimah Israel-te Zin"},"11":{"text":"Oboth panin ding khia uh a, nisuahna lam, Iyeabarim munah giahphual sat uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua lai panin ding khia uh a, Zered Kuam-ah giahphual sat uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua lai panin ding khia uh a, Amor mite’ gamgi panin a hong kikhungsuk gamlak a om Arnon gun galkhatah giahphual sat uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Arnon gun pen Moab le Amor mite’ kikalah Moab-te’ gamgi ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa’ Gal Laibu sungah, “Sufa gam a Vuahep khua, le Arnon gun kuamte,"},"15":{"text":"le Ar khua ciang ban sukin, Moab gamgi lamah a paisuk kuam” kici hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua lai panin Beer munah pai uh hi. Tua mun pen Topa in Moses kiangah, “Mite kaikhawm in; amaute tui ka pia ding hi,” a cihna tuikhuk ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mite in hih la sa uh hi: “Tuikhuk aw, phul in! La kong sak ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi ciangkhut le amau’ ciangkhutte tawh mite’ uliante in a tawh, kumpi tate in a tawh tuikhuk aw,” a ci uh hi. Gamlak panin amaute Mattanah munah pai uh a,"},"19":{"text":"Mattanah panin Nahaliel, Nahaliel panin Bamoth,"},"20":{"text":"Bamoth panin sehnel gam a kimuhsuk theihna Pisgah mual kiang nai, Moab gam sunga kuam khatah tung uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te in Amor kumpipa Sihon kiangah kamtaite sawl uh a,","title":"Israel-te in Kumpi Sihon Zo (Thkna 2:26-37)"},"22":{"text":"“Na gam hong kantansak in. Tuikhuk tuite kong neksak kei ding uh a, na gam ka khen’ khit mateng uh Kumpipa’ Lamlian tawnin ka pai ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin Sihon in Israel mite ama gam kantansak lo hi. Amah in a mite khempeuh kaikhawmin, Israel-te a do dingin gamlakah pai-in Jahaz mun tung a, Israel-te a do hi."},"24":{"text":"Israel-te in namsau tawh amah le a mite tampi thatin, Arnon gun panin Jabbok lui, Ammon mite kiang dong bek a gam laksak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Ammon mite’ gamgi nawksuak zo lo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel-te in a khuapite khempeuh la-in, Heshbon gam sunga Amor mite’ khuapi khempeuh le khuaneu khempeuhah a teng uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Heshbon pen, nidangin Moab kumpipa simin a khutsung panin Arnon gun ciang dong a gam khempeuh a laksak, Amor mite’ kumpipa Sihon’ khuapi ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin la a sa pawlte in, “Heshbon-ah hong pai un. Lamkik unla, Sihon’ khuapi kipsak un."},"28":{"text":"Heshbon panin mei piangkhia a, Sihon’ khuapi panin meikuang piangkhia hi. Moab mite’ khuapi Ar, Arnon mual sang a ukte kangtum hi."},"29":{"text":"Moab! Gimna na ngah hi. Khemosh mite! Na mangthang uh hi. Amah in a tapate galtai-in, a tanute galmatin, Amor kumpipa Sihon a dingin hong bawl hi.","ref":"Jer 48:45-46"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amau’ suanlekhakte Heshbon pan Dibon ciang dong si uh a, mei in Medeba ciang dong a bat mateng ka siasak uh hi,” ci-in sa uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bangin Amor mite’ gam sungah Israel-te teng uh hi.","title":"Israel-te in Bashan Kumpi Og Zo (Thu 3:1-11)"},"32":{"text":"Moses in Jazer khua thu a kansim dingin mi a sawl hi. Amaute in a khuaneute la-in tua lai-a om Amor mite suankhia uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kihei-in Bashan lamah paito uh hi. Bashan kumpipa Og le a mite khempeuh Edrei-ah amaute a do dingin hong kuan uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in Moses kiangah, “Amah kihta kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah le a mite khempeuh le a leitang, nomau khut sungah kong pia khin hi. Heshbon-ah a teng Amor kumpipa Sihon na bawl bangun amah na bawl ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin khat beek a nungta a om nawn lo dingin amaute in amah le a tapate le a mite khempeuh that uh a, amaute in ama gam a luah uh hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mite ding khia uh a, Jerikho gei Jordan galkhat Moab gam zanglei-ah giahphual a sat uh hi.","title":"Balak in Balaam Samsak"},"2":{"text":"Israel-te in Amor mite tungah a bawlna khempeuh Zippor’ tapa Balak in mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute tam mahmah uh ahih manin Moab mite in tua mite kihta uh a, Israel mite kihtakna hangin Moab mite linggawp uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Moab mite in Midian upate kiangah, “Bawngtal in gamlak lopate a liah bangin hih mite in i kiima om mi khempeuh liaktum mang ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Zippor’ tapa Balak, tua hun laitak a Moab kumpipa in"},"5":{"text":"Amaw mite’ gam Gun gei Pethor-ah a om Beor’ tapa Balaam kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “En in, Egypt panin mihon khat hong paikhia hi. Amaute, lei maitang teng dim khin uh a, keima galkhatah amaute om uh hi.","ref":"Gam 31:8; 2Pe 2:15-16; Jude 11"},"6":{"text":"Tu-in hong pai inla, amaute hat lua uh ahih manin hih mite hong samsiatsak in. Tua hileh amaute zo-in hih gam panin ka hawlkhiazo kha ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thupha na piak mi in thupha ngahin, na samsiat mi in siatna a ngahna ka thei hi,” cisak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moab upate le Midian upate aisanna man ding tawh kuankhia-in Balaam kiangah pai uh a, Balak’ thu ama kiangah sung uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Balaam in amaute kiangah, “Tuzan hih lai-ah giak phot un. Topa in kei tungah hong gen bangin note tungah kong genkik ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Moab uliante Balaam tawh a om uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Balaam kiangah Pasian hong pai-in, “Nang tawh a om hih mite kua ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Balaam in Pasian kiangah, “Zippor’ tapa Balak, Moab kumpipa in kei kiangah mi hong sawlin,"},"11":{"text":"‘En in, Egypt panin mihon khat hong paikhia a, lei maitang teng dim uh hi. Tu-in hong pai inla, amaute hong samsiatsak in. Tua hileh amaute do-in ka hawlkhiazo kha ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasian in Balaam kiangah, “Amaute na zui kei ding hi. Tua mite thupha a kipia ahih manin na samsia kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Balaam tho-in Balak’ uliante kiangah, “Na gam uhah ciah un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in note kong zuih ding hong phal lo hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moab uliante dingin Balak kiangah ciah uh a, “Balaam in kote hong zui nuam lo hi,” a ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balak in amaute sangin a tamzaw leh a zahtakhuai zaw uliante khatvei sawlkik hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute zong Balaam kiangah pai-in ama kiangah, “Zippor’ tapa Balak in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Kei kiangah nong pai nading bangmah kikol-awksak kei in;"},"17":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh minphatna lianpi nang kong pia ding a, kei’ tunga nong gen peuhpeuh ka hih ding hi. Hong pai inla, hih mite hong samsiatsak in,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin Balaam in Balak’ nasemte kiangah, “Balak in kham leh ngun tawh a kidim ama inn hong pia ding hitaleh zong, Topa ka Pasian’ thupiakna banah a tamzaw hitaleh a tawmzaw hitaleh bangmah ka hih thei kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in kong thum hi; Topa in kei tungah bang hong ci lai ding hiam cih ka theihna dingin tuzan zong hih lai-ah giak phot un,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zanin Balaam kiangah Pasian hong pai-in, “Nangmah a sam dingin mite hong pai ahihleh, tho inla amaute zui in. Ahih hangin nang kong sawl teng bek na hih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Balaam tho-in a la tutphah vawhin Moab uliante a zui hi.","title":"Vantung mi le Balaam’ La"},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah pai ahih manin Pasian heh a, amah a khaktan dingin Topa’ vantungmi in lampi-ah na pang hi. Tu-in a la tungah amah tuang a, a nasemte nih in zong a zui uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in a khut sungah namsau dawhsa tawi-in lampi-ah a ding, a la in mu ahih manin lampi panin pialin gamlakah a pai hi. Balaam in lampi-ah a paikik nadingin a la a sat hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin leenggui lo kikal, a pang tuakah phung a omna lam kawcikah vantungmi na ding leuleu hi."},"25":{"text":"La in Topa’ vantungmi a muh ciangin phung phu a, phungah Balaam’ khe nengcip ahih ciangin amah in a la sat kik hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ vantungmi na ma pai-in, taklamah ahi a, veilamah ahi zongin kihei theih nading a om lohna mun kawcik khatah na ding leuleu hi."},"27":{"text":"La in Topa’ vantungmi a muh ciangin Balaam’ nuai-ah lumsuk hi. Balaam heh mahmah a, a ciangkhut tawh a la a sat hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa inla pau theisak a, la in Balaam kiangah, “Thumvei dong nong sat nadingin nang bang hong cih ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Balaam in a la kiangah, “Nang in kei nong mawlpihna hang ahi hi. Ka khutah namsau a tawi hi leng ka ut hi. Tua hileh nang kong that khin ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"La in Balaam’ kiangah, “Na khantawnin tuni ciang dong na tuanna na la hi lo ka hi hiam? Hih bangin nang hong hih ngei ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Nong hih ngei kei hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Balaam’ mitte honsak a, a khut sungah namsau dawhsa tawh Topa’ vantungmi lampi-ah a ding mu ahih manin a lu kunin a boksuk hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin na la thumvei dong sat na hi hiam? En in, hih na khualzinna-ah lungkim lo ka hih manin nang hong pang dingin kong kuankhia hi."},"33":{"text":"La in kei hong mu-in thumvei dong hong peel hi. Hong peel kei leh, tu mahmahin nang hong that khinin na la ka hingsak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam in Topa’ vantungmi kiangah, “Kei hong pangin lampi-ah na dinlam thei lo ka hih manin ka khial hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka khualzinna hoihsa lo na hih leh ka ciahkik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in Balaam kiangah, “Mite zui in; ahih hangin nang kong sawlteng bek na gen ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Balaam in Balak’ uliante a zuisuak hi."},"36":{"text":"Balaam’ hong paina thu Balak in a zak ciangin, Arnon gun gamgi-in a kizatna dunga om, Moab gamgi gei-a om Ar khuapi ciangah amah a dawn dingin a paikhia hi.","title":"Balaam le Balak"},"37":{"text":"Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Nang hong sam ding mi hong sawl hi lo ka hi hiam? Bang hangin hong pai lo na hi hiam? Nang hong liansak lah ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kiangah, “En in, na kiang hong tung ing! Thu khatpeuh ka gen theih nading vangliatna nei ka hi hiam? Pasian in hong sawl thu bek ka gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam in Balak zui a, Kiriathhuzoth khua-ah a tung uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Balak in bawngtalte le tuute tawh biakna pia-in Balaam le amah tawh a om uliante kiangah a puak hi."},"41":{"text":"A zing ciangin Balak in Balaam samin Bamothbaal munah paipihto hi. Tua lai panin amah in Israel mi a madawk pente galmuh thei hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Hih lai-ah kei a dingin biakna tau sagih hong bawlsak inla, kei a dingin bawngtal sagih le tuutal sagih hong pia in,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Balaam’ gen bangin Balak gamta a, Balak le Balaam in biakna tau simah bawngtal khat le tuutal khat ciat a pia uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Na meihal biakna kiangah na ding in; kei ka va pai ding hi. Kei hong dawn dingin Topa hong pai kha ding hi. Amah in kei hong lah khempeuh nang kiangah kong gen ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a sang mual dawn pawn khatah amah a paito hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian in Balaam na dawn hi. Balaam in ama kiangah, “Biakna tau sagih ka bawl khin a, biakna tau simah bawngtal khat le tuutal khat ciat ka pia hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Balaam in Israel-te Thupha Pia"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Balaam kiangah thu gen a, “Balak kiangah ciahkikin hih bangin na gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Balak kiangah a ciahkik ciangin amah le Moab uliante khempeuh ama meihal biakna gei-ah na ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Balaam in a thugen ding teng genin: “Aram panin Balak in kei hong paipih a, nisuahna mualte panin Moab kumpipa in kei hong paipih hi: ‘Hong pai in, Israel mite mawhsak in!’ hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian’ samsiat loh mite bangci samsiat ding ka hi hiam? Topa’ mawhsak loh mite bangci mawhsak ding ka hi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mual dawn panin amaute ka mu a, mual neute panin amaute ka en hi. En in, a tangten’ mite, minamte lakah a kihel lote!"},"10":{"text":"Leivui zahin a tam Jakob mite, kua in a mal simzo ding a, Israel mi phazah a mal simzo ding ahi hiam? Mi thuman pa’ sihna bangin hong sisak inla, ka mailam thu ama a’ bang hisak in!” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Kei bang hong cih na hi hiam? Ka galte a samsia dingin nang kong sam a, ahi zongin amaute bangmah cih loin, amaute thupha na pia zawsop hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in, “ Topa in ka gen dingin hong sawl thu, don lo ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balak in ama kiangah, “Amaute na muh theih nading mun dangah kei hong zui in. Amaute a madawk teng bek na mu ding a, a vekpi-in na mu kei ding hi. Tua ciangin tua lai panin amaute nong samsiatsak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Zofim gamlak, Pisgah mual dawnah amah paipihin, biakna tau sagih bawl a, biakna tau simah bawngtal khat le tuutal khat ciat a pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Hua lamah Topa tawh ka va kituah kalun na meihal biakna gei hih lai-ah na ding in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Balaam na dawnin ama kiangah, “Balak kiangah ciahkikin hih bangin thu na gen ding hi” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Balak kiangah a paikik ciangin a meihal biakna gei-ah amah na ding a, Moab uliante tawh na om uh hi. Balak in ama kiangah, “ Topa in bang hong gen ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam in a thugen ding teng genin: “Balak aw, ka thugen ding za in. Zippor’ tapa aw, ka thu ngai in:"},"19":{"text":"A zuau dingin Pasian pen mihing hi lo a, a kisik dingin mihing’ tapa hi lo hi. Amah in gen khin hi; a gen bangin hih lo ding ahi hiam? Amah in ci khin hi; a cih bangin tungsak lo ding ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"En in, thupha piak ding thu ka ngah hi. Amah in thupha pia khin a, ke’n ka kheelkik thei kei hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in Jakob mite tungah mawhna mu lo a, Israel mite tungah gamtatsiatna mu lo hi. Topa amau’ Pasian, amaute tawh om a, kumpipa phatna awging amaute’ lakah om hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasian in Egypt panin amaute paikhiatpih a, amaute in gamsial tha bang hatna nei uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Jakob mite a kibum nading om lo a, Israel mite’ langkhatah aisan ding om lo hi. Tu-in Israel-te tawh kisai-in, ‘Pasian’ sepna en un,’ kici ding hi."},"24":{"text":"En un, hua mite! Humpinelkai bangin thoto a, humpinelkai bangin kaangto hi. A an a nek mateng, amaute’ si a dawn mateng, lumsuk lo hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Amaute samsia peuhmah kei inla, thupha zong pia peuhmah kei in,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahih hangin Balaam in Balak kiangah, ” Topa’ cih khempeuh keimah in ka hih ding hi,’ hong ci hi lo ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"27":{"text":"Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Tu-in hong pai in; mun dangah kong paipih ding hi. Tua lai panin amaute nong samsiatsak nading Pasian in hong lungkimpih kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Balak in sehnel gam a kimuh sukna Peor mual dawnah Balaam paipih hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Hih lai-ah kei a dingin biakna tau sagih hong bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih le tuutal sagih hih lai-ah hong pia in,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Balaam’ cih bangin Balak in hih a, biakna tau simah bawngtal khat le tuutal khat ciat a pia hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te thupha piak ding in Topa lungkimsak ahihna Balaam in a muh ciangin, a hun dang a bangin kihilna lim a mu dingin pai lo a, a maitang gamlak lam ngat hi."},"2":{"text":"Balaam khuadak a, a nam namin Israel-te in giahphual a sat a mu hi. Pasian’ Kha ama tungah hong tung a,"},"3":{"text":"amah in a thugen ding teng genin: “Beor’ tapa Balaam’ thugen, a mit in khua a mu thei mipa’ thugen,"},"4":{"text":"Pasian’ thute a za, Vanglianpa’ maangmuhna a mu, maang mu napi-in a mit in khua a mu thei mipa’ thugen:"},"5":{"text":"Jakob mite aw, na puanbukte uh bangzahin hoih ahi hiam? Israel mite aw, na giahphual uh bangzahin hoih ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Saupi a kiphah kuamte tawh kibang a, gun gei-a om huante tawh kibang hi. Topa in a suan aloes paknamtui kungte tawh kibang a, tuipi gei-a om taamtak kungte tawh kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"A phelkhaite panin tui luang ding a, a khaici in tui tampi ngahin, a kumpipa uh, Agag sangin lianzaw ding a, ama kumpi gam kiliansak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian in Egypt gam panin amaute paikhiatpih a, gamsial bangin amaute thahat uh hi. Amaute in a gal uh ahi minam dangte sugawp ding uh a, amau’ guhte suzan gawp ding uh a, a thaltang uh tawh amaute kaplet ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute bok a, humpinelkai pa bangin lumsuk uh hi. Humpinelkaipi bangin lumsuk uh hi. Kua in amaute phong ngam ding ahi hiam? Note thupha hong piate in thupha ngah hen la, note hong samsiate in samsiatna ngah ta hen,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 12:3; 49:9"},"10":{"text":"Balaam’ tungah Balak heh mahmah a, amah in a khut le a khut a tuum hi. Balak in Balaam kiangah, “Ka galte a samsia dingin nang kong sam hi. En in, nang in amaute thumvei tak thupha na pia khinzo hi.","title":"Balaam’ Genkholhna"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na omna munah tai in. ‘Nang kong min liansak ding hi,’ ka hong ci hi. Ahih hangin na min liat nading panin Topa in nang hong khaktan hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Balaam in Balak kiangah, “Kei kiangah nong sawl na kamtaite kiangah,"},"13":{"text":"‘Balak in kham le ngun tawh a kidim ama inn hong pia ding hitaleh zong, Topa’ thu banah keima thu-in a pha bawl ding ahi a, a sia bawl ding ahi zongin bangmah ka hih thei kei hi. Topa’ gente bek keimah in ka gen ding hi,’ ci-in gen khin hi lo ka hi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"“Tu-in en in, ka mipihte kiangah ka pai ding hi. Hong pai in; nidang ciangin hih mite in na mite’ tungah a bawl dingte kong theisak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in a thugen ding teng genin, “Beor’ tapa Balaam’ thugen, a mit in khua a mu thei mipa’ thugen,"},"16":{"text":"Pasian’ thute a za, Sang Pen pa’ thugen a thei, Vanglianpa’ maangmuhna a mu, maang mu napi-in a mit in khua a mu thei mipa’ thugen in:"},"17":{"text":"Amah ka mu hi; ahih hangin tunai hun hi lo hi: Jakob sung pan aksi khat hong suakkhia ding a, Israel sung pan kumpi ciangkhut hong piang ding hi. Tua in Moab thaltang satkham ding a, Sheth’ suante khempeuh sugawp ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Israel gualzo ding a, Edom mite kisuankhia ding a, a galte ahi Seir zong, kisuankhia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Jakob tawh ukna na kisem ding a, khuapi sunga a suaktate kisusia ding!” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Amalek mite enin, ama thugen ding teng genin, “Amalek, minamte lakah a masa pen hi a, ahih hangin a tawpna-ah siatna a tuak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Ken mite enin, ama thugen ding teng genin, “Na omna mun kho a, suangpi sungah na bu kibawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kain bei ding hi. Asher in galmatin nang bang tanvei hong nei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in a thugen ding a omlai teng genin, “Ala! Pasian in hihte a hih ciangin kua nungtazo ding ahi hiam?"},"24":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kittim panin teembawte hong pai-in Asshur le Eber gimsak ding a, amah in zong siatna tuak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam dingin ama gamah ciahkik a, Balak zong a ciah hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shittim-ah Israel mite a om laitakin Moab gam numeite tawh paktat ding kipan uh hi.","title":"Israel mite in Baalpeor Bia"},"2":{"text":"Hih numeite in amau’ pasian biakpiakna pawi-ah Israel mite sam uh a, amaute in a pawi an nekpihin, amau’ pasian-te’ mai-ah kun uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Peor-a Baal tawh Israel mite va kizomtawm hi. Israel mite tungah Topa heh mahmah a,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Israel mite’ tung panin Topa’ hehna a kihtakhuai a bei theih nadingin mite’ ukpite khempeuh man inla, Topa’ mai-ah suntangin amaute khai in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses in Israel thukhente kiangah, “Note khempeuh in Peor-a Baal tawh a va kizomtawm na mite khempeuh uh na that ciat ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kikhopna bukkongah amaute kapin a om laitak, Moses’ muhna le Israel mihon buppi’ muhna-ah Israel mite khat hong pai-in, Midian numei khat ama innkuanpihte kiangah hong ciahpih hi."},"7":{"text":"Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar, Eleazar’ tapa Finehas in a muh ciangin dingin mihonte’ lak panin paikhia a, a khutah teipi khat tawi-in"},"8":{"text":"Israel mipa inndei sungah zui a, Israel mipa le a numei, a numei’ pumpi pailetin a nihin sun khawm hi. Tua bangin Israel mite’ sung panin gimna dai hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin gimna tawh a si mite tul sawmnih le tulli ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"11":{"text":"“Siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar, Eleazar’ tapa Finehas in Israel mite tungah ka hehna damsakkik hi. Keimah in pammaih ka sak bangin amah in pammaihsa ahih ciangin pammaih ka sakna tawh Israel mite ka beisak kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, ‘En in, ka thuciam ahi nopsakna, amah ka pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama tung le ama khitah a suanlekhakte tungah tawntung siampi hihna thuciamna hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama Pasian a’ ding amah in pammaih saksak a, Israel mite a ding kilemna bawlsak hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Midian numei tawh a kithat khawm, Israel mi a kithat pa’ min pen Simeon mite sung panin a beh lutang Salu’ tapa Zimri ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Midian numei a kithatnu’ min pen Midian innkuan sungah a beh lutang ahi Zur’ tanu Kozbi ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"17":{"text":"“Midian mite gimsakgawp inla, amaute vatgawp in;"},"18":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a khelpilna uh tawh note hong gimsakgawp uh a, Peor tawh kisai thu le Peor’ hangin gimna ni-in a kithat, amau’ sanggamnu, Midian uliante’ tanu Kozbi thu-ah note hong khem uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua gimna khit ciangin Topa in Moses tung le siampi Aaron’ tapa Eleazar tungah,","title":"Israel-te a Phazah Moab-ah a Kisimna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mihonte khempeuh kum sawmnih pan a tungsiah, a behbehin, Israel sung panin galdo dingin a kuankhia thei ding khempeuh sim in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses le siampi Eleazar in Jerikho nai, Jordan kiang, Moab zanglei-ah amaute’ tungah thu gen a,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin, “Kum sawmnih pan a tungsiah peuhmah mi sim un,” a ci hi. Egypt gam panin a paikhia Israel mite:"},"5":{"text":"Israel’ tacil Reuben hi a, Reuben’ tapate: Hanok pan Hanok behte ahi uh hi; Pallu pan Pallu behte ahi uh hi;"},"6":{"text":"Hezron pan Hezron behte ahi uh hi; Karmi pan Karmi behte ahi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh pen Reuben minam ahi uh hi; amau mi tul sawmli le tulthum le zasagih le sawmthum pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Pallu’ tapa Eliab ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Eliab’ tapate pen Nemuel, Dathan, le Abiram ahi uh hi. Hih Dathan le Abiram pen, mihonte lak panin pawl a kai, amaute in Topa’ thu a seel lai-in Korah tawh kipawlin Moses le Aaron’ thu a seelte ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mei in mihing zanih le sawmnga a kattum lai-in lei in a kam ka-in Korah tawh amaute valh tumin amau pawl teng si uh a, amaute pen hilhkholhna a suak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin Korah’ tapate si lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Simeon minamte: Nemuel pan Nemuel behte ahi uh hi; Jamin pan Jamin behte ahi uh hi; Jakhin pan Jakhin behte ahi uh hi;"},"13":{"text":"Zerah pan Zerah behte ahi uh hi; Shaul pan Shaul behte ahi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hihte pen Simeon minam hi uh a, mi tul sawmnih le tulnih le zanih ahi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Gad minamte: Zefon pan Zefon behte ahi uh hi; Haggi pan Haggi behte ahi uh hi; Shuni pan Shuni behte ahi uh hi;"},"16":{"text":"Ozni pan Ozni behte ahi uh hi; Eri pan Eri behte ahi uh hi;"},"17":{"text":"Arod pan Arod behte ahi uh hi; Areli pan Areli behte ahi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hihte pen Gad minamte hi a, mi tul sawmli le zanga ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Judah’ tapate pen Er le Onan hi a, Kanaan gamah Er le Onan si uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Judah minamte in: Shelah pan Shelah behte ahi uh hi; Perez pan Perez behte ahi uh hi; Zerah pan Zerah behte ahi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Perez mite: Hezron pan Hezron behte ahi uh hi; Hamul pan Hamul behte ahi uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hihte pen Judah minamte hi a, mi tul sawmsagih le tulguk le zanga ahi uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Issakhar minamte: Tola pan Tola behte ahi uh hi; Puvah pan Puvah behte ahi uh hi;"},"24":{"text":"Jashub pan Jashub behte ahi uh hi; Shimron pan Shimron behte ahi uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Hihte pen Issakhar minamte hi a, mi tul sawmguk le tulli le zathum ahi uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Zebulun minamte: Sered pan Sered behte ahi uh hi; Elon pan Elon behte ahi uh hi; Jahleel pan Jahleel behte ahi uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Hihte pen Zebulun minamte hi a, mi tul sawmguk le zanga ahi uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Josef minamte: Manasseh le Efraim ahi uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh minamte: Makhir pan Makhir behte ahi uh hi; Makhir pen Gilead’ pa ahi hi; Gilead pan Gilead behte ahi uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Gilead’ suante: Iezer pan Iezer behte ahi uh hi;"},"31":{"text":"Asriel pan Asriel behte ahi uh hi; Shekhem pan Shekhem behte ahi uh hi;"},"32":{"text":"Shemida pan Shemida behte ahi uh hi; Hefer pan Hefer behte ahi uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tu-in Hefer’ tapa Zelofehad in tapa nei lo a, ahih hangin tanu nei hi: Zelofehad’ tanute’ minte in Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Hihte pen Manasseh minamte hi a, mi tul sawmnga le tulnih le zasagih ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Efraim minamte: Suthelah pan Suthelah behte ahi uh hi; Bekher pan Bekher behte ahi uh hi; Tahan pan Tahan behte ahi uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Suthelah minamte: Eran pan Eran behte ahi uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Hihte pen Efraim minamte hi a, mi tul sawmthum le tulnih le zanga ahi hi. Hihte pen amau’ behbehin Josef minamte ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Benjamin minamte: Bela pan Bela behte ahi uh hi; Ashbel pan Ashbel behte ahi uh hi; Ahiram pan Ahiram behte ahi uh hi;"},"39":{"text":"Shefufam pan Shefufam behte ahi uh hi; Hufam pan Hufam behte ahi uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Bela’ tapate pen Ard le Naaman ahi uh hi: Ard pan Ard behte ahi uh hi; Naaman pan Naaman behte ahi uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Hihte pen amau’ behbehin Benjamin minamte hi a, mi tul sawmli le tulnga le zaguk ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Dan minamte: Shuham pan Shuham behte hi a, hihte pen Dan minamte ahi uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Dan minam sung pan Shuham behte mi tul sawmguk le tulli le za li ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Asher minamte: Imnah pan Imnah behte ahi uh hi; Ishvi pan Ishvi behte ahi uh hi; Beriah pan Beriah behte ahi uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Beriah minamte: Heber pan Heber behte ahi uh hi; Malkhiel pan Malkhiel behte ahi uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Asher’ tanu’ min Serah ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Hihte pen Asher minamte hi a, tul sawmnga le tulthum le zali ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Naftali minamte: Jahzeel pan Jahzeel behte ahi uh hi; Guni pan Guni behte ahi uh hi;"},"49":{"text":"Jezer pan Jezer behte ahi uh hi; Shillem pan Shillem behte ahi uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Hihte pen Naftali minamte hi a, mi tul sawmli le tulnga le za li ahi hi."},"51":{"text":"Hihte pen Israel mi vekpi a phazah hi a, mi tul zaguk le tul khat le zasagih le sawmthum ahi uh hi.","ref":"Gam 1:1-46"},"52":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Aisanna tawh Gam Kihawm ding"},"53":{"text":"“Mi a phazah tawh kizui-in hih mite tungah luah dingin leitang kihawm ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Minam a tamte tungah gamh a tam na pia ding a, minam a tawmte tungah gamh a tawm na pia ding hi. Minam khempeuh a mi phazah tawh kizui-in gamh kipia ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Ahih hangin leitang pen aisanna tawh kihawm ding a, amau’ beh min tawh kizui-in amaute in luah ding uh hi."},"56":{"text":"Aisanna tawh kizui-in a tamte tungah a tam, a tawmte tungah a tawm, a gamh uh kihawmsak ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 34:13; Josh 14:1-2"},"57":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin a kisim Levi minamte: Gershon pan Gershon behte ahi uh hi; Kohath pan Kohath behte ahi uh hi; Merari pan Merari behte ahi uh hi.","title":"Levi Minam"},"58":{"text":"Amau’ suante: Libni behte, Hebron behte, Mahli behte, Mushi behte, le Korah behte ahi uh hi. Kohath pen Aram’ pa ahi hi."},"59":{"text":"Amram’ zi pen Levi sung pan Egypt gamah a suak ahi Levi’ tanu Jokhebed ahi hi. Tua nu in Amram tawh Aaron, Moses, le a sanggamnu uh Miriam nei hi."},"60":{"text":"Aaron in ta Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar nei hi.","ref":"Gam 3:2"},"61":{"text":"Ahih hangin Nadab le Abihu pen amaute in Topa’ mai-ah mei siangtho lo a piak lai-un si uh hi.","ref":"Siam 10:1-2; Gam 3:4"},"62":{"text":"Pasal peuhmah kha khat pan a tungsiah, amau’ sung pan a kisimte, tul sawmnih le tulthum ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite lakah amaute gamh kipia lo ahih manin Israel mite lakah amaute kisimkhawm lo hi."},"63":{"text":"Jerikho nai Jordan kiang Moab zanglei-ah Israel mite a sim Moses le siampi Eleazar mah in a sim mite pen hihte ahi uh hi.","title":"Kaleb le Joshua bek Hinglai"},"64":{"text":"Ahih hangin Sinai sehnel gamah Israel mite a sim Moses le Aaron in a simte lakah tu-in khat zong kihel nawn lo hi."},"65":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amaute’ thu a genna-ah, “Amaute gamlakah si ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Jefunneh’ tapa Kaleb le Nun’ tapa Joshua lobuang amaute khat beek om nawn lo hi.","ref":"Gam 14:26-35"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef’ tapate sung panin Manasseh’ tapa Makhir, Makhir’ tapa Gilead, Gilead’ tapa Hefer, Hefer’ tapa Zelofehad’ tanute a nai-ah hong pai uh hi. Ama tanute’ minte in: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah ahi hi.","title":"Zelofehad’ Tanute’ Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute, Moses’ mai le siampi Eleazar’ mai le makaite’ mai le mihonte khempeuh’ mai, kikhopna bukkongah ding uh a,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka pa uh gamlakah a si hi. Korah tawh kipawlin Topa langpangin a kikaikhawm mihonte lakah amah kihel lo hi. Ahih hangin ama khialhna hangin si a, amah in tapa nei lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in tapa a neih loh man bekin bang hangin a beh sung panin ka pa uh’ min mangthang ding ahi hiam? Ka pa uh sanggamte’ lakah kote zong neihsa hong pia un,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses in Topa’ mai-ah amau’ thu a gen hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,"},"7":{"text":"“Zelofehad’ tanute’ thugen man hi. Amau’ pa’ sanggamte lakah neihsa gamh amaute tungah na pia ding a, amau’ pa’ gamh amaute’ tungah na tungsak ding hi.","ref":"Gam 36:2"},"8":{"text":"Israel mite tungah hih bangin na gen ding hi: ‘Pasal khat si-in, tapa a neih kei leh, ama gamh a tanu na luahsak ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in tanu a neih kei leh, ama gamh a sanggam pasalte tungah na tungsak ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in sanggam pasal a neih kei leh, ama gamh ama pa’ sanggam pasalte tungah na pia ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama pa in sanggam pasal a neih kei leh, ama gamh ama innkuan tawh a kinai ama behpa’ tungah na pia ding uh a, amah in tang ding hi. Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin hih pen Israel mite tungah thukham le ngeina kip hi ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Hih Abarim mual tungah paito inla, Israel mite’ tungah ka piak leitang en in.","title":"Moses in Amah Laih dingin Joshua Seh (Thkna 31:1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Na muh khit ciangin na sanggampa Aaron mah bangin nang zong na mite kiang na zuan ta ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh,"},"14":{"text":"mihonpite a kitot lai-un tui phualah keimah sianthosak ding hunin Zin gamlakah keima thu nong lehpan’ hi,” a ci hi. (Hihte pen Zin gamlak, Kadesh gam Meribah tui a thupiangte a cihna ahi hi.)","ref":"Thkna 3:23-27; 32:48-52"},"15":{"text":"Moses in Topa kiangah,"},"16":{"text":"“Topa’ mihonte, a cing nei lo tuute a bat loh nadingin amaute’ mai-ah paikhia-in amaute’ mai-ah a tum ding, amaute paikhiatpihin amaute a ciahpih ding, mihonte a uk dingin, Topa , mi khempeuh tungah nuntakna a pia Pasian ahi nangmah in mi khat seh in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 22:17; Ezk 34:5; Mat 9:36; Mrk 6:34","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah, “Nun’ tapa Joshua, siamna a nei mipa la inla, ama tungah na khut nga in.","ref":"Pai 24:13"},"19":{"text":"Siampi Eleazar le mihon khempeuh mai-ah amah na dingsak ding a, amaute’ muhna-ah amah za na pia ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel mihon khempeuh in ama thu a man’ theih nadingin thuneihna pawlkhat amah na guan ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Siampi Eleazar’ mai-ah amah ding ding a, amah in Topa’ mai-ah Urim thukhenna tawh thu dotsak ding hi. Amah le amah tawh a om Israel mi khempeuh, mihon buppi, ama thu tawh pusuak ding uh a, ama thu mah tawh sungtum ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 28:30; 1Sam 14:41; 28:6"},"22":{"text":"Topa in amah a thupiak bangin Moses gamta a, amah in Joshua la-in siampi Eleazar le mihon buppi mai-ah dingsak a,"},"23":{"text":"amah in ama tungah a khutte nga-in, Topa in ama tungah a gen bangin Joshua tungah za a pia hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:23"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses kiangah,","title":"Nisim Biakna (Pai 29:38-46)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mite thu pia-in amaute tungah, ‘Keimah hong kibiakna mei tawh a kihal an, a gim namtui keima-a’ pen a hunin kei tungah nong piak ding uh phawk un,’ ci-in gen in."},"3":{"text":"“ Topa’ tungah na piak ding uh mei tawh kihal biakna in: A sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuuno nih, tatsat loin biakpiakna-in nisimin na pia ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuuno khat zingsangin na pia ding uh a, a tuuno khat pen nitakin na pia ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"An tawh biakna-in oliv thau hai khat tawh a kibawl annel lawh khat na pia ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua pen Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, a gim namtui dingin Sinai Mual-ah a kikipsak, a kitatsat lo meihal biakna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Leenggahzu tawh biakna pen tuuno khat ciangin hai khat hi ding hi. Topa’ tungah leenggahzucil tawh biakna pen siangtho munah na sung ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A tuuno khat nitakin na pia ding uh hi. Zingsang a an tawh biakna le a leenggahzu tawh biakna mah bangin, mei tawh kihal biakna, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui-in na pia ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Sabbath ni-in a sitbaang lo, kum khat a pha tuuno nih le an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kibawl annel lawh nih le a leenggahzu tawh biakna hi ding hi.","title":"Sabbath Ni le Khasim Biakna"},"10":{"text":"Hih pen tatsat loin meihal biakna le a leenggahzu tawh biaknate banah Sabbath simin meihal biakna ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 12:5"},"11":{"text":"“Kha simin a ni masa ni-in Topa’ tungah meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi. Bawngtal nih, tuutal khat, a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sagih hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bawngtal khat ciangin an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kibawl annel lawh thum zong hi ding hi. A tuutal khat ciangin an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kibawl annel lawh nih hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuuno khat a dingin an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kibawl annel lawh khat ciat hi ding a, a gim namtui meihal biak nading ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Leenggahzu tawh biaknate pen, bawngtal khat ciangin leenggahzu thawl lang, tuutal khat ciangin leenggahzu hai nih, tuuno khat ciangin leenggahzu hai khat hi ding hi. Hihte pen kum khat sunga om kha simin meihal biakna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Khialhna hanga biakna-in Topa’ tungah keel a pa khat zong kipia ding hi. Tua pen a kitatsat loin meihal biakna le a leenggahzu tawh biaknate banah a kipia ding ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Kha masa a ni sawm le ni li ni pen Topa’ Paisan Pawi ni ahi hi.","title":"A Kiseh Pawite a Biaknate (Siam 23:1-44)","ref":"Pai 12:1-13; Thkna 16:1-2"},"17":{"text":"Tua kha a ni sawm le ni nga ni pen biakna pawi ni hi a, ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum kine ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat om ding hi. Tua ni-in leitung nasep na sem kei ding uh a,"},"19":{"text":"Topa’ tungah meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi. Tuate pen bawngtalno nih, tuutal khat, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sagih hi ding hi. Tuate a sitbaang lo ahih ding thei un."},"20":{"text":"Sathau tawh a kibawl annel ahi an tawh biaknate zong hi ding hi. Bawngtal khat ciangin annel lawh thum le tuutal khat ciangin annel lawh nih tawh na pia khawm ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuuno sagihte khat ciangin annel lawh khat mah tawh na pia khawm ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Note a dingin kilemna bawl nadingin khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat zong hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Meihal biak nading ahi zingsang a meihal biakna banah tatsat lo-a biakna-in hihte na pia ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangmahin mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna ahi, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui, ni sagih sung ni simin na pia ding uh hi. Tua pen a kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna le leenggahzu tawh biaknate banah kipia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A ni sagih ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh a, tua ni-in leitung nasep na sem kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 12:14-20; 23:15; 34:18; Thkna 16:3-8"},"26":{"text":"“Na nipikal pawi hunun Topa’ tungah an thak tawh biakna na piak hun uh anpal piak ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi. Tua ni-in leitung nasep na sem kei ding uh a,"},"27":{"text":"meihal biakna, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui na pia ding uh hi. Bawngtalno nih, tuutal khat, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sagih, a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo hi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Sathau tawh a kibawl ahi an tawh a biak nadingin zong, bawngtal khat ciangin annel lawh thum, tuutal khat ciangin lawh nih,"},"29":{"text":"tuuno sagihte khat ciangin lawh khat tawh na pia khawm ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Note a dingin kilemna bawl nadingin keel a pa khat zong na pia ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"A kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna le an tawh biaknate banah tuate le leenggahzu tawh biakna na pia ding uh hi. Tuate a sitbaang lo ahih ding thei ta un.","ref":"Pai 23:16; 34:22; Thkna 16:9-12"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“A kha sagihna a ni masa ni-in kikhopna siangtho khat na nei ding uh a, tua ni-in leitung nasep na sem kei ding uh hi. Tua ni pen note in peengkul na tum ni ding uh hi a,"},"2":{"text":"meihal biakna, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui na piak dingte un: Bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sagih, a vekpi-in a sitbaang lo hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Bawngtal tawh piak dingin sathau tawh a kibawl annel ahi an tawh biaknate lawh thum, tuutal tawh lawh nih,"},"4":{"text":"le tuuno sagihte khat ciangin lawh khat hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Note a dingin kilemna bawl nadingin khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat zong hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A khasim meihal biakna le an tawh biakna , le a kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna le an tawh biakna , le tuate a’ ding ngeina a om bangin a gim namtui, Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi leenggahzu tawh biaknate banah hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Hih kha sagihna a ni sawm ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh a, an tangin tua ni-in na na sem kei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ tungah a gim namtui meihal biakna na piak dingte un: Bawngtalno khat, tuutal khat, le kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sagih hi ding a, tuate pen note’ muhna-ah a sitbaang lo hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Sathau tawh a kibawl annel tawh biaknate pen, bawngtal tawh piak khawm dingin lawh thum, a tuutal tawh lawh nih,"},"10":{"text":"tuuno sagihte khat ciangin lawh khat hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kilem nadingin khialhna hanga biakna le a kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna le an tawh biakna le leenggahzu tawh biaknate banah khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat zong hi ding hi.","ref":"Siam 16:29-34"},"12":{"text":"“A kha sagihna ni sawm le ni nga ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat nei-in tua ni-in leitung nasep na sem kei ding uh a, Topa a dingin ni sagih sung pawi na kham ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in meihal biakna, Topa’ tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biak nadingin bawngtalno sawm le thum, tuutal nih, kum khat a pha tuuno a pa sawm le li na pia ding uh a, tuate a sitbaang lo hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Sathau tawh a kibawl annel ahi an tawh biaknate pen, bawngtal sawm le thumte khat ciangin lawh thum, tuutal nihte khat ciangin lawh nih,"},"15":{"text":"le tuuno sawm le lite khat ciangin lawh khat hi ding Ka pa uh namte’ gamhluah panin amau a’ kikhenkhia ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Topa’ genna tawh kizui-in Israel mite thu pia a, “Zelofehad minamte’ genna man hi."},"6":{"text":"Zelofehad’ tanute tawh kisai-in Topa’ thupiak hih bang ahi hi: ‘Amaute in hoih a sak pente uh tawh kiteng uh hen. Hih laibu sungah a kiciamteh a thupi pawlkhatte hih a nuai-a bang ahi hi. 1. Moses in a beisa kum sawmli sunga thupiang liante genkik hi. Pasian in gam sungah amaute a makaihna thu a phawkna ding uh leh Pasian' tungah citakin a thu a man'na ding uh hanthawn hi. 2. Moses in Thupiak Sawmte genkik a, thupiak masa pen a khiatna bulphuhin Topa bek a biak ding uh hanthawn hi. Tua ciangin amaute tungah piak dingin a kiciamna gamah a om uh ciangin a zuih ding uh ngeina tuamtuamte a genkik leuleu hi. 3. Pasian in amaute tawh thuciamna a bawlna a khiatna thu, Moses in mite phawksak kik a, tua thuciamna a letkipna dingun a hanthawn hi. 4. Moses zomah Pasian' mite a makai dingin Joshua kiseh hi. Pasian' cihtakna thu phawkna bawlin la khat sa uh a, Israel minamte tungah thupha a piak khit ciangin Jordan Gun nisuahna lama om Moab gam sungah Moses a si hi. Hih laibu in a bulphuh thu: Pasian in itin a teel a mite honkhia-in thupha pia ahih manin a mite in zong hih thu phawkin, amaute nungta-in thupha a ngah paisuakna dingun Pasian itin a thu a man' ding uh deihna ahi hi. Hih laibu sungah a thupi pen mun, 6:4-6 sung hi a, Topa Jesuh in thupiak khempeuh lakah a lian pen a cih, “Topa note' Pasian na lungsim khempeuh uh, na nuntakna khempeuh uh leh na thahatna khempeuh uh tawh na it ding uh hi,” a cihna ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte pen Jordan galkhat gamlak, Suf galkhat Arabah gam sung, Paran le Tofel, Laban, Hazeroth le Dizahab kikalah Moses in Israel-te khempeuh tungah a gen thute ahi hi.","title":"Moses in Horeb-ah Thuciamna Sutkik"},"2":{"text":"Tua mun pen Horeb panin Seir Mual tawnin Kadeshbarnea lamah ni sawm le ni khat paina ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Heshbon gamah a teng Amor kumpipa Sihon, le Ashtaroth le Edrei gamah a teng Bashan kumpipa a zawh khit ciangin, a kum sawmlina, kha sawm le kha khatna, a ni masa ni-in, amaute’ tungah thupiakna-in Topa in ama tungah a piak bangbangin Moses in Israel mite tungah a gen hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Moab gam Jordan galkhatah Moses in hih thu gentel a,"},"6":{"text":"“Horeb gam sungah Topa i Pasian in eite’ kiangah, ‘Hih mualah sauvei na om khinzo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kithawi-in na khualzin uh kipan kik unla, Amor mite’ mualtung gam le Arabah kiim, mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Negeb gam khempeuh, le Kanaan mite’ gam tuipi gei le Lebanon, gun golpi ahi Eufratis gun dongin pai un."},"8":{"text":"En un, note’ mai-ah leitang ka koihzo hi. Pai unla, Topa in na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, Jakob, le amau’ nunga a suanlekhakte uh tungah piak dingin a ciam leitang luah un,’ hong ci hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua hun laitakin note kiangah, ‘Kei guak bek in note kong enzo kei ding hi.","title":"Thukhente a Kisehna (Pai 18:13-27)"},"10":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note tampi hong phasakzo hi. Lau kei unla, lungkia kei un,’ kong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tua ciangin na vekpi-un ka kiangah nong pai uh a, ‘Eite a dingin gam va enin, i paitoh nading lampi le i zuat ding khuapite hong genkik thei ding eite’ mai-ah mi sawl ni,’ nong ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tua thu hoihtuak ka sa a, minam khatah khat, note mi sawm le nih kong la hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute kithawi-in mualtung gamah paito uh a, Eshkol kuamah pai-in va en uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in tua gam singgah pawlkhat a khutun hong tawi-in i kiangah hong tunpihsuk uh a, amaute in eite kiangah thu hong zasakkikin, ‘ Topa i Pasian in eite hong piak gam pen leitang hoih ahi hi,’ hong ci uh hi."},"26":{"text":"“Ahi zongin note paito nuam loin, Topa na Pasian un hong thupiak na nial uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 9:23; Heb 3:16"},"27":{"text":"Na puanbukte uh sungah na phun uh a, ‘ Topa in eite hong mudah ahih manin eite a hong susia ding Amor mite’ khut sungah hong pia dingin Egypt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi."},"28":{"text":"Koi lai-ah paito ding ihi hiam? Tua tham loin Anak mite tua munah ka mu uh hi,” hong ci uh hi,’ na ci uh hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tua ciangin note kiangah, ‘Lau kei unla, amaute kihta kei un."},"30":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah note’ mit muhah a hih bangin, mi khat in a tapa a puak bangin hih mun na tun matengun lam tawntung ah Topa na Pasian un note hong puak na muhsa uh sehnel gam a mah bangin, note’ mai-ah a pai Topa na Pasian un note a dingin hong dosak ding hi,’ kong ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:18","merge":"31"},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih bang thu om hinapi-in, na puanbuk lamna mun ding uh hong lak ding le na pai nading lampi uh hong lak dingin zanin mei, sunin meii tawh note’ mai lampi-ah a pai Topa na Pasian uh note in na um kei uh hi.","ref":"Heb 3:19","merge":"33"},"34":{"text":"“ Topa in note’ thu hong za a, a heh suakin kiciam a,","title":"Israel-te’ tungah Pasian’ Gimpiakna (Gam 14:20-35)"},"35":{"text":"‘Hih a gi lo khang mite khat beek in, na pate uh tungah piak dinga ka ciam gam hoih na mu kei ding uh a, Jefunneh’ tapa Kaleb bek in tua gam mu ding hi. Bangmah na kisam kei uh hi, ci-in gen in,’ hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Seir gamah a teng Esau’ suan i behte, le Elath le Eziongeber khua pan hong kipan Arabah lampi panin i paikhia suak hi. “Tua ciangin eite kihei-in Moab gam lamah i pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah, ‘Amau’ leitang na neih dingun note’ tungah hong pia lo ding ka hih manin Moab mite gimsak kei unla, amaute tawh galin kido kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh a neih dingun Lot’ suanlekhakte tungah Ar khua ka piazo hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"Pian 19:37"},"10":{"text":"(Anak mite zahin a tun a sang, a lian, a tam Emim mite tua lai-ah teng ngei hi."},"11":{"text":"Anak mite mah bangin amaute zong Refaim mite kici a, ahih hangin Moab mite in Emim ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Hor mite zong Seir-ah nidangin teng ngei a, ahih hangin Topa in amaute’ tungah a piak amau’ leitang tungah Israel mite in a hih mah bangin, Esau’ suanlekhakte in amaute suankhia-in susia uh a, amau’ munah teng uh hi.)"},"13":{"text":"“Tua ciangin Topa in, ‘Tu-in ding unla Zered lui kantan un,’ hong cih bangin Zered lui i kantan hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute tungah Topa a kiciam mah bangin galsim mi ahi tua khangmite khempeuh gam sungah a sih khit dong ahi, Kadeshbarnea i nusiat a kipan Zered lui i kantan dong kikal kum sawmthum le kum giat ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 14:28-35"},"15":{"text":"Amaute a bei khit mateng gamlakah amaute a susia dingin Topa langpang takpi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin mihingte lak panin galsim mite bei-in a sih khit ciangin"},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah,"},"18":{"text":"‘Tuni-in Ar khua san takah Moab gamgi a kantan ding na hi uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ammon mite’ leitang na neih dingun khat zong hong pia lo ding ka hih manin, Ammon mite’ gamgi na nai uh ciangin amaute gimsak kei unla, amaute tawh kido kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh a neih dingun Lot’ suanlekhakte tungah ka pia khin hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"Pian 19:38"},"20":{"text":"(Tua pen Refaim gamgi ci-in zong kithei ngei hi. Refaim mite tua lai-ah teng ngei a, ahih hangin Ammon mite in amaute pen, Anak mite bangin lianin a tun a sang ahi Zamzummim mite ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Topa in amaute’ mai-ah tua mite susia hi. Amaute in tua mite suankhia uh a, amau’ munah teng uh hi.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Amah in Seir-ah a teng Esau’ suanlekhakte a dingin amaute’ mai-ah Hor mite a suksiat mah bangin amaute in tua mite susia-in tuni dongin amau’ munah teng uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Gaza ciang dong khuaneute-ah a teng Avvim mite ahihleh Kaftor pana hong pai Kaftor mite in susia-in amau’ munah teng uh hi.)"},"24":{"text":"“Moab gam sung i khen’ ciangin Topa in, ‘Ding un, na khualzin uh kipan unla, Arnon kuam kantan un. bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in hih Jordan na kantan kei ding hi.","ref":"Gam 27:12-14; Thkna 32:48-52"},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin Joshua thu pia inla, hanthawnin thakhauhsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite’ mai-ah amah pai ding a, nangmah in na muh ding leitang amaute luahsak ding hi,’ hong ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Bethpeor gal-a kuam sungah i taam lai hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tu-in Israel-te aw, note nungta-in, Topa, na pate uh Pasian in note hong piak leitangah va pai-in na luah theih nadingun note kong hilh thukhamte le ngeina kipte don unla zui un.","title":"Moses in Israel-te a Thuman’ ding uh Hanthawn"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un hong piak ahi keima hong thugente na zuih theih nadingun no kong thupiakte behlap loin, zong na khiam kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Mang 22:18-19"},"3":{"text":"Na mit un Baalpeor-ah Topa’ hihna mu khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na Pasian un note’ lak panin Peor-a Baal a zui mi khempeuh susia a,","ref":"Gam 25:1-9"},"4":{"text":"ahih hangin Topa na Pasian uh a lenkipte khempeuh tuni-in na hinglai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“En un, note in a luah dingin na lutna uh gam sungah na zuih dingun Topa ka Pasian in kei hong thupiak bangin thukhamte le ngeina kipte kong hilh khinzo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate zui unla, sem un; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thukhamte khempeuh a zak uh ciangin, ‘Hih minam liante pen a pil thuthei taktak hi,’ a ci ding uh mite’ muhna-ah hih thu pen nomau’ pilna le nomau’ theihna hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh eite in Topa i sap hun simin eite’ kiangah i Pasian hong nai zahin tua bang pasian a nei minam lian koi-ah om ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Tuni-in note kong hilh thute bangin thukham le ngeina kip a man a nei minam lian koi-ah om ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"“Na mit un a muhsa nate na nuntak sungun mangngilh kha-in, na lungsim panun paikhia kha ding ahih manin limtakin ngaihsunin hoihtakin kikem un. Note in awging na za uh a, ahih hangin bangmah mu loin, awging bek a om hi.","ref":"Pai 19:16-18; Heb 12:18-19"},"13":{"text":"Thupiak Sawmte ahi note’ hih dinga hong thupiak ama thuciamna note’ tungah hong gen a, amah in suangpek nih tungah tuate a gelh hi.","ref":"Pai 31:18; 34:28; Thkna 9:10"},"14":{"text":"Note in na luah ding uh gam sungah na zuih theih nadingun, thukhamte le ngeina kipte note kong hilhna ding tua hun laitakin Topa in kei thu hong pia hi.","ref":"Pai 21:1"},"15":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin note hoihtakin kidawm un. Ahih hangin note in kantanin tua gam hoih na luah ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note tawh hong bawl thuciamna mangngilhin, Topa na Pasian un note’ hih dinga hong kham lim khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang a kiseek milim na bawlkhak loh nadingun kidawm un."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh hong kangtum thei mei tawh kibang a, a haza Pasian ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 12:29"},"25":{"text":"“Note in tuleta nei-in gam sungah mi khangham na suah uh ciangin, na khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang limin a kiseek milim bawlna le Topa na Pasian uh’ muhna-ah a sia bawlna tawh amah a heh nadingin na siat gamtat uhleh,"},"26":{"text":"Jordan galkhat luah dingin na paina leitang uhah na siat maimang baih nadingun note’ langkhatah teci pang dingin tuni-in van le lei ka sam hi. Tua leitang tungah note sauvei na hing kei ding uh a, na siamaimang ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in mite lakah note hong thehthang ding a, Topa in note hong hawlna minamte lakah mi tawmcik bek na omlai ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Note in tua lai munah mite’ khut in a bawl, khua mu thei lo, khua za thei lo, a ne thei lo, a nam thei lo sing le suang pasian-te’ na na sem ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 28:36"},"29":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua lai panin Topa na Pasian uh na zong ding uh a, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh na zon uhleh amah na mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 29:13"},"30":{"text":"Note in gimna thuakin, mailam hunah hih nate khempeuh note’ tungah hong tun ciangin, Topa na Pasian uh lamah kihei-in ama thu na mang ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh hehpihna a nei Pasian ahi hi. Amah in note hong tamasak loin, hong nusia lo ding a, na pate uh tawh a thuciamna mangngilh lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Pasian in leitungah mi a piansak ni a kipan, note’ pian’ ma-a hun beisa thu tu-in kan unla, van mong khat pan mong khat kikal thu zong kan un. Hih bang na lian piang ngei-in, a kiza ngei peuhmah hiam?"},"33":{"text":"Note in Pasian’ aw za khin napi-in na hin lai uh bangin meikuang sung panin pasian dang khat peuhpeuh’ pauna aw mi khat peuhpeuh in za ngei ahi hiam?"},"34":{"text":"Tua ahih kei leh, Topa na Pasian un Egypt gam sungah note a dingin na muhna uhah a bawlte khempeuh tawh a kibangin, ze-etna, lim, nalamdang, gal, a vanglian le a thahatna le a lauhuai mahmah tawh pasian dang khat peuhpeuh in ama mite a dingin minamdang khat sung pan minam khat a va lak ding hanciam ngam ngei ahi hiam?"},"35":{"text":"Topa Pasian hi, ci-in na theih nadingun note’ tungah hih thu hong kilak hi a, amah simloh kuamah dang om lo hi.","ref":"Mrk 12:32"},"36":{"text":"Amah in note hong khal theih nadingin vantung panin ama aw note hong zasak hi. A mei lianpi leitungah note hong musak a, mei sung panin ama aw na za uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amah in na pate uh itin, amau’ suanlekhakte hong teel a, amahmah in ama vanglian tawh Egypt panin note hong tuni-in hih bangin na om thei uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tunga om vantung hitaleh nuai-a om leitung hitaleh ah Topa pen Pasian ahihna thu tuni-in thei unla, na lungsim uhah ciamteh un; hi.","merge":"46"},"47":{"text":"Amaute in, Arnon kuam mong a a om Aroer panin Sirion Mual (Hermon a cihna) dong, Jordan nisuahna lama om Arabah gam khempeuh, Pisgah mualpang nuai Arabah tuipi dong 20:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Topa i Pasian in eite tawh Horeb-ah thuciamna khat bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in i pute i pate bek tawh hih thuciamna a bawl hi loin, tuni-a a hinglai eite khempeuh tawh zong Amah in:","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"“‘Kei pen salsuahna Egypt leitang panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi."},"7":{"text":"“‘Keimah longal pasian dang na nei kei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“‘A kiseek milim hitaleh, tunga vantung hitaleh, nuai-a leitung hitaleh, leinuai-a om tui sung hitaleh ah a om na khat peuhpeuh a sun khat peuhpeuh note a dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute’ mai-ah kun loin, amau’ na na sem kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah Topa note’ Pasian, a aam Pasian ka hi a, kei hong mudahte’ tungah a pate’ mawhna a tate’ tungah khang thum khang lina dongin thuk-in,","ref":"Siam 26:1; Thkna 4:15-18; 27:15"},"10":{"text":"ahih hangin kei hong itin ka thupiakte a zui mi a tul tampite’ tungah itna kip a lak pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Pai 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 7:9-10"},"11":{"text":"“ Topa note’ Pasian’ min a sia lamin na zang kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama min a sia lamin a zang mi a mawh lo hi, ci lo ding hi.","ref":"Siam 19:12"},"12":{"text":"“‘ Topa note’ Pasian in hong thupiak bangin na sianthosak nadingun Sabbath ni tang un.","ref":"Pai 16:23-30; 31:12-14"},"13":{"text":"Ni guk sung na semin na nasep ding khempeuh uh na hih ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin a ni sagih ni pen Topa note’ Pasian’ Sabbath ni ahi hi. Na vengte’ inn, a lo, a nasempa, a nasemnu, a bawngtal, a la, ahih kei leh na vengte’ na khat peuhpeuh na deihgawh kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Rom 7:7; 13:9"},"22":{"text":"“ Topa in mei, meii, le a mial mahmah sung panin awging lianpi tawh mualtung a no a kikhawm khempeuh tungah hih thute hong gen a, amah in bangmah dang genthuah lo hi. Amah in suangpek nih tungah tuate gelhin, tua suangpeekte kei tungah hong pia hi."},"23":{"text":"“Mei in mual a kat laitakin khuamial sung panin awging na zak uh ciangin minam lutang khempeuh le upate kei kiangah hong pai uh hi.","title":"Mite’ Launa (Pai 20:18-21)"},"24":{"text":"Note in, ‘En in, Topa i Pasian in a minthanna le a liatna eite’ tungah hong lak khin a, mei sung panin ama awging i za khin hi. Hihte pen na khan uh a sau theih nading ahi hi.","title":"A Thupi Thupiakna","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te aw, note nuamsa-in, Topa, na pate uh Pasian in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna gamah tampi pha-in na khan theih nadingun hih thute za unla, na zuih ding uh ngaihsun un."},"4":{"text":"“Israel-te aw, za un: Topa i Pasian, Topa khat bek ahi hi.","ref":"Mrk 12:29"},"5":{"text":"Topa note’ Pasian, na lungsim khempeuh uh, na nuntakna khempeuh uh, le na thahatna khempeuh uh tawh na it ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 22:37; Mrk 12:30; Luk 10:27"},"6":{"text":"Tuni-a no kong piak hih thute na lungsim uhah om ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na tate uh tungah limtakin na hilh ding uh a, na innsung uhah na tut uh ciang, lampi-ah na pai uh ciang, na lup ciang uh le na thawh ciangun tua thute na gengen ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khut tung uhah lim dingin tuate na hen ding uh a, na mitte uh kikalah tuate pen talsuante bang hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na inn kongkhak khuam tung uh le na kongpi uh tungah tuate na gelh ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:18-20"},"10":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note piak dingin na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tungah a ciam, note’ phuh loh a lian a hoih khuapite,","title":"Thuman lohkhak ding Hilhkholhna","ref":"Pian 12:7; 26:3; 28:13"},"11":{"text":"note’ khol loh na hoih khempeuh tawh a kidim innte, note’ bawl loh tuibeem, note’ suan loh leengguite, le oliv kungte a omna leitangah hong paipihin, note in ne-in na kham uh ciangin,"},"12":{"text":"salsuahna Egypt leitang panin hong paikhiatpih Topa na mangngilh khak loh nading uh kidawm un."},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh na zahtak ding uh hi. Amaute tawh thuciamna na bawl kei ding uh a, amaute tungah hehpihna na lak kei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute tawh kiteng loin, na tanute uh amau’ tapate pia loin, a tanute uh na tapate uh a dingin na la kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh pasian dangte’ na a sem dingin Topa zuihna panin na tapate uh amaute in heikhia ding uh hi. Tua ciangin no tungah Topa hong hehin note hong susia pak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute tungah hih bangin note na gamta ding uh hi: A biakna taute uh phelsakin, a biakna songte uh dengzanin, amau’ Asherah milimte phuksakin, a kiseek a milimte uh mei tawh na hal ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:3"},"6":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah a siangtho mi na hi uh hi. Leitung a om mite khempeuh sung panin ama mi ahi dingin Topa na Pasian un note hong teelzo hi.","ref":"Pai 19:5; Thkna 4:20; 14:2; 26:18; Tit 2:14; 1Pe 2:9"},"7":{"text":"“ Topa in note hong itin hong teelna pen midangte sangin na tamzawkna hang uh hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh lakah a tawmpen na hi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in salsuahna Egypt kumpipa Faro’ khutsung panin note hong honkhia-in a vangliatna tawh hong paikhiatpihna pen Topa in note hong itin, na pate uh tunga a kiciam thuciam a zuihna hang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian uh amah bek ahi Pasian hi a, amah itin a thupiakna a zuite tungah khang tulkhat dongin thuciamna le itna kip lenin a thuman Pasian,"},"10":{"text":"amah a mudah mite, suksiatna tawh a thukpah pa ahihna thei un.
