Amah a mudah mi tungah zekai loin a maitang mahah thuk ding hi.","ref":"Pai 20:5-6; 34:6-7; Gam 14:18; Thkna 5:9-10"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tuni-a no kong piak thute khempeuh limtakin na zuih ding uh ngaihsun un."},"12":{"text":"“Note in hih ngeina kipte za-in, kemin tuate na zuihna hangun, Topa na Pasian un na pu na pate uh tungah a ciam thuciamna le itna kip note tungah hong tungsak ding hi.","title":"Thu Manna hanga Thuphate (Siam 26:1-13 ; Thkna 28:1-14)"},"13":{"text":"Amah in note hong itin, tampi hong phasak ding hi. Amah in note tungah piak dingin na pu na pate uh tungah a ciam gam sungah note’ suanlekhakte le na gam sung panun a piangte, na an uh le na leenggahzu uh le na sathau uh, le na ganhingte uh pungsakin, na tuulekeelno honte uh zong thupha pia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Midangte khempeuh sangin note thupha hong kilim piakzaw ding hi. Note’ lak hitaleh na ganhingte uh lak hitaleh ah a nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin a ciing om lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in note’ tung panin natna khempeuh lakhia ding hi. Note in na theihsa uh ahi Egypt gam a natna siate note’ tungah khat zong hong tung lo ding a, ahih hangin no hong mudahte khempeuh tungah tuate tungsak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note tungah hong piak mi khempeuh na beisak ding uh a, amaute na khasiat kei ding uh hi. Note a dingin thangzak hi ding ahih manin amau’ pasian-te zong na bia kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 11:13-17"},"17":{"text":"“Na lungsim uhah, ‘Hih minamte ei sangin tamzaw hi. Amaute bangci suankhiat zawh ding ihi hiam?’ na cih khak uhleh,"},"18":{"text":"amaute na kihta kei ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un Faro le Egypt mite khempeuh tungah a hih,"},"19":{"text":"na mitte un a muhsa a lian ze-etnate, limte, na lamdangte, a vangliatna le Topa na Pasian un hong paikhiatpihna a thahatna na phawk ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un na kihtak uh mi khempeuh tungah tua bangin hih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua tham loin, a omlai mite le no kiang panin a bu mite a siat khit dong matengin Topa na Pasian un amaute’ lakah tunpi khah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Note in amaute na kihta kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a lian a kihtakhuai ahi Pasian, Topa na Pasian uh note tawh a om hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note’ mai-ah hih minamte tawm tawmin siang khiasak ding hi. Note a dingin gamsate hong tam khanlua kha ding ahih manin thakhatthu-in amaute na beisak kei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa na Pasian un note tungah amaute hong pia ding a, amaute a bei matengin kibuaisak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in note’ khut sungah amaute’ kumpite hong pia ding a, note in mun khempeuh panin amaute’ min na maimangsak ding uh hi. Amaute na susiamang khin ding uh a, note’ langkhatah mi khat beek hong pang zo lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A kiseek amau’ pasian milimte mei tawh na hal ding uh hi. Tua nate-ah na awk khak loh nadingun amaute’ tunga a om kham le ngun deihgawh loin, note a dingin na la kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen Topa na Pasian uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Note’ inn sungah a kihhuai nate na tumpih kei ding uh a, tua nate tawh kibangin samsiat a thuak mi na kisuaksak kei ding uh hi. Note in tua nate mudah mahmahin na kih ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua nate a kisamsia na ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note nungta-in tampi na phak theih nading uh le na pu na pate uh tungah piak dinga Topa a kiciamsa leitangah va pai-in na neih theih nadingun tuni-a note kiangah kong gen thupiakna khempeuh limtakin na zuih ding uh na ngaihsun ding uh hi.","title":"Luah Ding Gam Hoih"},"2":{"text":"A thupiakte na zui uh hiam, na zui kei uh hiam cih a theih nadingin note hong niamkhiatin, na lungsim uhah bang om hiam cih a theih nadingin Topa na Pasian un sehnel gamah hih kum sawmli sung note hong paipihna lampi khempeuh na ciamteh ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mite, an bek tawh nungta loin Topa’ kamsung panin a pusuak thu khempeuh tawh nungta hi, ci-in note hong theihsak nadingin, amah in note hong niamkhiatin hong gilkialsak a, note hitaleh na pu na pate uh hitaleh in a theih ngei loh manna tawh hong vak hi.","ref":"Mat 4:4; Luk 4:4"},"4":{"text":"Hih kum sawmli sung note’ tunga om na puan uh sia loin, na khe uh zong bawk lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mi khat in a tapa a khal bangin Topa na Pasian un note hong khalna thu na lungsim uhah thei un."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ama lampi zuihna le amah zahtakna tawh Topa note Pasian’ thupiakte na zui ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa note’ Pasian in, mual le guamah a luang tuite a omna, ciktui le tuikhuk a omna leitang,"},"8":{"text":"mangbuh le mangbuhham, leenggui le theikung, le mang kawlsing a omna leitang, oliv kungte le khuaizu a omna leitang,"},"9":{"text":"bangmah kisam loin, cilbawl loin an na nek nading uh leitang, a suangte sik ahihna leitang, mualte sung panin sumsan na tawh theihna uh leitang ahi gam hoihah note hong paipih hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in ne-in na gil uh vah ding a, note tungah gam hoih hong piakna hangin Topa na Pasian uh na phat ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tuni-a no tungah kong gen ahi ama thupiaknate le a ngeina kipte le a thukhamte zuih lohna tawh Topa na Pasian uh mangngilh kha ding na hih manun kidawm un.","title":"Topa Mangngilhkhak ding Hilhkholhna"},"12":{"text":"Tua hikeileh, an ne-in na kham uh ciang, inn hoihte lamin tuate sungah na ten uh ciang,"},"13":{"text":"na bawnghonte uh le na tuuhonte uh tampi a phak ciang le na khamte uh le na ngunte uh tampi pha-in, na neih khempeuh uh tampi a phak ciangin"},"14":{"text":"na lungsim uh lianin, salsuahna Egypt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih,"},"15":{"text":"a lian a lauhuai sehnel gamah gul gunei le momai lak le tui om lohna lei keu-ah a hong paipihpa, meisuang tawh a kibang suangpi panin tui a hong piapa,"},"16":{"text":"a tawpna-ah a hoihin na gamtat theih nading uh a deihna-in note hong niamkhiatin a hong ze-et theih nadingin na pu na pate un a theih loh manna tawh sehnel gamah a hong vak Topa na Pasian uh na mangngilh kha ding uh hi.","ref":"Hos 13:5-6"},"17":{"text":"Na lungsim uhah, ‘Ka vangliatna uh le ka thahatna un hih hauhna hong ngahsak hi,’ ci kha ding na hih manun kingaihsun un."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-a mah bangin na pu na pate uh tungah a kiciamna a kipsak theih nadingin, na hauh nadingun vangliatna a hong piapa amah ahih manin Topa na Pasian uh na phawk ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh mangngilhin pasian dangte’ nung zui-in tuate’ na semin na biak uhleh, na sia taktak ding uh hi, ci-in tuni-in limtakin kong hilhkhol hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa note’ Pasian’ aw ngai lo ahih manun, Topa in note’ mai-ah a siatsak minamte bangin note na sia ding uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Israel-te aw, za un; note sangin tamzaw-in a thahatzaw minamte, lianin van banin kulhpi a kiciangto khuapite, na theihsa uh mi ahi a pum lian a tun sang Anak mite, ‘Anak mite, kua in dozo ding ahi hiam?’ a kicih na zak ngei mite uh a suankhia dingin Jordan a kantan ta ding na hi uh hi.","title":"in Kanaan Minamte Susia Ding","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, a kangtum thei mei bangin note’ mai-ah a pai pa pen Topa na Pasian uh ahihna thu tuni-in thei un. Amah in note’ mai-ah amaute susia-in, amaute zogawp ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin amaute hawlkhia-in manlangin na siamangsak ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note mai panin amaute a nawhkhiat khit ciangin, na lungsim uhah, ‘Hih leitang a luah dingin Topa in hong paipihna pen komau’ thumanna hang ahi hi,’ ci kha kei un. Topa in na mai uhah amaute a hawlkhiatna pen hih minamte’ gitlohna hang hizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thumanna hang uh ahi a, na lungsim manna hang uh tawh ahi zongin amau’ leitang a luah ding na hi kei uh hi. Topa na Pasian un na mai panun amaute a hawlkhiatna pen hih minamte’ gitlohna hang le Topa in na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tungah a thuciamna kammal a kipsak theih nading ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin note’ thumanna hangin Topa na Pasian un na tan’ dingun hih leitang hoih note tungah hong pia ahihlohna thei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen lungsim khauh mi na hi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian uh sehnel gamah phinin na hehsakna uh phawk unla, mangngilh kei un. Egypt gam panin na paikhiat ni uh a kipan hih lai na tun dongun Topa langpanin na lehdo uh hi.","title":"Horeb-ah Israel-te’ Lehdona (Pai 31:18-32:35)"},"8":{"text":"Horeb mual nangawnah a heh nadingin Topa na phin uh a, note’ tungah Topa heh a, amah in note hong susia dektak hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in note tawh a bawl thuciamna suangpeekte a sang dingin mualtungah ka paitoh lai-in, mualtungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung ka om a, an ne lo, tui dawn loin ka om hi.","ref":"Pai 24:18"},"10":{"text":"Pasian’ khut tawh a kigelh suangpek nihte kei tungah Topa in hong pia hi. Kikhop ni-in mei sung panin note tungah Topa in hong gensa kammal khempeuh tua suangpeekte tungah om hi."},"11":{"text":"Sun sawmli le zan sawmli a cin ni-in kiciamna suangpek nihte Topa in kei hong pia hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, ‘Kithawi inla, hih lai panin paisuk mengmeng in. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt panin na paikhiatpih mite a sia-in gamta khin uh hi. Amaute ka thupiakna panin kiheikhia pak uh a, amaute a dingin a kisung milim khat bawl khin uh hi,’ hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tua tham loin Topa in kei kiangah, ‘Hih mite ka mu khin a, a lungsim khauh mite ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute susia-in mun khempeuh panin amaute’ min ka phiat theihna dingin kei guak hong omsak in. Amaute sangin a vanglianzaw, a tamzaw minamin nang kong bawl ding hi,’ hong ci lai hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin kihei-in mualtung panin kong paisuk a, mei in mual kangin na kuang hi. Kiciamna suangpek nihte ka khut nihte sungah om hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh, Topa na Pasian tung uhah na khial khin takpi uh a, a kisung bawngno milim amaute a dingin na bawl uh hi. Topa in note hong thupiakna panin na kiheikhia pak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin suangpek nihte la-in ka khut nihte’ sung panin lawnin note’ muhna-ah ka sukham hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin a masa-a bangin sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa’ mai-ah kunin ka om a, ama heh nadingin phinin, Topa’ muhna-ah a sia gamtatna tawh note’ khialhnate khempeuh hangin an ne lo, tui dawn loin ka om hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ tungah Topa’ hehna le a lungkim hetlohna, note susia dingin a kithawina hangin ka lau hi. Ahih hangin tua hunin zong Topa in kei’ thu hong ngai hi.","ref":"Heb 12:21"},"20":{"text":"Aaron’ tungah Topa heh mahmah a, amah susia dingin kithawi a, tua hun mahin Aaron a’ ding zong thu ka ngen hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin note’ khialhna, na bawlsa uh bawngno, mei tawh halin sukhamin, leivui bangin a neel dongin ka gawizan hi. Tua ciangin mualtung panin a hong luangsuk lui sungah a vuite ka lawn hi."},"22":{"text":"“Taberah, Massah, le Kibrothhattaavah munte-ah zong Topa phinin na hehsak uh hi.","ref":"Pai 17:7; Gam 11:3,34"},"23":{"text":"Topa in Kadeshbarnea panin note hong sawlin, ‘Paito unla note kong piak leitang luah un,’ hong cih lai-in Topa na Pasian uh hong thupiakna nialin, amah um loin, ama aw na ngai kei uh hi.","ref":"Gam 13:25-14:38; Thkna 1:21,26; Heb 3:16"},"24":{"text":"Note kong theih ni a kipan Topa na nial uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa in note ka susia ding ci ahih manin hih sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa’ mai-ah kunin ka om hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa’ tungah thu ka ngen a, ‘Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in na liatna tawh na hotkhiatsa, na vangliatna tawh Egypt panin na paikhiatpih na mite le na luahte susia kei in."},"27":{"text":"Na nasem Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob phawk inla, hih mihingte’ lungsim khauhna hitaleh a gitlohna uh hitaleh a khialhna uh hitaleh thusim kei in."},"28":{"text":"Tua bang hikeileh kote nong paikhiatpihna gam mite in, “ Topa in amaute tungah a ciamsa leitangah amaute paipih zo loin, amah in amaute mudah ahih manin, sehnel gamah amaute a that dingin paikhiatpih hi,” ci kha ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen na vangliatna le na thahatna tawh na paikhiatpih na mihingte le na luahte ahi hi,’ ka ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun laitakin Topa in kei kiangah, ‘A masa-a bangin suangpek nih seekin, mualtung ka kiangah hong pai inla, sing singkuang khat bawl in.","title":"A Nihveina Suangpeekte (Pai 34:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"A masa-a suangpek na sukkhapte’ tunga thute tua suangpeekte tungah ka gelh ding a, singkuang sungah tuate na koih ding hi,’ hong ci hi."},"3":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin singkha sing tawh singkuang khat bawlin, a masa-a bangin suangpek nih ka seek a, ka khut sungah a peek nihte tawi-in mualtungah ka paito hi."},"4":{"text":"Kikhop ni-in mei sung panin mualtungah Topa in note tungah hong gensa thupiak sawmte, a masa-a a kigelh bangin tua suangpeekte tungah amah in gelh a, tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah tua suangpeekte hong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin kihei-in mualtung panin ka paisuk a, ka bawlsa singkuang sungah tua suangpeekte ka koih hi. Topa in kei hong thupiak bangin suangpeekte tua sungah a om hi."},"6":{"text":"(Beeroth Benejaakan panin Moserah-ah Israel mite zin uh hi. Tua lai-ah Aaron si a, tua lai munah kivui hi. Ama tangin a tapa Eleazar in siampi na sem hi.","ref":"Gam 20:28; 33:38"},"7":{"text":"Tua lai panin Gudgodah-ah pai uh a, Gudgodah panin lui tuite a omna gam Jotbathah-ah pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Topa in, tuni dongin ama na a sem ding le ama min tawh thupha a pia dingin Topa’ mai-ah dingin, Topa’ thuciamna singkuang a pua dingin Levi minamte a tuam koih hi.","ref":"Gam 3:5-8"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a sanggamte uh bangin Levi mite in tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo uh a, Topa na Pasian un amau kiangah a gen bangin Topa pen amau’ luah ahi hi.)"},"10":{"text":"“A masa-a bangin sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung mualtungah ka om a, Topa in tua hunin zong ka thu hong ngai a, Topa in note hong susia nawn lo hi.","ref":"Pai 34:28"},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah, ‘Amaute tungah piak dingin a pu a pate uh tungah ka kiciam leitangah pai-in a luah theih nadingun ding inla, na khualzin uh zomin mite mai-ah pai in,’ hong ci hi."},"12":{"text":"“Israel-te aw, tu-in, Topa na Pasian uh zahtak ding, ama lampite tot ding, amah it ding, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Topa note’ Pasian’ na sep ding,","title":"Pasian’ Kalhte"},"13":{"text":"le nomau’ hoih nadingin tuni-a kong gen thupiaknate le Topa’ thukhamte zuih ding cih simloh, Topa na Pasian un note’ tung panin bang dang hong kal ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"En un, vantung le vantung a sangpente le leitung le a sunga om khempeuh pen Topa note’ Pasian-a’ ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hi napi-in Topa in na pu na pate uh a itna lian mahmah ahih manin tuni-a mah bangin midangte khempeuh sangin amau’ suanlekhakte hong teelzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ thu mang unla, lungkhauh nawn kei un."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh a lian, a vanglian, a kihtakhuai Pasian, angvan nei loin, sumgolh a la lo, pasian-te’ Pasian, topate’ Topa ahi hi.","ref":"1Tim 6:15; Mang 17:14; 19:16; Sawl 10:34; Rom 2:11; Gal 2:6; Efe 6:9"},"18":{"text":"Amah in pa nei lote le meigong numeite a dingin thutang semin, peemtate itin an le puan a pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin peemtate it un; bang hang hiam cih leh note zong Egypt gamah peemta na hi uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa note’ Pasian na zahtak ding uh a, ama na semin, amah beelin, ama min tawh na kiciam ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah pen nomau’ phat ding ahi hi. Na mitte un a muhsa hih a lian a kihtakhuai nate note a dingin hong bawlsak pa pen na Pasian uh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh mihing sawmsagih bek Egypt-ah paisuk uh a, ahi zongin tu-in Topa na Pasian un vantung aksi zahin note hong tamsak hi.","ref":"Pian 15:5; 22:17; 46:27"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian uh itin ama hong thuhilhna, a thukhamte, a ngeina kipte, a thupiakte na zui tawntung ding uh hi.","title":"a Liatna"},"2":{"text":"Tuni-in ngaihsun un (a thei nai lo, a mu nai lo na tate uh tungah a gen hi lo ka hih ciangin), Topa note’ Pasian’ hong thuhilhna, ama liatna, a vangliatna le a thahatna,"},"3":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa Faro le a leitang tung khempeuhah a hih Egypt gam sunga ama limte le a sepnate;","ref":"Pai 7:8-12:13"},"4":{"text":"Egypt galkapte, a sakolte le a leengte tungah a hihte; note hong delh laitakin San Tuipi tawh amaute tuumsakin, tuni dongin Topa in amaute a suksiatna;","ref":"Pai 14:28"},"5":{"text":"hih mun na tun ma sungtengun sehnel gamah amah in note tungah hong hihte;"},"6":{"text":"Reuben’ tapa Eliab, a tapa Dathan le Abiram-te tungah a hihte; leitang a kam ka-in Israel khempeuh lakah a innkuanpihte, a puanbukte le amau a zuite khempeuh tawh amaute a nawmvalhna ngaihsun un.","ref":"Gam 16:31-32"},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ hihsa a nasepna a liante khempeuh na mitte un mu khin hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin note thahatin, na luah ding uh leitangah va pai-in na luah theih nading uh le, Topa in na pu na pate uh le a suanlekhakte uh tungah piak dingin a kiciam, bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gamah sauvei na nuntak theih nadingun tuni-a kong gen thupiakna khempeuh na zui ding uh hi.","title":"Ciamsa Gam Thuphate","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh luah dinga na lut nading uh leitang pen note’ hong paikhiatna, anteh cinna huan banga khaici vawhin tui na buah nadingun nakpitakin na semin tui na lakna uh Egypt leitang tawh kibang lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Note va pai-in na luah ding uh leitang pen, vantung panin guahtui a ngah mual le guam a omna leitang,"},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un a kep leitang hi a, kum kipat a kipan kum bei dongin Topa note’ Pasian in tua leitang en tawntung hi."},"13":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian uh itin, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh ama na na sep nadingun tuni-a kong gen ama thupiaknate na zuih uhleh,"},"14":{"text":"na an uh le na leenggahzu uh le na sathau uh na kaihkhop theih nadingun amah in guah masa le guah nunung, a hunin na leitang uh a dingin hong zusak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in na ganhingte uh a dingin na gam sung uhah lopa hong posak ding a, note in zong an ne-in na gil uh vah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Midangte’ hong khemna hangin note kihei-in pasian dangte’ na semin tuate na biakkhak loh nadingun kingaihsun un."},"17":{"text":"Tua hikeileh no tungah Topa hong hehin guah zu lo ding a, leitang in bangmah piangsak loin, Topa in no hong piak leitang hoihah manlangin na siat pak theihna dingun amah in vantungte khakcip kha ding hi.","ref":"Siam 26:3-5; Thkna 7:12-16; 28:1-4"},"18":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin hih ka thugente na lungsim uhah ciamtehin na ngaihsun ding uh hi. Na khut tung uhah lim dingin na khih ding uh a, tuate pen na mitte uh kikalah talsuan hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na tate uh tungah na hilh ding uh a, na innsung uhah na lut laitak, lampi-ah na pai laitak, na lup ciang uhleh na thawh ciangun tuate genin na nei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Vantungte, leitung’ tungah a om laiteng, amaute tungah piak dingin Topa in na pu na pate uh tungah a kiciam gam sungah note le na tate uh khan a sau theih nadingin na inn kongkhak khuam uh le na kongpite uh tungah tuate na gelh ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:6-9","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh itin, ama lampi khempeuh zui-in, amah beelin, nomau zuih dingin kong gen hih thupiakna khempeuh zuih ding na kingaihsut uhleh,"},"23":{"text":"Topa in na mai uhah a om hih minamte khempeuh hawlkhia ding a, note sangin lianzaw-in a thahatzaw minamte na suankhia ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Na khe un a sikna mun khempeuh nomau a’ hi ding hi. Na gamgi uh sehnel gam panin Lebanon ciang dong le Eufratis gun panin nitumna tuipi dong hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na lang uhah kuamah pang zo lo ding hi. No tungah hong ciam bangin Topa na Pasian un na tot ding uh gam khempeuh tungah note hong kizahtakna le note hong kikihtakna tungsak ding hi.","ref":"Josh 3:1-5"},"26":{"text":"“En un, tuni-in na mai uhah thupha khat le hamsia khat ka koih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuni-a kong gen, Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate na zuih uhleh thupha hi a,"},"28":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate mang loin, na theih nai loh uh pasian dangte’ nungzui dingin tuni-a no kong thupiakna panin na kiheikhiat uh le hamsia ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Luah dingin na lutna uh leitangah Topa na Pasian un hong paipih ciangin Gerizim Mual tungah thupha taangko-in, Ebal Mual tungah hamsia na taangko ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:11-14; Josh 8:33-35"},"30":{"text":"(Tua mualte, Jordan gal, lampi panin nitumna lam, Moreh tawsaw gei-a Gilgal galkhat, Arabah-ah a teng Kanaan mite’ gam sungah om hi.)"},"31":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitang a luah dingin Jordan kantanin a pai ding na hi uh hi. Tua leitang luahin a sungah na ten uh ciangin,"},"32":{"text":"tuni-a note kong piak thukhamte le ngeina kipte khempeuh na zuih ding uh limtakin na ngaihsun ding uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hihte pen, leitungah na nuntak laiteng uh Topa, na pu na pate uh Pasian in na neih dingun no hong piaksa gam sungah limtakin na zuih ding uh thukhamte le ngeina kipte ahi hi.","title":"Biak nading Mun Khat Bek"},"2":{"text":"Na suankhiat ding uh minamte in a biakna mun mual sangte tung le mual neute tung le singniim nuai, mun khempeuh na susia taktak ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute’ biakna taute phelkhia-in, a biakna songte dengzanin, amaute’ Asherah milimte mei tawh na hal ding uh hi. A kiseek amau’ pasian-te’ limte na phukpai ding uh a, tua mun panin amau’ min na maimangsak ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 7:5"},"4":{"text":"“Ahih hangin Topa na Pasian uh tungah tua bangin na hih kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un na minam khempeuh uh sung panin ama min koih nadingin teelin, ama omna dinga a bawlna mun na zong ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua lai-ah na pai ding uh a, na meihal biaknate uh le na biakpiaknate uh, note in na piak uh sawm-ah-khat le na piak thuahte uh, thuciamna biakpiakna, utthu-a na piakna, na bawnghon tacilte uh le na tuuhon tacilte uh tua lai-ah na paipih ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh mai tua lai munah na ne ding uh a, Topa na Pasian un note thupha hong piakna hangin na hihna khempeuh uhah note le na innkuanpihte na lungdam ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua hun ciangin mi khempeuh in ama hoihsak bangin a gamtat ngei ciat bangin na gamta nawn kei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un note hong piak tawlngakna le luahna-ah na tung nai kei uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin Jordan galkhatah pai-in, Topa na Pasian un luah dingin note hong piak leitangah tengin, nuamtakin na nuntak theih nadingun na kiim uha na langte khempeuh uh kiang panin tawlngakna hong piak ciangin,"},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un ama min om nading munin a teelna munah note kong sawl khempeuh na paipih ding uh hi. Na meihal biaknate uh le na biakpiaknate uh, note in na piak uh sawm-ah-khat le na piak thuahte uh le Topa’ tungah na ciam uh na thuciam piaknate uh na paipih ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah note le na tapate uh le na tanute uh, na nasem numeite uh le na nasem pasalte uh, le note’ neih bangin tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin a nei lo na khuasung uha om Levi mite tawh lungdam khawm un."},"13":{"text":"Na tuahna mun peuh uhah na meihal biaknate uh na piak loh nadingun kingaihsun un."},"14":{"text":"Na minamte uh sung panin Topa in a teelna mun khatah na meihal biaknate uh pia-in, note kong thupiakte khempeuh tua lai munah na hih ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Ahi zongin, Topa na Pasian un note tungah hong piak thupha tawh kizui-in na khuapite uh khat peuhpeuh sungah sa na deih zahzah uh go-in na ne thei ding uh hi. Sanang le sakhitalte a kinek mah bangin mi a nin le a siang kideidan loin na ne thei ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"A si na ne kei bek ding uh hi; tui bangin leitungah a si na bua ding uh hi.","ref":"Pian 9:4; Siam 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 15:23"},"17":{"text":"Na an uh sawm-ah-khat ahi a, na leenggahzu uh ahi a, na sathau uh ahi zongin, na bawnghon uh le na tuuhonte uh sung pan tacilte ahi zongin, na kiciamna uh ahi na thuciam uh biakpiakna khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, utthu-a na piakte uh ahi zongin, nomau’ piak thuahte ahi zongin na khuapite uh sungah na ne thei kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah note le na tapate le na tanute, na nasem numeite le na nasem pasalte, le na khuapite uh sunga om Levi mite in Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah na ne ding uh hi. Na hihna khempeuh uhah Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah na lungdam ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Na gam sung uhah na ten laiteng uh Levi mite na mangngilh loh nadingun kingaihsun un."},"20":{"text":"“No tungah hong ciamsa bangin Topa na Pasian un na gamgi uh hong sotsak ciangin, sa na duh manun, ‘Sa ka ne ding uh hi,’ na cih uhleh, na duh zahzah uh sa na ne thei ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un ama min koih nadingin a teelna mun pen note kiang panin a gamla lua ahihleh, note kong thupiaksa bangin Topa in no hong piaksa na bawnghon uh pan ahi a, na tuuhon uh pan ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh na go thei ding uh a, na duh zahzah uh na khuasung uhah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Sanang ahi a, sakhital ahi zongin a kinek mah bangin na ne thei ding uh a, mi a nin le a siang kideidan loin a kibangin na ne thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"A si na nek loh ding uh theitel un. Bang hang hiam cih leh si pen nuntakna hi a, nuntakna pen sa tawh na ne khawm kei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Si na ne kei ding uh a, tui bangin leitungah na buakhia ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 17:10-14"},"25":{"text":"Topa’ muhna-ah a manin na gamtat uh ciangin note le note’ khit cianga na tate uh a nopsak theih nadingin si na ne kei ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahih hangin na bat uh a siangtho nate le na thuciamna uh na piaknate uh note in la-in Topa in a teelna munah na paipih ding uh a,"},"27":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh biakna tau tungah na meihal biakna uh, a sa le a si na pia ding uh hi. Na biakpiakna uh site Topa note’ Pasian’ biakna tau tungah kibuakhia ding a, ahih hangin a sa na ne thei ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh muhna-ah a hoih le a manin na gamtat uh ciangin note le note’ khit cianga na tate uh a nopsak theih nadingin note kong thupiak khempeuh na kin ding uh limtakin ngaihsun un."},"29":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un na mai panun na suankhiat ding uh minamte beimangsakin, amaute suankhia-in amau’ leitangah na ten uh ciangin,","title":"Milim Biak loh ding Hilhkholhna"},"30":{"text":"na mai uhah amaute a kisuksiat khit ciangin amaute zui-in na awk khak loh nading uh le, ‘Kei zong amau’ hih bangin ka hih theih nadingin hih minamte in a pasian-te uh bangci biak ahi uh hiam?’ ci-in a pasian-te uh thu na kan loh nadingun kingaihsun un."},"31":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh tungah tua bangin na hih kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a muhdah a kihhuai nam khempeuh amaute in a pasian-te uh a dingin hih uh hi. A pasian-te uh a dingin a tapate uh le a tanute nangawn uh mei sungah a hal uh hi."},"32":{"text":"“Note kong thupiak khempeuh na hih ding uh na lim ngaihsut ding uh hi. Na behlap kei ding uh a, zong na khiam kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:2; Mang 22:18-19"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note lakah kamsang khat ahi a, mangman khat ahi zongin hong khangin, lim ahi a, nalamdang ahi zongin hong lak a,"},"2":{"text":"ama hong gen lim ahi a, nalamdang ahi zongin hong tungin, na theih ngei loh uh, ‘Adang pasian-te’ nung zui-in amaute va bia ni,’ hong cih leh,"},"3":{"text":"tua kamsangpa’ thu ahi a, mangman pa’ thu ahi zongin na ngai kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa note’ Pasian na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh na it uh hiam cih a kitheih nadingin Topa na Pasian un no hong ze-etna ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh nung zui-in, amah na zahtak ding uh a, a thupiaknate zui-in a thu na ngai ding uh a, amah bia-in amah na beel ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua kamsangpa ahi a, mangman pa ahi zongin kithat ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un na pai nadingun a hong thupiak na nusiat theih nading uh le Egypt leitang panin hong paikhiatpihin salsuahna panin hong honkhia Topa na Pasian uh langpangin na lehdo nading uh thu hong hilh ahi hi. Tua bangin note’ lak panin siatna na siangkhiasak ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Na sanggampa ahi a, na tanu ahih kei leh na tapa in ahi a, na ang sunga om na zi ahi a, nangmah banga na ngaihsut na lawm it in ahi zongin nang hong zol simin, leimong khat pan mong khat dong kikalah, nang kiang pan a nai ahi a, a gamla ahi zongin, nang hitaleh na pu na pate hitaleh in a theih ngei loh, na kiima om mite’ pasian-te, ‘Va pai-in pasian dangte va bia ni,’ hong cih leh","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"ama cih mang loin, a thu ngai loin, amah hehpih loin, amah khahkhong loin, amah na im kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in amah na that ding hi. Amah a that dingin nangmah a masa pen na hi ding a, tua khit ciangin midangte khempeuh in hong zui ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Salsuahna ahi Egypt gam panin a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh kiang panin note hong paikhiatpih ding ngaihsun ahih manin suang tawh amah na denglum ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te khempeuh in za-in lau ding uh a, hih banga gitlohna note lakah bawlkik ngei nawn lo ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un tenna dinga hong piak na khuapite uh khat peuhpeuh sungah,"},"13":{"text":"mi ginalo pawlkhat note lakah hong pai-in, ‘Pai-in pasian dangte va bia ni,’ ci-in na theih ngei lohte uh lamah khuapi sunga teng mite a paikhiatpihna na zak uhleh,"},"14":{"text":"note in a thu na kan ding uh a, zongin limtakin na dong ding uh hi. Note lakah tua banga a kihhuai-in gamtatna thu a om mah ahih takpi leh,"},"15":{"text":"tua khua sunga mite namsau tawh na that ding uh a, khua sunga om mi khempeuh le a ganhingte, namsau tawh na susiamang ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Note in van kinusiate khempeuh khua laizang mun awngah khawmin, Topa na Pasian uh tungah khuapi le van kinusia khempeuh meihal biakna bupin mei tawh na hal ding uh hi. Tua khuapi pen ninkikholna hi tawntung ding a, kilamkik nawn lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuni-a kong gen ama thupiaknate khempeuh zui-in Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah a manin gamtatna tawh Topa na Pasian uh’ aw na ngaih uhleh, na pu na pate uh tungah a ciamsa bangin, a kihtakhuai ama hehna panin Topa kihei-in note tungah migitna hong lakin, note tungah hehpihna hong nei-in, note tampi tak hong phaksak theih nadingin a ki-apsa na khat beek zong note a dingin na kem kei ding uh hi.","merge":"18"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note pen Topa na Pasian uh mite na hi uh hi. Misite hangin note ki-atkeh loin, na sam uh zong na mettol kei ding uh hi.","title":"A Kikham Dahna Zia","ref":"Siam 19:28; 21:5"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen Topa na Pasian uh tungah a siangtho mite na hi uh a, leitung a om mite khempeuh sung panin ama neih dingin Topa in note hong teel ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 19:5-6; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 26:18; Tit 2:14; 1Pe 2:9"},"3":{"text":"“A kihhuai na khat peuhpeuh na ne kei ding uh hi.","title":"Ganhing a Siang le a Nin (Siam 11:1-47)"},"4":{"text":"Na nek theih ding uh ganhingte: Bawng, tuu, keel,"},"5":{"text":"sakhital, sanang, simsakhi, sathak, saza, zosakhi, le gamtuu ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ganhingte lak panin a khecin a ka, eknel a hai ganhing peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin eknel a hai a, a khecin a ka ahi zongin na nek theih loh dingte uh: Kalaoh, bilpi, le sakikhte in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih manin note a dingin a nin ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Vok pen a khecin a kat hangin eknel hai lo ahih manin note-a’ dingin a nin ahi hi. Tuate’ sa ne loin, a sisate zong na lawng kei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tui sunga om khempeuh lak panin phe le lip a nei peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Phe le lip a nei lo peuhmah na ne kei ding uh a, tuate pen no-a’ dingin a nin ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Vasa a siang khempeuh na ne thei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin na nek loh dingte uh: Muvanlai, musane, luimu,"},"13":{"text":"mupi, mumeika, amau nam ciat;"},"14":{"text":"va-ak nam khempeuh;"},"15":{"text":"vasa-kalaoh, pengpelep, vatawt, musi nam khempeuh;"},"16":{"text":"keising le simbu, gam vatawt"},"17":{"text":"le tui vatawt, samuat ne musane le tuimu,"},"18":{"text":"gun vapi, gun vazonei nam khempeuh; huihtun le bak ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"“Kha a nei insek ganhing khempeuh no a dingin a nin ahi hi; tuate kine lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A leng thei insek ganhing a siangte khempeuh na ne thei ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ama thu-a a si tawm ganhing peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi. A nek dingun na khuasung uha om khualmite tungah na pia thei ding uh a, tua ahih kei leh zong gamdang mite tungah na zuak thei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen Topa na Pasian uh tungah a siangtho mi na hi uh hi. “Keelno a pi’ nawizu tawh na huan kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:19; 34:26"},"22":{"text":"“A kum kumin na lo uhah a piang, na khaici panun a piang khempeuh sawm-ah-khat na pia ding uh hi.","title":"Sawm-ah-khat Thu"},"23":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh na zahtak tawntung nading uh na theih nadingun, ama min a ten nadingin a teelna mun Topa note’ Pasian’ mai-ah na an uh, na leenggahzu uh, na sathau uh sawm-ah-khat, le na bawnghon uh le na tuuhon tacilte uh na ne ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un a min koih nadingin a teelna mun pen, Topa na Pasian un no thupha hong piak ciangin note kiang panin gamla lua a, no a dingin lam a sau luat manin sawm-ah-khat na paipih zawh kei uhleh,"},"25":{"text":"tuate sum na suah ding uh a, a sumte tunin, Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah na pai ding uh a,"},"26":{"text":"na deih peuhpeuh uh bawng ahi a, tuu ahi a, leenggahzu ahi a, khamtheihzu ahi zongin, na duh peuhpeuh uh leina-in a sum na zang ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian uh mai tua lai munah na ne ding uh a, note le na innkuanpihte uh na lungdam ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"“Note bangin amaute in tanh le luah nei lo ahih manin na khuasung uha om Levi mite na mangngilh kei ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"“Kum thum simin tua kum-a note’ anpiang sawm-ah-khat khempeuh hong paikhiatpihin na khuasung uhah na khol ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un na sepnate khempeuh uhah thupha hong piak theih nadingin, note tawh kibangin amaute in tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo uh ahih manin note’ khua sunga om Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei lote, leh meigong numeite hong pai-in tua ante ne-in a gilvah ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 27:30-33; Gam 18:21"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Kum sagih a cin simin leiba maisakna na nei ding uh hi.","title":"Maisakna Kum (Siam 25:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Maisak nading zia in: Leitawi a pia mi khempeuh in a vengte tungah leitawi a a piaksate maisak ding hi. Topa’ maisakna thu kigen khin ahih manin a vengpa, a sanggampa’ tung pan kuamah in leiba siik nawn lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdang mite’ tung pan na siik thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na sanggamte uh tung panin no-a’ hong bat peuhmah na maisak ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Ahih hangin tuni-a kong gen hih thupiakna khempeuh zui-in Topa note’ Pasian’ aw na ngaih nak-uhleh note’ lakah a zawng om lo ding hi (bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un na neih dingun gamhluahin hong piak leitang tungah Topa in note thupha hong pia ding hi).","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un hong ciamsa bangin note thupha hong pia ding a, minam tampi tungah leitawi na pia ding uh a, ahih hangin note in lei na tawi kei ding uh hi. Minam tampite na uk ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute in note hong uk lo ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note hong piak gam sunga na khuate uh khat peuhpeuh sungah na sanggam khat uh note lakah a zawng a om leh na lungsim uh khauhsak loin, na sanggam zawng pa uh huh loin na om kei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama tungah na cingh gamtat ding uh a, bangbang hitaleh ama kisap zah na leitawi ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 25:35"},"9":{"text":"Na lungsim uhah ngaihsutna hoih lo omin, ‘Kum sagihna, maisakna kum hong nai hi,’ ci-in na sanggampa galmi et-in amah bangmah na piak loh uh ciangin na langkhatah Topa’ tungah amah kiko-in, no tungah khialhna a suahkhak ding kingaihsun un."},"10":{"text":"Citna tawh amah na pia ding uh a, amah na piak uh ciangin lungsim neihna na nei kei ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un na sepna na hihna khempeuh uhah hih thu hangin note thupha hong pia ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leitang tungah mizawng bei ngei lo ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin, ‘Gam sungah a om na sanggampa, na a kisam mite le mizawngte tungah na cingh mahmah ding uh hi,’ ci-in thu kong pia hi.","ref":"Mat 26:11; Mrk 14:7; Joh 12:8"},"12":{"text":"“Na sanggampa, Hebru pasal khat ahi a, Hebru numei khat ahi zongin nang tungah hong kizuak leh, amah in nangma na kum guk sung hong sem ding a, a kum sagihna ciangin nang kiang panin a suakta-in na paikhiasak ding hi.","title":"Silate a Kibawlna (Pai 21:1-11)"},"13":{"text":"Na kiang panin a suakta-in na paikhiatsak ciangin khuthawm guakin na paisak kei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na tuuhon lak, na ancilna le na leenggah sukna panin citna tawh tampi na pia ding a, Topa na Pasian in nang thupha hong piak zahin amah na pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gamah sila na hihna uh le Topa na Pasian un note hong suahtaksakna na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih thu tuni-in kong pia hi."},"16":{"text":"“Ahih hangin amah in note nuam hong sa-in, nang le na innkuanpihte hong it ahih manin ‘Nang kiang panin ka paikhia kei ding hi,’ hong cih leh,"},"17":{"text":"phimpi khat la-in, kongkhak dapphahin a bil na vut ding a, na sila hi tawntung ding hi. Na sila numei zong tua bangmahin na hih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na kiang panin a suakta-in amah na paisak ciangin haksa sa kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh a kicial nasem thaman lang tawh amah in nangma na kum guk sung hong sem khinzo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian un na hihna khempeuh uhah thupha hong pia ding hi.","ref":"Siam 25:39-46"},"19":{"text":"“Na bawnghon uh le na tuuhon uh panin tacil a pa khempeuh Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah na ap ding uh hi. Na bawnghon tacilte uh tawh na na sem kei ding uh a, na tuuhon tacilte uh zong a mul na met kei ding uh hi.","title":"Tacilte Apna","ref":"Pai 13:12"},"20":{"text":"Topa in a teelna munah a kum kumin Topa note’ Pasian’ mai-ah na innkuanpihte uh tawh na ne ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahih hangin poina khatpeuh, a khebai a mittaw, ahih kei leh poina lian khat peuhpeuh a neih leh, Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah biakna-in na pia kei ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Na khuasung uhah na ne ding uh hi. Sanang ahi a, sakhi ahi zongin a kinek bangin mi nin le mi siangte in a kibangin ne thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"A si na ne kei bek ding uh a, tui bangin leilakah a si na buakhia ding uh hi.","ref":"Pian 9:4; Siam 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16,23"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Abib kha tang unla, Topa na Pasian uh a dingin Paisan Pawi bawl un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Abib kha sungin Topa na Pasian un Egypt gam panin zanin note hong paikhiatpih hi.","title":"A Kiseh Pawi Thumte (Pai 23:14-17 ; 34:18-24)"},"2":{"text":"Tuuhon pan ahi a, bawnghon pan ahi zongin Topa in ama min om nadingin a teelna munah Paisan Pawi biakpiakna Topa na Pasian uh tungah na pia ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Silngo sawh anlum tawh na ne kei ding uh a, ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum, gimna anlum tawh na ne ding uh hi. Egypt gam panin nawhsa-in na taikhia uh hi. Egypt gam panin na taikhiat uh hun na nuntak sung tawntung uh na phawk theih nading uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na gam sung khempeuh uhah ni sagih sung note lakah silngo kimu lo ding hi. A ni masa nitakin biakpiakna-ah na piak uh sa khat peuhpeuh zong a zingsang dong zan tawntung na omsak kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note hong piak khua khempeuhah Paisan Pawi biakpiakna na pia thei kei ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un ama min om nadingin a teelna mun bekah ni a tum khit nitak, Egypt panin na paikhiat uh hunin Paisan Pawi biakpiakna na pia ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah huanin na ne ding uh a, zingsang ciangin na puanbukte uhah na ciah thei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni guk sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in Topa na Pasian uh a dingin a thupi kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi. Tua ni-in na na sem kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 12:1-20; Siam 23:5-8; Gam 28:16-25"},"9":{"text":"“An na lak masak ni uh a kipanin nipikal sagih na simto ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa na Pasian un note thupha hong piakna tawh kizui-in na piak ding uh ahi note’ khutsung panin utthu-a piakna tawh Topa na Pasian uh tungah nipikal pawi na bawl ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasian uh mai, ama min om nadingin Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah, note a kipan na tanute le na tapate, na nasem numeite le na nasem pasalte, na khua sunga om Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei lote, le note lakah a om meigong numeite tawh na lungdam khawm ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt-ah sila na hihna uh na phawk ding uh a, hih thukhamte zuih ding limtakin na ngaihsun ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 23:15-21; Gam 28:26-31"},"13":{"text":"“Na ancilna uh le na leenggah sukna panun an na kaihkhop uh ciangin ni sagih sung buk pawi na bawl ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua pawi sungah nang a kipan na tanute le na tapate, na nasem numeite le na nasem pasalte, Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei lote, le na khua sunga om meigong numeite tawh na lungdam khawm ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in a teelna munah ni sagih sung Topa na Pasian uh tungah pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note na lungdam khawm theih nadingun na khawhsa uh le na khut uh tawh na sepna khempeuh uhah Topa na Pasian un note thupha hong pia ding hi.","ref":"Siam 23:33-36,39-43; Gam 29:12-38"},"16":{"text":"“Amah in a teelna mun, Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah pasal khempeuh kum khatin thumvei, silngo sawh loh anlum pawi, nipikal pawi, le buk pawi-ah kilaak ding uh hi. Amaute khut hawmguakin Topa’ mai-ah kilak lo ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un note thupha hong piaknasa tawh kizui-in mi khempeuh in ama hih theih bang ciatin pia ding uh hi.","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"“Na minam uh tawh kizui-in Topa na Pasian un note hong piakna khuate-ah thukhente le uliante na koih ding uh a, amaute in a manin mite tungah thu khen ding uh hi.","title":"Thu A Tangin Khenna"},"19":{"text":"Thutang na heikhia kei ding uh a, angvan tuam na nei kei ding uh hi. Sumgolh in mipilte’ mit tawsakin thumante’ thu heikhia ahih manin sumgolh na la kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:6-8; Siam 19:15"},"20":{"text":"Note nungta-in Topa na Pasian un hong piak leitang na luah theih nadingun a thuman bekbekin na gamta ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"“Note in na bawlsa uh ahi, Topa na Pasian uh biakna tau kiangah Asherah milim dingin khuam khat peuhpeuh na phut kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 34:13"},"22":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un a muhdah biakna songpi na phut kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 26:1"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bawng ahi a, tuu ahi zongin, poina a nei, kisapna khat peuhpeuh a om peuhmah Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah biakpiakna-in na pia kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen Topa note’ Pasian a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"“ Topa note’ Pasian in note hong piak khua khat peuhpeuh sungah numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin, ama thuciamna palsatin, Topa na Pasian uh muhna-ah a sia-in a gamtatna kimu-in,"},"3":{"text":"pasian dangte’ na semin tuate bia ahi zongin, keimah in ka kham ahi ni ahi a, kha ahi a, vantung na khat peuhpeuhte’ na semin bia ahi zongin,","ref":"Pai 22:20"},"4":{"text":"no kiangah hong kigenin tua thu na zak uhleh, note in limtakin na kantel ding uh a, Israel-te sungah tua bang a kihhuai na a kigamtatna thu a om mah ahih takpi leh,"},"5":{"text":"numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin tua banga a sia-in a gamta mi pen na khua pua uhah na paipih ding uh a, tua numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin suang tawh na denglum ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Teci nih ahih kei leh thum bang genna tawh a si ding pa kithat ding a, teci khat bek thugenna tawh mi kithat lo ding hi.","ref":"Gam 35:30; Thkna 19:15; Mat 18:16; 2Kor 13:1; 1Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28"},"7":{"text":"A that dingin tecite masa ding a, tua khit ciangin midang khempeuh in hih ding uh hi. Tua bangin note’ sung panin hoih lohna na siangsak ding uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 5:13"},"8":{"text":"“Mi khatlekhat kithah khakna, khatlekhat thu kituhna, mi khatlekhat kisatna, note a dingin a haksalua thu khat peuhpeuh note’ khua sungah khen ding hong om leh, note kithawi-in Topa na Pasian un a teelna mun,"},"9":{"text":"Levi siampite le tua huna thukhente kiangah pai-in thu na dong ding uh a, amaute in note kiangah thukhen nading hong gen ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in a teelna mun panin note’ tungah hong gen bangun na hih ding uh hi. Amaute in note tungah hong lah bangin limtakin na hih ding uh na ngaihsun ding uh a,"},"11":{"text":"amaute in note tungah hong piak thuhilhna le note tungah hong gen uh thukhensatna tawh kizui-in na hih ding uh hi. Amaute in note tungah hong gen bang teekteekin na hih ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa note’ Pasian’ mai-ah nasem dingin a ding siampipa’ thu ahi a, thukhen pa’ thu ahi zongin man lohna tawh a khengvala a gamta mi peuhpeuh kithat ding hi. Tua bangin Israel-te’ sung panin hoih lohna na siangsak ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hileh mi khempeuh in za-in, kihta-in, a khengvalin gamta ngam nawn lo ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitangah tungin, note in tua leitang nei-in a tungah na ten uh ciangin, ‘Eite’ kimkota om minamte khempeuh mah bangin eite’ tungah kumpi khat i koih ding hi,’ na ci nuam kha ding uh hi.","title":"Kumpipa tawh Kisai Hilhna","ref":"1Sam 8:5"},"15":{"text":"Topa note’ Pasian in a teel mipa note’ tungah kumpi-in na koih thei takpi ding uh hi. Ahi zongin na mipihte bek uh lak panin kumpi-in mi khat na koih ding uh a, na sanggam uh ahi lo gamdang mi khat no’ tungah na koih thei kei ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in ama aituam dingin sakol tampi nei lo ding hi. Topa in no kiangah, ‘Hih lampi tawnin na kilehkik ngei kei ding uh hi,’ hong ci ahih manin, amah in sakolte a lei dingin Egypt gamah mite paisak lo ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:28; 2Khang 1:16; 9:28"},"17":{"text":"A lungsim heikhia kha ding ahih manin zi la thuah lo ding a, ama a dingin ngun le kham zong nakpitakin behlap lo ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:14-22,27; 11:1-8; 2Khang 1:15; 9:27"},"18":{"text":"Ama kumpi tokhom tungah a tut ciangin Levi siampite’ kep hih thukhamte ama a dingin laibu khat sungah gelh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hih thukham sunga thute le hih ngeinate kemin zuihna tawh Topa a Pasian zahtak ding a theih nading, a mipihte tungah ama lungsim a kiliatsak loh nading, thupiaknate them khat zong a pelh loh nading, le Israel-te sung ahi ama kumpi gam sungah amah le a tate saupi a om theih nadingin amah in a nuntak sung tawntung tua sunga thute sim ding hi.","merge":"20"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Siampi ahi Levi minam khempeuh in Israel-te bangin tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo ding uh a, amaute in Topa’ tungah mei tawh kihal biaknate le a kaih ngeite uh ne ding uh hi.","title":"Siampite le Levi mite’ Tanh"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in a sanggamte uh lakah gamhluah nei lo ding uh a, amah in amaute tungah a ciam mah bangin Topa pen amaute’ luah ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:20"},"3":{"text":"“Bawng hitaleh tuu hitaleh biakna-in a pia mite’ tung panin siampite’ kaih dingte: Amaute in siampite’ tungah a liang le a paang nihte le a gilpi pia ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Na anpal, na leenggahzu, na sathau, le na meet masak uh na tuumul uh na pia ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Levi minamte Topa’ na a sem tawntung dingin na minam khempeuh uh sung panin Topa na Pasian un a teel ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Levi mi khat, Israel-te sung na khuapi uh khat peuhpeuh ahi ama tenna panin ama ut hun peuh ciangin Topa’ teelna munah hong pai thei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ mai-ah nasem dingin a om a lawm Levi midangte khempeuh mah bangin Topa a Pasian’ min tawh na sem thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a gamhluah a zuakna pan a sum ngahte banah nek ding a kikimin amaute tawh tanh ngahkhawm ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitangah na tun uh ciangin, tua minamte’ gamtatna a kihhuaite zuih ding na kisin kei ding uh hi.","title":"Lawki Gamtat Zuih loh ding Hilhkholhna"},"10":{"text":"Note lakah a tanu ahi a, a tapa ahi zongin biakna-in a zang, ai a saan, khong a khai, mailam thu a gen, ai a tawi,","ref":"Siam 19:26; Pai 22:18"},"11":{"text":"bum a zang, van a kah, sikhate tawh a kiho, sikha thu a dong kuamah na om kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:31"},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh hihte a hih mi peuhmah Topa a dingin a kihhuai ahi hi. Hih bang a kihhuai gamtatnate hangin note’ mai panin Topa na Pasian un amaute hawlkhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Note pen Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah paubaang loin na om ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 5:48"},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note in na suankhiat ding uh hih minamte in khongkhaite le aisante thu ngai uh hi. Ahih hangin note ahihleh tua bangin na gamtat ding uh Topa na Pasian un hong phal lo hi."},"15":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note lak ahi na sanggamte uh lak panin note a dingin kei tawh a kibang kamsang khat hong khangsak ding hi. Note in ama thu na ngai ding uh hi.","title":"Moses tawh a kibang Kamsang khat Pasian in Kham","ref":"Sawl 3:22; 7:37"},"16":{"text":"“Note in, ‘Si kha ding ka hih manun Topa kote’ Pasian’ aw hong zasakkik kei in. Hih a lian mei zong hong musak nawn kei in,’ ci-in na kikhop ni-un Horeb-ah Topa na Pasian uh tung pan na deih bang uh hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah, ‘Amaute’ hong ngetna thuman taktak hi."},"18":{"text":"Amau sanggamte lak panin nang tawh a kibang kamsang khat amaute a dingin ka khangsak ding hi. Ama gen dingte ka hilh ding a, amah ka thupiak khempeuh amaute tungah a gen ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in keima min tawh a gen ka thute a don lo mi peuhmahte kei mahmah in ka thuk ding hi.","ref":"Sawl 3:23"},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in thugen dingin thu pia lo napi-in keima min tawh thu a gen ngam kamsangpa hitaleh pasian dangte’ min tawh thu a gen pa hitaleh, tua bang mite si ding hi,’ hong ci hi."},"21":{"text":"“Na lungsim sung uhah, ‘ Topa’ gen ahi lo thu bangci theih ding ihi hiam?’ na cih uhleh,"},"22":{"text":"kamsang khat in Topa’ min tawh thu genin, tua thu pen hong tung lo ahi a, a man lo ahi zongin hong hih leh, tua thu pen Topa’ gen loh thu ahi hi. Kamsangpa in ama utthu a gen hi a, amah na kihtak ding uh kul lo hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un amaute’ leitang note hong piak minamte beisakin, note in amaute suankhia-in, amaute’ khuapite le innte-ah na ten uh ciangin,","title":"Bukna Khuapite, Tanglai Gamgite (Gam 35:9-28 ; Josh 20:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note’ neih dingin hong piak gam sungah note a dingin khuapi thum na tuamkoih ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi a thatkha peuhpeuh a tai theih nadingin Topa na Pasian un na neih dingun a hong piak leitang seh thumin khenin seh khat sungah khuapi khat ciat koihin a lampite na puah ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khat sing a phuk dingin a vengpa tawh gamlakah pai-in, sing a phuk dingin a khut tawh a hei vaanin, a heitang a ga panin kikhongin a vengpa kha-in a sih bang danin, mi khat in sawm lohpi, a beisa hunah amah tawh kigal neihna om lopi-in a vengpa a sihsak khak leh, hih khuapite khat peuhpeuhah amah tai-in a nuntakna hu thei ding hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Tua bang hikeileh, amah in a beisa hunah a vengpa tawh kigal neihna nei lo ahih manin sih nading thu om lo napi-in, a hehna tawh phula nuampa in mi that khapa delhin lampi a gamlatna hangin amah pha-in a si dingin liamsak kha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, khuapi thum tuamkoih un, ci-in note thu a hong pia ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Note in Topa na Pasian uh itin, ama lampi zuih tawntungna tawh tuni-a kong gen hih thupiakna khempeuh limtakin na zuih uh a, amah in na pu na pate uh tungah a kiciam mah bangin Topa na Pasian un na gamgite uh hong keeksakin, na pu na pate uh piak dingin a ciam leitang note tungah hong piak leh, hih khuapi thum banah khuapi thum mah na behlap ding uh hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Tua hikeileh Topa na Pasian un luah dingin note hong piak leitang tungah mawhbaang lo mi kithat kha ding a, tua mi thahna hanga mawhna note’ tungah hong tu ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ahih hangin mi khat in a vengpa mudahin, amah pangsim a, amah satin liamsakin a sihsak a, tua mipa hih khuapi khat peuhpeuhah a tai leh,"},"12":{"text":"ama khua upate in amah hong puakin hong paipih ding uh a, a sih theih nadingin phulapa tungah ap ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Note na nopsak theih nadingun amah hehpih loin, Israel-te sung panin mi that pa na beisak ding uh hi.","ref":"Josh 20:1-9"},"14":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un na neih dingun hong piak leitang tungah note’ kep ding na gamhluahna sung uhah khanglui mite in a phuhsa na vengte’ gisuang na khin kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:17"},"15":{"text":"“Mi khat in a hihkhak mawhna lian ahi a, khialhna khat peuhpeuh a gamtatna-ah ahi zongin tua mipa’ langah teci khat guak kicing lo ding a, teci nih ahih kei leh teci thum bang thugenna tawh mawhsakna kikipsak bek ding hi.","title":"Tecite tawh kisai Ngeina","ref":"Gam 35:30; Thkna 17:6; Mat 18:16; Joh 8:17; 2Kor 13:1; 1Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28"},"16":{"text":"Elna lungsim a nei teci khat in mi khat gamta khial hi, ci-in a mawhsak leh,"},"17":{"text":"thuneite a langnih tuakin, tuahun laitak a siampite le thukhente’ mai, Topa’ mai-ah pai ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Thukhente in limtakin kan ding uh a, teci pa pen zuau teci hi-in, a man lopi-in a sanggampa a mawhsak ahihleh,"},"19":{"text":"a sanggampa tungah amah in hih dinga a sawm bang teekin ama tungah na hih ding uh hi. Tua bangin note sung panin gitlohna na siangsak ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hileh a omlai mite in za-in lau ding a, note lakah tua bang gitlohna bawlkik ngei nawn lo ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah na hehpih kei ding uh hi. Nuntakna tang ding nuntakna, mit tang ding mit, ha tang ding ha, khut tang ding khut, khe tang ding khe na hisak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 21:23-25; Siam 24:19-20; Mat 5:38"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na langte uh a do dingin pai-in a sakolte, a leengte, le a galkapte uh nomau-a’ sangin a tamzaw-in na muh uh hangin amaute na kihta tuan kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh note tawh hong om hi.","title":"Gal tawh kisai Ngeinate"},"2":{"text":"Gal nai na tun uh ciangin siampipa a mai-ah hong pai-in mite kiangah thu genin"},"3":{"text":"amaute kiangah, ‘Israel-te aw, za un. Tuni-in na langte uh a do dingin na nai uh hi. Na lungsim uh lausak kei un. Lau kei un, ling kei un, amaute kihta kei un."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note tungah gualzawhna a hong pia ding, na langte uh hong dosak dingin note tawh hong kuan khawm pa pen Topa na Pasian uh ahi hi,’ ci ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tua ciangin uliante in mite kiangah thu genin, ‘Inn thak lam khinin a ap nai lo kua om na hi uh hiam? Gal sungah amah si-in midang khat in a inn ap kha ding ahih manin a inn-ah ciahkik hen."},"6":{"text":"Leenggui lo kho khinin a gah a ne nai lo kua om na hi uh hiam? Gal sungah amah si-in midang khat in a gah ne kha ding ahih manin a inn-ah ciahkik hen."},"7":{"text":"A zi dingin lawm dong khinin a la nai lo kua om na hi uh hiam? Gal sungah amah si-in midang khat in tua numei la kha ding ahih manin a inn-ah ciahkik hen,’ ci ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Uliante in mite kiangah thu genthuah lai-in, ‘A lau, a lungsim meidawi kua om na hi uh hiam? A lawmte meidawilawh kha ding ahih manin a inn-ah ciahkik hen,’ ci ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Uliante in mite kiangah thugen a man khit uh ciangin mite a makai ding kiseh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“A do dingin khuapi khatpeuh na nai uh ciangin kilem nading thu gen masa un."},"11":{"text":"Note hong dawnna pen kilem nading lam hi-in note kongpi hong hon leh, tua sunga om mi khempeuh in note a dingin aana tawh na semin, na na uh hong sepsak ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin note tawh kilemna hong bawl loin note hong do leh, note in tua khua na umcih ding uh a,"},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note’ khut sungah hong piak ciangin pasal khempeuh namsau tawh na that ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin numeite le naupangte, ganhingte, khua sunga na dang khempeuh, a kinusiate khempeuh note a dingin na la ding uh a, Topa na Pasian un note hong piak ahi na langte uh vante na tang ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih nai-a om minamte’ khuapi ahi lo, note kiang panin a gamla khuapi khempeuh tungah tu-a bangin na hih ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"“Ahih hangin, amau’ pasian-te a biakna uhah a hih uh a kihhuai gamtatnate khempeuh note hong hilh theih loh nading le tua bangin Topa na Pasian uh tungah na khialh theih loh nadingun, Topa na Pasian un luah dingin note’ tungah hong piak hih mite’ khuapi sungah mi khempeuh na hingkhawi kei ding uh a, Topa na Pasian un hong thupiaksa bangin Hit mite le Amor mite, Kanaan mite le Perez mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite, a vekpi-in amaute na susiamang ding uh hi.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"“Khuapi khat na lak theih nadingun do-in sauveipi na umcih uh hangin hei zatna tawh a singgah kungte na susia kei ding uh hi. A gahte na ne thei ding uh a, ahih hangin a kungte na phuk kei ding uh hi. Gamlak a om singkungte, note’ sukgawp dingin na gal uh hi zenzen ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Nek dinga kizang lo singkung hi, ci-in na theih teng bek uh note hong do khuapi a tuk mateng umcihna-in na zat dingun na phuk thei ding uh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un note’ neih dingin a hong piak leitangah mi khat kithatin gamlakah lum a, a that a kitheih kei leh,","title":"Mi that a Kithei lopa’ Thu Khenna"},"2":{"text":"na upate uh le na thukhente uh hong paikhia-in, a kithat mipa’ omna kiima khuapite a gamlatna teh ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kithat mipa’ omna tawh a kinai pen khuapi upate in a kisin nai lo, kol a kai nai lo bawngla khat la ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua khuapi upate in a kikho nai lo, khaici a kivawh nai lo, tuiluang a omna kuam khatah a bawngla paipihsuk ding uh a, tua kuam sungah a bawngla ngawng attan ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un Levi mi siampite ama na a sem ding le Topa’ min tawh thupha a pia dingin teelkhia ahih manin amaute hong pai ding uh a, kithuneihna le kitotna peuhmah amau’ thu tawh kivengsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A kithat mipa tawh a kinai pen khuapi upate khempeuh in kuam sunga a ngawng a kitan bawngla tungah a khut uh sil ding uh a,"},"7":{"text":"amaute in teci pangin, ‘Kote in hih mipa ka that kei uh a, a kithahlam zong ka thei kei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, na hotkhiatsa Israel mite’ mawhna hong maisak inla, mawhna nei lo mipa a kithahna hanga mawhna na Israel mihingte hong thuaksak kei in. Mi thahna hanga mawhna pan hong maisak in,’ ci ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ muhna-ah a manin na gamtat uh ciangin note lak panin mawhna nei lo mi thahna hanga mawhna tua bangin na siangsak ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Na galte uh a do dingin kuan khia-in, Topa na Pasian un note’ khut sungah amaute hong pia a, amaute salin na mat ciangun,","title":"Galmat Numeite a Kibawlna"},"11":{"text":"salte lakah numei a melhoih khat mu-in, tua nu deihin na zi dingin na lak nop leh,"},"12":{"text":"na inn-ah tua numei na ciahpih ding a, amah in a lu metin a cinte tan ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in sal hihna puan suahkhia-in, na inn-ah om ding a, a nu le a pa’ hangin kha khat bit sung kap ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah na luppih thei pan ding a, nang pen ama pasal hi-in, amah pen na zi hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin, amah na deih nawn kei leh, ama utna peuhah na paisak ding hi. Ahih hangin amah daisak khin na hih manin sumin amah zuak loin, sila bangin na bawl kei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Mi khat in zi nih nei a, khat itin a khat mudah a, a it leh a muhdah a zi tegel in ta nei tuakin, tapa a neih cil pen a muhdah nu tawh a neih ahihleh,","title":"Tacil tawh kisai Ngeina"},"16":{"text":"a tapate tungah gamhluah dingin ama neihsa a hawm ciangin, a muhdah nu’ tapa cil sangin deihzawkna hangin a it nu’ tapa pen a ta cil-in bawl thei lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama neihsa khempeuh tanh nih piakna tawh a muhdah nu’ tapa a tacil mahin sang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pa pen ama sung panin a piang masa pen ahih manin tacil hihna za pen ama a’ ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"“Mi khat in a lungkhauh, a langpang thei, a nu’ thu ahi a, a pa’ thu ahi zongin a mang lo, a tai hangun amau’ thu a ngai lo tapa khat a neih leh,","title":"A Thumang lo Tapa"},"19":{"text":"a nu le a pa in tua mipa manin ama khuapi upate kiang, a tenna mun kongpi-ah paipihin,"},"20":{"text":"amaute in a khuapi upate kiangah, ‘Hih ka tapa uh lungkhauhin hong langpang thei a, amah in ka thu uh hong mang lo a, an hai, zu hai bek ahi hi,’ ci ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin khuapi pasal khempeuh in suang tawh amah denglum ding uh hi. Tua bangin note’ sung panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi. Tua hileh Israel-te khempeuh in za-in lau ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mi khat in sihna thuak theih nading mawhna bawlin amah kithat a, sing tungah na khai uhleh,","title":"Ngeina Tuamtuamte"},"23":{"text":"zan tawntung sing tungah ama luang na omsak kei ding uh a, a ni mahin na phum ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khuam tungah a kikhai siluang hawm pen Pasian in muhthadah sa hi. Topa na Pasian un luah dingin note hong piak na leitang uh na ninsak kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Gal 3:13"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na mipihte’ bawngtal ahi a, a tuu ahi zongin a gammang na muh uhleh huh loin na om kei ding uh hi. A nei pa kiangah na ciahpih kik ding uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Amah na veng nai uh hi lo a, a nei na theih kei uhleh, na inn uhah a gan ciahpihin a nei pa in hong zon mateng na kem ding uh a, hong zon ciangin na piakik ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bangin a la, a puan, a mangsa na muh, na mipihte’ na a mang khat peuhpeuh na hih ding uh a, huh loin na om kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Na mipihte’ la ahi a, a bawngtal ahi zongin lam gei-ah a kia na muh uhleh, tuate huh loin na om kei ding uh a, tuate phottohsakkikna tawh na huh ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:4-5"},"5":{"text":"“Numei in pasal puan khat peuhpeuh silh lo ding a, pasal in zong numei puan silh lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih bangin a gamta peuhmah Topa na Pasian uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Vasabu khat, sing tung ahi a, leilakah ahi zongin, a no ahi a, a tui ahi zongin omin, a pi in a no a ompih ahi a, a op ahi zongin na muh khak zenzen uhleh, a pi pen a no tawh na la khawm kei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A pi na khah ding uh a, a no na la thei ding uh hi. Hih bang gamtatna pen na nopsak nading uh, sauveipi na nuntak theih nading uh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Na inn tung panun mi khat kia-in mi sihna hanga mawhna na innsung uhah na tunsak khak loh nadingun inn thak na lam uh ciangin na innkhumzang uhah tangban na khung ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na leenggui lo uhah khaici nam nih na vawh kei ding uh hi. Vawh le-uh cin na vawh uh an le na leenggui lo uhah a piang khempeuh a nin suak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Bawngtal khat le la khat tawh lo na khokhawm kei ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Samul le khau a kigankhawm puan na silh kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:19"},"12":{"text":"“Na puanza uh kiu lite tungah puanmongteep na bawl ding uh hi.","ref":"Gam 15:37-41"},"13":{"text":"“Mi khat in zi la-in, amah a luppih khit ciangin amah mudahin,","title":"Sianthona tawh kisai Ngeinate"},"14":{"text":"a zumhuai gamtatna tawh tua nu mawhsakin, ‘Keimah in hih numei ka la a, amah tawh ka lupkhop ciangin ama sungah nungakna lim ka mu kei hi,’ cihna tawh tua nu tungah minsia a tut leh,"},"15":{"text":"tua numei’ nu le a pa in a tanu uh’ nungakna lim a kilatna puan lakhia-in upate kiang kongpi-ah paipih ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Numei’ pa in upate kiangah, ‘Hih mipa tungah a zi dingin ka tanu ka pia a, amah in deih nawn lo a,"},"17":{"text":"“Na tanu’ sungah nungakna lim ka mu kei hi,” cihna tawh a zumhuai-in amah mawhsak hi. Ahi zongin hihte pen ka tanu’ nungakna a kilatna limte ahi hi,’ ci-in a puan lak ding hi. Amaute in khua upate mai-ah a puan phah ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua khua upate in tua mipa la-in sat ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in ngun shekel zakhat liausak ding uh a, a numei’ pa’ tungah tuate pia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Israel nungak tungah minsia tun hi. Tua ciangin a numei pen ama zi mah hi ding a, a nuntak laiteng tua nu ma thei lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Ahih hangin a mawhsakna thumanin, numei sungah nungakna lim a kimuh kei takpi leh,"},"21":{"text":"amaute in a pa’ inn kongah a numei paipih ding uh a, ama khuapi pasalte in suang tawh amah denglum ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a pa’ inn sungah paktat gamtatna tawh Israel sungah haina tun hi. Tua bangin note’ lak panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mi khat, midang khat’ zi tawh a lumkhawm a kimuh leh, numei tawh a lum pa le a numei, a nih tuakun kithat ding hi. Tua bangin Israel sung panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"“A kidongsa nungak khat om a, mi khat in khuapi sungah tua nu tuakin amah tawh a lupkhop leh,"},"24":{"text":"tua khuapi kongpi-ah amau tegel na paipih ding uh a, a numei khuapi sungah a om hinapi-in mi’ huhna ngen dingin a kiko lohna hang le, tua pasal in a vengpa’ zi a va suksakna hangin, suang tawh a nihun na denglum ding uh hi. Tua bangin note’ lak panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ahih hangin mi khat in a kidongsa nungak khat gamlakah tuakin, mipa in tua nu buanin a luppih leh, tua numei tawh a lum mipa bek kithat ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A numei’ tungah bangmah na hih kei ding uh hi. Numei’ tungah sih nading mawhna om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu pen mi khat in a vengpa do-in a thah tawh kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"Hih mipa in gamlakah numei hih ahih manin, a kidongsa numei in huhna ngen dingin a kiko hangin amah a hon ding kuamah om lo hi."},"28":{"text":"“Mi khat in a kidong nai lo nungak khat tuakin, tua numei buanin luppih a, amau tegel a kimuh leh,"},"29":{"text":"numei tawh a lum pa in nungak’ pa tungah ngun shekel sawmnga pia ding a, tua numei ama zi hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a numei va su khin hi. A nuntak laiteng tua numei ma thei lo ding hi.","ref":"Pai 22:16-17"},"30":{"text":"“Mi khat in a pa’ zidangte tenpih lo ding a, a pa-a’ ahi numei tawh mawh lo ding hi.","ref":"Siam 18:8; 20:11; Thkna 27:20"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“A ciltang a kitam ahih kei leh, a pasal na a cing lo mipa Topa a’ ding kikhopna sungah lut lo ding hi.","title":"Kikhopna-ah A Kihel Thei lote"},"2":{"text":"“Zawlta peuhmah, Topa a’ ding kikhopna sungah lut lo ding hi. A suan a khak khang sawmna dong nangawnin Topa a’ ding kikhopna sungah tua bang mi kuamah lut thei lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ammon mite ahi a, Moab mite ahi zongin Topa a’ ding kikhopna sungah lut thei lo ding uh hi. A khang sawmna dong nangawnun Topa a’ ding kikhopna sungah lut thei ngei peuhmah lo ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt panin na paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah anletui tawh amaute in note hong dawn lo uh a, note hong samsia dingin Mesopotamia gam Pethor khua panin Beor’ tapa Balaam cial uh hi.","ref":"Gam 22:1-6"},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa na Pasian un Balaam’ thu ngai lo hi. Topa na Pasian un note hong it ahih manin, Topa na Pasian un samsiatna pen note a dingin thupha-in hong heisakzaw hi.","ref":"Neh 13:1-2; Gam 23:7-24:9"},"6":{"text":"Amaute’ nopsak nading ahi a, a daupai nading uh ahi zongin na khantawnun na hanciam kei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Edom mite khatpeuh na mudah kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute na sanggam uh ahi hi. Egypt mi khatpeuh na mudah kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ gamah peemta na hi ngei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute’ sung pana piang a khang thumna mite a kipan Topa a’ ding kikhopna sungah lut thei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na galte uh a do dingin kuanin giahphual ah na om uh ciangin, siatna nam khempeuh panin nomau na kikem ding uh hi.","title":"Galsung Giahphual Sianthona"},"10":{"text":"Note lakah, zan sungin ama tungah thupiang hangin a siang lo mi a om leh giahphual pualamah amah paikhia ding a, giahphual sungah hong pai lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin nitak ciangin amahmah tui sungah kisil ding a, ni a tum ciangin giahphual sungah hong paithei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Giahphual pua-ah awnghawh nading mun khat na nei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Na galhiamte uh banah tulzum khat na nei ding uh a, awng na hawh khit uh ciangin tua tawh lei to-in, na ek uh na vuk ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note hong hon ding le note’ mai-a na galte uh a hong pia dingin Topa na Pasian uh na giahphual laizang uhah hong pai hi. Tua ahih ciangin note lakah a kilawm lo nate a muh loh nading le note kiang panin amah a paikhiat loh nadingin na giahphual uh siangtho ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“A topa’ kiang panin no kiangah a hong tai sila, a topa kiang mahah na apkik kei ding uh hi.","title":"Ngeina Tuamtuamte"},"16":{"text":"Na khuapite uh lak panin ama teelna mun, ama lungkim penna, note lakah note tawh amah hong teng ding a, amah na nengniam kei ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Israel ta numeite biakinn sunga a paktat pawlin om lo ding uh a, Israel tapate zong a paktat pawlin om lo ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:29"},"18":{"text":"A paktat nu a kiguaihna sum ahi a, a paktat pa a kiguaihna sum ahi zongin thuciamna khat peuhpeuh piakna-in Topa note’ Pasian’ inn sungah na paipih kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih tegel pen Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah a kihhuai ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na sanggampa tungah sumgum hitaleh, ankhing hitaleh, a meet ngaihsutna-in na khat peuhpeuh leitawi na pia kei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Gamdang mi tungah a meetin leitawi na pia thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na sanggampa tungah a meetin leitawi na pia kei ding uh hi. Hihte pen a luah dingin na tumna uh gam sungah Topa na Pasian un na sepna khempeuh uhah thupha hong piak theih nading ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 22:25; Siam 25:36-37; Thkna 15:7-11"},"21":{"text":"“ Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah thuciamna na bawl ciangun na ciamna uh tungsak loin na ommawk kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un hong kal teekteek ding a, note tungah khialhna hong hi ding hi.","ref":"Gam 13:1-16; Mat 5:33"},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin thuciamna bawl ding pan na kikep uhleh note’ sungah khialhna om lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na kam uh tawh na ciamsa uh thu pen Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah nomau utthu-a na ciam uh ahih manin na kam uh panin a gingkhia peuhmah na tunsak ding uh na ngaihsun ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"“Na vengpa’ leenggui lo-ah na pai uh ciangin na ut zahzah uh na kham dong uh leenggah na ne thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na van sung uhah na guang kei ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Na vengpa’ ankung ding laite lakah na pai uh ciangin na khut uh tawh a vuite na zut thei ding uh a, ahih hangin phiaukawi tawh na vengpa’ ankung ding laite na at kei ding uh hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khat in zi la-in a tenpih ciangin, tua nu tungah kilawm lohna a om manin numei in a pasal’ mitah maipha mu lo a, amah in makna lai gelhin ama tungah pia-in ama inn panin sawlkhia a, a pasal’ inn panin amah kihem khia-in,","title":"Kimakna Thu","ref":"Mat 5:31; 19:7; Mrk 10:4"},"2":{"text":"amah pai-in midang khat’ zi va suak a,"},"3":{"text":"a pasal nunung in amah deih lo leuleu a, makna lai gelhin a numei’ khut sungah koih a, a inn panin tua nu sawlkhia-in, tua ahih kei leh zi dinga a la a pasal nunung a sih leh,"},"4":{"text":"tua numei a hawlkhia a pasal masa in, tua nu a kinitsak khit ciangin a zi dingin lakik thei nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen Topa’ mai-ah kihhuaina hi a, Topa note’ Pasian un luah dingin hong piak leitang tungah mawhna na tunpih kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Mi khat in zi a neih tungin galkapte tawh kuankhia lo ding a, nasep khat peuhpeuh zong kisawl lo ding hi. A laksa a zi tawh a lungdam khawm dingin inn-ah kum khat sung maang ding hi.","title":"Ngeina Tuamtuamte"},"6":{"text":"“Kuamah in an gawina ahi a, an gawina suangpek a tungnung ahi zongin khapna-in la lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khapna-in nuntakna a la suak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mi khat in Israel mi a sanggamte khat gu-in, amah in sila bangin a bawl ahi a, a zuak ahi zongin a kimuh leh, tua guta pa kithat ding hi. Tua bangin note’ lak panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 21:16"},"8":{"text":"“Phaknatna hong tun ciangin Levi siampite in hong gen bangin na gamtat ding uh ngaihsun un. Amaute ka thupiakna bangin na gamtatna dingun na kingaihsun ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 13:1-14:54"},"9":{"text":"Egypt panin na paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah Topa na Pasian un Miriam’ tungah a hihna phawk un.","ref":"Gam 12:10"},"10":{"text":"“Na vengte uh tungah na khat peuhpeuh leitawi na piak uh ciangin ama hong khapna a la dingin a inn-ah pai kei un."},"11":{"text":"A pualamah na ding ding uh a, leitawi na piakna mipa in nang kiangah a na khap hong paipih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah mizawng ahihleh ama hong khap puan na zantaamsak kei ding uh a,"},"13":{"text":"ni a tum ciangin, a puanza silhin nang thupha hong piak theihna dingin tua hong na khap ama kiangah na piakik ding uh hi. Tua pen Topa note’ Pasian’ mai-ah note a dingin thumanna hi ding hi.","ref":"Pai 22:26-27"},"14":{"text":"“A zawng a cimawh a kicial nasempa, na sanggamte khat ahi a, na gam sung na khuapite sunga om peemta khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, na nengniam kei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A sep ni-in ama thaman, nitum ma-in na pia ding uh hi (bang hang hiam cih leh amah zawng a, tua bek a lungsimah om hi). Tua hikeileh Topa’ tungah amah in hong khia ding a, note na mawh ding uh hi.","ref":"Siam 19:13"},"16":{"text":"“Tate’ tangin pate kithat lo ding a, pate’ tangin zong tate kithat lo ding hi. Mi khempeuh ama khialhna hang bekin kithat ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 14:6; 2Khang 25:4; Ezk 18:20"},"17":{"text":"“Peemta’ thu ahi a, pa nei lo mi’ thu ahi zongin tuate a’ ding thutang na heisak kei ding uh a, meigong numei’ puan zong khapna-in na laksak kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Egypt-ah sila na hihna uh le Topa note’ Pasian in tua lai panin hong hotkhiatna na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih banga na gamtat nading uh thu kong pia hi.","ref":"Pai 23:9; Siam 19:33-34; Thkna 27:19"},"19":{"text":"“Na lo-ah an la-in lo lai-ah anlom na mangngilh uh ciangin a tawm dingin na paikik kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a’ ding ahi hi. Hih pen Topa note’ Pasian in na khut uh tawh na sepna khempeuh uhah note thupha hong piak theih nading ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Na oliv kungte uh na sat uh ciangin a hiangte na sat kikkik kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a’ ding ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Na leenggui lo panun leenggah na kaihkhop uh ciangin a sang na nung khop kik kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a’ ding ahi hi.","ref":"Siam 19:9-10; 23:22"},"22":{"text":"Egypt gamah sila na hihna uh na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih bangin na gamtat nadingun thu kong pia hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mite kikalah thu kineihna om a, thukhen zumah amaute pai-in, thukhente in amau’ thu khensakin, a dikpa khahin a mawh pa lelsak a,"},"2":{"text":"a mawh pa satna thuak dinga kilawm ahihleh, thukhen pa in amah lumsuksakin a khialhna zahin ama muhin satsak ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sat sawmli kipia thei ding a, ahih hangin tua val hi lo ding hi. Tua hikeileh, hih sangin a tamvei zaw mi khat in sat lai leh note’ muhna-ah na sanggampa uh a kineubawl suak ding hi.","ref":"2Kor 11:24"},"4":{"text":"“Bawng in an a cil laitakin a muk na tuam kei ding uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 9:9; 1Tim 5:18"},"5":{"text":"“Sanggam pasalte teng khawmin, tuate khat si-in tapa a neih kei le, a sipa’ zi pen innkuan pualam khualmi tawh kiteng lo ding hi. A pasal’ sanggampa in luppihin a zi dingin amah la ding a, ama tungah pasal’ sanggampa’ nasep sem ding hi.","title":"Levi mite’ Kitenna"},"6":{"text":"Ama min Israel tungah a maiman’ loh nadingin tua nu in a neih masak a tapa pen a sisa a pasal’ ta-in kiseh ding hi.","ref":"Mat 22:24; Mrk 12:19; Luk 20:28"},"7":{"text":"Mipa in a sanggampa’ zi a laknop kei leh, upate kiang kongpi-ah a sanggampa’ zi pai ding a, ‘Ka pasal’ sanggampa in a sanggampa’ min Israel sungah a zop ding ut lo a, pasal’ sanggampa’ nasep kei tungah hong sem nuam lo hi,’ ci ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa’ khuapi upate in amah samin thu genpih ding uh hi. Amah in, ‘Tua nu ka la nuam kei hi,’ a cih teitei leh,"},"9":{"text":"upate’ omin a sanggampa’ zi ama kiangah paito-in a khe panin a khedap kaihkhiatsakin a maitang cilphih ding hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in, ‘A sanggampa’ innkuan a zomto lo mipa hih bangin kibawl ta hen,’ cikhia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel mite lakah ama innkuan pen, ‘A khedap a kikaih khiatsak mipa’ innkuan,’ kici ding hi.","ref":"Ruth 4:7-8"},"11":{"text":"“Mi khatlekhat a kilai ciangin, a satpa’ kiang panin a pasal a honkhia dingin a khat pa’ zi hong pai a, a khutin a selsimte a matsak leh,","title":"Ngeina Dangte"},"12":{"text":"tua nu’ khut na sattansak ding uh a, amah na hehpih kei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"“Na ipsung uhah tawisuang nam nih, a lian le a neu, na neikhawm kei ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Na innsung uhah tehna nam nih, a lian le a neu, na neikhawm kei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tawisuang a cing a man na nei ding uh a, tehna a cing a man na nei ding uh hi. Topa note’ Pasian in hong piak leitangah na khan uh a sau theih nading ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tua bangin gamta-in, a thuman lote khempeuh, Topa note’ Pasian’ tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.","ref":"Siam 19:35-36"},"17":{"text":"“Egypt panin nong paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah Amalek mite in note hong bawlna,","title":"Amalek mite Phiatkhiat ding Thupiakna"},"18":{"text":"note gimin lungkhamin na om laitakun lampi-ah a hong simna, le note’ nungah a nunung khempeuh hong thahna uh phawk un; amaute in Pasian kihta lo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa note’ Pasian in note’ neih dingin gamh-in hong piak leitang tungah, Topa na Pasian un na kiim uha na galte khempeuh panun tawlngakna hong piak ciangin, mun khempeuh panin Amalek mite a kiphawkna na phiatkhiat ding uh na mangngilh kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 17:8-14; 1Sam 15:2-9"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian un luah dingin a hong piak leitangah va pai-in, tua leitang luahin a tungah na ten uh ciangin,","title":"Anpalte le Sawm-ah-khat Piakna Zia"},"2":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un a hong piak leitang pana piang gah khempeuh panin a gah masa pawlkhat la-in lawh khat sungah na koih ding uh a, ama min na omsak nadingun Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah na pai ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 23:19"},"3":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin na a sem siampipa kiangah pai-in ama kiangah, ‘ Topa in kote piak dingin ka pu ka pate uh tungah a ciam leitangah ka tun khitna uh tuni-in Topa na Pasian kiangah kong ko uh hi,’ na ci ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua ciangin siampipa in note’ khut panin a lawh hong saang ding a, Topa note’ Pasian biakna tau mai-ah koih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“ Topa note’ Pasian mai-ah note in, ‘A vak kawikawi kote’ pupi pen Aram mi hi a, amah Egypt-ah paisukin tua munah a peem lai-in mi tawmno ahi hi.
