Bang hang hiam cih leh mualtung gam a teng Amor kumpite khempeuh kote langpangin kikhawm uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Gilgal panin amah le galhang mite khempeuh le a thahat mi khempeuh tawh Joshua a kuanto hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Joshua kiangah, “Amaute na khut sungah hong pia khin ka hih manin amaute kihta kei in. Amaute khat beek in nang hong nang zo lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Gilgal panin zan tawntung paito-in Joshua in thakhatthu-in amaute simgawp hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te’ mai-ah amaute amkhamsakin, amaute in Gibeon-ah amaute tampi tak that uh a, Bethhoron paitohna lampi-ah amaute delhin, Azekah le Makkedah ciang dong amaute a vatgawp uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel-te’ mai-ah amaute a tai laitak, Bethhoron paitohna-ah amaute a paisuk laitakun, Topa in vantung panin gialpi lianpite Azekah khua ciang dong, amaute’ tungah lawnsuk a, amaute a si uh hi. Israel mite in namsau tawh a thah sangin tua gialpi hangin a si mi tamzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin, Topa in Israel mite tungah Amor mite a piak ni-in Joshua in Topa tungah thu gen a, amah in Israel mite’ muhna-ah, “Ni aw, Gibeon-ah, Kha aw, Aijalon Kuam-ah khawlcip in,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin hih minamte in a galte uh a zawh khit mateng ni ding cipin kha a khawl hi. Hih thute, Jashar’ Laibu sungah kigelh hi. Vankim lai-ah ni khawlin ni khat bup bang tumsuk lo hi.","ref":"2Sam 1:18"},"14":{"text":"Tua hun ma hitaleh tua hun khit hitaleh Topa in mi khat thu a ngaih tua ni bang nidang om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Israel mite a dingin a dosak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua, amah tawh a om Israel-te khempeuh tawh Gilgal-a giahphual ah a ciahkik hi."},"16":{"text":"Hih kumpi ngate tai-in Makkedah leihawm sungah bu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua kiangah, “Kumpi ngate Makkedah leihawm sungah a bu kimu khin hi,” ci-in kigen hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in, “Suangtum lianpite a leihawm gong liknelh unla, a cing dingin a gei-ah mi koih un."},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin note tua lai-ah om kei un. Na galte uh delhin a nungdalte bawh unla, a khuapi sung uhah amaute lutsak kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un note’ khut sungah amaute hong piazo hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Joshua le Israel mite in amaute a beisiang dongin tampi tak a thah khit uh ciang, le a suakta lai mite amau’ khuapi muanhuai sungah a tum khit uh ciangin,"},"21":{"text":"Makkedah giahphual Joshua kiangah mi khempeuh cidamin a ciahkik uh hi. Israel mite khatpeuh a paupih ngam kuamah om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in, “Leihawm gong hong unla, leihawm panin tua kumpi ngate kei kiangah hong paikhiatpih un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in tua bangmahin hih uh a, leihawm panin tua kumpi ngate, Jerusalem kumpi, Hebron kumpi, Jarmuth kumpi, Lakhish kumpi, le Eglon kumpite, ama kiangah a paipih uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute in Joshua kiangah tua kumpi ngate a paikhiatpih uh ciangin, Joshua in Israel mi khempeuh samin, amah tawh a kuankhawm galkapmangte kiangah, “A nai-ah hong pai unla, hih kumpite’ ngawngah na khe uh nga un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute a nai-ah hong pai-in, a khe uh amaute’ ngawng tungah a nga uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Joshua in amaute kiangah, “Lau kei unla, lungkia kei un. Thakhauh unla, hang un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ do na gal khempeuhte uh tungah Topa in hih bangin bawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Joshua in amaute satin sisak a, singkung nga tungah amaute a khai hi. Amaute in nitak dong sing tungah a khai uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin ni a tum hun ciangin Joshua in thu pia a, amaute in sing tung panin lakhia sukin, amaute a buknasa leihawm sungah lawnsuk uh a, suangtum lianpite leihawm gongah a koih uh hi. Tu dongin tua suangtumte omlai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ni-in Joshua in Makkedah khua la a, namsau tawh tua khua le a kumpipa vatgawp hi. A sunga om mi khempeuh susia mangin, bangmah siit lo a, Jerikho kumpipa tungah a bawl bangin Makkedah kumpipa tungah a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua, amah tawh a om Israel-te khempeuh tawh Makkedah panin Libnah-ah paisuak uh a, Libnah khua a sim uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in tua khua le a kumpipa zong Israel mite’ khut sungah a pia hi. Amah in namsau tawh tua khua le a sunga om mi khempeuh a vatgawp hi. Tua khua sungah bangmah siit lo a, Jerikho kumpipa tungah a bawl bangin a kumpipa tungah a bawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua, amah tawh a om Israel-te khempeuh tawh Libnah panin Lakhish-ah paisuak uh a, tua khua umcihin a sim uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite’ khut sungah Lakhish pia a, amah in a ni nih ni-in la-in, Libnah a bawl bangin tua khua le a sunga om mi khempeuh namsau tawh a vatgawp hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Lakhish a huh dingin Gezer kumpipa Horam hong kuanto hi. Ahi zongin khat zong a om nawn lo dongin Joshua in amah le a mite a vatgawp hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Lakhish panin Eglon-ah, amah tawh a om Israel-te khempeuh tawh Joshua paisuakin tua khua umcihin a sim uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ni mahin tua khua la uh a, namsau tawh a vatgawp uh hi. Lakhish a hih mah bangin tua khua sunga om mi khempeuh tua ni-in amah in a susiamang hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua, Israel-te khempeuh tawh Eglon panin Hebron-ah a paito hi. Amaute in tua khua simin,"},"37":{"text":"la-in, namsau tawh tua khua le a kumpi le a kiima om khempeuh a vatgawp hi. Eglon tungah a bawl bangin amah in kuamah siit lo a, tua khua le a sunga om khempeuh a susiamang hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua, Israel-te khempeuh tawh Debir lamah kihei kikin tua khua a sim hi."},"39":{"text":"Amah in a kumpipa le a kiimnai-a khuapite khempeuh tawh tua Debir khua a la hi. Amaute in namsau tawh vatgawp uh a, a sunga om mi khempeuh a susiamang uh hi. Amah in kuamah siit lo a, Hebron le Libnah le a kumpipa tungah a bawlsa bangin Debir le a kumpipa tungah a bawl hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Joshua in gam khempeuh, mualtung gam le Negeb gam le lei niamna mun le mualpang suk, le a khuapite khempeuh a zo hi. Amah in kuamah siit lo a, Israel-te’ Topa Pasian’ thupiaksa bangin mi khempeuh a susiamang hi."},"41":{"text":"Joshua in amaute Kadeshbarnea panin Gaza ciang dong, le Goshen gam khempeuh Gibeon ciang dong a zogawp hi."},"42":{"text":"Israel-te’ Topa Pasian in Israel-te a dingin dosak ahih manin Joshua in hih kumpite khempeuh le amau’ leitang hun khat sungin a la khin hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah tawh a om Israel khempeuh tawh Gilgal-a a giahphual ah Joshua a ciahkik hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hazor kumpipa Jabin in Israel-te’ gualzawhna thu a zak ciangin amah in Madon kumpipa Jobab le Shimron kumpipa, Akshaf kumpipa,","title":"Leilu lam gam Kumpite a Kizawhna"},"2":{"text":"saklam mualtung le Khinneroth leitaw lama om Arabah gam sung, le Jordan gunkuam le nitumna lamah Nafathdor gam sunga om kumpite,"},"3":{"text":"nisuahna le nitumna lama om Kanaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, le mualtung gam a om Jebus mite, le Mizpah gam Hermon nuai-a Hiv mite tungah thu a puak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute tampi a pha a galkap honpite tawh, a tam mahmah sakolte le leengte tawh, tuipi gei-a om sehnel bangin tampi tak hong kuankhia uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih kumpite khempeuh in amau’ galkapte gawmin Israel mite tawh a kido dingin hong pai-in Merom lui-ah giahphual a sat khawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Joshua kiangah, “Zing ciang tubang hunin amaute khempeuh a kithatsa-in Israel mite tungah pia ding ka hih manin amaute kihta kei un. A sakolte uh a zagui na sattat ding uh a, a leengte uh mei tawh na hal ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Joshua zong a galkapte khempeuh tawh thakhat thu-in Merom lui gei amaute kiangah pai-in va sim uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Israel-te’ khut sungah amaute pia a, amaute in vatgawpin a Lian Sidon le Misrefothmaim ciang dong, le nisuahna lamah Mizpeh kuam ciang dong delh uh a, amaute kuamah a om nawn lo dongin a vatgawp uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ sawl bangin Joshua in amaute hih a, amau’ sakolte uh a zagui sattat sakin mei tawh a leengte uh a halsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Joshua kihei kikin Hazor la a, namsau tawh a kumpipa a that hi. (Tua hun laitakin Hazor khua pen tua kumpipa gam khempeuh sungah a thahat pen ahi hi.)"},"11":{"text":"Amaute in tua sunga om mi khempeuh namsau tawh that khinmang uh hi. Khat zong hingkhawi lo uh a, a khuapi uh zong a haltum uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses in a thupiaksa bangin Joshua in tua kumpite’ khuapite, le a kumpi khempeuh la-in namsau tawh amaute vatin thatmang khin hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin Hazor khua longal mualtung a om khuapite khat zong Israel mite in hal lo uh a, Joshua in tua khua bek a hal hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel mite in tua khuapite sunga van kinusiate le ganhingte amau’ galzawh van dingin a la uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute a thah khit matengun namsau tawh vatgawp uh a, khat beek hingkhawi lo uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in ama nasem Moses a thupiak bangin Moses in zong Joshua thu pia a, Joshua zong tua bangmahin gamta a, Topa in Moses a thupiaknate khempeuh a hihloh om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Joshua in gam khempeuh, mualtung gam le Negeb gam le Goshen gam khempeuh le lei niamna gam le Arabah le Israel-te’ mualtung gam le a lei niamna gamte,","title":"Joshua in Gambup La"},"17":{"text":"Seir lamah a kikhungto Halak Mual panin Hermon Mual nuai Lebanon kuama om Baalgad ciang dong a la hi. Amah in amau’ kumpite khempeuh la-in amaute vatgawpin a that hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih kumpite khempeuh le Joshua sauveipi sung a kido hi."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon khua-a teng Hiv mite longal, Israel mite tawh kilemna a bawl khuapi khat zong om lo hi. Amaute in tua khua dangte khempeuh simin a lak uh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Moses a thupiakna bangin amaute a kisuksiat mang nading le hehpihna ngah loin a kibeisak theih nadingin Israel-te a do nadingin a lungsim uh a khauhsak pa pen Topa ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 7:16"},"21":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Joshua hong pai-in mualtung gam, Hebron, Debir, Anab, le Judah mualtung gam khempeuh, le Israel mualtung gam khempeuh panin Anak mite notkhiasiang a, Joshua in a khuapite uh tawh amaute susiamang khawm hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel mite’ leitangah Anak mite khat zong om nawn lo a, Gaza, Gath, le Ashdod sung bekah pawlkhat omlai hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a gensa bangin Joshua in leitang khempeuh a la hi. Tua ciangin Joshua in amau minam tawh kizui-in a ngah ding bangin Israel mite tungah gamh-in a pia hi. Tua hun a kipan galdona panin tua gam a tawlnga hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in nisuahna lam Jordan galkhat, Arnon kuam panin Arabah khempeuh, Hermon Mual ciang dong Israel mite in a leitang uh laksakin a zawh kumpi nihte:","title":"Moses in a Zawh Kumpite"},"2":{"text":"Heshbon-ah a teng Amor kumpi, Arnon kuam gei-a om Aroer pan, le Gilead kuam laizang panin phellang ahi Ammon mite’ gamgi Jabbok gun ciang dong, le Arabah panin nisuahna lamah Khinneroth Tuipi, le Bethjeshimoth lamah Pisgah mualpang bul leitaw lama om Ci Tuipi ahi Arabah tuipi ciang dong a uk Sihon;","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"le Bashan kumpi, Refaim panin a suaktate lakah khat, Ashtaroth le Edrei-ah tengin, Hermon Mual le Salekah le Bashan gam khempeuh, Geshur mite le Maakath mite gamgi ciang, le Gilead langkhat panin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon’ gamgi ciang dong a uk Og ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-35; Thkna 2:26-3:11","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Topa’ nasem Moses le Israel mite in amau tegel a zo uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa’ nasem Moses in Reuben mite le Gad mite le Manasseh minam alangte tungah a neih dingun amau’ leitang a pia hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"7":{"text":"Hihte pen, Joshua le Israel mite in a zawh Jordan nitumna lampang, Lebanon kuam sung Baalgad panin Seir lamah a kikhungto Halak Mual kikal-a om kumpite ahi hi. (Joshua in mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Arabah gam, mualpang suk, sehnel gam, le Negeb gam sunga om Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite’ leitangte Israel minamte’ tungah amau’ ngah ding tawh kizui-in a neih dingun a pia hi.)","title":"Joshua in a Zawh Kumpite","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"A zawh uh kumpite: Jerikho kumpi, khat; Bethel gei-a om Ai kumpi, khat;"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem kumpi, khat; Hebron kumpi, khat;"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth kumpi, khat; Lakhish kumpi, khat;"},"12":{"text":"Eglon kumpi, khat; Gezer kumpi, khat;"},"13":{"text":"Debir kumpi, khat; Geder kumpi, khat;"},"14":{"text":"Hormah kumpi, khat; Arad kumpi, khat;"},"15":{"text":"Libnah kumpi, khat; Adullam kumpi, khat;"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah kumpi, khat; Bethel kumpi, khat;"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah kumpi, khat; Hefer kumpi, khat;"},"18":{"text":"Afek kumpi, khat; Lasharon kumpi, khat;"},"19":{"text":"Madon kumpi, khat; Hazor kumpi, khat;"},"20":{"text":"Shimronmeron kumpi, khat; Akshaf kumpi, khat;"},"21":{"text":"Taanak kumpi, khat; Megiddo kumpi, khat;"},"22":{"text":"Kadesh kumpi, khat; Karmel gam sunga Jokneam kumpi, khat;"},"23":{"text":"Nafathdor sunga Dor kumpi, khat; Galilee sunga Goiim kumpi, khat;"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah kumpi, khat; a vekpi-in kumpi sawmthum le khat ahi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Joshua teekin a kum tampi pha hi. Topa in ama kiangah, “Nang teekin na kum tampi pha a, ahi zongin leitang lak ding tampi tak omlai hi.","title":"Lak Lai Ding Gam"},"2":{"text":"A omlai leitang: Filistia gam sung khempeuh, le Geshur gam khempeuh"},"3":{"text":"(Kanaan mite’ gam ci-a a kiciamteh, leilu lam Ekron gamgi lam, Egypt nisuahna lama om Shihor pan Filistia gam Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, le Ekron gamte a uk mi nga om hi), le Avvim gam,"},"4":{"text":"leitaw lamah, Kanaan mite leitang khempeuh, le Sidon mite gam ahi Mearah gam Amor mite gamgi ahi Afek ciang,"},"5":{"text":"le Gebal mite’ leitang, le Lebanon gam khempeuh, nisuahna lamah, Hermon Mual nuai-a Baalgad panin Hamath tumna ciang,"},"6":{"text":"Lebanon le Misrefothmaim kikalah a teng Sidon mite khempeuh ahi hi. Kei mahmah in Israel mite’ mai panin amaute ka hawlkhia ding a, nang kong thupiaksa bangin Israel mite tungah a luah dingun leitang hawm in.","ref":"Gam 33:54"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in minam kua le Manasseh minam alangte tungah luah dingin hih leitang hawm in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Reuben mite le Gad mite in Manasseh minam alang dang khatte tawh Topa’ nasem Moses in amaute a piaksa ahih manin nisuahna lam Jordan galkhatah gamh ngah khin uh hi.","title":"Manasseh, Reuben, le Gad a Kipia Gam","ref":"Gam 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"9":{"text":"Arnon kuam mong a om Aroer pan, le kuam laizang a om khuapi, le Dibon ciang dong Medeba mualzang khempeuh;"},"10":{"text":"le Ammon mite’ gamgi ciang dong Heshbon-ah a uk Amor kumpi Sihon’ khuapi khempeuh;"},"11":{"text":"Gilead, le Geshur mite le Maakath mite’ gam, le Hermon Mual khempeuh, le Salekah dong Bashan gam khempeuh;"},"12":{"text":"Ashtaroth le Edrei-ah a uk Bashan gam sunga Og kumpi gam khempeuh (Refaim-a a suak tate lakah amah bek om hi); Moses in hihte zo-in a hawlkhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel mite in Geshur mite ahi a, Maakath mite ahi zongin hawlkhia lo uh a, tuni dongin Geshur mite le Maakath mite Israel-te lakah a teng uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Levi minamte tung bekah Moses in gamh pia lo hi. Topa in Moses kiangah a gensa mah bangin Israel-te’ Topa Pasian’ tungah a kipia mei tawh kihal biaknate pen amau’ gamh ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:1"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Reuben minamte tungah amau’ beh tawh kizui-in gamh pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amau’ gamh pen Arnon kuam gei-a a om Aroer pan, le kuam laizang a om khuapi, le Medeba kianga mualzang khempeuh,"},"17":{"text":"Heshbon tawh, le mualzang tunga om a khuapite khempeuh; Dibon, Bamothbaal, Bethbaalmeon,"},"18":{"text":"Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mefaath,"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Sibmah, le tua kuam mualtung a om Zereth-shahar,"},"20":{"text":"Bethpeor, Pisgah pang suk, le Bethjeshimoth hi a,"},"21":{"text":"mualzang khuapite khempeuh, le Heshbon-ah a uk, Moses in Midian makaite Evi, Reke, Zur, Hur, le Reba, tua gam a teng Sihon’ uliante tawh a zawh khop ahi Amor kumpi gam khempeuh a huam ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Beor’ tapa, aisan pa Balaam zong, Israel mite in adang a thahte lakah namsau tawh thatkhawm uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Reuben mite’ gampi pen Jordan ahi hi. Hihte pen amau’ beh tawh kizui-in a khuapite le a khuaneute tawh Reuben mite’ gamhluah ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Gad minamte tungah zong amau’ beh tawh kizui-in gamh pia hi."},"25":{"text":"Amau’ gam pen Jazer, le Gilead khuapite khempeuh, le Rabbah nisuahna lamah a om Aroer ciang dong Ammon mite’ leitang kimkhat,"},"26":{"text":"le Heshbon panin Ramathmizpeh le Betonim ciang, le Mahanaim panin Debir gam ciang dong,"},"27":{"text":"le Bethharam kuam sungah Bethnimrah, Sukkoth, le Zafon, Jordan galkhat nisuahna lam, Khinnereth Tuipi a niamna lam mong ciang, Jordan gamgi-in a nei, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon’ kumpi gam a omlai teng ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hihte pen amau’ beh tawh kizui-in a khuapite le a khuaneute tawh Gad mite’ gamhluah ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Manasseh minam alangte tungah amau’ beh tawh kizui-in gamh a pia hi."},"30":{"text":"Amau’ gam pen Mahanaim pan kipanin Bashan gam sung khempeuh, Bashan kumpipa Og’ kumpi gam sung khempeuh, le Bashan gam sunga om Jair khuapi sawmgukte,"},"31":{"text":"le Gilead alang, Ashtaroth, le Edrei, Bashan gam a Og’ kumpi gam khempeuh ahi hi. Hihte amau’ innkuan tawh kizui-in Makhir mi alangte a dingin Manasseh’ tapa Makhir mite tungah kipia hi."},"32":{"text":"Hihte pen Jerikho nisuahna lam Jordan galkhat, Moab zanglei-ah Moses in a hawm gamhte ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahih hangin Levi minamte tungah Moses in gamh pia lo hi. Israel-te’ Topa Pasian in amaute kiangah a gensa mah bangin amah pen amau’ gamh ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 18:20; Thkna 18:2"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte pen, siampi Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua, le Israel minam sung pan beh lutangte in amaute tungah a piak, Kanaan gam sungah Israel mite’ ngah gamhte ahi hi.","title":"Aisanna tawh Kanaan gam Kihawm"},"2":{"text":"Minam kua le alangte a dingin Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin amau’ gamhte aisanna tawh kipia hi.","ref":"Gam 26:52-56; 34:13"},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in Jordan galkhatah minam nih le alangte tungah gamh pia khinzo hi. Ahih hangin amaute lakah Levi mite tungah bangmah pia lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Josef mite minam nihin kikhen a, Manasseh le Efraim minamte ahi uh hi. Tua gam sungah Levi-te tungah tanh kipia lo a, ahih hangin amau’ ten nading khuapite le a ganhingte uh a dingin lonona gamte kipia bek hi.","ref":"Gam 32:33; 34:14-15; Thkna 3:12-17"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin Israel mite gamta uh a, amaute in leitang a hawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah minamte Gilgal-a Joshua kiangah pai uh a, amaute sung panin Kenaz mi Jefunneh tapa Kaleb in ama kiangah, “ Topa in Kadeshbarnea-ah Pasian mi Moses tungah nang le kei’ thu tawh kisai a gente na thei hi.","title":"Kaleb tungah Hebron Kipia","ref":"Gam 14:30"},"7":{"text":"A gam sung thukansim dingin Topa’ nasem Moses in Kadeshbarnea panin kei hong sawl lai-in kum sawmli ka pha a, ka lungsim a om bangin ama kiangah thu ka tunkik hi.","ref":"Gam 13:1-30"},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei tawh hong paito khawm ka sanggamte in mite lungkiasak uh a, ahi zongin keimah in lungsim tak tawh Topa ka Pasian ka zui hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni-in Moses kiciamin, ‘Nangmah in Topa ka Pasian, lungsim tak tawh zui na hih manin na khe in a totsa leitang pen nang le na tate a dingin gamh hi tawntung ding hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"Gam 14:24"},"10":{"text":"Tu-in, a cihsa bangin Topa in, Israel mite sehnel gamah a pai sung, Topa in hih thu Moses tungah a gen a kipan hih kum sawmli le nga sung kei hong nungtasak a, tu-in kei kum sawmgiat le nga ka pha hi."},"11":{"text":"Moses in hong sawl hun lai mah bangin tuni-in kei ka tha hat lai a, galdo nading, le kuankhiatna le ciahkik nadingin ka thatang pen tua hun lai-a ka thatang mah bang lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in tua ni-a Topa’ gen hih mualtung gam kei hong pia in. Anak mite a muanhuai mahmah khuapi sungah a omna thu tua hun lai-in kong gen uh hi. Topa in kei hong ompih ding a, Topa’ cih mah bangin amaute ka hawlkhiazo kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in amah thupha pia a, Jefunneh’ tapa Kaleb tungah gamh-in Hebron a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in Topa , Israel-te’ Pasian, lungsimtak tawh zui ahih manin tuni dongin Hebron pen Kenaz mi Jefunneh’ tapa Kaleb’ gamh a suak hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih Hebron min a nidangin Kiriatharba kici hi; Arba pen Anak mite lakah mi lianpen khat ahi hi. Tua ciangin galdona panin tua gam a tawlnga hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amau’ beh tawh kizui-in Judah mite’ ngah pen leitaw lamah Edom gamgi ciang hi a, leitaw lam a gamla penna munah Zin gam ciang ban hi.","title":"Judah a Kipia Gam"},"2":{"text":"Leitaw lam a gamgi pen Ci Tuipi mong, leitaw lam a sun tuidawk pan kipan hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitaw lam Akrabbim kahtohna-ah paikhia-in, Zin dong ban a, Kadeshbarnea leitaw lamah Hezron dung tawnin Addar ciang dong paito-in Karka lamah kihei a,"},"4":{"text":"Azmon ciang dong pai-in Egypt lui-ah suakkhia a, tuipi-ah a mong bei hi. Hih pen amau’ leitaw lam gamgi hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin nisuahna lam gamgi pen Jordan tunna ciang dong Ci Tuipi ahi hi. Leilu lampang gamgi pen Jordan tunna tuipi dawk panin kipan hi."},"6":{"text":"Bethhoglah lamah a gamgi paito a, Betharabah leilu lampangah paisuak hi. Tua ciangin Reuben tapa Bohan’ Suangpi dongah a gamgi paito-in,"},"7":{"text":"Akhor Kuam panin Debir-ah paito a, leilu lam manawhin, tua kuam leitaw lampangah a om, Adummim kahtohna galkhatah a om Gilgal lamah kihei hi. Tua ciangin Enshemesh luidung ah gamgi pai-in Enrogel-ah tawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jebus (Jerusalem a cihna) liangko leitaw lam Hinnom’ tapa’ kuamah gamgi paito-in, Refaim kuam leilu lam mong, nitumna lam Hinnom Kuam galkhatah a kikhung mual dawnah gamgi paito hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin mual dawn panin Neftoah lui-ah gamgi kikhung a, tua panin Efron Mual khuapite-ah pai a, tua ciangin Baalah (Kiriathjearim a cihna) lamah gamgi kawi kual hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Baalah nitumna lam Seir Mual-ah gamgi kual a, tua panin paisuakin Jearim Mual (Khesalon a cihna) liangko leilu lamah pai-in, Bethshemesh-ah paisuk a, Timnah kiangah paisuak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ekron leilu lam mual liangko-ah a gamgi paikhia a, tua ciangin Shikkeron-ah gamgi kawi kualin, Baalah Mual-ah paisuak a, Jabneel-ah lengkhia-in tuipi-ah a gamgi tawp hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin nitumna gamgi pen Tuipi Lian dungteng ahi hi. Hih pen amau’ beh tawh kizui-in Judah mite’ kiimah a gamgi ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Joshua tungah a thupiak bangin Jefunneh tapa Kaleb tungah amah in Judah mite lakah tanh khat Kiriatharba, Hebron a cihna, (Arba pen Anak’ pa hi) pia hi.","title":"Kaleb in Hebron le Debir Zo (Thu 1:11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Tua lai panin Kaleb in Anak’ tapa thumte Sheshai, Ahiman, le Talmai, Anak’ suanlekhakte a hawlkhia hi.","ref":"Thkna 1:20"},"15":{"text":"Tua lai panin Debir sunga a teng mite a sim dingin amah kuanto hi. Debir pen a nidangin Kiriathsefer kici hi."},"16":{"text":"Kaleb in, “Kiriathsefer vatgawpin a lazo mi tungah ka tanu Aksah a zi dingin ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kaleb’ sanggampa Kenaz’ tapa Othniel inla a, amah in a zi dingin a tanu Aksah a pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua nu ama kiangah a pai ding ciangin ama pa’ tung panin lo khat a nget ding hah gen hi. A la tung panin tua nu a kum ciangin Kaleb in tua nu kiangah, “Bang ut na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in, “Letsong khat hong pia in. Negeb gamah kei hong koih na hih buangin cik tuikhukte zong hong pia in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Kaleb in tua nu tungah ciktui tungnungte le ciktui nuainungte a pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Hihte pen amau’ beh tawh kizui-in Judah minamte’ gamhluah ahi hi.","title":"Judah Khuapite"},"21":{"text":"Leitaw lam mongciik, Edom gamgi lamah Judah minamte’ neih khuapite: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kadesh, Hazor, Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Zif, Telem, Bealoth,"},"25":{"text":"Hazorhadattah, Keriothhezron (Hazor a cihna),"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema, Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazargaddah, Heshmon, Bethpelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazarshual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, Iim, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Khesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, le Rimmon: a vekpi-in khuapi sawmnih le kua, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin lei niamna lamah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, Engannim, Tappuah, Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, le Gederothaim: khuapi sawm le li, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua banah Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilean, Mizpeh, Joktheel,"},"39":{"text":"Lakhish, Bozkath, Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"Kabbon, Lahmam, Khitlish,"},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Bethdagon, Naamah, le Makkedah: khuapi sawm le guk, a khuaneute tawh zong ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Iftah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Akzib, le Mareshah: khuapi kua, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ekron a khuapite le a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Ekron panin tuipi dong, Ashdod lampang a omte khempeuh a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Ashdod, a khuapite le a khuaneute tawh ahi hi. Gaza, a khuapite le a khuaneute tawh ahi hi. Egypt lui le tuipi lian a gei ciang dong tawh ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin mualtung gamah Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,"},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kiriathsannah (Debir a cihna),"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,"},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon, le Giloh: khuapi sawm le khat, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Arab, Dumah, Eshan,"},"53":{"text":"Janim, Bethtappuah, Afekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Kiriatharba (Hebron a cihna), le Zior: khuapi kua, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"55":{"text":"Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah, le Timnah: khuapi sawm, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"58":{"text":"Halhul, Bethzur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Maarath, Bethanoth, le Eltekon: khuapi guk, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"60":{"text":"Kiriathbaal (Kiriathjearim a cihna), le Rabbah: khuapi nih, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"61":{"text":"Sehnel gamah Betharabah, Middin, Sekakah,"},"62":{"text":"Nibshan, Ci Khuapi, le Engedi: khuapi guk, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"63":{"text":"Ahih hangin Judah mite in Jerusalem-a a teng Jebus mite hawlkhia zo lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Jebus mite pen Judah mite tawh Jerusalem-ah a tengkhawm uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 1:21; 2Sam 5:6; 1Khang 11:4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef’ suanlekhakte’ tanh gamgi pen Jerikho luite’ nisuahna lam, Jerikho kiang Jordan panin sehnel gamah pai a, Jerikho panin mualtung gamte tawnin Bethel-ah paito hi.","title":"Efraim le Manasseh a Kipia Gam"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Bethel panin Luz-ah pai-in, Arkhi mite gam Ataroth nawk hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin nitumna lam Jaflet mite’ gam lam Bethhoron a niam lam gam ciang dongah paisuk hi. Tua ciangin Gezer-ah pai-in tuipi-ah tawp hi."},"4":{"text":"Josef’ suan Manasseh, le Efraim mite in amau’ gamhluah dingin hih gamte ngah uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amau’ behbehin Efraim mite’ gam pen a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Nisuahna lamah amau’ gamgi pen Atarothaddar pan Bethhoron tungnung ciang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua panin tuipi ciangah a gamgi pai a, leilu lamah Mikmethath ahi hi. Tua ciangin nisuahna lam a gamgi Taanathshiloh lamah kual pai-in, nisuahna lam galah pai-in Janoah a tung hi."},"7":{"text":"Janoah panin Ataroth le Naarah ah paisuk a, Jerikho banin Jordan-ah tawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah panin nitumna lam Kanah lui-ah gamgi pai-in tuipi-ah tawp hi. Hih pen amau’ behbehin Efraim minamte’ gamhluah hi a,"},"9":{"text":"Manasseh mite’ gamhluah sung panin Efraim mite a dingin a kikhenkhia khuapite, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in Gezer sunga teng Kanaan mite hawlkhia lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Kanaan mite pen Efraim mite lakah teng a, ahih hangin aana nasep a sem dingin sal a suak uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 1:29"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef’ tacil ahih manin Manasseh minam tungah tanh kipia hi. Manasseh minam sung panin tacil, Gilead’ pa Makhir tungah Gilead gam le Bashan gam kipia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah galhang mi ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manasseh minam a omlaite Abiezer, Halek, Asriel, Shekhem, Hefer, le Shemida-te tungah a behbehin piakna kinei hi. Hihte pen Josef’ tapa Manasseh’ ta pasal suanlekhakte a behbeh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Manasseh’ tapa Makhir, a tapa Hefer, a tapa Zelofehad in tapa nei loin tanu bek nei a, a tanute’ min in: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute, siampi Eleazar le Nun tapa Joshua le makaite mai-ah pai uh a, “Ka sanggamte uh tawh gamh hong piak nadingin Topa in Moses thu pia hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ thupiakna bangin amau pate’ sanggamte tawh amah in gamh a pia khawm hi.","ref":"Gam 27:1-7"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jordan galkhatah Gilead le Bashan-te simloh Manasseh tungah tanh sawm kia hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Manasseh’ tanute in a tapate tawh gamh ngahkhawm uh hi. A omlai Manasseh mite tungah Gilead leitang kipia hi."},"7":{"text":"Manasseh-te’ gam in Asher panin Shekhem nisuahna lamah a om Mikmethath dong ban a, tua ciangin Entappuah mite’ leitaw lamah a gamgi pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah leitang pen Manasseh a’ ahi hi. Ahih hangin Manasseh gamgi a om Tappuah khuapi pen Efraim tapate a’ ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kanah lui-ah a gamgi paisuk hi. Manasseh khuapite lak panin lui leitaw lama om hih lai-a khuapite pen Efraim a’ ahi hi. Tua ciangin lui leilu lampangah Manasseh gamgi paisuakin tuipi-ah tawp hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua gam leitaw lamteng Efraim a’ hi-in, a leilu lamteng Manasseh a’ hi a, tuipi pen a gamgi hi a, leilu lamah Asher banin nisuahna lamah Issakhar a ban hi."},"11":{"text":"Issakhar le Asher gam sungah zong Manasseh in gam ngah a, tuate pen Bethshean le a khuaneute, Ibleam le a khuaneute, Dor-a tengte le a khuaneute, Endor a tengte le a khuaneute, Taanak a tengte le a khuaneute, le Megiddo a tengte le a khuaneute hi a, a thumna pen Nafath ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin Manasseh’ tapate in hih khuapite luah zo lo uh ahih manin tua gamah Kanaan mite teng teitei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin Israel mite tampi pha-in a hat uh ciangin amaute in Kanaan mite nasemin koih uh a, hawlkhiamang khin lo uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 1:27-28"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josef minam in Joshua kiangah thu genin, “ Topa in kote thu hong pia khin a, kote mi tampi hi napi-in bang hangin ngah khat le tanh khat bek gamh-in hong pia na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in amaute kiangah, “Note mi tampi pha a, Efraim mualtung gam pen note a dingin neulua ahih ciangin Perez le Refaim gam tulakah pai unla, nomau a dingin gam sattawm un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Josef minam in, “Kote a dingin mualtung gam kicing zo lo hi. Ahi zongin zang gam a teng Kanaan mite khempeuh, Bethshean le a khuaneute, Jezreel Kuam sunga om mite pen sik leeng neite hi zel uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in Josef’ suan Efraim le Manasseh mite tungah, “Note mi tampi pha-in vanglian na hih manun tanh khat kia na nei kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Mualtung gam pen note a’ hi ding a, tulak ahih hangin note in hah siangin a gamgi mong dong na luah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in sik leeng nei-in, amaute a thahat hangin Kanaan mite na hawlkhiazo ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mihon buppi Shiloh-ah kikhawmin tua lai-ah kikhopna buk lam uh a, amaute’ mai-ah gam zawhsa-in om hi.","title":"Shiloh-ah Leitang Hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite lakah gamh a kipia nai lo minam sagih omlai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Joshua in Israel mite kiangah, “ Topa , na pu na pate uh Pasian in note hong piaksa leitangah pai-in na luah ding uh bang tanvei zekai lai ding na hi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Minam khat panin mi thum ciat hong pia unla, amaute va kuan khia-in vaksuk vakto-in, amaute’ luah dinga ngaihsutna tawh a leitang omziate hong gelhin, tua ciangin kei kiangah hong ciah dingun amaute ka sawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in seh sagihin khenin, leitaw lam ama gam mahah Judah omsuakin, Josef’ innkuante leilu lam amau’ gamah om ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Note in leitang khen sagihin hong ciamteh unla, na ciaptehna uh hih mun kei kiangah nong paipih ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah in Topa i Pasian’ mai-ah note a’ ding ai ka san ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Levi mite in note lakah tanh nei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ siampi nasepna pen amau’ luah ahi hi. Gad, Reuben, le Manasseh minam alangte in Topa’ nasem Moses in amaute tungah a piak ahi Jordan Nisuahna lam galkhatah amau’ gamh ngah khinzo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mite a kuan uh hi. Leitang a ciaptehna a gelhna dingun Joshua in a pai mite thu pia a, “Vaksuk vakto-in leitang ciaptehna hong gelh unla, kei kiangah hong paikik un. Tua ciangin Shiloh mun Topa’ mai-ah note a dingin ai ka san ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin mite kuanin gam sungah paisuk paito-in khen sagih suahin tua gam a khuakhua-in a ciaptehna uh laibu khat sungah khum uh a, Shiloh giahphual a Joshua kiangah amaute hong pai uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Joshua in amaute a dingin Topa’ mai Shiloh-ah ai sansak hi. Tua ciangin Joshua in amau’ tanh ding ciat Israel-te tungah leitang a pia hi."},"11":{"text":"A behbeh tawh kizui-in Benjamin minamte a’ ding aisan hun hong tung a, amau’ tungah a kipia gam pen Judah minam le Josef minamte kikalah hong kia hi.","title":"Benjamin a Kipia Gam"},"12":{"text":"Leilu lamah amau’ gamgi pen Jordan panin kipan a, Jerikho leilu lam liangko-ah paito-in, tua panin mualtung gam nawkin nitumna lamah pai a, Bethaven sehnel gamah a tawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua lai panin gamgi in Luz lam manawhin leitaw lam nawtin Luz (Bethel a kici) liangko-ah pai a, Bethhoron Nuainung leitaw lama om mualtung a Atarothaddar khua-ah paisuk hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin mun dang manawhin gamgi pai a, Bethhoron galkhat, leitaw lama om mual panin nitumna lampang leitaw lamah kihei a, Judah minamte a’ ahi Kiriathbaal (Kiriathjearim a cihna)-ah a tawp hi. Hih in a nitumna lampang piangsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kiriathjearim mong panin leitaw lampang kipan a, Efron lam, Neftoah Luite-ah gamgi pai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Refaim kuam leilu lam mong a om, Hinnom’ tapa’ kuam a kimuhna mual a gamgi-ah pai hi. Tua ciangin Jebus mite’ gam liangko leitaw lam, Hinnom Kuam-ah paisukin, Enrogel-ah paisuk suak hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin leilu lam manawhin kawi-in, Enshemesh-ah paisuak a, tua lai panin Adummim kahtohna galkhat, Geliloth-ah pai a, Reuben’ tapa Bohan’ Suangpi-ah paisuk hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Betharabah gam liangko leilu lamah paisuakin Arabah-ah paisuk hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Bethhoglah gam liangko leilu lamah gamgi paisuak a, Jordan mong leitaw lam, Ci Tuipi dawk leilu lamah a tawp hi. Hih pen leitaw lam gamgi hi a,"},"20":{"text":"Jordan in nisuahna lampang a gamgi piangsak hi. Hih pen a beh zui-in a kimkotah a gamgi a gamgi-in Benjamin minam’ luah ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in amau’ beh tawh kizui-in Benjamin minamte’ khuapite in Jerikho, Bethhoglah, Emekkeziz,"},"22":{"text":"Betharabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"Avvim, Parah, Ofrah,"},"24":{"text":"Khefarammoni, Ofni, Geba - khuapi sawm le nih, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"Mizpeh, Khefirah, Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"Zela, Haelef, Jebus (Jerusalem a cihna), Gibeah, le Kiriathjearim - khuapi sawm le li, a khuaneute tawh zong ahi hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Benjamin minamte’ luah ahi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A beh zui-in Simeon minam a’ ding aisan nihna hong tung hi. Amau’ gamh in Judah minamte’ gamh ngahsa pawkhat huam hi.","title":"Simeon a Kipia Gam"},"2":{"text":"Amau’ ngah ding gamhte pen Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,"},"3":{"text":"Hazarshual, Bala, Ezem,"},"4":{"text":"Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,"},"5":{"text":"Ziklag, Bethmarkaboth, Hazarsusah,"},"6":{"text":"Bethlebaoth, le Sharuhen - khuapi sawm le thum, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ain, Rimmon, Ether, le Ashan - khuapi li a khuaneute tawh zong ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Negeb gam Ramah-a om Baalathbeer ciang dong hih khuapite’ kiima om khuaneute khempeuh zong a huam ahi hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Simeon minamte’ luah ahi hi.","ref":"1Khang 4:28-33"},"9":{"text":"Simeon minamte’ luah in Judah minamte’ gam sung khenkhat hong huam hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Judah minamte’ ngah pen amau a dingin lianlua a, amau’ luah sung panin Simeon minam in gamh ngahsawn uh hi."},"10":{"text":"A beh tawh kizui-in Zebulun minam a dingin aisan thumna hong tung hi. Ahih hangin amah bu ahih manin Jerubbaal’ tapa neupen Jotham a suakta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shekhem khuamite khempeuh le Bethmillo khuamite khempeuh hong paikhawm uh a, amaute in Shekhem khua-a tawsaw songpi kiangah Abimelek kumpi a suaksak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Jotham kiangah tua thu a kigen ciangin amah pai-in Gerizim Mual dawnah ding a, nakpi-in kiko-in amaute kiangah, “No Shekhem mite aw, Pasian in note’ thu hong ngaih theih nadingin ka thu hong ngai un."},"8":{"text":"Khatvei, singkungte amau’ tungah kumpi-in sathau a nilh dingin kuankhia uh a, amaute in oliv kung kiangah, ‘Kote hong uk in,’ a ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin oliv kung in amaute kiangah, ‘Keimah in pasian-te le mite a kipahtawina ahi ka thaunate nusia-in singkungte a uk dingin hong pai ding ka hi hiam?’ ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkungte in theikung kiangah, ‘Hong pai inla, kote hong uk in,’ ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin theikung in amaute kiangah, ‘Keimah in ka khumna le ka gah hoihte nusia-in singkungte a uk dingin hong pai ding ka hi hiam?’ ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkungte in leenggui kiangah, ‘Hong pai inla, kote hong uk in,’ ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin leenggui in amaute kiangah, ‘Keimah in pasian-te le mite a lungnuamsak ka leenggahzu nusia-in singkungte a uk dingin hong pai ding ka hi hiam?’ ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkung khempeuh in thangling kung kiangah, ‘Hong pai inla, kote hong uk in,’ ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Thangling kung in singkungte kiangah, ‘Note tungah kumpi-in lungsim tak tawh sathau hong nilh na hih uhleh, hong pai unla, ka liimah hong bu un. Ahi zongin ka liim nuai-ah nong buk kei uhleh, thangling kung lak panin meikuang hong paikhia hen la, Lebanon taamtak kungte kangtum hen,’ ci hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Abimelek kumpi-in na bawl uh ciangin lungsimtak le thumantak mah tawh a gamta na hi uh hiam? Jerubbaal le a innkuan tungah thuman takin gamta-in ama sepna tawh a kituakin amah a bawl mah na hi uh hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa in note a’ ding hong dosakin a lauhuaina sungah a nuntakna pia a, Midian-te’ khutsung panin note hong honkhia hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuni-in ka pa’ innkuan langkhatah note pangin a tapate mi sawmsagih suang khat tungah na that uh a, ka pa in a nasem numei tawh a neih a tapa Abimelek pen note’ naihuai ahihna hangin Shekhem khuamite tungah kumpi-in na bawl uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Note in tuni-in Jerubbaal le a innkuanpihte tungah lungsimtak le thumantak tawh a gamta takpi mah na hih uhleh, Abimelek tungah note lungdam unla, note tungah zong amah lungdam tahen."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua bang ahih takpi kei leh, Abimelek sung panin meikuang hong paikhia hen la, Shekhem le Bethmillo khuamite kangtum hen. Shekhem khuamite sung pan le Bethmillo khuamite sung panin meikuang hong pai hen la, Abimelek kangtum hen,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sanggampa Abimelek a kihtakna hangin Jotham taikhia-in Beer-ah pai-in tua lai-ah a teng hi."},"22":{"text":"Abimelek in Israel-te tungah kum thum sung uk hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian in Abimelek le Shekhem mite kikalah kigalneihna omsak a, Shekhem mite in Abimelek lehdo uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua pen, Jerubbaal tapa sawmsagihte a kithahna thu tawh kisai-in, amaute a that a sanggampa uh Abimelek, le a sanggamte thah nadingin a hanthawn Shekhem mite tungah thukkikna hong tuntheih nadingin a kibawl mahmah ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua hi a, Shekhem mite in Abimelek a pangsim dingin mual dawnah mi koih uh a, amaute in tua lam a tawn mi khempeuhte’ na na sut uh hi; hih thu Abimelek kiangah kigen hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ebed’ tapa Gaal a tanaute tawh Shekhem-ah hong kikhin uh hi. Shekhem mite in amah muang uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute lo-ah kuanin a leenggui uh panin leenggah khawmin cil uh a, pawi khamin amaute’ pasian’ inn-ah pai uh a, an ne tui dawnin omin Abimelek zahko uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ebed’ tapa Gaal in, “Abimelek, kua hi a, ama na i sepsak dingin ei Shekhem mite kua ihi hiam? Jerubbaal’ tapa le ama ulian Zebul in Shekhem mite’ pulepa Hamor’ na sem uh hi lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ama na sem ding ihi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Hih mite keima khutnuai hileh! Abimelek ka khinkhia ding hi. Abimelek kiangah, ‘Na galkap behlap inla hong kuankhia in,’ ka ci ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua khuapi a uk Zebul in Ebed tapa Gaal’ kammalte a zak ciangin heh mahmah hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in Arumah khua-a om Abimelek kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “En in, Ebed tapa Gaal le a tanaute Shekhem-ah hong pai-in nang langpangin tua khuapi sosuah hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na ompih mite tawh zanin pai unla, gamlakah pangsim un."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin zingsang ni a suah phetin tho baih unla, khuapi simgawp un. A ompih mite tawh nang a do dingin hong kuankhiat ciangun ahi thei bangin amaute tungah na bawl ding uh hi,” cisak hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Abimelek le amah tawh a om mite khempeuh zanin tho-in pawl li kisuahin Shekhem a sim dingin pangsim uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ebed tapa Gaal paikhia-in khuapi kulhkongpi lutna-ah ding a, Abimelek le amah tawh a om mite zong a pansimna panun dingto uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Gaal in tua mite a muh ciangin amah in Zebul kiangah, “En in, mual dawn panin mite hong paisuk!” a ci hi. Zebul in ama kiangah, “Mual liimte mi bangin a mu na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Gaal pau kikin, “En in, a gam laizang panin mite hong paisuk a, Aisante’ Tawsaw lam panin pawlkhat hong pai hi,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zebul in ama kiangah, “Tu-in na kamhanna koi-ah om ahi hiam? ‘Ama na i sep dingin Abimelek kua ahi hiam?’ a ci pa hi lo na hi hiam? Hih mite, na simmawhte hi lo ahi hiam? Tu-in paikhia inla amaute tawh kido in,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shekhem mite’ mai-ah Gaal kuankhia-in Abimelek tawh kido hi."},"40":{"text":"Abimelek in Gaal delh a, ama mai-ah Gaal a tai hi. Kulhkongpi lutna ciang dong nangawnah mi tampi liamin tuk hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciangin Arumah ah Abimelek a teng hi. Zebul in Gaal le a tanaute hawlkhia a, amaute Shekhem-ah teng thei nawn lo uh hi."},"42":{"text":"A zing ciangin gamlakah Shekhem mite paikhia uh hi. Hih thu Abimelek kiangah kigen hi."},"43":{"text":"Amah in a mite la-in pawl thum suahin gamlakah pangsim uh hi. Tua ciangin amah khuadakin khuapi panin mite a kuankhia mu a, amaute do-in kipan a, amaute that hi."},"44":{"text":"Abimelek le amah tawh a om a pawlte in thakhatin mainawt uh a, ama pawldang nihte in gamlak a om mite delhin a thah sungin khuapikulh lutna-ah amaute na ding uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Abimelek in sun tawntung tua khuapi sim a, tua khuapi la-in a sunga om mite that a, tua khuapi phiatin ci a vawh hi."},"46":{"text":"Shekhem Tausang mite khempeuh in tua thu a zak uh ciangin Elberith’ inn munmuanhuai-ah lut uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Shekhem Tausang mite khempeuh kikaikhawm uh hi, ci-in Abimelek kiangah kigen hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah tawh a om mi khempeuh tawh Zalmon Mual-ah Abimelek kuanto hi. Abimelek in a khutin hei khat la-in selkeu lom khat sat a, tuate la to-in a liangko tungah koih hi. Tua ciangin amah tawh a om mite kiangah, “Kei’ hih nong muhsa bangun kei’ hih bangbangin manlangin hih un,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh in amau a’ ding ciat selkeu tomin Abimelek zui-in munmuanhuai sim nadingin koih uh a, amaute in mei tawh munmuanhuai halin Shekhem Tausang mite, numei le pasal mi tulkhat bang a si hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciangin Thebez-ah Abimelek pai a, Thebez langpangin giahphual sat a, tua khua a la hi."},"51":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua khuapi sungah tausang muanhuai om a, tua khua numei le pasal, tua khuami khempeuh tua tausangah tai-in kikhaknelh uh a, tausang khumah amaute om uh hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua ciangin Abimelek zong tausangah pai-in sim a, mei tawh a hal dingin tausang kongkhak a naih hi."},"53":{"text":"Numei khat in an gawina suangpek tungnung, Abimelek’ lu tungah lawnin a lu guh dengkham hi.","ref":"2Sam 11:21"},"54":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in ama hiam a tawisak tangvalpa nawh sapin ama kiangah, “Na namsau dok inla kei hong that in. Tua hikeileh mite in, ‘Numei khat in amah that hi,’ hong ci kha ding uh hi,” a ci hi. A tangvalpa in amah sunletin amah a si ta hi."},"55":{"text":"Israel mite in Abimelek a sihna a muh uh ciangin amau’ inn ciatah a ciah uh hi."},"56":{"text":"Ama sanggam sawmsagihte thatin a pa tungah a khialhna hangin tua bangin Pasian in Abimelek’ khialhna a thuk ahi hi."},"57":{"text":"Pasian in Shekhem mite khempeuh’ gitlohna hangin Jerubbaal’ tapa Jotham’ samsiatna bangin amau’ tungah gimna a tungsak hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abimelek khit ciangin Israel-te a honkhia dingin Issakhar minam Dodo’ tapa Puah, Puah’ tapa Tola hong khang a, Efraim mualtung gam Shamir-ah a teng hi.","title":"Tola le Jair in Israel Thu Khen"},"2":{"text":"Amah in Israel-te kum sawmnih le kum thum sung thu khen hi. Tua ciangin amah si a, Shamir-ah kivui hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama khit ciangin Israel-te kum sawmnih le kum nih sung thu a khen Gilead mi Jair hong khang hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in la sawmthum tungah a tuang tapa sawmthum a nei hi. Amaute in Gilead gam sunga om tu dongin Havvothjair a kici khuapi sawmthum nei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jair si-in Kamon-ah kivui hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ muhna-ah Israel mite a sia gamta kik uh a, Syria mite’ pasian-te, Sidon mite’ pasian-te, Moab mite’ pasian-te, Ammon mite’ pasian-te, Filistia mite’ pasian-te le Baal-te, le Ashtaroth bia uh a, amaute in Topa nusia-in ama na sem lo uh hi.","title":"Ammon Mite in Israel Nengniam"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te tungah Topa sinso a, amah in Filistia mite tung le Ammon mite tungah amaute pia a,"},"8":{"text":"amaute in Israel mite tua kum sugawpin nengniam uh hi. Amaute in Jordan galkhat Gilead gam sunga om Amor mite’ leitangah a om Israel mite khempeuh kum sawm le kum giat sung nengniam uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Judah, Benjamin, le Efraim minamte a sim dingin Ammon mite Jordan hong galkah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te nakpitakin lungkham uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa tungah Israel-te kiko uh a, “Nang tungah kong khial khin uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kote in ka Pasian uh nusia-in Baal-te ka bia uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite kiangah, “Egypt-te le Amor mite, Ammon mite le Filistia mite kiang panin hong honkhia hi lo ka hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Sidon mite, Amalek mite, le Maon mite in note hong nengniam uh hi. Kei tungah note nong kiko uh a, keimah in amaute’ khutsung panin note kong honkhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hinapi-in note in kei hong nusia-in pasian dangte na bia uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin note kong honkhia nawn kei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pai unla note’ teel pasian-te tungah ko un. Na lungkham hunun amaute kihonkhia sak un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel mite in Topa tungah, “Ka khial khin uh hi. Hoih na sak bangin ko tungah hong hih in. Tuni-in hong honkhia in, kong thum uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in amau’ lak panin gamdang pasian-te koih khia-in Topa a bia uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te’ gentheihna ah amah a dah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ammon mite galhiam tawi dingin kisam uh a, Gilead-ah giahphual sat uh hi. Israel mite zong kikaikhawmin Gilead gam sung Mizpah-ah giahphual sat uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mihonte le makaite khatlekhat in, “Ammon mite do dinga a kipan ngam kua om ihi hiam? A kipan ngam mipa, Gilead gam a teng mite khempeuh tungah lutang hi ding hi,” a kici uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Gilead khuami Jefthah, a thahat galhang khat hi a, ahih hangin amah pen zawlta ahi hi. Jefthah’ pa Gilead hi a,","title":"Jefthah in Ammon mite panin Israel Honkhia"},"2":{"text":"Gilead’ zi in zong amah tawh tapa dang nei hi. A tapate a khan ciangun amaute in Jefthah notkhia-in ama kiangah, “Ka pa uh inn sungah gamh na luah kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen numei dang tawh zawlta na hi lel hi,” a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sanggamte kiang panin Jefthah tai-in Tob gam sungah teng a, bangmah a man lo mite in Jefthah pawmin amah tawh mite sugawpin pai kawikawi uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tawlkhat khit ciangin Ammon mite in Israel-te sim uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ammon mite in Israel-te a sim ciangin Tob gam panin Jefthah a la dingin Gilead upate va pai uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in Jefthah kiangah, “Ammon mite i do theih nadingin hong pai inla kote’ makai hong hi in,” va ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin Jefthah in Gilead upate kiangah, “Note in kei hong mudahin ka pa’ inn pan hong hawlkhia hi lo na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin thuhaksa na tuah uh ciangin kei kiangah hong pai na hi uh hiam?” na ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Gilead upate in Jefthah kiangah, “Kote tawh nang hong pai-in Ammon mite do-in Gilead gam sunga teng mi khempeuh tungah lutang nong hih theih nadingin nang’ lamah hong kihei ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Jefthah in Gilead upate kiangah, “Note in Ammon mite a do dingin inn-ah kei nong ciahpih uh a, kei tungah Topa in amaute hong piak leh kei pen note’ lutang ka hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Gilead upate in Jefthah kiangah, “ Topa pen eite’ kikalah teci hi ding hi. Na cih bangin ka gamta ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Gilead upate tawh Jefthah pai a, mite in amau’ tungah lutang le makai-in amah koih uh hi. Jefthah in hih thute khempeuh Mizpah khuasung Topa’ mai-ah a gen ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jefthah in Ammon mite’ kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “Ka gam a sim dingin kei kiangah nong pai nadingin kei’ tungah bang thu om ahi hiam?” cisak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ammon mite’ kumpipa in Jefthah’ kamtaite dawng a, “Egypt panin Israel-te hong pai lai-in Arnon panin Jabbok le Jordan ciang ka gam hong laksak hang ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in thudamin hong piakik in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Jefthah in Ammon mite’ kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawlkikin"},"15":{"text":"ama kiangah, “Jefthah in hih bangin ci hi: Israel-te in Moab leitang hitaleh Ammon mite’ leitang hitaleh la lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Egypt panin Israel-te hong paitoh lai-in gamlak tawnin San Tuipi-ah hong pai-in Kadesh hong tung uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel-te in Edom kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawl a, ‘Kong thum uh hi; na gam sung hong nawksak in,’ cisak uh hi. Ahih hangin Edom kumpipa in a thu ngai lo hi. Tua ciangin Moab kumpipa kiangah zong sawl uh a, ahih hangin amah thukim lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Kadesh-ah Israel-te om phot uh hi.","ref":"Gam 20:14-21"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin sehnel gam tawnin amaute khualzin uh a, Edom gam le Moab gam kimkotin pai-in Moab gam nisuahna lampangah tung uh a, Arnon gun galkhatah phual sat uh hi. Ahih hangin Moab gam sungah amaute lut lo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Arnon gun pen Moab gamgi ahi hi.","ref":"Gam 21:4"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te in Heshbon khua-ah a om Amor mite’ kumpi Sihon kiangah kamtaite sawl uh hi. Israel-te in ama kiangah, ‘Kong thum uh hi; ka gam uh a zuan dingin na gam hong nawksak in,’ ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin Sihon in ama gam a nawk dingin Israel-te muang lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Sihon in a mite khempeuh kaikhawmin Jahaz-ah giahphual sat a, Israel-te na sim hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa, Israel-te’ Pasian in Sihon le a mite khempeuh Israel-te’ khut sungah pia a, amaute in zo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua gam sunga teng Amor mite’ leitang khempeuh Israel-te in luah uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute in Arnon gun panin Jabbok lui ciang leh sehnel gam panin Jordan gun ciang, Amor mite’ gam khempeuh a luah uh hi.","ref":"Gam 21:21-24"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa, Israel-te’ Pasian in ama mi Israel-te’ mai panin Amor mite paaikhia hi. Tu-in nangmah in luahkik ding sawm na hi hiam?"},"24":{"text":"Na pasian Khemosh in na neih dinga hong piakte kem peuh in. Kote ahihleh Topa ka Pasian un kote’ mai-ah a suankhiatte ka tang ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in nang pen Moab kumpipa, Zippor’ tapa Balak sangin ginazaw na hi hiam? Amah in Israel-te to ngei a, amaute do ngei ahi hiam?","ref":"Gam 22:1-6"},"26":{"text":"Heshbon le a khuaneute, Aroer le a khuaneute, le Arnon gun panga om khuapite khempeuh sungah Israel-te a ten kum zathum hun sung tengin bang hangin lakik lo na hi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin nang tungah ka khial kei a, kei nong simna-ah kei tungah nang nong khial hi. Topa, Thukhen pa in Israel mite le Ammon mite kikalah tuni-in thu khen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin Ammon kumpipa in ama kiangah thu a puak Jefthah’ thu a don kei hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jefthah’ tungah Topa’ kha hong tung a, amah in Gilead le Manasseh nawkin Gilead gam Mizpah-ah paisuak a, Gilead gam Mizpah panin Ammon mite kiangah paisuak lai hi."},"30":{"text":"Jefthah in Topa tungah thuciamna bawlin, “Ka khut sungah Ammon mite nong piak leh"},"31":{"text":"Ammon mite kiang panin gualzo-in ka ciah ciangin keimah a dawn dingin ka innsung pan a hong pai peuhpeuh Topa a’ hi ding a, meihal biak nadingin kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute a sim dingin Ammon mite kiangah Jefthah galkah a, Topa in ama khut sungah amaute a pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah in Aroer panin Minnith kiimnai ciang dong khuapi sawmnih, le Abelkeramim ciang dong mi tampi tak thatin a vatgawp hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite mai-ah Ammon mite guallel uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mizpah-a ama inn-ah Jefthah hong ciah hi. Amah a dawn dingin a tanu khuangneute tawh a laamsa-in hong paikhia hi. Tua nu pen ama ta khat neihsun hi a, amah simloh tapa ahi a, tanu ahi zongin adang nei lo hi.","title":"Jefthah’ Tanu"},"35":{"text":"Amah in a tanu a muh ciangin a puan balkekin, “Ala, ka tanu! Kei nong niamkoih mahmah hi. Kei a dingin lungkhamna lianpi nong suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa tungah thu ka ciam khin a, ka thuciamna ka dokkik thei kei hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 30:2"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin a tanu in ama kiangah, “Ka pa aw, Topa tungah thu ciam khin na hih leh, na thuciamna tawh kizui-in kei’ tungah hong bawl in. Tu-in Topa in na gal Ammon mite tungah nang a’ ding hong thuksak khin hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a pa kiangah, “Kong ngetnop thu khat om hi. Kei pai-in mualtungah vak kawikawi-in kei le ka lawmte in nungak-in ka sih nading hangin ka thum theih nadingun kha nih sung kei guak hong omsak in,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Amah in, “Pai ta in,” a ci hi. Amah in kha nih sung a tanu paikhia sak hi. Tua ciangin amah le a lawmte paikhia-in nungakin a sih nading hangin mualte tungah kapin a thum uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Kha nih a cin ciangin a pa kiangah amah ciahkik a, amah in ama bawlsa a thuciamna bangin a tanu tungah hih hi. Tua nu pen pasal tawh a lumkhawm nai lo, nungakin khansih hi. Tua ciangin Israel-te sungah ngeina khat suak a,"},"40":{"text":"Israel numeite kum khatin ni li sung kum simin Gilead mi Jefthah’ tanu hangin a thum dingin paikhia uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim mite galhiam tawi dingin kisam uh a, amaute Zafon gun kantanin galkah uh a, Jefthah kiangah, “Bang hangin Ammon mite a sim dingin galkahin, nang tawh a kuankhawm dingin kote hong zawn lo na hi hiam? Na inn tawh nang kong halnelh ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.","title":"Jefthah le Efraim Mite"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jefthah in amaute kiangah, “Kei le ka mite in Ammon mite tawh buaina lianpi khat ka nei ngei uh hi. Note kong sap hangin amau’ khutsung panin kei nong honkhia kei uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Note in kei nong hotkhiat loh ding uh ka theih ciangin kei mahmah hanciam tawmin Ammon mite a sim dingin ka galkah a, Topa in kei’ khut sungah amaute hong pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin tuni-in kei a hong sim dingin hong kuan na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jefthah in Gilead mite khempeuh khawmin Efraim mite tawh kido uh hi. Gilead mite in Efraim mite vatgawp uh hi. (Efraim mite in, “No Gilead mite pen Efraim-te le Manasseh-te sung panin Efraim mite a taisante na hi uh hi,” ci ngei uh hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Gilead mite in Efraim mite tung panin Jordan ngahmunte la uh hi. Efraim galtaite khat peuhpeuh in, “Hong galkah sak in,” a cih ciangin Gilead mite in ama kiangah, “Efraim mi na hi hiam?” ci uh hi. Amah in, “Hi kei ing,” a cih ciangin"},"6":{"text":"amaute in ama kiangah, “Tua ahihleh Shibboleth ci in,” ci uh a, tua ciangin amah in, “Sibboleth,” ci hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a manin ci thei lo hi. Tua ciangin amaute in amah manin Jordan ngahmunte-ah that uh hi. Tua tungin Efraim mi tul sawmli le tulnih tuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Jefthah in Israel mite kum guk sung thu khen hi. Tua ciangin Gilead mi Jefthah si a, Gilead gam ama khuapi sungah kivui hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama nungah Bethlehem khuami Ibzan in Israel-te thu khen hi.","title":"Ibzan, Elon, le Abdon in Israel-te Thu Khen"},"9":{"text":"Amah in tapa sawmthum nei hi. Ama beh pualam mite tungah tanu sawmthum mo kha a, a pualam panin a tapate a dingin tanu sawmthum la hi. Amah in Israel-te kum sagih sung thu khen hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ibzan si a, Bethlehem-ah kivui hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama nungah Zebulun mi Elon in Israel-te kum sawm sung thu khen hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zebulun mi Elon si a, Zebulun gam Aijalon-ah kivui hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama nungah Pirathon mi Hillel’ tapa Abdon in Israel-te thu khen hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in la sawmsagihte tungah a tuang tapa sawmli le tupa sawmthum nei hi. Amah in Israel-te kum giat sung thu khen hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pirathon mi Hillel’ tapa Abdon si a, Amalek mite’ mualtung gam Efraim leitang tung, Pirathon-ah kivui hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ muhna-ah Israel mite a sia gamtakik uh a, Topa in Filistia mite’ khut sungah kum sawmli sung amaute a pia hi.","title":"Samson’ Suahna"},"2":{"text":"Dan minam sung panin Zorah khuami Manoah min nei mi khat om hi. Ama zi tasel ahih manin ta nei lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi tua numei kiangah kilangin ama kiangah, “En in, na tasel a, ta na nei kei hi. Ahi zongin tu-in gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kidawm inla, leenggahzu ahi a, khamtheihzu ahi zongin ne loin, a nin bangmah ne kei in."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi. Ama lu tungah mulkiatna kitah lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh naupang pen a suah a kipanin Pasian’ tungah Nazir mi hi ding a, amah in Filistia mite’ khutsung panin Israel-te hotkhiat ding kipan ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 6:1-5"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua nu pai-in a pasal’ kiangah gen a, “Pasian’ mi khat ka kiangah hong pai a, ama mel pen Pasian’ vantungmi mel tawh kibangin dipkuathuai mahmah hi. Koi panin hong pai cih amah ka dong kei a, amah in ama min hong gen lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in kei kiangah, ‘En in, nang gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin leenggahzu ahi a, khamtheihzu ahi zongin ne kei inla, a nin bangmah ne kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh naupang pen a suah a kipan a sih dong Pasian’ tungah Nazir mi hi ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manoah in Topa kunh a, “ Topa aw, kong thum hi; na hong sawl Pasian’ mipa ko’ kiangah hong paisakkik inla, a hong suak ding naupang ka bawl nading uh hong hilhsak in,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian in Manoah’ aw ngai-in lo lai-ah tua nu a tut laitakin Pasian’ vantungmi ama kiangah hong pai hi. Ahih hangin a pasal Manoah amah tawh om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua nu nawhsa-in tai-in a pasal kiangah, “En in, zanhal a kei kiangah hong pai mipa ka kiangah hong kilang kik hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manoah dingin a zi zui a, mipa kiangah pai-in, “Hihnu kiangah thugenpa nang na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manoah in, “Na thugente a manin hong tun ciangin naupang’ nuntakna zia ding bang hi a, amah in bang hih ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ vantungmi in Manoah’ kiangah, “Numei’ kiangah ka gente khempeuh na kidawm hen."},"14":{"text":"Amah in leenggui pana piang peuhmah ne thei lo ding a, leenggahzu ahi a, khamtheihzu ahi zongin ne thei loin, a nin na khat peuhpeuh ne thei lo ding hi; amah ka thupiak khempeuh tang hen,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Manoah in Topa’ vantungmi kiangah, “Kong thum hi; tawlkhat khawl inla, nang a dingin keelno khat hong bawlsak nung,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in Manoah kiangah, “Nong khawlsak zongin na an ka ne kei ding hi. Ahih hangin meihal biak nading a baihsa-in na bawl leh Topa tungah pia in,” a ci hi. (Bang hang hiam cih leh Manoah in amah Topa’ vantungmi ahihlam thei lo hi.)"},"17":{"text":"Manoah in Topa’ vantungmi kiangah, “Na thugente a manin hong tun ciangin nang kong pahtawi theih nadingun, na min bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi in ama kiangah, “Hih thu a lamdang hi, ci-in thei napi-in bang hangin ka min hong dong na hi hiam?” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 32:29"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Manoah in an-a biakna tawh a keelno la-in nalamdang a bawl Topa a dingin suang tungah a pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Biakna tau panin vantung lamah meikuang a paitoh ciangin, Manoah le a zi in a et laitakun biakna tau meikuang sungah Topa’ vantungmi kahto hi. Tua ciangin amaute leilakah a bok uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Manoah le a zi’ tungah Topa’ vantungmi kilang nawn lo hi. Tua ciangin Manoah in amah Topa’ vantungmi ahihlam thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Manoah in a zi kiangah, “Pasian mu khin ihih manin i si taktak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin a zi in ama kiangah, “ Topa in eite thah hong sawm hileh, i meihal biakna le an tawh i biakna hong sang lo ding a, hih nate khempeuh hong lak loin, hih bang nate zong eite’ tungah hong pulak lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua numei in tapa khat nei-in a min Samson a phuak hi. Naupang khangto a, Topa in thupha a pia hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ kha in Zorah le Eshtaol kikal Mahanehdan ah Samson hanthot ding a kipan hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei Timnah-ah Samson va paisuk a, Timnah-ah Filistia nungak khat mu hi.","title":"Samson le Timnah Numei"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah ciahto-in a nu le a pa kiangah, “Filistia nungak khat Timnah-ah ka mu hi. Ka zi dingin va la un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin a nu le a pa in ama kiangah, “Nang pai-in dawibia Filistia mite kiang panin zi na lak nadingin na tanaute’ lak ahi a, i mipih khempeuh lakah ahi zongin numei khat beek om lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A nu le a pa in hih thu pen Topa’ kiang pan ahihlam thei lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Filistia mite tungah paulap ding a zong ahi hi. Tua hun laitakin Filistia mite in Israel-te uk uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nu le a pa tawh Timnah-ah Samson paisuk a, Timnah leenggui lote-ah amah tung hi. Tua lai-ah humpinelkai khanglai khat in amah hawksan hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama tungah Topa’ kha khauhtakin hong tung a, mi khat in keelno khat a balgawp bangin amah in a khut guak tawh humpinelkai a balzan hi. Ahih hangin tua bangin ahihna thu a nu tung ahi a, a pa tungah ahi zongin gen lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah paisukin a numei tawh kiho hi. Tua nu in Samson lungkimsak mahmah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tawlkhat khit ciangin tua nu a la dingin paikik hi. Humpinelkai luanghawm a en dingin amah lampialin a va et leh humpinelkai luanghawm sungah khuai hon khat le khuaizu na om hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in a khut tawh tuate sawkin paisuak a, a pai kawmin a ne hi. Amah a nu le a pa kiangah tungin tuate pawlkhat pia a, amaute in a ne uh hi. Ahih hangin humpinelkai luanghawm sung panin tua khuaizu a lakna thu gen lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei kiangah a pa paisuk a, Samson in zong tua lai-ah pawi khat a kham hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tangvalte’ hih ngei ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mite in amah a muh uh ciangin amah a uap dingin tangval sawmthum hong paipih uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samson in amaute kiangah, “Note’ mai-ah thuhaksa khat hong gen ning. Hih pawi ni sagih sungin a thu mukhia-in bang hiam cih nong gentheih uhleh saihadial puan silh sawmthum le pawipuan silh sawmthum note kong pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin bang hiam cih nong gentheih kei uhleh saihadial puan silh sawmthum le pawipuan silh sawmthum kei nong pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, “Na thuhaksa hong gen in, za dih ni,” a ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “A ne pa sung panin nek ding pawlkhat hong piang a, a thahatpa sung panin a khum pawlkhat hong piang hi,” a ci hi. Ni thum sungin tua thuhaksa bang hiam cih gen thei lo uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A ni li ni-in amaute in Samson’ zi kiangah, “A thuhaksa bang hiam cih hong gen nadingin na pasal zol in. Tua hi kei le nang le na pa, na inn uh tawh kong hal ding uh hi. Kote a hong zawngsak dingin hih lai-ah hong sam na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samson’ zi ama mai-ah kapin, “Kei nong mudah hi, kei nong it kei hi. Ka gam mite tungah thuhaksa na gen a, bang hiam cih kei’ tungah nong gen kei hi,” a ci hi. Amah in numei kiangah, “En in, ka nu kiang hitaleh ka pa kiang hitaleh ah ka gen kei hi. Nang kiangah hong gen tuan ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A pawi ni sagih hun sungteng ama mai-ah tua nu kap niloh hi. A ni sagih ni-in Samson in a lawmnu kiangah gen ta hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in nakpitakin kunh niloh hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in a gam mite kiangah tua thuhaksa gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua khuapi mite in a ni sagih ni, ni a tum ma-in ama kiangah gen uh a, “Khuaizu sangin bang khumzaw a, humpinelkai sangin bang hatzaw ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Ka bawngla tawh lo kho khawm lo hi le-uhcin, ka thuhaksa na thei kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samson’ tungah Topa’ kha khauhtakin hong tung a, Ashkelon ah amah paisukin tua khuamite sawmthum that a, amaute’ nate la-in a thuhaksa a genthei mite tungah a pawipuante a pia hi. A hehsa-in a pa’ inn-ah amaute ciahsan hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Samson’ zi pen a moliah pa’ zi dingin na kipia hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawlkhat khit, mangbuh lak hunin a zi kiangah a hawh dingin keelno khat tawh Samson a pai hi. Amah in, “Inndei sung ka zi kiangah ka lum ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a sungpa in amah lutsak lo hi."},"2":{"text":"A sungpa in, “Amah mudah taktak hi ni teh, ci-in ngaihsun ka hih manin na lawmpa’ zi dingin ka pia hi. A naunu amah sangin hoihzaw hi lo ahi hiam? A u tangin amah na tenpih nadingin kong thum hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Samson in, “Tutungin amau tungah siatna ka bawlna-ah Filistia mite tawh kisai-in ka mawh kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samson pai-in ngia zathum manin meilah zong a la hi. Amah in a ngia meite khatlekhat kimatsakin a meite kikalah meilah khat ciat hencip hi."},"5":{"text":"A meilahte a kuansak khit ciangin Filistia mite’ ankung dinglaite lakah ngiate paisak a, anphualte le ankung dinglaite, le oliv lote kangtum hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mite in, “Kua in hih ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Amaute in, “Timnah mite’ makpa Samson in hih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a sungpa in a zi laksakin a lawmpa tungah piaksak hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Filistia mite hong paito-in tua nu le a pa mei tawh a hallum uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Samson in amaute kiangah, “Hih pen, note’ hih ahihleh, ka kiciam hi. Note kong thuk ding a, tua khit ciangin ka khawl ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in amaute dawm loin tampi that a, tua ciangin paisukin Etam suanghawm sungah a om hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mite paito-in Judah gamah giahphual sat uh a, Lehi sim uh hi.","title":"Samson in Lehi-ah Filistia mite Zo"},"10":{"text":"Judah mite in, “Bang hangin kote simin hong paito na hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi. Amaute in, “Samson a hen ding le ko tungah amah in hong hih bangin ama tungah a hih dingin kong paito uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah mite mihing tulthum Etam suanghawmah paisukin Samson kiangah, “Filistia mite, eite a hong ukte ahihlam thei lo na hi hiam? Kote’ tungah nang’ hong bawl bang ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Samson in amaute kiangah, “Amaute in kei tungah hong bawl bangin amaute tungah ka bawl hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Samson kiangah, “Filistia mite’ khut sungah nang kong piak theih nadingun nangmah a hen dingin kong paisuk uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Samson in amaute kiangah, “Note mahmah in nong thah loh nading uh kei tungah hong kiciam un,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in Samson kiangah, “Kong that kei ding uh hi. Nang hong henin amaute’ khut sungah kong pia bek ding uh a, nang kong that het kei ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in khauhual thak nih tawh amah hen uh a, tua suanghawm sung panin amah pai khiatpihto uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Lehi-ah Samson a tun ciangin amah a dawn dingin Filistia mite hong pai-in awng uh hi. Tua ciangin ama tungah Topa’ kha khauhtakin hong tung a, a khut tunga om khauhualte pen mei in a kat anthul khau tawh kibang a, amah a kikhihnate a khut panin tolhkhia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in la khaguh thak khat mu a, a khut zanin tua khaguh la-in tua tawh mihing tulkhat a that hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samson in, “La khaguh khat tawh a lom lomin, la khaguh khat tawh mihing tulkhat ka that hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua a thugen a man khit ciangin a la khaguh paaikhia hi; tua mun pen Ramathlehi kici hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah dangtak mahmah ahih manin Topa samin, “Na nasempa’ tha tawh hih bang suahtakna lian nong piazo hi. Tu-in dangtakin kei si-in dawibia mite’ khut sungah puk ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian in Lehi a om komdep khat hong a, tua sung panin tui hong phul hi. Amah in tua tui a dawn ciangin a tha hong dimkikin thakhauh kik hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun min Enhakkore kici a, tuhun dongin Lehi-ah tua tuikhuk omlai hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in Filistia mite’ uk hun sung Israel-te kum sawmnih sung thu a khen hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat, Gaza khua-ah Samson pai a, tua lai-ah numei paktat khat mu-in tua nu kiangah a giak dingin a pai hi.","title":"Gaza-ah Samson"},"2":{"text":"Gaza mite kiangah, “Samson hong pai,” ci-in kigen a, amaute in tua khua umcihin khuapi kulhkongpi-ah zan tawntung amah pangsim uh hi. Amaute zan tawntung daitakin om uh a, “Zingsang khuavak mateng ngak ni; tua ciangin amah that ni,” ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin zankim ciang dong Samson lum a, zankim ciangin tho-in khuapi kulhkongpi kongkhakte le a khuam nihte lenin a zawlte le a na khempeuh botto a, a liangko tungah tuate pua-in Hebron mai-ah a om mual dawnah tuate a tunpih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Samson in Sorek kuamah Delilah a kici numei khat ngai hi.","title":"Samson le Delilah"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante tua nu kiangah hong pai-in, “Amah hong zol inla, ama hatna koi-ah om hiam cihna le amah i nuaisiah zawh nadingin amah i hen theih nading, amah i zawh theih nading zia hong thei in. Na theihzawh le ngun pek tul le zakhat ciat nang kong pia ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Delilah in Samson kiangah, “Na hatna lian koi-ah om a, mi khatpeuh in nang hong zawhtheih nadingin hong bangci kihen ding cihna thu, nong hehpihna-in hong gen in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Samson in tua nu kiangah, “Amaute in a keu nai lo thalkhau thak sagih tawh hong hen leh ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante in tua nu kiangah a keu nai lo thalkhau sagih hong paipih uh a, tua nu in tua khaute tawh amah a hen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua laitakin tua nu in inndei sungah mi busak hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in ama kiangah, “Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!” a ci hi. Ahih hangin, patkhaute in mei a sukkhak ciangin a kitah bangin amah in thalkhaute botsat ziau hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama thahatna thusim kithei zo lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Delilah in Samson kiangah, “En in, kei nong simmawh a, zuauthu nong gen hi. Nang hong bangci kihen theih ding cih nong hehpihna-in hong gen in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in tua nu kiangah, “Amaute in a kizang nai lo khauhual thakte tawh kei hong hen leh ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Delilah in khauhual thakte la-in tuate tawh amah hen a, “Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!” a ci hi. A busim mite inndei sungnungah om uh hi. Ahih hangin Samson in mimkhau bangin khauhualte botsat ziau hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Delilah in Samson kiangah, “Tu dong kei nong simmawh a, zuauthu nong gen hi. Nang hong bangci kihen theih ding cih hong gen in,” a ci hi. Amah in tua nu kiangah, “Ka lu tunga ka sam lom sagihte mimkhau tawh gan khawmin ciampek tawh khen bikbek lecin ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah a ihmut laitakin a lu tunga a sam lom sagihte la-in siamin a gan hi. Amah in ciampek tawh khen bikbek a, “Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a ihmutna pan amah khanglo-in a ciampek, a siambu, le a siam a kaikhia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin na lungsim kei tawh a om lopi, ‘Nang kong it hi,’ ci thei na hi hiam? Hih thumvei dong kei nong simmawh a, na thahatna a omna mun nong gen kei hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Nisimin nakpitakin a kutkut ciangin, sihna dong dingin Samson lunggim hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in tua nu kiangah a lungsim khempeuh gen a, “Ka lu tungah mulkiatna kitah ngei lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka suah tung a kipan Pasian’ tungah a kipia Nazir mi ka hi hi. Ka sam kimet leh ka hatna in kei hong nusia ding a, ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama tungah a lungsim khempeuh gen khin hi, ci-in Delilah in a theih ciangin amah in mi sawlin Filistia mi uliante sam a, “Tu-a khatvei hong pai un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a lungsim khempeuh kei kiangah hong gen khinzo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Filistia uliante tua nu kiangah hong pai-in sum zong hong pua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua nu in a phei tungah Samson ihmusak hi. Amah in mi khat samin a lu tunga a sam lom sagihte metsak hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in amah gimsak ding kipan a, ama thahatna in amah nusia ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!” a ci hi. A ihmutna panin amah khanglo-in, “Nidanga mah bangin paikhia-in keimah kisingin suakta ning,” a ci hi. Topa in amah a nusiat khitlam amah in thei lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mite in amah manin a mitte khelkhia uh a, Gaza-ah paipihin amah sumngo kol a bulh uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Israel-te’ lakah kihhuaina le lanluat khialhna gamta uh hi."},"7":{"text":"En un, no Israel mihingte khempeuh aw, na ngaihsutna uh gen unla, hih lai-ah kikum un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khempeuh mihing khat bangin ding lianin, “Eite khempeuh khat zong i puanbukah pai loin, eite khat zong i inn-ah i ciah kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in Gibeah tungah eite’ hih ding thu in: Tua khua a sim dingin aisanna tawh i pai ding a,"},"10":{"text":"amaute in Israel-te sungah lanluatna tawh a khialhna uh hangin Benjamin-te’ gam Gibeah a thuk theih nadingun mite a’ ding annek tuidawn a pua dingin Israel minamte khempeuh sung panin mi zakhat sung pan mihing sawm, tulkhat sung pan zakhat, tul sawm sung pan tulkhat i la ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin khuapi a sim dingin Israel mite khempeuh kikhawm uh a, kipawlin mi khat a bang uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel minamte in Benjamin minam khempeuh kiangah mi sawl uh a, “Note’ lakah a piang thu pen bangzah tatsiatna ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kote in amaute thatin Israel-te’ sung panin siatna ka phiatkhiat theih nadingun Gibeah khuasunga om a mi ginalote hong piakhia un,” a ci uh hi. Ruth pen Moab gam numei hi a, Israel mite khat tawh kiteng hi. A pasal a sih ciangin midang tawh kibang loin Ruth pen Israel mi a teeknu leh Israel Pasian tungah thutakin beel cinten hi. A tawpna-ah a pasal' behte tawh kiteng a, tua kiten'na hangin Israel mite' kumpi lianpen David a hong pian'khiatna pii a suak hi. Thukhente Laibu sungah a mite in Pasian a nusiat uh ciangin thuhaksa a tun'na thu kilak hi. Ahi zongin Ruth Laibu sungah minam dang khat in Israel-te' Pasian beelin ama mi citak a suah ciangin thupha a tun'na thu kilak hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thukhente in a uk hun lai-in tua gam sungah kialpi tung a, Judah gam sunga Bethlehem khuami khat, a zi le a tapa nihte tawh Moab gamah a peem dingin a pai uh hi.","title":"Ruth le Naomi"},"2":{"text":"Tua mipa’ min Elimelek hi a, a zi’ min Naomi hi-in, a tapa nihte min Mahlon le Khilion ahi hi. Amaute Moab gamah pai-in tua lai-ah om uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Naomi’ pasal Elimelek si a, a tapa nihte bek tawh tua nu a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih a tapa nihte in Moab mite zi-in la uh hi.
