Tua lai-ah amaute kum sawm bang teng uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mahlon le Khilion si a, tua nupi a tapa nihte le a pasal in sihsan hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua nu a mo tegel tawh Moab gam panin a ciahkik dingin kithawi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a mite kemin an a piakna thu Moab gam sung panin amah in za hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ama omna mun panin a mo tegel tawh tua nu ding khia a, Judah gamah a ciahkik dingin pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin Naomi in a mo nihte kiangah, “Pai un, na inn tuak uhah ciahkik unla, na nute uh tawh om un. A sisate hitaleh kei hitaleh nong limbawl uh mah bangin Topa in note hong limbawl tahen."},"9":{"text":"Topa in na pasal kik uh inn tuakah hong nuamsasak ta hen!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute namin, amaute a kap uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, “Hilo hi, na mipihte kiangah nang tawh kong ciahkhawm ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin Naomi in, “Kilehkik un, ka tanute aw, bang hangin hong zui ding na hi uh hiam? Note’ pasal hong hi thei dingin tapa nei nawn ding ka hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Kilehkik un, ka tanute aw, na pai nading uhah pai un; bang hang hiam cih leh pasal nei dingin ka teek luata hi. Pasal nei dingin kilamen ing ci mah lengzong, tunitak mahmahin pasal nei-in tapate nei phial ta mah lengzong,"},"13":{"text":"amaute a khan khit dong ngakzo ding na hi uh hiam? Hilo hi, ka tanute aw, Topa in kei hong bawlsia ahih manin note sangin nakpitakin kei ka lunggimzaw hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute a kap kik uh hi. Orpah in a teeknu namin ciah a, ahih hangin Ruth in a teeknu beel hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “En in, na sanggamnu a mipihte le a pasian-te kiangah ciahkik khin hi. Na sanggamnu’ nungah nang zong ciah in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin Ruth in, “Nang kong nusiat nading ahi a, nang zuihna panin ka ciahkik nading ahi zongin hong cici nawn kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh na paina-ah ka pai ding a, na giahna-ah ka giak ding hi. Na mite keima mite hi ding a, na Pasian keima Pasian hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na sihna-ah si-in ka kivui ding hi. Sihna cih lohbuang thudang hangin kong nusiat taak leh Topa in kei hong dawm kei ta hen,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naomi in amah a zuih ding a lungsim a khentatna a muh ciangin bangmah ci nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Bethlehem a tun mateng uh a nihun paisuak uh hi. Bethlehem a tun uh ciangin amaute’ hangin a khuazang un luum lialua-in nupite in, “Hihnu Naomi mah ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in amaute kiangah, “Naomi hong ci nawn kei un; Mara hong ci un; bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglianpa in nakpitakin kei hong gimsak hi."},"21":{"text":"A dimin ka paikhia a, Topa in a hawmin hong ciahpih kik hi. Topa in kei hong gimsakin, Vanglianpa in kei tungah gimna hong tungsak ahih ciangin bang hangin Naomi hong ci lai na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-a bangin Moab gam panin Naomi, Moab mi a monu Ruth tawh hong ciahkik hi. Mangbuhham lak kipat laitakin Bethlehem khua hong tung uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Naomi in a pasal’ tanaute, Elimelek innkuansung mi, Boaz min nei a hau migina khat nei hi.","title":"Ruth in Boaz’ Lo-ah Ansang Tawm"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moab mi Ruth in Naomi kiangah, “Lo-ah hong kuansak in la, maipha ka muhna peuhpeuh pa’ nungah anvuite lakah a sang hong tawmsak in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Pai in, ka tanu aw,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siam 19:9-10; Thkna 24:19"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah kuankhia-in pai a, anlate’ nung lo sungah ansangte a tawm hi. Elimelek-te innkuan Boaz’ lo-ah va kuankha hi."},"4":{"text":"Boaz zong Bethlehem panin hong kuanin amah in anlate kiangah, “ Topa in note hong ompih ta hen!” a ci hi. Amaute in dawngin, “ Topa in nang thupha hong pia ta hen,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Boaz in anlate a uk a nasempa kiangah, “Hih ka muh ngei loh numei kua’ ta ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin anlate a uk nasempa in dawngin, “Moab gam panin Naomi tawh a hong ciahkik Moab numei ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua numei in, ‘Kong thum hi; ansang hong tawmsakin anlate’ nungah anlomte lakah a kiate hong khawmsak in,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah hong pai-in tawlkhat zong khawl loin zingsang tung a kipan tu dong semsuak hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Boaz in Ruth kiangah, “Tu-in ngai in ka ta aw; midangte’ lo-ah ansang tawm dingin pai kei inla, hih lo zong nusia kei in. Hih lai-ah kuamah in bangmah hong cih lo ding ahih manin ka nasem numeite’ nai-ah om cinten in."},"9":{"text":"Amaute’ anlakna lo mitsuan inla, amaute’ nungah zui in. Nang hong bawlsiat loh nading uh tangvalte thu ka pia khin hi. Na dang a tak ciangin pai inla tangvalte’ tui tawisa dawn in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah a mai-in lei-ah puk a, leilakah kunin ama kiangah, “Kei gamdang mi khat hinapi, hih banga kei nong phawkna dingin bang hangin na mai-ah maipha ngah thei ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin Boaz in tua nu dawngin, “Na pasal a sih khit a kipan na teeknu a dingin na sepnate khempeuh, le na nu le na pa le na pianna gam nusia-in cikmahin na theih ngei loh mite kiangah na paina thu a kicing takin kei kiangah hong kigenzo hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in na gamtatnasate a pha tawh hong thuk a, a liimnuai beel dinga na paina Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa in thaman a cingin hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ruth in, “Ka topa aw, kei tungah nong dik mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen na nasem numeite hi lo napi-in na nasemnu’ tungah migitna kam nong pau hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Annek hun ciangin Boaz in tua nu kiangah, “Hih lai-ah hong pai in; anlum ne inla, leenggahzu sungah na an diah in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin anlate gei-ah amah tu a, tua pa in ankante tua nu a pia hi. Amah in a kham mateng ne a, a khamval zong pawlkhat omlai hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nu ansang tawm dingin a din ciangin Boaz in a tangvalte hilh a, “Anlomte lak nangawnah tawmsak unla, amah ko sia kei un."},"16":{"text":"Anlom hente lak panin zong ama a dingin pawlkhat dokkhia-in ama top dingin nusia unla, amah tai kei un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in nitak dong lo sungah ansang tawm hi. A topsa teng satkhia a, mangbuhham seu khat bang pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in tuate pua-in khuapi sungah a ciah hi. A an top teng a teeknu lakin, a ankhamvalte zong la-in a pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin a teeknu in ama kiangah, “Tuni-in koi-ah tawm na hi hiam? Koi-ah sem na hi hiam? Nang hong phawk mipa in thupha ngah ta hen,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a teeknu kiangah a naseppihte gen a, “Tuni-a ka sepna mipa pen Boaz ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naomi in a monu kiangah, “A dikna in a site hitaleh a hingte hitaleh a mangngilh lo Topa in amah thupha pia ta hen,” a ci hi. Naomi in ama kiangah, “Tua mipa pen i behte, i tanau naipen khat ahi hi,” zong ci lai hi.","ref":"Siam 25:25"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moab numei Ruth in, “Tu-a banah amah in kei kiangah, ‘Ka an khempeuh a lak khit matengun ka nasemte’ kiang nai-ah om in,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Naomi in a monu Ruth kiangah, “Ka tanu aw, ama numeite tawh na kuankhop theih hoih mahmah hi; tua hikeileh lo dangah nang hong kibawlsia kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Boaz’ numeite’ nai-ah amah omin mangbuhham lak khit dong ansang tawm a, a teeknu tawh a omkhawm hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin a teeknu Naomi in ama kiangah, “Ka tanu aw, inn khat na suantheih nadingin na pasal ding kong vaihawmsak ding kilawm hi lo ahi hiam?","title":"Ruth le Boaz Ancilna-ah"},"2":{"text":"A numeite tawh na nasepna Boaz pen i tanau hi lo ahi hiam? Thei in, amah in tu nitakin ancilna-ah mangbuhham haih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kisilin sathau kinuh inla, na puan hoihpente silhin ancilna-ah paisuk in. Ahih hangin a nek a dawn a man mateng ama kiangah na pailam kitheisak kei in."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah a lup ciangin a lupna mun encik in; tua ciangin pai inla a khe lam puan leemin lum in; tua ciangin na gamtat nading amah in hong gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, “Na gen khempeuh ka hih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ancilna-ah amah paisukin a teeknu in ama kiangah a gensa bang teekteekin a gamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Boaz in a nek a dawn khit ciangin a lung nuam a, anphual nawlah lum dingin a pai hi. Tua ciangin damtakin numei hong pai-in a khe lam puan leem sakin a lumsuk hi."},"8":{"text":"Zankim ciangin mipa a kihei ciangin a khe-ah numei khat na lum hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in, “Kua na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua nu in dawngin, “Keimah na nasemnu Ruth ka hi hi; tanaute na hih ciangin na nasemnu na puan hong zawn in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “ Topa in thupha hong pia ta hen, ka tanu aw; a hau hitaleh a zawng hitaleh tangvalte’ nung na zuih lohna-ah a masa sangin a lianzaw a tawpkhak hih ngeina man na gamta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ka tanu aw, lau kei in; na nget khempeuh nang a dingin kong hihsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka khuapih mite khempeuh in numei gina na hihlam hong thei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei pen tanau nai ka hi mah hi; ahih hangin kei sangin a naizaw tanau khat omlai hi.","ref":"Ruth 2:20"},"13":{"text":"Tuzan om in; zingsang ciangin amah in nang tungah tanaute’ hih ding hong hih leh pha hi; amah hih sak in. Ahih hangin nang tungah tanaute’ sep ding a sepnop kei leh, tua ciangin, Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin nang tungah tanau nasep kong sem ding hi. Zingsang dong lum in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin zingsang dong a khe kiangah lum a, ahih hangin mi mel khatlekhat a kitheih ma-in amah a tho hi. Tua ciangin mipa in, “Ancilna-ah numei a paina kitheisak kei in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Mipa in, “Na puanza hong paipih inla hong dawh in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin a numei in dawh a, amah in mangbuhham lawh guk tehkhia-in tua nu guan a, tua ciangin khuapi sungah tua nu a ciah hi."},"16":{"text":"A teeknu kiangah a tun ciangin amah in, “Ka tanu aw, bang na ci hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a thu khempeuh genin,"},"17":{"text":"“Hih mangbuhham lawh guk hong guan hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, ‘Na teeknu kiangah khut hawmguakin na ciah kei ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in dawngin, “Ka tanu aw, a thu hong bangci suahkhiat cih na theih mateng ngak in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah mawk om lo ding a, tuni-in a thu siangsak ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihon kikhopna kulhkongpi-ah Boaz paito-in tua munah tusuk hi. Tua laitakin a tanaute, Boaz’ gen pa hong pai hi. Tua ahih ciangin Boaz in, “Hong pai dih in, lawm aw; hih lai-ah tu dih in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah hong kihei-in tusuk hi.","title":"Boaz in Ruth Tenpih"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in khua upate mihing sawm samin, “Hih lai-ah tu dih un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute tusuk uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a tanaupa kiangah, “Moab gam panin a hong ciahkik Naomi in i tanaute Elimelek’ leitang zuak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hih thu nang kiangah kong gen ding ngaihsunin, ‘Hih lai-ah a tu mite’ muhna le keima mi upate’ muhna-ah lei in,’ kong ci hi. Na tat ding leh tanh in; ahih hangin na tat kei ding leh, a thu ka theih nadingin kei kiangah hong gen in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang simloh a tanh ding kuamah om lo ahih manin nang kiangah kong pai hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Boaz in, “Naomi’ tung panin a lo na lei ni a kipanin, a site’ gamh a site’ beh sungah a kiptheih nadingin a sipa’ zi Moab numei Ruth zong a lei na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin a tanaupa in, “Keima gamhluah siasak kha ding ka hih manin keima a dingin ka tanh thei kei ding hi. Keimah in tanh thei lo ka hih ciangin keima tattheihna thu nangmah in tang in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Nidang lai-in Israel-te sungah tatna le kikhekna thu-ah ngeina hih bang ahi hi: Thu vaihawm khat peuhpeuh a kipsak nadingin mipa khat in a khedap suahkhia-in a lawmpa pia hi; hih banga hihna pen Israel-te’ sungah kipsakna ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a tanaupa in Boaz kiangah, “Nang a dingin lei in,” a cih ciangin amah in a khedap suahkhia hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:9"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Boaz in upate le mi khempeuh kiangah, “Tuni-in note pen Naomi’ tung panin Elimelek le Khilion le Mahlon’ neihsa khempeuh ka lei khitna thu teci na hi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"A site’ min ama sanggamte le a pianna a khuasung panin a maiman loh nadingin ama gamhluahna-ah a site’ min a kizop theih nadingin a si khin Mahlon’ zi, Moab numei Ruth zong ka zi dingin ka lei khin hi; note pen tuni-in teci na hi uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5-6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kulhkongpi-a om mite khempeuh le upate in, “Kote, teci ka hi uh hi. Topa in Israel-te’ pianna Rachel le Leah bangin na innkuan sunga hong pai numei bawl tahen. Efrathah-ah na dau pai hen la, Bethlehem-ah na min thang tahen.","ref":"Pian 29:31"},"12":{"text":"Topa in hih a khangno lai numei tawh nang hong piak na tate’ hangin Judah in Tamar tawh a neih a tapa Perez innkuan tawh kibangin na innkuan piang ta hen,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"Pian 38:27-30"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Boaz in Ruth la-in ama zi a suak hi. Amah in a zi luppih a, Topa in tua nu gaisakin amah in tapa khat nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin nupite in Naomi kiangah, “Tanau nei loin tuni-in nang a hong omsak lo Topa in thupha ngah hen la, Israel-te’ sungah ama min thang ta hen!"},"15":{"text":"Amah pen nang a dingin na nuntakna a hong piakik, le na khanghamna-ah hong vak pa hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, tapa sagih sangin a thupizaw, nangmah hong it na monu’ neih tapa ahi hi,” a ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naomi in naungek la-in a ang-ah tawi a, amah a cingnu a suak hi."},"17":{"text":"A veng nupite in a min phuak uh a, “Naomi’ sung pan tapa khat suak,” a ci uh hi. Amaute in a min Obed phuak uh hi. Amah pen Jessi’ pa hi a, Jessi pen David’ pa ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Perez’ suanlekhakte hih bang ahi hi: Perez pen Hezron’ pa,"},"19":{"text":"Hezron pen Ram’ pa, Ram pen Amminadab’ pa,"},"20":{"text":"Amminadab pen Nahshon’ pa, Nahshon pen Salmon’ pa,"},"21":{"text":"Salmon pen Boaz’ pa, Boaz pen Obed’ pa,"},"22":{"text":"Obed pen Jessi’ pa, Jessi pen David’ pa ahi hi."}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"Samuel Masa","shortname":"1Sa","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel Masa Laibu sungah thukhente' hun panin kumpi neihna hunah Israel mite' nuntakna a kikhelna hun sung thu kiciamteh hi. Hih Israel minamte' nuntak kikhelna pen mihing thum thu tawh kizom a, tuate in: Thukhen lian a nunung pen Samuel hi a, Israel-te' kumpi masa pen Saul hi a, tua ciangin David ahi hi. David kumpi a suah hun ma-a ama gamtatna teng leh Samuel leh Saul thu kigen khawm kawikawi hi. Hih laibu sungah a bulphuh thu pen Thuciam Lui sunga tangthu laibu dangte mah tawh kibang a, Pasian' tungah cihtakna in ma nawtzawhna hi a, Pasian' thu zuihlohna in thu haksa tuahna hi, cihna ahi hi. Hih thu pen 2:30 sungah siampi Eli kiangah Topa in teltakin a gen sinsen thu hi a, “Kei hong pahtawite ka pahtawi ding a, kei hong simmawhte ka simmawh ding hi,” na ci hi. Hih laibu sungah mihing kumpi a kikoihna hangin ngaihsutna nam nih a omna thu na kiciamteh hi. Topa mahmah pen Israel-te' kumpi-in kingaihsun a, ahi zongin mihingte' ngetna tawh kizui-in Topa in amau-a' dingin khat sehsak hi. Hih sungah a thupi pen, 2:7-10 sungah a kigelh mah bangin Israel mite leh a kumpipa uh Pasian' aana leh a thukhenna nuai-ah a omkhawm uh ahihna thu ahi hi. Pasian' thu sungah a hau a zawng a kibangin mi khempeuh in thu a neihna uh kibang kim hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim mi Zuf’ tapa Tohu, a tapa Elihu, a tapa Jehoram, a tapa Elkanah a kici min nei mi khat Efraim mualtung gam Ramathaimzofim-ah om hi.","title":"Samuel’ Suahna"},"2":{"text":"Amah in zi nih nei hi. Khat’ min Hannah hi a, a khat’ min Peninnah ahi hi. Peninnah in ta nei a, ahih hangin Hannah in nei lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Elkanah a kumkumin a khuapi panin, Eli’ tapa nihte Hofni le Finehas in Topa’ siampi a sepna mun Shiloh-ah Vanglian Topa a bia ding le ama tungah biakna a pia dingin a pai zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Elkanah in biakna a piak ciangin a zi Peninnah le a tanu le a tapate khempeuh tungah tanh pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in Hannah a it hangin Topa in amah ta neisak lo ahih manin Hannah tungah tanh khat bek a pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in amah ta neisak lo ahih manin amah a el a zipih in amah nakpitakin phin zel, hehsak zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a kumkumin tua bangin hi den uh hi. Topa’ inn-ah a paitoh simin Peninnah in Hannah phin zel hi. Tua ahih ciangin Hannah kapin an ne lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama pasal Elkanah in, “Hannah aw, bang hangin kap na hi hiam? Bang hangin an ne lo na hi hiam? Bang hangin na lungsim dah ahi hiam? Kei pen tapa sawm sangin nang a dingin hoihzaw hi lo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in Shiloh-ah an a nek khit uh ciangin khatvei Hannah ding khia-in biakinn-ah thungen dingin a pai hi. Tua hun laitakin Topa’ biakinn kongkhak khuam pangah siampi Eli na tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua nu nakpitakin lungkhamin Topa’ tungah thu ngenin nakpitakin a kap hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in thuciamna khat bawlin, “Vanglian Topa aw, nangmah in na nasemnu’ gimna nong et takpi a, keimah hong phawkin na nasemnu hong mangngilh loin na nasemnu tungah tapa khat nong piak leh, Topa’ tungah a khan tawntungin amah kong pia ding a, ama lu-ah mulkiatna kitah lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 6:5"},"12":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah thungenin a om laitakin Eli in tua nu’ kam na en hi."},"13":{"text":"Hannah a lungsimah pau hi. A mukte bek lingin a awging kiza lo ahih ciangin Eli in tua numei zukhamin ngaihsun hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Eli in ama kiangah, “Bang tanvei zu kham ding na hi hiam? Na leenggahzu nek khawl in,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin Hannah in dawngin, “Hilo hi, ka topa aw; kei pen nakpitakin a lungkham numei ka hi hi. Leenggahzu ahi a, khamtheihzu ahi zongin ka ne kei a, Topa’ mai-ah ka lungsim a sungkhia ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Lungkhamna le gimna tawh a pau ka hih manin numei ginalo bangin na nasemnu hong ngaihsun kei in, a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Eli in dawngin, “Nuam takin pai in. Israel-te’ Pasian in ama tungah na ngetsa thu hong pia hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in, “Nangma mitah na nasemnu maipha hong musak in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua numei pai-in an ne a, dahmai pua nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute zingsangin tho baihin biakinn-ah Topa a biak khit uh ciangin amaute’ khua Ramah-a a inn uhah a ciahkik uh hi. Tua ciangin Elkanah in a zi Hannah luppih a, Topa in tua nu’ thungetna a pia hi."},"20":{"text":"A hun ciangin Hannah gai-in tapa khat nei a, a min Samuel a phuak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “ Topa’ tung panin amah ka nget ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elkanah le a innkuante khempeuh Topa’ tungah kumsim biakna le a thuciamna a pia dingin paito kik uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin Hannah paito lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a pasal kiangah, “Naungek nawi tawh a kikhen phetin Topa’ omna mai-ah kilakin tua lai-ah a om tawntung dingin ka paipih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"A pasal Elkanah in ama kiangah, “Nangmah in hoih na sak pen bangin gamta inla, amah nawi tawh a kikhen dong ngak in. Topa in a kammal hong kipsak ta hen,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin nupi omin nawi tawh a kikhen mateng a ta a khoi hi."},"24":{"text":"Numei in amah nawi tawh a kikhensak khit ciangin kum thum a pha bawngtal khat, annel seu khat, le leenggahzu savun thawl khat tawh amah la-in, Shiloh-a Topa’ inn-ah amah a paipih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a bawngtal go-in Eli kiangah a naupang a paipih uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Aw ka topa! Nangmah, a nungta na hih mah bangin ka topa aw, keimah in Topa’ tungah thu ngenin nangma omna hih lai munah a ding nu ka hi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hih naupang ka ngen hi. Topa in ama tungah keima ngetna hong pia hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ tungah amah ka kawm hi. A nuntak laiteng Topa’ tungah amah a kikawm ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in tua lai-ah Topa a bia uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hannah in zong thu ngenin, “ Topa’ tungah ka lungdam a, Topa’ hangin ka kipak hi. Nong huhna hangin ka galte ka nuihsan hi.","title":"Hannah’ La"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa bangin a siangtho kuamah dang om lo a, amah simloh kuamah dang om lo a, i Pasian tawh a kibang hong hu dang om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bangin kiphatsakna tawh pau nawn kei inla, na kamsung pan kihihsakna gingkhiasak kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa pen a thei Pasian hi a, amah in gamtatnate a tawi khai hi."},"4":{"text":"A thahatte’ thalte kitan a, ahih hangin a thaneemte in thahatna ngah uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A gilvahte in an thalawh uh a, ahih hangin a gilkialte kial nawn lo uh hi. Tasel mi in ta sagih nei a, ahih hangin ta tampi a nei nu a lungzuang hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in thatin hingsakkik a, amah in Leinuai-ah paipih sukin thotosak hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in zawngsakin hausak a, amah in niamkhiat sukin, zong sangtosak hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in leivui panin mizawngte phongto a, amah in a cimawhte a lungkhamna panun a phongto hi. Uliante tawh tukhawmsak a, minphatna ngahsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung khuampite Topa a’ hi a, tuate tungah amah in leitung pumpi a koih hi."},"9":{"text":"“Amah in a thuman mite’ kalsuanna limtakin cing a, ahih hangin migilote khuamialna sungah kikhiasuk ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thatang hatna tawh mi gualzo lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ langte tamkham ding a, amah in amaute do-in vantungah van gingsak ding hi. Topa in leimong dongah thu khen ding hi. Amah in ama kumpipa tungah thahatna pia ding a, a sathau nilh pa’ vangliatna sangsak ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 1:46-55"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ramah-a a inn-ah Elkanah a ciah hi. Ahi zongin naupang in siampi Eli’ omna-ah Topa’ na a sem hi."},"12":{"text":"Eli’ tapate pen bangmah a man lo mite ahi uh hi. Amaute in Topa zahtakna nei lo uh hi.","title":"Eli’ Innkuan Siat nading Genkholhna"},"13":{"text":"Mite’ tungah siampite’ gamtat zia ding ngeinate don lo uh hi. Mi khatpeuh in biakna a piak ciangin a sa a huan laitakin siampipa’ nasempa sikkeu-ka-thum nei khat a khutah tawi-in hong pai a,"},"14":{"text":"amah in a sikkeu tawh sikbeel daii ahi a, beel-uk ahi a, beelpi ahi a, beel sungah ahi zongin sunsuk hi. Sikkeuka in a kaihkhiattoh khempeuh siampipa in tang ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin Shiloh-ah a pai Israel-te khempeuh tungah amaute in tua bangin hih uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua tham loin a thau a kihal ma-in siampipa’ nasempa hong pai-in biakna a pia mipa kiangah, “Siampipa a’ ding han’ ding sa hong pia in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in nang tung panin sa minsa hong sang loin a sial bek hong sang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in ama kiangah, “A thau hong hal masa sak inla, tua khit ciangin na deih zahzah la in,” a cih leh, amah in, “Hilo hi; tu mahmahin nong pia ding uh hi. Tua hikeileh thatanghat thu-in kong laksak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ muhna-ah tangvalte’ khialhna lian mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Topa’ tungah biakpiaknate thupi seh lo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Samuel pen saihadial siampipuan silhin Topa’ mai-ah na a sem naupang khat ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel’ nu a pasal tawh kumsim biakna pia dingin a paitoh ciangin ama a dingin puantual neu khat bawlin kum simin ama kiangah a puak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Eli in Elkanah le a zi thupha pia-in, “Amah in Topa’ tungah a apkik a ta’ tang dingin Topa in hih numei tawh nang ta dang hong neisak ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a inn uhah amaute a ciah uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Hannah thupha pia a, tua nu gai-in tanu nih le tapa thum a nei hi. Naupang Samuel ahihleh Topa’ omna-ah a khang hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-in Eli teek mahmah a, Israel-te khempeuh tungah a tapate’ gamtatnate, le kikhopna buk lutna-ah na a sem numeite tawh a lupkhopna thute khempeuh zong a za hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin tua bangin gamta na hi uh hiam? Mi khempeuh tung panin na gamtat siatnate uh ka za hi."},"24":{"text":"Hilo hi, ka tapate aw; Topa’ mite in a genthangna thu ka zakte hoih lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi khat midang khat tungah a khialh le ama a dingin thukhente in palai sem ding hi. Ahih hangin mi khat Topa’ tungah khial leh ama a dingin kua in va thumsak ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amaute in a pa’ thu ngai lo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen amaute a thah nadingin Topa’ deihna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in naupang Samuel a pumpi khangin Topa le mite’ maipha a ngahtoto hi.","ref":"Luk 2:52"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian’ mi khat Eli’ kiangah hong pai-in ama kiangah, “ Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Egypt gam sung Faro’ khutnuai-ah na pupi Aaron le a innkuante a om laitakin Aaron’ tungah keimah ka kilang hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel minamte khempeuh sung panin amah ka siampi ahi ding, ka biakna tau-ah a pai ding, paknamtui a hal ding, keima mai-ah siampipuan a silh dingin ka teel hi. Israel mite’ tung panin mei tawh kihal keimah hong kibiaknate khempeuh na pupi innkuan tungah ka pia hi.","ref":"Pai 28:1-4; Siam 7:35-36"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin keimah hong kibiaknate le ka thupiak ahi keimah hong kipiakte thusim loin, keima mi Israel-te’ piak a limci pen teng tawh note kithausakin, kei sangin na tapate pahtawi zaw na hi hiam?’ ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa in thu hong genin: ‘Nangma innkuan le na behte keima mai-ah sungtumin pusuak tawntung ding hi, ci-in thu ka ciamsa hi,’ ci hi. Ahih hangin tu-in Topa in thu genin: ‘Tua bang hi nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei hong pahtawite ka pahtawi ding a, kei hong simmawhte ka simmawh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"En in, nangma innkuan sung le na beh sunga tangval hat khempeuh ka suksiat hun hong tung ding a, na innkuan sungah puteekte a om nawn loh hun hong tung ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te tungah ka piak daupainate khempeuh na lungkham hunin enna mit tawh na en ding a, na innkuan sungah puteek om ngei nawn lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ka biakna tau panin ka suksiat loh na suante khat pen mitlawt dongin a kap ding le a lunggim dingin kikoih ding hi. Tua ciangin na innsung panin a khang khempeuh, mite’ namsau tawh si ding uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Na tapa nihte, Hofni le Finehas tungah hong tung ding hih thu pen nang a dingin lim hi ding hi. Amau tegel a ni kikhatin si ding uh hi.","ref":"1Sam 4:11"},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka lungsim sung le ka ngaihsutna bangin a sem ding a citak siampi khat keima a dingin ka khangsak ding hi. Amah, suanlekhak nei-in ka bawl ding a, ka sathau nilh pa’ mai-ah amah sungtumin pusuak tawntung ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Na suanlekhak a suakta mite khempeuh ngun peek khat ahi a, anlum lum khat ngen ding ahi zongin ama kiangah pai-in, “An tawm ka neih theih nadingin siampipa’ omna mun khat peuhpeuhah kei hong koih in, ci-in kong thum hi,” ci ding uh hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Eli’ khutnuai-ah naupang Samuel in Topa’ na sem hi. Tua hun lai-in Topa in thu genmun lo a, maangmuh ommun lo hi.","title":"in Samuel Sam"},"2":{"text":"Tua hunin a mit a maang dingin a kipan khin Eli in khua mu thei lo a, ama omna tuamah lum hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian’ meivak mit nai lo a, Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang a omna mun Topa’ mun siangtho sungah Samuel lum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Samuel! Samuel!” ci-in sam ahih manin amah in, “Hih lai-ah om ing!” ci-in"},"5":{"text":"Eli kiangah tai a, “Hih lai-ah om ing, nong sam hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, “Kong sam kei hi; lumkik in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in a lum hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in sam kikin, “Samuel!” a ci hi. Samuel tho-in Eli kiangah pai-in, “Hih lai-ah om ing, nong sam hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, “Kong sam kei hi, ka tapa aw; lum kik in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua laitakin Samuel in Topa thei nai lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amah hopih ngei nai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Samuel a thum veina sam kik hi. Amah tho-in Eli kiangah pai-in, “Hih lai-ah om ing, nong sam hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in naupang a sapna thu Eli in a thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Eli in Samuel kiangah, “Pai-in lum in; amah in nang hong sap leh nangmah in, ‘Hong gen in, Topa aw, na nasempa in za hi,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Samuel pai-in ama omna-ah lumsuk hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa hong pai-in hong ding a, a hun dangte-a mah bangin, “Samuel! Samuel!” ci-in a sam hi. Amaute in, “Hilo! Kote’ tungah kumpi khat ka nei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Kote zong minam dangte khempeuh mah bangin, ka kumpipa uh’n kote hong ukin kote’ mai-ah pai-in ka galte uh hong dosak ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Samuel in mite’ thugen khempeuh a zak khit ciangin Topa’ kiangah tua thute a genkik hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Samuel kiangah, “Amaute’ thu ngai inla, amaute-a’ dingin kumpi khat koih in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Samuel in Israel mite kiangah, “Mi khempeuh na khuapi ciat uhah ciah un,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin-te sung panin Afiah’ tapa Bekorath, a tapa Zeror, a tapa Abiel, a tapa Kish min nei, Benjamin-te mihau khat a om hi.","title":"Kumpi-in Saul Kiteel"},"2":{"text":"Amah in tangval a melhoih, a min Saul ahi tapa khat nei hi. Israel mite lakah amah sangin a melhoihzaw, a thacingzaw khat zong om lo a, midang khempeuh ama liangko ciang bek pha uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua laitakin Saul’ pa Kish’ late a mang hi. Tua ahih ciangin Kish in a tapa Saul kiangah, “Nasemte khat sam inla, late va zong in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Efraim mualtung gamteng le Shalisha gam teng nawkin zong uh a, ahih hangin mu lo uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Shaalim gamteng zong uh a, ahih hangin tua gamah na om tuan lo hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Benjamin gamteng zong uh a, ahih hangin mu sam lo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Zuf gam a tun uh ciangin Saul in amah tawh a om a nasempa kiangah, “Hong pai in, ciahkik ni. Tua hikeileh ka pa in late ngaihsun nawn loin eite hong lunghimawh zaw kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahih hangin a nasempa in, “En in, hih khuapi sungah Pasian’ mi khat om a, a kizahtak mi khat ahi hi. Ama gen khempeuh a manin tung hi. Tua lai-ah pai ni. Eite’ khualzin khiatna thu amah in hong genthei kha ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in a nasempa kiangah, “Ahih hangin pai lehang, tua mipa bang puak ding ihi hiam? I van sunga i anlum beita a, Pasian’ mipa kiangah i puak ding letsong om lo hi. Bang nei nawn ihi hiam?” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nasempa in Saul dawngkikin, “Hih lai-ah ngun sumnen tang khat ka nei hi. I vai hong gen nadingin Pasian’ mipa kiangah ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"(Tua ma lai-in Israel-te sungah mi khat in Pasian kiangah thudong dingin a pai ciangin amah in, “Hong pai in, thumu pa kiangah va pai ni,” ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuhuna kamsang i cihte tua ma-in thumu pa kici hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in a nasempa kiangah, “Tua ahihleh hoih hi, va pai ni,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian’ mipa a omna khuapi-ah amaute a pai uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute khuapi omna mual tungah a paitoh laitakun khuapi panin tui tawi dingin hong paikhia nungaknote tawh kituak uh ahih manin amaute kiangah, “Thumu pa hih lai-ah a om hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in, “Amah om hi; note’ mai diakah pai hi. Kinawh un; khuapi sungah tu mahmahin hong pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite in tuni-in mualtung a biakna-ah biakna pia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Khuapi sung na lut phetun mualtung a biakna-ah an ne dingin a pai ma-in amah na mu ding uh hi. Amah in biakpiakna thupha pia ding ahih manin ama pai mateng mite in an ne lo ding uh hi. Thupha a piak khit ciangin a kisam mite in ne thei pan uh hi. Tu-in paito un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah na tuakpah ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin khuapi-ah amaute paito uh hi. Khuapi sungah amaute a lut laitakun mualtung a biakna lamah Samuel a pai dingin amau’ lamah hong paikhia a mu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in Saul hong pai ni a zan ni-in Samuel tungah Topa in thu na gen khin hi:"},"16":{"text":"“Zing ciang tubang hunin Benjamin gam sung panin nang kiangah mi khat kong sawl ding a, nangmah in ka mi Israel-te tungah ulian dingin amah sathau na nilh ding hi. Amah in Filistia mite’ khutsung panin ka mite honkhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute’ kikona kei kiang hong tung khin ahih manin ka mite’ gimna ka mu khinzo hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Samuel in Saul a muh ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, “Nang kiangah kong gen mipa hih lai-ah hong paita hi. Amah pen ka mite’ tungah a uk ding pa ahi hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in kulhkongpi-ah Samuel va naihin, “Hong gen in; thumu pa’ inn koilai ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel in Saul dawngin, “Keimah, thumu pa ka hi hi; mualtung a biakna-ah keima mai-ah na paito in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in tuni-in kei tawh an na ne ding a, zingsang ciangin nang hong ciahsakin na lungsim a om khempeuh nang kiangah kong gen ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuma ni thum lai-in a mang na late ahihleh, kimu khinta ahih manin tuate na lungsimah ngaihsun nawn kei in. Israel-te’ deihdeihte kua’ tungah om ahi hiam? Nang le na pa’ innkuante khempeuh tungah a om hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in dawngin, “Kei pen Israel minamte sung panin a tawmpen Benjamin-te hi lo ka hi hiam? Keima innkuan, Benjamin minam innkuan khempeuh sung panin a niampen hi lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin hih bangin kei tungah hong pau na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in Saul le a nasempa samin inndei sungah paipih a, mihing sawmthum bang a pha a kisam mite lak tutna bul lamah a tusak hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in anhuan pa kiangah, “Nang kiangah kong piak, ‘Na tuam koih in,’ kong cih pawl hong paipih in,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin anhuan pa in a khe le a kawngsa la-in Saul’ mai-ah a lui hi. Tua ciangin Samuel in, “Thei in, a kisit pen nang’ mai-ah hong kilui hi. Ne in; bang hang hiam cih leh leenglate tawh na nektheih nadingin a kiseh hun a cin mateng nang a dingin hong kisitsak ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-in Saul in Samuel tawh an ne khawm hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute mualtung a biakna panin khuapi sungah a paisuk uh ciangin innkhumzangah Saul a dingin lupna khat na kiphah a, a ihmu dingin amah lumsuk hi."},"26":{"text":"Khua a vak ciangin Samuel in innkhumzanga Saul samin, “Na paina dingah kong sawl theih nadingin tho in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul tho-in, amah le Samuel, khuapi kongzingah a pai uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute khuapi nawlah a paikawmun Samuel in Saul kiangah, “I mai-ah na nasempa a paisuak nading gen inla, amah a paisuak khit ciangin nang’ tungah Pasian’ thute kong theihsak theih nadingin tawlkhat hih lai-ah khawl in,” a ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in sathau thawl khat la a, ama lu tungah buakin amah nam a, “ Topa in ama mi Israel-te tungah ulian dingin nang sathau hong nilh khin hi lo ahi hiam? Nangmah in Topa’ mite ukin a kiima om amau’ galte’ khutsung panin amaute na honkhia ding hi. Topa in ama luahte tungah ulian dingin nang sathau hong nilh khitna lim hih bang hi ding hi:"},"2":{"text":"Tuni-in kei kiang panin na paikhiat ciangin Benjamin-te’ gam Rachel’ han kiang Zelzah-ah mihing nih na tuak ding a, amaute in nang kiangah, ‘Pai a na zon late kimu khin a, tu-in na pa in late ngaihsun nawn loin nangmah hong lunghimawh a, “Ka tapa bang cih ding ka hi hiam?” ci hi,’ hong ci ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua lai panin pai lai-in Tabor tawsaw lak na tung ding hi. Tua lai panin Bethel-a Pasian kiangah a paito, keelno thum a pua mi khat, anlum thum a pua adang khat, le leenggahzu savun thawl khat a pua mi khat, mi thum in nang hong dawn ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong hopihin nangmah in amau’ tung panin na san ding anlum nih nang tungah hong pia ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Filistia khuacingte a omna Gibeath-elohim na tung ding hi. Tua khuapi sung na tun ciangin amaute mai-ah, harp lasakna, khuangneu, tamngai, le laiza lasakna tawh laamin awng kawmin mualtung a biakna panin hong paisuk kamsang honkhat na tuak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ kha in khauhtakin nang hong uk ding a, amaute tawh laamin awng khawmin mi tuamdang khatin na kikheel ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hih limte nang tungah hong tun ciangin na tuah peuhpeuh na hih ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tawh Pasian hong om hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin keima mai Gilgal-ah na paisuk ding hi. Meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate a pia dingin nang kiangah kei zong kong pai ding hi. Nang kiangah kei hong pai-in na hih ding teng kong lah mateng, ni sagih sung na ngak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Samuel nusia dingin a nunghei ciangin Pasian in ama tungah pianzia thak khat a pia hi. Tua ni-in Samuel’ gen limte khempeuh a piang hi."},"10":{"text":"Gibeah-ah amaute a tun uh ciangin, kamsang honkhat in amah na dawn hi. Pasian’ kha in khauhtakin amah hong man takpi a, amah zong amaute’ lakah laamin a awng hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsangte tawh a gamtat khawmna, amah a theisa mi khempeuhte in a muh uh ciangin khatlekhat in, “Kish’ tapa’ tungah bang tung ahi hiam? Saul zong kamsang suak ahi hiam?” kici uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua lai-a mite khat in dongin, “Hih kamsang dangte kua’ tate ahi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin, “Saul nangawn kamsang suak hi,” cihna paunak a kipatna hong suak hi.","ref":"1Sam 19:23-24"},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin laamin a otna a man ciangin mualtung a biakna tau omna-ah a pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Saul’ pano in amah le a nasempa a muh ciangin, “Koi-ah pai na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amah in, “Late a zong dingin ka pai uh hi. Late kimu zo lo ding ci-in ka theih uh ciangin Samuel kiangah ka pai uh hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul’ pano in, “Kong thum hi; Samuel in nang kiangah hong gen teng kei tungah hong gen in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in a pano kiangah, “Late a kimuh khitna ko kiangah teltakin hong kigen hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Samuel in a gen kumpi suah nading thu tawh kisai ama tungah bangmah gen lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in Samuel in Mizpah-a Topa’ kiangah mite khawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in Israel mite kiangah, “Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Egypt panin Israel-te ka paikhiatpih a, Egypt-te’ khutsung le note hong nengniam kumpi gamte khempeuh’ khutsung panin note kong honkhia hi,’ ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin note in na tuahsiatnate uh le na lungkhamnate uh panin note a hong honkhia na Pasian uh tuni-in na nial uh a, note in, ‘Kote’ tungah kumpi khat koih in,’ na ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na minam nam uh le a tul tulin Topa’ mai-ah kilak un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in Israel minamte khempeuh a nai-ah hong paipih a, aisanna tawh Benjamin minam kila hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in Benjamin minamte a behbehin hong paipih a, aisanna tawh Matri innkuan kila hi. A tawpna-ah amah in Matri innkuan a mi malin hong paipih a, aisanna tawh Kish’ tapa Saul kila hi. Ahih hangin amaute in amah a zon uh ciangin amah kimu zo lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Topa kiangah dongkik uh a, “Tua mipa hih lai-ah hong pai hiam?” ci uh a, Topa in, “En un, amahmah van kawm lakah bu hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute tai-in tua lai mun panin amah hong paipih uh hi. Mite’ lakah amah a din ciangin mi khempeuh ama liangko ciang bek pha uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in mi khempeuh tungah, “ Topa in a teelsa mipa na mu uh hiam? Mi khempeuh lakah amah tawh a kibang khat zong om lo hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh awngin, “Kumpipa khansau hen!” a ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in kumpipa’ thuneihna le a nasepte mite kiangah gen a, amah in tuate laibu khat sungah gelhin Topa’ mai-ah a koih hi. Tua ciangin Samuel in mi khempeuh amau’ inn ciatah a ciahsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Saul zong Gibeah-a ama inn-ah ciah a, Pasian in amau’ lungsim a lawnsak mi thahatte zong amah tawh a pai uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin bangmah a man lo mi pawlkhat in, “Hih mipa in eite hong bangci hotkhiat zawh ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Amaute in amah simmawhin ama kiangah letsong puak lo uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in tua mite bangmah cih lo hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ammon mi Nahash a galkapte tawh paito-in Jabeshgilead umcih hi. Jabesh mite in Nahash kiangah, “Kote tawh kilemna hong bawl in; nangma na kong sem ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.","title":"Saul in Ammon mite Zo"},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin Ammon mi Nahash in amaute kiangah, “Hih thu khat tawh note tawh kilemna ka bawl ding hi. Keimah in note’ taklam mittang khempeuh khelkhia-in Israel-te khempeuh tungah mindaina kong omsak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jabesh upate in ama kiangah, “Israel-te’ gam sung khempeuhah kamtaite ka sawltheih nadingun ni sagih sung a hun hong sot in. Tua ciangin kote hong honkhia ding kuamah a om kei le nang tungah kote kong kipia ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Saul’ khua Gibeah-ah kamtaite a tun uh ciangin amaute in mite kiangah a thu gen uh a, tua ciangin mi khempeuh a gingin kapkhia uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Saul a bawngtalte’ nung zui-in lo panin hong ciah hi. Saul in, “Amaute a kah nadingin bang in mite nasak ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Jabesh mite’ thute ama kiangah a gen uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in hih thute a zak ciangin Pasian’ kha in khauhtakin amah hanthawn a, nakpitakin a sin hong so hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in bawng leengkai kap khat la a, tuate go-in semnen a, kamtaite sawlin Israel gam khempeuhah khak a, “Saul le Samuel nung zui-in a kuankhia lo peuhmah a bawngtalte’ tungah hih bangin kihih ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciangin mite tungah Topa kihtakna hong tung a, mihing khat bangin amaute hong kuankhia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in Bezek-ah amaute a kaihkhop ciangin Israel mite tul zathum pha a, Judah mite tul sawmthum pha hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in a hong pai kamtaite kiangah, “Jabeshgilead mite tungah hih bangin gen un: ‘Zing ciang, sun hun ma-in note hong kihonkhia ding hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi. Kamtaite hong tungin Jabesh mite kiangah a gen uh ciangin amaute lungdam uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jabesh mite in Nahash kiangah, “Zing ciangin nang tungah kote kong kipia ding uh a, nangmah in hoih na sak bangbangin kote’ tungah nong hih ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A zing ciangin Saul in mite pawl thumin a khen hi. Tua ciangin amaute’ giahphual laizangah zingsang tungin hong pai uh a, sun nisat dong Ammon-te a satlum uh hi. A suakta mite kithehthang uh a, amaute mi nih nangawn a omkhopna om nawn lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin mite in Saul kiangah, ”‘Saul in eite hong uk ding hiam?’ a cite kua ahi hiam? Amaute i thah theih nadingin a mite hong paipih in,” a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin Saul in, “Tuni-in mi khat zong kithat lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tuni pen Topa in Israel-te hong hotkhiat ni ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in mite kiangah, “Hong pai un; Gilgal-ah pai-in kumpi dingin Saul kipsak phakik ni,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh Gilgal-ah pai uh a, tua lai mun Topa’ mai Gilgal-ah Saul kumpi-in a koih uh hi. Amaute in tua lai Topa’ mai-ah thunuama biakna pia uh a, Saul le Israel mite khempeuh tua lai-ah nakpitakin lungdam khawm uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in Israel-te khempeuh tungah, “En un, note in keima kiangah nong gen uh thu khempeuh ka hong mang a, note tungah kumpi khat ka koih khin hi.","title":"Mite tungah Samuel’ Thugenna"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in note’ makai pa pen kumpipa ahi hi. Keimah teekin ka sam kang ta a, ahi zongin note tawh ka tapate om hi. Ka neulai a kipan tuni dong note’ makai ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hih lai-ah ka om hi; ka mawhna a om leh Topa’ mai le a sathau nilh pa’ mai-ah ka mawhna hong pulak un. Kua’ bawngtal ka laksak hiam? Ahih kei leh kua’ la ka laksak hiam? Ahih kei leh kua khem ka hi hiam? Kua nengniam ka hi hiam? Ahih kei leh keima mit a tawsak dingin kua’ tung panin sumgolh la ngei ka hi hiam? Ka mawhna nong lah theih uhleh kong dinkik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, “Nangmah in kote nong khem kei a, zong nong nengniam kei a, mi khat peuhpeuh tung panin zong bangmah na la kei hi,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Note in kei tungah bangmah na muh lohna thu uh Topa pen note’ langkhatah teci hi a, ama sathau nilh pa zong tuni-in teci ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Hi mah hi; Topa, i teci ahi hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in mite kiangah, “Moses le Aaron teelin Egypt gam panin na pu na pate uh a paikhiatpih Topa, teci ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 6:26"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tuni-in note le na pu na pate uh a dingin Topa in hotkhiatna a sepna thu khempeuh Topa’ mai note’ tungah hong genin kong mawhsak theih nadingin ding lai dih un."},"8":{"text":"Egypt-ah Jakob pai-in Egypt-te in amaute a netniam uh ciangin Topa’ tungah na pu na pate uh kiko uh a, Egypt panin na pu na pate uh paikhiatpihin hih lai munah amaute a tengsak ahi Moses le Aaron, Topa in a puak hi.","ref":"Pai 2:23"},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in Topa a Pasian uh mangngilh uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in Hazor kumpipa Jabin’ galkap mangpa Sisera’ tung le Filistia-te tung le Moab kumpipa tungah amaute zuak a, hih mite in amaute sim uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 3:12; 4:2; 13:1"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa tungah amaute kiko uh a, ‘Kote ka khial khin uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa nusia-in Baal-te le Ashtaroth na ka sem uh hi. Ahih hangin tu-in ka galte uh khutsung panin kote hong honkhia in; nangma na kong sem ding uh hi,’ a ci uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:10-15"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Jerubbaal, Barak, Jefthah, le Samuel hong sawl a, na kiim khempeuh uha na galte uh khutsung panin note hong honkhia a, note lungmuang takin na om uh hi.","ref":"1Sam 3:20; Thkna 4:6; 7:1; 11:29"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin note a sim dingin Ammon kumpipa Nahash hong kuanna na muh uh ciangin, Topa na Pasian uh na kumpi uh hi napi-in note in kei kiangah, ‘Kumpi khat in kote hong uk ding hi,’ na ci uh hi.","ref":"1Sam 8:19"},"13":{"text":"“Tu-in note’ teelsa, note’ nget kumpipa en un; Topa in note’ tungah kumpi khat koih khinta hi."},"14":{"text":"Note in Topa zahtakin ama na sem a, ama aw ngai-in Topa’ thupiakna na langpan’ kei uh a, note a hong uk kumpipa le na Pasian uh na zuih uhleh thu hong nuam ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin note in Topa’ aw ngai loin Topa’ thupiakna na langpan’ uhleh Topa in note le na kumpipa uh hong langpan’ ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in taang loin ding unla, note’ muhna-ah Topa in a hih ding hih na lian en un."},"17":{"text":"Tuhun pen mangbuh lak laitak hi lo ahi hiam? Amah in vanging le guah hong puaktheih nadingin Topa’ tungah thu ka ngen ding hi. Note a dingin kumpi khat na ngetna uh hangin Topa’ muhna-ah na gamtatnasa na gitlohna uh a liatna thu thei-in na mu ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Samuel in Topa’ tungah thu ngen a, Topa in tua ni-in van gingsakin guah zusak hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in Topa le Samuel nakpitakin a zahtak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in Samuel kiangah, “Kote ka sih loh nadingun na nasemte a dingin Topa’ tungah thu ngen in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka khialhnasate uh banah kote a dingin kumpi khat ngenin ka khialhnate uh banah hih siatna ka behlap lailai uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samuel in mite kiangah, “Lau kei un; hih siatnate khempeuh na gamta khin uh hi. Saul in amah nakpitakin it a, amah pen a galhiam puapa a suak hi."},"22":{"text":"Saul in Jessi kiangah mi sawlin, “Keima nasepna-ah David hong omsak in. Amah ka pahtak mahmah mi khat ahi hi,” cisak hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian’ sawl kha gilo Saul’ tungah a om peuhmah ciangin David in a laiza la-in a khut tawh tum ahih ciangin Saul thaksuakin a ci dam a, ama kiang panin kha gilo kihemkhia hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Filistia-te in galsim dingin a galkapte uh khawmin Judah gam Sokoh-ah amaute kituah uh a, Sokoh le Azekah kikal Efesdammim-ah giahphual sat uh hi.","title":"David in Goliath That"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul le Israel mite kikhawmin Elah kuamah giahphual sat uh a, Filistia-te a do dingin kithawi uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Filistia-te a gal mualtungah ding uh a, Israel-te a galkhat mualtungah dingin, amaute’ kikalah kuam khat om hi."},"4":{"text":"Filistia-te’ giahphual panin Gath khuami Goliath a kici a makai, a tun pi kua val a sang mi khat hong paikhia hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in a lu tungah sumngo sik lukhu khu-in, sik puan tawh amah kithawi a, a puan gihna sumngo shekel tulnga ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in a khete tungah sumngo ngaltuam bulh a, a liangko-ah sumngo teipi khawh kikhai hi."},"7":{"text":"A teibul siam lawngpi cia bang pha a, a teipak sik shekel zaguk gik a, ama mai-ah a lum puapa a pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah dingin Israel uliante otsanin, “Galdo dingin bang hangin hong kuankhia ngam na hi uh hiam? I kido theih nadingin mi khat hong pia un,” cithuah lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Saul le Israel-te khempeuh in Filistia mipa’ kammalte a zak uh ciangin amaute lungkia-in nakpitakin a lau uh hi."},"12":{"text":"David pen Judah gam Bethlehem khua-a om Efrathah mi, tapa giat a nei Jessi min a nei pa’ tapa ahi hi. David in ama kampau a za hi."},"24":{"text":"Israel mite khempeuh in tua mipa a muh uh ciangin ama kiang panin taikhia uh a, lau mahmah uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel mite khatlekhat kiho-in, “Hih hong paikhia mipa na mu ngei uh hiam? David in tuate suahkhia hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a khutah a ciangkhut tawi-in, lui panin suangmai tang nga tengin a tuucin thungip sungah tuate koih hi. Nang tungah zi dingin kong pia ding hi. Kei a dingin hang peuh inla, Topa’ gal do in,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Saul in, “Keima khut sungah amah si loin Filistia-te’ khut sungah si hen,” ci-in ngaihsun hi."},"18":{"text":"David in Saul kiangah, “Kei pen kumpipa’ makpa ka hih nadingin kei, bang hi a, Israel-te tungah ka tanaute, ka pa’ innkuante bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin David’ tungah Saul’ tanu Merab a kipiak ding laitakin Meholah mi Adriel tungah a zi dingin kipia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in Saul’ tanu Mikhal in David ngai hi. Saul kiangah hih thu a kigen ciangin Saul a lungdam hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Ama a dingin ka tanu pen thangzak ahih theih nading le Filistia-te’ khut sungah a sihtheih nadingin ama tungah ka tanu pia ning,” ci-in ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul in David kiangah a nih veina genin, “Nang pen tu-in ka makpa na hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Saul in a nasemte thu pia a, “David kiangah thu tuam genpih unla, ‘En in, nang tungah kumpipa lungkim a, ama nasemte khempeuh in nang hong it hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kumpipa’ makpa suak in,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Saul’ nasemte in David kiangah hih thute gen uh hi. David in, “Kei pen mizawng hi-in a zahtakhuai lo ka hihna mu napi-in kumpipa’ makpa suah ding a thuneu sa na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul’ nasemte in ama kiangah, “Tua bang tua bangin David in gen hi,” a ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in, “David kiangah hih bangin na gen ding uh hi: ‘Kumpipa in a galte a thukkik theih nadingin Filistia-te’ zangteep zakhat cih simloh kumpipa in moman deih lo hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi. Tu-in Saul in Filistia-te’ khut tawh David sihsak ding ngaihsun hi."},"26":{"text":"Saul’ nasemte in David kiangah hih thute a gen uh ciangin kumpipa’ makpa ahih ding David a lungkim hi. A hun a bei ma-in,"},"27":{"text":"David dingin ama mite tawh pai a, Filistia mi zanih that hi. Tua ciangin amah kumpipa’ makpa a suahtheih nadingin kumpipa tungah a cingin a kipia amaute’ zangvun teepte David in hong paipih hi. Saul in a tanu Mikhal ama zi dingin a pia hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in David a ompihna le Israel-te khempeuh in amah a itna thu Saul in a muh ciangin"},"29":{"text":"David a kihta semsem hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul pen David’ gal hi tawntung hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante galsim dingin hong kuankhia uh a, amaute hong kuankhiat simin Saul’ nasem dangte khempeuh sangin David in a maa tunzaw hi. Tua ahih manin mite in David thupi muh semsem hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in David thah ding a ngaihsutna thu a tapa Jonathan le a nuai-a ulian khempeuh kiangah a gen hi. Ahih hangin Saul’ tapa Jonathan in David diksa mahmah hi.","title":"Saul in David Thah Sawm"},"2":{"text":"Jonathan in David kiangah, “Ka pa Saul in nang thah hong sawm hi. Tua ahih ciangin zingsang ciangin kidawm inla, mun simtham khatah omin bu in."},"3":{"text":"Kei paikhia-in nangma bukna phual nai-ah ka pa kiangah ka ding ding a, nangma thu ka pa kiangah ka gen ding hi. Ama tung panin phawk ka neih leh nang kiangah kong gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jonathan in a pa Saul kiangah David’ thu a hoihin genin ama kiangah, “Kumpipa, a nasempa David tungah khial kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tungah amah hong khial lo a, ama nasepnate nang a dingin nasep hoih ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in a nuntakna pia ngamin Filistia-pa that a, Topa in Israel-te khempeuh a dingin gualzawhna lianpi piangsak hi. Nangmah in hih thu na mu a, na lung a dam hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin thu om lopi-in David thahna tawh a mawhbaang lo mipa tungah khial ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in Jonathan’ thu mang hi. Saul kiciam a, “ Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin amah kithat lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in David samin, Jonathan in hih thute khempeuh ama tungah lak hi. Jonathan in Saul kiangah David paipih a, a nidanga mah bangin ama sepna ngei-ah a sem hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin gal hong omkik hi. David kuankhia-in Filistia-te tawh kido a, amaute tampi tak that a, ama mai-ah amaute a tai uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin a khut sungah a teipi tawi-in a inn sungah a tut laitakin Topa’ sawl kha gilo Saul’ tungah hong tung hi. David in a laiza lasakna tum hi."},"10":{"text":"Saul in a teipi-in kawm tawh David khawhcip dingin khawh a, ahih hangin amah in na pelh a, kawm tungah a teipi kiphut hi. Tua ciangin David tai-in a suakta hi."},"11":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin amah a thahtheih nadingin tua zanin Saul in amah a vil dingin David’ inn-ah mi sawl hi. Ahih hangin David’ zi Mikhal in ama kiangah, “Tuzanin na nuntakna na suahtak kei leh, zing ciangin nang hong kithat ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 59:1 Thulu"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Mikhal in tawlet-ah David khiasuk hi. Amah taikhia-in suakta hi."},"13":{"text":"Mikhal in milim khat la-in lupna tungah koih a, keelmul lukham khat a lu-ah koihin puan silhsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Saul in David a man dingin mi a paisak ciangin amah in, “Amah a ci na hi,” na ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in David a en dingin mi sawl a, “Amah ka thahtheih nadingin a lupna tawh kei kiangah amah hong puato un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"A mi sawlte hong tun ciangin, keelmul lukham a lu sanah omin lupna tungah a milim na om hi."},"17":{"text":"Saul in Mikhal kiangah, “Bang hangin tua bangin kei hong khem a, amah a suahtak nadingin ka gal pa khah na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Mikhal in Saul dawngin, “Amah in kei kiangah, ‘Hong paisak in; bang hangin nang hong that ding ka hi hiam?’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in David tai-in suakta a, Ramah-ah Samuel kiangah pai-in, ama tungah Saul’ hihna teng a gen hi. Tua ciangin amah le Samuel pai-in Naioth-ah om uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul kiangah, “En in, Ramah khuasung Naioth vengah David om hi,” kici hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin David a man dingin Saul in mi sawl hi. Amaute in kamsang honte laamin awngin omin, amaute a makai-in Samuel a ding a muh uh ciangin, Saul’ sawltakte tungah Pasian’ kha hong tung a, amaute zong laamin a awng uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Hih thu Saul kiangah a kigen ciangin, amah in midang sawl leuleu a, amaute zong laamin awng leuleu uh hi. Tua ciangin Saul in mi a thum veina sawl a, amaute zong tua bangmah hi veve uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin amahmah Ramah-ah pai a, Seku-a om tuikhuk lianpi tung hi. Amah in, “Samuel le David koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Mi khat in, “En in, Ramah khuasung Naioth vengah om uh hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua lai panin Ramah khuasung Naioth vengah amah pai hi. Ama tungah zong Pasian’ kha hong tung a, Ramah khuasung Naioth veng a tun mateng a paikawmin laamin awng hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in zong a puante suahkhia-in Samuel’ mai-ah laamin awng a, tua sun tawntung le tua zan tawntung a guaktangin a om hi. Tua hun a kipanin, “Saul zong kamsang suak khin ahi hiam?” kici hi.","ref":"1Sam 10:11-12"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ramah khuasung Naioth veng panin David tai-in, Jonathan kiangah hong tungin ama mai-ah, “Bang hih ka hi hiam?
