Amah in kei thah dingin hong zon nadingin na pa’ mai-ah ka khialhna bang om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.","title":"David le Jonathan’ Kilawmtatna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in David kiangah, “Tua bang hi het lo ding! Na si kei ding hi. En in, ka pa in kei kiangah gen loin a lian hitaleh a neu hitaleh bangmah hihlo hi; bang hangin ka pa in kei tungah hih thu hong im ding ahi hiam? Tua bang hi lo hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin David in dawngin, “Nangma nong pahtaklam na pa in teltakin thei hi. Tua ahih manin amah in, ‘Amah dah kha ding ahih manin hih thu Jonathan theisak kei ning,’ ci-in ngaihsun hi. Ahih hangin a taktakin, Topa nungta-in nang na nuntak mah bangin kei ka sih nading themkhat bek in sam hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, “Na gen peuhpeuh nang a dingin kong hihsak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"David in Jonathan kiangah, “En in, zing ciang pen Khadet ni hi a, kumpipa tawh sabuai-ah pel loin ka tut ding ahi hi. Ahih hangin a ni thum ni nitak dongin lo sungah ka buk theih nadingin kei hong paisak in.","ref":"Gam 28:11"},"6":{"text":"Na pa in kei hong kan leh, ‘David in ama khuapi Bethlehem-ah a va taipak dingin kei kiangah limtakin hong kingen hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau innkuan khempeuh a dingin kumsim biakpiakna tua lai-ah om hi,’ na ci ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Pha hi!’ a cih leh na nasempa a dingin a hoih hi ding hi; ahih hangin amah a heh leh amah in siatna a ngaihsutna thei in."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin thuman itna tawh na nasempa hong bawl in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tawh a siangtho thuciamna-ah na nasempa na tunpih hi. Ahih hangin kei sungah mawhna a om leh, nangmahmah in kei hong that in; bang hangin na pa kiangah kei hong paipih ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in, “Nang tungah tua bang hi het kei hen! Ka pa in nang tungah siatna tung ding a ngaihsutna thei leng nang kiangah hong gen lo ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Jonathan kiangah, “Na pa in nang hong ngawh dawn leh kua in kei kiangah hong gen ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jonathan in David kiangah, “Hong pai in, lo sungah pai ni,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau tegel lo sungah a pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, “Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa, teci hi ta hen! Zing ciang tubang hun ahi a, a ni thum ni-in ahi zongin, ka pa’ ngaihsutna tawng ka kankhiat khit ciangin, nangma tungah a lungsim a hoih leh, nang kiangah mi hong sawlin hong pulak lo ding ka hi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin nang tungah siatna bawl nading in ka pa a lungkimsak leh, a muanhuaina-ah nang na pai theih nadingin nang kiangah a thu kong pulak kei a, nang kong sawlkhiat kei taak leh Topa in keimah Jonathan hong dawm kei tahen. Topa in ka pa a ompih mah bangin nang zong hong ompih tahen."},"14":{"text":"Kei ka nuntak lai leh ka sih loh nadingin Topa’ thuman itna kei tungah hong lak in."},"15":{"text":"Keima innkuan panin na thumanna dokkik ngei kei in. Leitung maitang panin David’ galte khempeuh Topa in a phiatkhiat ciangin,","ref":"2Sam 9:1"},"16":{"text":"David’ innkuan panin Jonathan’ min phiatkhia kei in. Topa in David’ galte tungah phu la ta hen,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in amah a itna David tungah kiciampha kik hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama pumpi a it zahin amah in David a it hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in ama kiangah, “Zing ciang pen Khadet ni ahi hi. Na tutna awng ding ahih manin nang hong kiphawk ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in nakpitakin nang hong kiphawk kanzaw lai ding hi. A thu a kikup ciangin na bukna-ah pai inla, suangcian hua lampangah om in."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin muitum bangin tua lampangah thaltang thum ka lawn ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Naupang khat sawlin ama kiangah, ‘Pai in; thaltangte va zong in,’ ka ci ding hi. Naupang’ kiangah, ‘En in, nangma kiang hih lamah thaltangte om hi, tawm in,’ ka cih leh nang a hong pai ding na hi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin nang a dingin lungmuanhuai-in launa om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin tangvalpa kiangah, ‘En in, thaltangte nangma khen ah om hi,’ ka cih leh, nang paikhia in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in nang hong sawlkhia hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang le kei in i gen thu tawh kisai-in ahihleh, nang le kei kikalah Topa om tawntung hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin lo sungah David bu hi. Khadet ni hong tun ciangin an ne dingin kumpipa tu hi."},"25":{"text":"A nidanga bangin kawm gei-a a tutna tung, ama tutna-ah kumpipa tu hi. A kigalsai-in Jonathan tu-in, Saul’ pangah Abner tu a, ahih hangin David’ mun a awng hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin Saul in tua ni-in bangmah gen lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “Ama tungah thu khatpeuh piang hi ding hi; amah siang lo hi; siang lo taktak hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin a ni nih ni, Khadet ni khit a zing ciangin David’ mun awng lai hi. Tua ciangin Saul in a tapa Jonathan kiangah, “Bang hangin Jessi’ tapa zanni hitaleh tuni hitaleh an nekna-ah hong pai lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Jonathan in Saul dawngin, “Bethlehem-ah a pai dingin limtakin kei tungah David hong kingen hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Kei hong ciahsak in; ka innkuante un khua sungah biakpiakna bawl uh a, ka sanggampa in tua lai-ah ka om ding thu hong pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nong hehpihna-in hong paisakin ka sanggamte hong musak in,’ hong ci hi. Hih thu hangin kumpipa’ sabuai-ah amah hong pai lo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan tungah Saul heh mahmahin ama kiangah, “A kiheikhial, a lehdo numei’ tapa aw, nangma maizum nading le na nu’ mindai nadingin Jessi’ tapa na pawlpihna thu a thei lo hong sa na hi hiam?"},"31":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leitungah Jessi’ tapa a nuntak laiteng nang na hi a, na kumpi za ahi zongin kip lo ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin mi sawl inla, kei kiangah amah hong paipih in. Amah a si taktak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in a pa Saul dawngin, “Bang hangin amah kithat ding ahi hiam? Amah in bang hih ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahih hangin Saul in amah a khawhkha dingin ama lamah a teipi lawn hi. Tua ahih ciangin a pa in David thah ding a ngaihsutna Jonathan in theitel hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin heh mahmahna tawh sabuai panin Jonathan ding khia a, tua pawi a ni nih ni-in an ne lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pa in David minsiasak ahih manin ama hangin a dah hi."},"35":{"text":"A zing ciangin David tawh a kiciamna lo-ah Jonathan pai-in, amah tawh naupangno khat pai hi."},"36":{"text":"Amah in a naupang kiangah, “Tai inla ka thaltang lotte va tawm in,” a ci hi. Naupang a tai laitakin ama khen ah a thaltang khat lawn hi."},"37":{"text":"Jonathan’ thaltang lot a tukna munah naupang a tun ciangin Jonathan in a naupang samin, “Nang’ khen’ hua lamah thaltang om hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in naupang samin, “Manlang in; hong kinawh in; tua lai-ah om kei in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jonathan’ naupang pa in a thaltangte khawmin a topa kiangah a paipih hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahih hangin naupang in bangmah thei lo a, Jonathan le David bek in a thu thei uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in a hiamte a naupang pa kiangah pia-in ama kiangah, “Pai inla, khuapi sungah ciahpih in,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Naupang a paikhiat khit phetin suangcian pang panin David dingin lei-ah maipuk a, thumvei kun hi. Jonathan sangin David nakpitakin dahzaw a, amau khatlekhat kinamin, khitui luangin khatlekhat kikah uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, “Ei tegel Topa’ min tawh kiciamin, ‘Kei le nang kikal, le keima suanlekhakte le nangma suanlekhakte kikalah a tawntungin Topa om ding hi,’ i cih mah bangin nuamtakin pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah dingin paikhia a, Jonathan zong khuapi sungah a ciah hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nob khua-a siampipa Ahimelek kiangah David pai hi. Ahimelek a lingsa-in David a dawn dingin hong pai-in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin nang guak hong hi a, kuamah hong tonpih lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.","title":"Saul kiang pan David Tai"},"2":{"text":"David in siampi Ahimelek kiangah, “Kumpipa in na khat hong sawlin kei kiangah, ‘Nang kong sawlna le nang kong hilh thute khat zong kuamah theisak kei in,’ hong ci hi. Tua mun tua munah tangvalte tawh kiciamna khat ka bawlzo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang bang nei na hi hiam? Anlum lum nga ahih kei leh hih lai-a a om peuhpeuh hong pia in,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Siampipa in David dawngin, “Tutakin anlum mawkmawk ka nei kei hi; ahih hangin anlum siangtho om hi; tangvalte numei panin a kikep nak-uhleh la in,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in siampipa dawngin, “A taktakin ci lehang, hih bangin ka paikhiat uh ciangin numeite kiang panin kote ka kikem tawntung uh hi. Khualzin mawkmawk ciang nangawnin zong tangvalte siangtho hi. Tuni-in amaute bangzahin siangthozaw kan ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin siampipa in anlum siangtho amah pia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh anlum dang om lo a, a kilakkhiat ni-in anlum a lum lai tawh a kilaih pah ding, Topa’ mai panin a kilakhia Ompihna Anlum bek om hi.","ref":"Mat 12:3-4; Mrk 2:25-26; Luk 6:3; Siam 24:5-9"},"7":{"text":"Tua laitakin Topa’ mai-ah biakna vai-in a om, Saul’ nasemte mi khat tua lai-ah na omkha hi. Ama min Doeg hi a, Saul’ gancing makai pa hi a, Edom mi ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Ahimelek kiangah, “Teipi ahi a, namsau ahi zongin hih lai-ah nei lo na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa’ nasep pen nawhtat ding kul ahih manin ka namsau ahi a, ka hiamte ahi zongin ka la man kei hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Siampipa in, “Elah kuamah na thah Filistia mi Goliath’ namsau, puan tawh kitunin hih lai-ah siampipuan nungah om hi. Tua na deih leh la in. Bang hang hiam cih leh adang om lo a, tua bek hih lai-ah om hi,” a ci hi. David in, “Tua sanga hoihzaw adang om lo hi; kei hong pia in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 17:51"},"10":{"text":"David dingin tua ni-in Saul kiang panin tai a, Gath kumpipa Akhish kiangah pai hi."},"11":{"text":"Akhish’ nasemte in ama kiangah, “Hih David, a gam kumpipa hi lo ahi hiam? Amaute khatlekhat in ama thu la-in sa-in laam uh a, ‘Saul in a tulin that, David in a tul sawmin that,’ ci hi lo ahi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.","ref":"1Sam 18:7; 29:5"},"12":{"text":"David in hih thute a lungsimah ciamteh a, Gath kumpipa Akhish kihta mahmah hi.","ref":"La 56:1 Thulu"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute’ mai-ah a gamtat kheelin, amaute’ muhna-ah a hai-in kibawl a, kulhkongkhakte tung kui gawpin, a khamul tungah a cilphuan kaisuksak hi.","ref":"La 34:1 Thulu"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Akhish in a nasemte kiangah, “En un, hih mipa a hai ahihlam na mu uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin kei kiangah amah hong paipih na hi uh hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Ka omna-ah mihai-a gamta dingin hih mipa nong paipih nadingun mihai kisam thuah lai ka hi hiam? Hih mipa ka inn sungah hong pai ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David tua lai panin kihemkhia-in Adullam leihawmah tai hi. A sanggamte le a pa’ innkuante khempeuh in a zak uh ciangin ama kiang tua lai munah paisuk uh hi.","ref":"La 57 Thulu; 142 Thulu"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin a lungkham mi khempeuh, leiba a nei mi khempeuh, le a lungkim lo mite khempeuh ama kiangah hong kikhawm uh hi. Amah pen amaute tungah a ukpa a suak hi. Tua lai-ah amah tawh mihing zali bang a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua lai mun panin Moab gam Mizpah-ah David a pai hi. Amah in Moab kumpipa kiangah, “Pasian in kei a dingin hong sepsak ding ka theih matengin ka nu le ka pa na kiangah hong omsak in, ci-in kong thum hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in Moab kumpipa kiangah amaute nusia a, munmuanhuaina sungah David a om sungteng amah tawh omkhawm uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsangpa Gad in David kiangah, “Munmuanhuai sungah om nawn kei in; kihem inla, Judah gamah pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David kihemkhia-in Hereth tulakah a pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in David le amah tawh a om mite a kimuhna thu Saul in za hi. A khut sungah a teipi tawi-in, a nasemte khempeuh a kimkotah dingin Gibeah khua a sangna mun makeng kung nuai-ah Saul a tu hi.","title":"Saul in Nob khua Siampite That"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in a kimkotah a ding a nasemte kiangah, “Tu-in za un, no Benjamin-te aw; Jessi’ tapa in note khempeuh’ lote le leenggui lote hong pia-in, note khempeuh a tul a uk, a za a ukin hong koih dingin um a,"},"8":{"text":"note khempeuh in kei hong sawmsim na hi uh hiam? Tuni-a bangin hong pangsim dingin ka tapa in Jessi’ tapa tawh thukimna a bawl ciangin kuamah in kei kiangah hong pulak loin, ka tapa in keimah a do dingin ka nasempa a hanthotna-ah note kuamah dah loin, kei kiangah zong nong pulak kei uh hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul’ nasemte’ kiangah a ding, Edom mi Doeg in dawngin, “Ahitub’ tapa Amalek’ kiang, Nob khua-ah Jessi’ tapa a pai ka mu a,"},"10":{"text":"amah in ama a dingin Topa’ tungah thu dotsakin, anletui pia a, Filistia mi Goliath’ namsau ama tungah pia hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 21:7-9; La 52 Thulu"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ahitub’ tapa siampi Ahimelek le a pa’ innkuante ahi Nob-a om siampi khempeuh a sam dingin mi sawl a, kumpipa kiangah amaute khempeuh hong pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in, “Ahitub’ tapa aw, tu-in za in,” a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, “Hih lai-ah om ing, topa aw,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in ama kiangah, “Tuni-a bangin hong pangsimin kei a do dingin hong kipat theih nadingin bang hangin nang le Jessi’ tapa in kei hong sawmsim a, ama tungah an le namsau pia-in, ama a dingin Pasian kiangah thu dotsak na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ahimelek in kumpipa dawngin, “Na nasemte khempeuh lak panin kumpipa’ makpa ahi nangmah hong cingte a ukpa David bangin kua thumanin, na inn sungah kua kipahtawi ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Ama a dingin Pasian’ kiangah thu ka dotsak a masa pen tuni ahi hiam? Hilo hi. Kumpipa in a nasempa ahi a, ka pa’ innkuante khempeuh ahi zongin ngawh kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasempa in a tam hitaleh a tawm hitaleh hih thu khempeuh bangmah thei lo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Ahimelek aw, nang le na pa’ innkuante na si taktak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama kiimah a ding a cingte kiangah, “Kihei unla Topa’ siampite that un; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute zong David tawh pangkhawm uh a, amaute in ama tailam thei napi-in kei kiangah hong pulak lo uh hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin kumpipa’ nasemte in Topa’ siampite tung a tu dingin a khut uh taangkhiasak lo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Doeg kiangah, “Kihei inla, siampite hih in,” a ci hi. Edom mi Doeg kihei-in siampite hih a, tua ni-in saihadial siampipuan a silh mihing sawmgiat le nga a that hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in siampite’ khuapi Nob khua sunga om nuntakna a nei khempeuh numei le pasal, naupang le nawine, bawngtalte, late le tuute, namsau tawh a that khin hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin Ahitub’ tapa Ahimelek’ tapate lakah Abiathar a kici khat suakta-in David kiangah a tai hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in Topa’ siampite a thah khitna thu Abiathar in David kiangah a gen hi."},"22":{"text":"David in Abiathar kiangah, “Tua ni-in Doeg tua lai-ah om ahih ciangin Saul’ kiangah gen taktak ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Na pa’ innkuanpih mite khempeuh’ sihna ka piangsakkha hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei tawh hong om in; lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh kei a that dingin a hong zongte in nang zong thah dingin a hong zong ahi hi; kei kiangah om lecin lungmuanna sunga om na hi ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in amaute in David kiangah, “En in, Filistia-te in Keilah khua sim uh a, a ancilnate uh luh uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.","title":"David in Keilah khuamite Honkhia-in Gamlakah Om"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David in Topa thu dongin, “Pai-in Filistia-te ka sim ding hiam?” a ci hi. Topa in David kiangah, “Pai-in Filistia-te sim inla, Keilah khuamite honkhia in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin David’ mite in ama kiangah, “En in, Judah gam hih munah eite i lau hi. Filistia galkapte simin Keilah-ah pai lehang bangzahin lauzaw ding ihi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Topa thu dongkik hi. Topa in amah dawngin, “Ding in; Keilah-ah paisuk in; bang hang hiam cih leh na khut sungah Filistia-te kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin David le a mite Keilah-ah paisuk uh a, Filistia-te tawh kido-in amau’ ganhingte ciahpihin amaute tampi tak a that uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in Keilah-a teng mite a honkhia hi."},"6":{"text":"David kiang Keilah-ah Ahimelek’ tapa Abiathar a tai lai-in amah in siampipuan khat kengin paisuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Keilah-ah David a tunkhitna thu tu-in Saul kiangah kigen hi. Saul in, “Pasian in ka khut sungah amah hong pia khin hi; bang hang hiam cih le kulhkongpi le a kalhna zawl a nei khua sungah lutna tawh amahmah kikhaknelh hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in galsim ding, Keilah khua-ah a paisuk ding, David le a mite a umcih dingin mi khempeuh a sam hi."},"9":{"text":"Saul in ama tungah a sia a sawmna David in thei hi. Amah in a siampi Abiathar kiangah, “Hih lai-ah siampipuan hong paipih in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in, “Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa aw, keima hangin khuapi susia dingin Saul in Keilah-ah pai hong sawmna thu na nasempa in za khin taktak hi."},"11":{"text":"Keilah mite in ama tungah kei hong ap ding hiam? Na nasempa’ zak bangin Saul hong paisuk ding hiam? Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa aw, kong thum hi, na nasempa tungah hong gen in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, “Amah hong paisuk ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in, “Keilah mite in kei le ka mite Saul’ tungah hong ap ding uh hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, “Amaute in note hong ap ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi zaguk bang a pha, David le a mite dingin Keilah panin kihemkhia uh a, amaute a pai theihna peuhpeuh uhah pai uh hi. Keilah panin David a suahtakna thu Saul kiangah a kigen ciangin amah in a vai a khawl phot hi."},"14":{"text":"Zif gamlak mualtung gam sung, gamlak munmuanhuaina-ah David om hi. Saul in nisimin amah zong a, ahih hangin Pasian in ama tungah David pia lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah a that dingin Saul kuankhia khin ahih manin David a lau hi. Zif gamlak Horesh munah David om hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul’ tapa Jonathan dingin David kiang Horesh-ah pai a, Pasian in hong huh ding hi, ci-in amah a hanthawn hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in David kiangah, “Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa Saul in nang hong sukhalo ding hi. Nang pen Israel-te tungah kumpi na hi ding a, kei pen nangma zom ka hi ding hi; ka pa Saul in zong hih thu thei hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amau tegel in Topa’ mai-ah thuciamna bawl uh hi. Horesh-ah David om lai-in, Jonathan a inn-ah a ciah hi.","ref":"1Sam 18:3"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul’ kiang Gibeah-ah Zif mite paito uh a, “Jeshimon leitaw lam, Hakhilah mualtung, Horesh a munmuanhuai sung kote’ lakah David om hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"La 54 Thulu"},"20":{"text":"Tu-in hong paisuk in, kumpipa aw; amah na matnopna thu thei ka hih manun hong paisuk in. Kote’ hih ding ahihleh kumpipa tungah amah kong ap ding uh ahi hi,” a ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in, “ Topa in note thupha hong pia ta hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh note in kei tungah hehpihna nong nei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Pai-in va kiciansak lai un. Ama bukna mun thei-in va mu unla, tua lai-ah kua in mu hiam, hong thei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah ngiansiam mahmah hi, ci-in kei tungah hong kigen hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah a bukna, a kiselsimna mun khempeuh hong ciamteh unla, thu a kiteltak tawh kei kiangah hong paikik un. Tua ciangin note tawh kei kong kuan ding hi. Gam sungah amah a omlai nakleh , Judah gam sung khempeuh zon ding ahi zongin a tul lak panin amah ka zongkhia teitei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute ding uh a, Zif-ah a pai dingin Saul’ mai-ah a na ma pai uh hi. Tu-in David le a mite Jeshimon leitaw lam Arabah gam sung Maon gamlakah om uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Saul le a mite amah a zong dingin kuan uh hi. Hih thu David kiangah kigen hi. Tua ahih ciangin Maon gamlak a om suangpi-ah amah paisuk hi. Saul in tua thu a zak ciangin amah in Maon gamlakah David delh hi."},"26":{"text":"A mualpang khatah Saul pai a, David le a mite a mualpang langkhatah pai uh hi. Saul le a mite in David le a mite a man dingin hong um uh ahih manin Saul a pelh dingin David a nawhtai laitakin,"},"27":{"text":"Saul kiangah kamtai khat hong tung a, “Hong kinawh inla hong ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh Filistia-te in gam sung hong sim hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David a delhna panin Saul kileh kik a, Filistia-te a do-in a pai hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun pen Kikhenna Mual kici hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua lai panin David paito-in Engedi munmuanhuai-ah a om hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistia-te a delhna panin Saul a ciah ciangin ama kiangah, “En in, Engedi gamlakah David om hi,” ci-in kigen hi.","title":"David in Engedi-ah Saul Suaktasak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in Israel-te khempeuh sung pan a kiteel mihing tulthum la-in Sathak Suangpi mai-ah David le a mite a zong dingin a pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Lam gei-a tuukhawk omna-ah a pai hi. Tua gei-ah leihawm khat om a, awng hawh dingin tua sungah Saul a pai hi. Tu-in David le a mite tua leihawm tawngnung sungah na tu uh hi.","ref":"La 57 Thulu; 142 Thulu"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin David’ mite in ama kiangah, “ Topa in nang kiangah, ‘En in, na khut sungah na gal pa kong pia ding a, hoih na sak bangin ama tungah na hih ding hi,’ hong cih pen tuni hita hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin David dingin Saul’ puantualpi mong atkhiatsak sim hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in Saul’ puanmong a atkhiat manin David a lungsim nuamthei nawn lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in a mite kiangah, “Amah pen Topa’ sathau nilh pa hi, ci-in a thei gegupi-in ama tungah ka khut ka ngak ding, Topa’ sathau nilh pa ahi ka topa tungah hih bang ka hih ding Topa in hong kham hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 26:11"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David in hih thute tawh a mite zol a, amaute Saul hihsak lo hi. Tua ciangin Saul ding khia-in leihawm nusia a, a pai nading lampi-ah a paisuak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin David zong leihawm sung panin paikhia-in Saul nung sap a, “Ka to kumpipa!” a ci hi. Saul in a nung a et ciangin David in lei-ah a mai kunin zahtakna a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Saul kiangah, “Bang hangin, ‘En in, David in na siat nading zong hi,’ a ci mite’ thu um na hi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"En in, Topa in tuni-in leihawm sung, ka khut sungah nang hong piakna nangmahmah in tuni-in na thei khin hi. Mi pawlkhat in nang a that dingin kei hong sawl a, ahih hangin nang kong hih kei hi. Keimah in, ‘Ka topa tungah ka khut ka nga kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah pen Topa’ sathau nilh pa ahi hi,’ ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"En in, ka pa aw, ka khutsunga na puantualpi mong en in. Kei tungah khialhna ahi a, kumpi dona ahi zongin a om lohna, na puantualpi mong atkhia napi-in nang kong thahlohna thu tawh thei-in na mu ding hi. Kei thah dingin nong zon hangin nang tungah ka khial kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in kei le nang kikalah thu hong khen tahen. Topa in kei tangin nang tungah hong thuk tahen. Ahih hangin keima khut tawh nang kong hih kei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tang-ate’ paunak in, ‘A gilote’ sung panin gitlohna hong piang,’ a cih mah bang ahi hi. Ahih hangin keima khut tawh nang kong hih kei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel kumpipa kua do-a hong kuankhia ahi hiam? Kua delh na hi hiam? Uisi maw! Uili maw!","ref":"1Sam 26:20"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa thukhen hong hi-in, kei le nang kikalah thukhenna hong pia hen la, hih thu thei-in ka thu-ah hong pang hen la, na khutsung panin kei hong honkhia ta hen,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"David in hih thute Saul kiangah a gen a man khit ciangin Saul in, “Ka tapa David, tu-a ka zak nang’ aw ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Saul a kap hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in David kiangah, “Nang pen kei sangin na thuman zaw hi. Keimah in nang tungah a sia kong bawl laitakin nang in kei tungah a pha nong bawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in na khut sungah kei hong koih laitakin nang in kei nong thah lohna-ah kei nong limbawlna tu-in na hong laktel hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh in a gal pa mu leh amah in a suakta-in a gal pa paikhiasak ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin tuni-in kei tungah nong bawlna hangin Topa in a hoih tawh nang thaman hong pia tahen."},"20":{"text":"Tu-in en in, kumpi na hih taktak ding ka thei hi. Israel kumpi gam nangma khut sungah a kip ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin keima nunga ka suanlekhakte beisak loin, ka pa’ innkuan panin ka min na phiat loh nadingin Topa’ min tawh kei tungah hong kiciam in,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul’ deih bangin David a kiciam hi. Tua ciangin Saul a inn-ah a ciah hi. Ahih hangin David le a mite munmuanhuai-ah paito uh hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Samuel si a, Israel-te khempeuh kikhawmin ama hangin kap uh a, amaute in Ramah-a a inn-ah amah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin Paran gamlakah David paisuk hi.","title":"David le Abigail"},"2":{"text":"Karmel mualah nasep a nei mi khat Maon khua-ah a om hi. Tua pa hau mahmah a, amah in tuu tulthum le keel tulkhat nei hi. Amah in Karmel-ah a tuumul a met hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua mipa’ min Nabal hi a, a zi’ min Abigail ahi hi. Tua numei, tei le melhoih a thuah khat hi a, ahih hangin a pasal pen a ki-uk zo lo mi le a gamtatsia khat hi a, amah Kaleb mi ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nabal in a tuumul a metna thu David in gamlakah a za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David in a tangvalte sawm sawl hi. David in a tangvalte kiangah, “Karmel-ah paito-in Nabal kiangah pai unla, keima min tawh amah va hopih un."},"6":{"text":"Hih bangin amah na hopih ding uh hi: ‘Nang tungah nopna om ta hen, na innkuan tungah nopna om ta hen, na neih khempeuh tungah zong nopna om tahen."},"7":{"text":"Gan mul mette na neihna ka za hi. Na tuucingte kote tawh omin amaute tungah siatna ka bawl kei uh a, Karmel-ah a om sungteng uh amaute in bangmah mansuah lo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Na tangvalte uh dong lecin amaute in nang kiangah hong genthei ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka tangvalte maipha na musak in; bang hang hiam cih leh pawi ni-in kong pai uh hi. Na neih sung pan nong piak theih peuhpeuh na nasemte le na tapa David tungah pia in,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tangvalte hong tun ciangin amaute in hih thu khempeuh David’ minin Nabal kiangah gen uh a, tua ciangin amaute in ngak uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nabal in David’ nasemte dawngin, “David kua ahi hiam? Jessi’ tapa kua ahi hiam? Tulai-in a tote kiang panin a taikhia nasem tampi om hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka anlum le ka tui le ka gan mul meette a dingin ka gawh ka sate la-in koilai panin hong pai cih ka theih loh mite tungah pia ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David’ tangvalte ciahkikin hih thu khempeuh ama kiangah a gen uh hi."},"13":{"text":"David in a mite kiangah, “Mi khempeuh in na namsau uh kuah ciat un!” a ci hi. Amaute khempeuh in a namsau uh kuah uh a, David in zong a namsau a kuah hi. Mihing zali bang David’ nungah paito uh a, mihing za nihte van ngakin om uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin Nabal’ nasem tangvalte khat in Nabal’ zi Abigail kiangah thu genin, “En in, ka topa uh a hopih dingin gamlak panin David in kamtaite hong paisak a, amah in amaute na tai hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin kote tungah tua mite hoih mahmahin kote in siatna ka thuak kei uh a, amaute tawh ka pai laiteng uh gamlakah ka om sungun bangmah ka mansuah kei uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuute kemin amaute tawh ka omsung khempeuh uh sun le zanin amaute in kote hong hu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hih thu thei inla, na hih ding ngaihsun in. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka topa le a innkuan khempeuh tungah siatna tunsak ding kingaihsun a, amah a khansia ahih manin kuamah in hopih thei lo hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Abigail kinawhin, anlum lum zanih, leenggahzu savun thawl nih, a han’ minsa tuu nga, ankan lawh nga, leenggahkeu bawk zakhat, le theimoh zanih la-in late tungah tuate a guang hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua nu in a tangvalte kiangah, “Keima mai-ah na paisuak un; note’ nungah kei kong pai ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in a pasal Nabal hilh lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah la tungah tuangin mual liahah a paisuk laitakin, en in, David le a mite ama lamah hong paisuk uh hi; amah in amaute na dawn hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in David in, “Ama neihsa khempeuh khat zong a mangthang lo dingin hih mipa’ neih khempeuh gamlakah a mawkna-in ka cing a, amah in hih thuhoihte a sia tawh kei tungah hong thuk hi."},"22":{"text":"Zing ciangin ama neihsa khempeuh lakah pasal khat zong ka siit taak leh Pasian in keimah David hong dawm kei ta hen,” na ci khin hi."},"23":{"text":"Abigail in David a muh ciangin kinawh a, a la tung panin tuakin David’ mai-ah puk a, leilakah a kun hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama khe phungah pukin, “Kei tung bekah, ka topa aw, mawhna om tahen. Na kiangah na nasemnu thu hong gensak inla, na nasemnu’ thugente hong ngai in, ci-in kong thum hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka topa in hih a khansia mipa Nabal ngaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh ama min mah bangin amah zong a tuaci mah ahi hi. Nabal ama min hi a, haina in amah vukcip hi. Ahih hangin na nasemnu keimah in nangma hong sawl na tangvalte ka mukha kei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, ka topa aw, Topa nungta-in, nang zong na nuntak mah bangin, mi na thahloh nading le nangma khut tawh thukkikna na hihloh nadingin Topa in nang hong kho ahih manin, tu-in na galte le nangma tungah siat nading a zongte khempeuh Nabal bang tahen."},"27":{"text":"Tu-in na nasemnu keimah in nangmah ka hong puak hih letsong nangma nung hong zui tangvalte hong piasak in."},"28":{"text":"Na nasemnu’ khialhna hong maisak in, ci-in kong thum hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in Topa’ galte do na hih manin Topa in na suanlekhakte kipsak paisuak ding a, na nuntak laiteng nang sungah siatna kimu lo ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Nangmah delhin hong that dingin mite hong kipat leh, nang pen Topa na Pasian’ kepna sung a hing mite lakah na om ding a, amah in suanglotna tawh lotkhiat bangin na galte lawnkhia ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in nangmah tawh kisai thu a hoih a gente khempeuh tawh kizui-in hong hihin, Israel-te tungah ulianin nang hong koih khit ciangin,"},"31":{"text":"thu om lopi-in mi thahna ahi a, nangmahmah in phulakna hangin ahi zongin, dah nading thu ahi a, lungsim nat nading thu ahi zongin na nei kei ding hi. Topa in limtakin nang hong bawl ciangin na nasemnu hong phawk in,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Abigail kiangah, “Tuni-in keimah a dawn dingin nang a hong sawl Israel-te’ Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen!"},"33":{"text":"Tuni-in mi thahna le keima khut tawh phulak nading panin keimah hong kem nangma ngaihsutna in thupha ngah ta hen!"},"34":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang kong gimsak nading panin hong kho Israel Pasian, Topa a nungta taktak ahih mah bangin, nang hong kinawhin keimah a dawn dingin hong pai lo hi lecin, zing ciangin Nabal sung pan pasal khat zong hing nawn lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in ama tung panin amah a puakte a sang hi. Amah in tua nu kiangah, “Lung nuamin na inn-ah ciahto ta in. Na thu ka ngai a, nong thumna kong pia khin hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nabal kiangah Abigail hong tungkik hi. Kumpipa’ pawi tawh kibangin amah in a inn sungah pawi na kham hi. Nabal lungnuam mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in zu kham mahmah hi. Amaute in Jabesh-ah tunpihin tua lai-ah a hal uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in a guhte la-in Jabesh khuasung makeng kung nuai-ah vui uh a, ni sagih sung an a tang uh hi."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"Samuel Nihna","shortname":"2Sa","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel Masa Laibu tawh a thu a kizom hi a, David in kumpi za tawh Judah gam sung a uk masakna (a lian 1-4) leh leilu lama om Israel mite kihelin Israel minam khempeuh a ukna (a lian 5-24) thu ahi hi. Nang in amah sawlkhia-in amah a ciahkhiat khitna bang thu ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Nang hong khem ding, na pusuahna le na sungtumna a thei ding, le na hihna khempeuh a thei dingin Ner’ tapa Abner’ hong paina na thei hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"David’ omna panin Joab a paikhiat ciangin, amah in Abner’ nungah kamtaite sawl a, amaute in Sirah Tuibeem panin amah hong paipih kik uh hi. Ahih hangin David in tua thu thei lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Hebron-ah Abner hong paikik ciangin, Joab in amah tawh a kituam ho dingin kulhkongpi pamah paikhiatpih a, a sanggampa Asahel’ phulakna-in amah in a gil sun a, tua ciangin a si hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua khit, David in tua thu a zak ciangin amah in, “Ner’ tapa Abner a kithahna hangin Topa’ mai-ah keimah le ka kumpi gam, a tawntungin mawhbaang lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Joab lu tung le ama innkuante khempeuh tungah tu ta hen! Joab’ innkuante nin paikhia a nei mi ahi a, a phak mi ahi a, ciangkhut khun mi ahi a, namsau tawh a kithat mi ahi a, annek ding a nei lo mi tawh ahi zongin kilawi ngei kei ta hen!” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua bangin Joab le a sanggampa Abishai in Abner that uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Gibeon-a galkidona-ah a sanggampa uh Asahel thahsak hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Joab le amah tawh a om mi khempeuh kiangah, “Na puan uh balkekin puanhampi silh unla, Abner’ mai-ah kap un,” a ci hi. Kumpipa David in hankuang a zui hi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute in Hebron-ah Abner vui uh a, Abner’ hanah kumpipa a kap hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh zong a kap uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Abner’ hangin kumpipa in kah la-in, “Mi hai pa a sih bangin Abner si ding ahi hiam?"},"34":{"text":"Na khutte kihen lo a, na khete kol kibulh lo hi. Mi gilote’ thah bangin nang na si hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh ama hangin kap kik uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin ni a omlai-in an ne dingin David a zol dingin mi khempeuh hong pai uh a, ahih hangin David kiciamin, “Ni a tum matengin an ahi a, na khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin ka ciap taak leh Pasian in kei hong dawm kei ta hen!” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in tua thu thei uh a, tua in amaute lungdamsak hi. Kumpipa’ sep khempeuh in mi khempeuh lungdamsak hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Ner’ tapa Abner thah ding kumpipa’ deihna ahih lohlam tua ni-in mi khempeuh le Israel-te khempeuh in thei uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a nasemte kiangah, “Tuni-in Israel-te sungah ulian ahi milian khat a tukna thei lo na hi uh hiam?"},"39":{"text":"Sathau kinilh kumpipa hinapi-in tuni-in ka tha a nem hi. Zeruiah’ ta hih mite kei a dingin haksa lua hi. Gamtatsia pa a gitlohna bangin Topa in thuk ta hen!” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul’ tapa Ishbosheth in Hebron-ah Abner a sihna thu a zak ciangin a tha kiam a, Israel-te khempeuh lungkia hi.","title":"Ishbosheth A Kisuamlupna"},"2":{"text":"Saul’ tapa in galsim pawlte a makai mi nih nei hi. Khat pa’ min Baanah hi-in, adang khat pa’ min Rekhab hi a, Beeroth khua pan Benjamin mi Rimmon’ tapate ahi uh hi. (Bang hang hiam cih leh Beeroth zong Benjamin a’ in kisim hi."},"3":{"text":"Beeroth mite Gittaim-ah tai uh a, tuni dongin tua lai-ah peemta-in om uh hi.)"},"4":{"text":"Saul’ tapa Jonathan in a khezaw tapa khat nei hi. Jezreel panin Saul le Jonathan’ thu hong tunin amah kum nga pha hi. Amah a cingnu in amah la-in taipih a, tua nu a nawhtaina lamin naupang kia-in a khe zaw hi. Ama min Mefibosheth ahi hi.","ref":"2Sam 9:3"},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Beeroth mi Rimmon’ tapate Rekhab le Baanah ding khia uh a, sun nisat hun pawlin Ishbosheth’ inn-ah a sun tawlngak laitakin hong tung uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Inn kongcing nu mangbuh a su khin hi a, a lusuk suakin ihmu hi. Tua ahih ciangin Rekhab le a sanggampa Baanah simlut uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute inn sungah a tun uh ciangin a lupna deisung a lupna tungah Ishbosheth lumin a om laitakin amaute in amah satin that uh a, a lu tan uh hi. Amaute in ama lu la-in Arabah lam tawnin zan tawntung pai uh a,"},"8":{"text":"Ishbosheth’ lutang Hebron-a David’ kiang tunpih uh hi. Topa in tuni-in Saul le a suanlekhakte tungah kote’ to kumpipa a dingin hong thuksak hi,” a ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin David in Beeroth mi Rimmon’ tapate Rekhab le a sanggampa Baanah dawngin, “Haksatna khempeuh panin ka nuntakna hong honkhia Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin,"},"10":{"text":"mi khat in kei kiangah, ‘En in, Saul si hi,’ ci-in hong gen ciangin, amah thuhoih puakin kingaihsun a, ama thu puak thaman ka piakna-in amah manin Ziklag-ah ka that hi.","ref":"2Sam 1:1-16"},"11":{"text":"Migilote in a thuman mi khat ama innsung a lupna tungah a thah ciangin note’ tungah ama phu hong la-in, leitung panin note hong susiazaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in a tangvalte thu pia a, tangvalte in amaute thatin a khut le a khete sattan uh a, Hebron-a bual gei-ah amaute khai uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in Ishbosheth’ lutang la-in Hebron-a Abner’ hanah a vui uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel minamte khempeuh Hebron-a David kiangah hong pai-in, “En in, kote pen nangma guh le nangma sa ka hi uh hi.","title":"Israel Kumpi-in David Kikoih (1Khang 11:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"A beisa hunte-ah, kote tungah Saul kumpi ahih laitakin Israel-te kuan khiatpihin a ciahpih pa pen nangmah na hi hi. Topa in nangma kiangah, ‘Nang pen keima mi Israel-te a cing pa hi-in, Israel-te tungah ulian na hi ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel upate khempeuh Hebron-a kumpipa kiangah hong pai uh hi. Kumpipa David in amaute tawh Topa’ mai Hebron-ah thuciamna khat bawl a, amaute in Israel-te tungah kumpi-in David sathau a nilh uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Gam uk dingin a kipatin David kum sawmthum pha a, amah in kum sawmli sung uk hi."},"5":{"text":"Hebron panin kum sagih le kha guk sung Judah gam sung uk a, Jerusalem panin kum sawmthum le thum sung Israel-te khempeuh le Judah gam a uk hi.","ref":"1Kum 2:11; 1Khang 3:4; 29:27"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa le a mite tua gam a teng Jebus mite a sim dingin Jerusalem-ah pai uh a, amaute in David kiangah, “Kote nong zo vet kei ding hi; mittaw le khebaite nangawn in nang hong notkhiazo ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. “Hih lai-ah David hong paizo peuhmah lo ding hi,” ci-in ngaihsun uh hi.","title":"David in Zion La (1Khang 11:4-9)","ref":"Josh 15:63; Thkna 1:21"},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin David in kumpipa’ khua ahi Zion munmuanhuai la hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in tua ni-in, “Jebus mite a vatgawp nuam peuhmah, keimah David in ka muhdah zahin a mudah mi peuhmah, tua khebaite le mittawte a sim dingin tuizawl dungah pai ta hen,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin, “Mittawte le khebaite Topa’ inn sungah lut lo ding hi,” kici hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin munmuanhuai sungah David tengin David khuapi ci-in min a phuak hi. Tua ciangin David in Millo panin biakinn lamah khuapi lam hi."},"10":{"text":"David lian semsem hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Pasian, Topa in amah ompih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Taia kumpipa Hiram in kamtaite le taamtak singte, le David a dingin inn khat a lamsak khutsiamte, le leilesuang innlam a siamte zong a puak hi.","title":"Hiram in David a Theihna (1Khang 14:1-2)"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Israel-te’ tungah kumpi-in Topa in amah a kipsak khitna le Israel mite’ hangin ama kumpi gam a liatsakna a phawktel hi."},"13":{"text":"Hebron panin hong tun khit ciangin David in Jerusalem panin zineute le zite lathuah lai a, David’ tanute le tapate piangthuah lai hi.","title":"Jerusalem-ah David’ Tate Suak (1Khang 3:5-9 ; 14:3-7)"},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem-ah a neih a tate’ min: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"15":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"16":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada, le Elifelet ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel-te tungah kumpi-in David sathau a kinilh khitna thu Filistia-te in a zak uh ciangin David a man dingin Filistia-te khempeuh kuanto uh hi. Ahih hangin David in tua thu za-in munmuanhuai-ah paisuk hi.","title":"David in Filistia-te Zo (1Khang 14:8-17)"},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Filistia-te hong pai-in Refaim kuamsung dim uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Topa thu dongin, “Filistia-te do-in ka kuanto ding hiam? Topa in David kiangah, “Kuanto in; bang hang hiam cih leh na khut sungah Filistia-te kong pia taktak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Baalperazim-ah David hong pai-in David in tua lai-ah amaute a zo hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Tuikhang in a phulkhap bangin Topa in ka mai-ah ka galte phukham hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun Baalperazim ci-in min kiphuak hi."},"21":{"text":"Filistia-te in tua lai-ah a milimte uh nusia uh a, David le a mite in tuate a puakhia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia-te hong kuantokik lai-in Refaim kuamsung dim khin uh hi."},"23":{"text":"David in Topa thu a dot ciangin amah in, “Na kuanto kei ding hi; amaute’ nung lamah kual pai inla, lungli kungte gal panin amaute hih in."},"24":{"text":"Lungli kungte’ dawnah lampaina kheging na zak ciangin na tha saan in; bang hang hiam cih leh Filistia galkapte a vatgawp dingin na mai-ah Topa pai hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in amah a thupiak bangin David in hih a, Geba panin Gezer ciang dong Filistia-te a vatgawp hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel-te a kiteelkhia mi tul sawmthum khawmkik hi.","title":"Thuciamna Singkuang a la dingin David Pai (1Khang 13:5-14)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in kherub-te tungah a tu, Vanglian Topa’ min tawh a kisam Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang tua mun panin a paipihto dingin amah tawh a om mi khempeuh tawh Baalejudah-ah a pai hi.","ref":"Pai 25:22"},"3":{"text":"Amaute in leeng thak khat tungah Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang pua uh a, mualtung a om Abinadab’ inn panin paikhiatpih uh hi. Abinadab’ tapate Uzzah le Ahio in leeng thak tungah Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang koihin hawl uh a, Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah Ahio a pai hi.","ref":"1Sam 7:1-2","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin David le Israel mite khempeuh in Topa’ mai-ah a tha neih zahun la sa-in, laiza khausai lasaknate, harp khausai lasaknate, khuangneute, kuangtuahte, le daltuahte tumin lungdamin a lam uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nakon’ ancilna mun a tun uh ciangin bawngtalte muktu ahih manin Uzzah in Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang lamah a khut zanin len kha hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Uzzah tungah Topa hong sinso hi. Amah in Thuciamna Singkuang lamah a khut zan ahih manin Pasian in tua lai-ah amah vatlum a, Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang gei-ah amah si hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Uzzah gim pia ahih manin David heh hi. Tuni dongin tua mun pen Perezuzzah kici hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-in David in Topa kihta hi. Amah in, “ Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang bangci-in ka kiangah hong tung thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David khuapi sungah Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang a paipih ding David ut lo a, Gath khua mi Obededom’ inn-ah paipih hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang Gath khua mi Obededom’ inn sungah kha thum sung om a, Topa in Obededom le a innkuan khempeuh thupha a pia hi.","ref":"1Khang 26:4-5"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi David kiangah, “Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang hangin Topa in Obededom innkuan le ama neih khempeuh thupha pia hi,” ci-in kigen hi.
