Tua ciangin Assiria kumpipa in Judah kumpi Hezekiah tung panin ngun talen zathum le kham talen sawmthum a kal hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in Topa’ biakinn sung le kumpipa’ inn vankoihnate-ah a om ngun khempeuh ama tungah a pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hunin Hezekiah in Topa’ biakinn kongkhakte tung pan, le amahmah in kongkhak mungte a zutna khamte hawkkhia-in Assiria kumpipa tungah a pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Assiria kumpipa in Lakhish panin Kumpi Hezekiah kiang Jerusalem-ah galkap hon lianpi khat tawh a galkapmang lianpen pa, a innsung mang lianpen pa, le a ulian khat a sawl hi. Amaute paito-in Jerusalem tung uh hi. Amaute a tun uh ciangin amaute hong pai-in Puansawppa’ nasepna phual zuatna lampi-a om bual tungnung tuilakna gei-ah hong ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in kumpipa a sap uh ciangin, amaute kiangah innsung ukpa ahi, Hilkiah’ tapa Eliakim, lai-at Shebnah, le thuciamteh pa ahi, Asaf’ tapa Joah hong pai uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ulianpa in amaute kiangah, “Hezekiah kiangah hih bangin gen un. ‘Assiria kumpipa, kumpi lianpa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih banga na kimuanna uh bang suang na hi uh hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Note in kampau lel pen galsim nadingin thu lamlahna le thahatna-in na ngaihsun uh hi. Note in kei nong lehdo nadingun bang suang na hi uh hiam?"},"21":{"text":"En un, a tungah a kingam mipa’ khut a sun ding pumpeeng kung kitam a banglel Egypt tu-in na suang uh hi. Amah a suangte khempeuh tungah Egypt kumpipa Faro pen tua banglel ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"“‘Ahih hangin note in kei kiangah, “Kote in Topa ka Pasian uh ka suang uh hi,” na cih uhleh, Hezekiah in mualtung a biaknate le biakna taute hepkhiatsakin Jerusalem tungah, “Jerusalem khuasung hih biakna tau mai-ah na bia ding uh hi,” a cih pa hi lo ahi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"Tu-in hong pai un; Assiria kumpi ka topa tawh kikhapna khat bawl un; no lam panin a tunga tuang ding na ngah nak-uhleh note tungah sakol tulnih kong pia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note in leengte le sakol tung tuangte tawh kisai-in Egypt a suang kimlai in bangci-in ka topa’ nasemte lakah a neupen galkap ukpa khat lehnawhzo ding na hi uh hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Topa tawh a kikop lopi-in hih mun simin a susia dingin a hong paito ka hi hiam? Topa in kei kiangah, “Hih gam a sim dingin paito inla susia in,” hong ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hilkiah’ tapa Eliakim, Shebnah, le Joah in a ulianpa kiangah, “Kong thum uh hi; kote in Aram pau thei ka hih manun na nasemte tungah Aram pau-in thu hong gen in; kulh tunga om mite’ zakin Jew pau-in kote’ tungah hong gen kei in,” a ci uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin a ulianpa in amaute kiangah, “Ka topa in hih thute na topa uh le note tung bekah a gen dingin hong sawlin, amau’ ek mah ne-in, amau’ zun mah dawnin note tawh a siakhawm ding kulh tunga tu mite kiangah a gen lo dingin hong sawl ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ulianpa dingin Jew pau-in a gingin kiko a, “Assiria kumpi, kumpi lianpa’ thu za un!"},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Hezekiah’ khemsa-in om kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in keima khutsung panin note hong honkhia zo lo ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in eite hong honkhia taktak ding a, Assiria kumpipa’ khut sungah hih khuapi kipia lo ding hi, ci-a Hezekiah’ hong genna tawh Topa suang kei un,’ ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Hezekiah’ thu ngai kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Assiria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Kei tawh kilemna hong bawl unla, kei kiangah hong pai un. Tua hileh kei hong pai-in nomau’ leitang tawh a kibatna mun, an le leenggahzu a omna, oliv kungte le khuaizu a omna gamah, note si loin na nuntak nadingun kong koih dong matengin note khempeuh in nomau’ leenggah ciat ne-in, mi khempeuh in a theigah ciat uh ne ding uh a, note khempeuh in na tuinak ciat uh panin tui na tawi ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in note kiangah, “ Topa in eite hong honkhia ding hi,” ci-in note hong lamlah khialhna-ah Hezekiah’ thu ngai kei un.","merge":"32"},"33":{"text":"Assiria kumpipa’ khutsung panin minam dangte’ pasian khatpeuh in a gam honkhiazo ngei ahi hiam?"},"34":{"text":"Hamath le Arpad’ pasian-te koi-ah om ahi uh hiam? Sefarvaim, Hena, le Ivvah pasian-te koi-ah om ahi uh hiam? Keima khutsung panin amaute in Samaria a honkhiazo uh hiam?"},"35":{"text":"Topa in ka khutsung panin Jerusalem a hotkhiat nadingin, gam sungah pasian-te khempeuh lakah kua in keima khutsung panin a gam uh honkhiazo ngei ahi hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahih hangin mite dai-in kam khat beek dawngkik lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa’ thupiakna pen, “Amah dawng kei un,” cihna ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin innsung a uk, Hilkiah’ tapa Eliakim, lai-at pa Shebnah, le thuciamteh pa, Asaf’ tapa Joah-te a puan uh balkeksa-in Hezekiah kiangah hong pai uh a, a ulianpa’ kammalte ama kiangah a gen uh hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in hih thu a zak ciangin a dahna hangin a puante balkekin puanhampi silh a, Topa’ biakinn sungah a pai hi.","title":"Sennakherib kiang panin Judah Kisuaktasak (2Khang 32:20-23 ; Isa 37:1-38)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in biakinn sung a ukpa Eliakim, lai-at pa Shebnah, le siampi khangham zawdeuhte puanhampi silhsakin Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isaiah kiangah a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in ama kiangah, “Hezekiah in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Tuni pen lungkham ni, hong kitai ni, mindai ni ahi hi. Naungekte a suah hun tung a, amaute hinkhiatna ding thatang om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama topa ahi Assiria kumpipa in a nungta Pasian a zahko dingin a sawl a ulianpa’ kammalte khempeuh Topa na Pasian in za-in, Topa na Pasian in a zaksa thute nialkhin kha ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin a omlai mite a dingin thu ngen in,’ ci hi,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah’ nasemte Isaiah kiang hong tun uh ciangin"},"6":{"text":"“Isaiah in amaute kiangah, “Na topa uh kiangah hih bangin gen un. Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Assiria kumpipa’ nasemte in kei hong simmawhna, na zaksa uh thute hangin lau kei un."},"7":{"text":"En un, keimah in ama tungah thu khat ka piangsak ding a, amah in kamdawn khat za-in a gamah ciahkik ding hi. Ama gam mahah namsau tawh amah a tukna ding ka piangsak ding hi,” ci hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Assiria kumpipa in Lakhish nusia khinin Libnah khua tawh a kidona thu, a ulianpa in za ahih manin, kumpipa kiangah thu a dong dingin a pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia kumpi Tirhakah amah a sim dingin a hong kuankhiat khitna thu kumpipa in a zak ciangin, amah in Hezekiah kiangah kamtaite sawl kikin,"},"10":{"text":"“Judah kumpi Hezekiah kiangah hih bangin gen un: ‘Assiria kumpipa’ khut sungah Jerusalem kipia lo ding hi, ci-a a hong ciamna tawh na suan na Pasian’ khemsa-in om kei in."},"11":{"text":"En in, Assiria kumpite in gam khempeuh a hihnasa, a suksiat mangna thu na za khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin nang hong honkhiazo ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate in a suksiat minam Gozan, Haran, Rezef, le Telassar gam sunga Eden mite, tua minamte’ pasian-te in amaute honkhiazo ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sefarvaim khuapi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa, ahih kei leh Ivvah kumpipa koi-ah om ahi uh hiam, ci hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah in kamtaite tung panin a lai sangin a sim hi. Tua ciangin Topa’ biakinn-ah Hezekiah paito a, Topa’ mai-ah a lai a zal hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in Topa’ mai-ah thu ngenin, “ Topa, Israel Pasian, kherub tungah a tupa aw, leitung kumpi gam khempeuh lakah nangmah, nangmah bek Pasian na hi a, nangmah in vantung le leitung na bawl hi.","ref":"Pai 25:22"},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, na bil hong ngat inla hong za in. Topa aw, na mitte hak inla hong mu in. Tua ciangin a nungta Pasian a zahko nadingin a hong khak Sennakherib’ thute za in."},"17":{"text":"A taktakin, Topa aw, Assiria kumpite in minam dangte le a gam uh siasak uh a,"},"18":{"text":"a pasian-te uh meikhuk sungah lotsak uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pasian hi loin, mihingte’ khut tawh a kibawl sing le suang ahi hi. Tua ahih manin tuate kisusia hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, Topa kote’ Pasian aw, leitung kumpi gam khempeuh in nang, nang bek Pasian na hihna a theih nadingun ama khutsung panin kote hong honkhia in, kong thum hi, Topa aw,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Hezekiah kiangah thu puak a, “Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib tawh kisai kei tungah nong thungetna ka zazo hi,’ ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah tawh kisai-in Topa’ gensa thu hih bang ahi hi: Zion khuapi in nang hong simmawh a, nang hong nuihsan hi. Jerusalem khuapi in na nungah a lu hong peisan hi."},"22":{"text":"Kua zahko-in, a simmawh na hi hiam? Kua langpangin na aw sang sakin kihihsakna tawh gamta na hi hiam? Israel-te’ a Siangtho pa, a simmawh na hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Na kamtaite tawh Topa na zahko a, nangmah in, ‘Ka leeng tampite tawh mual sangpen munah ka pai khin a, Lebanon gam tawng pek dong ka tung khin hi. A taamtak sangpente ka phukmang khin a, a taaksan hoihpente zong ka phukmang khin hi. A gam tawngnung pen dongah keimah ka lut a, a tulak thukpen dongah zong ka lut khin hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuikhukte ka to a, gamdang tuite ka dawn hi. Ka khenuai tawh Egypt lui khempeuh ka keusak hi,’ na ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Sawt pek lai-in ka ngaihsutsa ahihlam za nai lo na hi hiam? Tanglai pek panin ka geelkholhsa hi a, tu-a ka tunsak ding thute kulh a nei khuapite ninbulomtangin na heina ding,"},"26":{"text":"a sunga tengte a hatna teng kilakhia-in, lungkia-in cih nading thei loin, gamlak singnote le lo ngeekte bangin, innkhumzanga lopate bangin a om laitak, a khankhit ma-in a sih ding ka geelsa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in na tutsukna le na pusuahna le na sungtumna, kei tungah na hehna ka thei khin hi."},"28":{"text":"Kei tungah na hehna hang le na kiphatsakna ka bilah hong tunkhitna hangin na nakah nakpheh hong bulhin, na kamah kamkaih kong bulh ding a, nong kuankhiatna lam mahah kong lehhei kik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Isaiah in Hezekiah kiangah, “Nang a dingin lim hih bang hong hi ding hi: Tu kumin ama thu-in a pote na ne ding a, a kum nihna ciangin tua bangmahin a selkhiate na ne ding hi. A kum thumna ciangin khai tuhin atin, leenggui suanin a gah na ne ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah gam sungah a suakta a omlaite in singkung bangin a thuk lamah zung kha kikin a tung lamah gah hong gahto ding hi;"},"31":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh a omlaite Jerusalem panin hong paikhia ding a, a suakta khat Zion Mual panin hong paikhia ding hi. Topa’ deih luatna in hih thu hong tungsak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa tawh kisai-in hih bangin gen hi: ‘Hih khuapi sungah amah hong pai lo ding a, thaltang khat zong lawn lo ding hi. Khuapi mai-ah lum tawh zong hong pai loin, khuapi simna-in phung zong ciang lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah hong paina lampi mah tawnin amah kilehkik ding a, hih khuapi sungah amah hong pai lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh keima min ka khualna le ka nasempa David tungah ka ciamsa thu hangin hih khuapi ka hu ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua zanin Topa’ vantungmi paikhia a, Assiria-te giahphual ah galkap tul zakhat le tul sawmgiat le tulnga a that hi. Zingsang tungin mite a thawh ciangin, hihte khempeuh si luanghawm na hi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib kihemkhia a, inn-ah ciahin Nineveh-ah a teng hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in ama pasian Nisrok’ biakinn sungah bia-in a om laitakin, ama tapate Adrammelek le Sharezer in namsau tawh amah thatin Ararat gamah a tai uh hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Esarhaddon in a uk hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Hezekiah cina-in si dektak hi. Tua ciangin Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isaiah hong pai-in ama kiangah, “ Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Na innkuan vai ding hawm in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang na si ding hi; na damkikzo kei ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Cinatna (2Khang 32:24-26 ; Isa 38:1-22)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in a mai kawm lam ngatin Topa tungah thu ngen a,"},"3":{"text":"“Nangma mai-ah thuman tak le ka lungsim khempeuh tawh ka gamtatna, le nangma muhna-ah a hoih ka sepna thu tu-in hong phawk in, kong thum hi, Topa aw,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Hezekiah nakpitakin a kap hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin inntual laita panin Isaiah a paikhiat ma-in ama tungah Topa’ thu hong tung hi."},"5":{"text":"“Kileh kik inla keima mite’ makai Hezekiah kiangah hih bangin gen in: Na thungetna ka za khin a, na khituite ka mu khin hi. En in, nang kong damsak ding a, ni thum ni-in Topa’ biakinn-ah na paito ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na nuntakna kum sawm le nga sung kong behlap ding hi. Assiria kumpipa khutsung panin nangmah le hih khuapi ka honkhia ding a, keima hang le ka nasempa David hangin hih khuapi ka hu ding hi, ci hi, ci-in gen in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Isaiah in, “Theimoh khat hong la un. Amah a damkik theih nadingin tuate la unla, a uilut nuh un,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in Isaiah kiangah, “ Topa in kei hong damsakna ding, le a ni thum ni-in Topa’ biakinn-ah ka paitohna ding a lim bang hi ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Isaiah in, “ Topa in a ciamsa thu hong hih nadingin Topa’ tung panin nangma tungah a lim hih bang hi ding hi: A liim kal sawm maipai ding hiam, ahih kei leh kal sawm nungkik ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in dawngin, “Liim kal sawm a mai nawt ding a baih khat ahi hi; liim kal sawm nungkiksak zaw in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa tungah kamsangpa Isaiah kiko hi. Tua ciangin amah in Ahaz’ ni-nai tungah a ni tumsa a liim kal sawm lehkaih kik hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Babylon kumpipa, Baladan’ tapa Merodak-baladan in Hezekiah kiangah laikhakte le letsong khat tawh kamtaite a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hezekiah a ci na hi, ci-in amah in za hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Babylon pana Kamtaite Saang (2Khang 32:27-31 ; Isa 39:1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in amaute na zindo a, amah in amaute kiangah a vankoihna inn khempeuh, ngun, kham, a namtui nate, sathau manpha, a galvan, le a vankoihna innte-ah a om khempeuh a lak hi. Ama innsung hitaleh ama gam sung khempeuh pan hitaleh Hezekiah in amaute a lah loh om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Hezekiah kiangah kamsang Isaiah hong pai-in ama kiangah, “Hih mite in bang gen ahi hiam? Koi lai panin nang kiangah hong pai ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Hezekiah in, “Amaute, Babylon gam, a gamlapi panin hong pai uh hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in, “Amaute in na inn sungah bang mu ahi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Hezekiah in dawngin, “Amaute in ka innsunga om khempeuh mu uh hi; ka vankoihna inn sungte panin amaute ka lah loh bangmah om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Isaiah in Hezekiah kiangah, “ Topa’ thu za in:"},"17":{"text":"En in, na innsunga om khempeuh le na pu na pate in tuni donga a kholte Babylon-ah a kipuak ni ding hong tung ding hi; bangmah kisiit lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:13; 2Khang 36:10"},"18":{"text":"Nangma sung pan a suak na tapate pawlkhat kilakhia ding a, amaute pen Babylon kumpipa inn sungah innsung maangte hi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:14-15; Dan 1:1-7"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in Isaiah kiangah, “Na gensa ahi Topa’ thugen a hoih hi,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “Keima hun sungin kilemna le lungmuanna a om nakleh bang phamawh ding ahi hiam?” ci-in ngaihsun hi."},"20":{"text":"Hezekiah’ sepna a omlaite, a vangliatna, le tuili le tuilakna bawlin khuapi sungah tui a tutna, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Sihna (2Khang 32:32-33)"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah si a, ama tangin a tapa Manasseh in a uk hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh in uk ding a kipatin kum sawm le nih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnga le nga sung a uk hi. Ama nu’ min Hefzibah ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Manasseh’ Ukna (2Khang 33:1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite’ mai-ah a hawlkhiat minamte’ gamtatna a kihhuaite mah bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi.","ref":"Jer 15:4"},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a pa Hezekiah’ suksiatsa mualtung a biaknate lamkik hi. Tua ciangin amah in Baal a dingin biakna taute phut a, Israel kumpi Ahab’ bawl bangin Asherah milim khat bawl a, vantung a om nate khempeuh bia-in tuate’ na a sem hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Jerusalem-ah ka min ka koih ding hi,” a cihna Topa’ biakinn sungah amah in biakna taute lam hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:13"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ biakinn tual nihte tungah vantung a om nate khempeuh a dingin biakna taute a lam hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in biakna-in a tapa hal a, aisanna le mailam thugen kholhnate semin, vankah theite le aisante tawh na semkhawm hi. Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia tampi gamta a, amah hehsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in David le a tapa Solomon tungah, “Israel minam khempeuh sung panin ka teelkhiat hih biakinn sung le Jerusalem-ah ka min ka koih tawntung ding hi. Amaute ka thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kizui, le ka nasempa Moses in amaute a piak thukham khempeuh tawh kizui-in gamtat ding a kingaihsut nak-uhleh, a pu a pate uh tungah ka piak gam sungah Israel mite mi vakvai ka hisak nawn kei ding hi,” a cihna biakinn sungah amah in ama bawlsa a kiseek Asherah milim a koih hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:3-5; 2Khang 7:12-18","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in thu ngai lo uh a, Topa in Israel-te’ mai-ah a suksiat minamte’ gamtatna sangin a siahuaizaw a gamtat nadingun Manasseh in amaute a zol hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kamsangte ahi a nasemte’ tungtawnin gen a,"},"11":{"text":"“Judah kumpipa Manasseh in hih a kihhuai nate sem a, ama ma-a Amor mite’ gamtatna sangin a siazaw-in na semin a milimte tawh Judah mite zong khialsak khin hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel Pasian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, a za mite khempeuh’ bilte a vut ding siatna Jerusalem le Judah tungah ka tungsak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Keimah in Samaria le Ahab le ama suante gim ka piak bangin Jerusalem tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi. Tua ciangin mi khat in pakan a nul bangin keimah in Jerusalem nulin ka lumlet ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in ka mi a omlaite paaikhia-in amau’ galte tungah ka pia ding a, amaute pen a galte’ mat ding mi le vankiate suak ding uh hi;"},"15":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate uh Egypt panin hong paikhiat a kipan tuni dongin keima muhna-ah a sia gamta-in kei hong hehsak uh hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua tham loin Topa’ muhna-ah amaute a sia a gamtat nadingun amah in Judah mite a khialhsak banah, Jerusalem mong khat pan mong khat sisan tawh a kidimsak dongin Manasseh in mawhna baang lo mi tampi a that hi."},"17":{"text":"Manasseh’ sepna a omlaite, a hih khempeuh, le ama hihsa a khialhna, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manasseh si a, Uzza’ huansung, ama inn huan sungah kivui hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Amon in a uk hi."},"19":{"text":"Amon in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum nih sung uk hi. Ama nu’ min Meshullemeth hi a, Jotbah khuami Haruz’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Amon’ Ukna (2Khang 33:21-25)"},"20":{"text":"A pa Manasseh’ gamtat bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in a pa’ khekhap khempeuh tawn a, a pa in a na a sepsak milimte’ na mah semin tuate a bia hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in a pu a pate’ Pasian, Topa nusia a, Topa’ lampi tawn lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Amon’ nasemte in amah sawmsim uh a, ama inn sungah kumpipa a that uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua gammite in Kumpi Amon a sawmsimte khempeuh that leuleu uh a, tua ciangin tua gammite in ama tangin a tapa Josiah kumpi-in a koih uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in Amon’ hihsa a gamtatna a omlaite pen Judah Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Uzza’ huansung ama hanah amah kivui a, ama tangin a tapa Josiah in a uk hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in uk ding a kipatin kum giat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum le khat sung uk hi. Ama nu’ min Jedidah hi a, Bozkath khuami Adaiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Josiah le Thukham Laibu (2Khang 34:1-2 , 8-33)","ref":"Jer 3:6"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ mitah amah a manin gamta-in, a pu David’ khekhap khempeuh zui cinten a, themkhat zong pial lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi Josiah’ kum sawm le giatna kumin, kumpipa in a lai-at pa Meshullam’ tapa Azaliah, a tapa Shafan, Topa’ biakinn-ah sawl a,"},"4":{"text":"“Kongcingte in mite tung panin a kaihkhop uh ahi Topa’ biakinn sungah hong kipaipih sum phazah a theih nadingin siampi lianpen pa Hilkiah kiangah paito in."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ biakinn nasemte tungah a sum piasak in. Topa’ biakinn-ah a om inn a puah nasemte tungah amaute tua sum piasak in."},"6":{"text":"Tua sumte pen khutsiamte, innlamte, le leilesuang innlam siamte tungah piak ding le biakinn puah nadingin sing leina ding le suang tawhna ding zong ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin thuman takin amaute gamta uh ahih manin amaute’ khut sungah a kipia sumte hangin amaute tung panin sazian kingen lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 12:15"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa Hilkiah in lai-at pa Shafan kiangah, “ Topa’ biakinn sungah thukham laibu ka mu hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Hilkiah in Shafan kiangah a laibu pia a, amah in a sim hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah lai-at pa Shafan hong pai-in thu zasak a, “Nasemte in biakinn sungah a om sumte lakhia-in Topa’ biakinn nasemte tungah pia khinzo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin lai-at pa Shafan in kumpipa kiangah, “Siampi Hilkiah in laibu khat kei hong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shafan in kumpipa mai-ah tua laibu a sim hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in thukham laibu sunga thute a zak ciangin a dahna hangin a puante a balkek hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in siampi Hilkiah, Shafan’ tapa Ahikam, Mikaiah’ tapa Akbor, lai-at pa Shafan, le kumpipa’ nasem Asaiah thu pia a,"},"13":{"text":"“Pai unla, a kimu hih laibu sunga thute tawh kisai-in keima a’ ding, mite a’ ding, le Judah mi khempeuh a dingin Topa’ tungah thu va dong un; bang hang hiam cih leh hih laibu sunga thu, eite tawh kisai-in a kigelh khempeuh bangin gamtat ding i pu i pate in na mang lo uh ahih manin eite tungah Topa’ hehna lian hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin siampi Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shafan, le Asaiah te zong Harhas tapa Tikvah, a tapa Shallum, biakinn puan a kem pa’ zi kamsangnu Huldah kiangah a pai uh hi (tua laitakin Jerusalem khuasung a Veng Nihna-ah tua nu teng hi); tua ciangin tua nu tawh amaute kiho uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Kei kiangah note hong sawl mipa kiangah gen un."},"16":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, hih lai mun le a tungah a tengte tungah Judah kumpipa in laibu sunga a sim siatna thute khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kei hong nusia-in pasian dangte tungah paknamtui hal uh a, amau khut tawh a bawl milimte tawh kei hong hehsak uh ahih manin hih mun tungah ka hehna so ding a, ka hehna dai lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa’ tungah thu a dong dingin note a hong sawl Judah kumpipa tungah ahihleh note in hih bangin na gen ding uh hi. Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nangmah in na zaksa thute tawh kisai-in,"},"19":{"text":"amaute gamkhing le samsiat a ngahte a suah nadingin hih mun le a tungah a teng mite tungah ka kampauna na zak ciangin na lungsim kisikin Topa’ mai-ah nangmahmah kiniamkhiatin, na puante balkekin ka mai-ah na kahna thu, keimah in zong ka za hi, Topa in ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, nangmah in nuamtakin na han na zuan ding a, hih mun tungah ka tunsak ding siatna khempeuh na mit in mu lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in kumpipa kiangah tua thu a puakkik uh hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Judah le Jerusalem upate khempeuh samsak a, ama kiangah hong kikhawm uh hi.","title":"Josiah’ Puahphatte (2Khang 34:3-7 , 29-33)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ biakinn-ah kumpipa paito a, amah tawh Judah mi khempeuh, Jerusalem-a tengte khempeuh, siampite, kamsangte, le mi khempeuh a neu a lian tawh pai uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute’ zakin Topa’ biakinn sungah a kimu thuciamna laibu sunga thute khempeuh a sim hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin khuampi gei-ah kumpipa dingin hih laibu sunga a kigelh thuciamna kammalte khempeuh a sepna ding, Topa’ thu mangin a thupiaknate le a thukhamte, a lungsim le a ngaihsutna khempeuh tawh a zuihna ding, Topa’ mai-ah thuciamna khat a bawl hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh zong tua thuciamna-ah a kihel uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in siampi lianpen pa Hilkiah, le a nihna siampi, le kongcingte in Topa’ biakinn sung panin Baal le Asherah nusian milim a dingin a kibawl nazatte khempeuh, le vantung a om nate khempeuh biak nadingin a kibawlte hong paikhiatpih nading uh thu a pia hi. Amah in Jerusalem pualam Kidron leikang halna munah tuate halin a vute Bethel khua-ah a pua hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Judah khuapite le Jerusalem kiima om mualtung a biaknate tungah paknamtui hal dingin Judah kumpite in a kipsaksa milim biate’ siampite a hawlkhia hi. Baal tung, ni tung, kha tung, aksi honpite tung, le vantung a om nate khempeuh tungah paknamtui a halte zong a hawlkhia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ biakinn panin Jerusalem pualam, Kidron lui-ah Asherah nusian milim paikhiatpihin hal a, tua ciangin amah in satvui-in mi nautangte’ han tungah a vuite lawn hi.","ref":"2Kum 21:3; 2Khang 33:3"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in numeite in Asherah milim a dingin a kizang puante a gatna mun Topa’ biakinn sunga om a paktat pawlte’ innte a phelkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Judah khuapite panin siampite khempeuh paikhiatpih a, Geba panin Beersheba ciang dong, siampite in paknamtui a halna mualtung a biaknate a susia hi. Tua ciangin amah in khuapi kulhkongpi veilam, khuapi ukpa Joshua’ kongpi lutna-ah a om dawibiakna munte a phelkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua lai-a sem siampite ahihleh Jerusalem-a Topa’ biakna tau-ah hong paito thei lo uh a, ahi zongin amau’ sanggamte’ lakah silngo sawh loh anlum ne thei uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin kuamah in Molek pasian tungah a tanu ahi a, a tapa ahi zongin biakna-in a hal theih nawn loh nadingin Hinnom Kuam sunga om Tofeth kici milim biakna mun a susia hi.","ref":"Siam 18:21; Jer 7:31; 19:1-6; 32:35"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a kiimnai-a om, innsung ulian Nathanmelek’ inn gei, Topa’ biakinn sung lutna munah, Judah kumpite in ni tungah a ap uh a sakolte hemkhia hi. Tua ciangin amah in ni’ sakol leengte mei tawh a hal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah kumpite in a bawlsa, Ahaz’ inndei tungnung khumzanga a om biakna taute, le Topa’ biakinn tual nihte sungah Manasseh in a bawlsa biakna taute, amah in phelin satnen a, tua a vuite Kidron lui-ah a paai hi.","ref":"2Kum 21:5; 2Khang 33:5"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon in Sidon mite’ kihhuaina Ashtoreth pasian a’ ding, le Moab-te’ kihhuaina Khemosh pasian a’ ding, le Ammon mite’ kihhuaina Milkom pasian a dingin a lam, Jerusalem nisuahna lam, Oliv Mual leitaw lama om mualtung a biaknate kumpipa in a susia hi.","ref":"1Kum 11:7"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a biakna songte satkhamin, Asherah milimte phuk a, mihing guh tawh a dim tua munte a vuk hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua tham loin Israel-te a khialsak Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam in Bethel-ah a phuhsa mualtung a biakna, tua biakna mun a biakna tau tawh, amah in phelin a suangte sukham a, tuate a satvui hi. Amah in Asherah milim zong a hal hi.","ref":"1Kum 12:33"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josiah kihei-in khuadak a, mualtung a om hante a mu hi. Amah in mi sawlin hante sung panin a guhte lasak a, hih thute a genkhol Pasian’ mipa in a gen Topa’ thugen tawh kizui-in biakna tau tungah tuate halin a susia hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:2"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Hua galkhat a ka muh phawkna mual bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin khuapisung mite in ama kiangah, “Judah panin hong pai-in Bethel-a biakna tau tungah na bawl hih thute a genkhol Pasian’ mipa’ han ahi hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:30-32"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Amah tuaci omsak un; kuamah in ama guhte khin kei un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Samaria panin hong paikhia kamsangte’ guhte le ama guhte tuaci omsak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpite in a bawlsa, Topa a hehsakna uh, Samaria khuapite sunga om mualtung a biakna munte khempeuh zong Josiah in a lakhia hi. Bethel-a a hihsa khempeuh mah bangin tuate tungah a hih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in tua lai-a a om, mualtung a biakna siampite khempeuh, biakna taute tungah that a, tuate tungah mihing guh a hal hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah amah a ciahkik hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi khempeuh thu pia a, “Hih thuciamna laibu sungah a kigelh mah bangin Topa na Pasian uh pahtawina-in Paisan Pawi bawl un,” a ci hi.","title":"Josiah in Paisan Pawi Bawl (2Khang 35:1-19)"},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te thu a khen thukhente’ hun a kipan hitaleh, Israel kumpite ahih kei leh Judah kumpite’ hun sung khempeuh tua bang Paisan Pawi kibawl ngei lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kumpi Josiah’ uk kum sawm le giatna kumin Jerusalem-ah Topa a dingin Paisan Pawi kibawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua tham loin Topa’ biakinn sungah siampi Hilkiah in a muh laibu sungah a kigelh thukham kammalte amah in a kipsak theih nadingin Judah gam sung le Jerusalem-a om vankahte, aisante, innsung pasian-te, milimte, le a kihhuai nate khempeuh Josiah in a hemkhia hi.","title":"Judah tungah Heh Nilohna"},"25":{"text":"Ama hun ma-in, amah tawh a kibang, Moses thukham tawh kizui-in a lungsim khempeuh, a nuntakna khempeuh, le a thahatna khempeuh tawh Topa’ lamah a kihei kumpi om lo a, ama nungah zong amah tawh a kibang khat zong hong khang nawn lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Manasseh in amah a phinnate khempeuh hangin Judah tungah ama hehna, a lauhuai hih hehna lian panin Topa kihei nai lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel ka khinkhiat bangin ka muhna panin Judah zong ka khinkhia ding a, keimah in ka teelsa khuapi Jerusalem, le ka min om ding hi, ka cihna biakinn ka paaikhia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu-in Josiah’ gamtatna a omlaite, le a hih khempeuh, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.","title":"Josiah’ Sihna (2Khang 35:20-27)"},"29":{"text":"Ama hun sungin Assiria kumpipa a huh dingin Eufratis gun-ah Egypt kumpipa Faro Neko kuanto hi. Amah a khaktan dingin Kumpi Josiah zong a kuan hi. Faro Neko in Josiah a muh ciangin Megiddo ah a that hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama nasemte in Megiddo panin a sisa-in leeng khat sungah amah pua-in Jerusalem-ah ciahpih uh a, a hanah amah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin tua gam mite in Josiah’ tapa Jehoahaz la-in sathau nilh uh a, a pa’ tangin kumpi-in a koih uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Jehoahaz in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le thum pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kha thum sung uk hi. Ama nu’ min Hamutal hi a, Libnah khua mi Jeremiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoahaz’ Ukna le A Zakiatna (2Khang 36:1-4)"},"32":{"text":"A pu a pate’ gamtatnasa khempeuh bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Jerusalem a uk theih loh nadingin Faro Neko in Hamath gam sung Riblah khua-ah amah kol bulh a, Judah mite tung panin ngun talen zakhat le kham talen khat siah a kai hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Faro Neko in a pa Josiah’ tangin Josiah’ tapa Eliakim kumpi-in koih a, ama min Jehoiakim ci-in a kheelsak hi. Ahih hangin amah in Jehoahaz paikhiatpih hi; amah Egypt tung a, tua lai-ah a si hi.","ref":"Jer 22:11-12"},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jehoiakim in a ngun le a kham Faro’ tungah pia a, ahih hangin Faro’ thupiakna bangin tua sum a piak dingin a gam sung mite tung pan amah in siah a dong hi. Faro Neko tungah a piak dingin, amah in mi khempeuh tung panin a neihsa uh tawh kizui-in a gam sung mite’ ngun le kham a dok hi."},"36":{"text":"Jehoiakim in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nga pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le khat sung uk hi. Ama nu’ min Zebidah hi a, Rumah khuami Pedaiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoiakim’ Ukna (2Khang 36:5-8)","ref":"Jer 22:18-19; 26:1-6; 35:1-19"},"37":{"text":"A pu a pate’ gamtatnasa khempeuh bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama hun sungin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar hong kuanto a, Jehoiakim kum thum sung ama nasem a suak hi. Tua ciangin Jehoiakim in amah lehdo hi.","ref":"Jer 25:1-38; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama nasem kamsangte tungtawnin a gen Topa’ thugenna bangin Judah a susia dingin ama langkhatah Topa in Khaldea mihonte, Syria mihonte, Moab mihonte, le Ammon mihonte a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama gamtatnasate khempeuh tawh kizui-in Manasseh’ khialhna hangin ama muhna panin amaute a khinkhiatna ding, le a diakdiakin, amah in khialhna nei lo mite a thahna hangin Topa’ thupiakna tawh Judah tungah hih thu a hong tung taktak ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a mawh lo mite’ sisan tawh Jerusalem kidimsak a, Topa in ama mawhna maisak lo hi.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoiakim’ sepna a omlaite, le a hih khempeuh, Judah Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jehoiakim si a, ama tangin a tapa Jehoiakhin in a uk hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Babylon kumpipa in Egypt lui panin Eufratis gun dong Egypt kumpipa’ neih khempeuh laksak khin ahih manin Egypt kumpipa a gam panin hong kuankhia kikzo nawn lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiakhin kumpi a suahin kum sawm le giat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kha thum sung uk hi. Ama nu’ min Nehushta hi a, Jerusalem khuami Elnathan’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Jehoiakhin le a Uliante Galmatin Babylon-ah Kila (2Khang 36:9-10)"},"9":{"text":"A pa’ gamtatnasa khempeuh bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Jerusalem-ah Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar hong kuanto a, tua khuapi a umcih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama nasemte in a umcih laitakin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar tua khuapi-ah hong tung hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah kumpipa Jehoiakhin in Babylon kumpipa tungah amah a kipan, ama nu, a nasemte, a uliante, le a kumpi inn-a zaneite a kipia hi. Topa in a genkholhsa bangin Babylon kumpipa in ama uk a kum giatna kumin thongkia-in amah la a, Topa’ biakinn-a van manpha khempeuh puakhia-in, Kumpi Solomon in a bawlsa, Topa’ biakinn sunga kham nazat khempeuh a satnen hi.","ref":"Jer 22:24-30; 24:1-10; 29:1-2","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Amah in Jerusalem mi khempeuh, a ulian khempeuh, le a thahat a vanglian khempeuh, galmatin tul sawm, le khutsiamte le sikseekte khempeuh a ciahpih hi. Tua gam a a zawngpente simloh kuamah dang om nawn lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in Babylon-ah Jehoiakhin a ciahpih hi. Kumpipa’ nu, kumpipa’ zite, ama nuai-ah a zaneite, le tua gam sung ukpite, Jerusalem panin Babylon-ah galmatin a la hi.","ref":"Ezk 17:12"},"16":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in a thahat, galdo dingin a hoih mi thahat khempeuh a vekpi-in tulsagih, le khutsiamte le sikseekte tulkhat, galmatin Babylon-ah a paipih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Babylon kumpipa in Jehoiakhin’ tangin ama pa’ sanggampa Mattaniah kumpi-in koih a, ama min Zedekiah-in a kheelsak hi.","ref":"Jer 37:1; Ezk 17:13"},"18":{"text":"Zedekiah kumpi a suahin kum sawmnih le khat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le khat sung a uk hi. Ama nu’ min Hamutal hi a, Libnah khuami Jeremiah’ tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Zedekiah’ Ukna (2Khang 36:11-16 ; Jer 52:1-3)","ref":"Jer 27:1-22; 28:1-17"},"19":{"text":"Jehoiakim’ gamtatnasa khempeuh bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ hehna hangin ama kiang panin amaute a paihkhiatna zah dong dingin Jerusalem le Judah tungah thu hong om hi.","ref":"Ezk 17:15"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zedekiah in Babylon kumpipa lehdo hi. Tua ahih manin ama uk a kum kuana, tua kum a kha sawmna, tua kha a ni sawm ni-in Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar a galkap khempeuh tawh Jerusalem a sim dingin hong kuanin tua khua a umcih uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a kimkotah umcih nading panmun a bawl uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem A Pukna (Jer 39:1-7 ; 52:3-11 ; 2Khang 36:13-21)","ref":"Jer 21:1-10; 34:1-5; Ezk 24:2"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Zedekiah’ kum sawm le khatna kum dong tua khuapi ki-umcih hi."},"3":{"text":"A kha lina a ni kua ni-in tua khuapi sungah kialpi nasia mahmah ahih manin tua gam mite a’ ding an om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin khuapikulh sulet uh hi. Khaldea mite khuapi kiimah a ompi mahin, kumpipa’ huan kiang lam kulhpi nih kikal kulhkongpi lampi zui-in kumpipa le a galhang mi khempeuh zanin a tai uh hi. Arabah lam manawhin amaute pai uh hi.","ref":"Ezk 33:21"},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin Khaldea mite’ galkapte in kumpipa delh uh a, Jerikho zanglei-ah amah pha uh hi; tua ciangin a galkap khempeuh ama kiang panin kithehthang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in kumpipa man uh a, ama tungah thukhenna a pia, Riblah-a Babylon kumpipa kiangah amah paipih uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in Zedekiah’ muhna-ah a tapate thatin, Zedekiah’ mitte khelkhia uh a, amah kol bulhin Babylon-ah a paipih uh hi.","ref":"Ezk 12:13"},"8":{"text":"A kha ngana, tua kha a ni sagih ni-in, Babylon Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar’ kum sawm le kuana kumin, Babylon kumpipa’ nasem, amah a cingte a ukpa Nebuzaradan Jerusalem-ah hong pai hi.","title":"Judah Mite A Kimatna (2Khang 36:17-21 ; Jer 39:8-10 ; 52:12-30)"},"9":{"text":"Amah in Topa’ biakinn a kipan kumpipa’ inn le Jerusalem khuasunga om inn khempeuh hal a, inn lian khempeuh amah in haltum hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:8"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin a cingte a ukpa tawh a om Khaldea mi galkapte khempeuh in Jerusalem kimkota kulhpi susia uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin a cingte a ukpa Nebuzaradan in khuapi sungah a kinusia a omlai mite le Babylon kumpipa a taisan mite, mihonpi a omlai teng khempeuh salin paipih khawm hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin a cingte a ukpa in leenggui lote a en ding le lo kho dingin tua gammi a zawngpente pawlkhat nusia lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ biakinn sungah a om sumngo khuampite, Topa’ biakinn sungah a om tuikuang kingaknate, le sumngo tuikuangpi, Khaldea mite in satnen uh a, Babylon-ah a sumngo pua uh hi.","ref":"1Kum 7:15-26; 2Khang 3:15-17; 4:2-5"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in beelte, kawbiate, taitehte, paknamtui a dingin pakante, le biakinn sung nasepna a kizang sumngo nazatte khempeuh,","ref":"1Kum 7:45; 2Khang 4:16"},"15":{"text":"vutluahna, le haite lakhia uh hi. A cingte a ukpa in kham ahite kham mahin la-in, ngun ahite a ngun mahin a la hi."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in Topa’ biakinn a dinga a bawl khuampi nihte, tuikuangpi khat, le a kingaknate, sumngo tawh kibawl hih nazatte khempeuh ahihleh tawi teh zawh ding hi lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuampi khat a sanna pi sawmnih le sagih hi a, tua tungah sumngo khuamluzepna khat om hi; khuamluzepna a sanna pi li le alang ahi hi. Sumngo tawh a kibawl ngen banga kikalh simsiam le mang kawlsingte khuamluzepna kimkotah om hi. A khuampi nihna zong tua mah bangin, ngen banga kikalh simsiam tawh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin a cingte a ukpa in siampi lianpa Seraiah, siampi nihna Zefaniah, le kong a cing mi thumte a la hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin khuapi panin galkapte a uk ngei ulian khat, le khuapi sungah a om kumpipa’ thukuppihte mi nga a la hi. Tua ciangin gam sung mite a khawm galkapte a ukpa’ lai-at pa a la hi. Tua ciangin khuapi sungah a om tua gam sung mi sawmguk a la hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin a cingte a ukpa Nebuzaradan in amaute la-in Riblah-a Babylon kumpipa kiangah amaute a paipih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Babylon kumpipa in amaute vat a, Hamath gam sung Riblah-ah amaute a that hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau’ gam panin salin Judah mite kilakhia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah gam sungah a omlai, Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in a nusiatte tungah a uk dingin Shafan’ tapa Ahikam, a tapa Gedaliah amah in a seh hi.","title":"A Omlaite Egypt-ah Tai (Jer 40:7-9 ; 41:1-3)"},"23":{"text":"Tu-in gam sunga om galkap a ukte le a mite in Babylon kumpipa in a uk dingin Gedaliah a sehna thu a zak uh ciangin amaute a mite uh tawh Mizpah-a Gedaliah kiangah hong pai uh hi. Tuate pen Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael, Kareah’ tapa Johanan, Netofah mi Tanhumeth’ tapa Seraiah, le Maakath mi Jaazaniah ahi uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute le a mite uh tungah Gedaliah kiciamin, “Khaldea mi uliante’ hangin lau kei un; gam sungah tengin, Babylon kumpipa’ na sem un. Tua hileh note a dingin thu hong nuam ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 40:7-9"},"25":{"text":"Ahih hangin a kha sagihna sungin kumpi innkuan sung panin Elishama’ tapa Nethaniah, a tapa Ishmael mihing sawm tawh hong kuanin Gedaliah le Mizpah-ah amah tawh a om Judah mi le Khaldea mite simin a that hi.","ref":"Jer 41:1-3"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin a lian a neu-in mi khempeuh, le galkap a ukte kithawi-in Egypt-ah pai uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Khaldea mite kihta uh hi.","ref":"Jer 43:5-7"},"27":{"text":"Judah kumpi Jehoiakhin thong sungah a omzawh kum sawmthum le kum sagihna kum, kha sawm le nihna, tua kha ni sawmnih le sagih ni, Babylon kumpipa Evilmerodak in uk ding a kipat kumin, hehpihna tawh thong panin Judah kumpi Jehoiakhin a khah hi.","title":"Babylon-ah Jehoiakhin Kikhahin Kipahtawi (Jer 52:31-34)"},"28":{"text":"Amah in migitna kam tawh amah hopih a, Babylon sunga amah tawh a om kumpi a mat dangte khempeuh sangin a sangzaw-in amah a pahtawi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jehoiakhin in a thong puante suahkhia hi. Tua ciangin a nuntak sung nisimin kumpipa’ sabuai-ah a manmanin an a ne hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama ngahthuap dingin, amah a nuntaksung tawntung nisimin tanh khat, a manmanin ngahthuapna ama tungah kumpipa in a pia hi."}}}}},"13":{"info":{"name":"Khang Tangthu Masa","shortname":"1Kt","abbr":[],"desc":"Khang Tangthu Masate leh Khang Tangthu Nihnate sunga thu omte pen Samuel leh Kumpi Laibute sungah a kigelhsate mah a genpha kik hi a, ahi zongin ngimna tuamdang tawh a kigelh ahi hi. Khang Tangthu Laibute sungah Israel mi tawh kisai-in gennop bulpi nih om a, tuate in: 1. Israel kumpi gam leh Judah kumpi gam in siatna a tuah uh hangin Pasian in hih minamte tungah a thuciamsa mah lenkip lai a, hih minamte tungah a ciamna a tun'sak theihna dingin Judah gamah a teng mite zangin vai a hawm ahihna kilangsak hi. Hih thu a man tak ahihna a kilatsakna dingin David leh Solomon in na lianpipi a sepnate, leh Jehoshafat, Hezekiah, Josiah, leh Pasian' tungah a citak mite in puahphatna tuamtuam a bawlte a gelh hi. 2. Jerusalem khua-a om Biakinnpi-ah Pasian biakna a kipatna thu, leh biakna hoihtakin a paisuak theihna dingin siampite leh Levi mite a pawl pawlin a kiphuatna thu gentelna ahi hi. Ahih hangin keimah in bangmah khialhna nei lo napi-in ka langte tungah kei a hong lehhek dingin a hong pai na hih uhleh, i pu i pate’ Pasian in thei hen la, note hong tai ta hen,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihing sawmthum a ukpipa Amasai’ tungah Pasian’ kha hong tungin amah in, “David aw, kote, nangma a’ hi ung! Tua ciangin David in amaute sang a, ama galkap uliante-in a bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Saul a do dingin Filistia mite tawh David a kuan laitakin Manasseh mi pawlkhat tai-in David a beel hi. amah sawlkhia uh hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Ziklag-ah amah a pai laitakin Manasseh sung panin tai-in amah a beelte: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikhael, Jozabad, Elihu, le Zillethai hi a, Manasseh sungah mi a tulin a ukte ahi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute in mi’ na a sut thei mite panin David huh uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute a thahat a vanglian mi hi a, galkap sungah a ukte ahi uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Simeon mi: Galdo dingin a thahat a vanglian mihing tulsagih le zakhat ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Levi mi: Tul li le zaguk ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Aaron’ suante sung pan ulian bang hang hiam cih leh Saul’ hun lai-in i don kei hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in tua thu hoihsa uh ahih manin tua bangin hih ding a kikhawm mi khempeuh a thukim uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Kiriathjearim panin Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang a ciahpih dingin David in Egypt gam Shihor lui panin Hamath lutna ciang dong Israel mi khempeuh a khawm hi.","title":"Thuciamna Singkuang A La Dingin David Pai (2Sam 6:1-11)","ref":"1Sam 7:1-2"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin David le Israel mi khempeuh, kherub-te’ tungah a tu Topa’ min tawh a kilo Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang a paipihto dingin Kiriathjearim a kici Baalah-ah a paito uh hi.","ref":"Pai 25:22"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in Abinadab’ inn panin leeng thak khat tungah Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang pua uh a, Uzza le Ahio in a leeng a hawl uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin David le Israel mi khempeuh in Pasian’ mai-ah la le laiza lasakna, harp lasakna, khuangneute, daltuahte, le peengkulte tawh a tha neih zahun gualnopna a bawl uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute Khidon’ ancilna phual a tun uh ciangin bawngtalte muktu ahih manin Uzza in Thuciamna Singkuang a len dingin a khut va zan kha hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Uzza tungah Topa heh hi. Tua ciangin Pasian’ mai tua lai-ah amah si hi."},"11":{"text":"Uzza tungah Topa hehin gim pia ahih manin David zong a heh suak hi. Tua mun pen tuni dongin Perezuzza kici hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni-in David in Pasian kihta hi. Amah in, “Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang kei kiang inn-ah bangci ciahpih theih ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David in Thuciamna Singkuang David khuapi a inn-ah ciahpih lo-a, Gath mi Obededom’ inn-ah va koih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang Obededom’ innkuan tawh kha thum sung om hi. Topa in Obededom’ innkuan le a neih khempeuh thupha a pia hi.","ref":"1Khang 26:4-5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Taia kumpipa Hiram in David kiangah kamtaite, taamtak singte, ama a dingin inn khat a lamsak dingin leilesuang innlam a siamte, le khutsiamte zong a puak hi.","title":"Hiram in David a Theihna (2Sam 5:11-12)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Israel-te tungah kumpi-in Topa in amah a kipsak khitna le ama mi Israel-te’ hangin ama kumpi gam nakpitakin a lianin a kibawlna a phawktel hi."},"3":{"text":"David in Jerusalem-ah zi nei thuahin tapate le tanute a nei hi.","title":"Jerusalem-ah David’ Tate Suak (2Sam 5:13-16 ; 1Khang 3:5-9)"},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem-ah a neih a tate’ min: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"5":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,"},"6":{"text":"Nogah, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"7":{"text":"Elishama, Beeliada, le Elifelet ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi khempeuh tungah kumpi-in David sathau a kinilhna thu Filistia mite in a zak uh ciangin David a zong dingin Filistia mi khempeuh kuanto uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun a min Baalperazim kici hi."},"12":{"text":"Filistia mite in tua lai-ah a pasian-te uh nusia uh a, David’ thupiakna tawh tuate kihal hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filistia mite hong kuanin kuam sung hong luhkik lai uh hi."},"14":{"text":"David in Pasian kiangah thu a dotkik ciangin Pasian in ama kiangah, “Amaute’ nungah na kuanto kei ding hi. Tua ciangin David in siampipuan khat silh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel mi khempeuh in sakite le peengkulte, le daltuahte’ awging tawh kizui-in awng kawmin Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang paipihto uh a, harp lasaknate le laiza lasaknate tawh nakpitakin la a sa uh hi."},"29":{"text":"David khuapi-ah Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang hong tun laitakin Saul’ tanu a zi Mikhal in tawlet panin na en a, Kumpi David lamin a gualnuam-a a om a mu hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a lungsim sungah David a neu-et hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang hong tumpih uh a, David in ama a dingin a lamsak puanbuk sungah koih uh hi. Asaf in daltuahte a tum ding hi a,"},"6":{"text":"siampite Benaiah le Jahaziel-te in Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah peengkulte a tum paisuak ding uh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua ni-in David in Asaf le a Levi mipihte in Topa tungah hih bangin lungdamkohna la a sa dingin a seh masa hi:","title":"David’ Lungdam Kohna La (La 105:1-15 ; 96:1-13 ; 106:47-48)"},"8":{"text":"Topa’ tungah lungdamna ko-in, ama min lo unla, ama septe khempeuh mite’ lakah kitheisak un!"},"9":{"text":"Amah la sak un. Amaute’ hangin amah in kumpite taigawp a,"},"22":{"text":"“Ka sathau nilhte lawng kei unla, ka kamsangte tungah siatna hih kei un!” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 20:3-7"},"23":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa la sak un! A ni ni-in ama hotkhiatna thu gengen un."},"24":{"text":"Minam dangte lakah ama minthanna genkhia unla, a lamdang ama septe mi khempeuh lakah gen un!"},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian mahmah a, nakpitakin phat ding ahi hi; pasian khempeuh sangin lamdang sakzawk ding ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh minam dangte’ pasian-te milim hi lel a, ahih hangin Topa ahihleh vantungte a bawlpa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Pahtawina le minliatna in amah umcih a, thahatna le lungdamna in amah kimkot hi."},"28":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa theitel unla, Topa’ minthanna le a thahatna theitel un!"},"29":{"text":"Amah in a ngah ding a kilawm minthanna Topa’ tungah pia un. Leitung miliante khat min bangin nang a dingin min khat kong bawlsak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amau’ inn ciatah a ten theih nading le a kinawngkaisak nawn loh nadingin ka mi Israel-te a dingin mun khat sehin amaute ka phut ding hi. Nangma hun ma-a sem Saul’ tung panin ka lakkhiat bangin nangma tung panin ka itna kip ka lakhia kei ding a,","ref":"2Kor 6:18; Heb 1:5"},"14":{"text":"ka mite le ka kumpi gam a kem dingin amah ka koih ding a, ama kumpi tokhom kip paisuak ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih kammalte khempeuh tawh kizui le hih maangmuhna khempeuh tawh kizui-in Nathan in David kiangah a gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi David tumin Topa’ mai-ah tu a, “ Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in hih ciang dong kei nong tunpihna kei kua hi a, ka innkuanpihte bang ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Hih a beisa thu pen nangma mitah na neu khat ahi hi, Pasian aw. David le a nasemte’ khutin amaute puk uh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Satan in Israel mite gimsak nuam ahih manin Israel mi phazah a sim dingin David hanthawn hi.","title":"David in Israel le Judah Mi Phazah Sim (2Sam 24:1-25)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David in Joab le galkap a ukte kiangah, “Pai un; Beersheba panin Dan ciang dong Israel mi phazah va sim unla, amaute a phazah ka theih nadingin kei kiangah thu hong zasak un,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Joab in, “ Topa in a mite a zah za khatin behlap ta hen! Khialin a gitloh gamtat mahmah pa keimah ka hi hi. Ahih hangin hih mite in bang gamtat khialhna nei ahi uh hiam? Topa ka Pasian aw, kong thum hi, keimah le ka innkuan gim hong pia in. Meihal biaknate-a zat dingin bawngtalte, a sing dingin ancilna singte, le an tawh biak nadingin a mangbuhte kong pia hi. A vekpi-in kong pia hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kumpi David in Ornan kiangah, “Hilo hi, a man a cing tawh kong lei ding hi. Topa a dingin nangma a’ ka la kei ding a, keima sum bei loin meihal biaknate zong ka pia kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin David in Ornan’ tungah a mun lei nadingin kham shekel zaguk a gik a pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in tua lai-ah Topa a dingin biakna tau khat lamin meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate bawlin Topa’ tungah thu ngen a, tua ciangin amah in a thungetna a piakna-in a meihal biakna a hal dingin vantung panin meikuang a piasuk hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ thupiakna tawh vantungmi in a namsau a pai sungah a siatkik hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua hunin, Jebus mi Ornan’ ancilna phualah ama nget thu Topa in a piakna David in a muh ciangin amah in tua lai-ah a biakpiaknate a bawl hi.","title":"Biakinn Mun Ding"},"29":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in gamlakah a bawl Topa’ biakbuk le meihal biakna tau pen tua hunin Gibeon mual dawnah omlai hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in Topa’ vantungmi’ namsau kihta ahih manin Pasian tungah thu a dong dingin tua lai-ah David pai ngam lo hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in, “Hih lai-ah Topa Pasian’ inn om ding a, hih lai-ah Israel mite’ meihal biakna tau om ding hi,” a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Israel gam sunga om gamdang mite a kikaihkhop nadingun David in thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah in Pasian’ biakinn lam nadingin suangseeksate a bawl dingin suangseekte a koih hi.","title":"Biakinn Ding David’ Kiginna"},"3":{"text":"David in kongpi kongkhak-a zat dingin siktukkilh le gak nadingin sik tampi koihin, teh zawh lohin sumngo tampi tak zong koih a,"},"4":{"text":"taamtak singte simzawh hi lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon khuamite le Taia khuamite in David kiangah taamtak tampi tak puak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, “Ka tapa Solomon khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nai lo a, Topa a’ ding a kilam biakinn pen gam khempeuhah minthanna le pahtawina-ah a lian mahmah ding ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua biakinn dingin keimah ka kigingkhol ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a sih ma-in na tampi tak koihkhol hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a tapa Solomon sam a, Israel Pasian, Topa a dingin biakinn khat a lam ding a gen hi."},"7":{"text":"David in Solomon kiangah, “Ka ta aw, Topa ka Pasian’ min dingin biakinn khat lam ding ka lungsimah om hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei’ tungah Topa’ thu hong tung a, ‘Nangmah in gal lianpipi tampi simin mi tampi na that hi. Nangmah in keima mai leitungah sisan tua zahta luangsak na hih manin ka min dingin biakinn na lam kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"En in, nangma sung panin tapa khat hong piang ding a, amah pen lungnopna a nei mi hi ding hi. Keimah in a kimkota a galte khempeuh panin ama tungah lungnopna ka pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama min Solomon hi ding a, ama hun sungin Israel tungah lungnopna le daihna ka pia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in keima min dingin biakinn khat lam ding hi. Amah ka tapa hi-in, kei, ama pa ka hi ding a, Israel sungah ama kumpi tokhom ka kipsak paisuak ding hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-16; 1Khang 17:1-14"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in ka ta aw, amah in nangma thu a gensa bangin Topa na Pasian’ biakinn na lamna-ah na tangtun theih nadingin Topa in nang hong ompih tahen."},"12":{"text":"Amah in Israel tungah nang hong uksak ciangin Topa na Pasian’ thukham na zuih theih nadingin Topa in ngaihsut pilna le thutelna nang tungah hong pia tahen."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te a dingin Topa in Moses a piak thukhamte le biakna ngeina kipte zuih ding na kidop nakleh na maavang ding hi. Thakhauh inla hang in. Lau kei inla lungkia kei in.","ref":"Josh 1:6-9"},"14":{"text":"Nakpi taka hanciamna le gimna lianpi tawh Topa’ biakinn dingin kham talen tul zakhat, ngun talen awn khat, le tehzawh lohin sumngo le sik ka koih khinzo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tam mahmah hi; sing le suang zong ka koihzo hi. Nangmah in hihte na behlap ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah in na a sem ding mi tampi na nei hi; suangseekte, leilesuang innlam siamte, khutsiamte, le simzawh lohin siamna nam khempeuh a nei,"},"16":{"text":"kham, ngun, sumngo, le sik sep a siamte na nei ding hi. Kithawi inla sem in! Topa in nang hong ompih ta hen!” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel makaite khempeuh in zong a tapa Solomon a huhna ding David in thu pia a,"},"18":{"text":"“ Topa na Pasian uh note tawh hong om hi lo ahi hiam? Amah in na kiim khempeuh uhah lungnopna hong pia hi lo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in gam sunga teng mite keima khut sungah hong pia khin a, Topa le ama mite’ mai-ah gam sung khempeuh kinuaisiah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in Topa na Pasian uh a zong dingin na ngaihsutna uh le na lungsim uh kipsak un. Topa’ min dingin a kilam biakinn sungah Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang le Pasian’ umlebeel siangthote a kipaipih theih nadingin kithawi unla Topa Pasian’ biakinn lam un,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in David teekin kum tampi pha a, amah in Israel tungah kumpi-in a tapa Solomon a koih hi.","ref":"1Kum 1:1-40"},"2":{"text":"David in Israel makai khempeuh le siampite le Levi mite a khawm hi.","title":"Levi mite le Siampite a Kisehkhenna le a Nasepte uh"},"3":{"text":"Levi mite kum sawmthum panin a tungsiah teng kisim a, a vekpi-in pasal tul sawmthum le tulgiat pha hi."},"4":{"text":"David in, “Hihte sung panin tul sawmnih le tulli in Topa’ biakinn sungah nasep uk ding a, tulguk pen maangte le thukhente hi ding a,"},"5":{"text":"tulli kongcingte, le tulli in phatna dinga ka bawlsa lasaknate tawh Topa tungah phatna pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Levi mite a behbehin pawl thum suah a, tuate pen: Gershom pawl, Kohath pawl, le Merari pawl ahi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Gershom’ tapate: Ladan le Shimei ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ladan’ tapate: A ukpi Jehiel, le Zetham, le Joel, thum pha uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Shimei’ tapate: Shelomoth, Haziel, le Haran, thum pha uh hi. Hihte pen Ladan’ beh lutangte ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shimei’ tapate: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, le Beriah ahi uh hi. Hih lite pen Shimei’ tapate ahi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Jahath a ukpi hi-in, Zina a nihna ahi hi. Ahih hangin Jeush le Beriah-te in tapa tampi nei lo uh ahih manin innkuan khat kisuak sakin sim khatin kisim khawm uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kohath’ tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel, li pha uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amram’ tapate: Aaron le Moses ahi uh hi. Amah le a tapate in Topa’ mai-ah paknamtui a hal tawntung ding le ama na semin ama min tawh thupha a piak tawntung theih nadingin a siangtho pen nate a ap dingin Aaron kituam koih hi.","ref":"Pai 28:1"},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian’ mipa Moses’ tapate ahihleh Levi minamte lakah kisim hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses’ tapate: Gershom le Eliezer ahi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Gershom’ tapate lakah Shebuel a ukpi ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Eliezer’ tapa Rehabiah zong a ukpi ahi hi. Eliezer in tapa dang nei lo a, ahih hangin Rehabiah’ tapate tam mahmah hi."},"18":{"text":"Kohath’ tapa nihna Izhar’ tapate lakah Shelomoth a ukpi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Kohath’ tapa thumna Hebron’ tapate lakah: Jeriah a ukpi, Amariah a nihna, Jahaziel a thumna, le Jekameam a lina ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Kohath’ tapa lina Uzziel’ tapate lakah: Mikah a ukpi, le Isshiah a nihna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Merari’ tapate: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Mahli’ tapate: Eleazar le Kish ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Eleazar in tapa nei loin si a, tanu bek nei hi. Amau’ tanau, Kish tapate in amaute tenpih uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Mushi’ tapate: Mahli, Eder, le Jeremoth, thum pha uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Hihte pen Topa’ biakinn nasepna-ah na a sem ding, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah, a milipin a minin a mi phazah zui-in a kiciamtehna bangin beh lutangte, a behbehin Levi suante ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, “Israel Pasian, Topa in a mite tungah lungnopna piazo a, Jerusalem-ah amah om tawntung ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in puanbuk hitaleh tua tawh kisai nasepna ding nate khat peuhpeuh hitaleh a puak ding uh kisam nawn lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:8"},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh David’ thupiakna a nunung pen tawh a kisim hihte pen kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah Levi mi a phazah ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"“Ahih hangin amaute’ nasep ding pen Topa’ biakinn nasepna-ah Aaron’ suante huhin, biakinn tualte le biakinn deite kemin, biakna na khempeuh a siangtho sak ding, le Pasian’ biakinn nasepna-ah hih ding khat peuhpeuh a sem ding uh ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Ompihna Anlum, an tawh biak nadingin annel, silngo sawh loh anlum moh, a ki-em piakna, sathau tawh a kihel piakna, le a tam tehna ahih kei leh a lian tehna nasep khempeuh zong a huh ding uh ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute zingsang simin ding ding uh a, lungdamna ko-in Topa phatin, nitakin zong tua bangmahin hih ding uh a,"},"31":{"text":"a mal zah a kisam bangin Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le pawi nite-in Topa tungah meihal biakna a kipiak peuhpeuh ciangin a tawntungin Topa’ mai-ah om ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bangin amaute in kikhopna puanbuk le biakinn kemin, Topa’ biakinn nasepna-ah amau’ behte ahi Aaron’ suante huh ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Gam 3:5-9"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron’ suante a kisehkhennate hih bang ahi hi. Aaron’ tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar ahi uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin a pa uh a sih ma-in Nadab le Abihu si-in ta nei lo uh ahih manin Eleazar le Ithamar-te siampi suak uh hi.","ref":"Siam 10:1-2"},"3":{"text":"Eleazar’ suan Zadok, le Ithamar’ suan Ahimelek’ huhna tawh David in amau’ nasepna-ah a kiseh bangin Aaron’ suante a koih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ithamar’ suante lak sangin Eleazar’ suante lakah ukpi tam omzaw ahih manin, amaute in Eleazar’ suante pawl sawm le guk suahin, Ithamar’ suante pawl giat suah uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Eleazar’ suante le Ithamar’ suante lakah biakinn uliante le Pasian’ uliante om tuak uh ahih manin amaute in a kibangin aisanna tawh amaute koih uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi mi Nethanel’ tapa ahi lai-at pa Shemaiah in kumpipa, uliante, siampi Zadok, Abiathar’ tapa Ahimelek, siampite, le Levi mi beh lutangte’ omna-ah amaute ciamteh hi. Eleazar’ suante-a’ dingin khat kiteelin, tua ciangin Ithamar’ suante a dingin khat kiteel a, kilaihsak niloh uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Aisanna a masa pen Jehoiarib tung, a nihna Jedaiah tung,"},"8":{"text":"a thumna Harim tung, a lina Seorim tung,"},"9":{"text":"a ngana Malkhijah tung, a gukna Mijamin tung,"},"10":{"text":"a sagihna Hakkoz tung, a giatna Abijah tung,"},"11":{"text":"a kuana Jeshua tung, a sawmna Shekaniah tung,"},"12":{"text":"a sawm le khatna Eliashib tung, a sawm le nihna Jakim tung,"},"13":{"text":"a sawm le thumna Huppah tung, a sawm le lina Jeshebeab tung,"},"14":{"text":"a sawm le ngana Bilgah tung, a sawm le gukna Immer tung,"},"15":{"text":"a sawm le sagihna Hezir tung, a sawm le giatna Happizzez tung,"},"16":{"text":"a sawm le kuana Pethahiah tung, a sawmnihna Jehezkel tung,"},"17":{"text":"a sawmnih le khatna Jakhin tung, a sawmnih le nihna Gamul tung,"},"18":{"text":"a sawmnih le thumna Delaiah tung, a sawmnih le lina Maaziah tungah a tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Hihte in Israel Topa Pasian in amah a thupiak bangin a pupi uh Aaron in amaute-a’ dingin a kipsaksa ngeina bangin Topa’ biakinn sungah a pai dingin amau’ nasep uh ahi a kiseh nasep nei uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi suante a omlaite lakah: Aram’ suante sung panin Shubael’ suante Jehdeiah ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Rehabiah’ suante sung panin Isshiah a ukpi ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Izhar’ suante sung panin Shelomoth’ suante Jahath ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hebron’ suante lakah: Jeriah a ukpi, Amariah a nihna, Jahaziel a thumna, Jekameam a lina ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Uzziel’ suante sung panin Mikah’ suante Shamir ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Isshiah’ suante sung panin Zekhariah ahi hi. Mikah’ sanggampa pen Isshiah ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Merari’ suante: Mahli, Mushi, le Jaaziah ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Merari’ suante Jaaziah sung panin Beno, Shoham, Zakkur, le Ibri ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Mahli in tapa nih, Eleazar le Kish nei hi. Eleazar in tapa nei lo a, Kish in Jerahmeel a kici tapa khat nei hi.","merge":"29"},"30":{"text":"Mushi’ tapate: Mahli, Eder, le Jerimoth ahi uh hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Levi’ suante ahi uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Hihte in zong a behte uh ahi Aaron’ suante mah bangin Kumpi David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampite, le Levi mi beh lutangte’ muhna-ah beh lutangte le a nau pasalte khat ciat in a kibangin aisanna tawh nasep tavuan a la uh hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David le nasepna ah a ukpite in zong laiza lasaknate, harp lasaknate, le daltuahte tawh Pasian thu a gen dingin Asaf, Heman, le Jeduthun-te’ tapate pawlkhat nasepna-a dingin koihtuam uh hi. Na a semte le amau’ nasepte:","title":"Lasiamte a Kisehkhenna"},"2":{"text":"Asaf’ tapate sung panin: Kumpipa’ makaihna nuai-ah Pasian’ thu a gen Asaf’ makaihna nuai-ah Asaf’ tapate Zakkur, Josef, Nethaniah, le Asharelah ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Jeduthun’ sung panin Jeduthun’ tapate: Lungdam kohna le Topa phatna-in laiza lasakna tawh thu a gen, a pa uh Jeduthun’ makaihna nuai-ah Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, le Mattithiah, guk pha uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Heman sung panin Heman’ tapate: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, le Mahazioth ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh pen Pasian thuciamna bangin amah a pahtawi dingin kumpipa’ thumu pa Heman’ tapate ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Heman tungah tapa sawm le li le tanu thum pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute khempeuh Pasian’ biakinn nasep nadingin Topa’ biakinn sungah daltuahte, harp lasaknate, le laiza lasaknate tawh la lamsangah a pa uh ukna nuai-ah om uh hi. Asaf, Jeduthun, le Heman-te pen kumpipa’ thupiakna nuai-ah om uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A Levi mipihte uh tawh Topa a’ ding lasakna lamah sinna a nei a siam mi a vekpi-in zanih le sawmgiat le giat ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin a neu a lian, sia le a sinte a kibangin, amaute in amau’ nasep ding uh ai a san uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Asaf’ behte a dingin ai masa Josef tungah tu hi. A nihna Gedaliah, a sanggamte, le a tapate, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"10":{"text":"A thumna Zakkur, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"11":{"text":"A lina Izri, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A ngana Nethaniah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"13":{"text":"A gukna Bukkiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A sagihna Jesharelah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A giatna Jeshaiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A kuana Mattaniah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"17":{"text":"A sawmna Shimei, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A sawm le khatna Azarel, a tapate le a innkuan sung panin Kore’ tapa Meshelemiah ahi hi.","title":"Kongcingte le a Ukte"},"2":{"text":"Meshelemiah’ tapate: Zekhariah a tacil, Jediael a nihna, Zebadiah a thumna, Jathniel a Shemakhiah ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh pen Obededom’ tapate le amau’ tapate le a sanggamte uh tawh, nasep nadingin siamna a nei mi kician ahi uh hi. Obededom sung panin sawmguk le nih pha uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Meshelemiah in siamna a nei tapate le sanggamte, sawm le giat nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Merari innkuan sung panin Hosah’ tapate: Shimri a ukpi (amah tacil ahih loh hangin a pa in a ukpi-in amah bawl hi),"},"11":{"text":"Hilkiah a nihna, Tebaliah a thumna, Zekhariah a lina ahi hi.
