Amaute in a sanggamte uh tawh Topa’ biakinn sungah nasep nei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in a neu a lian a kibangin a pate uh innkuankuanin amau’ kongpi cin ding ai san uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Nisuahna lama dingin ai, Shelemiah tungah tu hi. A tapa, a pil thulamlak pa Zekhariah a dingin zong ai san uh a, leilu lama dingin ai pha hi."},"15":{"text":"Obededom a dingin leitaw lamah hong suak a, a tapa tungah vankoihna inndei kipia hi."},"16":{"text":"Shuppim le Hosah a dingin lampi a paitohna, Shallekheth kongpi san, nitumna lamah kia hi. Galvil le galvil kimaituah uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Vankoihna inndei kongah nih nihin a om mah bangin nisimin nisuahna lamah guk omin, nisim mahin leitaw lamah li om hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin nitumna lama om lampi inn-a dingin a lampi-ah li omin a inn-ah nih om hi."},"19":{"text":"Hihte pen Korah mite le Merari’ tapate lakah kongcingte a kisehkhenna ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi mite sung panin Ahijah in Pasian’ biakinn vanmanpha koihnate le a ki-ap letsong koihnate uk hi."},"21":{"text":"Gershon-te beh sung panin Ladan pen innkuan tampi a piankhiatna mi khat hi a, Jehiel innkuante zong ama sung panin a piang ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Jehiel’ tapa Zetham le a sanggampa Joel in Topa’ biakinn vanmanpha koihnate uk uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite, le Uzziel mite sung panin:"},"24":{"text":"Moses’ tapa Gershom-te beh sung panin Shebuel pen vanmanpha koihna a ukte lakah a ukpi ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Gershom’ sanggam Eliezer’ suan Shelomith tawh zong beh kinai ahi hi. Eliezer’ sung panin a tapa Rehabiah, a tapa Jeshaiah, a tapa Joram, a tapa Zikri, a tapa Shelomith ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Hih Shelomith le a sanggamte in, Kumpi David, beh lutangte, le a tultul le a zaza-a uk uliante, le galkap a ukte in a ap uh ahi, a ki-ap letsongte a kikoihna khempeuh uk uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Gal sungah a ngah uh van kinusiate sung panin Topa’ biakinn puah nadingin amaute in letsongte ap uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Thumu pa Samuel, Kish’ tapa Saul, Ner’ tapa Abner, le Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in a apsate khempeuh zong, a ki-ap letsong khempeuh Shelomith le a sanggamte’ kepna sungah om hi."},"29":{"text":"Izhar mite sung panin Khenaniah le a tapate pen Israel a dingin uliante le thukhente-in a pualam nasepna-ah kiseh hi."},"30":{"text":"Hebron mite sung panin Hashabiah le a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tulkhat le zasagih in Jordan nitumna lam Israel tungah Topa’ nasepna khempeuh le kumpipa’ nasepna-ah uk uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Hebron mite sung panin Jerijah a ukpi ahi hi. (David’ uk a kum sawmlina kumin kikantelna bawl uh a, Gilead gam sung Jazer-ah amaute sung panin siamna lian a nei mihing kimu hi.)"},"32":{"text":"Kumpi David in Jerijah le a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tulnih le zasagih, a beh sungah lutang ahite pen Pasian tawh a kisai na khempeuh le kumpipa’ vaite-ah, Reuben mite, Gad mite, le Manasseh minam alangte tungah a uk dingin a seh hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Israel mite, beh lutangte, a tul le a za-a a ukte, le khen khatah mi tul sawmnih le tulli a om, kum tawntung kha khat khit kha khat hong tungin a kuankhia a khente tawh kisai-in na khempeuhah kumpipa’ na a sem a uliante:","title":"Kumpi Gam Uliante"},"2":{"text":"A kha masa sungin Zabdiel’ tapa Jashobeam a khen masa a uk hi a, ama khen sungah mi tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah pen Perez’ suanlekhak hi a, a kha masa sungin galkap a ukte khempeuh a ukpi ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A kha nihna sungin Ahoh-te beh Dodai a khen a ukpi hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"5":{"text":"A kha thumna sungin siampi Jehoiada’ tapa Benaiah a ukpi hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih pa pen mihing sawmthumte sungah a thahat, mihing sawmthumte a uk Benaiah hi a, ama tapa Ammizabad pen ama khen a ukpa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A kha lina sungin Joab sanggampa Asahel hi a, ama nungah amah a laih dingin a tapa Zebadiah om hi. Ama khen sungah mi tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"8":{"text":"A kha ngana sungin Izrah-te beh Shamhuth hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"9":{"text":"A kha gukna sungin Tekoa khuami Ikkesh’ tapa Ira hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"10":{"text":"A kha sagihna sungin Efraim suante sung panin Pelon khuami Helez hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"11":{"text":"A kha giatna sungin Jerah mi sung panin Hushah khuami Sibbekai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"12":{"text":"A kha kuana sungin Benjamin mi sung panin Anathoth khuami Abiezer hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"13":{"text":"A kha sawmna sungin Zerah mi sung panin Netofah khuami Maharai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"14":{"text":"A kha sawm le khatna sungin Efraim suante sung panin Pirathon khuami Benaiah hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"15":{"text":"A kha sawm le nihna sungin Othniel’ suante sung panin Netofah khuami Heldai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel minamte tungah a ukpite: Reuben mite a dingin Zikri’ tapa Eliezer ahi hi. Simeon mite a dingin Maakah’ tapa Shefatiah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Levi mite a dingin Kemuel’ tapa Hashabiah ahi hi. Aaron mite a dingin Zadok ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Judah mite a dingin David’ sanggamte’ sung panin Elihu ahi hi. Issakhar mite a dingin Mikhael’ tapa Omri ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Zebulun mite a dingin Obadiah’ tapa Ishmaiah ahi hi. Naftali mite a dingin Azriel’ tapa Jeremoth ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Efraim mite a dingin Azariah’ tapa Hoshea ahi hi. Manasseh minam a langte a dingin Pedaiah’ tapa Joel ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Gilead gam sunga Manasseh minam alangte a dingin Zekhariah’ tapa Iddo ahi hi. Benjamin mite a dingin Abner’ tapa Jaasiel ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Dan mite a dingin Jehoram’ tapa Azarel ahi hi. Hihte pen Israel minamte’ makaite ahi uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel mite vantung aksi zahin a tamin a bawlna ding Topa in thu ciam khin ahih manin David in kum sawmnih le a nuaisiah mite sim lo hi.","ref":"Pian 15:5; 22:17; 26:4"},"24":{"text":"Zeruiah’ tapa Joab in sim ding kipan a, ahih hangin zo man lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu hangin Israel tungah Pasian’ hehna hong tung a, Kumpi David’ khang tangthu sungah tua a kisimte kikhum lo hi.","ref":"2Sam 24:15; 1Khang 21:1-14"},"25":{"text":"Kumpipa’ vanmanpha a ukte: Kumpipa’ vanmanpha koihnate-ah Adiel’ tapa Azmaveth ahi hi. Gam sunga vanmanpha koihnate, khuapi sungate, khuaneute le tausangte sunga omte tungah Uzziah’ tapa Jonathan ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Lo khawh nasep a sem mite tungah Khelub’ tapa Ezri ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Leenggui lote tungah Ramah khuami Shimei ahi hi. Leenggui lo panin a piang leenggahzu koihnate tungah Shifmoth khuami Zabdi ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Shefelah gam sunga om oliv le theithek kungte tungah Gederah khuami Baalhanan ahi hi. Sathau koihnate tungah Joash ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Sharon gam sungah a gamta ganhonte tungah Sharon khuami Shitrai ahi hi. Kuam sunga om ganhonte tungah Adlai’ tapa Shafat ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Kalaohte tungah Ishmael mi Obil ahi hi. La a nute tungah Meronoth khuami Jehdeiah ahi hi. Tuuhonte tungah Hagri mi Jaziz ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh pen Kumpi David’ neihsa a kemte ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"David’ pano Jonathan pen thuthei mi le laithei mi ahih manin thu lamlak pa ahi hi. Amah le Hakmoni’ tapa Jehiel in kumpipa’ tapate cing uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahithofel pen kumpipa’ thu lamlak pa hi a, Arkhi mi Hushai pen kumpipa’ lawmpa ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahithofel a sih ciangin Benaiah’ tapa Jehoiada le Abiathar in laih uh hi. Joab pen kumpipa’ galkapte a ukpa ahi hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Jerusalem-a Israel-te lakah zaneite, minamte sungah zaneite, kumpipa’ na a sem a khente sungah uliante, a tultul a a ukte, a zaza-a a ukte, neihsa khempeuh le kumpipa’ ganhingte le a tapate a kemte pen, kumpi inn-a zaneite, a thahat mite, le gal a hang tawntungte khempeuh tawh a khawm hi.","title":"David in Biakinn Lam Nasep Solomon Tungah Ap"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi David a khe-in dingto-in, “Ka sanggamte le ka mite aw, ka thugen hong za un. Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang a’ ding le i Pasian’ khengak nadingin tawlngakna biakinn khat lam ding ka lungsim sungah om a, a lamna ding ka kiging hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian in kei kiangah, ‘Nang pen galhang khat hi-in sisan tampi luangsak na hih manin keima min dingin biakinn na lam thei kei ding hi,’ hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel Topa Pasian in Israel tungah kumpi ahi tawntung dingin ka pa’ innkuan khempeuh panin kei hong teel hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in makai-in Judah teel a, tua ciangin Judah innkuan panin ka pa’ innkuan teel a, tua ciangin ka pa’ tate lak panin Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi-in kei hong bawl ding kei tungah amah lungkim hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka tapate khempeuh lak panin (bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah tapa tampi hong pia hi) Israel-te a ukin Topa’ kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin amah in ka tapa Solomon teel khin hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, ‘Ka biakinn le a inntualte a bawl ding pa pen na tapa Solomon ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka tapa dingin amah ka teel khin a, kei pen ama pa ka hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in ka thupiaknate le ka biakna ngeina kipte tuni-a mah bangin zuih ding a ngaihsut paisuak nakleh ama kumpi gam ka kipsak tawntung ding hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-16; 1Khang 17:1-14"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note in hih leitang hoih nei-in note’ khit na tate uh tungah gamh-in na nusiat tawntung theih nadingun Topa’ mai-ah kikhopna ahi Israel khempeuh’ muhna, le i Pasian’ zakna-ah Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate khempeuh zui-in zong un."},"9":{"text":"“Tu-in nang, ka tapa Solomon aw, na pa’ Pasian thei inla, na lungsim khempeuh le utna lungsim tawh ama na sem in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in lungsim sung zong a, ngimna le ngaihsutna khempeuh thei hi. Nangmah in amah na zon le nangmah in amah na mu ding hi. Ahih hangin amah na nusiat leh amah in nang hong paaikhia paisuak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Biakinn dingin inn khat a lam dingin Topa in nang hong teel khin ahih manin tu-in kingaihsun in; thahat inla sem in,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon tungah biakinn innliim, a innte, a vanmanpha koihnate, a dawl tungnungte, a dei sungnungte, le hehpihna tokhom a dingin inndei a geelna;"},"12":{"text":"le Topa’ inn a tualte a dingin a lungsim ah a ngaihsut khempeuh, a kimkot a inndeite khempeuh, Pasian’ biakinn sung van manpha koihnate, le a ki-ap letsongte a’ ding van manpha koihnate;"},"13":{"text":"siampite le Levi mi a khente, le Topa’ biakinn sungah nasepna khempeuh a ding; Topa’ biakinn sungah nasepna ding umlebeel khempeuh a’ ding,"},"14":{"text":"nasepna-ah zat ding kham tawh kibawl umlebeel khempeuh a gihna, nasepna-ah zat dingin ngun tawh kibawl umlebeelte a gihna,"},"15":{"text":"nasepna-ah meivakkhuam a kizat ciatna bangin kham meivakkhuamte le a meivakte a gihna, a meivakkhuam le meivakte a gihna zah ciat, meivakkhuam khat le a meivakte ngun a gihna,"},"16":{"text":"Ompihna Anlum a dingin sabuai kham a gihna ciat, ngun sabuaite a dingin ngun a gihna,"},"17":{"text":"le sikkeute, kuangte, le haite a dingin kham citak a gihna; kham haipite le a gihna ciat, ngun haipite le a gihna ciat;"},"18":{"text":"a kisiangsaksa kham tawh kibawl paknamtui biakna tau ding le a gihna zah ding a geelna; a khate uh zakin Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang a khuh kherub-te’ kham leeng ding a geelna zong a pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Nasep ding khempeuh geelsa bangin sep dingin hih thu tawh kizui-in Topa’ genna bangin lai-in gelhna tawh amah in hihte khempeuh a siangin a hih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon kiangah, “Thakhauhin hang inla sem in. Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian, keima Pasian nangawn nang tawh hong om hi. Topa’ biakinn sung nasepna khempeuh a kizawh matengin amah in nang hong tamasak lo ding a, hong nusia lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian’ biakinn-ah nasep khempeuh a sem dingin siampite le Levi mi a khente om hi. Nasepna khat peuhpeuhah siamna a nei mite in nasepna khempeuhah nang hong huh ding hi. Uliante le mi khempeuh zong nangma thupiakna bangbangin gamta ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi David in a kikhawm khempeuhte kiangah, “Pasian in amah bek a teelsa ka tapa Solomon pen khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nai lo a, nasep ding pen lian mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih biakinn lianpi pen mihing a’ ding hi lo a, Topa Pasian a’ ding ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian’ biakinn dingin ka hih theihzah ciang, phuh dingin onik suang, suangpak, mel tuamtuam a nei suang, suangkang, le suangmanpha nam khempeuh tampi takte banah kham zatna ding nate-ah kham, ngun zatna ding nate-ah ngun, sumngo zatna ding nate-ah sumngo, sik zatna ding nate-ah sik, le sing zatna ding nate-ah sing ka koih khinzo hi.","ref":"1Khang 22:5"},"3":{"text":"Tua tham loin, a siangtho biakinn a dingin ka koihte khempeuh banah, ngun le kham keima-a’ mahmah zong om a, ka Pasian’ biakinn ka ngaihsutna hangin ka Pasian’ inn-ah ka piakte:"},"4":{"text":"Kawm zut nadingin Ofir gam kham ahi kham talen tulthum, le a kisiangsaksa ngun talen tulsagih,"},"5":{"text":"le siamneelte in a hih ding nasepna khempeuh a dingin kham zatna ding nate-ah kham, le ngun zatna ding nate-ah ngun ahi hi. Kua teng utna lungsim tawh Topa’ tungah tuni-in amahmah kipia-in ki-ap ding na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin beh lutangte in utthu-a piakna bawl uh a, minam makaite, a tul tul-a a ukte le a za za-a a ukte, le kumpipa’ nasepna-ah a uk uliante in zong hih uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian’ biakinn nasep nadingin kham talen tulnga le kham darik tul sawm, ngun talen tul sawm, sumngo talen tul sawm le tulgiat, le sik talen tul zakhat a pia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Suangmanpha a nei peuhmah in Gershon mi Jehiel’ kepna sung, Topa’ biakinn sung vanmanpha koihna-ah a pia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin hih mite in utna lungsim tawh pia uh ahih manin mite lungdam uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Topa’ tungah pia ziahziah uh a, kumpi David zong nakpitakin a lungdam hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh’ omna-ah David in Topa phat hi. David in, “Nang, Topa , ka pu uh Israel Pasian aw, a tawntungin thupha ngah ta in.","title":"David in Topa Phat David in Phat"},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, liatna, vangliatna, minthanna, gualzawhna, le min liatnate nangma a’ ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh vantung le leitungah a om khempeuh zong nangma a’ ahi hi. Topa aw, kumpi gam nangma a’ hi a, tuate khempeuh tungah nang a lutangin hong kisangsak hi.","ref":"Mat 6:13"},"12":{"text":"Hauhna le minphatna nangma kiang pan hong pai a, nangmah in na khempeuh tungah na uk hi. Na khut sungah vangliatna le minthanna om a, liatsakna ding le thakhauhsakna ding na khut sungah om hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in nangma tungah ka nuam uh hi, kote’ Pasian aw, a minthang na min ka phat uh hi."},"14":{"text":"“Ahih hangin kote in hih bangin utna tawh kong piak nadingun kei kua hi a, ka mite bang ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh na khempeuh nang kiang pan hong pai hi a, nangma a’ mah nang tungah a hong pia ka hi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu ka pate khempeuh uh mah bangin kote pen nangma mai-ah khualmite le pemtate ka hi uh hi. Ka hunte uh leitungah niliim bang hi a, sih ding ka pelh thei kei uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa kote’ Pasian aw, na min siangtho pahtawi nadingin nang a’ ding biakinn lam nadingin ka piaksa uh hih a tampite zong nangma khutsung panin hong pai hi a, a vekpi-in nangma a’ mah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah in lungsim entelin thumanna-ah na lungkimna ka thei hi, ka Pasian aw. Lungsim thumanna le citna tawh hih nate khempeuh kong pia khin a, tu-in nang tungah citna le lungdamna tawh a hong pia, hih lai-ah a om na mite ka muzo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka pute uh Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasian, Topa aw, na mite’ lungsim sungah tua bang ngimnate le ngaihsutnate omsak tawntung inla, amaute’ lungsim nangma lamah kai in."},"19":{"text":"Amah in a lungsim khempeuh tawh na thupiaknate, na teci pannate, le na thukhamte kemin a vekpi-in sem a, keimah in ka vaihawmsa biakinn lianpi amah in a lam theih nadingin ka tapa Solomon tungah utna lungsim guan in,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in a kikhawmte khempeuh tungah, “ Topa na Pasian uh phat un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in a pute a pate uh Pasian Topa phatin a lu uh kun uh a, Topa bia-in kumpipa tungah zahtakna a bawl uh hi.","title":"Solomon in Kumpi-in David Laih (1Kum 2:10-12)"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Topa tungah biakpiakna bawl uh a, a zing ciangin Topa tungah meihal biakna bawngtal tulkhat, tuutal tulkhat, le tuuno tulkhat, a leenggahzu tawh a biakna teng tawh, le Israel khempeuh a dingin biakpiakna tampi a pia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in tua ni-in lungdamna lianpi tawh Topa’ mai-ah pawi khamin a om uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in David’ tapa Solomon kumpi-in a nihveina bawl uh a, amaute in Topa a dingin amah kumpi-in sathau nilhin, siampi dingin Zadok sathau a nilh uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pa David tangin Topa’ phuhsa kumpi tokhom tungah kumpi-in Solomon a tu hi. Amah a dau pai a, Israel mi khempeuh in ama thu a mang uh hi.","ref":"1Kum 2:12"},"24":{"text":"Makaite khempeuh le a thahat mite, le Kumpi David’ tapate khempeuh in zong Kumpi Solomon tungah a thuman ding uh thu ciam uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Israel mi khempeuh muhna-ah Solomon tungah minthanna lianpi pia a, Israel sungah ama ma-in kumpi khat peuhpeuh tungah a kipia ngei nai lo kumpi minliatna a guan hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hi a, Jessi’ tapa David in Israel khempeuh tungah a uk hi."},"27":{"text":"Israel tungah ama uk hun kum sawmli sung hi a, amah in Hebron-ah kum sagih sung, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum le thum sung a uk hi.","ref":"2Sam 5:4-5; 1Khang 3:4"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin a khangham, a ni cing, hauhna le minthanna tawh a si hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Solomon in ama tangin uk hi."},"29":{"text":"Tu-in Kumpi David’ gamtatna a patna pan a tawpna dongin thumu pa Samuel’ Khang Tangthu sung, kamsang Nathan’ Khang Tangthu sung, le thumu pa Gad’ Khang Tangthu sungah"},"30":{"text":"ama ukna le ama vangliatnate khempeuh le ama tung le Israel tung, gam sung kumpi gamte khempeuh tungah a tung thute a kiciamtehna tawh kigelh khawm hi."}}}}},"14":{"info":{"name":"Khang Tangthu Nihna","shortname":"2Kt","abbr":[],"desc":"Khang Tangthu Nihnate in Khang Tangthu Masate a tawpna panin a thu zomto hi. Hih laibu sungah Solomon' ukna thu teng gen a, Jeroboam' makaihna tawh leilu lama om minamte in Kumpi Solomon' za a laih a tapa Rehoboam a lehpeina thu na ciamteh a, B.C. 586 kuma Jerusalem khuapi a puk hun dong Judah kumpi gam thu tawh na zomto hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David’ tapa Solomon in ama kumpi gam kho takin lenkip hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ama Pasian in ompih a, a lian mahmahin amah a bawl hi.","title":"Pilna ding Solomon’ Thungetna (1Kum 3:3-15)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Israel mi khempeuh tung, a tultul le a zaza-a a ukte tung, thukhente tung, Israel sunga makai khempeuh tung, le beh lutangte tungah thu a gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon le amah tawh a om khempeuh, Gibeon-a a om mual dawna biakpiakna munah pai uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ nasem Moses in gamlakah a bawlsa Pasian’ kikhopna buk tua lai-ah om hi."},"4":{"text":"(Ahih hangin David in Kiriathjearim panin ama a dingin a bawlsak nasa munah Pasian’ Thuciamna Singkuang paipihto khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Jerusalem-ah ama a dingin puanbuk khat lamsak khin hi.)","ref":"2Sam 16:1-17; 1Khang 13:5-14; 15:25-16:1"},"5":{"text":"Tua tham loin Hur’ tapa Uri, a tapa Bezalel in a bawl sumngo biakna tau pen Topa’ biakbuk mai tua lai-ah om hi. Tua ciangin Solomon le a kikhawm mite in Topa thu dong uh hi.","ref":"Pai 38:1-7"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kikhopna bukah a om Topa’ mai-a sumngo biakna tau-ah Solomon paito-in tua tungah meihal biakna ganhing tulkhat a pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zanin Solomon tungah Pasian kilangin ama kiangah, “Nang kong piak ding hong gen in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in Pasian kiangah, “Nangmah in ka pa David tungah a lian le a kip itna na lak khin a, ama tangin kumpi-in keimah nong koih khin hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Pasian aw, leitung leivui zahin a tam mite tungah kumpi-in kei hong koih khin na hih manin ka pa David tungah na thuciamna tu-in hong tungsak in.","ref":"Pian 13:16; 28:14"},"10":{"text":"Hih mite ka uk theih nadingin tu-in pilna le theihna hong pia in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih zahin a tam hih na mite kua in ukzo ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in Solomon dawngin, “Hih thu na lungsim sungah om a, nangmah in neihsate, hauhna, pahtawina, ahih kei leh nang hong mudahte’ nuntakna hong ngen loin, a tungah kumpi-in nang kong koihna ka mite na uk theih nadingin nang a’ ding pilna le theihna hong ngen na hih manin,"},"12":{"text":"pilna le theihna nangma tungah hong kipia hi. Nang’ ma-a kumpite kuamah in a neih ngei loh, nang’ khit-ate kuamah in zong tua bang a neih loh ding hauhnate, neihnate, le pahtawina zong, nangma tungah kong pia thuah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Gibeon-a om mual dawna biakpiakna mun, kikhopna buk mai panin Jerusalem-ah Solomon hong pai hi. Tua ciangin amah in Israel tungah a uk hi."},"14":{"text":"Solomon in leengte le sakol tung tuangte kaikhawm hi. Amah in leeng tulkhat le zali le sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm le tulnih nei a, leeng khuapite sung le Jerusalem-ah tuate a koih hi.","title":"Sakolte le Leengte tawh Solomon’ Sumbawlna (1Kum 10:26-29 ; 2Khang 9:25-28)","ref":"1Kum 4:26"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah suang bangin ngun le kham olsak a, taamtak singte pen Shefelah theithek sing bangin tamsak hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:17; 1Kum 10:27"},"16":{"text":"Solomon in gamdang panin sakol a lakna munte pen Egypt le Kue pan hi a, kumpipa’ sumbawlte in a man ding pia-in Kue panin tuate ngah uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:16"},"17":{"text":"Amaute in Egypt panin leeng khat ciangin ngun shekel za guk-in la uh a, sakol khat ciangin za le sawmnga-in la uh hi. Tua bangmahin amaute in zuakkhiat kik dingin Hit kumpite le Syria kumpite khempeuh tung panin zong sakol le leeng a la uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon in Topa’ min dingin biakinn khat le ama a dingin kumpi inn khat lam ding sawm hi.","title":"Kumpi Hiram tawh Solomon’ Thukimna (1Kum 5:1-18 ; 7:13-14)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in van a pua ding mi tul sawmsagih le mualtung gamah suang a to ding mi tul sawmgiat, le tuate a van dingin mi tulthum le zaguk a seh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in Taia kumpi Hiram kiangah thu puak a, “Tenna ding inn khat a lam nadingin ka pa David tungah taamtak sing na puak mah bangin kei tungah zong hong puak in."},"4":{"text":"En in, Israel-te a dingin a tawntung a ding a kikipsaksa bangin, ama mai-ah a namtui nate ahi paknamtui halna ding, le Ompihna Anlum piak tawntungna ding, le Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le Topa kote’ Pasian a dingin a kisehsa pawi nite-in zing le nitakin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Topa ka Pasian’ minin biakinn khat lamin ama tungah a ap ding ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Kote’ Pasian pen pasian dang khempeuh sangin lianzaw ahih manin ka lam ding biakinn zong lian ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahih hangin vantung, a sang pen vantung nangawn in amah huam zo lo ahih manin ama a dingin kua in biakinn lamzo ding ahi hiam? Ama mai-ah paknamtui halna ding cih simloh ama a dingin biakinn a lamsak dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?","ref":"1Kum 8:27; 2Khang 6:18"},"7":{"text":"Tua hi a, tu-in ka pa David in a sehsa, Judah le Jerusalem-ah kei tawh a om nasep siamte tawh a semkhawm dingin kham, ngun, sumngo, le sik, le a ausan, a dupsan, puandumte, le nasepna-ah zong siamna a nei mi khat hong puak in."},"8":{"text":"Taamtak, taaksan, le cingsing zong, Lebanon panin hong puak in; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasemte in Lebanon sing phuk ding zia a theihna ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin kei a dingin sing tampi a sem dingin nangma nasemte pen keima nasemte tawh om ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka lam ding biakinn pen lianin lamdang ding hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Sing nasem sing a phukte a dingin a kisuvui mangbuh beem tul sawmnih, mangbuhham beem tul sawmnih, leenggahzu tambong tul sawmli, le sathau tambong tul sawmli ka hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Taia kumpipa Hiram in lai-in thuk-in Solomon kiangah khak a, “ Topa in a mite it ahih manin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin a lai sungah genthuah lai a, “ Topa a dingin biakinn khat, le ama a dingin kumpi inn khat a lam ding, thutheihna le thutelna tawh a kidim mipil, David tungah a pia, van le lei a bawl Israel Topa Pasian in thupha ngah tahen."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in Dan minam numei khat’ tapa, thutelna tawh a kidim, siamna a nei, siapa Huram kong puak hi. Ama pa pen Taia khuami ahi hi. Amah in kham, ngun, sumngo, sik, le sing, le a ausan, a dum, le a dupsan puante, le saihadial puan, le zepna nam khempeuh a sem ding le ka topa ahi na pa David’ mi khutsiamte tawh a semkhawm dingin ama tungah a kipia nasep khat peuhpeuh a sem dingin siamna a neisa ahi hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka topa in a gensa mangbuh le mangbuhham, sathau le leenggahzute, na nasemte tungah hong puak in."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin na kisap sing peuhmah Lebanon panin kong phuk ding uh a, nangmah in Jerusalem-ah na puaktoh theih nadingin phongin tuipi tungah Joppa dong nang kiangah kong paipih ding uh hi,” zong ci lai hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pa David in mi phazah a sim mah bangin, Solomon in Israel gam sunga om gamdang mi phazah simna bawl a, mi tul zakhat le tul sawmnga le tulthum le zaguk pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in van a pua dingin amaute tul sawmsagih, mualtung gamah suang a to dingin tul sawmgiat, le mite’ nasep a van dingin tulthum le zaguk a seh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in Jerusalem sung Moriah Mual tung, a pa David’ tungah Topa a kilahna mun, David in a sehnasa mun ahi, Jebus mi Ornan’ ancilna phualah Topa’ biakinn lam ding kipan hi.","title":"Solomon in Topa’ Biakinn Lam Solomon in Biakinn Lam (1Kum 6:1-38)","ref":"Pian 22:2"},"2":{"text":"Amah in ama uk a kum lina a kha nihna sungin lam ding kipan hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian’ biakinn lamna ding Solomon’ geelna hih bang ahi hi: A dung pi sawmkua hi a, a vai pi sawmthum ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Inn mai-a innliim pen inn vai tawh kikimin pi sawmthum sau a, a sanna zong pi sawmthum mah ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in taaksan tawh innpi kawm dapin kham hoih tawh zut a, tua tungah nisuh le khainiang a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in suangmanpha phutin a inn zem hi. A kham zatte Parvaim kham ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in a inn, a innsunte, a sangkilte, a kawmte, le a kongkhakte kham tawh zut a, tua ciangin a kawmte tungah kherub-te a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in siangtho pen mun bawl hi. A dung pen a vai tawh kizui-in pi sawmthum hi a, a vai zong pi sawmthum mah ahi hi. Amah in kham hoih talen zaguk tawh a zut hi.","ref":"Pai 26:33-34"},"9":{"text":"A kilhnate a gihna kham shekel sawmnga ahi hi. Tua ciangin amah in a inn dawl tungnungte kham tawh a zut hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in siangtho pen mun sungah sing kherub nih bawlin kham tawh tuate zut hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua kherub tegel’ kha a kizalin pi sawmthum ahi hi. A khat’ kha pen pi sagih le alang hi-in inn kawm ban a, tua ciangin alang khat pi sagih le alang in a kherub dang khat’ kha ban hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua mah bangin a kherub dang khat’ kha langkhat zong pi sagih le alang hi-in inn kawm langkhat ban a, pi sagih le alang mah a sau a kha langkhat pen a kherub masa’ kha tawh kizom hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih kherub-te’ khate in pi sawmthum huam hi. Kherub-te amau’ khe-in dingin innpi sunglam nga uh hi.","ref":"Pai 25:18-20"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a dum, a ausan, le a dupsan puante, le saihadial puan tawh a dalna puan bawl a, tua tungah kherub-te a bawl hi.","ref":"Pai 26:31"},"15":{"text":"Amah in inn mai sanah pi sawmnga le pi nih le alang a sang, a dawn tuakah pi sagih le alang a pha khuamluzepna a nei khuampi nih bawl hi.","title":"Biakinn Sungah Huram’ Nasep (1Kum 7:15-51)"},"16":{"text":"Amah in ngawng a awhte bangin khainiangte bawlin khuampite dawnah khai hi. Tua ciangin amah in mang kawlsing zakhat bawlin khainiangte tungah koih hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in tua khuamte, khat leitaw lam, a khat leilu lam, biakinn mai-ah phut hi. Amah in leitaw lama om pen Jakhin phuakin, leilu lama om pen Boaz a phuak hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah in sumngo biakna tau, a dung pi sawmthum, a vai pi sawmthum, a sang pi sawm le nga a pha khat bawl hi.","ref":"Pai 27:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a kisung tuikuangpi khat zong bawl hi. Tua pen a bem hi a, a gei khat pan a gei khat dong pi sawm le nga pha-in, pi sagih le alang sang a, a kimkot pi sawmli le nga a pha hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuikuangpi pualam kimkot pi sawmlinga sungah umgah limte om hi. Tua um gahte gual nihin om a, tuikuangpi a kisunin kisungkhawm pah hi."},"4":{"text":"Bawngtal sawm le nihte tungah tua tuikuangpi kinga a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuahna lam nga hi. Tuate tungah a tuikuangpi kinga a, a nunglam uh a sunglamah om hi."},"5":{"text":"A sahna pen khutpeek mai cia ahi hi; a geivial pen unok tawh a kibang hai geivial bangin kibawl a, tua sungah tui tambong tulguk val ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in kisilna ding tuikuang dang sawm zong bawl a, leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga a koih hi. Amaute in meihal biakna-a a zatte uh hihte sungah silsiang ding uh a, tuikuangpi pen siampite’ kisilna ding ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 30:17-21"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a kigelhsa bangin kham meivakkhuam sawm bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga a koih hi.","ref":"Pai 25:31-40"},"8":{"text":"Amah in sabuai sawm zong bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lampangah nga, leilu lampangah nga koih hi. Tua ciangin amah in kham kuang zakhat bawl hi.","ref":"Pai 25:23-30"},"9":{"text":"Amah in siampite’ inntual, le inntual lian, le inntual kongkhakte bawl a, a kongkhakte sumngo tawh a zut hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in inn khang nisuahna lam kiu-ah tuikuangpi koih hi."},"11":{"text":"Huram in beelte, kawbiate, le kuangte zong bawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin Huram in Kumpi Solomon a dingin Pasian’ biakinn a bawl nasep a zawhte:"},"12":{"text":"Khuampi nihte, kuang-ukte, le a khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna nihte, khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna, kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen bangin a kibawl nihte,"},"13":{"text":"khuampite tungah a om khuamluzepna kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen banga kibawl khat a dingin mang kawlsing gual nih ahi ngen banga kibawl nihte a dingin mang kawlsing za lite,"},"14":{"text":"tuikuang a kingaknate le tuate tungah a kikoih tuikuangte,"},"15":{"text":"tuikuangpi khat, le tua nuai-a a om bawngtal sawm le nihte,"},"16":{"text":"Topa’ biakinn dingin Kumpi Solomon a dingin siapa Huram in a kihal sumngo tawh a bawl beelte, kawbiate, sikkeukate, le hihte a dingin nazat khempeuh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Jordan zanglei sung Sukkoth le Zeredah kikal beel lei-ah kumpipa in hihte sungsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Solomon in hih nate tampi tak bawlsak a, sumngo a gikzah kithei zo lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Pasian’ biakinn sunga na khempeuh a bawl sakte: Kham biakna tau, Ompihna Anlum a dingin sabuaite,"},"20":{"text":"a kigelhsa bangin biakinn sungnung mai-ah vak dingin kham citak meivakkhuamte le a meivakte;"},"21":{"text":"kham hoih pen tawh a kibawl a paakte, a meivakte, le a tehte;"},"22":{"text":"kham citak tawh a kibawl a taitehte, kuangte, paknamtui a dingin pakante, le vutluahna ahi hi. Siangtho pen mun pai nading kongkhak sungnungte a’ ding le biakinnpi sung kongkhakte a dingin biakinn kongkhak bilte zong kham tawh a kibawl ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua bangin Topa’ biakinn ding a hih nasep khempeuh kizo hi. Tua ciangin a pa David in a apsa nate Solomon in paipihin, Pasian’ biakinn sung vanmanpha koihnate sungah a ngunte, a khamte, le umlebeel khempeuh a seng hi.","ref":"2Sam 8:11; 1Khang 18:11"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zion a kici David khuapi sung panin Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang a paipihto dingin Kumpi Solomon in Israel upate, minam lutang khempeuh, le Israel beh makaite, Jerusalem-ah kaikhawm hi.","title":"Solomon in Thuciamna Singkuang Biakinn sungah Paipih (1Kum 8:1-11)","ref":"2Sam 6:12-15; 1Khang 15:25-28"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kha sagihna-a pawi hun sungin kumpipa’ mai-ah Israel mi khempeuh kikhawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel upate khempeuh hong pai uh a, Levi mite in Thuciamna Singkuang la uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Thuciamna Singkuang, le kikhopna buk, le puanbuk sunga om a siangtho umlebeel khempeuh puato uh a, siampite le Levi mite in tuate puato uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon le ama mai-ah a kikhawm Israel-te khempeuh Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah om uh a, biakna-in tuu le bawngtal tampi tak pia uh ahih manin a phazah kisim zo lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin siampite in kherub-te’ kha nuai, siangtho pen mun sung, biakinn sungnung sung ama munah Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang a paipih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kherub-te in Thuciamna Singkuang tungah a khate uh zak uh ahih manin kherub-te pen Thuciamna Singkuang le a zawlte tungah khuhna khat a suak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A zawlte sau ahih manin siangtho mun panin biakinn sungnung mai-ah a mongte kidawk a, ahih hangin a pualam panin kimu thei lo hi; tuni dongin tua lai-ah tuate om hi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt panin amaute hong paikhiat lai-in Topa in Israel mite tawh thuciamna a bawlna mun Horeb-ah Moses in suangpek nihte a koih simloh Thuciamna Singkuang sungah bangmah dang om lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:5"},"11":{"text":"Siangtho mun panin siampite hong pusuakin (bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ pawlte cihtuam om loin tua lai-a om siampite khempeuh amau mahmah kisiansuah uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi mi lasate Asaf, Heman, le Jeduthun, amau’ tapate le a behte, saihadial puan tawh kizemin, daltuahte, harp lasaknate, le laiza lasaknate tawi-in peengkul tum siampite za le sawmnih tawh biakna tau nisuahna lamah ding khawm uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw kikhatin phatin Topa’ tungah lungdam koh ding pen peengkul tumte le lasate’ nasep ahi hi) peengkulte le daltuahte le adang lasaknate tawh, “ Topa’ tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi,” ci-in Topa phatna-in la a kisak ciangin, Topa’ biakinn sung meii tawh kidim a,","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 7:3; Ezr 3:11; La 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"14":{"text":"meii hangin siampite in na sem zo lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ minthanna vangtaang Pasian’ biakinn sung a dim hi.","ref":"Pai 40:34-35"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in, “Khuamial sahpi sungah ten ding a teel Topa aw,","title":"Biakinn Apna (1Kum 8:12-66)"},"2":{"text":"a tawntungin na tenna ding a lian biakinn khat hih lai-ah kong lamsak khin hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in en kawikawi a, Israel mi a kikhawmte khempeuh a din laitakin amaute khempeuh thupha a pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, ‘Egypt gam panin ka mite ka paikhiatpih ni a kipanin keima min a om nadingin Israel minam khempeuh sungah biakinn khat lamna ding khuapi khat zong ka teel kei a, keima mi Israel tungah kumpi dingin mi khat zong ka teel kei hi. Ahih hangin tu-in ka min a om theih nadingin Jerusalem teelin ka mi Israel-te tungah a uk dingin David ka teel khinta hi,’ ci-in genin, ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a thuciamna a khut tawh a tungsak Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah tahen.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"“Tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa’ min dingin biakinn khat lam ding ka pa David’ lungsim sungah om hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in ka pa David tungah, ‘Na lungsimah keima min dingin biakinn khat lam ding na ngaihsun a, tua na ngaihsutna hoih mahmah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin keima min dingin tua biakinn a lam ding pa nangmah hi loin, nangma sung pan hong piang ding na tapa hizaw ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-13; 1Khang 17:1-12"},"10":{"text":"“Tu-in Topa in a bawlsa thuciamna tungsak khin hi; bang hang hiam cih le Topa’ thuciam bangin ka pa David munah hong khangin Israel kumpi tokhomah kong tu a, Israel Pasian, Topa’ min dingin biakinn ka lam khin hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in Israel mite tawh a bawl Topa’ thuciamna a kikoihna Thuciamna Singkuang tu-in tua lai-ah ka koih khin hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh’ omna Topa’ biakna tau mai-ah Solomon dingin a khut zan hi."},"13":{"text":"Solomon in a dung pi sagih le alang, a vai pi sagih le alang, a sang pi li le alang a pha sumngo tau khat bawlin inntualah a koih khin hi. Tua ciangin tua tungah amah ding hi. Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh’ muhin amah khukdinin van lamah a khut zan hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in thu ngen a, “Israel Pasian, Topa aw, vantungah ahi a, leitungah ahi zongin thuciamna lenin a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh nangma thu hong mang na nasemte tungah itna kip a lak, nang tawh a kibang Pasian dang om lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama tungah na gensa bangin na nasem ka pa David tungah a tungsak pa na hi hi. Na kam tawh thu na gen a, na khut tawh tuni-in na tungsak takpi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa aw, ama tungah thu ciamin, ‘Keima thu na hong man’ bangin na suan na khakte in ka thukham zui-in a gamtatna uhah a kidop nak-uhleh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin keima mai-ah mi khat beek na kitasam kei ding hi,’ na cihsa bangin na nasem ka pa David tawh na thuciamsa kipsak in.","ref":"1Kum 2:4"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa aw, na nasempa David tungah na gensa na kammal kipsak in."},"18":{"text":"“Ahih hangin Pasian pen mite tawh leitungah hong teng takpi ding ahi hiam? En in, vantung le a sangpen vantung in nang hong huam zo lo hi; hih keima lamsa biakinn in hong huam zo lo zaw kan ding!","ref":"2Khang 2:6"},"19":{"text":"Ahi zongin na nasempa’ thungetna le hong thumna don in, Topa ka Pasian aw, na nasempa na mai-ah hong kikona le a hong nget thungetna hong ngai in."},"20":{"text":"Na nasempa in hih mun lamah hong thungetna na zak theih nadingin nangmah in na min koih nadingin na ciamsa mun hih biakinn lam sun le zanin hong en in.","ref":"Thkna 12:11"},"21":{"text":"Amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu hong nget uh ciangin na nasempa le na mi Israel-te’ hong thumnate nangmah in ngai in. Na tenna mun vantung panin hong za takpi inla, na zak ciangin hong maisak in."},"22":{"text":"“Mi khat a vengte tungah khialin kiciamna kiciamsak a, hong pai-in hih biakinn sung na biakna tau mai-ah a kiciamna hong kiciam le,"},"23":{"text":"vantung panin za-in gamta inla, na nasemte thu khenin, a mawh mi a gamtatna ama lu tung mahah tusakin thuk inla, a thuman mi a thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman piakna tawh langsak in."},"24":{"text":"“Na mi Israel-te nang tungah hong khialhna hangin a galte uh mai-ah guallelin, amaute hong kihei kikin na min hong phawkin hih biakinn sung nangma kiangah thu ngenin thumna hong bawl uh ciangin,"},"25":{"text":"vantung panin nangmah in za inla, na mi Israel-te’ khialhna maisakin amaute le a pu a pate uh tungah na piak leitangah amaute paipih kik in."},"26":{"text":"“Amaute nangma tungah hong khialhna hangin vantung kikhak cipin guah a zuk loh hun, amaute na gimsak hun ciangin, amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu ngen a, na min hong phawkin amau’ khialhna panin a kihei uh le,"},"27":{"text":"amaute a pai nading lampi hoih hilh inla, vantung panin za-in na nasem, na mi Israel-te’ khialhna maisak in. Tua ciangin na mite tungah gamh-in na piak leitang tungah guah zusak in."},"28":{"text":"“Gam sungah kialpi tungin, pulnatna ahi a, ankung natna ahi a, ankung zawngkhalna ahi a, kauphe ahi a, lung ahi zongin a om a, amau’ khuapi khat peuhpeuhah a galte un umcihin, bangbang gimna, bangbang natna hitaleh,"},"29":{"text":"mi khatpeuh ahi a, na mi Israel-te khempeuh in ahi zongin amau’ natna le a dahna ciat uh thei-in hih biakinn lamah a khut uh hong zanin bangbang thungetna hitaleh bangbang thumna hitaleh hong bawl uhleh,"},"30":{"text":"na tenna mun vantung panin za inla, maisakin, amau’ gamtatna khempeuh tawh kizui-in a lungsim uh na theih bangin amaute tungah pia ciat in (bang hang hiam cih leh nang, nang bek in mihing’ lungsim na thei hi)."},"31":{"text":"Tua hileh ka pu ka pate uh tungah na piak leitang tungah a nuntak hun sung khempeuh uh amaute in nang hong zahtakin nangma thu hong zui ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tua mah bangin na mi Israel ahi lo gamdang mi khat a lian nangma min hang, le nangma thahatna hangin a gamlapi gam panin hong pai-in, hih biakinn lam nga-in thu hong nget leh"},"33":{"text":"na tenna mun vantung panin za inla, gamdang mipa in na tungah hong ngetna khempeuh tawh kizui-in hih in. Tua hileh nangma mi Israel-te mah bangin leitung mi khempeuh in na min thei-in nang hong zahtak ding uh a, keima lamsa hih biakinn pen nangma min tawh a kilo ahihna thei ding uh hi."},"34":{"text":"“A galte uh a do dingin na mite kuankhia-in, bangbang lamah amaute sawl hita lecin, nangmah in na teelsa hih khuapi, nangma tung le nangma min dingin ka lamsa hih biakinn lam nga-in amaute in thu hong nget uhleh,"},"35":{"text":"amau’ hong thungetna le hong thumnate vantung panin za-in amau’ vai huh in."},"36":{"text":"“Amaute nang tungah hong khialin (a khial lo kua om ahi hiam?) amaute tungah nang heh a, galte tungah amaute pia-in, amaute a gamla gam ahi a, a nai-ah ahi zongin galmatin kipuakhia a,"},"37":{"text":"ahi zongin galmatin a kipuakna gamah amaute in a lungsim sung uhah tua thu ngaihsunin kisikkik a, ‘Kote khialin lampialin ka gitloh tat uh hi,’ ci-in amaute galmatin a omna uh gam panin nang tungah hong thum a,"},"38":{"text":"amaute galmatin a kitutna, galmatin a omna uh leitangah a ngaihsutna khempeuh uh le a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amaute kisikkikin, na teelsa khuapi le nangma min dingin ka lamsa biakinn, nangmah in amau’ pute pate tungah na piak amau’ leitang lam nga-in thu hong nget uh le,"},"39":{"text":"na tenna vantung panin amau’ thungetna le hong thumnate za in la, amau’ vai huhin nang tungah hong khial na mite maisak in."},"40":{"text":"“Ka Pasian aw, tu-in na mit hak inla, hih lai mun a thungetna na bil hong ngat in."},"41":{"text":"Tu-in ding in, Topa Pasian aw, na tawlngakna ding munah na vangliatna lim Thuciamna Singkuang tawh pai in. Topa Pasian aw, na siampite, thupha pia inla, na hoihna-ah na mi siangthote lungdam tahen."},"42":{"text":"Topa Pasian aw, na sathau nilh pa nial kei in. Na nasempa David na itnasa hong phawk in,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 132:8-10"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon a thunget a tawp ciangin, vantung panin meikuang hong paisukin meihal biakna le biakpiaknate kangtum a, tua ciangin Topa’ minthanna vang biakinn sung hong dim hi.","ref":"Siam 9:23-24"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ minthanna vang biakinn dim ahih manin Topa’ biakinn sungah siampite lut thei lo uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mite khempeuh in meikuang hong paisukin Topa’ minthanna vang biakinn tungah a om a muh uh ciangin suangphah tungah leilam maingatin kun uh a, Pasian bia-in Topa’ tungah lungdamna ko-in, “ Topa’ tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 5:13; Ezr 3:11; La 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa le mi khempeuh in Topa’ mai-ah biakna pia uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in biakna-in bawngtal tul sawmnih le tulnih, le tuu tul zakhat le tul sawmnih pia hi. Tua bangin kumpipa le mi khempeuh in Pasian’ biakinn a ap uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampite amau panmun uhah ding uh hi. Levi mite zong, Kumpi David in Topa tungah lungdam koh nadingin a bawl Topa’ tungah lasakna ding lasaknate tawh ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi. David in amau’ nasepna tawh phatnate a bawl ciangin tua bangin hih uh hi. Amaute tawh a kigalsai-ah siampite in peengkulte tum uh a, Israel mi khempeuh zong a ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in Topa’ biakinn mai-ah a om inntual laizang ap hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Solomon in a bawl sumngo biakna tau-ah meihal biakna le a thaute ta zo lo ahih manin tua lai munah amah in meihal biakna le thunuama biakna thaute a pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Solomon le amah tawh a om Israel khempeuh mihon tampi in Hamath lutna panin Egypt lui ciang dongah ni sagih sung pawi a kham uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ni giat ni-in amaute in a thukhupna khat nei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in biakinn apna ni sagih sung pawi kham uh a, tua pawi ni sagih sung kibawl hi."},"10":{"text":"A kha sagihna a ni thum ni-in, Topa in David le Solomon, le ama mi Israel tungah a hoih a bawlna hangin amah in lungdamna le kipakna tawh a inn uhah mite a ciahsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua bangin Solomon in Topa’ biakinn le kumpi inn zo hi. Solomon in Topa’ biakinn le ama inn sungah hih dinga a geel khempeuh nuamtakin zo hi.","title":"Solomon tungah Topa a Solomon tungah a Nihveina Kilang (1Kum 9:1-9)"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin zanin Solomon tungah Topa kilangin ama kiangah, “Na thungetna ka za khin a, keima-a’ dingin biakpiakna inn dingin hih mun ka teel khin hi."},"13":{"text":"Keimah in vantungte khakcipin guah a zuk loh ciang ahi a, gam sung a netum dingin kauphe thu ka piak ciang ahi a, ka mite lakah natna ka tunsak ciang ahi zongin,"},"14":{"text":"keima minin a kisam ka mite amau mahmah kiniamkhiatin, thu ngenin ka mai hong zong a, amau’ gitlohnate panin a kihei uhleh, keimah in vantung panin ka za ding a, amaute’ khialhna maisakin a leitang uh ka hoihsakkik ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in ka mitte hakin hih lai munah a kingen thungetna ka bilte in ngai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a tawntungin ka min a om theih nadingin keimah in hih biakinn teelin ka ap khin a, ka mit tawh enin ka lungsim a tawntungin tua lai-ah om ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang a dingin ahihleh, na pa David a gamtat bangin keima mai-ah na gamtat a, nang kong sawl khempeuh bangin semin, ka thukhamte le ka biakna ngeina kipte na zuih leh,"},"18":{"text":"na pa David tawh kiciamin, ‘Israel a uk dingin mi khat zong na kitasam kei ding hi,’ ka cih bangin na kumpi tokhom ka kipsak ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 2:4"},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin note kihei-in, na mai uhah ka koihsa ka thukhamte leh ka thupiaknate nusia a, pai-in pasian dangte’ na semin tuate na biak uhleh,"},"20":{"text":"note’ tungah kong piaksa leitang panin note kong botkhia ding hi. Tua ciangin ka min dingin ka apsa hih biakinn ka muhna panin ka lawnkhia ding a, mi khempeuh lakah paunak le gentehna ka suaksak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua ciangin a minthangsa hih biakinn a nawkkha khempeuh in lamdangsa-in, ‘Bang hangin hih bangin Topa in hih gam le hih biakinn bawl ahi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, ‘Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt gam panin amaute a paikhiatpih a pu a pate uh Pasian ahi Topa amaute in nusia uh a, pasian dangte pom uh a, tuate bia-in a na sem uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in hih bang siatna khempeuh amaute tungah tungsak hi,’ ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Topa’ biakinn le ama inn a lam khit kum sawmnih a cin ciangin,","title":"Solomon’ Sepzomte (1Kum 9:10-28)"},"2":{"text":"Kumpi Hiram in ama tungah a piaksa khuapite Solomon in lampha-in tuate sungah Israel mite tengsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hamathzobah-ah Solomon pai-in tua gam a la hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in sehnel gam sungah Tadmor khua satin Hamath gam sungah vankoihna khuapite khempeuh a lam hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in khuapi kulh, kongpite, le zawlte a nei Bethhoron Tungnung leh Bethhoron Nuainung,"},"6":{"text":"le Baalath, le Solomon’ neih vankoihna khuapite khempeuh, a leengte a’ ding khuapite khempeuh, a sakol tuangte a’ ding khuapite, le Solomon in Jerusalem, Lebanon sung, le ama ukna gam sung khempeuhah a lamnop khempeuh zong a lam hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel ahi lo Hit mite, Amor mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite sung panin a omlai,"},"8":{"text":"Israel mite in a suksiat nai loh amau nungah a suanlekhakte uh tua gam sungah a omlaite, Solomon in aana tawh siah a pia dingin bawl a, tua bangin tuni dongin amaute om uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin Israel mite ahihleh Solomon in ama na a sem dingin salin bawl lo hi. Amaute pen galkapte, ama nuai-ah uliante, a leengte a ukte, le a sakol tung tuangte ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon’ ulian, mite’ tungah aana a zang mihing zanih le sawmnga a om uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in David khuapi panin Faro’ tanu ama zi paipihin ama a’ dingin a lamsak inn-ah tunpih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “ Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang a tunnasa munte a siangtho ahih manin Israel kumpi David’ inn sungah ka zi teng lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le kum simin a kinei pawi thum - silngo sawh loh anlum pawi, nipikal pawi, le biakbuk pawite a dingin Moses’ thupiakna tawh kizui-in nisimin piakna nasep ding a kisam ahih mah bangin innliim mai-a a lam Topa’ biakna tau tungah Solomon in meihal biakna Topa tungah a pia hi.","ref":"Pai 23:14-17; 34:22-23; Gam 28:9-15; 28:16-29:39; Thkna 16:16","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"A pa David’ biakna ngeina kip tawh kizui-in, nasep nadingin siampite a pawlpawlin a kikhennate, le nisim nasepna-ah a kisam bangin siampite’ mai-ah Levi mite phatna lasak panmunte le kongpi tampite-a’ dingin kongcingte amau’ pawl kikhenna ciatah amah in seh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua bangin Pasian’ mipa David in thu pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Thu khat peuhpeuh le vanmanpha koihnate tawh kisai-in kumpipa in siampite le Levi mite a thupiakna bang teekteekin amaute in a sem uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin Topa’ biakinnpi a kiphuh ni a kipan a kizawh dongin Solomon’ nasep khempeuh kimansiang hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ biakinn kizo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Edom gam sung tuipi gei-a om Eziongeber le Eloth khuate-ah Solomon pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Hiram in teembawte le tuipi a thei a nasemte tawh ama nasemte sawl a, Solomon’ nasemte tawh Ofir-ah paikhawmin tua lai panin kham talen zali le sawmnga pua-in Kumpi Solomon kiang a tunpih uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Sheba kumpinu in Solomon’ minthanna a zak ciangin thudotna haksate tawh a ze-et dingin Jerusalem-ah hong pai a, nungzui honpi le a namtui nate le kham tampi le suangmanphate a pua kalaohte hong keng hi. Solomon kiangah amah hong tun ciangin a lungsim a om khempeuh ama tungah gen hi.","title":"Solomon kiangah Sheba Kumpinu Hawh (1Kum 10:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in ama dotna khempeuh dawng hi. Solomon in ama tungah a gentel theih loh haksa lua a sak bangmah om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon’ pilna, a lamsa inn,"},"4":{"text":"a sabuai-ah a an, a uliante’ omzia, le a nasemte’ etna zia le a puansilhte, a anpiate le a puansilhte, le Topa’ biakinn-ah a piak a meihal biaknate a muh khit ciangin a lungsim a bei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah, “Ka gam sung panin nangma thute le na pilna ka zak a kigen thute a man hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei hong pai-in ka mit in a muh matengin a kigen thute ka um kei hi. A taktakin, na pilna alang zong kei kiangah hong kigen lo ahi hi. Ka zaksa thute sangin na thupi zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Na zite hampha mahmah hi. Na mai-ah ding tawntungin na pilna a za hih na nasemte hampha mahmah hi."},"8":{"text":"Na tungah lungkimin Topa na Pasian a dingin kumpi-in a kumpi tokhom tungah nang hong tusak Topa na Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen! Na Pasian in Israel mite itin a tawntungin amaute kipsak ding ahih manin, nangmah in thutang le thuman na sepkhiat theih nadingin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa tungah kham talen zakhat le sawmnih, le a namtui nate tampi tak, le suangmanphate a pia hi. Sheba kumpinu in Kumpi Solomon tungah a piak tua banga a namtui nate zahin a hoih om ngei lo hi.","ref":"Mat 12:42; Luk 11:31"},"10":{"text":"Tua tham loin Ofir panin kham hong pua Kumpi Hiram’ nasemte le Solomon’ nasemte in cingsing le suangmanphate hong pua uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Topa’ biakinn le kumpi inn-a cingsing kahlei ding le lasate-a’ dingin laiza lasaknate le harp lasaknate-in zong a bawl hi. Tua hun ma-in Judah gam sungah tua bang kimu ngei lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpinu in amah a puakte a thukna-in letsong a piakte banah, a deih khempeuh, a nget khempeuh, Sheba kumpinu tungah Solomon in a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kihei-in a nasemte tawh ama gamah a ciahkik hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in kum khat sungin Solomon tungah a tung kham a gihna talen zaguk le sawmguk le guk hi a,","title":"Solomon’ Hauhna le Minthanna (1Kum 10:14-25 ; 2Khang 1:14-17)"},"14":{"text":"sumbawlte le sumbukte’ tutte a kisim lo ahi hi. Arabia kumpite khempeuh le gam sung a ukte in Solomon kiangah kham le ngun puak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in kham a kiseek lumpi zanih bawl hi; lum khat ciangin a kiseek kham shekel zaguk bei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a kiseek kham lum zathum bawl hi; lum khat ciangin kham shekel zathum bei hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Lebanon Tulak Inn sungah tuate koih hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in saiha kibawl kumpi tokhom a lian khat zong bawl a, kham citak tawh zut hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi tokhom in cial guk le kham a kibawl khengakna khat nei-in, tuate kumpi tokhom tawh kimat a, a tutna pang tuakah ban ngaknate le a ban ngaknate pangah humpinelkai nih ding a,"},"19":{"text":"kahlei cial guk mong ciatah khat ciat, humpinelkai sawm le nih ding hi. Kumpi gam khat peuhpeuhah tua tawh a kibang kibawl ngei lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon’ dawnna haite khempeuh kham hi a, Lebanon Tulak Inn sunga umlebeelte khempeuh zong kham citak ahi hi. Solomon’ hun lai-in ngun bangmahin kingaihsun lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpi Hiram’ nasemte tawh kumpipa’ teembawte, Tarshish-ah pai hi. Tarshish teembawte kum thum simin khatvei hong tungin kham, ngun, saiha, zawngmaw, le utong hong puak zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua bangin kumpi Solomon in hauhna le pilna tawh leitung kumpi khempeuh khumkhelh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian in ama lungsim sungah a koihsak pilna a za dingin leitung kumpi khempeuh in Solomon’ omna hong zong uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute khempeuh in a letsong ciat uh, ngun le kham tawh a kibawl nate, puante, myrrh paknamtuite, a namtui nate, sakolte, le la-sakolte, a kum kumin tampi tak hong puak uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Solomon in sakolte le leengte a dingin buk tulli, le sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm le tulnih nei a, leeng khuapite sungah pawlkhat koih a, Jerusalem khua ama kiangah pawlkhat koih hi.","ref":"1Kum 4:26"},"26":{"text":"Amah in Eufratis panin Filistia gam ciang, le Egypt gamgi ciang dong kumpi khempeuh a uk hi.","ref":"Pian 15:18; 1Kum 4:21"},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah suang bangin ngun olsak a, Shefelah theithek sing bangin taamtak sing tamsak hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:27"},"28":{"text":"Solomon a dingin Egypt le gam khempeuh panin sakolte kila hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:16"},"29":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon’ gamtatna a omlaite, a kipatna pan a tawp dong, Kamsang Nathan’ Tangthu sung, le Shiloh Khua Mi Ahijah’ Thugen Kholhna sung, le Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam thu tawh kisai-in Thumu pa Iddo’ Maangmuhna sungah kigelh hi.","title":"Solomon’ Sihna (1Kum 11:41-43)"},"30":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem panin Israel khempeuh tungah kum sawmli sung uk hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon si a, a pa David khuapi sungah kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Rehoboam in ama tangin a uk hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah kumpi a suaksak dingin Israel khempeuh Shekhem-ah pai ahih manin Shekhem-ah Rehoboam pai hi.","title":"Israel-te’ Galthawhna (1Kum 12:1-24)"},"2":{"text":"Nebat’ tapa Jeroboam in tua thu a zak ciangin (bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpi Solomon kiang panin a taina Egypt-ah amah omlai hi), Egypt panin Jeroboam hong ciahkik hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in mi sawlin amah samkik uh a, tua ciangin Jeroboam le Israel khempeuh hong pai-in Rehoboam kiangah,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa in hong gimbawlin vangik hong suan hi. Amah in galhiamte le lumte zong tampi bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in mite a uk dingin galdona-ah a ukte koih a, khuapi kulhkongpi mun awnna ama kiangah amaute khawmin amaute tungah hanthotna tawh thu genin,"},"7":{"text":"“Thakhauh unla hang un. Tua ahih ciangin mite in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah’ kammalte a muang uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih thute khit ciangin a galkap khempeuh tawh Lakhish a umcih, Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah le Jerusalem-ah a om Judah mi khempeuh kiang Jerusalem-ah a nasemte sawlin,"},"10":{"text":"“Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Note in Jerusalem umcihna na nanna ding uh bang suang na hi uh hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Hezekiah in note kiangah, “Assiria kumpipa’ khut panin Topa i Pasian in eite hong honkhia ding hi,” hong cih ciangin, note gilkial dangtakin a hong sisak dingin amah in note hong makai khial hi lo ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Hih Hezekiah mah in mual dawna a biakpiaknate le ama biakna taute lakhia-in Judah le Jerusalem thu pia a, “Biakna tau khat mai-ah note in bia-in tua tungah na biakpiaknate uh na hal ding uh hi,” ci hi lo ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Keimah le ka pu ka pate in gamdang mi khempeuh tungah ka hihnasate uh thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua gam minamte’ pasian in keima khutsung panin a gam uh honkhiazo ahi uh hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Na Pasian un keima khutsung panin note hong hotkhiat theih nadingin ka pu ka pate in a suksiatmang tua minamte’ pasian khempeuh lakah kua in a mite honkhiazo ngei ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note, Hezekiah’ khemsa-in ta kei unla, hih bangin kimakai khialsak kei un. Amah um kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh minam khatpeuh, kumpi gam khatpeuh’ pasian in keima khut pan ahi a, ka pu ka pate’ khutsung pan ahi zongin a mite honkhiazo ngei nai lo hi. Keima khutsung pan na Pasian un note hong honkhia zo lo zaw kan ding hi,’ ci un,” a cisak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama nasemte in Topa Pasian le a nasempa Hezekiah langpangin thu tamzaw gen lai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Israel Pasian, Topa’ hehna ding le amah a langpanna-in laikhakte gelh a, “Ka khutsung panin a mite a honkhia zo lo gam sung minam dangte’ pasian-te mah bangin ka khutsung panin Hezekiah’ Pasian in a mite honkhia zo lo ding hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in khuapi a laktheih nadingin khuapi mite lau-in a linglawnsak nadingun kulh tungah a om Jerusalem mite tungah Judah pau tawh nakpitakin kiko uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in, mite’ khut tawh a kibawl leitung mite’ pasian-te a gen bang lelun Jerusalem Pasian a gen uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa Hezekiah le Amoz’ tapa, kamsang Isaiah in hih thu hangin thu ngenin vantung lamah kiko uh hi.","title":"Topa in Hezekiah Honkhia in Hezekiah Honkhia (2Kum 19:1-37 ; Isa 37:1-38)"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa’ giahphual ah a thahat galhang khempeuh le galkap a ukte le uliante a susia vantungmi khat a sawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama gamah maizumna tawh a ciahkik hi. Ama pasian’ inn sungah amah a tun ciangin ama tapate pawlkhat in namsau tawh amah satlum uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib’ khut le ama galte khempeuh panin Hezekiah le Jerusalem-a a tengte honkhia a, amah in mun khempeuh panin galdaihna amaute tungah a pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi tampi in Jerusalem khua Topa kiangah letsongte hong puakin, Judah kumpi Hezekiah kiangah na manphate hong puak uh a, tua hun a kipanin minam khempeuh’ muhna-ah amah kisangtawi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Hezekiah cina-in si dektak a, amah in Topa’ tungah thu ngen hi. Topa in a ngetna pia-in ama tungah lim khat a pia hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Cinatna (2Kum 20:1-11 ; Isa 38:1-22)"},"25":{"text":"Ahih hangin a lungsim kiphasak ahih manin ama tungah phattuamna a kibawl zahin Topa’ tungah Hezekiah in lungdam ko nuam lo hi. Tua ahih manin amah le Judah le Jerusalem tungah Topa’ hehna hong tung hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin a nung ciangin Hezekiah a lungsim kiphatsakna thu-ah amah le Jerusalem-a teng mite tawh kiniamkhiat uh ahih manin amaute’ tungah Topa’ hehna hong tung lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah hau mahmahin a min thang mahmah hi. Amah in ngun, kham, suangmanphate, a namtui nate, lumte, a manpha umlebeel khempeuh a dingin vanmanpha koihnate a bawl hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Babylon pana Kamtaite Saang (2Kum 20:12-19 ; Isa 39:1-8)"},"28":{"text":"An, leenggahzu, le sathau koihna ding vankoihnate zong a bawl hi. Ganhing nam khempeuh a dingin ganbukte, le tuubukte a bawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in tua bangmahin amahmah a dingin khuapite le tuuhonte le ganhonte tampi a koih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in ama tungah neihsa tampi tak pia hi."},"30":{"text":"Hih Hezekiah mah in Gihon tui tungnungte khaktanin David khuapi nitumna lampangah luangsak hi. Hezekiah a nasepna khempeuhah a maa vang hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin gam sung omzia lim a kan dingin ama kiangah a kisawl Babylon uliante’ kamtaite tawh kisai-in, amah a ze-etna ding le ama lungsim sungah bang om hiam cih a vekpi-in a theih nadingin Pasian in ama thu-in amah a omsak hi."},"32":{"text":"Tu-in Hezekiah’ gamtatna a omlaite, le ama nasep hoihte, Judah le Israel Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sung, le Amoz’ Tapa, Kamsang Isaiah’ Maangmuhna sungah kigelh hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Sihna (2Kum 20:20-21)"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah si a, amaute in David’ suante’ han paina mualpangah amah vui uh hi. Judah mi khempeuh le Jerusalem-a tengte in a sih lai-in amah zahtakna bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin ama tapa Manasseh in ama tangin a uk hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh in uk ding a kipatin kum sawm le nih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnga le nga sung uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Manasseh’ Ukna (2Kum 21:1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Israel minamte’ mai-ah a hawlkhiat minamte’ zat a kihhuai gamtatnate mah bangin, Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi.","ref":"Jer 15:4"},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a pa Hezekiah in a suksiatsa mual dawna biakpiaknate amah in lamkikin, Baal-te a dingin biakna taute phut a, Asherah milimte bawlin vantung nate khempeuh bia a, tuate’ na sem hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem-ah ka min om tawntung ding hi,” a cihna Topa’ biakinn sungah amah in biakna taute a lam hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:13; 2Khang 6:6"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ biakinn tual nihte sungah vantung nate khempeuh a dingin biakna taute lam hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Hinnom’ tapa’ kuamah biakna-in a tapate hal a, aisanna le mailam thugenkholhna le khongkhaina zang a, vankah theite le aisante tawh na semkhawm hi. Amah in Topa’ muhna-ah siatna tampi bawl a, amah hehsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian in David le a tapa Solomon tungah, “Amaute ka thupiak khempeuh, thukham khempeuh, ngeinate, le Moses tungtawnin a kipia biakna ngeina kipte zuih ding a kidop nak-uhleh, Israel minam khempeuh sung panin ka teelkhiat hih biakinn sung le Jerusalem sungah ka min ka koih tawntung ding hi. Tua ciangin na pu na pate uh a dingin ka sehsa gam panin Israel-te ka khinkhia nawn kei ding hi,” a cih Pasian’ biakinn sungah amah in ama bawlsa milim koih hi.","ref":"1Kum 9:3-5; 2Khang 7:12-18","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Manasseh in Judah le Jerusalem-a tengte zol ahih manin, Israel mite’ mai-ah Topa in a suksiat minamte sangin amaute a sia tamzaw gamta uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Manasseh tung le ama mite tungah thu gen a, ahih hangin amaute in don lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa’ galkap ukte amau’ kiangah paipih a, amaute in sikkawite tawh Manasseh manin sumngo khau tawh khihin Babylon-ah a paipih uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah a lungkham ciangin Topa a Pasian kunh-in a pu a pate’ Pasian’ mai-ah nakpitakin amahmah kiniamkhiat hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in ama kiangah thu ngen a, tua ciangin Pasian in ama kutna saangin, a thumna a ngai hi. Amah in Jerusalem-ah amah paipih kikin a kumpi gam a piakik hi. Tua ciangin Topa pen Pasian ahihna Manasseh in a thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in kuam sung, Gihon nitumna lam, David khuapi-ah, Ngasa Kongpi lutna lamah kulh puanung khat ciang a, Ofel kiimah ciang suakin a sang mahmahin ciangto hi. Amah in Judah gam sunga kulhnei khuapi khempeuhah zong galkap a ukte koih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ biakinn panin gamdang pasian-te le a milim lakhia a, Topa’ biakinn mualtung le Jerusalem-a ama lamsa biakna tau khempeuh lakhia-in, khuapi pualamah tuate paai hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in Topa’ biakna tau zong koihkikin tua tungah thunuama biakna le lungdamkohna a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah in Israel Pasian, Topa’ na a sep nadingun Judah-te thu a pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin mite in mual dawna biakpiaknate ah biakna pia lai uh a, ahih hangin Topa amaute’ Pasian’ tung bek mahah a piak uh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Manasseh’ gamtatna a omlaite, le a Pasian’ tungah a thungetna, le Israel Pasian, Topa’ min tawh ama tungah thu a gen thumute’ thugente, Israel Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu sungah om hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama thungetna, le ama kutna Pasian in a sanna, le ama khialhna le a cihtak lohna khempeuh, le amah a kiniamkhiat ma-in mual dawna biakpiaknate bawlin Asherah-te le milim dangte a koihna munte thu, Thumute’ Khang Tangthu sungah kigelh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manasseh si a, amaute in a inn sungah vui uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Amon in ama tangin a uk hi."},"21":{"text":"Amon in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum nih sung uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Amon’ Ukna (2Kum 21:19-26)"},"22":{"text":"A pa Manasseh’ gamtatnasa khempeuh bangin Topa’ muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi. Amon in a pa Manasseh’ bawlsa milim khempeuh tungah biakna pia a, tuate’ na sem hi."},"23":{"text":"A pa Manasseh a kiniamkhiat bangin Topa’ mai-ah amah kiniamkhiat lo a, hih Amon in mawhna tam piangsak semsem hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama nasemte in amah sawmsimin ama inn sungah amah that uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua gam mite in Kumpi Amon a sawmsim khempeuh that leuleu uh hi. Tua ciangin tua gam mite in ama tangin a tapa Josiah kumpi-in a koih uh hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in uk ding a kipatin kum giat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum le khat sung uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Josiah’ Ukna (2Kum 22:1-2)","ref":"Jer 3:6"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ mitah a man gamta a, a pu David’ khekhap zui-in themkhat zong lampial lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama uk a kum giatna sung, naupang ahi laipi mahin, amah in a pu David’ Pasian zon ding kipan hi. A kum sawm le nihna ciangin amah in Judah le Jerusalem panin mual dawna biaknate, Asherah milimte, le a kiseek le a kisung milimte beisiangsak ding kipan hi.","title":"Josiah’ Puahphatte (2Kum 23:1-20)"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Baal-te’ biakna taute ama muhna-ah supaisak hi. Tua ciangin amah in tuate tungah a om paknamtui biakna taute phuk a, Asherah milimte, le a kiseek le a kisung milimte sukhamin gawivui a, tuate’ tungah biakna a pia mite’ han tungah tua a vuite a theh hi.","ref":"2Kum 21:3; 2Khang 33:3"},"5":{"text":"Amah in amau’ biakna taute tungah a siampite’ guhte zong hal a, Judah le Jerusalem a siangsak hi.","ref":"1Kum 13:2"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manasseh, Efraim, le Simeon, le Naftali khuapi ciang dong, mun awngte le a kiim a pamah,"},"7":{"text":"amah in biakna taute sukhamin Asherah milimte le milim dangte satvui a, Israel gam sung khempeuhah paknamtui biakna taute a satvui hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah a ciahkik hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in ama uk a kum sawm le giatna, gam sung le biakinn a siansak khit ciangin, Topa a Pasian’ biakinn a puah dingin amah in Azariah’ tapa Shafan, le khuapi sung ukpa Maaseiah, le thu ciamteh pa ahi, Joahaz’ tapa Joah a sawl hi.","title":"Thukham Laibu Kimu (2Kum 22:3-23:20)"},"9":{"text":"Siampi lianpen pa Hilkiah kiangah amaute hong pai uh a, kongcingte ahi Levi mite in Manasseh le Efraim, le Israel a omlaite khempeuh, le Judah le Benjamin khempeuh, le Jerusalem-a a teng mite tung panin a khop uh ahi, Pasian’ biakinn-ah a hong kipaipih sumte a pia uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in Topa’ biakinn a vaan nasemte tungah tua sumte pia uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa’ biakinn-ah a sem nasemte in biakinn puahna ding le a ngei batsakkik nadingin pia uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in a kito suangte leina ding, le Judah kumpite in a siatsak, tep nadingin singte le biakinn lam nadingin innkamte leina dingin khutsiamte le innlamte tungah a sumte a pia uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin mite in cihtakna tawh na sem uh hi. Amaute tungah a en dingin Levi mi Merari-te beh sung pan Jahath le Obadiah, le Kohath-te beh sung pan Zekhariah le Meshullam kikoih hi. Levi mi, lasakna nazatte-ah siamna a nei khempeuh,"},"13":{"text":"vangik puate a uk, le nasep namkim a sem khempeuh a makaih uh hi. Tua ciangin Levi mi pawlkhatte pen laigelhte, le za neite, le kulhkongpi cingte ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in Topa’ biakinn-ah a kipaipih sumte a lakkhiat laitakun siampi Hilkiah in Moses tungtawnin a kipia thukham laibu a mu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hilkiah in lai-at pa Shafan kiangah, “ Topa’ biakinn sungah thukham laibu ka mu hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin Hilkiah in Shafan tungah a laibu pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Shafan in kumpipa kiangah a laibu paipihin ama kiangah, “Na nasemte tungah a kipia khempeuh amaute in a sep san laitak uh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa’ biakinn sungah a kikoih sumte amaute in lakhia-in nasep vaante le nasemte tungah pia uh hi,” ci-in gen thuah lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin lai-at pa Shafan in kumpipa kiangah, “Siampi Hilkiah in kei tungah laibu khat hong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shafan in kumpipa mai-ah tua laibu a sim hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in thukham kammalte a zak ciangin a puante balkek hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Hilkiah, Shafan’ tapa Ahikam, Mikah’ tapa Abdon, lai-at pa Shafan, le kumpipa’ nasempa Asaiah thu pia-in,"},"21":{"text":"“Pai unla, a kimu laibu sunga kammalte tawh kisai-in keima a’ ding le Israel le Judah-ah a omlai mite a dingin Topa thu va dong un; bang hang hiam cih leh i pu i pate in hih laibu sungah a kigelh khempeuh bangin sep ding Topa’ kammal na zui lo uh ahih manin eite tungah Topa’ hehna lian hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Hilkiah le kumpipa in a sawl mite, Hasrah, a tapa Tokhath, a tapa Shallum, biakinn puante a kem pa’ zi ahi kamsangnu Huldah kiangah pai-in (tu-in tua nu Jerusalem sung a Veng Nihna-ah teng hi) tua thu tawh kisai ama kiangah va gen uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua nu in amaute kiangah, “Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Kei kiangah note a hong sawl pa kiangah gen un."},"24":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, Judah kumpipa mai-ah a kisim laibu sunga kigelh samsiatnate khempeuh ahi siatna, hih mun le a tungah a teng mi khempeuh tungah ka tungsak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in amau’ gamtatna tawh kei hong hehsak theih nadingun amaute in kei hong nusia-in pasian dangte tungah paknamtui hal uh ahih manin hih mun tungah ka hehna kisungin dai lo ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa thu a dong dingin note a hong sawl Judah kumpipa tungah hih bangin na gen ding uh hi. Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Na zaksa thute tawh kisai-in,"},"27":{"text":"hih mun le a tunga tengte langpanna ama kammal na zak ciangin na lungsim kisikin Pasian’ mai-ah na kiniamkhiat a, keima mai-ah nang kiniamkhiatin na puante balkekin ka mai-ah kap na hih manin, kei zong nang kong za hi, Topa in ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Na pate kiang kong zuansak ding a, hih mun le a tunga tengte tungah ka tunsak ding siatna khempeuh na mit in mu lo ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in kumpipa kiangah a thu puakkik uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi sawlin Judah le Jerusalem upa khempeuh kaikhawm hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa, Judah mite le Jerusalem-a a teng mite, siampite le Levi mite, le mi khempeuh a lian a neu tawh, Topa’ biakinn-ah paito uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in Topa’ biakinn sungah a kimu thuciamna laibu sunga thute khempeuh amau’ zakin a sim hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa ama munah dingin, hih laibu sungah a kigelh thuciamna kammalte a sem dingin a lungsim khempeuh le a nuntakna khempeuh tawh Topa’ nung a zuihna ding le ama thupiaknate, ama tecipannate, le a thukhamte a zuihna ding, Topa’ mai-ah thuciamna khat a bawl hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Jerusalem le Benjamin sunga a om mi khempeuh hih thu a zuisak hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-a teng mite zong amau’ pute pate’ Pasian ahi Pasian’ thuciamna bangin a gamta uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josiah in Israel mite’ neihsa gam sung khempeuh panin a kihhuaite khempeuh lakhia a, Israel sunga om mi khempeuh Topa amaute’ Pasian’ na a semsak hi. Ama nuntak sung khempeuh amau’ pute pate’ Pasian ahi Topa zuihna panin amaute kiheikhia lo uh hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in Topa a dingin Jerusalem-ah Paisan Pawi bawl hi. Amaute in a kha masa a ni sawm le li ni-in Paisan Pawi tuuno go uh hi.","title":"Josiah in Paisan Pawi Bawl (2Kum 23:21-23)"},"2":{"text":"Amah in siampite amau’ panmunte-ah seh a, Topa’ biakinn sunga nasepna-ah amaute hanthawn hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Israel khempeuh hilhin Topa’ tungah a siangtho Levi mite tungah, “Israel kumpipa, David’ tapa Solomon in a lam biakinn sungah Thuciamna Singkuang siangtho koih un. Na liangko tung uhah na puak ding uh kisam nawn lo hi. Tu-in Topa na Pasian uh le ama mi Israel-te’ na sem un."},"4":{"text":"Note a khenkhenin na beh uh tawh kizui-in kithawi unla, Israel kumpipa David’ lamlahna le a tapa Solomon’ lamlahna zui un.","ref":"2Khang 8:14"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi nautang na sanggamte uh beh kikhenna tawh kizui-in siangtho munah ding uh hen la, Levi minam beh tuamtuamte sung pan kihelkim un."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Paisan Pawi bawlna ganhing go-in nomau mah kisiansuah unla, Moses’ tungtawnin Topa’ thugen bangin na sanggamte uh a dingin kithawi un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Josiah in tua lai-a a om mi khempeuhte a dingin Paisan Pawi piakna-in a ganhon panin mi nautangte tungah tuunote le keelnote tul sawmthum ciang dong, le bawngtal tulthum a pia hi. Hihte pen kumpipa’ neihsa sung pan a kipia ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama uliante in zong utna lungsim tawh mite tung, siampite tung, le Levi mite tungah a pia uh hi. Pasian’ biakinn-ah ulianpite ahi Hilkiah, Zekhariah, le Jehiel-te in siampite tungah Paisan Pawi bawl nadingin tuuno le keelno tulnih le zaguk, le bawngtal zathum a pia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Levi mi ukpite Konaniah, Shemaiah, le a sanggam Nethanel, Hashabiah, Jeiel le Jozabad-te in Paisan Pawi piak nadingin Levi mite tungah tuuno le keelno tulnga, le bawngtal zanga a pia uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nasepna ding a kithawi khit uh ciangin, siampite amau’ munah ding uh a, kumpipa’ thupiakna bangin Levi mite amau’ khen sungah om uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Paisan tuuno go uh a, Levi mite in a vun a hawk laitakun siampite in amau’ tung panin a ngah uh sisan a theh uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, Moses laibu sungah a kigelh bangin Topa’ tungah piak dingin mi nautang sungah a innkuan a pawlpawl tawh kizui-in a hawm theih nadingun meihal biaknate a tuamkoih uh hi. Tua bangin amaute in bawngtalte zong a hih uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in biakna ngeina kip tawh kizui-in Paisan tuuno sa mei-ah a hang uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in amau a’ ding le Aaron’ suan siampite a dingin a sa bawl uh hi."},"15":{"text":"David’ thupiak bangin Asaf’ behte ahi lasate, le Asaf, le Heman, le kumpipa’ thumu pa Jeduthun-te amau’ munah om uh hi.
