Amaute in lasa numei le pasal mihing zanih nei uh hi."},"66":{"text":"Amau’ sakolte - zasagih sawmthum le guk, amau’ la-sakol - zanih sawmli le nga,"},"67":{"text":"amau’ kalaoh - zali sawmthum le nga, le a la uh - tulguk zasagih le sawmnih pha hi."},"68":{"text":"Amaute Jerusalem-a Topa’ biakinn a tun uh ciangin Pasian’ biakinn ama mun ngei-ah lamkik nadingin innkuan lutangte pawlkhat in Pasian’ biakinn a dingin piakna bawl uh hi."},"69":{"text":"Amaute in a hih zawhna zah uh tawh kizui-in tua nasep nadingin vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tul sawmguk le tulkhat, ngun mina tulnga, le siampipuan zakhat a pia uh hi."},"70":{"text":"Siampite, Levi mite, le mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem le a kiim nai-ah teng uh hi. Lasate, kongcingte, biakinn nasemte, le Israel mi khempeuh amau’ khuapi ciatah a teng uh hi.","ref":"1Khang 9:2; Neh 11:3"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kha sagihna hong cin ciangin Israel mite amau’ khuapi ciatah teng khin uh ahih manin, khekhat khai bangin Jerusalem-ah hong kituah diam uh hi.","title":"Pasian Biakna a Ki-omsak Kikna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua le a siampipihte, le Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le a behte hong kipan uh a, Pasian’ mi Moses thukham sungah a kigelh bangin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Israel Pasian biakna tau a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Pai 27:1"},"3":{"text":"Amaute in tua gam a midang tengte kihta uh ahih manin a mun lui mahah biakna tau phut pahin zing le nitak simin Topa’ tungah meihal biakna a pia uh hi.","ref":"Gam 28:1-8"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a kikipsaksa bangin buk pawi bawl uh a, nisimin zat dingin a kisehsa zah bangin meihal biakna nisimin a pia uh hi.","ref":"Gam 29:12-38"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin hihte banah a tawntung a meihal biakna, Khadet sima biakna, le Topa’ pawi a kisehsa hun khempeuh le Topa’ tungah amau’ utthu tawh a pia mite khempeuh’ biaknate zong a pia uh hi.","ref":"Gam 28:11-29:39"},"6":{"text":"Topa’ biakinnpi a bul a kiphuh nai loh hangin a kha sagihna a ni masa ni a kipanin amaute in Topa’ tungah meihal biaknate piak ding kipan uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hi a, amaute in suangseekte le khutsiamte tungah sum pia uh a, Persia kumpi Sairas’ tung panin a thu ngahna bangun Lebanon mualtung gam panin tuipi gei Joppa khua-ah taamtak singte a hong puaksuk ding Sidon khuamite le Taia khuamite tungah zong annek tuidawn le sathau a pia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute, Jerusalem khua-a Pasian’ biakinn-ah a hong ciahkik uh a kum nihna, tua kum a kha nihna sungin Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua, nasep kipan uh a, a Israel mipihte, siampite, Levi mite, le salsuahna panin Jerusalem-ah a hong ciahkik mite khempeuh in zong a huh uh hi. Amaute in Levi mite kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah Topa’ biakinn sungah biakna nasepte a vaan dingin a seh uh hi.","title":"Biakinn Lamkik Kipan"},"9":{"text":"Jeshua a tapate le a behte tawh, le Hodaviah-te beh Kadmiel le a tate in Henadad’ tapate le Levi mi a tapate uh le a behte uh tawh Pasian’ biakinn-ah nasemte tungah ukna tavuan a lakhawm uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Innlamte in Topa’ biakinn a bul a phuh uh ciangin, Israel kumpipa David in a geelkholhsa bangin Topa a phat dingin siampite in a puan uh silhin peengkul tawh, Asaf’ tapa Levi mite daltuah tawh a panmun ding uhah hong pang uh hi.","ref":"1Khang 25:1"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Topa phatna le lungdamkohna a kidawngin sa uh a, “ Topa hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te hong itna kip tawntung hi,” a ci uh hi. Topa’ biakinn bulpi kiphut khin ahih manin mi khempeuh in nakpitakin Topa phat uh hi.","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 5:13; 7:3; La 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"12":{"text":"Midang tampi lungdamin a aw neih zahun a kiko uh hangin a biakinn masa a mu ngeisa siampite, Levi mite, le innkuan lutang, midang tampite in hih biakinn bulpi a kiphuh a muh uh ciangin kapin a thum uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mite nakpitakin kiko ahih manin lungdamna awging, le kahna le thumna awgingte mite in khen thei lo uh hi. Gamlapi pek panin tua awgingte a kiza hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik mite in Israel Pasian Topa a dingin biakinn khat a lamna thu Judah le Benjamin mite’ galte in a zak uh ciangin","title":"A Galte un Nasep Khawlsak"},"2":{"text":"Zerubbabel, Jeshua, le innkuan lutangte kiangah va pai-in amaute kiangah, “Biakinn lamna-ah ko zong hong kihelsak un; bang hang hiam cih leh note mah bangin ko zong na Pasian uh ka bia uh a, hih lai-ah kote hong koih Assiria kumpipa Esarhaddon’ hun lai a kipanin note’ Pasian’ tungah biakna ka pia uh hi,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"2Kum 17:24-41"},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Zerubbabel le Israel sunga innkuan lutang a omlaite in amaute kiangah, “Kote’ Pasian a dingin ka lam uh biakinn pen note’ hong lunghihmawhpih ding hi lo hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas in kote hong thupiaksa bangin Israel Pasian, Topa a dingin ko teng guak mah in ka lam ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua gam a teng midangte in Judah mite lungkiasakin biakinn a lam zomlai ding uh a lausak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amau’ ngimna a tangtun theih loh nadingin amaute in a langpang dingin zum nasemte golhguk pia uh hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas’ hun a kipan kumpi Darias hun dong hih bangin hih ngitnget uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahasueras in uk ding hong kipat ciangin Judah gam le Jerusalem-a a tengte a khiatna thu tua gamah a na tengsate in lai-in a gelh uh hi.","ref":"Est 1:1"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Persia kumpi Artakzaksis hun ciangin Mithredath, Tabeel, le a lawmte uh thukimna tawh kumpipa tungah lai gelh uh a, a lai pen Aram lai-in kigelh a, Aram pau mahin kisimkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Menzipipa Rehum le lai-at pa Shimshai in Kumpi Artakzaksis tungah Jerusalem tawh kisai thu a nuai-a bangin gelh uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, le a lawmte khempeuh, thukhente, mangpite, thuvaante, uliante, Erek khuami le Babylon khuami, Susa khua-a om Elam mite,"},"10":{"text":"le a lian a minthang Ashurbanipal in hong puakhia-in Samaria khuapi-ah a hong tensak mite le Eufratis Gun langkhat a kizawhna gam sunga a om mite tung panin lai puak, a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A lai sung thu hih a nuai-a bang ahi hi: “Artakzaksis Kumpipa tungah, Eufratis Gungal gam a om na nasemte in hopihna kam kong puak uh hi."},"12":{"text":"“Nangma kiang panin ko kiangah a hong pai Judah mite, tu-in Jerusalem-ah tung khin uh a, a gilo, mi lehdo thei ahi khuapi pen amaute in lamkikin, amaute in a khua bulpi vel khinin, kulhpi cian’ a kipat khitna thu thei in."},"13":{"text":"Amau’ khuapi kilam kikin kulhte kizo leh amaute in siah ahi a, mangmu ahi a, losap ahi zongin hong pia nawn lo ding uh a, a tawpna-ah kumpi hong sukkhak ding thu thei in."},"14":{"text":"Kote in kumpipa tawh thuciamna kip nei khin ka hih manun kumpipa’ minsiatna ka muh ding uh kilawm lo hi. Tua ahih manin nangma mai-a a semte’ thuciamtehna laibute a ki-etkik theih nadingin kumpipa tungah thu kong zasak uh hi. Thuciamtehna laibu sung en lecin hih khuapi pen a lehdo thei khuapi, kumpipa tung le a ukna gamte tungah siatna a piangsak, kumpi dona a khua sungah a om tawntungna thu na mukhia ding hi. Hih khuapi a kisukcipna zong hih thu hang mah ahi hi.","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Hih khuapi kilam kikin a kulhte kizo khin leh Eufratis Gungal gam na uk nawn loh nading thu, nangma tungah kong theikholsak uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a lai uh hih bangin thuk hi: “Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at pa Shimshai, le Samaria le Eufratis Gungal gam sunga om na lawmte khempeuh uh tungah hopihna lai kong khak hi."},"18":{"text":"“Keima tungah nong khak uh lai pen a kitel takin keima zakna-ah hong kisim khin hi."},"19":{"text":"Keimah in hih thu a kikanna ding thu ka pia a, tu-in kikantel khinta hi. Tanglai a kipanin hih khuapi pen kumpi langah pangin, hih khua sungah lehdona le kumpi dona a om ngitngetna thu kimukhia hi."},"20":{"text":"A vanglian kumpite in Jerusalem-ah uk ngei-in, Eufratis Gungal gambup tungah aana zang uh a, siah, mangmu, le losapte tua kumpite tungah kipia hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hih mite a nasep uh a khawlna ding thu pia in. Keimah in thu kong piakkik mateng hih khuapi kilamkik lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih thu tawh kisai-in na sep ding don loin ommawk kei in. Tua hi kei leh kumpi tungah siatna le gimna hong khang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, le amau’ lawmte’ zakna-ah Kumpi Artakzaksis tung panin a kingah lai a kisim ciangin, Jerusalem-ah amaute pai pahin Judah mite a nasep uh aana tawh a khawlsak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hun a kipanin Jerusalem-a om Pasian’ biakinn a kisepna a khawl hi. Persia kumpi Darias’ uk a kum nihna dong tua bangin a khawlcip phot hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in kamsangte Haggai le Iddo’ suan Zekhariah in Judah gam le Jerusalem-ah a om Judah mite hanthawnin, Israel Pasian’ min tawh thu a gen uh hi.","title":"Biakinn Kilamkik","ref":"Hag 1:1; Zek 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua, Jerusalem-a Pasian’ biakinn lamkik ding kipan pah uh a, Pasian’ kamsangte in amaute ompihin huh uh hi.","ref":"Hag 1:12; Zek 4:6-9"},"3":{"text":"Tua laitakin Eufratis Gungal gam sung teng a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le amau’ lawmte hong paipahin amaute kiangah, “Note in hih biakinn lamkikin a nate na bawlna ding uh kua in thu hong pia ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih biakinn lam nasepna-ah a sem mite’ min zong amaute in dong uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in Judah upate huh ahih manin Darias kiangah a thu va tungin ama tung pan thu a kingahkik hun dong a nasep zomna uh kikhaktan lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Eufratis Gungal gam a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le Eufratis Gungal gam sung thu a vaan ama lawmte in Kumpi Darias tungah lai khak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in thuzaksakna lai hih bangin a gelh uh hi: “Kumpi Darias tungah thupha namcin hong tung tahen."},"8":{"text":"“Judah gam, a lian Pasian’ biakinn-ah ka va paina uh kong theisak uh hi. Tua biakinn pen suang lianpipite tawh kilamin a kawmte sing tawh kibawl hi. Hih biakinn limtakin kisemin amau’ makaihna tawh a nasep uh telh mahmah hi."},"9":{"text":"“Hih biakinn a kilamkikna ding le a nate a zawh nadingin kua in thu pia hiam, cih thu hih upate tungah ka dong uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in a makai teng na theih nadingin amaute’ min zong ka dong uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Amaute in hih bangin hong dawng uh hi: ‘Kote pen vantung le leitung Pasian’ nasemte ka hi uh a, kum tampi lai-in a kilamsa biakinn a lamkik ka hi uh a, a lian Israel kumpi khat in lamin a zawhsa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin ka pu ka pate un vantung Pasian hehsakkha uh ahih manin Babylon kumpipa, Khaldea mi Nebukhadnezzar’ khut sungah amaute pia hi. Tua kumpipa in hih biakinn susia a, a mite Babylon-ah ciahpih hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:8-12; 2Khang 36:17-20; Jer 52:12-15"},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin Babylon kumpipa Sairas’ uk a kum khatna kumin hih Pasian’ biakinn a kilamkikna ding amah in thu pia hi.","ref":"Ezr 1:2-11"},"14":{"text":"Tua tham loin Jerusalem-a biakinn sung panin Nebukhadnezzar in la-in Babylon biakinn sunga a koih ahi Pasian’ biakinn sunga om ngeisa kham le ngun kibawl umlebeelte zong kumpi Sairas in Babylon biakinn panin lakhia-in gam ukin a hong koih Sheshbazzar min nei pa tungah ap hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama tungah, “Hih umlebeelte paipih inla, Jerusalem-a biakinn-ah va koihkik in. Tua lai-a Pasian’ biakinn pen a mun ngei mahah lamkik sak in,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Sheshbazzar hong pai-in Jerusalem-a Pasian’ biakinn a bulpi hong phut hi. Tua hun a kipanin tu dong lamkik kisem suak a, ahi zongin kizo nai lo hi,’ ci uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin hoih na sak leh, Jerusalem-a hih Pasian’ biakinn a kilamkikna ding thu kumpipa Sairas in thu pia takpi hiam, pia taktak lo hiam cih a kitheih nadingin Babylon khua sunga om laibu koihna innte sung zongsak in. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in na deihna hong zasakkik in,” a ci uh hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in thu pia a, Babylon khua sunga lai manphate a kisenna innte sung kizong hi.","title":"Kumpi Sairas’ Thupiakna Kimu"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin Babylon khua sungah na om lo a, Media gam sung kumpi khuapi Ekbatana-ah laizial khat kimu a, tua sungah hih a nuai-a bangin a kiciamteh kimu hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Kumpi Sairas’ kum khatna kumin Jerusalem khua-a Pasian’ biakinn tawh kisai-in kumpipa in thu pia hi: Biakna kipia-in meihal biakna a kipaipihna munah biakinn lamsakkik un. A sanna pi sawmkua, a vai pi sawmkua mah hi ding a,"},"4":{"text":"a kawm pen suang thuap thum le sing thuap khat tawh a kibawl, thuap li hi ding hi. Hih sum beinate ahihleh kumpi sum panin kipia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem biakinn panin lakhia-in Babylon-ah a hong tunpih Pasian’ biakinn sunga om kham le ngun tawh kibawl umlebeelte zong kipiakik ding hi. Tuate khempeuh Jerusalem biakinn-ah kipuakik ding a, Pasian’ biakinn sunga a omna munmun ciatah kikoihkik ding hi,” ci-in kigelh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in hih bangin thu a pia hi: “Tu-in Eufratis Gungal gam a uk Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le Eufratis Gungal gam sung a vaan na lawmte, tua mun panin na kihemkhia ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Judah mi a ukpa le a upate in hih Pasian’ biakinn a lamkik theih nadingun na tuaci omsak ding uh hi. Ama mun ngei mahah a biakinn lamsakkik un."},"8":{"text":"Hih a kigen Pasian’ biakinn a kilamkik theih nadingin hih Judah upate a dingin na hih dingte uh zong thu kong pia hi. Hih nasepna a mawk khawl loh nadingin, Eufratis Gungal gam sung panin a kingah siahte ahi kumpi sum sung panin beina khempeuh a cingin kipia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Vantung Pasian’ tungah meihal biakna-in piak dingin a kisam khempeuh - bawngtalnote, tuutalte, ahih kei leh tuunote na pia ding uh a, Jerusalem-a siampite’ hong ngetna bangin mangbuh, ci, leenggahzu, ahih kei leh sathaute, kitasam loin nisimin amaute tungah piasak un."},"10":{"text":"Tua hileh amaute in vantung Pasian’ tungah a namtui biaknate pia-in kumpipa le a tapate’ nuntakna ding thu hong ngetsak thei ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua tham loin, mi khatpeuh in hih thupiakna a siatsak leh ama inn panin a innkam khat kidawhkhiat sakin tua tungah amah kihen cipin kisatgawp ding a, tua banah a inn zong a kisuksiatna ding thu kong pia thuah lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih ka thupiakna a siasak nuam, Jerusalem-a Pasian’ biakinn a susia nuam kumpi khatpeuh ahi a, mi khatpeuh ahi zongin a om leh, ama min omna dinga tua mun a bawl Pasian in tua mipa lawnthal tahen. Keimah Darias in thu kong pia hi. Ka thupiak bang teekteekin sep ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in amaute tungah a thupiak bang teekteekin Eufratis Gungal gam sung a uksawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le a lawmte in sem uh hi.","title":"Biakinn Apna"},"14":{"text":"Tua hi a, kamsang Haggai le Iddo’ suan Zekhariah’ thugenna hangin Judah upate in a biakinn lam uh zom suakin maavang uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute in sal suaksa a hong ciahkik khempeuh a’ ding, a siampipihte uh le amau mahmah a dingin Paisan tuuno a go uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik Israel-te le Israel Pasian, Topa a bia dingin tua gam a midang tengte le a nitna uh pan amau le amau a kihemkhia tawm mite khempeuh in tua Paisan Pawi an a ne uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua hi a, amaute in lungdamna tawh ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum pawi a bawl uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ lungdamna ding a om theih nadingin Topa in Assiria kumpipa’ lungsim amau’ tungah a nuam dingin a bawlsak hi. Tua ahih manin Israel Pasian ahi Pasian’ biakinn a sepna uhah kumpipa in amaute a huh hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thu teng khit ciangin Persia kumpi Artakzaksis uk hun sungin Ezra, a pa Seraiah, a pa Azariah, a pa Hikiah,","title":"Ezra le A Pawlte Jerusalem-ah Hong Tung"},"2":{"text":"a pa Shalum, a pa Zadok, a pa Ahitub,"},"3":{"text":"a pa Amariah, a pa Azariah, a pa Meraioth,"},"4":{"text":"a pa Zerahiah, a pa Uzzi, a pa Bukki,"},"5":{"text":"a pa Abishua, a pa Finehas, a pa Eleazar, a pa siampi lianpen pa Aaron:"},"6":{"text":"hih Ezra pen Babylon panin hong tungto hi. Amah pen Israel Pasian, Topa in a piak Moses thukham a siam laithei mi khat ahi hi. in Topa’ thukham sinin zuih ding, le Israel mite a hilh dingin amah kipia hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpi Artakzaksis in siampi ahi, laithei pa lah ahi, Israel-te a dingin Topa’ thupiaknate le thukhamte a zong,"},"16":{"text":"Babylon gamah na muh uh ngun le khamte, le Jerusalem-a note’ Pasian’ biakinn dingin mite le siampite in lungkim takin a piak khiat zuazuate uh tawh a va puakkhawm ding na hi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hih ka thupiakna tawh kizui-in hih sumte pen Jerusalem-a note’ Pasian’ biakinn-a biakna tau tungah piak dingin bawngtalte, tuutalte, tuunote, le a an tawh biaknate, le a leenggahzu tawh biakna dingte leina ding bekin na zang ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua banah ngun le kham a val a omlai leh, note’ Pasian’ deihna tawh kituakin hoih na sak bangun na lawmte tawh na zang thei ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Na Pasian’ biakinn-ah zat dingin hong kipia umlebeelte pen Jerusalem Pasian tungah na va pia ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na Pasian’ biakinn a dingin a kisam, na piak ding a phamawh a omkhak zenzen leh kumpipa sum sung panin na zang thei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua hi a, kumpipa keimah Artakzaksis in Eufratis Gungal gam sunga om kumpi vankemte khempeuh tungah hih Tu-in kei tungah maavanna hong pia inla, kei tungah hih kumpipa hong migitna ding lungsim hong guan in,” ka ci hi. Tua hun laitakin kei pen kumpipa’ an a piapa ka hi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Artakzaksis’ kum sawmnihna Nisan kha sungin khatvei, a leenggahzu a baihsa-in a om khit ciangin la-in kumpipa ka pia a, ama mai-ah ka om laitakin ka mai a khing hi.","title":"Jerusalem-ah Nehemiah Kisawl"},"2":{"text":"Amah in, “Cina lopi-in bang hangin na mai khing ahi hiam? Na dahna khat om hi ding hi,” hong ci hi. Tua ciangin lau mahmahna tawh"},"3":{"text":"kumpipa ka dawng a, “Kumpipa nungta tawntung in. Ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi siagawp a, a kongpite kangtum ahih ciangin maikhing loin bangci om theih ding ka hi hiam?” ka ci hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:8-10; 2Khang 36:19; Jer 52:12-14"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Kei tungah bang hong ngen nuam na hi hiam?” hong ci hi. Kei zong ka lungsim tawngah vantung Pasian kiangah thu ka ngen a,"},"5":{"text":"tua khit ciangin kumpipa dawngin, “Kumpipa na lung a kim a, dik na sak leh, ka puahphatkik theih nadingin Judah gam sung ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi-ah nong paisakna ding kong thum hi, topa,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in (kumpinu a gei-ah tukawmin), “Bang tanvei sawt ding a, cik ciangin hong ciahkik thei ding na hi hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ka ngetna hong thukimpih a, kei zong ka ciahkik ding hun ka gen hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa na thukim leh, Judah gam ka tun dong amaute in hong paisuaksak theih nadingun Eufratis Gungal gam sung a uksawn mite ka piak ding laikhakte,"},"8":{"text":"le biakinn hutna ding munmuanhuai kongpi ding, khuapi kulh ding, le ka omna ding inn lam nadingin sing hong piaktheih nadingin kumpipa’ tulak a kem Asaf’ tungah piak ding laikhak zong, kei tungah hong pia in,” ka ci hi. A dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompih ahih manin kumpipa in ka ngette hong pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Eufratis Gungal gam a uksawn mite kiang ka tung a, kumpipa’ laikhakte amaute tungah ka pia hi. Kumpipa in galkapmangte le sakol galkapte kei hong khasak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel mite’ phattuamna ding a sem dingin mi khat a paina thu Horonaim khuami Sanballat le Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah in a zak uh ciangin nakpitakin lungkim lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ka tun ciangin ni thum sung ka tawlnga hi.","title":"Kulhte a Ciangkik dingin Nehemiah in Mite Hanthawn"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin zanin vakkhia-in mi tawmkhat ka tonpih hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem a dingin ka bawlsak ding ka Pasian in ka lungsimah hong suahsak thu kuama kiangah ka gen kei hi. Keima tuanna simloh ganhing dang ka kizuisak kei hi."},"13":{"text":"Kuam Kongpi tawnin Gulpi Tuikhuk le Nin Kongpi lamah ka pai a, a kicimsa Jerusalem kulhpi le mei in a kattumsa a kongpite ka en hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Tuinak Kongpi le Kumpipa’ Bual-ah ka paisuak hi. Ahi zongin ka tuanna ganhing a paisuak theih nading mun om lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hi a, a zanpi mahin kuam lampi-ah pai-in khuapi kulh ka vel hi. Tua ciangin Kuam Kongpi mah tawnin khuapi sungah ka lutkik hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hi a, khuasung upate in ka paina mun ahi a, ka sep ahi zongin thei lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih nasep tavuan a la ding Judah mite, siampite, uliante, khuasung upate, le a dangte tungah ka gen nai kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, “I lungkhamna thu na thei uh hi. Jerusalem a siasa-in omin, a kongpite mei in kangtum hi. Hong pai un, zahkona i ngah nawn loh nadingin Jerusalem kulh ciangpha ni,” ka ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin a dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompihna le kumpipa in kei tungah hong gen thute zong amaute tungah ka gen hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Tu-in nasep kipan pah ni,” hong ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin lawp mahmahna le ngimna hoih tawh nasep a kipan uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi zongin Horonaim khuami Sanballat, Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah, le Arab gammi ahi Geshem in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, kote zahpihna le simmawhna tawh, “Hih na sep uh bang ahi hiam? Kumpipa lehpan’ na hi uh hiam?” hong ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute dawngin, “Vantung Pasian in ka maa uh hong telhsak ding a, ko ama nasemte in nasep a kipan ta ka hi uh hi; note in ahihleh Jerusalem tawh kisai-in thu na neih theih nadingun bangmah kimematna na nei kei uh hi,” ka ci hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa Eliashib le a siampipihte in nasep kipanin Tuu Kongpi a bawl uh hi. Amaute in a khuamte le a zawlte bawlin a kongkhakte bulh uh hi. Amaute in Za Khat Tausang ciang banah Hananel Tausang dong sem uh a, tua ciangin Pasian’ tungah ap uh hi.","title":"Puahphat ding Munte"},"2":{"text":"A zomah Jerikho khua mite in sem uh hi. Amaute’ zomah Imri’ tapa Zakkur in sem hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hassenaah’ tapate in Ngasa Kongpi bawl uh hi. Amaute in a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute’ zomah Hakkoz’ tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in ama khawk sung puah hi. Tua zomah Meshezabel’ tapa Berekhiah, a tapa Meshullam hi a, tua zomah Baana’ tapa Zadok in puah hi."},"5":{"text":"A zom kikah Tekoa khua mite in puah uh a, ahi zongin amau’ uliante in a tote uh sawl bangin sem nuam lo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Paseah’ tapa Joiada le Besodeiah’ tapa Meshullam in Jeshanah Kongpi puah uh a, a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute’ zomah Gibeon le Mizpah khuami ahi, Gibeon mi Melatiah le Meronoth khuami Jadon in Eufratis Gungal gam a uksawn pa’ zum dong puah uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zomah khamseek pa Harhaiah’ tapa Uzziel in puah a, a zomah paknamtui bawlpa Hananiah in puah hi. Amaute in Kulh Zai ciang dong a ngeina bangin Jerusalem bawlkik uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute’ zomah Jerusalem gam phelkhat a uk, Hur’ tapa Refaiah in puah hi."},"10":{"text":"A zomah Harumaf’ tapa Jedaiah in ama inn mai san teng puah hi. Tua ciangin a zomah Hashabneiah’ tapa Hattush in puah hi."},"11":{"text":"Harim’ tapa Malkhijah le Pahathmoab’ tapa Hasshub in Meikhuk Tausang a huam khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute’ zomah Jerusalem gam a phelkhat a uk, Hallohesh’ tapa Shallum in a tanute tawh a puah uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Hanun le Zanoah khua-a teng mite in Kuam Kongpi puah uh hi. Amaute in tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh a, Nin Kongpi ciang dong pi tul le pi zanga sung kulh a puah uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Bethhakkherem gam a uk, Rekhab’ tapa Malkhijah in Nin Kongpi puah a, tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna a bulh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mizpah gam a uk, Kolhozeh’ tapa Shallum in Tuinak Kongpi puah a, tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh hi. Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa’ huan gei-a kulh ciang a, David khuapi pana hong paisuk kahlei ciang dong a sem hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama zomah Bethzur gam phelkhat a uk, Azbuk’ tapa Nehemiah in David’ han san ciang, a kibawl tawm bual le Galkap Inn ciang dong puah hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama zomah a puah Levi mite: Bani’ tapa Rehum hi a, ama zomah Keilah gam phelkhat a uk Hashabiah in ama gam tangin puah hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama zomah a puah a behte: Keilah gam phelkhat a uk, Henadad’ tapa Bavvai in puah hi."},"19":{"text":"A zomah Mizpah gam a uk, Jeshua’ tapa Ezer in a Kiu-a galvan koihna kahtohna san khawk khat puah hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama zomah Zabbai’ tapa Baruk in a Kiu panin siampi lianpen pa Eliashib’ inn kongkhak ciang dong khawk khat sung puah hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama zomah Hakkoz’ tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in Eliashib’ inn kongkhak panin Eliashib’ innmong ciang dong khawk khat sung puah hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama zomah Jerusalem kiimnai-a om siampite in puah uh hi."},"23":{"text":"A zomah Benjamin le Hasshub in amau’ inn mai san puah uh hi. A zomah Ananiah’ tapa Maaseiah, a tapa Azariah in ama inn gei san teng puah hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama zomah Henadad’ tapa Binnui in Azariah’ inn panin a Kiu,"},"25":{"text":"le kulh kiu ciang khawk khat sung puah hi. Uzai’ tapa Palal in a Kiu gal san teng le kumpipa’ inn panin hong dawkkhia, zumcingte’ omna ahi tausang tungnung teng puah hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama zomah Parosh’ tapa Pedaiah in nisuahna lam manawhin Tui Kongpi gal san ciang le tausang dawk puah hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama zomah Tekoa khuamite in a lian tausang dawk panin Ofel mualbo kulh ciang, khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Sakol Kongpi tung san teng ahihleh siampite in amau’ inn mai san ciat puah uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute’ zomah Immer’ tapa Zadok in ama inn mai san puah hi. Ama zomah Nisuahna Kongpi a cing, Shekaniah’ tapa Shemaiah in puah hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama zomah Shemaiah’ tapa Hananiah le Zalaf’ tapa gukna Hanun in khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi. Amau zomah Berekhiah’ tapa Meshullam in ama inndei mai san teng puah hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama zomah khamseek pa Malkhijah in Kikaihkhopna Kongpi mai sana om biakinn nasemte’ inn le sumbukte’ inn ciang, le a kiu-a inndei tungnung ciang dong puah hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin khamseekte le sumbukte in a kiu-a inndei tungnung le Tuu Kongpi kikal a puah uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanballat in kote’ kulh cianna thu a zak ciangin lungkim loin heh mahmah a, ko Jew mite hong zahko hi.","title":"Nasemte in Amau a Langpangte Vil Kawm"},"2":{"text":"Amah in a kikholhpihte le Samaria galkapte’ kiangah, “Hih Jew mi niangnuangte in bang hih ding a kipan ahi uh hiam? Hih mun a bawlpha dinga kingaihsun ahi uh hiam? Biakpiakna hangin a nasep uh ni khat sungin zo dingin kilamen ahi uh hiam? Amaute in a kangtumsa ninbulomtang panin suangtum bawlkik thei ding ahi uh hiam?” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama kiangah a om Ammon mi Tobiah in, “Amaute in bangbang ciang ta le amau’ kulh cian’ tungah ngia khat kah leh kicim lel ding hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah Nehemiah in thu ka ngen a, “Hong za in, kote’ Pasian aw; kote hong kisimmawh hi. Kote hong zahkona amau’ lu tungah lehtuksak inla, gamdang khatah sal suakin mi’ bawlsiatin amaute omsak in."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in a langtangin kulh ciangte’ mai-ah nang hong hehsak uh ahih manin amau’ mawhna maisak kei inla, na ciaptehna panin zong a mawhna uh sumit kei in,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kulh ka ciang uh a, nasep a kimciang bang kizo hi. Mite in utna lungsim tawh sem uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mite, Ammon mite, le Ashdod mite in Jerusalem kulh cian’ nasep kizom suakin, kulh vang teng huk ding a kipat khitna thu a zak uh ciangin heh mahmah uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hi a, Jerusalem hong simin buaina a piangsak dingin amaute kipawlin vaihawmna khat nei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian uh tungah thu ka ngen uh a, amaute a en dingin sun le zanin galvil ka koih uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah gam mite in, “Nasemte a tha uh zaw ta a, ahi zong nin tampi omlai hi. Eima tha tawh kulh cian’ i zo ngei kei ding hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka galte un, “Amau’ phawk loh kalun amaute lakah pai-in i that ding a, a nasep uh i beisak ding hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute lakah a teng Jew mite khuapi sungah hong pai ciangin, ka galte uh a omna khempeuh ciat panun hong pai-in kote hong simna ding thu, sawmvei tak hong hilhkhol uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kulh nunglam mun niam penna mun awng tengah a namsau uh, a teipi uh, le a thal uh tawh, a innkuan kuanun ka mite ka pangsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Mite’ launa ka muh ciangin, uliante, mi ukte, le mi khempeuh tungah, “Amaute kihta kei un. Na sanggamte, na tapate, na tanute, na zite uh, le na inn na lote uh a dingin hong dosak, a lian a kihtakhuai Topa phawk un,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amau’ hong sawmna thu kote in ka phawkna uh le Pasian in amau’ geelna a suksiatna thu ka galte un thei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka nasepna ciat uh kulh tungah ka vekpi-un ka kuankik uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hun a kipanin ka khutnuai-a om mite kimkhat in na sem a, a kimkhat in a teipite, a lumte, le a thalte uh tawi-in sik puan silhin ding uh a, uliante in kulh a ciang Judah mi khempeuh uk uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kulh-a cian’ ding na a nawn mite in a khut langkhat uh tawh a van puak uh lenin a khut langkhat uhah galhiam tawi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kulh ciangte in na a sep kawmun a kawng ciat uhah a namsau uh kuah uh hi. Peengkul tum pa ahihleh keima kiangah om hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi liante, mi ukte, le mi khempeuh tungah, “I nasepna lian a, zaipi tak huam hi; eite kulh tungah kikhenin khatlekhat i kigamla hi."},"20":{"text":"Peengkul kitum na zakna peuhpeuh panun ko kiangah hong kikhawm un. I Pasian in eite a dingin hong dosak ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hi a, nisimin khuavak a kipan nitak aksi suah dong, mi kimkhat in teipi tawi-in, mi kimkhat in na ka sem uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua hun mahin mite kiangah, “Zanin galvil, sunin nasemin hong om theih nadingun mi khempeuh na nasemte ciat uh tawh Jerusalem khua sungah hong giak un,” ka ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin keimah a kipan ka behte, ka nasemte, le kei hong cingte, a kuamah peuh puan suah man om loin, mi khempeuh in ka khut uhah galhiam ka tawi den uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in mi nautang numei le pasalte in a Jew mipihte uh tungah lungkim lohna kam hong gingsak uh hi.","title":"Summeet Piak Kiphiat"},"2":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte in an lei nadingin a tanute uh le a tapate uh a piakna thu hong gen uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in kial tun huhau-in an lei nadingin a lote, a leenggah lote, le a innte uh a piakna hong gen uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in kumpipa tungah siah piak dingin a lote uh le a leenggui lote uh khamin a piakna uh hong gen uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in, “Kote pen ka behte uh mah bangin cilesa kibang hi-in, ka naupangte uh zong amau’ naupangte mah bangin a hoih hinapi-in, ka tanute uh le ka tapate uh sal suak dingin ka phum uh hi. Ka tanute uh pawlkhat zong sal suakkhin a, ka lote uh le ka leenggui lote uh midangte a’ suakkhin ahih manin amaute tat nadingin ka hih zawh uh bangmah om lo hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute’ kikona le hih thute ka zak ciangin ka heh mahmah hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei zong hih thu limtakin ka ngaihsun a, tua ciangin uliante le thukhente taii-in amaute kiangah, “No le no leiba manin salin na kila uh hi,” ka ci hi. Amaute nakpitakin taii-in,","ref":"Pai 22:25; Siam 25:35-37; Thkna 23:19-20"},"8":{"text":"“Minam dangte tungah sala kizuaksa i Jew mipihte ahizo zahzahin i tanhkik hi. Tua hinapi-in note in na mipihte uh na zuak uh a, tu-in amaute i tatkik ding hi zel hi,” ka ci hi. Amaute pau loin om uh a, a gen ding mel uh thei lo uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Note’ gamtatna hoih lo hi. I gal ahi minam dangte’ zahkona i ngah loh nadingin i Pasian zahtakna tawh na gamtat ding uh kilawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Kei le ka behte le ka nasemte in zong an le sum leitawi-in ka piakhia uh hi. Leiba manin mi kilakna phiat ni."},"11":{"text":"Tuni mahmahin a lote, a oliv lote, a innte uh le a meetin na lak uh sum, an, leenggahzu, le sathaute, amaute tungah pia kik un,” ka ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, “Hihte khempeuh ka piakik ding uh a, amaute tung panin bangmah ka kal nawn kei ding uh hi. Na gen bangin ka gamta ding uh hi,” hong ci uh hi. Tua ciangin siampite ka sam a, a ciamsa bangun a gamtat nadingun siampite’ mai-ah kiciamna ka bawlsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei zong ka puan singin, “Hih thuciamna a tungsak lo peuhmah a inn le a neihsa panin Pasian in singkhia tahen. Hih bangin kisingkhia hen la, hawmsuak hen!” ka ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in, “Hi ta hen,” ci uh a, Topa a phat uh hi. Tua hi a, a ciamsa bangun mite a gamta uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Judah gam a uk dingin hong kiseh hun a kipan, Kumpi Artakzaksis’ kum sawmnihna pan a kum sawmthum le nihna dong, kum sawm le nih sung, kei le ka behte in gam ukte’ ngah ngei ante ka ne kei uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima hun ma-in a ukte in mite tungah van gikpi suan uh a, amaute’ tung panin nisimin an le leenggahzu ngun shekel sawmli man a la uh hi. Amau’ nasemte nangawn mite tungah kiliansak lai uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian ka zahtakna hangin tua bangin kei ka gamta kei hi."},"16":{"text":"Hih kulh cianna-ah kei mahmah in zong ka sem a, kei a dingin leitang bangmah ka la kei hi. Keima mite khempeuh nasem ding bekin tua lai-ah kisutuah uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kiim le pama minam dangte’ kiang pan hong paite banah, nisimin ka sabuai-ah an a ne, thukhente le Jew mi a kihelin leengla za le sawmnga bang ka nei den hi."},"18":{"text":"Nisimin innsung annektawm dinga kibawl bawngtal khat le tuu limci guk ahi hi. Tua mah bangin ak zong kibawl a, ni sawm simin leenggahzu a um tampipi-in kihih hi. Tua zahin bei taseleh gam ukte’ ngah theih ahi anletui ka kal kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mite genthei lua hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian aw, hih mite a dingin ka bawlna khempeuh kei a dingin a hoih lamin hong phawk in."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kongpite-ah kongkhak ka bulh nai loh uh hangin, kulh ka cian’ khitna uh le a vang khat zong a om nawn lohna thu, Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mi Geshem, le ka gal dangte khempeuh un a zak uh ciangin,","title":"A Langte’ Sawmsimna"},"2":{"text":"Sanballat le Geshem zong Ono zanglei sunga om Hakkofirim khua-ah pai-in amaute tawh thu a kikum dingin hong sam uh hi. Hih pen kei hong suksiat nopna uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah kamtaite ka sawl a, “Tu laitakin nasep thupi ka nei hi; kong pai thei kei ding hi. Kei hong pai leng, kong pai sung ka om loh kalteng nasep kitawlnga ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in tu-a bangmahin livei tak hong sam uh a, kei zong a livei mahin tu-a bangin ka dawngkik hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangmahin Sanballat in a ngaveina hong sam a, tua tungtangin a kamtai pa in laikhak khat hong pia hi."},"6":{"text":"A laikhak sungah, “Minam dangte lakah a kigen, Geshem in zong tu-a a kigen thu man hi, ci-a a gen thu in: Nang le Jew mite in kumpi lehdo ding na sawm uh a, tua thu hangin kulh na ciang uh hi. Tua banah nangmahmah zong kumpi na utna kigen lai hi."},"7":{"text":"Judah gam in kumpi khat nei ta hi, ci-in, nang kumpi na hihna thu Jerusalem-ah a taangko dingin kamsangte pawlkhat a koihin zong hong kigen hi. Kumpipa in hih thu za pelmawh ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin thakhatin hong pai inla, hih thu kikum ni,” ci-in kigelh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Tu-a na gen bangin bangmah om lo hi. Tua bang thu pen nangma phuahtawm ahi hi,” ci-in ka thuk hi."},"9":{"text":"Kote in ka hanciamna uh khiamin nasep a kizawh loh nading deihna tawh amaute in kote hong lausak theih nading uh a hanciam uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka hahkat semsem zaw uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mehetabel’ tapa Delaiah, a tapa Shemaiah a inn-ah omcip ahih manin ni khat ama kiangah ka pai leh amah in, “Pasian’ inn sung, siangtho munah kituahin biakinn kong kikhaknelh ni; bang hang hiam cih leh nang hong that dingin amaute hong pai uh a, zanin amaute in nang hong that ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in, “Mi kei bangte tai ding ahi hiam? Tua ciangin Tobiah a dingin Pasian’ biakinn huang sungah inndei khat a vaihawmsakna thu, Eliashib’ gamtat hoih lohna ka phawkkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih thu-ah lungkim het lo ka hih manin inndei sung panin Tobiah’ van teng ka lawnkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua inndei a siansakna ding uh, le Pasian’ biakinn-a umlebeelte, an tawh biakna le paknamtui a koihkik nadingun thu ka pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Levi mite’ ngah dingte amau’ tungah kipia lo ahih manin Levi mite le lasate in a nasep ngeite uh nusia-in a lote uhah na a sepna uh zong ka phawkkhia hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:19"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin uliante tungah ka lungkim kei a, “Bang hangin Pasian’ biakinn kinusiacip ahi hiam?” ka ci hi. Tua hi a, amaute kaikhawm kikin amau’ sepna ngei mun ciatah ka pangsakkik hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah mite khempeuh in an, leenggahzu, le sathau sung pan sawm-ah-khat hong paipihin vankoihna innte-ah hong tun uh hi.","ref":"Mal 3:10"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua vankoihna innte a kem dingin siampi Shelemiah, laithei Zadok, le Levi mi Pedaiah, le amaute a huh dingin Mattaniah’ tapa Zakkur, a tapa Hanan ka seh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute mi muanhuai ahi uh hi. Amau’ nasep pen a sanggamte uh tungah amau’ tanh ciat uh a hawmkhia ding uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, hih thu tawh kisai-in kei hong phawk inla, ka Pasian’ biakinn le a nasep nadingin ka sepsa gamtat hoihte maimangsak kei in."},"15":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Judah gam sungah mite in Sabbath ni-in leenggah sukin, a khawhsate uh khawmin late tungah suanin, leenggah, thei, le van namkim, Sabbath ni-in Jerusalem-ah hong puakna ka mu hi. Tua ni-in na a zuakna uh hangin ka lungkim lohna amaute tungah ka gen hi.","ref":"Pai 20:8-10; Thkna 5:12-14; Jer 17:21-22"},"16":{"text":"Jerusalem khuasunga teng Taia khuamite in zong ngasa le van namkim hong paipihin Judah mite tung le Jerusalem khua sungah Sabbath ni-in zuak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah uliante tungah lungkim loin amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin hih bangin hoih lohna gamta-in Sabbath ni ninsak ngam na hi uh hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh tu-a bang teekin a gamtat manin eite tung le hih khuapi tungah hih bang siatna khempeuh hong tung hi lo ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in note in Sabbath ni nitsakna tawh Israel tungah hehna tamzaw na tungsak uh hi,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hi a, Sabbath ni ding khuamial ciangin kongpite a kikhakna ding ka sawl a, Sabbath bei khit mateng a kihon loh nadingin thu ka pia hi. Tua ciangin, Sabbath ni-in khua sungah van hong kilutpih lohna dingin kongpite a cing dingin ka nasemte pawlkhat ka koih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin sumbukte le na nam tuamtuam a zuakte, khatvei nihvei khawng Jerusalem khua pualamah giak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute hilhkholin amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin kulh gei-ah giak na hi uh hiam? Nong giah kik uhleh note tungah thu kong bawl ding hi,” ka ci hi. Tua hun a kipanin Sabbath ni-in amaute hong pai nawn lo uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Sabbath ni a siangtho-in a omsak theih nadingun amaute kisiansuah tawmin kongpite hong cin nadingun Levi mite ka sawl hi. Ka Pasian aw, hih thu-ah zong hong phawk inla, na itna tawh kizui-in siatna panin kei hong pengsak in."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun lai mahin zong Judah mite in Ashdod numei, Ammon numei, le Moab numeite a tenpihna,"},"24":{"text":"le a tate uh kimkhat in Ashdod kampau a zatna, le Judah kampau zang thei loin, amau pau ciat bek a zat theihna thu ka mukhia hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute taigawpin ka samsia a, pawlkhat satin a sam uh ka bawhsak gawp hi. Tua ciangin Pasian’ min tawh amaute ka kiciamsak a, “Note in amau’ tapate’ zi dingin na tanute uh na pia kei ding uh a, na tapate uh zi ding ahi a, nomau’ zi dingin ahi zongin amaute’ tanu na la kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 34:11-16; Thkna 7:1-5"},"26":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Solomon zong tua bang numeite’ hangin khial hi lo ahi hiam? Minam tampite lakah amah tawh a kibang kumpi khat zong om lo a, ama Pasian in amah itin, Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi-in amah koih hi; ahi ta zongin gamdang numeite in amah nangawn khialsakzo hi.","ref":"2Sam 12:24-25; 1Kum 11:1-8"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Solomon aw, nangma gamtatnate hong zui-in, gamdang numeite tenpihna tawh hih siatna lian khempeuh gamta-in i Pasian tungah hong zuautat ding ka hi uh hiam?” ka cisak hi."},"28":{"text":"Siampi lianpen pa Eliashib’ tapa Jehoiada’ tapate khat pen Horonaim khuami Sanbalat’ makpa na hi hi. Tua ahih manin keima kiang panin amah ka hawlkhia hi.","ref":"Neh 4:1"},"29":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, amaute in siampi nasepna le siampite le Levi mite’ thuciamna siasak uh ahih manin amaute thei ta in."},"30":{"text":"Tua bangin gamdang tawh a kizom nate khempeuh panin amaute ka siangsak a, siampite le Levi mite a nasep ngei mah uhah ka semsakkik hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kiseh hunin zat dingin cih ding sing tawh biakna le anpal tawh biakna ding ka vaihawmsak hi. Ka Pasian aw, a hoih lamin kei hong phawk in."}}}}},"17":{"info":{"name":"Esther","shortname":"Est","abbr":[],"desc":"Esther Laibu sungah a kigelh thupiangte pen Persia gambup a uk kumpipa' phalbi inn-ah a piang thu ahi hi. A gen bulpi pen in a lungsim hang Jew numei Esther a kici numei khat thu ahi hi. Tua numei in a mite a itna leh a lungsim han'na hangin a galte un a thahmang khitna ding panin a mipihte a suahtak hi. Hih sungah Jew mite' Purim Pawipi a kipatna zia leh a khiatnate a kigen hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih lai-a kigelh thupiangte pen India gam panin Ethiopia gam dong, gamneu zakhat sawmnih le sagih a uk Ahasueras’ hun lai-a piang thu ahi hi.","title":"Kumpinu Vashti in Kumpipa Ahasueras’ thu Nial","ref":"Ezr 4:6"},"2":{"text":"Hih hun laitakin kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi sunga kumpi tokhom tungah amah tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama uk a kum thumna kumin ama nuai-a a uliante khempeuh le a nasemte a dingin pawi khat bawlsak hi. Ama khutnuai-a om Persia le Media galkapmangte le ama nuai-a uliante le ama nuai-ah gam a uksawnte a om laitakin,"},"4":{"text":"a kumpi gam hauhna le ama thupi ziazuana ni tampi sung, ni za le ni sawmgiat sung tak a lak hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih pawi hun a bei khit ciangin kumpi khua Susa khuapi sunga om milian mineu mi khempeuh a dingin kumpipa in pawi khat a bawl hi. Tua pawi pen kumpi inn huang sungah kibawl a, ni sagih sung kibawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua huang sungah suangkang khuamte kiphut a, khau malneu le khau dupsan tawh ngun kualte-ah kikhihin a kikhai dalna puanpakte kikhungin, suangmanpha a san, a dum, a kang, le a vom, a nam tuamtuamte kizangin a kizem suangphah kiphah tungah kham le ngun kibawl lupnate kikoih hi."},"7":{"text":"Kham hai nam tuamtuamte tawh zu kihawm a, kumpipa’ hauhna tawh kituakin deihdeihin zu kizang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua lai-ah zu nekna zia pen kihah piak cih om lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh in amau’ duh zahzah bek a neksakna ding uh kumpipa in a nuai-a a uliante thu pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua banah Kumpinu Vashti in zong numeite a dingin Kumpipa Ahasueras’ innsung mahah pawi khat a bawl hi."},"10":{"text":"A ni sagih ni, zunekna hangin a lung a nop ciangin kumpipa in ama na a sem innsungmang sagihte Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, le Karkas-te sam a, mite le uliante mai-ah Kumpinu Vashti a melhoihna a lahtheih nadingin a kumpi lukhu khusa-in ama kiangah a paipih nadingun a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua nu a mel a hoih takpi mah ahi hi.","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kumpinu Vashti in innsungmangte’ thupuak kumpipa’ sapna a nial hi. Hih a nialna thu-ah kumpipa heh mahmah a, a hehna hangin a sin so hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in upadi siam a mipilte thu dong hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh upadi le biakna lam thutheite khempeuh thu dot pen kumpipa’ zat ngei khat ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama gei nai penah a tu mite pen Persia le Media gam ulian sagihte ahi Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, le Memukan-te hi uh a, kumpipa kiangah a hawh thei, kumpi gam sungah ulian pente ahi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Innsung mangte’ tungtawnin keimah kumpi Ahasueras’ thupiakna bangin Kumpinu Vashti gamta lo ahih manin Kumpinu Vashti tungah upadi tawh kizui-in bangci kihih ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa le uliante’ zakin Memukan in dawng a, “Kumpinu Vashti khial hi; kumpipa tung bek hi loin Kumpipa Ahasueras’ ukna gam sung khempeuha om uliante le mi khempeuh tungah zong a khial ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpinu’ gamtatna thu numei dangte khempeuh in thei ding uh a, hih thu hangin numeite in a pasalte uh simmawh ding uh a, amaute in, ‘Kumpipa Ahasueras in ama kiangah a pai dingin Kumpinu Vashti thu pia napi-in pai lo hi,’ ci ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih banga kumpinu’ gamtatna thu a za Persia le Media gam numei liante in kumpipa nuai-a uliante tungah tuni mahmahin hih thu gen ding uh a, kisimmawhna le kizahtak lohna tampi piangsak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh, kumpi thupiakna khat paisak inla, Kumpipa Ahasueras’ mai-ah Vashti a kilakkik nawn loh nadingin a kikhelkik ngei nawn lo ding Persia mite le Media mite’ upadi sungah gelhsak in. Tua ciangin amah sangin a kilawmzaw numei khat ama za luahsak in."},"20":{"text":"Tua banga kumpipa’ thupiakna thu kumpi gam sung khempeuhah a kizak ciangin numei khempeuh in a neu a lian amau’ pasal ciat zahtak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa le uliante in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa uh a, Memukan’ gen bangin kumpipa a gamta hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasal khempeuh pen ama innsung ukpa ahihna ding le ama kampau a kizuih kim nadingin kumpipa’ ukna gam khempeuhah amau’ lai ciat, le mi khempeuh tungah amau’ pau ciatin laikhakte kigelh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thu teng a pian’ khit, Kumpipa Ahasueras’ hehna a dam ciangin, amah in Vashti phawkin, Vashti’ gamtatna le amah tawh kisai-in a thupiakna zong thei hi.","title":"Esther, Kumpinu Kisuaksak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa’ nasemte in ama kiangah, “Kumpipa a dingin a melhoih nungak khangnote zongsak in."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi-a numeite’ omna-ah a melhoih nungak khangno khempeuh hong paipih nadingun na ukna gam tuamtuam khempeuhah uliante sawl in. Tua numeite pen numeite a uk, kumpipa’ innsungmang Hegai’ kep dingin ki-ap hen. Tua ciangin tua numeite tungah paknamtui tuamtuam kiguan’ hen."},"4":{"text":"Tua sung panin kumpipa’ deih bel nungak pen Vashti’ tangin kumpinu suak hen,” a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa a, tua bangin a gamta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Benjamin minam Kish, a tapa Shimei, a tapa Jair, a tapa Mordekai a kici Jew mi khat om hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah pen, Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin Judah kumpipa Jekoniah tawh a lak galmatte lak a kihel khat ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 24:10-16; 2Khang 36:10"},"7":{"text":"Amah in a innlak pate khat’ tanu, a min masa Hadassah, a nung ciangin Esther a kici, a khoi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a nu le a pa om nawn lo hi. Tua numei melhoihin a ngaihbaang mahmah khat hi a, a nu le a pa a sih ciangin Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupiakna kithei kimin, Hegai’ kep dingin ap dingin kumpi khua Susa khuapi-ah numei tampi hong kipaipih ciangin, numeite a uk Hegai’ tungah ap dingin kumpipa’ inn-ah Esther zong kipaipih hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in tua nungak hoihsa-in pakta mahmah ahih manin paknamtuite le a annek ding pia pah a, kumpipa’ innsung panin a kiteel nasem numei sagih zong guan a, amah le a nasem numeite’ tungah numeite’ omna a hoihpen mun a pia pah hi."},"10":{"text":"Mordekai in kham ahih manin Esther in ama namlephung genkhia lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Esther bangci om a, ama tungah bang piang hiam cih a theih nadingin numeite’ omna inntual mai-ah nisimin Mordekai va pai zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Numeite a kigin’ hun a vekpi-in kha sawm le nih sung hi a, sathau le myrrh paknamtui tawh kha guk sung kipuahin, paknamtui tuamtuamte le kipuahna dangte tawh kha guk sung mah kipuah uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kiginkholhna hun cing a, Kumpipa Ahasueras’ kiangah numeite a pai ciangin numeite’ omna panin kumpipa’ inn-ah a deih peuhpeuh uh kikengsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Nitakin kumpipa kiangah va pai a, a zingsang ciangin numeite’ omna a mun dang khatah kiciahsak a, kumpipa’ zineute a uk, kumpipa’ innsungmang Shaashgaz in kem hi. Kumpipa in a deihkik kei leh kumpipa kiangah paikik nawn lo a, kumpipa in a deih leh a minin kisamkik hi."},"15":{"text":"Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak a innlak pa Abihail’ tanu Esther pen kumpipa kiangah a pai ding hun a tun ciangin, numeite a uk kumpipa’ innsung mangpa Hegai’ gen teng lobuang kizepna ding puan dang bangmah ngenthuah lo hi. Tu-in Esther a mu mi peuhmah in hoihsa kim uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama uk a kum sagihna, kha sawmna ahi Tebeth kha sungin kumpi innsung Kumpi Ahasueras’ kiangah Esther a kipaipih ciangin,"},"17":{"text":"kumpipa in ama numei dangte khempeuh sangin itzaw a, a nungak dangte khempeuh sangin limbawl zaw hi. Tua hi a, kumpi lukhu amah khusakin Vashti’ tangin kumpinu a suaksak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Esther pahtawina-in ama uliante le a nasem khempeuh a dingin pawi lianpi khat a bawl hi. Amah in ama ukna gam khempeuhah tua ni nasep khawlin zum a khakna ding uh zong thu zasak kim a, kumpipa min tawh a kilawm a kituak letsongte zong a hawmkhia hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hun sungin Mordekai in kumpi nasep a ngah hi.","title":"Kumpipa a Kisawmsimna Thu Mordekai in Pulak"},"20":{"text":"Ama hilhna tawh kizui-in Esther in ama minam ahi a, a innkuan ahi zongin pulak lo hi. Mordekai’ kep sungin ama thu a man’ mah bangin tu-in zong Mordekai’ gen bangin gamta hi."},"21":{"text":"Ni khat, kumpi nasemin Mordekai a om hun sungin kongcing ahi kumpipa’ innsungmangte Bigthana le Teresh heh uh a, Kumpipa Ahasueras thah ding a sawm uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih thu Mordekai in phawkin Kumpinu Esther kiangah ko a, Esther in Mordekai’ hong thupuak, ci-in kumpipa kiangah a gensawn hi."},"23":{"text":"A thu kikanin a manna a kitheih ciangin khuampite tungah tua mi nih tegel kikhailum hi. Hih thupiangte khempeuh kumpipa’ theihin Kumpi Gam Tangthu Laibu sungah kiciamteh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thute khit ciangin Kumpipa Ahasueras in Agag-te beh Hammedatha’ tapa Haman a za khangsak a, amah tawh a semkhawm ulian dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in a bawl hi.","title":"Jew Mite Suksiat ding Haman’ Sawmna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kumpi huang sunga om kumpipa’ nasem khempeuh in Haman zahtak bawlin ama mai-ah kun uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua banga a hih ding uh kumpipa in thu pia hi. Ahih hangin Mordekai pen amah zahtakna limin a mai-ah kun lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa’ huang sunga om kumpipa’ nasemte in Mordekai kiangah, “Bang hangin kumpipa’ thupiak mang lo na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Nisimin amaute in Mordekai kiangah gengen uh a, ahih hangin amah in mang nuam lo hi. Jew mi ahihna thu amaute kiangah gen khin ahih manin tua banga ama nialna a kimang ding mah ahi hiam cih a theih nadingun Haman kiangah a thu ko uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama mai-ah Mordekai a kun lohna, amah a zahtakbawl lohna a theih ciangin Haman nak heh mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in Mordekai’ mipihte a theih ciangin amah bek suktaak sa lo a, Ahasueras’ kumpi gam sung khempeuhah a om Jew mi khempeuh, Mordekai le a minam buppi-in a suksiat theih nading lampi a zong hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Ahasueras’ uk a kum sawm le nihna, a kha masa pen ahi Nisan kha a kipanin a ni ni, a kha kha-in Pur a kici aisanna tawh Haman’ muhin ai kisan a, a kha sawm le nihna Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni-in ai a pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Haman in Kumpipa Ahasueras’ kiangah, “Na ukna gam tuamtuam sunga om mite lakah a om kawikawi, amau a tuam om mi pawlkhat om hi. Amau’ ngeinate pen midangte a’ tawh kibang lo a, amaute in nangma thukhamte zui lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih mite na hici khahkhong ding kilawm lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh amaute a kisuksiatna ding thu pia-in lai-in gelh in. Tua hileh nangma sumkholna sungah koih dingin na khutnuai-a na uliante tungah ngun talen tul sawm ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ama khutsung panin a minthuhna zungbuh suahin Jew mite’ gal, Agag-te beh Hammedatha’ tapa Haman’ tungah a pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, “Na sum cihte nangmah kong piakik hi; na mi cihte zong nangma khut sungah kong pia hi; na ut bangbangin bawl in,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"A kha masa a ni sawm le thum ni-in kumpipa’ lai-atte khempeuh kisam a, Haman’ genna tawh kizui-in kumpipa’ nuai-ah gam tampi a uksawnte le gam khat a uksawnte, le gam uksawnte’ khutnuai-ah a mi tuamtuamte lakah uliante tungah lai kipaisak hi. Gam khempeuhah amau’ lai ciat, mi khempeuh tungah amau pau ciatin kigelh hi. Hih lai pen kumpipa Ahasueras’ min tawh kigelhin kumpipa’ minthuhna zungbuh tawh min kithuh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin kumpipa’ ukna gam khempeuhah laitaite kipiasak a, Adar kha ahi a kha sawm le nihna a ni sawm le thum ni, ni khat sungin Jew mi a moi a ham, numei naupang, a vekpi-in susia-in, thatin, a beisakmangna ding uh, le a neihsate uh a laksak nadingun thu kipia hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua a ni seh ni-in amaute a baihsa-in a om theih nadingun hih thupiakna lai pen gam khempeuhah dal khat ciat kipuakin tua thu pen a gam sung mi khempeuh tungah a kizasak kim ding ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupiakna tawh laitaite kinawh sawl a, hih thupiakna pen kumpi khua Susa khuapi panin a kihawmkhia ahi hi. Kumpipa le Haman zu ne-in om hithiat uh a, ahi zongin Susa khuapi sung buai mahmah hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mordekai in hih thupiang teng a theih ciangin a puan balkekin puanhampi silhin vut kibuak a, nakpitakin a kap kawmin khua sungah vak kawikawi hi.","title":"Esther in Ama mite a’ ding Thumsak ding Kam Ciam"},"2":{"text":"Puanhampi silh kawmpi-in kongpi-ah kuamah kilutsak lo ahih manin kumpi inn kongpi panin a kimuhna mun ciangah pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thupiakna a tunna gam Jew mite’ omna khempeuhah nakpi taka thumna le tauna, antanna, kahna, le dip-humna om hi. Mi a tamzaw in puanhampi silhin vut lakah lum uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Esther’ nasem numeite le a innsungmangte hong pai-in ama kiangah tua thu a gen ciangun kumpinu in lamdangsa mahmah hi. A puanhampi a laih nadingin amah in Mordekai a’ ding puante khak a, ahih hangin Mordekai in tuate na sang lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Esther in ama na a sem dingin a kiseh, kumpipa innsungmangte lak panin Hathak a kici mipa samin hih thu pen bang hi a, bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, ci-in Mordekai tung panin thu a va kan dingin a sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpi inn kongpi mai-a om khuapi kongzing tualpi a om Mordekai kiangah Hathak va pai a,"},"7":{"text":"Mordekai in ama tunga thupiangte khempeuh le Jew mite sukmang nadingin kumpipa’ sumkholna-ah Haman in piak dinga a sum ciamzah thute khempeuh ama kiangah na gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute a kisukmang nadingin Susa khua panin a kihawmkhia lai dal khat zong Mordekai in ama tungah pia a, amah in Esther tungah tua lai na pia-in a thu a na gentelna ding le, kumpipa kiangah Esther na pai-in ama mipihte a dingin a na thumsak ding zong a sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Hathak zong ciahin Mordekai’ thugen teng Esther kiangah va gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Esther in Hathak mah sawlkikin Mordekai’ tungah thu zasak a,"},"11":{"text":"“Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin sap lohpi-in mi khat peuhpeuh kumpipa’ omna inn sungah a va lut leh upadi khat bek om a, tua pen, thah ding ahi hi; kumpipa in ama lamah a kham kumpi ciangkhut a na zan leh tua mipa suakta bek ding ahihna thu kumpipa’ nasemte le ama ukna gam mi khempeuh in a theih ciat uh ahi hi. Hih kumpi inn na tunna pen hih bang huna mah dinga a tung na hih mel zong kua in thei ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Esther in Mordekai a dawnna lai amah puasak leuleu a,"},"16":{"text":"“Pai-in Susa khua sunga om Jew mi khempeuh khawm inla, keimah ngaihsutna-in an na tang un. Tua khit ciangin ngeina ahihloh hangin kumpipa kiangah ka va pai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai pai-in Esther’ sawl bang teekteekin a gamta hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in Esther in a kumpipuan silhin kumpipa’ inntual sungnungah dingin kumpi inn lam a nga hi. Haman in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa a, a khuam a phutsak hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zanin kumpipa ihmu thei lo a, nisim thupiang ciaptehna Khang Tangthu Laibu lasak a, ama zakin tua laibu kisim hi.","title":"Mordekai A Pahtawi Dingin Haman Ki-aana-sawl"},"2":{"text":"Tua banga a kisim ciangin, kongcingte sung panin innsungmang Bigthana le Teresh in Kumpipa Ahasueras thah a sawmna thu pen Mordekai in a genna thu a kiciamtehna simkha uh hi.","ref":"Est 2:21-22"},"3":{"text":"Tua thu a zak ciangin kumpipa in, “Hih thu hangin Mordekai’ tungah pahtawina ahi a, minliatna ahi zongin bang kipia ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa pen amah zemsak inla, tua ciangin khuasung kongzing lampi-ah sakol tungah a tuangsa-in na ulian pen pa kaisak inla, ama mai-ah kiko sakin, ‘Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi,’ cisak in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, “Na cihsa bangin manlangin kumpi puante le sakol la pah inla, kongpi-a om Jew mi Mordekai tungah hih thute khempeuh hih in. Kumpipa in tua thu a cih phetin amaute in Haman’ mai puan a khuh uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa’ na a sem innsungmangte lakah Harbona in, “Nidangin kumpipa’ na hoihtakin a sem ngei Mordekai thah nadingin Haman mahmah in a phuhsak, pi sawmsagih le nga a sang khuam pen Haman’ inn-ah tumahin om hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Tua tungah amah khailum un,” a ci hi. Tua hi a, midangte in Jew mite kihta uh ahih manin tua gam a om mi tampi tak in Jew mi ka hi uh hi, a ci uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kha sawm le nihna ahi Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni-in kumpipa’ thupiakna bangin sepkhiatna ding hun hong tung hi. Ahi zongin amau’ neihsate suksak lo uh hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sunga a kithat zah tua ni mahmahin kumpipa kiangah kizasak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Kumpinu Esther kiangah, “Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Jew mite in mi zanga that uh a, Haman’ tapa sawmte zong that uh hi. Ahih hangin a neihsate uh suksak lo uh hi.","title":"Purim Pawi"},"17":{"text":"Hih banga a hih pen Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni hi a, a ni sawm le li ni-in tawlnga uh a, pawi bawlin lungdamin om uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin Susa khua sunga om Jew mite ahihleh a ni sawm le thum le sawm le li ni-in kikaikhawm uh a, a ni sawm le nga ni tawlnga uh a, pawi bawlin lungdamin om uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Hih thu hangin gam sung khuaneute-a teng Jew mite in Adar kha a ni sawm le li ni pawi bawlna le lungdam ni dingin tawlngak ni-in nei uh a, anlim nono kikholhna ni-in a zang uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mordekai in hih thupiangte khempeuh lai-in ciamteh a, a nai a gamla a om Kumpi Ahasueras’ ukna gam sung khempeuha om Jew mite tungah lai paisak hi."},"21":{"text":"A kumkumin Adar kha ni sawm le li ni le sawm le nga ni a tanna dingun thu a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua nite pen Jew mite a galte uh tung panin a suahtak ni, dahna le thumnate lungdamna le lungnopna a suah kha ahi hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in pawi bawl ni le lungdam ni-in nei-in, anlim nono khatlekhat kikholh ni le mizawngte tungah letsong piak ni-in a zat dingun thu a pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai’ laigelhna tawh kizui-in Jew mite in a patsa uh hih banga a hihnate uh a zom uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Jew mi khempeuh’ gal ahi, Hammedatha’ tapa, Agag-te beh Haman in Jew mite sugawpin a suksiat nadingin Pur kici ai sanin Jew mite suksiat ding sawm hi.","ref":"Est 3:7"},"25":{"text":"Ahih hangin kumpipa in hih thu a theih ciangin, Jew mite sukna dingin Haman in a geelsa thu hoih lo pen Haman’ lu tung mah a lehtukna ding, le amah le a tapate khuam tungah a kikhaina ding lai-in gelhin thu a pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Pur min tamin hih hun sung teng Purim ci-in min a phuak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih lai sunga a kigelh thute khempeuh, le hih thute amau’ mit tawh mu-in a pumpi uh tawh a tuahna uh hangin,"},"27":{"text":"Jew mite amau mahmah, le a suan a khakte uh, le amau a pawlpih khempeuh in lai sunga kigelh bangin a kiseh hunin kum simin hih ni nihte a pel loin a tan’ ding uh kipsak uh a,"},"28":{"text":"a khangkhangin innkuan sim, gam sim, khuapi simah hih nite phawkin a kitanna ding, le Jew mite lakah hih Purim nite a kitan’ ngitngetna ding ahi a, a suanlekhakte un zong hih thu a mangngilh hetloh nading uh ahi zongin khotakin a len uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Abihail’ tanu Kumpinu Esther in Purim thu tawh kisai hih laikhak nihna a kipsak nadingin Jew mi Mordekai tungah aana a kicingin a piakna lai-in a gelh hi."},"30":{"text":"Kumpi Ahasueras’ ukna gam za le sawmnih le sagih sungah a om Jew mite khempeuh tungah kilemna le nopna a omna ding deihsakna laite kikhak a,"},"31":{"text":"Jew mi Mordekai in a gelhsa bangin a kisehsa tawh kizui-in hih Purim nite a tan nadingun thu kipia hi. Tua mah bangin amaute le a suanlekhakte uh a dingin antanna ding le thumna bawlna ding ngeinate a gelh uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Kumpinu Esther’ thupiakna in hih Purim bawlna ding ngeinate kipsak a, lai thupite sungah hih thu kiciamteh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahasueras in a ukna gam leitung le tuikulh tunga tengte tung panin siah kai hi.","title":"Mordekai’ Liatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama vangliatna le a sepnate khempeuh, le Mordekai tungah a piak minphatnate, Media le Persia Kumpite’ Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpipa Ahasueras’ zomah Mordekai a lianpen ahi hi. Mordekai in ama mite’ phattuamna ding le a suanlekhakte uh a khantohna ding hanciam ahih manin Jew mite lakah milian khat hi a, a gam mihonpite in a it kim uh hi."}}}}},"18":{"info":{"name":"Job","shortname":"Job","abbr":[],"desc":"Job Laibu sungah mihoih khat in siatna lianpi a tuahna thu kigelh hi. Tua mihoihpa a tate khempeuh si khin a, a neihsa khempeuh a maiman' khit banah a kihhuai mahmah meima vei lai hi. Hih lai a gelhpa in la-pau zangin mi tuamtuam thum tawh a kihona thu-ah, hih tuahsiatna huhau-in a kihopih mi tuamtuam thumte leh Job' lungsim ngaihsutzia a lak hi. A thutawpna lamah, mite tawh na a semkhawm Pasian' thu a kilim gen pha ahihna thu Job tungah kilang hi. Job' lawmte in ama thuaknate pen tanglai amau' biakna lungsim puakzia tawh kizui-in na genpih uh hi. Pasian in mihoihte thaman pia a, mi gilote gimna thuaksak ahih manin Job in hih zahin gimna a thuakna pen a mawhna hang ahi hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Ahi zongin Job in hih bang ngaihsutna cingtaak sa zolo hi. Kuamah tawh teh theihlohin a hoih a thuman mahmah mi khat ahih manin hih bang gimna a thuak dingin kingaihsun theilo hi. Tua zahin mihoih ama tungah Pasian in hih zah gimna a tun'sakna thu theilo ahih manin hang takin Pasian kiang panin a hang a kal hi. Job in a upna khahsuahlo hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' mai-ah mi thuman ahihna kilangsak nuam a, mihoih hihna hangin pahtawina ngahkik nuam hi. Pasian in Job' thudotte dawnglo hi. Ahi zongin ama vangliatna leh a pilna thu Job tungah limtakin a genna tawh Job' upna thu na langsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin Job in kiniamkhiatna tawh Pasian a pil mahmah a lian mahmah ahihna thu na phawk a, a heh paunasa teng na kisikkik hi. A tawpna-ah Job in ama pian'ngei a ngahkikna thu leh a ni dang sangin zong a cihtheih zawkna thu na kigelh hi. Job' thuakna thu a theih zawhlohna uh hangin Pasian in Job' lawmte na taigawp hi. Tanglai biakna in a theihna zah sangin Pasian a liatzawk taktakna thu Job bek in phawkzo hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uz gamah Job kici min nei mi khat a om hi. Tua ahih manin nisuahna gam sungah Job a haupen khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama tapate in inn khat panin inn khatah a ban banin pawi bawlin pai kawikawi uh a, tua pawi a siim dingin a sanggam numei thumte uh zong a sam kawikawi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua banga a pawi bawl uh gual khat a kikhit ciangin Job in a tapate samin amaute siansuah a, zingsangin tho baihin a ta phazah tawh kizui-in meihal biakna a pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Job in, “Ka tate khialin, a lungsim sung uhah Pasian samsia khathei ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tu-a bangin Job in hih tawntung hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni khat ni-in Topa’ omna-ah vantung mite hong pai uh a, tuate lakah Satan zong hong kihel hi.","ref":"Pian 6:2"},"7":{"text":"Topa in Satan kiangah, “Koi pana hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Satan in Topa dawngin, “Leitung khempeuh a lu pan a taw dong vak kawikawi-in ka va phehlehna mun panin ka hong pai hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, “Ka nasem Job na phawkkha hiam? A paubaang lo, a thutang, Pasian zahtakin gamtat hoih lo a peel amah tawh a kibang midang leitungah na mu kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Satan in Topa dawngin, “Job in Pasian hong mawk zahtak ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Amah le a innkuan le a neihsate khempeuh na hutna-in a kimkotah daai khan hi lo na hi hiam? Ama hihna khempeuhah thupha na pia a, genzawh lohin ama neihsa pung hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin na khut zanin ama neihsa khempeuh suksak lecin na maitang mahmahah nang hong samsia pah ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mang 12:10"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, “En in, ama neihsa khempeuh na khut sungah kong ap hi; ahi zongin amah taktak ahihleh na su kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa’ omna panin Satan a paikhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni khat, a tapate le a tanute in a u pen uh inn-ah an ne zu ne-in om uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Kamtai khat Job kiangah hong tungin, “Bawngtalte in lo kho-in, tuate gei-ah late gamta uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua laitakin Seba mite hong pai-in ganhingte hong sut a, namsau tawh gancingte thatkhin uh hi. Hih thu a hong zasak thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in a thugen a khit ma-in kamtai dang khat hong tungin, “Vantung panin keek hong kia a, tuute le tuucingte kha-in kangtum uh hi. Hih thu nang kiangah a hong ko thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua pa in a thugen a khit ma-in kamtai dang khat hong tung leuleu-in, “Khaldea mite hon thum in kalaohte hong sut a, namsau tawh kalaoh tung tuangte khempeuh that hi. Hih thu nang kiangah a hong ko thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in a thugen a khit ma-in kamtai dang khat hong tung leuleu a, “Na tapate le na tanute a u pen uh inn-ah an ne zu ne-in om uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua laitakin sehnel gam panin huihpi pingpei hong nungin a inn mutpai-in na tate denglum hi. Nang kiangah hih thu a hong ko thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih thu a zak ciangin Job dahlua-in a puan balkek a, a sam met khia-in leilakah bok sukin Pasian a bia hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Ka nu sung panin guaktangin ka suak a, guaktang mahin ka ciahkik ding hi. Topa’ min kiphat ta hen,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih thu khempeuhah Job khial lo a, Pasian zong mawhsak lo hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni-in Topa’ omna-ah vantung mite hong paikik uh a, Satan zong amaute lakah hong kihelin Topa’ omna mahah hong pai hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, “Koi lai panin hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Satan in Topa dawngin, “Leitung khempeuh a lu pan a taw dong vak kawikawi-in ka va phehlehna mun panin kong pai hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, “Ka nasem Job na phawk hiam? Thu om lopi-in amah susia dingin kei nong kam pausak a, ahi zongin ama hoihna bangmah hem tuan lo hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Satan in Topa dawngin, “Vun bek in vun mah leizo bek, ci-in paunak a om mah bangin mi khat in ama nuntakna a hutna-in a neih khempeuh pia ngam ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in na khut zan inla, ama sa le a guh suksak lecin nangma maitang mahah pel loin nang hong samsia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, “En in, na khut sungah amah kong ap hi; ahi zongin amah sisak kei in,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ omna panin Satan paikhia a, Job a khetul pan a luzang dongin a kihhuai meima a veisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in beel kitam themkhat la-in tua tawh kikhuatin vut lakah a tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin a zi in, “Na upna khiam tuan lo ding na hi hiam? Pasian samsia inla sisuk mai in,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in a zi kiangah, “Numei haite’ kampau bangin na pau hi. Pasian’ tung panin a hoih sang ihih ciangin siatna zong sang lo ding ihi hiam?” a ci hi. Hih thu khempeuhah a kampau nangawnin Job khial lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Job’ lawmte thum, Teman khuami Elifaz, Shuah gammi Bildad, le Naamah gammi Zofar-te in Job in a thuak gimna thu teng a zak uh ciangin a inn ciat panun amah a hehnem ding le a hanthawn dingin kituahin hong paikhawm uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in a gamla sim mun panin Job a muh tungun amah thei pah lo uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute a gingin kapkhia uh a, a puan uh balkekin a lu tung uh a tukik dingin leivui lawnto uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin leilakah sun sagih le zan sagih sung amah tawh tukhawm uh a, ama thuakna a nasiat mahmah lamtak mu uh ahih manin kuamah in kam khat beek a paupih ngam kei uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih bang teng khit ciangin Job in thugen hong kipan a, mihingin a pian’ ni a samsia hi.","title":"Mihingin a Pian’ Job Dahin Thum"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka suah ni, le ‘Pasal naungek khat kipaii hi,’ a kicih zan beimang hen!"},"4":{"text":"Tua ni khimzin’ ni suak hen! Vana Pasian in phawkin nei kei hen la, tua ni-in khuavak taang kei hen."},"5":{"text":"Khuaniim, khuamial in khuhcip hen. Tua ni-in meiipi zing hen la, tua ni awk in valhtum hen."},"6":{"text":"“Tua zan, khuamial sahpi in mancip hen! Kum khat sunga nidangte tawh kisim khawm kei hen la, kha khat sunga nidangte lakah kiseh khawm kei hen."},"7":{"text":"Tua zanin ta piang kei hen la, lungdam otna awging tua zanin ging nawnkei hen."},"8":{"text":"Phuisamna tawh awle a khiim thei, a mitphial tawh tuipi ganhing a hencip thei mite in tua zan samsia tahen."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni zingsang aksite mial hen. A vak ngei lo ding khuavak ngak niloh hen la, zingsang phalvak mu ngeikei hen;"},"10":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh kei hong kipaiina naugil na khakcip lo a, kei’ muhna panin lungkhamna hong hepkhiatsak lo hi."},"11":{"text":"“Bang hangin a sisa-in suak hoh lo a, bang hangin ka suah phetin si pah hoh lo ka hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Bang hangin ka nu’ khuk tungah hong kitawi se a, ka nu’ nawi hong kiteepsak se ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Tua hi zenzen kei leh hanah nuamtakin ka lum hithiat khin ding hi. Sihna sungah ihmu-in ka tawlnga khin ding a,"},"14":{"text":"inn hoihnono a lam kumpite le uliante,"},"15":{"text":"ngun le kham tawh a kidim a hau a liante tawh nuamtakin hanah ka tawlnga khinta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hangin a hun cing lo-a suakte bang, khuavak a mu man loin a si naungekte bangin hong kiseelcip hoh lo ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Tua lai-ah migilote in hong sukha nawn lo ding a, a gim mite tawlnga hithiat ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua lai-ah galmat salte in nopna ngah ding a, nasem ukpa’ awging za nawn lo ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua lai munah milian mineu omkhawm a, silate nangawn a topa’ kiang pan suakta hi.","ref":"Jer 20:14-18"},"20":{"text":"“Bang hangin lungkhamna a thuak mipa, a nuntakna haksa a sa mahmah mipa,"},"21":{"text":"sih ding lunggulh ngeungau napi, a si thei lo, sum phum zon sangin sih ding a lim zonzaw,","ref":"Mang 9:6"},"22":{"text":"han sung a tun ciangin a nuam mahmah, hankhuk a tun ciangin nuam lua-in a dianggawp mite, khuavak a mu dingin mi-in piang laizang ahi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"Bang hangin mailam thu ding a thei lopi-in a mot om ding, a kimkotah Pasian in daai a khaknelh mipa, mi-in piang zenzen ahi hiam?"},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh khuisatna, ka annek suak a, ka tauna, luipi ging bang hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka kihtaktak thu ka tungah hong tung ta a, ka laulau thu, ka tuak ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Lungnopna, daitakin omna, ka nei kei hi. Lungkhamna in hong nawk niloh a, tawldam hun ka nei kei hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Teman khuami Elifaz in thu hong gen a,","title":"Elifaz in Job Tai"},"2":{"text":"“Mi khatpeuh in thu hong genpih leh na heh ding hiam? Kua in a kam ipzo nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Lunghiang mite na hanthotna, khut kha ban kha mite na thakhauhsakna,"},"4":{"text":"a puk mite na thugenna tawh na kipsakna, khukzaw mite na hatsak ngeite ngaihsun in."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin nang tungah tuate hong tung a, na thuakzo kei hi. Tuate in nang hong su a, na lungniam hi."},"6":{"text":"Na biakna in hong hehnem zo lo ahi hiam? A paubaang lo, na nuntakna in lametna hong pia zo lo ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Tu-in ngaihsun in: Midik kimlai kua sia ngei ahi hiam? A thutang mi a kisuksiatna koi-ah mu ngei na hi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Mawhna bawlin buaina a piangsak mi in a gamtatna bangin a gah a atna ka thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian’ husanna tawh tua bang mite sia a, ama hehna in tua bang mite kangtum hi."},"10":{"text":"Humpinelkai hawk bangin migilote’ hawkna dai ta a, Pasian in amaute’ ha suktansak khin ahih manin gamdai ta uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Annek ding a mu lo a thahat humpinelkai bangin amaute simang khin uh a, a tate uh kithehthang hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tu-in kei kiangah thu khat hong tung khian a, ka bil in tua thu ginghiau a za hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi a ihsip hun zankim laitak, zan mangmat hun laitakin","ref":"Job 33:15"},"14":{"text":"launa le linna kei tungah hong tung a, ka pumpi linna in kei hong lausak hi."},"15":{"text":"Huih in ka mai hong mut a, ka khuasikmul hong suaksak hi."},"16":{"text":"A mel ka khen theih loh lim khat hong ding a, keima mai-ah mihing lim khat hong om a, tua ciangin aw un duadua khat ka za a,"},"17":{"text":"‘Pasian’ mai-ah mi khatpeuh paubaang loin omzo ngei ding ahi hiam? Amah a Bawlpa’ mai-ah sitbaang loin omzo ngei ding ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Pasian in ama nasemte mahmah muangzo loin, ama sawltakte’ mawhna mu ahihleh,"},"19":{"text":"inn umna kawmin buan a kizatna inn sunga a teng mite, a inn bulpi leivui ahi,"},"20":{"text":"zing kal nitak kalin, a kisusia thei sungah a omte, bangzah ta-in kuama don lohin si pakin,"},"21":{"text":"amau’ liatna in taisan pak ding a, pilna ngah ngei loin si pakzaw ding hi lo ahi hiam?’ hong ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tu-in na thu ko in: Nang hong huh ding om ahi hiam? A siangthote kua pen’ lam zuan ding na hi hiam?"},"2":{"text":"Mihai pa in a hehna sihlawh a, muhdahna in sihna piangsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihai pa in limtakin zung kha ngei napi, ama inn thakhatin a kizunglot ka mu ngei hi."},"4":{"text":"A tapate suahtaksak zawh ding hi nawn lo hi. Kulhkongpi gei-ah amaute kisugawp a, amaute a honkhia ding kuamah om lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Midangte in a neihsate liahtumsak uh a, amah sangin a hatzaw pa in a um a beel sunga a omte nangawn laksak a, a neih a lam duhgawhin a deihgawh hi."},"6":{"text":"Leilak panin gimna hong piangtawm lo a, lei sung panin lungkhamna hong pokhiatawm lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Mei-ek a to leen mah bangin mihingte in amau’ lungkhamna ding mah a piangsak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nang hi leng, ka Pasian’ tungah ka thum ding a, ama tungah ka thu ka ap ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in na liante le kuama phawk zawh loh thute sem a, genzawh lohin a lamdang na tampi a bawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in guah zusak a, lo khempeuh tui a buak hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in mi niamte sangkoih a, a dahte lungnuamsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in migilote’ geelna suksiatsak ahih manin amaute in a ngimna uh tangtun thei lo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in migilote amau’ gitlohna mahah awksak a, ngian a zangte’ geelna zong a lumletsak hi.","ref":"1Kor 3:19"},"14":{"text":"Sunthapai-in khuamial sung kidenna a, suntangpi mahin zan bangin mial a zawt uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah in amau’ kiang panin pa nei lote honkhia a, mi thahatte kiang panin mi cimawhte a honkhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mizawngte in lametna neikik uh a, thuman lo mite ahihleh kihencip hi."},"17":{"text":"“Pasian in a taii mite mi nuamsa hizaw ahih manin, Vanglianpa’ taiina thupi san in.","ref":"Pau 3:11-12; Heb 12:5-6"},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a liamsak hangin a liamna tunsak ding a, ama satna liamma damsak ding hi.","ref":"Hos 6:1"},"19":{"text":"Lungkhamna gukvei dong na tuahna-ah amah in nang hong hon ding a, a sagihveina dingah siatna in nang hong su nawn lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Kialpi sungin sih nading pan nang hong honkhia ding a, gal sungah namsau panin nang hong suaktasak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Gensiatna panin nang hong kihu ding a, siatna hong tun ciangin na lau kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Suksiat ding le puksih dingte na nuihsan lel ding a, leitung gamsate na kihta kei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na lo sungah suang om lo ding a, gamlak gamsate in hong su lo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na inn sungah lunghihmawhna ding om lo hi, ci-in na thei ding a, na inn kiim na et ciangin a kitasam bangmah om lo ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na suan na khakte tampi tak pha ding hi, ci-in na thei ding a, na sunga piangte leitung lopa zah pha ding hi, ci-in na thei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A hun ciangin ancilna phualah buhlom a tun mah bangin a teek sihin han na zuan ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Hih thute khempeuh ka kantel uh a, a thuman a na hi hi. Hih thute ka zaksa uh hi a, a manna na thei ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Job in A Lawmte Tai"},"2":{"text":"“Ka lunggimna kitawikhai hen la, ka haksatna khempeuh kitawiteh leh!"},"3":{"text":"Tuipi sehnel khempeuh sangin gikzaw ding ahih manin ka kampaute guhin a kha hi."},"4":{"text":"Vanglianpa’ thaltangte in kei hong kha a, ka sungah a thal gu kidiah hi. Pasian in a kihtakhuai-in kei hong su hi."},"5":{"text":"Gam late in lopa a nek laitakin ham a, bawngtal in an a nek laitakin ham ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"An lim lote, ci sawh loin kine thei a, aktui da kang in limna nei ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Ka kam in tuate ciam nuam lo a, tuate khempeuh a luaksuahhuai an tawh a kibang lel ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ka ngetna ngah thei hi leng a, Pasian in ka deihna hong pia ding hileh"},"9":{"text":"Pasian in kei hong sucip hen la, a khut zanin kei hong that vet leh!"},"10":{"text":"Tua hileh keima kihehnepna hi ding a, hih zahta ka thuakna-ah nuamin ka diang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Siangtho Pa’ thu ka nial khat zong om lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka thuak lai nadingin bang hatna nei nawn a, lungduai a ka om nadingin lamet ding bang om nawn ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka thahatna suang bang hi a, ka pumpi in sumngo tha paii ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Kei le kei’ sung panin huhna bangci ngahtawm theih ding ka hi hiam?
