Kei hong kihuhna ding ka ngetna ding kuamah om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"“Pasian ka nusia a, ka nusia kei zongin, hih bang lungkham hunin lawm citak ka kisam hi."},"15":{"text":"No ka lawmte pen, lui tuikhang bang, a mangthang pak tui let bang,"},"16":{"text":"nin a khalhnelh vuk le tuikhal bangin na zuautat uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Khua a lum ciangin tuate tui mangthang a, ni a sat ciangin a kang hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua tui a zong dingin khualzin mite pai kawikawi a, gam sung tengah kawi pai-in a mangthang uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tema khuami khualzinte in zong tua tui zong uh a, Sheba mite in zong tua tui muanin a nei uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua a lametna uhah cimawh uh hi. Tua tui zuan uh a, a om loh ciangin cih nading thei loin kamka lel uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu-in zong kei a dingin note tua bang lel na hi uh hi. Ka gimna teng nong mu uh a, na lau uh hi."},"22":{"text":"No kiangah, ‘Na khat peuhpeuh hong pia un, ka suahtak nadingin sum tawh hong huh un,"},"23":{"text":"ka galte’ kiang panin hong honkhia un, kei a hong nengniamte’ khutsung panin hong tankhia un,’ hong ci ngei zenzen ka hi hiam?"},"24":{"text":"“Hong hilh thei le-uhcin, pau loin ka ompah ding hi. Ka khialhna hong theitelsak dih un."},"25":{"text":"Lungsim takpi tawh thugennate heh loin kisang thei a, ahi zongin no hong taiina in bang phatuamsak ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Kamging mawkmawk lelte heh taak sa a, huih’ letmang cihmawh kamte thupi ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?"},"27":{"text":"Mi cimawh khat suksiatgawp sawm a, na lawm khat uh hihgawp sawm na hi uh hiam?"},"28":{"text":"Tu-in kong thum hi; kihei unla kei hong en un. Na maitang uhah zuau a gen dingin kilawm ka hi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Ngaihsun pha un, a kilawm lopi-in kei hong hih kei un. Ngaihsun pha un, ka hoihna teng a hong kize-et hi lel hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin zuau gen mahin nong ngaihsun lai veve uh a, a sia le a pha a khenthei loin nong seh lai veve uh hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Leitungah mihing in nasep haksa nei a, ama hun pen nasempa-a’ bang hi lo ahi hiam?","title":"Job in Pasian Seel"},"2":{"text":"Sila nasemte in niliim lunggulhin nasempa in a thaman a ngak tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"A mawkna-in kha tampi sung ka om a, zanthapai-in lungkhamna bek keima tanh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nitak ka lup ciangin, ‘Cik ciangin khua hong vakin zing ka tho tam,’ ka ci hi. Ahi zongin zan sau a, zingsang khuavak mateng ka kigawigawi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka pumpi tung khempeuhah than bekbek kidim a, ka vun tung khempeuh meima in tuamcip hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka hunte siamgante’ siam ciangtang sangin manlang zaw a, lametna om loin a mong tung pak hi."},"7":{"text":"“Pasian aw, ka nuntakna husan’ bang bek ahihna hong phawk in. Ka mit in hun nuam mukik ngei nawn lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei hong mu ngei pa in kei hong mukik nawn lo ding a, na hong et laitak mahin ka mangthang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Meiilum kaite bei-in a manthan bangin Leinuai a paisuk pa mangthang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama inn ah hong ciahkik nawn lo ding a, ama omna ngei mun in amah thei nawn lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin pau loin ka om kei ding hi. Ka lungkham manin kam ka pau ding a, ka gimluat manin ka phun ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Kei a hong cing ding na koih nadingin kei, tuipi ganhing hong sa na hi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Lum leng nuam ding a, ihmu leng phatuam ding hi, ci leng lah,"},"14":{"text":"a lauhuai mang nong mansak a, a lauhuai maangmuhna tawh nong lausak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih manin gui-awk ding ka utzaw a, hih bang ka thuak sangin ka si nuamzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka lungkham a, ka nungta nuam nawn kei hi. Ka nuntakna pen husan’ bang hi lel ahih manin hong hici omsak hoh in."},"17":{"text":"“Nang in hih zahin na thupi ngaihsut dingin na lungsimah na ngaihsut dingin","ref":"La 8:4; 144:3"},"18":{"text":"zingsang simin gim a pia dingin ama kiangah pai-in amah na ze-et themthum nadingin mihing bang hi lel ahi hiam?"},"19":{"text":"Tomkha sung beek hong pelh lo ding a, ka hu beek hong sangsak man lo ding na hi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Mihingte a encik pa aw, a khial ka hih leh zong nangma tungah bang gamta khial ka hi hiam? Bang hangin kei hong ngim a, bang hangin nangma muitum suak zenzen ka hi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Bang hangin ka khialhna hong maisak lo a, ka mawhna hong maisak lo na hi hiam? Tu-in han sungah ka lum ding a, nong zonzon hangin ka na om nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shuah gammi Bildad in dawng a,","title":"Bildad in Pasian Thuman hi, Ci"},"2":{"text":"“Tua bang thu bang tanvei gengen ding a, bang tanvei paupau ding na hi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Pasian in thutang a zanglo sa na hi hiam? Vanglianpa in thuman a zanglo sa na hi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Na tate ama tungah khial a, amau’ mawhnate amaute a tuaksak ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A hun lai-in Pasian zong inla, Vanglianpa’ hehpihna ding thuum lecin,"},"6":{"text":"nang dikin thutang kisa mahmah na hih leh pel loin amah in nang hong en ding a, na thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman hong pia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hileh, na zawn’ mahmah khit hangin a tawpna-ah na hau kik ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Khangluite’ thu kantel inla, pute pate’ tuahsa thute ngaihsun pha in."},"9":{"text":"Eite pen zan mah mi ihi a, bangmah i thei kei hi. Leitung a i nuntakna pen niliim bang lel ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong hilhin, a thu hong genin, amau’ phawksa thute hong gen ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"“Ciknawng om lohna-ah laiphai kung po thei ahi hiam? Tui om lohna-ah pumpeeng pung thei ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuate a pak kimlai a phuk hun nai lopi-in kungno dang khempeuh sangin keu masa zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian a mangngilhte tua bangmah ahi hi. Pasian a don lo mite’ lametna a bei ta ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama kimuanna maimom khau bang hi lel a, ama ki-upna maimom bu bang hi lel hi."},"15":{"text":"A inn tungah kingam a, a inn hoi hi. A inn lencip a, ahi zongin kip zo lo hi."},"16":{"text":"“Amah pen nitaang sungah hoihtakin a khang kungno, a huan sungah a dawn hilhhelh kungno ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin suangtum lakah a zung a kivialgawp, suangtawphah a phukha zung a suak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khatpeuh in a phung pan zungbawh a, ‘Cik mahin nang hong thei ngei peuhmah kei ing,’ ci-in a lawnkhia hi."},"19":{"text":"Hih bang danin ama nuntakna bei a, lei sung panin kung dangte hong pokhia hi."},"20":{"text":"“Theitel in; Pasian in cikmah hunin mawhbaang lo mite nilkhia lo ding a, gamtatsia mite huh ngei lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na mukah lungdam nuihna hong omsak ding a, na kam sungah lungdam a kikona hong omsak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nang hong mudahte in maizumna ngah ding uh a, migilote’ puanbuk maimang ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in Pasian dawng a,","title":"Job in Pasian A Dawn’ Theihlohna"},"2":{"text":"“Kuamah in Pasian a zawhzawh lohna a teltakin ka theita hi.","ref":"Job 4:17"},"3":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh Pasian tawh thu a kinial ding hileh tulkhat sungah khatvei nangawn dawng thei lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah pil mahmah a, vanglian mahmah hi. Kua in khauhtakin nial a, nial paisuakzo ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Pasian in mualte lingsak a, tawlngasak lo hi. Ama hehna tawh mualte a lumlet hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in leitung lokgawp a, a khuampite kiling hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in ni a suak lo dingin thu pia a, aksite sincip hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah bek in vanpi zal a, tuipi tuihualte tuancil hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah pen vana a om Khawlei-uikai, Zawlzawng, Seguk, le Khanglam aksite a bawlpa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 38:31; Amos 5:8"},"10":{"text":"Amah in kuama theih zawh loh na lian tampi bawl a, kuama simzawh loh nalamdang tampi sem hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ka kiangah amah hong pai a, ke’n amah ka mu thei kei hi. Amah gam tangtang napi-in, amah ka theithei kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in lakhia nuam leh a khaktanzo ding kua om ahi hiam? Bang hih na hi hiam, kua’n ci thei ding ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Pasian in ama hehna dokkik het lo mah ding hi. Rahab’ pawlte nangawn a khenuai-ah kun uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin keimah in bangci dawn theih ding a, amah ka nialna ding kammal bangci muh ding ka hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Kei ka dik hangin amah ka dawng thei kei hi. Kei hong mawhsak pa tungah hong hehpih ding ka nget kul hi."},"16":{"text":"Thukhen zumah amah samin hong pai hita mah leh zong ka thumna hong ngai dingin ka um tuan kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thu themno khat hangin nakpitakin kei hong hih a, thu om lopi-in gimna tampi hong thuaksak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka hu nangawn hong sangsak man lo a, lungkhamna tawh kei hong kidimsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Thatanghat thu ding hileh, amah hat mahmah a, thutang kituh hi leng, kua in thukhen zumah amah samzo ding ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Kei ka dik hangin keima kam mah siksanin kei hong man ding a, mawhbaang lo ka hih hangin keima kampau hong lehheisak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Paubaanna ka neih loh hangin kei a thupi-in ka kingaihsun tuan het kei a, ka nuntakna ka kih hi."},"22":{"text":"Thu khat bek om hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a paubaang lote le a gilote susia khawm hi, ka ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Lauhuai lianpi hong tung pakin sihna a om ciangin mawhbaang lote’ thumna a nuihsan lel hi."},"24":{"text":"Migilote’ khut sungah leitung kipia a, amah in thukhen mangte’ mit a tuncipsak hi - amah hikeileh kua hi ding ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"“Laitaite sangin ka hun nawhtai zaw a, beipak ahih manin nopna ngah kha lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Pumpeeng gunkuang bangin ka hun nawhpai a, muvanlai sa bawh bangin a nawhlen’ hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka dahnate kimangngilh bawlin kimaitaisak ding ci taleng zong,"},"28":{"text":"a dikin nong seh loh ding lamtak thei khin ka hih manin ka thuak ding thute hangin kei ka lau mahmah hi."},"29":{"text":"Kei a mawhin hong kiseh veve ding ahihleh bang hangin a mawkna-in na sem ding ka hi hiam?"},"30":{"text":"Satpiang tawh kei kisilin, vuttui tawh ka khut sawp taleng,"},"31":{"text":"buannawng sungah kei nong hencip veve ding a, ka puan ninte in a kihhuai hong suaksak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Amah ka dawn theih nadingin amah, kei bangin mi hi lo a, thukhen zumah thu kineihpih theih hi lo hi."},"33":{"text":"Ko tegel kikalah thu hong khen ding khat om thei hen la, ko tegel tungah aana hong zang ding khat om thei hileh,"},"34":{"text":"kei hong kisatna ciang hong paih khiatsak ding a, kei tungah lauhuaina lianpite hong om nawn lo ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin amah kihta hetloin ka pau ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kei’ omzia ding bangin kei ka om loh lamtak teltakin ka kithei hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka nuntakna ka cimtak mahmah ta hi. Ka dahna thu ka ut utin ka gen ding a, ka lungkham manin ka paupau ding hi.","title":"Ama Pianzia Hangin Job Thum"},"2":{"text":"Pasian kiangah hih bangin ka ci ding hi: Kei hong mawhsak kei in. Kei nong langpanna thu hong gen in."},"3":{"text":"Na khut tawh na sepsate simmawh bawlin, migilote’ vai panpihin, hih bangin nong netniamna ah bang phattuamna ngah na hi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Mihing bang lelin gamta na hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Na nuntak hun tan kote’ nuntak tan bang lelin ngaihsun na hi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Bang hangin ka mawhna hong sulzuihin, ka khialhna khempeuh hong kantel na hi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Ka mawh lohna na thei a, nang kiang panin kei hong hon ding a om lohna na theihsa mah ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nangma khut tawh kei hong lomin na hong piangsak a, tu-in nangma khut mah in kei hong lehsuksiat hi."},"9":{"text":"Leivui pana kei nong bawlna hong phawkkik in. Leivui mahin hong dengvui kik takpi ding na hi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Kei ka pian nadingin ka pa’ tungah tha na guan a, ka nu’ sungah kei nong khangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Guh le thaguite tawh ka pumpi ding nong bawl a, sazang le vun tawh tua guhte nong tuamsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei, nuntakna hong pia-in, nong it tawntung a, nangma hong kepna hangin kei ka nungta hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin a beisa hun sung khempeuhah kei a’ ding thusim khat na neihna tu-in ka theita hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka khialhkhaknate hong ensim niloh na hih manin ka mawhnate hong maisak nuam lo na hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka khialh phetin gim nong pia pah a, ka gamtat hoih ciangin zong nong pakta tuan kei hi. Mindaina le maizumna tawh kei ka kidim hi."},"16":{"text":"Mavanna khatpeuh neisun leng zong, humpinelkai bangin ka siatna ding na zong a, kei’ gimtheih nadingin nalamdang tuamtuam nangawn na bawl liang hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei a hong langpang dingin teci na nei tawntung a, keima tungah na hehna hong khang semsem a, kei nong sukna ding thuthak na mu tawntung hi."},"18":{"text":"“Pasian aw, bang hangin ka nu’ sung panin kei hong piangsak peuhmah na hi hiam? Kuama hong muh ma-in a si hizaw hoh leng!"},"19":{"text":"Ka nu’ sung pan hankhuk zuat pah ding pen mihing a pian loh zah mahin a hoih ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima nuntakna bei dektak ta hi lo ahi hiam? Hong hici omsak hoh in! Ka hun neih laisun teng nuam takin hong zangsak in."},"21":{"text":"Kei a pai baihta ding ka hi a, a hong ciahkik ngei ding ka hi kei hi - khuamial, lungzinna gam,"},"22":{"text":"khuavak nangawn khuamial ahihna gam, khuamial gam, lungzinna gam, lungkhamna gam, a zuan ta ding ka hi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naamah gammi Zofar in dawng a,","title":"Zofar in Job Mawhna Nei-in Ngawh"},"2":{"text":"“Kampau hih zahta hong kidawng lo ding sa a, kam tam pauna hangin thumanin hong kiseh dingin ngaihsun na hi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Job aw, na thugente hong dawng thei lo dingin hong ngaihsun na hi hiam? Na simmawh kampaute hong kidawng mawh dingin ngaihsun na hi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Nangma thugente a man na sa kha a, Pasian’ muhna-ah a siangtho dingin na kingaihsun kha hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian in na thugente hong dawngkik le ut mahmah ing!"},"6":{"text":"Pilna nam tampi a omna thu, mihing’ theih zawh loh thuthuk, a omna thu hong gen ding hi. Na mawhna zahin Pasian in gim hong piak lohna thei in."},"7":{"text":"“Pasian’ thuthuk thei khinzo ding na hi hiam? Vanglianpa’ hih theihna thei khinzo ding na hi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Vantung sangin Pasian sangzaw a, ahi zongin tua vantung nangawn na banzo kei hi. Pasian in leinuai thu thei a, ahi zongin nangmah in tua thu na thei kei hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian’ liatna pen leitung sangin golzaw a, tuipi sangin zaizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian in nang hong manin thu hong sit leh amah a khaktan ding kua om ahi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Pasian in mi hoih lote thei takpi hi. Mawhna a muh ciangin thudon lo ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Gamlak a om late mihing suak ngei ding a, mihaite pil ngei ding ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"“Job aw, na lungsim a hoihin bawl inla, Pasian’ lamah kihei in."},"14":{"text":"Khialhna na bawl khak leh paaikhia inla, na inn sungah gitlohna omsak kei in."},"15":{"text":"Tua hileh kisuanna om loin na khuadak ngam ding a, na lung nuamin launa na nei kei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na lungkhamnate veng ding a, tuikhang pak bangin na phawk nawn kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin na nuntakna, sun sangin taangzaw ding a, nuntak lungzin’ pen hun, sun sangin taangzaw ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungnuam tak le lametna nei-in na om ding a, Pasian in nang hong hu-in, tawldamna hong pia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Kuamah kihtak nei loin nuamtakin na om ding a, mi tampi in nangma maipha hong zong ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin migilote ahihleh cimawhin khuadak ding uh a, suahtakna ding lampi mu lo ding uh hi. Amau’ ngah ding ahihleh sihna bek ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Job in Pasian’ Vangliatna le Pasian’ Pilna Gen"},"2":{"text":"“Note pen theihna kicing na kisa mah uh a, pilna a nei na kisa mah uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin note zah mahin kei zong thu ka thei a, midangte sangin na theihzawk uh bang om tuan ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Ka lawmte nangawn in tu-in kei hong nuihsan uh a, kei dikin paubaang lo napi hong nuihsan uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in ka thungetna a hong piak hun om hi."},"5":{"text":"Note in lungkhamna bangmah na nei kei uh a, kei na hong ciamnuih bawl gawpgawp uh hi. A puk dektak mipa na satgawp uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Guta mite nuamtakin om hithiat uh a, Pasian a simmawhte nuamtakin nungta uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ahi zongin gamsate va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi. Vasate va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Leitung ganhingte va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi. Tui sung ngasate zong va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian’ khut in amaute a bawlna thu a vekpi-un thei kim uh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"A piansaksate’ nuntakna Pasian mah in a uk ahi hi. Mihing khempeuhte’ nuntakna ama khut sungah om hi."},"11":{"text":"Leii in an a ciap mah bangin, bil in ngai thei hi lo ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"“Khanghamte in pilna nei a, nuntak saute in thu theitel uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian in pilna le vang nei a, amah thukipin thu a theitel hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian in phelkek leh kuamah in lamkik zo lo a, Pasian in thongah mi koih leh kuamah in suaktasak zo lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Pasian in guah khaktan leh leitung keugaw a, tui a khah ciangin tui hong khang hi."},"16":{"text":"“Pasian thahatin gualzo tawntung a, mi khemte le khemna a thuakte Pasian’ ukna nuai-ah a om uh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in mipilte’ pilna susia-in, makaite pen mihai bangin gamtasak hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in kumpite zakiasak a, thongah a khia hi."},"19":{"text":"Siampite mihai suaksak a, mi vangliante lawnthal hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in mi’ muante a pau thei loin bawl a, khanghamte’ pilna a paihkhiatsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in mi vangliante mindaisak a, mi thupite’ kihihsakna a beisak hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in khuamial sung panin thuthukte kalkhia a, a kithei zo lo thute kitelsak hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in minamte thahatsakin liansak a, ahi zongin amah in tuate zogawpin susia hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in minam makaite a pilna uh paihkhiatsak a, lampi om lohna gamlakah vakvaisak hi."},"25":{"text":"Khuamial lakah amaute in mialzawt uh a, zukham bangin amaute hoihoi uh hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na gen uh thu khempeuh ka muhsa vive hi a, ka bil-in ka zakzaksa, ka theihtheihsa thu ahi hi.","title":"Job in Ama Hoihna Gen"},"2":{"text":"Note’ theih khempeuh, kei zong ka thei hi. Note khempeuh sangin ka neuzaw tuan het kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin note tawh kam a kinial hi loin, Pasian tawh a kinial ka hi hi. Pasian tawh hih ka thu ka kinial nuam hi."},"4":{"text":"Note in na haina uh zuauthu tawh na melh uh a, kuamah a damsak zo lo zato siam-a kinei mite tawh na kibang uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Pau hetloin om hi le-uhcin, mipil mah hong kisazaw ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tu-in ka thugen hong ngai unla, ka gen laitakin limtak ngai un."},"7":{"text":"Pasian’ min dingin thuman lo genin, ama a dingin zuauthu gensak ding na hi uh hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Pasian angvan ding a, ama a’ ding gensak ding na hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Pasian in limtakin note hong entel leh note’ sungah hoihna mu ding ahi hiam? Mihingte na khem bangun Pasian a khem thei dingin kingaihsun na hi uh hiam?"},"10":{"text":"A simthamin angvanna na zat uhleh amah in note hong taii taktak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama vangliatna in note hong lausak ding a, note tungah amah kihtakna hong tung ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Na thugente uh vutkhu bang hi lel a, na siksante uh leivui bang hi lel hi."},"13":{"text":"Pau kei unla, kei, thu hong gensak dih un; a piang peuhpeuh a piang hi mai hen."},"14":{"text":"“Ka nuntakna pia ngamin, ka nuntakna ka ap ngam hi."},"15":{"text":"Pasian in kei hong that mah taleh zong, phamawh ka sa kei hi. Ahi zongin ama mai-ah ka thu ka gen veve ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian’ mai-ah migilote pai ngam lo uh ahih manin, ka hanna pen ka gualzawhna hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka thugente limtak ngai unla, ka lahtelnate na za un."},"18":{"text":"Ka thu a gen dingin a baihsa-in ka om a, thu ka zawh ding lamtak teltakin ka thei hi."},"19":{"text":"“Pasian aw, keimah hong mawhsak ding na hi hiam? Nong mawhsak leh pau hetloin a si dingin ka kiging hi."},"20":{"text":"Thu nih ka hong ngen hi, ka hong nget hong pia in. Tua ciangin nang tungah bangmah kong im kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei tungah gim hong pia nawn kei inla, hih bang launa hong thuaksak nawn kei in."},"22":{"text":"Pasian aw, hong hopih masa in, kong dawng ding hi. Kei, thu hong gensak inla, nangmah in hong dawng in."},"23":{"text":"Ka mawhna ka khialhna bangzah pha ahi hiam? Ka mawh ka khialhna teng hong theisak in."},"24":{"text":"“Bang hangin kei hong peel a, gal bangin hong ngaihsun na hi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Bang hangin keimah lausak ding hanciam na hi hiam? Kei, singteh bang lel hi lo ka hi hiam? Anvai themkhat galin do ding na hi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"“Nangmah in kei tungah thusiapi nong zong a, ka neulai huna ka gamtatna nangawn tawh nong mawhsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Nangmah in ka khe sikkol nong bulh a, ka kalsuanna khempeuh le ka khekhap nangawn na entel hi.","ref":"Job 33:11"},"28":{"text":"Tua huhau-in singmuat bangin ka puk a, nget in a nek puan bangin ka zan-gawp hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mihingte a nuntak hun tom mahmah a, lungkhamna tawh kidim hi.","title":"Job in Nuntak Tomno Thu Lungngaingai"},"2":{"text":"Amaute paak bangin khangin keu pak uh a, niliim bangin pai hanhanin, mangthang uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian aw, tua bang lel mi kei hong en a, thukhenna a thuak dingin na mai-ah hong sam na hi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Mihing banga a ninte sung panin a siang hong piang lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A nuntak tan ding kisehkhol a, a nuntak kha phazah ding kiciangtan khin hi. Nangmah in na ciangtan khin a, kikheel thei nawn lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah en loin tuaci omsak mai inla, a nuntak haksapi mah zomzomsak hoh in."},"7":{"text":"“A kiphuk khinsa singkung nangawn in lametna nei buang a, a bul sel kikin nungtakik thei hi."},"8":{"text":"Lei sungah a zungte teek a, a bulsum a si zongin,"},"9":{"text":"guahtui ngahin, singkungno-in hong selkik hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi si a, amah maimang pah hi. Amah a beina tungta a, koi-ah om nawn ahi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"“Gun tuite le tuipi tuite a kan’ hun om thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin vanpi a omlaiteng, misite thokik ngei lo ding a, a ihmutna panun khanglo ngei lo, gamtang ngei lo ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"“Hih gimna tawh ka kipelh theih nadingin nong phawk loh nading mun misite’ gam sungah kei hong busak in. Mi a si khinsate hingkik thei lo ahih manin a hingin hong omsak peuh lecin tua lai-ah ka ut hi. Na hehna a dam ciangin hong phawkkik peuh lecin tua lai-ah ka ngak nuam hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin kei na hong sam ding a, ke’n kong dawng ding hi. Nangma bawlsa ahi keimah na hong lunggulh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin ka kalsuanna khempeuh nong en ding a, ahi zongin ka khialhnate nong sulzuih nawn kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka khialhnate hong maisakin, nong paihkhiatsak ding a, ka mawhna khempeuh nong phiatkhiatsak ding hi. Tu-a bangin a piang thei hileh ka ut mahmah hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ahi zongin a taktakin, mualte a puk ding hun suangkeente nangawn a cip ding hun hong tung ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tui in suangte nawtkhia-in, guahtui in lei a nawtkhiat bangin nangmah in mihingte’ lametna na beisak hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah in mi khat zogawpin na hawlkhia a, na sa mahmah ahih manin a si dingin a ha a li hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah a pahtawi dingin a tapate hong pai taleh zong amah gimlua ahih manin bangmah phawkzo nawn lo a, a tapate mindai taleh zong bangmah phawkzo nawn lo hi."},"22":{"text":"A pumpi sunga a natnate le a lungsim gimnate bek a phawkzo lai hi,” a ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Teman khuami Elifaz in Job dawng a,","title":"Elifaz in Job Tai"},"2":{"text":"“Job aw, mawk paupau kei in! Nang’ pau bangin mipilte pau ngei lo a,"},"3":{"text":"bangmah-a kimang lo kampaute pau lo a, phattuamna om lo dingpi-in thu seello uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin nangmah in Pasian zahtakna na beisak a, ama mai-ah thugenna ding na khaktan hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in na mawhna thu na kam pan hong gingkhia a, ngian zangin na kampau tawh na mawhna na seel hi."},"6":{"text":"Na mawhna thu kei’ hong gen kisam lo a, na pauna khempeuh in na mawhna hong langsakta hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mihing a a piang lakah a masa pen kisa na hi hiam? Pasian in mualte a bawl lai-in a piang khin kisa na hi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Pasian’ vaihawmnate a za simin kingaihsun na hiam? Nang bek in pilna khempeuh a nei-in kingaihsun na hi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Ko’ theih loh thu bang thei tuan na hi hiam? Ko’ muh loh thu bang mu tuan na hi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Na pa’ pianma a a piang puteek samkangte’ tung panin kote in ka pilnate uh a ngah ka hi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Pasian in nang hong hehnem hi; bang hangin nialnial na hi hiam? Kam khum kam nem tawh Pasian’ tangin nang tungah thu kong gen uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin na lung khauhin kote nong heh et hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah a heh na hi a, amah a simmawh na hi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mihing a a piang peuhmah paubaang hetloin siangtho taktak zo ding ahi hiam? Pasian’ tungah a thumanzo kua om ding ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Pasian in a siangtho vantung mite nangawn muang lo ahihleh, ei mawhnei mite bang hangin hong muang mah ding ahi hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Mihing in tui i dawn bangin siatna i dawndawn a, mihing pen siahuai-in bangmah i man kei hi.","ref":"Job 25:4-6"},"17":{"text":"“Job aw, ka thutheihte na ngai in."},"18":{"text":"Amaute tung bekah gam kipia ahih manin, amaute a pialkhiatpih ding gamdang mi tawh a kihel lo, a pu a pate un bangmah im loin thu a hilh suksuk uh mipilte’ thugente kong gen ding hi. Tua a gen uh thute in:","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"“Mi a nengniam migilo pa in a khan tawntungin lungkhamna thuak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Launa ding awging a bilah za ngitnget ding a, lungmuangin a om laitakin gutate in buluh ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Lungzinna pan suahtakna ding lametna om lo a, amah a that dingin mun khatah namsau in ngak khinkhian a,"},"23":{"text":"amah a ne dingin musanete in a ngak uh hi. A mailam thu lungzinhuai ahihna thei hi."},"24":{"text":"A thahat kumpi khat bangin lungkhamna le lungzinna in amah a hihgawp dingin a ngak khikhe hi."},"25":{"text":"“Pasian langpangin a khuttum a lahsan, Vanglianpa a dem mipa in hih bang thute a thuak hi."},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in khauhtakin Pasian langpangin, a lum sahpi tawh a lehdo hi."},"27":{"text":"“A thatang muanhuai-in a pumpi a liat hangin"},"28":{"text":"ama tenna khuapi sia-in, ama inn kinusia ding a, a sawt loin ninbulomtang suak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah sauvei hau lo ding a, a neihsate kip lo ding hi. Ama liim nangawn maimang ding a,"},"30":{"text":"khuamial panin suakta lo ding hi. Amah pen a hiangte mei in a kattumsak, a paakte huih in a letkhiatsak, singkung tawh kibang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in gitlohna suanin nei ahih manin, gitlohna bek mah ngahkik ding hi."},"32":{"text":"A hun a tun ma-in amah bei ding a, singhiang bangin keu-in hingkik nawn lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"A min ma-in a gahte a pulh leenggui bang ding a, a paakte a pulhmang khin oliv kung bang ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian a ngaihsun lote mi cimang suak a, sumgolh tawh a kilam innte mei in kangtum hi."},"35":{"text":"Mihingte in siatna ding bek ngaihsunin sem uh a, mi khem ding bekbek ngaihsun niloh uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Pasian’ Bawlna hangin Job Phun"},"2":{"text":"“Tua bang thute ka zaza khin a, no’ hehnepna pen gimna ding bek ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Khawl hun nei loin gengen lai ding na hi uh hiam? Na gen ding uh omom lai ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Note le keimah a kikhek thei hi lehang, note’ gen khempeuh kei zong ka gen thei ding hi. Note ka lu hong peisanin thu tampi tak mah ka hong gen thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin keimah in note hong tua cih loin, thuhoih mahmah tawh note hong hehnemin, note hehnepna ding thu ka gen ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Thu gengen taleng ka natna nuamtuam lo a, pau kei taleng zong, phatuam tuan lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian aw, kei nong paatsak ngingei a, ka innkuan khempeuh na sisakmang khin hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei na hong mancip a, keima gal na suak hi. Ka vun guak le ka guh guak bekin ka om a, keima mawhna a kilatna-in mite in a ngaihsun uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Pasian in a hehna tawh hong balnen ngingei a, a ha hong gawisanin hong heh et hi."},"10":{"text":"Mite in kei hong zahko uh a, ka paang a beeng dingin hong kikhawmtuah uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in migilote’ khut sungah kei hong pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei nuamtakin a om kimlai, Pasian in ka gawlin hong manin, hong balgawpin hong sugawp hi. Pasian in a muitum dingin kei hong suang a,"},"13":{"text":"ka kimkot panin a thaltangte tawh hong kap hi. Tua thaltangte in kei hong kha-in hong liamsak a, tua bang nangawnah kei hong hehpih lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in hong hehpih hetloin kei hong liamsak thuahthuah a, galkap a heh pa bangin kei hong hihgawp hi."},"15":{"text":"“Kei thumin puanhampi ka silh a, guallelin leivui lakah ka om hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka kahkahna-in ka mai khempeuh san gawp a, ka mitkhute bawkgawpin khua ka mu thei kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin ngongtatna themkhat zong ka zang kei a, Pasian tungah ka thungetna pen lungsim takpi tawh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"“Leitung aw, a man loin kei hong kibawlna seelcip kei in! Thuman deihin ka kikona ka awging daicipsak kei in."},"19":{"text":"Kei a dingin a ding ding, a hong panpih ding mi khat vantungah om hi.","ref":"Job 19:25"},"20":{"text":"Pasian in ka khitui luanna hong mu-in ka thungetna hong za leh ka ut hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khat in a lawmpa a’ ding a thumsak mah bangin mi khatpeuh in Pasian’ kiangah kei a dingin hong thuumsak leh ka ut hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hun nai mahmah ta a, ka lehzuih nawn loh ding lampi zui-in a pai ka hita hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka bei ding hun nai kuan ta a, hu ka sangzo nawn kei hi. Kei a dingin hankhuk cih loh bangmah dang om nawn lo hi."},"2":{"text":"Ka heina khempeuhah mite in hong zahko uh a, amau’ hong phinna in hong lungzingsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian aw, kei hong hu in. Ka thugente hong panpih ding kuamah dang om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah in amaute thuman a mu lo dingin bawl na hih manin amaute a gualzo-in na bawl kei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Paunak-ah, sum ngahnop manin mi khat in a lawmte a heek leh, ama tate in tua gitlohna thaman thuak hi, kici hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in amaute in kei tungah hih paunak hong bulh uh a, mite in hih thu za-in kei hong cilphih uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka dahna hangin ka mit mial a, ka khut ka khete ciangkang bang ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihoihin a kineite in lamdang hong sa uh a, migiloin kei hong seh uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Mite’ zahtaka a kinei mite in amau’ ngaihsutna uh man mahmah sa semsem uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute khempeuh hong pai-in ka mai-ah hong ding le-uh amaute’ lakah mipil khat zong ka mu kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ka hun beita hi. Ka geelna teng maimang a, ka lametna teng beita hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka lawmte in, khuamial kimlai, sun khuavak, ci uh hi. Khuavak hong nai ta hi, ci-in gen uh a, ahi zongin khuamial sung mahah kei ka omlai veve hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei’ lamet ding misite’ gam bek omlai a, tua khuamial sungah lumin ka ihmu ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hankhuk sung pen ka pa hi, ka ci ding a, kei hong ne thante pen ka nu le ka sanggam numeite, ka ci ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei’ lamet ding tua lai-ah bang om ahi hiam? Tua lai-ah ka lamet ding bang nong muhsak uh hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Misite’ gam Leinuai-ah ka pai ciangin nopsakna in kei hong zui lo ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shuah gammi Bildad in dawng a,","title":"Bildad in Migilote’ Thuak Dingte Gen"},"2":{"text":"“Job aw, khawl hun nei thei lo ding na hi hiam? Hong khawl phot lecin, thu kong gen thei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hangin bawng bang lelin kote hong ngaihsun a, mihaipi-in kote hong seh na hi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Na hehna tawh nangmah a kigimsak bek na hi hi. Nangma hangin leitung kinusia ding a, mualte a kinkhia dingin ngaihsun na hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"“Migilo pa’ meivak kisumit ding a, cikmah hunin kuangkik nawn lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama buk sungah a meivak mit ding a, ama inn sungah khua a mial ding hi.","ref":"Job 21:17"},"7":{"text":"A khe kip ngei a, ahi zongin tu-in a khe bai ta hi. Amah in a ngaihsut khialhna a puklawh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thangsiahna ngen sungah amah bungbu tuk a, gum sungah amah kia hi."},"9":{"text":"Thangah a khetulin awk a, thangkhau in amah gakcip hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah siahna-in leilakah khauzak kitung a, a pai nading lampi-ah thang kisiah hi."},"11":{"text":"Lauhuaina in amah pang a, a kalsuanna khempeuh a sulzuih hi."},"12":{"text":"A hauh ngei hangin tu-in gilkial ta a, siatna in a su dingin amah ngak gige hi."},"13":{"text":"A kihtakhuai natna in a pum khempeuh tuam a, a khut le a khete muatsakmang khinta hi."},"14":{"text":"Lungmuang takin a omna a inn panin amah kikaikhia a, Sihna Kumpipa kiangah amah kitunpih hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin zatui tawh ama inn a kisiansuah khit ciangin tua inn-ah a ut peuhpeuh teng thei pah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Lei sunga ama zungte keu-in, a tunga a hiangte a si ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Inn le gamah ama minthanna beita a, kuamah in amah phawkkha nawn lo hi."},"18":{"text":"A nungtate’ gam panin amah kihawlkhia ding a, khuavakna mun panin khuamialna-ah kihawlkhia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in suanlekhak nei lo a, ama tennasa munah ama gui a zom ding om lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Nisuahna pan nitumna dong ama thuakna a za peuhmah kigaihin a ling uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Migilote, Pasian a ngaihsun lote a thutawpna uh tu-a bang ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Pasian in Hong Diksak ding ci-in Job in a Upna"},"2":{"text":"“Bang tanvei thu genin hong gimsak ding na hi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Kei nong simmawh niloh a, tua banga na gamtatna-ah maizumna mel na nei thei kei hi."},"4":{"text":"A khial takpi hi taleng zong nang’ lainatna ding bang om ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Keimah sangin a hoihzaw-in nang na kingaihsun a, ka thuak gimnate pen keima mawhna hangin na ngaihsun hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih thu hong piangsak pa Pasian ahihlam mu thei lo na hi hiam? Kei hong mat nadingin amah in thang hong siah hi."},"7":{"text":"Keimah hong ngongbawlna ka nialnial hangin kuamah in hong don kei hi. Thuman ka deih hangin hong kipia kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian in ka lampi khaktan a, ka paisuakzo kei hi. Amah in ka pai nading lampi khua mialcipsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in ka hauhna khempeuh hong lakkhiatsak a, ka min hoih kimlai hong siasak hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in ka pumpi khempeuh hong satgawp hi. Ka nopsakna teng hong zunglot sakin, vulgawpin a si dingin kei a hong nusia hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima tungah Pasian’ hehna hong sogawp a, ama gal lian penin kei a hong ngaihsun hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in keimah a sim dingin a galkapte hong sawl a, a galkapte in dum to-in ka buk hong umcih uh hi."},"13":{"text":"“Pasian in ka sanggamte hong taisansak a, kei hong theisate kiangah khualmi ka suak hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka behte le ka lawmte beimang khinta uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka inn-ah a hong tung ngei keima zinte in hong mangngilh ta a, ka na a sem numeite in khualmi bangin hong bawl uh a, amaute’ mai-ah midangpi khat ka suak hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka nasemte khatpeuh ka sap ciangin hong dawng nuam lo uh a, hong huhna ding uh ka thum ciang nangawnin hong thudon lo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka zi nangawn in ka gimnam thuak zo lo a, ka sanggamte mahmah in zong hong naih nuam lo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Naupang melmawl nangawn in kei hong simmawh uh a, kei hong muh uh ciangin hong nuihsan uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka lawm it pente nangawn in kei hong muhdah et uh a, ka it pente nangawn in kei hong langbawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka guh tungah ka vun kol dihdiahin om a, a nungta liailiai bekin kei a om ka hi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hong hehpih un! Hong hehpih un! Keima lawmte hi lo na hi uh hiam? Pasian in kei hong satpai ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasian’ hong bawlsiat bangin bang hangin no zong kei hong bawlsia ding na hi uh hiam? Nong gimsakna uh kicing ta hoh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"“Ka thugente khempeuh mi khatpeuh in ciamteh hen la, laibu khat sungah a khum hileh ut mahmah ing!"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih kei leh zong, ka thugente khempeuh sikkhu khat tawh suang tungah kikhen hen la, a mang ngei nawn lo dingin a kigelh hileh ut ing!"},"25":{"text":"“Ahi zongin a tawpna-ah kei hong panpih ding a nungta tawntung khat vantungah a omna thu ka thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Natna in ka vun a nektum khit hangin, hih ka pumpi mahmah tawh Pasian ka mu ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima mit teekteek tawh amah ka mu ding a, amah in kei hong khualmi et lo ding hi. “Ka lungsim hanna a bei hi."},"28":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh, ‘Amah bangci gimsak thei ding ihi hiam?’ na ci uh hi. Kei nong suktheih nadingun paulap khatpeuh na zong uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in namsau kihta un. Tua namsau in a mawhte tungah Pasian’ hehna hong sem ding hi. Tua ciangin thukhen ding khat a omlam na thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naamah gammi Zofar in dawng a,","title":"Zofar in Migilote’ Tuahtheih Thute Gen"},"2":{"text":"“Job aw, ka heh nong suaksak a, ka ki-ipzo nawn kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Na thugente khempeuh kei nong simmawhna kampau vive hi a, ahi zongin kong dawnna ding ka thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tanglai pek a kipan, leitung mi a om cil a kipanin,"},"5":{"text":"migilote’ nopsak hun a tom mahmahna thu, Pasian a don lote’ lungdam hun a tom mahmahna thu thei lo na hi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Migilo pa lian mahmahin vantung a banto zongin, lian mahmahin a lutang in meii lak a banto zongin,"},"7":{"text":"leivui them bangin maimang veve lel ding hi. Amah a thei ngei mite in, ‘Amah koi-ah omta ahi hiam?’ ci-in lamdangsa ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah pen zan a mangmat bang, mumaang bangin maimang ding a, cikmah hunin kimukik ngei nawn lo ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama tenna ngei mun panin amah maimang ding a,"},"10":{"text":"mizawngte’ na a suhsakte, a tate in lohsak ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A pumpi moi suahin a thatang a hat mahmah hangin a sawt loin leivui a suakpak ding ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ama kam sungah gitlohna lim sa mahmahin, namtui mahmah sa-in, a leii tawh lop melmel a,"},"13":{"text":"amah in muammuam nuamin siakhia nuam lo a, lim sa mahmahin a dangtawng denna-in a neih hangin,"},"14":{"text":"a gil sung a tun ciangin a kha mahmah an suakin, gu a kha mahmahte zahin kha deidai hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilo pa in a guksa nate luakhia kik a, a gil sung nangawn panin Pasian in a lakkhiatsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilo pa’ nekte pen gu tawh kibang a, gul guneite’ tuk bangin amah a sisak hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in bawngnawi le khuaizu gun tui bangin a luang mukha lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in a nasep thamante nusia ding a, a hauhna khempeuh zangkha man lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in mizawngte bawlsia-in don lo a, midangte’ inn lamsate sutin a tang hi."},"20":{"text":"“A huaihamna bei ngei lo a, a duh khempeuh siit nei lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in a nek ciangin a khamval cih om ngei lo a, tu-in a hauhna khempeuh a beimang khinta ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A cihtheih pen hun laitakin lungkhamna lianpen a tuak hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in a duhduh ne mai hen! Pasian in hehna tawh amah gim pia ngawn ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in namsau pelhin a taina-ah sumngo thal in kaptuk ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thaltang khat in ama pumpi pailet a, a te-dildel thaltang mukah si taak keuhkeuh a, ama tungah a kihtakhuai hong tung hi."},"26":{"text":"A kholsa khempeuh kisusia a, mihing’ tawh loh meikuang in amah le a innkuan khempeuh a kangtum hi."},"27":{"text":"Vantungte in hih mipa’ mawhna pholak uh a, leitung in ama langah teci a pang hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasian’ hehna hangin ama hauhna khempeuh a kisusiamang ding ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Migilote’ ngah dingin Pasian in a piak gimna migilote’ ngah pen tu-a bang ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Job in Migilote’ Mawk Daupaina Gen"},"2":{"text":"“Ka thugente limtakin hong ngai unla, ka thu nong ngaihna uh nong hehnepna uh hisak ni."},"3":{"text":"Thu ka gen theih nading hun hong pia unla, ka gen khit ciangin na ut uhleh hong zahpih un."},"4":{"text":"“Kei’ kitotpih pen mihing hi lo hi. Bang hangin lungtom lo ding ka hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Kei hong en dih un. Lamdangsak taak hi lo ka hi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Keima tunga thupiang ka ngaihsut ciangin lamdangsa mahmahin lau-in ka ling hi."},"7":{"text":"“Bang hangin Pasian in migilote khantosak a, hausakin liansak ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"A tate uh nuamtakin a khantohna, a u a nau, a suan a khakte uh a punna a mu ding dongin a nungta uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian in amaute’ inn sungah lungkhamna tungsak lo a, amaute in lauhuaina thuakkha ngei lo uh hi."},"10":{"text":"A bawngte uh pung a, tatolh cih om ngei lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuuno bangin a naupangte uh taikhia-in kimawl uh a,"},"12":{"text":"tamngai le harp lasakna aw tawh a kituakin a lam uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute a nuntak sungin cithei mahmah uh a, gentheihna tuak se loin nuamtakin a si hiat uh hi."},"14":{"text":"“Migilote in Pasian nawlkhin uh a, Pasian in amau’ nuntak ding a deihsakte thei nuam lo uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Pasian’ na sep ding kisam sa se lo uh a, Pasian kianga thunget phattuamna om kei, ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amau’ thahatna hang bek tawh a gina kisa uh a, amau’ ngaihsutna le kei’ ngaihsutna kigamla hi."},"17":{"text":"“Migilo pa’ meivak kisukmitsak ngei ahi hiam? Amaute khat beek in lungkhamna tuak ngei ahi uh hiam? Pasian in hehna tawh migilote gim pia ngei ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Huih in a letkhiat buhkungte, le huihpi in a mutkhiat buhsi bangin amaute bawl ngei ahi hiam?"},"19":{"text":"“Pasian in a pa’ khialhna hangin a ta gim pia hi, na ci uh hi. Tua bang hi lo! Pasian in a mawhte teek mah gim pia hen la, amau’ mawhna hangin gim pia ahihna theisak hen."},"20":{"text":"Mawhneite amau’ mawhna hangin gimna thuaksak hen la, Vanglianpa’ hehna theisak tahen."},"21":{"text":"Mi khat a nuntakna a bei khit ciangin, a naupangte’ nopsakna phawk thei nawn ahi hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Mi khat in Pasian’ tungah thu hilh thei ding ahi hiam? Vanglianpa tungah thu khen thei ding ahi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"“Mi pawlkhatte a cithei mahmahin si a, lungmuang tak le lungnuam takin om uh a,"},"24":{"text":"annek tuidawn a kicingin a nei uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte ahihleh nopsak cih theikha ngei loin lunggimin a si uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin a kibangin a vekpi-in si-in kivui a, than in amaute tuamcip hi."},"27":{"text":"“Na lungsim sung uhah na ngaihsutna uh, kei nong siatsak nopnate uh ka tel mahmah hi."},"28":{"text":"Siatna a gamta, mi lianpa’ inn, koi-ah omta ahi hiam, na ci uh hi."},"29":{"text":"“Khualzinzin mite tawh kiho ngei lo na hi uh hiam? Amaute’ thugente, thei lo na hi uh hiam?"},"30":{"text":"Pasian hehin, mite gim a piak ciangin migilote peng tawntung zawsop hi."},"31":{"text":"Migilo pa a gamtatna bangin a thukkik ding, migilo pa mawhsakin a langpang ding kuamah om lo hi."},"32":{"text":"Migilo pa a kivui ciangin a hankhuk kicing a,"},"33":{"text":"mi tul tampi in amah kha-in hoihtakin lei tawh kivuk hi."},"34":{"text":"“Tu-in note in a mawknapi tawh hehnep nong sawm uh hi. Na gen uh thu khempeuh zuauthu vive hi lel hi,” a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Teman khuami Elifaz in dawng a,","title":"Elifaz in Job Migilo Mahmah, ci-in Mawhsak"},"2":{"text":"“Mipil pente i cih nangawn, ama a’ ding cih lohbuang, Pasian a dingin a kimanna om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Na gamtat hoihna in Pasian’ phattuamna ding bangmah piangsak lo a, na hoihna in Pasian hoihsak tuan lo hi.","ref":"Job 35:6-8"},"4":{"text":"Nangmah in Pasian na zahtakna hangin amah in nang hong taii-in hong ze-et hi lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Na mawhna a tamna hang, na gitlohna a liatna hang hizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sanggampa’ leiba tangin a silh ding sitsak loin a puan teng na laksak hi."},"7":{"text":"A dangtakte tui na pia nuam kei a, a gilkialte an na pia nuam kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Na vangliatna le na za liatna zangin, gam khempeuh na la khin hi."},"9":{"text":"Meigongte a huh nuam lo ciang bek hi loin, mi tagahte bawlsia-in a neihsa uh na sut hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih manin na kimkotah thang hong kisiah a, thakhatthu-in launa in nang hong buaisak hi."},"11":{"text":"Khuavak kimlai khuamial hong suak vatin khua na mu thei kei a, tuikhang in nang hong tuumcip hi."},"12":{"text":"“Van a sangpen dawnah Pasian a om hi a, a sang mahmah a om aksite hong suk et lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin nangmah in, ‘Pasian in bang thei ding ahi hiam? Meii in Pasian tuamcip hi. Eite’ thu bangci-in khenthei ding ahi hiam?’ na ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Van khumzangah Pasian a paikawmin meii pailetin Pasian in hong musuk thei lo ding hi, ci-in na ngaihsun hi."},"15":{"text":"“Migilote’ gamtat ngeite mah gamtat ding ngaihsun na hi hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Amau’ hun tung lopi-in tuikhang in amaute taai hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih mite pen Pasian a nial, Pasian in bangmah a cih thei lo dingin a ki-um mite ahi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hitaseleh amaute a daupaisak Pasian hi a, migilote’ ngaihsutna pen keima ngaihsutna tawh kigamla mahmah hi."},"19":{"text":"Migilote tungah gim kipia a muh uh ciangin mihoihte nuam a, paubaanna a nei lo mite in a nuihsan uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote’ neih khempeuh kisuksiatsak gawp a, a omlai sunte nangawn mei in a kangtum hi."},"21":{"text":"“Job aw, tu-in Pasian tawh kilem inla, amah galbawl nawn kei in. Tua hileh amah in nang thupha hong pia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama hong hilhnate zui inla, ama thute ciamteh in."},"23":{"text":"Lungsim tak tawh Vanglianpa lamah kihei inla, na innsung pan gamtatsia beisak inla,"},"24":{"text":"na kham neihte leivui bang lelin ngaihsunin, na Ofir khamte suang bang lelin ngaihsunin,"},"25":{"text":"Vanglian Pasian pen na kham le na ngun hisak lecin,"},"26":{"text":"Pasian muanin na nei tawntung ding a, na lungdamna bulpi amah ahihlam na thei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Thu na nget ciangin na ngetna hong pia ding a, nangma thuciamnate na tungsak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Na hih khempeuh na tangtun ding a, na maa hong vang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian in mi kiphasakte niamkhiat a, mi niamte a hon hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang a mawhbaang lo, a gamtat man na hih nakleh nang hong hon ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Pasian’ Mai-ah Job in A Thu Gen Nuam"},"2":{"text":"“Tu laitakin Pasian’ tungah a phun lo, a heh loin ka om thei kei a, thum loin ka om thei kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah ka zon dan ding thei-in, ama kiang ka tunna ding zia a thei hi leng,"},"4":{"text":"a mai-ah ka thu ka gen ding a, kei ka dikna thu a kicingin ka gen ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama hong gen ding thute le kei a hong dawnna ding thute ka thei nuam hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in a thaneih khempeuh tawh keima langkhatah hong pang ding ahi hiam? Hong langpan lo ding a, ka thugen hong ngai ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei a thuman ka hi a, Pasian kiangah ka gen ding hi. Kuama phelzawh nawn loh dingin kei’ dikna a genkhia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ahi zongin Nisuahna lam ka zong a, Pasian ka mu kei hi. Nitumna lam ka zong a, amah ka mu thei tuan kei hi."},"9":{"text":"Leilu lam ka zon hangin amah ka mu thei kei a, Leitaw lam ka zon hangin zong amah ka mu thei tuan kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in ka kalsuanna khempeuh thei a, kei hong ze-et leh ka sianthona a mu ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama hong lamlahna citakin ka zui cinten a, lam ka pial ngei kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasian’ thupiakna bangin ka gamta ngitnget a, keima utna zui loin ama deihna ka zui hi."},"13":{"text":"“Amah kikheel ngei lo a, kuamah in amah nial zo lo hi. Ama hih nopte kuamah in khaktan zo lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kei a dingin a geelsate tungsak ding hi. Amah in hih bangin geelna tampi tak a nei ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hi a, ama omna-ah kei ka lau mahmah a, ka ngaihsut khak ciangin amah ka kihta hi."},"16":{"text":"Vanglian Pasian in ka lungsim hanna hong mangsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuamial in ka mit a mialsak hangin keima kihtak pen khuamial hi lo a, Pasian ahi hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Pasian in bang hangin a thukhen ni ding seh lo a, ama nasemte thutang ahihna a lah ni ding seh lo ahi hiam?","title":"Pasian in Gitlohnate A Thudon Lohna Hangin Job Phun"},"2":{"text":"“Mihingte in leitang zaipi a ngah theih nadingun gisuangte khinsim uh a, tuute gu-in amau’ tuuhonte tawh khawi khawm uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi tagahte’ la neihsunte guksak uh a, meigong numei in a leiba a loh khit dong a bawngtal a matsak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mizawngte’ ngah theih dingte khaktan uh a, mizawngte notkhia ahih manun amaute lau-in a bucip uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin gamlak a om la bangin gam keu sungah a an ding uh zongtawm uh a, a tate uh an ding koimahah mu zo lo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Midangte’ lo sungah anlak na sem uh a, migilote’ leenggui lo-ah leenggah loin a om uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Zanin puan silhloin lum uh a, khuadampi lakah silh ding nei loin om uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mualtung gam panin a hong zu guahtui in amaute kawtciimsak a, suangpi pang peuh beelin a toncip uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Migilote in pa nei nawn lo naupangte sila-in nei uh a, mizawngte’ tate leiba tangin a la uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mizawngte in puan silhloin na sem uh a, gilkialpi mahin anlak na a sem uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A thau ngah nadingin oliv gahte gawi-in leenggahzu ngah nadingin leenggahte cil napi-in, gilkial dangtakin ki-omsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuapi sungah a liam le a si kuante’ kikona kiza napi-in Pasian in amau’ thungetnate don lo hi."},"13":{"text":"“Sun khuavak a nial, tua khuavak thuzia a thei lo, khuavak lampi a pelh mi pawlkhat om hi."},"14":{"text":"A zawng a cimawhte a thatlum dingin khuavak ma-in mi that pa kuankhia a, zan khuamial hun sungin mite’ na a guksak hi."},"15":{"text":"Numei tunga a mawh mipa in khuamial ding ngakin om a, mite’ theih loh dingin ama mel a seel hi."},"16":{"text":"Gutate in sun sungin a ciamtehsa teng zanin a inn luh uh a, sun sung bu-in khuavak a peel uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh zan khuamial pen amaute khempeuh a dingin zing khuavak bang hi a, zan khuamial lauhuai sung nuam a sa uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tua bang migilo peuhpeuh tuikhang in taai a, ama neih leitangte Pasian in samsia a, tua leenggui lote-ah nasemin kikuan nawn lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Nisat hun le khuakhal hunin vukkhalte a manthan bangin mihingte’ gam sung panin mawhnei mi a mangthang hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah kiphawkkha nawn lo a, ama nu nangawn in zong a mangngilh ta hi. Thante in amah netum a, amah maimang ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang mite, numei taciingte’ neihsa tawh a kivak uh hi a, meigongte’ phattuamna ding bangmah bawl lo uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasian in a thahatna tawh mi vangliante susia a, amah a gamtat ciangin migilo pa a si pah hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian in a lungnuamin amah nungtasak a, ahi zongin Pasian in amah encik tawntung hi."},"24":{"text":"Migilo pa tomkha sung a liat hangin kiak bangin vulkik pah a, a kisattan ankung bangin a keu pah hi."},"25":{"text":"Hih thu kua in nialzo ding na hi uh hiam? Ka thugennate man lo hi, ci-in kei langah hong pangin ka thugente hong selzo ding kua om na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shuah gammi Bildad in dawng a,","title":"Bildad in, “Pasian’ Muhna ah Mihing Dikzo Ngei lo Ding,” Ci"},"2":{"text":"“Pasian vanglian a, mi khempeuh in a zahtak ding ahi hi. Ama vantung kumpi gam, nuamtakin a omsakzo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama na a sem vantung mite bangzah pha cih kua in simzo ding ahi hiam? Pasian’ khuavak in a bat lohna koi lai mun om ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Pasian’ muhna-ah kua dikzo ding a, siangthozo ding ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Ama mitah khapi nangawn taang sa zo lo lai a, aksite nangawn siang sa zo lo lai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahihleh, lungno, ganhing no ahi lel mihing pen bangci ding ahi hiam? Mihing in Pasian’ muhna-ah bang man lel ahi hiam?” a ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,","title":"Job in Pasian’ Liatna Gen"},"2":{"text":"“A hehpihhuai kei nong huhna, a thazawngkhal kei nong hotna, hih bang ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Kei bang mihai tungah thu manpha nong gen a, pilna thu tampi nong pulak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bang thu a gen dingin kua in hong sawl a, kua’ lungsim hong pulakkhia na hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"“Misite’ gam kiling a, a sunga a teng mite launa tawh a ling hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian’ muhna-ah misite’ gam kilang sinsen a, a muh theih loh nadingin a liah bangmah om lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian in mun awng tungah vanpi hong zalkhia a, bangmah in a len lopi-in leitung a khai lingleng hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in meiilom lakah tuite khol a, tua a gik mahmah tui meii a puazosak hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in kha a liah ding bawl a, meii tawh kha a khuh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in muh tawpna-ah git dinden a, khuavak le khuamial a khen hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in vanpi a pua khuampite a taii ciangin tua khuampite lau-in a ling uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama thahatna tawh tuipi zo a, ama siamna tawh tui ganhing golpi Rahab thatlum hi."},"13":{"text":"A hu a san ciangin vantung teng siang pah a, ama khut in a taikhia gulpi thatlum hi."},"14":{"text":"Hihte pen ama vangliatna themkhat bek hi pan a, i zak thute pen a hemlam bek hi pan hi. Pasian a liatna taktak kua’n theizo ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in thu genkik a,","title":"Job in Migilote’ Thuak Ding Gen"},"2":{"text":"“Keima dikna a hong seelcipsak Pasian, ka lungsim a hong gimsak Vanglian Pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin,"},"3":{"text":"ka sungah nuntakna a omlaiteng, Pasian’ hu, ka nakah ka diik laiteng,"},"4":{"text":"ka muk tawh thusia peuhmah ka gen het kei ding a, ka kam tawh zuauthu peuhmah ka gen het kei ding hi, ci-in ka kiciam hi."},"5":{"text":"Note a thuman hi, kong ci ngei kei ding a, ka nuntak laiteng, kei a thuman hi’ng, ka cihna thu ka khia ngei kei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei thuman ka kisakna ka khia ngei kei ding hi. Ka lungsimah kisuanna om loin siang mahmah hi."},"7":{"text":"“Kei a hong langpan’, kei a hong dote in migilo le thuman lote bangin gimna thuak ta uh hen."},"8":{"text":"Pasian in amaute’ nuntakna a laksak hun ciangin, migilote a dingin lametna om nawn ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Lungkhamna a thuak uh ciangin Pasian in amau’ kikona awging ngai ding ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Pasian’ piak ding lungdamna a deih ding uh kilawm ahih manin, ama tungah thu a nget tawntung ding uh a kilawm ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Pasian’ vangliatna bangzahin lian mahmah cih hong gensak unla, Vanglian Pasian’ geelsa teng hong laktelsak dih un."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuate khempeuh na theih khitsa uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin mawk pau na hi uh hiam?"},"13":{"text":"“Vanglian Pasian in migilote, mi ngongtatte, gim a piakzia hih bang ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tapa tampi a neih hangun, a vekpi-in gal sungah si mangkhin ding uh hi. A tate uh a tawntungin gilkial niloh ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A nungta laisunte zong pulnatna tawh si ding uh a, meigong numeite in misite kahzo nawn lo ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilote in kuama simzawh loh ngun tampi tak nei ding uh a, genzawh lohin nikten’ puansilh ciang venvan ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin mihoih pawlkhat in tua puante silhin, thuman mi pawlkhat in tua ngunte tang lel ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilote’ lam innte kho lo a, maimom bu, ahih kei leh lo honna buk tawh kibang lel hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute a hausa-in lum uh a, ahih hangin a khanlawh uh ciangin a hauhna teng uh na maimang ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Lauhuaina in tuikhang pak bangin nawkgawp ding a, zan ciangin huihpi in amaute mutkhiamang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Nisuahna huihpi in amaute leenkhia-in a inn panun gamlapi-ah leenkhia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute a suahtak theih nading a hanciam tantan kimlai mah, hehpih ngaihsut hetloin leenkhiamang ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute a tai laitakun huih in nawk gawpin, a susiagawp dingin mutkhiagawp ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngun a kitawh khiatna a khuk om a, kham a kisiansakna a mun mah om hi.","title":"Mihing in Pilna a Zonna"},"2":{"text":"Mihingte in lei sung panin sik tokhia a, suang sung panin sumsan a huantui uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in khuamial thukpen sung zongin, lei sung a thukpi dong hahkatin zong uh a, khuamial thuktawng sung pan suang a tokhia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihingte’ tenna panin a gamlapi mun, kuamah a pai ngei lohna sungah lei sung sumte a tokhia uh hi. Tua lai munah amau guak in na semsem uh a, lei thuk sungah khauhual tawh kiveisuk kiveito uh hi."},"5":{"text":"I annek dingte leitungah hong pokhia a, ahi zongin leinuai thuk sung mei bangin a sa mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Lei sunga om suangte sungah sapfaia suangmanpha om a, a leivuite sungah kham a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Simbung in zong tua lampi thei ngei lo a, luimu zong tua lai-ah va leng ngei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Humpinelkai ahi a, ganhing dangte ahi zongin cikmah hunin tua lai-ah va pai ngei lo uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Mihingte in suang a sakpente to uh a, mualte’ bul lei sung panin a tokhia uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Suangte a tawhvang uh ciangin suangmanphate a mu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in tuinak kipatna dong lei sung to uh a, a kiphumcip nate hong suahkhia uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin koi lai-ah pilna kimu ding ahi hiam? Koi lai-ah thutheihna nak om ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"“Mihingte in a kimuhna ding a lampi thei lo uh a, mihingte’ gam sungah zong a lampi om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"A thuk mahmah tuipi liante in, ‘Ko’ sungah om lo hi,’ ci uh a, tuipite in, ‘Ko kiangah om lo hi,’ a ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilna pen kham tawh a kileizo hi lo a, a man ding zah zong ngun tawh sehtheih hi lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Ofir kham tawh pilna a kileizo hi lo a, suangmanpha pen tawh zong a kileizo hi tuan lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pilna a manphatna kham le limlang tawh tehtheih hi lo a, kham hoihpen a kibawl nate tawh zong leizawh hi lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Pilna a manphatna suangkhi le limlang tawh genteh theih hi lo a, pilna themkhat bek nangawn kep sangin manphazaw lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Ethiopia gamah a piang topaz suangmanphate tawh tehtheih ding hi lo a, kham citak hoihpen tawh zong kiteh thei tuan lo hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ahihleh koi lai panin pilna hong piang ahi hiam? Thutheihna koi lai-ah om ahi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei sung pan a mu thei kuamah om lo a, a leengthei vasate nangawn in mu thei lo uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Sihna le siatna nangawn in a thu hemzak bek ung, ci lai uh hi."},"23":{"text":"“Pasian bek in pilna lampi thei a, amah bek in a omna mun a thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in leimong dong mu a, vantung nuai-ah a om na khempeuh a mu thei hi."},"25":{"text":"Pasian in huih a gik ding zah bawlin, tuipi a liatna ding zah a seh laitak,"},"26":{"text":"guah zukna ding mun thu pia-in, khuaphialep in a zuih ding lampi bawlin a vaihawm laitak nangawnin,"},"27":{"text":"amah in pilna mu-in a manphate entel a, amah in hoihsa ahih manin a kipsak hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tua ciangin amah in mihingte tungah thu genin, ‘Topa zahtakna, pilna hi a, siatna pelhna pen thutheihna hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 111:10; Pau 1:7; 9:10"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in a thu genkik a,","title":"Job in Nidanga a Nopsakna Phawkkik"},"2":{"text":"“Ka nuntakna nidanga bang hi kik hen la, Pasian in kei hong et hun lai bang hong hi kik leh ka ut hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Pasian in kei hong ompih tawntung a, khuamial sungah ka pai laitakin khuavak hong pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun pen ka cihtheih hun laitak hi a, Pasian in ka innkuan a hong hut laitak hun ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in Vanglian Pasian in kei hong ompih a, ka kimkotah ka tate a om uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka bawngte le ka keelte in nawi deih zahzah hong pia uh a, suang tam penna nangawnah ka oliv kungte hoih mahmah hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuasung upate a kikhop uh ciangin a kikhawm dingin kei ka pai ciangin"},"8":{"text":"kei hong muh phetun khangnote in tutna hong awn uh a, kei hong zahtakna limun papite na ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Khuasung uliante a kiho na khawl pah uh a, a khut uh tawh a kam uh na hum uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi a thupi pente nangawn na gamdai pah uh a, kuamah pau loin na om uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ka thugen a za mi peuhmah in a hoihlamin na za uh a, a hong mu mi peuhmah in dik hong sa uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Mizawng ka theih peuhmah ka huh tawntung a, cih nading thei lo tagahte zong ka huh hi."},"13":{"text":"A lungkham a cimawhte in kei hong phat uh a, meigong numeite a lungnuamin ka omsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Thuman, puan bangin ka silh a, thuman in kei hong tuam hi. Thutang, puanpi-in ka silh a, thutang in kei hong tuam hi."},"15":{"text":"Mittaw mite a dingin mittang ka hi a, khebai mite a dingin khe ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mizawngte a dingin a pa uh ka hi a, lungkhamna a thuak, ka theih loh mite nangawn ka panpih tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Migilote’ gitlohna khempeuh ka susia gawpmang a, amau’ sukgawp mi khempeuh ka honkhia hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ka nuntak kum sehnel zahin a tam dingin ka ngaihsun a, lungnuam takin inn-ah a si dingin ka kilamen hi."},"19":{"text":"A zung in tui a ngah tawntung singkung tawh ka kibang a, daitui in a hiangte a nomsak singkung tawh ka kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in kei hong phat tawntung uh a, ka tha a hat tawntung hi."},"21":{"text":"Mite in ka thugen ngai-in hong ngak dimdem uh a, kuamah pau hetloin limtakin hong ngai uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Thu ka gen khit ciangin a genthuah ding uh bangmah thei nawn lo uh a, ka thugente khempeuh hoihtakin na sang pah uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Lo khote in khuapi guah deih mahmahin a ngak bangin, ka thugente khempeuh hoihtakin na sang uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Itna tawh ka nuihsat ciangin amaute lungnuam mahmah uh a, ka mai a tai ciangin a maigumna uh a bei hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute ukin a vai ding uh ka hawmsak a, kumpipa in a galkapte a makaih bangin ka makai a, a lungkham uh ciangin amaute ka hehnem hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ahi zongin tu-in, a pate uh kimanna a nei lo ka uite tawh tuu cing dingin a kuan dingin zong ka deih loh, kei sanga a khangnozawte in hong ciamnuih bawlta uh hi.","title":"A Lungkham Laitakin Job Thum"},"2":{"text":"Amau’ hatna khempeuh tu-in bei khinta ahih manin, amau’ hatna kei a dingin a kimanna om nawn lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute zawng mahmahin gilkial uh ahih manin gamlak singzung keu peuh teep lel ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in singkungnote botin ne uh a, limna alna a nei lo poding zung nangawn a ne uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Gutate otkhai-in a kidelh khiat bangin mite lak panin amaute kihawlkhia hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute pen hawkguam sung, leihawm sung, luihawm, le keenhawm sungah a ten uh a kul ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ganhing bangin gamlakah amaute ham uh a, sawlkawm nuai-ah kilomin a omkhawm uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangmahin a kimang lo hih bang misia honte, mite omna gam sung panin a kihawlkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in amaute in kei hong simmawh bawlin hong nuihsan uh a, amaute’ ciamnuihna bek ka suak khinta hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong kih uh a, kei tawh tehna-in amaute hoihlua kisa uh a, amaute in ka maitang nangawn cil hong phih vial uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in hong zawngkhalsak, hong cimawhsak ahih manin amaute in a ut utun kei hong bawlsia uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in hong simgawpin, kei hong taikhiasak uh a, ka sih theih nadingin ka mai-ah na pang uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka suahtak theih nading lampi na khaktan uh a, kei suksiat ding hanciam uh a, amaute a kho ding kuamah om lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei ka bukna leihawmah amaute hong tuaksuk uh a, kei hong sucipsuk uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Launa tawh ka kidim a, ka cihtheihna khempeuh meii bangin a thengta hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tu-in a si ding ka hita a, ka gimna panin noptuam ngahna ding bangmah om nawn lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Zan thapai-in ka guh sung, ka tang sung khempeuh na a, a hong pet tawntung natna dai ngei peuhmah lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasian in ka puan ngawng pan kei hong manin ka puan tawh hong heekcip hi."},"19":{"text":"Buannawng ciim sungah kei hong lawnkhia a, ninbulom bang lel ka hita hi."},"20":{"text":"“Pasian aw, nang kong sam a, na hong dawng ngei kei hi. Nang tungah thu kong ngen a, nong don het kei hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei tungah nong gilo mahmah a, nong hih theih zahin kei na hong bawlsia hi."},"22":{"text":"Huih lakah na hong lawn a, huih na hong leensak a, huihpi in hong lawnsuk hong lawnto hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi khempeuh a dingin sehkholhin a kikoihsa sihna-ah a hong paipih na hihna ka thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Na hehpih ding a hong thum ding cih lohbuang, bangmah dang a hih thei nawn lo misia pa, bang hangin sugawp na hi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"A lungkham mite tawh kei kap khawmin, a cimawh mite dahpih hi lo ka hi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Lungdamna le khuavakna ka lamet laitakin, lungkhamna le khuamialna hong tung zawsop hi."},"27":{"text":"Lunggimna le natna in kei hong sugawp a, gimna ka thuak ding cih loh bangmah dang om nawn lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Lungkham sinkhamin ka om a, mihon lakah dingin huhna ka ngen hi."},"29":{"text":"Kei pen gamkhing sunga a om ngia le vasa-kalaohte tawh kipawlin a kikhawl ka hita hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka vun vomin dulhkhia a, ka pumtangin ka ci sa gawp hi."},"31":{"text":"Nidangin lungdamna la a kisa ka zakna munah tu-in thumna le kahna aw bek ka za ta hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Lunggulhna tawh nungak khatpeuh ka et ngei loh nading, kiciamna ka bawlkhin hi.","title":"Job in Ama Ginatna Lak"},"2":{"text":"Vanglian Pasian in eite bang hong cih a, mihingte’ gamtatna bangci thuhkik ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"A man loin a gamtate tungah siatna le gimna a tungsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian in ka gamtatna khempeuh thei a, ka kalsuanna khempeuh a hong mu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Ka gitloh gamtat ngei lohna, kuamah ka khem ngei hetlohna, ka gamtat hoihna thute-ah ka kiciam ngam hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in tawikhaina manah hong tawikhai hen; ka paubaan hetlohna hong mu ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Lampi man panin ka pial a, siatna lam ka zuih a, ka khut tungah mawhna a baan taak leh"},"8":{"text":"ka khawhsa ante midangte’ nek suak hen la, ka an neih khempeuh maimang tahen."},"9":{"text":"“Ka vengte’ zi zawlmitin, a kong gei-ah ngakin ka buk taak leh"},"10":{"text":"ka it ka zi in midangte’ an suksak hen la, midangte’ ang-ah lum tahen."},"11":{"text":"(Tua bang mawhna pen a siahuai hi a, sihna a thuak ding ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka neih khempeuh a kangtum thei mei husia tawh a kibang ahi hi.)"},"13":{"text":"“Ka nasemte khat peuhpeuh kei tungah hong phun ciangin, ama thu ngai-in limtakin ka bawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaci kei leng, Pasian’ mai mu ngam ding ka hi hiam? Keima thu a khen dingin Pasian hong pai ciangin bang gen mawk ding ka hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Kei a hong piangsak Pasian mah in keima nasemte zong a piangsak ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mizawngte ka huh ding ka mangngilh ngei kei a, meigong numeite ka guaksuaksak ngei kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Keimah in an ne napi-in, tagahte a gilkialin ka koihkhong ngei kei hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka khang tawntungin tua bangte ka en tawntung hi."},"19":{"text":"“Mi a cimawh, puan silh ding a lei zo lo, a zawng lua ka muh ciangin,"},"20":{"text":"ka tuuhon panin ka ngah tuumul puan kibawl ka pia hi. Amah in zong a lungsim neih khempeuh tawh kei a hong phat hi."},"21":{"text":"“Zum thukhenna-ah zo-na ning cih ngaihsutna tawh tagah khatpeuh ka khem taak leh,"},"22":{"text":"ka khutte buisum hen la, ka liang bul panin kilongkhia tahen."},"23":{"text":"Pasian’ gimpiak ding kihta ka hih manin, tua bang peuhmah ka gamta ngei kei ding hi."},"24":{"text":"“Leitung hauhna muan le suanin ka nei ngei kei a,"},"25":{"text":"ka hauhna zong ka kisaktheihpih ngei kei hi."},"26":{"text":"A taang mahmah ni ahi a, a hoih mahmah kha ahi zongin, cikmahin ka bia ngei kei hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuate pahtawina le zahtakna limin ka khut lapna tawh cikmah hunin ka khial ngei het kei hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua bang mawhna in sihna a thuak ding hi a, tua bang mawhna pen Vanglian Pasian nialna ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Ka galte’n gim a thuak teh ka kipak ngei kei a, haksatna a tuah uh teh ka lungdam ngei kei hi."},"30":{"text":"A sih ding uh deihna tawh ka samsia ngei kei hi."},"31":{"text":"Zin le leengte limtakin ka do tawntungna thu ka na a hong sepsak mi khempeuh in a thei uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Khualzin mi khempeuh ka inn-ah ka tungsak tawntung a, kongzing lakah amaute ka lumsak ngei kei hi."},"33":{"text":"Midangte in a mawhnate uh pulak loin imcip uh a, ahih hangin keima mawhna cikmahin ka im ngei kei hi."},"34":{"text":"Midangte’ hong kam pau ding kihtakin ka nei ngei kei hi. Amau’ hong simmawh ding ka kihtakna hangin pau loin ka om ngei kei a, ka bucip ngei kei hi."},"35":{"text":"“Ka thugente kuamah in na ngai lo ding ahi hiam? Ka gen thu khempeuh man hi, ci-in ka kiciam hi. Vanglian Pasian in kei hong dawng tahen. “Ka langte in kei hong mawhsakna thute ka tawi theih dingin lai sungah a kigelh hileh"},"36":{"text":"tua mawhsaknate kisialhna tawh ka ngawngah ka ok ding a, mi khempeuh in a muh dingin ka sangsak ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka gamtatna khempeuh Pasian kiangah ka gen ding a, ama muhna-ah lungdamin kihihsakna tawh ka om ding hi."},"38":{"text":"“Ka khawh leitang ka guk ahih a, a nei taktak pa’ tung pan ka suh ahih a,"},"39":{"text":"tua leitang a piang ante ka nek a, tua lo a khote a puksi-in ka omsak taak leh,"},"40":{"text":"tua lo sungah mangbuh le mangbuh ham tangin kiak le ling po ta hen,” a ci hi. Job’ thugente beita hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job amahmah dik kisa tawntung ahih manin hih mihing thumte in Job’ thugente dawn ding ngaihsun nawn lo uh hi.","title":"Elihu in Job a Dawng dingin a Kilawmna Gen"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin a thu a za, Ram minam, Buz-te beh, Barakhel’ tapa Elihu a heh hong suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Job amah kidiksakin Pasian mawhsak zawsop hi."},"3":{"text":"Job’ lawm thumte tungah zong a heh suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Job a dawnna ding uh thei lo uh ahih manin Pasian a khial tawh hong kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Elihu ahihleh amaute lak panin a khangno pen ahih manin adangte a pau kim khit mateng bangmah pau loin a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih mihing thumte in Job a dawn theih loh a muh ciangin a hehna thuakzo nawn lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Buz-te beh Barakhel’ tapa Elihu in thu gen ding hong kipan a, “Kei a khangno lai hi-in, note a khangham na hih manun, ka ngaihsutna note lakah kong gen ngam kei hi."},"7":{"text":"No a khangham zawte in thu a gen ding kilawm hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin mihingte tungah a hong tung pilna pen Vanglian Pasian’ kha in a hong piak ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Khanghamna in mi pilsak lo a, thuman zong theisak tuan lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in keima thugen dingte nong ngaih ding uh ka deih hi. Keima ngaihsutna hong gensak dih un."},"11":{"text":"“Thu na gengen laitakun lungduai takin kong ngaingai a, na thugen dingte uh na zonzon laitakun ka hong ngak hithiat hi."},"12":{"text":"Limtakin kong ngai a, na cihmawhna uh ka thei hi. Job’ thugente a man lohna na gentel thei kei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hangin pilna a nei-in kigen thei ding na hi uh hiam? Note in lel na hih manun Pasian in Job dawng ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Job in note tungah thu tampi hong gen a, kei tungah hong gen lo hi. Ahi zongin note’ dawn bangin ka dawng ngei kei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Job aw, hih mite in nang hong lel uh a, nang hong dawnna ding bangmah thei lo uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute pau loin a om ciangun kei zong pau loin ngak lailai ding ka hi hiam? nasepna hangin mi khempeuh in a phat tawntung mah bangin nang zong amah phatzaw in."},"25":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in Pasian’ sepsate mu uh a, theikim zo lo uh ahih manin lamdang a sa uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in meii sung panin guah piangsak a, mihing khempeuh a dingin guah a zusak hi."},"29":{"text":"Meiite a pai henhanna hitaleh, vanah van a ginna hitaleh kuamah in thei zo lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Amah in vantungah khua phiasak a, ahi zongin tuipi thuk sung a mialsak hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in tu-a bangin mihingte hong vak a, annek ding tampi tak a hong pia ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Amah in keek thu pia a, a kap nop penpen a kha dingin a sawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah a heh ciangin huihpi sam a, vanging pen ama hong pai nading a kitheihna ahi hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hih huihpi in ka dip hong kuasak a, ka dip vana khai hong bangsak hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama kam panin a hong gingkhia hih vanging Pasian’ pauna awging, limtakin ngai in."},"3":{"text":"Amah in vanah khua phiasak a, leimong khat pan mong khat dong a taan hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin a vanglian vanging, ama awging hong kiza a, tua hun sungteng mahin khua a hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in mihingte a nasep uh khawlsak a, amah a gamtang ahihna a kilangsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Gamsate in a lupna ngei delh uh a, a kua sungah bucip uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitaw lam panin guahpi hong zu a, leilu lam panin huihpi hong nung hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian’ husanna in tuite khalsak a, tui lianpite khalin sik bangin a sak hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in meiipi nomsak a,
