Amah muang in; amah in hong sem ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in nangma dikna khuavak bangin, nangma thumanna nitaang bangin hong langsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah khawl dide inla, lungduai takin ngak in. A hihna a daupai pa tung le siatna a bawlpa tungah kilungso tawmsak ke’n!"},"8":{"text":"Hehna panin kikham inla, sinsona nusia in. Nangmah kilungso tawmsak ke’n; tua in siatna bekah a hong paipih hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote kipuaseh ding a, ahih hangin Topa a ngakte in leitung luah ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin tawlkhat sungin migilo pa om nawn lo ding a, ama omna mun na lim zon mahmah hangin tua lai-ah amah na om lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin lungnemte in leitung luahin, genzawh lohin amaute nuamsa ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 5:5"},"12":{"text":"Migilo in thuman pa sawm a, a ha a gawisan hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in migilo pa’ hun a tungta ahihlam mu ahih manin amah a nuihsan lel hi."},"14":{"text":"Mizawngte le mi cimawhte a suniam ding, a thutangte a that dingin migilote in namsau dokin, a thal uh a keek hi."},"15":{"text":"A namsau uh amau’ lungtang mahah tumin, a thalte uh kitan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilote’ hauhna sangin thuman mite in tawmno khat bek a neihna hoihzaw lai hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote’ thahatna kipaih khiatsak ding a, ahih hangin Topa in mihoihte a huh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in a paubaang lote kem a, amau’ gamh kipden ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Siatna hun ciangin amaute kimaizumsak lo a, kial hun ciangin tampi nei uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin migilote kisia hi. Topa’ galte pen lono etlawm tawh kibang a, amaute mangthang pak uh hi. Meikhu bangin mangthang uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Migilo in leitawi la a, lohkikzo nawn lo hi. Thuman mi ahihleh cingh-in mi a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ thupha piakte in leitung luah ding uh a, ahih hangin a samsiatte kipuaseh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in mi a lam pai nading lak a, ama lungkim bangin a gamta pa amah in a kipsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah a puk hangin lutuk lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama khut len hi."},"25":{"text":"Thuman mi a kinusiacip, a suanlekhakte ngen tawmin a kivak, ka neu lai a kipanin tu-a ka teek hun ciang dong ka mu ngei nai kei hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in mi citpiak ngitngetin, mi tungah leitawi piakhia a, a suanlekhakte zong thupha ngah mi a suak hi."},"27":{"text":"Siatna panin kikem inla, gamtat hoih in; tua hileh na khantawnin, na kip paisuak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in thutang deih a, ama mi siangthote nusia lo ding hi. Thuman mite kikemcing den ding a, ahi zongin migilo’ suanlekhakte kipuaseh ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Thuman mi in leitung luah ding a, tua leitang tungah teng paisuak ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Thuman mi’ kam in pilna gen a, a leii in thutang gen hi."},"31":{"text":"A lungsim sungah ama Pasian’ thukham om a, a gamtatna khempeuhah lampial het lo hi."},"32":{"text":"Migilo in thuman mi encik a, thah dingin a zong hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in migilo pa’ khut sungah amah nusia lo ding a, thusit dingin a kipaipih ciangin mawhna thuaksak lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa ngak inla, ama lampi zui in. Leitang a luah dingin nang hong liansak ding a, migilote’ siatna nangmah in na en ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Lebanon taamtak sing bangin a sang pha mahmah migilo kiphasak khat keimah in ka mu hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama kiangah ka paikik a, amah na om nawn lo hi. Amah ka zonzon hangin kimuzo nawn lo hi."},"37":{"text":"Paubaang lo mi ciamteh inla, thutang mi en in; bang hang hiam cih leh gal a phuang lo mi a dingin nopna a om hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahih hangin thupalsatte kisusiamang khin ding a, migilote’ suanlekhakte kipuaseh ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Topa in thuman mite honkhia a, amah pen haksat hun ciangin amaute’ bukna ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Amaute in Topa beel ahih manin amah in amaute huhin honkhia a, migilote’ kiang panin amaute honin suaktasak hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, a hehsa-in kei hong taii kei inla, lungsosa in kei hong thuhilh kei in.","title":"Gimna a Thuak, a Kisik mipa’ Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma thaltangte ka sungah hong tum khin a, ka tungah na khuttum hong tu khinta hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma hehna hangin kei ka ci na a, ka mawhna hangin ka pumtangin ka na hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mawhnate in ka lu dong hong tuumzo a, keima puak dingin a giklua vangik tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka haina hangin ka liamnate nai-in uih a,"},"6":{"text":"keimah hong kikunsak a, hong kibokcipsak hi. Sunthapai-in kapin ka vak kawikawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka ci sa mahmah a, nakpitakin ka ci na hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei hong kinengcip gawpin ka thahatna beimang khin a, ka lungsim gimna hangin thumin ka tautau hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, ka deihna khempeuh na thei a, ka khuisatnate na za hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka lungtang kisat a, ka tha in lel hi. Ka mit in zong khua mu thei nawn lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka gim thuakna-ah ka lawmte le ka kithuahpihte kidang koih uh a, keima behte nangawn kei kiang pan gamla om uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei a hong that nuamte in a thang uh zak a, kei’ natna ding a zongte in siatna ding thu bek gen uh a, sunthapai-in khemna bekbek ngaihsutin nei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei pen bilngong ka bang a, khua ka za kei hi. A kam a ka thei lo, a pau thei lo mi ka bang hi."},"14":{"text":"Bil khua za lo, tawnna kam a za thei lo mi khat tawh kei ka kibang takpi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa aw, nangmah ka hong muang hi. Topa ka Pasian aw, a hong dawng ding pa nangmah na hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh, “Ka khe a taal ciangin kei tunga hong kihisakte, keima gim thuakna-ah lungdam sak kei in,” cih bek ka hong thum hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh puk dingin ka kithawi a, ka gimna kam tuan lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka thuman lohna ka pulak a, ka mawhna hangin ka dah hi."},"19":{"text":"A thuman lopi-in ka gal a hite thahat a, kei a hong mudah khialte tam mahmah uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A hoih gamta ka hih manin ka hoihna pen siatna tawh a hong thukte ka langpangte ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa aw, kei hong nusia kei in. Ka Pasian aw, ka kiang pan gamla om ke’n!"},"22":{"text":"Topa, kei hong honpa aw, keimah a hong huh dingin hong manlang in."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka leii tawh ka khialhloh nadingin ka gamtatna ka kikem ding a, ka omna-ah migilote a omlaiteng ka kam ka kham ding hi,” ka ci hi.","title":"Nuntakna Kician lo, A Mawkna Ahihna"},"2":{"text":"Pau loin ka dai om a, ka dai omna a mawkna suak a, ka thuakna khang semsem hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka sungah ka lung so a, ka lungngaih ciangin ka lung so semsem hi. Tua ciangin ka paukhia a,"},"4":{"text":"“ Topa aw, ka mong le ka hun a kisehzah hong theisak inla, ka nuntakna a beipak hun ding hong theisak in!” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka nuntakna hun khutme tan bang bekin na bawl a, ka nuntakna hun nangma muhna-ah bangmah gentham lo hi. Mihing khempeuh, husan’ bang bek hi takpi hi."},"6":{"text":"Niliim bangin mihing pai kawikawi takpi hi. A mawkna-in amau lungkham takpi uh a, kua’ ngah ding cih thei lopi-in mite in na a khol uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in Topa aw, ke’n, bang ngaklai ding ka hi hiam? Keima lametna nangma sung bekah om hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thupalsatna khempeuh panin kei hong honkhia inla, mite’ nuihsatin kei hong bawl kei in."},"9":{"text":"Hih bangin a hong bawl nangmah na hih manin pau loin ka om a, ka kam ka ka kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Nong vuakna ma ka tung panin lakhia in. Na hong vuakna hangin ka tha beita hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi khat a mawhna hangin tai-in na sat ciangin, nget in a nektum bangin ama na manpha na beisak hi. Mihing khempeuh husan’ khat bang bek hi takpi hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna hong ngai inla, ka kikona hong za in. Ka khitui luanna hong thudon in. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu ka pate khempeuh bangin kei zong na zin, na peemta ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka manthan hun matengin ka lungnop theih nadingin kei hong en in!"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa lamenin ka ngak ngiungeu a, amah kei lam hong nga-in ka kikona aw hong za hi.","title":"Phatna tawh Biakna le Pasian’ Huh Baih ding Ngetna (La 70:1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Dahna dum sung, buannawng panin kei hong kaikhia-in suangpi tungah ka khete nga a, ka khesikna mun a muanhuaisak hi."},"3":{"text":"Eima Pasian phatna la thak keimah hong hilh hi. Mi tampite in hih thu mu-in amah zahtak ding uh a, amaute khempeuh in Topa muang ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa a muang a, mi kiphasakte lamah a kihei lo, pasian man lote lamah a pialkhia lo mi thupha ngah ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa ka Pasian aw, na sep a lamdangte le ko a dingin na ngaihsutnate tampi tak na phasak a, kuamah dang tawh tehtheih na hi kei hi. Tuate pulakin gen ding hi leng, genkhit zawh ding hi lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Gan gawh biakna le khawhsa tawh biakna na deih kei a, khua ka zak theih nading bil na hong guan hi. Meihal biakna le mawhmaina ding biakna zong na kulsak kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “En in, laibu sungah keima thu a kigelh khinsa bangin ka hong pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma deih bang hihna-ah nuam ka sa hi, ka Pasian aw. Nangma thukham ka lung sungah om hi,” ka ci hi.","ref":"Heb 10:5-7"},"9":{"text":"Hotkhiatna hangin lungdam thu mihonpi lakah ka gen ding hi. Topa aw, lungdam thugen ka khawl ngei kei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma hotkhiatna thu ka im kei a, na thumanna le na hotkhiatna ka gen khin hi. Na itna kip le na thumanna mihonpi tungah ka im kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, na hehpihna kei kiang panin humcip kei inla, na itna kip le na thumanna kei a hong kem tawntung ding hisak ta in."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a malin simzawh loh ding siatna tampite in kei hong umcih a, khua a hong musak thei lo zah dong dingin ka mawhna thaman ka thuak khinta hi. Amaute ka sam mal sangin tamzaw uh a, ka lung in a lel ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, keimah hong honkhia nuam in. Topa aw, hong huh meng in."},"14":{"text":"Kei a hong that nuamte zahhuaisak inla, maisiasak in. Keima siatna ding a deihte nungkiksak inla minsiasak in."},"15":{"text":"Keima tungah, “Ha ha!” hong ci vialte zahhuaina tawh maikhingsak in."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin nang a hong zongte khempeuh nangma hangin nuamin kipak hen la, na hotkhiat ding a deihte in, “ Topa lian hi!” ci ngitnget ta uh hen."},"17":{"text":"Kei ahihleh zawngin ka cimawh a, ahih hangin Topa in kei hong mangngilh lo hi. Nang pen kei hong huhpa le hong honkhia pa na hi hi. Zekai kei in, ka Pasian aw."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi genthei a khualte thupha ngah ahi hi. Topa in haksatna hunah amaute honkhia ding hi.","title":"Cidamna ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in amaute hu-in hingsak ding a, leitungah amaute thupha ngah mi kici ding hi. Amau’ galte’ khut sungah amaute pia lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A ci uh a nat ciangin Topa in amaute kem ding a, a cinatna khempeuh uh damsakkik ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ke’n ahihleh, “ Topa aw, kei hong hehpih inla, kei hong damsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tungah kong khialzo hi,” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka galte in elna tawh keima thu gen uh a, “Cik ciangin amah a si tam, cik ciangin a min a mang tam,” ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Keimah a en dingin mi hong pai ciangin, kam mawkna a pau uh hi. A lungsim uhah siatna kaikhawm uh a, a paikhiat uh ciangin a genthang uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei hong mudah khempeuh in keima thu kihuauhuau uh a, kei a dingin a sia thei pen ding a geelgeel uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in, “Amah nak gim mahmah hi. A lupna panin thokikzo nawn lo ding hi,” ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka muan, ka lawm it pa, keima an a ne pa nangawn in a khetul tawh kei hong peek vial hi.","ref":"Mat 26:23; Mrk 14:18,20; Luk 22:21; Joh 13:18"},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin, Topa aw, amaute na thukkik theih nadingin kei hong hehpih inla, hong damsak in."},"11":{"text":"Ka galte in keimah hong zo lo ding a, keima tungah nong lungkimna ka thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima hoihna hangin na hong huh ding a, nangma omna-ah nong omsak tawntung ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel Pasian, Topa in khang tawntungin thupha ngah tahen. Amen, Amen!","ref":"La 106:48."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sakhi in tuiluang sialsial a lunggulh bangin nang ka hong lunggulh hi, ka Pasian aw.","title":"BU NIHNA (La 42-72) Sala om hun le Lungkham hunin Pasian Lunggulhna"},"2":{"text":"A nungta Pasian kong deih hi. Cik ciangin kei hong pai-in Pasian’ maitang hong mu thei ding ka hi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Mite in keima tungah, “Na Pasian koi-ah om ahi hiam?” hong cihcih sungteng, sun le zanin ka khitui an-in ka ne hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lungsim sung ka suahkhia a, pawi bawl mihon khat kipakin otna le nuamna la tawh Pasian’ inn-ah ka makaihna, mihonpi tawh ka paina ka phawkkik hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hangin khakunkun a, lunghimawh niloh ka hi hiam? Pasian’ sungah lametna nei ning; bang hang hiam cih leh kei a hong huh ka Pasian ka phatkik ngawn ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka lungsim tamkham ahih manin Jordan le Hermon gam, Mizar mualtung panin nang ka hong phawk hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma tuizeu gingte khatlekhat kidawng uh a, dahna tuihualte in kei a hong tuum hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in sun tawntungin a itna kip hong lak a, zan hun ciangin nuntakna a hong pia Pasian’ tungah thungetna la ka sa hi."},"9":{"text":"“Bang hangin kei hong mangngilh na hi hiam? Galte in hong sukcip manin bang hangin kapin kidikdik ka hi hiam?” ci-in ka Pasian, kei a hong huhpa’ tungah ka gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka langte in kei tungah, “Na Pasian koi-ah om ahi hiam?” hong cihcih sungteng, ka sungah meima nai tawm bangin hong tum ngangngang hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hangin khakunkun a, lunghimawh niloh ka hi hiam? Pasian’ sungah lametna nei ning; bang hang hiam cih leh kei a hong huh ka Pasian ka phatkik ngawn ding hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka dikna hong langsak inla, migilote tawh ka thu-ah kei hong panpih in. Mi khemte le thutang lote kiang panin kei hong honkhia in.","title":"Biakinn-ah Ciahkik ding Lamenin Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hong belh Pasian na hi hi. Bang hangin kei hong nilkhia na hi hiam? Galte’ sukcip manin bang hangin kapin kidikdik ka hi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Na khuavak le na thuman hong sawlkhia inla, na mual siangtho, na omna-ah kei hong paipih sakin, hong khasak in."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin na biakna tau-ah ahi a, ka lung a hong damsak Pasian kiangah ahi zongin ka pai ding a, laiza khausai lasakna tawh nang ka hong phat ding hi, aw Pasian, ka Pasian aw."},"5":{"text":"Bang hangin khakunkun a, lunghimawh niloh ka hi hiam? Pasian sungah lametna nei ning; bang hang hiam cih leh kei a hong huh ka Pasian ka phatkik ngawn ding hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka pu ka pate uh a khan lai-a na hihnasate, amaute in kote tungah hong gen uh a, kote in ka bil uh tawh ka za khin uh hi.","title":"Lungkham Hunin Nidanga Hotkhiatna Phawk"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah in minam dangte na hawlkhia mang a, ahih hangin amau’ munah ka pu ka pate uh na tengsak hi. Midangte na sugawp a, ahih hangin amaute na suaktasak hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in namsau tawh leitang ngah lo uh a, amau’ khut in amaute’ tungah gualzawhna pia lo hi. Na khut taklam le na baan, na hehpihna maipha hizaw hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah nang na lungkim hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang pen Jakob a dingin gualzawhna a sehkhol, keima Kumpipa le keima Pasian na hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma huhna tawh ka galte uh ka sawnpai uh a, ko a hong do mite na min suangin ka tuancil uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih ka thalpi suanin ka nei kei a, ka namsau in zong kei hong hon zo lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in ka galte’ kiang panun kote na hong hon a, ko a hong mudahte na zahhuai gawpsak khin hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian’ hangin kote ka angtang ngitnget uh a, nangma tungah ka lungdam tawntung ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in kote hong nusia-in, nong minsiasak khin a, ka galkap hon uh tawh na hong kuankhawm kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Galte kiang panin kote nong nungkiksak a, ka galte un ka neihsa teng uh buluah khin uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuu gawh ding bangin kote na hong bawl a, minam dangte lakah nong thehthang khin hi."},"12":{"text":"Na mite a man tawmno khatin na hong zuak a, a man ding na sang nget kei hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka vengte uh’ zahko, ka kiim uha omte’ nuihsat leh thusim lohin kote na hong bawl khin hi."},"14":{"text":"Minam dangte lakah a sia lama gentehna, mite lakah ciamnuih-a neihin kote na hong bawl khin hi."},"15":{"text":"Keimah a hong ko mi le keimah a hong minsiasak mite’ kampauna ahi a, galte le langte in hong bawlna hang ahi zongin, sunthapai-in ka zahhuai den a, maizumna tawh ka kidim hi.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Na thuciamna-ah khial lo napi, nang hong mangngilh lo napi, hih thute khempeuh ko tungah hong tung khin hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngiate’ omna-ah kote hong balnen gawpin, khuamialpi sungah nong paihdak ding zahin, ka lungsim uh kihei nai lo a, ka kalsuan uh lampial nai lo hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Ka Pasian uh mangngilh khinin pasian dang tungah ka khutte uh a khakkhin hi le ung,"},"21":{"text":"Pasian in hih thu mukhia lo ding ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in lungsim thusim a thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma hangin sunthapai-in kote hong kithat a, gan gote’ tuu gawh ding bangin kote hong kikoih hi.","ref":"Rom 8:36"},"23":{"text":"Topa aw, bang hangin ihmu na hi hiam? Nangmah hong tho tawm in!"},"24":{"text":"Bang hangin na maitang seel na hi hiam? Bang hangin ka thuakna uh le hong kisukcipnate mangngilh na hi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leilakah ka puk uh a, leivui lakah guallelin ka lum uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tho to in, kote a hong huh dingin hong pai in! Na itna kip hangin kote hong honkhia in!"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thubul hoih khat tawh ka lungsim hong dimletin, kumpipa la ka phuah a, ka leii pen laithei pa’ laikung tawh hong kibang hi.","title":"Kumpi Mopina Pawi La"},"2":{"text":"Mihingte lakah nangmah na hoihpen a, thugen na siam a, na kam khum zungzung hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian in nang thupha hong pia tawntung hi."},"3":{"text":"Vanglian kumpipa aw, na minthanna le na liatna tawh na namsau kuah in."},"4":{"text":"Thumanna a omna ding le thuman a hu dingin na minliatna tawh gualzo-in hong pusuak inla, dipkuathuai hihnate na taklam khut nangmah kihilhsak in."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa’ galte’ lungtangah na thaltang hiamte lut a, mite na nuai-ah puk uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Na kumpi tokhom siangtho kip tawntung hi. Na kumpi ciangkhut thumanna ciangkhut hi a,"},"7":{"text":"thuman deihin gitlohna na mudah hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian ahi, nangma Pasian in na khangualte tungah a kikhai to-in lungdamna sathau nang hong nilhzo a,","ref":"Heb 1:8-9"},"8":{"text":"na puantualpite myrrh paknamtui, aloes paknamtui, le thalsing namtuite a nam hi. Saiha tawh kibawl innpite panin khausai lasaknate in nang hong lungdamsak a,"},"9":{"text":"kumpite’ tanute, numei uliante lakah om a, na taklamah Ofir gam khamte tawh kizemin kumpinu a ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tanu aw, ngai dih in; ngaihsun inla, na bil hong ngat in. Na mite le na behte mangngilh in."},"11":{"text":"Na melhoihna hangin kumpipa in hong deih ding hi. Na topa ahih ciangin ama mai-ah kun in."},"12":{"text":"Mi haupen ahi Taia mite in na manpha namkim letsong tawh nang hong maivil ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi tanu a inndei sungah kham puantualpi tawh kizem a, mel tuamtuam a nei puantualpite silh a, mihon kigual deudaute lakah a kithuahpih nungakte le amah a khate tawh kumpipa kiangah kipaipih hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa’ inn-ah a tun ciangun lungdamna le nuamna tawh amaute kitumpih hi."},"16":{"text":"Na pate’ tang ding na tapate hong hi ding a, nangmah in leitung khempeuhah amaute, ulian na suaksak ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Keimah in khang tawntungin na min ka kiphawksak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin mite in nang hong phat den ding uh hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian, i belh leh i thahatna hi a, haksat hunin a hong huh pahpah pa ahi hi.","title":"Pasian, Ama Mite’ Belh"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, leitung kikhinin, mualte tuipi sung a kidenna zongin, a tuite ging zuazua-in phuan zuazua a, hih ginna hangin mual liante a ling zongin, i lau kei ding hi.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Sangpenpa’ tenna khua siangtho, Pasian’ khuapi, a lungdamsak gun khat a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama laizangah Pasian om a, amah a kiling kei ding hi. Pasian in phalvak tungin amah huh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Minamte lungkham uh a, kumpi gamte kiling hi. Ama aw gingkhiasak a, leitung kicimgawp hi."},"7":{"text":"Vanglian Topa eite tawh hong omkhawm a, Jakob Pasian eima belh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hong pai unla, Topa’ sepna hong mu un. Leitung khempeuh gamkhing a suahsak khitna hong en un."},"9":{"text":"Amah in leimong dongah gal beisak hi. Amah in thalpi kuaitanin teipi susia a, leengte mei tawh a haltum hi."},"10":{"text":"“Om hithiat unla, Pasian ka hihna thei un. Minamte lakah keimah hong kisangsak a, leitung khempeuhah ka min hong kithangsak hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Vanglian Topa, eite tawh hong omkhawm a, Jakob’ Pasian, eima belh ahi hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi khempeuh aw, na khut uh beeng un! Lungdamna la nakpi-in sa-in Pasian phat un.","title":"Pasian, Leitung Bup Kumpi Ahihna ah Minamkimte’ Lungdamna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa, a Sangpenpa, dipkuathuai a, leitung khempeuh a uk kumpi lian khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khempeuh eima nuai-ah, minamte i khenuai-ah amah in hong zawhsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama it Israel-te’ angtanpih eima luah ding leitang amah in hong teelsak hi."},"5":{"text":"Awging tawh Pasian paito a, peengkul aw tawh Topa paito hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian tungah phatna la sa un, phatna la sa un! I Kumpipa tungah phatna la sa un, phatna la sa un!"},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian pen leitung khempeuhte’ kumpi ahi hi. La sakna tawh amah phat un!"},"8":{"text":"Pasian in minamte uk a, a tokhom siangtho tungah Pasian tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Uliante le Abraham’ Pasian’ mite kipawl khawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung mite’ lumte khempeuh Pasian-a’ suak khinta a, amah a sangpi-in kithangsak hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa lian a, i Pasian’ khuapi sungah nakpitakin phat ding ahi hi.","title":"Zion a Hoihna le a Muanhuaina"},"2":{"text":"Kumpi lianpa’ khuapi, leilu lama a om ama mual siangtho hoihin a sang mahmah Zion mual pen leitung khempeuh’ lungdamna ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 5:35"},"3":{"text":"A muanhuai tua mualah amah a hu taktakpa ahihna Pasian in a lakkhin hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin, kumpite kikaikhawmin, a sim dingin hong kuankhawm uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in Zion a muh phetun lamdangsa mahmah uh a, dipkua vatin tai uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Numei nausuak na a sa bangin amaute linggawp uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Nisuahna huihpi tawh Tarshish kici teembaw liante nang na susia hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka zaksa bangun Vanglian Topa’ khuapi, i Pasian’ khuapi, Pasian in a phuhkip ngitngetna ka mu khin uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian aw, na biakinn sungah nangma itna kip ka ngaihsun uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian aw, na min in leimong dong a zelh bangin, nangmah hong kiphatna in zong a zel hi. Na taklam khut gualzawhna tawh a kidim hi."},"11":{"text":"Zion Mual lungdamsak in. Na thukhenna hangin Judah mite lungdamsak in."},"12":{"text":"Hih pen eima Pasian hi a, a tawntungin eima Pasian hi, ci-in khangkikte tungah na gen theih nadingun Zion kiimvelin pai-in, a tausang phazah sim unla, a kulh phungmai a hoih mahmahte ngaihsunin, a phualpi muanhuaite va nawk kim un. Amah pen a tawntungin lam hong lak ding pa ahi hi.","merge":"14"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thu za un, mi khempeuh aw! Ngai un, leitung a a teng khempeuh,","title":"Hauhna in Sihna Pengsak lo"},"2":{"text":"milian mineu, mihau mizawngte aw!"},"3":{"text":"Ka kam in pilna thu gen ding a, ka lungsim ngaihsutna kitelsiang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Paunak thu theihhak khat ka ngaihsun ding a, laiza lasakna tawh a khiatna ka gentel ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Haksat hun, hong bawlsiate’ gitlohna in hong nencip ciangin bang hangin lau ding ka hi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Mite in a hauhna uh muangin, tampi a neihna uh a kisaktheihpih hangun,"},"7":{"text":"amah le amah a kitankhia tawmzo taktak, a nuntakna man ding Pasian’ tungah a piazo mi kuamah om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a nuntakna tatna ding a man tam mahmah a, Leihawmpi mu ngei lo zah ding a hing tawntung dingin kitankhiazo ngei lo hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Amah in a pilte nangawn a si mu ding a, a haite le a tei lote a kibangin sia-in, amau’ neihsa khempeuh midangte’ tungah nusiat uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in leitangte amau’ min a puaksak uh hangin hankhuk pen khang tawntung amau’ omna hi ngitnget ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama hauhna-ah mi kipsuak thei lo a, a sithei ganhingte tawh a kibang lel ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih pen a kihai muante’ ngah hi a, amau’ ngahsa tawh a lungkimte’ thumong ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua bangin amaute Leinuai-a dingin kiseh hi. Sihna pen amau a cing pa hi ding hi. Hankhuk sungah amaute tuaksuksuak ding uh a, a mel uh sia ding a, Leinuai, amau’ inn hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian in Leinuai’ vangliatna panin kei hong honkhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in kei hong sang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh a hauh ciang ahi a, a innkuan minthanna a khan ciang ahi zongin lau-in lunghihmawh dingin ngaihsun tuan kei in."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a sih ciangin bangmah keng lo ding a, a minthanna in amah zuisuk lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A hin lai-in amah a lungdamin kingaihsunin, mi khat in ama a’ ding na a lim sep ciangin phatna a ngah hangin,"},"19":{"text":"khuavak a mu nawn lo dingin a si khinsa a pu a pate kiang mahah amah pai veve ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama hauhna in mi hing paisuaksak thei lo a, a sithei ganhingte tawh a kibang lel ahi hi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vanglian, Topa Pasian hong paukhia a, nisuahna le nitumna kikal leitung mi khempeuh a khawm hi.","title":"Pasian in Biakpiakna Sangin Gamtatna tawh Thu Khenzaw"},"2":{"text":"Hoih kicinna Zion panin Pasian hong taangkhia hi."},"3":{"text":"Eite’ Pasian hong pai a, amah dai ommawk lo hi. Ama mai-ah mei husia om a, a kimkotah huihpi om hi."},"4":{"text":"A mite tungah thu a khen theih nadingin tunglam vantung le leitung a sam hi."},"5":{"text":"“Biakpiakna tawh, kei tungah thuciamna a bawlte, ka mi citakte ka kiangah hong khawm un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantung in ama thumanna gen hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian mahmah thukhen pa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka mite aw, ngai un; thu ka hong gen ding hi. Israel-te aw, note’ langkhatah teci ka pang ding hi. Kei pen Pasian ka hi a, nomau’ Pasian ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Na biakpiakna uhah note kong mawhsak kei hi. Na meihal biaknate uh ka mai-ah om ngitnget hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin na inn pan uha bawngtal hitaleh na ganbuk pan uha keeltal hitaleh ka hong sang kei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlak ganhingte khempeuh, mual tul tampite tunga a om ganhingte keima-a’ ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Huih lak vasate khempeuh keimah in ka thei a, gamlak a gamta khempeuh keima-a’ ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ka gil kial taleh zong note kiang panin an kong ngen kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh leitung le a sunga om khempeuh keima-a’ ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Bawngtalte’ sa ne ding a, keelte’ sisan dawn ding ka hi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Lungdam biakpiakna Pasian tungah pia unla, Sangpenpa tungah na thuciamnate uh bawl un."},"15":{"text":"Haksat hun ciangin keima tungah hong ko un. Note kong honkhia ding a, note in keima min nong thangsak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin migilote tungah Pasian in thu gen a, “Ka thukhamte lawhna ding ka thuciamna na muk uh tawh genna ding thu nei na hi uh hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh hilh ding na ut kei uh a, ka thute na nunglam uhah na paai uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Guta khat mu le-uhcin ama lawm na hi pah uh a, a paktat mite tawh na kikhawl uh hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na kam uh, siatna na uksak uh a, na leii un khemna a khangsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Na sanggamte uh langpangin thu na gen uh a, amaute’ mawhna na zong uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh na gamta khin uh a, bangmah ka pau kei hi. Kei pen no tawh a kibangin nong ngaihsunkha uh hi. Ahih hangin tu-in note ka hong taii a, na mawhna uh na mai uhah ka koih hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Pasian a mangngilh mite aw, hih thu ciamteh un. Tua hikeileh note kong balgawp ding hi. Note hong honkhia ding kuamah om lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Biakpiak nadingin lungdam piakna hong paipih mi in kei a hong pahtawi ahi hi. Ka thu a mang mite khempeuh ka honkhia ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, nangma itna kip om bangin kei hong hehpih inla, na hehpihna lian om bangin ka thu palsatnate hong phiatkhiatsak in.","title":"Mawhmaina ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka khialhna panin hong silsiang kiuhkeuh inla, ka mawhna panin kei hong siangsak in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka thupalsatnate ka thei a, ka mawhnate khempeuh ka phawk ngitnget hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma tungah khialin, nangma muhna-ah a sia ka gamta khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin na thugenna-ah nang na thutang a, thu na hong khenna-ah pauna ding bangmah om lo hi.","ref":"Rom 3:4"},"5":{"text":"A khialsa mahin kei ka suak a, ka nu in a gil sungah hong paii tung a kipan a mawh sa ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang in nuntakna sungah thumanna na deih hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka lungsim tawngah ciimna hong hilh in."},"7":{"text":"Puknah tawh hong nul in; kei ka siang ding hi. Hong sil in; vuk sangin ka ngozaw ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungdamna le kipahna kei tungah hong pia inla, na hong sukgawp mipa hong lungdamsak in."},"9":{"text":"Ka mawhna khempeuh na mai panin seel inla, ka khialhna khempeuh hong phiatkhiatsak in."},"10":{"text":"Pasian aw, keima sungah lungsim siangtho hong piangsak inla, a thak a man ngaihsutna ka sungah hong guan in."},"11":{"text":"Nangma omna panin kei hong paaikhia kei inla, keima kiang panin na kha siangtho lakhia kei in."},"12":{"text":"Nong hotkhiatna hangin hong lungdamsakkik inla, utna lungsim tawh keimah hong huh ta in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin thupalsatte na zia na tong ka hilh ding a, nangma lamah mimawhte hong kiheikik ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei a hong hon Pasian aw, sih nading panin kei hong honkhia in. Nong hotkhiatna thu lungdam takin ka sa ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa aw, ka pau theih nadingin kei hong huh in; nangmah ka hong phat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ganhing tawh biakna na deih kei hi. Meihal biakna hong pia hita leng zong, na lungdam kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian’ san theih biakna pen lungsim kitamzan ahi hi. Pasian aw, a kitamzan, a kisik lungsim na simmawh kei ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na lungkimna pha tawh Zion tungah a pha bawl inla, Jerusalem kulhpite ciangkik ta in."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakpiakna man, meihal biakna le meihal biakpiakna bupah na lungkim ding a, na biakna tau tungah bawngtalte hong kipia ding hi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi thahatpa aw, bang hangin miphate suksiatna-ah kisial na hi hiam? Sunthapai-in, suksiatna na ngaihsunsun hi.","title":"Gilo a Kisialhna Kitai"},"2":{"text":"Zuau nasempa aw, na leii a hiam pha mahmah mulkiatna tem tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Hoihna sangin siatna na deihzaw a, thuman genna sangin zuauna na deihzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi a khem thei pa aw, a siasak thei kammal khempeuh deih belin na nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in nang hong susia paisuak ding hi. Amah in nang hong bawhin na buk sung panin hong kaikhia ding a, a hingte’ leitang panin hong zunglot ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Thuman mite in nang hong mu-in, lau mahmah ding uh a, nang hong nuihsanin,"},"7":{"text":"“Pasian a bel lo, ama hauhnate a muang, ama hauhna a bel pa en un,” hong ci ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei ka hih leh Pasian’ innsunga a om oliv kung a hing tawh ka kibang hi. Pasian’ itna kip ka muang ngitnget hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih bangin keimah hong bawlkhin na hih manin nangma tungah ka lungdam ngitnget ding hi. Thuhoih ahih manin miphate omna-ah nangma min ka taangko ding hi."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihai in a lungsim sungah, “Pasian om lo hi,” ci-in ngaihsun hi. Amaute sia uh hi. A kihhuai-in gamta uh a, a hoihin a gamta kuamah om lo hi.","title":"Mite’ Haina le Gitlohna (La 14:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"A pil, Pasian a zong mi a om uh hiam, cih a theih nadingin Pasian in vantung panin mihingte hong ensuk hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute khempeuh a vekpi-un pukkhin uh hi. A kibangin kisia kim uh a, a hoihin a gamta khat beek om lo hi.","ref":"Rom 3:10-12"},"4":{"text":"Pasian tungah thu a ngen lo, an nek bangin ka mite a netum, siatna a bawlte in thu theihtelna nei lo ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Cikmahin tua bang launa a om ngei lo, launa lianpi sungah amaute om uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in migilote’ guhte thehthang ding hi. Pasian in amaute nial ahih manin, amaute maizumin kikoih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Zion panin Israel-te a’ ding hotkhiatna hong tunna ding thu ka ngenngen hi. Pasian in ama mite tungah nopsakna a piakkik ciangin, ama mi Israel-te kipak mahmah ding uh hi."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, na thahatna tawh kei hong honkhia inla, na vangliatna tawh ka dikna hong kilangsak in.","title":"Galte pan Hotkhiat ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka thungetna hong za inla, ka kampaute hong ngai in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi kiphasakte in kei hong langpang uh a, mi helhhawtte in thah dingin hong zong uh hi. Amaute in Pasian thudon lo uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian, kei hong huhpa hi a, Topa, kei hong hupa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in ka galte siatna tawh thuk ding hi. Na thumanna tawh kizui-in amaute sumai in."},"6":{"text":"Utna lungsim tawh biakpiakna kong pia ding a, nang hoih na hih manin, nangma tungah lungdamna kong ko ding hi, Topa aw."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh haksatna khempeuh panin kei nong honkhia khin a, ka galte a guallelhna keimah in ka mu khin ta hi."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka thungetna hong ngai inla, ka hong thumna panin nangmah bu kei in.","title":"Suahtaksakna ding le Mi khemte Suksiat ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Keima lam hong nga inla, ka hong ngetna hong pia in. Ka lungsim gimna in kei hong zogawp ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Migilote’ sukcipna, galte’ huging in kei hong gimsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in keima tungah haksatna hong tun uh a, hehna tawh keimah hong galbawl ding amaute in nuamsa uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka sungah ka lungsim na mahmah a, sih ding launate kei tungah hong tungzo hi."},"5":{"text":"Launa le linna ka tungah hong tung a, launa in hong vukcip hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih bangin ka ci hi: “Vakhu bangin kha nei hi leng! Ka leengkhia ding a, nuamtakin ka om hithiat ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Gamla pekah ka vakthap ding a, gam sungah ka giak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gensiatna huihpi le huih husiate panin bukna ka zong pak ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, amau’ geelnate suksiat sakin a pau uh kilamdangsak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh khua sungah ngongtatna le kam kiselna ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute sun le zanin kulhpi tungah kot paipai uh a, khua sungah siatna le ngongtatnate om a, mite lakah lungkhamna om hi."},"11":{"text":"Sumzuak sumleina mun panin kisukcipna le kikhemnate veng lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei hong phin galte hi lo hi. Hi leh ka thuakzo ding hi. Kiphatsakna tawh kei hong bawlte, langpang mi hi lo hi. Hi leh ama kiang panin ka bu thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin ka kikimpih, ka kikholhpih, ka lawm theih mahmah, nangmah na hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Kam khum tawh i kihoho ngei a, Pasian’ inn sungah i kikhawl khawm ngei hi."},"15":{"text":"Amau’ tungah sihna tungsak in. Leinuai-ah a hingtangin amaute paisuk sak inla, amaute launa lianpi tawh a han uhah paisak in."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in Pasian’ tungah ka ko a, Topa in kei hong hon ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nitak, zingsang, le sunin ka gimna leh ka thumnate ama tungah ka gen a, amah in keima thumna aw, hong za ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in ka galsimna sungah kei hong kem ding a, a muanhuai munah kei hong koih ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah a hong do dingin mi tampi tak kigual deudau uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tanglai pek panin kumpi-in a kikoih Pasian in za-in amaute niamkhiat ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in thukham zui lo uh a, Pasian zahtak lo uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka kikholhpih ngei mi in a lawmte langpangin sugawp a, a thuciamna palsat hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama kampau, thawhbat sangin nelzaw a, ahi zongin a lung sungah muhdahna om hi. A kammalte sathau sangin nipzaw a, ahi zongin tuate pen namsau hiam mahmah tawh kibang hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa tungah na vangik nga in, amah in hong huh ding hi. Amah in mi thumante kilingsak ngei lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian aw, dum thuk penna munah amaute na lawnsuk ding a, mi thatte le mi khemte pen amau nuntak ding zah lang hing lo ding uh hi. Ahih hangin keimah in nang ka hong muang ding hi."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, mite in kei hong tuancil ahih manin kei hong hehpih in. Sunthapai-in galte in kei hong sucip hi.","title":"Muanna tawh Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Sunthapai-in ka galte in kei hong tuancil uh a, kiphatsakna tawh mi tampi in kei hong do hi."},"3":{"text":"Kei ka lau ciangin nangmah ka hong muang hi."},"4":{"text":"A thu ka phat Pasian’ sungah, lunghihmawhna khat zong nei hetloin Pasian ka muang hi. Mihing ahi lelte in kei, bang hong cihzo ding ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Amaute in ka vai siatsak ding sunthapai-in hanciam uh a, amau’ ngaihsutnate khempeuh keima siatna ding ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute kikaikhawmin keimah hong buk uh a, ka gamtatna khempeuh hong encik uh hi. Amaute in keimah thah ding a hanciam uh bangin,"},"7":{"text":"amau’ khialhna hangin amaute thuk in. Pasian aw, hehna tawh tua mite lawnkhiasuk in."},"8":{"text":"Ka sin linnate khempeuh nangmah in na ciamteh khin hi. Ka khituite khempeuh na thawl sungah thun in. Tuate na laibu sungah kiciamteh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin, keimah in kong koh ni peuh ciangin ka galte nungkik ding hi. Pasian pen keima-a’ ahihna ka thei hi."},"10":{"text":"A thu ka phat Pasian’ sungah, a thu ka phat Topa’ sungah,"},"11":{"text":"lunghihmawhna khat zong nei hetloin Pasian ka muang hi. Mihing lellelte in kei, bang hong cihzo ding ahi uh hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Pasian aw, nang tungah ka kiciamna ka zuih kul hi. Nangma tungah lungdamna kong thuk hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna panin nong honkhia khin hi. Pasian’ mai, nuntakna khuavak sungah ka pai theih nadingin ka khe a taalna ding panin na hong honkhia hi."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei hong hehpih in Pasian aw, nang hong bel ka hih manin kei hong hehpih in. Siatna huihpi a ven’ mateng na kha liimah kong bu ding hi.","title":"Pasian’ Hut ding Lungmuangin Ngetna (La 108:1-5)"},"2":{"text":"A Sangpen Pasian’ tungah, keima deihna a hong tungsak Pasian’ tungah ka ko hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in vantung panin keimah hong dawngin hong honkhia ding a, amah in kei hong tuancilte maizumin a koih ding hi. Pasian in ama itna kip le a thumanna hong lak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Huaihamna tawh mihing a netum, humpinelkai tawh a kibang mite’ lakah ka om hithiat hi. Leitung khempeuhah na minthanna omsak in."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in keima khe, thang hong siah uh a, lungkhamin hong koih uh hi. Zingsang khuavak hong phong ning."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, mite lakah lungdam kong ko ding a, minamte lakah nangmah phatna ka sa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na itna kip in vantung ban a, na thumanna in meiipi banto hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian aw, vantungah na liatna kilangsak in. Leitung khempeuhah na minthanna omsak in."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No gam ukte aw, a manin thu na khen uh hiam? A suah tung mahun lam khial pah uh a, zuauthu gen uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in gulpi’ gu bang gu nei uh a, a khiimte’ aw ahi a, a zol siamte’ aw ahi zongin bangmah a za het lo, gul bilngong tawh kibang uh hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Pasian aw, amau’ kam sunga a om a hate uh sutan inla, humpinelkai khanglai hatu-te botkhia in, Topa aw."},"7":{"text":"Tui luangkhiate bangin amaute mangthangsak inla, lopa bangin amaute kituancil gawpin keutumsak in."},"8":{"text":"Amaute a naai a bei toktol, a hun cing loin a suak, ni a mu ngei lote bangsak in."},"9":{"text":"Na beelte in lingkung kuang sa a sak ma-in, a hing a keu-in amah in phiatkhia mang hen."},"10":{"text":"Heh thukna a muh ciangin thuman mipa lungdam ding a, migilote’ sisan sungah amah in a khete sil ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mite in, “Thuman mi a’ ding noptuamna om taktak a, leitung thu a khen Pasian khat om taktak hi,” ci ding uh hi."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, ka galte’ kiang panin keimah hong honkhia in. Kei a hong langpangte panin kei hong dal in.","title":"Galte pan Hotkhiat ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Siatna a bawlte’ kiang panin hong suaktasak inla, mi that nuamte’ kiang panin keimah hong hon in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kei hong pangsim uh a, a kihtakhuai mite keimah hong langpangin kikaikhawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh, “Kua’n hong za ding hiam?” ci-in amaute in ngaihsun uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, ahih hangin nang in amaute na nuihsan lel a, minam khempeuh na zahpih hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka thahatna aw, nangmah phatna ka sa ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka Pasian aw, ka munkip muanhuai na hi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka Pasian in ama itna kip tawh keimah hong dawn ding a, ka Pasian in gualzawhna tawh ka galte hong en sak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute that kei in; that lecin ka mite in mangngilh ding hi. Na vangliatna tawh amaute kilokgawp sak inla, amaute niamkhiat in, Topa, kote hong hupa aw."},"12":{"text":"Amau’ kama a mawhna a muk uh tawh a pauna hangin, amau’ kiphatsakna-ah amau mah awksak in. Tua hileh Pasian in Israel-te tungah leimong dongin a uk khitna thu mi khempeuh in thei ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Nitak simin amaute hong paikik zelzelin ui bangin ku uh a, khuasung tengah vak khuankhuan uh hi."},"15":{"text":"An zong dingin vak kawikawi uh a, a kham uh ngah kei leh humham uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in na vangliatna la ka sa ding a, zingsangin na itna kip phatna la nakpitakin ka sa ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian aw, nang pen ka munkip muanhuai, keima tungah itna kip a hong lak Pasian na hi hi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, kote na hong nilkhia khin a, ka panmunte uh na sukham mang khin hi. Kote ka ngei uh hong bangsakkik ta in.","title":"Gal Lelhna-ah Thumna le Huh ding Ngetna (La 108:6-13)"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah in lei na lingsak khin a, lei na khangkhamsak khin hi. Amah pen i galte hong sikcipsak ding pa ahi hi."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka kikona aw hong za inla, ka thungetna hong ngai in.","title":"Pasian’ Hut ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungsim a neu ciangin, leimong panin nang kong sam hi. Keimah sangin a sangzaw suangpi tungah hong paipih in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang, keima bukna na hi a, galte’ langah tausang muanhuai na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na buk sungah hong omsak tawntung inla, nangma khate’ hutna sungah lungmuangin hong omsak in."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian aw, ka thuciamnate khempeuh nangmah in na za khin a, nangmah a hong zahtak mite’ ngah dingte keimah nong pia khinta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa khantosak inla, khang tawntungin nungtasak in."},"7":{"text":"Pasian’ mai-ah amah om ngitnget hen la, ama itna kip le a thumanna in amah kem tahen."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin nisimin ka thuciamnate bangin gamta-in, na min phatna ka sasa ding hi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dai dide-in Pasian bek ka ngak a, ama hong hotkhiat ding muangin ka om hi.","title":"Pasian’ Hut ding Muanna"},"2":{"text":"Kei hong huhpa le hong honpa amah bek hi a, ka guallel ngei kei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Note khempeuh in kawm a hoi tawh a kibang, gawl bangin a kiling mi khat a susia dingin bang tanvei hih huan nilohin, susia ding na hi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Amah a zaliatna panin sukniam ding bekbek amaute in a sawm uh hi. Amaute in thuman lo-ah nuamsa mahmah uh hi. Amaute in a kampi uh tawh phat khem uh a, ahih hangin a sungtawng uhah samsiat uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah bek ka muan ahih manin, daitakin Pasian bek ka ngak hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei hong hupa le hong honpa amah bek mah hi a, ka guallel ngei kei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima suahtakna le ka minphatna Pasian’ hang ahi hi. A muanhuai ka belh pa, ka bukna Pasian ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Mite aw, amah muang tawntung unla, na lungkhamna teng uh ama tungah gen un. Pasian, eite’ bukna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihingte ahihleh husan’ bang bek hi a, a lian a neu kibang lel hi. Tawi a kikhai ciangin amaute in leek lo uh a, amaute a kigawmin husan’ sangin zangzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Zawhthawh thu tawh ngahna muanin nei kei inla, suhgawpnate lametin nei kei in. Na hauhna a khan leh, tuate muanin nei kei in."},"11":{"text":"Vangliatna pen keima a’ hi, ci-in Pasian in a genna ka zak ngeingeisa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, itna kip nangma a’ ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a sepna bang ciatin mite na thuk hi.","ref":"Job 34:11; Jer 17:10; Mat 16:27; Rom 2:6; Mang 2:23"}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, keima Pasian na hi hi. Nangmah kong zong a, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh nang kong deih hi. Tui om lohna gamkeu bangin ka pumpi bup in nang hong deih hi.","title":"Pasian Lunggulhna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih manin biakinn sungah nangmahmah le na vangliatna na minthannate kei hong musak in."},"3":{"text":"Nuntakna sangin nangma itna kip hoihzaw ahih manin nangmah ka hong phat ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka nuntak laiteng nang kong phat ding a, ka khutte hong laam to-in thu kong ngen ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka lupna tungah nangmah hong ngaihsunsunin, zanthapai-in kong lungngaihngaih ciangin guhngek le sathau ne bangin ka lung tai mahmah a, lungdam mahmahna tawh nangmah phatna la ka sa ding hi.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kei a hong huhpa na hi a, nangma hutna sungah lungdamin la ka sa hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah ka hong bel a, nangma taklam khut in keimah a hong len hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin thah dingin kei a hong zongte, lei thukpi sungah paisuk ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Gal sungah amaute si ding uh a, ngiate’ an suak ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ hangin kumpipa lungdam ding a, Pasian tawh thuciamna a nei khempeuhte zong minthang ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh zuauthu a gen kam khempeuh kihubing ding hi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka thumna aw hong za inla, gallauna panin kei hong kem in.","title":"Galte pan Hut ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Migilote’ sawmsimna, thusia bawlte’ vaihawmna,"},"3":{"text":"namsau taat bangin a leii uh a taatte, thaltang bangin thu hoih lo a ngimte,"},"4":{"text":"a buk simna panun mawhbaang lo mi a kapte, lau hetloin thakhatin amah a kapte’ kiang panin kei hong liah in."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in thusia bekbek ngaihsun niloh uh hi. Amaute in thangsiah sim ding gen uh a, “Eite kua in hong mu ding ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Eite’ mawhna kua in phawkzo ding ahi hiam? Siam mahmahna tawh i sawmsimna i vaihawm hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihingte’ sung thu le a lungsim ngaihsutna uh thuk mahmah hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian in a thaltang tawh amaute kapgawp ding a, amaute khempeuh thakhatin liam ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amau’ kampaunate hangin amaute siatna thuaksak ding a, amaute a mu khempeuh in a lu uh peisan ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khempeuh lau ding uh hi. Amaute in Pasian’ hihsa thute gengen ding uh a, ama hihsa nate khempeuh ngaihsunsun ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ nasepna hangin midikte lungdam ding uh a, amah a bel ding uh hi. Lungsim thutangte khempeuh in amah a phat ding uh hi."}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, Zion-ah nangmah phat dingin kilawm a, nangma tunga thuciamsate hong kitungsak ding hi.","title":"Leitang a Hoihsak Pasian Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Thungetna a zapa na hi a, mawhna hangin nangma kiangah mi khempeuh hong pai ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka mawhnate un kote hong zawh ciangin, nangmah in tuate na hong maisak hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma inn-ah a om dingin na teel na lakte mi nuamsa ahi hi. Nangma biakinn siangtho, na innsunga hoihna tawh kote ka lungkim ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi gamla pente le leimong khempeuhte’ lamet, kote a hong honkhia Pasian,"},"6":{"text":"a thahatna tawh mualte a bawl, vangliatna tawh a kidim,"},"7":{"text":"tuipi gingte, tuihualte, mi gamlumte a daisak pa aw,"},"8":{"text":"leimong peka omte in na hihna limte a kihtak nadingun a kihtakhuai gamtatna zangin, nong hotkhiatna tawh kote’ ngetna nong pia hi. Nisuahna le nitumna kikalah a om mi khempeuhte lungdamna tawh a awng dingin na bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in leitung enin, guah na hong zusak a, leitung a hoihna nakpitakin na behlap hi. Pasian’ gunpi tui tawh kidim a, leitungah an na piangsak hi. Tua bangin nangmah in na khempeuh na bawlkhol hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-ma-kuakte khempeuh tui tampi tak na buak a, leivumte zalhmai-in, guahtui tawh na nipsak a, a po kungte thupha na pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma hauhna tawh kum na phasak a, na leeng paina khempeuhah sathau a taak hi."},"12":{"text":"Ganhing tatna, a noptuak mahmah munte-ah ganhing honte omin, mualte khempeuh zong lungdamna tawh kidim a,"},"13":{"text":"gamlak lonona munte tuuhon tawh kizemin, kuampite an tawh kidim a, amaute lungdamin awngin la a sa khawm uh hi."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Pasian’ tungah lungdamna aw ging phasak un.","title":"Pasian’ Nasep A Lamdangte Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama minthanna sa unla, ama tungah minthanna pia un."},"3":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah thu gen unla, “Nangma bawlnate bangzahta-in dipkuathuai! Na vang lian mahmah ahih manin na mai-ah na galte in nang hong mai-et uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh in nangmah hong bia uh hi. Amaute in nangmah phatna la hong sak uh a, nangma minphatna la hong sak uh hi,” ci-in gen un."},"5":{"text":"Hong pai unla, Pasian’ sepsate mu un. Mite’ lak a a bawlnate-ah amah dipkuathuai hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in tuipi tui pen leikeu suaksak a, i pu i pate in a khe uh tawh tua tuipi na kantan uh hi. Tua bangin ama nasepna hangin eite i lungdam hi.","ref":"Pai 14:21; Josh 3:14-17"},"7":{"text":"Ama thahatna tawh a uk ngitnget pa, ama mit tawh minamte a encik ngitnget pa, mi lehdote in langpan’ kei uh hen."},"8":{"text":"Mite aw, a hingte lak a a hong kem pa, i khe a hong taalsak lopa, eite’ Pasian phat un. Amah phatna aw kizasak tawntung un.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian aw, kote na hong sin khin a, mei tawh ngun a kisin bangin kote na hong sin khin hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangmah in ngen sungah kote na hong tungsak a, ka nungzang uhah vangikpi na hong suan hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka galte uh nong tuancilsak a, tui le mei lauhuainate ka thuak uh hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in a tanzau munah kote nong paipih hi."},"13":{"text":"Meihal biaknate tawh nangma inn sungah kei ka hong pai ding hi. Ka lungkham laitakin ka muk pana a gingkhia, ka kama ka thuciamte nangma tungah ka hong pia ding hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Ganhing thaute tawh meihal biaknate, tuutal-a biakna khute tawh biakna kong pia ding a, bawngtalte le keelte tawh nangmah biakpiakna ka bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian a zahtakte khempeuh aw, hong pai unla, hong za un. Kei-a’ dinga ama bawlsate ka hong gen ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama tungah huhna ngenin nakpitakin ka kiko a, lasakna tawh amah ka phat hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka lung sungah mawhna kem leng, Topa in keima thu hong ngai lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian in, keima thu hong ngai khin taktak a, keima thungetna aw, hong don khinzo hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in keima thungetna hong nolh loin, keima kiang panin a itna kip lakhia lo ahih manin Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen!"}}},"67":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian in eite hong hehpihin thupha hong pia hen la, eite khempeuh tungah a mai hong taangsak tahen.","title":"Lungdam Kohna La"},"2":{"text":"Leitungah nangma deihna, minam khempeuhte lakah na vanglian hotkhiatna kithei tahen."},"3":{"text":"Pasian aw, mi khempeuh in nangmah hong phat hen la, mi khempeuh in nangmah hong pahtawi tahen."},"4":{"text":"Mite’ thu a manin khenin, leitung minamte khempeuh lamlakin makai na hih manin, minamte nuamin lungdamna la hong sak ta uh hen."},"5":{"text":"Pasian aw, mi khempeuh in nangmah hong phat hen la, mi khempeuh in nangmah hong pahtawi tahen."},"6":{"text":"Leitang in ama hauhna gahkhia khinta a, Pasian, eima Pasian in eite thupha hong pia khin hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian in eite thupha hong pia khin hi. Leimong dong mi khempeuhte in amah zahtak uh hen."}}},"68":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian hong kipan hen la, ama galte kithehthangsak hen. Amah a mudahte ama mai-ah tai uh hen.","title":"Pasian’ Gualzawh La"},"2":{"text":"Meikhu leengkhia bangin amaute a hawlkhia ding hi. Mei mai-ah khuainun a tui bangin Pasian’ mai-ah migilote siamang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin midikte lungdam ding hi. Pasian’ mai-ah nuamin diang ding uh a, amaute lungdam mahmahin awng-awng ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah la sa unla, ama min phatna la sa un. Meiite tungah a tuang pa la sak un. Ama min pen Topa ahi hi; ama mai-ah lungdamin diang un!"},"5":{"text":"Pa nei lote’ pa le meigong numeite a hupa pen, a siangtho mahmah ama omna-ah a om Pasian ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in a cimawhte a tenna ding innlelo guan a, thongkia mite nopsakna munah a tunpih hi. Ahih hangin mi lehdote ahihleh keugaw gamah teng uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian aw, nangma mite mai-ah na kuankhiat ciang, gamlak nawkin na pai ciangin,"},"8":{"text":"nangmah Pasian na om manin lei kiling gawpin vantungte in guah a zusak hi. Pasian ahi, Israel Pasian’ omna-ah Sinai mual nangawn a kiling gawp hi.","ref":"Pai 19:18"},"9":{"text":"Pasian aw, na luah mite vulgawp uh ahih manin guah tampi zusakin na nosuaksakkik hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma mihonte in tua sungah omna ding mu uh hi. Pasian aw, nangma hoihna tawh a cimawh mite’ kisapna a kicingin na guan hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in thu pia hi: Hih thu a pua mihonte tam mahmah uh a,"},"12":{"text":"“Kumpipa’ galkapte tai uh!” ci uh hi. Inn-a om nupite in galte’ van a kisutte hawm uh a, tua vante pen"},"13":{"text":"ngun tawh a kizut vakhu limte hi a, a khate kham tawh kizut hi. Bang hangin note pawlkhat, tuukhawk sungah mawk om na hi uh hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Vanglianpa in tua gam panin kumpite a nawhkeek ciangin Zalmon mualtungah vuk a kia tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"Aw mual lianpi, Bashan mual, aw mual dawnzum tampi a nei Bashan mual!"},"16":{"text":"Dawnzum tampi a nei mual aw, Pasian in ama om nadingin a deih mual Pasian’ om tawntungna ding mun bang hangin simmawh et na hi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Leeng muanhuai tul sawmnih, vantungmi a tultul tawh, Sinai mual pan siangtho munah Topa hong pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa nangmah Pasian tua munah na om theih nadingin a sangna-ah kahto-in salte na paipih a, mihonte le mi lehdote’ tung nangawn panin piakkhong nate na ngah hi.","ref":"Efe 4:8"},"19":{"text":"Nisimin eite a dingin a hong thuaksak Topa in thupha ngah tahen. Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen!"}}},"69":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, hong hon in! Na hotkhiat ding a utte in, “Pasian lian hi,” cici tahen."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei zawngin ka cimawh hi. Pasian aw, hong manlang in. Nang pen keimah huhpa le hong honkhia pa na hi hi. Topa aw, hong zekai kei in."}}},"71":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang kong bel hi. Kei hong zahhuaisak kei in.","title":"Puteek khat’ Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Na thumanna tawh kei hong huh inla, hong honkhia in. Keima lamah na bil hong ngat inla, hong hon in."},"3":{"text":"Hong hon dingin ka belh suangpi, ka kulh muanhuai, hong hi ta in; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah hong honpa le ka belh pa na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, migilote’ khutsung pan le thuman lo mite le migilote’ matna panin keimah hong hon in."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian aw, ka neu lai a kipanin ka hong lamet, ka hong muan na hi hi, Topa aw."},"6":{"text":"Ka suah tung a kipanin nangmah kong bel a, ka nu’ gil sung panin hong lakhia pa na hi hi. Nangmah ka hong phat ngitnget hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi tampite a dingin a siahil bang ka hih hangin nang pen a muanhuai, keima belh na hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Sunthapai-in nangmah ka hong phat a, na minthanna ka gen tawntung hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka teek hun ciangin kei hong lawnkhia kei inla, ka tha a kiat ciangin kei hong nusia kei in."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka galte kihoho-in, keimah hong thahnopna thu kikumkum uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Pasian in amah nusiazo a, amah a hon ding kuamah om lo ahih manin, amah delhin man ni,” kici uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasian aw, kei kiang panin gamla om kei in. Ka Pasian aw, keimah a huh dingin hong manlang in."},"13":{"text":"Kei hong mawhsakte zahhuai-in beimang uh hen la, keima siatna ding a zongte simmawhna le minsiatna in tuamcip tahen."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin ke’n, nang kong lamen ding a, nangmah kong phat semsem lai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Thuman tawh na hotkhiatna na nasepnate simzawh lohin tam ahih manin sunthapai-in ka gengen ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa Pasian aw, na nasep liante ka phat ding a, na thumanna bek genin ka nei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka khangno lai a kipanin nong thuhilh a, a lamdang na nasepnate ka gengen lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Pasian aw, hong piang lai ding mite khempeuh tungah nangma hatna thu ka gen khit matengin, teekin ka sam a kang zongin kei hong nusia kei in."},"19":{"text":"Pasian aw, na vangliatna le na thumanna in van sangpite banto hi. Nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Gimna lianpipi a hong tuaksak nangmah in kei nong hingkiksak ding a, lei thukpi sung panin nong lakhiato ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Nangmah in ka min hoihna nong khangsak ding a, nong hehnem kik ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, na thumannate hangin kei zong harp lasakna tawh nangmah kong phat ding hi. Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa aw, laiza lasakna tawh nangmah phatna ka sa ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Nangmah phatna ka sak ciangin nuamin ka awng ding a, na hong hotkhiatna hangin ka lungsim khempeuh tawh hi."}}},"72":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, nangma thutang, kumpipa hilh inla, nangma thuman, kumpi tapa hilh in.","title":"Thuman Kumpipa’ Ukna"},"2":{"text":"Amah in thumanna tawh na mite tungah thu khen hen la, na mizawngte tungah thu a tangin khen tahen."},"3":{"text":"Mual liante le mual neute in thumanna tawh na mite a dingin nopna tampi piangsak tahen."},"4":{"text":"Amah in mizawngte a’ pawn lak lopa tungah a kia guah, lei a kawtsak guahzu tawh kibang tahen."},"7":{"text":"Ama hun sungin thuman pung hen la, khapi a bei mateng nopna om tahen."},"8":{"text":"Ama ukna, tuipi khat pan sem ta uh hen."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi cimawhte in a koh ciangin amah in honkhia a, mizawng, a huh ding a om lote amah in a honkhia hi."},"13":{"text":"A thakiam, a cimawh mite amah in hehpih a, mi cimawhte’ nuntakna amah in a honkhia hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in amaute pammaihsa ahih manin netniamna le ngong hihna panin amaute a honkhia hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah a khansau hen la, Ama hangin mite in thupha ngah hen la, minam khempeuh in amah pen thupha ngah pa, ci ta uh hen."},"18":{"text":"Na lamdangte a bawl amah bek ahi Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah tahen."},"19":{"text":"A minthang ama min in thupha ngah tawntung hen la, ama minthanna tawh leitung khempeuh kidim tahen. Amen! Amen!"},"20":{"text":"Jessi’ tapa David’ thungetnate a beita ahi hi."}}},"73":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite bangin a lungsim a siangtho a thutang mite tungah Pasian hoih takpi hi.","title":"BU THUMNA (La 73-89) Migilote’ Daupaina: Amaute’ Mong le Midikte’ Mong Etkakna"},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei ka hih leh ka khe kisuipuk dektak a, ka khe taal dektak hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote’ daupaina ka muh ciangin mi kihisakte ka eng hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in nat velvalna bangmah thuak lo uh a, a pumpi uh cidamin zol hilhial hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in midangte bangin haksatna thuak lo uh a, amaute in midangte bangin gimna ngah lo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in khainiang bangin kiphatsakna ok uh a, puan bangin ngongtatna silh uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A lungsim panun gitlohna pusuaksak uh a, a ngaihsutna uh gitlohna tawh a dimlet hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in mi thusim loin el pau uh a, kiliatsakna tawh a sucip dingin mi a tawng uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute’ gensiatna in vantung dong banto a, kiliatsakna tawh leitungah thu gen kawikawi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mite in amaute phat uh a, amau’ mawhna zong lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in, “Pasian in bangci theih ding ahi hiam? Sangpenpa in phawk ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute migilo ahi uh hi. A tawntungin nuamtakin om hithiat uh a, amaute a hauhna uh khang semsem zaw lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka lungsim siangsak a, mawhna ka bawl loh hangin a phattuamna om tuan lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sunthapai-in gimna ka thuak a, zingsang simin hong kithuhilh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-a bangin thu a gen hi leng, nangma mite tungah a thutak lo ka suak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin hih thu a bangci hiam, ci-in ka ngaihsut ciangin kei a dingin a lunggimhuai mahmah nasep khat hong suak a,"},"17":{"text":"Pasian’ biakinn sungah ka pai ciangin a thutawpna dongte ka tel hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangmah in amaute mun nalna-ah na koih takpi ding a, a sia dingin amaute na tuksak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tomno sungin amaute kisusia-in, lau mahmahna in amaute nilkhiamang ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute pen zan a mangmat tawh kibang lel a, na khanlawh ciangin amaute a bangci pian hiam, ci-in na phawk nawn kei hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka lung khamin ka lungsim hong nat ciangin,"},"22":{"text":"keimah hai-in bangmah ka thei kei a, nangma mai-ah ganhing tawh ka kibang hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah tawh ka omkhawm ngitnget a, ka khut taklamin kei na hong len hi."},"24":{"text":"Thulahna tawh keimah nong makaih a, a nung ciangin minthanna munah na hong tunpih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Nang simloh vantungah kua nei ka hi hiam? Nang simloh ka deih ding leitungah kuamah om lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka lungsim le ka pumpi zawngkhal kha ding a, ahih hangin Pasian pen ka lungsim hatna le keima a’ hi tawntung ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang tawh a kigamlate kisia ding uh a, nangma tungah a hong khialte na beisak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei a dingin Pasian’ kiangah om ding a hoih ahi hi. Na sepnate khempeuh ka gentheih nadingin Topa Pasian ka hong bel hi."}}},"74":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, bang hangin kote hong paaikhia paisuak na hi hiam? Bang hangin na gam sunga om nangma tuute tungah heh na hi hiam?","title":"Galte in Gam sung Siasak: Pasian’ Hotkhiat ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Tanglai-in na ngahsa na mihonte, nangma luah minam dingin na tatkhiatsate phawk in! Na tennasa Zion Mual hong phawk in."},"3":{"text":"A sia densa munah hong pai in. Na biakinn sunga om khempeuh galte in susia khinta hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma galte mun siangtho laizangah awng uh a, amau’ dialte gualzawhna lim dingin a khai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute pen tulak sing phatna-ah pai-in heipi tawh sing a phuk bang uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinn na a kizemte khempeuh sek-hei le sekpi tawh a satkham uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in mei tawh na biakinn hal uh a, nangmah hong kibiakna mun a susia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in, “A vekpi-in zo mang khin ni,” kici uh a, gam sung tenga om Pasian biakna inn khempeuh mei tawh a hal uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Kote in ka mailam thu ding uh ka thei kei uh hi.
