Nangmah in ni le kha na bawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung gamgi khempeuhte le phalbi hun le khuakhal hunte na bawl khin hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa aw, galte in nang hong thusim lohna le, dawibia mite in nangma min a hong simmawhna hong phawk ta in."},"19":{"text":"A cimawh mite a gal gilote uh khut sungah nusia kei inla, bawlsiatna a thuak mite mangngilh kei in."},"20":{"text":"Nangma thuciamna hong pi ngaihsut in; bang hang hiam cih leh leitung mun mialna khempeuh mi ngongtatte tawh kidim hi."},"21":{"text":"A kisikcip mite zahhuaisak kei inla, mizawng le mi cimawhte nangma min kiphatsak in."},"22":{"text":"Pasian aw, tho inla, nangma thu-ah hong pang in. Dawibia mite in sun tawntungin nang a hong thusim lohna hong phawk ta in!"},"23":{"text":"Nangma galte’ kikona aw, nang a hong langpangte a gamlum semsemna mangngilh kei ta in."}}},"75":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, nangma tungah ka lungdam mahmah uh a, nangma tungah ka nuam mahmah uh hi. Nangma liatna thu ka gen uh a, a lamdang na bawlnate ka sut kikkik uh hi.","title":"Pasian in Thu a Manin A Khenna"},"2":{"text":"A hun ka sehsa ni ciangin thu a manin ka khen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitung le a tunga tengte khempeuh a kilin’ ciangin a khuampite a kipsak pa keimah ka hi hi."},"4":{"text":"A kiphasakte tungah, “Kiphasak kei un,” a gilote tungah, “Kihisak kei un."},"5":{"text":"Kihisak kei unla, kiphatsakna tawh kampau kei un,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh vangliatna pen nisuahna lam ahi a, nitumna lam ahi a, gamlak pan ahi zongin a hong pai hi lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing khat a sangsak, mihing khat a niamsak thukhen pa pen Pasian ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ khut sungah leenggahzu a phuan, a kihelkim ngingei hai khat om a, amah in tua sung panin hong bungkhia ding a, leitung migilo khempeuh in a tawdat dong takin a liaktum ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin kei ahihleh ka lungdam ngitnget ding a, Jakob Pasian’ tungah phatna late ka sa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote’ vangliatna khempeuh amah in susia ding a, ahih hangin thuman mite’ vangliatna khang semsem ding hi."}}},"76":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah gam sungah Pasian kithei a, Israel gam sungah ama min lian hi.","title":"Zion-ah Pasian’ Liatna"},"2":{"text":"Zion khua sungah ama tenna mun kibawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in tua lai-ah thaltangte, lum, namsau, le galhiamte a kuaitan hi."},"4":{"text":"A om ngitnget mual liante sangin na min thangzaw a, na lianzaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A thahatte’ neihsa nate kisutkhia a, amaute ihmucip suak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Jakob’ Pasian aw, nangma thuhilhna hangin sakol le a tung tuang pa khawlcip uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin nang na kihtakhuai mahmah hi. Na heh khit phot ciangin nangma mai-ah kua ding ngam nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Vantung panin thukhenna na genkhia hi. Gimna a thuak leitung mi khempeuh a hon dingin thukhen dingin Pasian a kipat ciangin leitung lau mahmahin tang hetloin a om khikhe hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Mihingte’ hehna in nang hong kiphatna ding piangsak ding a, na hehna panin a suakta mite in nangmah pahtawina pawi a bawl ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa na Pasian’ tungah na thuciamnate uh pia unla, tuate khempeuh zui un. Leitung kumpite sangin a kihtakhuai zaw, uliante’ lungsim a niamkhiat, zahtak ding ahipa’ tungah, ama kiimah a om mi khempeuhte in letsong puak ta uh hen!","merge":"12"}}},"77":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah a gingin ka kiko khia a, a hong zaktheih nadingin a gingin ka kiko hi.","title":"Lungkham Ciangin Kihehnepna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungkham hunin keimah in Topa ka zong hi. Zanin thu ngenin gim hetloin ka khut ka zan a, ahi zongin hehnepna ka ngah kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Keimah in Pasian ka ngaihsun a, ka tautau hi. Lung ka geelgeel a, ka gim mahmah hi."},"4":{"text":"A ihmu lo dingin kei na hong bawl a, lungkham lua-in ka pau thei kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Hun luite ka ngaihsun a, sawtpek lai-a kumte ka phawk hi."},"6":{"text":"Zanthapai-in ka lungsimah ka kihoho a, lung geelgeelin thu ka kan ciangin:"},"7":{"text":"“Topa in hong nial paisuakin, kei tungah maipha hong piakik lo ding hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Ama itna kip bei paisuakin, ama thuciamte maimang suak ding hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Pasian in hehpihna a neih ding mangngilh khinta ahi hiam? Ama hehna in hehpihnate vukcip khin ahi hiam?” ka ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua bang ahihleh, “Sangpenpa’ hat nawn lohna pen ka khakham veina ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa’ sepnate ka lungsimah ka phawk ding a, hun lui lai-a nangma na lamdangte ka ciamteh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma nasepna khempeuh ka lungngaingai ding a, nangma sep na liante ka ngaihsunsun ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian aw, nangma lampi siangtho hi. Eima Pasian tawh kibangin bang pasian lian ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Nang pen na lamdangte a bawl, minam dangte’ lakah na vangliatna a langkhiasak khin Pasian na hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah in na vangliatna tawh Jakob le Josef’ suante, na mite na honkhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tui in nang hong muh ciangin Pasian aw, tuite in nang hong muh ciangin a lau uh hi. Tui thukpi zong a ling hi."},"17":{"text":"Meiipite in tui sungkhia-in, vante ging damdam a, nangma thaltangte mun citengah a leeng uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Na vanging lianpi pingpei sungah omin, khuaphialepte in leitung taan a, leitang linggawpin a kising damdam hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma lamlianpi tuipi tung hi a, nangma lamneute zong luiliante’ tung mah ahi hi. Ahi zongin na khekhapte kimu lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah in Moses le Aaron’ khut tawh nangma mite tuuhon bangin na makaih hi."}}},"78":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka mite aw, keima hilhna ngai unla, ka kam tawh ka thugente na bil uh hong ngat un.","title":"Ama Mite Thumang lo Napi-in Pasian in Lam Lak"},"2":{"text":"Note tungah thugentehna zangin ka kam ka-in thu ka hong gen ding hi. I pu i pate in hong gensa, eite in i zaksa le i theihsa, tanglai-a thuthukte ka hong genkhia ding hi.","merge":"3","ref":"Mat 13:35"},"4":{"text":"Hih thute, i tate tungah eite in im loin, a hong piang lai ding khang thakte tungah, Topa’ minthang nasepna, ama vangliatna, ama sepsa na lamdangte i gen ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute pen Pasian tungah a lungsim thuman lo, lungsim kip a nei lo khangmi, lungsim khauhin a lehdo khangmi, amau’ pulepate tawh kibang loin, amaute in Pasian sungah amau’ lametna koihin, Pasian’ nasepnate mangngilh loin, ama thupiakte zui-in, a suak nai lo naupangte, a hong piangkik khang thakte in a thu thei-in, amaute ding khia-in amau’ tuletate tungah a thu a gentheih nadingin, amah in, i pate in a tate a hilhsawn dinga a sawl ahi, Israel sungah thukham khat koihin, Jakob sungah tecipanna khat a koih hi.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Thal a tawi Efraim mite, galkido ni-in nungkik uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian’ thuciamna zui lo uh a, ama thukham bangin gamta nuam lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama bawlsa le amaute tungah nalamdang a lahsate amaute in mangngilh uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt gam sung Zoan munah, a pu a pate uh’ muhna-ah amah in nalamdang a bawl hi.","ref":"Pai 7:8-12:32"},"13":{"text":"Amah in tuipi kikhensakin amaute kantansak a, tuite a lompi-in a omsak hi.","ref":"Pai 14:21-22"},"14":{"text":"Sun hunin amah in amaute meiipi khat tawh kha a, zan tawntung, meikuang taang khat tawh amaute a kha hi.","ref":"Pai 13:21-22"},"15":{"text":"Amah in gam sungah suangpite kitamsak a, tuithukpi sung panin a piangkhia bangin amaute’ tungah tui dawn ding tampi a pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in suangpi sung panin luitui luangkhiasak a, guntui luang bangin tuite a luangsak hi.","ref":"Pai 17:1-7; Gam 20:2-13"},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin ama tungah amaute khial lailai uh a, Sehnel gam sungah Sangpen pa a lehpan uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in amau’ duh mahmah an a kalhna uh tawh amaute in a lungsim sung uhah Pasian a ze-et uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian gensia uh a, “Pasian in gamlakah an pia thei ding ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Amah in suangpi sat a, tui lengkhia-in tuite dimlet takpi ahi hiam? Amah in ama mite, an ahi a, sameh ahi zongin a pia thei takpi ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in tua thu a zak ciangin hehna tawh kidimin, meikuang tawh Jakob sugawp a, Israel tungah a heh semsem hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Pasian um lo uh a, a honkhiazo dingin muang lo uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah in, tunga om vantungte thu pia-in, vantung kongte hong a,"},"24":{"text":"nek dingin amau tungah manna an zusakin, amaute tungah vantung an a pia hi.","ref":"Joh 6:31"},"25":{"text":"Mihingte in vantung mite’ an ne uh a, amah in amaute tungah an tampi a puak hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in vantungah nisuahna huih nungsakin, ama vangliatna tawh leitaw lam huih paikhiatpih a,"},"27":{"text":"amah in amaute tungah leivui zah-a tam sa zusak a, tuipi sehnel zah-a tam vasate a khiatsuk hi."},"28":{"text":"Amau’ giahphual laizang, amau’ omna kiim khempeuhah tuate a kiasak hi."},"29":{"text":"Amau’ duh pen pia ahih manin, amaute in ne-in gilvah uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in a duh pen uh a kham ma, amau’ kam sungah an a omlaipi mahin,"},"31":{"text":"amaute’ tungah Pasian’ hehna tungkikin amah in amaute lakah a hatpen teng thatin, Israel-te’ muanlesuan teng a vatlum hi.","ref":"Pai 16:2-15; Gam 11:4-23,31-35"},"32":{"text":"Hih na lamdangte khempeuh a omkhin hinapi-in amaute khial lai veve uh a, ama na lamdangte’ hangin amaute in um tuan lo uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in amau’ hunte husan’ khat bangin maimangsak a, amau’ nuntakna, launa lianpi tawh a beisak hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaute pawlkhat a thah khit ciangin a omlai mite in amah zong pan uh hi. Amaute kisikin, lungsim taktak tawh Pasian a zong uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian pen, amaute a honkhia, Sangpen Pasian, amaute a hupa ahihna a phawk uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in a kampi bek uh tawh amah phatkhem uh a, a leii uh tawh ama tungah zuaugen uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amaute’ lungsim ama lamah kip lo uh a, ama thuciamna-ah amaute thuman lo uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:21"},"38":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah in hehpihna lungsim nei ahih manin amau’ khialhnate maisakin, amaute susia lo hi. Amah in a hehna ip zelzel a, a hehna khempeuh phongkhia lo hi."},"39":{"text":"Amah in, amaute pen mihing hi lel a, a hong paikik nawn lo huihnung bang ahihna uh a phawk hi."},"40":{"text":"Amaute in gamlakah amah lehdo zelzel uh a, sehnel gam sungah amah dahsak uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Amaute in amah ze-et kikkik uh a, Israel-te’ Siangtho Pasian a phin uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Galte’ kiang panin amah in amaute a hotkhiat ni hitaleh, Egypt gamah ama limte a bawl hun lai hitaleh, Zoan gamah a bawl a na lamdangte hitaleh, ama vangliatna hitaleh, amaute in ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi.","merge":"43"},"44":{"text":"Amaute in a luituite uh a dawn theih loh nadingin amau’ guntuite amah in sisan a suaksak hi.","ref":"Pai 7:17-21"},"45":{"text":"Amaute a petthei cippi honte, amaute’ lote a susia uiphukte amau’ lakah a sawl hi.","ref":"Pai 8:1-6,20-24"},"46":{"text":"Amau’ lo ante tangngol pia a, amau’ sepna gahte kauphe a pia hi.","ref":"Pai 10:12-15"},"47":{"text":"A leengguite uh gial tawh denggawp a, a theithekte uh vukkhal tawh susia hi."},"48":{"text":"A ganhingte uh gial tawh denglum a, a gan khawite uh keek tawh a denglum hi.","ref":"Pai 9:22-25"},"49":{"text":"Amaute’ tungah a lauhuai ama sinsona, hehna, thangpaihna, gimna, le a susiathei van mi honkhat a khah hi."},"50":{"text":"Amah in a sinsona ip loin, kuamah hinkhawi lo a, pulnatna tawh amaute a sisak hi."},"51":{"text":"Ham’ suante’ inn sungah a ta upa pen teng, Egypt gam sung tacil khempeuh amah in a vatmai hi.","ref":"Pai 12:29"},"52":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in tua bangin ama mite gamlakah paikhiatpihin, ganhing honpi bangin amaute a paipih hi.","ref":"Pai 13:17-22"},"53":{"text":"Amah in a muanhuaina munah amaute paipih ahih manin amaute lau lo uh hi. Ahih hangin tuipi in amau’ galte tuumcip hi.","ref":"Pai 14:26-28"},"54":{"text":"A khut taklam tawh ama ngahsa mual ahi, a gam siangtho-ah amaute a paipih hi.","ref":"Pai 15:17; Josh 3:14-17"},"55":{"text":"Amau’ mai panin midangte hawlkhia-in, amaute’ luah ding neihsa hawmsak a, Israel minamte amau’ buk sungah a tengsak hi.","ref":"Josh 11:16-23"},"56":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in Sangpen Pasian ze-etin lehdo uh a, ama thupiakna zui loin,","ref":"Thkna 2:11-15"},"57":{"text":"a pu a pate uh mah bangin kiheikhia-in a zuau gamtat uh hi. Thal ginalo bangin amaute a kihuiheek uh hi."},"58":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a munsangte uh tawh amah a sinso nadingin phinphin uh a, amau’ milim bawlte tawh ama hazatna ding a piangsak uh hi."},"59":{"text":"Pasian in a zak ciangin heh pha mahmah a, amah in Israel-te a nial siangtho hi."},"60":{"text":"Mihingte’ lakah ama omna puanbuk ahi, Shiloh khua-a ama omna biakinn nusia a,","ref":"Josh 18:1; Jer 7:12-14; 26:6"},"61":{"text":"ama vangliatna, galte’ tungah ap a, ama minthanna, galte’ khutah a pia hi.","ref":"1Sam 4:4-22"},"62":{"text":"Amah in ama mite namsau tawh sisak a, ama luahte tungah a hehna a nga hi."},"63":{"text":"Mei in a tangvalte kanglum a, a nungakte’ pasal ding kuamah om nawn lo hi."},"64":{"text":"Amau’ siampite, namsau in puksak a, amau’ zite in a pasalte kah zo lo uh hi."},"65":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa pen zukhamin a awng mi thahatpa, a ihmu tho bangin a khanglo hi."},"66":{"text":"Amah in a langpangte zo a, a maizum tawntung dingin amaute a koih hi."},"67":{"text":"Amah in Josef’ suante nial a, Efraim minamte teello hi."},"68":{"text":"Ahih hangin ama it Zion Mual, Judah minam a teel hi."},"69":{"text":"A kip den dingin a phuhsa leitang bang leh, a vantung inn bangin ama biakinn a lam hi."},"70":{"text":"Amah in ama mi Jakob, ama luah Israel a cing dingin, no a nei tuupite a cinna, tuubukte panin la-in, ama nasem David a teel hi.","merge":"71","ref":"1Sam 16:11-12; 2Sam 7:8; 1Khang 17:7"},"72":{"text":"Amah in lungsim thutang tawh amaute hoihtakin cingin, a siam mahmah a khut tawh amaute lam a lak hi."}}},"79":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, na luah gam sungah dawibiate hong pai uh hi. Amaute in na biakinn siangtho ninsak gawp uh a, Jerusalem khuapi siasak gawp khin uh hi.","title":"Biakinn Kininsak: Pasian’ Huh ding Ngetna","ref":"2Kum 25:8-10; 2Khang 36:17-19; Jer 52:12-14"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in, na nasemte’ luanghawmte huihlak vasate pia uh a, na mi siangthote’ sate leilak ganhingte a pia uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in Jerusalem kimkotah tui buakkhiat bangin amaute’ sisan buakhia uh a, amaute a vui ding kuamah om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote pen ka vengte uh’ zahko, ka kiim uha omte in a hong ko a hong nuihsat ka suak khinta uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, bang tanvei hi ding ahi hiam? Heh paisuak ding na hi hiam? Nangma hazat hehna meikuang bangin kuang paisuak ding ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Nangmah a hong thei lo minamte tung le, nangma tungah thu a hong ngen lo kumpi gamte tungah hehgawp in."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka mite uh thatmang khin uh a, ka gam sung khempeuh uh susiagawp khin uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh mawhna hangin ko a suanlekhakte hong lang ngaihsut kei inla, hong kiniamkoih ahih manin kote a huh dingin na hehpihna hong paisak mengmeng in."},"9":{"text":"Kote a hong honkhia Pasian aw, nangma min a than nadingin kote hong huhin, nangma min hangin kote hong khahkhia-in, ka mawhnate uh hong maisak ta in."},"10":{"text":"“Amaute’ Pasian koi-ah om ahi hiam?” minam dangte in a cih ding kilawm ding ahi hiam? Na nasemte’ sisan luangkhia a phulakna pen, minam dangte’ lak, komau’ muhna-ah kitheisak in."},"11":{"text":"Thongkiate’ tauna ngai inla, thah dingin a kisehte na vangliatna tawh kizui-in suaktasak in."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong zahkona mah tawh ka vengte uh’ ang sungah a zah sagihin thuk in, Topa !"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin nangma mi, nangma gam sung tuu kote in nangma tungah lungdamna kong lak ngitnget ding uh a, a khang khangin nangmah phatnate ka gengen ding uh hi."}}},"80":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuuhon bangin Josef a paipih, Israel Tuucingpa aw, ngai in! Kherub tungah a tupa aw,","title":"Israel-te A Ngei A Batsakkik Ding Ngetna","ref":"Pai 25:22"},"2":{"text":"Efraim, Benjamin le Manasseh’ mai-ah taangkhia in! Na tha saan inla, kote a honkhia dingin hong pai ta in."},"3":{"text":"Ka ngei uh hong bangsakkik in, Pasian aw. Kote khempeuh hong kihotkhiat theih nadingin na maitang hong taangsak in."},"4":{"text":"Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, na mite’ thungetna-ah bang tanvei sinso niloh ding na hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Nangmah in a an dingun amaute tungah khitui na pia a, amaute’ dawn dingin khitui tampi na pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah in, ka vengte uh’ thusim lohin kote na hong bawl a, ka galte un hong thusim loin hong nuihsan uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ngei uh hong bangsakkik in, Vanglian Pasian aw. Kote khempeuh hong kihotkhiat theih nadingin na maitang hong taangsak in."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah in Egypt panin leenggui khat na la a, minam dangte hawlkhia-in, tua leenggui na suan hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in tua leenggui a dingin leitang na hahsiang a, amah in zungthuk kha-in gam sung a dim hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama liim in mual liante hoihtakin liimsun a, a hiang in taamtak sing liante hoihtakin khuh a,"},"11":{"text":"tuipi lamah a hiangte zamin, a dawnngekte in Gunpi lam a zuan hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, lampi-ah a pai mi khempeuh in a gah a lawhtheih nadingin, bang hangin nangmah in a daigawl suvang na hi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Gamlak a om ngal in susiagawp a, zangsung sa khempeuh in kivakna-in nei uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hong kiheikik in, Vanglian Pasian aw. Vantung panin hong ensukin hong mu in. Na khut taklam in a suansa, hih leenggui hong don in.","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Amaute in mei tawh halin sattan gawp uh hi. Amaute heh et inla, susiagawp in."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangma a dingin na hatsak mi’ tapa, na taklama om mipa tungah na thahatna guan in."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin nang kiang panin ka kiheikik nawn kei ding uh hi. Kote hong nungtasak in, nang kong phat ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka ngei uh hong bangsakkik in, Vanglian Topa Pasian aw. Kote khempeuh hong kihotkhiat theih nadingin na maitang hong taangsak in."}}},"81":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Eite’ thahatna Pasian’ tungah nakpitakin la sa unla, Jakob Pasian’ tungah lungdamin awng un.","title":"Pasian’ Hoihna le A Thutak lo Ama Mite A Lunggulhna"},"2":{"text":"La khat phuangin, khuangno tumin, a ngaih laiza khausai lasakna le harp khausai lasakna limtakin tum un."},"3":{"text":"Khadet, khalik, i pawi ni-in peengkul tum un.","ref":"Gam 10:10"},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh, tua bang hih ding pen Israel-te a dingin thukham hi a, Jakob Pasian’ biakna ngeina a kip khat ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gamah a pai lai-un Israel mite’ tungah thupiakna-in amah in a neih ahi hi. Ka theih ngei loh kampau khat hih bangin ka za hi:"},"6":{"text":"“Na liangko uha om na vangikte uh ka hong lakkhiatsak a, na khut uha vangikte ka hong khiasak hi."},"7":{"text":"Na cihmawh uh ciangin kei na hong sam uh a, keimah in note ka hong honkhia hi. A kilang lo vanging sung panin note ka hong dawng a, Meribah tui phualte-ah note ka hong ze-et hi.","ref":"Pai 17:7; Gam 20:13"},"8":{"text":"Ka mite aw, note kong thuhilh laitakin limtakin hong ngai un. Israel-te aw, keima thu a hong ngai hi hoh le-uh cin!"},"9":{"text":"Note’ lakah pasian dang om lo ding a, pasian dang khat’ mai-ah na kun kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pai 20:2-3; Thkna 5:6-7"},"10":{"text":"Egypt gam panin note a hong lakhia, Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi. Na kam uh a golin ka un, keimah in kong dimsak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ahih hangin ka mite in keima thu hong ngai lo uh a, Israel-te in keima thu themkha zong zui lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a ut bangun a gamta dingin amau’ lungsim khauhna bangin ka gamtasak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite in ka thu hong ngai-in, keima deih bangin Israel a gamta hileh!"},"14":{"text":"Amau’ galte khempeuh ka zawhsak pak ding a, amau’ galte langpangin ka khut ka liik ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei a hong mudahte ka mai-ah hong kun ding uh a, amaute’ gimthuakna kip paisuak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangbuh hoihpen tawh note ka hong vak ding a, suangpi pana khuaizu tawh note kong gilvahsak ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"82":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thu vaihawm kikhopna sungah Pasian in ama panmun hong len a, amah in pasian-te’ lakah thu a khen hi.","title":"Thutang loin Thukhente Kitai"},"2":{"text":"“Note in bang tanvei a man loin thu khenin, migilote tungah angvanna zang ding na hi uh hiam?"},"3":{"text":"A ginalo mite le pa a nei lo mite tungah thuman unla, a thuakte le a cimawhte’ thu a manin khen un."},"4":{"text":"A ginalo mite le a cimawh mite hon unla, migilote’ khutsung panin amaute honkhia un,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in thutheihna ahi a, thutelna ahi zongin bangmah nei lo uh a, khuamial sungah gamta uh ahih manin leitung bulpite khempeuh a kilinggawp hi."},"6":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, “Note khempeuh, Sangpenpa’ tate, pasian-te na hi uh hi.","ref":"Joh 10:34"},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin mite bangin si-in, kumpi khat peuhpeuh bangin na kia ding uh hi,” kong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian aw, tho in; leitung mite thu khen in. Bang hang hiam cih leh minam khempeuh nangma a’ ahi hi."}}},"83":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, dai dide-in om kei in. Lungnuamin, tang loin ommawk kei in, Pasian aw.","title":"Pasian in Israel-te’ Galte A Suksiat ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na galte in gamlumna piangsak uh a, nang hong mudahte kiphasak mahmah uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in khem siamna tawh na mite thangsiah uh a, amaute in na it mite langpangin thu kikum uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in, “Hong pai un, minam khat hihna panin amaute beisak ni. Israel min peuhmah kiphawksak nawn kei ni!” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in siatna ding geelin kithukhat uh a, nangmah hong langpangin thuciamna a bawl uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Edom mite le Ishmael mite, Moab le Hagri mite,"},"7":{"text":"Gebal, Ammon, le Amalek mite, Filistia le Taia khua mite tawh thuciam a bawl uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Assiria mite in zong amaute pawlpih uh a, amaute pen Lot’ suanlekhakte a dingin pawl muanhuaite ahi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Endor munah a kizogawp, leilakah a luang uh a muatgawp, Midian mite’ tungah na bawl bang leh, Kishon gun-a Sisera le Jabin-te’ tungah na bawl bangin amaute tungah bawl in.","merge":"10","ref":"Thkna 4:6-22; 7:1-23"},"11":{"text":"“Pasian’ gam hoihte eima tan’ dingin la ni,” a ci Oreb le Zeeb-te bangin amau’ miliante bawl inla, Zeba le Zalmunna-te bangin amau a ukte khempeuh bawl in.","merge":"12","ref":"Thkna 7:25; 8:12"},"13":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, amaute pen pingpei sunga ninnen, huih mai-a ansi leeng bangsak ta in."},"14":{"text":"Mei in gamlak a haltum bang, mualliante a kuansak bangin"},"15":{"text":"na khuapi huihpi tawh amaute delh inla, na huihpi tawh amaute lausak gawp in."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, amaute in na min hong zontheih nadingin amaute khempeuh maizumna tawh kidimsak in."},"17":{"text":"Amaute maizumin lungkia densak inla, a mindai-in siasak in."},"18":{"text":"Topa a kici min nei nangmah bek leitung khempeuhah a Sangpenpa na hihna amaute theisak in."}}},"84":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vanglian Topa aw, nangma tenna mun bangzah takin etlawm ahi hiam?","title":"Pasian’ Inn Lunggulhna"},"2":{"text":"Ke’n ka lunggulh mahmah hi. Topa’ huangsung ka lunggulh mahmah a, ka lungsim le ka pumpi a nungta Pasian’ tungah lungdam mahmahin la a sa hi."},"3":{"text":"Vanglian Topa, ka kumpi le ka Pasian aw, na biakna tau-ah, kawlgit nangawn in a inn ding mu a, phialphiah in a omna ding, a note a koihna ding bu a mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma inn sungah tengin, nangmah phatna a sa ngitnget mite thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma tung panin thahatna ngahin Zion zuatna lampi a tawn nuam mite thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in Kuamkeu mun kantanin a pai laitakun tua kuam pen ciktui tampi tawh kidim a, guahzu masate in zong tua mun pen bualtuite tawh a kidimsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute a paikawmun a tha uh hat semsem a, pasian-te’ Pasian Zion-ah mu ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, ka thungetna hong za inla, ka thungetna hong ngai in, Jakob Pasian!"},"9":{"text":"Pasian aw, kote a hong hu ding pa hong etsak inla, na sathau nilh pa hong kem in."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mun dangah ni tulkhat om sangin nangma huang sungah ni khat om hoihzaw hi. Gitlohna inn sungah ka ten sangin ka Pasian’ inn kongcing pa ka hi nuamzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian pen eite a hong hupa a minthang i kumpi hi a, maipha le pahtawina a hong piapa ahi hi. Thumanin a gamta mite tungah Topa in na hoih bangmah siit lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Vanglian Topa aw, nangmah a hong muang mite, thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi."}}},"85":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma leitang na hehpih a, Jakob’ nopsaknate a ngeina na bangsakkik hi.","title":"Pasian in Israel-te A Hehpih ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Na mite’ mawhna na maisak a, amau’ khialhna khempeuh na maisak hi."},"3":{"text":"Na hehna khempeuh na damsak a, na sinsona na daisak hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote hong honkhia Pasian aw, kote ka ngei uh hong bangsakkik inla, kote tunga na lungkim lohna hong beisak ta in."},"5":{"text":"Kote’ tungah heh paisuak ding na hi hiam? Khang tawntungin heh paisuak ding na hi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Kote in nangmah kong phat theih nadingun ko na mite hong nungtasakkik lo ding na hi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, kote tungah na itna kip hong lak inla, hong huhin hong hon in."},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasian’ thugen ding hong zasak dih un. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama lamah lungsim takpi tawh a kihei ama mi siangtho, ama mite’ tungah kilemna thu a gen ding hi."},"9":{"text":"I gam sungah minthanna a om theih nadingin amah a zahtakte a dingin ama hong hotkhiatna hong om takpi hi."},"10":{"text":"Itna kip le thutak kigawm ding a, thuman le kilemna kihual ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Leilak panin thutak hong pokhia ding a, vantung panin thuman in hong ensuk ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in a hoih nate eite tungah hong pia ding a, i leitang in hauhna piangsak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah thuman na ma pai ding a, ama lampi a bawlkhol ding hi."}}},"86":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, kei hehpihhuai-in cimawh ka hih manin na bil hong ngat inla, hong dawng in.","title":"Pasian’ Hehpih ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Mihoih ka hih manin kei hong kem in. Nangmah a hong muang na nasempa hong hon in."},"3":{"text":"Nang pen ka Pasian na hi hi. Topa aw, sun tawntung hong kiko ka hih manin kei hong hehpih in."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma tungah thu hong ngen ka hih manin na nasempa hong kipaaksak in."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah hoihin mawhna na maisak a, hong ngente khempeuh tungah itna kip tampi na nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna hong za inla, nang tungah thumin kong kikona hong ngai in."},"7":{"text":"Kei hong dawng na hih manin ka haksat hun ciangin nangma tungah kong ngen hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, pasian-te lakah nang tawh a kibang kuamah om lo a, nangma sep bang, kuamah in sem thei lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, na bawlsa minam khempeuh hong pai-in na mai-ah hong kun ding uh a, nangma min hong phat ding uh hi.","ref":"Mang 15:4"},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah lianin na lamdangte na bawl a, nang bek Pasian na hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, nang tungah hong thumanin nangma lampi ka zuih theih nadingin kei hong hilh inla, nangma min a zahtakte tawh keima lungsim pumkhat hong bangsak in."},"12":{"text":"Topa ka Pasian aw, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh na tungah ka lungdam a, nangma min ka thangsak ngitnget ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah na hong itna kip lian mahmah a, Leinuai thuk sung panin kei nong honkhia khin hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian aw, mi kihisakte, kei langpangin hong kipan hi. Thu-helhawt mi pawlkhat in kei, thah hong sawm uh a, amaute in nang hong thudon lo uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa aw, nang pen a hehpih thei, a dik Pasian na hi a, heh hak mahmahin, itna kip le thumanna tawh a kidim na hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei lamah hong kihei inla, kei hong hehpih in. Na nasempa thahatsak inla, na nasem numei’ tapa hong hon in."},"17":{"text":"Topa nangmah in kei hong huhin, nong thahatsakna hangin, kei hong mudahte in mu-in a zahhuai nadingun keima tungah na maipha hong lak in."}}},"87":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mual Siangtho tungah ama phuhsa khuapi om hi.","title":"Pasian’ Khuapi Minthang"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Israel gam mundang khempeuhte sangin Zion kulhkongpi itzaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian’ khuapi aw, na minthanna teng hong kigengen hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei hong theite lakah Egypt le Babylon ka hel hi. Filistia, Taia le Ethiopia te zong kihel a, “Hihte pen hua lai mah panin a piang ahi hi,” kici ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Zion tawh kisai-in ahihleh, “Minam khempeuh ama sung pana suak ahi hi,” kici ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Sangpenpa mahmah in amah kipsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Hihte pen hua lai-a suak,” ci-in minam khempeuh ciamtehin a gelh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua sunga teng mite in, “Kote’ lungdamna khempeuh nangma sungah om hi,” ci ciat ding uh hi."}}},"88":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa, ka Pasian aw, sunin huhna kong ngen a, zan hun sungin nangma mai-ah kong kiko hi.","title":"Cina pa’ Lungkham Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thungetna hong za inla, nong huh ding ka hong ngetna hong ngai in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh lungkhamna tampi thuakin, ka si dektak hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei pen a sidek mi tawh ka kibang ta a, ka thahatna khempeuh beimang khinta hi."},"5":{"text":"Misite lakah a kinusia, a kithatlum, han sunga lum, na huh zawh ahi nawn lo, na phawk nawn lohte ka bang ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei pen, mialin a thukna mun, Leihawm thuk sungah nong koih khinta hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma hehna keima tungah gik mahmah a, na tuihualte khempeuh tawh kei na hong vukcip hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka kikholhpih mite in kei a hong pelh dingin na hong bawl a, amaute tungah a cikzethuai khatin kei na hong bawl hi. Ka suahtak theih loh nadingin kei hong kikhumcip a,"},"9":{"text":"ka gim thuakna hangin ka mit a mial ta hi. Topa aw, nisimin nangma tungah kong ngen a, thu ngenin ka khutte nangma lamah kong zan hi."},"10":{"text":"A sisate a dingin nalamdang a bawl na hi hiam? Nangmah a phat dingin mi a si khinsate hong tho ding ahi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Han sungah na itna kip kigen ding a, siatna munah nangma thumannate kigen ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Khuamialna sungah na na lamdangte kithei a, mangngilhna gam sungah na hotkhiat huhna kithei ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa aw, na tungah huhna kong ngen a, zingsang simin na mai-ah thu ka hong ngen hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa aw, bang hangin kei hong paaikhia na hi hiam? Bang hangin kei kiang panin na maitang seel na hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Ka neu tung a kipan gim thuakin ka si dektak hi. Nong gimpiakte ka thuak a, ka cih nading mel ka thei nawn kei hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma hehna in keimah hong nawkgawp khin a, a lauhuai mahmah nangma hong sukgawpna in kei hong susia ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in tuikhang bangin sun tawntungin kei hong umcih uh a, kei hong tuamcip uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei hong itte le ka lawmte keimah nong pelhsak khin a, khuamial bekbek, keima kikholhpih ahi hi."}}},"89":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip la-in ka sa tawntung ding a, nangma thutakna ka gen tawntung ding hi.","title":"David tawh Pasian’ Thuciamna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma itna kip tawntung a, na thutakna zong vantung bangin kip tawntung hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in, “Ka teelpa tawh thuciamna ka bawlzo a, ka nasem David tungah thu ka ciamzo hi:"},"4":{"text":"‘Na suan na khakte kumpi-in ka kipsak ding a, na kumpi gam khang tawntungin ka kipsak ding hi,’” na ci khin hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12-16; 1Khang 17:11-14; La 132:11; Sawl 2:30"},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasepna a lamdangte, vantungte phatsak inla, mi siangthote’ kikhopna sungah na thumanna phatsak in."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa pen vantung a kua tawh kitehthei ding ahi hiam? Mi siangthote’ kikhopna sungah a kizahtak Pasian, a kiima omte khempeuh tungah lianin a zahtakhuai Topa pen van mite’ lakah kua pen tawh kibang ahi hiam?","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, na khempeuhah na thutak a, nangmah bangin a vanglian kua om ahi hiam, Topa aw."},"9":{"text":"Nang in tuipi khang na uk a, a tuihualte a san ciangin na daisak hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in a kithat lumsa luanghawm khat bangin ganhing golpi Rahab na sugawp a, na thahatna tawh na galte na zogawp hi."},"11":{"text":"Vantungte nangma a’ hi a, leitung zong nangma a’ mah ahi hi. Leitung le a sunga om khempeuh nangma phuhsa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Saklam le khanglamte nangma bawlsa hi a, Tabor mual le Hermon mual in lungdamna tawh na min hong phat uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma vang lian mahmah a, na thahatna kigen thei lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Thuman le thutang tawh na ukna za na phut a, itna kip le thuman tawh na khempeuh na sem hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa aw, lungdamin lasakna tawh nang hong bia a, na migitna khuavak sungah nuamtakin a nungta, nangma hangin sunthapai-in lungdam a, nangma hoihna hong phat mite mi nuamsa ahi uh hi.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in nakpitakin kote na hong gualzosak a, kote hong angvanin na hong gualzosak hi."},"18":{"text":"Kote a hong hu Topa hi a, Israel-te’ Siangtho Pasian nangmah in ka kumpipa uh nong pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Hun lui lai-in na thuman mipa tungah mang sungah thu na gen a, “A vanglian khat pa tungah lukhu ka koih khinzo a, mite lak panin a kitengkhia mi khat ka liansakzo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka nasempa David ka muzo hi. Ka thahatna ama tungah a om ngitnget theih nading, ka vangliatna in zong, amah a thakhauhsak theih nadingin ka sathau siangtho amah ka nilh khin hi.","merge":"21","ref":"1Sam 13:14; Sawl 13:22; 1Sam 16:12"},"22":{"text":"Galte in amah khemzo ngei lo ding a, migilote in zong amah zo ngei lo ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama mai-ah a galte ka sugawp ding a, amah a mudahte ka satpuk ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah it tawntungin ama tungah ka thutak ding a, amah a gualzo-in ka bawl tawntung ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Mediterranean Tuipi a kipan Eufratis Gunpi dong amah ka uksak ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, ‘Nang pen keima Pa le ka Pasian na hi a, kei a hong honkhia pa le a hong hupa na hi hi,’ hong ci ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Keimah in amah ta upa penin ka bawl ding a, leitung kumpite lakah a lianpenin ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Mang 1:5"},"28":{"text":"Amah ka itna ka kipsak tawntung ding a, ama tungah ka thuciamna ka kipsak tawntung ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama suanlekhakte kumpi ka hisak ngitnget ding a, a ukna za, vantung bangin ka kipsak ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Ama tate in ka thukhamte nusia-in, ka biakna ngeina kip om bangin a gamtat kei uh a, amaute in ka ngeina siasakin ka thupiak a zuih kei uhleh, amaute’ thupalsatna hangin ciang tawh gim ka pia ding a, amau’ mawhnate hangin satna tawh gim ka pia ding hi.","merge":"32"},"33":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah ka itna ka khiam kei ding a, ka thuciamna ka kipelhsak kei ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka thuciamna siasak loin, ka kam pana paikhia thute ka kheel kei ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“A tawntung a kimang dingin ka sianthona tawh khatvei ka kiciam khin a, David’ tungah ka zuau kei ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama suanlekhakte kizom paisuak ding a, vana ni a taan laiteng a kumpi gam ka kipsak ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Khapi bangin tua pen kipsuak ding a, vantung a om laiteng kip ding hi,” na ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahih hangin tu-in amah nialin na lawnkhia a, na sathau nilh pa’ tungah na heh mahmah hi."},"39":{"text":"Na nasempa tawh na thuciamna na pelh khin a, ama kumpi lukhu leivui lakah na paihsak hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama kulhte khempeuh na sukham khin a, ama galpanmun kipte a sia na suah khin hi."},"41":{"text":"A pai khempeuh in ama nate sutgawp uh a, amah pen a vengte’ nuihsat a suak hi."},"42":{"text":"Ama galte na gualzosak a, ama galte na lungdamsak khin hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama galhiamte a mawkna na suaksak a, gal kidona-ah amah na guallelsak hi."},"44":{"text":"Nangmah in ama khut panin a kumpi ciangkhut na lakhia a, a kumpi tokhom leilak na denna hi."},"45":{"text":"Nangmah in a teek hun nai lopi-in amah na teeksak a, maizumna tawh na kidimsak hi."},"46":{"text":"Topa aw, nang bang tanvei bucip den ding na hi hiam? Na hehna bang tanvei meikuang bangin kuangkuang ding ahi hiam?"},"47":{"text":"Topa aw, nuntak hun a tom mahmahlam hong phawk in. Mihingte a mawk nadingin bawl na hi hiam?"},"48":{"text":"A si thei lo kua om ahi hiam? Sihna hankhuk panin kua suaktazo ahi hiam?"},"49":{"text":"Topa aw, na thumanna tawh David tunga na thuciamna, hun lui lai-a na itna kip koi-ah omta ahi hiam?"},"50":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasempa bangzah takin hong kithusim lohna, galte in phinna-in a hong neihna, Topa aw, amaute in na sathau nilh pa a paina khempeuhah a hong nuihsatna uh hong phawk ta in.","merge":"51"},"52":{"text":"Topa in thupha ngah tawntung tahen. Amen! Amen!"}}},"90":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, khang tawntungin kote’ omna mun na hi hi.","title":"BU LINA (La 90-106) Pasian Khansau, Mi Khantom"},"2":{"text":"Mual liante a kipiansak ma, leitang le leitung na bawl ma pek, a tawntung a kipan a tawntung dongin Pasian na hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi, leivui na suaksakkik a, “Mihingte aw, ciahkik un,” na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma muhna-ah kum tulkhat a bei ciangin zanni ahi a, zan ihmut laitakin khanlawh khat sung tawh ahi zongin a kibang bek hi.","ref":"2Pe 3:8"},"5":{"text":"Nangmah in mite na phiatkhia hi. Amaute pen a ihmu tawh kibang uh a, zingsangin a nokik lopa tawh kibang uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingsangin palhin thaksuak kik a, nitak ciangin vulin a keu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma sinsona in kote hong susia a, na hehluatna in kote hong lausak gawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah in ka mawhnate uh na mai-ah na koih a, ka khialh simnate uh na maitangah na koih hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hun khempeuh uh na hehna-in bei a, ka nuntak hun uh husan’ khat bangin a bei hi."},"10":{"text":"Kote’ nuntak sung kum sawmsagih bang hi a, cidam le-ung kum sawmgiat bang hithei hi. Ahih hangin tua hunsung nangawn gimna le haksatna hi a, tua hunte bei pakin kote ka maimang uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Nang hong kizahtak nadingin na sinsona’ vangliatna kua in thei a, na hehna’ husiatna kua in thei ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin pilna lungsim ka ngah theih nadingun ka nuntak hun uh a tomlam ka theih nadingun hong hilh in."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, hong kihei kik in. Bang tan sauvei ding hiam? Na nasemte hong hehpih in."},"14":{"text":"Ka nuntak tawntung uh lungdamin ka kipak theih nadingun zingsangin na itna kip tawh kote hong lungkimsak in."},"15":{"text":"Kote nong gimsak ni zah, siatna ka thuak uh kum phazah mah, kote hong kipaaksak in."},"16":{"text":"Na nasemte tungah na nasepna, a tate uh tungah na minthanna, na vang hong kilangsak in."},"17":{"text":"Kote’ Topa Pasian aw, kote tungah na thupha hong tungsak inla, kote’ nasepna khempeuh hong tangtungsak in."}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sangpenpa’ liahna sung, Vanglianpa’ liim sungah a om mi khempeuh in","title":"Pasian in Amah a Muangte Hu"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ tungah, “Ka bukna le ka munkip muanhuai, ka muan ka Pasian na hi hi,” ci ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thangsiah pa’ thangzak le a lauhuai pulnatna panin nang hong honkhia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in a khate tawh nang hong tuam ding a, ama khate’ nuai-ah bukna ding na mu ding hi. Ama thumanna in nang hong dalin hong hu ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah in zan a lauhuaina, sun-a thaltang leengte, khuamial lakah a vak khiankhian pulnatna, sun nitaang a suksiatnate na kihta kei ding hi.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Na kiangah mi tulkhat, na kimkotah mi tul sawm, hong tukin a sih hangin bangmah na ci kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na mit tawh na en bek ding a, migilote a kithukkikna na mu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in Topa pen na buk nadingin bawlin, Sangpenpa, nang a hong hu dingin bawl khin na hih manin"},"10":{"text":"nangma tungah siatna hong tung lo ding a, na inn sungah gimna hong tung lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah a hong cing dingin amah in ama vantungmi nang hong kemsak ding hi.","ref":"Mat 4:6; Luk 4:10"},"12":{"text":"Na khete le suang a kitahkhak loh nadingin amaute in a khut uh tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 4:6; Luk 4:11"},"13":{"text":"Nangmah in humpinelkai le gul gunei tung na tawn ding a, na khenuai-ah humpinelkai khanglai le gulpi na tuancil ding hi.","ref":"Luk 10:19"},"14":{"text":"Itna tawh hong bel ahih manin amah ka honkhia ding a, ka min hong thei ahih manin mun sangna-ah amah ka koih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in hong sap ciangin amah ka dawng ding hi. Haksatna sungah amah ka ompih ding a, amah honkhia-in ka pahtawi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nuntak sau tawh amah ka lungkimsak ding a, amah ka honkhia ding hi."}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sangpenpa aw, Topa tungah lungdamna lah ding, nangma min phatna la sak dingin kilawm a, zangsawm khausai lasakna le harp lasakna, laiza lasaknate tumin, zingsangin nangma itna kip, zanin na thumanna genkhiat dingin a kilawm ahi hi.","title":"Pasian’ Huhna Phatna","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangma sepna tawh kei nong lungdamsak a, nangma sepnate hangin lungdamin la ka sa hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, na nasepnate lian mahmah a, na ngaihsutnate thuk mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Migilote, lopa bangin selkhia-in, siatna bawl khempeuh a pun’ mahmah hangun, a tawntungin siatna a thuak ding uh ahi hi. Ahih hangin Topa aw, nang pen a sangna-ah a omden na hihna thu, lungsimmawl mi in theithei lo a, lungsim tei lo mi in tel thei lo hi.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, na galte si ta ding! Bang hang hiam cih leh na galte beimang ding a, siatna a bawl khempeuhte kithehthang ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in zangsial bangin kei na hong hatsak a, kei thupha hong pia-in nong lungdamsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka galte’ pukna ka mit in mu khinta a, keimah a hong do a gilote’ siatna ka bil in za khinta hi."},"12":{"text":"Nisuh kung bangin thuman mi palh a, Lebanon mualtung a om taamtak kung bangin a khang hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ inn sungah amaute kisuan a, i Pasian’ huang sungah amaute palh uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa thutang hi, ci-in a lah nadingun amaute teek napi-in gah lailai uh a, amaute tui kiuhkeuhin hing sitset uh hi. Amah pen kei hong hupa hi a, ama sungah thuman lohna om lo hi.","merge":"15"}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in uk a, vangliatna kumpi puan kisilhsak hi. Topa, kumpi puan kisilhsak a, thahatna tawh amah kidim hi. Leitung kikipsak a, kiling ngei lo ding hi.","title":"Pasian’ Liatna"},"2":{"text":"Tanglai pek panin na tokhom a kipsa hi a, nang pen a tawntung a om na hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, gunte hong khangin, a aw uh hong sangsak a, nakpitakin hong ging hi."},"4":{"text":"A sangna munah a om Topa vanglian hi. Tui tampi gingte sangin vanglian zaw a, tuipi hualte sangin vanglian zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thupiaknate kip mahmah hi. Topa aw, sianthona pen a tawntungin na inn tawh a kilawm ahi hi."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A thukkik Pasian, a thukkik Pasian, Topa aw, na hehna hong lakkhia in.","title":"Thukkik ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Tho in, leitung thukhen pa aw, a kiphasak mite tungah amau’ ngah ding a kilawm gimna pia ta in."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, migilote bang tanvei lungdam ding uh a, migilote bang tanvei lungnuamin omom lai ding ahi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Gamtatsiate bang tanvei kihisak lai ding uh a, a siat gamtatna uh bang tanvei kisialhpih lai ding ahi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, amaute in nangma mite sugawp uh a, nangma luahte gimsak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in meigong numeite le khualmite thatlumin pa nei lote suamlum uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in, “ Topa in mu lo hi; Jakob Pasian in thei lo hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Theitel un, mi lungsimmawl pente aw! Lung pillote aw, cik ciangin pil ding na hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"I bil a bawlpa in khua za lo ding ahi hiam? I mit a piangsak pa in khua mu lo ding ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Minamte a thuhilhpa in mi thuhilh lo ding ahi hiam? Mihingte tungah theihtheihna a hilh Topa in mihingte’ ngaihsutna thei a, amaute pen husan’ bang bek ahihna teltakin a thei hi.","merge":"11","ref":"1Kor 3:20"},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, migilote a dingin gum khat a kitawh hun mateng, haksat hun sungteng a tawlngak theih nadingin na thukham na hilh mi, na thuhilh mi, mi nuamsa ahi hi.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama mite nusia lo ding a, ama luahte paidak lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thutang pen thuman mite tungah hong tungkik ding a, lungsim thutang khempeuh in amah zui ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei a dingin migilote a do dingin kua kipan ahi hiam? Kei a dingin siatna a bawlte’ langkhatah kua ding ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei hong huh lo hileh, gamkhing sungah ka tung khinta ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa aw, “Ka khe taal,” ci-in ka ngaihsut ciangin na itna kip in kei hong kaito hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka lungsim ngaihsutna a tam mahmah ciangin kei na hong hehnem a, na hong lungdamsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Sihna ding ngeina a bawl, a gilo gam ukte, nang tawh kipawl ding ahi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Amaute in thuman mihoihte thah sawm uh a, a mawhbaang lo mite sihna thuaksak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa pen keima munkip, keima Pasian, ka belh suangpi a suak khinta hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in amau’ mawhnate amau’ tung mahah tungsakkikin, a gitlohna hangun amaute a maimangsak ding hi. Topa, i Pasian in amaute maimangsak ding hi."}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hong pai un, Topa phat ni. Eite a hong hu, a hong honkhia pa tungah lungdamna la sa ni.","title":"Pasian Phatna: Thumang lote Hilhkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Ama omna-ah lungdamna ko-in pai ni. Phatna late, ama tungah lungdam takin sa ni."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa, a lian Pasian hi a, pasian khempeuh tungah Kumpi lianpa ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in leitung khempeuh uk a, guam thuk pen panin mual sang pen dawn dongin amah in a uk hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama bawlsa tuipite uk a, ama bawlsa leitung zong amah in a uk hi."},"6":{"text":"Hong pai un, amah bia-in kun ni. Eite hong Bawl Topa’ mai-ah khukdin ni."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah pen eite’ Pasian hi a, eite pen ama hong kep mite le ama khutsunga om a tuute ihi hi. Tuni-in hih bangin ama hong thugen za un:"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in ka nasepna mu khin uh hinapi, Meribah le Massah munah na pate un kei hong ze-etin, gamtatna tawh ka lah ding hong kalh hun lai uh bangin, note in na lungsim uh khauhsak kei un.","merge":"9","ref":"Heb 3:15; 4:7; Pai 17:1-7; Gam 20:2-13"},"10":{"text":"Kum sawmli sung tua minam ka kih a, “Amaute pen a lungsim uhah a khial mi hi a, amaute in ka thupiakte mang lo uh hi,” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin keima nopsakna munah amaute a lut lo dingin sinso kawmin ka kiciam hi.","ref":"Heb 3:7-11; Gam 14:20-23; Thkna 1:34-36; 12:9-10; Heb 4:3,5"}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa tungah la thak khat sa un. Topa tungah la sa un.","title":"Phatna La (1Khang 16:23-33)"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah la sa unla, ama min phat un. Ni khat khit ni khat ama hong hotkhiatna thu gen tawntung un."},"3":{"text":"Ama minthanna minamte lakah gen unla, ama nalamdang septe mi khempeuh lakah pulak un."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian a, nakpitakin phat ding ahi hi; pasian dangte khempeuh sangin amah zahtak zawk ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh minam dangte’ pasian khempeuh milim hi lel a, ahih hangin Topa ahihleh vantungte a bawlpa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pahtawina le liatnate ama mai-ah om a, hatna le hoihnate ama omna mun siangtho-ah om hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi namkimte aw, Topa in minthanna le hatna nei hi, ci-in mang un. Topa in nei hi, ci-in mang un."},"8":{"text":"Ama min in a ngah dingin a kilawm minthanna Topa’ tungah pia unla, biakpiakna hong kengin ama huang sungah hong pai un."},"9":{"text":"Puan siangtho silhin Topa bia un. Leitung mi khempeuh aw, ama mai-ah ling un.","ref":"La 29:1-2"},"10":{"text":"Minam khempeuh lakah thu gen kawikawi unla, “ Topa in uk hi. Leitung kikipsak a, kiling ngei lo ding hi. Amah in mihingte’ thu a manin khen ding hi,” ci un."},"11":{"text":"Vantung mite kipak hen la, leitung mite lungdam hen. Tuipi le a sunga om khempeuh awng ta uh hen."},"12":{"text":"Lo le a sunga om khempeuh nuamin diang uh hen. Gamlak a sing om khempeuh in Topa’ mai-ah lungdamin la sa hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah hong pai ta hi. Leitung mite’ thu a khen dingin hong pai ta hi. Amah in thumanna tawh leitung ukin mite’ thu ahi bangin khen ding hi.","merge":"13"}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in uk hi. Leitung lungdam hen la, tuikulh neu tampite zong lungdam ta uh hen.","title":"Ukna le A Vangliatna"},"2":{"text":"Meiipite le khuamial sahpite ama kiimah om a, thumanna le thutannate ama tokhom bulpi ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama mai-ah mei pai a, ama kiima om a galte a kangtum hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama khuaphialepte in leitung taangsak a, leitung in mu-in a ling hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ mai, leitung mi khempeuh’ Topa’ mai-ah mual liante khuainun bangin a tuisuak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantungte in ama thumanna genkhia uh a, mi khempeuh in ama minthanna mu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangmah a man lo milimte a kisaktheihpih, milim a bia mi khempeuhte maizumin kikoih a, ama mai-ah pasian khempeuh kun uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian aw, Zion in za-in nuam a, na thukhennate hangin Judah khuapite lungdam uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, leitung khempeuh a ukpa na hi a, pasian dang khempeuh sangin nakpitakin na lianzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in gitlohna a mudahte it a, amah in a mi siangthote’ nuntakna siatna ding pan a kem hi. Amah in migilote’ khutsung panin amaute a honkhia hi."},"11":{"text":"Thuman mite’ tungah khuavak hong taang a, lungsim thutang mite tungah lungdamna hong tung hi."},"12":{"text":"Thuman mite aw, Topa’ nasepnate hangin lungdam unla, ama min siangtho phat un."}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah in na lamdangte bawl ahih manin Topa’ tungah la thak sa un. Ama khut taklam le ama khut siangthote in amah gualzosak hi.","title":"Pasian’ Thumanna Phat Ding"},"2":{"text":"Topa in ama gualzawhna kitheisak khinzo a, amah in minamte’ muhna-ah ama thumanna langsak khin hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah thutakin, it tawntungna nei ahih manin Israel-te tungah a thuciamna a tungsak hi. Leitung mi khempeuh in eite’ Pasian’ gualzawhna mu khinta uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa’ tungah lungdamin la sa-in lungdamin awngkhia unla, phatna la sa un."},"5":{"text":"Laia lasakna tawh Topa’ tungah phatna late sa unla, laiza lasakna le la ngaih tawh phat un."},"6":{"text":"Peengkulte le saki aw tawh Topa, Kumpipa’ mai-ah lungdamna gingsak un."},"7":{"text":"Tuipi le a sunga omte khempeuh aw, awng unla, leitung le a tunga teng khempeuhte aw, la sa un."},"8":{"text":"Gunte aw, na khut uh beeng un. Mualte aw, Topa’ mai-ah lungdamin la sa un. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung a uk dingin amah hong pai ta a, thumanna tawh leitung mite’ thu ahi ding bangin hong khen ding hi.","merge":"9"}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in uk hi. Mihonte ling hen. Kherub-te tungah amah tu hi. Leitung ling tahen.","title":"Siangtho Pasian Phatna","ref":"Pai 25:22"},"2":{"text":"Zion khuapi-ah Topa lian a, amah in leitung mi khempeuh uk hi."},"3":{"text":"A lian a kihtakhuai ama min mi khempeuh in phat ta uh hen. Amah siangtho hi."},"4":{"text":"Thutang a deih, Vanglian Kumpipa aw, nangmah in thuman na phut khin a, Israel-te sungah thutang le thuman na semkhia hi."},"5":{"text":"I Topa Pasian phat unla, ama khengakna munah bia un. Amah siangtho hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses le Aaron-te ama siampi hi uh a, amah a biate lakah Samuel zong a kihel hi. Topa’ tungah amaute kiko uh a, amah in amaute a dawng hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in meii khuampi sung pan amaute tungah thu gen a, ama teci pannate le amah in amaute tungah a thukham piakte amaute in a zui uh hi.","ref":"Pai 33:9"},"8":{"text":"Kote’ Topa Pasian aw, nang in amaute na dawng hi. Amau’ mawhna hangin gim na piak tei hangin amau’ mawhnate a maisak nuam Pasian na hihna amaute’ tungah na kilangsak hi."},"9":{"text":"I Topa Pasian phat unla, ama mual siangtho-ah bia un; bang hang hiam cih leh i Topa Pasian a siangtho hi."}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gam khempeuh aw, Topa’ tungah lungdamna aw gingsak un.","title":"Lungdamna tawh Na Sem Un"},"2":{"text":"Lungdamna tawh Topa’ na sem un. Ama omna-ah la sa kawmin hong pai un."},"3":{"text":"Topa, Pasian ahihna thei un. Eite hong bawlpa amah hi a, eite ama a’ ihi hi. Eite ama mi ihi a, ama gankhahna sunga om a tuute ihi hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungdam kohna tawh ama kongpi-ah lut unla, amah phatna tawh ama huang sungah tum un. Ama tungah lungdam ko unla, ama min phat un."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa hoih hi. Ama itna kipin kho tawntung a, ama thumanna a khang khangin kip hi.","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; La 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima la pen thumanna le thutanna la ahi hi. Nang ka hong sak ding hi; Topa aw, kong sak ding hi.","title":"Kumpipa’ Kamciamna"},"2":{"text":"Paubaanna a om lo thu bek ka kin ding hi. Cik ciangin kei kiangah hong pai ding na hi hiam? Lungsim hoihna tawh ka inn sungah ka gamta ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A sia na peuhmah ka deih kei ding hi. Lamkhial mite’ nasepna ka mudah a, tuate tawh ka kisukha kei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungsim kawina ka deih hetkei a, siatna, ngaihsutin zong ka neikha kei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A vengte a gensia sim mite ka susia ding a, kiphatsakna, kihihsakna lungsim a nei mi ka thuak kei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Leitungah a thuman mite kei tawh a om theih nadingin maipha ka pia ding a, paubaanna om loin a gamta mi in keima na hong sem ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Khemna a zang mi peuhmah keima inn-ah teng lo ding a, zuauthu a gen mi peuhmah keima omna-ah om thei nawn lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Zingsang simin leitung a migilote khempeuh ka susia ding a, Topa’ khuapi panin siatna bawlte khempeuh ka khenkhia ding hi."}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna hong za inla, ka thumna hong ngai in.","title":"Lungkham Cianga Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka cihmawh hunin kei kiang panin bu kei in. Keima lam hong nga inla, kong sap ciangin hong dawng pah in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka nuntakna, meikhu bangin beimang a, ka pumpi meikuang bangin a sa hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungkham luatna hangin lopa bangin ka keutum a, an nangawn ka nezo kei hi."},"5":{"text":"A gingin ka tautauna hangin ka guh guakin ka om hi."},"6":{"text":"Gamlak a om musane le mun kolhna-ah a om simbu tawh ka kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Ihmu thei loin ka om a, innkhum dawna vasa khat guak a om tawh ka kibang hi."},"8":{"text":"Sun nilohin ka galte in kei hong zahko uh a, kei hong simmawhte in samsiatna-in ka min a zang uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh vut bek ka annek hita a, na thangpaihna le na hehna hangin ka tuidawnte khitui tawh kihel hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in kei hong domto napi-in lei nong denna hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Keima nuntakna pen nitak lama a om niliim tawh kibang lel a, lopa bangin ka vulgawp hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa aw, nang na kip ngitnget a, khang tawntungin nang hong kiphawkna kip hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangmah tho-in Zion khua na hehpih ding hi. Amah na angvan hun ding hita a, a kiciangtansa hun hong tung khin hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasemte in tua khua suangtumte it uh a, a leivuite nangawn pammaih sa uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte in Topa hong zahtakin, leitung kumpi khempeuh in na minthanna hong zahtak ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Zion khua lam ding a, ama minthanna hong kilang ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in mi cimawhte’ thungetna kinin, amau’ thumna simmawh lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A suak nai lo mite in Topa a phat theih nadingin a hong tung lai ding khang mite a dingin hih thu kiciamteh hen:"},"19":{"text":"Mihingte, kumpi gamte, Topa a bia dingin a kikaihkhop uh ciangin, mite in Zion khua sungah Topa’ min, Jerusalem khua sungah amah phatna a pulak theih nadingun, thongkiate’ taunate a za ding le a si dingin a kisehte a khahkhia dingin a sangna ama siangtho mun panin amah in hong ensukin, vantung panin Topa in leitung hong en hi.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Amah in kei a khangtung kimlai ka thahatna hong suktat sakin, ka hunte hong khiapsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Keimah in, “Khang tawntungin a kip ka Pasian aw, hong khansihsak kei in,” ka ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tanglai hunin nangmah in leitung bulpi na koih a, vantungte zong nangma khut tawh na bawlsa ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute sia ding uh a, ahih hangin nang na kip ding hi. Puan bangin amaute paatkhia ding uh hi. Nangmah in amaute puan bangin na khek a, amaute a maimang uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin nang na kibang ngitnget a, na nuntak hun in mong nei lo hi.","ref":"Heb 1:10-12"},"28":{"text":"Na nasemte’ tate lungmuangin om ding uh a, amau’ suanlekhakte na mai-ah kip ding uh hi."}}},"103":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ka phat ding a, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh ama min siangtho ka phat ding hi.","title":"Pasian’ Itna Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Topa ka phat ding a, ama migitna ka mangngilh kei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in ka mawhna khempeuh hong maisak a, ka natna khempeuh hong damsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Hankhuk tung ding kimlai hong suaktasak a, itna le hehpihna tampi hong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin ka tha a hat theih nadingin thupha namkim hong pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a kinengniamte a dingin thuman thutangin thu a khen hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in ama geelna Moses tungah gen a, ama nasepnate Israel mite a musak hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa dikin hehpihna tawh kidim a, heh hakin, a lian mahmah itna kip tawh a kidim hi.","ref":"James 5:11"},"9":{"text":"Amah in a tawntungin hong taii ngitnget lo ding a, amah heh paisuak lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in eite’ khialhna tawh a kituakin eite tungah hong bawl lo a, eite’ mawhna tawh a kituakin hong thukkik lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Vantung pen leitung panin a san mah bangin amah Topa ka phat ding hi."}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamna ko-in, ama min phat unla, ama sepnate khempeuh mite lakah kitheisak un.","title":"Israel-te a dingin Pasian’ Sep Na Lamdangte (1Khang 16:7-22)"},"2":{"text":"Ama tungah la sa un. Ama tungah phatna la sa unla, a lamdang a septe khempeuh gen ciat ta un."},"3":{"text":"Ama min siangtho hangin lungdam unla, Topa a zong mite lungdam tahen."},"4":{"text":"Topa le ama huh ding zon belin nei unla, a tawntungin ama maipha zong niloh un."},"5":{"text":"No ama nasem, Abraham’ suanlekhak, Jakob’ tate, ama teel mite aw, ama sepsa a lamdang nate, ama nalamdang lahte, a genkhiat a thukhennate phawk ciat ta un!","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Amah pen Topa, eite’ Pasian hi a, ama thupiaknate leitung khempeuh in a zuih ding ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Na luah dingin Kanaan gam ka hong pia ding hi,” ci-in Abraham tawh thuciam a bawlsa, Isaac tungah a thuciamsa, Jakob tungah thupiakna a kipsak, Israel tungah tawntung thuciamna, ama thupiaksa kammal, ama thuciamna pen khang tulkhat dongin amah in phawk ngitnget hi.","merge":"11","ref":"Pian 12:7; 17:8; 26:3; Pian 28:13"},"12":{"text":"Amaute tawm mahmahin, bangmah gentham lo uh a, khualmi hi-in,"},"13":{"text":"minam khat panin minam dang khatah, gam khat pan gam khatah a vak kawikawi laitakun,"},"14":{"text":"amah in amaute kuamah nengniamsak lo hi. Amaute’ hangin amah in kumpite thuhilhin,"},"15":{"text":"“Ka sathau nilhte sukha kei un; ka kamsangte tungah siatna bawl kei un,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 20:3-7"},"16":{"text":"Amah in leitungah kialpi tungsakin, nektheih an khempeuh a siatsak ciangin,","ref":"Pian 41:53-57"},"17":{"text":"amah in, Josef a kici, sila-a a kizuak mi khat, amaute’ mai-ah a sawl hi.","ref":"Pian 37:28; 45:5"},"18":{"text":"Ama khete pen kolte in nasak a, ama ngawng pen sikkol sungah kikoih hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama thugente a tun matengin Topa in amah ze-et hi.","ref":"Pian 39:20-40:23"},"20":{"text":"Amah a khahkhia dingin kumpipa in mi paisak a, mihingte a ukpa in amah a khahkhia hi.","ref":"Pian 41:14"},"21":{"text":"Josef in kumpipa’ uliante ama ut bangin lamlakin, a upate pen pilna hilhsak a, ama innsung topa ama neihsa khempeuh a ukpa-in a koih hi.","merge":"22","ref":"Pian 41:39-41"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Egypt gamah Israel va pai a, Ham’ gam sungah peemta-in Jakob va om hi.","ref":"Pian 46:6; 47:11"},"24":{"text":"Topa in ama mite pungsak mahmah a, a galte sangin amaute hatzaw sak hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama mite mudahin, ama nasemte siamna tawh a khem dingin amaute’ lungsim amah in kiheisak hi.","ref":"Pai 1:7-14"},"26":{"text":"Amah in, ama nasem Moses le ama teelsa Aaron a sawl hi.","ref":"Pai 3:1-4:17"},"27":{"text":"Amaute in ama limte amaute’ lakah na lamdangte Ham’ gam sungah a bawl uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in khuamial sawl a, leitung khim a zingsak hi. Topa phat un.","merge":"45","ref":"Josh 11:16-23"}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un.
