Topa phat un.","ref":"1Khang 16:35-36"}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Topa tungah lungdam ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip tawntung!”","title":"BU NGANA (La 107-150) A Lamdangin Mihingte A Hot Manin Pasian’ Tungah Lungdam Kohna","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; La 100:5; 106:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Tu-a teng mah, nisuahna le nitumna, leilu lam le leitaw lam, leitung pana ama kaihkhop, galte’ khutsung panin a hong hotkhiat mite in ci kikkik ta uh hen.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Pawlkhatte gamlakah gammang uh a, a tenna ding uh khuapi tunna lampi mu zo lo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Gilkial dangtakin amaute sibup uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uhah Topa ko uh a, amau’ cihmawhna panin amah in a honkhia hi."},"7":{"text":"Amau’ tenna ding khuapi a tun matengun amah in lampi manah amaute a paipih hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama itna kip le mihing tate tungah a lamdang ama sepnate hangin amaute in Topa’ tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a gilkial a dangtakte phasak a, bangmah a nei lote tungah na hoih tampi a pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, khuamial sung, a zing sungah tu uh a, sikkol kibulhin gimna thuakin thong kia uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Pasian’ thu sel uh a, Sangpenpa’ thugente a nial uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Nasep haksa tawh amaute’ lungsim niamsak hi. Amaute puk uh a, a huh ding kuamah om lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uhah Topa ko uh a, amau’ cihmawhna panin amah in a honkhia hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in khuamial sung le a zing sung panin amaute lakhia a, amau a kihennate a botsat hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama itna kip le mihing tate tungah a lamdang a nasepnate hangin amaute in Topa tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in sumngo kongkhakte sukhamin sikzawlte tum nih a suah hi."},"17":{"text":"Pawlkhatte amau’ khialhna hangin a ci uh na a, a mawhna hangun gimna a thuak uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in an peuhmah kih uh a, sihna kongpi tawh amaute kinai ta uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uhah Topa ko uh a, amau’ cihmawhna panin amah in a honkhia hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in thu vaikhakin amaute damsak a, siatna ding panin amaute a honkhia hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama itna kip le mihing tate tungah a lamdang a nasepnate hangin amaute in Topa tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen."},"22":{"text":"Lungdam koh piaknate pia-in ama nasepnate lungdam la tawh amaute gensak un."},"23":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, teembaw tawh tuipi-ah pai uh a, tui liante tungah sumbawl na a sem uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute in tuithuk tungah Topa’ gamtatna a lamdang a septe a mu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thu pia a, tuipi hualte a piangsak huihpi a nungsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute, vanah kilawnto-in, a thukna-ah kiasuk uh hi. A lauhuai siatna sungah amau’ lungsim hanna a bei hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute zukham bangin hoisuk hoito uh a, a cih nading mel uh thei nawn lo uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a lungkhamna uhah Topa ko uh a, amau’ cihmawhna panin amah in a honkhia hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in huihpi daisak a, tuipi hualte a bei hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin, tua tuihualte a khawl manin amaute a lungdam uh hi. Amah in amaute’ utna khua-ah a paipih hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama itna kip le mihing tate tungah a lamdang a sepnate hangin amaute in Topa tungah lungdamna ko ta uh hen."},"32":{"text":"Amaute in mihon kikhopna sungah amah pahtawi-in, upate’ kikhopna sungah amah phat ta uh hen."},"33":{"text":"Amah in, a tunga a teng mihingte’ gitlohna hangin gunte sehnel gam suaksakin ciktuite leikeu suaksak a, an tampi a pianna leitang pen ci-lei a suaksak hi.","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Amah in sehnel gam pen bualtuite suaksak a, leitang keu pen ciktui a suaksak hi."},"36":{"text":"Amah in tua munah gilkialte tengsak a, a tenna ding uh khuapi amaute in a sat uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amaute in lo-ah an tuhin leenggui suan uh a, a gah tampi tak a ngah uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama thupha piakna hangin ante nakpitakin pung a, amau’ bawngte zong kiamsak lo hi."},"39":{"text":"Amaute pen nenniamna, haksatna le dahna tawh khiamsuk gawpin a kiniamkoih suk ciangin"},"40":{"text":"amah in, amau a bawlsiate tungah simmawhna buak sukin lampi om lohna gam sungah amaute a vakvaisak hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah in amau’ thuakna sung panin a cimawhte laamto a, tuu honpite bangin amau’ innkuante a pungsak hi."},"42":{"text":"Lungsim thutangte in hih thu mu-in kipak uh a, a gilote in ahihleh amau’ kam a cih ciat uh hi."},"43":{"text":"A pil peuhmah in hih thute don hen la, Topa’ itna kip lungngaingai tahen."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka lungsim a kigingsa-in om hi. Ka sa ding hi; nangmah phatna late ka sa ding hi. Kei ka khanglo ding hi.","title":"Pasian Phatna le Gualzawhna ding Ngetna (La 57:7-11 ; 60:5-12)"},"2":{"text":"Harp lasakna le laiza lasakna aw, khanglo un. Zingsang khuavak hong phong ning."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, mite lakah nangma tungah lungdamna kong ko ding a, minam dangte lakah nangma tungah phatna ka sa ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na itna kip in vantung ban a, na thumanna in meiipite banto hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian aw, vantungte’ tungah sangto lai in. Leitung khempeuhah na minthanna omsak in."},"6":{"text":"Nangma it mite, na hatna tawh hon inla, kong ngetna bangun hong pia in."},"7":{"text":"Ama biakinn sungah Pasian in thu ciam khin a, “Gualzo a lungdamna tawh Shekhem gam khenkhia-in, Sukkoth gam kuam ka sehkhia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead gam keima a’ hi a, Manasseh gam zong keima-a’ mah ahi hi. Efraim gam ka siklukhu hi a, Judah gam ka ciangkhut ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Moab gam ka kisilna kuang hi a, keima neihsa hi, cih lahna limin Edom gam tungah ka khedap ka lawn hi. Filistia gam tungah gualzawhna tawh ka awng hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kua in khuapi muanhuai-ah kei hong paipih ding hiam? Kua in Edom gamah kei hong paipih ding hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Pasian aw, nangmah in kote hong don lo khinta hi lo na hi hiam? Pasian aw, komau galkapte tawh na kuankhia kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka galdona uhah kote hong huh in. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihing’ huhna a mawkna hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian tawh khauhtakin i hih ding hi. Amah pen i galte hong sikcipsak ding pa ahi hi."}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima hong phat Pasian aw, dai dide-in ommawk kei in.","title":"Thukkik Ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote le zuauthu gente keima langah hong pang uh a, keimah hong gensia-in, zuauthu bekbek genin nei uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in muhdah kamte pau-in kei hong gensia uh a, thu om lopi-in kei hong langpang uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute ka itna, amaute a dingin thu ka ngetsakna nangawn amaute in hong thukna-in kei hong mawhsak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in hoihna a dingin siatna itna a dingin muhdahna tawh kei hong thuk uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka gal pa’ langah migilo khat pangsak inla, thusitna a thuak dingin mawhna a zong mi khat paipih sak in."},"7":{"text":"Amah thu a kisit ciangin thu lelin pusuaksak inla, ama hong thumnate zong mawhna suaksak in."},"8":{"text":"Amah khantom hen la, midang khat in ama nasep za ngah tahen.","ref":"Sawl 1:20"},"9":{"text":"Ama tate pa nei lo hi ta hen la, a zi zong meigong numei hi tahen."},"10":{"text":"Ama tate vak kawikawi-in khut dawhin ngen hen la, a kisiasa a tenna mun panun kihawlkhia ta uh hen."},"11":{"text":"Ama leibatna pa in a neih khempeuh man hen la, khualmite in a omlai sunsunte sut tahen."},"12":{"text":"Ama tungah kuamah migi kei hen la, pa nei lo ama tate kuamah in hehpih kei tahen."},"13":{"text":"Ama suanlekhakte bei hen la, khang khat sungin a vangliatna maimang tahen."},"14":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah a pu a pate’ mawhna kiciamteh hen la, a nu’ mawhna kimaisak kei tahen."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ mai-ah tua mawhnate omsak inla, leitung panin amah a kiphawkna bei tahen."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh migitna lah ding ngaihsun lo a, a zawng a cimawhte le lungsim kitamzan mite a sih dongun a bawlsia hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in mi samsiat nuam a sa hi. Ama tungah samsiatnate tungsak in. Amah in thupha pia nuam lo hi. Kuamah in amah thupha pia kei tahen."},"18":{"text":"Amah pen puansilh bangin samsiatna kingeina seh hi. Tua a samsiatnate ama pumpi sungah tui bangin a guhte sungah sathau bangin lutin kizel tahen."},"19":{"text":"Tua samsiatnate pen ama kituamna puan tawh kibang hen la, nisimin amah a kigakna a kawnggak tawh kibang tahen."},"20":{"text":"Hih bang teng pen keimah hong mawhsakte’ tung, kei hong gensiate’ tungah Topa’ kiang pan a thaman hi tahen."},"21":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa ka Pasian aw, na min na ngaihsutna tawh keima tangin hong pang inla, na itna kip hoih ahih manin kei hong honkhia in."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kei genthei-in ka cimawh a, ka lungsim tawng dongin na hong nasak hi."},"23":{"text":"Nitak a niliim bangin kei ka bei a, kauphe bangin kei hong kisingkhia hi."},"24":{"text":"An ngolhna hangin ka khukte zaw a, ka pumpi silesa zong kiamgawp khinta hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute’ nuihsatin kei ka om a, amaute in kei hong muh ciangun lusu ngeungeu uh hi.","ref":"Mat 27:39; Mrk 15:29"},"26":{"text":"Topa ka Pasian aw, kei hong huh in. Nangma itna kip tawh kituakin kei hong hon in."},"27":{"text":"Topa aw, hih pen nangma bawl, nangma khut in a sep ahihna amaute theisak in."},"28":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong samsiat hangin nangmah in kei thupha nong pia ding hi. Ka langte zahhuaisak inla, na nasempa keimah hong kipsak ta in."},"29":{"text":"Kei hong mawhsakte in mindaina silh uh hen la, puanza silh bangin amau’ maizumna tawh kituamcip ta uh hen."},"30":{"text":"Topa tungah ka lungdamna a gingpha-in ka ko ding a, mihonte lakah amah ka phat ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sih nading gimna a piapa’ khutsung pan a honkhia dingin mi cimawh pa’ taklamah amah hong ding hi."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in ka to kumpipa tungah, “Na galte nangma khengakna-in ka bawl matengin ka taklamah tu in,” a ci hi.","title":"Pasian in Kumpipa tungah Ukna Pia","ref":"Mat 22:24; Mrk 12:36; Luk 20:42-43; Sawl 2:34-35; 1Kor 15:25; Efe 1:20-22; Kol 3:1; Heb 1:13; 8:1; 10:12-13"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Zion panin na kumpi ciangkhut hong puak hi. Na galte’ tungah uk in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma mihonte mual siangtho tungah na makaih ciangin, utna lungsim tawh na mite hong kipia ding uh hi. Daitui bangin zingsangin na khangnona nangma tungah hong tung ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in thu ciamzo a, ama ngaihsutna kheel lo ding hi. “Melkhizedek bangin a tawntungin siampi na hi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 5:6; 6:20; 7:17,21"},"5":{"text":"Nangma taklamah Topa hong om a, ama heh ni-in kumpite a zogawp ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa in minamte lakah thu khen ding a, tua munte si luanghawm tawh a dimsak ding hi. Amah in a zai mahmah leitungah ukpite a susia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in lampi gei-a om luitui dawn ding a, amah a tha hatin a gualzo pa hi ding hi."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Lungsim thutangte a omna, mihon kikhopna sungah ka lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa’ tungah lungdamna ka ko ding hi.","title":"Liatna le A Hoihna"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ nasepna lian a, hoih a sa mi khempeuh in tuate kankan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama nasepnate, pahtawina le minliatna tawh kidim a, ama thumanna kip tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in phawk tawntung dingin a lamdang nasepnate hong bawl a, Topa dikin hehpihna nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in amah a zahtakte an pia a, a thuciamna a phawk tawntung hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in ama mite tungah minamte’ gamh a piakna tawh ama vangliatna hong lak khin hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama nasepnate khempeuhah amah thumanin citak a, a thupiaknate muantaak mahmah hi."},"8":{"text":"A tawntungin tuate kip ngitnget a, thuman le thutang tawh zuih ding ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in ama mite honkhia a, a tawntung a kimang dingin thupiakna a bawl khin hi. Ama min siangtho-in vanglian mahmah hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa zahtakna pen pilna kipatna ahi hi. Ama thupiak a zuite khempeuh tungah thukhen siamna a pia hi. Amah phat tawntung ding ahi hi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Pau 1:7; 9:10"}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Topa zahtakin a thupiaknate nuam a sa mahmah mi, thupha ngah mi ahi hi.","title":"Miphate’ Lungdamna"},"2":{"text":"Ama suanlekhakte leitungah vanglian ding a, a lungsim thutang mite’ suanlekhakte thupha kipia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Hauhna le nopsaknate a innkuan sungah dim ding a, ama thumanna kip tawntung ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungsim thutangte a dingin khuamial sung panin khuavak hong taangkhia hi. Topa dik a, hehpihna nei-in, amah thuman hi."},"5":{"text":"Cingh gamtatin mite tungah leitawi pia a, thutangin a gamta mite tungah thu a hoih hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah kiling lo taktak ding a, kiphawk tawntung ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in thusia zak ding lau lo hi. Topa muang a, ama lungsim a kip hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah lau loin, lunghimawh loin om hithiat a, amah a langpangte a guallelh ding a theitel hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in hawmkhia zuahzuah a, mizawngte tungah a piakhia hi. Ama migitna kip tawntung a, amah vanglianin kipahtawi ding hi.","ref":"2Kor 9:9"},"10":{"text":"Migilo in hih thu mu-in a heh suak mahmah a, a ha gawigawi-in a tuimang hi. Migilote’ lametna a mawkna a suakta hi."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Topa’ nasemte aw, phat un. Topa’ min phat un.","title":"Pasian in Miniamte Sangsak"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ min in tu a kipanin thupha ngah tawntung tahen."},"3":{"text":"Nisuahna pan nitumna dongin Topa’ min phat ding ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in minam khempeuh tungah uk a, ama minthanna vantung sangin sangzaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A sangna munah a tu, vantung le leitung a hong ensuk Topa, eite’ Pasian pen kua tawh kibang ahi hiam?","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Amah in leivui panin mizawngte laamto-in, ninphual panin mi cimawhte le a lungkhamte domto a,"},"8":{"text":"uliante tawh kikhawl sakin ama mite’ ulianin a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in tasel numei tungah ta guan a, ta a nei nu a lungdamin a bawl hi. Topa phat un."}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te, Egypt gam panin pusuakin, Jakob innkuanpihte paudang a zang mite kiang pan a paikhiat uh ciangin","title":"Egypt Panin Israel-te Hotkhiatna","ref":"Pai 12:51"},"2":{"text":"Judah-te, Topa’ mi siangtho suak a, Israel-te, ama uk mi a suak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuipi in amaute mu-in taikhia a, Jordan gun a nungkik hi.","ref":"Pai 14:21; Josh 3:16"},"4":{"text":"Mual liante tuutal bangin diang uh a, mual neute tuuno bangin a diang uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi aw, na taikhiatna ding, Jordan gun aw, na nungkikna ding,"},"6":{"text":"mual liante aw, tuu bangin mual neute aw, tuuno bangin na dianna ding uh bang in hong nasak ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Leitung aw, suangpi, bualtui suaksak a, meisuang, ciktui a suaksak, Jakob’ Pasian’ omna, Topa’ omna-ah ling in.","merge":"8","ref":"Pai 17:1-7; Gam 20:2-13"}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kote tungah hi loin, Topa aw, kote tungah hi loin, na itna kip le na thumanna hangin nangma tungah minthanna om tahen.","title":"Milim A Haihuaina le Muanna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hangin minam dangte in, “Amaute’ Pasian koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci laizang ding ahi uh hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Vantungah eite’ Pasian om a, ama ut peuhpeuh a hih hi."},"4":{"text":"Amau’ milimte pen ngun le kham hi lel a, mihingte’ khut tawh a kibawl ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in kam nei napi-in pau thei lo uh a, mit nei napi-in khua mu thei lo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in bil nei napi-in khua za lo uh a, nak nei napi-in a nam thei lo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in khut nei napi-in lawng thei lo uh a, khe nei napi-in pai thei lo uh hi. Amaute in aw gingsak thei lo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate a bawlte le tuate a muangte khempeuh pen tuate mah tawh kibang uh hi.","ref":"La 135:15-18; Mang 9:20"},"9":{"text":"Israel-te aw, Topa muang un. Amah pen note hong huhpa le hong hupa ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Aaron innkuante aw, Topa muang un. Amah pen note hong huhpa le hong hupa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa a zahtakte aw, Topa muang un. Amah pen note hong huhpa le hong hupa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in eite hong phawk a, thupha hong pia ding hi. Amah in Israel mite, thupha hong pia ding a, amah in Aaron innkuante thupha hong pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in Topa a zahtakte a lian a neu-in thupha hong pia ding hi.","ref":"Mang 11:18; 19:5"},"14":{"text":"Topa in note le na tate uh hong pungsak tahen."},"15":{"text":"Van le lei a bawl Topa in note thupha hong pia tahen."},"16":{"text":"Vantung pen Topa a’ hi a, ahih hangin leitung pen mihingte tungah hong pia khin hi."},"17":{"text":"Misite ahi a, gamdaihna sungah a pai peuhpeuhte in ahi zongin Topa phat lo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin eite in tu a kipanin a tawntungin Topa i phat ngitnget ding hi. Topa phat un."}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ka it hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in ka aw hong za-in ka thumnate hong ngai hi.","title":"Sihna panin Hotkhiat manin Lungdam Kohna"},"2":{"text":"Amah ka sap sialin ka sapna aw hong ngai hi."},"3":{"text":"Sihna khau in kei hong gakcip hi. Leinuai sihna in kei hong mancip a, natna le lungkhamna ka thuak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ tungah thu ngenin, “ Topa aw, nang tungah kong thum hi; kei hong hon in,” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa dikin thuman a, i Pasian in hehpihna nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in thu thei lo mi hong kem a, kei hong kiniamkoih ciangin amah in hong huh hi."},"7":{"text":"Lungmuang takin ka om ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keima tungah Topa hong thunuam hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in sihna panin kei hong honkhia hi. Ka khituite hong kangsak a, kei hong guallelsak lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mihingte’ omna leitung, Topa’ mai-ah nungta-in ka vak kawikawi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Nakpi takin gimna ka thuak hi,” ka cih hun ciang nangawnin ka upna mah ka len cinten hi.","ref":"2Kor 4:13"},"11":{"text":"Lunghihmawhna tawh, “Mi khempeuh zuau gen vive hi,” ka cih hun nangawnin ka um lailai hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei tunga ama thupha tampite Topa’ tungah bangci thuk ding ka hi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Topa in kei hong hotkhiat ka lungdamna hangin, ama kiangah tuiphih biakna ka paipih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa’ tungah ka thuciamnasa pen ama mite khempeuh a kikhopna munah ka pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama mi siangthote a sih ciangin Topa in na sa mahmah hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, kei pen nangma nasem ka hi hi. Nangma nasem ka hi a, na nasemnu’ ta ka hi hi. Keimah hong kikhihnate nong sutkhiatsak zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Lungdam koh biakpiakna nang tungah kong pia ding a, Topa’ tungah thu kong ngen ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi aw, ama mi khempeuh a omna sung, Topa’ inn huangsung, nangma laizangah, Topa’ tungah ka thuciamnasa ka pia ding hi. Topa phat un.","merge":"19"}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minam khempeuhte aw, Topa phat un. Minam khempeuhte aw, amah phat un.","title":"Topa Phat Un Phat Un","ref":"Rom 15:11"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh eite a hong itna lian mahmah a, Topa’ thutakna a tawntungin kip ngitnget hi. Topa phat un."}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ tungah lungdamna ko un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip tawntung hi.","title":"Hehpihna Kip Tawntung","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; La 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"“Ama itna kip tawntung hi,” Israel-te in ci ta uh hen."},"3":{"text":"“Ama itna kip tawntung hi,” Aaron innkuante in ci ta uh hen."},"4":{"text":"“Ama itna kip tawntung hi,” amah a zahtakte in ci ta uh hen."},"5":{"text":"Ka cihmawhna-ah Topa ka sam a, Topa in hong dawngin mun tanzau-ah hong koih hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in kei hong ompih hi. Bangmah ka kihta kei ding hi. Mihingte in kei, bang hong cihzo ding ahi uh hiam?","ref":"Heb 13:6"},"7":{"text":"Kei hong huh dingin kei lamah Topa om hi. Kei hong mudahte pen gualzawhna tawh ka en ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi i muan sangin Topa belh ding hoihzaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Uliante i muan sangin Topa belh ding hoihzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Minam khempeuh in kei hong umcih uh hi. Ahih hangin Topa’ vang tawh amaute ka sugawp hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in ka kimkotah kei hong umcih uh hi. Ahih hangin Topa’ vang tawh amaute ka sugawp hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in khuaipi bangin kei hong umcih uh a, ahi zongin selkeu kuang bangin amaute daikik pak uh hi. Topa’ vang tawh amaute ka sugawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei ka puk nadingin nakpitakin hong kisawn a, ahih hangin Topa in kei hong huh hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in a vanglian, a thahatin kei hong bawl a, amah pen kei a hong honpa ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 15:2; Isa 12:2"},"15":{"text":"Ngai un! Thuman mite’ puanbuk sungah gualzawh lungdamna la kisa a, “ Topa’ taklam khut in a lian nate hih khin hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa’ taklam khut kipahtawi a, Topa’ taklam khut in a lian nate hih khin hi,” kici hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei ka si kei ding a, ka hing ding hi. Topa’ sepnate ka gengen ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in nasia takin kei hong thuhilh a, ahih hangin kei hong sisak lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa’ tungah lungdamna ko-in ka lut theih nadingin biakinn kongpite kei hong hon in."},"20":{"text":"Hih pen Topa’ kongpi ahi hi. Nang pen keima Pasian na hi a, nangmah kong phat ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip tawntung hi."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amau’ gamtatna-ah paubaan om loin Topa’ ngeina sungah a gamtate thupha ngah ahi hi.","title":"Pasian’ Thu Ngaihsut Ngiungeuna"},"2":{"text":"Ama thuhilhnate zui-in, a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amah zongin, khialhna zong bawl loin, ama lampi a zuite, thupha ngah ahi hi.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhte limtakin zuih dingin thu nong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma ngeina kipte zuihna-ah ka gamtatna kip tahen."},"6":{"text":"Na thupiakte khempeuh mitsuanin nei ka hih manin, kei ka maizum kei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah biakna ngeina kipte ka sin khit ciangin lungsim thutang tawh nangmah kong phat ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma ngeina kipte ka zui ding hi; kei hong nusia suak kei in."},"9":{"text":"Tangval khat in ama gamtatna a siangtho mahmah dingin bangci kep ding ahi hiam? Nangma thu zuihna tawh ama gamtatna siangthosak thei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh nang ka hong zong hi. Na thupiaknate panin kei hong pialsak kei in."},"11":{"text":"Nangma tungah kong khialh loh nadingin ka lungsim sungah nangma thu ka khol hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, thupha ngah ta in; na ngeina kipte kei hong hilh in."},"13":{"text":"Nangma hong piak nangmah biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh ka gengen ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hauhnate khempeuh sangin nangma thuhilhnate nuam ka sa zaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhnate lungngaingai-in, nangma lampite ka mitsuan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma ngeina kipte-ah nuam ka sa ding a, nangma thu ka mangngilh ngei kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nungta-in nangma thu ka zuih theih nadingin na nasempa tungah hong cingh in."},"18":{"text":"Nangma thukham sung panin a lamdang nate ka muh theih nadingin keima mitte hong honsak in."},"19":{"text":"Kei pen hih leitungah peemta ka hi hi; kei’ kiang panin na thuphate seel kei in."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah biakna ngeina kipte a tawntungin ka lunggulh venvan hi."},"21":{"text":"Nangmah in na thupiaknate panin a pialkhia, a kisamsiat, a kiphasakte na thuhilh hi."},"22":{"text":"Na thuhilhnate zui ka hih manin amau’ hong nuihsatna le hong simmawhnate panin kei hong suaktasak in."},"23":{"text":"Uliante in kei hong langpangin thu a vaihawm uh hangin na nasempa in na ngeina kipte ngaihsunsun ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na thuhilhnate ka deih hi. A mong dongin ka zui ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Nangma thute kemin ka lungsim khempeuh tawh ka zuih theih nadingin thu theihtelna hong pia in."},"35":{"text":"Nangma thupiakna lampi-ah kei hong paipih in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah biakna ngeina kipte hoih mahmah hi."},"40":{"text":"En in, na thuhilhnate ka lunggulh hi. Na thumanna tawh kei hong hingsak in."},"41":{"text":"Topa aw, na ciamna bangin na itna kip, na hotkhiatna kei tungah hong tungsak in."},"42":{"text":"Tua hileh na thu ka muanna hangin kei hong zahkote ka dawnna ding hong om ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Nangmah biakna ngeina kipte lamenin om ka hih manin a man thu hong gen theisak tawntung in."},"44":{"text":"Nangma thu tatsat loin ka zui ngitnget ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhnate zuih ding hanciam ka hih manin nuamtakin ka nungta ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Kumpite’ mai-ah nangma thute ka gen ding a, maizumna ka thuak kei ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka deih nangma thupiakna zuih ding nuam ka sa hi."},"48":{"text":"Keima deih ahi na thupiakte ka zahtak a, na ngeina kipte ka lungngaingai ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Keimah nong lametsakna ahi na nasempa’ tungah na thuciamna hong phawk in."},"50":{"text":"Hih pen ka thuakna-ah keima kihehnepna hi a, na thuciamna in kei tungah nuntakna hong pia hi."},"51":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte in kei hong zahko gawp uh a, ahih hangin nangma thupiakna panin kei ka pial kei hi."},"52":{"text":"Topa aw, hun lui lai-a nangmah biakna ngeina kipte ka ngaihsut ciangin ka lung hong nuam hi."},"53":{"text":"Nangma thu a nusia migilote’ hangin ka heh a suak hi."},"54":{"text":"Hih leitung ka omna peuhah nangma ngeina kipte la phuahin ka sa hi."},"55":{"text":"Topa aw, zanin na min ka phawk a, nangma thu ka zui hi."},"56":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhte zui ka hih manin keima tungah hih thupha hong tung hi."},"57":{"text":"Topa pen keima tanh ahi hi. Na thute zuih ding ka kiciam hi."},"58":{"text":"Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh na maipha kong ngen hi. Na thuciamna omsa bangin kei hong hehpih in."},"59":{"text":"Ka gamtatnate ka ngaihsun a, na ngeinate zuih ding ka kiciam hi."},"60":{"text":"Kei kinawhin, na thupiakte zuih ding ka zekai kei hi."},"61":{"text":"Migilote’ khau in kei hong vialh hangin nangma thu ka mangngilh tuan kei hi."},"62":{"text":"A thuman na ngeina kipte hangin nangmah a phat dingin zankim laitakin ka tho hi."},"63":{"text":"Kei pen, na thuhilhte a zui, nangmah a hong zahtakte tawh a kikhawlpa ka hi hi."},"64":{"text":"Topa aw, leitung pen nangma itna kip tawh kidim hi. Na ngeina kipte kei hong hilh in."},"65":{"text":"Topa aw, na thuciamna bangin na nasempa na limbawl hi."},"66":{"text":"Na thupiakte um ka hih manin thu khentel theihna le theihsiamna hong hilh in."},"67":{"text":"Gim nong piak ma-in lam ka pial thei zel a, ahih hangin tu-in na thu ka zui hi."},"68":{"text":"Nangmah na hoih a, a hoih nate na sem hi. Na ngeina kipte kei hong hilh in."},"69":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte in kei’ thu, zuau vive gengen uh a, ahih hangin keimah in ka lungsim khempeuh tawh na thuhilhte ka zui hi."},"70":{"text":"Amaute’ lungsim in thu theithei loin khikcip a, ahih hangin keimah in nangma thu sung nuam ka sa hi."},"71":{"text":"Nangma ngeina kipte ka sin theih nadingin gimna ka thuak pen kei a dingin hoih mahmah hi."},"72":{"text":"Nangma kam sung pana thu pen kham le ngun tul tampite sangin kei a dingin hoihzaw hi."},"73":{"text":"Nangmah in kei hong piangsakin na hong bawl hi. Na thupiaknate ka sin theih nadingin thu theihtelna hong pia in."},"74":{"text":"Nangma thuciamna muang ka hih manin nang hong zahtakte in kei hong mu-in lungdam ding uh hi."},"75":{"text":"Topa aw, nangmah biakna ngeina kipte man hi, ci-in ka thei a, na thumanna hangin kei gim na hong pia hi."},"76":{"text":"Na nasempa tungah na thuciamna bangin keimah hong hehnem dingin na itna kip a baihsa-in hong omsak in."},"77":{"text":"Ka nuntak theih nadingin kei hong hehpih in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma thu nuam ka sa hi."},"78":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte zahhuaisak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in khemna tawh kei hong lumlet uh hi. Ke’n ahihleh na thuhilhte ka lungngaingai ding hi."},"79":{"text":"Na teci pannate a theih nadingun nang hong zahtakte kei’ lamah hong kiheisak in."},"80":{"text":"Guallelh maizumna ka thuak loh nadingin nangma ngeina kipte a kicing takin a zuizo mi hong hisak ta in."},"81":{"text":"Na hong hotkhiat ding ka ngakngakna-in ka tha bei ta a, nangma thu muangin ka lamen hi."},"82":{"text":"Na thuciamnate ka etetna-in ka mitte thazaw ta hi. “Cik ciangin hong hehnem ding na hiam?” kong ci hi."},"83":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen meikhu lak a a kikoihdak savun-um tawh ka kibang a, ahi zongin nangma ngeina kipte ka mangngilh tuan kei hi."},"84":{"text":"Na nasempa in bang tanvei ngaklai ding ka hi hiam? Kei hong bawlsiate cik ciangin thu khen ding na hi hiam?"},"85":{"text":"Nangma thu a zui lo, mi kiphasakte in keimah hong siahna-in gum a to uh hi."},"86":{"text":"Nangma thupiakte khempeuh man taktak hi. Amaute in thuman lopi-in kei hong bawlsia uh hi. Kei hong huh in."},"87":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong thatzo dektak uh hi. Ahih hangin na thuhilhnate ka mangngilh tuan kei hi."},"88":{"text":"Na kam pana na teci pannate ka zuih theih nadingin na itna kip tawh kei hong hingsak in."},"89":{"text":"Topa aw, vantungah nangma thu kip tawntung hi."},"90":{"text":"Nangma thumanna khang tawntungin kip hi. Ahih hangin na teci pannate ke’n ka lungngaingai ding hi."},"96":{"text":"A kicinga a kingaihsun nate khempeuh in mong a neihna ka mu khin a, ahih hangin na thupiakna in mong nei loin zai mahmah hi."},"97":{"text":"Na thu deih mahmah ing. Bang hang hiam cih leh na thuhilhnate ka zui hi."},"101":{"text":"Na thu ka zuih theih nadingin gamtatsia khempeuh ka pelh hi."},"102":{"text":"Nangmah in hong hilh khin na hih manin na biakna ngeina kipte panin kei ka pial kei hi."},"103":{"text":"Nangma thute khum mahmah a, khuaizu sangin khumzaw hi."},"104":{"text":"Na thuhilhnate hangin thu theihtelna ka ngah hi. Topa aw, nong ciamsa bangin kei hong nungtasak in."},"108":{"text":"Topa aw, phatin kong biaknate hong sang inla, nangmah biakna ngeina kipte kei hong hilh in."},"109":{"text":"Nisimin ka nuntakna a lauhuai sungah om ngitnget a, ahih hangin nangma thu ka mangngilh tuan kei hi."},"110":{"text":"Migilote in kei thang hong siah uh a, ahih hangin na thuhilhnate panin kei ka pial kei hi."},"111":{"text":"Nangmah biakna ngeina kipte tawntung keima luah ahi hi. Tuate pen keima lungdamna ahi hi."},"112":{"text":"Nangma ngeina kipte ka sih mateng a zui tawntung dingin ka lungsim ka khensat hi."},"113":{"text":"Nangma tungah a thuman lote ka mudah a, ahih hangin keimah in nangma thu ka deih hi."},"114":{"text":"Nang pen keima bukna mun le kei hong hupa na hi hi. Na thuciamna ka muang hi."},"115":{"text":"No, siatna a bawlte aw, Pasian’ thupiakte ka zuih theih nadingin kei kiang panin paikhia un."},"116":{"text":"Kei ka nuntak theih nadingin na thuciamna tawh kizui-in kei hong huh inla, ka lametna-ah kei hong zahhuaisak kei in."},"117":{"text":"Ka suahtak theih nading le na ngeina kipte sungah nuamsa-in ka om ngitnget theih nadingin kei hong huh in."},"118":{"text":"Nangma ngeina kipte panin a pialkhiate khempeuh na nilkhia hi. Amau’ khem siamna a mawkna ahi hi."},"119":{"text":"Leitung a migilote khempeuh sik-ek bangin na ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih ciangin na teci pannate ka deih hi."},"120":{"text":"Nang kong zahtakna hangin ka khuasikmul suak a, na thukhennate ka zahtak hi."},"121":{"text":"Thutang thumanin ka gamta hi. Hong nengniamte’ khut sungah kei hong nusia kei in."},"122":{"text":"Na nasempa a dingin nangmah hong kikham inla, mi kiphasakte hong nengniamsak kei in."},"123":{"text":"Nangma hotkhiatna le a man na thuciamna hong tun ding ka etna-in ka mitte a gim ta hi."},"124":{"text":"Na itna kip tawh kituakin na nasempa tungah hong bawl inla, na ngeina kipte kei hong hilh in."},"125":{"text":"Kei pen na nasempa ka hi hi. Na thuhilhnate ka theih nadingin thu theihtelna hong guan in."},"126":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma thu kipalsat khin ahih ciangin thu na khen ding hun hita hi."},"127":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin khamte, le kham hoihpente sangin nangma thupiakna ka deihzaw hi."},"128":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin na thuhilhnate khempeuh tawh a kituakin kei ka gamta a, a man lo lampi khempeuh ka mudah hi."},"129":{"text":"Na thuhilhnate lamdang pha mahmah a, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh tuate ka zui hi."},"130":{"text":"Na thute gentelna in khua vaksak a, thu thei lote tungah thu theihtelna a guan hi."},"131":{"text":"Na thupiakte ka lunggulhna-in ka kam ka-in ka leii ka kha hi."},"132":{"text":"Nangmah hong itte tungah na hih ngei bangin kei lamah hong kihei-in kei hong hehpih in."},"133":{"text":"Na hong ciamsa bangin ka pukna ding panin hong kem inla, keima tungah siatna gualzosak kei in."},"134":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhte ka zuih theih nadingin hong nengniamte’ kiang pan kei hong honkhia in."},"135":{"text":"Na nasempa tungah na mai hong taangsak inla, na ngeina kipte hong hilh in."},"136":{"text":"Mite in nangma thu zui lo uh ahih manin ka khitui hawk luanin a luang hi."},"137":{"text":"Topa aw, nang na thuman a, na thukhennate zong thuman mahmah hi."},"138":{"text":"Nangma koihsa ngeina kipte thumanin thutak hi."},"139":{"text":"Ka galte in nangma thu kin het lo uh ahih manin keima hehna mei bangin a kuang hi."},"140":{"text":"Na thuciamnate kician mahmah a, na nasempa in tuate deih mahmah hi."},"141":{"text":"Kei ka neu a, hong kisimmawh hi. Na thuhilhnate ka zuih theih nadingin kei hong hon in."},"147":{"text":"Khuavak ma-in tho-in huhna ngenin kong kiko a, nangma thuciamna hong tun ding lamenin ka om niloh hi."},"148":{"text":"Nangma thuciamna a lungngaingai dingin zan khuavakin ka zanhak hi."},"149":{"text":"Topa aw, na itna kip tawh a kizui-in ka aw hong za inla, nangma thutang tawh kizui-in ka nuntakna hong kem in."},"150":{"text":"Gitloh ngimna tawh kei hong bawlsia mite in kei hong nehta uh a, amaute in nangma thu ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi."},"151":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa aw, kei kiangah nang nong nai a, na thupiaknate khempeuh ahi taktak vive ahi hi."},"152":{"text":"Tuate a tawntungin a kip dingin na bawl ahihna thu, nangma thuhilhnate panin sawtpi-in ka thei hi."},"153":{"text":"Ka thuakna hong en inla, kei hong honkhia in. Na biakna ngeina kip tawh a kituakin kei hong honkhia in."},"157":{"text":"Kei hong bawlsiate, ka langte tam mahmah a, ahih hangin nangma thu panin kei ka pial tuan kei hi."},"158":{"text":"Thuman lo mite ka muh ciangin ka kih mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in nangma thupiakte zui lo uh hi."},"159":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhnate bangzah takin ka deihna hong ngaihsun in. Topa aw, na itna kip tawh a kizui-in kei hong hon in."},"160":{"text":"Na thubulpi thumanna hi a, a man mahmah, nangmah biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh a tawntungin kip paisuak hi."},"161":{"text":"Uliante in thu om lopi-in kei hong bawlsia uh a, ahih hangin na thute lamdang sa mahmahin ka thupi ngaihsut hi."},"162":{"text":"Vankinusia tampi tak a ngah pa bangin na thuciamna-ah ka lung a dam mahmah hi."},"163":{"text":"Zuaunate zadahin ka kih a, ahih hangin nangma thu ka deih mahmah hi."},"164":{"text":"Nangmah biakna ngeina kipte hangin nisimin sagihvei nang kong phat hi."},"165":{"text":"Nangma thu a deihte in lungnopna lianpi ngah uh a, amaute a tuksakzo ding bangmah om lo hi."},"166":{"text":"Topa aw, nong hotkhiat ding ka ngak a, na thupiakte ka sem hi."},"167":{"text":"Na thuhilhnate ka zui a, tuate ka nak deih mahmah hi."},"168":{"text":"Na thuhilhnate le na ngeina kip omte khempeuh hoihtakin ka zui a, ka gamtatna khempeuh nangmah in na hong mu hi."},"169":{"text":"Topa aw, kong kikona aw, na kiang hong tung hen la, nangma thu omsa tawh kizui-in thu theihtelna kei hong guan in."},"170":{"text":"Keima thumna in na kiang hong ban hen la, nangma thu omsa tawh kizui-in kei hong honkhia in."},"171":{"text":"Na ngeina kipte kei hong hilh na hih manin kong phat tawntung ding hi."},"172":{"text":"Na thupiak khempeuh man mahmah ahih manin nangma thu phatna la ka sa ding hi."},"173":{"text":"Nangma thuhilhte hong zui ka hih manin keimah hong huh dingin a kigingsa-in om tawntung in."},"174":{"text":"Topa aw, nong hotkhiat ding ka lamen a, nangma khut sungah nuam ka sa mahmah hi."},"175":{"text":"Nang kong phat theih nadingin kei hong nungtasak inla, nangmah biakna ngeina kipte kei hong huhsak in."},"176":{"text":"A gammang tuu bangin lam ka pial khin hi. Tua ahih manin na nasempa hong zong in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma thupiaknate ka pelh kei hi."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka cihmawh ciangin Topa’ tungah ka kiko a, amah in hong dawng hi.","title":"Huh Ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, mizuaute le mikhemte’ kiang panin kei hong honkhia in."},"3":{"text":"Mikhem theite aw, note’ tungah bang hong kipia ding a, note’ tungah bang hong kihih ding ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Galhang pa’ thal hiamte le sesing hol-am hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Note lakah ka omkhak pen Meshek gam sungah tenkhak sangin haksazaw a, Kedar mite lakah tenkhak sangin siahuaizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Gal kilemna a deih lo mite lakah sauvei ka teng luakha hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei pen gal kilemna a ngaihsun mi ka hi hi. Ahih hangin kilemna ding thu ka gen ciangin amaute in galkido ding utna tengin nei uh hi."}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keimah in mualtung lam ka ento hi. Keimah huhna koi lai pan hong pai ding ahi hiam?","title":"Ama Mite A Kem pa"},"2":{"text":"Van le lei a bawl Topa’ kiang panin keimah huhna hong pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in ka khe taalsak lo ding a, kei hong kem pa lusu lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"En un, Israel a kem pa lusu lo a, zong ihmu lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in nang hong cing ding a, nangmah a hong hu dingin na kiangah hong om hi."},"6":{"text":"Sunin ni in nang hong gimsak lo ding a, zanin kha in zong nang hong sukha lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in siatna khempeuh panin nang hong hu ding a, amah in a muanhuai-in nang hong kem ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in tua kipan a tawntungin na vaksuk na vaktohna-ah nang hong kem ding hi."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaute in kei tungah, “ Topa’ inn-ah pai ni,” hong cih uh ciangin kei ka kipak hi.","title":"Jerusalem’ Nopsakna ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, na kulhkongpi sungah kote hong tungin ka ding khinta uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi pen Israel-te tungah thu a kipiaksa bangin Topa’ tungah lungdamna a ko dingin Topa’ minamte, Israel minamte, a hong paitohna, khuapi lian tawh a kibangin a kibawl, kiptakin a kilam bikbek khuapi ahi hi.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"David’ innkuante’ kumpi tokhom, thukhenna ding kumpi tokhomte, tua lai-ah kikoih hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi, a nopsakna ding thu ngen unla, “Nang hong itte a dau pai tahen."},"7":{"text":"Na khua sungah lungnopna om hen la, na galvilna tausangte’ huam sungah lungmuanna om ta hen,” ci-in ngen un."},"8":{"text":"Sanggamte le kikholhpihte ka khualna-in, “Jerusalem in nopna om ta hen,” ka ci ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa eite’ Pasian’ inn ka khualna-in nangma hoihna ding thu ka ngen ding hi."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantungah a om pa aw, nangmah kong ento hi.","title":"Lamen a Pasian Ngakna"},"2":{"text":"Nasem pasalte in a topa uh muang a, nasem numeite in a tonu uh a muan mah bangin ko tungah hehpihna nong neih matengin Topa kote’ Pasian kong mitsuan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kote hong hehpih in. Topa aw, kote hong hehpih in. Bang hang hiam cih leh kote in ka thuak zawh loh uh simmawhna ka thuak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A ututin a gamta mite in kote a hong zahkona, a kiphasak mite in hong simmawh bawlna hangin ka gimthuakna uh sauvei lua khinta hi."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite aw, Topa in hong panpih lo hileh i tuah ding thu thei un.","title":"Hotkhiatna hangin Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Eite langpangin mite hong kipat ciangin eite’ lamah Topa hong pang lo hileh,"},"3":{"text":"eite’ tungah a hehna uh a kisosuah ciangin amaute in eite a hingin hong nawmvalh khin ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuikhang in eite hong tai-in, tuihual in hong tum khin ding a,"},"5":{"text":"tuipi husiate in hong tuummang khin ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute’ suksiat dingin eite a hong piakhia lo Topa in thupha ngah tahen."},"7":{"text":"Thangsiahte’ thangzak panin vasa a suahtak bangin eite i suakta hi. Thangkhau kibottat a, eite i suakta khinta hi."},"8":{"text":"Van le lei a bawl Topa’ tung panin eite huhna hong pai hi."}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa a muang mite pen ling hetloin a om tawntung Zion Mual tawh kibang hi.","title":"Ama Mite’ Kimkotah Om"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem kimkotah mualte a om mah bangin ama mite’ kimkotah tua kipan a tawntungin Topa om ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Thuman mite a khialhkhak loh nadingun amau a kipia leitang tungah migilote in amaute uk paisuak lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, a hoih mite tung le na thupiakna a zui mite tungah hehpihna hong nei in."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin amau’ gitlohna a zuite pen siatna a bawlte gim na piak ciangin amaute tawh piakhawm in. Israel tungah nopna om ta hen!"}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Zion-ah eite hong ciahpih kik ciangin i mang tawh kibang liang hi.","title":"Salin Omna Pan Ciahkikna"},"2":{"text":"Lungdamin i nui a, lungdam lua-in la i sa hi. Tua ciangin minam dangte kiho-in, “ Topa in amau a dingin na lianpite bawl khinta hi,” kici uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in eite a dingin na lianpite bawl khinta a, eite i kipak hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, lei keuna munah guah in tui a puak bangin kote’ nopsaknate a ngei hong bangsakkik ta in."},"5":{"text":"Khitui tawh khai a tuhte lungdamin kikona tawh an la sak ta in."},"6":{"text":"Kap kawmin kuankhia-in a tuh ding khaici a pua mi lungdamin kikona tawh buhlomte pua-in hong ciah ding hi."}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in inn lampih kei leh innlamte’ sepna a mawkna ahi hi. Topa in khuapi hutpih kei leh khuapi cingte’ cinna a mawkna ahi hi.","title":"Pasian, Hauhna Hong Pia pa"},"2":{"text":"Zingsangin tho baihin, gimpi a nangma sepsa an na nek hakna zong a mawkna mah ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in ama itte tungah a ihmut sung nangawnun a pia hi."},"3":{"text":"En un, tate pen Topa’ tung pana letsong hi a, tapate pen ama hong piak thupha ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khat in a khangno lai-in a neih tate pen galhang pa’ khutsunga a om a thaltangte tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"A thallawng dimin tua bang thaltang a nei pa mi lungdam ahi hi. Amah guallel ngei lo ding a, zahhuai ngei lo ding hi."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa zahtakin ama thu a zui mi khempeuh thupha ngah mi ahi hi.","title":"Mipha Innkuan Sunga Thupha"},"2":{"text":"Na khut tawh na sep thaman na ne ding a, na lungdamin na maavang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma inn sungah na zi, a gah pha mahmah leenggui tawh kibang ding a, na sabuai kiimah a tu na tate, oliv no dawng hilhhelh tawh kibang ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"En un, Topa a zahtak mi tua bangin thupha kipia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Zion panin nang thupha hong pia hen la, na nuntak sung tawntung Jerusalem’ nopsakna mu ta in."},"6":{"text":"Na tute a mu dingin hong siam tahen. Israel tungah nopna om ta hen!"}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka neu lai a kipanin nakpitakin amaute in kei hong gimsak uh hi,” Israel in tu-in ci tahen.","title":"Galte, Lotthal ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka neu lai a kipanin nakpitakin amaute in kei hong gimsak uh a, ahih hangin amaute in kei hong zo nai lo uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Lo khote in lei a kuih bangin ka nungzang hong kuikek uh a, tu-ma-kuakte tawh kibangsak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa thuman a, amah in migilote’ henna khaute sutat khinta hi,” amaute in ci ta uh hen."},"5":{"text":"Zion a mudahte khempeuh maizumin kinungkiksak tahen."},"6":{"text":"Amaute pen a khan khit ma-a a vul, innkhumzanga lopa, an at pa in a khut sungah a kaihkhop loh, buhlom hen pa in a ang-ah a pom loh, amau a mukhate in, “ Topa’ thupha na tungah om tahen. Topa’ min tawh thupha kong pia uh hi,” a cih loh mite tawh kibangsak in.","merge":"8"}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka lungkham mahmahna panin nang tungah kong kiko hi.","title":"Huh Ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, ka aw hong za in. Ka thumna awgingte hong ngai in."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, nangmah in mawhneite ciamteh lecin, Topa aw, kua in thuakzo ding ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah hong kizahtak theih nadingin nangmah in mawhna na maisak hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ hong huh ding lawpna tawh ka ngak a, ama thugen ka muang hi."},"6":{"text":"Galvilte in zingsang hun ding a ngaklah sangin galvilte in phalvak hun ding a ngaklah sangin, Topa ka ngaklah zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel aw, Topa muang in. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ itna kip tawntungin, hong honkhia nuam tawntung hi."},"8":{"text":"Mawhna a om khempeuh panin amah in Israel-te a honkhia ding hi.","ref":"Mat 1:21; Tit 2:14"}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka lungsim kiliansak nawn lo a, kei ka kihisak nawnkei hi. Kei a dingin a lianlua le a lamdang luate ngaihsutin ka nei kei hi.","title":"Kiniamsakna tawh Pasian Muanna"},"2":{"text":"A nu’ nawi tawh a kikhenta naupang bangin daitakin ka om dide zota hi. A dai hithiat-a om naupang tawh ka kibangta hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel aw, tu a kipanin a tawntungin Topa muang in."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, David na ngaihsutna-in a gim thuaknate khempeuh le amah in, “Jakob’ Vanglianpa’ tenna ding, Topa a’ ding mun ka muh matengin ka inn sungah ka lum kei ding a, ka lupna ka zuan kei ding hi. Ka ihmu kei ding a, ka mitkhute ka kikhupsak kei ding hi,” ci-in Jakob’ Vanglianpa’ tungah hong thuciamna le Topa’ tungah hong kiciamnate phawk in.","title":"Pasian’ Inn Deihna","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Jaar gam sungah Thuciamna Singkuang ka mu uh hi, cihna thuthak Bethlehem-ah kiza hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ama omna munah va pai ni; ama khengakna-ah va bia ni,” ka ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, tho inla na vangliatna lim Thuciamna Singkuang tawh na omna munah pai in."},"9":{"text":"Na mite na hotkhiatna thu, na siampite in taangko hen la, na mi siangthote lungdamin awng ta uh hen."},"10":{"text":"Na nasempa David tungah thu na ciamzo hi; na sathau nilh pa nial kei in.","ref":"2Khang 6:41-42"},"11":{"text":"Topa in a pelh loh ding kiciamna taktak khat David tungah kiciam a, “Nang’ sung pana na tate khat na kumpi tokhom tungah ka koih ding hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12-16; 1Khang 17:11-14; La 89:3-4; Sawl 2:30"},"12":{"text":"Na tate in, amau’ tungah ka hilh ding ka thuciamna le ka teci pannate a zuih nak-uhleh, amau’ tate zong na kumpi tokhom tungah tu paisuak ding uh hi,” na ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Zion teel khinzo a, amah in tua mun pen ama ten nadingin a deih hi."},"14":{"text":"“Hih mun pen ka om tawntungna ding ahi hi; hih mun deih ka hih manin hih lai-ah ka teng ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama beemlepang thupha tampi ka pia ding a, a mizawngte an ka vak kham ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka hotkhiatna thu, a siampite ka taangkosak ding a, a mi siangthote lungdamin la sa-in awng ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Keimah in tua lai-ah David’ suanlekhakte kumpi lianin ka koih ding a, ka sathau nilh pa’ ukna ka kipsak ding hi.","ref":"1Kum 11:36"},"18":{"text":"Ama galte maizumna tawh ka dimsak ding a, ahih hangin ama kumpi gam khangin zai semsem ding hi,” na ci hi."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, sanggamte pumkhat suakin a tut khawm uh ciangin bangzahin hoihin nuam ahi hiam?","title":"Sanggam Pumkhat Hihna A Nopna"},"2":{"text":"Tua pen a puan ngawng tungah Aaron’ khamul kaisuk zui-in a lu tung panin a taaksuk, sathau manpha tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua pen Zion mualte tungah a kia, Hermon mual pana hong piang daitui tawh kibang hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in nuntak tawntungna thupha tua munah a pia hi."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zan khuavakin Topa’ inn sungah a ding, Topa’ nasemte khempeuh aw, hong pai-in Topa phat un.","title":"Zan Hunin Pasian Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Siangtho mun lamah na khutte uh laamto-in Topa phat un."},"3":{"text":"Van le lei a bawl Topa in Zion panin note tungah thupha hong pia tahen."}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. I Pasian’ inn huangsung, Topa’ innsunga a ding, Topa’ nasemte aw, Topa phat un; ama min phat un.","title":"Milim A Mawkna","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Topa phat un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa hoih hi. Ama min phatna la sak un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah phatnophuai hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama a dingin Jakob teel a, ama neihsa dingin Israel teel khinta hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian hi, ci-in ka thei a, eite’ Topa pen pasian dang khempeuh sangin a lianzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantung le leitung, tuipi le a thukna sung khempeuhah Topa in ama ut peuhpeuh a bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in leimong panin meiipi kaisakin, guahzuk nadingin khuaphialepte bawl a, a huihkua panin huih a pusuaksak hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in Egypt gam sungah mihing ganhing tacil khempeuh a vatmai hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt aw, nangma sungah lim le na lamdangte, Faro le a nasem khempeuhte gimpiakna-in a lak hi."},"10":{"text":"Minam tampite vatmai-in kumpi vangliante that a,"},"11":{"text":"Amor kumpipa Sihon, Bashan kumpipa Og le Kanaan kumpite a that hi."},"12":{"text":"Amau’ leitang khempeuh, ama mi Israel-te’ luah dingin a piakhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma min kip tawntung hi. Topa aw, na minthanna khang tawntungin a kip hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama mite’ thu khenin, ama nasemte tungah hehpihna a nei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Minam dangte’ pasian-te pen mihingte’ khut tawh a kibawl, ngun le kham ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute in kam nei napi, pau thei lo uh hi. Amaute in mit nei napi, khua mu thei lo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in bil nei napi, khua za thei lo uh hi. Amaute’ kam sungah naksuk naktoh theihna nei lo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Milim a bawl mite pen milim mah bangsak in. Milim a muang khempeuhte zong tua milimte mah bangsak in.","ref":"La 115:4-8; Mang 9:20"},"19":{"text":"Israel mite aw, Topa phat un. Aaron’ innkuante aw, Topa phat un."},"20":{"text":"Levi mite aw, Topa phat un. Topa a zahtakte aw, Topa phat un."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem inn-a a nei, Zion-a om Topa in thupha ngah tahen. Topa phat un."}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah hoih ahih manin Topa tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","title":"Pasian’ Itna Hangin Lungdamna","ref":"1Khang 16:34; 2Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezr 3:11; La 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Lungdamna pen pasian-te’ Pasian’ tungah ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"3":{"text":"Lungdamna pen topate’ Topa’ tungah ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Na lamdang lian a bawl amah bek Pasian ahipa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"5":{"text":"Theihna tawh vantungte a bawlpa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pian 1:1"},"6":{"text":"Tuite tungah leitung a zal pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pian 1:2"},"7":{"text":"Khuavak lianpite a bawlpa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"8":{"text":"Sun pen ni a uksak pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"9":{"text":"Zan pen kha le aksite a uksak pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pian 1:16"},"10":{"text":"Egypt gam tacil khempeuh a vatmaipa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pai 12:29"},"11":{"text":"Amau’ gam sung pan Israel-te a paikhiatpih pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pai 12:51"},"12":{"text":"A baan zanin a khut thahat tawh a paikhiatpih pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"13":{"text":"San Tuipi a phelkham pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel-te tui laizang a kantan sakpa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin Faro le a mihonte San Tuipi sungah a thalpaih pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pai 14:21-29"},"16":{"text":"Sehnel gam nawkin ama mite a paipihpa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpi liante a vatmaipa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi minthangte a that pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"19":{"text":"Amor mite’ kumpipa Sihon’ hang le, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi;","ref":"Gam 21:21-30"},"20":{"text":"Bashan kumpipa Og’ hangin, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Gam 21:31-35"},"21":{"text":"Amaute’ leitang pen gamhluah dingin a piakhia pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama nasem Israel tungah gamh a a piapa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"23":{"text":"Miniam ihih laitakin a hong phawk pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"24":{"text":"I galte’ kiang pan eite hong honkhia pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"25":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei khempeuh an a vak pa tungah, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."},"26":{"text":"Vantung Pasian’ tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion khuapi i ngaihsut khak ciangin Babylon luite gei-ah eite tusukin i kapkap hi.","title":"Babylon-ah Sala om Manin Gimna"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai-a gialhek kungte tungah i laiza lasaknate i khai hi;"},"3":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh ei hong man mite in la i sak ding hong deih a, ei hong bawlsiate in i gualnop ding hong deihin, “Zion late khat hong sak un,” hong ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ la, gam dangah bangci sak theih ding ihi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi aw, nang kong mangngilh taak leh ka taklam khut buisum ta hen!"},"6":{"text":"Nang kong phawk kei a, kei’ lungdamna a lian pen sangin Jerusalem a sangzaw-in kong koih kei taak leh ka dang tawngah ka leii toncip ta hen!"},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, Jerusalem a siat hun lai-in Edom mite in, “Sumai un, sumai un! A bulpi dongin sumai un!” a cih vialna uh phawk in."},"8":{"text":"Misusia Babylon aw, kote’ tungah nong bawl bangin nang tungah hong thukpa in lungdamna ngah ta hen!","ref":"Mang 18:6"},"9":{"text":"Na taneute hong laksakin suangtumpi denna-in a hong neihsak pa in lungdamna ngah ta hen!"}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh nangma tungah lungdamna kong ko a, pasian-te’ mai-ah nangmah phatna ka sa hi.","title":"Pasian’ Maipha Hangin Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Na biakinn siangtho lamah kei ka kun a, na itna kip le na thumanna hangin na min kong phat hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na dang khempeuh sangin na min le na thu a liatzawkna na lak hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang kong sap ciangin kei nong dawng a, na thahatna tawh kei nong thakhauhsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, leitung khempeuh in na thuciamnate za khin uh ahih manin nang hong phat ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ minthanna lian mahmah ahih manin amaute in Topa’ nasepna ziate la-in sa ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian mahmah napi-in amah in a neute don a, a kiphasakte ahihleh amah in gamlapi panin mu thei veve hi."},"7":{"text":"Haksatna tuamtuamte ka thuak ciangin kei nong kem hi. A heh ka galte, kei’ tangin nong dosak a, na thahatna tawh kei na hong honkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in kei a dingin a ngaihsutte hong tungsak ding hi. Topa aw, na itna kip tawntung hi. Na sepsa na maban hong tun ta in."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nangmah in kei na hong entel a, nong thei khin hi.","title":"Pasian in Na Khempeuh Thei, Mun Khempeuhah Om"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah in ka heksukna, ka hektohnate na thei hi. Nangmah in ka ngaihsutnate gamlapi pek panin na thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in ka sep laitak ahi a, ka khawl laitak ahi zongin na hong mu a, ka gamtatna khempeuh a vekpi-in na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, kam khat bek nangawn ka paukhiat ma-in, nangmah in ka gen dingteng a vekpi-in na thei khin hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah in ka nung le ka mai-ah nong dal a, na thahatna tawh kei na hong hu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin kei nong theihna pen kei a dingin lamdang lua mahmah a, thuthuk lua ahih manin kei’ theihtel zawh ding hi lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah a pelh dingin koi-ah pai ding a, nangma omna panin koi lai-ah taikhia ding ka hi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Vantungah kahto leng tua lai-ah nang na om ding a, Leinuai misite’ gamah lupna bawlta leng zong tua lai-ah zong nang na om veve ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Leimong pekah leengin, tuipi mong pekah omta leng zong,"},"10":{"text":"tua lai nangawnah nangma khut in kei hong paipihin, na khut taklam in kei hong len ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Khuamial in kei hong tuamcip hen la, ka kiima khuavak omte zan khuamial suak hen,” ci taleng zong,"},"12":{"text":"tua nangawnah, nangma a dingin khuamial pen mial lo a, zan khuamial pen sun nitaang tawh kibang hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang a dingin khuamial pen khuavak mah bang lel hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pumpi na khempeuh na hong piangsak a, ka nu’ gil sungah keimah nong khuituah hi."},"14":{"text":"Kihtak dingin a kilawm na hih manin nang ka hong phat hi. Na nasepnate lamdang mahmah! Nangmah in kei nong lim theih mahmah hi."},"15":{"text":"A thukna sung mun simthamah kei hong kikhuituahin hong kibawl laitakin, ka guh ka taang, na mai-ah kiliah lo hi."},"16":{"text":"A kipiangsak nai lo keima pumpi nate na mit in a mu hi. Ka pumpi nate khat beek a om ma, ka ni zah ding a kiciangtan laitakin, tuate khempeuh na laibu sungah kigelh khin hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian aw, na ngaihsutnate kei a dingin manpha mahmah a, tuate khempeuh a vekpi-in zai mahmah hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuate a mal sim leng sehnel sangin tamzaw hi. Ka khanlawh ciangin nang tawh ka omkhawm lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian aw, migilote that inla, kei kiang panin mi that theite paikhia sak in."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in nang hong dem uh a, ngimna hoih lo tawh nang hong pang uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa aw, nang hong mudah mite ke’n mudah hi lo ka hi hiam? Nang’ langah hong pangte ke’n kih hi lo ka hi hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Amaute ka mudah mahmah a, amaute ka galin ka seh hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian aw, kei hong entel inla, ka lungsim hong thei in. Kei hong sit inla, ka ngaihsutnate hong thei in."},"24":{"text":"Kei sungah siattheihna a omkha hiam hong en inla, tawntung lampi-ah kei hong kha in."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, migilote kiang panin kei hong honkhia inla, mi ngongtatte kiang panin kei hong kem in.","title":"A Ngongtatte’ Kiang Pan Hut Ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in a lung sung uhah thusia geelgeel uh a, gal phuang ngitnget uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A leii uh gulpi leii bang a, a thugente uh gulgu bang hi.","ref":"Rom 3:13"},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, migilote’ khutsung panin kei hong cing inla, kei, sukpaih ding a hong sawm mi ngongtatte kiang panin kei hong kem in."},"5":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte in keimah hong siahna-in tehlop tung sim uh a, amaute in ngenthang zakin lam gei-ah thangzak tawh kei hong siah uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa’ tungah hih bangin ka ci hi: Nang pen keima Pasian na hi hi; ka thumna awte hong ngai in, Topa !"},"7":{"text":"Topa, keima Topa, a thahat hong honkhia pa aw, galkidona sungah keimah nong hu hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, migilo pa’ deihnate tangtungsak kei inla, ama thusia sawmna a maban sotsak kei in!"},"9":{"text":"Kei hong umcih mite gualzosak kei inla, kei hong sawmnate uh amau’ lu tung mah tusak in!"},"10":{"text":"Amaute tungah mei-am kuang zusak in. A thokikzo nawn lo dingin dum sungah amaute kiasak in!"},"11":{"text":"Mi gensia pa leitungah mavangsak kei inla, mi ngongtat pa pen thusia in sulzuih ta hen!"},"12":{"text":"Topa in gimna a thuak mite’ thu a panpihna, mi cimawhte a dingin thu a manin a khenna ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuman mite in nangma min hong phat pelmawh ding uh a, lungsim thutangte pen nangma omna-ah teng ding uh hi."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang kong sam hi; hong kinawh in. Nang kong sap ciangin ka aw hong ngai in.","title":"Thuman Theihna Ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thungetna pen na mai-ah paknamtui bangsak inla, ka khutte ka laptohna pen nitak biakpiakna bangsak in.","ref":"Mang 5:8"},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, keima kam a cing ding khat koih inla, ka mukte’ kongkhak a vil ding khat koih in."},"4":{"text":"Mawh bawlnopna lungsim hong neisak kei inla, a gilo mite tawh hong kikhawlsak kei in. Amau’ anlimte hong duhgawh sak kei ta in."},"5":{"text":"Mipha pa kei hong vuasak inla, ahih hangin migilote ka lu sathau nilhsak kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ gitloh gamtatnate nakpitakin langpangin thu ka ngenngen hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute, thu kisitin mawhsakna a thuak uh ciangin, Topa’ thute man hi, ci-in a thei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khat in suangpi khat sukhamin leitungah a thehthang gawp bangin Leinuai’ kongvangah amau’ guhte kithehthang hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa Pasian aw, nang ka hong muang tawntung a, nangmah ka hong bel hi. Tua ahih manin kei hong nusia kei in."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong siahna uh tehlop le siatna bawlte’ thangzak panin kei hong kem in."},"10":{"text":"Kei ka suahtak khit ciangin amau’ ngenthang sung mahah migilote awksak in."}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ hong huh ding ngenin ka kiko a, Topa’ tungah ka thum hi.","title":"Bawlsiatna pan Hot ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Ama mai-ah ka lungkim lohna ka sung a, ama mai-ah ka haksatna teng ka gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka cih nading ka theih nawn loh ciangin, amah in ka mailam ding hong theihsak hi. Ka paina lampi-ah ka galte in tehlop khat tawh kei hong siah uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka kiim ka pam khuadakin ka en kawikawi a, ahih hangin kei hong huh ding kuamah om lo hi. Ka belh ding kuamah om lo a, kuamah in kei hong don lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, nang tungah kong kiko hi. Nang pen keima belh na hi a, a hingte’ leitangah keima tanh na hi hi, ka hong ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka kikona hong ngai in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nakpitakin kei hong kiniamkoih suk hi. Kei hong bawlsiate’ kiang pan hong honkhia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei a dingin amaute hatlua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Thong sung panin kei hong lakhia in. Tua ciangin nangma mite tawh kong phatkhawm ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh itna lianpi tawh kei tungah nong gamta hi."}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, ka thungetna hong za inla, kong thumnate hong ngai in. Na thumanna le na thutakna tawh kizui-in kei hong dawng in.","title":"Hotkhiat ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Na nasempa, thu hong sit kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma mai-ah mihing a dikzo kuamah om lo hi.","ref":"Rom 3:20; Gal 2:16"},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh gal in kei hong bawlsia-in hong zogawp hi. Sauveipi lai-a a site bangin a mial sungah hong tusak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin cih nading ka thei nawn kei a, ka lungtangah si teng nawn lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Hun luite ka phawk a, na sepsa khempeuh ka ngaihsunsun hi. Na khut in a sepsa nate ka lungngaingai hi."},"6":{"text":"Thu ngenin nang lamah ka khutte ka hong zan a, lei keu in tui a duh bangin nang ka hong duh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, kei hong dawng mengmeng in. Kei ka cimawh ta hi. Leihawm sung misite kiangah a paisukte tawh ka kibat loh nadingin kei kiang panin na maitang seel kei in."},"8":{"text":"Nang hong muang ka hih manin zingsang simin na itna kip kei hong phawksak in. Nangma tungah thu hong ngen ka hih manin ka pai nading lampi hong hilh ta in."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, ka langte’ kiang panin kei hong honkhia in. Nangmah a bel dingin ka hong tai hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima Pasian na hih manin nangma deih bangin a gamta dingin kei hong hilh in. Kei hong hehpih inla, lam phei-ah hong kha in."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma min na ngaihsutna-in keima nuntakna hong kem in. Nangma thumanna tawh kituakin haksatna panin hong paikhiatpih in."},"12":{"text":"Kei pen nangma nasem ka hih manin na itna kip tawh kituakin ka galte khenkhia inla, ka langte khempeuh susia in."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka khutte galdona ding ka khutmete galkap nadingin a hilh, keimah a hong hu, Topa in thupha ngah tahen.","title":"Hotkhiat ding le Cihtheihna ding Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Amah pen ka suangpi le ka munkip muanhuai, ka kulhpi le hong honkhia pa, ka lum le ka belh pa, ka nuai-ah mite a zopa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, nangmah in na hong phawk tham dingin mi pen bang hi a, nangmah in na hong ngaihsut tham dingin mihing’ tapa bang ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 7:17-18; La 8:4"},"4":{"text":"Mi pen husan’ khat tawh kibang a, ama hunte pen a tai dandan niliim tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa aw, na vanpite niamsak inla, hong paisuk in. Mualte lawng inla, meikhu suaksak in."},"6":{"text":"Khuaphialep phiasak inla, amaute kithehthang sak in. Na thaltangte lawn inla, amaute susia in."},"7":{"text":"A sangna mun panin na khut hong zan inla, tui lian lauhuaite le gamdang mite’ vangliatna panin hong honkhia in."},"8":{"text":"A kam uh tawh zuauthu a gente le limtakin kiciamna a bawl khit ciang nangawnin zuauthu mah a gen lai vevete’ kiang pan kei hong phel inla, hong honkhia ta in."},"9":{"text":"Pasian aw, la thak khat kong sak ding a, harp zangsawm khausai lasakna nang kong tum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpite tungah gualzawhna a piapa, na nasem David a honkhia pa na hi hi."},"11":{"text":"A gilo galte kiang panin kei hong hon inla, a kam uh tawh zuauthu a gen limtakin kiciamna a bawl khit ciang nangawnin zuau a gen lai veve gamdang mite’ khutsung pan kei hong honkhia in."},"12":{"text":"Ka tapate uh a tangval lai-in khang cingin a khauh mahmah singkungte bang ta hen la, ka tanute uh a nungak lai-in kumpi inn lamna dinga a kisui innkiu khuampite bang tahen."},"13":{"text":"Ka saalte uh a dimin an nam khempeuh om ta hen la, ka tuute uh a tultul a thenthen-in gamlakah suak tahen."},"14":{"text":"Ka kongzingte uhah cimawhin kikona om kei tahen."},"15":{"text":"Tua bang thupha a ngah mi mi lungdam ahi hi. Topa pen amau’ Pasian ahi mite pen mi lungdam ahi hi."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasian le ka Kumpipa aw, nangmah hong pahtawi-in a tawntungin nangma min kong phatphat ding hi.","title":"Pasian’ Liatna le A Hoihna"},"2":{"text":"Nisimin hong pahtawi-in a tawntungin nangma min kong phatphat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa lian hi; nakpitakin phat ding hi a, ama liatna ngaihsutzawh ding hi lo hi."},"4":{"text":"A khang a khangin nangma nasepnate kiphatphat ding a, a vanglian na bawlnate kigengen ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na liatna le na minthanna a lamdang nangma sepnate ka lungngaingai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A vanglian nangma bawlnate mite in taangko ding uh a, nangma vangliatna mah kei zong ka pulak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in nangma liatna, na minthanna genkhia-in nangma thumanna nakpitakin sa ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa dikin hehpihna nei a, heh hak mahmahin itna kip lianpi a nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa pen mi khempeuh tungah hoih a, a bawlsa khempeuh tungah hehpihna a nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma bawlsa khempeuh in nangma tungah lungdamna hong ko ding uh a, na mi siangtho khempeuh in nang hong phat ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in na kumpi gam a minthanna thu gengenin na vangliatna thu sutsut ding uh a,"},"12":{"text":"a vanglian nangma sepnate le na kumpi gam a hoihna, a minthannate mi khempeuh tungah kitheisak ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma kumpi gam pen a kip tawntung kumpi gam hi a, nangma ukna khang tawntungin a kip hi. A thuciamna khempeuhah Topa thutak mahmah a, a gamtatna khempeuhah zong hehpihna a nei ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in a puk mite khempeuh huh a, niamsakna a thuakte khempeuh a sangtosak hi."},"15":{"text":"Nuntak husanna a nei khempeuhte’ mit in nang hong en uh a, a hun a tun ciangin amaute an na vak hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangmah in na khut na hong a, nuntak husanna a nei khempeuhte’ deihna a kicingin na pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa pen a sepna khempeuhah thutang a, a gamtatna khempeuhah hehpihna a nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah a sam mi khempeuh kiangah Topa nai om a, lungsim takpi tawh a sam mi khempeuh kiangah amah nai om hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah a zahtakte’ deihna a kicingin tungsak a, amaute’ kikona zong za-in amaute a honkhia hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in amah a itte khempeuh kem a, ahih hangin migilo khempeuh amah in susia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa ka phat tawntung ding hi. Mi khempeuh in a tawntungin ama min siangtho phat ta uh hen."}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Ke’n, Topa ka phat ding hi.","title":"Pasian, Mite A Huh, A Lianpa"},"2":{"text":"Ka hin laiteng Topa ka phat ding a, ka nuntak laiteng ka Pasian’ tungah phatnate ka sa ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Huhna a hong pia thei lo uliante ahi a, mi mawkmawkte ahi zongin muang kei un."},"4":{"text":"A husanna a bei ciangin lei-ah ciahkik uh a, tua ni mahmahin a ngaihsutnate uh beita hi."},"5":{"text":"Jakob’ Pasian pen amah huhpa hi-in, ama Topa Pasian a muang mipa mi lungdam ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in van le lei, tuipi le tuate sungah a om khempeuh bawl a, a tawntungin thuman hi.","ref":"Sawl 4:24; 14:15"},"7":{"text":"A kinengniam mite a dingin thumanna semkhia a, gilkialte an a vak hi. Topa in thongkiate a khahkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in mittawte khua a musak hi. Topa in niamsakna a thuak mite sangtosak a, Topa in thuman mite a it hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in peemtate kem a, meigong numeite le pa nei lote a huh hi. Ahih hangin amah in migilote’ vaihawmna a suksiatsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Zion aw, nangma Pasian Topa in khang tawntungin uk ding hi. Topa phat un."}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Bang hang hiam cih leh eite’ Pasian’ tungah phatnate i sak ding hoih hi. Phatna sak ding nuam a, zong a kilawm ahi hi.","title":"Vanglian Pasian Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem khuapi lam a, amah in a kinilkhia Israel-te a kaikhawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in lungsim kitamte damsak a, amau’ meimate a tuamsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in aksite a phazah ding seh a, tua aksite amau min ciatin a sam hi."},"5":{"text":"Eite’ Topa lian a, ama vang lian mahmah hi. Amah in thu a theihtelna pen ngaihsutzawh ding hi lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a kisikcip mite laamto-in, migilote leilak a denna hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamkohna la sa unla, laiza lasakna tawh eite’ Pasian’ tungah la ngaih sa un."},"8":{"text":"Amah in vanpite meiipi tawh tuamin, leitung a dingin gun bawl a, mualte tungah lopa a posak hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in ganhingte le a ham va-aknote an a vak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama lungkimna le amah in nuam a saknate pen sakol thahatna le galhangte’ hang hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah a zahtak mite le ama itna kip a muangte tungah Topa a lungkim hi."},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi aw, Topa phat in. Zion aw, nangma Pasian phat in."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in na kulhkongpi zawlte tosak a, nangma mite thupha hong piaksak hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in na gam sungah kilemna bawl a, mangbuh hoihpente tawh nang hong gilvahsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in thu hong pia a, ama thu manlangin leitung hong tungsuk hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in tuumul bangin vukkhal hong pia a, vut bangin vukpak hong thehthang hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in suangtum bangin tuikhalte hong lawnkhia hi. Tua a votna kua in thuakzo ding ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Amah in thu pia-in tuate tuisuak hi. Amah in a huih nungsak a, tuite a luang hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in Jakob tungah ama thu gen a, Israel tungah ama ngeina kipte le ama biakna ngeina kipte a gen hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in tua bangin minam dang khat peuhpeuh tungah bawl ngei lo hi. Amaute in amah biakna ngeina kipte thei lo uh hi. Topa phat un."}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Vantung panin Topa phat unla, a sangna panin amah phat un.","title":"A Kipiangsak Khempeuh in Phat Ding"},"2":{"text":"Ama vantungmi khempeuh aw, amah phat un. Ama mihonte khempeuh aw, amah phat un."},"3":{"text":"Ni le kha aw, amah phat un. A taang aksi khempeuh aw, amah phat un."},"4":{"text":"Van sangpente le vantung a om tuite aw, amah phat un."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ min amaute phatsak un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thu pia a, amaute a piang hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute a tawntung a om dingin amah in kipsak a, a palsat loh ding uh thupiakna amah in a bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitung panin Topa phat un, no gulpi liante le tuipi thuk khempeuh,"},"8":{"text":"mei le gial, tuikhal le vuk, ama thupiakna a mang huihpi!"},"9":{"text":"Amah phat un, no mual liante le mual neute khempeuh, gah a nei singkungte le taamtak singkung khempeuh!"},"10":{"text":"Gamsate le innsate khempeuh, a bokvak ganhingte le a leeng vasate khempeuh!"},"11":{"text":"No leitung kumpite le mihing khempeuh, leitung uliante le thukhente khempeuh!"},"12":{"text":"Nungakte le tangvalte, teeksiate le naupangte aw, amah phat un."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ min phat un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah bek a minlian hi a, ama minthanna pen leitung le vantung sangin sangzaw lai hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in ama mite thahatsak a, ama mi siangthote khempeuh, ama mai-ah a om Israel-te khempeuh in amah phat uh hi. Topa phat un."}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Topa’ tungah la thak sa un. A thuman mite’ kikhopna sungah amah phatna sa un.","title":"Israel in Phat Hen"},"2":{"text":"Amah a Bawlpa tungah Israel lungdam hen la, amau’ Kumpipa’ tungah Zion mite kipak tahen."},"3":{"text":"Lamna tawh amah phat unla, khuang le laiza lasakna tawh ama tungah la ngaih sa un."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ama mite tungah Topa lungdam a, miniamte gualzo sakin a pahtawi hi."},"5":{"text":"A gualzawhna uhah thuman mite lungdamin diang uh hen la, ama mai-ah khukdinin nuamna la sa uh hen."},"6":{"text":"Minam dangte tungah phu la-in gim a pia ding, a kumpite uh sikkhau tawh henin a miliante uh sikkol a bulh ding, a kigelhsa thukhenna bangin amaute tungah a semkhia dingin langnih a hiam namsau a tawi kawmun Pasian phatin awng ta uh hen. Hih pen Pasian’ mite’ gualzawhna ahi hi. Topa phat un.","merge":"9"}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa phat un. Topa phat un."}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Paunak","shortname":"Pau","abbr":[],"desc":"Paunak Laibu pen gamtat hoihna ding leh biakna thuhilhnate tom lakin paunak-in a kizangte a kikaihkhopna ahi hi. A tamzaw pen nisim nuntakna-ah a kizangte vive ahi hi. “Thu theihna dingin Topa zahtak masa ding,” ci-in phawksakna tawh a thu na pan a, tua ciangin biakna-ah gamtat hoihna ding ciang bek gen loin, thu ngaihsuttawm theihna ding leh gamtat hoihna dingte zong na gento lai hi. Hih thugenna tomnono tampite in tanglai Israel siate in thu khat peuhpeuh a om ciangin mipil ahite bangci gamtat ding, ci-in a ngaihsutna uh hong kilangsak hi. Pawlkhatte in innkuan sung kizopna zia ding, pawlkhatte in midang tawh kizopna zia ding, leh pawlkhatte in sumbawl paibawlna tawh kisai thute a gen hi. Pawlkhatte in khuasung gamsung gamtatna zia ding gen a, pawlkhatte in pumpi ki-uk ding a kisapna thu a gen hi. Kongzing lampi le van kizuakna phualpi-ah pilna hong kiko hi.","title":"Pilna’ Hong Thumna"},"21":{"text":"Khuapi kulhkongpi tual le mi a kikhopna mun khempeuhah nakpitakin hong awngkhia a,","ref":"Pau 8:1-3"},"22":{"text":"“Mihaite aw, bang tanvei hai omom nuam na hi uh hiam? Limtakin kei nong zong ding uh a, ahi zongin koimahah nong mu kei ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Note in pilna na deih kei uh a, Topa na zahtak nuam kei uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka thugente na deih kei uh a, kong thuhilhna ngai nuam lo na hih manun,"},"31":{"text":"na gamtatna bangun na thuak ding uh a, nomau’ gamtatna mah in note hong gimsak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thu thei nuamtakin om hithiat ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, kong hilhte thei inla, kong gente mangngilh kei in.","title":"Pilna Zonna Hanga Phattuamna"},"2":{"text":"Pilna gamta,"},"14":{"text":"a sia-in gamtat ding nuam a sa, a sia-a gamtatna-ah a lungkim mahmah,"},"15":{"text":"mi lungsim kawi, muan theih loh ding mite panin nang hong kem ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A pasal tungah citak loin a pasal a nusia, Pasian’ mai-ah a kiciamna a mangngilh, kam khum mahmah tawh nangmah zol ding a hanciam, numei paktatte panin hong cing ding hi.","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Tua nu’ inn-ah pai lecin sihna lampi a zui na hi a, misite gam a zuan na hi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua bang numei tawh mawhna a bawl mite in nuntak nuam neikik ngei lo uh thuhilh bangin Topa in a it mite a thuhilh hi.","ref":"Heb 12:5-6; Mang 3:19"},"13":{"text":"Pilna nei-in thu a thei mipa, a lungdam mi ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pilna nei leeng ngun sangin hoihzaw a, theihpah ding thute ahih nakleh , zing ciangin hong paikik in, ci-in a hun sotto kei in."},"29":{"text":"Nangmah hong muangin nangma nai-ah a hong teng na vengpa, gim a ngahna ding bangmah vaihawm kei in."},"30":{"text":"Nangma tungah siatna bangmah a hong bawl lo, mi khatpeuh tawh thu om lopi-in kimawk tot kei in."},"31":{"text":"A ngongtat thei mite engkha kei inla, amau’ gamtat bangin gamtakha uh a, mihaite in maizumna le mindaina ngah ding uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tate aw, na pa uh’ hong hilhnate ngai unla, thu na teltheih nadingun limtakin ngaihsun un.","title":"Pilna A Tua hileh na nasep peuhpeuh maavang ding hi.","ref":"Heb 12:13"},"27":{"text":"Siatna peelin a manin gamta inla, thuman lampi panin themcik zong pialkha kei in."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta in."},"20":{"text":"Ka ta aw, bang hangin numei dang lunggulh ding a, numei dangte’ ngaihbaanna iplah ding na hi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in na gamtatna khempeuh hong mu a, sihlawh a, ama hailuatna in hankhuk sung a tun hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na lawmte khatpeuh in sum leitawi a lak ciangin a lohzawh kei leh ama tangin a lohsak dingin kam na ciamkha ciamteh niloh in."},"22":{"text":"Tua thute in na paina peuhah lam hong lak ding a, zanin na ihmut kalin nang hong cing ding a, sunin na hah sungin na gamtatna ding hong hilh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thukham le a hilhnate pen a taang mahmah khuavak bang hi a, khalna le hilhnate pen nuntakna ding lampi hi a,"},"24":{"text":"mi’ zi tawh na mawh loh nadingin nang hong kemin, kam khum zangin a hong zol numei ginalote kiang panin nang hong hu ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amau’ melhoihna iplahkha kei inla, amau’ hong zawlmitna khenglahkha kei in."},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh anlum khat tawh numei paktat khat kingahzo a, ahi zongin numei tawh mawhna in nuntakna bup siasak hi."},"27":{"text":"Na ang sungah meikuang pom lecin na puan kang loin om ding ahi hiam?"},"28":{"text":"Mei-am tungtawnin pai lecin na khe kang loin om ding ahi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Tua mah bangin mi’ zi tawh a mawhte in gimna thuak ding uh a, tua bang a gamta peuhmah in gimna thuak ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"A gilkial a cimawh mi khat in na a guk ciangin, midangte in mawhsak lua lo napi,"},"31":{"text":"amah kiman leh a zah sagihin kilohsak a, a neih khempeuh a piak kul hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin numei tawh a mawhte pen thu ngaihsun thei lo mi hi a, amau le amau a kisusiatawm ahi uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Mawhna a bawl mi in satgawpna thuak ding a, a min sia-in mindai paisuak ding hi."},"34":{"text":"A numei’ pasal a hehzawk theih nading thudang om nawn lo a, a heh thukna-ah khawl hun cih nei thei lo hi."},"35":{"text":"Amah in sumlepai sang nuam vet lo a, letsong tampi piakna in a hehna damsak zo lo hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thugente ciamteh inla, kong sawl thute khempeuh mangngilh ngei kei in.","title":"Numei Paktatte’ Hoih lohna"},"2":{"text":"Kong gen bangin gamta lecin na nungta ding hi.
