Kong thuhilhte, na mitnauta bangin hoihtakin kem in."},"3":{"text":"Kong hilhnate kem tawntung inla, na lungtang tungah gelh in."},"4":{"text":"Pilna na sanggamnu dingin nei inla, thumuhna na lawm it pen dingin nei in."},"5":{"text":"Tua hileh midangte’ zi tungah na khialhkhak loh nading, kam khum tawh a hong zol numei ginalote tawh na khialhkhak loh nadingin hong hu ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Khatvei, ka omna inn-ah, ka tawlet panin ka khuadak a,"},"7":{"text":"bangmah a phawk nai lo tangval honkhat lakah, tangval thu thei lo khat, ka lim muhkha hi."},"8":{"text":"Lamdungah amah a vak laitakin, tua bang numei paktat a omna inn gei khatah va paikha a,"},"9":{"text":"tua hun pen nitak nitum khit zawh, khuamui hun laitak ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua numei in numei paktatte’ puansilh ngeite a silh kawmin ngimna khat tawh tua tangval na dawntuah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua numei pen maizumna mel thei loin a hang mahmah hi a, lamdung tengah vak tawntung hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihon omna van zuakna phual, lamdung citeng, kongkiu khatpeuhah mi ngakin om niloh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua numei in tangvalpa thakhatin kawi-in tawp a, na maitai bawl mahmahin ama kiangah,"},"14":{"text":"“Tuni-in biakpiakna ka bawl a, nek ding sa tampi ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka nekpih dingin nang ka hong zong a, tu-in kong mu petmah hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka lupna tungah a nop mahmah dingin, Egypt gam puan hoihpente ka phahzo hi."},"17":{"text":"Myrrh paknamtui, aloes paknamtui, le sinnamon paknamtui tawh, ka lupna tung a namtui dingin ka bawl khinta hi."},"18":{"text":"Hong pai in; zanthapai-in ki-itna bawlin, ang kikawmin lungnuam ni."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pasal khual gamlapi-ah zin a, tu laitakin inn-ah om lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in sum tampi keng a, nipikal nih bang mateng hong tung lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kam khum kam neel tawh amah zol a, tangvalpa in tua zolna a mangkha hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a kigo ding bawngtal in a sih nading mun a zuat bangin, sakhi in a awkna ding thang zuanin a dian’ laklak bangin,"},"23":{"text":"thaltang in ama lungtang a khakna ding munah amah va pai hi. Vasa in a sih nading thang antah a bawh bangin va bawh a, a lauhuai sung a tun lamtak thei lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka tate aw, kei’ lam hong nga unla, ka thugente hong ngai un."},"25":{"text":"Tua bang numeite’ zolna mang kei unla, tua bangte tawh khialkha kei un."},"26":{"text":"Tua bang numei in mi tampi tak siasakin, simzawh loh ding mi tampi’ sihna a piangsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua bang numei zuihna pen sihna gam zuatna hi a, sih baihna ding lampi zuatna ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngai un! Pilna in hong sam a, thungaihsut theihna hong kiko hi lo ahi hiam?","title":"Pilna A Hoihna le Sauvei A Kimanna"},"2":{"text":"Lamdung mualtung tengah, lamka citeng mun khempeuhah ding a,"},"3":{"text":"khuapi lutna lampi gei-ah, mi omna kongpi tualah hong kiko a,","ref":"Pau 1:20-21"},"4":{"text":"“Mi khempeuh tungah ka hong thum a, leitung a om mi khempeuh ka hong sam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngaihsut kicing nai lote aw, na lungsim uh khanghamsak un. Mihaite aw, thu ngaihsun un."},"6":{"text":"Ngai un, thu manpha kong gen ding hi; ka gen khempeuh thuman vive ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka thugente a man bekbek hi a, zuauthu ka deih kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka gen khempeuh ahi vive hi a, zuauthu, thukawi om het lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite a dingin telnop mahmah a, thu mutheite a dingin siang mahmah hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngun sangin kong thuhilhnate deihzaw unla, kham hoihpen sangin thutheihna deihzaw un."},"11":{"text":"“Suangmanpha sangin pilna ahi keimah ka hoihzaw a, kei tawh na hong tehpih theih ding uh a manpha dang om lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Pilna ahi keimah in thuthuk muhtheihna ka nei a, thu a telin theihna le a kilawm ngaihsut theihna ka nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa zahtakna pen thusia muhdahna hi a, kiphatsakna le kihihsakna, gamtatsia le thuzuau ka mudah hi."},"14":{"text":"Thu geelin ka semkhia a, thu theihtelna nei-in, kei ka thahat hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpite in a gammite a ukna ding, mi ukte in ngeina man a zat theih nadingin keimah in ka huh hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitung a om mi ukte khempeuh in keima huhna bek tawh ukzo uh a, milian mi thupite in keima huhna bek tawh vaihawmzo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei hong itte ka it a, kei hong zong peuhmahte in hong mu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Piakkhiat theih ding hauhna le minphatna, daupaina le ma tutsak zawhna a kicingin ka nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima kiang panin na ngahte uh ngun hoihpen sangin hoihzaw a, kham hoihpen sangin zong hoihzaw lai hi."},"20":{"text":"Thuman lampi ka zui a, thutang lampi ka tawn hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei hong itte ka hausak a, a inn dimin neihlelam ka pia hi."},"22":{"text":"“ Topa in kei hong piangsak masa pen a, tangtawnga ama sep lak pan a masa pen ka hi hi.","ref":"Mang 3:14"},"23":{"text":"Tangtawng pek lai-in kei hong bawl a, leitung a om ma-in hong bawl masak pen ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuipite a om ma-in kei ka suakkhin a, kei’ suah hunin lui tuite om nai lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Mual liante a kibawl ma-in kei ka suakkhin a, mual neute a kibawl mapekin kei ka om khinta hi."},"26":{"text":"Leitung khempeuh a bawl ma, lei themkhat bek nangawn a bawl mapekin kei ka om khinta hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in vantung bawlin tuipi kimkotah vanpi mong ding a bawl laitak,"},"28":{"text":"amah in vantungah meiite kipsakin tuipi tuinakte a bawl laitak,"},"29":{"text":"tuipi tuite in ama cihna ban a khengin a luan loh nading thu a piak laitak ka om a, leitung bulpi a phuh laitak kei ka om hi."},"30":{"text":"Na geel siampa bangin amah tawh kikhawlin keimah pen nisimin ama lungdamna ka hi a, ama kianga om nuamsa-in,"},"31":{"text":"leitungah ka lungdam a, mihingte lakah nuam ka sa hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tate aw, tu-in ka thugen hong ngai unla, kong gente zui le-uhcin lungdamna na ngah ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Hong kihilhnate zui-in pilna ngah unla, thudon loin ommawk kei un."},"34":{"text":"Ka thugenna a ngai, nisimin ka kong gei-ah omin, ka inn-ah a ngak mipa in lungdamna ngah ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Kei hong mu mi in nuntakna a mu hi a, Topa’ mai-ah maipha ngah ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi zongin kei hong mu lo mi, amahmah a kisusia hi a, kei hong mudah peuhmah, a si nuam ahi hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna in a inn lam a, a innkhuampi sagih a phut hi.","title":"Pilna le Haina"},"2":{"text":"Amah in pawi bawl dingin sa go-in leenggahzu khaih a, annekna ding sabuai a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuasung munsang khempeuh panin mi a sam dingin a nasem numeite sawl a,"},"4":{"text":"“Thu thei lote aw, hong pai un,” ci-in samsak a, mihaite kiangah,"},"5":{"text":"“Hong pai unla, ka an huansa ne-in, ka bawlsa leenggahzu hong dawn un."},"6":{"text":"Thu thei lote taisanin khansau unla, pilna lampi zui un,” cisak hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihaite thuhilh lecin hong maizumsak ding a, migilote thuhilh lecin hong sugawp ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihaite thuhilh kei in; hong mudah ding uh hi. Mipilte thuhilh in; hong it ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Mipilte thuhilh lecin pil semsemna-in nei ding a, thuman mite thuhilh lecin a thutheihna uh khang semsem ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa zahtakna pen pilna kipatna hi a, Siangtho Pa theihna pen thumuhna ahi hi.","ref":"Job 28:28; La 111:10; Pau 1:7"},"11":{"text":"Pilna in na khang hong khan ding a, na nuntakna hong sausak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Pil lecin nangma phattuamna ding hi a, pilna don kei lecin nangma supna ding ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Haina pen a kamtam, zumna mel a thei lo numei tawh kibang a,"},"14":{"text":"ama kong gei-ah ahi a, a sangpen munah ahi zongin amah tu a,"},"15":{"text":"ama kiang a nawkkha, amau’ nasep bek a phawk kimlai mite kiangah,"},"16":{"text":"“Thu thei lote aw, hong pai un,” ci-in samin, mihaite kiangah,"},"17":{"text":"“Tui dawnsim, khumdiak a, an neksim, limdiak hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua lai-ah a paite a sihna thu tua lai-ah a lutsate sihna gam thuk sungah a om khitna thu, a khemzawh mite in phawkkha lo uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte pen Solomon’ paunakte ahi hi: Ta pil in a pa lungdamsak a, ta hai in a nu dahsak hi.","title":"Mipha le Misia Etkakna"},"2":{"text":"Thuman loin ngahna-ah phattuamna om lo a, thumanna in sih nading pan hong hon hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in mihoihte a gilkialin koih lo a, migilote a duh uh nesak lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Thadahna in zawnna hi a, thanuamna in hauhna hi."},"5":{"text":"A hunin an a lapa mipil hi a, anlak hunin a ihmu pa in maizumna a ngah hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihoihte in thupha ngah a, migilote in thusia bekbek gen hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihoihte kiphawkphawk a, migilote kimangngilh pah hi."},"8":{"text":"Mipilte in thuhilhna mang a, a hai paute in lungkhamna tuak hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuman mite lungnuamin om hithiat a, thuman lote kiman hi."},"10":{"text":"Khialhna kimuhmawh bawlna in buaina piangsak a, hang takin hilh ngamna in nopna piangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihoihte’ kampaute pen nuntakna tuinak bang a, migilote in thusia bekbek gen uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Muhdahna in kitotna piangsak a, itna in mawhna khempeuh maisak hi.","ref":"James 5:20; 1Pe 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite’ kam sungah pilna om a, mihaite’ nungzangah ciangduai kinga hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilte in a pilna uh behlapin, mihaite a pau ciangin thusia tawh kizom pahpah hi."},"15":{"text":"Hauhna in mihaute hu a, zawnna in mizawngte siasak hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihoihte’ thaman nuntakna hi a, migilote’ thaman siatna ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kihilhna manna nuntak lampi zuihna hi a, hilhna man’ nop lohna lampi lauhuai zuihna ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mi a mudahte bek in zuauthu gen a, mi a gensiate mihai ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Kam tam paute tampi khial a, pau iptheite mipil hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihoihte’ thugente nguntang bang a, migilote’ ngaihsutnate in bangmah man lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihoihte’ thugente in mi tampi nuamtuamsak a, mihaite in a hai sihpih uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa’ thupha in mite hausak a, dahna le gimna tawh piakhawm lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihaite in gamtatsiat ding nuamsa uh a, thungaihsun theite in pil gamtatna nuamsa uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Migilote tungah a kihtaktak uh tung a, mihoihte in a deihdeih uh ngah uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Huihpi a nun’ ciangin migilote leenmang a, thuman mite lungmuangin om tawntung uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Leenggahtui thuk in ha kimsak a, meikhu in mit a siipsak bangin, mi thadah in a cial pa a nasak hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa zahtakna in khan sausak a, migilote khansih hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihoihte’ lametna lungdamna hi a, migilote’ lametna a hawmpi ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in midikte hu a, migilote a susia hi."},"30":{"text":"Midikte lungmuang takin om tawntung ding uh a, migilote in omna ding mun ngah zo lo ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Midikte in pilna thu gen uh a, thu hoih lo a gente’ leii ki-attan ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Midikte in a gen ding uh thuhoih thei a, migilote in thusia bekbek gengen uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawikhaina man lo a zangte Topa in mudah a, tawikhaina man a zangte tungah Topa lungkim hi."},"2":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte in minsiatna ngahpak ding ahih manin a hoihbekin om ding hoihzaw tham hi."},"3":{"text":"Midikte thumanin gamta uh a, migilote amau’ hoih lohna in susia hi."},"4":{"text":"Hauhna in sih nading panin hong hu thei lo a, thumanna in na sih ding hong hu thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Thumanna in midikte’ nuntakna a nuamzaw-in piangsak a, migilote in amau’ gitlohna mah puklawh uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Thumanna in midikte honkhia a, thuman lo mite in amau’ huaihamna mah awkpih uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote a sih ciangin a lametna teng uh tawh bei khawm a, hauhna suanna a mawkna a suak hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungkhamna a tuah loh nadingun midikte kihu a, migilote tungah lungkhamna tungzaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian a ngaihsun lo mite’ thugenna hangin mite in siatna thuak a, midikte’ pilna hangin mite in hotkhiatna ngah uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Midikte a tuahphat ciangin khua sungah lungdamna om a, migilote a sih ciangin zong khua sungah lungdamin kikona a om hi."},"11":{"text":"Thuman mite’ omna hangin khuapi a lian suak a, migilote’ kampauna hangin khuapi a sia suak hi."},"12":{"text":"Simmawhna tawh midang hopihna pen haina hi a, mipilte pau loin om dide hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi a gensiasiate tungah thusim kigen ngam lo a, a muanhuai mite’ tung bekah thusim kigen ngam hi."},"14":{"text":"Thulamlak ding a nei lo mihingte kipuk uh a, thulamlak tampi neihna pen lungmuanna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Midang khat’ leiba lohsak ding na kiciam leh na kisik ding hi. Tua bang thu-ah kihel kei lecin nang a dingin hoihzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"A dik numei kizahtak a, a dik lo numei mindai hi. A thadah mi in sum nei ngei lo a, a hahkat mi in sum hau hi."},"17":{"text":"Migi lecin nang a dingin a hoih a bawl na hi a, gilo lecin nangmahmah a kigimsak na hi bek hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilote in a man nei taktak bangmah ngah lo a, thumanin a gamtate in peel loin thaman hoih a ngah hi."},"19":{"text":"Thumanin gamtat ding a hanciamte nungta ding a, a sia-in a gamta teiteite si ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in lungsim gilote mudah a, a manin a gamtate tungah a lungkim hi."},"21":{"text":"Migilote in gim a thuak hamtang nading, midikte gimna tawh a kipelhna ding teltakin thei in."},"22":{"text":"Thu a ngaihsun thei lo numei melhoih pen vokpi muk a om kham nakbah tawh kibang lel hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihoihte’ deihna thuhoih tawh kizom tawntung a, migilote’ deihna a tun ciangin mi khempeuh a heh hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in sum zang ziahziah napi-in hau semsem uh a, mi pawlkhat cil mahmah napi, zawng semsem hi."},"25":{"text":"A cingh mite hau semsem ding a, midang a huhte in huhna mah ngahkik ding hi."},"26":{"text":"An man khan ding ngakna-in a zuak nuam lote kisamsia a, leinop hunin a zuakpahte kiphat hi."},"27":{"text":"Thuhoih a hanciamte in pahtakna ngah a, siatna a hanciamte in siatna mah ngah hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuk lai-a singteh tam bangin midikte’ hauhna khang ding a, phalbi lai-a singteh pulh bangin hauhna a suangte kiam ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"A innkuan sung a ukkhial mite hawmsuak ding a, a haite pen mipilte’ sila suak tawntung ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Midikte a khansau a, migilote khansih hi."},"31":{"text":"Mihoihte hih leitungah thaman kipia ahihleh migilo le mawhneite gimna kipiazaw kan ding hi.","ref":"1Pe 4:18"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna a deihte, kithuhilh ding ut uh a, kitai ding ut lohna pen haina ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihoihte in Topa’ maipha ngah a, siatna a gamtate amah in a mawhsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Gitlohna in lungmuanna piangsak lo a, thuman mite lungmuang takin om uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Zi hoih pen a pasal’ minthanna le lungdamna hi a, a pasal a maizumsak zi pen a pasal a dingin a dam thei lo guhnatna tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuman mite in a kilawm a kituakin hong bawl a, migilote bek in hong khem nuam hi."},"6":{"text":"Migilote’ thugente mi thahnopna bekbek hi a, midikte’ thugente in lauhuaina sunga om mite a honkhia hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote in sihna tuakin cimang a, thuman mite nungta-in khang kizom hi."},"8":{"text":"Mipilte kiphatin kipahtawi a, mihaite kineu-et hi."},"9":{"text":"Nektawm ding nei lopi-in milian bangin omna sangin nuntakna ding na semin mi mawkmawk hihna hoihzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Midikte in a gannote hoihtakin don a, migilote in a gannote bawlsia hi."},"11":{"text":"Nakpi takin lo khote in an hau a, man nei lopi-in hun beisakna in haina ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Migilote’ belh munmuanhuai pen leikhal bangin kitamzan a, mihoihte’ zung kip tawntung hi."},"13":{"text":"Migilote in a zuaugenna uh awkpih a, thuman mite buaina tawh kipelh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mite in kam hoih pauna hangin thaman ngah uh a, a sepna bangun zong thaman ngah uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihaite pen amau mah thuman kisa tawntung a, mipilte in mi’ thugenna ngai nuam uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihaite in a hehna uh langsakpah uh a, mipilte in a hehna uh ipzo hi."},"17":{"text":"Thuman mite in thu taktak mah gen uh a, zuau tecite in khemna thu bek gen uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngaihsun lo-a kampauna in tem hiam bangin mi liamsak thei a, mipilte’ kampauna in tua bang liamna damsak thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Thuman genna kip tawntung a, thuzuau genna tomno sung bek kimang hi."},"20":{"text":"Thusia ngaihsunte lungkham uh a, thuhoih vaihawmte lungdam uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Thuman mite tungah thusia tung lo a, migilote lungkhamna tawh kidim hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in zuaugen mite mudah a, mi citakte tungah a lungdam hi."},"23":{"text":"Mipilte in a theihna uh im khinkhian a, mihaite in a haina uh pholaklak hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi thanuamte vanglian a, mi thadahte sila suak hi."},"25":{"text":"Lunghihmawhna in lungkhamna piangsak a, kampau hoih in mi lungdamsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Midikte in a gamtatna uh tel et a, migilote a gamtatna un lam pialsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Thadahte a tup tung ngei lo a, a thanuamte in a deih ngah hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi thumante’ gamtatna in nuntakna piangsak a, mihaite’ gamtatna in sihna piangsak hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ta pil in a pa’ hilhna mang a, a kihisak mi in a khial min pua nuam lo hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihoihte in a kam siamna bangun thaman sang a, mizuaute pen siattat ding bek ut uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pau a ki-ipzo mi in a nuntakna a hu hi a, a mawk paupau mi pen amah a kisiasak tawm ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Thadah mi in a deih ngahzo lo a, nasep hahkat mi in a deih khempeuh ngahzo hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuman mi in zuauthu deih lo a, a gilo mi in gensiatna le mindaina ding bek a pau hi."},"6":{"text":"Thumanna in midikte hu a, gitlohna pen mawhneite’ pukna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte, zawng napi-in kihausak uh a, mi pawlkhatte, hau napi-in kizawngsak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihau pa’ sum hauhna in a nuntakna tankhiazo a, mizawng pa in a kitatna ding bangmah nei lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuman mite khuavak bangin taang lela a, migilote meivak bangin mitpak hi."},"10":{"text":"Hilh ding ut lo, kihihsakna in kitotna bek piangsak thei a, hong kithuhilh ding utna pen a hoihzaw ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ol takin hauhpakna oltak mahin kiamkik pah a, haksapi-in hauhtohna khangto semsem hi."},"12":{"text":"Lamet tun lohna in lungsim cinasak a, deihna tangtunna pen lungdamna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Thu kihilh ding ut lohna pen siat ding utna hi a, thu kihilhna zuihna pen lungnopna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilte’ thuhilhna pen nuntakna tuinak bang hi a, sihna thang tawh kipelhna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thungaihsut theihna maipha ngahna hi a, zuautatna in lungkhamna bek piangsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite pilna tawh gamta a, mihaite in a haina taangko hi."},"17":{"text":"Kamtai ginalo in mi lungkhamsak a, a citak thupuak pa in mi lungdamsakkik hi."},"18":{"text":"Thukihilhna a zui lo mi in zawnna le mindaina ngah a, thukihilhna a zui mi in minphatna le pahtawina a ngah hi."},"19":{"text":"Deihna ngahna in lungsim nuamsak a, siat gamtatna panin mihaite pialkhia nuam lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipil tawh kikhawl lecin na pil ding a, mihai tawh kikhawl lecin gimna na thuak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuahsiatna in mawhneite sulzuih kawikawi a, midikte tuahpha kawikawi hi."},"22":{"text":"Midikte in a tu a tate’ luah ding gamh nei uh a, mawhneite’ neihsate ahihleh midikte a’ ding hi lel hi."},"23":{"text":"Lo thak panin mizawngte’ khamkhop ding an piangkha ding a, ahi zongin thuman lohna hangin tua nangawn maimang thei ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A ta a tai nuam lote a ta mudah hi a, a ta a itte in limtakin thuhilhin a tai hi."},"25":{"text":"Thuman mi in a kham ding nei-in gilvah a, a gilo mi in nektawm ding nei loin a gil a kial hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numei pilte in innsung nuntakna khangsak a, numei haite in innsung susia hi."},"2":{"text":"Thumanin a gamta mite in Topa zahtak uh a, a sia-in a gamta mite in Topa simmawh uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihaite a pau ciangin siatna thuaklawh uh a, mipilte’ pauna in siatna ding pan pengsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Bawngtal om kei leh lo panin an tawm bek kila a, bawngtal tha tawh an a kihau ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A citak teci in thuman bekbek gen tawntung a, a ginalo teci in zuau bekbek gen tawntung hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi a simmawh theite in pilna a zon uh hangin ngah zo lo uh a, thungaihsun theite in olno takin ngah thei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihaite tawh kikhawl kei in; amau’ kiang pan pilna na ngah kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite a pilna in lampi man musak a, mihaite a haina in lam khialsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihaite in a khialh hangun phamawh sa lo uh a, mipilte a khialh ciangun mawhmaisak ding deih uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Lungdamna le lungkhamna eimah bek in i theih hi a, midang kuamah in hong phawkpih kha lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilote’ inn kisusia ding a, thuman mite’ inn kipin gina semsem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte in thuman lampi hi, ci-in a ngaihsutte pen sihna lampi hikha thei hi.","ref":"Pau 16:25"},"13":{"text":"Nuihna pen cihmawh seelna zong hithei a, kigualnop sakna a ven’ ciangin dahna hong kilangkik hi."},"14":{"text":"Misia in siatna thaman ngah a, mipha in phatna thaman ngah hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihaite in a thuzak peuh um pahpah a, mipilte in a gamtatna ding ngaihsun cian hi."},"16":{"text":"Mipilte kidawmin siatna panin kihem a, mihaite in thu ngaihsun masa loin gamta pahpah hi."},"17":{"text":"A lungtom mite hai gamtat a, mipilte lungduai hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihaite in haina bek mah ngah a, mipilte in pilna mah ngah thuah hi."},"19":{"text":"Migilote in mihoihte mai-et uh a, maipha a piak ding uh a thum uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Kuamah in mizawngte ngai lo a, mihaute in lawm tampi nei hi."},"21":{"text":"Mizawngte a simmawhte a khial hi a, mizawngte tungah a cinghte a lungdam hi."},"22":{"text":"Na a hoih a semte mite in muangin zahtak a, a sia gamtatna pen khialhna lianpi ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Gimpi-a nasepna pen hauhna hi a, kam bek pau-in tutmawkna pen zawnna ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Pilna pen mipilte’ minthanna lukhu hi a, haina pen mihaite’ kizepna bulpi ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Thutak a gen teci in nuntakna huzo a, zuauthu a gen teci in mi lehhek hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa a zahtak mi in lungmuanna nei a, a tate’ belhtheih ding mi kician ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa zahtakna pen nuntakna tuinak tawh kibang a, sihna thang tawh hong kipelhsak hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi tampi a uk kumpipa minthang a, a uk ding mi om kei leh a mawkna ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"A lungduaite mipil hi a, lungtomna pen haina kilatna ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Lungnopna in pumpi cidamsak a, hazatna pen guh a muatsak natna ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Mizawngte bawlsiatna pen a piangsak Pasian simmawhna hi a, mizawngte tungah citna pen Pasian zahtakna ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Migilo pa ama tatsiatna in puksak a, mihoih pa ama hoihtatna in hu hi."},"33":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite’ sungah pilna teng a, mihaite in pilna thei kha lo uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Thumanna in minam minthangsak a, mawhna in minam mindaisak hi."},"35":{"text":"A hoihin a gamta a mite tungah kumpipa lungdam a, a gina-in a gamta lote gim a pia hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kam nemin dawnna in hehna damsak a, kam khauh in hehna piangsak hi."},"2":{"text":"Mipilte in pilna thu gen a, mihaite in haina thu gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa’ mit in mun khempeuh mu a, misia, mipha, hong encik kim hi."},"4":{"text":"Kam khum in nuntakna piangsak a, kam sia in lung gimsak hi."},"5":{"text":"A pa’ hilhna a ngai nuam lote mihai hi a, hilhna a mang nuamte mipil ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Thuman mite’ neihsa kip a, migilote’ hauhna in lungkham a guan hi."},"7":{"text":"Mipilte’ kampauna in pilna khangsak a, mihaite’ lungsimah thuman lohna bek om hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in migilote’ biakpiakna kihhuai sa a, thuman mite’ thungetna-ah lungdam hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in migilote’ gamtatna kihhuai sa a, thuman a deih mite a it hi."},"10":{"text":"A gamta khial mite nakpitakin kithuhilh a, thukihilhna a mang nuam lote in sihna thuak ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Sihna gam sungah a omte nangawn Pasian in mu ahihleh, mihingte’ ngaihsutna tel muhzaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"A kihisak mite in kithuhilhna ngai nuam lo uh a, mipilte kiangah thu dong ngei lo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungdamna in maitaisak a, lungkhamna in maigumsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite in pilna zong uh a, mihaite ahihleh a theih lohna uh tawh lungkim uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mizawngte lungkham tawntung uh a, a lungdam mite in nuntak nuamsa mahmah uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Hau napi-in lungkham sangin zawng napi-in Topa zahtakna hoihzaw tham hi."},"17":{"text":"Kitawngtawng kawmin sameh limpen nekna sangin ki-it diamdiamin anteh meh nek hoihzaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungtomna in kitotna piangsak a, lungduaina in kilemna piangsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi thadahte in mun khempeuhah haksatna tuak a, mi thumante in haksatna tuak kha lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ta pilte in a pa lungdamsak a, ta haite bek in a nu simmawh hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihaite in a hai mah uh lungdampih a, mipilte ahihleh a manin gamta uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Lim ngaihsut loin sepna tawh bangmah piang zo lo a, limtakin geelna tawh maa kitunzo bek hi."},"23":{"text":"A hun mahin dawnpah theihna lungkimhuai a, a kilawm kammal tawh dawnpah theihna hoihzaw kan hi."},"24":{"text":"Mipilte in nuntakna lampi zuito uh a, sihna lampi zuisuk lo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in mi kiphasakte’ inn phelkhiatsak a, meigongte’ neihsa hutpih hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in migilote’ ngaihsutna kihhuaisa a, midikte’ kampaunate hoih a sa hi."},"27":{"text":"A man loin sum ngahna in innsung lungkhamsak a, sumgolh a deih lote a nuntak sauvei nuam hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihoihte in a kampau ding ngaihsun phot a, migilote’ paupakna pen thusia tawh kizom hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in midikte’ thungetna ngai a, migilote’ thungetna thudon lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Maitaina in lung nuamsak a, thuhoih zakna in lung damsak hi."},"31":{"text":"Kithuhilhna zuih theihna pen mipilte’ lakah kihel theihna ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Kihilh ding a ut lote amahmah a kisusia hi a, kithuhilh ding a utte pil semsem ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa zahtakna pen pilna mah hi pah a, kiniamkhiatna in pahtawina hong ngahsak hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mite in bangbang a geel zongin Topa’ deihna bang bekin a piang ding hizaw hi.","title":"Nuntakna le Gamtatna tawh kisai Paunakte"},"2":{"text":"Mihingte pen a gamtatna uhah man kisa a, ahi zongin Topa in a khenna khat na om hi."},"3":{"text":"Na geelnate khempeuh Topa ap in; tua hileh na geelna bangin tangtung ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in na khempeuh ngimna nei-in bawl a, migilote nangawn siatna a thuak dingin a bawl ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in a kihisak mite mudah a, amaute in gimna thuak hamtang uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Thumanna le cihtakna mawhmai ngahna hi a, Topa zahtakna siatna tawh kipelhna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa’ deih bangin gamtatna pen galte nangawn lawma kaihzawhna ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Thuman loin hauhna sangin thumanin tawmno neihna a hoihzaw ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing in thu geel a, ahi zongin Topa’ deihna bangin kisemkhia hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in thuman genin thu a khen ciangin khial ngei lo hi."},"11":{"text":"A man tawikhaina le tawi tehnate Topa a’ hi a, a tawisuang khempeuh ama bawlsa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Thumanin gamtatna bek in kumpi kipsak ahih manin a sia-a gamtat ding kumpite ut lo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpite in thuman genna deih uh a, thuman a gen mite it uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa heh leh mi khatpeuh in sihlawh thei a, mipil khat in kumpipa lungdamsak thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa maitai leh nuntakna hi a, ama pahtakna pen tuk hunin guah a zusak meiipi tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Kham sangin pilna hoihzaw a, ngun sangin thutheihna deihhuai zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihoihte in siatna tawh a kipelh ding lampi tawn uh a, a lampi tot ding limtakin a ngaihsun mi in a nuntakna a hu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Kisaktheihna in siatna hong tuaksak a, kiphatsakna in pukna hong piangsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi kihisak tawh kipawlin vankisutte ngahna sangin mizawngte tawh kikhawlin mineu a om hoihzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Thuhilhna a mang mite a maa vang ding a, Topa a muang mite a lung dam ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Lungsim pilte thumuhna tawh kampau uh a, amau’ kam khumna zaknophuai kisa semsem hi."},"22":{"text":"Pilna pen mipilte a dingin hinna tuinak bang hi a, mihaite ahihleh amau’ haina mah in gimna thuaksak hi."},"23":{"text":"Mipilte in thu ngaihsun kawmin kam pau uh a, amau’ pauna zaknophuai semsem hi."},"24":{"text":"Kam khum pen khuaizu bang hi a, i kamah khum a, i pumpi a dingin zong hoih mahmah hi."},"25":{"text":"Hoih hi, ci-in i ngaihsut thu khat pen sih theih nading thu na hi zawsop thei hi.","ref":"Pau 14:12"},"26":{"text":"An duhna in mi na semsak a, gilkialna in nak sepsak semsem zaw hi."},"27":{"text":"Migilote in siatna ding bek zongzong uh a, a kampaunate uh na a kangtumthei meikuang tawh kibang hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihoih lote in kitotna piangsak a, mi gensiate in lawmta ki-it kimlai kimudahsak hi."},"29":{"text":"A ngongtat mite in a lawmte zol a, lungkhamna sung tunpih hi."},"30":{"text":"A mit hong sitsante thusia a ngaihsun hi a, a neh hong piksante thusia geel ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"A teekte’ sam kang minthanna lukhu hi a, thumanin nuntakna tawh a ngah ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Thahatna sangin lungduaina hoihzaw a, khuapi khat ukzawhna sangin eimah ki-ukzawhna hoihzaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Mite in bangbangin ai a san zongin, a piang ding thu pen Topa’ deihna bangbek hizaw hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kitawng kawmkawmin pawipi sungah an nekna sangin lungnuam takin mohkeu themkhat nekna hoihzaw hi."},"2":{"text":"A pil silapa in a topa’ ta hai tungah aana nei-in a topa’ gamh pawlkhat a luah hi."},"3":{"text":"Kham le ngunte mei sungah kize-et a, mihingte’ lungsim Topa in ze-et hi."},"4":{"text":"Migilote in gitlohna thu bek mah ngaihin nei uh a, zuautheite in zuauthu mah ngaihin nei hi."},"5":{"text":"A zawngte a simmawh pa in amah a Piangsak pa a simmawh hi a, midangte’ tuahsiatna-ah a lungdam mipa in gim thuak hamtang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tute pen puteekte a dingin minthanna lukhu hi a, tate pen pate’ minthanna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Miliante in zuauthu gen ngei lo a, mihaite in na-a kimang kam pau ngei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Sumgolh a zangte in ai bangin ngaihsun uh a, a deih khempeuh uh a ngahsak dingin ngaihsun uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi’ khialhna a maisakte midangte in itin lawm hau uh a, mi’ khialhna ciaptehna pen lawm taanna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihai khat zavei a kisatna sangin mipil khat khatvei tai-na in bunzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Thusia bekbek a deih tawntung migilote kiangah, a gilo kamtai pa bangin sihna tung ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihaite a hai gamtatna uh i tuahkhak sangin a no a kilaksak vompi hang khat tuak lehang hoihzaw lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuhoih kimlai thusia tawh a thukte’ inn sungah cikmahin thusia veng cih om ngei lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Kitot i kipat ciangin tui lipi cinna phung kehsakkhak tawh kibang hi. Tua ahih manin a nasiat ma-in kitot khawlpak in."},"15":{"text":"Migilote khahkhongna, thuman mite mawhsakna, a nih tuakin Topa in deih lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihai pa in thu ngaihsun thei lo ahih manin pilna zonna ding sum tampi a zat hangin a phattuamna om lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Lawm citak in a tawntungin hong it a, i sanggamte pen i lungkhamna a hong thuakpih dingin a piang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Thu a ngaihsun thei lo mihaite bek midang’ leiba lohsak dingin kipia ngam hi."},"19":{"text":"Khialh ding a utte lungkham ding a ut hi a, kihisak-a kam paupaute buaina ding a zongzong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Lungsim hoih lote in lungdam mu lo uh a, mi a khem theite in lungkhamna tuak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tapa hai pen a pa’ lungkhamna hi a, ta hai a nei pa a lung dam lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Maitaina in ci damsak a, maigum tawntungna in guhtui teepkang hi."},"23":{"text":"A ginalo thukhente in sumgolh sangsim uh a, a thukhenna uhah thuman om nawn lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Mipilte in a hoihpenin gamtatna ding thei uh a, mihaite in a cih nading thei lo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ta hai in a pa dahsak a, a nu lungkhamsak hi."},"26":{"text":"A thuman mi gimpiak ding hoih lo a, mihoihte satna pen thukhialhna ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Thu a thei taktakte in gengen khol lo a, a paupau khol lote thumu taktak hizaw hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihaite pau loin om leh a pil mahin kingaihsun hi. Thungaihsun thei na hihna a kilat nadingin pau loin om khinkhian in."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Midangte tawh a kipawlthei pha lote amah bek thupi a kisate hi a, midangte’ cih khempeuh man a sak khat beek om lo hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihaite in thu a teltheih zawhna ding uh kin lo uh a, pil si, a kicih theih nading deihna bek tawh thu gen uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mawhna bawl leeng maizumna tawh kizom pah a, minsiatna ngah leeng mindaina tawh kizom pah hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihingte’ kampau pen pilna kipatna suak thei a, tuipi bangin thuk-in luitui bangin a siang hi."},"5":{"text":"Mimawhte angvanin diksak a, midikte mawhsak ding thuman lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihaite in kitotna ding a pat ciangin hong sat un, ci-in a ngenngen ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihaite a pau ciangin amau’ siatna ding mah a pau hi a, amau’ kampau mah awkpih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Gensiatna pen anlim mahmah tawh kibang a, thakhatin i sungah kihupsuk hi."},"9":{"text":"Na a susia mite a hoih loh zah mahin a thadahte zong mihoih lo ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ min pen tausang muanhuai tawh kibang a, thuman mite in belin lungmuangin om thei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Khuapi kiima kulhpi in amah a hut bangin a hauhna in amah a hu dingin mihau pa in ngaihsunkha hi."},"12":{"text":"A kiniamkhiatte in zahtakna ngah uh a, a kihisakte pen siat ding a manawh hita hi."},"13":{"text":"A thu za khin nai lopi-in dawnkikna pen haina le maizumna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihingte’ lungsim in cinatna thuakzo sak a, mihing lungsim kisia leh cih nading om nawn lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Thungaihsun theite in a pilna uh behlap a, pilna a ngah nadingun mipilte in a bil uh tawh limtakin ngai uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Letsong in a piapa a dingin lampi honsak a, miliante tawh kimusak thei hi."},"17":{"text":"Thukhenna zumah a lang pa in a thuk mateng a gen masa pa a thuman tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Thugen a siam tuak mi nih zum sungah a kiseel ciangin kiciamna bek in thu khenzo hi."},"19":{"text":"Sanggamte na huhna in khuapi muanhuai bangin hong hu a, sanggam tawh kitotna in kidon lohna piangsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khat in a kampauna hangin gilvahna ngah ding a, a thugenna hangin nuntakna ngah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Kampauna in sihna ahi a, hinna ahi zongin piangsak thei a, i kampauna bangin a piangte san loh phamawh hi."},"22":{"text":"Zi a muzote na hoih a mu hi a, Topa’ maipha a ngah ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mizawngte a pau ciangin thumna kam zang a, mihaute in a dawn ciangin kihihsakna kam zang hi."},"24":{"text":"Lawm pawlkhatte sauvei kimang lo a, lawm pawlkhatte sanggam sangin kipzaw hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zuau genin mihai hihna sangin citakin zawn’ khiukheuna hoihzaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Thuthei lopi-in lawpluatna hoih lo a, mawk nawhtatna in lungkhamna piangsak thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in amau’ haitatna hangin gimna a ngah hinapi-in Topa ngawhin mawk heh uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihaute in lawm mu thuahthuah a, mizawngte in a neihsun teng nangawn khahsuahsuah uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuman gen lo teci in gim tuak pelmawh ding a, zuaugen mi suakta lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A cingh mihau pa’ maipha ngah ding ki-ut ciat a, na a piak mi khempeuh ama lawm ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in a sanggam zawng pa uh mudah ciat ahih manin a lawmte in a taisatna a thu lamdang hi lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Pilna a zongpa in ama phattuamna ding a zong hi a, thu a thei mipa’ sepna maavang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuman lo teci in gim tuak pelmawh ding a, zuaugen mi in sihna thuak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihaite a nop lua-in a nuntak ding kilawm lo a, silate in miliante a uk ding kilawm lo zaw lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Pilna in mi lungduaisak a, mi’ hong hehsaknate kiphawkmawh bawlna in minthanna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa’ hehna humpinelkai hawk bangin lauhuai a, ama pahtakna lopa tunga daitui taak bangin deihhuai hi."},"13":{"text":"Tapa hai pen a pa’ lungkhamna hi a, zi phunphun pen a theu thei lo guahciin tawh kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Inn le neihsate pen pate’ tung panin a kiluah hi a, zi pil ahihleh Topa bek in hong pia thei hi."},"15":{"text":"A thadahte lumlum a, a mawk omte a gil kial hi."},"16":{"text":"Thukham a zuite a khansau ding a, thukham a zui lote si ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mizawngte tungah a piate in Topa’ tungah a pia hi a, Topa in a cingin amaute tungah lohkik ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Thu hong mantheih lai-in na ta thuhilh in; na hilh kei leh a siatna ding a deih na hi hi."},"19":{"text":"Migilo pa ama thuak ding gimna mah thuaksak zaw in. Honkhia lecin na hotkhiatkik zelzel kul ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Thu kigente ngai-in hong kihilhte mang lecin mai lamah na pil ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing’ ngaihsutna-ah thu tampi om a, ahi zongin Topa’ deihna tawh a kituakte bek kimang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Duhhopna pen mindaina hi a, zuau gen pa hihna sangin mizawng hihna hoihzaw lai hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa a zahtakte a khansau a, lungkim takin nuamsa-in om uh a, siatna bangmah tuak kha lo uh hi."},"24":{"text":"A thadah mi in a khut tawh ankuang sawksukin a kam sungah a tuttohkik ding nangawn ut lo liang hi."},"25":{"text":"Thu thei lote in satna bek tawh pilna ngahzo a, thungaihsun theite in taina lel tawh pilna ngahzo uh hi."},"26":{"text":"A pa nawtgawpin a nu a notkhia tapa pen zumna le mindaina a piangsak tapa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Thuhilhna a mang nuam lo tapa pen pilna a thei kha lo ding tapa ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi a susia nuam teci in thuman gen nuam lo a, migilote in gitloh tatna nuamsa uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Mi a thusim lote in ciangduai thuak uh a, mihaite in satna thuak uh hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leenggahzu in mi kamtam sakin khamtheihzu in mi kitawngsak a, zukhamna pen haina ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa’ hehna pen a lauhuai mahmah humpinelkai hawk bang hi a, kumpipa a hehsak khate in sihlawh uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kitot khak ding pelhna in pahtak ngahna hi a, mihaite bek kitot ding ut uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Lo khawh hunin a kho nuam lo thadahpa in tuk anlak hun ciangin bangmah nei lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihingte’ ngaihsutna pen a thuk sunga om tui tawh kibang a, thuthuk mu theite bek in suahkhia thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi khempeuh pen mi citakin kigen kim uh hi; ahi zongin a citak takpi ding mi kimuzo ding ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Mi khat thumanin a hoihin a nuntak leh ama suanlekhakte mi hampha ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thukhenna tokhom tungah thu khenin a tu kumpipa in a mitin a etna tawh a hoih lote khenkhia thei hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ka lungsim siangtho hi; mawhna ka nei het kei hi,” a ci thei ding mi kua om ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Tawisuang nam nih le piciang nam nih zangin mi khemna pen Topa in a deih lohna kibang hi."},"11":{"text":"Naupangte nangawn mi citak mihoih ahihna a gamtatna panun kimukhia thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in khua muhna ding mit, khua zakna ding bil hong guan hi."},"13":{"text":"Lumlum lecin na zawng ding a, semsem lecin na hau ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Van leipa in van zuakpa kiangah, “Kiman kei, kiman kei,” cici khem a, a paikhiat khit ciangin sumdek siam mahmah ing, ci-in mi kiangah kisial hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilna tawh kam na pau theih leh kham le suang manpha sangin a manphazaw a nei na hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khat in gamdang mi khat’ leiba a lohsak dingin kam a hai ciam leh a ciam bangin a neihsa kilaksak takpi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A man loin a kingah an pen lim zungzung a, ahi zongin a nung ciangin suangtang haikhak tawh a kibang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hoihtakin geelna tawh nasepna tangtung hi. Geelna kician om lopi-in galsim dingin kipan kei in."},"19":{"text":"Mi a gensia kawikawite in thu im thei lo hi. Tua banga mi haipaute tawh kikhawl kei in."},"20":{"text":"Na nu le na pa na samsiat leh khuamial sunga om meivak kisumit na bang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A baih lamin hauhpakna pen a tawpna-ah phattuamna om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Mite’ hong bawlsiatna thuk ding ngaihsun kei inla, Topa’ hong huh ding ngakzaw in."},"23":{"text":"Tawisuang nam nih a zangte Topa in mudah a, amah in tawikhaina man lote hoih sa lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in mite’ gamtatna zia ding uk hi. Koici gamtat ding cih mihing in bangci theih ding ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah piak ding na ciam ma-in hoihtakin ngaihsun masa in. Tua hikeileh na kinungsik kha ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A pil kumpipa in migilote tengkhia a, khasiat loin gim piagawp hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in mihing lungsim meivak bangin zang a, i sungtawng dongin hong mu tel hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa in thuman, thutang, citakin a uk laiteng a kumpi za-ah kip bek hi."},"29":{"text":"Khangnote’ thahatna pen amau’ minthanna hi a, khanghamte’ sam kanna pen amau’ thupina lim ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Nakpi takin satna in misia kimlai a pha hong suah a, nakpitakin vuakna in i sungtawng hoih lohna teng a siangsak hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa’ khut sungah kumpipa om a, lo sunga tuilak bangin a deihna peuhah hei kawikawi thei hi."},"2":{"text":"Na gamtatna khempeuh nangmah in man na sak hangin Topa in na lungsim tawng a ettelna phawk in."},"3":{"text":"Topa in biakpiakna sangin thuman thutang deihzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Kihisakin gamtatna le kiphatsakna lungsimte pen mawhna hi a, migilo hihna lim ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Limtakin ngaihsunin geelgeelna pen hauhna lampi hi a, nawhsa-in lopthop hihna pen zawnna lampi ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Zuaugenna tawh hauhnate beimang pak a, sihna khuk sung hong tunpih hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote a manin gamta nuam lo uh ahih manin amau’ gamtatsiatna mah a awkpih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mimawhte thukawi-in gamta uh a, midikte a manin gamta uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Phun bek a thei zi tawh inn sungah tenkhop sangin innkhumzang kiu khatah tangten’ hoihzaw tham hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote in thusia bekbek deih uh a, a lawmte nangawn zah tuan lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte gim a kipiak ciangin mi mawkmawkte in pillawh uh a, mipilte a kihilh ciangin thutheihna-in nei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasian in migilo pa’ inn sungah a kisem khempeuh mu tel a, migilote lawnthalin a siasak hi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawngte’ huh ngetna a pia nuam lote pen amau zong cimawhin huhna a nget uh ciangin kipia lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A simthamin letsong piakna in hehna damsak a, puannuai tawi in sinsona daisak hi."},"15":{"text":"Thutangin na a kisep ciangin midik khempeuh lungdam a, ahi zongin migilote lungkham hi."},"16":{"text":"A kilawm gamtatna pan a pialkhia mite misi honte lakah a tung hi."},"17":{"text":"A noptat nuamte zawng uh a, zu ne-in sathau namtui a nilhte hau lo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Midikte’ thuak dingin a bawlsak uh gimnate pen migilote mah in lehthuak zawsop uh hi."},"19":{"text":"A phun hat zi gilo tawh tenkhop sangin gam simthamah khat guak tangten’ hoihzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipil pa’ inn sungah neihlelam a dimin om a, ahi zongin mihai pa in a ngahzahzah zangkhia pah hi."},"21":{"text":"Thuman thutakin gamta tawntung lecin na khan sau-in pahtawina na ngah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mipil khat in mi thahatte in a hut khuapi lazo a, amau’ muanmuan kulhpi nangawn susiazo hi."},"23":{"text":"Kampau a ki-ipzote lungkhamna tawh kipelh hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi kihisak i cihte pen kilian sakin a kiphasak mite ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi thadahpa in na sem nuam lo ahih manin amahmah a kithattawm ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihoih lote in lungkim hun nei loin deih thuah tawntung uh a, mihoihte cingh-in piakhia tawntung uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in migilote’ biakpiaknate deih lo a, ngimna hoih lo tawh a piakte uh deih lo zaw kan lai hi."},"28":{"text":"A man lo tecite mangthang ding uh a, thuman tecite’ kam kizaza ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Migilote pen muantheih dingin khauh pau uh a, midikte ahihleh lungmuang takin kampau hiathiat uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Mihingte’ pilna, a thutheihna le a thugente khempeuh, Topa’ deihna tawh a kituah kei leh a kimanna om lo hi."},"31":{"text":"Galdo nadingin sakolte a baihsa-in kikoih a, ahi zongin galzawhna pen Topa’ hang hizaw hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hauhna sangin min hoihna deihhuai zaw a, kham le ngun sangin mi’ hong thusimna deihhuai zaw hi."},"2":{"text":"A hau a zawng a kilamdanna om lo a, a nih tuakun Topa’ bawlsa ahi uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mipilte in a lauhuai thu mu thei-in pelh uh a, mi mawkmawkte in phusuakin thuak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kiniamkhiat-a Topa zahtakna thaman in hauhna, minthanna, le khansauna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Migilote’ lampi-ah thang kisiahin so kidawh a, mipilte in tua lampi pelh uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Naupang khat a neulai-in lampi man tawnsak lecin a teek dongin lampial nawn lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihaute in mizawngte uk a, leitawi a late pen a piate’ sila a suak hi."},"8":{"text":"Thuman lo khaici a vawhte in lungkhamna tuak uh a, amau’ hehna ciangduai amau’ tung mah tukik ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A cingh mi in mizawngte an pia a, amah in thupha ngahkik hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte hawlkhia lecin kitotna le kisimmawhna bei pah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsiamna in kumpipa’ lawm hong suaksak a, ahi zongin Topa in lungsim takpi a deih hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in thuman mite kem a, ahi zongin thuzuau gente a lawnthal hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi thadahte a inn-ah lumlum a, “Pua pial lehang humpi’n hong hih kha’n teh,” ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Numei tungah mawhna pen thangzak bang hi a, tua thangah a awkte tungah Topa a heh hi."},"15":{"text":"Naupangte a hai gamtat a ngeina hi a, deihtakin pangbetna in mihoih suaksak thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Hauhnop manin mihaute letsong pia leeng kizawnlawh a, hauhnop manin mizawngte’ neihsa laksak lehang zong kihauhlawh tuan lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Na bil uh hong ngatin mipilte’ thugen ngai unla, ka hong hilh pilna thute na lungsim uhah lutsak un.","title":"Thupiakte le Hilhkholhna Sawmthumte"},"18":{"text":"Na lungsim uhah ciingin zang thei le-uhcin, na lung uh dam tawntung ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hileh Topa muanin na nei ding uh a, tuni-in note’ phattuamna ding kam a pau ka suak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Thuhilhna le pilna thu nam sawmthum hih lai-ah note a dingin ka gelh a,"},"21":{"text":"thuman a kan dingin note hong sawlte’ tungah thuman bang hiam cih na genkik theih nadingun thuman na theih nading uh ka deihna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangmah hong cih zo lo ding cihna hangin nuamtak sa-in mizawngte’ neihsa mawk suh kei unla, zumah khia-in mawk bawlsiat kei un.","title":"-1-"},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amaute panpih ding a, amau a bawlsiate tungah phu a laksak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A hehbaih mite tawh kipawl kei unla, a lungtom mite tawh kikhawl kei un.","title":"-2-"},"25":{"text":"Amau’ hoih lohnate na zuihkhak loh nadingun na kidop kei uhleh note in zong na awklawh kha ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Midangte’ leiba lohsak dingin kamciamin leiba tavuan lakha kei un.","title":"-3-"},"27":{"text":"A leiba lohsakzo kei le-uhcin na lupna nangawn uh hong kidawhkhiatsak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Na pu na pate’ phuhsa gisuang cikmah hunin khin kei un.","title":"-4-"},"29":{"text":"A nasepna-ah a siam mahmah mi na theikha uh hiam? Amah in mi mawkmawkte’ na sem lo ding a, kumpite’ na sem ding hi.","title":"-5-"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miliante tawh an nekhawm dingin na tut uh ciangin na tutpih pa limtakin en un.","title":"-6-"},"2":{"text":"An a ngaklah thei mi na hih khak uhleh zong limtakin kidawm un."},"3":{"text":"Hong thangsiahna hi khathei ding ahih manin tua anlimte lunggulh pah lua kei un."},"4":{"text":"Hauhnop man bekin sum’ sila suak kei unla, a man loin gamtakha kei un.","title":"-7-"},"5":{"text":"Na ngahsa uh sumte mitphiat kalin beimang thei a, muvanlai bangin thakhatin leengmang thei hi."},"6":{"text":"A cil tentan mite’ an neksak kei unla, a anlimte uh duhgawhkha kei un.","title":"-8-"},"7":{"text":"“Ne ne un,” hong cih hangin a cih takpi hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na dangtawng a hong sun samzang nekkhak tawh kibang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na neksa teng uh na luakhia kik ding uh a, na kamsiam ngah teng uh maimang ta ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihaite pil hopih kei un; amaute in a manphatna phawk thei lo uh hi.","title":"-9-"},"10":{"text":"Tanglai gisuang khin kei unla, tagahte’ leitang va keek kei un.","title":"-10-"},"11":{"text":"Amaute a pawlpih pa pen Topa hi a, note’ langkhatah amaute panpih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hong kihilhnate zui unla, pilna thu hong kigente ngai un.","title":"-11-"},"13":{"text":"Naupangte sat ding lunghiang kei un; satna hangin si lo ding hi.","title":"-12-"},"14":{"text":"Ciangduai tawh sat le-uhcin nuntaklawh zaw ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka ta aw, mipil suak lecin ka lungdam mahmah ding hi.","title":"-13-"},"16":{"text":"Thuman na gen ciangin ka nuam mahmah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mawhnei mite engkha kei inla, Topa zahtakna zom paisuak in.","title":"-14-"},"18":{"text":"Tua bang hi lecin lametna om a, cithei-in na khansau ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thu ngai inla, mipil suak in; lampi man zuih ding ngaihsutpi-in nei in.","title":"-15-"},"20":{"text":"Zu nenete tawh kikhawl kei inla, a uisante tawh kithuahkha kei in."},"21":{"text":"Zu nenete le a uisante zawng ding uh a, a ne beka nitumte in puansia bek silhzo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma pianna na pa’ thu ngai inla, na nu a teek ciangin simmawh bawl kei in.","title":"-16-"},"23":{"text":"Thuman, pilna, siamna, thungaihsut theihna lei in; zuakkhiat dingin tuate pammaih lua hi."},"24":{"text":"Ta hoih a nei pa a lung dam ding a, ta pil a nei pa a ta’ tungah lungkim ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na nu le na pa a kipak nadingin gamta inla, na pianna nu lungdamsak in."},"26":{"text":"Ka ta aw, ka thugente ciamteh inla, keima gamtat bangin nang zong gamta in.","title":"-17-"},"27":{"text":"Numei paktatte pen kiattheihna ding gum tawh kibang a, numei ginalote pen tangciak theihna hawkguam tawh kibang hi."},"28":{"text":"Gutate bangin nang hong buksim a, mi tampi tak siasak uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Kuate in gal nei a, kuate in dahna thuak hiam? Thu om lopi-in kuate liam a, thu om lopi-in kuate a mit san gega hiam?","title":"-18-"},"30":{"text":"Zu ne-a a tut khote zu a nenete ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hai sungah a phuan seuhseuh gawl sungah a tumsuk hithit thei leenggahzu san et-in nei kei in."},"32":{"text":"A tawpna-ah gulpi bangin nang hong tu ding a, gul gunei in a tuk na bang ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Na mitah na lamdangdang hong suak ding a, hoihtakin na pau thei nawn kei ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuipi tungah a lum tawh na kibang ding a, a suk awn a to awn teembaw dawna tuang tawh na kibang ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“Hong vuak hangun ka liam kei a, hong sat hangun ka phawk kei hi. Ka pilvang ciangin zu ka ne kik ding hi,” na ci ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilote eng kei inla, amaute tawh kikhawl kei in.","title":"-19-"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in tatsiat ding bek ngaihsun uh a, thusia bekbek genin nei uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna tawh inn kilam a, ngaihsut siamna tawh inn kip hi.","title":"-20-"},"4":{"text":"Thungaihsut theihna inn sungah a hoih a manpha nate a dimtakin om hi."},"5":{"text":"Thahatna sangin pilna hoihzaw a, thakhauhna sangin thutheihna hoihzaw hi.","title":"-21-"},"6":{"text":"Geel siamna tawh galte kizo a, ngaihsut siamna tawh gualzawhna kingah hi."},"7":{"text":"Pil kampauna pen mihaite’ theihzawh dingin thuk lua mahmah a, mihaite in mihon lakah thu gen ngam lo uh hi.","title":"-22-"},"8":{"text":"Thusia lamsang a deih mite thusia bawl mi kici hi.","title":"-23-"},"9":{"text":"Mihaite’ vaihawmna in khialhna bek piangsak lel a, mi a simmawh theite midangte in mudah uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Haksatna na tuah ciangin na lung a kiat leh a ginalo mi na hi hi.","title":"-24-"},"11":{"text":"Thah dinga a kikaikhia mipa honkhia inla, sih nading mun a zuan mipa lehkaih kik in.","title":"-25-"},"12":{"text":"Ke’n theikha kei ing, na cihnop hangin lungsim a thei Pasian in theitel veve hi; nang hong encik Pasian in hong teltheihna phawk in. Mi khempeuh a gamtatna bangin a thukkik ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka ta aw, khuaizu khum ahih manin ne in. I kamah khuailuzu khum mahmah hi.","title":"-26-"},"14":{"text":"Pilna pen i nuntakna-ah khuaizu tawh kibang a, pilna nei lecin mai lamah lametna om a, na khan hong sausak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilote’ gamtat bangin thuman mite’ omna sugawp kei inla, amau’ tenna inn luhgawp kei in.","title":"-27-"},"16":{"text":"Mihoihte sagihvei dong a puk hangin tho kikkik thei a, migilote ahihleh tuahsiatna thuakin kithallot hi."},"17":{"text":"Na galte in gimna a ngah ciangin lungdam kei inla, a puk ciangin kipak kei in.","title":"-28-"},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hong thei-in nang tungah lungkim lo ding a, na galte tungah heh nawn loin gim pia lo kha ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Migilote’ hangin lung nuammawh kei inla, amaute eng kei in.","title":"-29-"},"20":{"text":"Amaute in mai lamah lamet ding bangmah nei lo a, amaute’ meivak kisukmitsak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka ta aw, Topa le kumpipa zahtak khawm inla, amau a langpangte tawh kipawlkha kei in.","title":"-30-"},"22":{"text":"Tua bang mite thakhatthu-in kisugawp thei ding hi. Pasian le kumpipa’ piansak theih ding gimna kuamah in genkhol thei lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Mipil dangte in zong hih bangin thu gen uh hi: Mi lang muhin thukhenna hoih lo hi.","title":"Mipilte’ Thugen Dangte"},"24":{"text":"Mimawh kimlai a diksak thukhen pa leitung a mi khempeuh in mudahin phuisam ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A mawh mi gim a pia thukhen pa ahihleh thupha kipia-in daupai ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A mantakin dawnkikna pen lawm taktak hihna lim ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Na nuntakna ding zong masa inla, na an nek ding a kicin ciang bekin na inn ding lamin zi le ta nei pan in."},"28":{"text":"Thu kician om lopi-in na vengpa’ langkhatah teci pang kei inla, amau’ siat nadingin zuauthu gen kei in."},"29":{"text":"Kei tungah hong bawl bangin kei zong ka bawl ding a, ama hong hihna bangin ka thuk ding hi, cikha kei in."},"30":{"text":"Mi thadahpa’ lo gei-ah ka va pai a, mihai pa’ leenggui lo ka va nawkkha hi."},"31":{"text":"Limtakin ka et ciangin a lo ciing bupah kiak dim a, a leitang khempeuh lopa in khuhcip a, a umna a phungcian suangte kicim khin hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bang ka muh ciangin thu ka lungngaingai a, thu manpha khat ka mukhia hi."},"33":{"text":"Tawmkhat ihmutna, tawmkhat lusukna, tawmkhat sung na sep lohna, khutzepin ommawkna hangin"},"34":{"text":"i tungah zawnna hong tung a, cihmawhna in hong khuhcip hi.","ref":"Pau 6:10-11"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Hezekiah’ lai-atte in a teikhiat uh Solomon’ paunak dangte:","title":"Etkakna le Theihhuai Thute"},"2":{"text":"Pasian in thu a ip manin a min thang a, kumpite in thu a genkhiat manin minthang uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Vantung sang lua-in leisung a thuk luat mah bangin kumpipa’ ngaihsutna thuk lua-in kithei zo lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngun a ek teng paikhia lehang sikseekpa in na hoihpi piangsak thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa kiang pan migilote nilkhia lehang thumanin ama ukna kip thei bek hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa mai-ah na om ciangin milian kineih kei inla, miliante’ tutna ding munah tukha kei in."},"7":{"text":"Uliante a awn dingin hua lai-ah va tusuk in, hong kicih sangin hih lai-ah hong tuto in, hong kicih ding hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Luk 14:8-10"},"8":{"text":"Thu khatpeuh na theih ciangin thukhen zum tun pah kei in. Na vengpa in nang’ khialhna hong laktel kik leh nang bang lawh nawn ding na hi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Na thuneihpih na vengpa bek mah tawh thu kiseel inla, mi khat’ thusim midang’ tungah genthang kei in."},"10":{"text":"Tua hikeileh amah hehin nang hong maizumsak ding a, na minsiatna bei ngei nawn lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A kilawm hunin kammal khat paukhiatna pen ngun pek tunga kham pek khat a kisuang tawh kibang hi."},"12":{"text":"Hilhna a sang thei mipa a dingin a pil thuhilhpa pen kizepna kham bilbah tawh kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah a sawlte tungah a citak kamtai pa pen anlak huna tuivot tawh kibang a, a tote’ lungsim thaksuak sak hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangmah a piak lohpi a kisialhpih pa pen guah a zusak tuan lo meiipi le huihpi nung tawh kibang lel hi."},"15":{"text":"Lungduai a zolzolna tawh gam ukte kizo thei a, kam nemin pauna tawh aana neite kizo thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Khuaizu na nek ciangin a hoihkhop bek zah ne in. Tua hikeileh khamlua-in na lua ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na vengte’ inn-ah hawh mun lua kei in. Hong cimtakin hong mudah kha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A lawmte’ langkhatah teci man lo a pang mi pen molhtum, namsau, ahih kei leh thal hiam tawh kibang hi."},"19":{"text":"Haksat hunin a zuautat mi muanin neihkhakna pen hana, ahih kei leh khebai tawh kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"A dah a lungkham mipa kiangah lasakna pen khuadam laitakin puan suahkhiat tawh kibang a, meima ci-al nuh tawh kibang hi."},"21":{"text":"Na galte a gil a kial leh an pia inla, a dang a tak leh tui pia in."},"22":{"text":"Tua hileh amau’ maizum nadingin a bawl na hi a, Topa in nang tungah thaman hong pia ding hi.","ref":"Rom 12:20"},"23":{"text":"Leilu lam huih in guah a zuksak bangin gensiatna in hehna piangsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Phun bek a thei zi tawh inn sungah tenkhop sangin innkhumzang kiu khatah tangten’ hoihzaw tham hi."},"25":{"text":"A dangtak mipa in tuivot lim a sak bangin gamlapi-a om lawmte’ kiang panin thuzak nuam kisa hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihoih khat in mihoih lote’ gamtatna a zuihkhak ciangin hawktui nin, ahih kei leh tui uih tawh kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"Khuaizu a tam lua nek ding a hoih loh bangin phat ding deihluatna a hoih lo ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama lungsim a ki-uk zo lo mipa pen dalna kulhpi a nei lo khuapi tawh kibang hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuk laitak a vuk kia le anlak huna guahzu bangin mihaite a dingin pahtawina a kilawmna om lo hi."},"2":{"text":"Thu om lopi a hong kisamsiatna pen bangmah a hong cih thei lo, khawlna mun mel a nei lo, a leengsuk a leengto phialphiah tawh kibang lel hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakolte sat ding kisam a, late kamkaih kisam a, mihaite zong sat ding a kisam ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihaite’ thudotna dawngdawng lecin nang zong amau mah bangin a hai na hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaite a pilin a kingaihsut khak loh nadingin amau’ haina tawh kizui-in dawng zaw in."},"6":{"text":"Mihai khat kamtai-in a zang pa pen ama khe mah a sattantawm, siatna a zong pa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Khebai pa’ khe a kimanna om loin a kikhai mawk bangin mihaite a dingin paunak in bangmah man nei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Saili kuangah sailungtang khihcip lehang phattuamna a om loh bangin mihaite pahtawina zong a mawkna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihaite in paunak thuhilhnate a paukhiat ciangin zukham pa in a khut a ling om a khei dingin a kipan tawh kibang lel hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihai a tuahkhak peuh tha cial a a nei pa pen a tuahkhak peuh a ban kap thal tawipa tawh kibang hi."},"11":{"text":"Ui in a luak a zuatkik bangin mihaite zong a haitat ngei bangin ta kik zel hi.","ref":"2Pe 2:22"},"12":{"text":"A pil lo kimlai a pil a kisapa sangin mihaite a dingin lametna omzaw lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Thadahpa in, “Lampi-ah humpinelkai om! Kongzingah humpinelkai om!” ci-in lumlum hi."},"14":{"text":"Kongkhak pen kawmhek tungah a kiheihei lel bangin mi thadahpa a lupna tungah kiheihei hi."},"15":{"text":"Thadahpa in a khutin ankuang sawksuk a, a kamah a bahtoh kik ding nangawn gim zungzung kisa hi."},"16":{"text":"A kilawmin thu a dawngthei mihing sagih sangin mi thadahpa a ngaihsutna-ah pil kisa zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Eite tawh a kisai lo kitotna sunga kiphumna pen ui ommuang khat a bil-in i kaihsak tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"A vengte a khem khit ciangin ka ciamnuihna hi, a ci pa pen"},"19":{"text":"sihtheihna gu a baang thaltang tawh a kap pa tawh kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Sing om kei leh mei mit a, gensiatna om kei leh kitotna bei hi."},"21":{"text":"Meihol in mei-am ding piangsak a, sing in mei kuangsak a, migilo in kitotna piangsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Gensiatna pen a lim mahmah an tawh a kibang hi a, mihingte’ sungtawng pekah tumsuk pahpah hi."},"23":{"text":"Tungtham beka kam khum pauna pen cimbeng kizut leibeel tawh kibang hi."},"24":{"text":"A simtat mi in a kampi bek tawh thuhoih gen a, a lungsimah zuauthu bek om hi."},"25":{"text":"A lungsimah a deihhuai lo thu sagih tak om ahih manin kam khum takin a pau manin umkha kei in."},"26":{"text":"Ama hoih lohna a ip nop hangin mi khempeuh in ama gitlohna thei veve hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi siahna-in gum a tote amau’ gum tawhna sung mahah lehkiat zawsop uh a, mi a dengkha dingin suang a khukte amau’ suang khuk mah in amau mah lehden kha zaw hi."},"28":{"text":"Zuaugenna in midik kimlai a mawh bangsak a, tungtham beka thugenna in siatna bek piangsak hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zing ciang hun ading kima-sialh kei in. Tuhun le tua hun kikalah a piang ding thu bangmah na thei kei hi.","ref":"James 4:13-16"},"2":{"text":"Midangte in hong phat lohbuang nangmah kiphattawm kei in. Khual mite in hong phat lohbuang nangma kamin kiphattawm kei in."},"3":{"text":"Suangtum le sehnel gik mahmah a, ahi zongin mihaite’ piansak lungkhamna gikzaw lai hi."},"4":{"text":"Hehna le sinsona siahuai a, ahi zongin hazatna siahuaizaw lai hi."},"5":{"text":"Itna i seel bawl sangin a langtangin taina hoihzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"I lawmte in hong liamsak hangin i hoihna ding a hong deihsakna hizaw hi. I galte in hong ngawng kawina pen hong lehbawlna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A gilvah mipa in khuaizu nangawn duh nawn lo a, a gilkial mipa in a kha an nangawn limsa hi."},"8":{"text":"Inn panin gamlapi-ah a zinkhia mipa a bu panin a leengkhia vasa tawh kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Sathau namtui le paknamtui in lung nuamsak a, lawmte’ limbawlna in tha hatsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Na lawmte daangkoih kei inla, na pa’ lawmte dong nangawn lawm bawl in. Na lungkham ciangin na sanggampa va ko kei in. A gamla-ah a om i sanggampa sangin a nai-ah a om i vengpa kimangzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ta aw, pil in; tua hileh ka lungdam ding a, kei hong mawhsak nuamte in bangmah hong cih thei lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipilte in a lauhuai thu muthei-in pelh uh a, mi mawkmawkte in phusuakin thuak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi khat in gamdang mi khat’ leiba a lohsak dingin kam a ciam leh a ciam bangin ama neihsa kilaksak takpi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in a kituak lopi-in midang khat limbawl lualiang leh amah in a sia lamin na ngaihsun zaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Phun bekbek a thei zi pen theu hun mel a nei lo guahciin tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bang numeite kikho thei lo a, a kikham thei lo huihnung, le i khutin sathau i tawi nop tawh kibang hi."},"17":{"text":"Sik in sik mah hiamsak thei a, mi in midang pilsak thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Theikung a cing pa in a theigah ne a, a tapa a kem pa in pahtakna ngah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tui sung en leeng eima maitang i muh bangin i lungsim en leeng eima pianzia kilang hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihingte’ lungsim pen misite’ gam tawh kibang a, tamlua cih hun nei thei lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngun le khamte meikhukah kize-et a, mihing ahihleh phatna tawh kize-et hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihai khat a sih dek dongin na satsat hangin a hai ngei mahin hai veve lai ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tuuhonte hoihtakin thei inla, na bawnghonte hoihtakin kem in."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh neihsa kip tawntung lo a, hauhna pen a khangkhangin kizom suak lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Lopate ki-atmang khin a, ahi zongin a no hong selkik hi. Mualtungah a po lopa hing khempeuh ki-atin inn-ah kipua a,"},"26":{"text":"tuute in na puan ding hong guan a, na keeltal mante lo ciing khat man tawh kikim hi."},"27":{"text":"Na keelnawite ahihleh na innkuan annek ding, le na nasem numeite’ nuntak nadingin kicing ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kuama delh lohpi-in migilote taimang a, mithumante ahihleh humpinelkai bangin a hang uh hi.","title":"Migilo le Mithuman"},"2":{"text":"Gam sung mite a hoih loh ciangin a banbanin gam uk kumpi tampi nei uh a, ahi zongin mipil thungaihsun theite in gam sung thahatsakin kipsak uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mizawngte a bawlsia aana a nei mipa pen lo-a ante a susiagawp guahzu tawh kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham a zui lo mite in migilote pakta uh a, thukham a zui mite ahihleh migilote tawh kilem lo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi siahuaite in thutang cihmel thei lo uh a, Topa a biate in ahihleh a kicingin a thei uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Hau napi-in lungsimkawi mi hihna sangin zawng napi-in paubaan neih lohna hoihzaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Thuhilhna a mang mite ta pil hi a, lawm gilo tawh a kikhawl mi in a pa mindaisak hi."},"8":{"text":"A meet a pung lakna tawh a hau mipa pen mizawngte a hehpih mipa a dingin sum a zonsak hi lel hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khat in thukham a zuihnop kei leh ama thungetna nangawn Pasian in zakthadahhuai sa hi."},"10":{"text":"A diktat mi khat siatsak ding a hanciam pa pen ama tawhsa gum sung mahah kia ding hi. A dik mipa in gamh hoih luah ding a, migilo pa in bangmah luah lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihau pa pen amah pil kisa a, ahi zongin a zawng mi pil pa in a hau pa’ haina phawkkhia veve hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihoihte in vangliatna a ngah ciangin mi khempeuh lungdam uh a, migilote a liat ciangin adangte in gimna thuak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A khialhna a im mite a dau pai lo ding a, a mawhna pulakin a kikheel mite in hehpihna ngah ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa a zahtak tawntungte pen mi nuamsa hi a, a lungkhauh mite in lungkhamna tuak ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mizawngte a uk migilo pa pen humpinelkai gilkial le vompi halungvei tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngaihsut siamna a nei lo gam ukpa a gilo kumpi hi ding a, thuman tawh ngah ding bek a deih mipa in sauveipi uk ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi thatin a khial pa in ama hankhuk ding a to ahi hi. Ama hankhuk tawh kho kei in."},"18":{"text":"Thumanin a gamta mite lungmuangin om ding uh a, a zuautat mite ahihleh puk ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Nakpi takin lo a khopa hau mahmah a, bangmahin a kimang tum lo na a sempa zawng mahmah hi."},"20":{"text":"A citak mipa in thupha tampi ngah ding a, a hau baih nuam mipa in gim tuak pelmawh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi langbawlna hoih lo a, ahi zongin letsong neucik khat hangin thukhente gamta khial thei zel hi."},"22":{"text":"A huaiham mi in a hauh nadingin huai mengmeng a, a tawpna-ah a zawn’ ding lamtak phawkkha lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi khat tai-in thuhilh lecin tungthama phatna sangin a tawpna-ah lungdamzaw ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A nu a pa’ neihsa laksakin, “Khialhna hi kei,” a ci pa pen guta mah hi veve hi."},"25":{"text":"A huaiham mi in kitotna piangsak a, Topa a muang mite mihau hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ei le ei kimuanna haina hi a, mipilte’ hilhna zuihna pen lungmuanna ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mizawng a huhte cimawh ngei lo ding a, huhna a pia nuam lote in samsiatna ngah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Migilote a liat ciangin midangte bucip uh a, amaute a zakiat ciangin midikte in ukkik ding hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kihilh napi-in a mang nuam lote bawlphat zawh nawn loh dongin kisia ding uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Midikte in gam a uk ciangin gammite lungdam uh a, migilote in a uk ciangin a gammite thum uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna a deih mi in a pa lungdamsak a, numei paktat tawh a kikhawl mi in a neihsa teng lawnmang hi."},"4":{"text":"Thumanin a gamta kumpi in a gam kipsak a, sum bek a ngaihsun kumpi in a gam siasak hi."},"5":{"text":"A man lopi-in mi khat mawkphatna pen a awk nadingin thangsiahna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Migilote amau mawhna sungah awkcip a, midikte ahihleh suakta-in lungdam uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Midikte in mi cimawhte a’ ding thu khual uh a, migilote in tua bang thukhualna thei lo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thu a khual lote in khua sungah buaina lianpi piangsak a, mipilte in tua buaina daisak thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Mipil khat in mihai khat tawh zumah thu nei leh mipil pa tungah hehin zahko a, phattuamna piang tuan lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi a that nuamte in a thuman mi mudah a, midikte in a thuman mi hu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihai pa a hehna bangin kam pau-in gamta gawp a, mipil pa ahihleh ki-ipin a hehna damsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa in zuauthu saangin na sem leh a nuai-a ulian khempeuh zong zuaugenin nitum ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawng pa le mi bawlsia pa a kibatna uh khat om hi. Topa in a nih tuakun mittang guan hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in mizawngte’ thu a manin khensak leh a ukna kip tawntung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ciangduai le tai-na in pilna guan a, a kikhahkhong ta in a nu maizumsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilote ulian suak leh siatna khang semsem a, ahi zongin midikte in amau’ mit mahmah tawh a gilo uliante’ zakiatna mu ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Na ta thuhilhin tai lecin ama hangin na kipak ding a, na lung hong kimsak ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasian’ lamlahna a kizuih lohna gamah gam sung mite phengtat gawp uh hi. Pasian’ thukham a zui mite ahihleh a lungdam uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Kama hilh lel tawh silate pil zo lo a, a theih hangun hong mang tuan lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Thu ngaihsun loin a pheng paupau mipa sangin mihai pa a dingin lametna omzaw lai hi."},"21":{"text":"Sila khat a neu tung a kipan limtakin na khoi hangin a tawpna-ah nang hong hehsak veve ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A heh pahpahte in kitotna piangsak a, a heh baihte khial thei tawntung hi."},"23":{"text":"A kiphasakte in niamkhiatna thuak ding a, a kiniamkhiatte in pahtawina ngah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Guktakna sungah a kipawl mipa ama a dingin thusia zongpa ahi hi. A guktakna pulak leh amah gim kipia ding a, genkhia kei leh lah Pasian in samsia veve ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Midangte kihtakna in hong lunghimawhsak a, Topa muanna in hong lungmuangsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in gam ukte’ maipha ngah ding hanciam ciat uh a, ahi zongin Topa’ kiang pan bekin thutang kingah hi."},"27":{"text":"Midikte in migilote mudah uh a, migilote in midikte mudah uh hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakeh’ tapa Agur’ thugente: Amah in, “Pasian aw, ka lunggim a, ka cih nading ka thei kei hi.","title":"Agur’ Muhna Zia"},"2":{"text":"Ka hai lua a, mihing ka sun kei hi. Mihing bangin ngaihsut siamna ka nei kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna thu ka thei kei a, Pasian’ thu ka theih om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantungah kua kahto a, leitungah kua hong kumsuk kik ahi hiam? Kua in a khut sungah huihte lomcip a, puan tawh tuite tuncip ahi hiam? Kua in leitung bulpite phut kip ahi hiam? Tua bang mi na theih ngei leh a tapa’ min bang ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"“Pasian in a thugen khempeuh a manna laktel a, amah a belte a dingin kidalna lum ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama gen lohpi behlapsak kei in; na tua cih leh amah in nang hong tai-in zuau thugen na hihna hong kilang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian aw, thu nih kong ngen hi. Ka sih ma-in tuate hong pia in.","title":"Paunak Dangte"},"8":{"text":"Zuauna le khemna ka zat loh nadingin hong huh inla, a haulua lo, a zawnglua loin hong bawl inla, ka khamkhop zah lian bek an hong pia in."},"9":{"text":"Haulua leng nang hong nialin, “ Topa i cih kua ahi hiam?” kong ci kha ding a, zawnglua leuleu leng mi’ na guksakin ka Pasian’ min kong daisak khazel ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Sila khat a topa kiangah gensia kei in; amah in nang hong gensia-in gimna na thuakkha ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A pate samsia-in a min a daisak, a nute a phat lo mi pawlkhat om hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute a nin mahmah hinapi-in amau’ muhna-ah siang a kisa mahmah mi pawlkhat om hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihoih pha mahmahin a kingaihsun, a kiliansak mahmah mi pawlkhat om hi."},"14":{"text":"A ha uh namsau tawh a kibang gam sung mizawngte a netum, mi cimawhte a liaktum mi pawlkhat om hi."},"15":{"text":"Vot in tanu nih nei a, khat in, “Hong pia in,” ci a, a khat in zong, “Hong pia in,” mah ci veve hi. “Phazo ta,” a ci ngei lo nam thum om a, eh! li hi zaw:"},"16":{"text":"Han khuk, taciing numei, tui a deih tawntung lei keu, le a kisumit zo lo meikuang."},"17":{"text":"A pa a simmawh mipa, a nu’ thu a mang nuam lo mipa, va-ak in a mittang khelkhiat sakin musanete in a sa ne ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka theihzawh hetloh a lamdang mahmah thu thum om a, eh! li hi zaw:"},"19":{"text":"Vanah musane a leentheihna zia, suangpi tungah gul a pai theihna zia, tuipi tungah teembaw a pai theihna zia, le nungak tangval a kingaihna zia."},"20":{"text":"A citak lo zi hih bangin gamta hi: Midang tawh khialin tua ciangin kisilsiang a, “Khialhna bangmah gamta kei ing,” ci khem hi."},"21":{"text":"Leitung mi khempeuh in a thuakzawh loh thu thum, eh! thu li om a,"},"22":{"text":"sila khat kumpi a suah ciang, mihai khat in a duh bangbang a nek zawh ciang,"},"23":{"text":"a muhthadahhuai numei khat in pasal a neih ciang, nasem numeino in a tonu’ za a suan ciang."},"24":{"text":"A neu mahmah ganhing nam li leitungah om a, ahi zongin a pil penpente ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Miksite: A hat het lo ganhing hinapi-in khuakhal sungin a nek ding uh kholzo uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ngalvangte: A thahat lo ganhing hinapi-in suang lakah a kua ding bawl uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Kauphete: Kumpi nei lo napi-in a kituak diamdiamin hontat thei uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Innhikte: Khut sunga tawizawh ganhing hilel napi-in kumpi inn sungah tengzo uh hi."},"29":{"text":"A gamtatna i et ciangin a thupi suak mahmah thum, eh! li om hi."},"30":{"text":"Humpinelkai: Ganhing lak pan a hatpen kuamah a kihta lo."},"31":{"text":"Aklui: A kihisak pai kuankuan. Keeltal: A kihisak pai gangan. Kumpipa: A mite’ mai-ah a pai lanlan."},"32":{"text":"Kiphasakin na hai pau ngei a, thusia bawl ding na ngaihsut ngei khak leh limtakin thu ngaihsun pha in."},"33":{"text":"Bawngnawi toktok lehang thawhbat hong suak a, mi khat’ nak tupsak lehang si hong luang a, mi phin lehang kitotna hong piang hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Lemuel, a nu in a thuhilhna:","title":"Kumpipa Tungah Ngaihsut Piakna"},"2":{"text":"Kong it mahmah ka ta aw, thu ngenngenin kong neih ka tapa na hi hi. Nangma tungah bang teng hong gen ding ka hi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Na thatang teng numei tungah beisak kei inla, na sum khempeuh numei tungah zang kei in. Numei in kumpipa siasak thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Lemuel aw, ka thugen hong ngai in. Kumpite in zu nek huai lo a, mi ukte in khamtheihzu a duh ding hi lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Zu ne le-uh, thukham mangngilh uh a, thukham hei-in mizawngte gim pia khathei uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A si dekdekte, khamtheihzu pia inla, a lungkham mahmahte, leenggahzu pia in."},"7":{"text":"Amaute nesak lecin a zawnna uh mangngilhin, a lungkhamna uh phawk nawn lo ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thu a gen thei lo mite a dingin thu gensak inla, a huh ding a om lo mite panpih in."},"9":{"text":"Amau a’ ding thu genin thu a tangin khen inla, a zawng a cimawh mite amau a dingin a kilawm hamphatna ngahsak in."},"10":{"text":"Zi hoih pen suangmanpha sangin manphazaw pek a, ahi zongin zi hoih ngah ding haksa mahmah hi.","title":"Zi Hoih Pahtawina"},"11":{"text":"A pasal in muang mahmah a, a innsung uhah annek kitasam ngei lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in a khan tawntungin a pasal tungah thupha bawl a, a pasal tungah thusia tun ngei lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in samul le khau zongin thanuam takin na sem hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in sumbukte’ van pua teembaw bangin gamlapi panin an hong ciahpih hi."},"15":{"text":"Phalvak tungin zingtho a, annek ding teng limtakin bawlin a nasem numeite’ sep dingteng a vaihawmsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in leitang hoih penpen zong a, a thalawhsa sum tawh a leenggui lo ding a lei hi."},"17":{"text":"A nik singtenin a puanban zial a, thalawp takin na a sem hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in a nasepte a manphatna thei a, zankim zankhang dongin nakpitakin na a sem hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in khau kheekin a puan ding gantawm hi."},"20":{"text":"A zawng mite tungah amah cingh mahmah a, a cimawh mite tungah huhna a pia hi."},"21":{"text":"A innkuan buppi puanlum guanzo ahih manin phalbi tun ding lunghimawh lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in a puan ding khuitawm a, saihadial puansan vive a silhzo hi."},"23":{"text":"Thukhen upate lakah a pasal a tut ciangin mite’ lakah a kitheikim mi khat ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in puan khui-in kawnggakte zong bawl a, sumbukte tungah tuate a zuak hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah a tha hatin zong kizahtak a, mailam hun ading a lung patau lo hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in a pilna tawh thu gen a, kam khum takin pau hiathiat hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in a innkuansung kisapna teng sem a, a tawntungin manlah den hi."},"28":{"text":"A tate in amah it mahmah uh a, a pasal in zong pakta mahmah a,"},"29":{"text":"“Zi hoih tampi a om tei hangin nang kan-a hoih kuamah om kei,” ci-in a phat hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngaihbaanna pen zuaupi hithei a, melhoihna zong maimang thei hi. Ahi zongin Topa a zahtak numei a phattaak ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"A sepna khempeuh hangin amah phat un. Mi khempeuh in a zahtak dingin a kilawm ahi hi."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thuhilhna","shortname":"Thn","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuhilhna Laibu sungah mihingte' nuntakna bangzahin tomin, i ngaihsutna tawh kilehbulh a, thumanlohna leh lungkiathuaina tampi om ahih manin, “Nuntakna a mawknapi hi,” ci-in a thu a khum, “Thu ngaihsunsunpa” in limtakin a ngaihsut thute kigelh hi. Amah in mihingte' thutawpna ciangdong a uk Pasian' ngaihsutna theitel zolo hi. Tua bang hinapi-in mite in nakpi takin na semin, ahih thei laiteng a ngah theih zahzah uh Pasian' piak letsongte nuamtakin a zat dingun a hanthawn hi. Hih thu ngaihsunsunpa' ngaihsutna a tampite a sia lam vive, a lungkiathuai vive ahi hi. Ahi zongin Lai Siangtho sungah hih laibu hong kihel ciangin hih bang uplahna leh a sia lam bek ngaihsutnate nangawn a huam zah dingin Lai Siangtho thu upna a zai mahmah ahihna thu hong kilangsak hi. Mi tampi tak in hih thuhilhna a sim uh ciangin amaute' pian'zia kimu-in thakhauhna-in nei uh a, hih bang ngaihsutna a kigelhna Lai Siangtho mah in nuntakna a manphazaw a hong pia thei Pasian muan'na hong ngahsak thei hi, ci-in thu phawkna-in a nei uh hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sungah kumpi a sem, David’ tapa, Thugen Siampa’ thugente:","title":"Na Khempeuh A Mawknapi"},"2":{"text":"Thugen Siampa in hih bangin ci hi: A mawknapi, a mawknapi, na khempeuh a mawknapi."},"3":{"text":"Gimpi-a nisa thuakin nasepna-ah mihing in bang noptuam ngah ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Khang khat bei-in khang khat hong tung a, ahi zongin leitung kibangbang niloh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni hong suakin ni tum a, a suakkik dingin tum zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Leitaw lamah huih nungin leilu lamah nung leuleu a, a zuih ngeina teng mah zui-in nungnung niloh hi."},"7":{"text":"Lui khempeuh tuipi-ah luangsuk a, ahi zongin tuipi dim nai lo hi. Tuipi tuite a khu-in leengin tuinakah guahin zu a, a nak panin hong luangsuk kik zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khempeuh lunggimhuai a, kuama genzawh ding hi lo hi. Mit in a muh cim thei lo a, bil in a zak cim thei lo hi."},"9":{"text":"A omsa mah bangin hong piang kik ding a, a kisemsa bangin hong kisem kik ding hi. Leitungah a thak na khat beek om lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih pen a thak ahi hi, a kici thei ding khat beek om lo hi. Eite’ khan ma-in a omsa vive ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A beisa nate kiphawkkha nawn lo a, hong tung lai ding thute zong a khangkikte in phawk nawn lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Thugen Siampa kei pen Jerusalem khua-ah Israel kumpipa ka hi ngei hi.","title":"Thugen Siampa’ Tuahkhak Thu"},"13":{"text":"Hih leitungah a kisem na khempeuh entelin a thu kan ding ka ngaihsun hi. Pasian in tua bang nasep ei tungah hong guat pen a nuam het lo nasep khat ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Leitungah a kisem khempeuh ka mu khin a, tuate khempeuh a mawknapi na hi a, huihpi nung tawh kibang lel hi."},"15":{"text":"A kawisate kimamsak thei lo a, a om lopi a omin kiseh thei lo hi."},"16":{"text":"“Pilna sangpi ka nei a, keima mai-ah Jerusalem a uk dangte khempeuh sangin ka pilzaw hi. Pilna le theihna a kici khempeuh ka thei loh om lo hi,” ka ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 4:29-31"},"17":{"text":"Pilna le haina, theihna le mawlna, a kilamdanna ka zong hi.
