Ahi zongin tua bang ka hahkatna zong a mawknapi ahihlam ka phawk hi."},"18":{"text":"Pil semsem lehang kilunghimawh semsem a, tam thei semsem lehang hong gimsak semsem zawsop hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungdamna zongin nuam ka sak bang bangin om ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun leuleu hi. Tua zong a mawknapi ahihna ka phawk zel hi."},"2":{"text":"Nuihna pen haina ahihna, nopna pen bangmahin a kiman lohna ka mukhia hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in leitungah tomno a nuntak sungin bangci om leh hoih ding ahi hiam, cih ka muh theih nadingin pilna ka deihna mah tawh, zunekna tawh ka lung nuamsakin, ka utut sep ding ka hanciam hi."},"4":{"text":"Na lian tampi tak mah ka sem zo hi. Keima a dingin inn tampi tak ka lam a, leenggui lo tampi tak mah ka nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Huan bawlin singno cinna lo zong ka nei a, ka huan sungah nektheih namkim kidim hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua singnote tui piak nadingin tuikhukpi zong ka bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka inn-ah a suak silate banah, sila a nu a pa-in tampi tak ka neithuah hi. Tuuhonte le bawnghonte zong tampi tak ka nei a, Jerusalem-a om ngei dangte khempeuh sangin ka hauzaw hi.","ref":"1Kum 4:23"},"8":{"text":"Ka zawhsa kumpite’ sumkholna panin keima a dingin ngun le kham zong ka la hi. Ka lungnop nadingin la a sa ding lasiam numei le pasal tampi ka nei a, ka deih zahzah zong ka neizo hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:23-27; 2Khang 9:22-27; 1Kum 10:10,14-22"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin keima hun ma-in Jerusalem-ah a om ngei mite khempeuh sangin ka lianzaw a, ka pilna zong bei tuan lo hi.","ref":"1Khang 29:25"},"10":{"text":"Ka deih khempeuh ka nei a, ka ut bangbangin omin ka gamta hi. Ka sepna khempeuhah nuam ka sa hi; tua nopsakna pen ka nasepna hangin ka phattuamna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka sepsa na khempeuh, tua bangin haksapi a ka sepnate ka ngaihsut kik ciangin, na khempeuh a mawknapi ahihna, le leitungah bangmah phattuamna a om lohna ka phawk hi."},"12":{"text":"A hi-in ci lehang, kumpi khat in ama ma-a kumpipa’ hihsa teng mah a hih thei bek ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin pilna, haina, mawkna i cih bang ahi hiam, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banga ka ngaihsut ciangin, khuavak in khuamial a zawh bangin, pilna pen haina zawhna ahihlam ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilte in a pai nading mun mu thei a, mihaite in a pai nading mun mu thei lo hi. Ahi zongin a pil le a hai in a kibang khat a tuah tuak ding ka thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin, “Mihaite tungah a piang ding thute kei’ tungah zong hong piang ding ahih manin, ka pil mahmah manin bang phattuamna ngah ka hi hiam?” ka ci a, “Bangmah ngah kei ing, themkhat zong ngah kei ing,” ci-in ka kidawng hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihaite a kiphawkphawk loh mah bangin, mipilte zong kiphawkphawk tuan lo a, mailam hunah i vekpi-in hong kimangngilh lel ding ahi hi. A pil a hai-in, i vekpi-in i si ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hih leitung a sepna khempeuh in lungkhamna cih loh hong piaktheih dang bangmah om lo ahih manin, hih leitung a hinna pen kei a dingin a kimanna bangmah om lo hi. A mawknapi, huih hawmguak bang bek hi lel hi."},"18":{"text":"Keimah a hong laih ding pa tungah ka neih ka lam khempeuh ka nusiat ding thei ka hih manin, nakpitakin sem-a ka gimpih nate pen kei a dingin a phattuamna om lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Kei hong laih pa pil taleh hai taleh, ka pilna ka siamna khempeuh zanga ka sepsa nate luahin a ukpa hi ding hi. Hih pen a mawknapi taktak ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hih leitungah nakpitakin na ka sepna ka kisik hi."},"21":{"text":"Pilna, siamna, theihna siit loin na kisem a, themkhat zong a gimpih het lo mi khat a dingin nusiat ding hi zenzen hi. Hih thu a man het lo, a mawknapi taktak ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi khat in hih leitungah lunghimawhin thatang sanin na a sepna-ah bang phattuamna ngah ahi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"Sepna bawlna khempeuhah lungkhamna le sinkhamna bekbek hi a, zan nangawnin a ihmut mawhpih hi. Hih pen a mawknapi taktak ahi hi.","ref":"Job 5:7; 14:1"},"24":{"text":"Mihing khat in a nasepna thamanin an ne tui dawnin nuamsa-in a om sangin a hoihzaw bangmah dang om lo hi. Ahi zongin tua nangawn zong, Pasian’ hang ahihna ka phawk hi.","ref":"Thna 3:13; 5:18; 9:7; Isa 56:12; Luk 12:19; 1Kor 15:32"},"25":{"text":"Pasian kihel loin kua in an ne-in nuamsa thei ding ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Pasian in amah a lungdamsakte tungah pilna, theihna, le lungdamna pia a, ahi zongin a hehpihhuai mimawhte ahihleh a sep bek sisakin, amau’ thalawhsa khempeuh amah a lungdamsakte tungah a piaksak hi. Hih pen a mawknapi taktak, huihpi nungdelh bang bek ahi hi.","ref":"Job 32:8; Pau 2:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih leitungah a piang thu khempeuh, Pasian in ama pian’ hun dinga a sehsa hunin a piansak ahi hi.","title":"Na Khempeuh in Hun Nei Ciat"},"2":{"text":"Suah hun om a, sih hun om hi. Suan hun om a, bawhkhiat hun om hi."},"3":{"text":"Gawh hun om a, khoi hun om hi. Phel hun om a, lam hun om hi."},"4":{"text":"Kah hun om a, nuih hun om hi. Dah hun om a, laam hun om hi."},"5":{"text":"Lupkhawm hun om a, tuamlup hun om hi. Kikawi hun om a, kikhah hun om hi."},"6":{"text":"Zon’ hun om a, mansuah hun om hi. Kep hun om a, paihkhiat hun om hi."},"7":{"text":"Balkek hun om a, phop hun om hi. Daih hun om a, pau hun om hi."},"8":{"text":"It hun om a, muhdah hun om hi. Kido hun om a, kilem hun om hi."},"9":{"text":"Na a sem mipa in a sepsa khempeuh thamanin bang ngah ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Pasian in eite’ manlahpih dingin hong piak nasep ka thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in na khempeuh amau’ hun ciat tawh a kituak dingin a bawl hi. Amah in mailam thu theihnopna lungsim eite tungah hong guan a, ahi zongin ama sepnate a cing a theihzawhna ding hong guan lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mihingte in a nuntak laiteng a siam tawpun gamta-in lungdamin a om ding a thupi pen ahihna ka phawk hi."},"13":{"text":"Eite khempeuh in an ne tui dawnin i sepna thaman tawh lungdamin i om ding kilawm a, tua pen Pasian’ hong piak letsong ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian’ sep khempeuh a kip tawntung ding ahihna ka thei hi. I behlap theih ding om lo a, i paihkhiat ding zong om lo hi. Amah i zahtak theih nadingin Pasian in tua bang ding mahin a bawl ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A piang khat peuhpeuh pen a piang ngeisa mah na hi a, a piang lai ding khat peuhpeuh zong a piang ngeisa mah na hi lel hi. Pasian in ama hun hunin a piang ngeisa mah piangsakkik zelzel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua tham loin, hih leitungah gitlohna in thuman thutang a suankhiatna zong ka mu hi.","title":"Leitungah Thuman lohna"},"17":{"text":"Pasian in sepna bawlna le na khempeuh ama hun ding sehkhol khin ahih manin, midikte le migilote thu khen ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihingte pen ganhing bang lel ahihna uh a lahtel nadingin Pasian in mihingte ze-et hi, ci-in ka lungsimah ka ngaihsun hi."},"19":{"text":"A tawpna-ah ci lehang, mihingte le ganhingte in a tuah ding uh kibang a, ganhing mah bangin mihing zong a si ahi hi. Mihing le ganhing in a kibangin nuntakna hu nei a, mihing le ganhing nuntakna a kimanna bangmah om lo ahih manin, mihing pen ganhing sangin a hoihzawkna bangmah om tuan lo hi."},"20":{"text":"A nih tuakun mun khatah tung khawm ding uh a, leivui panin a piang uh ahih mah bangin leivui mah suakkik ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte’ kha vanah kahto-in ganhingte’ kha lei-ah lutsuk hi, cih a thei zong kuamah om lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mihingte in a sep thaman uh ne-in nuamsa-in a om ding uh a hoihpen ahihna ka phawk hi. Tua lo a hih theih ding uh bangmah dang om lo hi. I sih khit ciangin bang piang ding cih theihtheihna bangmah om lo hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin leitungah thuman loin a kigamtatnate khempeuh ka ngaihsun kik leuleu hi. Nenniamna a thuak mite kap uh a, ahi zongin kuamah in amaute hehnem lo uh hi. A nengniam mite thahat lua uh ahih manin kuamah in thuk ngam lo hi."},"2":{"text":"A hinglai mite sangin a si khinsa mite hamphazaw ka sa hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing a hong piang nai lo, hih leitung gitlohna teng a mu nai lote hamphazaw lai sawnsawn uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khatlekhat, hauhnop mana kidemna hangin nakpi taka na kisem ahihna ka mu hi. Hih zong a mawknapi hi a, huihpi nungdelh mah tawh kibang bek hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaite in na sem loin a khut zepin om uh a, a tawpna-ah gilkialin sihlawh uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nakpi takin na sem a, a mawknapi ahi ding, khut nih dim sangin lungsim nuamin khut khat dim neihna hoihzaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Nuntakna sungah a mawknapi ahi thudang khat ka mu leuleu hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat in tapa ahi a, sanggam ahi zongin nei lo napi-in, a tawntungin na semin a neihsa tawh lungkim hun nei thei lo hi. Kua a dingin gimpi-in na sem a, a ututin ta hoh lo ahi hiam? Hih zong a mawknapi mah, a dahhuai nuntakna khat ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khat sangin mi nih hoihzaw hi; amau’ sepna thaman a tamzaw ngah uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh khat cimawh leh a khat in huh a, mi khat guak pen cimawh zenzen leh a huh ding om lo ahih manin a dahhuai pha mahmah ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Khua a dam ciangin mi nih lumkhawm leh khua lum hi; khat guak bangci khualum theih ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat bek hileh zawhnop kisa a, nih pha leh kizo zo lo hi. Zang thum a kiheek khauhual bawhsat hak hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi’ thugen a sang thei nawn lo, teek leh hai a thuah kumpipa sangin zawng napi-in a pil tangval khat hoihzaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat pen thong panin suakta-in kumpi suak thei a, zawng napi-in ama gam sungah kumpi suak thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih leitungah mi khempeuh’ thu ka ngaihsun a, tua mite lak panin kumpipa’ za a luah ding khangno mi khat a omlam ka phawk hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa’ uk ding mite simzawh lohin tam a, ahi zongin amah a sih ciangin ama nasepna hangin a lungdam khat beek om lo hi. Hih pen a mawkna taktak, huihpi nungdelh bang bek ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinn-ah na pai ciangin limtakin kingaihsun in. A man le a man lo a khen thei lo mihaite’ biakpiaknate tawh a kibang piakna sangin thu ngai dingin biakinn-a paina hoihzaw hi.","title":"Thu Mawk Ciampak A Haihuaina"},"2":{"text":"Thu ngaihsun masa-in pau inla, Pasian’ tungah thu mawk ciampak kei in. Vantungah Pasian om a, leitungah nang om na hih manin na pau ding a kilawm zahval pau kei in."},"3":{"text":"Lunghimawh semsem lecin na mang sia semsem ding a, tam pau semsem lecin na haina kilang semsem ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah thu na ciam ciangin manlangin tungsak pah in. Amah in mihaite diksa lo hi. Na thuciamna bangin tungsak in.","ref":"La 66:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Na thuciamna bangin na tunsak kei ding le thu ciam vet kei zaw in."},"6":{"text":"Khialkha ing, ci-in Pasian’ siampipa’ mai-ah na gen ding kisam kha ding ahih manin na kampauna hangin khialkha kei in. Tua bangin gamta khial lecin nangma tungah Pasian heh ding a, na sepsa khempeuh hong suksiatsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mang tam man leeng a mawkna mah tam a, kam tam pau leeng zong a kituak mahin a mawkna thu mah kibehlap hi; bangbang ahi zongin Pasian zahtak lai veve in."},"8":{"text":"Kumpite in mizawngte gim ngahsakin, thuman thutangin na a kisep kei leh lamdang sa kei in. Uliante pen amau’ tunga uliante in en uh a, tuate’ tungah a ensawn a lianzaw khat omlai hi.","title":"Nuntakna A Mawkna"},"9":{"text":"Gam khat peuhpeuh in lo khawhna lamsang a lunghimawh kumpi khat kisam hi."},"10":{"text":"Sum deihna lungsim na neih leh lungkim hun cih na nei ngei kei ding hi. Na hauhnop hangin na deih khempeuh na ngah ngei kei ding hi. Hih pen a mawknapi ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hau semsem lecin na vak ding mi tam semsem a, a hau zaw hi’ng, ci-a na theih bek cih simloh bangmah phattuamna na ngah kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Na a sem mipa pen a nek ding nei taleh nei ta kei leh lungnuam takin ihmu thei a, a haute ahihleh lungnuam takin ihmu thei lo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A hoih het lo na khat hih leitungah ka mu hi: Mite amau’ lunggim nadingin hau uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Na a sep khialh manun a neihsa teng uh suplawh uh a, a tu a tate’ luah ding bangmah om nawn lo hi."},"15":{"text":"I nute’ sung panin bangmah nei loin guaktangin i suah mah bangin guaktang mahin i ciahkik hi. I sepsate i ciahpihkik theih bangmah om lo hi.","ref":"Job 1:21; La 49:17; 1Tim 6:7"},"16":{"text":"A dahhuai mahmah thu in: I suah hun lai-a mah bang teekteekin i ciahkik ding hi. A mawknapi ding a i sepna-ah bang phattuamna ngah ihi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"I nuntak sungteng lungzinna, dahna, lunghihmawhna, natna satna le hehna bek tawh hun bei lel hi."},"18":{"text":"Keimah in ka phawkkhiat thu in: Pasian in tomkha nuntak hih leitungah hong piak sungin, i sep thaman ne-in dawnin i om ding a hoihpen ahi hi. Hih pen mihingte’ thumong ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian in mi khat neihlelam guanin, a hauhna nuamtakin a neksak leh, amah lungdamin a sepna thaman ne-in a om ding hi. Tua nopsakna pen Pasian’ kiang pan ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasian in lungdamin omsak ahih manin a nuntak tomlam phawkin nei kha lo ding hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih leitung a mihingte tungah a man hetloin hong kibawlna ka phawk hi."},"2":{"text":"Pasian in mi khatpeuh tungah neihlelam, hauhna, le pahtawina pia-in, a deih khempeuh neisak napi-in, tua nate nuamtakin zangsak loin, midang khat in nopsaklawh laizang hi. Hih pen a mawknapi, a thuman het lo khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khat in ta zakhat nei-in kum saupi zong nungta thei kha ding hi. Bangzahin sauveipi a nungta ahi zongin leitungah nopsakna ngah loin, limtak a vuina a ngah kei leh, a sisa-a suak naungek hoihzaw lai hi."},"4":{"text":"A sisa-a suak naungek a kimanna om lo hi. Khuamial sungah suakin, khuamial sung mahah mangthangin kiphawk nawn lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Sun khuavak mukha loin, nuntakna bangci hiam, cih a theihkhak loh hangin tawlngakna a ngah hi buang hi."},"6":{"text":"Nuntakna-ah nopsakna a ngah lo mipa kum tulnih a hing zongin, a tawpna-ah a sisa-a suak naungek mah tawh a tunna mun kibang lel hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihingte’ nasepna pen a nektawm ding bek a ngaihsutna hi lo napi-in, a khamkhop ngahzo tuan lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mihai pa sangin mipil pa a hamphat zawkna bang om tuan ahi hiam? Mihai pa in nuntakna ding zia a theih hangin bang phatuam tuan ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Na dangdang deihthuah ngitngetna sangin i neihsa teng tawh lungkimna hoihzaw hi. Hih zong a mawknapi, huihpi nungdelh mah tawh a kibang bek ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"A piang thu khempeuh, a tuaci mahin tangtawnga kisehsa hi a, mi khat in amah sangin a thahatzaw mi khat a nial zawh lohna thu i vekpi-in i thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Sauvei kinial lehang a mawkna hi semsem a, a phattuamna om lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Niliim bangin a pai hanhan, a mawknapi hih nuntak tom sungah mihing a’ ding a hoihpen kua in thei ding ahi hiam? Ama sih khit ciangin leitungah bang piang ding cih kua in gen thei ahi hiam?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A manpha paknamtui sangin minpha hoihzaw a, i suah ni sangin i sih ni hoihzaw hi.","title":"Pilna A Thupina","ref":"Pau 22:1"},"2":{"text":"Pawisimna sangin sigalna hoihzaw hi. Sih ding bek a ngak ahihna mihing khempeuh in a phawk ding uh kilawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Nuihna sangin dahna hoihzaw hi; na mai hong gumsak zahin na thu theihna hong khangsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Mipilte dahna lakah omtual a, mihaite nopna lakah omtual hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaite in pahtawina la hong sak sangin mipilte’ hong taina hoihzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihaite’ nuihna pen meikuang sunga selkeu kikhul a puak zaizai tawh kibang a, khiatna nei lo, a mawknapi ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mipil khat in midangte a khem ciangin mihai bangin a gamta ahi hi. Sumgolh lakna in a lapa’ gamtat hoihna siasak hi."},"8":{"text":"Thu khatpeuh a kipatna sangin a tawpna hoihzaw a, kiphatsakna sangin lungduaina hoihzaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Heh pahpah kei in; hehna a haihuai ahi hi.","ref":"James 1:19"},"10":{"text":"“Bang hangin nidang lai-in hih sangin hoihzaw tham ahi hiam?” ci-in dong kei in. Tua bangte pil thudotna hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Pilna pen hauhna zahin hoih a, mihingte a dingin phattuamna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Sum in hong lungmuansak bangin pilna in zong hong lungmuangsak hi. Pilna a manphatna, a pilte a nuntaksak theihna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian’ sepsate ngaihsun dih in. Pasian in a kawi-a a bawlsate kua in mamsakkik thei ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Nopna na ngah laitakin lungdam in; haksatna na tuah ciangin hih thu ngaihsun in: Lungdamna le lungkhamna hong piapa pen Pasian hi a, mai lamah bang piang ding cih kuamah in thei lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka nuntakna a mawknapi hi a, ahi zongin ka nuntak sungin thu khempeuh ka thei hi. Mi khat hoih napi-in si a, mi khat siahuai napi-in a khansau hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hoihlua kei inla, lah sia lua kei in. Bang hangin nang kisiasak tawm ding na hi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Gilo lua, hau lua kei in. Bang hangin khansih laizang ding na hi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"A nih tuakin lenkip in. Pasian na zahtak nakleh khat peuhpeuh na zuihna-ah na maa vang ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuapi a uk mihing sawm sangin pilna in mi khat hatsak zaw hi."},"20":{"text":"A manin a gamta, a khial ngei het lo, leitungah mi khat zong om het lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi’ gen khempeuh thudon kei in. Na nasempa’ hong samsiatna na zakha ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nang zong midang na samsiat zelzelna teltakin na kithei hi."},"23":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh ka pilna tawh ka ze-et a, pil ding ka hahkat hangin kei’ batzawh ding hi lo hi.","title":"Pilna Zonna"},"24":{"text":"Mihing nuntakna kua in theikhia zo ding ahi hiam? Eite a dingin thuk lua a, telhak lua hi."},"25":{"text":"Keimah in pilna siamna ka theih nading, pilna mu-in thupiangte a hang ka theih nadingin nakpitakin hanciamin ka lungsim ka pia a, haina a hoih lohna le a haihuaina ka theikhia hi."},"26":{"text":"Sihna sangin numei a siahuai zawkna ka theikhia hi. Ama hong piak itna in thang bangin hong tepcip a, ama hong kawina khut in sikkhau bangin hong hencip hi. Pasian’ deihna bangin a gamtate in tua bang numei pelhthei a, ahi zongin a mawh nuamte a thangah a awk uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Thugen siampa in hih bangin ci hi: Thu ka kan ciangin, a banbanin thu ka phawkkhia hi."},"28":{"text":"A thudang ka zonzon hangin bangmah ka muzo nawnkei hi. Pasal tulkhat sung pan khat bang bek a pil a omkhak theihna, ahi zongin numei lakah a pil cih bang a om lohna keimah in ka phawkkhia hi."},"29":{"text":"Keima theihkhiat thu in: Pasian in eite a thuman dingin hong bawl hinapi-in, eite in paulap tuamtuam zongin, i kikai-awksak hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipilte bek in na a khiatna taktak theithei uh hi. Pilna in mipilte maitaisak a, a hehmai a beisak hi."},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa’ hong sawl bangin gamta inla, Pasian’ tungah thu mawk ciampak kei in.","title":"Kumpipa’ Thu Mang In"},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in a ut peuhpeuh hih thei ahih manin ama kiang panin paikhia in; ama lungkim lohna hih teitei kei in."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa aana neihna tawh gamta hi. Ama gen bangin gamta in; kuamah in amah nial zo lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama thu a mangte in haksatna tuakkha lo ding hi. Mipilte in a gamtatna zia le a hun hoih thei uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Na khatpeuh i hih ding ciangin a kilawm hun, le a ngeina man om a, ahi zongin eite in bangmah i thei kei hi.","title":"Pasian’ Sepna Ziate Mihing’ Theihzawh Hilo"},"7":{"text":"A hong piang ding thu i thei kei a, a hong gen thei zong kuamah om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"A sih ding a pelhthei, a sih ding hun a phiatthei kuamah om lo hi. Gal a om ciangin gallauna a pelhthei, siatna sungah a lut ciangin a pengthei kuamah om lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitung a gamtatnate ka ngaihsut ciangin hih thute ka mukhia hi. Mi khat in midang tungah vangliatna nei-in, a uk sung mite a gimsak gawp hun a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote si-in kivui a, a siat gamtatna khuasunga om mite mah in han panin a ciah ciangun amah a phat veve-na uh ka mu hi."},"11":{"text":"A mawhte gim kipia pahpah lo ahih manin mihingte in khialh ding haksa sa lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Mawhnei khat in zavei dong siatna bawl napi-in a khansau veve hi. Ahi zongin “Pasian a zahtakte a dingin thu khempeuh nuam ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Migilote a dingin thu nuam lo ding a, amaute in Pasian zahtak lo uh ahih manin a nuntak hun uh niliim bangin beipak ding a, khansih ding uh hi,” kici hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih thugenna a mawknapi ahi hi. Leitung a thupiangte ngaihsun dih in: Khat veivei midikte in migilote’ gimthuak dingteng thuak zawsop a, migilote in midikte’ thaman ngah dingteng ngah zawsop uh hi. Hih thu pen a haivai, a mawkna taktak ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mihing in hih leitungah nuam a sak theih ding adang om lo ahih manin an ne tui dawnin nuamsa-in a om ding bek ahi hi. Pasian in hih leitungah nuntak a piak sungteng a sep thaman a ngah theih ding hih bek om hi."},"16":{"text":"Pil ding hahkatin, leitung a thupiangte ka theih ciangin sun le zanin ihmu lo liangin i om hangin,"},"17":{"text":"Pasian’ nasepna i theihzawh lohna ka phawk hi. Mihingte in bangzahin i hahkat hangin kitheikhia zo lo hi. Mipilte in thei a kisak hangun bangmah thei lo uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nakpi takin sauveipi ngaihsunin ka phawk thu in: Mipilte le midikte’ gamtatna a vekpi-in Pasian in uk a, Pasian’ itna hang hizaw hiam, a muhdahna hang hizaw hiam kuamah in thei lo hi. Amau’ mailam thu khempeuh a mawkna ahi hi.","title":"Nuntakna A Kikim lohna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh a thumong kibang a, midikte le migilote, mihoihte le misiate, mi siangte le mi ninte, biakna piate le a pia lote, a thutawpna uh a vekpi-in kibang lel hi. Mawhnei pa sangin mihoih pa hamphazaw tuan lo a, thuciamna a bawl lopa sangin a bawl pa hamphazaw tuan lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khempeuh’ thumong kibang kim a, hih pen leitung a thupiang lakah a man het lo khat ahi hi. Mihingte a nuntak laiteng gitlohna le a mawkna thu tawh a lungsim uh kidim a, theihkholh lohin mihingte sipak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin a hing laite a’ ding lametna om thei a, a sisa humpinelkai sangin a hinglai ui hoihzaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A hing laite in a si ding ahihlam uh thei a, a sisate in bangmah thei nawn lo uh hi. A sisate in thaman bangmah nei nawn lo uh a, amaute kiphawkkha nawn lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Amau a dingin itna, muhdahna, hanciamna cihte om nawn lo a, leitung a om nate khat beek theikha kik nawn lo ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"An ne-in lungdam inla, zu ne-in lungnuam in. Na gamtatna peuhpeuh Pasian in hoih a sa hi."},"8":{"text":"Na puante siangsakin paaksak tawntung inla, na sam gumsak ngei kei in."},"9":{"text":"Pasian in hih leitungah nang a hong piak, tomkha sung na nuntak laiteng, na it na zi tawh a nuam theithei-in om in. Leitung lungkhamna sungah na lawhtak, tua bek mah hi kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na mai-ah sep ding a om khempeuh, na tha neihzah tawh sem in. Bang hang hiam cih leh na zuat ding sihna gam sungah nasepna le thungaihsutna, pilna le theihna cihte om lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih leitungah ka phawk dang thu khat in: A taihat mite in tai kidemna-ah zo tawntung lo a, galhang thahatte in gal zo tawntung lo hi. A pilte in an a kham ngah tawntung lo a, a pilte hau tawntung lo hi. Hih theih siamna a neite milian suak tawntung lo hi. Mi khempeuh tungah kamsiatna vive tung hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing in ama hun ding thei ngei lo hi. Thangah a awk vasate le ngen-ah a awk ngasate tawh i kibang hi. Lamet loh hun laitak keekin hunsia sungah mihingte i tung hi."},"13":{"text":"Thudang khat zong ka mukhia hi: Hih leitungah pilna a hoihna gentehna a hoih khat om hi.","title":"Thahatna Sangin Pilna Hoihzaw"},"14":{"text":"Mi tawmno bek a omna khua khat om a, a vanglian kumpi khat in tua khua a sim hi. Amah in tua khua umcihin a khuasung luhgawp dingin a ngaihsun hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khua sungah a zawng mipil khat om a, ama pilna tawh tua khua a huzo hi. Ahi zongin kuamah in tua mizawng pa phawkkha lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Thahatna sangin pilna hoihzaw ka ci hi; ahi zongin kuamah in mizawngte a pil dingin ngaihsun lo a, mizawngte’ thugen kuamah in thudonin nei lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihai hon lakah gam ukpa in thu a gen lualua sangin mipil pa in damtakin a gen hiathiat ngaihhuai zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Galhiamte sangin pilna hoihzaw a, ahi zongin khialhna khat in a hoih tampi susia thei hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A sisa thote in paknamtui bung sungah a om paknamtui uihsak thei a, haitatna themno khat in pilna lianpen susia thei hi.","title":"Haina Thaman"},"2":{"text":"Mipilte a manin a gamtat ding a ngeina hi a, mihaite a sia-in a gamtat ding a ngeina ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihaite lampi-ah a paikawm nangawnin hai tat uh a, a haina uh mi khempeuh theisak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang tungah gam ukpa a heh leh na nasep za taisan pah kei in. Dai tak-a om hithiatna in khialhna lianpi maisak thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih leitungah a thuman lo gam ukte’ piansak ka muhte:"},"6":{"text":"Mihaite, zalianpi kipia a, mihaute kiniamkoih suk hi."},"7":{"text":"Sakol tungah silate tuang a, miliante, sila bangin a khe-un pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Gum a tote gum sung mahah kia ding a, mi’ phung a phelsakte gul in tu ding hi.","ref":"La 7:15; Pau 26:27"},"9":{"text":"Suang a tokhiate suang mah in liamsak ding a, sing a ekte sing ehna mahah liam ding hi."},"10":{"text":"I hei mawlnapi-in i tat kei leh nakpitakin sat kul a, ngaihsut masak ding pilhuai zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Gul khimthei napi i khim kei leh a kimanna om tuan lo hi; gul in hong tu veve ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipilte’ kampauna in pahtawina ngahsak a, mihaite’ kampauna in amau mah siasak hi."},"13":{"text":"Thugen a kipat ciangun bangtumlo teng tawh kipan pah malam uh a, gitloh vai teng tawh a thugen a khum lel uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihaite in thu gengenin ciakciak uh hi. Mailam a thupiang ding kuamah in thei lo a, a sih khit-a thupiang ding a hong gen thei om lo hi."},"15":{"text":"A inn zuatna ding lampi a thei lo mihai luate bek, a inn lam zonna-in gim ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"A kumpipa mi’ cih bangbangin gamta lel a, zankhuavak-in zune makai a a nei, gam khat peuhpeuh in lungkhamna thuak hi."},"17":{"text":"A kumpipa in lungsim khentatna nei thei a, a makaite in annek tuidawn a hun thei a, amau ki-uk thei-in zu a kham lo makai a nei, gam khat peuhpeuh a hampha gam ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Thadah lua-in a inn vang nangawn a hu nuam lo mipa, a inn keh ding a, a inn nangawn in puklawh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"An in lung damsak a, zu in lung nuamsak hi. Sum in ahihleh na khempeuh a kicingsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Na lungsim nangawnah kumpipa gensia kei in. Kuama zak lohna mun na lupna tung nangawnah mihaute samsia kei in. Thopi in na thugen teng na puakkha ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sumbawl nadingin na sumte zang in. Ni khat ni peuh teh a meet na ngah ding hi.","title":"Mipilte’ Gamtatzia"},"2":{"text":"Na sumbuk vante mun sagih-ah ahi a, mun giat-ah ahi zongin khen kawikawi in. Hih leitungah bang thusia hong piang ding cih na theikhol kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Meii sungah tui a tamluat ciangin leitungah guahin hong zusuk a, singkung khatpeuh a puk ciangin a pukna san sanah om paisuak hi."},"4":{"text":"Huih le guah ngakin khuahun hoih dong a ngak mi in khaici tuh ngei lo ding a, an zong la ngei lo ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nupi gai khat sungah nuntakna thak bangci kipat hiam, ci-in na theihzawh loh mah bangin na khempeuh a bawl Pasian’ nasepna na theizo ngei kei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingsang a kipan khaici tuh inla, nitak dong mateng khawl kei in. A vekpi-in a po kim ding ahi a, a khat sia-in, a khat a po ding ahi zongin na theihkholh bangmah om lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuavak hoih mahmah a, i mit in nitaang a muh ciangin nuam mahmah hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat sauveipi a nuntak le a nuntak sung nuamtakin om tahen. Sauveipi tak a hing zongin a sih khit hun a sauvei zawkna phawk tahen. Mailamah a lamethuai bangmah a om kei hi."},"9":{"text":"Khangnote aw, na khangnona uh nuamsa unla, na khangno lai-un lungdam un. Na hihnop peuhpeuh uh hih unla, na ut bangbangun gamta un. Ahi zongin na gamtatna uh tawh kizui-in Pasian in thu hong khen ding phawk gige un.","title":"Khangnote Tungah Thuhilhna"},"10":{"text":"Note kilunggimsak kei unla, na pumpi uh gentheisak kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh na khangno hunsung uh sauvei lo ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na lungkham hun ding a hong tun ma, “Nuntak nuamsa kei ing,” na cih ma hun, na khangno lai-in nang hong Piangsak pa phawk in."},"2":{"text":"Lungkham hun i cih in: Nang a dingin nitaang, khataang, aksi taangte a dialh hun, meiipi kai a then’ nawn loh hun,"},"3":{"text":"na muan na suan a thahat na khut, na baan, na khete, a thaneem hun, an hai nadingin na hatang tawmlua ta-in na mit maangin, limtakin khua na muh theih nawn loh hun,"},"4":{"text":"khuasung gamlumnate na bil in za thei nawn loin, ansukna gingte na zak theih phat nawn loh hun, la kisate za thei nawn loin vasa ham nangawn in hong phawnzawh nawn loh hun,"},"5":{"text":"keen sangte-ah pai ngam nawn loin, lam pai ding a haksat hun, na samte hong kangin, na khangno thahatna beita-in na tha a kiam hun ding ahi hi. Eite in a tawntung inn ding a zuan ding ihi a, khuasung lampi-ah kahna awging kiza ding hi."},"6":{"text":"I ngun meivak khaina a khau kitatin, i kham meivak kia-in kitam ding a, i tuikhaina khau kitatin, i tuikhaina beel kitam ding hi."},"7":{"text":"I pumpi, lei suakkik ding a, i nuntakna a hong pia Pasian’ kiangah i kha ciahkik ta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Thugen Siampa in, “A kimanna a om lo, a mawknapi, na khempeuh a mawknapi ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Thugen Siampa, mipil ahih banah, amah in ama theihteng mite tungah a hilh hi. Amah in paunakte limtakin sin a, a man ahihna thu hoihtakin entel hi.","title":"Mihing’ Tavuan Bulpi"},"10":{"text":"Thugen Siampa in a zaknophuai kammal khawm a, ama gelh kammalte a man taktak ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mipilte’ thugente pen tuucingte in tuu hawlna-in a zat ciangkhut hiam tawh kibang hi. Tua thute pen eite khempeuh tuucin bangin a hong Cing Pasian’ piak ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka ta aw, na phawk ding thudang khat omlai hi. Lai gelhin a bu-a bawlna in bei hun nei thei lo a, lai tam sin luatna in pumpi gimsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih thute khempeuh banah gen ding thu khat bek om hi. Mihing hong kipiansakna a thu bulpi pen in: Pasian zahtakna le a thupiakte manna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"A pha hitaleh a sia hitaleh a simthamin i hih simte nangawn i hihna khempeuhah Pasian in thu hong khen ding hi."}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Solomon La","shortname":"Sol","abbr":[],"desc":"Solomon La pen zawl la a kikaikhawm hi a, a tamzaw-ah tangval in nungak a phuah, nungak in zong tangval a phuah vive ahi hi. Solomon La a min a kipiakna pen Hebru pau-in a kigelhna-ah Solomon La ci-in a kigelhna hang ahi hi. Hih late pen Pasian leh a mite a kizopna dan a kiphuahna hi, ci-in Jew mite in khia uh a, Khristiante in ahih leh Khrih leh pawlpi a kizopna dan a kiphuahna hi, ci-in a khia uh hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon’ la ngaih pente:","ref":"1Kum 4:32"},"2":{"text":"Na muk tawh nong tawp a, na hong itna leenggahzu sangin khumzaw hi.","title":"Dawng Khatna Nungak"},"3":{"text":"Na omna khempeuh nam vuauvuau a, na min kizaza a, nungak khempeuh in nang hong ngai hi."},"4":{"text":"Hong kai inla zawltai ni. Ka kumpi hong hi inla, na inn-ah hong ciahpih in. Nang tawh om leeng i lung dam hi; leenggahzu ne-in nuamsa ni. Nang kong ngaihkhak tuahpha ing."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem nungakte aw, ka vom hangin ngaihbaang ing. Savun puanbuk bangin ang hiuhiau ing a, Solomon’ puankhaite tawh kei ka kibang hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka vom manin hong en neu kei un. Nisa ka thuakna hang ahi hi. Ka ute in kei hong gawtbawl uh a, lo hong kuansaksak uh a, ka pumpi ka don man kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngaihno aw, hong gen dih in. Koi lai-ah na tuu cing ding a, sunin koi lai-ah khawl ding na hi hiam? Bang hangin tuucing dangte lakah nang hong zong kawikawi masa se ding ka hi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Nungak khempeuh lakah a ngaihbaang pen nungak aw, a mun thei lo na hi hiam? Tuuhonte zui-in na keelte hong khah inla, tuucingpa’ puanbuk gei-ah hong cing in.","title":"Tangval"},"9":{"text":"Ngaihno aw, Faro’ sakoltal in sakolpite a delh bangin nang hong kidelh hi."},"10":{"text":"Na biang tuakah a kaisuk na samphekte ngaihbaang a, suangmanpha bangin na liangko tungah kinga hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma a dingin kham khainiang bawlin na kizepna ding zong ngun tawh bawl ni."},"12":{"text":"Ka kumpipa a lupna tungah a om laitakin ka paknamtui hong kizel hi.","title":"Nungak"},"13":{"text":"Ka ang-ah ka ngaihno hong lup laitakin myrrh paknamtui bangin namtui viauviau hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka ngaihno pen Engedi gam leenggui lo-ah a palh lihleh pak hoihte tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"Ngaihno aw, na mel hoih a, na mit zong ngaihbaang hi.","title":"Tangval"},"16":{"text":"Ngaihno ngingei aw, na etlawm a, na ngaihhuai hi.","title":"Nungak"},"17":{"text":"I lupna mun lopa tung hi ding a, taamtak kungte i inn khuam hi-in, taaksan hiangte i inn tungdap hi ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei pen Sharon gam sunga a om gamlak pak, mualkuam sunga a om unok pak bang ka hi lel hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua bang hi lo a, ka ngaihno pen numei khempeuh lak panin ling lak a a om unok pak tawh kibang hi.","title":"Tangval"},"3":{"text":"Ka ngaihno tangval dang tawh teh lehang gamlak singkung lak a a om epel kung tawh kibang hi. Ama liimah ka tu nuam a, a gahte lim ka sa hi.","title":"Nungak"},"4":{"text":"Annekna phualah hong paipih inla, itna mai tawh hong en in."},"5":{"text":"Lungzuang, duangvul ka hih manin leenggahkeu tawh hong vak inla, epel gah tawh hong thadimsak in."},"6":{"text":"A veilam baan hong khamsak a, a taklam khutin kei hong kawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem nungakte aw, ko’ kingaihna nong suknawi loh nadingun sakhi le sanang tawh kei tungah hong kiciam un."},"8":{"text":"Ka ngaihno’ awging ka za hi. Mualtung tawnin hong tai a, mualte kantanin kei hong zuan hi.","title":"Dawng Nihna Nungak"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngaihno sanang tawh kibang a, sakhitalno tawh zong a kibang hi. Ka inn pualam uhah ding a, tawlet-ah hong dak zialin kawmvang panin hong en giau hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaihno in ka kiangah thu hong gen a, “Hong pai in, ngaihno aw, hong zui in, itluat aw.","title":"Tangval"},"11":{"text":"Phalbi veng ta a, guah zu nawn lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Gam sung tengah paakte palh a, lasak hun tung ta hi. Gam sung tengah vakhu hamte kiza ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Theite zong min ta a, leenggah pak gim namtui zong kiza ta hi. Hong pai in, ngaihno aw, hong zui in, itluat aw."},"14":{"text":"Suangheeng kawma vasa bangin nang na bu niloh hi. A ngaihbaang na mai hong musak inla, a lungzuanhuai na awging hong zasak in."},"15":{"text":"“I leengguite pak ta ahih manin ngiano hon in a suksiat ma-in tua ngiano honte man ni,” hong ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka ngaihno keima a’ hi; kei zong ama a’ hi’ng. Amah in unok paakte lakah a tuu cing a,","title":"Nungak"},"17":{"text":"nitak huih vot mateng nitak nitum mateng a cing hi. Sanang bangin mualtung a sakhitalno bangin itluat aw, hong paikik in."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zan sialin ka lup kawmin, ka ngaihno ka lungngaingai a, amah ka zon hangin ka mu zo kei hi."},"2":{"text":"Tho-in khuasung tengah ka vak a, kongzing kawm tengah ka pai kawikawi a, ka ngaihno ka zong a, ka zonzon hangin ka mu zo kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuasung cingin a pai kawikawite ka tuak a, “Ka ngaihno na mu uh hiam?” ci-in ka dong hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuasung cingte tawh ka kikhen khit phetin ka ngaihno tawh ka kimu hi. Amah kawi-in ka lencip a, ka pianna ka nu’ inndei sung, ka nu’ inn dong ka tunpih mateng ka khah kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem nungakte aw, ko’ kingaihna nong suknawi loh nadingun sakhi le sanang tawh kei tungah hong kiciam un."},"6":{"text":"Myrrh paknamtui le saledi pak namtui a kihel tawh a kibang, sumbuk a paknamtui om khempeuh a kihal khin a khu tawh a kibang, gamlak a hong khuto henhan bang ahi hiam?","title":"Dawng Thumna Nungak"},"7":{"text":"En un, Solomon kumpi luai-in hong kizawng! Israel gam sunga om galkap hoihpen galkap sawmguk in amah cing hi."},"8":{"text":"A vekpi-in namsau zat a siam vive hi a, galdo a siam vive hi khin uh hi. A vekpi-in namsau kuah kim uh a, mi’ hihkhak ding a cing uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Sing hoihpen tawh a kibawl luai-in Kumpi Solomon hong kizawng hi."},"10":{"text":"A luai khuamte, ngun tawh kizut a, a tungah kham tawh a kizem puan a kilam hi. A tut nadingin puansan kibawl a, a sungah savun kidap hi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem nungakte aw, hong pai unla, Kumpi Solomon en dih ve un. A zi neih ni, a lungdam ni-a, a nu in amah a khuksak Kumpi lukhu hong khu hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itluat aw, na ngaihbaang a, na lu khuhna puan vang panin a ngaihbaang na mit hong tee kelkel hi. Gilead mual tunga keelhon diang leklek bangin na samphekte phe velvel hi.","title":"Tangval"},"2":{"text":"Na ha pak singsengte zong a mul a kimet khin phet, a kisawpsiang tuute tawh kibang hi. Na ha khat zong tok lo a, a vekpi-in kituak dimdiam hi."},"3":{"text":"Na mukte puansan tawh kibang a, na kampau ngaihnop-huai hi. Na lu khuhna puan sung panin na kho hong san lihleh hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng pen galhangte’ zat lum tangzang tulkhat a kikhai zeizaina David’ tausang tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Na nawite unok pak lakah a ta khawm helhel sanang nih tawh ahi a, a ta khawm hialhial sakhi peeng tawh ahi zongin a kibang hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingsang huih vot a nun’ mateng, zingsang khuavak hong tun mateng, myrrh paknamtui a omna mualtungah omsuakin, saledi paknamtui lakah ka bual ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngaihno aw, na ngaihbaang mahmah a, kawkbaanna ding na nei kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka lawm ngaih aw, Lebanon Mual-ah hong pai inla, Lebanon Mual panin kei hong zui in. Humpinelkaite le kamkeite a tenna, Amana Mual dawn panin hong taisuk inla, Senir Mual le Hermon Mual panin hong paisuk in."},"9":{"text":"Itluat ka lawm ngaih aw, na mit hah in ka lung hong kuai a, na khi awh in ka lungsim hong zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Itluat ka lawm ngaih aw, nang tawh kingaih nuam mahmah hi. Na itna leenggahzu sangin khumzaw a, na paknamtui paknamtui dang khempeuh sangin namtui zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Lawm aw, na muk, khuaizu bangin khum a, na leii, bawngnawi le khuaizu bang hi. Na puante Lebanon Mual tunga paknamtui namkim a nam hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka lawmnu, ka naunu, a ki-umcip huan hi a, a kinei tuam tuinak ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua huan sungah singkungte hoihtakin khang a, mang kawlsing cinna huan tawh kibang hi. Singgah limci pente tua lai-ah gah a, henna leh nard sing namtuite tua lai-ah a po hi."},"14":{"text":"Nard sing le saffron sing, thalsing le sinnamon kung, a namtui a gah namkim kung po a, myrrh le aloes, a namtui namkim om hi."},"15":{"text":"Lebanon Mual tung panin tui hong luangsuk a, ciktui luangte, luitui luangte, tua huan sungah a tungsuk hi."},"16":{"text":"Saklam huih aw, hong nungsuk inla, khanglam huih aw, hong nungto in. Ka huan sungteng hong namtuisak un. Ka ngaihno, ka huanah hong paisak unla, a gah limci pente hong nesak un.","title":"Nungak"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itluat ka lawmnu aw, ka huansung hong tungzo ing. Ka paknamtuite ka kaikhawm hi. Ka khuaizu le ka khuailuzu ka ne a, ka leenggahzu le ka bawngnawite ka dawn hi. Nungak le tangval aw, na lungkim piikpeek dongun ne-in dawnin nuamsa un.","title":"Nungakte"},"2":{"text":"Ka lup hangin ka lungsim ihmu lo a, ka ngaihno in ka kong hong kiuh ka za hi. Itluat ngaihno ka lungtup aw, kei hong tumsak in. Ka lu tungah daingo kia a, meiizun in ka sam kawtsak hi.","title":"Tangval"},"3":{"text":"Ka puante suah khinzo ing. Ka puante silhkik ding ka hi hiam? Ka khete sil khinzo ing; ninsakkik ding ka hi hiam?","title":"Nungak"},"4":{"text":"Ka ngaihno in kongkhak hong len khin napi hong taisan kik hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka ngaihno tumsak dingin ka kithawi a, ka khutte myrrh paknamtui tawh ka zut a, ka khutmete myrrh paknamtui ka nuh a, kong a hong dingin a honna ka len hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka ngaihno a lutsak dingin kong ka hon a, amah na taikhia khinta hi. Amah a taikhiat manin ka dah lua a, amah ka zon hangin ka mu kei a, amah ka sap hangin hong dawng lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuasung a cing mite tawh ka kituak a, kei hong satin hong liamsak uh a, kulhzang a a kileh den khuacingte in ka puantungsilh hawkkhia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kong thum hi, Jerusalem nungakte aw, ka ngaihno na muh uhleh lungzuangin ka sih dekna na gensak un."},"9":{"text":"Nungak lak a a hoihpen aw, na ngaihno a bangci hiam, hong gen dih in. Tua bangin kong gen liang ding uh bangzahtakin lamdang ahi hiam?","title":"Nungakte"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaihno a melhoih a, a thahat hi. Mi tul sawm lakah tehpih ding dang om lo hi.","title":"Nungak"},"11":{"text":"A sam sau-in kil thiuhtheuh a, a sam hoihin vom dikdek a, kham sangin zong deihhuai zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"A mittangte ahihleh tuisiang phuan lakah a kisil siang kiuhkeuh, luitui luang gei-a a om vahuite tawh kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"A biangte pen paknamtui a dimin a kithun thawl san kiuhkeuh tawh a kibang hi. A mukte pen myrrh paknamtui tawh a kidim unok pak tawh kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"A khutte etlawmin hi linlian a, suangmanpha a kiphut zungbuhte a bulh hi. A pumpi pen suangmanpha a kiphut dimdiam saiha pak tawh kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"A khete pen kham citak a kiphuh dimdiamna suangngo khuamte tawh kibang a, ama duang pen Lebanon mual sang, taamtak kung hoih bangin thupi suak mahmah hi."},"16":{"text":"A kampaute khum zungzung a, a vekin, deih loh ding khat zong om lo hi. Ka ngaihno, hih bang teng hi, Jerusalem nungakte aw."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nungak lak a hoihpen nu aw, na ngaihno, koi-ah pai hiam? Na ngaihno koi lam pai hiam? Amah hong zonpih nung.","title":"Nungakte"},"2":{"text":"Ka ngaihno, paknamtui kung a pona, a huan sungah pai hi. A huan sungah a tuu cing a, unok paakte a lo hi.","title":"Nungak"},"3":{"text":"Ka ngaihno kei a’ hi a, kei zong ama a’ hi’ng. Amah in unok pak lakah a tuute gamtasak hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngaihno aw, Jerusalem khuapi bangin na etlawm mahmah a, Tirzah khuapi bangin na hoih mahmah a, vantung aksi bangin na deihhuai hi.","title":"Dawng Ngana Tangval"},"5":{"text":"Keima lam hong nga kei in. Na mai in hong leng lua hi. Gilead mual tunga keelhon diang leklek bangin na samphekte phe velvel hi."},"6":{"text":"Na hate zong, a kisil khin phet tuuhon bangin pak singseng hi. A tok khat zong om lo a, a vekpi-in kituak dimdiam hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lu khuhna puan sung panin na kho hong san lihleh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpi-zi sawmguk, kumpi zineu sawmgiat, simzawh lohin nungak tampi om kha ding a,"},"9":{"text":"ahi zongin khat bek ka ngai a, amah pen vahui bangin it-huai hi. Amah pen a nu’ tanu neihsun hi a, a nu’ ta it pen khat ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Zing khuavak tawh a kibang hih nungak kua ahi hiam? Amah melhoih mahmah a, nitaang, khataang, a bang hi."},"11":{"text":"Kuam sunga om singkungnote a en ding, leengguite a pak nai hiam a en ding, mang kawlsing a pak nai hiam a en dingin singno huanah ka paisuk hi."},"12":{"text":"Galdo dingin a kipan sakol hawlpa a lin’ bangin nang kong ngaihna hangin ka lingling hi."},"13":{"text":"Hong ciahkik in, hong ciahkik in, Shulam numei aw. Nang kong muh theih nadingun hong ciahkik in, hong ciahkik in. Shulam nungak, khanglui lai-a a lamte bangin bang hangin hong mu nuam na hi uh hiam?","title":"Nungak"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi mel a pua a ngaihbaang nungak aw, na khete le na khedap kilawm mahmah! Na phei le na tanzumte sing suih siamte’ suih bang hiuhiau!","title":"Tangval"},"2":{"text":"Na kalkawm pen leenggahzu lim tawh a kilawi lo hai bangin uk kiukeu hi. Na kawng pen unok pak tawh a ki-um buhlom hen tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Na nawite pen a takhawm helhel sakhi peeng, a omkhawm hialhial sanang nih tawh kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng, saiha tausang tawh kibang hi. Na mitte pen Heshbon khuapi kulh gei-a om tuilite tawh kibang hi. Na nak pen Damaskas khuapi lam a nga Lebanon tausang bangin hoih hiuhiau hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lutang pen Karmel Mual bangin kitawito a, na samphekte san hiuhiau a, a etlawmna in kumpipa’ mit la vangvang hi."},"6":{"text":"Itluat aw na ngaihbaang a, na mel kong muh nuam zungzung hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuum kung bangin na etlawm a, na nawite pen, nisuh gah a bawk pha mahmah tawh a kibang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuum kung tungah kahto-in a gah ka lo ding hi. Na nawite kei a dingin leenggah bawk tawh kibang a, na gimnam epel min bangin namtui hi."},"9":{"text":"Na kam, leenggahzu bangin khum zungzung hi. Ka ngaihno tungah leenggahzu khum luang hen la, a muk a ha tawk kim hen.","title":"Nungak"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaihno a’ ka hi a, amah in kei hong deih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngaihno aw, gamlakah paikhia-in leenggui lo-ah va giak ni."},"12":{"text":"Zingsangin tho baihin leengguite a sel nai hiam, leengguite a pak nai hiam, mang kawlsing kungte a pak nai hiam, i en ding hi. Tua lai munah kong itna letsong ka hong pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua lai-ah zawl-ai kung a namtui gim na za ding a, singgah lim namcin i kong gei-ah a om hi. Ngaihno aw, a gah a lui le a thak nang a dingin na duhduh kong koihsak hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka nu’ sung pana piang ka sanggampa hi lecin kei ka ut hi. Tua hileh, lamkalah hong tuak taleng zong kong tawptawp ding a, kuamah in phamawh sa lo ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Keima pianna ka nu’ inndei sungah nang kong paipih ding a, tua lai-ah nong kawi ding hi. Tua lai-ah leenggahzu lim, mang kawlsing tui, kong tulh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A veilam khut hong khamsak a, a taklam khutin hong kawi hi."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem nungakte aw, ko’ kingaihna nong suknawi loh nadingun kei tungah hong kiciam un."},"5":{"text":"Gamlak panin a lawmpa tawh khut kilensa-in a hong paikhia kua ahi hiam? Nangmah na pianna mun, na nu in hong neihna mun, epel kung nuai panin nang kong phong hi.","title":"Nungak"},"6":{"text":"Kei simloh kuamah ngai kei inla, kei simloh kuamah kawi kei in. Itna zong sihna zahin thahat a, ngaihna zong sihna zahin khauh hi. Itna, mei bangin kuangkhia a, meikuang lianpen a suak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tui tampi nangawn tawh kisumit zo lo a, tui sungah i phumcip hangin mitzo tuan lo hi. Mi khat in a neihsa sum khempeuh tawh itna a lei dingin hong kithawi leh kinuihsan lel ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Sanggam numeino khat ka nei uh a, a nawite neu mahmah hi. Tangval khat in hong hel zenzen leh ka sanggamnu uh bangci huh ding ka hi uh hiam?","title":"Nungak’ Sanggamte"},"9":{"text":"Amah khua umna kulh hileh, ngun kibawl tausang tawh ka hu ding uh a, amah kulhkongpi hileh, taamtak singpekte tawh ka dal ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kei, khuakulh ka hi a, ka nawite, a tausang ahi hi. Limtakin kei hong kihutna ka ngaihno in thei ding hi.","title":"Nungak"},"11":{"text":"Baalhamon a kici munah Solomon in leenggui lo khat a nei hi. Amah in tua lo a kho dingin losapte sawl a, a lo-a piangte’ man dingin losapte khat in ngun dangka tulkhat ciat a piak ding uh ahi hi.","title":"Tangval"},"12":{"text":"Keimah in keima aituam leenggui lo khat ka nei hi. Solomon aw, na ngun dangka tulkhat la inla, lokhote’ tungah amau’ tanh ding a zah nih pia in."},"13":{"text":"Huan sunga om ka ngaihno aw, ka lawmte in hong ngai dide ahih manin nangma aw zong, hong gingsak dih in."},"14":{"text":"Ka ngaihno aw, sanang bangin, paknamtui kung a pona mun mualtung a om sakhitalno bangin kei kiangah hong pai in.","title":"Nungak"}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isaiah","shortname":"Isa","abbr":[],"desc":"Isaiah Laibu pen B.C. 750 khit lam pawlin Jerusalem khua-ah a teng kamsang lianpa' min tamin a kiphuak laibu ahi hi. Hih laibu sungah a om thute khen thum kisuah thei a, tuate in: A lian 1—39: Leitaw lam kumpi gam ahi Judah pen a gam veng a vanglian Assiria gam in a su dingin a kithawi hun sung ahi hi. Isaiah' muhna panin Judah gam mite-a' dingin hih bang lauhuaina a omna thu pen Assiria a thahatna hang bek hiloin, Judah gammite' mawhna, Pasian' thu a man'lohna leh Pasian a muan'lohna hang uh ahi hi, ci-in mu hi. Tua ahih manin Isaiah in mipite leh a makaite thuman thutangin a omna ding uh leh, Pasian' thu a zuih kei uh leh siatna a tuahna ding uh thuhilhna-in kampau leh a gamtatna tawh a kitel takin a lak hi. Tua banah, leitung bupah gal kilemna a omna ding thu leh David' suan sung panin kumpi hoih mahmah khat a hong pian'khiatna ding thu zong a gen hi. A lian 40—55: Judah mite tampi tak salin Babylon khua-ah omin, lungkhamin lametna neizo nawnloin a om laitak uh hun sung thu ahi hi. Pasian in ama mite suaktasak ding a, nuntakna thak a kipan dingin amaute' khua Jerusalem-ah ciahpih ding hi, ci-in kamsangpa in a gen hi. Hih sungtengah a kilim gen thu khat in: Pasian pen khang tawntung-a uk Topa hi a, ama mite-a' dingin a geelna sungah amau Israel mite' hangin thupha a ngah ding minam khempeuh tungah tavuan a neihna uh kihel hi, cihna thu ahi hi. “Topa' Nasempa” ci-in a kigelhna mun pen Thuciam Lui sungah a kithei pha mahmah mun khat ahi hi. A lian 56—66: Hih sungah a om thute pen Jerusalem khua a tungkik khin, Pasian in amau minamte tungah a thuciamnasate tungsak takpi ding hi, ci-in hanthot ding a kisam mite tungah a kigelh ahi hi. Thuman thutangin gamtatna ding, Sabbath tan'na ding, Pasian biakna gan gawhna ding, leh thunget tawh a kisai thute zong a lunghihmawh thu ahi hi. A kilim theihkim mahmah 61:1-2 sunga om thute pen Jesuh in nasep a kipat ding ciangin amah nasem dingin a kisawlna thu a genna-in bulphuhin a nei hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah gam kumpi ahi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, le Hezekiah-te’ hun lai-in Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Judah gam le Jerusalem khua tawh kisai a maangmuhnate:","title":"A Khial Minam","ref":"2Kum 15:1-7; 15:32-16:20; 18:1-20:21; 2Khang 26:1-32:33"},"2":{"text":"Vantungte aw, na za un; leitung aw, na ngai in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in thu hong gen khinzo a, “Ka pattahsa ka tate in kei hong lehdo uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bawng in amah a nei pa thei a, la in zong a topa’ an piakna mun thei buang hi. Ahih hangin Israel in bangmah thei lo a, keima mite in thei thei lo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ah, a khial minam, mawhna in a nencip mite, siatna a bawlte’ suanlekhakte, a gamtatsia tapate! Amaute in Topa nusia khin uh a, amaute in Israel-te’ Siangtho Pasian simmawh khin uh hi. Amaute in lam khial khin taktak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hangin note hong kisat theih nadingin lehdo teitei na hi uh hiam? Israel aw, na lutang khempeuh liamma dim a, na lungsim le na ngaihsutna gim mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Khenuai a kipan luzang dong nangawnin a cidamna mun om lo a, sanim gawpnate, meimapite, le siluang liammate a om hi. Tuate pen a nai kisal lo, kitun lo, sathau tawh zong kinomsak lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na gam uh khing a, na khuapite uh mei tawh kihal hi. Na muh tangpi mahun gamdang mite in na gam uh hong laksakin na khempeuh susia gawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi bek omlai a, leenggui lo-a buk, tangmai lo sunga om hampheng bangin kuama don lohin kinusia a, a ki-umcip khuapi bangin kinusia hi."},"9":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in eite tawmno khat a nungta-in hong siit hikeileh, eite pen Sodom khua bang khinin Gomorrah khua i bang khinta ding hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24; Rom 9:29"},"10":{"text":"Sodom a uk mangte aw, Topa ’ thu na za un! No Gomorrah mite aw, i Pasian’ hihna na ngai un!","title":"Kisik Takpi Ding Kutna"},"11":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Note’ biakpiakna a tampite pen kei’ tungah bang hi leltak ahi hiam? Tuutalte le ganhing thaute’ sathau tawh meihal biaknate ka kham ta hi. Bawngtalte, tuunote, le keelte’ si tawh kei ka lungkim kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei’ mai-ah a kilaak dingin na hong pai uh ciangin hih bangin ka huangsung na tuatcil gawpna uh kua’n hong deih ding ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Bangmahin a kimang lo piaknate hong paipih nawn kei un. Paknamtui halna ka kih hi. Khadet ni, Sabbath ni, le thupi takin na kikhopnate uh mawhna tawh kidim ahih manin ke’n ka thuakzo kei hi."},"14":{"text":"Note’ Khadet nite le na pawite uh ka mudah hi. Tuate pen kei a dingin vangikpi khat suakkhin a, tuate khempeuh ka puakna-in ka gim hi.","ref":"Amos 5:21-22"},"15":{"text":"“Thungenin na khutte uh nong zaak uh ciangin note kong en kei ding a, thu tampi na nget uh hangin ke’n ka ngai tuan kei ding hi. Pa nei lote hu unla, meigong numei panpih un,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Tu-in hong pai unla, thu kikumkhawm ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hih thu gen khinzo hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"A thutak, thutang tawh a kidim ngeisa khuapi, bangci-a a paktat numei tawh kibang ta ahi hiam? Ama sungah thumanna om ngei napi-in tu-in mi thatte bek a om ta hi.","title":"Jerusalem Tungah Thukhenna le A Hotkhiatna"},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi aw, nguntang na bang ngei a, tu-in ahihleh ngun-ek na suakta hi. Leenggahzu limci na bang ngei a, tu-in ahihleh tui mawkmawk na bangta hi."},"23":{"text":"Na uliante, mi lehdote hi a, gutate tawh a kikhawlte ahi hi. Mi khempeuh in sumgolh le letsong a deih uh hi. Amaute in pa nei lote panpih lo uh a, meigongnu’ thu amaute in sang lo uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin, Topa, Vanglian Topa , Israel-te’ Vanglian Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: “Ah, ka lang ahi note’ tungah ka hehna kong khahkhia ding a, ka gal ahi note tungah keimah in kong thuk ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note tungah na kong sem ding a, meikhukah haltui bangin na saam-ek teng uh tuikhia sakin, na kihelpih na nin khempeuh uh ka lakhia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A masa-a bangin na thukhente, a kipat cil-a bangin na upate ka koihkik ding hi. Tua khit ciangin nang pen thuman khuapi, thutak khuapi, hong kici ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa thutang ahih manin Jerusalem khuapi honkhia ding a, a sungah a teng a kisik mi khempeuh zong a honkhia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin a lehdo mite le a khial mite kisusia khawmin Topa a nusiate pen kibeimangsak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tawsaw kungte na biakna hangun note na maizum ding uh a, biakna huan na bawlna hangun zahhuai-in na mai uh san ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen a teh a vul tawsaw kung le tui a ngah lo huan tawh na kibang ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"A thahat mipa pen patlom tawh kibang ding a, ama nasepna pen mei-ek suak ding hi. Kuamah in phelhzo loin amau tegel kangtum khawm ding uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah gam le Jerusalem tawh kisai thu Amoz’ tapa Isaiah’ muhna hih bang ahi hi:","title":"’ Ukkimna Nuam (Mik 4:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Nidang ciangin Topa ’ inn a omna mual pen mual liante lakah a sangpenin kikipsak ding a, mual neute tungah kisangsak ding hi. Amaute’ mawhna maisak kei in."},"10":{"text":"Topa kihtakna le a lian ama minthanna panin suanghawm sungah lut unla, leihawm sungah bu un.","ref":"Mang 6:15; 2The 1:9"},"11":{"text":"Mite’ kiliatsakna pen kiniam koih ding a, mihingte’ kiphatsakna pen kiniamkhiat ding hi. Amaute leltak banga simtham ding ahi hiam?"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa, Vanglian Topa in Jerusalem khua le Judah gam panin nuntakna le luhinna, nuntakna an khempeuh le nuntakna tui khempeuh;","title":"Judah le Jerusalem tungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"mi vanglian pa le galkap pa, thukhen pa le kamsang pa, aisan pa le upa pa,"},"3":{"text":"mi sawmnga a ukpa le zalian a nei pa, thu lamlak pa le mitphial siampa, le bum siamte a lakhia hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute’ ulian dingin naupangte ka bawl ding a, naungekte in amaute uk ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mite khatlekhat, mi khempeuh in a lawmte ciat, mi khempeuh in a vengte ciat, hihgawp ding uh hi. Khangnote pen uhamte tungah, mi ginalote pen miliante tungah kiphasak ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi khat in ama pa inn sungah a sanggampa lenin, “Nang in puan na nei hi; nang, kote’ makai pa nong hi ding a, hih a sialomtangte pen nangma khutsung hi ding hi,” a cih ciangin amah in,"},"7":{"text":"“Bangmah hihzo kei ning. Mite a makai-in nong bawl kei ding hi,” ci-in a genkhia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute khempeuh le amau’ gamtatnate in Topa langpangin amah dem uh ahih manin Jerusalem khua kipukin Judah gam kia hi."},"9":{"text":"Amau’ maiput in amau’ langah teci pang hi. Sodom bangin amaute a langtangin gamta uh a, amaute in im lo uh hi. Amaute in gimna ngah ta hen! Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in amau’ tung mahah siatna kitun uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute tungah thu hoih ding hi, ci-in thuman mite kiangah hih thu gen un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in amau’ gamtat hoih thaman ngah ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilo in gimna ngah ta hen! Midang tungah a gitloh gamtatna tawh kizui-in ama tungah kithukkik ding ahih manin ama tungah thu sia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima mite ahihleh naupangte in bawlsia uh a, numeite in zong uk uh hi. Ka mite aw, na makaite un note lam hong lakkhial a, note’ lampi zuih pen hong siasak hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in thupang dingin ama panmun hong la a, ama mite’ thu a khen dingin a ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa pen upate le ama mite’ uliante tawh thukhen dingin kipan a, “Leenggui lo a netumte, note na hi uh a, mizawngte’ na a kisutte note’ inn sungah om hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka mite sucipin mizawngte na gawina uh bang na cihnopna uh a hiam?” Vanglian Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Jerusalem numeite kiphasakin ngawng doksa-in lam pai uh a, kiphatsakna tawh a mit uh hei pampamin hi tuihtuihin lam pai uh a, a khe uh gingsak sualsual ahih ciangun","title":"Jerusalem Numeite tungah Thukhenna"},"17":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem numeite’ lutang meima sakin Topa in amau’ lutang kolhsak ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in khebuh hoihte, lutuam le khade lim tawh a kibang kizepnate;"},"19":{"text":"bilbah tualte, taaute, le mai sitnate;"},"20":{"text":"lukhute, banbulhte, kawngtente, paknamtui bungte, le a kivom aite;"},"21":{"text":"min gelhna zungbuhte le nakbuhte;"},"22":{"text":"pawipuante, puanza neute, puanpite le khutkhai ipte;"},"23":{"text":"puanza neu vang siseihte, saihadial puansungsilhte, dialkhipte, le kikhuhna puante lakhia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Paknamtui tangin uihna, kawnggak tangin khauhualpi, limtak a kizem sam tangin lu kolhna, puan hoih tangin puanhampi, melhoihna tangin maizumna hun hong tung ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na mite, namsau tawh si ding uh a, a vanglian na mite, gal sungah kisia ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Khuapi kongpi tau-in thum ding hi. Khuapi, gamkhing suak ding a, a guaktanga om nupi leilakah a tucip tawh kibang ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin nupi sagih in papi khat neikhawm ding uh a, “Kote in komau’ an ciat ne-in, komau’ puan ciat mah ka silh ding uh hi. Kote pen, nangma zi cih min bek hong puasak in; ka minsiatna teng uh hong hum in,” ci ding uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Topa ’ bulsel pen melhoihin minthang ding a, leitung panin a piang gahte pen, a suakta lai Israel mite’ kiphatsakna le minthanna hi ding hi.","title":"Jerusalem’ Mailam Minthanna"},"3":{"text":"Topa in thukhenna le meihalna tawh Zion mite’ mawhna teng siangsakin, Jerusalem khuasung panin mi thahna teng a beisak ciangin Zion-ah a omlai mi, Jerusalem-ah khang tawntungin a om dingin a kiciamtehsa mite khempeuh, a siangtho kici ding hi.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zion Mual tung, tua lai-a kikhawm mi khempeuh tungah, sunin meii sungah, zanin meikuang khu tawh Topa hong kilang ding a, Topa ’ minthanna vang in khuapi hu ding hi.","ref":"Pai 13:21; 24:16"},"6":{"text":"Tua minthanna vang pen sun ciangin nisa a liah ding le huihpi guahpi panin bukna le belhna zong hi ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lawm it pa’ tangin a leenggui lo a itna la ke’n hong sa ning: Ka lawm it pa in leitang a hoih mahmahna mualtung khatah leenggui lo khat a nei hi.","title":"Leenggui Thugentehna"},"2":{"text":"Amah in lei to-in a suangte paikhia a, leenggui hoihte a suan hi. A laizangah tausang khat lam a, tua lo sungah leenggahsukna khuk khat a to hi. Amah in leenggah hoih a hong gah ding lamen a, ahih hangin gam leenggah hong gah mawk hi.","ref":"Mat 21:33; Mrk 12:1; Luk 20:9"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in, Jerusalem khua-ah a tengte le Judah mite aw, kei le ka leenggui lo kikalah thu nong khenna ding uh ka hong thum hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka leenggui lo a dingin ka hih nai loh ka hih ding a kilawm bang omlai ahi hiam? Leenggah hoih gah ding ka lamet laitakin bang hangin gam leenggah hong gah mawk ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Tu-in, ka leenggui lo tungah ka hih ding thu note tungah kong gen ding hi. Kipuah loin, kikho lo ding a, tua lo sungah lingkung le lingte a khang ding hi. Ama tungah meiite in zong guah a zuksak loh nadingin thu ka pia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa ’ leenggui lo pen Israel mite hi a, Judah mite pen lungdamna tawh a suan kungte ahi hi. Amah in thutang lamen a, ahih hangin sisan luanna om hi. Thumanna lamen a, ahih hangin kahna om hi."},"8":{"text":"Leitang tungah amau guak a teng ding dong zahin midangte a dingin mun khempeuh a bei matengin inn khatlekhat, lo khatlekhat gawmin a la thuah tawntung mite in gimna ngah tahen.","title":"Migilote tunga Kizasak Gimnate"},"9":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in ka zakna-ah hih bangin kiciam a, “A mantakin inn tampi tak hawmsuak ding a, a lian a hoih innte-ah a teng om lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leenggah lo eka sawm in phelpi khat dim bek gah ding a, khaici beem khat in an seu khat bek piangsak ding hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Zingsang tungin tho-in, khamtheihzu delhin, leenggahzu in amaute a satsak pialpual matengin nitakin a tutkho mite in gimna ngah ta hen!"},"12":{"text":"Amaute in a pawi sung uhah laiza lasakna le harp lasakna, khuang, tamngai, le leenggahzu, tampi a nei uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in Topa ’ sepnate don lo uh a, a khut tawh a bawlte zong mu lo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hi a, thu theih lohna hangin ka mite sal suak uh hi. A miliante uh gilkialin si dek uh a, a mihonte uh dangtakin keu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Leinuai in a duhna khangsakin bangmah tawh a kiteh thei lo zahin a kam ka beba a, Jerusalem’ hoihna teng, a mipite, a mihonte, ama sunga a lungdam mite, a nawmvalh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi khempeuh a niamin kikoih suk hi. A kiphasak mite kiniamkhiat suk hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin thutang sepna tawh Vanglian Topa in a liatna hong kilangsak a, a Siangtho Pasian in a mite a thukhenna tawh ama sianthona hong kilangsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin tuunote in amau’ tatna gamlak mun bangin tua khua sungah lopa ne ding uh a, a thau ganhingte le keelnote a siasa khuapi sungah gamta ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in, “I muh theih nadingin amah manlang sakin, ama nasep khawlsak ni. Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa’ deihna i theih theih nadingin naisakin tungsak ni!” ci-in ganhing kaih bangin khauzen tawh mawhna kai-in, khauhualpi tawh khialhna kai uh ahih manin gimna ngah ta uh hen.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"A phate sia ci-in, a siate pha ci a, khuavak dingin khuamial koihin, khuamial dingin khuavak koih a, a khum dingin a kha koihin, a kha dingin a khum a koihte in gimna ngah tahen."},"21":{"text":"Amau’ mitah pil kisa a, amau’ muhna-ah siam a kisate in gimna ngah ta hen!"},"22":{"text":"Leenggahzu tampi a dawnte, khamtheih zunek a hatte,"},"23":{"text":"mimawhte sumgolh tawh khah a, midikte a mawhsakte in gimna ngah ta hen!"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mei in buhkung keute kangtum a, meikuang sungah lopa keute a kattum bangin amaute’ zung pen muatgawp ding a, amaute’ pakpalhte leivui bangin vanah leengto ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Vanglian Topa ’ thu nialin Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa’ thu a simmawh uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa ’ hehna ama mite tungah hong khangin, a khut zanin amaute vatgawp a, mualte a kiling hi. Amaute’ luanghawmte kongzing lampite-ah nin bangin a om hi. Hih bang teng hangin zong a hehna damzo nai loin ama khut kizanlai hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in a gamlapi-a om minam khat a sapna-in lim khat lak a, leimong panin hong pai nadingin a sam hi. Manlang takin tua mite hong pai pah hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua a hong pai mite kuamah gim lo uh a, kuamah tuk lo uh hi. Kuamah lusu lo a, kuamah ihmu lo uh hi. Dialkaih khat zong kol lo a, khedap khau khat zong kitat lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Amau’ thaltangte hiam a, a thal khempeuh uh a kikeeksa ahi hi. Amau’ sakolte’ khecinte meisuang bangin sak a, a leengpeite uh pingpei bangin manlang hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute’ kikona pen humpinelkai hawk bang a, humpinelkai khanglaite bangin amaute a hawk uh hi. Amaute humhamin a sa nek ding uh man uh a, amaute in puakhia-in kuamah in honkhia zo lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin amaute in tuipi ging bangin Israel ngik ding uh hi. Mi khatpeuh in hih gam sung en leh khuamial le lungzinna bek om a, meiite in khua a mialsak hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Uzziah a sih kumin, a sang mahmah, a lian kumpi tokhom tungah Topa a tu ka mu hi. Ama kumpi puanpi pen biakinn sungteng a dim hi.","title":"Isaiah’ Maangmuhna le Amah A Kisapna","ref":"2Kum 15:7; 2Khang 26:23"},"2":{"text":"Ama kiimah serafim van mite a ding uh hi. Tuate in kha guk ciat nei uh hi; nih tawh a mai liahin, nih tawh a khe tuamin, nih tawh a leeng uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute khatlekhat kisamin: “Vanglian Topa , siangtho, siangtho, siangtho; leitung khempeuh ama minthanna tawh kidim,” ci-in awng uh hi.","ref":"Mang 4:8"},"4":{"text":"Tua kikona aw in biakinn kongkhak khuam bulpite kilingsak a, inn sungteng meikhu tawh a kidim hi.","ref":"Mang 15:8"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Gim ngah pa hi ta ing! Bang hang hiam cih leh a mawknapi ka hi hi; ka kama ka thugen khempeuh a mawkna vive hi a, a thugen khempeuh uh mawhna le nitna ahi mite lakah ka tengkha hi. Vanglian Topa , Kumpipa ka mukha khinta hi,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin serafim van mite khat, biakna tau panin taiteh tawh a teh mei-am khat a khutah tawi-in keima kiangah hong leeng hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in ka muk hong bi a, “En in, hih in na muk sukha zo hi; na mawhna beita a, na khialhna kimaisak zo hi,” hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin, “Kua sawl ding a, eite a dingin kua va pai ding ahi hiam?” Topa’ cihna aw ka za hi. Tua ciangin ke’n, “Hih lai-ah kei om ing! Kei hong sawl in,” ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Pai inla, hih mite tungah, ‘Zaza napi tel lo; mumu napi thei lo,’ va ci in."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in a mit uh tawh a muh loh nading, a bil uh tawh a zak loh nading, a lungsim uh tawh thu a theihtel loh nading, amaute kihei-in damna a ngah loh nadingun hih mite’ lungsim mawlsak inla, amau’ bil uh ngongsak inla, a mit uh va sisak in,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Mat 13:14-15; Mrk 4:12; Luk 8:10; Joh 12:40; Sawl 28:26-27"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “ Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam?” ka ci hi. Amah in, “Khuapi-ah a teng kuamah om loin hawm suakin, innte-ah kuamah om loin, leitang pen gamkhing suak kiuhkeuhin,"},"12":{"text":"Topa in gamlapi-ah mite khinkhia-in, leitungah a kinusia mun tampi a om dong, hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi sawm ah khat bang a omlai tei hangin, taak kung le tawsaw kungte a kiphuk khit ciangin a bulsum a omlaite mei tawh a kihalkik bangin amaute zong kisusia ding hi,” hong ci hi. (A bulsum pen Pasian’ mite a kipatthakna ding lahna lim ahi hi.)"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uzziah’ tapa Jotham, Jotham’ tapa Ahaz ahi Judah kumpipa’ hun laitakin, Syria kumpipa Rezin le Remaliah’ tapa Pekah ahi Israel kumpipa, Jerusalem khuapi a sim dingin kuanto uh a, ahih hangin amaute in zo zo lo uh hi.","title":"Ahaz tungah Isaiah’ Thupuak Masak","ref":"2Kum 16:5; 2Khang 28:5-6"},"2":{"text":"“Syria-te pen Efraim mite tawh kikop,” ci-in David’ innkuante tungah a kigen ciangin, huih in gamlak a singte a mut bangin amah le a mihingte’ lungsim kiling hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in Isaiah tungah, “Ahaz tawh kimu dingin Puansawppa’ nasepna phual zuatna lampi kiangah a om, bual tungnung tuilakna mongah nang le na tapa Shearjashub pai-in"},"4":{"text":"ama tungah, ‘Kidawm inla, om khinkhian in. Lau kei in.
