Amaute in Edom mite le Moab mite zogawp ding uh a, Ammon mite in amau’ thu mang ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in ama huihsa nungsakin Nail gunpi le Eufratis gunpi tuite kangsak ding a, mi khempeuh in nuamtakin a kantan zawh ding lui neu sagih bek sitlai ding hi.","ref":"Mang 16:12"},"16":{"text":"Egypt gam panin Israel-te hong paitoh ciangin amau a dingin lam lianpi khat a om mah bangin, ama mi a omlaite a dingin Assiria gam panin zong lam lianpi khat om ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni ciangin mite in, “ Topa aw, kei tungah na heh hangin na hehna damta a, kei hong hehnem na hih manin nang tungah lungdamna kong ko ding hi.","title":"Lungdam Kohna La"},"2":{"text":"En in, Pasian pen kei a hong honkhia pa ahi hi. Amah ka muang ding a, ka lau kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian in thahatna le vangliatna hong pia a, amah pen kei a hong honkhia pa ahi hi,” a cih hun uh hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Pai 15:2; La 118:14"},"3":{"text":"Tui siangtho in a dangtakte a lungdamsak mah bangin, Pasian’ hotkhiatna in a mite lungdamsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ni khat ni ciangin mite in, “ Topa ’ tungah lungdam ko unla, ama hong huh ding ngen un. Minam khempeuh lakah ama septe kitheisak unla, ama min kiliansak hi, ci-in gen un."},"5":{"text":"Amah in minthang takin sem khin ahih manin Topa ’ tungah phatna la sa unla, leitung khempeuhah hih thu kitheisak un."},"6":{"text":"Zion-a teng mite aw, nomau’ lakah Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa lianin om ahih manin lungdamin awng unla, lungdamin la sa un,” a cih hun uh hong tung ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz’ tapa Isaiah in Babylon siatna ding tawh kisai a thumuhnate:","title":"Babylon tawh Kisai Thu"},"2":{"text":"Mualkolh tungah lim khat lakto unla, galkapte tungah nakpitakin kiko un. Miliante’ kongpi-ah amaute va pai-in a sim nadingun amaute khut vaan un."},"3":{"text":"Keimah in ka tuamkoihsa mite thu pia khinin, ka hehna thu a semkhia dingin kiphatsakna tawh a lungdam ka mi thahatte ka sam khin hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, mihonpi lungdam bangin mualtungte ah gamlumna! Ngai un, minamte’ kumpi gamte kikhawmin a gamlumna! Vanglian Topa in galdo dingin mihon khat kaikhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Leitung buppi a susia dingin Topa le ama hehna galhiamte gamlapi van mong panin hong pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa ’ ni hong naita ahih manin nakpitakin kap un. Vanglianpa’ kiang panin suksiatna hong tung ta ding hi.","ref":"Joel 1:15"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin khut khempeuh zaw-in, mi khempeuh’ lungsim tuisuak ding a, amaute lungkia ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in gim mahmahna le nat velvalna thuak ding uh a, numei nausuak ding bangin na sa ding uh hi. Amaute khatlekhat lamdang sakna tawh ki-en ding uh a, a maitangte un gimna mel pua ding hi."},"9":{"text":"En un, leitung gamkhing suaksakin, leitung mawhneite a susia dingin hehna le sinsona tawh nasia takin Topa ’ ni hong tung ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh vantung aksite le amau’ aksi honpite in khuavak piakhia lo ding hi. Ni a suahtung a kipan mial ding a, kha in zong khuavak taangkhiasak lo ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 32:7; Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Mang 6:12-13; 8:12"},"11":{"text":"Leitung mite a tatsiatna hangun gim ka pia ding a, migilote a mawhna hangun gim ka thuaksak ding hi. Mi kihisakte’ kiphatsakna beisiang sakin, a kisatheite’ kiliatsakna ka niamkhiat ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte pen kham hoihte sangin a hoihzaw, minam pen Ofir gam khamte sangin a hoihzaw-in ka bawl ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka sinso ni-in Vanglian Topa ka hehna hangin vantung lausakin ka lingsak ding a, ama omna panin leitung kisingkhia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A kidelh sanang le a cing om lo tuu bangin mi khempeuh amau’ mite’ lam ciatah kihei-in, amau’ gam ciatah tai ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A kimu mi peuhmah kithat ding a, a kiman mi peuhmah namsau tawh si ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amau’ muhna mahah a naungekte uh leilak kidengawpna ding hi. Amaute’ inn kiluhin, a zite uh kibuansak ding hi."},"17":{"text":"En un, ngun le khamte tawh a lungkim lo Media mite pen amaute a sim dingin ka hanthawn hi."},"18":{"text":"Amau’ thalte in tangvalte that ding hi. Amaute in gil sung pana piang naungekte hehpih lo ding uh hi. Amaute’ mit in naupangte khasiat lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khaldea mite’ hoihna, a kiphatsakpih, kumpi gam a minthang bel Babylon khuapi pen Pasian in Sodom le Gomorrah a siatsak lai hun bang ding hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24"},"20":{"text":"Khang tawntungin tua lai-ah kuamah teng lo ding a, tua lai-ah kuamah om ngei nawn lo ding hi. Arabia mite kuamah in tua lai-ah a puanbuk lam lo ding a, tuucingte kuamah in tua lai-ah a tuute lumsak lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua munah gamsate lum ding uh a, tua mun a innte pen a hawk ganhingte tawh kidim ding hi. Tua munah vasa-kalaoh golpite tengin, tua munah keeldawite laam ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 34:14; Zefa 2:14; Mang 18:2"},"22":{"text":"Mihaute’ inn sungah ngiate, kumpi inn nuam sungah se-alte a ham ding uh hi. Babylon khuapi a siat ding hun hong naita a, a ni sawt nawn lo ding hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Jakob hehpihin Israel teelkik ding a, amaute pen a gam uhah koihkik ding hi. Khual mite in amaute pawlin Jakob innkuan bel ding uh hi.","title":"Babylon Kumpipa A Kizahkona"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite in amaute manin amau’ gamah ciahpih ding uh a, Topa’ gam sungah amaute pen sila numei sila pasal dingin nei ding uh hi. Amaute a man ngei mite pen tu-in amaute in lehmat ding uh a, amaute a nengniam ngei mite tungah tu-in ukna nei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A haksa nasep hong kisepsakna, gimna le lungkhamna panin Topa in note tungah tawldamna hong piak ciangin,"},"4":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa tungah hih zahkona kam na zang ding uh a, “Kumpi gilo pa pukta a, amah in kuamah nengniamzo nawn lo ding!"},"5":{"text":"Tawlnga loin mihingte satna-in a kizang, hehna tawh minamte ukin nakpitakin a bawlsia, migilote’ ciangkhut le gam ukte’ kumpi ciangkhut, Topa in kuaitan khinta hi.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Leitung khempeuh tawlnga-in gamdai takin omta uh a, amaute inla sa-in kiko uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Taksing kungte na tungah lungdamin, Lebanon mual taamtak singkungte in, ‘Nang hong kiniam koih khit a kipanin kote a phuk dingin kuamah hong pai nawn kei,’ ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Nang na paisuk ciangin a hong dawntuah dingin Leinuai-a misite kihanthawn a, nangmah a hong hopih dingin leitungah a lian ngei misi uliante kipusuak sak hi. A minamte’ kumpite khempeuh amau’ kumpi tokhom panin hong ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong hopihin, ‘Nang zong kote mah bangin na thahat kei hi. Kote mah na bangta hi,’ hong ci ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma harp lasakna awte, nangma liatna khempeuh Leinuai-ah kipaipih suk hi. Thante pen nangma delhphah hi a, thante pen nangma silh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Nang Khuavak’ ta, Zingsol, Babylon kumpipa aw, vantung panin nang bangci kiat na hi hiam? Minamte a niam koihpa ahi nangmah leilak dongah hong bangci kiphukpai ahi hiam?","ref":"Mang 8:10; 9:1"},"13":{"text":"Nang in na lungsim sungah, ‘Vantungah ka kahto ding hi. A sangna mun, Pasian’ aksite’ tung pekah ka kumpi tokhom ka koih ding a, leilu lam peka kikhopna mualtungah ka tu ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Meiite’ tung pekah ka kahto ding a, Sang Pen pa bangin ka kibawl ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin nang pen Leinuai thuk penna Leihawm sungah hong kikoih suk ding hi.","ref":"Mat 11:23; Luk 10:15"},"16":{"text":"“Nangmah hong mu mite in nang hong en gega-in, nangma thu lungngai dedu ding uh a, ‘Hih mipa pen leitung a lingsak pa, kumpi gamte a lokgawp pa,"},"17":{"text":"leitung pen sehnel gam suaksakin, khuapite a susiapa, thong sungah a kikhum mite inn-ah a ciahsak lopa hih pa hi lo ahi hiam?’ hong ci ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Minam dangte’ kumpite khempeuh amau hankhuk sung ciat uhah a minthangin lum uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahih hangin nang pen namsau tawh a kithat misi a uihte, Suanghawmpi sunga a paisukte, khe tawh a kisikcip si luanghawmte bangin, na hankhuk pualamah hong kilawnkhia hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah in na gam susia-in, nangma mihingte that khin na hih manin, nang pen amaute tawh hong kivui khawm lo ding hi. Siatna a bawlpa’ suanlekhakte’ min kilo ngei nawn kei ta hen!"},"21":{"text":"Amaute khangto loin leitung a neih loh nading le leitung maitang teng khuapite tawh a kidimsak loh nadingin amau’ pate’ mawhna hangin a tate’ kithahna ding piang ta hen,” na ci ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in, “Amaute’ langkhatah ka pang ding a, Babylon min le a omlai mite’ tate le suanlekhakte ka susia ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Saphulipte’ om nadingin tua khuapi bawlin, bualtui ka suaksak ding a, siatna munphiah tawh ka phiatkhia siang ding hi,” Vanglian Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 47:1-15; Jer 50:1-51:64"},"24":{"text":"Vanglian Topa kiciam khin a, “Ka geelsa bangin piang ding a, ka ngimnasa bangin kip ding hi.","title":"Assiria Kisusia Ding"},"25":{"text":"Keimah in ka gam sungah Assiria mite ka susia ding a, ka mual tungah ka sikcip ding hi. Ka mite’ tung panin Assiria-te’ hakkol amaute’ liangko panin Assiria-te’ vangik kiakhia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Hih ngimna pen leitung buppi a dingin a kingim ahi hi. Hih ka khut pen minam khempeuh gimpiak nadingin a kizan ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in ngim khin ahih manin kua in phiatzo ding ahi hiam? Ama khut kizan khin ahih manin kua in kaiton kikzo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 10:5-34; Nah 1:1-3:19; Zefa 2:13-15"},"28":{"text":"Kumpi Ahaz a sih kumin thu hong tung a,","title":"Filistia tawh kisai Thu","ref":"2Kum 16:20; 2Khang 28:27"},"29":{"text":"“Filistia mi khempeuh aw, note hong kisatna ciangkhut a kitan manin lungdam kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh singbul panin a sel a om bangin, gulpi a sih khit ciangin a siahuaizaw gul gunei hong om ding a, tuate pen a leng thei gulpi hong hi ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Mizawngte in keima gankhahna sungah an ne ding uh a, a cimawhte lungnuam takin lum hithiat ding uh hi. Ahih hangin no Filistia mite, kialpi tawh kong that ding a, a suaktakha a omlaite keimah in ka that ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“Filistia khuapi kongpite aw, nakpitakin kap un; khuapite aw, kiko un. Filistia mi khempeuh aw, lau-in ling un! Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu lam panin galkap honte’ hong paina leivui khu hong kitung a, tua galkapte a meidawi khat beek om lo hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zefa 2:4-7; Zek 9:5-7"},"32":{"text":"Filistia mite in a hong sawl kamtaite mi khatpeuh in bangci dawn ding ahi hiam? “ Topa in Zion kipsak khin a, gimna a thuak ama mite in tua sungah bukna mu uh hi,” ci-in a dawng ding uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab gam tawh kisai thu: Zan khat thu-in Ar khua kisiasak ahih manin Moab gam a bei hi. Zan khat thu-in Kir khua kisiasak ahih manin Moab gam a beita ahi hi.","title":"Moab tawh kisai Thu"},"2":{"text":"A sangna munte-ah a kap dingin Dibon khuamite paito uh hi. Nebo le Medeba khuate’ hangin Moab mite nakpitakin kap uh hi. Dahna limin lu khempeuh kimettol a, khamul khempeuh zong kimetmai hi."},"3":{"text":"Kongzing lakah amaute in puanhampi silh uh hi. Innkhumzang le kongzing lampi kituahnate-ah mi khempeuh nakpi-in kapin khitui tawh a kawt uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Heshbon khua le Elealeh khua kiko uh a, amau’ kahna awging Jahaz khua dongah kiza hi. Tua ahih ciangin Moab mi galhiam tawite lau-in nakpitakin kiko uh a, amaute a ling uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Moab gam adingin ka lungsim kiko hi. A galtai ama mite Zoar khua le Eglathshelishiah khuate-ah a tai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Luhith lampi-ah amaute a kapsa-in paito uh hi. Horonaim khua zuatna lampi-ah amaute in siatna a thuakna uh hangin nakpi-in kiko uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nimrim luite kang hi. Lopa keu-in a selthak om lo a, lopa hing om nawn lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a ngahsa uh le a kholsa uh na tampite pua-in Gialhek Lui-ah a paipih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Moab gam kiim khempeuhah kahna aw a ging hi. Kahna in Eglaim khua ban a, kahna in Beerelim khua zong a ban hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Dibon luituite sisan tawh kidim hi. Ahi zongin Dibon khua in a thuak ding a nasiazaw omlai a, Moab gam panin a suakta mi le gam sungah a omlai mite khempeuh kithat gawp ding hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab mite in Jerusalem-a om gam ukpa tungah sehnel gam Sela khua panin tuunote a puak uh hi."},"2":{"text":"A bu a kipaih khiatsak ciangin a cih nading thei loin a leng kawikawi vasate bangin Arnon guntui ngahmunah Moab mite om uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in Judah mite kiangah, “Kote tungah thuhoih hong lak unla, thutangin hong gamta un. Sunkim laitak a singliim bangin kote hong liah un. A kihawlkhia kote hong seel unla, galtai kote hong heek kei un."},"4":{"text":"A kihawlkhia ko Moab mite note lakah hong tengsak unla, kote hong susiate’ kiang panin kote’ belh hong hi un. A nengniam pa om nawn loin siatna hun beita a, a khe tawh a sik mipa gam sung panin a manthan ciangin,"},"5":{"text":"itna kip tawh kumpi tokhom khat kiphut ding a, thuman sep ding a manlang, thutang zongin thu a khen mipa pen David’ buk sunga om tua tokhom tungah thuman tawh tu ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah mite in, “Moab’ kiphatsakna thu i za khinta hi. Amah kiphasak mahmah hi. A kiliatsakna, a kiphatsakna, a kihihsakna, ama kisialhnate khempeuh a mawkna ahi hi,” a ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a thuakna uh hangin Moab mite kap hen la, mi khempeuh zong Moab mite’ hangin kap ta uh hen. Nakpi takin gimna a thuak laitakun Kirhareseth khua-ah a anlim nekte uh a phawkkhak uh ciangin khasia-in a kap uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a hiang zaai-in tuipi kantan a, Jazer khua banin sehnel gam dongah a zaam ama hiangte, minam dangte’ tote in sattan ahih manin Heshbon lolaite le Sibmah leengguite vul ta uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jazer khua mite a kah bangin Sibmah leengguite’ hangin kei ka kap hi. Heshbon le Elealeh khuamite aw, ka khitui tawh note kong kawtsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh galkidona in note’ singgah le ante hong banzo hi."},"10":{"text":"An tampi a pian’ ngeina lolai-ah lungdamna le nuamna om nawn lo hi. Leenggui lote-ah lasakna om lo a, lungdam a kikona om nawn lo hi. Leenggah cilna-ah kuamah in leengtui suk nawn lo a, leenggah lawh cianga kikona aw kidaisak ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moab gam hangin laiza lasakna bangin ka lungsim kisat gaihgaih a, Kirhareseth khuapi hangin kei mahmah zong ka kisat gaihgaih hi."},"12":{"text":"Moab amahmah hong kilaakin, a sangna munah lungkhamin hong pai a, ama siangtho munah thu a nget ciangin bangmah ngah lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih bang thu pen Topa in a beisa hun lai-in Moab tawh kisai-in a gensa thu ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahih hangin tu-in Topa in, “Nasem dingin a kicial kum hunte sung bangin, kum thum sungin, ama mihon tampite om taseleh Moab’ minthanna in simmawhna thuak ding a, a suakta lai mite pen tawm mahmahin, thaneem ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Ezk 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zefa 2:8-11"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Damaskas tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: En un, Damaskas pen khuapi hi nawn loin ninbulomtang suak ding hi.","title":"Damaskas tawh kisai Thu"},"2":{"text":"Ama khuapite kinusiacip paisuak ding hi. Tuuhonte’ omna mun suak ding a, tua tuuhonte lum hithiatin bangmah in lausak lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Efraim gam panin kulhpi bei-in, Damaskas khua panin kumpi gam mangthang ding hi. Syria mi a suakta laite pen Israel mite mah bangin mindai ding uh hi, Vanglian Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 49:23-27; Amos 1:3-5; Zek 9:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Jakob’ liatna bei ding a, ama hauhna khempeuh mangthang ding hi.","title":"Israel tungah Thukhenna"},"5":{"text":"An a la mi in ankung ding laite kaikhawmin ante a kilak khit ciangin leitang a hawm guakin a om tawh kibang ding a, mi khat in Refaim Kuam sungah ansang a kaihkhop khit ciangin lolai a hawm guakin a om tawh zong kibang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Oliv kung a kisin’ khit ciangin a hiang sangpen dawnah pum nih pum thum singkung hiang dawnah pum li pum nga a omlai tawh kibang lel ding hi, Israel-te’ Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mite in amaute a Bawlpa pi ngaihsut ding uh a, amaute’ mit in Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa en ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in amau khut tawh a bawlsa uh biakna taute don lo ding uh a, amau’ bawlsa Asherah milimte hitaleh paknamtui halna biakna taute hitaleh muanin nei nawn lo ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin amau’ khuapi muanhuaite pen Hiv mite le Amor mite in Israel mite’ hangin a nusiat uh munte tawh kibang ding a, gamkhing a suak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nomau hong honkhia Pasian note in mangngilhin, nomau’ belh Suangpi phawk lo na hih manun note in biakna huan bawlin kung hoihte suan a, kung namdangte tawh pehin,"},"11":{"text":"tuate na suan ni mahun thakhatin khang a, na tuh ni uh a zing ciang mahin a hong pak hangin note in a gah na lokha kei ding uh hi. Gimna le lungkhamna hong tun ni-in tuate maimang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ah, mi tampite’ kikona, tuipi ging bang! Ah, minamte’ otna, tui lianpi ging bang!"},"13":{"text":"Tui lianpi a ging bangin minamte awng uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in amaute tai ding a, gamlapi pekah amaute taikhia ding uh hi. Mualtung a huih mai-ah ansi leeng bang leh huihpi mai-a pingpei bangin leengkhia mang ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"En un, nitakin hong lausak a, zingsang ma-in amaute beita! Hih bang thute pen eite hong susia-in eite a hong luhgawpte in a thuak ding uh ahi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ah, Ethiopia gunte’ galkhat, puankhai gunkuangpi a omna gamte in Nail gun tawnin tui tungah laisah tawh a kibawl gunkuangpite tungah tuangin taangmi hong sawl uh hi. No a zaptel makaite aw, amau’ gam gunpi in a phelkhap, a vanglian a gualzo minam, a nai a gamla-ah a kikihta mi, a tun sang mi, a cineel minamte kiangah va pai un.","title":"Ethiopia thu Genkholhna","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Leitung a teng mi khempeuh, leitung a om mi khempeuh aw, mualte tungah lim khat hong kilah ciangin en un! Peengkul hong kimut ciangin ngai un!"},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah, “Nitaang sunga nisa silsel, anlak nisat hun sunga meiizun bangin, ka omna panin daitakin ka en ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leenggah lawh hun ma deuh, leenggui a pak khit, leenggah a puamcin laitakin, amah in singhiang heuhna temkawi tawh a selte atkhia ding a, a zaam zeizai a hiangte heuhkhia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate khempeuh mualtung a om vasate’ nek ding le leitung a ganhingte’ nek dingin kinusia ding hi. Khuakhal ciangin vasate in ne ding a, phalbi ciangin leitung a ganhingte in ne ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin, amau’ gam gunpi in a phelkhap, a vanglian a gualzo minam, a nai a gamla-ah a kikihta mi, a tun sang mi, a cineel mite kiang panin Vanglian Topa ’ min omna Zion mual, Vanglian Topa ’ tungah letsong hong kipuak ding hi.","ref":"Zefa 2:12"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: A manlang mahmah meii tungah Topa tuangin Egypt gamah a pai hi. Ama mai-ah Egypt gam milimte lau-in ling ding uh a, Egypt mite’ hanna beita ding hi.","title":"Egypt tawh kisai Thu"},"2":{"text":"Egypt mite amau le amau ka kitawngsak ding hi. Mi kim in ama vengte ciat do ding a, khua khatlekhat kido-in, mi khatlekhat kumpi za kituh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt mite’ lungsim hawmsuak ding a, amau’ geelnate ka siasak ding hi. Amaute in milimte, vankah theite le aisan theite tungah thu dong ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A thuakhak topa’ khut sungah Egypt mite ka pia ding a, a kihtakhuai mahmah a gilo kumpipa in amaute uk ding hi, Topa, Vanglian Topa in ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Nail guntuite keu ding a, guntui kangcipin keu ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Lei zui-a tui kilate uihin, Egypt gam a om Nail gun hiangte kiamin keucip ding a, pumpeeng kung le phai kungte muat ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nail gun gei, Nail gun kiang kolh ding a, Nail gun kiangah a kituh khempeuh keucipin huih in leenkhia-in om nawn lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nail gun sungah ngasiahna sikkawi a khia ngei, ngasa bengte thumin tau ding uh a, tui tungah ngen a pai ngei mite thaneem ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Anthul khau ciingin na a semte le patpuan a gante lungkham ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Gam sung makaite kisusiacip ding a, a kicial nasemte dah ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Zoan uliante hai cihtakin hai uh a, Faro’ mipil thu lamlakte in thu haihuai gen uh hi. Nang in Faro’ tungah, “Mipil pa’ tapa ka hi hi; tanglai kumpite’ tapa ka hi hi,” bangci-in ci thei ding na hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih kei leh Egypt kumpipa Faro aw, na mipilte koi-ah om ahi uh hiam? Vanglian Topa in Egypt gam gimpiak ding a ngimna thu, na mipilte in nangma tungah hong genthei kha ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Zoan uliante mihai suak khin uh a, Memfis uliante zong hai khin uh hi. Minamte a makai dinga kineite in a mite uh lam khialhpih khin hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in amaute’ lungsim kitukalhsak khinzo hi. Zukham pa ama luak lakah a puk bangin Egypt gam mite’ hihna khempeuh khialin hoimang khin hi."},"15":{"text":"A hau a zawng, a lian a neu, mi khat beek in Egypt a dingin a hihsak theih ding bangmah om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt mite, numei bang ding uh a, Vanglian Topa in amaute a khut a sinsanna hangin lau-in ling ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah gam pen Egypt mite’ kihtak hong suak ding hi. Vanglian Topa in amaute gimpiak ding a ngimna hangin, hih thu a kigenna mi khempeuh lau ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt gam sungah khuapi nga in Kanaan mite’ kampau zangin Vanglian Topa ’ tungah thuman ding thu ciam ding uh hi. Hih khuapi khat pen, “Ni Khuapi,” kici ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt gamah Topa a’ ding biakna tau khat, a gamgi-ah Topa a’ ding khuapi khat om ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua pen Vanglian Topa a dingin Egypt gam sungah lim le teci hi ding hi. A nengniam mite’ bawlsiatna hangin Topa tungah amaute a kiko ciangin, amah in amaute kiangah honpa khat sawl ding a, amaute hu-in khahkhia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Egypt mite tungah amahmah kitheisak ding hi. Tua ni ciangin Egypt mite in Topa thei-in biakpiakna le meihal biakna tawh bia ding uh a, amaute in Topa ’ tungah thuciamna bawlin, tua thuciamnate sem ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Egypt mite sat ding a, ahi zongin damsakkik ding hi. Topa ’ lamah amaute kihei kik ding uh a, amah in amaute’ thumna donin amaute a damsak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Egypt gam panin Assiria gamah lam lianpi khat pai-in, Assiria mite Egypt gamah hong pai ding a, Egypt mite Assiria gam sungah pai-in, Egypt mite in Assiria mite tawh biakhawm ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Israel, Egypt, le Assiria, hih thumte pen leitung khempeuh a dingin thupha hi ding uh a,"},"25":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in, “Ka mihingte ahi Egypt, ka khut tawh ka bawlsa ahi Assiria, le keima luah ahi Israel mite in thupha ngah ta hen,” ci-in thupha a piakte hi ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 46:2-26; Ezk 29:1-32:32"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Assiria kumpipa Sargon in a sawl galkapmang lianpen pa, Filistia khuapi Ashdod-ah pai-in, tua khua va sim hi.","title":"Assiria in Egypt le Ethiopia Zo Ding"},"2":{"text":"Tua hun ma kum thum laitakin Topa in Amoz’ tapa Isaiah tungtawnin thu genin, “Na puanhampi suah inla, na khe panin na khedapte suah in,” a ci hi. Amah zong tua mah bangin gamta-in, tangguak le kheguak tawh lam a pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Ashdod khua a kilak khit ciangin Topa in, “Egypt le Ethiopia langkhatah lim le siahil dingin ka nasempa Isaiah tangguak le kheguak tawh kum thum sung lam a pai mah bangin,"},"4":{"text":"Assiria kumpipa in, Egypt gam mite’ maizumna ahi, a moi a hamin, tangguak kheguakin, tawbo dawksa-in, Egypt mite galin manin, Ethiopia mite salin manin paikhiatpih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amau’ lametna Ethiopia le amau’ kisialhpih Egypt’ hangin amaute lungkia-in a cih nading uh thei lo ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin hih tuipi gei-a teng mite in, ‘En un, eite’ lametna, Assiria kumpipa’ kiang panin eite hong honkhia dingin i belh mite’ tungah hih bang piang khinta hi. Eite bangci suahtak ding ihi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon gam tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: Leitaw lam panin pingpei hong kipat mah bangin, a lauhuai gam panin siatna hong pai hi.","title":"Babylon Gam tawh Kisai Thu"},"2":{"text":"A kihtakhuai maangmuhna khat kei tungah hong kigen hi. A sutzo mipa in sut a, a susiazo mipa in susia hi. Elam galkapte aw, kuanto un. Media galkapte aw, umcih un. Babylon’ piansak khuisatnate khempeuh Pasian in beisak ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka kawng na a, nausuak numei in na a sak bangin na ka sa hi. Khua a za thei lo zah dongin a kuncipin ka om a, khua a mu thei lo zah dongin lungkia-in ka om hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lung vai a, launa in hong sidaangsak hi. Keima lunggulh zan khuamial pen keima linna a suak hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in sabuai phahin, sualpuante phah uh a, an ne-in tui dawn uh hi. Uliante aw, tho un; lum, sathau nuh un!"},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah: “Pai in; galvil khat koih inla, ama muh bangbang gensak in."},"7":{"text":"Amah in a kopkopin sakol tung tuang mite, la tunga a tuangte, kalaoh tunga a tuangte a muh ciangin limtak, phatakin encik hen,” hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mu pa kiko a, “Topa aw, tausang tungah sun tawntung ka ding a, ka vilna munah zan khuavak ka om hi."},"9":{"text":"En in, sakol tung tuangte a kopkopin hong pai!” a ci hi. Adang khat in, “Babylon cim hi, cim hi. A milim pasian-te khempeuh leilak dongah amah in suksiatsak hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mang 14:8; 18:2"},"10":{"text":"A kicilsa, a kiseepsa keima mite aw, Israel-te’ Pasian, Vanglian Topa ’ tung panin ka zaksa thu teng note tungah ka hong gen hi."},"11":{"text":"Edom gam tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: Seir mual tung panin khat in kei hong sam a, “Galvil pa aw, tuzan bangci hiam? Galvil pa aw, tuzan bangci hiam?” hong ci hi.","title":"Edom Gam tawh Kisai Thu"},"12":{"text":"Galvil pa keimah in, “Zing ni hong suak a, zan khua zong hong mial hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa , Israel Pasian in hih thu gen khinzo hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maangmuhna Kuam tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: Kikona tawh a kidim, a gamlum khuapi, lungdamin a diang khua aw, note khempeuh, innkhumzangah na kah toh uh bang na cihnopna uh ahi hiam? A kithat nangma mite pen namsau tawh a kithat hi lo a, galsung a si hi lo uh hi.","title":"Maangmuhna Kuam tawh kisai Thu","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Note hong uk mite tai uh a, thal zat kul loin amaute kiman hi. Gamlapi-ah na tai uh hangin hong kimu note khempeuh hong kiman hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin keimah in, “Kei hong en kei unla, khitui tampi luangin hong kapkap sak un. Ka mi tampi a sihna hangin keimah hehnep ding hong hanciam kei un,” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa Pasian in Maangmuhna Kuam sungah buaina le tuatcil gawpna, kitawhzauna, kulhte suksiat gawpna le mualte tungah kikona hong tungsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Sakol leengte le sakol tung tuangte tawh Elam galkapte in thallawng pua uh a, Kir galkapte in a lumte uh a baihsa-in nei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Nomau’ teel Judah kuamte sakol leeng tawh kidim a, sakol tung tuangte in Jerusalem kulhkongpite-ah a pang uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah a kihutna teng khempeuh kicim khinta hi. Tua ni ciangin Tulak Inn sunga kikoih galhiamte na suang ding a,"},"9":{"text":"David khuapi mun tampi tak a siatna mu-in, bual nuainung tuite na cingkik a,"},"10":{"text":"nangmah in Jerusalem innte a phazah simin, kulhpi siate puahna dingin innte na phel hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangmah in, bual lui pana tuite khol nadingin kulhpi nih kikalah tuibempi khat na bawl hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in, tua na a na bawlpa phawk loin, sawtpekin a na geel pa na don kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Vanglian Topa Pasian in kahna le thumna, sam mettolna le puanhampi silhna a zang dingin thu hong pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahih hangin note in lungdamna le kipahna, bawngtalte le tuute gawhna, sa nekna le leenggahzu nekna na nei zawsop uh a, “Zing ciangin si ding ihih ciangin nene-in dawndawn ni,” na ci zawsop uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 15:32"},"14":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in keima tungah thu hong gen a, “Na sih matengun hih mawhna hong kimaisak het lo ding hi,” Vanglian Topa Pasian in hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Vanglian Topa Pasian in, “Hong pai in. Innsung na teng a uk, neihsa kem pa Shebna kiangah pai inla ama tungah hih bangin gen in:","title":"Eliakim in Shebna Laih Ding"},"16":{"text":"Hih lai-ah nangma a’ ding hankhuk a to, a sangna munah hankhuk a bawl, na omna ding suang a khuak mipa aw, nang in hih lai-ah bang hih a, vui ding kua nei na hi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"En in, nang mi that pa aw, Topa in nang hong lawnkhia gawp ding hi. Amah in nakpitakin nang hong lenin,"},"18":{"text":"hong pingpei ding a, lei tanzau munah bawlung bangin hong lawn ding hi. Na topa’ inn sunga dingin maizumna ahi nang pen tua munah si-in, na kisaktheihpih na sakol leengte lakah na tuk ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na nasepna phual panin nang kong nawtkhia ding a, na omna panin nang hong kilawnkhia suk ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ni ciangin Hikiah’ tapa ahi ka nasempa Eliakim ka sam ding a,"},"21":{"text":"nangma puantualpi amah silhsakin, nangma kawnggak tawh amah ka gak ding a, nangma ukna ama tungah ka pia ding hi. Amah pen Jerusalem khua-a teng mite le Judah mite tungah pa hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"David’ suanlekhakte’ khutnuai-ah aana neihna tawhtang, ama tungah ka pia ding hi. Amah in hongin, kuamah in khak zo lo ding hi. Amah in khakin, kuamah in hong zo lo ding hi.","ref":"Mang 3:7"},"23":{"text":"Amah pen a kician mun khatah vankhaina bangin ka khenkip ding a, ama beh sungah pahtawi ngahna phungpi a suak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ahi zongin a beh a phung, a suan a khakte khempeuh ama a dingin van gikpi hi ding a, umlebeel, kuanglekeute, hai a kipan thawl dongin van khaina-ah a kikhai bangin ama tungah kibom ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mun hoihna a a kikhen vankhai in lel ding hi. Topa in gen khin ahih ciangin, amah pen kitanin kia ding a, ama tunga vangik kikhai teng kisia ding hi,” Vanglian Topa in hong ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Taia khua tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: Tarshish teembaw hawlte aw, Taia khua kisia a, inn le khawlmunte om nawn lo ahih manin kap un! Saipras gam panin amaute in hih thu hong za uh hi.","title":"Taia le Sidon tawh kisai Thu"},"2":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a teng mite aw, thumin tau un. Sidon sumbukte aw, na sawltakte un tuipi kantanin tui lianpite tungah om uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt gam a piang ante lei-in na zuak uh a, minam khempeuh tawh sum bawlin na kizom uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Sidon aw, maizum in; bang hang hiam cih leh tuipi in thu gen khin hi. Tua tuipi muanhuai in, “Keimah in naupaii-in na ka sa ngei kei a, nau ka nei ngei kei hi. Ta numei ka khoi ngei kei a, ta pasal zong ka khansuah ngei kei hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt gamah hih thu a kizak ciangin, Taia tawh kisai thu hangin amaute in na sa ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a teng mite aw, Tarshish khua-ah tai-in kap un!"},"7":{"text":"Tanglai pekin a piang, gamlapi pek panin a kiphut hih khuapi nomau’ lungdampih khuapi mah ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Kumpi khuapi ahi, ama sumbukte ulian ahi, ama sumbawlte leitungah a kipahtawite ahi, Taia khuapi hih bang a pianna ding kua’ vaihawm ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"A Vanglian Topa ’ vaihawm ahi hi. Miliante’ kiphatsaknate a beisakna ding le a kipahtawi uliante a niamkhiat nadingin a bawl ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tarshish mite aw, tu-in kuankhia-in lo kho un. Na sumbawlna teng uh maimang khinta hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in tuipi tungah a khut zan a, kumpi gamte lumlet gawp hi. Sumbawlna phualpite a kisuksiatna ding Topa in thu piazo hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in, “Sidon khuapi aw, na lungdamna teng bei khinta hi. Na mite in nenniamna thuak uh a, Saipras tuikulh-ah a va tai uh hangin, tua lai nangawnah lungnopna hun nei lo ding uh hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Taia khuapi, gamsate’ phualpi a suaksakte pen Assiria mite hi lo a, Babylon mite ahi hi. Babylon mite in khuapi luhna ding panmun bawl uh a, Taia khuapi kulhte susia-in, khuapi sung khempeuh a sia a suaksak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tarshish teembaw hawlte aw, na muan uh khuapi kisia ta ahih manin thumin kap un."},"15":{"text":"Tua a siat hun a kipanin kumpi khat nuntak hunsung tan ahi, kum sawmsagih sung Taia khuapi kimangngilh ding hi. Tua la sungah,"},"16":{"text":"“Kuama phawk loh numei paktat aw, harp lasakna khat la inla, khuapi kimkotah pai in! Nangmah hong kiphawk theih nadingin la ngaih phuak inla, la tampi sa in,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Kum sawmsagih a cin ciangin Taia khuapi-ah Topa hawh ding a, Taia khuapi in ama sep ngei sem kikin, leitung kumpi gam khempeuh tawh kizomin sumbawlna sem ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama sumbuk vante le ama sepna panin a ngah nate pen Topa ’ tungah kipia ding hi. Ahih hangin tuate kikholcip mawk loin, Topa a bia mite’ an ding le puan hoihnono leina-in kizang ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 26:1-28:19; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zek 9:1-4; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, Topa in leitung hawmsuak sakin gamkhing suaksak ding a, amah in lei maitang huiheek gawpin, a tunga a teng mite thehthang gawp ding hi.","title":"Leitungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Mi khempeuhte’ thuakna kibang kim ding hi. Siampite le mi mawkmawkte silate le a tote, van leite le van zuakte, sumneite le leibate, a hau a zawng, a thuakna uh kibang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitung kihawmsuak sakin kisiacip ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hih thu gen khinzo hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung vulin keugaw a, leitung buppi thaneemin vulgawp hi. Vantung le leitung a nih tuakin vulkhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama tunga a tengte in leitung ninsak uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in thukhamte khialin ngeina kipte palsat uh a, tawntung thuciamna peel uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in leitung samsiatin susia a, a tunga a teng mite in amau’ mawhna hangun a thuak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin leitungah a teng mite tawm semsem hi."},"7":{"text":"Leengguite keutumin leenggahzu tawm semsem a, a lungdam mi khempeuh khuisa ta uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungdamna khuang gingte dai-in lungdam a gamlumnate om nawn lo a, lungdam a laiza tawh lasaknate a dai ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Zu phungah lungdam a lasakna om nawn lo a, zu khempeuh kisia-in khagawp ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Khuapi hawmsuak pen kisiacip ta a, kuamah a tum theih loh nadingin inn khempeuh kikhakcip hi."},"11":{"text":"Leenggahzu a duh manun kongzingah mite kiko uh hi. Lungdamna khempeuh mangthang khinta a, leitung kipahna teng kibeisak ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuapi sungah gamkhinna bek om a, kongpite kisat khamin kisiamang khinta hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih bangmahin leitungah a om mi khempeuh tungah a hong tung ding ahi hi. Oliv kung a kisin’ khit ciang, leenggah kilo khinin a sangte a kikaihkhop khit ciangin a kinusia lo hawmte tawh kibang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A suaktasun mite in lungdamin la sa ding uh hi. Nitumna lama om mite in Topa a liat mahmahna thu gen ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Nisuahna lama om mite in Topa phat ding uh hi. Tuipi dunga teng mite in Topa , Israel-te’ Pasian phat ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Leimong a gamla pek pan nangawnin a thuman Israel minamte a kiphatna la i za ding hi. Ahih hangin keimah in, “Ka lungkham hi; ka lungkham hi. Gimna ngah hi ta ing! Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khemte in khemkhem lai-in sia semsem uh a, khemzawh thu mah ciamciam lai uh hi,” ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung a a teng mite aw, note a dingin launa, gum le thangzakte om hi."},"18":{"text":"Lauhuaina panin a tai mipa gum sungah kia ding a, gum sung panin a taikhiat ciangin thangzak sungah awk ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh van panin guahpi hong bua sukin leitung bulpite kiling ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitung khangkhamin kilokgawp ding a, kiphelkham ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Leitung pumpi zukham bangin hoi ding a, huihpi’ mutgawp buk bangin awn ding hi. Ama mawhnate in nengcip gawp ding a, amah pukin thokikzo ngei nawn lo ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Topa in vantung a om mihonpite le leitung kumpite gim pia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Dum sunga om thongkiate bangin amaute khempeuh kikaikhawm ding hi. Thong sungah amaute kikhaknelh ding a, ni tampi khit ciangin amaute gim kipia pan ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin khapi mial ding a, ni taang nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa in Zion Mual tung le Jerusalem khua sungah uk ding a, ama upate’ mai-ah ama minthanna vang kilangsak ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa aw, nang pen keima Pasian na hi hi. Nangmah kong liansak ding a, nangma min ka phat ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a lamdang nate na sem khin a, tanglai peka na geelnate a kip a kho takpi ahi hi.","title":"Angvanna Hanga Phatna La"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in khuapi ninbulomtang na suah a, a muanhuai khuapi a sia na suaksak hi. Mi kiphasakte’ kumpi inn pen khua bang nawn lo a, cikmah hunin kilamkik nawn lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mi thahatte in nangma min hong thangsak ding a, thukhual lo minamte’ khuapite in nang hong zahtak ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen mizawngte a dingin munmuanhuai, a cimawh mite a dingin a lungkhamna uhah munmuanhuai, huihpi panin bukna le nisa panin niliim na hi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thukhual lo mite’ hihna pen huihpi in kulh a nawkgawp tawh kibang a,"},"5":{"text":"mun keuna-ah nisa mahmah tawh kibang hi. Nang in mi kiphasakte’ gamlumna na daisak hi. Meii liim in nisa a votsak bangin thukhual lo mite’ lasakna kitawpsak ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in hih mual tungah mi khempeuh a dingin anlim nekna pawi, a ciil mahmah leenggahzu nekna pawi, guhngek tawh a kidim an nekna, a siangtho leenggahzu ciil nekna pawi bawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in mi khempeuh’ khuk dahna puan le minam khempeuh’ silh dahna puante, hih mual tungah susia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in sihna beimangsak ding a, maitang khempeuh panin khitui nul ding hi. Leitung khempeuh panin ama mite a kizahkona lakhia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hih thu gen khinzo hi.","ref":"1Kor 15:54; Mang 7:17; 21:4"},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin, “En un, amah pen eima Pasian ahi hi. Eite a hong hon dingin amah i ngak hi. Amah pen eima Topa ahi hi. Amah i ngak hi. Amah in eite hong honkhia ahih manin lungdamin kipak ni,” kici ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hih Zion Mual hu ding a, ahi zongin Moab mite ahihleh ninkholna dum sungah buhkungte a kisikcip bangin kisikcip gawp ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuipeek pa in tui peek dingin a khutte a van bangin amaute in a khut uh vanvan ding uh a, ahih hangin a khut uh a van simin a kiphatsaknate uh a khut uh tawh bengtumsuk ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in Moab mite’ kulh muanhuaite suksiat sakin leilak denna ding a, leivui suakmangkhin ding hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1-16:14; Jer 48:1-47; Ezk 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zefa 2:8-11"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Judah gam sungah hih la kisa ding hi: Khuapi muanhuai khat i nei a, Topa mahmah in i kulhte le i panmun kipte hong hutsak hi.","title":"Hut Ding Muanna La"},"2":{"text":"Upna-ah a kip thuman minamte a lut theih nadingin kulhkongpite hong ta un."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, nang hong muang a, nangma tungah a lungsim khempeuh a koih mipa lungnopna kicing pia ta in."},"4":{"text":"Topa Pasian in eite khempeuh hong hu tawntung ahih manin Topa muang tawntung un."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a kiphasak mite niamkhiat suk hi. Amau’ tenna khuapi muanhuai suksiatsak a, a kulhpite denkhap sakin leivui a suah hi."},"6":{"text":"A zawng a cimawh a kinengniam mite in tu-in tua khua tuancil uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Midik pa’ lampi tamkim a, nangmah in midik pa’ lampi na neelsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma deihna kong zui uh a, nang kong ngak uh hi. Nang pen kote’ deih kicinna na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh zanin nang kong deih a, zingsang khuavak ciangin lungsim tak tawh nang kong zong hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung le a mite tungah thu na khen ciangin leitung a a teng mite in thuman i cih bang hiam, cih a phawk ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilote tungah nangmah na migit hangin a manin gamtat ding theithei tuan lo uh a, lungsim thutang mite’ gam sungah amaute in khialhna bawllai veve uh hi. Amaute in Topa ’ minliatna hong phawk nuam lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa aw, amaute gim na piak ding lamtak na galte in thei lo uh hi. Amaute maizumna thuaksak inla, amaute a dingin na geelsa gimnate amaute thuaksak in. Na mite na itna thu na galte tungah kilangsak in.","ref":"Heb 10:27"},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, kote tungah maavanna hong pia in. Kote’ matut zawhna khempeuh nangmah in na hong sepsakna hang ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa , kote’ Pasian aw, nang ahi lo to dangte in ko tungah hong uk hangin, nangmah bek mah kote’ Topa na hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute si a, hingkik lo ding uh hi. Amaute mangthang ta uh a, omkik nawn lo ding uh hi. Tua bang a piantheih nadingin nangmah in amaute tungah siatna na tungsak a, amaute a kiphawkna khempeuh na beisak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in ko minam nong khangsak hi. Topa aw, nangmah in ko minam nong khangsak a, gamgi khempeuh na hong keeksak khin hi. Hih thu hangin nangma min a thang hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, ka cihmawh uh ciangin nang kong zong uh a, nangma hong taina pen kote nong gimpiakna ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, nangma hangin kote pen naupaii numei a hun a nai ciangin na sa-in kiheek a, a kap tawh ka kibang uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kote in naupaii-in ka kiheekheek uh a, huih bek a hingkhia tawh ka kibang uh hi. Kote in ka gam uh a’ ding bangmah ka suakkhiasak kei uh a, leitungah a teng ding mi kuamah ka hingkhia kei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma mi a sisate hingkik ding uh a, amau’ pumpi thokik ding hi. Han sungah a lum mite aw, tho-in lungdamin la sa un! Bang hang hiam cih leh zing daitui in leitung a nosakkik bangin sawtpi-a a sisa mite Topa in hingkiksak ding hi.","ref":"Dan 12:2"},"20":{"text":"Ka mite aw, hong pai-in na innsung uhah tum unla, na kongte uh khak un. Hehna a dam matengin tawlkhat sung bu un."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh en un, amau’ mawhna hangin leitungah a teng mite gim a pia dingin ama omna panin Topa hong paikhia a, leitung in ama tunga a kithat mite lakkhia ding a, a kithat ama mite sincip nawn lo ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Topa in a sak mahmah, a lian mahmah, a to mahmah namsau tawh, a taikhia gulpi ahi awle, a kikualvial gulpi ahi awle gim pia ding a, amah in tuipi sunga om tua gulpi a that ding hi.","title":"Israel Mite Khahkhiatna le Kaihkhopna","ref":"Job 41:1; La 74:14; 104:26"},"2":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin, “A deihhuai leenggah lo thu la-in sa un!"},"3":{"text":"Keimah, Topa , tua lo a hong pa ka hi a, a hunhunin tui ka buak hi. Khatpeuh in a suksiat loh nadingin sun le zanin ka hong ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Leenggui lo tungah ka heh nawn kei hi. Ling le lingkungte hong om leh keimah kuankhia-in tuate ka haltum ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih kei leh keima hutna sungah amaute hong om hen la, amaute in kei tawh kilemna hong bawlin keimah tawh amaute hong kilem ta uh hen,” Topa in ci ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hong tung ding hunah Jakob in zung kha ding a, Israel palhin dawnkhia ding a, leitung khempeuh a gah tawh kidimsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian in Israel-te’ galte a vatgawp bangin Israel-te vatgawp ahi hiam? Tua ahih kei leh amau a thatte a kithah bangin Israel-te kithat ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"A kithukkim dingin amaute sal suahsakna tawh gim a pia hi. Nisuahna huihpi in a mutkhiat bangin amaute a khinkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel in suang tawh a kibawl biakna tau khempeuh suangkang satvui a batsak ciangin Asherah milimte le paknamtui taute a dinglai om nawn lo hi. Hih thu hangin Jakob’ mawhna kimaisakin a mawhna kilakkhiatsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a muanhuai khuapi pen gamlak bangin amah guakin omin, mi’ tenna mun pen kitaisanin kinusia hi. Tua lai-ah bawngno gamta-in lum a, singhiangte a kheuh hi."},"11":{"text":"A hiangte a keu ciangin kitan hi. Nupite hong pai-in mei-in cih uh hi. Hih mite in khentel theihna nei lo ahih ciangin amaute a bawlpa in amaute hehpih lo ding a, amaute a piangsak pa in amaute tungah maipha lak lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel mite aw, tua ni ciangin Eufratis gunpi panin Egypt luipi dongin Topa in thu hong khen ding a, note khat khatin hong kikaikhawm ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin peengkul lianpi khat kitum ding a, Assiria gam sunga a mangthang mite le Egypt gam sunga a kihawlkhia mite hong pai-in Jerusalem mual siangtho tungah Topa hong bia ding uh hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel Kumpi gam in siatna a thuak ding hita hi. Zu a kham, a gam makaite’ lu tungah a om pak tawh a kibawl Kumpi lukhu bangin a minthanna maimangta hi. A lutang uh paknamtui kinuh napi-in zukhamin tukmangkhin uh hi.","title":"Israel-te Zakkholhsakna"},"2":{"text":"En un, a vang a lian, a hat mahmah mi khat Topa in nei hi. A susia huihpi gialpi, tuikhang le a thahat huihpi bangin amah in leilak dengawpna ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel zukham makaite in a kiphatsakpih kumpi lukhu pen khenuai-ah kituancil ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua a kiphasak zukham makaite’ minthanna pen tuk tun ma-in a om theipal min tawh kibang ding a, mi khat in tua theigah a muh ciangin lo-in a nekpah bangin maimang lel ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Vanglian Topa pen ama mi a omlaite a dingin minthanna kumpi lukhu le hoihna lukhu hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Thukhenin a tupa tungah thutang lungsim guan ding a, khuapikulh hong luh galte a notkhia ding mite tungah hanna lungsim guan ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hih mite zong leenggahzu tawh hoi-in khamtheihzu tawh awn uh hi. Siampite le kamsangte nangawn zukhamin hoi uh hi. Kamsangte in zu kham lua uh ahih manin Pasian’ muhsak maangmuhnate theithei lo uh a, siampite in zong zu kham lua uh ahih manin a thukhen dingte uh khen thei lo uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem tungah Zakkholhsakna le Kamciamna"},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sabuai tung khempeuh a luak uh tawh kidim a, a nit lohna mun om lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong phunsan uh a, “Amah in kua tungah hilh a, kua tungah thugen-a kinei ahi hiam? Angsung panin a kilakhia, nawi tawh a kikhen tung naungekte a hilha kinei ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mal khat khit mal khat, gual khat khit gual khat, thu khat khit thu khat, cih bang hilel hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A mantakin, note in ka thugen na ngaih kei uhleh Topa in a pau na theih loh uh gamdang mite, note tungah thu hong hilhsak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in note tungah tawlngakna le lungnopna hong pia napi-in, note in ama thu na ngai kei uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 14:21"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in note tungah, mal khat khit mal khat, gual khat khit gual khat, thu khat khit thu khat, cih bangin hong hilh ding ahi hi. Tua ciangin na kalsuanna khempeuh uhah na puk ding uh a, note liamin, thangah awkin, salin hong kipaipih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem khua sungah hih mite a uk, a kiphasak no uliante aw, Topa ’ thu za un!"},"15":{"text":"“Eite in sihna tawh thuciamna khat i bawl khin a, Leinuai tawh thukimna khat i neizo hi. A tuumcip ding tuiciin hong tun ciangin eite hong ban lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh zuauthu i bel a, zuauna-ah i bu hi,” na ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian in, “En un, keimah in Zion sungah bulpi ding khat, suang, a kize-etsa suang, a manpha innkiu suang, bulpi muanhuai khat ka koih hi. Tua suang tungah, ‘Hih a um mi in lungkhamna tuaklo ding hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"La 118:22-23; Rom 9:33; 10:11; 1Pe 2:6"},"17":{"text":"Keimah in thutang pen khaukhai bangin ka bawl ding a, thuman pen khaukhai sikbawk bangin ka bawl ding hi. Gial in na zuau buk uh dengkhia ding a, tui in na bukna mun uh susia ding hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin sihna tawh na thuciamna uh kiphiat ding a, Leinuai tawh na thukimna uh kip lo ding hi. A tuumcip ding tuiciin in a hong nawk ciangin note hong sugawp ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hong nawk sialin note hong ban ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh zingsang khat khit zingsang khat, sun le zanin hong nawk tawntung ding hi. Topa ’ tung panin na zak uh thute a banbanin launa lianpi vive hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh puanbuk sungah khe khuan nadingin lupna tom lua a, silh dingin puanza neu lua hi, a cih tawh na kibang ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a lamdang ama bawlte a bawl ding le a lamdang ama nasep a sem dingin Perazim Mual tungah a sep bangin Topa in hong sem ding a, Gibeon kuama a heh bangin amah hong heh ding hi.","ref":"Josh 10:10-12; 2Sam 5:20; 1Khang 14:11"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, note hong kikhihna a to mahmahin kibawl kha ding ahih manin thusim loin om kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihonpite’ Topa Pasian ’ tung panin gambuppi-ah siatna ding thukhenna ka za khin hi."},"23":{"text":"Na bil uh hong ngat unla, ka aw hong za un. Ngai unla, ka thugenna hong za un."},"24":{"text":"Lokho pa in khaici tuhna ding a lo kho niloh ahi hiam? Amah in lei kalkhamin git niloh ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Amah in lei a zalhtam khit ciangin masala tang vawhin, kummin tang tuh a, mangbuhte a gualgualin tuhin, mangbuhham a omna ding sanah tuh a, mangbuhhamte a nawl hui-ah tuh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amah a manin kihilh a, ama Pasian in amah hilh hi."},"27":{"text":"Masalate buhcilna tawh kicil lo a, kummin tangte tungah buhcilna pei kihual lo hi. Ahih hangin masalate ciangkang tawh kisatkhia a, kumminte molhtum tawh kisat hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in antang cilvui ahi hiam? Hi lo hi; amah in cil paisuak ngitnget lo hi. A sakol tawh buhcilna pei a kihualsak ciangin amah in kitamvuisak lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Hih zong Vanglian Topa ’ kiang pan a hong pai thu ahi hi. Amah pen thu lamlahna-ah lamdang mahmah a, pilna-ah lian mahmah hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian’ biakna tau, Jerusalem khuapi, David in a sat khuapi, a sia ding hita hi. Kumte, a banbanin paipai sak unla, pawite zong a ngeina bangin kot paipai sak un.","title":"Jerusalem le A Galte"},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin keimah in “Pasian biakna tau,” a kici tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi. Thumna le tauna om ding a, tua khuapi pen biakna halna biakna tau suak ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na kimkotah hong umcihin tausangpite tawh kong um ding a, nangmah umcih nading dum ka bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin leithuk sung panin nang na pau ding a, a niamna mun leisung panin nangma kammal hong ging ding hi. Nangma aw pen leisung panin sikha’ aw bangin hong ging ding a, na thugenna pen leisung panin hong phun suausuau ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangma gal honpite leivuineel leeng bang ding uh a, thukhual lo mihonpite ansi leeng bang ding uh hi. Tua ciangin tomkha sungin thakhat thu-in,"},"6":{"text":"Vanglian Topa in vanging, zinling, a ging lianpi, pingpei le huihpi le, a kangtum thei meikuang tawh nang hong hon ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian biakna tau a do minam honpite khempeuh, tua khuapi le a kulhpi simin a lungkhamsakte khempeuh, zan a mangmat tawh kibangin maimang ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A gilkial mipa in a mangin an ne a, a khanlawh ciangin a gil a vah tuan lo, a dangtak mipa in a mangin tui dawn a, a dangtak pha tuan loin a gim mahmahin a khanlawh mah bangin Jerusalem khuapi a do mi khempeuh zong tuaci ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Lamdang kisasak unla lamdang a sa hi un! Kimittawsak unla a mittaw hi un! Leenggahzu a dawn lopi-in a zukham hi unla, khamtheihzu a ne lopi-in hoi un!","title":"Israel’ Mittawtna le Simtatna"},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in note’ sungah ihmut nopna lungsim hong guan a, amau’ mit ahi kamsangte mitsi sakin amau’ lutang ahi thu mutheite khuhcip hi.","ref":"Rom 11:8"},"11":{"text":"Hih maangmuhnate khempeuh pen note a dingin ahihleh a kimatcip laibu sunga thu om tawh a kibang a suak hi. Mite in lai a sim thei pa khat tungah, “Hih lai sim dih in,” a cih ciangin amah in, “Kimatcip ahih manin ka sim thei kei hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in lai a sim thei lopa kiangah, “Hih lai sim dih in,” a cih uh ciangin amah in, “Ka sim thei kei hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Amaute’ lungsim kei tawh kigamla napi-in hih mite in a kam uh tawh kei kiangah hong pai uh a, a muk uh tawh kei hong pahtawi-in, amaute in kei hong kihtakna pen mihingte’ thupiak a zuihna uh ahi lel hi.","ref":"Mat 15:8-9; Mrk 7:6-7"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin en un, hih mite tungah a tumdang le a lamdang ahi a lamdang nate ka bawlkik ding hi. Amau’ mipilte’ pilna kisia ding a, amau’ thu mutheite’ thu muhtel theihna kiseel ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kor 1:19"},"15":{"text":"Topa ’ kiang panin amau’ thuvaihawmna a seelcip, khuamial sungah a gamta, “Kua in hong mu ding hiam? Kua in hong thei ding hiam?” a cite in gimna ngah tahen."},"16":{"text":"Note in na khempeuh a lehlamin na koih uh hi. Beelseek pa pen tungman bangin kingaihsun ding a, a kibawlsa na in a bawlpa tungah, “Amah in kei hong bawl lo hi,” ci ding ahi hiam? A kipiangsak na in a piangsak pa tungah, “Amah in theihna nei kei,” ci ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 45:9"},"17":{"text":"Lebanon mual pen singno lo hoih suakin, singno lo hoih pen tulak a suahna ding hun tomno sung bek hi lo ahi hiam?","title":"Israel A Kihotkhiatna"},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin bilngongte in laibu sunga thute za ding a, lungzinna le khuamialna sung panin mittawte’ mit in mu ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi’ nopnehte in Topa ’ sungah lungdamna thak ngah ding uh a, Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa’ sungah mizawngte lungdam ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kampauna tawh a khialh nadingun mite bawlin, kongpi sungah mi a thuhilhpa thang siahin, a thuman mipa pen zuauthu tawh a heikhia, thukhual lo mite a mawkna suakin, mi a thusim lo mite bei-in, siatna hih ding a sawm mite khempeuh kisusia ding hi.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Abraham a honkhia Topa in Jakob innkuan tawh kisai thu a genin-ah: “Jakob maizum nawn lo ding a, a mai khing nawn lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh keima khut tawh ka bawlsa amau’ tate a muh uh ciangin amaute in keima min hong phat ding uh hi. Amaute in Jakob’ Siangtho Pa, a siangtho ahihna phawk ding uh a, Israel Pasian zahtakin kihta ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Lungzingin a khial mite in thu theitel ta ding uh a, a phunphun mite in thuhilhna ngai ta ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Kei’ ngimna hilopi-in thu vaihawmna a semkhia, kei’ lungsim lopi-in kipawlna dang a bawl manun khialhna a bawl thuahthuah; keimah thu hong dong lopi-in Faro’ hutna sung a bel ding le Egypt’ liahna a zong dingin Egypt gamah paisuk dingin a kuankhia, a lehdo mite in gimna ngah tahen.","title":"Egypt Belhna A Guaksuakna","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Faro’ hutna pen na maizumna uh hi ding a, Egypt liahna sungah na bukna uh nomau’ zahhuaina hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ uliante Zoan khua-ah va tung uh a, amau’ tangmite in Hanes khua a va phak uh hangin,"},"5":{"text":"amaute tungah phattuamna a pia thei lo, maizumna le mindaina cih loh buang huhna le phattuamna bangmah a pia thei lo Egypt mite’ hangin Judah mi khempeuh in maizumna ngah ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Negeb gam a om ganhingte tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: Amaute in humpinelkai nu le humpinelkai pa, gul gunei le a leeng thei gulpi a omna, lungkhamna le gimna gam nawkin, amau’ hauhnate la nungzangah amau’ sumte kalaoh tungah suanin, amaute tungah phattuamna bangmah a pia thei lo mite tungah a puak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt’ huhna bangmah man loin a hawmpi ahi hi. Tua ahih manin, “Taang loin a tu hithiat Egypt,” ci-in min ka phuah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in pai inla, hong tung lai ding hunte-ah teci ahi ngitnget dingin amaute’ mai-ah suangpek tungah gelh inla, laibu khat sungah at in."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen a lehdo mite, a zuauthei tapate, Topa ’ thuhilhna a ngai nuam lo mite ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in thu mutheite tungah, “Mu kei un,” ci uh a, kamsangte tungah, “Kote’ tungah thuman hong gen kei un. Kote tungah thuzol bek hong gen unla, thutak ahi lote hong gen un."},"11":{"text":"Lampi nusia-in, lamzin panin pial unla, Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa’ thu hong zasak kei un,” a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa in, “Note in hih thu simmawhin, zawhthawhna le khemna suangin, tuate muang na hih manun,"},"13":{"text":"hih mawhna pen note a dingin kulh sangpi khat khangkham a, lawtkhia-in a cim dektak, theihkholh lohin a cim vat tawh kibang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua cipna pen iplah ding om nawn loin a kidengkham beelseek pa’ beel themte meikhuka om meilakna ding ahi zongin, tuikhuka om tui dipna ding ahi zongin a om nawn het lo tawh kibang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa, Topa Pasian in, “Kihei kikna le khawlna bek tawh note in suahtakna na ngah ding uh hi. Daitakin omna le muanna pen nomau’ thahatna hi ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin note na tuaci kei uh a,"},"16":{"text":"“Hilo! Sakol tung tuangin manlang takin i tai ding hi,” ci na hih uh ciangin note na taikhia ding uh hi. “Sakol zaptel tungah i tuang ding hi,” ci na hih uh ciangin note hong delh mite zong zaptel ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mual sang dawna om dial khuam ahi a, mualtung a limlahna tawh a kibangin ahi zongin, note hong kinusiat dong matengin, mi khat’ tawnna tawh mi tulkhat tai-in, mihing nga’ tawnna tawh note khempeuh na taimang ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note hong hehpih nuamin Topa in hong ngak a, note tungah hehpihna hong lah ding amah kipakta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa pen a thutang Pasian hi a, amah a muangte khempeuh thupha ngah ahi hi.","title":"A Mite tungah Pasian’ Hehpihna Kamciam"},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem khuasunga a teng, Zion sunga om mite aw, note na kap nawn kei ding uh hi. Note’ kahna aw hangin Topa in hong hehpih taktak ding a, amah in a zak ciangin note hong dawng ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in note tungah cihmawhna le gimna hong tunsak hangin amahmah in note hong hilh ding a, note in amah na mu ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Taklamah na kihei ciang uh ahi a, veilamah na kihei ciang uh ahi zongin, “Hih pen lampi hi, hih tawn un,” cihna aw, na nunglam panun na bil un a za ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin note in ngun tawh a kizut na milimte uh le kham a kiluan, a kisung na milimte uh na ninsak ding uh hi. Nin bangin tuate na thehthang ding uh a, tuate tungah, “Beimang ta un!” na ci ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Khaici na tuh nadingun amah in guah hong zusak ding a, lei panin a piang an hoih tampi tak hong pia ding hi. Tua ni ciangin gankhahna, mun zaina-ah na ganhingte un lopa ne ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Lo a kho bawngtalte le late in kawbia le tu-ka tawh a kitoksa an al ne ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Na galte uh’ tausangte pukin mi tampi a sih ni-in, mual sang le mual neute tung khempeuhah luitui luang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua tham loin, Topa in ama mite’ liamma tuamin ama satna meimate a damsak ni ciangin, khataang pen nitaang bang ding a, nitaang pen ni sagih sunga taangzah bangin a zah sagihin a taang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"En un, Topa ’ vangliatna le a minthanna vang, gamlapi panin kimu thei hi. Meikuang le meikhu in ama hehna hong kilangsak a, ama kampaunate, mei bangin a kuang hi.","title":"Assiria tungah Thukhenna"},"28":{"text":"Na khempeuh a tai tuikhang bangin ama mai-ah huihpi nungsak a, minam dangte nawtin sugawp a, amau’ gitloh vaihawmnate a suksiatsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin no Pasian’ mite in ahihleh biakna pawi a kikham ni zan a bangin la na sa ding uh hi. Israel-te a hu Topa ’ biakinn-ah a pai dingin tamngai aw ginna zui-in a kuankhiate bangin na lungdam ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in heh mahmahna le a kangtum thei meikuang sung panin vanging, huihpi, le gialpi tawh, ama liatna minthanna aw kizasakin, ama khut a vik sukna kimusak ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in a ciangkhut tawh a sat ciangin, Assiria mite in Topa ’ aw kihta mahmah ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa in amaute gim pia-in ciang tawh a satna a gingte tawh kituakin khuang le laiza lasaknate tumin na gingsak ding uh hi. Amah in a khut vikin amaute a do ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Assiria kumpipa a kihalna ding mei phualpi mun, sawtpekin kibawl khinzo hi. Kumpipa a dingin a baihsa-in kikoih a, a mi halna pen lianin kisangsak a, sing a sangpi-in vum venvan hi. Topa in kaat kuang hu sangkhia ding a, tua mei phualpi tawhkuang ding hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gamah huhna ngen dingin paisuk a, sakol suanin nei-in leengte a tam manin muang a, sakol tung tuangte a hat mahmah manin muang napi-in Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa a suang lo, Topa thu a dong lote in gimna ngah ta hen!","title":"Egypt Mite Mihing, Pasian Hilo"},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah pilin gimna tungsak a, thu a gensate dokkik loin, siatna a bawl mite le mawhna nasep a seppihte gim a pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt mite mihing hi a, Pasian hi lo hi. Amau’ sakolte sa hi a, kha hi lo hi. Topa in a khut a zan ciangin a huhpa pukin, huhna a ngah pa tuk ding a, amaute khempeuh siakhawm ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in keima tungah hih bangin hong ci hi: Humpinelkai ahi a, humpinelkai khanglai a hat mahmah in ahi zongin a sa nek ding a ngik ciangin tua humpi a do dingin tuucing honpi khat kikaikhawmin, amaute’ otna hangin lau tuan hetloin, amaute’ gamlumna hangin a sin a dawi tuan loh mah bangin Vanglian Topa zong Zion Mual tungah galdo dingin kuansuk ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A bu a hongin, a kot lamlam vasate bangin Vanglian Topa in Jerusalem dal ding hi. Amah in dalin khahkhia ding a, amah susia loin suaktasak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel mite aw, nakpitakin na do pa uh’ lamah kihei kik un."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a kuamah peuh in no a dingin na bawlsa uh, mawhna ahi na ngun milimte uh na paihkhiat hun uh hong tung ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Assiria pen mihing’ namsau ahi lo, namsau khat tawh puk ding a, mihing’ namsau ahi lo, namsau khat in susia ding hi. Namsau panin tai ding uh a, a tangvalte uh zawhthawh thu tawh nasem dingin kikoih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amau’ belh a kumpipa uh a launa hangin tai ding a, buaina hangin a uliante in a dialkhai uh taisan ding uh hi,” ama meikuang Zion-ah a om, ama meikhuk Jerusalem khua-ah a om Topa in ci hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, ni khat ni ciangin thuman takin kumpi khat in hong uk ding a, uliante in thutang tawh hong uk ding uh hi.","title":"Thuman Kumpipa"},"2":{"text":"Amaute pen huihpi panin belhna, guahpi panin bukna bang ding uh hi. Sehnel gam sungah a luang tui bang ding uh a, nisa gam sungah a om suangpi liim bang ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amau’ mit in mi cimawhte’ kisapna mu ding uh a, amau’ bil in mi cimawhte’ thugen ngai ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute lungtomin hi phangphang nawn lo ding uh a, deihsakna lungsim tawh a kitel takin thu gen hiathiat ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaite pen mi thupi kici nawn lo ding a, mi ginalote pen mi zahtakhuai kici nawn lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mihai in haina thu gen a, a hoihin gamtat loh ding, Topa ’ thu a hoih lopi-in gen ding, a gilkialte’ an duhna a phat loh nading le a dangtakte in tui dawn ding a neih theih loh nadingin, ama lungsim in mawhna bawl ding a sawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi ginalo’ ginat lohna siahuai mahmah hi. Zuauna kam tawh mizawngte a siasak ding le mi cimawhte’ thu a thuman ciang nangawnin a siasak dingin amah in gitloh nasepna a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin mipi lungsim a nei mi in na a hoihte geel a, thuhoih nate-ah a pang hi."},"9":{"text":"Nuamtakin a om hithiat numeite aw, tho unla, ka aw za un. Nomau’ tumtakin a lungkim tanute aw, ka thugenna na ngai un.","title":"Jerusalem Numeite tungah Thu Kizasakkhol"},"10":{"text":"Nomau’ tumtakin a lungkim numeite aw, kum khat val zek khit ciangin na linglawng ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leenggah kum hong sia ding a, singgah lawhna hun hong tung lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nuamtakin a om hithiat numeite aw, ling un. Nomau tumtakin a lungkimte aw, linglawng un. Na puan uh hawkkhia-in na tangguakun om unla na kawng uhah puanhampi teng un."},"12":{"text":"A hoih mahmah lote le tampi a gah leengguite a siatna, keima mite’ leitangah ling le lingkungte a pona, lungdamna khuapi sungah lungdamna a omna innte a siatna hangin dahin na dip uh hum un.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Kumpi innte kinusia-in, mi tampi a omna kumpi khuapi kilawi ding hi. Mual le tausangte zong kisiagawp ding a, late le tuuhonte in gamtatna munin nei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in ama kha hong puak ding hi. Leitang siate lei hoih suakkik ding a, lo-a ante hoih mahmahin tulak bang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin gam sung mun khempeuhah thutang om ding a, thu a manin kisem ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin thumanna hangin nopna om ding a, thumanna hangin daihna le lungmuan tawntungna om ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka mihingte pen kilem takin a tenna, lungmuang takin a omna, daitakin a tawlngakna munah om ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"(Tua ciangin tulak kolhsiang ding a, a khuapi pen cimzan ding hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Tui tampi a omna-ah khai tuh a, bawngtal le late a ut utna-ah a tasak note pen mi nuamsa na hi uh hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hong kisusia nai lo, mi a susiapa aw, tu-in gimna a ngah ding na hita hi. Kuamah in hong khem nai loh, mi khem pa aw, tu-in gimna a ngah ding na hita hi. Na suksiat nawn loh ciangin nang hong kisusia ding a, na khem nawn loh ciangin nang hong kikhem ding hi.","title":"in Jerusalem Honkhia Ding"},"2":{"text":"Topa aw, kote hong hehpih in; nang kong muang uh hi. A tawntungin kote hong hu inla, lungkham hunin hong honkhia in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma vanging hangin mite tai uh a, nangma thawhtohna hangin minamte kithehthang hi."},"4":{"text":"Tangngol in na a khop bangin amau van kinusiate kaikhawm a, kauphe honpi bangin van tawmin mite phe zaizai hi."},"5":{"text":"A sangna munah teng ahih manin Topa kipahtawi hi. Amah in thutang le thuman tawh Jerusalem dimsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah pen nangma hunte a kipna, hotkhiatna a kicinna, pilna le theihna hi ding hi. Topa kihtakna pen ama sumgum hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"En un, galhangte huhna ngenin kiko uh a, kilemna ding palai semte nakpitakin kap uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Lam lianpite gambulak suak a, kuamah khualzinin pai ngam nawn lo uh hi. Thuciamnate kipeksatin, thukimnasate kipalsat a, khatlekhat kizahtakna om nawn lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitang kinusiacipin om mawk hi. Lebanon muala tulak singte vulgawp a, Sharon gam lei hoihpen sehnel gam bang ta hi. Bashan le Karmel muala singtehte pulhmang khinta hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in minam dangte kiangah, “Tu-in ka gamtang ding a, ka vangliatna ka lak ding hi. Tu-in kei hong kipahtawi ta ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na geelnate uh a kimanna om lo a, na nasepnate uh a mawkna ahi hi. No le no a kisusia na hi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Leikang ngah nadingin suangkang a kihal bangin na vui suak ding uh a, meikhuk sunga a kihaltum lingkungte na bang ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Gamlapi-a a om mite aw, ka sepna thu za un. A nai-a a om mite aw, ka vangliatna thei un."},"14":{"text":"Zion-a a om mawhnei mite lau uh a, Pasian’ thu a ngaihsun lo mite lau-in lingcip uh hi. Amaute in, “Pasian’ thukhenna pen a kuang tawntung mei tawh kibang hi. Tua bang meikuang kua in thuakzo ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Thumanin gamta-in thutang na gen uhleh na suakta ding uh hi. Na vangliatna uh mizawngte khemna-in zang kei unla, sumgolh deih kei un. Mi thah ding le siatna gamtat ding a vaihawmte tawh kipawl kei un."},"16":{"text":"Tua hileh na tangtung ding uh a, kulh muanhuai mahmah sungah a om bangin lungnuam takin na om ding uh hi. Annek tuidawn na kitasam kei ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thupi mahmah kumpipa na mu ding uh a, a zai mahmah a gam zong na en ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Nidangin na kihtak uh gamdangmi siahdongte, siahkhawmte, thukan mite, na phawk nawn kei ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Na theihtheih loh uh, a kitel lo kampau a zang, na teltheih lohun a pau bualbual, mi kihisakte na mu nawn kei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Pawite i bawlna khuapi Zion en un! Daitakin a kitenna mun, a khetphimte kidokkhia ngei loin a khaute a tat ngei lo, a kikhin thei het lo puanbuk a bang, Jerusalem khuapi, na mu ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua khua sungah Topa in ama minthanna vang hong langsak ding a, a zai gunte le a zai lui geite-ah i teng ding hi. Tua tuite tungah ei hong do ding gal gunkuang hong kihot nawn lo ding a, gal teembaw zong hong pai nawn lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa pen eite’ thukhen, Topa pen eite hong ukpa, Topa pen eite’ kumpi ahi hi. Amah in eite hong honkhia ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Gal teembaw khaute kol a, ama omna ding mun sanah gunkuang puan khuam lenkip zo lo a, gunkuang puan kizal thei lo hi. Tua ciangin galte’ neihsate kihawmkeek ding a, khebaite nangawn in van ngah ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"I gamah a teng mite kuamah in, “Ka ci na hi,” ci nawn lo ding uh a, mawhna khempeuh kimaisak ding hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minam khempeuhte aw, thu za dingin hong pai un. Mihingte aw, hong ngai un! Leitang le a tungah a om khempeuhte aw, ngai un. Leitung buppi le a tung panin a hong pai mi khempeuh in ngai un.","title":"Minam Dangte le Edom-te tungah Thangpaihna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh minam khempeuh tungah Topa lunghamin, amaute khempeuh tungah heh mahmah a, a simang dingin amaute koihin, thah dingin a pia khinta hi."},"3":{"text":"A kithat amau’ mite kilawnkhia ding a, a siluang hawmte uih semsem ding hi. Amau’ sisan in mual khempeuh sansak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantunga a om khempeuh muatmang ding a, laidal bangin vantungte kizial ding hi. Leenggui panin a tehte pulhin, theikung panin a tehte a pulh bangin aksi hon khempeuh pulh ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:25; Luk 21:26; Mang 6:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka namsau in vantungah a sep ding khempeuh a zawh khit ciangin, en un, a siamang dinga ka sehsa Edom mite tungah thu a khen dingin hong kumsuk ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in namsau khat nei hi. Sisan tawh kidim ding a, biakpiakna tuuno si le keel si, tuutalte’ kal thau tawh a kizolsak bang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Bozrah khua-ah hih biakpiakna nei ding a, Edom gamah hih bang tampi thahna omsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Gamsial talte amaute tawh tukkhawm ding a, bawngtalno gehsate le bawngtal hatte tukkhawm ding hi. Amau’ gam pen sisan tawh kidiah ding a, amau’ leitang pen sathau in nipsak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Zion a hotkhiat ding, a galte a thuksak ding hun khat a nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Luitui khempeuh kultaltui suak ding a, leitang pen kaat suak ding hi. Gam sung khempeuh pen a kuang kultaltui a suak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Sun le zanin mit lo ding a, vantung lamah a khu kahto ngitnget ding hi. Khang khat pan khang khat, a hawmguakin om ding a, kuamah in nawk ngei nawn het lo ding hi.","ref":"Mang 14:11; 19:3"},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin mu le sakuh in gam sung teng luah ding uh a, keising le va-akte om ding uh hi. Tua gam pen gamsimtham suakin, hawmsuak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpi om lo Gam, ci-in amaute in min phuak ding uh a, a ulian khempeuhte a mawkna hi ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi inn liante sungah lingkung po ding a, kulh a nei khua sungah laho le thangling kungte a po ding hi. Ngiate’ an zonna mun suakin, vasa-kalaohte’ omna mun hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Sangak le ngiate kikhawl ding uh a, keeldawi in a lawmte sam ding hi. Dawi zong hong tuaksukin ama omna ding mun a zong ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua munah keising in bu tomin, tua lai-ah tui-in keuh ding a, ama liimah a note huai ding hi. Musite zong kikhawm tuahin a nupa ciat un om ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa ’ laibu sung panin zong unla hih thu sim un. Hih ganhingte khempeuh khat beek zong mangthang lo ding a, lawm sam khat zong om lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in thu pia khinzo a, amahmah in amaute kaikhawm ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in amaute a dingin leitang hawmsak ding a, amau’ tanh ding ciat a pia ding hi. Amaute in tua gam nei tawntung ding uh a, khang khat pan khang khat dongin teng paisuak ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gamlak le lei keuna gam lungdam ding a, sehnel gam lungdamin palhkhia ding hi. Unok pak bangin","title":"Pasian’ Mite A Ngei Tunkik"},"2":{"text":"tampi takin palhkhia ding a, lungnopna le lasakna tawh lungdam ding hi. Lebanon mual a minthanna, Karmel mual le Sharon mual a minliatna tua leitang in ngah ding hi. Mi khempeuh in Topa ’ minthanna, i Pasian’ liatna mu ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A zaw khutte khauhsak unla, a no khukte kipsak un.","ref":"Heb 12:12"},"4":{"text":"Lungsim patau-in, a lauthawng mite kiangah, “Thakhauh un, lau kei un! En un, na galte uh tungah phu hong laksak dingin Pasian hong pai ding a, amah in note hong honkhia ding hi,” ci un."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin mittawte’ mit kihong ding a, bilngongte’ bil kihong ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin khebai mipa diangin lam ding a, a pau thei lo mipa in lungdamin la sa ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlakah tui hong phulkhia ding a, sehnel gam sungah luitui hong luang ding hi.","ref":"Mat 11:5; Luk 7:22"},"7":{"text":"A sa mahmah sehnelte bualtui hong suak ding a, a keugaw leitang pen ciktui tawh hong kidim ding hi. Ngiate’ omna ngei leitang pen nawngpi suakin, lopa, pumpeeng, le mau, a po ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua lai-ah lam lianpi khat om ding a, Lampi Siangtho kici ding hi. A siang lo mite in tua tung tawn ngei lo ding a, mihaite in tua lam a zui mite khialsak nawn lo ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua lai-ah humpinelkai om lo ding a, sasialne ganhing khat peuhpeuh hong pai lo ding hi. Tua lai-ah ganhing lauhuaite kimu lo ding hi. Topa ’ hotkhiatsa mite in tua lampi tawnin hong ciah ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa ’ hotkhiatsa mite hong ciahkikin, lungdam tawntungna mai pua-in la sa kawmin Jerusalem-ah hong tung ding uh hi. Amaute in lungdamna le kipakna ngah ding uh a, dahna le khuisatna om nawn lo ding hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in a uk zawh kum sawmli le ngana kumin Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib in Judah gam sunga khuapi muanhuai khempeuh simin a la hi.","title":"Sennakherib’ Galsimna (2Kum 18:13-37 ; 2Khang 32:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Lakhish khua panin Assiria kumpipa in Jerusalem khua-a kumpi Hezekiah a lut ding a gen dingin ama nuai-a ulian khat le galkap honpi a sawl hi. Puansawppa’ nasepna phual zuatna lampi-a bual tungnung tui lampi gei-ah a ulianpa a khawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah tawh a kimu dingin Hilkiah’ tapa ahi kumpi innsung a saipa Eliakim le lai-at pa Shebna, le Asaf’ tapa ahi thuciamteh pa Joah hong paikhia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ulianpa in amaute kiangah a genna panin, “Hezekiah kiangah, ‘Kumpi lian ahi Assiria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih na lungmuanna uhah bang siksan na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Kampau lel pen galdo nadingin vaihawmna le vangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam? Kei nong lehdo nadingun kua suang na hi uh hiam?"},"6":{"text":"En un, ama tunga a kingam mipa’ khut a sun ding, a kikuaitansa pumpeeng ciangkhut tawh a kibang Egypt na suang uh hi. Amah a muang khempeuhte’ tungah Egypt kumpipa Faro, tua pumpeeng bang hi lel hi.","ref":"Ezk 29:6-7"},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin note in, “ Topa ka Pasian uh ka suang uh hi,” a ci-a kinei na hih uhleh ama mun sangte le biakna taute Hezekiah in lakhia-in, Judah le Jerusalem tungah, “Hih biakna tau mai-ah na bia ding uh hi,” ci hi lo ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Tu-in hong pai unla, ka topa Assiria kumpipa tawh kiciamna khat bawl un. A tungah a tuang ding mi na ngahzawh nak-uhleh sakol tulnih kong pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt mite’ leengte le sakol galkapte muanna tawh ka topa’ nasemte lak panin a neupen khat ahi galkapmang khat bek nangawn bangci-in notzo ding na hi uh hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Tua tham loin, hih gam a susia dingin Topa ’ thu loin hong pai ka hi hiam? Topa in kei kiangah, “Paito-in hih gam sim inla, susia in,” hong ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Eliakim, Shebna, le Joah in a ulianpa kiangah, “Kote in thei ngawn ka hih manun na nasemte tungah Aram pau tawh hong gen hoh in. Kulh tunga om mite’ zakna-ah Judah pau tawh thu nong gen loh nadingin kong thum hi,” a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahih hangin a ulianpa in, “Hih thute na topa uh le note’ tung bekah gen ding a, amau’ ek mah ne-in amau’ zun mah dawnin note tawh a siakhawm ding kulh tunga a tu mite tungah a gen lo dingin ka topa in hong sawl sa na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ulianpa dingto-in, Judah pau-in nakpitakin kiko a, “Assiria kumpi, kumpi lianpa’ thu za un!"},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in, ‘Amah in note hong honkhia thei lo ding ahih manin Hezekiah’ khemsa-in om kei un."},"15":{"text":"“ Topa in eite hong honkhia taktak ding a, hih khuapi pen Assiria kumpipa khut sungah kipia lo ding hi,” ci-in Hezekiah in hong genna tawh na Topa uh muangkha kei un."},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah’ thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh Assiria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Kei tawh kilemna hong bawl unla kei kiangah hong pai un. Tua hileh kei hong pai-in, note’ gam tawh a kibang gam khat, an le leenggahzu gamah kong koih matengin note khempeuh in nomau’ leenggah ciat, nomau’ theigah ciat, na tuikhuk panun nomau tui ciat na ne ding uh hi.","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Hezekiah in, “ Topa in eite hong honkhia ding hi,” ci-in lam hong khialsak kha ding ahih ciangin kidawm un. Assiria kumpipa’ khutsung panin minam dangte’ pasian khatpeuh in ama gam honkhiazo ngei ahi hiam?"},"19":{"text":"Hamath gam le Arpad gam pasian-te koi-ah om ahi hiam? Sefarvaim gam pasian-te koi-ah om ahi hiam? Amaute in ka khutsung panin Samaria honkhiazo ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Topa in ka khutsung panin Jerusalem khua a hotkhiat nadingin, hih gamte khempeuh’ pasian lakah kua in ka khutsung panin a gam uh honkhiazo ahi hiam?’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahih hangin kumpipa in, “Dawng kei un,” ci-in thu piakhol ahih manin amaute daitakin om uh a, kam khat beek dawng lo uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hilkiah’ tapa ahi kumpi innsung a sai Eliakim, lai-at Shebna le Asaf’ tapa ahi thuciamteh pa Joah in a puan uh balkekin Hezekiah kiangah pai uh a, a ulianpa’ thugen teng a va gen uh hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in a zak ciangin dahin ama puante balkek a, Topa ’ inn sungah a pai hi.","title":"Sennakherib’ kiang panin Judah Kisuaktasak (2Kum 19:1-37 ; 2Khang 32:20-23)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in innsung saipa Eliakim, lai-at pa Shebna, le siampi khangham teng dahna limin puanhampi silh kawmin Amoz’ tapa kamsangpa Isaiah kiangah a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in Isaiah kiangah, “Hezekiah in, ‘Tuni pen lungkham ni, tai ngah ni, mindai ni ahi hi. Naungek a suah hun tung napi-in a hingkhia zo lo nupi tawh i kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"A nungta Pasian a zahko dingin ama topa, Assiria kumpipa in a sawl a ulianpa’ thugente, Topa na Pasian in za hen la, tua bang thu a gente gim pia tahen.
