Amaute pen Topa in thupha a piak mite hi, ci-in a mu mi khempeuhte in thei-in sang ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa ’ hangin nakpitakin ka lungdam ding a, ka Pasian’ hangin kipakin ka diang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh zipi pa puanhoih tawh kizemin, mothak nu a suangmanphate tawh a kizep mah bangin amah in hotkhiatna puan kei hong silhsakin, thumanna puanpi tawh kei hong tuam khin hi.","ref":"Mang 21:2"},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung in a dawn meengsakin, huan in a kituhte a posak mah bangin Topa Pasian in minam khempeuh mai-ah thumanna le phatna a pokhia sak hi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion a kihotkhiatna thu khuavak bangin a taankhiat mateng, ama gualzawhna thu meivak kuang bangin a taankhiat matengin, Zion ka ngaihsutna-in gamdai takin ka om mawk kei ding a, Jerusalem ka ngaihsutna-in ka khawl mawk kei ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Minamte in na gualzawhna mu ding uh a, kumpi khempeuh in na minthanna mu ding uh hi. Topa in nang a hong phuah min thak tawh nang hong kisam ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang pen Topa a dingin hotkhiatna lukhu, na Pasian a dingin kumpi lukhu tawh na kibang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang pen a kinusia, hong kici nawn lo ding a, na leitang pen Gamkhing, kici nawn lo ding hi. Nang pen ama tungah ka lungkimna om, hong kici ding a, na leitang pen a Kitenpih, kici ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang tungah Topa lungkim a, na leitang pen a kitenpih zi tawh kibang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tangval in nungak khat a tenpih mah bangin nang hong lam pa in nang hong tenpih ding a, zipi pa mothak nu tungah a lungdam mah bangin nang tungah na Pasian lungdam ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, na kulhte tungah galvilte ka koih khin a, sun tawntung le zan tawntungin amaute gamdai ngei lo ding uh hi. Amaute in a thuciamna Topa phawksak ding uh a, amah in Jerusalem kipsakin leitung mite’ phat dingin a bawlkik matengin amaute khawl lo ding uh hi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Topa in limtakin thuciamna bawl khinzo a, a vangliatna tawh tungsak ding hi. “Na galte’ an dingin na ante ka piakik nawn kei ding a, nangma sepsa leenggahzu gamdang mite in dawn nawn lo ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin an a kholte in ne-in Topa na phat ding uh a, a kaikhawmte in keima biakinn huang sungah a dawn ding uh hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem mite aw, kulhkongpite panin paikhia unla a hong ciahkik na mipihte uh a dingin lam bawlkhol un. Lam zik un; lam lianpi zikin suangtumte paikhia unla, mite’ muh dingin lim khat khaito un."},"11":{"text":"Leimong dongah Topa taangko khin hi. Jerusalem mite tungah, “En un, no hong honkhia pa hong pai hi. Ama sep thaman a mite hong pua a, a gualzawhna thaman a mite hong masuan hi,” ci un.","ref":"Isa 40:10; Mang 22:12"},"12":{"text":"Amaute pen A Siangtho Mi, Topa ’ Hotkhiatte kici ding a, nang pen a Kizongkhia, a kinusia lo khuapi, hong kici ding hi."}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Edom gam, Bozrah khua panin puan ausan silhin a hong pai, a puansilhna-ah minthanna mel nei-in, ama thahatna tawh a hong pai pa kua ahi hiam? A honkhiazo dingin hatna a nei, gualzawhna thu a zasak dingin a hong pai pa pen Topa ahi keimah ka hi hi.","title":"Phulak Ni"},"2":{"text":"Bang hangin na puan san a, na puansilhte, leenggah cilna-ah leenggah a cil pa’ puan tawh kibang ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Mite lak panin kuamah in kei hong huh lo a, keimah guak in leenggah cil bangin minam dangte ka cil hi. Sinsona tawh amaute ka cil a, hehna tawh amaute ka tuancil hi. Ka puan tungah amaute’ si hong kithehgawp a, ka puan khempeuh tungah sisan hong baang khin hi.","ref":"Mang 14:20; 19:13,15"},"4":{"text":"Ka mite ka hotkhiat ding hunta ka sa a, a galte uh gimpiak ding a hun hita hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi."},"5":{"text":"Hong huh ding mi ka zong a, ahi zongin kuamah om lo hi. Kei a hong huh ding a om loh ciangin lamdang ka sa hi. Ahi zongin ka hehna in hong thahatsak a, kei mahmah thahatna tawh ka gualzo hi.","ref":"Isa 59:16"},"6":{"text":"Ka sinsona tawh minam dangte cilin, ka hehna hangin amaute zukham ka bangsak a, amaute’ sisan leilakah ka thehthang hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"7":{"text":"Topa ’ itna kip, Topa phatnate, Topa in eite tungah a hong piak khempeuh tawh a kizui leh, ama hehpihna le a lianpi ama itna kip tawh a kizui-in amaute tunga a piak, Israel innkuan tungah ama hoihna lianpite ka gengen ding hi.","title":"Israel’ tungah Hoihna"},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in, “Amaute pen keima mi taktak hi a, amaute in kei hong khem lo ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin a lungkhamna panun amaute a honkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Vantung mite’ hotkhiat hi loin, Topa mahmah in amaute honkhia hi. A itna le a hehpihna tawh amaute honkhia a, amah in a beisa hun khempeuhah amaute hoihtakin a kem hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in lehdo uh a, ama kha siangtho a dahsak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pen amaute’ gal suak a, amahmah in amaute a do hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in hun lui lai, ama nasem Moses’ hun a phawk uh hi. Ama mi a makaite honkhia-in, tuipi sung panin a paikhiatpih Topa koi-ah omta ahi hiam? Amaute’ tungah ama kha a piapa,"},"12":{"text":"Moses tungtawnin a vangliatna zangin na lianpipi a sempa, ama mite’ mai-ah tuite khenkhamin, a minthan’ tawntung nadingin hih bang nate a sempa, tu-in koi-ah omta ahi hiam, ci uh hi.","ref":"Pai 14:21"},"13":{"text":"Topa in tuithuk kantanin amaute a paipih ciangin leilak a sakol pai bangin kip mahmah uh a, amaute puk lo uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Lonona kuamsung a zuansuk bawngte bangin Topa in amaute tawldamna a pia hi. Tua bangin Topa in a mite lamlak ahih manin ama min thang tawntung hi."},"15":{"text":"A siangtho, a minthang, nangma omna vantung panin hong ensuk inla hong mu in. Nangma deihsakna le na vangliatna koi-ah omta ahi hiam? Na lungsim’ deihna le nangma hehpihna kote a dingin maimangta hi.","title":"Hehpihna le Huhna Ngetna"},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh, Abraham in kote hong huh loin, Israel in kote hong phawk loh hangin nang pen kote’ Pa na hi hi. Topa aw, nang pen kote’ Pa na hi a, nangmah in tanglai pek pan kote a hong honkhia pa na hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa aw, kote in nang kong kihtak loh theih nadingun bang hangin na lampi panin kote hong pialsakin ka lungsim uh khauhsak na hi hiam? Nangma nasemte, nangma luah minamte na ngaihsutna-in hong kihei kik in."},"18":{"text":"Nangma mi siangthote in tawlkhat sung bek na biakinn nei a, ko hong langpangte in tua na biakinn pen tuancilgawp khinta hi."},"19":{"text":"Kote pen nangmah in cikmahin na uk ngei loh mite, nangma mi ahi ngei lo mite tawh a kibang ka suakkhin uh hi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma langte tungah na min na theihsakna ding le nangma omna-ah minamte lau-in a lin nadingin mei in selkeu kuangsakin mei in tui a sosak bangin nangma mai-ah mualte a lin nadingin bang hangin na vangliatna tawh vantung balkekin hong paisuk lo na hi hiam?","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Kote’ lamet lohpi-in nang hong pai-in a lauhuai nate na bawl ngei a, na mai-ah mualte a ling hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah a ngakte a dingin na a sempa’ thu tanglai pek panin kuamah in thei ngei lo, kuama bil in za ngei lo a, kuama mit in nang simloh Pasian dang mu ngei lo uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 2:9"},"5":{"text":"Thuman nasep lungdam takin a semte, nangma deih bangin a nungtate, nangmah in na limbawl hi. Kote tungah nang na heh a, ahi zongin kote ka khial lai veve uh hi. Tanglai pek a kipanin ka mawh ngitnget uh hi. A tua bangpi mahin kote hong kihon ding ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Kote khempeuh mawhnei mi ka hi khin uh a, ka gamtat hoih khempeuh uh zong puannin tawh kibanglai veve hi. Kote khempeuh singteh bangin ka vul uh a, ka mawhna hangun huih letkhiat nahthel keu ka bang uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin nangmah a hong pom dingin a hanciam tawm, nangma min a lo kuamah om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kote kiang panin nang in na maitang na seel a, mawhna khut sungah kote na hong pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa aw, nang pen kote’ Pa na hi hi. Kote pen tungman bang hi-in, nang pen beelseek pa bang na hi a, kote khempeuh nangma bawl mite ka hi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa aw, nakpitakin sinso kei inla, mawhna ciamtehteh kei in. Kote khempeuh nangma mi ka hihna uh hong ngaihsun in."},"10":{"text":"Nangma khuapi siangthote gamlak suak khinta a, Zion zong gamlakpi suak a, Jerusalem khua gamkhing a suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Kote’ inn a siangtho le a hoihte, ka pate un nangmah hong phatna munte mei in kang khin a, kote’ mun nuam khempeuh a sia suak khinta hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa aw, hih thute-ah nangmah ki-ipcip niloh ding na hi hiam? Nang daitakin om dide-in nakpitakin kote hong gimsak ding na hi hiam?"}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima mite’ thungetna a pia dingin a baihsa-in kei om napi-in, amaute in hong ngen lo uh hi. Amaute’ muh dingin kei om napi-in, amaute in hong zong beek lo uh hi. Minamte tungah, “Hih lai-ah om ing, hih lai-ah om ing,” ci-in a dawng pah dingin kiging napi-in, amaute in kei tungah thu hong ngen lo uh hi.","title":"A Lehdote Gimpiakna","ref":"Rom 10:20"},"2":{"text":"A hoih loin gamta-in, amau’ deih bang a zui teitei mite,","ref":"Rom 10:21"},"3":{"text":"ka maitangah a tawntungin kei hong hehsak denin, biakna huan sungah biakpiakna bawlin dawibiakna tau tungah paknamtui a hal mite,"},"4":{"text":"han sungah tu-in, mun simthamah zanin misite thu a dong mite, voksa ne-in amau’ beel sungah dawibiakna sa mehtui a koih mite,"},"5":{"text":"“Note kiang panin kote hong kituamkoih ahih manin kihemkhia unla, ko kiangah hong pai kei un,” ci-in midangte tungah a gen mite - hih bang mite khempeuh a sang dingin a beisa hun sungah ka kiging tawntung hi. Hih bang mite ka thuakzo nawn kei hi. Amaute tungah ka hehna pen a mit ngei lo meikuang tawh kibang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in amaute gimpiak ding ka khentat khin a, amaute’ thuak dingte lai sungah kiciamteh khin hi. Amau’ mawhnate ka mawk koih kei ding a, amau’ mawhna le a pu a pate uh mawhnate ka thukkik ding hi. Amaute in mual liante tungah paknamtui halin, mual neute tungah hong simmawh uh ahih manin amau’ gamtatna tawh kizui-in ka thuk ding hi, ci hi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Leenggahzu pen leenggah bom panin kingah a, mite in, ‘Tuate kimang thei ding ahih ciangin susia kei un,’ a cih mah bangun kei zong a minam bupun susia loin, keima na hong semte ka suaktasak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Jakob sung panin Judah minamte thupha ka pia ding a, amau’ suanlekhakte in mualtung gam a luah ding uh hi. Keima na hong sem, keima teel mite, tua gamah teng ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong bia ding uh a, Sharon gam pen amau’ tuuhon gamtatna mun suaksak ding uh a, Akhor Kuam pen amau’ bawng honte’ lupna mun a suaksak ding uh hi.","ref":"Josh 7:24-26"},"11":{"text":"“Ahih hangin kei a hong nusia, ka mual siangtho a mangngilh, Gad pasian a dingin sabuai phahin, Meni pasian a dingin zu helsa hai sungah a dim note pen,"},"12":{"text":"namsau tawh a si dingin ka hong seh ding a, hong that dingte’ mai-ah na ngawng uh na dawh ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kong sap ciangin note in nong dawng kei uh a, thu ka gen ciangin nong ngai kei uh hi. Keima thu man loh ding mah na utzaw uh a, a sia na gamta uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: En un, ka nasemte in ne ding uh a, ahih hangin note na gilkial ding uh hi. Ka nasemte in dawn ding uh a, ahih hangin note na dangtak ding uh hi. Ka nasemte lungdam ding uh a, ahih hangin note na maizum ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka nasemte in lungdamin la sa ding uh a, note in lungsim na sa-in kiko-in, lungsim gimna hangin na tau ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima teel mite in samsiatna-in na min uh zang ding uh a, Topa Pasian in note hong that ding hi. Ahih hangin ama nasemte pen min dang a phuah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitungah thupha a kipiak ding a ngen pa in thuman Pasian min tawh thupha a kipiak ding ngen ding a, leitungah thuciamna a lapa in thuman Pasian min tawh a ciam ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a beisa huna haksatnate khempeuh kimangngilh khinta a, tuate beimang khinta hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tu-in vantung thakte le leitung thak ka piangsak hi. A beisa thute kiciamteh nawn lo ding a, kiphawkkha nawn lo ding hi.","title":"Van Thak le Lei Thak","ref":"Isa 66:22; 2Pe 3:13; Mang 21:1"},"18":{"text":"Keima piansaksa sungah lungdamin kipakin om tawntung un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Jerusalem khuapi lungdamna khua-in bawlin, a mite a lungnuam dingin ka bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem’ hangin ka lungdam ding a, ka mite’ hangin ka kipak ding hi. Tua khua sungah kahna aw le cimawhin kikona aw om nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Mang 21:4"},"20":{"text":"Naupangte a ngeksih om lo ding a, sauveipipi kinungta ding hi. Kum za bek a nungtate a khansihin kingaihsun ding a, kum za cing loin a site, keima gimpiakna lim hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute in inn lam ding uh a, a sungah teng ding uh hi. Amaute in leenggui lo bawl ding uh a, a gah ne ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute in inn lam ding uh a, tua inn-ah midang teng, cih om nawn lo ding hi. Amaute in leenggui suanin adang khat in ne, cih om lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keima mite’ nuntak hun pen singkung khat nuntak tan bang sawt ding a, keima teel mite in amau’ khut tawh a sepsa nate lungdamin nesuak ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in a mawk nadingin na sem lo ding uh a, lungkham nadingin ta nei lo ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen Topa ’ thupha piak, suanlekhakte hi ding uh a, amau’ tate amaute tawh nungta khawm ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute in hong sap ma-in ke’n ka dawng ding a, amaute in thu a gen laitakin ke’n ka za ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Keivom le tuuno in an nekhawm ding uh a, humpinelkai in bawngtal bangin buhkung ne ding hi. Leivui pen gulpi’ an hita ding a, mite hong tu nawn lo ding hi. Keima mual siangtho tung tengah amaute kiliamsak lo ding uh a, kisusia lo ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:6-9"}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung pen keima tokhom hi a, leitung pen keima khengakna ahi hi. Kei a dingin koi lai-ah inn lam ding a, keima tawlngakna ding mun koi lai ahi hiam?","title":"Thukhenna le Zion’ Mailam Daupaina","ref":"Mat 5:34-35; 23:22"},"2":{"text":"Hih nate khempeuh keima bawlsa ahih manin hih nate khempeuh keima-a’ ahi hi, Topa in ci hi. Ahih hangin kiniamkhiatin, lungsim a kitamzan mipa, keima thu-ah lau-in a ling kelkel pa, keima deih mipa ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:49-50"},"3":{"text":"Biakna-in bawngtal a gopa in mihing zong that hi. Biakpiakna-in tuuno a gopa in ui ngawng zong at hi. An tawh biakpiakna a bawlpa in vok si zong pia hi. Paknamtui tawh phawkna biakpiakna a bawlpa in milim zong bia-in thupha a pia hi. Hih mite amau ut bang ciatin gamta uh a, amau’ kihhuai gamtatna uhah nuam a sa uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amaute tungah gimna ka tungsak ding a, amau’ kihtak thute mah amau’ tungah ka tungsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sap ciangin kuamah in hong dawng lo uh a, thu ka gen ciangin kuamah in hong ngai lo uh hi. Keima thu man loh ding mah utzaw uh a, a sia-in gamta uh hi, a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama thu-ah lau-in a ling mite aw, Topa ’ thu za un: Keima tungah note nong cihtakna hangun na mipihte uh pawlkhat in note hong mudahin hong hawlkhia ding uh a, zahpihna tawh note hong hopihin, “Lungdamin na om ding uh hong deihsak ka hih manun, Topa in ama liatna hong lak hen la, note hong honkhia ta hen,” hong ci vial ding uh hi. Hih banga hong paute pen mindaina a thuak ding mite ahi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngai un, khuapi sunga gamlumna! Biakinn sunga awging! Topa in a galte gim a piakna huging ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka khuapi siangtho pen nausuak natna a thuak ma-in nau a suak nupi tawh kibang a, nausuak gimna a tun ma-in amah in tapa khat a nei hi.","ref":"Mang 12:5"},"8":{"text":"A tuaci bang kua’n za ngei na hi uh hiam? A tuaci bang kua’n mu ngei na hi uh hiam? Ni khat thu-in gam khat piang ngei ahi hiam? Tomnokhat sungin minam khat piangkhia ngei ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh Zion in nausuak gimna a thuak phetin a minamte suakkhia pah hi."},"9":{"text":"Nausuah hun tungsak napi-in suaksak lo ding ka hi hiam, Topa in ci hi. Nau a suakkhiasak keimah in naugil khakcip ding ka hi hiam, na Pasian in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Naungek in a nu’ nawi teepin nuam a sak mah bangin, Jerusalem in nuam a sakna ah nuam na sakkhawm theih nadingun amah a it khempeuhte aw, Jerusalem tawh lungdam unla, ama hangin kipak un. Ama hangin kapin a thum khempeuhte aw, ama lungdamna ah amah tawh lungdam khawm un, a ci hi.","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Tu-in gunpi bangin nopsakna le tuiletkhia bangin minamte’ hauhna ama tungah ka tungsak ding hi. Note pen a nu’ nawi teepin, a ang-ah kipua a, a khuk tungah a diang naungek na bang ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A nu in a ta a hehnep bangin note kong hehnem ding a, note in Jerusalem khua sungah hehnepna na ngah ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih thu a hong piang na muh uh ciangin na lungdam ding uh hi. Note hong thahatsakin hong cidamsak ding hi. Tua ciangin ka thu hong mangte ka huhna, ka galte tungah ka hehna ka lahna thu na thei ding uh hi, ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh heh mahmahna tawh ama sinsona le meikuang tawh gim a pia dingin meikuang sungah Topa hong pai ding a, huihpi bangin a leengte hong pai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in mei tawh thukhenna sem ding a, a mawh mi khempeuh tungah a namsau tawh thu khen ding a, Topa in a thah mite tam mahmah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Biakna huan sungah a pai dingin amaute kisiansuahin a kisiangthosak, a laizang a om pen a zuite, voksa le kihhuaina le zusa a nete beimang khawm ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ nasepnate le amau’ ngaihsutnate ka thei a, minam khempeuh a khawm dingin ka hong pai hi. Amaute hong pai-in ka minthanna mu ding uh a,"},"19":{"text":"amaute’ lakah lim khat ka khai ding hi. Amau’ sung panin, minamte tung, Tarshish mite tung, Put mi le Lud mite tung, Meshek mite tung, Tubal mi le Javan mite tung, ka min hoihna a za ngei lo, ka minthanna a mu ngei lo tuipi gei-a om gam mite tungah a suakta lai mite ka sawl ding hi. Amaute in minamte lakah ka minthanna genthang ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel mite in beel siangtho sungah an tawh amau biakpiakna tawi-in Topa ’ biakinn-ah hong paipih uh mah bangin amaute in minam khempeuh lak panin Topa ’ tungah piak dingin na sanggamte khempeuh uh, sakolte, leengte, taalte, le late, kalaoh hatte tungah hong pua-in ka mual siangtho Jerusalem-ah hong paipih ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute kimkhat zong, siampite le Levi mite a suak dingin ka la ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka bawl ding vantung thak le leitung thak pen ahihleh keima mai-ah kip ding hi. Tua mah bangin na suan na khakte uh le na min uh kip ding hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 65:17; 2Pe 3:13; Mang 21:1"},"23":{"text":"Khadet khat pan Khadet khat, keimah bia dingin Jerusalem-ah mi khempeuh hong pai ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute a ciah uh ciangin kei hong lehdo mite’ luanghawmte en ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau a ne thante si ngei loin, amau a kihalna mei mit ngei lo ding a, amaute pen mi khempeuh’ kih hi ding hi, a ci hi.","ref":"Mrk 9:48"}}}}},"24":{"info":{"name":"Jeremiah","shortname":"Jer","abbr":[],"desc":"Kamsang Jeremiah pen B.C. kum za sagihna beikuan lam leh kum za gukna kipatlam kikal sungah a nungta mi ahi hi. Pasian' mite in milim a biakna leh a mawhna uh hangin a minam bup uh tungah gimna hong tung ding hi, ci-in sauveipi na a sep sungin a hilhkhol hi. A genkholh thute a tun'na thu a mit tawh mu a, Babylon kumpi Nebukhadnezzar' khut sungah Jerusalem khuapi a kiatna, a khuapi leh biakinn a siatna, Judah kumpipa leh mi tampi tak, Babylon-ah salin a paina thu ama hin' lai-in a piang ahi hi. Ni khat ni ciangin salsuahna panin a hong ciahkikna ding uh leh amau minam a kipatphat kikna ding uh thu zong a genkhol hi. Jeremiah Laibu sungah a om thute a nuai-a bangin kikhen thei hi. 1. Jeremiah a kisapna. 2. Judah gam a uk Josiah, Jehoiakim, Jehoiakhin, leh Zedekiah hun laitakin Judah minam leh amau a ukte tungah Pasian' kiang panin hong pai thute. 3. Jeremiah' lai-atpa Baruk in a ciamteh thu sung panin thugenna tuamtuamte leh Jeremiah nuntakna sungah a piang thu lian tuamtuamte. 4. Gamdang minam a tuamtuamte thu tawh kisai Topa' genna. 5. Jerusalem khuapi a pukna leh Babylon-ah salin a paina uh tawh kisai tangthu behlapna. Jeremiah pen a mite a it mahmah, a lungsim a kitoklo baih mi khat hi a, mite tungah gimna thukhenna thu a gen nuam hetlo khat ahi hi. Pasian in kamsang nasem dingin a sapna hangin gimna a thuakna thute a lungsim a sukkhak mahmahna tawh mun tampi-ah a gen hi. Pasian' thugente a lungsimah meikuang bang a, imcip zolo hi. Jeremiah Laibu sungah kam thupi pen pawlkhat in, a lungkhamhuai Jeremiah' nuntak hun khit ciangin Pasian' thuciamnate amau' lungtang tungah kigelh ding ahih manin, amaute a hilh, a phawksak kik ding sia kulloin Pasian' mite in a zuih ding uh thuciamna thak a om ding hun gen a, 31:31-34 sungah kiciamteh hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin gam Anathoth khua-a siampi khat ahi Hilkiah’ tapa Jeremiah’ thugente hih bang ahi hi.","title":"Jeremiah A Kisapna le A Kisawlna"},"2":{"text":"Amon’ tapa Josiah, Judah gamah kumpi a suahzawh kum sawm le kum thum a cin kumin ‘ Topa in Jeremiah a hopih hi.","ref":"2Kum 22:3-23:27; 2Khang 34:8-35:19"},"3":{"text":"Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah ciangin Topa in Jeremiah a hopih leuleu hi. Tua khit ciangin Josiah’ tapa Zedekiah kumpi a suahzawh kum sawm le kum khat a phak kum, a kha ngana, Jerusalem khua mite sal tang dingin a kipuakkhiat dong tam veipi a hopihpih hi.","ref":"2Kum 23:36—24:7,18; 25:21; 2Khang 36:5-8,11-21"},"4":{"text":"Topa in kei hong hopih a,"},"5":{"text":"“Gil sungah kong bawl ma-in nang kong thei khinzo hi. Na suah ma-in nang kong teelkhia khinzo a, minam dangte tungah kamsang dingin kong koih khinzo hi,” hong ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ah, Topa Pasian aw, kei thugen ka siam kei a, naupang khat ka hi lel hi,” ka ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in, “‘Naupang khat ka hi lel hi,’ ci kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh kong puakna khempeuhte kiangah na pai ding a, kong sawl peuhpeuh na gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute kihta kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah a hong hu dingin ka hong ompih hi, Topa in kong ci hi,” hong ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in a khut tawh hong zam phei-in ka muk hong lawnsakin hong hopih hi. “En in, ka thute na kam sungah kong koih khinzo hi."},"10":{"text":"Gam khempeuh le kumpi khempeuhte’ tungah a botkhia ding le a phelkhia dingin ahi zongin, a susia ding le a lawnkhia dingin ahi zongin, a lam ding le a phut dingin ahi zongin, tuni-in za, nang kong piazo hi,” hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah, “Jeremiah aw, bang mu na hi hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, “Ngak, a kici almond singhiang khat ka mu hi,” ci-in ka dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Na man hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka thugente ka tangtunsak nadingin kei zong ka ngak hi,” hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in a nihveina hong hopih leuleu a, “Bang na mu hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, “Beel a so khat ka mu a, leilu lam panin hong awnsuk hi,” ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Leilu lam panin hih gammi khempeuhte’ tungah siatna hong sosuk ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu lamah a om gam khempeuh keimah in ka sam a, amaute hong pai-in Jerusalem khua kongpite-ah ahi zongin, khua kimkota kulh kiimte-ah ahi zongin, Judah gam khuapi khempeuh kiimte-ah ahi zongin a kumpi tokhomte uh hong phut ciat ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka mite in kei hong taisan uh ahih manin a mawhna uh hangin amau’ tungah thu ka khen ding hi; pasian dangte tungah meihal biakna pia uh a, a khut uh tawh a bawlsa uh milimte a bia uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Jeremiah aw, kithawi in. Pai inla kong sawl khempeuh amaute kiangah va gen in. Amaute kihta kei in; na kihtak leh amau’ mai-ah kong lausakzaw lai ding hi."},"18":{"text":"En in, hih gambup langah a ding ding, Judah kumpite, uliante, siampite le hih gammi khempeuh langah a pang dingin tuni-in nang, khuapi muanhuai khat bang ahi zongin, sikkhuampi khat bangin ahi zongin, sumngo kulhpi khat bangin ahi zongin ka hong bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in nang’ langkhatah hong do ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a hong zo kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kong cihin-ah, nangmah a hong hu dingin ka hong ompih ding hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong hopih a,","title":"in a Tawtolh Israel Mite Zol"},"2":{"text":"“Pai inla, Jerusalem khuamite’ zak dingin va taangko in. Topa in kong cihin-ah: Na khangno lai-a nong kipiakna, na mothak lai-a nong itna, a kikho nai lo gamlakah kei’ nung nong zuih lai hun ka phawk hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mite pen Topa a dingin a tuam om hi a, ama anlakna ah a anpalte ahi uh hi. Amaute a ne peuhpeuh a mawh suak uh a, gimna a thuak uh hi, Topa in hong ci hi, ci-in va gen in,” hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jakob suan le Israel innkuan khempeuhte aw, Topa’ kammal ngai dih un."},"5":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Na pute na pate uh kei kiang panin gamlapi-ah paikhia-in, bangmahin a kimang lo milim peuh bia-in, amau mahmah zong bangmahin a kimang lo a suah khit nadingun kei tungah bang mawhna hong mu uh ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Amaute in, ‘Egypt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpihin sehnel lak le dum lak, lei keu lak le a lauhuai khuamial bekbak lak, kuama pai ngei lohna mun, kuama ten lohna gamlakah a hong makaih Topa koi-ah om ahi hiam?’ ci beek lo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Singgah le a hoih nate na nek theih nadingun an tamna munah kong tunpih hi. Ahih hangin no nong pai uh ciangin ka gam na ninsak uh a, ka neihsa leitang a kihhuai mun na suaksak tazen uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Siampite in, ‘ Topa koi-ah om ahi hiam?’ ci-in dong lo uh hi. Thukham a theite nangawn in kei hong thei lo uh hi. Kei tungah kumpi uliante hong khial khin uh a, kamsangte in Baal min tawh thu genin kimanna a nei lo milimte a bia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin Topa in kong cihin-ah, note kong mawhsaklai ding a, na tate uh’ tate zong ka mawhsak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nitumna lamah Saipras tuikulh mong dong kantan unla va en dih un. Nisuahna lamah Kedar gamah mi sawl unla limtakin kan dih un; tua bang thu a piang ngei peuhmah hiam, en dih un."},"11":{"text":"Gam khat peuhpeuh in pasian ahi taktak beek lo a pasian-te uh nangawn a khek ngei peuhmah uh hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in a minthanna uh ahi keimah, bangmahin a kimang lo na peuh tawh hong khek tazen uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua thu phawk unla lau un; vantungte aw, dah mahmah unla ling un, Topa in kong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mite in mawhna nam nih a bawlzo uh hi. Nuntakna ciktui ahi keimah a hong taisanzo uh hi. Tuikhuk totawm uh a, a tuikhuk tawh uh keu-in, tui a vung thei kei hi."},"14":{"text":"“Israel sal ahi hiam? Sila namte ahi zenzen hiam? Hilo ahihleh bang hangin a galte in luhgawpzo ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Humpinelkai bangin a galte in amah hawksan uh a, nakpitakin a hawkgawp uh hi. A gam uh gam simtham a suah uh a, a khuapite uh cimin kuamah teng lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tham loin, Memfis le Tahpanhes mite in zong a luguh a suktapsak zo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel aw, Topa na Pasian in lampi-ah hong makaih laitakin amah na nusiat manin nang tungah hih bang teng hong tung hi lo ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Tu-in Egypt gamah nang na pai manin bang phattuamna ngah ding na hi hiam? Nail gun tui a va dawn lel ding na hi hiam? Assiria gamah na pai manin bang phattuamna ngah ding na hi hiam? Eufratis gun tui a va dawn lel ding na hi hiam?"},"19":{"text":"Na gitlohna mah in nangmah hong thuhilh ding a, kei na hong up nawn lohna in nangmah hong mawhsak ding hi. Topa na Pasian nong nusia a, keimah nong kihtak nawn loh ciangin, nuam hetloin kha velval hi, cih thu thei inla mu in, Vanglian Topa Pasian in ka hong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"“Sawtpek lai a kipanin ka hakkol kuaitanin ka ukna nong nial a, hong kihenna khau sutatin, ‘Na na ka sem kei ding hi,’ na hong ci hi. Numei paktatte na bang uh a, mual sang tung teng le sing liim nuai tengah milim na bia kawikawi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A kiteelteel leenggui ci hoihte bangin nang kong suankik zo a, ahih hangin nang kisia kikin bang hangin leenggah gui a hoih lote na suakkik na hi hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Vuttui tawh kisilin satpiang tampi na zang zongin na mawhna nin ka mu lai veve hi, Topa Pasian in kong ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangci bangin nangmah in, ‘Kei ka nin kei hi. Baal pasian-te’ nung ka zui kei hi,’ bang hangin ci thei ding na hi hiam? Mualkuam zangah a om na lampi totte ento inla, na hihsate mu dih in. A suktai a totai kawikawi kalaoh huk na bang tazen hi."},"24":{"text":"Gamlak nuam a sa, lano hukte na bang tazen hi. A huk laitakin kua in khamzo ding ahi hiam? Amah a hih nuam peuhpeuh in haksa loin, a ut hunhunin a ngah lel ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Na khe guakin lam pai kei inla, na dang taaksak kei in, kong cih hangin, nangmah in, ‘Bang phamawh ahi hiam? Gamdang pasian-te ka it a, amau’ nung ka zui ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"26":{"text":"“Guta khatpeuh a kimat ciangin a zum bangin, Israel mite, a kumpite, a uliante, a siampite, le a kamsangte uh zong a maizum ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute in singtawng khat kiangah, ‘Nang pen ka pasian na hi hi,’ ci uh a, suangtum khat kiangah, ‘Ka pianna ka nu na hi hi,’ peuh a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kei hong nungngatin hong maingat lo uh hi. Ahih hangin haksatna a tuah uh ciangin, ‘Tho inla hong hon in,’ hong ci uh hi."},"28":{"text":"“Note-a’ dinga na bawl uh na pasian-te uh koi-ah om ahi hiam? Haksatna na tuah uh ciangin a hong hon thei ahihleh kihonsak ta un; bang hang hiam cih leh Judah gam aw, na khuapi zahzah uh pasian na nei tazen uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Kei na hong mawhsakna uh bang thu teng tawh ahi hiam? Na vekpi-un kei nong langpan’ khin uh hi, Topa in kong ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Na tate uh thuhilhin ka sat hangin a mawkna suakzo ta hi. Amaute kibawlpha tuan lo uh hi. Humpinelkai hawk bangin na namsaute un na kamsangte uh a that khinzo uh hi."},"31":{"text":"No Israel mite aw, Topa’ kammal limtakin ngai dih un. Israel-te a dingin gamlak tawh kibang ngei ka hi hiam? A mial mahmah gam tawh kibang ngei ka hi hiam? Tua ahihleh bang hangin ka mite in, ‘Ko ka suakta uh hi; nang kiangah kong pai nawn kei ding uh hi,’ ci uh ahi hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Nungak khat in a kizepnate mangngilh thei ahi hiam? A kipi mothak in a mothak puante mangngilh thei ahi hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in simzawh loh ni tampi sung a hong mangngilh uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Na lawm ngaih ding na zon siam mahmah a, numei gilote nangawn a zia na hilh thei zen hi."},"34":{"text":"Mawhnei lo mizawngte’ sisan na puan tungah baang hi. Amaute in na inn hong luhngei beek lo uh hi. “Tua bang teng hinapi-in"},"35":{"text":"nang in, ‘Kei ka mawh kei hi, kei tungah Pasian heh nawn lo hi,’ na ci hi. En in, ‘Kei ka mawh kei hi,’ na cih manin nang tungah thu kong khen ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Bang hangin na lungsim kheel ziauziau na hi hiam? Assiria in nang hong maizumsak ngei bangin Egypt-te in zong nang hong maizumsak ding uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Nangmah zong tua gam panin maizumna tawh na lu tungah vut khusa-in nong paikhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah Topa in na muan mite ka nialzo hi; amaute’ hangin na gualzo ngei kei ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khat in a zi ma hen la, tua nu in zong amah nusia-in, midang khat’ zi va suak leh, a pasal masa in tua nu lakik thei ding ahi hiam? Nang pen numei paktat suakin mi tampi tak tawh kingai khinzo napi-in, tu-in kei kiang hong zuankik ding na hi hiam, Topa in kong ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Khuadak inla mualsang dawnte en dih in. Hong kilup khoppih lohna mun koi laitakah om ahi hiam? Arab mite in a suam dingun gamlakah mi a ngak uh bangin lam gei-ah tu-in na luppih ding mi na ngak hi. Na paktatna le na gitlohna tawh hih gam na ninsakzo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hang mahin guahtui kikangsak a, guah nunung hong zu lo hi. Ahi zongin numei paktatte tawh a kibang hinapi-in na maizum thei kei lailai hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tumahin kei nong sam a, ‘Ka pa aw, ka neulai pek pan ka lawm na hi hi"},"5":{"text":"nang keima tungah heh tawntung ding na hi hiam? En in, tua bang na cih hangin, siatna na hih theih khempeuh na hih khinzo hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpi Josiah in a uk laitakin Topa in kei hong hopih a, “A zulhzau Israel, mualsang tung khempeuhah pai-in singliim nuai khempeuhah numei paktat bangin a om kawikawina na mu khinzo hiam?","title":"Israel le Judah A Kisikkik Kul","ref":"2Kum 22:1-23:30; 2Khang 34:1-35:27"},"7":{"text":"Hih teng a hih khit ciangin kei kiangah hong kileh kik ngawn ding hi, ci-in ka up hangin amah hong kileh kik tuan lo hi. Tua bangin a gamtatna pen numei ginalo a sanggamnu Judah in zong a mu hi."},"8":{"text":"A zulhzau Israel, midang tawh a khialhna hangin kimakna lai pia-in, ka hawlkhiat zong amah in a mu hi. Ahih hangin numei ginalo Judah lau tuan loin, amah zong numei paktat khat mah a va suak veve hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua bang hih ding amah in baih ngaihsut lel ahih manin suangtum le singtawng peuh bia-in khial a, gam a ninsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih bang teng hinapi a sanggamnu, numei ginalo Judah, a lungsim takpi tawh hong kilehkik loin, a kilehkik hong kineihkhem bek hi, Topa in kong ci hi,” hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih a, “A zulhzau Israel, numei ginalo Judah sangin a mawhna tamzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Pai inla leilu lam Israel gamah hih bangin va taangko in: ‘Hong kilehkik in, a zulhzau Israel aw, Topa in kong ci hi. Hehna tawh nang kong en kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a hehpih thei pa ka hi hi, Topa in kong ci hi. Ka heh tawntung kei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na mawhna na phawk ding bek kisam hi. Topa na Pasian na langpanna, singliim nuai khempeuhah gamdang pasian-te tawh na khialh kawikawina le ka thu nong man lohnate pulak in, Topa in kong ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Hong kileh kik un, a zulhzau ka tate aw, Topa in kong ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen keima mite na hi uh a, khuapi khat panin mi khat, beh khat sung panin nih cih bangin hong la-in, Zion khua-ah ka hong puak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“‘Ka thu a hong mang makaite ka hong pia ding a, amaute in pilna le siamna tawh note hong uk ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin gam sungah note pungin na tam uh ciangin Topa in kong cihin-ah, mite in, “ Topa’ Thuciamna Singkuang,” ci-in genin a nei nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute in ngaihsun kha lo ding uh a, phawkkha loin, zong a goih beek kei ding uh hi. Tham loin zong a bawlkik nawn kei ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin Jerusalem khua pen Topa’ kumpi tokhom kici ding a, Jerusalem khua Topa’ omna-ah gam khempeuh hong kikhawmin, amaute in amau’ mawhnopna lungsim uh a zui tentan nawn kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin Judah mite in Israel mite hong pawlpih ding uh a, leilu lam gam salsuahna panin na pu na pate uh’ luah dingin ka piaksa gamah a paikhawm ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"“‘Israel aw, ka tapa bangin nang hong bawlin, gam khempeuh lakah a hoihpen gam nopci mahmah khat nang hong pia ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin a thuman lo zi in a pasal a nusiat bangin Israel mite aw, Topa in kong cihin-ah, no zong kei tungah nong thuman kei uh hi,’ ci-in va taangko in,” hong ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Mualtung panin awging khat hong kiza a, Israel mite’ kahna le tauna awging ahi hi. Lam a pialna hang uh le Topa a Pasian uh a mangngilhna hang uh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in, “Hong kileh kik un, a zulhzau ka tate aw, na zulhzauna uh kong damsak ding hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in zong, “En in, nang kiang kong pai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa kote’ Pasian na hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mualtungte le mualsangte’ tungah gamlum lialuanate zuaupi taktak hi a, Israel mite hotkhiatna ding Topa eite’ Pasian’ kiang bekah om takpi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ahih hangin i neu lai a kipan a zumhuai Baal pasian i biakna hangin i pu i pate’ biakna ahi tuulebawngte, a tapate le a tanute khempeuh uh i sum khinzo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih manin maizumin lum ni. I minsiatna silh ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh i neulai a kipan tuni ciang dong eite le i pu i pate pen Topa i Pasian’ tungah i mawh khinzo hi. Topa i Pasian’ thu i mang kei khinzo hi,” a ci uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel mite aw, na kilehkik nop uhleh kei kiangah hong kilehkik un. Na kihhuainate uh kei kiang pan na paihkhiat uh a, na tai kawikawi kei uh a,"},"2":{"text":"‘ Topa a nuntak bangin,’ ci-in, thuman tak, kiptak, thutang takin thu na ciam nak-uhleh gam khempeuh in thupha ka piak ding hong ngen ding uh a, kei’ sungah amaute a lungdam ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Judah gammite le Jerusalem khuamite tungah Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Na lote uh kal unla, ling lakah khai vawh kei un.","ref":"Hos 10:12"},"4":{"text":"Judah mite le Jerusalem khuamite aw, Topa’ thu zui unla, lungsim takpi tawh zui un. Na tuacih kei uhleh na bawl uh mawhnate hangin ka hehna mei bangin hong kuangkhia ding a, a phelhzo kuamah om lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Judah gamah va gen unla, Jerusalem khua-ah va taangko un. Hong kikhawm unla khuapi muanhuaite sungah va bu ni, va ci un.","title":"Judah Gam Kila Ding"},"6":{"text":"Zion paina lampi kihilh unla, na suahtak nadingun tai un; zekai kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu lam panin siatna lianpi ka hong puaksuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Humpinelkai khat a bukna sawlkawm panin hong kuankhiazo a, gamte a susia ding pa hong paikhiazo hi. Na gam uh a kisiasak ding le na khuapite uhah kuamah a ten loh nadingin a susia dingin ama omna panin hong kuankhia khinzo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin puanhampi silhin tau-in kap un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ hehna lauhuaipi eite’ kiang panin kiheikhia nai lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua ni ciangin kumpipa le kumpi uliante lungkia ding uh a, siampite lau mahmahin, kamsangte dipkua ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ah, Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in hih mite le Jerusalem khuamite khem cih takin na khem khinzo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau kiangah, ‘Nopna hong om ding hi,’ ci napi-in, amau a sunlum dingin namsau khat a om gige hi,” ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin hih mite le Jerusalem khua mite kiangah, “A sa mahmah huih, sehnel gam a sang mun panin ka mite tungah hong nung ding a, tua huih pen anvaite a zapsiang dingin a nung huih bang hi lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka sawl huih pen tua bang dingin hat lua ding hi. Tu-in Topa in amaute tungah thu khenin a gen hi,” kici ding hi."},"13":{"text":"En un, meii bangin i gal pa hong pai a, a sakol leengte pingpei tawh kibang a, a sakolte muvanlai sangin manlang zaw hi. Gimna i thuak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh gal lel ding ihi ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem khua aw, nang hong kihotkhiat nadingin na lungsim sung panin gitlohna sawpkhia in. Na sungah gitlohna lungsim bang tanvei kemcip ding na hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Ngai un; Dan gam panin aw khat hong ging a, Efraim Mual panin kisiatna ding thu hong kitaangko hi."},"16":{"text":"Minamte kiangah va gen unla, Jerusalem kiangah va taangko un. “Gamlapi panin mite hong pai uh a, Judah gam khuapite langpangin hong kiko uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah gam in kei hong langpan’ ahih manin lohongte bangin a galte in a kimkotah a pang dimdiam uh hi, Topa in kong ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Na lungsim le na gamtatnate’ hangin nang’ tungah hih thu hong tung hi. Hih pen nangma gitlohna hang hi a, na lungtang pailetin hong sun hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Aw, ka lungtang, ka lungtang! Na ka sa mahmah hi. Ka lungtang kisai vanvan a, ka om hithiat thei kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh peengkul mutna aw, gal kisimna aw ka za hi."},"20":{"text":"Siatna khat khit ciangin adang khat hong tung a, gam sung khempeuh kisia khinta hi. Bang tanvei peengkul aw za lai ding ka hi hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka mite hai uh a, kei hong thei lo uh hi. Naupang haite bang uh a, bangmah thei lo uh hi. Khuapi khempeuh kinusia khin a, kuamah teng nawn lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi aw, a siacip ding na hita hi. Na lawm ngaihte in nang hong nusia ta uh a, tu-in hong that nuam ta uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Nau a suak ding numei a kiko bang khat ka za a, tacil a suak numei’ tauna tawh kibang hi. Zion’ tanu husam liangin a kikona aw na hi a, a khut tegel zakin, “Gimna ka thuak ding hi. Kei hong that ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sungah kileh kawikawi un. Na muh uhleh tua khua’ mawhna ka maisak ding hi.","title":"Jerusalem le Judah’ Mawhnate"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa a nuntak bangin,” ci-in a kiciam uh hangin a zuaupi uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa aw, nangmah in thuman en gige hi lo na hi hiam? Nangmah in amaute na sat hangin a awlmawh tuan kei uh hi. Na sukgawp hangin na thuhilhna a ngai tuan kei uh hi. Amaute’ maitang suangtum sangin sakzaw a, a kisik nuam kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Hih mite mihai hi a, a hehpihhuai ahi hi. Topa’ lampi thei lo uh a, amau’ Pasian’ deihna a thei kei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Miliante kiangah pai-in ka va kiho ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a vekpi-un ka uk ding nial khin uh a, ka hakkol kuaitanin ka henna khaute sutat khinzo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tulak panin humpinelkai in amaute that ding a, sehnel gam panin keivom in amaute a petgawp ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute’ mawhna tamlua a, hong taisan mun lua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Na mawhnate uh hong koici maisak thei ding ka hi hiam? Amaute a gilvah dong uh an ka vak khit ciangin amaute in angkawmin, numei paktatte’ inn-ah a hon om uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Sakol gilvah a lante bangin a inn vengte’ zite uh nehin a tau huthut uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih thute hangin amaute gim pia lo ding ka hi hiam? A hiangte heuhkhiatsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh tua a hiangte Topa a’ hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel minamte le Judah minamte, Topa in ka cihin-ah, kei’ tungah hong thuman nawn het lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"“Amaute in Topa hong nial uh a, ‘Amah in bangmah hihlo ding hi. Amau’ gen bangun amau mah in a thuak ding uh hi,’ ci uh hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa, Vanglian Pasian in hong hopih a, “Amaute, tu-a bangin kampau uh ahih manin na kam sungah mei bangin ka kuansak ka thute in sing tawh kibang hih minamte kangtum gawp ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“En un, Israel minamte aw, Topa in kong cihin-ah, gamlapi panin note a hong sim dingin gam khat kong kuansak ding hi. Na muan mahmah uh kulhpi tawh a ki-um na khuapite uh namsau tawh hong suksiatsak ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ahih hangin tua bang hun ciang nangawnin, Topa in kong cihin-ah, note kong sumaimang khin sam kei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na mipihte un, ‘Bang hangin Topa i Pasian in hih bangin ei’ tungah hong bawl ahi hiam?’ a cih uh ciangin nangmah in, ‘ Topa nusia-in na gam sung uhah gamdang pasian-te’ na na sep uh bangin, note’ gam ahi lo gam dangah, gamdang mite’ na na sem ding uh hi,’ na ci ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Jakob’ suante’ tungah gen in. A nopna munah tuk lailai na hih leh Jordan gun gei sing kawm lakah bangcih ding na hi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggamte le na innkuanpihte nangawn in nang hong zuak uh a, nang a hong do ding mihonpi a kaikhawm uh hi. Kam khum tawh nang a hong zol uh hangin um kei in,” ci-in hong dawngkik hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Ka inn ka nusia khin a, ka luahsa mite ka paimangta hi. Ka it mahmah ka mite, a galte uh’ khut sungah ka piata hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka luah dingin ka teelsa mite in gamlak a humpinelkai bangin kei’ langkhatah pangin hong hawksan uh ahih manin amaute ka mudah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mite pen, sasialne vasa gial khat, sasialne vasa dangte in a kimkot panin a tuk huan nainai uh tawh a kibang uh hi. Gamsate aw, hong kikhawm unla, pawi hong siim un."},"10":{"text":"Tuucing dang tampi in ka leenggah lo hong suksiatsak uh a, kei a’ teng hong tuatcilsak uh hi. A hoih mahmah ka leenggah lo pawnlak, gamlak, a suaksak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Pawn lak hong suahsak uh a, dahin ka kap hi. Gam sung khempeuh a kisiat khit hangin kuamah in phamawh sa lo sawnsawn uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Sehnel gam mualsang panin a susia dingte hong paizo uh hi. Gammong khat panin gammong khat dongah a lungmuang kuamah om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ namsau in mi khempeuh a vattuk hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in mangbuh tuh uh a, ahi zongin kiak bek a ngah uh hi. Nasep a hahkat mahmah hangun bangmah a ngah kei uh hi. A kihtakhuai Topa’ hehna hangin anlak hun ciangin a maizum ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mi Israel-te’ luah dingin ka piak gamh a susia nuam a gilo a vengte tawh kisai-in Topa in ka cihin-ah, “En un, a gam uh panin amaute ka botkhia ding a, amau’ khutsung panin Judah mite ka suaktasak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute ka lakkhiat khit ciangin ka hehpihkik ding a, amau’ luah ding amau’ gam ciatciat uhah ka koihkik ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin, ka mite’ omdan hoihtakin a sin uh a, Baal min tawh a kiciam dingin ka mite a sinsak mah bangun, ‘ Topa a nuntak mah bangin,’ ci-in keima min tawh kiciam ding a sin uhleh ka mite lakah kiptakin a om ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin gam khat peuhpeuh in ka thu hong ngaih kei leh tua gam botkhia-in ka susia ding hi, Topa in kong ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah, “Pai inla patpuan dialkaih khat na lei khit ciangin kawtsak loin teeng in,” hong ci hi.","title":"Dialkaih Ngot Tawh Thuhilhna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei zong Topa’ hong gen mah bangin dialkaih khat lei-in ka teeng hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in a nih veina hong hopih a,"},"4":{"text":"“Na kawngah na teen, na dialkaih lei la in. Tho inla Eufratis gun-ah pai in. Tua lai-ah suanghawm sungah va seel in,” hong ci leuleu hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei zong pai-in Topa’ hong sawlna bangin Eufratis gun gei-ah ka seel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawh ni tampi khit ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, “Eufratis gun-ah va pai inla, na seel dingin ka hong sawl na dialkaih va lakik in,” hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei zong Eufratis gun-ah pai-in dialkaih ka seelna mun khuat kikin ka la hi. Dialkaih na ngotgawp khin a, zattheih ding hi nawn lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih a,"},"9":{"text":"“ Topa in kong cihin-ah, hih bangmahin Judah mite’ kisaktheihna le Jerusalem khuate’ ki-uatsaknate ka susia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka thu hong ngai nuam loin amau’ ngaihsutna bang bekin a pai tentan nuam, pasian dangte’ na a sem ding le a bia dingin a nung a zui hih migilote pen zattheih ding ahi nawn lo, hih dialkaih bang ahi ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh dialkaih, mite’ kawng tungah a belh cinten mah bangin Israel mi khempeuh le Judah mi khempeuh kei’ tungah a hong belh cinten dingin ka bawl hi. Tua hileh amaute ka mi hi ding uh a, ka minthanna, ka hoihna, le ka vangliatna ding ahi ding uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in ka thu hong mang lo uh hi, Topa in kong ci hi,” hong ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Jeremiah aw, amau’ kiangah, ‘ Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in a hong genin-ah, “Zubeel khempeuh leenggahzu tawh a kidim ding hi,” hong ci hi,’ va ci in. Amaute in nang kiangah, ‘Beel khempeuh leenggahzu tawh kidim ding cih kote in thei lo ka hi uh hiam?’ hong ci kik ding uh hi.","title":"Leenggahzu Tawh A Kidim Beelte Tawh Thuhilhna"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, ‘ Topa in hong cihin-ah: En un, David’ tokhom tungah a tu kumpite, siampite, kamsangte, le Jerusalem khua-a a teng mi khempeuh a kipan gam sungah a om mi khempeuh zu tawh kidim sakin ka khamsak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pate le tate a kipan amaute khatlekhat ka kiphusak ding a, Topa in kong cihin-ah, hehpih lo, lainat lo, it loin ka sisak ding hi, ci hi,’ va ci in,” hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ngai-in na bil uh ngat un; kisathei kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in thu a genzo hi.","title":"Judah A Kisikkik Lohna Hangin Salin Mat Ding Tawh Tawnna"},"16":{"text":"Topa in khua mialsak a, khuamialna mualtungah na tuk ma un, na lamet uh khuavak pen khuamial bikbek a suah ma-in, Topa na Pasian uh pahtawi un."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin ka thu nong ngaih kei uhleh na kisaktheihna uh hangin ka kapsim ding a, khitui luangin nakpitakin ka kidik ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ tuuhonte sal dingin kikaikhia zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah, “Kumpipa le a nu kiangah, ‘Na kumpi tokhomte tung panun hong tuaksuk un. Bang hang hiam cih leh na kumpi lukhute uh na lu tung uh panin kia khinzo hi,’ va ci in."},"19":{"text":"Negeb gam a om khua kongpite lah kikhak a, kuamah lut thei nawn lo hi. Judah mite zong salin kikai a, a vekun sal suak khin uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Jerusalem khua aw, khuadak inla, leilu lam panin a hong paite en dih in. Nangmah a hong kipia a hoih mahmah na tuuhonte koi-ah om ahi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Nangma lawm dingin na bawl mite teekteek in nang hong uk ni ciangin bang na ci ding hiam? Numei nausuakte in na a sak velval uh bangin nang zong na na sa ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hangin hih thute kei tungah hong tung ahi hiam, ci-in na ngaihsut leh na mawhna a liatluatna hang ahi hi. Tua thu hangin na nik hong kihawkgawp a, a hong kibuan gawp ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ethiopia mivomte in a vun uh khek thei a, kamkei in a gial khek thei ahi hiam? A khek theih uhleh siatna bawl ding a zongsang khin note in zong a hoih na bawl thei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Sehnel gam panin a hong nung huih in buhvai a mut bangin note kong thehthang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hih pen nangma ngah dingin ka hong sehsak ahi hi, Topa in kong ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei na hong mangngilh a, pasian zuau peuh na um hi."},"26":{"text":"Kei mahmah in na nik kong hawksak ding a, kong maizumsak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Na kihhuainate, na angkawmna, na hukna le gamlak mualtungah numei paktat bangin milim pasian peuh na biak kawikawinate ka muzo hi. Jerusalem aw, gimna ngah ta in. Na siantho nadingin bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam, a ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Guah zu loin khua keuna tawh kisai-in Topa in Jerusalem kiangah hih bangin a gen hi:","title":"Guah Zuk lohna Thu"},"2":{"text":"“Judah gam kap a, a khuapite maimang dekdek hi. A mite in puan vom khu-in leilakah bok uh a, Jerusalem khua-a om mite’ kahna aw ging hi."},"3":{"text":"Uliante in a nasemte uh tuitawi dingin sawl uh a, tuikhuk a zuat uhleh tui na om lo hi. A beel hawm uh tawh hong kilehkik uh a, lungkhamin cih nading thei loin a lu uh puan a khuh uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Lokhote lungmang uh a, a lu uh puan a khuh uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh guah zu lo ahih manin lei a keugawp hi."},"5":{"text":"Lopa om lo lua ahih manin sazuk in gamlakah a no a nusia liang hi."},"6":{"text":"Gam sakolte, bangmah om lohna mualtungah se-alte bangin a nak huhu uh hi. Lopa om lo ahih manin a hakzo kei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka mite in kei tungah, ‘ Topa aw, ka mawhna uh kote’ langkhatah hong pang ahi ta zongin nangma min hangin kote hong hehpih in. Kote in tam veipi nang kong nungngat uh a, nangma tungah ka hong khial khinzo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mite’ lamet pa aw, haksat hun ciangin ko a hong honkhia pa na hi hi. Bang hangin ka gam sung uhah khualmi bangin nang omin khualzin zan khat bek a taam bangin hong om na hi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Bang hangin mi lungkiagawp bangin omin, a honkhia thei lo galkap pa bangin om na hi hiam? Ahih hangin Topa aw, kote’ laizangah nang na om a, nangma minin kote hong kisam hi. Kote hong nusia kei in,’ hong ci uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih mite tawh kisai-in Topa in thu gen a, “Kei kiang panin amaute vakkhia kawikawi nuam uh a, a kideek kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin Topa keimah in amaute ka sang kei a, a khialhnate uh phawkin, a mawhnate uh hangin gim ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah, “Hih mite in thupha a ngah nadingin thu hong ngen nawn kei in."},"12":{"text":"An a tan’ uh hangin amau’ thumna ka ngai kei ding a, meihal biakna le an tawh biaknate hong piak uh hangin ka sang kei ding hi. Amaute namsau tawh ahi zongin, kial tawh ahi zongin, pulnatna tawh ahi zongin ka sisakzaw ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ah, Topa Pasian aw, en dih in. Kamsangte in amaute kiangah, ‘Note in namsau ahi zongin, kial ahi zongin na mukha ngei kei ding uh a, hih munah Pasian in lungnopna kip hong pia ding hi,’ a ci uh hi,” ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Tua kamsangte in kei’ min suangin zuauthu hong gen uh hi. Note kiangah hong gen uh thute a man lo maangmuhna, bangmahin a kimang lo aisanna, le amau’ ngaihsuttawm thute ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka sawl lohpi, ‘Hih gam sungah namsau ahi zongin, kial ahi zongin hong tung lo ding hi,’ ci-in keima min suangin thu a gen kamsangte tawh kisai-in Topa in ka cihin-ah, namsau le kial tawh hih kamsangte a si khin ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"A hilh uh mite in zong kial le namsau thuakin amaute a kipan a zite uh, a tapate uh, le a tanute uh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah kipaithang ding a, kuamah in a vui kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ gitlohna amau’ tung mahah ka buaksuk ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a, “Jeremiah aw, amaute kiangah, ‘Sun le zanin ka khitui luangluang hen la, kang ngei kei tahen. Bang hang hiam cih leh keima mite in nakpitakin liamna thuak uh a, nakpitakin a kisat uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Lolai-ah paikhia leng, namsau tawh a kithat mi bekbek ka mu a, khuapi sungah lut leng, kialin a puksite bekbek ka mu hi. Damna ding hun ka lamen uh a, lauhuaina bekbek ka mu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa aw, ka gitlohna uh le ka pute ka pate uh gitlohnate ka hong pulak uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma tungah ka hong mawh khin uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Nangma min na khualna-in kote hong nolh kei inla, a vanglian na tokhom mindaisak kei ta in. Kote tawh nong thuciamna hong phawk inla, hong ciampel kei ta in."},"22":{"text":"Gamdang pasian zuaute’ lakah guah a zusak thei om ahi hiam? Topa kote’ Pasian aw, nangmah in tuate khempeuh hih na hih manin nangma sungah lametna kong nei uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih a, “Moses le Samuel nangawn ka mai-ah hong dingin hong thum uh zongin hih mite ka hehpih tuan kei ding hi. Kei nong nungngat niloh hi. Tua ahih manin ka khut zanin nang kong susia hi. Ka hehna ka ki-ipzo nawn kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Na gam sung khua kongpite-ah huihpi’ mut bangin note kong mutmang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na gitlohna uh le na omdan hoih lo panun na kiheikik kei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuipi a sehnel omzah sangin nupi meigong ka tamsakzaw ding hi. No a nungta laite na galte un namsau tawh a hong satlup dingun ka hong pia ding hi, Topa in kong ci hi,” a hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Gimna ka thuak hi; ka nu aw, gam sung khempeuh a mite tawh a kitawng a kisel dingin kei nong suaksak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hehna mei bangin kitawhkuang a, a mit nawn kei ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in: Topa aw, nang na thei hi. Hong phawk inla hong veh in. Nangma hangin minsiatna a thuak ka hihlam hong thei in.","title":"in Jeremiah A Ompihna Gen"},"16":{"text":"Na thute in kei hong kem a, an bangin ka ne hi. Na thute kei a dingin kipahna le lungdamna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma minin kei hong kilo hi, aw, Topa, Vanglian Pasian aw."},"17":{"text":"Mi gualnuam mawkmawkte tawh ka kikhawl kei a, zong ka lungdam khawm kei hi. Nangma thu kong manna hangin kei tangkai ka hih manin a hehin ka omden hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang hangin ka natna dai thei lo a, ka liamna dam thei lo a, dam nuam het lo ahi hiam? Tui a kang lui tawh kibangin lungkiatna hong thuaksak ding na hi hiam, ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa in, “Na hong kilehkik leh kong koihna ngei-ah kong koihkik ding a, ka na na sem kik ding hi. Nang kiangah amaute hong pai ding uh a, nang na hih leh amau’ kiangah na pai kei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih mite tungah sumngo a kibawl khuakulhpi kong bangsak ding a, amaute in a hong sim uh hangin a hong zo kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a hong honkhia ding le a hong suaktasak dingin nang ka hong ompih hi, Topa in ka hong ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Migilote’ khutsung panin nang kong suaktasak ding a, mi lauhuaite’ khutsung panin nang kong honkhia ding hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong hopih a,","title":"Mite’ Tungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"“Hih bang munah zi nei kei inla, tanu tapa zong nei kei in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh hih mun a suak tanu tapate le a nute uh tawh kisai-in Topa in ka cihin-ah:"},"4":{"text":"Natna lian tawh si ding uh a, kuamah in kah loin kuamah in zong a vui kei ding uh hi. Leilak a ek ki-tha a bang lel ding uh hi. Namsau le kial tawh a si ding uh a, a luanghawmte uh huihlaka a leeng vasate le leilaka ganhingte in a ne ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kong cihin-ah, mi’ kahna inn sungah lut kei unla, thumin kuamah va kah se kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh lungnopna, itna lianpi, le ka hehpihna hih mite kiang panin ka lakhia khinzo hi, Topa in kong ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih gamah miliante le mineute si ding uh a, kivui loin, amau’ hangin kuamah kap loin, kuamah in a pumpi uh kuiliam loin a sam uh zong a met kei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Misi hangin a kapte hehnep nadingin kuamah in anletui a lui kei ding uh a, a nu ahih kei leh a pa a site nangawn kuamah in a hehnem kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pawi kibawlna inn-ah na pai kei ding uh a, amaute tawh a ne a dawnkhawm dingin na tu kei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in hih bangin kong ci hi: En un, hih mun panin note’ muh teekteekin, note’ theih hunsung mahin gualnopna, lungdamna awte le zinei thakte, pasalnei thakte’ awte ka gingsak nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 7:34; 25:10; Mang 18:23"},"10":{"text":"“Hih thuteng hih mite tungah na gen ciangin amaute in, ‘Bang hangin Topa in hih gimna lianpi eite tungah hong tungsak ahi hiam? Topa i Pasian’ tungah bang mawhna bawl ihi hiam?’ hong ci ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, ‘ Topa in, “Na pu na pate un kei hong taisan khin uh a, kei hong nusia-in ka thukham a zui kei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note, na pu na pate sangun na siahuaizaw uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh en un, note’ utna bang ciat na zui tentan uh a, ka thu nong ngai nuam kei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih gam panin note le na pu na pate un na theih ngei loh uh gamah kong notkhia ding hi. Tua lai-ah sun le zanin pasian dangte’ na na sem niloh ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh note kong angvan nawn kei ding hi,” ci hi,’ na ci ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin, en un, Topa in kong cihin-ah, kuamah in, ‘Egypt gam panin Israel mite a hong lakhia Topa a nuntak bangin,’ ci-in kei’ minin a kiciam nawn loh hun hong tung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute in, ‘Leilu lam gam le eite hong hawlkhiatna gam khempeuh panin Israel mite a hong kaikhawm Topa a nuntak bangin,’ a cizaw ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate uh ka piaksa, amau’ neihsa gamah amaute ka paipih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“En un, Topa in kong cihin-ah, ngabeng tampi ka khah ding a, amaute ka mansak ding hi.
