Ahih hangin Topa in ko tegel a hong seelsim hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima sit bangin Baruk in a at laizial kumpipa in a haltum khit ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih a,"},"28":{"text":"“Laizial dang khat la inla tua tungah, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim in a haltum a masa laizial sunga thu omteng khempeuh atkik in."},"29":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim’ thu tawh kisai-in hih bangin ama kiangah va gen in: ‘ Topa in hong genin-ah: Nangmah in, “Jeremiah aw, bang hangin Babylon kumpipa hong pai taktakin hih gam hong susia ding a, mihing le ganhing a tengsak nawn kei ding hi, ci-in hih lai sungah at na hi hiam?” ci-in na gen a, tua laizial na haltum hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim’ thu tawh kisai-in Topa in kong genin-ah, amah in David tokhom tunga tu ding suanlekhak a nei kei ding a, ama luanghawm pen sun laitakin nisa’ kap ding le zan laitakin vukngo’ tuam dingin kipaidak ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah le a suanlekhakte le a nasemte a mawhna uh hangin gim ka pia ding a, ama tung le Jerusalem khua-a tengte tung a kipan Judah mite’ tungah amau’ tungah tunsak dingin ka gensa gimna khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thu hong ngai lo uh hi,’ ci-in va gen in,” ci-in kei a hong sawl hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei zong laizial dang khat la leuleu-in Neriah’ tapa lai-at Baruk ka pia hi. A thu kibang tampi zong ka gelhbehsak hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Jehoiakim’ tapa Jehoiakhin’ tangin Judah gam a uk dingin Josiah’ tapa Zedekiah a koih hi.","title":"Jeremiah Thong Kia","ref":"2Kum 24:17; 2Khang 36:10"},"2":{"text":"Ahih hangin amahmah a kipan a nasemte le a gam sung mite in keima tung tawna Topa’ thugennate a ngai kei uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi Zedekiah in Shelemiah’ tapa Jehukal le Maaseiah’ tapa siampipa Zefaniah keima kiangah hong sawl a, “ Topa i Pasian’ kiangah kote a dingin thu hong ngetsak in,” ci-in a hong gensak hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih hunin thong kia nai lo ka hih manin mi lakah ka ut utin ka vak kawikawi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hun laitak pen Babylon galkapte in Jerusalem khua a sim laitak uh hi a, tua hun laitak mahin Faro kumpipa’ galkapte, galsim dingin Egypt gam panin hong kuankhia hi, cih thu a zak uh ciangin Jerusalem khua panin a nungkik uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih a,"},"7":{"text":"“ Topa ahi Israel mite’ Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Kei’ tungah thu a hong dongsak Judah kumpipa kiangah hih bangin na va gen ding hi: ‘En in, nang hong huh dingin a hong pai Faro kumpipa’ galkapte a gam uhah ciahkik ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Babylon-te hong kileh kikin hih khuapi hong sim ding uh a, khuapi la-in mei tawh a hal ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in kong cihin-ah, nang le nang kikhemin, “Babylon-te hong kilehkik nawn lo taktak ding uh hi,” cikha kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute hong kilehkik ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in na gal Babylon galkap khempeuh zolua kisa-in buk sunga mi liam teng bek na suaktasak khaphial ahi zongin, amaute hong thokik teitei ding uh a, hih khuapi hong halsak veve ding uh hi,’ ci-in va gen in,” a hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Faro’ galkapte Jerusalem khua a hong naih ciangun Babylon galkapte a nungkik uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua laitakin kei zong Jerusalem khua panin ka behte kiangah ka gamhluah teng a la dingin Benjamin gamah a pai dingin ka ding khia hi."},"13":{"text":"Benjamin Kongpi ka tun ciangin Shelemiah’ tapa, Hananiah’ tupa Irijah a kici kongcing pa in kei kiangah, “Nang Babylon mite’ lamah a taisim ding na hi hi,” ci-in a hong man hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei zong, “Hilo hi’ng; Babylon mite’ lamah ka taisim kei ding hi,” ka ci hi. Ahih hangin Irijah in ka thugen hong ngai loin kei hong man a, kumpi uliante kiangah hong paipih hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi uliante zong kei tungah heh mahmah uh a, hong sat khit uh ciangin thong dingin a kizangsa, kumpi thuvanpi pa Jonathan’ inn-ah thong hong kiasak uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Leisung thongmial-ah ni tampi ka om khit ciangin","title":"Zedekiah in Jeremiah Thu Dong"},"17":{"text":"kumpi Zedekiah in kei hong samsak hi. Tua ahih manin kumpipa’ thong sungah a om ka suak hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mattan’ tapa Shefatiah, Pashhur’ tapa Gedaliah, Shelemiah’ tapa Jehukal, le Malkhiah’ tapa Pashhur-te in mi khempeuh tungah keima thugenna a za uh hi.","title":"Tuikhuk Sung Pan Jeremiah Kihonkhia"},"2":{"text":"Keimah in mite kiangah, “ Topa in hong cihin-ah: Hih khuapi sungah a om mi peuhmah namsau tawh ahi a, kial tawh ahi a, pulnatna tawh ahi zongin a si ding uh hi. Ahih hangin pusuak khia-in Babylon mite a beel peuhmah nungta ding a, suakta liailiai ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in hong cihin-ah, Babylon kumpipa’ khut sungah hih khuapi kipia taktak ding a, a kila ta ding ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa’ uliante in kumpipa kiangah, “Hih mipa i thatlum ding hi. Tua ciangin kumpi cing galkap mangpa in an le letsong hong pia-in kei a hong paisak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei zong Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah’ omna Mizpah khua-ah ka pai a, gam sungah a omlai ka mipihte tawh ka omkhawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in gam uk dingin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah koih a, Babylon khua-ah sal dingin a kipaipih lo gam sungah mizawng pente ahi papi, nupi, le naupangte a en dingin a koihna thu, Babylon-te’ khut sungah a lut nai lo, gam sung khuaneu-a om galkapbute le a galkapte un a zak uh ciangin","title":"Judah Gam A Ukin Gedaliah Om (2Kum 25:22-24)"},"8":{"text":"Mizpah khua Gedaliah kiangah a pai uh hi. Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael, Kareah’ tapa Johanan, Tanhumeth’ tapa Seraiah, Netofah khuami Efai’ tate, le Maakath mi Jezaniah-te in a galkapte hong paipih uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahikam’ tapa, Shafan’ tupa Gedaliah in zong amaute kiangah kiciamin gen a, “Babylon mite’ khutnuai-ah na om ding uh kihta tuan kei un. Hih gam sung mahah om unla, Babylon kumpipa’ na sepsak le-uhcin note tungah thusia bangmah om lo ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:22-24"},"10":{"text":"Kei ka hih leh Mizpah khua mahah ka om ding a, ei kiangah hong pai ding Babylon mite kiangah note’ tangin ka ding ding hi. No na hih uhleh leenggahzu, khuakhal ante, le sathaute khawm unla, na beel sung uhah koih un. Na laksa uh khua ciat mahah na teng un,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Moab gam, Ammon gam, Edom gam, le gamdang a teng Judah mi khempeuh in, Babylon kumpipa in Judah gamah mi pawlkhat omsak lai a, tuate a uk dingin Ahikam’ tapa, Shafan’ tupa Gedaliah koih hi, cih thu a za uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jew mi khempeuh a kithehthangna mun khempeuh panin Judah gamah hong ciahkik uh a, Mizpah khua Gedaliah kiangah hong pai uh hi. Leenggahzu le khuakhal an tampi a kaikhawm uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le gam sung khuaneu-a om galkapbute khempeuh Mizpah khua Gedaliah kiangah hong pai uh a,","title":"Ishmael in Gedaliah A Suamna (2Kum 25:25-26)"},"14":{"text":"“Ammon kumpipa Baalis in nang a hong suam dingin Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael a sawllam na thei hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Ahih hangin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah in amau’ thugen a um kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kareah’ tapa Johanan in Mizpah khua-a Gedaliah’ kiangah, “Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael hong thatsak in. Kuamah in hong thei lo ding uh hi. Nang hong kithat leh nang a hong beel Jew mite kikhenthang ding a, Judah gamah mi a omlai sunteng in zong beilawh ding uh ahih manin bang hangin amah in nang hong that laizang ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a hopihsim hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah in Kareah’ tapa Johanan’ kiangah, “Tua bangin hih kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Ishmael’ thu na genna man lo hi,” a ci kik hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kha sagih kha hong tun ciangin Nethaniah’ tapa, Elishama’ tupa, kumpi nam le kumpipa’ ulian pente khat ahi Ishmael, mi sawm tawh Mizpah khua Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah’ kiangah hong hawh uh hi. Mizpah khua-ah amaute in an a nekkhawm laitakun,"},"2":{"text":"Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael le tua mi sawmte in, Babylon kumpipa in gam uk dingin a koih Ahikam’ tapa, Shafan’ tupa Gedaliah pen namsau tawh satin a thatlum uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ishmael in Mizpah khua-ah Gedaliah tawh a omkhawm Jew mi khempeuh le tua laitakin a om Babylon galkapte zong a that hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:25"},"4":{"text":"Gedaliah a kisuam ni a zing ciang, kuama theih ma-in"},"5":{"text":"Shekhem, Shiloh, le Samaria khuate panin mi sawmgiat hong pai uh hi. Amaute in a khamul uh metin a puan uh balkekin, a pumpi uh a kikui gawpsa-in Topa’ biakinn-ah an tawh biakna le paknamtui tawh biakna a piak ding uh hong tawi khawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael zong Mizpah khua panin kap kawmin hong paikhia a, amau hong dawntuah hi. Amau tawh a kimuh ciangin amah in, “Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah hong en dih un,” ci-in a sam hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuapi sung a tun uh ciangin Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael le a mi sawmte in amaute thatin a luang uh tuikhuk sung khatah a paai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute’ lakah mi sawm in Ishmael’ kiangah, “Ko hong that kei in. Mangbuh, mangbuhham, sathau le khuaizu ka seelsim uh lolai-ah tampi a om hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin amah le a lawmte in amaute a that kei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ishmael in a thahsa misi luanghawm khempeuh a paihna tuikhuk pen a gol khat hi a, kumpipa Asa in Israel kumpipa Baasha a nan nadingin a bawl ahi hi. Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in a thahsa misi luanghawmte tua tuikhuk a dimsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpi cing galkapmang Nebuzaradan in, Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah’ uk dingin a piak kumpipa’ tanute le Mizpah khua-a a kinusia mi khempeuh a kipan Mizpah khua-ah a omlai mi khempeuh Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in man a, Ammon gam lam zuanin a paikhiatpih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahih hangin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le amah tawh a omkhawm galkapmang khempeuh in Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael’ tatsiatnate a zak uh ciangin"},"12":{"text":"a galkap khempeuh uh tawh Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael a sim dingin a kuankhia uh hi. Gibeon tuikhukpi a tun uh ciangin a pha uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ishmael’ mat mi khempeuh in Kareah’ tapa Johanan le a hong tonpih galkapmangte a muh uh ciangin a nuam uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Mizpah khua panin Ishmael in manin a paikhiatpihte khempeuh hong kilehhei kikin Kareah’ tapa Johanan a beel uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael le mihing giat Johanan’ khutsung panin suakta uh a, Ammon gamah a tai uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le a paipih galkapmangte khempeuh in, Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in Mizpah khua-ah Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah a thah khit ciangin manin a paikhiatpih galkapte, nupite, naupangte le kumpi innsung mangte a kipan a omlai mi khempeuh Gibeon khua panin a ciahpih kik uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt gam a zuan dingin amaute pai uh a, Bethlehem khua gei Khimham Khawlmun-ah a khawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Babylon mite a kihta uh hi. Babylon kumpipa in gam uk dingin a koih Ahikam’ tapa Gedaliah pen Nethaniah’ tapa Ishmael in suamlum ahih manin a kihta uh ahi hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin galkapmangte khempeuh, Kareah’ tapa Johanan, Hoshaiah’ tapa Azariah, le a neupen pan a kipan a lianpen dongin mi khempeuh hong paikhawmin","title":"Johanan’ Tungah Jeremiah’ Thugen"},"2":{"text":"kei kiangah, “Kong thumna uh hong ngai inla, a hong kinusia ko teng a dingin Topa na Pasian kiangah thu hong ngetsak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh khatvei lai-in mi tampi ka hih uh hangin tu-in nong muh bangin mi tawmno khat bek ka hita uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa na Pasian in ka lam pai nading uh ahi a, ka na sepna ding uh ahi zongin a hong lah nadingin thu hong ngetsak in,” hong ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei zong amaute kiangah, “Nong genna uh ka thei khinzo hi. En un, nong ngetna bangun Topa na Pasian uh kiangah thu ka ngen ding a, Topa’ hong dawnkikna bangbang ka hong gen ding hi. Bangmah kong im kei ding hi,” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in kei kiangah, “ Topa na Pasian in kote a dingin nang tungah a hong gen bangbang ka zuih kei tak mah uh leh Topa in mantakin thei tahen."},"6":{"text":"Nang kong sawlna uh Topa i Pasian’ hong gen bangbang hoih taleh sia taleh ka mang ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa i Pasian’ thu mang leeng, ei a dingin na hong hoih ding hi,” a hong ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawh ni sawm khit ciangin Topa in kei a hong hopih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in Kareah’ tapa Johanan, amah tawh a omkhawm galkapmangte khempeuh, le a neupen a kipan a lianpen dongin mi khempeuh ka sam a,"},"9":{"text":"“Na deihna uh kong thumsak nadingin nong sawlna uh Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in a hong genin-ah:"},"10":{"text":"Hih gamah note na omsuak uhleh note kong lam ding a, kong phel kei ding hi. Kong phut ding a, kong botkhia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note’ tungah siatna kong tunsak manin ka dah hi."},"11":{"text":"Na kihtak uh Babylon kumpipa kihta nawn kei un. Topa in kong cihin-ah, lau nawn kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama khutsung pan a hong honkhia ding le a hong lakhia dingin keimah in note kong ompih hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in note hong hehpihin na gam mah uhah na tensuak theihna dingun keimah in note kong hehpih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ahih hangin note in Topa na Pasian uh’ thu mang loin, ‘Hih gam sungah ka teng nawn kei ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Gal om lohna, peengkul kitum lohna, anduh gilkial lohna Egypt gamah pai-in tua lai-ah ka teng ding uh hi,’ na cih uhleh"},"15":{"text":"Judah gamah a omlai mite aw, Topa’ kammal ngai un. Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Egypt gamah a teng dingin na pai teitei uh a, na ten teitei uhleh"},"16":{"text":"na kihtaktak uh namsau in Egypt gamah note hong that veve ding a, na kihtaktak uh kialpi in zong Egypt gamah note hong nungdelh veve-in, tua lai munah na si veve ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt gamah pai-in a teng khempeuh namsau tawh ahi a, kialpi tawh ahi a, pulnatna tawh ahi zongin a si ding uh hi. Amaute’ tungah ka tunsak ding gimna panin kuamah a suakta kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Jerusalem khua-ah a teng mite’ tungah ka hehna le ka thangpaihna a kibuak bangmahin Egypt gamah na pai uhleh note tungah ka hehna hong kibua ding hi. Mite in note hong lipkhap ding a, kihamsiatna-in hong zangin hong zahko ding uh hi. Note in hih mun na mukik nawn kei ding uh hi, ci-in gen hi,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judah gamah a omlai sunte kiangah, “ Topa in note kiangah, Egypt gamah pai kei un, hong ci hi. Tuni-in note kong hilhkholhnate teltakin thei un."},"20":{"text":"Na sih nadingun lam na pial khin uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh kiangah kei nong paisak uh a, ‘Ko a dingin Topa i Pasian’ kiangah thu hong ngetsak in. Topa i Pasian in a hong gen peuhpeuh ko kiangah hong gen in. Ko zong ka mang ding uh hi,’ na hong ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa na Pasian un note’ kiangah gen dingin a hong sawl tu-in kong gen khinzo hi. Ahih hangin note in khat beek na mang kei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin na tennopna mun uhah namsau tawh thahna, kial le pulnatna tawh sihna na thuak ding uh hi, ci-in tu-in teltakpi-in thei ta un,” ka cithuah lai hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasian in mi khempeuh kiangah a hong sawl hih thuteng ka gen khit ciangin","title":"Egypt Gamah Lalna"},"2":{"text":"Hoshaiah’ tapa Azariah le Kareah’ tapa Johanan a kipan migilo dangte khempeuh in kei kiangah, “Nang in zuau na phuak hi. Topa i Pasian in, ‘Egypt gamah a teng dingin pai kei un,’ ci-in a gen dingin nang hong sawl lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Neriah’ tapa Baruk in Babylon mite’ khut sungah kote hong pia nuamin, hong kithahna ding ahih kei leh Babylon-ah saltang dingin hong kilak theih nading deih ahih manin ko a hong langpang dingin nang a hong zang ahi zaw hi,” a hong ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le galkapmangte khempeuh a kipan mi khempeuh in Judah gamah omsuakna ding Topa’ thugenna a mang kei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kareah’ tapa Johanan le galkapmangte khempeuh in, a kihawlkhiatna uh gam khempeuh panin a hong ciahkik mite le Judah gamah a omlaisun teng Egypt gamah a paipih uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Papi, nupi, naupang, kumpipa’ tanute a kipan kumpi cing galkapmang Nebuzaradan in Ahikam’ tapa, Shafan’ tupa ahi Gedaliah’ kep dingin a nusiat mi khempeuh a paipih uh hi. Neriah’ tapa Baruk le kei zong a hong kipaipih hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in Topa’ thu mang lo uh a, Egypt gamah pai-in Tahpanhes khua dong kitung hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:26"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Tahpanhes khua-ah Topa in kei hong hopih a,"},"9":{"text":"“Suangtum gol pawlkhat la inla, Tahpanhes khua Faro kumpi inn lutna suangphah nuai-ah phum in. Na phumlam Judah mi khempeuh musak in."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, ‘Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in hong genin-ah: En un, keimah in ka nasempa ahi Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar ka la ding a, hih ka suang phumte tungah ama kumpi tokhom hong phut ding a, tuate tungah a kumpi puanbuk a lam ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah hong pai-in Egypt gam hong simgawp ding a, pulnatna tawh a si ding mite pulnatna tawh si-in, sala mat dingte salin kimanin, namsau a si ding mite namsau tawh kithat ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt pasian-te a kibiakna biakinnte hal ding a, a pasian-te uh halin a puakhia ding hi. Tuucingte in a puan tung uha om khahte paai-in a siansak uh bangin amah in Egypt gam siangsak ding a, tua khit ciangin ngaihmuang takin a ciahkik ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in Egypt gam Heliopolis khua-a mual suangte susia ding a, Egypt pasian-te a kibiakna innte mei tawh a halsak ding hi, ci hi,’ ci-in va gen in,” hong ci hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gam Migdol khua, Tahpanhes khua, Memfis khua, le leitaw lama teng Jew mite tawh kisai-in Topa in thu hong gen a,","title":"Jeremiah in Egypt Gam a Om Jew Mite Kiangah Thu Hilh"},"2":{"text":"“Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in kong genin-ah: Note in Jerusalem khua le Judah gam khuapi khempeuh tungah ka tunsak gimna na muzo uh hi. En un, tuni-in tua khuate a siasa mahin omlai a, kuamah teng lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka heh nadingin gitlohna bawl uh a, amaute a kipan note le na pu na pate un a theih ngei loh uh pasian-te’ na semin paknamtui halin a bia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin note kiangah ka nasem kamsangte khempeuh kong sawl a, ‘Ka muhdah hih a kihhuai na na gamta nawn kei un,’ ci-in kong gensak tawntung hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin amaute in ka thu hong ngai loin a bil uh hong ngat lo uh a, a gitlohna uh panin kihei loin, pasian dangte kiangah paknamtui hal veve uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Judah gam khuapite sung le Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah ka hehna le ka thangpaihna ka bua a, ka kuangsak hi. Tuni-a na muh uh bangin tuate kisia-in gamlak suak khinta hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tu-in Vanglian Topa Pasian, Israel mite’ Pasian in kong genin-ah: Bang hangin note in hih bangin note’ siat nadingin mawhna lianpi bawl na hi uh hiam? Judah gam sungah papi, nupi, naupang, le naungek a kipan a nungtalai kuamah om nawn kei hen, cih na deihna uh ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Note si-in, leitung a minam dang khempeuhte in hamsiatna-in a hong zat ding uh le hong simmawh nadingun bang hangin na khut uh tawh milim bawlin, na ten nadingun na zuat uh Egypt gamah pasian dangte’ kiangah paknamtui halin kei hong hehsak na hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Judah gam le Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah na pute na pate uh’ gitlohna, Judah kumpite’ gitlohna, a zite uh’ gitlohna, note mahmah’ gitlohna, le na zite uh’ gitlohnate mangngilh khin na hi uh hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Tuni ciang dong note na kiniamkhiat kei uh a, kei hong zahtak loin, note le na pute na pate uh tungah kong piak ka thukhamte le ka ngeinate na zui kei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in kong genin-ah: En un, note a susia dingin na langkhat uhah kei ka ding a, Judah gam khempeuh ka susia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt gamah a teng dingin a lungsim a khensat khin Judah mi a omlaite, a vekpi-un ka sisak khin ding hi. Egypt gamah namsau tawh kithat sakin kial tawh ka puksisak ding hi. A neupen a kipan a golpen dongin namsau le kialpi tawh a si ding uh a, mite’ lipkhap, mite in kihamsiatna-in a zat leh mite’ simmawh ka suaksak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ka siatsak bangin Egypt gam a teng mite namsau tawh, kialpi tawh, pulnatna tawh sihna ka thuaksak ding a,"},"14":{"text":"Egypt gamah pai-in a teng Judah mi a omlaite in a zuatkik nop uh ahi Judah gamah ciahkik thei nawn loin, khat beek suakta loin, zong a nungta suak kei ding uh hi. Galtai pawlkhat longal khat beek a suakta kei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin a zite un pasian dangte kiangah paknamtui a hallam a thei papi khempeuh le tua lai-ah a ding nupi khempeuh a kipan Egypt gam leitaw lamah a teng mi khempeuh, a vekpi-in mi tampi tak in kei kiangah,"},"16":{"text":"“ Topa’ mina nong gen thute kong mang kei ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin ka ciamsa uh bangin kote, ka pute ka pate, ka kumpite uh le kumpi uliante in Judah gam khuapite le Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah ka hih ngei uh bangin vantung kumpinu kiangah paknamtui halin tuidawn biakna ka hihzaw ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka tuacih uh ciangin an tampi ka nei uh a, hau-in gimna zong ka thuak kei uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin vantung kumpinu kiangah paknamtui halna le tuidawn biakna ka hih nawn loh uh a kipan bangmah ka nei nawn kei uh a, namsau le kial in hong thatlum zawsop hi,” a hong ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Nupite in zong, “Vantung kumpinu’ lim a sun dingin moh bawlin paknamtui halna le tuidawn biakna ka bawl uh ciangin ka pasalte uh’ thukim lohpi-in a bawl ka hi zenzen uh hiam?” a hong ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua bangin a hong dawngkik papi, nupi a kipan mi khempeuhte kiangah,"},"21":{"text":"“Judah gam khuapite le Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah note, na pute na pate uh, na kumpite uh, le na kumpi uliante uh a kipan gam sung mi khempeuh in paknamtui halna na bawl uh ciangin Topa in tua pen a phawk lo sa na hi uh hiam? A ngaihsun lo sa na hi uh hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Topa in na hoih lohnate uh le na bawl uh kihhuainate hangin note hong thuakzo nawn lo hi. Tua ahih manin tuni mahmahin zong na gam uh gamlak suakkhin a, mite’ kihamsiatna suakin kuamah teng nawn lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Note in paknamtui halin, Topa’ tungah mawh tham loin, Topa’ thu mang loin ama thukhamte, a ngeinate, le a hong thupiakte zui lo na hih manun tuni mahmahin zong hih gimna note tungah hong tung ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khempeuhte kiang le a diakdiakin nupi khempeuhte kiangah, “ Topa’ kammal ngai dih un. Egypt gamah a om no Judah mite khempeuh aw,"},"25":{"text":"Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in hong genin-ah: Note le na zite un na khut bek uh tawh na sep uh hi loin na kam mahmah uh tawh, ‘Vantung kumpinu’ tungah paknamtui hal ding le tuidawn biakna piak dingin ka kiciamnasa uh bangin ka sem taktak ding uh hi,’ ci-in na gen khinzo uh hi. Tua ahihleh na kiciamna uh kipsak ta unla, na kiciamna uh bangin sem dih un!"},"26":{"text":"Ahih hangin Egypt gamah a om no Judah mite aw, Topa’ thugenna hong ngai un. En un, Topa in kong cihin-ah, Egypt gamah a om Judah mi khat beek in, ‘ Topa a nuntak bangin,’ ci-in ka min zangin a kiciam nawn loh nadingun ka min lianpi tawh ka kiciam khinzo hi."},"27":{"text":"En un, amaute tungah hoihna tung loin siatna a tun nadingin keimah in ka bawl ding hi. Egypt gamah a om Judah mi khempeuh namsau le kialpi tawh si ding uh a, khat beek a suakta kei ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Namsau tawh thahna a thuak kha lo mi tawmkhate, Egypt gam panin Judah gamah hong ciahkik ding uh a, Egypt gamah a teng dingin a pai a nungtalai sunte in kei’ kammal le amau’ kammal koizaw a manin tung, cih a thei ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Note’ siatna ding ka gensa thute a hong tung takpi ding ahihna thu na theih nadingun Topa in kong cihin-ah, note tungah hih lim kong pia ding a, hih munah note kong thuaksak ding hi:"},"30":{"text":"Topa in kong genin-ah: ‘En un, Judah kumpi Zedekiah, a gal pa ahi amah a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar’ khut sungah ka piak mah bangin Egypt kumpipa Faro Hofra, a galte’ khutsung, amah a thatnuam mite’ khut sungah ka pia ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” ka cithuah lai hi.","ref":"2Kum 25:1-7"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim, Judah gamah kumpi a suahzawh kum li a cin ciangin Neriah’ tapa Baruk in laibu khat sungah keima gen bangbang a gelh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Baruk kiangah,","title":"Baruk Tungah Jeremiah’ Thugenna","ref":"2Kum 24:1; 2Khang 36:5-7; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"“Baruk aw, Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in nang hong hopih hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in, ‘Gimna thuak ing! Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ka dahna le ka natna hong behlap hi. Ka tautauna-in ka gim khinzo a, ka tawlnga thei kei hi,’ na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"“ Topa in nang tungah hih bang a gen dingin hong sawl hi: En in, keimah in ka lamsate ka phelkik a, ka phuhsate ka botkhia kik hi. Keimah in leitung buppi tua bangin ka hih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua sung panin nang a pengthei tuam dingin kingaihsun na hi hiam? Tua bangin kingaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh en in, Topa in kong cihin-ah, mi khempeuh tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi. Ahih hangin nang pen na paina mun khempeuhah kong suaktasak liailiai ding hi, ci hi,” ka ci hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gamdangte’ thu tawh kisai-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen hi.","title":"Egypt Gam Tawh Kisai Genkholhnate"},"2":{"text":"Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim, Judah gamah kumpi a suahzawh kum li a phak hunin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Eufratis gun gei Karkhemish khua-ah Egypt kumpipa Faro Neko simin a zo hi. Egypt kumpipa’ galkapte tawh kisai-in hih bangin a hong gen hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Na lumte uh la unla galsim dingin kuankhia un!"},"4":{"text":"Sakol vante vawh unla, tuang ta un, sakol galkapte aw. Na sik lukhute uh khu unla, na teipite uh tat hiamin, na sik puante uh silh un."},"5":{"text":"“A bangci mawk ahi hiam? Amaute lungmangin a nungkik ta uh hi. A galkapte uh kilehhawl a, lau-in taikekmang mawk uh hi. Kinungleh hei kik lo uh hi; mun khempeuhah launa vive!"},"6":{"text":"A manlang pente zong paikhia thei tuan lo uh a, galkapte zong suakta lo uh hi. Leilu lam Eufratis gun gei-ah hoi-in a tuk uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Nail gunpi bangin a hong khang, guntui khang a bang kua ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Nail gunpi bangin Egypt gam hong khang a, guntui khang hong bang hi. Amah in, kei ka khang ding a, leitung khempeuh ka tuam ding hi. Khuapite le a sunga teng mite ka susia ding hi, a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Sakolte aw, mai nawt un; sakol leengte aw, hat un! Lum a tawi Ethiopia mite le Put mite aw, thal tawi a siam Lud mite aw, na galkapte uh kuansak un."},"10":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni pen Vanglian Topa Pasian’ ni hi a, phu a lakkik ni, a galte a thuk ni ahi hi. Namsau in amaute that ding a, a kham mateng a si uh a dawn ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa Pasian in Eufratis gun gei leilu lamah amaute biakna-in a nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Egypt nungakte aw, Gilead gamah pai unla, damna zatui va la un. Zatui tampi na zat khit uh hangin damna na ngah tuan kei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Gamdangte in na zumhuaina uh hong za khin uh a, leitung bupah na kahna aw uh kiza hi. Na galkapte uh khatlekhat kiphukha-in, a nihun a pukkhawm uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Egypt gam a sim dingin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar’ hong paina tawh kisai-in Topa in hih bangin kei kiangah a hong gen hi:","ref":"Jer 43:10-13"},"14":{"text":"“Egypt gam le Migdol khua-ah va gen in. Memfis khua le Tahpanhes khua-ah va taangko in: ‘Kigingsa le kithawisa-in om un; bang hang hiam cih leh namsau tawh note hong kithat khin ding hi,’ va ci in."},"15":{"text":"Bang hangin na bawngtal pasian uh Apis guallelin taimang ahi hiam? Topa in amah a vattuk hang ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Na mite uh tampi tak hoi-in tuk uh a, amaute in khatlekhat kiangah, ‘Kithawi dih un; i mipihte kiang, i suahna gamah va ciahkik ni; tua hileh hih namsau tawh sihna pan i suakta ding hi,’ a kici uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Egypt kumpipa Faro, min thak khat pia unla, ‘Kam si bekin hun mawk beisak pa,’ ci ta un."},"18":{"text":"Vanglian Topa keimah Kumpipa ka hi hi. Taber mual, mual khempeuh sangin sangzaw-in, Karmel mual, tuipi tungah sangpi-in a dawktoh bangin, no hong sim pa’ thahatna a lian mahmah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Egypt gamah a tengte aw, note salin a hong kipaipih cianga ding na puanlomte uh zialkhol un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Memfis khua gamlak suak ding a, kisia gawpin, kuamah teng lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Egypt gam, bawngla hoih mahmah tawh a kibang hi. Leilu lam panin a hong leeng cippi in amah a pet hi."},"21":{"text":"A galkap cialte nangawn amaute’ lakah bawngno hat lote a bang lel uh hi. Pang loin, do tentan lo uh a, nungkikin a taikeek uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ kisiat ding ni, amau’ gimthuak ding ni, hong tungzo hi."},"22":{"text":"A galte uh hong kuan uh ahih manin Egypt mite gul tai bangin zutkhat a kisuah uh hi. A galte uh sing phuk bangin hei tawh hong kuan uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Gam pha lua-in a kiphut zawh loh hangin a galte un a singte uh a phukmaisak teitei ding uh hi, Topa in a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute kauphe sangin tamzaw uh a, simzawh loh zahin a tam uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Egypt nungakte a maizum ding uh hi. Leilu lam panin a hong pai mite’ khut sungah amaute a kipia ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in, “En un: Keimah in Thebes khua-a Amon pasian le Faro kumpipa a kipan a pasian-te uh le a kumpite uh, Egypt kumpipa le amah a muang mi khempeuh tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar le a uliante’ khut sungah amaute ka pia ding hi. Ahi zongin Topa in kong cihin-ah, nidang lai bangin Egypt gamah mi a tengkik ding hi.","ref":"Isa 19:1-25; Ezk 29:1-32:32"},"27":{"text":"Ahih hangin lau kei un, ka nasempa Jakob’ suante aw. Patau kei un, Israel mite aw. Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlapi panin note kong honkhia ding a, na suanlekhakte uh saltanna gam panin kong honkhia ding hi. Jakob’ suante hong ciahkik ding uh a, nuamtakin a om ding uh hi. Kuamah in amaute a lausak nawn kei ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in kong cihin-ah, ka nasem Jakob’ suante aw, lau kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note kong ompih hi. Note ka hong thehthangna gamte khempeuh ka susia khin ding a, ahih hangin note kong susia khin kei ding hi. A kilawm zahin kong thuhilh ding a, gim pia loin kong mawk koih kei ding hi,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 30:10-11"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Faro kumpipa in Gaza khua a sim ma-in Filistia mite tawh kisai-in Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen hi.","title":"Filistia Mite’ Thu Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in a hong genin-ah, “En un, leilu lam panin tui hong khang ding a, hong letkhia-in hong luang ding hi. Gam sung le gam sunga om khempeuh hong tum ding a, khuapi le a sunga teng khempeuh hong tum ding hi. Mite kiko ding uh a, gam sunga om mi khempeuh a kap ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakol khegingte za-in, sakol leeng gingte le a pei kigawite a zak uh ciangin, a khut uh zaw luata ahih manin pate in a tate uh a donzo nawn kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Filistia mi khempeuh kisia-in, Taia le Sidon panin huhnate khaktanin, suksiat ding ni hong tungta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa keimah in Filistia mite le Kaftor tuipi gei-ah a omlaite ka susia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Gaza khuate maizum ta uh a, Ashkelon khua kisia ta hi. Aw, no Anak mi a omlaite aw, bang tanvei noleno kisuliam ding na hi uh hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Note in, ‘ Topa’ namsau aw, tawlnga nai lo ding na hi hiam? Na paai sungah lutkik inla, taang loin khawl dide in,’ na ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in ka sawl nakleh bang ci-in khawl dide thei ding ahi hiam? Ashkelon khua le tuipi gei teng a sim dingin ka sawlsa ahi hi,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zefa 2:4-7; Zek 9:5-7"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab gam tawh kisai-in Vanglian Topa, Israel mite’ Pasian in a genin-ah: “Nebo mite in gimna a thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a gam uh a kisia ding hi. Kiriathaim khua kila khinzo a, a kulhpite uh cim khinta hi. A mite in maizumna thuak uh a,","title":"Moab Gam Tawh Kisai Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Moab gam a minthanna beita hi. Heshbon khua-ah a galte un a simna ding uh vaihawm uh a, ‘Hong pai un, Moab gam i beimangsak ding hi,’ a ci uh hi. Madmen khua aw, nang zong na gamdai ta ding hi. Namsau in nang hong nungdelh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngai dih un! Horonaim khua-ah mi kiko a, ‘Ngongtatna le siatna lianpi,’ a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Moab gam kisusia khinta a, a kahna aw uh Zoar khua dongin a kiza hi."},"5":{"text":"Luhith mual kahtohna lampi-ah a paikawmun a kap uh hi. Horonaim khua-ah a tuahsuk laitakun khuapi siatna hangin a kikona aw uh a za uh hi."},"6":{"text":"‘Tai un! Na suahtak nadingun tai un! Sehnel gam a gamlak late bangin taimang un!’ a ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Na hatnate uh le na neihsate uh na suan manun note zong hong kipai khiatpih ding hi. Na pasian uh Khemosh zong a siampi teng le a ulian teng tawh, kipai khiatpih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khua khempeuh kisia khin ding a, khat beek a suakta kei ding hi. Topa in ka gensa bangin mualkuam le zangleite a kisia ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Moab mite a leenkhiat theih nadingun a kha ding uh pia un. A khuapite uh gamlak suak ding a, kuamah a teng kei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“ Topa’ na citakin a sem lopa in kamsiatna thuak tahen. Thah nadingin a namsau a dok lopa in hamsiatna thuak tahen."},"11":{"text":"Moab gam a neu lai a kipanin nuamtakin a om den ahi hi. Gamdangah kipaikhiatpih ngei lo a, thawl khat pan thawl khatah a kitei kawikawi leenggahzu tawh kibang lo hi. A limna kilamdang ngei lo a, a gimnam zong kikheel ngei lo hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin en un, Topa in kong cihin-ah, Moab mite leenggahzu buak bangin a buakhia ding mi kong paisak hun hong tung ding hi. Amaute in a thawl a hawm dong bungkhia-in, tua khit ciangin a thawl sukhamzan ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mite, a muan uh Bethel pasian in a maizumsak mah bangin Moab mite, a biak uh Khemosh pasian in a maizumsak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Note in bang hangin, ‘Galhangte ka hi uh a, galsim hatte ka hi uh hi,’ ci thei na hi uh hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Moab gam le a khuapite a susia ding pa hong paito ta hi. A tangval hoihpente uh thahlup dingin kipaipih khinzo hi, ci-in Vanglian Topa a kici keimah Kumpipa in kong gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Moab gam a kisiat ding sawt nawn lo a, a gimna ding hong naita hi."},"17":{"text":"“A kiima tengte le a min a thei mite aw, Moab gam kah un. ‘A minthanna bei khinta a, a vangliatna kumpi ciangkhut kitan ta hi,’ ci un."},"18":{"text":"Dibon khua-a teng mite aw, na minthanna uh mun sang panin hong kumsuk unla, leivui lakah hong tu un! Bang hang hiam cih leh Moab hong sim dingte hong paita a, na kulhte uh hong suksiatsak zo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Aroer khua-a teng mite aw, lam gei-ah dingin na en un! A hong galtai numei le pasalte kiangah, ‘Bang thu piang ahi hiam?’ ci-in dong un."},"20":{"text":"Moab gam kisia khinzo a, zumhuaina thuak khinzo hi. Thum unla kah un! Arnon gun dungah, Moab gam kisiatna thu va gen un."},"21":{"text":"“Pasian’ thukhenna, mualtung gamteng le Holon khua, Jahzah khua, Mefaath khua,"},"22":{"text":"Dibon khua, Nebo khua, Bethdiblathaim khua,"},"23":{"text":"Kiriathaim khua, Bethgamul khua, Bethmeon khua,"},"24":{"text":"Kerioth khua, le Bozrah khua a kipan Moab gam sung a gamla, a nai-a om khuapi khempeuhah hong tungzo hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in kong cihin-ah, Moab gam’ hatna teng bei khinta hi. A hatna le a vangliatna teng kisuksiatsak hi."},"26":{"text":"“Moab, zu khamsak un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Topa langpangin kiliansak hi. Tua ahih manin ama luak mahah amah bual ding a, mi khempeuh in awi-in a nuihsan ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Moab aw, nang zong Israel mite nuihsan hi lo na hi hiam? Ama thu na gen simin lungdamin na lu na sinsin’, amah guta sa na hi hiam?"},"28":{"text":"Moab gam a teng mite aw, khuapite nusia unla, kawl lakah teng un! Keen pangah vakhu bu bawl bangin va om un."},"29":{"text":"Moab’ kiphatsakna ka za khinzo a, kiphasak pha mahmah hi. Kiliansakin kisathei a, kuamah thusim loin mite a neu-et hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama hehna ka thei a, a kisialhna teng zuaupi hi-in, a sepna teng zong zuaupi mah ahi hi, Topa in kong ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Moab a dingin ka tau hi. Moab gammi khempeuh a dingin ka kap a, Kirheres khua a dingin zong ka thum hi."},"32":{"text":"Sibmah khua aw, Jazer khua a’ ding sangin nang a dingin ka nak kahzaw hi. Nang pen leenggah gui zaam bangin na hiangte in tuipi kantan a, Jazer khua dongah na zaam suak hi. Na khuakhal ante le na leenggahte hong kisuksiatsak ta hi."},"33":{"text":"Leihoih mahmah Moab gamah lungdamna le kipahna a beita hi. Leenggah cilna panin leenggahzu ka luangkhiasak nawn kei a, leenggah cilin lungdamin kuamah a kiko nawn kei a, a kikona uh lungdam kikona hi lo hi."},"34":{"text":"“Heshbon khua panin Elealeh khua le Jahaz dongah, Zoar khua panin Horonaim khua le Eglathshelishiah khua dongah mite’ kahna aw kiza hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Nimrim tui nangawn keu ta a, kisusia ta hi."},"35":{"text":"Moab gam mualsang tungah biakna pia a, milim pasian-te tungah paknamtui a hal mite, Topa in kong cihin-ah, tua bang ka hihsak nawn kei ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Moab a dingin ka kap a, Kirheres khua mite a dingin misi vuina tamngai kitum bangin ka kapkhia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a neih a lam khempeuh uh kisiamang khinta hi."},"37":{"text":"“Mi khempeuh in a lu uh mettol uh a, a khamul uh kiatsiang uh hi. A khutte uh kuikek uh a, a kawng uhah puanhampi a teng uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Moab gam innkhum khempeuh le lam lianpi khempeuhah kahna bekbek a om hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kong cihin-ah, leibeel suktap bangin Moab gam ka sutam a, kuamah in phamawh a sa kei hi."},"39":{"text":"Moab gam kitam ta! A mite kap! Maizumin hong nungngat ta! Tua ahih manin amah pen mite’ nuihsat ding le lipkhap ding a suakzo hi."},"40":{"text":"Topa in kong cihin-ah: En in, muvanlai leeng bangin manlang takin gam khat hong leeng ding a, Moab gam a sim dingin a kha hong zal ding hi."},"41":{"text":"A khuapite kila-in a kulhpite zong kila ding hi. Tua ni ciangin Moab galkapte nupi nausuak ding bangin a lau ding uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Moab kisusia ding a, a minamin a om nawn kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa demin a kiliansak uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Moab gam a teng mite aw, Topa in kong cihin-ah, launa, dum le thangte in note hong pang!"},"44":{"text":"Lauhuaina pan a taisim mite dum sungah a kia ding hi. Dum sung panin a hong kahkhiato mite, thangah a awk veve ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Moab gim ka piak ni-in hih thute ka tungsak ding hi, Topa in kong ci hi."},"45":{"text":"A bahgawp galtaite in Heshbon khua hong beel uh hi. Ahih hangin Sihon kumpipa a maanna ngei Heshbon khua panin meikuang hong kipankhia veve hi. Gal a simnuam mite’ tenna Moab gam, a gammong dongin mualsangte zong a kangtum hi."},"46":{"text":"Moab aw, gimna na thuak ding hi. Khemosh pasian a bia mite si khinta uh hi. Na tapate uh sal dingin kipaipih khin a, na tanute uh zong thongkia dingin kipaipih hi."},"47":{"text":"“Ahih hangin Topa in kong cihin-ah, nidang ciangin Moab gam a ngei bangsakin ka hausakkik ding hi,” a ci hi. Moab tungah thukhenna tu-a zah ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1-16:14; 25:10-12; Ezk 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zefa 2:8-11"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ammon mite tawh kisai-in Topa in a genin-ah: “Israel mite in tapa nei lo ahi uh hiam? Innluah ding nei lo ahi uh hiam? Bang hangin Milkom pasian biate in Gad gam la-in a khuapite sungah teng ahi uh hiam?","title":"Ammon Mite’ Thu Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih manin, Topa in kong cihin-ah, Ammon gam Rabbah khua kisimin, galdona aw a kizak hun ka tungsak ding hi. Tua khuapi kisusiamang ding a, a khuaneute a kihaltum ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa in kong cihin-ah, Israel mite in a gam uh a laksakte’ kiang panin a gam uh a ngahkik ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Heshbon khuamite aw, kap un! Ai khua kisia khinta! Rabbah khua numeite aw, kap un! Puanhampi silh unla kap un. Khua lakah lung-amin kawi taitai un. Bang hang hiam cih leh na Milkom pasian uh le a siampite le a uliante hong kilak khiatsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A citak lo mite aw, bang hangin na hatna uh kisaktheihpih na hi uh hiam? ‘Kua in eite hong simzo ding ahi hiam?’ ci-in bang hangin na hauhna uh suang na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Vanglian Topa Pasian in kong genin-ah, na kiim na pamte uh kiang panin note tungah gimna kong tungsak ding hi. Note hong kihawlkhia ding a, mi khempeuh amau tum ciatin taikeek ding uh a, a hong kaikhawm kik ding kuamah om lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Ahih hangin Topa in kong cihin-ah, nidang ciangin Ammon mite a ngei bangsakin ka hausakkik ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Ezk 21:28-32; 25:1-7; Amos 1:13-15; Zefa 2:8-11"},"7":{"text":"Edom gam tawh kisai-in Vanglian Topa in a genin-ah: “Teman gamah a pil om nawn lo ahi hiam? Thu ngaihsut siamte in ngaihsun thei nawn loin a pilna uh beita ahi hiam?","title":"Edom Gam Tawh Kisai Genkholhna"},"8":{"text":"Dedan gamah a tengte aw, kihei unla galtai un; guam sungah bu un. Bang hang hiam cih leh gim ka piak ni ciangin Esau’ suanlekhakte tungah siatna ka tungsak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mite in leenggah a lawh uh ciangin a gui tungah tawm a nusia lai uh hi. Zanin gutate in na a guk uh ciangin a deih teng bek uh a gu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin Esau’ suanlekhakte khempeuh ka guaksuaksak a, a bukna munte uh ka kilangkhia sak hi. Tua ahih manin a bu thei nawn kei uh hi. A tate uh, a sanggamte uh, le a vengte uh si khin uh a, khat beek a suakta kei hi."},"11":{"text":"A tagah na tate uh ka kiangah hong koih un; ke’n amaute ka kem ding hi. Na meigong numeite uh zong kei hong muangsak un."},"12":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kong cihin-ah: Gim a thuak dingin a kilawm lo mite nangawn in thuak veve uh ahihleh note in zong thuak loin om ding na hi uh hiam? Note in gim thuak loin na om kei ding uh a, na thuak veve ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kong cihin-ah, Bozrah khua pen mite’ lipkhap ding, zahpih ding, nusiat ding le kihamsiatna-in a zat ding uh a suak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa kiang pan thu ka za a, gam khempeuhah thugen dingin mi khat kisawl hi: “Hong kikaikhawm unla, Edom gam a sim dingin hong kithawi un."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in gamdangte sangin nang hong neusak zaw-in mite kong simmawhsak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na kisaktheihna in nang hong khem a, na ngaihsut bangin mite in nang hong kihta lo hi. Suangkeen dawnah na teng a, mualsang tungah na teng hi. Muvanlai bu zahin sangpi-in na ten hangin tua lai mun panin kong lakhiasuk veve ding hi, Topa in kong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"“Edom gam pen a mulkimhuai gam suak ding a, a kantan mi khempeuh in a siatgawpna hangin lamdangsa-in a mulkim ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in kong cihin-ah, Sodom khua, Gomorrah khua, le a kiima khuate a kisiatgawp bangin, tua lai munah kuamah teng lo ding a, kuamah a peem kei ding hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24-25"},"19":{"text":"En un, lonona-ah nuamtakin a om tuute, Jordan gam tulak panin a hong paito humpinelkai in a delhmang bangin, a gam uh nusia-in thakhat thu-in ka taimangsak ding a, a gam uh a uk dingin ka deih peuhpeuh ka seh ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei bang mi kua om ahi hiam? Keima to ahi ding kua omlai ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Ka mai-ah kua kumpi hong ding ngam ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin Edom mite’ thuak ding le Teman gam a teng mite’ gim nadingin Topa’ geelna le ngimnate ngai dih un. A ta ngeekte nangawn uh kikaikhia ding hi. Mi khempeuh lau taktak ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A pukna uh gin’ ngaih lua ahih manin leitung a kiling ding hi. A kahna uh San Tuipi dongah kiza ding hi."},"22":{"text":"En un, muvanlai bangin manlang takin galte hong leengin Bozrah khua a sim dingin tua khua tungah a kha hong zal ding uh hi. Kei zong tua laizial ka ne a, khuaizu tawh kibangin khum ka sa mahmah hi.","ref":"Mang 10:9-10"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mite kiangah pai inla, nang tungah kong gen peuhpeuh, amaute tungah va gen in."},"5":{"text":"A pau na theih loh minam dangte kiangah a hong sawl ka hi kei hi. Na mipih Israel-te kiangah a hong sawl ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"A pau na theih loh, pau haksa a zang minam liante kiangah nang hong sawl hi leng, amaute in na thugen hong mang ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel mite khat beek in na thu hong ngai lo ding uh hi. Keima kam teekteek nangawn ngai lo ding uh hi. Amaute a lungsim uh khauh a, demnopna lungsim nei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in amaute mah bangin a khauh mahmah, a duai mahmahin nang kong bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Suang khempeuh sangin a sakzaw, diamond suang zahin a sakin na lungsim kong bawl ding hi. Tua ahih manin hih a lehdo thei mite kihta kei in,” a hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in thu hong genthuah lai a, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, nang tungah kong thugen khempeuh limtakin ngai inla ciamteh in."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in na thu hong ngai a, hong ngai kei zongin, salin a om na mipihte kiangah va pai inla, nang tungah kong thugen khempeuh amaute tungah va gen in,” a hong ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian’ kha in hong paipihto a, zinling zahin a gin’ ngaih awging khat ka nungah ka za a, “Vantungah a om Topa, ama minthanna hangin phat un,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"13":{"text":"Ganhingte in huihlakah a khazapna le leengpei gingte ka za a, zinling zahin gin’ ngaih mahmah hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian’ kha in hong paikhiatpih laitakin lungkim hetloin ka heh suak mahmah hi. Ahi zongin Topa’ vangliatna in kei hong zozaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ka mipih salte’ omna, Khebar Gun gei-a a om Telabib munah ka va tung a, ka muhsa thute ngaihsunin tua lai-a amaute lakah ni sagih sung ka om hi."},"16":{"text":"Ni sagih a cin khit ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih a,","title":"Israel Mite’ Galvil pa (Ezk 33:1-9)"},"17":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel minamte’ galvil pa dingin nang kong koih hi. Nangma tungah ka hong gen hilhkholhnate khempeuh amaute tungah na gensawn ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilo pa khat pen si ding hi, ci-in kong gen ciangin, amah kikheelin a nuntak theih nadingin thu na hilhkholh kei leh, tua mipa pen mawhnei mahin si ding a, ahi zongin ama sihna thu ahihleh nang kong ngawh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Migilo khat hilhkhol napi-in a mawh bawlna a tawp kei leh, a mawhnei mahin si ding a, ahi zongin nangma nuntakna suakta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Mihoih mahmah khat gamtatsiat ding hong kipan leh a lauhuaina munah amah ka koih ding hi. Amah hilhkhol kei lecin si ding hi. Ama mawhna hangin si ding a, ama gamtat hoihsate phawkin ka nei kei ding hi. Ama sihna thu-ah nang kong ngawh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin a khialhloh nadingin mihoih khat na hilh a, na thu hong mangin mawhna a bawl kei leh amah nungta ding hi. Nang zong na suakta ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka sungah Topa’ vangliatna hong om lamtak ka phawk a, amah in kei kiangah, “Ding inla, kuam sungah va pai in. Tua lai mun panin nang kiangah thu kong gen ding hi,” hong cihna ka za hi.","title":"Kamsangpa Pau Thei lo"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kei zong kuam sungah ka va pai a, Khebar Gun gei-a ka muh bang teek mahin tua lai-ah Topa’ minthanna vang ka mu hi. Kei zong lei-ah ka boksuk a,"},"24":{"text":"ahi zongin ka sungah Pasian’ kha hong lutin ka khe-in hong dingsak hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Inn-ah ciah inla, inn kikhaknelh in."},"25":{"text":"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, khauhual tawh nang hong kikhih ding a, mite kiangah na paikhia thei kei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na leii ka zawsak ding a, hih a lehdo thei mite na thuhilh thei kei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin nang kong hopih kik ciangin kong pau theisakkik ding a, amaute kiangah, ‘ Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi,’ na ci ding hi. Tua ciangin mi pawlkhat in na thu hong ngai ding uh a, ahi zongin amaute pen a lehdo thei minam ahih uh manin pawlkhat in na thu hong ngai lo ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, leiseek khat la-in na mai-ah koih inla, Jerusalem khuapi lahna-in tua leiseek tung git in.","title":"Jerusalem A Ki-umcihna Ding Zia Ezekiel in Lak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua khuapi a ki-umcihna lah nadingin na kiimah dumte, phungte, galpanna phualte, le kulh sukkhapna ding molhtumte bawl in."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin sikpeek khat la inla, nang le khuapi kikalah kulh lim dingin koih in. Tua ciangin khuapi lam en in. Tua khuapi a ki-umcih hi-in, nang pen a umcihte’ lim ding na hi hi. Hih pen Israel mite a dingin lim hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua ciangin na veilam pang delhphahin lum in. Israel mite’ mawhna hanga gimna nangma tungah kong nga ding hi. Tua lai munah lumin amaute’ mawhna"},"5":{"text":"ni zathum le ni sawmkua sung na thuak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ gimthuak ding kum khat sung dingin ni khat, amau’ thuak ding kum zah nangmah in a ni-in na thuak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih bangin na gamtat khit ciangin na taklam delhphahin na kihei leuleu ding a, Judah mite’ mawhna ni sawmli sung gim na thuak leuleu ding hi. Nangma thuak ni khat pen amau’ thuak ding kum khat tang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jerusalem khuapi a ki-umcihna sal gega in. Na puanak ban zialto inla, tua khuapi siatna ding thu gen in."},"8":{"text":"Nang pen khauhual tawh kong hencip ding a, tua khuapi umcihna a kiman mateng na kihei thei kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tu-in mangbuh, mangbuhham, belawi, taang, le mangbuhman pawlkhat la inla, tuate hel khawmin anlumin bawl in. Na veilam delhphahin na lup hun ni zathum le ni sawmkua sung tua na bawl anlum na ne ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nek khatin anlum shekel sawmnih gik bek na ne ding a, ni khatin khatvei bek na ne ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tui zong duh zahzah hi loin, ni khatin thawl khat bek na dawn ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na nek ding anlum pen mite’ muhin mihing ekkeu khawmin tuate mei-in na cih khit ciangin tua sungah na em ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Israel mite, gam dangah ka thehthang hun ciangin thukham in nek dingin a kham an ninte tu-a mah bangin ne ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin kei zong ka dawngkik a, “Topa Pasian aw, cikmahin kei ka kininsak ngei kei hi. Ka neu tung a kipan tu dongin ama thu-in a sitawm ganhing sa ahi a, gamsate’ nek baang ahi zongin ka ne ngei kei hi. A ninin a kiseh an khat peuhpeuh ka ne ngei nai kei hi,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Tua ahihleh pha hi. Mihing ek tangin bawng-ek na zang ding a, tua bawng-ek am sungah na em ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in thu hong genthuah lai a, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Jerusalem khuapi sungah an ka beisak ding a, mite in lunghihmawhna tawh a annek a tuidawnte uh ciangtan ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"An le tui loin amaute om ding uh a, amaute lunggimin, a tawpna-ah a mawhna hangun beimang ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, namsau hiam khat la inla, na sam le na khamul ki-atkhia in. Tua ciangin a multe tawi tehin seh thum suah in.","title":"Ezekiel in a Sam le a Mul Kiat"},"2":{"text":"Umcihna lim na man ciangin khuapi lim sungah seh khat haltum in. Tua ciangin seh khat la leuleu inla, khuapi kiimah na paikawmin na namsau tawh satnen in. A omlai seh khat pen huihlakah lawn in. Keimah in ka namsau tawh tuate ka sat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a multe tawmno khat la inla, na puanmongteep-ah tun in."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin na tunsate sung panin tawmcikkhat la leuleu inla, meikuang sungah lawnin kangtumsak in. Tua sung panin mei hong kuangin Israel minam buppi hong lawh ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in, “Hih Jerusalem khuapi lim en in. Leitung laizangah ka koih a, a kimkotah gamdang khempeuh ka omsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jerusalem in ka thupiakna lehdo-in, minam dangte sangin a gilo zaw hong suak a, a kiima om gamdangte sangin a thumang lo zaw hong suak hi. Jerusalem in ka thupiakte nialin, ka thukhamte zui nuam lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, tu-in Topa Pasian ahi keima thugente ngai in. Ka thukhamte zui loin, ka thupiakte ngai lo na hih manin na kiima om minam dangte sangin siatna tamzaw na piangsak hi. Minam dangte’ gamtat ngeinate na zui hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa Pasian ahi keimah in nang kong langpanna thu a hong gen ka hi hi. Minam dang khempeuhte’ muhin nang tungah thu kong khen ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka deih loh hih nate khempeuh na gamtatna hangin cikmahin ka hih ngei nai loh, cikmah ciangin zong ka hih nawn loh ding thu tawh nang Jerusalem gim kong pia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua kong gimpiakna hangin nang Jerusalem khuapi sungah papite in a tapate’ sa ne-in, tapate in a pate uh’ sa ne ding uh hi. No a mite gim kong pia ding a, a suaktakha sunsunte nangawn mun khempeuhah kong thehthang gawp ding hi.","ref":"Kah 4:10"},"11":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian ahi keimah a nungta ka hih mah bangin, note in siatna nam khempeuh le a muhdahhuai gamtatna tawh ka biakinn ninsak na hih manun cikze hetloin note kong sukmang taak kei leh, ci-in ka kiciam hi."},"12":{"text":"Note seh thum suah seh khat pen cina le gilkialin khuapi sungah na si ding uh hi. Seh thum suah seh khat, khuapi kiimah namsau-in na si ding uh hi. A omlai seh thum suah seh khat ahihleh mun khempeuhah hong thehthangin namsau tawh kong delh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ka lung a kim dongin kong hih ding a, ka hehna le ka sinsona teng na thuak ding uh hi. Note tungah hih thute hong tun ciangin, note’ cihtak lohna hangin deihsak luatna tawh a hong heh pau ka hihna na phawk ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Na kiim uhah a om minamte in note hong muhkhak uh ciangin hong phitsanin hong pelh ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Note tungah hehin sinsona tawh gim kong piak ciangin na kim uha a om minam dangte khempeuh lau ding uh hi. Amaute in note hong muhdah et-in hong simmawhbawl ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Na annek ding uh hong khaktan sakin note kong puksisak ding hi. Note a hong susia ding gilkialna pen thaltang’ kapkhak bangin na na sa velval ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Na tate uh a sisak dingin kialpi hong tungsakin, a that dingin gamsate kong paisak ding hi. Natna, gal kidona, le gal kikapnate in note hong sisak ding hi. Topa ahi keimah in hih thu kong gen khin hi,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Mang 6:8"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Israel Mualsang Dawnte Hilhkholhna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mualsang dawnte en inla, amaute tungah kong thupiak gen in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in mual liante, mual neute, guam thukte, kuampite kiangah ka gen ding thute, Israel minamte in a ngaihna ding uh gen in. Mite in milim a biakna munte a vatgawp dingin namsau khat kong kuansak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Biakna taute kiphelkek ding a, paknamtui taute kisatkham ding hi. Tua lai-ah a om mi khempeuh kithatin, a milimte uh’ mai-ah kipaithang gawp ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel misi luanghawmte ka thehthang gawp ding a, a guhte uh biakna tau kiimah ka lawnthang gawp ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel khuapite khempeuh beimang ding a, milim a biakna uh mun khempeuh kisusia ding hi. Tua ahih manin a biakna taute uh le a milimte uh vutlevai suakin, a paknamtui taute uh kisatvui gawp ding ahih manin, milim biak nadingin a bawlsa khempeuh uh maimang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mun citengah mi kithatlum ding a, a suakta sunsunte in kei pen Topa ka hih lamtak hong phawk ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tua banga kihonthahna panin pawlkhat ka suaktasak ding a, minam dangte lakah kithehthangin,"},"9":{"text":"salin a om ding uh hi. Tua bangin salin a omna uh mun panin, amau’ lungsim cihtak lohna uh hangin kei hong nusiatna uh le keimah sangin milim a deihzawkna uh hangin a maizum nadingun gim a pia ding ka hih lamtak thei-in kei hong phawk ding uh hi. Amau’ gitlohna le a haitatnasate uh hangin amau mahmah kimudahtawm ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei pen Topa ka hih lamtak hong thei ding uh a, amaute gimpiak ding ka genkholhnate a mawkpau ka hihlohlam a phawk ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in, “Israel mite’ gitlohna le a muhdahhuai a gamtatnate khempeuh uh hangin na khut singin lei tuan inla, a dahin kap in. Amaute galkidona, kial, le natna hangin si ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A gamla a om mite cina-in si ding uh a, a nai-a omte gal sungah si ding uh hi. A omlai sunte gilkialin puksi ding uh hi. Amaute in keima hehna thuak ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Milimte’ lak le biakna tau kiimah si luanghawm kithehthang ding a, mual sang tungteng, mual dawnzangteng, singniim nuai citeng, tawsaw kung lian nuai khempeuh, le milim biakna-in paknamtui a halna uh mun khempeuhah si luanghawm om ziazua kawikawi ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hih lamtak mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Keimah in ka khut zanin a gam khempeuh uh ka susia ding hi. Leitaw lam sehnel gam pan a kipanin leilu lam Riblah khuapi dongin, Israel mite’ omna mun khempeuh, siit nei loin ka vatmai ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hih lamtak mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Beina Hong Tung"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Topa Pasian ahi keimah in Israel leitang tawh kisai-in ka gen thu hih bang ahi hi: A beina hita! Gam buppi a beina hita hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel-te aw, tu-in na beina ding uh hong tungta a, note in ka hehna tu-in na thuakta ding uh hi. Na gamtatnasa uh tawh kizui-in thu kong khen ding a, na gamtatsiatna uh tawh kizui-in gim kong pia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Note kong zah kei ding a, zong kong khasiat kei ding hi. A muhdahhuai na gamtatnasate uh tawh kizui-in gim kong pia ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hih lamtak na hong thei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasian in a gen thu in: “Note’ tungah haksatna khat khit khat a banbanin hong tung thuahthuah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A beina hong tungta hi. Note a man na hita uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel gam sungah a teng note’ beina ding hong tungta ding hi. Mualsang dawn citeng a biakna munte-ah lungdamna om nawn loin buaina bek a omna ding hong naita hi."},"8":{"text":"A sawt loin ka hehna thu na thuak ding uh a, na gamtatnasate uh hangin thu hong khenin, a muhdahhuai na gamtatnate uh hangin gim kong pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Note kong zah kei ding a, zong kong khasiat kei ding hi. A muhdahhuai na gamtatnasate uh hangin gim a hong pia ding ka hi hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna le note tungah gim a hong piapa ka hihna na thei ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Siatna ding hun hong tungta hi. Na ngongtatna uh khang a, na kiphatsakna uh lian hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilote’ hauhna le lungmuannate haksa loin beimang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A hun hong tungta a, a ni hong naita hi. Mi khempeuh tungah ka hehna hong tungta ding ahih manin sumlei sumzuak nasepnate a kimanna om nawn lo hi."},"13":{"text":"A neihsa a zuakkhia pa in a nuntak sungin a zuaksa van ngahkik lo ding hi. Mi khempeuh tungah hehna hong tung ahih manin a mawhna hangun kuamah nungta lo ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"“Amaute in gal peengkul tum uh a, a vekpi-un kiging uh hi. Ahi zongin mi khempeuh tungah ka hehna tungkim ding ahih manin galsim dingin kuamah kuankhia zo lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Khua pualamah galkidona om a, khua sungah cinatna le gilkialna om hi. Gamlak a om khempeuh gal sungah si ding uh a, khuasunga om khempeuh cina le gilkialin si ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Vakhu lau bangin mi pawlkhatte in mualtung tuh ding uh a, ahi zongin amau’ mawhna hangin si veve ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khempeuh’ khut zaw dakdakin, a khuk uh ling kelkel ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in dahna limin puanhampi silh ding uh a, pumlingawp ding uh hi. A sam uh kimettolsak ding a, a mindai ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa’ hehna amau’ tungah a tun ni ciangin, a ngun a khamte un amaute suahtak thei lo ahih manin, a ngun a khamte uh nin bangin kongzing lakah paai ding uh hi. A gilkial uh ciangin zong an bangin tuate ne thei lo uh hi. Ngun le khamte in mawhna sungah amaute tumpihzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute in a kiphatsakpih uh kizepna a manphate, a muhdahhuai milim dingin a bawl uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute’ hauhna pen amau mah in a kih dingin ka bawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Amau’ nate, gamdang mite ka sutsak ding a, a neihsa khempeuh uh migilote sutsakin, ka ninsak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka biakinn a kinitsak ciangin ka kho kei ding hi. Gutate in ka biakinn luhin ninsak ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"“Na khuttum uh zial un. Bang hang hiam cih leh gam sungah mi kithahna dim a, khua sungah ngongtatna dim hi."},"24":{"text":"Minam gilo pente hong paipihin na innte uh ka luahsak ding hi. Minam dangte in na biakna mun ngeite uh a nitsak ciangin mi thahat-a a kineite’ kimuanna beita ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Lungkhamna na tuah uh ciangin lungnopna na zong ding uh a, ahi zongin na mu kei ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Lungkhamna khat khit khat a banbanin na tuak ding uh a, thusia bekbek na zaza ding uh hi. Kamsangte kiangah thu na dong ding uh hi. Siampite in mite tungah hong hilh ding thu thei lo ding uh a, upate in hong gen ding mel thei lo ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa dahin thum ding a, ulian pen pa a cih nading thei loin omcipin, mi khempeuh lau-in ling ding uh hi. Na gamtatna uh tawh kizui-in gim kong pia ding a, midangte tungah thu na khen bangun note tungah thu kong khen ding hi. Hih bangin kong hih ciangin Topa ka hih lamtak na thei ding uh hi,” cihna thu ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Salin ka om uh kum guk a phak kum, a kha gukna, a ni nga ni-in sala om Judah makaite tawh ka inn sungah thu genin ka tut laitakun, thakhatin Topa Pasian’ vangliatna ka sungah hong tum hi.","title":"Jerusalem khuasung A Kihhuaina Zia Kamsangpa’ Muhna"},"2":{"text":"Ka khuadak leh, mihing tawh a kibang pian khat ka mu hi. A kawng nuaisiah ding teng meikuang tawh kibang a, a kawng tungsiah ding teng sumsan kinawtngil tawh kibangin san heuhau hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:27"},"3":{"text":"A khut ding tawh a kibang pian khat in hong sawkin ka samin hong man hi. Tua ciangin hih ka maang sungin Pasian’ kha in vanah hong lenpihto-in Jerusalem khuapi hong tunpih hi. Tua lai panin, Pasian a hehsuahna ahi milim a omna mun, biakinn tual sungnung lutna, leilu lam kongpi-ah hong paipih hi."},"4":{"text":"Kuam sungah ka maang a ka muh bang teekin tua sanah Pasian’ minthanna vang ka mu hi.","ref":"Ezk 1:28"},"5":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, leilu lamah khuadak in,” hong ci hi. Kei zong ka khuadak leh, kongpi kianga biakna tau kiangah, Pasian’ hehsuahna milim ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, amaute’ gamtatnate na mu hiam?
