Tu-in guahpi ka zusak ding a, gialpite in tua kulh kha-in huihpi hat in mutgawp ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bangin kulh a kicip ciangin na kulh zut uh bang phattuamna om ahi hiam, ci-in mite in hong dong ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen in: Ka hehna tawh huihpi nungsakin, guahpi zusakin, gialpi kiasakin, tua kulhpi ka susia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A tungtham na zut uh kulh sukhamin, thehthangin, a bul dawksak ding a sawm ka hi hi. Tua bangin ka suksiat ciangin note a hong denglum ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua bangin kulh le tua kulh a zut note in ka hehna na thuak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, ‘Tu-in kulh maimangta a, tua mah bangin kulh a zut mite -"},"16":{"text":"thu hoih lo napi-in thu hoih hi, ci-in Jerusalem a lungmuan nadingin thu a gen kamsangte zong bei khinta hi,’ ka ci ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen hi,” a hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, na mite’ lakah a om, a thugen ding uh a phuaktawm numeite en in. Amaute’ gamtatna hangin mawhsakna thu gen inla,"},"18":{"text":"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in amaute tungah ka gen thu hih bangin gen in: No numeite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Mi khempeuh in a khutah a bulh ding uhleh a lu tungah a khip ding uh aite na bawl uh a, tua nate in mite’ lungsim uk hi. Note’ phattuam nadingin sih nading le hinna ding vangliatna thu, ka mihingte tungah na zang nuam uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangbuhham khut khat dim le anlum them tawmkhat na ngah theih nadingun ka mite’ mai-ah kei nong minsiasak uh hi. A si dingin a kilawm lopite na that nuam uh a, a hing dingin a kilawm lopite na hingsak nuam uh hi. Tua bangin ka mite tungah zuauthu genin, amaute in note’ thugen hong um uh hi."},"20":{"text":"“Topa Pasian ahi keimah in ka gen thu in: Sihna le hinna ukna-in na zat uh na aite uh ka deih kei hi. Note’ khut panin tuate hong bawhkhiat sakin, ukcip dingin na hanciam uh mite ka khahkhia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na ai khipte uh zong hong hawkkhiat sakin note’ khutsung panin ka mite ka suaktasak paisuak ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Keima gen hi lo napi-in na thuzuau genteng uh tawh mihoihte na lunggimsak uh a, migilote a sihtheih nadingun hong kihei loh nading lamah na lehhanthot zawsop uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na zuau maangmuhnate uh le mi lam a khialsak thei na thugen kholhnate uh beita ding hi. Note’ khutsung panin ka mite ka honkhia ta ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mi makai pawlkhat kei kiangah hong pai-in Pasian’ deihna bang ahi hiam, ci-in hong dong uh hi.","title":"Kamsangpa tungah Thu a Dong Milim Biate tungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,"},"3":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih mite in milim bia uh a, milim in mawhna sungah amaute tunpih hi. Amaute’ thu theihnopte a gen dingin hong um uh ahi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian ahi keimah in amaute tungah ka gen hih thute gen in: Milim bia-in mawhna sungah milimte kitunsak a, tua khit ciangin kamsangte tungah thu a dong dingin a hong pai Israel mi peuhmah in keima thudawnna kam ngah ding uh hi. Tua thudawnna pen a milim tampite uh in a zak dingun a kilawm dawnna hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua milimte in keima kiang panin Israel mite paikhiatpih uh a, ahi zongin tua bangin ka dawnna tawh kei lamah ka mite ngahkik dingin ka kilamen hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen pen Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Hong kihei kik unla, na milimte uh nusia un."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite khat peuhpeuh ahi a, Israel mite lakah a om gamdang mi khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, kei kiang panin paikhia-in milim bia a, milim in mawhna sungah a tunpih khit ciangin kamsangpa tungah thu a dong dingin a pai leh, Topa ahi keimah in ama thudotna ka dawng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah nialin, midangte’ etteh dingin ka bawl ding hi. Keima mite lak panin amah ka lakhia ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na thei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Kamsang khat peuhpeuh in khemna tawh a man loin thu hong dawn leh, Topa ahi keima khem hi ding hi. Israel mite lak panin tua kamsangpa ka lakhia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kamsangpa le kamsang thu a dong pa a gim thuakna uh kibang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel mite in kei hong nusiat loh nading le a mawhna uh tawh a kinitsak loh nadingun hih bangin ka hih ding hi. Amaute pen keima mi hi ding uh a, kei pen amaute’ Pasian ka hi ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen hi,” a hong ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Pasian in Jerusalem Gim A Piakna Thuman"},"13":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, gam khat peuhpeuh in khialhna bawlin kei tungah hong thuman kei leh keimah in a annek dingteng uh ka susia ding hi. Kialpi tungsakin a mihing a ganhingin ka siasak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Noah, Daniel, le Job, hih mihing thumte nangawn, amaute’ lakah a om hileh, amaute’ hoihna in amau’ nuntakna ciat bek mah suahtakzo ding uh hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Mite a that dingin gamsa kihtakhuaite khahkhia-in, kuamah khual a zin ngam lo dingin tua gam sung a lauhuai-in om leh,"},"16":{"text":"tua gam sungah hih mihing thumte nangawn a om bang hileh, amaute’ tanute le tapate nangawn uh suahtak zo loin, amaute’ nuntakna ciat bek mah suahtakzo ding uh a, tua gam pen gamkhing suak takpi ding hi, ci-in a nungta Topa Pasian ka kiciam hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua gam sungah gal tungsakin, mihing ganhing a siaksiang dingin a husia galhiamte kizang leh,"},"18":{"text":"tua sungah hih mihing thumte a om hangin amau’ pumpi ciat simloh, amau’ tate nangawn suahtakzo tuan lo ding hi, ci-in a nungta Topa Pasian ka kiciam hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua gamah pulpi tungsakin, ka hehna tawh mihing ganhing sisak leng,"},"20":{"text":"tua sungah Noah, Daniel, le Job-te a om ahi zongin, amaute’ hoihna in amau’ nuntakna ciat bek a hutzawh cih loh, amaute’ tate nangawn huzo tuan lo ding hi, ci-in a nungta Topa Pasian ka kiciam hi."},"21":{"text":"“Topa Pasian’ thugen hih bang ahi hi: Mihing ganhing a sumai dingin gimna nasia pen li ahi gal, kialpi, a kihtakhuai gamsate, le natna, Jerusalem-ah ka tungsak ding hi.","ref":"Mang 6:8"},"22":{"text":"A tanute a tapate a paikhiatpih dingin mi khat peuhpeuh a suaktazo kha a om a, nang kiangah hong pai leh, amaute’ omzia na en in. Amaute’ gitlohna zia na mu ding a, Jerusalem gim ka piakna a kilawm a thuman mah ahihna na phawk ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute’ gitlohna zia na muh ciangin ka hihnate khempeuh a kilawm mah ahihna na phawk ding hi. Topa Pasian in thu hong gen khinta hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Jerusalem, A Kimanna a Om lo Leenggui tawh Kibang"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, leenggui pen singkung tawh bangci kiteh ding ahi hiam? Tulaka om singkungte tawh tehna-in leenggui hiangte banga kimang ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Leengguite na-in kizang thei ahi hiam? Vankhaina-a zat ding singzum khet dingin kimang thei ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Meitawhna ding bekin kimang hi. A mong tuak a kattum khit ciangin a omlai a zulkatteng, bangin kimang nawn ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"A kat ma-in zong bangmahin kimang lo ahih manin, kangin a vom khit ciangin a kimanna om lo semsem hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Tulaka om singte in kimanna nei hi. Ahi zongin leengguite kila-in a kihaltum mah bangin Jerusalem-a teng mite lakhia-in"},"7":{"text":"gim ka pia ding hi. Mei panin khatvei a suahtak khit hangun tu-in mei in amaute kangtum ding hi. Amaute gim ka piak ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei’ tungah amaute hong citak lo uh ahih manin gam sung khempeuh gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah thu hong genkik a,","title":"Jerusalem’ Cihtak lohna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, a muhdahhuai-in a gamtatna thu Jerusalem’ tungah gen in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasian in Jerusalem tungah ka gen hih thute gen in: Jerusalem aw, nang pen Kanaan gam panin a piang na hi hi. Na pa pen Amor mite hi a, na nu pen Hit mite ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang na suah lai-in kuamah in hong don lo hi. Na lai hong kitansak lo a, hong kisil lo a, ci tawh zong hong kizut lo a, puan tawh zong hong kitun lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh a hong hih dingin kuamah in nang hehpihna lungsim hong nei lo hi. Na suah lai-in kuamah in nang hong it lo ahih manin gamlakah nang hong kipaidak lel hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ciangin na kiangah kong paikha a, sisan naisan lakah na kitomtom kong mu hi. Tua bangin na om laitakin na sih loh nadingin thu kong pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Singkung hoih bangin nang kong khangtosak hi. Nang cidamin nong khangto a, nungak nong suak hi. Na nawite zong hoihtak mahin hong bawk a, na mul zong hong po ta hi; ahi zongin guaktangin na om hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nang kong muhkhak kik ciangin pasal nei thei ding hun na hita hi. Na pum guakin a om kimlai, ka puan tawh kong khuh a, na zumhuaina-teng hong seelsakin, tenpih dingin kam kong ciam hi. Kong kamciamna tangtung sakin nang pen keima-a’ nong suak hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei zong tui la-in na tunga si baangteng kong sawpkhiatsak a, oliv thau tawh kong zut zol hi."},"10":{"text":"Puanphan kizem hoihte tawh nang hong zemin, savun hoihpen tawh a kibawl khedap hong bulhsakin, saihadial puan hong khimsakin, nai puantungsilh kong silhsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Kizepna a manphate nang kong pia a, tau hong butsakin khainiang kong oksak hi."},"12":{"text":"Nakbahte, bilbahte, le na khuk ding kumpi lukhu hoih kong guan hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin kham le ngun kibawl kizepnate tawh na kizem a, saihadial puan, nai puan, le a kiphan a kizem puante bek na silh tawntung hi. Annel hoihpen pawl a kibawl anlum ne-in, nek ding khuaizu le oliv thaute na kitasam ngei kei hi. Na hoihna a kigen thei lo zahin hong om a, kumpinu na suak hi."},"14":{"text":"A paubaang het lo dingin nang hong bawl ka hih manin gam khempeuhah na melhoihna kithang kawikawi hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"“Ahi zongin na melhoihna le na minthanna a sia lamin zangin, na tuah peuhpeuh luppih ding zolna-in na zang hi."},"16":{"text":"Na puan pawlkhatte, na biakna mun zep nadingin na zang a, numei paktat bangin mi citeng tungah na pumpi na pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang kong piaksa kham le ngun kibawl kizepnate, pasal limin na bawl a, tuate tawh paktatna na gamta hi."},"18":{"text":"Nang ka hong piak, a kizem a kiphan puan hoihte la-in milimte na silhsak a, nang ka hong piak oliv thau le paknamtuite, milim biakna-in na zang hi."},"19":{"text":"Na nek dingin a limci pen annel, oliv thau, le khuaizu kong pia a, ahi zongin milim maipha zon nadingin biakna-in tuate na zang hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kei tawh na neih na tanute le tapate la-in milim biakna-in haltum dingin na pia hi. Kei tungah na cihtak lohna thuneu lua sa a,"},"21":{"text":"milim biak nadingin ka tate piathuah lai na hi hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Hih bangin numei paktat nuntakna tawh a mindaihuai-in na om laitakin na neulai thu, guaktangin na omlai, sisan naisan lakah na kitomtom lai thu na phawkkha kei hi."},"23":{"text":"“Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Gimna na thuak ding hi. Hih bang siatna nam khempeuh na gamta khin a,"},"24":{"text":"lam gei khempeuhah milim biakna ding mun bawlin, paktatna na gamta hi."},"25":{"text":"Na melhoihna beelmang na kizutnelh hi. Na kimuhpih peuhpeuh tungah na pumpi na kipia a, a ni ni-in na paktatna na khan semsem hi."},"26":{"text":"A lan mahmah na veng Egypt mite na luppih a, na paktatna tawh kei nong hehsak hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tu-in nangmah gim a pia ding le na nopsaknateng a lakhia dingin ka khut ka liik khin hi. Nang hong mudahin, na gamtat hoih lohna hangin nang a hong hua Filistia mite’ khut sungah nang kong piazo hi."},"28":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a dangte tawh lungkimzo nai lo na hih manin Assiria mite na nungdelh lai hi. Tuate tawh na paktat a, ahi zongin na lungkimzo nai sam kei hi."},"29":{"text":"Sumbawl Babylon mite tawh na paktat a, ahi zongin tuate tawh zong na lungkimzo tuan nai sam kei hi."},"30":{"text":"“Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: A bangci lawmlawm na hi hiam? Zumna mel thei loin hih bangin na paktat hi."},"31":{"text":"Kongzing citengah milim biakna ding mun na bawl a, paktatna na gamta hi. Ahi zongin numei paktat dangte bangin sum a ngah zong na hi kei hi."},"32":{"text":"A pasal itzaw loin, gamdang mite tawh mawhna a bawl numei tawh na kibang hi."},"33":{"text":"Numei paktatte sum tawh kiguai a, ahi zongin nang in na lunggulhte tungah letsong pia zawsopin, nang a hong luppih dingin mun khempeuh panin mi na guaizaw hi."},"34":{"text":"Nang pen a tuampian numei paktat na hi hi. Kuamah in na tuaci gamtat nadingin hong zol lo hi. Nang tungah sum tawh guaihna hong kipia loin nang in na pia zawsop hi. Tua ahih manin a tuampian mahmah na hi hi."},"35":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin a paktat Jerusalem aw, Topa’ thu ngai in."},"36":{"text":"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Nang in na puante suahkhia-in, numei paktat bangin na pumpi, na lunggulh mite le na milimte tungah kipia-in, milim biakna-in na tate that na hih manin"},"37":{"text":"na lawm luite khempeuh - na it hitaleh na muhdahte hitaleh a vekpi-in ka kaikhawm ding hi. Na kimkotah amaute omsakin, tua ciangin na puanteng kong hawkkhiatsak ding a, na guaktangin na omna ka ensak ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Midangte tawh na mawhna hang le na mi thahna hangin thu kong khen ding a, ka hehna tawh sihna kong thuaksak ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Na lunggulh mite’ khut sungah kong pia ding a, na paktat gamtatna munte le na milim biakna munte, amaute in susiagawp ding uh hi. Na puante le a manpha na kizepnate hong lakkhiat sakin, na guaktangin hong koih ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"“Amaute in mihonte hanthawnin, tua mihonte in suang tawh nang hong dengin, a namsau uh tawh hong satzan ding uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Amaute in na innte hong haltum sakin, na gimthuakna, numei honpi ensak ding uh hi. Numei paktat na hihna kong khawlsak ding a, na mawhpih ding pasalte sum tawh na guaihna kong khawlsak ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka hehna dam ding a, daitakin ka om ding hi. Na tungah ka heh nawn kei ding a, zong kong aam nawn kei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Na neu lai-a kong bawlna na mangngilh a, hih bang tengin na gamtatnate tawh kei nong hehsak hi. Tua ahih manin na gamtatna tawh kizui-in kong thuk hi. A muhdahhuai na gamtat dangte banah bang hangin hih paktatna gamta thuah na hi hiam?” Topa in ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem aw, ‘Tanu in a nu sun,’ cih paunak pen mite in nang tungah hong zang ding uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Nang pen na nu’ ta taktak na hi hi. Na nu in a pasal le a tate mudah hi. A pasalte uh le a tate uh a mudah na sanggam numeite mah tawh na kibang hi. Nang le na sanggam numei ahi khuapi dangte in nu-in Hit mi nei-in, pa-in Amor mi na nei uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Na unu pen leilu lama om Samaria le a khuaneute ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Amaute’ khekhap zui-in a muhdahhuai amaute’ gamtatnate bek tawh na lungkimzo nai kei lai a, tawmvei sungin na gamtatnate khempeuhah amaute sangin na siazaw hi."},"48":{"text":"“Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih takpi mah bangin kong cihin-ah: Nang le na khuaneute’ gamtatsiat zahin na sanggamnu Sodom le a khuaneute gamtatsia ngei nai lo hi."},"49":{"text":"Na sanggamnu’ mawhna pen: Amah le a tanute in nek ding tampi nei-in nuamsa mahmahin, daitakin om uh ahih manin amaute kiphasak uh a, a zawng a cimawhte don lo uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Amaute kihisakin ka deih loh nate gamta uh ahih manin, na theih mah bangin amaute ka nusia hi."},"51":{"text":"Samaria in nangma gamtatsiat zah lang gamta lo hi. Na sanggamnu sangin gamtat siazaw mahmah na hih manin, nang le na sanggam numei dangte i etkak ciangin, amaute a mawh mahmah hinapi-in a mawh lo zah phialin hong kimu hi."},"52":{"text":"Tu-in na mindainateng na thuak kul hi. Na sanggam numeite’ mawhna sangin nangma mawhnate naksiatzaw lua ahih manin nang kiang panin amaute a mawh lo tawh kibang phial hi. Na sanggam numeite a siangtho bangsak phial na hih manin zahla inla maizum in."},"53":{"text":"“Ahi zongin, Sodom le a khuaneute, le Samaria le a khuaneute a cithei-in ka bawlkik ding hi. Tua mah bangin nang Jerusalem zong kong citheisakkik ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Na gamtatnasate hangin na maizum ding a, tua na maizumna in na sanggam numei dangte maingalsak tuam ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Na sanggam numei Sodom le a khuaneute, le Samaria le a khuaneute cithei kikin a ngei uh bangkik ding a, nang le na khuaneute zong na cithei kik ding uh hi."},"56":{"text":"Nangma siatnateng hong kipholak ma, na kiphatsak om hun laitakin na sanggamnu Sodom simmawhbawl hi lo na hi hiam? Tu-in na simmawh ngei na sanggamnu mah na bang teekteek hi. Edom mite, Filistia mite, le na kiima om nang hong mudahte in hong simmawhbawl hi.","merge":"57"},"58":{"text":"Na gamtat hoih lohna, na zumhuai gamtatnateng na thuak kul hi, Topa in ci hi."},"59":{"text":"“Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi. Nang in i kamciamna le i thuciamna don lo na hih manin nangma gamtatna bangin nang tungah kong gamta hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahi zongin na neu lai-a nang tawh i thuciamna lenkipin, a kimang tawntung ding thuciamna nang tawh ka bawl ding hi."},"61":{"text":"Na unu le na naunu na ngahkik ciangin na gamtatnasa teng phawkkikin na mai a zum ding hi. Nang tawh i thuciamna sungah a kihel loh hangin amaute pen nangma tanu bangin hong om ding uh hi."},"62":{"text":"Nang tawh ka thuciamna ka bawlpha ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding hi."},"63":{"text":"Na gamtatnasa khempeuh kong maisak khit ciangin na gamtatnasa khempeuh na phawkkik ding a, maizum lua-in cih nading mel thei loin na om ding hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,","title":"Muvanlai le Leenggui Gentehna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mite kiangah thugentehna khat gen inla,"},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Muvanlai a gol mahmah, a khate zong golin a kizal deda khat om hi. Tua muvanlai in khaveng hoih mahmah nei hi. Lebanon Mual tungah va leengin taamtak kung khat a dawn va kuaitan a,"},"4":{"text":"sumbawlte’ omna gamah pua-in sumbuk bawlte’ khuapi sungah va koih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel gam panin leengguino khat la-in, a khan theih nadingin tui a om tawntungna leihoih mun khatah a suan hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua leengguino hong khangin a hiangpha leengguipi hong suak hi. A hiangte pen muvanlai lamah zaam a, a zungte in leisung thukpi-ah zung kha hi. Tua leenggui in hiang le teh tampi tak nei hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tua ciangin a gol mahmah, a khate golin a mul a pha mahmah muvanlai dang khat a om hi. Tua ahih manin tua leenggui in, ama kisuannasa mun a tui a ngah sangin tui a tamzaw piazo ding, ci-in lametna tawh tua muvanlai lamah a zung kha-in a tehte zong tua lam mah a ngasak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua leenggui pen, a teh no-in, a gah gah thei-in leenggui lianpi a suah theih nadingin limtakin tui a ngah theihna mun leihoihna sungah a kisuan khinsa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian ahi keimah in ka dotnop thu pen: ‘Hih leenggui hingin hoihtakin khangzo ding ahi hiam? Muvanlai masa pen in zungbawhin, a gahte zutkhia-in, a hiangte kuaitanin, keutumsak ding hi lo ahi hiam?’ cihna ahi hi. Tua leenggui bawhkhiat nadingin thahatna ahi a, minam lianpi ahi zongin kisam lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih leenggui pen a kisuan hi mah hi. Ahi zongin hingin khangzo ding ahi hiam? Nisuahna huihpi in a mutkhiat ciangin keutum ding hi lo ahi hiam? Tua a kisuanna munah keutum lel ding hi lo ahi hiam?” a hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah,"},"12":{"text":"“Hih a lehdo thei mite in hih thugentehna a khiatna a thei uh hiam, dong in. Jerusalem khua-ah Babylon kumpipa hong pai-in a kumpipa le a uliante manin Babylon-ah a ciahpihna thu gen in."},"13":{"text":"Amah in kumpipa’ innkuanpih mite khat la-in, amah tawh thuciamna khat bawl a, ama tungah a thuman taktak nadingin kiciamna bawlsak hi. Tua gam a miliante ciahpih hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tua minamte in lehdokik nawn loin, a thuciam bawlna uh a kizuihna ding a deihna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin Judah Kumpipa in amah lehdo veve a, sakol galkap honpite a ngen dingin Egypt gamah mi paisim sak hi. A deihna bangin tangtung ding ahi hiam? Tua bangin a gamtatna tawh suaktazo ding ahi hiam? A thuciamna palsat napi-in gimthuak loin om thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"2Kum 24:15-20; 2Khang 36:10-13"},"16":{"text":"“Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin, kumpi tokhom tungah a tusak, Babylon kumpipa tawh a thuciamna palsat ahih manin Babylon gamah hih kumpipa si ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Babylon mite in mi tampi a thah theih nadingun kan bawlin dum a tawh uh ciangin a thahat Faro’ galkap honpite nangawn in amah huh zo lo ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in a kiciamna le a thuciamna palsatin hih bangin gamta khin ahih manin, amah suakta ngei lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin a zuih dingin keima min tawh a kiciam thukimna palsat ahih manin gim ka pia ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah a awk theih nadingin ngenthang ka zak ding a, amah ka awksak ding hi. Kei tungah amah hong thutak lo ahih manin Babylon-ah paipihin tua lai-ah gim ka pia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A galkap muanhuai pente, gal sungah si ding a, a suakta sunte zong mun citengah kithehthang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ahi keimah in thu a gen ka hihlam na phawk ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in, “Keimah in taamtak sangpi a dawn khat la-in, a dawnngek khat ka satkhia ding a, mual sangpi dawn khatah ka suan ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel mual sangpen dawnah suanin, a hiang zaai-in a gah luai ding a, taamtak lianpi khat suak ding hi. Tua tungah vasa nam khempeuh tawlnga ding a, bu bawlna munin a nei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkung sangte phukin, singkung neute a liansak pa, singkung hingte keusakin, singkung keute a hingkiksak Topa ka hihna thu gam sunga om singkung khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi. Topa ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin a, hih dingin ka gen bangin ka gamta ding hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen leuleu a,","title":"A Mawh pa Si Ding"},"2":{"text":"“Israel gam sungah mite in zat belin a neih paunak, ‘A pate in leenggah thuk ne a, a tate’ ha kim,’ cihna pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 31:29"},"3":{"text":"Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin kong genin-ah: Israel gam sungah hih paunak na zang nawn kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khempeuh keima a’ hi a, pate ahi a, tate ahi zongin keima-a’ ahi hi. A mawh mipa bek si ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Gentehna-in mi a hoih mahmah, a thuman, a diktat mi khat om hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in Israel mite’ milim biakte biakpih lo a, milim biakna pia lo ding, ci-in a kikhamna munah milim biakna sate zong ne lo hi. Midangte’ zi zong luppih dingin zol lo a, numei in nin a neih laitakin zong luppih lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Kuamah khem lo a, kuama na zong sut lo hi. Sum leitawi a lapa in khapna van a apte zong piakik hi. Gilkialte an vakin, puan nei lote puan guan hi."},"8":{"text":"A meet bekbek lunggulhna-in sum leitawi pia lo hi. Gamtatsiat ding ut lo a, mite’ thu a manin khensak hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in ka thupiakte mangin, ka thukhamte hoihtakin zui hi. Tua bang mi pen mihoih ahih manin nungta ding hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi.","ref":"Siam 18:5"},"10":{"text":"“Tua ciangin gentehna-in hih mihoih pa in tapa khat nei a, tua tapa in mi’ na gu-in mi that a, a pa’ gamtat ngei loh a siateng gamta hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in milim biakna pia lo ding a kici munah a kipia biakna sate ne a, midangte’ zite zolin luppih hi."},"12":{"text":"Mizawng mi cimawhte khemin, mi’ na sut a, sum leitawi a lapa in khapna-in a piak nate piakik loin kemsuak hi. Milim bia-in a zumhuai-in gamta hi."},"13":{"text":"A meet lunggulhna-in sum leitawi pia a, a meet zong a kilawm loin tampi tak la hi. Hih bang mipa nungta ding ahi hiam? Nungta het lo ding hi. Hih bangin a mindaihuaite khempeuh gamta ahih manin tuate’ hangin amah si ding hi. Ama sihna pen ama mawhna hang ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Gentehna-in hih mihoih lopa in tapa khat hong nei hi. Tua a tapa in a pa’ gamtat hoih lohna teng mu a, a pa’ gamtat bangin gamta lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel mite’ milim biakte biakpih lo a, a kikhamna munah biakna-in a kipia biakna sa zong ne lo hi. Midangte’ zi zol lo a, zong luppih lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Kuamah bawlsia lo a, kuama na zong sut lo hi. Sum leitawi a lapa in a khapna van a apte zong piakik hi. Gilkialte an vak a, puan nei lote puan guan hi."},"17":{"text":"Gamtatsiat ding ut lo a, a meet bekbek lunggulhna-in sum leitawi pia lo hi. Ka thukhamte zui-in ka thupiakte mang hi. Tua ahih manin hih mipa pen nungta ding a, a pa’ mawhna hangin si het lo ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A pa in ahihleh mi’ na sutin, mite tungah a sia gamta tawntung hi. Tua ahih manin ama mawhna hangin amahmah si hi."},"19":{"text":"“Ahi zongin, ‘Bang hangin a pa’ mawhna a tapa in thuak lo ding ahi hiam?’ nong ci kha ding uh hi. A tapa a hoih a manin a gamtatna hang ahi hi. Amah in ka thukhamte kemin hoihtakin zui hi. Tua ahih manin pel loin amah nungta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A si ding pa pen a mawh mipa ahi hi. Ta in pa’ mawhna thuak lo ding a, tua mah bangin pa in ta’ mawhna thuak lo ding hi. Mihoih pa in a hoihna thaman ngah ding a, migilo pa in a gitlohna thaman thuak ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"21":{"text":"“Migilo khat in a mawh bawlna khawlin ka thukham zui hen la, a hoih a manin gamta leh, tua mipa si lo ding a, pel loin nungta ding hi.","title":"Pasian’ Hihna Zia Thutang (Ezk 33:10-20)"},"22":{"text":"Ama mawhnasa khempeuh kimaisak ding a, amah a manin a gamtat manin nungta ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Migilo khat a si ka muh ciangin a lungdam dingin hong ngaihsun na hi uh hiam? Ka lung dam het lo hi. Amah hong kisikin a nuntak ding pen keima deih ahi zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi zongin mihoih khat in a gamtat hoihnateng khawlin, migilote’ gamtat bangin a mindaihuai gamtatsiate gamtat ding hong kipan leh, amah nungta paisuak ding ahi hiam? Nungta het lo ding hi. A hoih ama gamtatnasate kiphawksak lo ding hi. Ama cihtak lohna le ama mawhna hangin si ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ahi zongin note in, ‘ Topa’ hihna zia man lo hi,’ na ci uh hi. Israel mite aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. Keima hihna zia a man loin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam? A man lo pen nomau’ ngaihsutna zia hizaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihoih khat a gamtat hoih khawlin mawhna a bawl ciangin si ding hi. Ama sihna pen a gamtatsiatna hang ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Migilo khat a gitlohna panin khawlin a hoih a manin gamta leh ama nuntakna a suahtak ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in a gamtatna phawkin a mawh bawlna khawl hi. Tua ahih manin amah si het lo ding a, nungta paisuak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin no Israel mite in, ‘ Topa’ hihna zia man lo hi,’ na ci uh hi. Israel mite aw, keima hihna zia man lo ahi zenzen hiam? A man lo pen nomau’ ngaihsutna zia hizaw hi."},"30":{"text":"“Topa Pasian ahi keimah in note kiangah kong genin-ah: Israel mite aw, na gamtatnasa bang ciat un thu kong khen ding hi. Kisik kikin na gamtatsiatna khempeuh panun khawl unla, na mawhna hangun kisisak kei un."},"31":{"text":"Na gamtatnasa uh mawhna khempeuh nusia unla, na lungsim uh le na ngaihsutna uh thaksuaksak un. Bang hangin no Israel mite si nuam na hi uh hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Kuama sih ding ka deih kei hi. Tua ahih manin na mawh gamtatna uh khawlin nungta un, Topa Pasian in ci hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel uliante hih bangin tamlawh in hong ci hi:","title":"Israel Uliante A Kitamlawhna"},"2":{"text":"Na nu uh humpinelkai tawh kibang hi. Humpinelkai dangte tawh kikhawlin, a note a khoi hi."},"3":{"text":"A note khat thuhilh a, hong khangcing hi. Sabet zong hong siam a, mi hong ne hi."},"4":{"text":"Mite in tua thu za uh a, gum sungah awksak uh hi. Bawm sungah khum uh a, Egypt gamah paipih uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A pi’ lametnateng beita hi. A no dang khat pantah leuleu a, a khangcing khat a suah hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah hong khangcing a, a dangte tawh kikhawl hi. Sabet zong hong siam a, mi hong ne hi."},"7":{"text":"Kulhpite sugawp a, khuapite siasak hi. Hawk zelzel a, a za mite lau mahmah hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah a hih dingin mite kikaikhawm uh a, mun khempeuh panin hong kuan uh hi. A ngenthang uh zak uh a, thangah a awksak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Bawm sungah khum uh a, Babylon kumpipa kiang a tunpih uh hi. Israel mualtung tengah ama hawkna a kizak nawn loh nadingin a khumcip uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Na nu uh, luitui gei-ah a kisuan leenggui tawh kibang hi. Tui tampi ngah a, a teh, a gah, a pha hi."},"11":{"text":"A gui hiangte hong lian a, kumpi ciangkhut hong suak hi. Leenggui hong khang a, van hong ban hi. A teh pha-in sang mahmah a, mi khempeuh in mu kim hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin hehna tawh leenggui kizungbawh a, leilak kidenna hi. Nisuahna huihpi hong nung a, a gahteng keutumsak hi. A hiangte kikuaitan a, keu-in kihaltum hi."},"13":{"text":"Tui om lohna lei keu gamah tu-in hih leenggui kituah hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih leenggui mei in kang a, a hiang a gah kangtummang hi. A hiangte liankik nawn lo ding a, kumpi ciangkhut suakkik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Hih a tunga pen tamlawhna hi a, a kisa zelzel ngei khat ahi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal ka suah uh a kum sagih kum, a kha ngana, a ni sawm ni-in Topa’ kiang panin thu a dong dingin Israel makai pawlkhat ka kiangah hong pai uh hi.","title":"Pasian in Israel-te A Bawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,"},"3":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Topa Pasian ahi keimah in amaute tungah ka gen, ‘Kei tungah thu a dong dingin hong pai na hi uh hiam? Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin note’ thudotin ka om het kei ding hi, ci-in gen in,’ hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, amaute tungah thu a khen dingin na kiging nai hiam? Na kigin’ khit leh amaute tungah thu khen in. A pu a pate uh’ gamtat hoih lohna teng amaute phawksak in."},"5":{"text":"Amaute tungah keima thugente gen in. Israel mite ka teel laitakin amaute tungah thuciamna khat ka bawl hi. Egypt gam sungah amaute tungah ka kilang a, kei pen Topa note’ Pasian ka hi hi, ci-in ka kigen hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt gam panin amaute paikhiatpihin, amaute a dingin ka zonkhiatsak, bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gam ahi, gam sung khempeuh panin a hoihpenna munah amaute ka tunpih ding ni teek mahin ka kiciam hi.","ref":"Pai 6:2-8"},"7":{"text":"Kei pen Topa amaute’ Pasian ka hih manin a muhdahhuai a milim itte uh paikhia-in, Egypt mite’ pasian man lote tawh a kinitsak loh nading uh ka gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in kei hong demin, ka thugen hong ngai lo uh hi. A muhdahhuai a milimte uh paikhia tuan lo uh a, Egypt pasian-te zong nusia lo uh hi. Tua hi a, ka heh mahmahna teng Egypt gam sungah thuaksakgawp ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin Egypt gam panin no Israel mite kong paikhiatpih ding hi, ci-in amau’ ompih mite’ zakin gen khin ka hih manin, tua bangin gim thuaksak leng keima min a daisak suak ding, cih ngaihsutna hangin gim ka pia kei hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Egypt gam panin amaute paikhiatpihin gamlak ka tunpih a,"},"11":{"text":"a zui peuhpeuh a nuntak theih nading ka thukhamte le ka thupiaknate ka hilh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa ahi keimah in amaute pen mi siangtho-in ka bawlna thu a phawk nadingun kote’ kikalah thukimna limin Sabbath tan’ ding thu ka pia hi.","ref":"Pai 31:13-17"},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel mite in gamlak nangawnah kei hong dem uh a, a zui peuhpeuh in nuntakna a ngahna ding uh ahi keima thukhamte le ka thupiaknate a nial uh hi. Ka Sabbath-te zong nakpitakin siasak uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute a maiman nadingin ka hehnateng gamlakah a thuaksakgawp dingin ka kithawi hi.","ref":"Siam 18:5"},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin Egypt gam panin amaute ka paikhiatpihna minam dangte in hong mu khin ahih manin tua bangin gamta leng, keima mindaina ding mah hi zel ahih manin amaute bangmah ka cih kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih manin bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna, gam hoihpen ahi, amaute tungah ka piaksa gamah amaute ka paipih loh nading thu, gamlakah ka kiciam hi.","ref":"Gam 14:26-35"},"16":{"text":"Tua bangin kiciamna ka bawlna pen, amaute in ka thupiaknate nialin, ka thukhamte zui lo uh a, ka Sabbath-te siasak uh hi. Amaute in kei hong biak ding uh sangin milim biak ding utzaw uh ahihna hang ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ahi zongin amaute ka khasiat a, gamlakah amaute ka susia kei a, ka maimangsak kei hi."},"18":{"text":"A tate uh kiangah, ‘Na pu na pate un a bawl thukhamte zui kei unla, amaute’ tat ngeinate zui kei un. A milim biakte uh tawh zong kininsak kei un."},"19":{"text":"Kei pen Topa ahi note’ Pasian ka hi hi. Ka thukhamte zui unla, ka thupiaknate bangin gamta un."},"20":{"text":"Kei pen Topa ahi note’ Pasian ka hihna na phawkna ding uh le note tawh i bawlsa thukimna lim dingin Sabbath-te na siangthosak un,’ ka ci hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ahi zongin a tate nangawn un kei hong dem uh hi. A zuite in nuntakna a ngahna ding ahi ka thukhamte palsatin ka thupiaknate mang lo uh a, Sabbath-te siasak uh hi. Tua ahih manin, ka hehnateng gamlakah thuaksak gawpin, amaute a sumai dingin ka kithawi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua bangin hih leng, Egypt gam panin Israel mite ka paikhiatpih hong mu mite’ lakah ka min daii ding ahih manin amaute ka susia kei hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin leitung gam khempeuhah amaute ka thehthang gawpna ding thu, amaute tungah kiciamna dang khat tua gamlakah ka bawl leuleu hi.","ref":"Siam 26:33"},"24":{"text":"Hih bangin kiciamna ka bawlna pen, amaute in ka thupiaknate nialin, ka thukhamte zui lo uh a, ka Sabbath-te siasak uh hi. Tua banah a pu a pate un a biak milimte mah a biakna hang uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin kei zong amaute a dingin nuntakna a piangsak lo thukhamte le thupiaknate amaute tungah ka pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute’ biakpiaknate mah tawh amau mah kininsakin, a tapa upa pente uh zong biakna-in ka piasak hi. Hih bangin ka hihna pen amaute gimpiakna le kei pen Topa ka hihna thu a hong theih nading uh ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen pen Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: A cihtak lohna uh tawh na pu na pate un ka min hong daisakin kei hong hehsak uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute tungah piak dingin ka ciamna gamah amaute ka paipih hi. Amaute in mual sang ahi a, singniim khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin a muh uh ciangin tua bang mun khempeuhah biakna a pia uh hi. Meihal biakna a piakna uh le tuiphih biakna a piaknate uh tawh kei hong hehsak uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, ‘Na paina uh mun sangte bang ahi hiam?’ ci-in ka dong hi. Tua ahih manin tua hun a kipanin tua munte pen ‘Mun Sangte,’ kici hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite tungah Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen hih bangin gen in: Na pu na pate un a bawl mawhnate mah note in zong bawlin a milimte mah uh sulzuih ding na hi uh hiam?"},"31":{"text":"Tuni ciang dongin note in a kipia ngei letsongte mah puakin, tua milimte mah biakna-in na tate uh na hal uh ciangin noleno a kininsaktawm na hi uh hi. Tua bangin na gamtat khit uh ciangin no Israel mite, kei kiangah thu a dong dingin nong pai lai uh hi. Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin, note’ thudotin ka om het kei taktak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Note in na lungsim ngaihsutna uh khentat khinin, gam dangah a teng minam dangte mah bangin sing le suang na bia nuam uh hi. Ahi zongin note’ utbang hithei ngei lo ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin, khut khauh tak le ka vangliatna le ka hehna tawh note kong ukgawp taktak ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Gam khempeuhah note kong thehthangna panin kong kaihkhopkik ciangin note tungah ka vangliatna le ka hehna kong lak ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Note pen minam tuamtuamte’ gamah kong paipih ding a, tua munah maitang kituahin note tungah thu kong khen ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Egypt gam sung Sinai gamlakah na pu na pate uh tungah thu ka khen mah bangin tu-in note’ tungah kong khen ding hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"37":{"text":"“Note khauhtakin kong uk ding a, thuciamna kong zuisak ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Note lak panin a lehdo thei mite le kei tungah hong mawh mite ka lakhia ding hi. Tu laitakin a ompakna uh gam panin ka lakhia ding a, ahi zongin Israel gamah ka ciahsakkik kei ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na thei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Topa Pasian in, “Israel mite khempeuh aw, na milimte uh biabia un! Ahih hangin tu a kipanin keima thu nong man’ uh kul ding a, na milimte uh letsong piakna tawh ka min siangtho na daisak nawn kei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Topa Pasian in, “Ka mual siangtho, Israel mual sang tungah Israel mite khempeuh in kei nong bia ding uh hi. Note tungah kong lungdam ta ding a, biakpiaknate, a limcipen piaknate, le na letsong siangthote uh kong lamen ta ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Na kithehthangna uh gam tuamtuam panin note hong paikhiatpihin mun khatah note kong kaihkhop khit ciangin a namtui na biakpiaknate uh kong sang ding hi. Note in kei nong biak manun minam dangte in a siangtho ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh tungah piak dingin ka ciam Israel gam sungah note kong tunpih ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin, a kilawm loin na gamtatnate khempeuh uh le nomau mah na kinitsak tawmna thute uh na phawk ding uh a, na gamtat siatnasate uh hangin nomau mah na kimudahtawm ding uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Na gitlohna, na gamtatsiatna uh tawh kizui-in note tungah hong bawl loin, ka min a daikhak ding khualna tawh note tungah hong gamta ka hih manin kei pen Topa ka hihna thu no Israel mite in na hong thei ding uh hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi,” a hong ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,","title":"Leitaw Lam Gam Siat Ding Genkholhna"},"46":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, leitaw lam gam en inla, leitaw lam gam siatna ding thu genin, leitaw lam gam tulakte a siatna ding thu genkhol in."},"47":{"text":"Leitaw lam tulakte kiangah thu gen inla, Topa’ thugen ngai un. Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: ‘En un, tu-in gamhal a kipan ding ka hi a, na sunga om singkung a hing, a keu-in kangtummang ding hi. Kuamah in tua meikuang phelh zo lo ding hi. Na pilna le na siamna tawh na lamsa na khempeuh amaute in hong vatmaisak ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong that ding uh a, na hankhuk ding tuipi sungah hong khia ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang a hong that ding a hong kuan ciangun, kei pasian bang hi ing, na ci lailai diam? Nang hong thatte na tuah ciangin mihing na hih lelna hong kilang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdang mite’ khut sungah ui bang lelin na si ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” a hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong genkik a,","title":"Taia Kumpipa A Kitamlawhna"},"12":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Taia kumpipa in a thuak ding tawh kisai-in tamlawh inla, Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen, hih bangin gen in: “Nidang lai-in mi kicing etteh pha khat na hi a, pilna le hoihna tawh a kidim na hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian’ Eden huan sungah nang na teng a, suangmanpha nam khempeuh tawh na kizem hi. Karnelian, topaz, le jasper, khrisolait, beryl, le onik, sapfaia, karbankel, le emerald suangmanphate, nangma kizepna hi a, kham tawh kibawl kizepna tampi tak zong na nei lai hi. Hihte khempeuh nangma a dingin na suah ni-in a hong kibawlsak ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Sathau a kinilh kherub-te nang ka hong cingsak a, ka mual siangtho tungah nang na teng a, a tee zaizai suangmanphate lakah na vak kawikawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Gamtatsiat ding na kipat ma hun ciang dong, na suah tung a kipanin na gamtatna khempeuh paubaanna khat beek om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Na sumbawl luatna hangin mi ngongtat na suak a, mawhna sungah na tungkha hi. Tua ahih manin ka mual siangtho panin nang ka hong hawlkhia a, a tee zaizai suangmanphate lak panin nang a hong cing kherub-te in a hong hawlkhia uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Na melhoihna na kisaktheihpih kha a, na minthanna in nang hong haitatsak hi. Leilak ka hong denna a, kumpi dangte hilhkholhna-in nang ka hong koih hi."},"18":{"text":"A man loin sum na bawl luatna hang, tua bang na mawhna hangin na biakna munte na siasak hi. Tua ahih manin khuapi sung ka hal a, a vekpi-in kangtummang hi. Nangmah a hong en mi khempeuh’ muhna-ah vutlevai ka hong suah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in nang a maimang paisuak na hita a, nangma tuah bang a tuahkhak ding uh nang hong theisa minam khempeuhte lau-in a ling uh hi,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zek 9:1-4; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"20":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Sidon’ Siat ding Genkholhna"},"21":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Sidon lam nga inla, a siatna ding thu genkhol in."},"22":{"text":"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in ka gen thu, amaute kiangah hih bangin gen in: “Sidon khuapi aw, kei pen nangma lang ka hi a, nangma tungah ka hong bawlna hangin mite in kei hong phat ding uh hi. Nangma sungah a teng mite gimpiakna tawh ka sianthona ka lah ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Nangma sungah cinatna ka tungsak ding a, na kongzing khempeuhah sisan ka luangsak ding hi. Na kimkot khempeuh panin nang hong kisim ding a, na mi khempeuh kithatlum mang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, “A kimkota om Israel mi a simmawh minam dangte in tu-in simmawh nawn lo ding uh a, Israel mite sunin a nasak thei ding ling le lingkung tawh kibang nawn lo ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi.","title":"Israel-te Thupha Kipia Ding"},"25":{"text":"Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Minam tuamtuamte lakah ka thehthangna panin Israel mite ka kaikhawm kik ding a, kei pen a siangthopa ka hihna thu minam khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi. Tua ciangin ka nasempa Jakob ka piak leitang ahi amaute’ gam sungah Israel mite a teng ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua gam sungah lungmuang takin teng ding uh a, amaute in inn lamin, leenggui suan ding uh hi. Israel mite a simmawh minam dangte gim ka pia ding a, Israel mite ahihleh lungmuang takin om hithiat ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa amau’ Pasian ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Joel 3:4-8; Zek 9:1-2; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawmna, a kha sawm, a ni sawm le nih ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Egypt’ Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt kumpipa Faro’ lam nga inla, amah le Egypt gam khempeuh gim a kipiakna ding thu genkhol in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasian in hih bangin gen hi, ci-in Egypt kumpipa kiangah gen in: “Gun sungah a om awle lianpi ahi, nang Egypt kumpipa aw, kei pen nangma lang ka hi hi. Nail Gunpi, nangma a’ in na gen a, nangma bawlsa-in na ngaihsun hi."},"4":{"text":"Na khaguh-ah sikkawi ka bulh ding a, na gun sunga om ngasa khempeuh nangma tungah ka belhsak ding hi. Tua ciangin nangma tungah a belh ngasa khempeuh tawh Nail gun sung panin nang kong kaikhia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang le na ngasa khempeuh gamlakah kong paai ding hi. Leilakah na pumpi kiphah ding a, phum lohin hong kikoih ding hi. Ganhingte le vasate’ an dingin nang ka hong pia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu Egypt mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen Israel mite’ muan le suan khat na hi ngei a, ahi zongin nang pen a khauh lo pumpeeng kung khat bang na hi lel hi.","ref":"Isa 36:6"},"7":{"text":"Nangma tungah amaute hong kingap uh ciangin nang na kitan a, amaute sunin na puksak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in Topa Pasian in nang kiangah kong genin-ah: Namsau tawh mi kong simsak ding a, na mite le na ganhingte thatlummang ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt gam khempeuh a kinusia gam simtham suak ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na hong thei ding hi. Nangmah in Nail Gunpi pen keima a’ hi a, keima bawlsa hi, ci na hih manin,"},"10":{"text":"nangmah le Nail Gunpi langah keimah ka pang hi. Egypt gam khempeuh, leilu lam Migdol khuapi panin leitaw lam Siene khuapi, Ethiopia gamgi dong, a kinusia gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na gam sungteng, mihing in ahi a, ganhing in ahi zongin sik nawn lo ding hi. Kum sawmli sung bangmah om lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Leitung gam khempeuh lakah Egypt gam pen a gamkhing penin ka bawl ding hi. Kum sawmli sung khuapi sia dang khempeuh sangin a siazaw-in Egypt khuapite ka bawl ding hi. Egypt mite galtai-in ka bawl ding a, gam khempeuh le minam dang khempeuh kiangah taisakin ka kithehthangsak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian in hih bangin ka ci hi: Kum sawmli khit ciangin a kithehthangna minamte lak panin Egypt mite ka kaikhawmkik ding a,"},"14":{"text":"amaute’ piancilna mun Egypt gam khanglam Pathros gamah ka tengsak ding hi. Tua lai-ah kumpi gam ginaloin om ding uh a,"},"15":{"text":"kumpi gam khempeuh lakah a ginalo pen suak ding uh a, minam dang kuamah ukzo nawn lo ding uh hi. A ginalo mahmahin bawl ding ka hih manin amau’ deih bangin minam dang khat beek tasak zo lo ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel mite in muan le suanin amaute neikik ngei nawn lo ding uh hi. Egypt-te a tuahsiat ciangin a suang khialkha ahih lamtak uh Israel mite in a phawk ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa Pasian ka hihna thu Israel mite in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawmnih le sagih kum, a kha masa a ni masa ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,"},"18":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Taia khuapi sim hi. A galkapte, nakpitakin hanciamsak lua ahih manin a sam nangawn uh pulhmangin, a liangkote uh a sa nangawn lengkhiamang a, ahi zongin tua bangin amau’ gim thamanin kumpipa le a galkapte in bangmah phattuamna ngah lo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih bangin thu kong gen hi: Tu-in Taia khuapi a simna hangin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar tungah Egypt gam ka pia ding hi. Amah in Egypt gam luhin a nate uh sut ding a, galkapte’ thaman dingin Egypt-te’ neihsa khempeuh puakhiamang ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A galkapte in keima a dingin na hong sepsak uh ahih manin, ama hong nasepsak ka thuhna-in ama tungah Egypt gam a pia ka hi hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi."},"21":{"text":"“Hih thu hong tun ciangin Israel mite a thahat minamin ka bawlkik ding a, mi khempeuh’ zakna ding munah nang thu kong gensak ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen leuleu a,","title":"Egypt Gamkhing A Suahna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen hih bangin pulak in: “‘A lauhuai ni,’ ci-in awng in."},"3":{"text":"Minamte’ siatna ding hun Topa’ ni hong naita hi."},"4":{"text":"Egypt gamah galpi tung ding a, Ethiopia gamah lungkhamna lianpi om ding hi. Egypt gamah mi tampi kithat ding a, a neihsa khempeuh uh kipuakhia-in, gam hawmguakin kinusia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tua galpi in Ethiopia gam, Put gam, Lud gam, Arabia gam, le Libya gam panin a kicial galkap khempeuh that ding a, keima mite’ lak pana galkapte nangawn si ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Leilu lama om Migdol khuapi panin leitaw lam Siene khuapi dong, Egypt gam a hute khempeuh gal sungah simang ding uh a, Egypt’ kiphatsakpih a galkapteng simang ding hi, ci-in Topa Pasian in ka gen khin hi."},"7":{"text":"Egypt gam, leitung gam khempeuhah a gamkhing pen suak ding a, khuapi dang a siate khempeuh sangin a khuapite siazaw ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Keimah in Egypt gam haltumin, a gam sung a hute khempeuh ka beisak khit ciangin, Topa ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua bangin Egypt gam a siat ni hun hong tun ciangin bangmah khuaphawk loin a om Ethiopia mite kiangah kamtaite ka sawl ding a, amaute lau mahmah ding uh hi. Tua hun ding tu-in hong tungta hi."},"10":{"text":"“Egypt’ hauhnateng a sumai dingin Babylon kumpi Nebukhadnezzar ka zang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah le a kihtakhuai a galkapte hong pai ding a, gam sung khempeuh susia ding hi. Namsau tawh Egypt mite vatlum ding a, gam sung khempeuhah misi luanghawm dim ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Nail Gun a tui ka kangsak ding a, migilote’ khut sungah Egypt ka koih ding hi. Gamdang mite in susia gawpin, gamkhing suaksak ding uh hi, Topa ahi keimah in ka ci khin hi."},"13":{"text":"“Milim khempeuh ka susia ding a, Memfis khuapi-ah a om pasian man lote ka beisak ding hi. Egypt gam a uk ding kuamah om nawn lo ding a, mi khempeuh lausakin ka lingsakgawp ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Egypt gam khanglam Pathros gamteng gamkhing ka suaksak ding a, Egypt gam saklamah a om Zoan khuapi ka hal ding a, kumpi khua ahi Thebes, gim ka pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gam sungah khuapi muanhuai pen Pelusium khuapi, ka hehna ka thuaksak ding a, Thebes khuapi mi khempeuh ka sumai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Egypt gam sung khempeuh ka haltum ding a, Pelusium khuapi in gimna lianpi thuak ding hi. Thebes khuapikulh khempeuh kicimgawp ding a, tui in a khuapi tuum ding hi."},"17":{"text":"On khuapi le Pibeseth khuapi tangvalte, gal sungah si khin ding uh a, adangteng salin kiman ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Egypt’ vangliatna ka suksiat ciangin Tahpanhes khuapi-ah khim zinggawp ding a, a kisaktheihpihna teng uh a beita ding hi. Egypt gam sung meiipi in khuhcip ding a, a mi khempeuh salin pai ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-a bangin Egypt tungah gim ka piak ciangin, Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawm le khat kum, a kha masa a ni sagih ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,"},"21":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt kumpipa Faro’ khut ka kuaihtansak zo hi. A khut damkikin namsau a tawizawh nadingin kuamah in a khut tuamsak lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa Pasian ahi keima thugen in: Kei pen Egypt kumpipa Faro’ lang ka hi hi. A khut a damlai pen le a kitansa zong, a lang nihin ka kuaihtansak ding a, a khut panin namsau ka kiasak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Egypt mite pen, gam khempeuh le minam khempeuhte lakah ka thehthang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Babylon kumpipa’ khut ka khauhsak ding a, ama khut sungah ka namsau ka pia ding hi. Ahi zongin Egypt kumpipa Faro’ khut ka kuaihtansak ding a, a langte’ mai-ah tai-in a si ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah ka thaneemsak ding a, Babylon kumpipa ka thakhauhsak ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi. Babylon kumpipa’ khut sungah ka namsau ka piak ciangin amah in Egypt lam a ngat ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin gam khempeuh le minam tuamtuamte lakah Egypt mite ka thehthang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawm le khat kum, a kha thumna a ni masa ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Faro le A Mite’ Tuah"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt kumpipa Faro le ama mite’ kiangah hih bangin gen in: “Na lian mahmah uh a, kong tehpihtheih ding kuamah om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"A hiangte hoihin pha mahmah a, a kung sang mahmahin meii lak a ban, Lebanon-a a po taamtak tawh na kibang uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A khangsak ding tui om a, leisung panin an a pia ding tui om hi. Tua sing a pona mun tui kawt a, gam sung sing khempeuh in zong tui a ngah uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Limtakin tui ngah ahih manin singkung dang khempeuh sangin a sangzaw hi. A hiangte golin sau mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Vasa nam khempeuh in a hiang tungah bu tom uh a, ganhing nam khempeuh in a liimnuai, tasuahna-in a nei uh hi. Leitung minam khempeuh in zong a liimnuai belhin a nei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua singkung hoih mahmah a, a kung sangin, a hiang zau a, a zung in tui omna lei thukpi sung a ban hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian’ huanah a om taamtak hoihte tawh tehtheih ding hi lo a, taksing kung in tua bang hiang hoih nei ngei lo a, hiangpa kung in zong tua bang hiang hoih nei ngei lo hi. Pasian’ huana singkungte zong tua zahin hoih ngei lo hi.","ref":"Pian 2:9"},"9":{"text":"A melhoihin ka bawl a, a hiang ka zausak hi. Pasian’ huan sunga a po singkung khempeuhte’ enin ka bawl hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian keimah in hih bangin ka ci hi. Tua sing in meiipi a bat dongin khangto a, ahi zongin a san semsemna tawh kizui-in kiphasak semsem hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua singkung ka deih nawn kei hi. Gamdang kumpi khat’ khut sungah ka pia ding a, ama thuak dingin a kilawm bangin tua kumpipa in a bawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Thukhualna a nei lo gamdang mite in tua singkung phukin a nusiacip ding uh hi. Mual khempeuh le guam khempeuhah a hiang kitante a kia ding uh hi. A lim a bel minam khempeuh in taisanta ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Vasate hong leengin tua sing puk tungah tuang ding uh a, gamsate in a hiangte tuancil ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu a kipanin singkung khat beek, bangzahin tui a ngah hangin tua zahin khangin, a dawn in meiipi banin sangzo ngei nawn lo ding hi. Misite’ omna Leinuai khua a zuan ding, a si thei mihingte mah bangin singkung khempeuh a si ding ahi ta hi."},"15":{"text":"“Topa Pasian in ka cihin-ah: Tua singkung in misite’ khua Leinuai a zuat ciangin, leinuai-a tuite tuumsakin ka thuumsak ding hi. Guntuite le luituite ka luangsak nawn kei ding a, Lebanon Mual maikhingin, gamlak sing khempeuh a keutum ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Misite’ omna Leinuai khua-ah tua singkung ka khiatsuk ciangin, a kiatna ging in minam khempeuh lokgawp ding hi. Tua singkung a kiat manin Eden singkung khempeuh, le a hoihpen, limtakin tui a ngah Lebanon singkungte khempeuh in zong Leinuai-ah nuamtuam na sa ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a sisate a zuan dingin misite’ omna Leinuai-ah amah tawh a paikhawm ding uh hi. Ama liimnuai a belte khempeuh, minam dangte’ lakah kithehthang khin uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tua singkung pen Egypt kumpipa Faro le ama mite ahi hi. Eden huana singkungte nangawn tua zahin lianin hoih zo lo hi. Ahi zongin, Eden huana singkungte mah bangin, Pasian’ thu a ngaihsun lo, galsung a a site’ omna a zuan dingin, misite’ omna Leinuai a manawh ta ahi hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawm le nih kum, a kha sawm le nih a ni masa ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Faro A Kitamlawhna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt kumpipa Faro tamlawh inla, hih bangin ci in: “Minam dangte lakah, humpinelkai bangin na kingaihsun hi. Ahi zongin nang pen gunsung tokgawpin a ninsak, awle tawh na kibangzaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in kong cihin-ah: Minam tampi hong kuansakin, ka ngen kong khuhsak ding a, tui gei-ah kong kaisak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Leilakah nang hong kaikhia-in, leilak kong denna ding a, vasate le ganhingte, a kham takun kong nesak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mualteng guamteng, na sa ka dimsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sisan tawh leitung khempeuh ka kawtsak ding a, mualteng guamteng na sisan tawh kidim ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang kong suksiat ni ciangin vanpi ka khuhcip ding a, aksi ka mialsak ding hi. Ni, meiipi ka liahsak ding a, kha, ka mialsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:10; Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Mang 6:12-13; 8:12"},"8":{"text":"Vantung khuavak khempeuh ka mialsak ding a, na gam khempeuh khim zing ding hi, ci-in Topa Pasian in ka gen khin hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na theih ngei loh gamdangte-ah salin kong omsak ciangin minam tampite lunggim ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang tunga kong bawlna thu minam tampite in lamdangsa ding uh hi. Ka namsau ka vik ciangin kumpite lau-in kigaih ding uh hi. Nang na puk ni ciangin a sihkhak ding uh lau-in mi khempeuh ling kelkel ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian in hih bangin ka ci hi: Babylon kumpipa’ namsau na thuak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Minam dang a gilo pente sung panin a galkapte uh a namsau uh doksakin, na mihonpite ka thatsak ding hi. “Na kisaktheihpih teng vatmai ding uh a, na minam khempeuh thatmang ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A tui nekna mun a omna khempeuh uhah, na gan khawite ka that khin ding hi. Tui a siknin ding mihing ganhing khat zong om nawn lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangmah in su nawn lo ding ahih manin, tuite ciim sitset ding a, gunte zong dum dide ding hi, ci-in Topa Pasian in ka gen khin hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt gam gamkhing suaksakin, a gam sunga omteng ka suksiat ciangin Topa ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"“Hih pen kah la-in a kisa ding tamlawhna hi a, Egypt le a mite tamlawhna-in minam dang numeite in nei ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawm le nih kum, a kha masa a ni sawm le nga ni-in Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,"},"18":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt mi tampite’ hangin kapin thum in. Misite’ omna Leinuai gamah a vanglian minam dangte tawh amaute paisak in. Amaute kiangah hih bangin ci in:"},"19":{"text":"“Midang khempeuh sangin melhoihzaw hi lo na hi uh hiam? Ahi zongin pai unla, Pasian a thei lo mite’ han sungah va lum un, ci-in gen in."},"20":{"text":"“Galsung a a kithatte tawh si khawm ding uh hi. Egypt gam sunga om mi khempeuh a vatlum dingin namsau khat a baihsa-in om hi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt mite a panpih galhang pente in misite’ gam Leinuai panin amaute na dawn ding uh a, ‘Pasian a thei lo, galsung a si mite hong paisuk uh a, hih lai-ah lumta uh hi,’ ci-in kiko ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Assiria zong, a kimkotah a galkapte’ han tawh, tua lai mahah om hi. Amaute khempeuh zong gal sungah a si uh hi a,"},"23":{"text":"Leinuai a thukpenna munah amaute’ han om hi. A galkap khempeuh gal sungah a si hi a, a hante uh ama kimkotah om hi. Ahi zongin amaute pen nidangin minam dangte a linglawngsak zo ngeite ahi uh hi."},"24":{"text":"“Elam zong, a kimkotah a galkapte’ han tawh, tua lai mahah om hi. Amaute khempeuh gal sungah a si uh hi a, misite’ gam Leinuai-ah Pasian a thei loin paisuk uh hi.
