Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi."},"15":{"text":"Minam dangte’ hong kobawlna za nawn loin, a hong mindaisakna uh na thuak nawn kei ding uh a, na sung uhah a teng mite’ tate zong no Israel mualtung gamte in na laksak nawn kei ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” hong ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,"},"17":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mite amaute’ gamah a ten lai-un amaute’ gamtatna le a sepnate uh tawh tua gam ninsak uh hi. Amaute’ gamtatnate pen numeite’ neih nin zahin a ninin ka ngaihsun hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih manin gam sungah amaute’ mi thahna le a milimte uh tawh gam sungteng a nitsakna hangun ka hehnateng ka thuaksak hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute’ nuntakna zia le a gamtatna ziate uh tawh kizui-in amaute tungah thu ka khen a, gamdang mun citengah amaute ka thehthang hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin midangte in, ‘Hih mite pen Topa’ mite hinapi-in, Pasian in amaute’ tungah a piak gam panin taikhia uh hi,’ ci-in a paina peuhpeuh uhah na kigen ahih manin, ka min siangtho hong daisak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel mite in a paina peuhpeuh uh gamdang mite lakah ka min siangtho hong daisak kawikawi uh ahih manin tua thu in ka lung hong himawhsak hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian keimah in Israel mite tungah ka gen ding thute hih bangin gen in: Israel mite aw, tu-a ka sep ding thu pen note kong khualna hang hi loin, minam dang khempeuhte’ lakah na daisak kawikawi uh ka min siangtho ka khualna hang hizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Note in minam dangte’ lakah na daisaksa uh a lian ka min siangtho pen tu-in minam dangte’ lakah a sianthona ka langsak ding hi. Keimah in minam dangte’ lakah ka sianthona ka lah nadingin note kong zang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi."},"24":{"text":"Gam khempeuh le minam khempeuhte lak panin note hong kaikhawm kikin na gam uhah kong tunpih kik ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note tungah tui siangtho kong theh ding a, na milim biakna uh le note hong ninsak na dang khempeuh panin kong siangsak ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Note sungah lungtang thak le lungsim thak kong guan ding a, na suang lungtang uh hong lakkhiatsakin mihing lungtang kong guan ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Note sungah keima kha kong guang ding a, note tungah kong piak ka thukhamte le ka thupiakte limtakin kong zuisak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin na pu na pate uh tungah ka piaksa gamah na teng ding uh a, note pen keima mi hi-in, kei pen note’ Pasian ka hi ding hi.","ref":"Ezk 11:19-20"},"29":{"text":"Note hong ninsak thei ding na khempeuh panin kong hu ding hi. An tampi ka piangsak ding a, gilkial na thuakkha nawn kei ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Na singgah kungte uh le na lolai ante uh tampi tak ka phasak ding a, minam dangte lakah gilkial a mindaina na thuakkha nawn kei ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Na gamtatnasa uh na gitlohnate uh le na hoih lohnate uh na phawk kik ding uh a, na mawhna uh le na khialhnate uh hangin nomau mahmah na kimudahtawm ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel mite aw, hih thute khempeuh, note’ lungdam nadingin a bawl ding ka hihlohna thu na theih ding uh ka deih hi. Na gamtatnasate uh hangin maizumin na mindai ding uh ka deihna hizaw hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu kong gen khin hi."},"33":{"text":"“Na mawhna khempeuh panun note kong siansak khit ciangin na khuapite uh sungah hong tengsakkikin, a sia khempeuh kong puahsakkik ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Na lote uh a nawkkha ngei mite’ muhna-ah gammang tulak a bat ngei hangin, tu-in tua lote kho-in note kong puahsakkik ta ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Hih leitang pen gammang tulak a bang ngei hinapi-in tu-in Eden Huan a batna le a kisusia, a kiluhgawp, a kinusiacip khuapite pen tu-in a muanhuai kulh tawh ki-umin a sungah mi a tenna thu mi khempeuh in gen belin nei ding uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin note’ kimkotah a om a suakta lai minam dangte in a siasa khuapite lamkikin, a kinusia lote a puahkik pa pen Topa ahi keimah ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi. Topa ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin a, ka gen bangin ka gamta ding hi."},"37":{"text":"“Tu-a tengbek hi loin adang zong ka hih lai ding hi. Keima tung pan Israel mite huhna ka ngensak ding a, tuuhonpi bangin Israel mite ka tamsak ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuhunin a sia-in a omcip khuapite pen a kiseh pawi hun ciangin biak nadingin a kipaipih, Jerusalem-a tuuhonpi om muamua bangin, mi tampi tawh kidim ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka sungah Topa’ vangliatna hong om lamtak ka kiphawk a, ama kha in kei hong paipihin, misi guh tawh a kidimin a om kuampi khatah hong koih hi.","title":"Guhkeu Omna Kuampi"},"2":{"text":"Tua guhte lakah hong vakpih kawikawi a, tua guhte a tam mahmahna le a keu mahmahna ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih misi guhte a nungtakik thei ding hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, “Topa Pasian aw, hih thu nang bek in na thei ding hi,” ci-in ka dawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Hih guhte tungah thu hilh inla, hih guhkeute in Topa’ thu a ngaih nadingun gen in."},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in amaute tungah ka gen thu hih bangin gen in: Note sungah hu kong guan ding a, note kong nungtasakkik ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Thagui le sazang kong guan ding a, vun tawh kong tuam ding hi. Tua ciangin na sung uhah hu hong guan in kong nungtasakkik ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna nong thei ding uh hi, ci-in gen in,” hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hong sawl bangin thu ka gen hi. Tua bangin thu ka gen laitakin a kigawi zuazua a ging ka za a, tua guhte khatlekhat kizomkik uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua bangin ka et laitakin thagui le sazang in tua guhte tuam a, tua ciangin a vun in zong hong tuam hi. Ahi zongin tua pumpite sungah hintheihna hu om nai lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, huihte tungah thu gen inla, hih a sisa pumpite sungah hu sangin a hingkiksak dingin mun khempeuh panin hong pai un, ci-in Topa Pasian in thu hong pia hi, ci-in gen in,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin hong sawl bangin ka gen hi. Tua pumpite sungah hintheihna hu hong lut a, tua ciangin amaute hingin a khe-un hong ding uh hi. Galkap honpi khat zah pha-in tam mahmah uh hi.","ref":"Mang 11:11"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mite pen hih guhte tawh kibang uh hi. Amaute in, ‘I keucip a, i lamet ding bangmah om nawn loin i nuntakna guipi beita hi,’ ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka mi Israel-te tungah thu gen inla, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Ka mite aw, tu-in note’ hankhuk kong honsak ding a, note hong paikhiatpihin, Israel gam kong tunpihkik ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Note na kiphumna uh hankhuk hong honsakin kong paikhiatpih ciangin Topa ka hihna thu nong thei ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Note sungah keima nuntakna hu kong guan ding a, note hong hingsakkikin, na gam uhah kong tengsakkik ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu nong thei ding uh hi. Hih bangin kong hihna ding thu ka kiciamzo a, ka kiciam bangin kong hih ding hi. Topa ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khinzo hi, ci-in gen in,” hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Judah le Israel A Kigawmkikna ding Genkholhna"},"16":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, sing ciangkhut khat la inla a tungah, ‘Judah kumpi gam,’ ci-in gelh in. Tua ciangin adang khat la leuleu inla a tungah, ‘Israel kumpi gam,’ ci-in gelh leuleu in."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua ciangkhut tegel ciangkhut khat a battheihna dingin na khut sungah tawikhawm in."},"18":{"text":"Bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, ci-in na mipihte in hong dot uh ciangin"},"19":{"text":"amaute kiangah, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Israel ciangkhut la-in Judah ciangkhut tawh ka koihkhawm ding hi. Tua ciangkhut nihte ciangkhut khatin ka bawl ding a, ka khut sungah ka tawi ding hi, ci hi, ci-in gen in."},"20":{"text":"“Tua na gelh ciangkhut nihte mite’ muhin na khut sungah tawi-in"},"21":{"text":"amaute kiangah, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Amaute’ omna minam dangte’ lak panin Israel mite la-in ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute’ gamah ka paipihkik ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel mualtung gamah, amaute minam khatin ka gawmkik ding hi. Amaute a uk ding kumpi khat nei ding uh a, amaute minam nihin kikhen nawn lo ding uh a, kumpi gam nihin zong kikhen nawn lo ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute pen a muhdahhuai milimte tawh kininsak nawn lo ding uh a, mawhnate tawh zong kininsak nawn lo ding uh hi. Amaute’ mawhna le kei hong lehheknate panin ka suaktasak ding hi. Amaute a siangtho mi-in ka bawl ding a, amaute keima mi hi-in, kei, amaute’ Pasian ka hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka nasempa David pen amaute’ kumpi hi ding a, mi khat’ ukna nuai-ah amaute kigawmin, ka thukhamte hoihtakin zui ding uh hi.","ref":"Ezk 34:24"},"25":{"text":"A pu a pate uh a tennasa ahi ka nasempa Jakob tungah ka piak leitangah amaute teng ding uh a, amaute bek hi loin a suan a khak dongun tengsuak ding uh hi. Ka nasempa David in amaute uk tawntung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute lungmuangin a om tawntungna ding uh thuciamna khat ka bawl ding a, amaute thupha pia-in a mi ka pungsak ding hi. Amaute’ lakah a om tawntung dingin ka biakinnpi ka phut ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute tawh tengkhawmin, amaute’ Pasian ka hi ding a, amaute pen keima mite hi ding uh hi.","ref":"2Kor 6:16; Mang 21:3"},"28":{"text":"Amaute’ lakah a om tawntung dingin ka biakinnpi ka koih ciangin, Topa ahi keimah in keima mi dingin Israel mite ka bawl khitna thu, minam dangte khempeuh in thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,","title":"Kumpi Gog’ Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Magog gam a om Gog kumpipa mawhsakna thu gen in. Amah pen Meshek minamte le Tubal minamte a ukpa ahi hi. Amah mawhsakna thu gen inla,","ref":"Mang 20:8"},"3":{"text":"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Meshek le Tubal minamte a ukpipa Gog aw, kei pen nangma langah ka pang hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang hong lehhei-in, na khaguh-ah sikkawi kong bulh ding a, na galkap honpite khempeuh tawh kong kaikhia ding hi. Na galkap honpite pen a sakolte uh le a sakol tung tuangte uh tawh tam mahmah a, na galkap khempeuh in lum le namsau nei kim uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Persia gam, Kush gam, le Put gammite in zong nang hong panpih uh a, amaute in lum le siklukhu nei kim uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Leilu lam gam peka om Gomer gam a galkapte khempeuh le Bethtogarmah gam a galkapte khempeuh in nang hong panpih uh a, minam dang tampite in zong nang hong pawlpih uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tu-in nang le na pawlte khempeuh a kigalging sa-in om unla, na thupiakna bangin a gamtang pah lian dingin na galkapte khempeuh omsak in."},"8":{"text":"Minam tuamtuamte lak panin kikaikhawm kikin a gam uh a kitutkik zawh gallauna nei loin a om Israel mite’ gam a sim dingin kum tampi khit ciangin kong sawl ding hi. Sauveipi sung kinusia-in gamkhing a suak ngei hinapi-in, tu-in a mite khempeuh lungmuang takin a omna Israel mualtung gamte a sim ding na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang le na galkap honpite le nang hong pawlpih minam tampite in khuapi huih bangin na simgawp ding uh a, meiipi bangin a gam sung khempeuh na tuamcip ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Topa Pasian ahi keimah in nang Gog tungah kong genin-ah: Tua hun ding hong tun ciangin na lungsim sungah gitloh gamtat ding ngaihsut na kipan ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A khuapite in galnanna ding kulh nei loin, lungmuang takin a om hithiat, a kihutawm zo lo ding gam khat, simgawp ding na ngaihsun ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A sia ngeisa khuapite sungah a teng mite luhin a nate uh na sutgawp ding hi. Tua mite pen minam tuamtuamte lak panin a kikaikhawm kik, tu-in ganhing le neihsa van zong nei kikin, leitung lam khempeuh a kituahna lamkabom sanah a teng mite ahi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Sheba mite le Dedan mite, le Tarshish khuapite-ah a teng sumbukte in nang kiangah, ‘Ngun le khamte, ganhingte le vante na ngah nadingin luhgawpin a sutgawp ding le genzawh loh van tampi tawh a ciahkhia dingin galsim dingin na galkapte na kaikhawm nai hiam?’ ci-in hong dong ding uh hi, ci-in gen in,” hong ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih bangin thu gen in hong ci hi: Keima mi Israel-te lungmuang takin a om hun laitakin nangmah na kihanthawntawm ding a,"},"15":{"text":"leilu lam peka na omna gam panin sakol tung vive-ah a tuang, minam tampite kiang panin na kaihkhop a thahat galkap hon tampite masuanin na kuankhia ding a,"},"16":{"text":"khuapi huih in gam sung a nawkgawp bangin keima mi Israel-te na sim ding hi. A hun a tun ciangin, nangmah zangin na ka sepna tawh minamte lakah ka sianthona ka lahtheih nadingin keima gam a sim dingin kong sawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ni khat ni ciangin Israel mite a sim dingin mi khat ka sawl ding hi, ci-in keima nasem Israel kamsangte tungtawnin, sawtpek lai-in ka gengen niloh mipa pen nang na hi hi. Hih thu Topa Pasian in gen khinzo hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ahi zongin Gog in Israel gam a sim ni ciangin ka heh suak mahmah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin ka hehluatna tawh Israel gamah nakpitakin zin ling hen, ka ci ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngasate le vasate, ganhing a neu a lian, le leitung a om mi khempeuh, keimah kihtakna hangin lau-in ling ding uh hi. Mualte pukin, keente cimin, kulh le phung khempeuh kicimmang ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Gimna a tuamtuamte tawh Gog ka lausakgawp ding hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi. Ama mite khatlekhat namsau tawh kisatgawp ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Pulnatna le sisan luanna tawh amah gim ka pia ding hi. Amah le a galkap honte le amah a panpih minam tampite tungah guahpi, gialpi, meikuang le kaat kuang, ka zusak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hih bangin hihna tawh a lian a siangtho ka hihna thu, keimah in minam khempeuh tungah ka langsak ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Gog mawhsakna thu gen inla, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Meshek le Tubal minamte a ukpipa Gog aw, kei pen nangma langkhatah a pang ka hi hi."},"2":{"text":"Mundang khatah nang kong paisak ding a, leilu lam gam pek panin Israel mualtung gamah kong tunpih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua lai mun panin na veilam khutah na tawi na thal hong betkhiatsakin, na taklam khutah na tawi na thaltangte zong kong betkhiatsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang le na galkap honte le nang hong panpih minam khempeuhte pen Israel mualtung gamah na simang ding uh a, vasa nam khempeuh le gamsate in na sa uh ne ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa Pasian in hih thu gen khin ka hih manin gamlakah na tuk zeizai ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kuamah in nawngkaisak loin nuamtakin mite a om hithiatna Magog gam sung le tuipi gei-a gamte ka hal ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima mi Israel-te lakah ka min siangtho ka kitheisak ding a, keima min a daii dingin ka omsak nawn kei ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah pen a Siangtho, Israel-te’ Pasian ahi Topa ka hihna thu minam khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasian in, “Tua ka gengen ni hong tung takpi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel gam khuapite-ah a teng mite kuankhia-in, tua a kinusia galhiamte ansing dingin khawm ding uh hi. Tua a kinusia lumte, thal le thaltangte, molhtumte le teipite, mei-in cih ding uh a, kum sagih sung kikhom ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in mei cih dingin a kinusia galhiamte nei uh ahih manin gamlakah sing tom kullo ding a, tulakah sing phuk ding zong kisam lo ding hi. Amaute in amau’ na a sutte’ na sutin, a suksiatsakte’ na suksiatsak ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Hih thu hong pian’ ni ciangin Israel gam sung Si Tuipi nisuahna lamah a om Khualzin Mite’ Kuam a cihna sungteng, a kivui nadingun Gog ka pia ding hi. Gog le a galkap honpite, tua lai munah kivui ding ahih manin khualzin mite’ lampi khaktan ding a, tua mun pen, ‘Gog Galkapte’ Kuam,’ kici ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel mite in a gam sung uh a siansakkik nadingin misi vuina-in kha sagih sung hun bei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Gam sunga om mi khempeuh in misi vuina-ah huh ding uh a, tua bangin a huhna hangun ka gualzawh ni-in pahtawina ngah ding uh hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi."},"14":{"text":"Kha sagih a cin khit ciangin, a gam sungteng uh a siangthosak theih nadingun a kimangngilhkha siluanghawmte zongin a phum dingin gam sungteng a zong kawikawi ding mi pawlkhat a seh ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Gam sungteng a zon kawikawina uhah misi guh a muh simun, misi vuite in hong tawmin Gog Galkapte’ Kuam-ah a vui hun ma sungteng uh a kitheih nadingin a gei-ah ciaptehna khat bawl pahpah uh hi."},"16":{"text":"(Tua galkap honpite’ min tamin a gei-ah khuapi khat om hi.) Tua bangin gam sung siangsak ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, amaute a dingin ka bawlsak biakpiakna sa a ne dingin mun khempeuh panin vasa khempeuh le ganhing khempeuh hong pai nadingun sam in. Israel mualtung gamah pawi lianpi khat om ding a, a duh zahzahun sa ne-in si dawn ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuutalte, tuunote, keelte le bawngtal thaute a kigawh bangin a kigo ahi galkapte’ sate ne-in, leitung gam ukte’ site a dawn ding uh ahi uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakna dinga gawh bangin hih mite ka gawh ciangin vasate le ganhingte in a nekzawh zahzah uh a thaute ne ding uh a, a kham dongun a si dawn ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute in ka sabuai tungah, sakolte le a tunga tuangte, galkapte le galkapmangte’ sa, a nekzawh zahzah uh ne ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Mang 19:17-18"},"21":{"text":"Topa in kei kiangah, “Minamte lakah ka minthanna ka lak ding a, thu a tangin ka khennate ka sepkhiat theih nadingin ka vangliatna ka zatna dan amaute tungah ka lak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khit a kipanin amaute’ Topa Pasian ka hihna thu, Israel mite in hong thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei tungah hong khialhna uh hangin Israel mite sal suak uh a, amaute nungngatin, a galte uh khut sungah pia-in gal sungah a vekun a sisak ka hihna,"},"24":{"text":"le amaute’ nitna le a gitlohna uh tawh kituakin amaute tungah bawlin, amaute a nungngat ka hihna thu, minam dangte in thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Tu-in Jakob suanlekhak Israel mite ka hehpih ding a, amaute a cithei-in ka bawlkik ding hi. Keima min siangtho ka hu ta ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute’ gam sungah kuamah in su loin lungmuangin a omkik uh hun ciangin, kei hong lehbawlnate uh le a mindainate uh mangngilh theita ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Kei a siangtho ka hihna thu, minam tampite tungah ka lah nadingin a galte uh a omna gamdang khempeuh panin amaute lakhia-in ka kaikhawm kik ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin, minam dangte’ khut sungah salin amaute puakin, tua khit ciangin amaute khat zong siit loin kaikhawm kikin a gam sung uh ka tunpih kimna hangin amaute’ Topa Pasian ka hihna thu, keima mite in hong thei ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel mite tungah ka kha ka sung ding a, amaute ka nungngat nawn kei ding hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi a kilak zawh a kum sawm le lina kum, salin hong kipaipih zawh a kum sawmnih le ngana, a kha masa a ni sawm ni-in ka sungah Topa’ vangliatna hong om lamtak ka kiphawk a, amah in kei hong paikhiatpih hi.","title":"Kamsangpa in Biakinn A Muhna"},"2":{"text":"Ka maang sungah, Pasian in Israel gamah hong paipih a, mual sang khat tungah hong koih hi. Khuapi tawh a kibang inn honpi bang khat ka mai-ah ka mu hi.","ref":"Mang 21:10"},"3":{"text":"Amah in tua khuapi nai-ah hong paipih a, sumngo bangin a tee mi khat ka mu hi. Tua mipa in pikhau khat le piciang khat tawi a, kongpi gei-ah a ding hi.","ref":"Mang 11:1; 21:15"},"4":{"text":"Tua mipa in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, tu-a kong lah ding nate, na mit tawh limtakin enin, na bil tawh limtakin ngai inla, limtakin ngaihsun in. Hih lai-ah nang kong paipihna pen hih thu hang mah ahi hi. Na muh na khempeuhte, Israel mite tungah a gen ding na hi hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka muh pen biakinn na hi a, a kimkotah kulh om hi. A mipa in pi sawm a pha tehna piciang la-in a kulh a teh hi. A teh ciangin pi sawm sahin, pi sawm mah sang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin nisuahna lama om kulhkongpi-ah amah pai a, a kahlei-ah kahto-in a khung a tun ciangin kulh kongvang teh a, pi sawm mah sang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua banah lampi khat om a, a lampi pang tuakah galvilna inndei neu thum tuak om hi. Inndei neute a dung a vai kikim a, pi sawm mah ahi hi. Inndei neu khatlekhat kikal pi giat sah hi. Tua galvilna inndei neute banah pi sawm mah a sau lampi khat om a, biakinnpi lam a maingat inndei golzaw sung a tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih inndei golzaw a teh ciangin pi sawm le li pha hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih inndei pen biakinn tunna ding lampi tawpna hi a, a biakinn lam neh pena om kawm pen pi li a sah hi."},"10":{"text":"(Hih lampi pang tuak a om galvilna inndei neute pen a golna kikim a, a kikal-a kawmte zong a sahna kikim hi.)"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mipa in a lampi teh a, pi sawm le guk zai-in pi sawmnih le nih a sau hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua galvilna inndei neu mai ciatah letmat sawmnih sangin letmat sawmnih a sah kidalna khat a om hi. (Hih galvilna inndei neute pen a dung a vai pi sawm tuak ahi hi.)"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin inndei neu kawm nung panin lampi kantanin a gal sana inndei neu kawm nung dong teh a, pi sawm le nih a pha hi."},"14":{"text":"Inndei nunung pen zomah biakinn tual om a, tua tual a teh ciangin pi sawmthum le li a pha hi."},"15":{"text":"Kulhkong pua panin inndei nawlnung kawm pua dong lampi sauna pi sawmgiat le li a pha hi."},"16":{"text":"Hih inndei neute’ kawm a pualam pangah tawlet neu om a, inndei kikal-a om kawm tungah zong a vang neu om hi. Lampi omna lampang, inndei kikal-a kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mipa in kongpi tawnin a tualah hong paipih hi. A tual pualam kawm tawh kizomin inndei sawmthum om a, tua inndeite mai-ah suang a kiphah lampi om hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih suangphah pen a tual kimkotah om a, hih a pualama tual pen a sunglam a om tual sangin niamzaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sunglam tual lut nadingin a sangzaw-ah kongpi khat om hi. A mipa in hih kongpi nih kikal a teh ciangin pi zakhat sawmguk giat a pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mipa in a pualam tual paina ahi, leilu lampangah a om kongpi lampi hong teh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua bangin a teh ciangin lampi pang tuak a om galvilna inndei neu thumte, a kikal-a om kawmte, le a inndei golzaw pen, nisuahna kongpi-ate mah bangin a dung a vai kikim ciat hi. Tua kongpi lampi pen pi sawmgiat le li sau a, pi sawmlinih zai hi."},"22":{"text":"A inndei golzaw, a tawlette, le nisuh kung lim a kibawlte pen nisuahna lam kongpi-a omte mah tawh kibangin kikim hi. Hih lai-ah zong kongpi lampi tun nadingin kahlei dawl sagih om a, a nawlnung a om a inndei golzaw pen in a tual lam maingat hi."},"23":{"text":"Nisuahna lampang a om bang teek mahin, leilu lam kongpi pana lutna-a a tual galkhatah tual sungnung lutna kongpi lampi khat mah a om hi. Tua kongpi nih kikal a teh ciangin pi za le sawmguk giat a sau hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mipa in leitaw lampangah hong paipih a, tua lai-ah kongpi lampi khat mah na om leuleu hi. A teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kikim hi."},"25":{"text":"Kongpi dang a omte mah bangin hih lai-ah zong inndeite in tawlet nei uh hi. A kongpi lampi pen pi sawmgiat le li sau-in pi sawmlinih zai hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua kongpi lampi tun nadingin kahlei cial sagih mah om a, a inndei golzaw pen a nawlnung mahah omin a tual lam a nga hi. Lampi omna lampang, kawm sungnungte’ tungah nisuh kung lim mah kibawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Hih lai-ah zong tual sungnung paina kongpi lampi khat mah om hi. A mipa in konglekong kikal a teh ciangin pi za le sawmguk giat a pha hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin leitaw lam kongpi tawnin tual sungnungah hong paipih hi. A lampi a teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kikim hi."},"29":{"text":"A galvilna inndei neute, a inndei golzaw, le kawm sungnungte pen, kongpi dangate mah tawh kibang hi. Hih kongpi lama om inndei neute-ah zong tawlet om hi. A lampi pi sawmgiat le li sau-in, pi sawmlinih zai hi.","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"A inndei golzaw pen tual puanung lam a nga hi. Lampi pang tuak a kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tun nadingin kahlei cial giat a om hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin nisuahna lam kongpi tawnin a tual sungnungah hong paipih hi. A lampi a teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kikim hi."},"33":{"text":"A galvilna inndei neute, a inndei golzaw, le a kawm sungnungte zong, kongpi dangate mah tawh kikim hi. A kimkotah tawlette om a, a inndei golzaw-ah zong a om hi. A lampi, pi sawmgiat le li sau a, pi sawmlinih zai hi."},"34":{"text":"A inndei golzaw pen a tual puanung lam nga hi. Lampi pang tuakah a om kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tunna dingin kahlei cial giat a om hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin leilu lam kongpi lampi-ah hong paipih a, a teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kibang hi."},"36":{"text":"A dangte mah bangin hih in zong galvilna inndei neute, kawmsung lam tung kizemte, inndei golzaw pen, le a kimkotah tawlette a nei hi. A lampi pi sawmgiat le li sau a, pi sawmlinih zai hi."},"37":{"text":"A inndei golzaw pen a tual puanung lam nga hi. Lampi pang tuakah a om kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tunna dingin kahlei cial giat a om hi."},"38":{"text":"Tual puanung sungah lampi tawh a kimatin inndei gol khat om a, a inndei pen a tual lam a nga hi. Hih lai munah, biakna-in a pum-a a hal ding uh ganhing luangte silsiang uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Hih inndei gol sungah sabuai li om a, a lang tuakah nih tuakin kikoih hi. Meihal biakna-a piak ding ahi a, mawhna le khialhna hanga biakna-in piak ding ganhingte ahi zongin, hih sabuaite tungah go uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Hih inndei pualam, leilu lam kongpi lutna pang tuakah zong sabuai nih tuak, a vekin sabuai li mah om hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ahih manin inndei sungah sabuai li, a pua-ah sabuai li, a vekpi-in giat om a, hih sabuaite pen, biakna-in piak ding ganhingte gawhna-in a kizang ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Meihal biakna-in piak ding ganhingte bawl nadingin a kizang sabuai lite pen suang a kiseek ahi hi. Tua sabuaite letmat sawmnih sang a, a dung a vai letmat sawmthum tuak ahi hi. Biakna-in piak ding gan gawhna-in a zat uh na khempeuh, hih sabuaite tungah koih uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Hih sabuaite’ kimkotah khutpeek cia bang a zai geihual kibawl hi. Biakna-in piak ding sa khempeuh hih sabuaite tungah kikoih hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pualam panin a tual sungnungah hong paipih a, a tual sungnungah inndei nih na om hi. Khat pen leilu lam kongpi lampangah omin leitaw lam nga a, a khat pen leitaw lam kongpi lampangah omin leilu lam nga hi."},"45":{"text":"A mipa in kei kiangah hih bangin hong gen hi: Leitaw lam a nga inndei pen biakinn sungah na a sem siampite a’ ding hi a,"},"46":{"text":"leilu lam a nga inndei pen biakna tau-ah na a sem siampite-a’ ding ahi hi. Tua siampite khempeuh pen Zadok’ suan Levi mite vive ahi uh hi. Ama na a sem dingin Topa’ omna-ah amaute bek kipaisak hi, hong ci hi."},"47":{"text":"A mipa in hih tual sungnung a teh ciangin a dung a vai pi zakhat sawmguk giat tuak a pha hi. A biakinn mai-ah biakna tau khat a om hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinn sung lutna inndei-ah hong paipih hi. Amah in a sung lutna lampi teh a, pi kua sau-in pi sawmnih le li zai a, a pang tuak a kawmte pi nga tuak a sah hi."},"49":{"text":"Innsung lutna inndei pen pi sawmthum le li sau a, pi sawmnih zai a, tua lai tun nadingin kahlei cial sawm a om hi. Innsung lutna inndei pang tuakah khuampi khat tuak a om hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mipa in a laizang a om inndei-ah hong paipih hi. Tua inndei lutna lampi teh a,"},"2":{"text":"pi sawm le giat zai a, a pang tuak a om kawmte pi giat tuak a sah hi. A laizang a om inndei sung a teh ciangin pi sawmguk giat sau a, pi sawmthum le li zai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin inndei sungnungah amah pai a, tua sung lutna lampi a teh ciangin pi thum sau-in pi sawm zai a, a pang tuak a om kawmte pi sawm le nih tuak a sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua inndei sungnung a teh ciangin a dung a vai pi sawmthum le li tuak a pha hi. Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, “Hih lai pen Siangtho Pen Mun ahi hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in biakinn kawm puanung teh a, pi sawm tak a sah hi. Hih kawm tawh a kimatin biakinn kimkotah inndei neuneu om a, tuate pi sagih vive a zai hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih inndei neute dawl thum pha a, dawl khat gual paiphei suakah inndei neu sawmthum om hi. Tua inndei neute a dawl sanna tawh kizui-in a biakinn kawm pa to tektek a, tua inndei neute a nang dingin khuam a tuamin kul loin a biakinn kawm kimang toto hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua biakinn kawm pang bela kibawl inndei neute sungah kahlei omto a, a dawl nuainung panin a tungnung dongin kizomto hi. A inndei neute a dawl sanna lamah a biakinn kawm a pat tektek mah bangin a sang lama om inndei neute a sung zai semsem hi."},"8":{"text":"Biakinn kimkotteng a lei kitawito a, a mundangte sangin pi sawmin sangtozaw hi. Tua mun panin biakinn kawm le a kimkota inndei neute kipanto pan hi."},"9":{"text":"Inndei neute a kawm sahna pi giat pha a,"},"10":{"text":"biakinn kimkotah suangphah bangin a kitawito-in a kibawl a zaina pi sawmthum le li ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Biakinn kimkotah a om inndei neute-ah pai nading kongvang, leilu lamah khat omin, leitaw lamah khat om hi. Tua biakinn kimkotah pi giat paisuak a zai cial khat a om leuleu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin nitumna lamah biakinn lam a nga inn khat om hi. A inn dung pi zakhat sawmnga hi a, a vai pi zakhat sawm le guk hi a, a kimkota a kawm pi kua a sah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in biakinn teh a, pi zakhat sawmguk giat a pha hi. A kimkota mun awng, a innsung le a kawm tawh kigawmin pi zakhat sawmguk giat ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Nisuahna lampang biakinn mailam a vailam zong a mun awng tawh kigawmin pi zakhat sawmguk giat mah ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinn nitumna lampangah a om, a tual lam a nga inn a sauna teh a, a kawm tegel tawh kigawmin pi zakhat sawmguk giat mah a pha hi. Biakinnsung lutna ding inndei, le a inndeipi, le Siangtho Pen Mun sungte pen"},"16":{"text":"a sual panin a kongvangneute ciang dong singpeek tawh kidap hi. A tawlette pen a pualam a kihui-in a kibawl ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Biakinn sunglam kawmte pen kongkhak zang ciang dong lim kibawlte tawh kidim a,"},"18":{"text":"nisuh kungte le kherub limte vive ahi hi. A masa-in nisuh kung, tua ciangin kherub, nisuh kung, kherub cih bangin a kimkot khempeuhah kihelhto dimdiam hi. Tua kherub-te in maitang nih ciat nei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"A mihing maitang pen a pangkhat lama om nisuh kung lam nga a, a humpinelkai maitang pen a pang langkhat lama om nisuh kung lam a nga hi. A biakinnsung kimkotah hih bangin kibawl a,"},"20":{"text":"sual panin kongkhak zang kikal sung khempeuhah a dimin a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Biakinn deipi kongkhak khuamte pen a siik kikim vive ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Siangtho Pen Mun mai-ah sing tawh a kibawl biakna tau bang pian khat a om hi. Pi nga sang a, a dung a vai pi li ahi hi. A khete, a kingaknate, le a zawlte sing tawh a kibawl ahi hi. A mipa in kei kiangah, “Hih pen Topa’ mai-ah a kikoih sabuai ahi hi,” hong ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Inndeipi sung lutna ding le Siangtho Pen Mun lutna dingah kongkhak a om hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua kongkhakte pen a laizangah a kituah, kongkhak peek nih nei-in a kibawl ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Biakinnsung kawmte tungah a kibawl mah bangin hih biakinn deipi sung lutna-a kongkhakte tungah zong nisuh kung le kherub mah a kibawl hi. Kongkhak pualam, innsung lutna ding inndei sanah singpeek tawh liimsun khat a kibawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Hih inndeipi sung kawmte tungah a pualam a kihui tawlette om a, nisuh kungte tawh zepna zong a kibawl hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in a tual puanungah hong paipih a, biakinn nitumna lam mongah a om inn tawh a kigamla lo, biakinn leilu lama om inn khatah hong tunpih hi."},"2":{"text":"Leilu lampang hih inn dung pi zakhat sawmguk giat hi a, a vai pi sawmgiat le li ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua inn pangkhat pen biakinn gei-a mun awng pi sawmthum le li a zai a omna lam nga a, a pang langkhat pen tual puanunga suangphah lam a nga hi. Tua inn pen cial thum a pha a kitawito tungah kilam a, a tunga a cialte pen a nuai-ate sangin neuto zaw tektek hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih inn leilu lampangah pi sawm le guk zai-in, pi zakhat sawmguk giat a sau lampi khat tung a, a lutna kong zong tua lam mahah a om hi."},"5":{"text":"A cial tungnungah a om inndeite pen a nuai-ate sangin neuzaw hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a sangto zaw, a kawcik zaw-ah om uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Biakinn tuala a inn dangte mah bangin tua inndei dawl thumte pen a cial tungah kinga uh a, a tuamin khuam nei lo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A cial nuainung a om inndeite pen pi sawmgiat le li sau a, tua lai panin tua inngualte tawh a paikhawm hilhel pi sawmgiat le li mah a sau kulh khat a om hi. Tua ciangin biakinn galkhat lama om kulh pen pi zakhat sawmguk giat sau hi.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinn nitumna lama om ahi, kulh a kipatna mun a inn nisuahna lam mongah kongkhakte a om hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Leilu lampang a om mah bangin hih inndeite mai-ah zong lampi khat a om hi. A sauna, a pianzia le a kongte zong leilu lama om mah tawh kibang hi."},"12":{"text":"Nisuahna lampang a kulh a kipatna mun a inn leitaw lamah kongkhakte a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin a mipa in kei kiangah, “Leilu lama om leh leitaw lama om hih inn nihte pen biakna inn siangtho ahi hi. Topa’ omna-ah a lut siampite in biakna-in a kipia a siangtho pente, hih innte sungah ne uh hi. Hih inndeite a siangtho ahih manin, a kipia nate an tawh biaknate le mawhna le khialhna hangin biakna-in a kipia sate, a sungah koih uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Siampite in Topa tungah biakna pia-in biakinn sungah a lut khit uh ciangin a pualamah a pusuah nop uhleh, Topa tungah biakna a piak laitakun a silh uh puante suahin hih inndeite sungah koih ding uh hi. Tua lai panin puan dang silhin midangte omna-ah pai thei pan uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"A mipa in biakinn sunglamteng a teh a zawh khit ciangin nisuahna lam kongpi tawnin hong pusuahpih a, biakinn pualamteng a teh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in a tehna piciang la-in nisuahna lampang teh a, pi zagiat sawmli a pha hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin leilu lampang, leitaw lampang, le nitumna lampang teh a, a thumin a sauna kikimin pi zagiat sawmli ciat a pha hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a umna kulh a pang li-in a teh ciangin a pang li mahin kikim a, pang khat ciangin pi zagiat sawmli vive pha a, tua deina kulh pen biakna-a a siangtho le a mawkmawkte a kikhenna ahi hi.","ref":"1Kum 6:1-38; 2Khang 3:1-9"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin a mipa in biakinn nisuahna lama om kongpi-ah hong paipih a,","title":"Minthanna Vang tawh Biakinn Kidim"},"2":{"text":"nisuahna lam panin Israel-te’ Pasian’ minthanna vang hong pai ka mu hi. Pasian’ awging pen tuipi ging tawh kibang a, ama minthanna vang in leitung taangsak lela hi.","ref":"Ezk 10:3-4,18-19; 11:22-23; Mang 1:15"},"3":{"text":"Hih ka maangmuhna pen, Pasian in Jerusalem khuapi a susia dingin a pailai a ka muh leh Khebar Gun gei-a ka muh tawh kibang hi. Tua ciangin thakhatin leilak kidenna-in ka boksuk hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa’ minthanna vang in nisuahna lam kongpi tawnin biakinn sungah a lut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa’ kha in hong la-in a tual sungnungah hong paipih a, tua lai panin, Topa’ minthanna vang tawh biakinnsung a kidimna ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua lai mun panin kei kiangah a mipa a din laitakin biakinnsung panin Topa in kei hong hopihna ka za a,"},"7":{"text":"“Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih lai munah ka kumpi tokhom om hi. Israel mite lak hih lai munah ka teng ding a, amaute ka uk tawntung ding hi. Israel mite le a kumpite un pasian dang biakna tawh ahi a, a kumpi sisate uh phawkna ding mual bawlna tawh ahi zongin ka min siangtho daisak ngei nawn lo ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a kumpite un a kongkhuam uh le a kongzawlte uh keima biakinn kongkhuam le kongzawlte tawh kimatin bawl uh a, ka kikal uh kawm bek in hong hal hi. A muhdahhuai a gamtatnate khempeuh uh tawh ka min siangtho hong daisak uh a, kei zong ka heh manin amaute ka susiamang hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in amaute in pasian dangte bia nawn loin, a kumpi sisate uh phawkna a mual uh a phiat ding uh ahi hi. Tua bangin a gamtat nak-uhleh amaute lakah ka teng paisuak tawntung ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in a thugen hong zomlai a, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mite tungah biakinn thu le a geelna khempeuh cingtakin lak inla, amaute’ mawh gamtatna hangin maizumsak in.","title":"Biakinn le Biakna tau Ngeinate"},"11":{"text":"Amaute a gamtatnasate uh hangin hong maizum theih uhleh, biakinn geelna, a lim, a lutna le a pusuahna, a buppi lim, a na khempeuh a kigeelna, le a zat dan ding khempeuh a cingtakin amaute tungah laktel in la, amaute in a kigelnate thei-in a zat dan ding bangin a zuih theihna dingun amaute a dingin lai-in gelhsak in."},"12":{"text":"Biakinn tawh kisai ngeina in: Mualtung a om biakinn kimkot mun khempeuh pen biakna tawh kisai-in a siangtho ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Biakna tau golna pen hih bang hi ding hi. A teh nadingin biakinn tehna a kizang ngeite mah hi ding hi. A biakna tau bul kimkot pen letmat sawmnih sangin, letmat sawmnih mah zai ding a, a tau kimkotah letmat sawm a sangin geivial nei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A tau bul panin a tau zawl nuainung ciang pi li hi ding a, a sahna letmat sawmnih hi ding hi. Tua ban siah pi sagih sangto ding a, letmat sawmnih sah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A tungnung pen, ganhing kihalna mun pi sagih sang ding a, a kiu li-ah letmat sawmnih a sang ki om ciat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A biakna tau dawnzang pen a dung a vai a kikim hi ding a, pi sawmnih sau-in pi sawmnih mah zai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Biakna tau a paito a laizang santeng pen a dung a vai a kikim, pi sawmnih le li hi ding a, a nuai dawl sangin letmat sawm pai-in neuzaw ding hi. Tua a dinna a nuai gual kimkot letmat sawmnih pai-in zai ding hi. Biakna tau tung kahna ding kahlei pen nisuahna lampangah om ding hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Pai 27:1-2; 2Khang 4:1"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih biakna tau zatna ding ngeinate hih bang hi ding hi: Biakna tau a kizawh khit ciangin a tungah meihal biakpiakna le biakpiakna ganhing site thehna tawh apna a bawl ding na hi hi."},"19":{"text":"Zadok’ suanlekhak Levi siampite pen keima na a sem dingin ka omna-ah a hong pai dingte ahi uh hi. Topa Pasian keimah in hih thu kong pia hi. Mawhna hangin biakna-a piak dingin amaute tungah bawngtal khat na pia ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah in a sisan pawlkhat la-in biakna tau kiu li-a om ki lite, biakna tau paito a laizang kiute, le a kimkotah a om a geihualte na nuh ding a, hih bangin hihna tawh biakna tau siansuahin na ap ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mawhna hangin biakna-in a kipia bawngtal pen la-in biakinn huang pualam, a mun hong kigenna sanah a hal ding na hi hi."},"22":{"text":"A zing ciangin paubaanna a om lo keeltal khat la-in mawhna hangin biakna-in na pia ding hi. An bung khat a kipiak ciangin sathau biing dim khat in zui ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Gam uk ulianpa in ama utthu-in biakpiakna, meihal biakna ahi a, thunuama biakna ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh a piak ciangin, ama lut nadingin nisuahna lama om tual sungnung kongpi kihonsak ding hi. Amah a ciahkik khit ciangin a kongpi kikhak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Gam uk ulianpa in meihal biakna-in piak dingin paubaanna a om lo kum khat a pha tuuno khat, zingsang simin Topa’ tungah biakna-in pia ding hi. Tua tual kiu lite’ kiu-ah tualno khat ciat na om hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua tualnote pi sawmguk giat sau-in pi sawmli le giat zai a, a vekin a golna kikim hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua tualno lite a umna kawm dingin suang kiciang ciat a, tua a kawmte belin meikhuk a om hi."},"24":{"text":"A mipa in, “Hihte pen, mite in biakna-in a piak sate, biakinnsung nasemte in a huanna anbuk ahi hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinn lutna kongkhakah hong paipih kik hi. Tua ciangin a mipa in tua gun gei mahah hong paipih kik a,"},"7":{"text":"tua lai mun ka tun ciangin a gun lang nih tuakah singkung tampi tak a po ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, “Hih tui pen nisuahna lam manawhin gam sung nawkin Jordan Kuam-ah luangsukin Si Tuipi sungah tung hi. A singgahte an ding hi ding a, a tehte zatui-in kizang ding hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Mang 22:2"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, “Israel minam sawm le nihte’ gamh dingin leitang hawm ding a gamgi ding hih bang hi ding hi. Josef minamte in a dangte’ ngahzah nih ngah ding uh hi.","title":"Gamgite le Leitang Hawmna"},"14":{"text":"Hih gam na pu na pate uh tanh dingin ka piakna ding thu, amaute tungah thupi takin ka kiciam khinzo hi. Tua ahih manin tu-in note’ lakah a kikim dimdiamin hawm un."},"15":{"text":"“Leilu lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi panin kipanin Hethlon khuapi-ah, Hamath khua lutna-ah, Zedad khuapi-ah,"},"16":{"text":"tua panin Berothah le Sibraim khuapite-ah (hih khuate pen Damaskas kumpi gam le Hamath kumpi gam kikalah om hi), tua panin Hazerhattikon khuapi (Hauran kumpi gamgi gei-a om) hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Leilu lam gamgi pen Mediterranean Tuipi a kipanin nisuahna lam manawhin Damaskas le Hamath gamgi a om Hazarenan khuapi ciang hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Nisuahna lam gamgi pen, Damaskas le Hauran gamgi kituahna panin hong kipan sukin, Jordan Gun zuisuk a, Jordan Gun nitumna lampangteng Israel gam hi-in, nisuahna lampangteng Gilead gam hi a, tua panin Si Tuipi kimang sukin Tamar khuapi ciang hisuk ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Leitaw lam gamgi pen, Tamar khuapi panin hong kipanin Meribathkadesh bual hong nawkin, tua panin sak nitumna lam manawhin Egypt gamgi zuito-in Mediterranean Tuipi sun ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Nitumna lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi hito-in, Hamath khualutna tawh a kitang ciang hito ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin hih gam sungteng, no Israel minamte lakah hawm un."},"22":{"text":"Note a dingin na neih kip tawntung ding uh gamh hi ding hi. Hih leitang na hawm uh ciangin note lakah hong tengin ta a nei khinsa minam dangte zong note mah bangin tanh na pia ding uh hi. Amaute pen Israel minam taktakte mah bangin na ngaihsun ding uh a, Israel minam dangte mah bangin leitang hawmna-ah ai sawk thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Note’ lakah a teng gamdang mite in amau’ tenna minamte tawh leitang ngahkhawm ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu kong gen khin hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Leilu lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi panin kipanin Hethlon khuapi-ah, Hamath khua lutna-ah, tua panin Damaskas le Hamath gamgi kituahna sana om Hazarenan khuapi ciang sun ding hi. Minam khat in leitang khen khat ciat ngah ding uh a, a kikal uh gamgite pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi ciang hi ding a, leilu lam panin a hawm uh kipan suk ding uh hi. Leilu lam a khungnung penah Dan minamte,"},"2":{"text":"a zomah Asher Minamte,"},"3":{"text":"a zomah Naftali Minamte,"},"4":{"text":"a zomah Manasseh Minamte,"},"5":{"text":"a zomah Efraim Minamte,"},"6":{"text":"a zomah Reuben Minamte,"},"7":{"text":"a zomah Judah Minamte hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuate zomah Pasian a dingin a kipia leitang hi ding a, a zaina pen leilu lam panin a kipan leitaw lam tai sawm hi ding hi. A dunglam pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi dong, minam dangte’ ngahzah tan mah hi ding a, a laizang sanah biakinn om ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa a dingin a kipia leitang a sauna tai sawm hi ding a, a zaina tai giat hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Siampite in hih a siangtho leitang sung panin tanh ngah ding uh a, leilu lampang le leitaw lampang tai sawm tuak hi-in, nisuahna lam le nitumna lampang tai li tuak hi ding hi. Siampite’ ngahna sung hih leitang laizangah Topa’ biakinn om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih munteng pen Zadok’ suanlekhak siampite a’ ding ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel midangte a gamtat khialh uh ciangin Levi midangte bangin va zui lo uh a, hih mite in citakin keima na hong sem uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Levi midangte zomah hih bangin a mun tuam diak khat nei ding uh a, tua mun a siangtho pen mun khat hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih siampite’ zomah Levi mite in leitang ngah ding uh a, a sauna tai sawm hi-in, a zaina tai li hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa tungah a kipia hih leitang siangtho pen, leitang khempeuh panin a hoihpen mun hi a, hih leitang sung panin mun khat peuhpeuh, kizuak thei lo, adang tawh zong kikhek thei lo, midang tungah zong kipia thei lo ding hi. Hih leitang pen a siangtho leitang hi a, Topa -a’ ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"“A omlai leitang, a sauna tai sawm le a zaina tai nih pen a siangtho leitang hi loin a mawkmawk leitang hi ding a, mite’ taang zat ding mun hi ding hi. Tenna ding le a mun awngthawl hi ding a, a laizangah khuapi om ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A khuapi golna a dung a vai-in a kikim hi ding a, a pang li-in pang khat ciangin pi tulsagih zanga sawmguk hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuapi kimkot paisuakah pi zali sawmnih paisuak a zai mun awng om ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Khuapi a kilam khit ciangin a siangtho leitang lamah a awng lai, nisuahna lam tai li, nitumna lam tai li a omlaiteng pen khuapi sungah a teng mite in a khawh ding leitang hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuapi sungah nasemin a om mi peuhmah in Israel minam sung panin kuamah kideidanna om loin hih leitang kho thei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih a kisehkhia leitang buppi pen a pang li-in tai sawm pai hi ding a, hih pen leitang siangtho le khuapihuam sung kigawm hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“A pang li-in tai sawm paisuak a pha, Topa a dingin a kipia leitang le khuapi huamteng a kilakkhiat khit ciangin, a pang tuakah a omlai leitang, nitumna lamah tuipi dong, nisuahna lamah gambup gamgi dong, gam uk uliante a’ ding hi ding hi. Hih leitang a kipia kikal sungah, biakinn, Topa’ tungah a kipia leitang, Levi mite a kipia leitang, le khuapihuam leitangte om ding a, gam uk uliante’ leitang in hihte laitaak ding hi. Hih gam uk uliante’ leitang pen leilu lamah Judah Minamte a’ le leitaw lamah Benjamin Minamte a’ kikalah om ding hi.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"“Hih leitang panin leitaw lampangah, Israel minam a omlaite in leitang ngah ding uh a, a kikal uh gamgite pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi ciang hi ding a, leilu lam panin a hawm uh kipan suk ding uh hi. Leilu lam a khungnung penah a ngah ding Benjamin Minamte,"},"24":{"text":"a zomah Simeon Minamte,"},"25":{"text":"a zomah Issakhar Minamte,"},"26":{"text":"a zomah Zebulun Minamte,"},"27":{"text":"a zomah Gad Minamte hi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Leitaw lam panin Gad Minamte a kipia leitang banah gambup gamgi om ding a, Tamar khuapi panin kipanin Meribathkadesh bual nawk ding a, tua panin sak nitumna lam manawhin Egypt-te’ gamgi zui ding a, Mediterranean Tuipi-ah tawp ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tu-a ka gen bangin Israel minamte in a khang a khangin a luah suksuk ding uh leitang dingin amaute tungah a kipia ding leitang ahi hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu kong gen khin hi."},"30":{"text":"“A khuapi sungah lutna ding kulhkongpite om hi. A khuapikulh pang lite, pang khat ciangin pi tulsagih zanga sawmguk sau hi. A pang khatah kulhkongpi thum ciat om a, Israel minamte khat ciat tam hi. Leilu lampang a om kulhkongpi thumte in Reuben, Judah, le Levi tam hi. Nisuahna lampang a omte in Josef, Benjamin, le Dan tam hi. Leitaw lampang a omte in Simeon, Issakhar, le Zebulun tam hi. Nitumna lampang a omte in Gad, Asher, le Naftali tam uh hi.","title":"Kulhkongpi le Khuapi Min","ref":"Mang 21:12-13","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Khuapi kimkot a sauna pi tul sawmthum zanih sawmli pha a, tu a kipanin hih khuapi min pen, ‘Hih lai-ah Topa om hi,’ kici ding hi,” hong ci hi."}}}}},"27":{"info":{"name":"Daniel","shortname":"Dan","abbr":[],"desc":"Daniel Laibu pen Jew mite in bawlsiatna leh netniamna nakpi takin a thuak laitakin a kigelh ahi hi. A laigelhpa in tangthu a tuamtuamte leh maangmuhnate zangin amau a sugawp mite Pasian in suniamin Pasian' mite nidang mah bangin liankik ding hi, ci-in a lametna tawh ama huna mite a hanthawn ahi hi. Hih laibu khen nihin kikhen a, tuate in: 1. Sala a om Daniel leh a lawmte pawlkhat in Pasian a upna leh ama thu a man'na uh hangin a galte uh tungah gualzo uh hi, cihna thu ahi hi. Hih thute pen Babylon kumpi leh Persia kumpite' uk hun laitakin a piang thu ahi hi. 2. Kumpi tampite, Babylon kumpi-a kipan a banbanin a khan'na leh a kiatna, leh amau a bawlsia dawibia mite a pukna ding leh Pasian' mite a gualzawhna ding thu Daniel in maang a tuamtuam a muhnate lim a tuamtuam tawh a genna ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim kumpi a suahzawh a kum thumna kumin, Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem khuapi simin a umcih hi.","title":"Daniel le A Lawmte’ Laisiamna","ref":"2Kum 24:1; 2Khang 36:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Topa in kumpi Jehoiakim le biakinnpi na manphate kumpi Nebukhadnezzar a mansak hi. Amah in a mi matte Babylon gam ama pasian biakinn-ah paipih a, na manpha a matte sumkoihna inn-ah a koih hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in Israel salte sunga kumpi nam le milian namte lak pan mi pawlkhat a teelkhia dingin innsungmang lian pen Ashpenaz thu a pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mite, kumpi innsunga nasem siamte a suahtheih nadingun a melhoih, pumpi tung poina a nei lo, a navak, hoihtakin pilna a kisinsak, na a thei baih, a lungsim navak ngentang ding ahi hi. Ashpenaz in amaute Babylon lai le a pau a hilh ding ahi hi.","ref":"2Kum 20:17-18; 24:10-16; 2Khang 36:10; Isa 39:7-8"},"5":{"text":"Amaute pen kumpi innsunga nasem dangte mah bangin nisimin an le leenggahzu tawh a vak dingin kumpipa in thu a pia hi. Tua bangin kum thum sung sinna a neih khit uh ciangin kumpipa mai-ah amaute a kilak kik ding uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua bangin a kiteelte, Judah mite vive hi a, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, le Azariah-te ahi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Innsungmang lianpen pa in amaute min thak phuah a, Daniel’ min dingin Belteshazzar, Hananiah’ min dingin Shadrak, Mishael’ min dingin Meshak, Azariah’ min dingin Abednego a phuak hi."},"8":{"text":"Daniel in kumpi innsunga an le leenggahzu tawh a pumpi a thanghuaisak loh nadingin a lungsim a khensat hi. Amah in innsungmang lianpen Ashpenaz kiangah tua bang an a kipiak loh nadingin a ngen zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian in Daniel tungah Ashpenaz in ngaihsut siamna a neih theih nadingin a bawlsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahih hangin Ashpenaz in Daniel kiangah, “Kumpipa in na annek ding uhleh na dawn ding uh sehsa-in nei khinzo ahih ciangin, khangno dangte banzo kei kha zenzen leteh a hong thah ding ka lau hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel zong Ashpenaz in amah le adang thumte a cing dingin a koihpa kiangah a pai hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in, “Ni sawm sung hong ze-etin, anteh bek hong nesak inla, tui bek hong dawnsak in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa’ an a ne khangnote tawh hong enkak khawm in la, nong muhna bangbangin thu khenta in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in amau’ ngetna bang mangin ni sawm sung ze-et dingin a thukim hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni sawm a cin khit ciangin amaute pen kumpi an nete sangin cidamzaw uh a, a ci a sa uh a hoihzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin a cing pa in kumpi an le leenggahzu pia loin amaute anteh an a pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian in tua khangno lite laitheih siamna le pilna thukte a pia hi. Daniel pen maangmuhna le mangkhiat siamna a pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa’ sehsa kum thum a cin khit ciangin Ashpenaz in khangnote khempeuh kumpipa kiangah a paipih hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in amaute khempeuh hopih a, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, le Azariah-te adangteng khempeuh sangin a hoihzawk tuanlam uh a mu hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpi inn-a vaihawm ulian pawl a suak uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumpipa in bangbang thuhaksa nono a dot hangin, hih mi lite pen ama gam sung khempeuha mitphial siamte le aisan theite khempeuh sangin a zah sawmin a siamzawklam uh a mu hi."},"21":{"text":"Sairas, Babylon kumpi a suah hun dong, kumpi inn-ah Daniel omto paisuak hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebukhadnezzar kumpi a suahzawh a kum nihna kumin mang khat a man hi. A lungsim pataulua mahmah ahih manin a ihmu thei kei hi.","title":"Daniel in Nebukhadnezzar’ Mang Khiatsak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin bang mang man cih a hilh dingin mitphial siamte, mibum theite, le khongkhai siamte a samsak hi.","ref":"Pian 41:8"},"3":{"text":"Amaute hong pai-in kumpipa mai-ah a din uh ciangin kumpipa in, “Mang khat ka man a, tua ka mang pen bang hiam cih theinuam ka hih manin ka lungsim a patau mahmah hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in Aram pau tawh, “Kumpipa aw, na khansau hen! Na mang hong gen leteh a khiatna zong kong gen ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ka mangmat le a khiatna nong gen theih kei uhleh note kong semnengawp ding a, na inn uh suksiatgawp dingin ka ngaihsun khinzo hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin ka mangmat le a khiatna nong gen theih uhleh, letsong le minphatna lianpi ka hong pia ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka mangmat bang hi a, a khiatna bang ahi hiam cih hong gen un,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in, “Kumpipa aw, na mang hong gen phot leteh a khiatna ka hong gen thei pan ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawngkik uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ka ngaihsutsa teng hong zasak khinzo ka hih manin hun sau theihtheihna ding a zong na hihlam uh teltakin kithei hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mangmat nong gen theih kei uhleh note khempeuh thukhenna khat bek ka hong pia ding hi. Noteng khempeuh in lungsim kikhatin zuauthu gengen leeng a ngaihsutna hong kikheel ding hi, a ci nuam na hi tazen uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka mangmat hong gen phot un. Tua hileh a khiatna zong hong gen thei ding ci-in ka hong muang pan ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Khongkhai theite in, “Kumpipa aw, na deihna bang a hong gen thei ding hih leitungah mihing khat beek om lo ding hi. Kumpi gen loh milian pen le mi thupi pen khat beek in, a aisan theite, a mitphial siamte, le a khongkhai theite tungah tua bang thu a dong ngei kuamah om nai lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thudotna pen haksa lua mahmah ahih manin, mihing ahi lo pasian-te longal a gen thei ding kuamah om lo hi,” a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua thu hangin kumpipa heh mahmah a, Babylon sunga kumpi’ thudot mipilte khempeuh thahlup khit dingin thu a pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mipilte khempeuh thahlup khitna ding thu kipia a, tua thahlup dingte sungah Daniel le a lawmte zong a kihel uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel zong Babylon gam sunga mipilteng a thatlum dingin a kisawl kumpi cing a ukpa Ariok kiangah kampau kidawm takin a va pai hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in Ariok kiangah, “Bang dingin kumpipa in hih zahtakin thukhauh suaksak ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ariok in a thupiang khempeuh a gen hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah Daniel pai a, a mangmat a khiatna a hilh theih nadingin hun tawmvei sung a kingak lai nadingin phalna a ngen hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel a inn-ah ciah a, a thupiangteng khempeuh a lawmte Hananiah, Mishael, le Azariah-te kiangah a ko hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in, vantung Pasian in eite hong hehpihin, tua thuthukpi genkhia thei-in, Babylon gam sunga mipil dangte tawh thahna i thuakkhawm loh nadingin thu i ngen ding hi, ci-in a gen hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua zan sungin maangmuhna tawh tua thuthukpi Daniel’ tungah kihilh a, amah in vantung Pasian’ min a phat hi."},"20":{"text":"“Pasian’ min kiphat tawntung ta hen; amah pilin a vanglian hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in hun le khuahunte kheel a, kumpite koihin lah a lakhia hi. Amah in mite tungah pilna le theihna a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in thuthukpite le thusimte a lakkhia hi. Amah in khuamial sunga kiseelte thei a, khuavak in amah a umcih hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang pen ka pu ka pate’ Pasian na hi a, ka hong phat a, ka hong zahtak hi. Nangmah in pilna le thahatna na hong piazo hi. Ka thungetna nong za a, kumpipa kianga ka gen ding thu nong lakzo hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Babylon mipilte a that dingin a sawl pa Ariok kiangah Daniel pai a, “Babylon gam sunga mipilte that kei in. Kumpipa kiangah hong paipih in; tu-in a mangmat a khiatna ka gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ariok in thakhatin kumpipa kiangah Daniel paipih pah a, “Kumpipa aw, na mangmat a khiatna a hong gen thei ding Jew mi salte khat ka va mu hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa in Belteshazzar a kici Daniel kiangah, “Ka mangmat bang hi a, a khiatna bang hiam cih hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"27":{"text":"Daniel in, “Kumpipa aw, tua na theihnop thu a hong gen thei ding khongkhai thei, mitphial siam, aisan siam kuamah om lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahih hangin thusim a lak thei vantungah Pasian khat a om hi. Amah in mai lamah bang thu hong piang ding cih nangmah Nebukhadnezzar kumpipa tungah a hong hilhzo hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa na ihmut laitakin mailam a hong piang ding mang khat na man a, thuthukpi a lakkhia Pasian in a piang ding thu a hong lakkholzo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tu-in midangte sangin ka pilzawk manin kei tungah tua thu a hong kilak hi loin, Kumpipa in na mangmat a khiatna le na ngaihsut thu na theih nadingin a hong kilak ahi zaw hi."},"31":{"text":"“Kumpipa aw, na mangin a tee daldal milim lian mahmah khat na mu a, kihtakhuai mahmahin na mai-ah a ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua milim lutang pen kham hoih mahmah tawh a kibawl ahi hi. A awm le a bante ngun tawh kibawl a, a gil le a pheite sumngo tawh kibawl hi."},"33":{"text":"A khete sik tawh kibawl a, a khepekte khen khat sik, khen khat tungman kigawm ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua banga na et laitakin mualtung panin suangtumpi khat kuama khuk lohin hong tuk a, sik le tungman kigawm milim khete dengtanin a kithehthang hi."},"35":{"text":"Thakhatin sik, tungman, sumngo, ngun le khamte kitamnen gawp a, khuakhal lai-a ansi zap bangin a leengmang hi. Huih in leenmang khin ahih manin themkha beek a kimu nawn kei hi. Ahih hangin tua suangtum hong khangkhang a, mual cia hong pha-in leitung khempeuh a dim hi."},"36":{"text":"“Na mangmat pen tu-a teng ahi hi. Tu-in a khiatna ka hong gen ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, kumpi khempeuh lak pan nang a lianpen na hi hi. Vantung Pasian in kumpi-in nang hong koih a, vangliatna, thahatna, le zahtakna a hong pia hi."},"38":{"text":"Amah in mi’ tenna leitungteng, ganhingteng le vasate a uk dingin nang a hong koih hi. Tua kham lutang pen nangmah na hi hi."},"39":{"text":"Nang’ khit ciangin nang’ kumpi gam sangin a neuzaw kumpi gam adang khat hong piang ding a, tua khit ciangin sumngo ahi kumpi gam a thumna in leitung khempeuh uk ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin kumpi gam lina hong piang ding a, sik bangin a khauh ding hi. Sik in na khempeuh satnenin a gawivui bangin, a masa kumpi gamteng khempeuh a sukham ding hi."},"41":{"text":"A khepek le a khemete khen khat sik le khen khat tungman kigawm ahi na mu hi. Tua pen kumpi gam kikhenthang ding hi, cihna ahi hi. Tungman le sik kigawm ahih mah bangin sik bangin a hoih khopkhat ciang khauhna a nei ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A khemete khenkhat sik hi a, a khenkhat tungman ahih mah bangin kumpi gam khenkhat thahatin khenkhat a thahat kei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Sik le tungman kigawm na muh mah bangin tua kumpi gam ukte in kigawm ding hanciamin zileta-in a kimat ding uh hi. Ahih hangin sik le tungman a kimat theih loh mah bangin a kigawm thei kei ding uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua kumpite a maan laitakun vantung Pasian in a bei thei ngei lo ding kumpi gam a hong phut ding hi. Tua kumpi gam kuamah in zo zo lo ding a, tua gam in gamdang khempeuhte zogawpin a kip tawntung ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Kuama lawn lohpi-in mualtung pan hong tuksuk suangtum in sik, sumngo, tungman, ngun, le kham tawh kibawl milim a denpaih na mu hi. A lian Pasian in mai lamah bang hong piang ding cih Kumpipa tungah a hong hilh ahi hi. Na mangmat pen ahi bang teekteekin kong gen a, a khiatna zong a man bangin kong genzo hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpi Nebukhadnezzar zong Daniel’ mai leilakah kunsukin, Daniel tungah sagawh biakna le a namtui biakpiakna bawl dingin thu a pia hi."},"47":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Hih thuthukpi hong genthei na hih manin na Pasian pen thuthuk a lak, pasian khempeuh sung pan a lianpen, kumpite’ tunga Topa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Daniel letsong hoih tampi pia a, a za liansak a, Babylon gamteng uksakin, Babylon mipil thudotte a ukpipa dingin a koih hi."},"49":{"text":"Kumpipa in Daniel’ ngetna mah bangin Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te Babylon gam khen tuamtuamte a uk dingin koih a, Daniel pen kumpi inn sungah a omsak hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar in a tun pi sawmkua a sang, a vailam pi kua a gol kham milim golpi khat bawlsak a, Babylon gam sung Dura zanglei-ah a koih hi.","title":"Mei Phualpi Sung Pan Suahtakna"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa in a milian khempeuh, kumpi tapate, gam ukpite, gam ukpi huhte, mangpite, sumkem mangte, thukhen mangte, khuapi uk mangte le milian dangte khempeuh, kumpipa’ milim bawl apna ah a paikim ciat dingin sapna thu a pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tua mangliante khempeuh milim ap nadingin milim mai-ah a ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin nakpitakin taangkona khat kibawl a, “Minam tuamtuamte le paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh aw!"},"5":{"text":"Peengkul ging na za ding uh a, tua khit ciangin tamngaite, laiza lasakna gingte, harp lasakna gingte, gawsemte, le tumtheih a tuamtuamte a hong kitum ciangin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar’ koih kham milim mai-ah kunin na bia ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A kun lo, a bia lo peuhmah thakhat thu-in mei phualpi sungah kikhul pah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mah bangin minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte le paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh in tumtheih gingte a zak phetun kunsukin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar’ kham milim koih a bia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Babylon mite pawlkhat pai-in Jew mite a heksim uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar’ kiangah, “Kumpipa aw, na khansau hen!"},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in, tumtheihte a hong kitum khit phetin mi khempeuh kham milim mai-ah kunin bia ding uh hi, ci-in thu na pia khinzo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua milim mai-ah kun loin, a bia lo khempeuh mei phualpi sungah a kikhul ding ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Babylon gam a khen liante a uk dingin na koih Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego a kici Jew mi pawlkhat a om uh hi. Amaute in kumpipa’ thupiakna a mang kei uh hi. Amaute in na pasian bia nuam loin, na milim koih mai-ah a kun nuam kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua thu hangin kumpipa heh mahmah a, tua mi thumte ama mai-ah a kipaipihna ding thu a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in, “Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te aw, ka pasian bianuam loin, ka kham milim koih mai-ah kun nuam lo na hi uh hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in peengkulte, tamngaite, laiza lasakna gingte, harp lasakna gingte, gawsem, le tumtheih dang a gingte na zak khit phet uh ciangin kunin milim na bia ding uh hi. Na biak kei uhleh thakhatin mei phualpi sungah hong kikhul ding ahih ciangin a hong honkhiazo ding pasian omin um na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te in Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar kiangah, “Kumpipa aw, hih thu kong dawng kei ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mei phualpi sung panin a hong honkhia thei pasian a om leh ka biak ka Pasian uh hi ding a, na khutsung panin a hong honkhia ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, a hong hotkhiat kei zenzen leh zong, na pasian lah ka bia tuan kei ding uh a, na kham milim mai-ah zong ka kun kei ding uh hi, ci-in theita in,” a ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar pen Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te tungah heh mahmah ahih manin a mai a san pempam hi. A sat ngeinazah sangin a zah sagihvei a sazaw mei phualpi a cih dingin a mite thu a pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te a hencip ding le mei phualpi sungah a khul dingin galkap thahat khempeuh thu a pia hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute puanak le puantualpi silhsa le lukhu khusa-in hencip uh a, mei phualpi sungah a khul uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa’ thupiakna kinawh lua mahmah a, mei phualpi lah sa lua mahmah ahih manin a khulte nangawn meikuang in hullum hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te hencipsa-in meikuangpi laizangah a kiasuk uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nebukhadnezzar in lamdangsa mahmahin a ding vat hi. Amah in a thudotte kiangah, “Mihing thum hencipsa-in mei phualpi sungah khul hi lo ihi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, “Hi mah hi, Kumpipa aw,” ci-in a dawngkik uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tua ahihleh bang hangin meikuang sungah mihing li a kawi paipai mu ka hi hiam? Amaute lah kihencip lo a, liam zong liam tuak beek lo uh hi. A lina pen pa hoh pasian-te khat tawh a kibang hi,” ci-in a dong hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Nebukhadnezzar zong mei phualpi kong gei-ah paito a, “Shadrak! Meshak! Abednego! A lianpen Pasian’ nasemte hong paikhia un,” ci-in a sam hi. Tua ciangin amaute zong thakhatin a hong paikhia pah uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpi tapate, gam ukpite, gam ukpi huhte, le kumpipa’ thudotte khempeuh kikhawm uh a, mei in a kat loh mite a en uh hi. A sam uh zang khat beek mei in kanghul lo a, a puan uh zong kang loin meikhu gim zong a nam beek kei uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te’ Pasian phat un. Amah in a vantung mite sawl a, amah a muang ama nasem hih mite a honkhia hi. Amaute in ka thupiakna mang loin, amau’ Pasian longal pasian dang’ mai-ah kun nuam lo, bia nuam lo uh ahih manin mei phualpi sungah khul ding a utzaw uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tu-in minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte, paunam tuamtuamte, mi khat peuhpeuh in Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te’ Pasian gensiatna kampau a om leh kibalnengawp ding a, a inn uh kisuksiatsak ding hi, ci-in thukham ka bawl hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih bangin a hon thei pasian dang om peuhmah lo hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego-te Babylon gam khen liante-ah a golzaw ukna za a pia hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebukhadnezzar kumpipa in leitung a om minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte, paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh tungah a nuai-a thute hih bangin a khak hi: “Note tungah nopna om ta hen!","title":"Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar A Haina"},"2":{"text":"A Lianpen Pasian in kei tungah lim le nalamdang a hong lahna thute ka hong gen nuam hi."},"3":{"text":"“Pasian’ hong lah na lamdangte, bangzahin lian ahi hiam? A bawl na lamdangte, bangzahin vanglian ahi hiam? A tawntungin Pasian kumpi hi ding a, amah in a tawntungin a uk paisuak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Keimah Nebukhadnezzar lungnuam takin kumpi inn-ah ka teng a, nuamsa mahmahin ka om hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahih hangin ka ihmut laitakin a lauhuai mang khat ka man a, a dipkuathuai maang ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mangmat a khiatna a hong hilh dingin Babylon gam kumpi thudotte khempeuh a hong pai nadingun thu ka pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin aisan theite, mitphial siamte, khongkhai theite, aksi et siamte khempeuh hong pai uh a, amaute kiangah ka mang ka gen hi. Ahih hangin a khiatna a hong gen thei kei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel (a min ding Betashazzar, ka pasian’ min tamin a kiphuak pa) a hong pai hi. Pasian’ kha ama sungah om ahih ciangin ama kiangah ka mangmat ka gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama kiangah, aisan theite lak a a lianpen Betashazzar aw, Pasian’ kha na sungah om ahih manin thuthuk khempeuh na theih theihlam ka thei hi. Hih ka mang a khiatna hong gen in, ka ci hi."},"10":{"text":"“Ka ihmut laitakin maangmuhna khat ka nei a, leitung laizangah a po singkung sang mahmah khat ka mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua singkung pen khangkhangin gol semsem a, vantung dong banto ahih ciangin leitung mi khempeuh in a mu thei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A tehte hoih mahmah a, leitung bup khamkhop ding gah a gah hi. Gamsate in a liim beel uh a, vasate in a hiang kawmah bu bawl uh a, a nungta thei khempeuh in a gah a ne uh hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ka maangmuhna ngaihsunin ka om laitakin ka khuadak leh a vil, a patau vantungmi khat vantung pan a hong tuaksuk ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah nakpi-in kiko-in, ‘A singkung phuk inla, a hiangteng sattan in. A tehteng heuhsiang inla, a gahteng thehthang in. A nuai-a ganhingteng le a hiang tunga vasateng hawlkhia in."},"15":{"text":"Ahih hangin a bul le leisung a a zungte nusia in. Sik le sumngo kual tawh vial inla, gamlak lopate tawh nusia khawm in. Hih mipa tungah daitui kai hen la, ganhingte le lopate tawh omkhawm hen."},"16":{"text":"Amah in mihing lungsim nei nawn loin, kum sagih sung ganhing lungsim a nei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih pen a vil, a patau vantungmi’ thukhenna ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin mun khempeuhah a om mi khempeuhte in, a Lian Pasian in mite’ kumpi gamah vai a hawm hi, cih a thei ding uh hi. Amah in a teel peuhpeuh a neupente nangawn kumpi a suaksak thei ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"“Beltashazzar aw, keimah Nebukhadnezzar Kumpipa in ka mangmat pen hih bang ahi hi. Ahi zongin nang’ sungah Pasian’ kha om ahih manin na hong gen thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Beltashazzar zong a kici Daniel lungmang lua ahih manin tawmvei sung bangmah gen thei loin a om hi. Kumpipa in, Beltashazzar aw, mang le a khiatna huhau-in na lung mangsak zenzen kei in, a ci hi. Beltashazzar in, Kumpipa aw, nang mangmat le a khiatna pen na galte tungah tungzaw hen, a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Singkung sang mahmah na muh pen hong khangkhang a, khauh mahmah a, vantung dong banto a, leitungah a teng mi khempeuh in a mu thei uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A tehte hoih mahmah a, leitung bup a vakzo ding gah a gah hi. Gamsate, a nuai-ah tawlnga uh a, vasate in a hiang kawmah bu a bawl uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, nang pen tua singkung na hi hi. Nang na lian a, na thahat hi. Nakpi takin khangin lian mahmah na hih manin vantung dong na banto a, leitung khempeuhah na vangliatna kizel hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa in na et laitakin, vantungmi khat vantung panin hong paisuk a, “A singkung phuk inla susia in; ahih hangin lei sungah a bul le a zungte nusia in. A tungah daitui kia hen la, kum sagih sung ganhingte tawh omkhawm ta hen,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, a khiatna pen hih bang ahi hi. A Lian Pasian in nang tungah a hong tung ding a thukhennasa a hong lak ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Mite sung panin hong kihawlkhia ding a, gamsate tawh na tengkhawm ding hi. Tua ciangin a Lian Pasian in mihingte’ kumpi gam uk a, a teel mi peuhpeuh kumpi suaksak thei hi, na ci ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Vantung mi in singbul le a zungte lei sungah nusiat dingin thu a pia hi. Tua pen, Pasian in leitung khempeuh uk hi, cih na theih ciangin kumpi na suakkik ding hi, a cihnopna ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa aw, kong thuhilhna hong mang in. Mizawngte hehpih leteh, tua in a sia-a na gamtatnasate hong puahsak ding a, na nuamsa toto ding hi, a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Hih thuteng khempeuh kumpi Nebukhadnezzar’ tungah hong tung hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua zawh kha sawm le nih khit ciangin kumpipa zong Babylon khua kumpi innkhumzang huan sungah vak a,"},"30":{"text":"Babylon khua bangzah takin lian ahi hiam? Kumpi khuapi ding le, ka vangliatna ka thahatna a kilat nadingin ka lam ahi hi, a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua thute a kamsung pan a pusuah ma-in vantung panin aw khat hong ging a, “Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar aw, ka thugen na ngai in. Na kumpi gam hong kilakkhiatsak zo hi."},"32":{"text":"Mite lak pan hong kihawlkhia ding a, gamsate tawh na tengkhawm ding hi. Bawngtal bangin kum sagih sung lopa na ne ding hi. Tua ciangin, Pasian in mihingte’ kumpi gam uk a, a teel mi peuhpeuh kumpi a suaksak thei hi, na ci ding hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua hun lianin Nebukhadnezzar’ tungah tua thukhenna a hong tung hi. Mite lak panin Nebukhadnezzar kihawlkhia a, bawngtal bangin lopa a ne takpi hi. A pumpi tungah daitui kia a, a pumpi tunga a multe keelmul bangin sau a, a khutcinte muvanlai khecin bangin a hong sau hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “A kisehsa hun a cin ciangin keimah Nebukhadnezzar in vantung lam ka ento a, ka khuatheihna a hong tungkik hi. A nungta tawntung a Lianpen Pasian’ min phatin, zahtakna le minthanna ka pia hi. “Amah in a tawntungin uk ding a, ama gam kip tawntung ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Amah in leitung mite bangmahin a sim kei a, vantung mite le leitung mite ama khutnuai ahi hi. Ama deihna kuamah in nial thei lo a, a bawlnate kuamah in a hang a kan thei kei hi."},"36":{"text":"“Ka khuatheihna a hong tunkik ciangin ka kumpi za, ka minthanna, le ka gam minthannate a hong kipia kik hi. Ama bawlna khempeuh a man hi. Amah a tawntungin thuman a, a kiphasakin a gamtate a neusak hi,” a ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi a suah ciangin Belshazzar in pawi lianpi khat bawl a, a mi liante tulkhat samin amaute tawh zu a ne uh hi.","title":"Kawm Tung a Laigelhna"},"2":{"text":"Zu a nek laitakun, Belshazzar in a pa Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem biakinnpi panin a puakkhiat ngun hai, kham hai, le kuangte a va la dingin thu a pia hi. Kumpipa in a miliante le a zite le a zineute in tua haite tawh zu a nektheih nadingun hai la dingin thu a pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Thakhatin kham haite, kuangte hong paipih uh a, a vekpi-un tua haite tawh zu a ne uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in zu ne uh a, kham tawh, ngun tawh, sumngo tawh, sik tawh, sing tawh, suang tawh a kibawl pasian-te a phat uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Thakhat thu-in kumpi innsung meivak a taan penna lam kawm tungah mihing khut khat hong kilangin lai a hong gelh hi. Tua khut in lai a gelh laitak kumpipa in a mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa lau lua mahmah a, a mai daang gawpin a khut a ling kauhkauh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in mitphial siamte, aisan siamte, aksi et siamte va sam pak un, ci-in a kiko hi. Tua mite a hong tun uh ciangin kumpipa in, “Hih lai kigelh a sim thei, a khiatna a hong gen thei peuhmah kumpi puanpi silhsakin, minphatna khamkhi a ngawngah ka oksak ding a, kumpi gam sungah a za lian a thumna-in ka koih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa’ thudot mite hong tung uh a, ahih hangin tua lai a sim thei le kumpipa tungah a khiatna a gen thei kuamah a om kei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua tak ciangin kumpi Belshazzar lungkham mahmahin a mel daang semsem a, a miliante in a cih nading mel a thei kei uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa le a miliante gamlum ngeingai-in a om laitakun, pawi inn sungah kumpinu hong lut a, “Kumpipa aw, sauveipi nungta in. Na pa kumpi ahih laitakin, tua mipa in pasian-te’ pilna tawh a kibang pilna, theihna le lungsim navakna a nei hi. Tua hi a, kumpi ahi na pa Nebukhadnezzar in tua pa pen aisan theite, mitphial siamte, khongkhai siamte, le aksi et siamte’ ukpi dingin a koih hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in a kanzaw siamna nei a, mangkhiat siamna, thudotna haksa nonote dawntheihna, le thuthukpite gentel theihna a nei hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Beteshazzar ci-in a min a phuah Daniel samsak in. Tua hileh amah in a hong gen thei pah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin thakhatin kumpipa kiangah Daniel a paipih uh hi. Kumpipa in, “Nang Daniel pen kumpi ahi ka pa in Judah gam panin a hong lakkhiat Jew mi salte khat hi lo na hi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Nangma sungah Pasian’ kha om ahih manin siamna nei-in, lungpilna le theihna na neihlam ka thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka thudot mite le mitphial siamte, hih lai kigelh a sim ding le a khiatna a gen dingin a hong pai uh hinapi, a khiatna a theizo kei uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahih hangin nangmah in thuthukpi le kuama theih zawh loh thute gen thei hi, ci-in kong zazo hi. Hih lai kigelh sim thei-in a khiatna nong gen theih leh kumpi puansan kong silhsak ding a, minphatna khamkhi na ngawngah hong oksakin, kumpi gam sungah a za lian thumna-in ka hong koih ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Daniel in kumpipa kiangah, “Letsong pen kei hong pia kei inla, midang khatpeuh piazaw in. Ahi zongin tua lai kigelh hong simsakin a khiatna kumpipa kong hilh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A Lianpen Pasian in na pa Nebukhadnezzar kumpi lianin koih a, zahtakna le vangliatna a pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah lianlua mahmah ahih manin gam khempeuh, nam khempeuh, pau khempeuhte in kihta-in a ling uh hi. Mi khatpeuh a thahnop leh that a, a nuntaksaknop leh a nungtasak hi. A ut leh mi khatpeuh pahtawi-in, a ut leh a daisak thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahih hangin amah a lung khauhin kiphasak a, gilo lua ahih manin a kumpi tokhom panin kilakhia a, a minthanna a taan hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte lak panin amah kihawlkhia a, ganhing lungsim a nei hi. Gam sakolte tawh tengkhawmin, bawngtal bangin lopa ne a, daitui dal ding nei loin a pualamah a lum hi. A tawpkhakna-ah a Lianpen Pasian in mihingte’ kumpi gamte uk a, a teel peuhpeuh kumpi suak hi, ci-in a phawk thei hi."},"22":{"text":"“Ahih hangin a tapa ahi nangmah Belshazzar in hih thu khempeuh na theih hangin na kiniamkhiat tuan kei hi."},"23":{"text":"Vantung Topa’ langah na pang hi. A biakinnpi hai le kuangte la-in sabuai tungah nangmah tawh, na miliante tawh a zineute le na zite uh tawh zunekna-in na zang uh hi. Theihna a nei lo, a mu thei lo, khua a za thei lo ngun, kham, sumngo, sik, sing, le suang tawh a kibawl pasian-te’ min na phat uh hi. Na nuntakna le na hihna khempeuh a hong uk Pasian na zahtak kei hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in hih laimalte tua khut a hong gelh sak hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua a kigelh laimal pen hih bang ahi hi: Mene, Mene, Tekel, Parsin."},"26":{"text":"A khiatna zong hih bang ahi hi: Mene pen kisim a cihna hi a, Pasian in na gam ukna hong simsak a, a beisak ta hi, cihna ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tekel pen kitawikhai a cihna hi a, nang hong kitawikhai-in na lek zo kei hi, a cihna ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Parsin pen kikhen cihna hi a, na gam kikhen khamin Media le Persia-te a kipiazo hi, a cihna ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Belshazzar in Daniel pen kumpi puansan a silhsak dingin thu pia pah a, minphatna khamkhi a ngawngah a oksak hi. A gam sungah a za lian thum nadingin a koih hi.","ref":"Pian 41:42"},"30":{"text":"Tua zan mahmahin Babylon kumpipa Belshazzar kithat a,"},"31":{"text":"Media mi Darias kumpi a suak hi. (Tua laitakin Darias kum sawmguk le kum nih a pha hi.)"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darias in gam sung khempeuh a uksawn dingin gam ukpi za le sawmnih dingin a ngaihsun hi.","title":"Humpinelkai Kikhumna Sungah Daniel Kikhia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua gam ukpite tungah a vaihawmpi ding le kumpi deih bang a sem dingin Daniel le adang mi nih a teel hi."},"3":{"text":"Gam ukpi dangte le vaihawmpi dangte sangin Daniel nasep siamzaw diak se hi. Amah in mi thahatte le Pasian’ mite a susia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A lungsim daplan lua ahih manin zuauphuah siamna tawh a hih khempeuh a tangtun ding hi.
