Ka maangmuhna thu thei zo lo ka hih manin cih nading mel thei loin daptakin ka om hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Media mi ahi Ahasueras’ tapa Darias in Babylon gamteng a uk hi.","title":"Daniel in A Mite a’ ding Thu A Ngetsakna"},"2":{"text":"Amah kumpi a suah a kum masa kumin keimah Daniel in, Topa in kamsang Jeremiah tungah Jerusalem kum sawmsagih sung kisia ding hi, ci-in a genna thu ngaihsunin biakna laibute ka sim hi.","ref":"Jer 25:11; 29:10"},"3":{"text":"An ngawlin, puanhampi silhin, vut lakah tu-in, Topa’ kiangah deih takin thu ka ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa ka Pasian’ kiangah thu ngenin ka mite’ mawhna ka pulak hi. Kote’ gamtatna pha a suang hi loin nangma migitna suangin thu ka hong ngen uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa aw, kong thungetna uh hong za inla, ka mawhna uh hong maisak in. Topa aw, hong ngai inla hong sem in! Mi khempeuh in Pasian na hihlam a hong theih nadingun hong zekai kei in. Hih khuapi le hih mite na neihsa ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima mawhna le ka mipih Israel-te’ mawhna pulakin, ka Topa Pasian kiangah a biakinn siangtho a hong puahkik nadingin thumin ka ngenngen hi.","title":"Nipikal Sawmsagih Thu Hilhkholhna"},"21":{"text":"Thu ka nget laitakin ka maangmuh masak sunga ka muh mipa Gabriel, ka omna munah a hong leengsuk hi. Tua hun pen nitak lam biakpiak hun laitak ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 1:19,26"},"22":{"text":"Amah in, “Daniel aw, hilhkholhna thu a theisak dingin a hong pai ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian tungah thum dingin na kisak laitakin amah in a hong zazo hi. Pasian in nang hong it ahih manin, tua thu a gen dingin ka hong pai hi. Tu-in, tua maangmuhna thu ka hong hilhtel laitakin ciamteh in."},"24":{"text":"“Na mite le khuapi siangtho, a mawhna le a gamtat khialhnate a beina ding hun kum sawmsagih mun sagih sung a kisehzo hi. Tua ciangin mawhna kimaisak ding a, a tawntung thutang thu a hong tung ding hi. Genkholhna le maangmuhna thu a mantakin hong tangtung ding a, a Siangtho Pen Mun biakinnpi kisiansuah ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hih thu ciamteh inla thei in: Jerusalem lamkikna ding thu a kipiak hun a kipan sathau kinilh pa hong pai dong kum sagih mun sagih sung hi ding hi. Jerusalem kongzing lampi nei le kulhpi nei-in kilamkik ding a, kum sawmguk le nih mun sagih sung kip ding a, ahih hangin buai hun sung ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hun a bei khit ciangin sathau kinilh pa thuman lopi-in a kithat ding hi. Galsim dingin a hong pai galkapmang lianpa in khuapi le biakinnpi a susia ding hi. A beina pen tuiciin tun bang hi ding a, a tawp dongin galdona le kisiatna vive ahi dingin Pasian in thu a khenzo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua makai pa in mi tampite tawh kum sagih sung thuciamna kip bawl ding uh hi. Gangawh biakna le biakpiakna, hih hunlang sung a khawlsak ding hi. Biakinn dawn sangpen munah a Lipkhaphuai na kikoih ding hi; ahi zongin Pasian in tua a koihpa’ thuak dingin a geelsa thu a koihpa in a thuak hun ciang dong, a Lipkhaphuai na pen a koihna mun mahah omlai phot ding hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Dan 11:31; 12:11; Mat 24:15; Mrk 13:14"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sairas, Persia gam kumpi a suahzawh kum thum a phak laitakin Beteshazzar zong a kici Daniel tungah thu khat a kipia hi. Tua thu pen theihtelhak mahmah ahih manin maangmuhna tawh teltakin a kilak hi.","title":"Tigris Gun Gei-ah Daniel’ Maangmuhna"},"2":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin keimah Daniel, nipikal thum sung khakunin dahin ka om hi."},"3":{"text":"Zu le sa ahi a, anlim ahi zongin bangmah ka ne kei a, nipikal thum a bei mateng ka sam zong ka hiat kei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua kum a kha masa, ni sawmnih le li ni-in Tigris gunpi gei-ah ka ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunglam ka ettoh leh puanpak silhin kham kawnggak tawh a kawng a gak mi khat ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"A pumpi, suangmanpha tawh kibangin a taang hi. A maitang, khuaphialep bangin taang a, a mittangte mei bangin a kuang zalzal hi. A ban le a khete sumngo zutsiang bangin tee daldal hi. A aw, mihonpi kiko tawh kibangin a ging zuazua hi.","ref":"Mang 1:13-15; 2:18; 19:12"},"7":{"text":"Tua maangmuhna keimah bek in ka mu hi. Ka gei-a om midangte in bangmah a mu kei uh hi. Amaute lau uh ahih manin taimangin a bu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei guak bek hong kinusia ahih manin tua a lamdang maangmuhna keimah guak bek mah in ka mu hi. Ka thaneihteng beikhin a, ka mel kikhelgawp ahih manin kei ka hihlam mel kuamah in a hong thei nawn kei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua mipa’ kampau ka zak ciangin ka khuplamin leilakah tuksukin khua ka phawk nawn kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua laitakin ka khut khatin hong phongto a, ka khut le ka khukin ka thoto a, ling kankan kawmin ka om hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in, “Daniel aw, Pasian in nang hong it hi. Ding inla kong thugente limtakin ciamteh in. Na kiangah thu a gen dingin kei hong kisawlzo hi,” a hong ci hi. Amah in hih thuteng a hong gen khit ciangin ling kankan kawmin ka ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Daniel aw, lau kei in. Kiniamkhiat dingin na lungsim na khensat masak pen ni a kipan, tua thu na theihtheih nadingin Pasian in na thungetna a hong zazo hi. Na thungetna bang a hong pia dingin ka hong pai hi."},"13":{"text":"Persia gam a cing vantungmi in ni sawmnih le khat sung kei a hong nial hi. Tua ciangin kei a hong huh dingin vantungmi thupite khat ahi Mikhael a hong pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Persia gam sungah keimah guak bek ka om hi.","ref":"Mang 12:7"},"14":{"text":"Mailam hunah na mipihte’ tunga hong tung ding thu a hilhkhol dingin a hong pai ka hi hi. Hih pen mailam a hong piang lai ding maangmuhna ahi hi,” a hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in hih thu a hong gen ciangin kei bangmah pau thei loin lei ka ensuk gega mawk hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin pasal mel tawh a kibang mi khat thakhatin ka mai-ah hong om a, ka muk a hong lawnsak hi. Tua ciangin thugen dingin ka kisa hi. Ka mai-a a ding pa kiangah, “Topa aw, ka maangmuhna in ka tha hong zawsak lua ahih manin ka ci-lin a pha thei kei hi."},"17":{"text":"A topa’ mai-ah a ding sila khat tawh ka kibang hi. Bangci bangin thu hong gen thei ding ka hi hiam? Husan’ zawhna ding thatang nangawn ka nei kei hi,” ka ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin khatvei hong lenkik leuleu a, ka tha a hong khauhkik zawdeuh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in, “Lunghimawh kei inla, lau kei in. Kihangsak in. Pasian in nang hong it hi,” a hong ci hi. Tuateng a hong gen khit ciangin ka tha hong khauhzaw a, “Topa aw, na gen ding peuhpeuh hong gen in; tu-in ka ci a hong damzaw diak hi,” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in, “Bang hangin na kiangah hong pai ka hi hiam, cih na thei hiam? Thuman Laibu sungah a kigelh thute a lak dingin a hong pai ka hi hi. Tu-in ciahkikin, Persia gam a cing vantungmi tawh ka kido ding hi. Tua khit ciangin Grik gam a cing vantungmi a hong kilang ding hi. Mikhael longal kei a hong huh ding kuamah a om kei hi.","ref":"Mang 12:7","merge":"21"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel a cing vantungmi pen kei hong huhpa le a hong dal pa ahi hi,” a hong ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Tu-a na tunga kong gen ding thu, a thuman ahi hi. Kumpi thum in Persia gam uk lai ding a, tua banah a lina hong khang ding hi. Tua pa, a dangteng sangin a hauzaw ding hi. Amah in a hauh penpen laitak le a thahat pen laitakin Grik kumpi a to ding hi.","title":"Egypt Kumpi le Syria Kumpite"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a minthang kumpi khat a hong kilang ding hi. Amah in gam zaipi tak uk ding a, ama thuthu-in a gamta ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin a thahat pen laitakin a gam hong kitam ding a, khen li a kisuah ding hi. A suan a khakte in ama gam a ukkha kei ding uh hi. Midangte in uk ding uh a, ahi zongin amah zahin vang a neizo kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Egypt kumpipa a hong thahat ding hi. Ahi zongin a galkapmang lianpente khat thahat pen ding a, gam lianzaw a uk ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kum sauvei sim khit ciangin Egypt kumpipa in a kipawlkhawm theih nadingin Syria kumpipa le ama tanu a kitengsak ding hi. Ahih hangin tua kipawlkhawmna kip lo ding a, tua numei le a tonpih a silate le a ta le a pasal a kithatlum ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“A sawt loin tua numei’ behte khat in Syria kumpi sim ding a, a kulhpi sungah tumin amaute a zogawp ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in amaute’ milim pasian-te le a na manpha ngun le khamte Egypt gamah a pua ding hi. Kum tawmvei sung bek kilemna a om ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Syria kumpipa in Egypt gam sim ding a, ahih hangin zo zo loin a nungkik ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa’ tate, galsim dingin kithawi-in galkap ding mi tampi a kaikhawm ding uh hi. Tua galkapmangte khat thahat diakin tuikhang bang ding a, galte’ kulhpi a luhzo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa zong heh mahmahin Syria kumpipa simgawp ding a, a galkapte tampi tak a matsak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A galhatna hang le galkap tampi a thahna hangin kisathei mahmah ding a, ahih hangin a gualzo tawntung kei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Syria kumpipa khatvei kuankikin a masa sangin galkap a tamzaw a kaikhawm ding hi. A hun kicingta a sak ciangin galkap tampi le galhiam kicing piikpeek tawh a kuankhia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tua hun ciangin mi tampi tak in Egypt kumpipa a lehdo ding uh hi. Daniel’ mipihte ahi, mihoih lo pawlkhat in zong a muhsa uh maangmuhna hangin a lehdo ding uh a, ahih hangin a guallel ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Syria kumpipa in kulhpi tawh a ki-umcih khuapite luhzo-in a la khin ding hi. Egypt galkapte in gal dosuakzo nawn lo ding uh a, galkap thahat pente a thaneem ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Galdo zo ding om nawn lo uh ahih manin a galte uh a ututin a gamta ding uh hi. Thuciam Gamah zong lutin a khut sungah tua gam a om ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa in a galkap neih khempeuh zangin galsim ding a ngaihsun ding hi. Olno takin a gualzawh theih nadingin a tanu le a galte tensak ding a ngaihsun ding hi. Ahih hangin a tangtungzo kei veve ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin tuipi tungtawnin minam dangte sim ding a, tampi tak mah a zo ding hi. Ahih hangin gamdang makai khat in amah zogawp ding a, a minthanna teng a beisak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa a kulhpi a zuankik dingin a gamah hong ciah ding a, ahih hangin gal lel khinta ahih manin amah a beita ding ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kumpi dang khat in ama nung hong zuikik leuleu ding a, a gam sung khantoh nadingin phiangsiah tampi a dong dingin mi khat a sawl ding hi. Tawlno khat khit ciangin tua kumpipa kithatlum ding a, ahih hangin galsung a si ahi kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ama zomah Syria kumpi ding pen migilo, kumpi dingin a kilawm lo mi khat ahi ding hi. Ahih hangin amah pen thakhat thu-in zuausiamna tawh kumpi a hong suakvat ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama thu a nial galkap honpite le Pasian’ siampi liante khempeuh a mangthangsak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Zuaugen siamna zangin minam dangte tawh kilemna a bawl ding hi. Minam tawmno khat bek a uk hangin a thahatna a khang semsem ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in a pu a pate’ hih ngei loh, gam hau, gam kilemte nangawn a sim ding hi. Tua ciangin galsung a a lak vante le nate a nungzuite tawh a hawm ding uh hi. Amah in galdalna kulhpite khempeuh luh ding hanciam ding a, ahih hangin tawmvei sung bek hun a nei ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Egypt gam hangtakin a sim theih nadingin galkap tampi a kaikhawm ding hi. Egypt-te in zong galkap tampi tawh nasia takin a na do ding uh hi. Ahi zongin Egypt kumpipa in khemna thuak ding ahih manin gal a zo kei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama muan pen a thudot mipilte in amah lehbawlin a siasak ding uh hi. A galkapte tampi tak si ding ahih manin gal a lel ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua kumpi tegel in sabuai khat tungah tu-in an a nekhawm ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a ngaihsutna uh a hoih zawsang om tuan lo ahih manin a kikhem tuak ding uh hi. A hun tung nai lo ahih manin a deih bang uh a ngahzo kei uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Syria kumpipa, a galvan lakteng tawh a gamah ciahkik ding a, Pasian mite’ biakna suksiatsak ding a lungngai ding hi. A utbang peuhin gamta ding a, tua ciangin a gam lamah a ciahkik ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tua nung ciangin Egypt gam simkik leuleu ding a, ahih hangin a masa-a bangin a piang kei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Rom mite, teembaw tawh hong pai-in amah do ding uh ahih manin a lau ding hi. Tua ciangin amah kilehkik ding a, a thangpaihna tawh Pasian’ mite’ biakna suksiat ding a hanciam ding hi. Amah in tua biakna a nusia mite’ zolsimna a mang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"A galkapte pawlkhat in biakinnpi le biakinnpi huang a ninsak ding uh hi. Amaute in nisim biakpiaknate khawlsak ding uh a, a Lipkhaphuai na a suang ding uh hi.","ref":"Dan 9:27; 12:11; Mat 24:15; Mrk 13:14"},"32":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua biakna a nusia mite a thuzawh theih nadingin zuaugen siamna a zang ding hi. Ahih hangin Pasian’ nung a zui mite ahih uhleh thahatin a gualzo ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Pilna a nei mite in a pilna uh midang tampite tawh a neikhawm ding uh hi. Ahih hangin tawlkhat sung mi pawlkhat in galsung a sihna le meikuang sunga thahna a thuak ding uh hi. Mi pawlkhatte in lawkgawpna le thongkiatna a thuak ding uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua bangin thahna a thuak laitakun, pawlkhat in huhna a ngah ding uh hi. Mi tampi in huhna a piak uh hangin amau’ meetna ding ngaihsutna bek ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in thahna a thuak ding uh hi. Tua bangin a pianna thu pen beina a tun mateng sianthosakna le mipha le misia khentelna, Pasian’ sehsa hun a tunna ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa a ut bangbangin a gamta ding hi. Amah in, pasian-te sangin ka lianzaw a, a Lianpen Pasian sangin zong ka thupizaw lai hi, ci-in a kisathei ding hi. Pasian in amah gim a piak mateng tua bangin a om ding hi.","ref":"2The 2:3-4; Mang 13:5-6"},"37":{"text":"Kumpipa in a pu a pate’ biak pasian le numeite in a it pasian a thusim kei ding hi. Pasian a kici peuhmah khat beek a thusim kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate sangin amah a lianzaw-in a kingaihsun hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua pasian-te sangin kulhpi a dal pasian a thupisim zaw ding hi. Amah in kham, ngun, suangmanpha, le a thupi letsongte, a pu a pate’ biak ngei loh pasian kiangah a pia ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Amah in a kulhpi a ciang dingin pasian dang a biate a sawl ding hi. Amah in amah kumpi-in a sang mite minphatna, zaliatna pia-in, leitang nangawn letsongin a pia ding hi."},"40":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa’ hun a bei dektak ciangin, Egypt kumpipa in amah a sim ding hi. Syria kumpipa in a thaneihteng siit loin tuikhang bangin sakol tawh, sakol galkapte tawh, teembaw tampi tawh Egypt a do ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Amah in Thuciamna Gam zong sim ding a, mi tul tampi tak a that ding hi. Ahih hangin Edom gam, Moab gam, le Ammon gam sungah a omlai sunteng a suakta ding uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Amah in gam tampi tak sim ding a, Egypt nangawn zong a suakta kei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Amah in Egypt gam sunga kiseel ngun le kham le a neihsa uh na manphateng khempeuh a la ding hi. Amah in Libya le Ethiopia gam zong a zo ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciangin, nisuahna lam le saklam panin thupiang in amah patausak ding a, thangpaihna tawh galdo-in mi tampi tak a that ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Amah in a kumpi puanbuk lianpite biakinn dinna mualtung le tuipi kikalah a lam ding hi. Ahih hangin amah a si ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah a huh ding kuamah a om kei hi,” a hong ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin saihadial puan a silh vantungmi in, “Na mite a cing, a lian vantungmi Mikhael hong kilang ding hi. Tua ciangin leitungah mihing a pianzawh a kipan a nasia penpen gimna hun hong tung ding hi. Tua hun a hong tun ciangin Pasian’ laibu sungah a min a kigelh na mite khempeuh kihonkhia ding hi.","title":"Beina Ding Hun","ref":"Mat 24:21; Mrk 13:19; Mang 7:14; 12:7"},"2":{"text":"A sisa mi tampite in nuntakna a ngahkik ding uh hi. Pawlkhatte nungta tawntung ding uh a, pawlkhatte in a tawntung zumna le minsiatna a ngah ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 26:19; Mat 25:46; Joh 5:29"},"3":{"text":"A pilte ahih uhleh vantung khuavak tawh a taangkhawm ding uh hi. A pha-in gamtat ding mi tampi a hilhte pen aksi bangin a taang tawntung ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in Daniel aw, beina hun a tun mateng laibu khupcip inla, a tungah ciaptehna koih in. A kallakah mi tampite in bang thu piang hiam cih theitel nuamin a hanciam ding uh hi,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Mang 22:10"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah Daniel in gun pang tuak a ding mi nih ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua mite khat in puanpak silh a, gungal a gamlazaw deuhin a ding pa kiangah, “Hih na lamdangte a beina ding bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"7":{"text":"Puanpak silhpa in a khut tegel vantung lamah laamto-in, Tawntung Pasian’ min tawh thuciamna a bawl hi. Amah in, “Kum thum le alang hi ding hi. Pasian’ mite a kibawlsiatna a bei ciangin hih thute khempeuh hong piang ding hi,” ci-in a gen ka za hi.","ref":"Mang 10:5; 12:14"},"8":{"text":"A thugen za napi-in teltakin ka thei kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin, “Topa aw, bangci bangin beina hong piang ding ahi hiam,” ci-in ka dong hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in, “Daniel aw, tu-in ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thute pen beina hun a tun mateng selcipin ipcip ding ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampite kisiansuahin a hoih le a hoih lo a kikhentel ding uh hi. Migilote in bangmah theitel thei lo uh ahih manin a gilo semsem ding uh hi. Ahih hangin mipilte in theihtel theihna a nei ding uh hi.","ref":"Mang 22:11"},"11":{"text":"Amaute in nisim biakpiakna a khawlsak, a Lipkhaphuai na a hong pian’ ciangin ni tulkhat zanih sawmkua sung a sawt ding hi.","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; Mat 24:15; Mrk 13:14"},"12":{"text":"Ni tulkhat zathum sawmthum le nga sung muanhuai takin a ngakzo kenkante in thupha a ngah ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Nang Daniel na hih leh a tawp dong muanhuai takin om in. Tua ciangin na si ding a, ahi zongin hun a bei ciangin thaman a sang dingin na hingkik ding hi,” a hong ci hi."}}}}},"28":{"info":{"name":"Hosea","shortname":"Hos","abbr":[],"desc":"Kamsang Hosea in kamsang Amos khit ciangin B.C. 721 kumin Samaria gam a kiat ma, lungkham hun laitakin leilu lam Israel kumpi gamsungah thu a hilh hi. Mite in milim a biakna leh Pasian tungah a thutaklohna uh ama lunghihmawhpi pen ahi hi. A thutaklo numei tawh ama kiten'na lim zangin a minampihte' thutaklohna hangtakin a gen hi. A zi Gomer ama tungah a thutakloh mah bangin Pasian' mite in zong Topa taisan uh hi. Hih thu hangin Israel mite tungah gimna ding thukhenna hong tung ding hi. Ahi zongin a tawpna-ah Pasian in a mite a it tawntungna mah hong gualzo ding a, Israel mite ngahkikin kizomkik ding uh hi. Pasian' itna pen lungsim a sukha mahmah kammalte tawh gen a, “Israel mite aw, bangci-a hong nusia thei ding a, bangci-a hong paidak thei ding ka hi hiam? Ka hong itna lianlua mahmah ahih manin ka hong tuaci bawl thei kei ding hi,” ci-in 11:8 sungtengah a kigelh hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpite Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, le Israel kumpi Joash’ tapa Jeroboam’ hun lai-in Beeri’ tapa Hosea tungah Topa in thu na gen hi.","title":"Hosea’ Zi le A Tate","ref":"2Kum 14:23-15:7; 15:32-16:20; 18:1-20:21; 2Khang 26:1-27:8; 28:1-32:33"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Hosea tungtawnin Israel-te tungah thu a na gen cil lai-in, amah in Hosea kiangah, “Hih gammite kei tungah citak loin pasian dangte bia uh ahih manin, nang zong hong tulpih lo ding numei paktat khat tenpih inla, tua nu tawh ta nei in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Hosea in zong Diblaim’ tanu Gomer tenpih a, tua nu hong gai-in tapa khat hong nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Hosea kiangah, “Na tapa’ min dingin Jezreel phuak in; bang hang hiam cih leh ama pute Jehu in Jezreel khua-ah a mi thahna hangin Israel kumpipa tungah gim ka pia baih ding a, Israel mite tungah Jehu’ suanlekhakte’ ukna ka beisak ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 10:11"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jezreel kuam-ah Israel mite’ galhiam khempeuh ka sumai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Gomer gaikikin tanu khat nei hi. Mawhneite in tua lampi tawn lo ahih manin a puk uh hi.","title":"Thukhupna"}}}}},"29":{"info":{"name":"Joel","shortname":"Joe","abbr":[],"desc":"Kamsang Joel thu tawmno bek kithei a, bang hun lai-a nungta ahi hiam, cih kitello hi. Ahi zongin Persia kumpi a khan' laitak, B.C. zanga leh zalina kikal pawl hunin hih laibu sung thu a piang hi leh kilawm hi. Joel in Palestine gamsung khempeuh kauphe in a simgawpna leh guah zukloh manin khua a keugawpna thu a gen hi. Hih thupiang sung panin Topa in ama thuman a nial mite gim a piakna ding hun Topa' Ni a hong tun'na ding lim a mu hi. Topa in a mite a kisik kikna ding a sapna leh mite a ngei bangsak kikin thupha a piakna ding thu, kamsang Joel in a gensawn hi. Numei leh pasal, a moi leh a ham, a kibangin mi khempeuh tungah Pasian in ama kha a piakna ding thuciamna a ciamtehhuai thu khat ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pethuel’ tapa Joel tungah hih bangin Topa’ thu hong tung hi:","title":"Kauphe in Gam sung a Suksiatna"},"2":{"text":"No khangham zawdiakte aw, ngai un; Judah gammi khempeuh aw, na bil uh ngat un. Note’ khansung ahi a, na pu na pate uh khansung ahi zongin, hih bang thu piang ngei peuhmah ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Hih thute khempeuh na tate uh kiangah gen unla, na tate un amau’ tate’ tungah na gensawn uh hen la, amaute in a khangsawnte tungah na gensawn leuleu uh hen."},"4":{"text":"A pettan kauphete’ nek bangteng, kauphe honte in netum a, kauphe honte’ nek bangteng, a tuan kauphete in netum a, a tuan kauphete’ nek bangteng, a susia kauphete in nemang khin uh hi."},"5":{"text":"No zukhamte aw, tho unla kap un. No leenggahzu nete aw, thumin tau un. Na zunek ding teng uh beimang khinta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kauphe honpi in i gam hong sim a, amaute tam mahmah uh a, hat mahmah uh hi. A ha uh humpinelkai ha bangin hiam a, humpinelkaipi ha bangin gupha mahmah hi.","ref":"Mang 9:8"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in i leengguiteng susiamang khin a, i theikungteng khempeuh netummang khin uh hi. A hawng khempeuh netum uh a, a hiangte kang sengsang hi."},"8":{"text":"Nungak khat, a tenpih ding a lawmpa in a sihsan ciangin a kah bangin note zong kapin thum un."},"9":{"text":"Topa’ biakinn-ah biakna-in piak ding an le leenggahzu om nawn lo a, Topa’ na a sem siampite thumin a tau uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Lo ante kisusia a, leengguite keutum hi. Oliv kungte keugaw a, lolai-ah bangmah om nawn lo ahih manin leitang lungzuangin a thum hi."},"11":{"text":"Lokhote aw, dah un; leenggui ciingte aw, kap un; mangbuh le mangbuhham, lo an khempeuh a beita hi."},"12":{"text":"Leengguite keu a, theikungte vuai ta hi. Mang kawlsingte, nisuhte, epel kungte a kipan singkung khempeuh keumang khin hi. Mihingte a lungdamna dingteng zong a maimang ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Siampite aw, puanhampi silhin kap un; biakna tau-a nasemte aw, thumin tau un. Ka Pasian’ na a semte aw, biakinn sungah tum unla, zanthapai-in dahna lim puanhampi silh un. Note’ Pasian’ biakinn sungah piak ding an le leenggahzu khat zong om nawn lo hi."},"14":{"text":"An tan’ ding thu pia unla, a thupi biak kikhopna bawl un. Note’ Topa Pasian’ biakinn sungah makaite le gammi khempeuh kaikhawm unla, Topa’ tungah kiko-in thum un."},"15":{"text":"Kalai! A hun hong naita! Topa ni hong naita ahih manin gam sung mi khempeuh lau ta uh hen."},"2":{"text":"Tua ni pen a mial, a lungzinhuai, meii kai-in khuazin’ ni ahi ding hi. A vekpi-in tangtakin mai hong nawt uh a, a hong heempai kuamah om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Amau’ lampi san ciat hong tawn uh a, a kiphukha kuamah om lo uh hi. A kiteng cil nungak le tangvalte nangawn in a omna uh nusia-in hong pai uh hen."},"17":{"text":"Topa’ na a sem siampite, biakinn sung innliim le biakna tau kikalah kapin thu ngen uh hen la, “ Topa aw, na mite hong hehpih in. Amaute’ nuihsatin kote hong omsak kei in,” ci uh hen."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in ama leitang hong donin, ama mite hong hehpih hi.","title":"Pasian in Leitang Hoihsak Kik"},"19":{"text":"Topa in ama mite’ thungetna dawng a, “Tu-in note tungah an, leenggahzu le sathau ka hong pia a, na kham takun na ne ding uh hi. Minam dangte’ simmawhin na om nawn kei ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Leilu lam gam panin a hong pai mite, note kiang panin sehnel gamah ka hawlkhia ding a, a madawkte uh nisuahna tuipi sungah khia-in, a nungdalte uh nitumna tuipi sungah ka khia ding a, amaute in note tungah hong bawlna hangin a luanghawmte uh uihgawp ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Lote aw, lau nawn kei unla, lungdam kipakin om un. Gam sung tengah lo nota a, singkungte gahta-in, theigah le leenggah tampi a om hi."},"23":{"text":"“Zion mite aw, kipak unla, Topa na Pasian uh tungah lungdam ta un. Note in an na hauh theih nadingun nidanga bangin khuapi guah, tuk guah le phalbi guah, a hoihbekzah hong zusak hi."},"24":{"text":"Na ancilna phual uh an tawh kidim ding a, na koihna uh umlebeel khempeuh leenggahzu le sathau tawh kidim ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note a hong sim dingin ka hong sawl kauphe honpi, a tuan kauphe, a susia kauphe, a pettan kauphe, hih ka galkap honte in a hong neksak kum sungin a piang ding teng tang kong piakik ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu-in nek ding tampi nei-in na gil uh vah ding a, note a dingin a lamdang nate a hong bawlsak Topa na Pasian uh na phat ding uh hi. Tua ciangin ka mite hong kisimmawh nawn lo ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin no Israel mite lakah kei ka omna thu, keimah Topa pen note’ Pasian ka hihna thu, kei simloh kuamah dang a om lohna na thei ding uh hi. Ka mite hong kisimmawh nawn lo ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh tungah ka kha ka sung ding a, na puteekte un mang manin na tangvalte un maang mu ding uh hi.","title":"Pasian’ Kha A Kisunna"},"29":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin nasem numei le nasem pasalte tung nangawnah ka kha ka sung ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tua ciangin vantung le leitungah hilhkholhna lim ahi, sisan kiluansakna, meikatna le meikhu lompi hong om ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa’ ni, tua a lauhuai hun a hong tun ma-in ni hong mialin, kha, sisan hong bang ding hi.","ref":"Mat 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Mang 6:12-13"},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa’ tungah huhna a ngen khempeuh in hotkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi. Topa in a teel mite, suakta ding uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 2:17-21; Rom 10:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun ciangin Judah le Jerusalem, a nidang hun lai mah uh ka bangsakkik ding hi.","title":"Minam Dangte tungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Minam dang khempeuh kaikhawmin Jehoshafat Kuam-ah ka paipih ding hi. Amaute in Israel mite, gam dangah thehthang uh a, ka gam sung teng phelhawm mangkhin uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A galmatte uh kua in ngah ding, ci-in ai san uh a, zu le numei lei nadingin numeino le naupangnote sila-in a zuak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Taia khua, Sidon khua, le Filistia gam khempeuh aw, kei bang hong cih nuamin a kinei na hi uh hiam? Kei a hong thukkik na hih uhleh, kei zong manlang takin kong thukkik pah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka ngun, ka kham, le ka na manpha tampite la-in, na biakinn sung uhah na puak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem mite, amau’ gam panin gamlapi-ah paipihin, Grik mite tungah na zuak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in amaute na zuakna uh mun panin a lakhia kik ding ka hi a, amaute tungah na bawl bangun note tungah kong bawl ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na tanute uh le na tapate uh Judah mite tungah ka zuak ding a, amaute in a gamlapi-a om Seba minamte tungah zuaksawn ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in gen khinzo hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; 23:1-18; Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-28:26; Amos 1:6-10; Zefa 2:4-7; Zek 9:1-7; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"9":{"text":"“Minam dangte tungah hih bangin thuzaksakna bawl in: Galhang mite sam unla, galdo dingin kithawi un. Galkap khempeuh kaikhawmin hong kuan un!"},"10":{"text":"Lokhawhna tute namsau-in seek unla, singhiang heuhna temkawite teipi-in seek un. A thahat lote nangawn in do uh hen.","ref":"Isa 2:4; Mik 4:3"},"11":{"text":"Kimkotah a om minam dang khempeuh aw, manlangin hong kuan unla, tua kuamah hong kikhawm un. Topa aw, na galhangte hong paipih suk in."},"12":{"text":"“Minam dangte hong kithawi hen la, Jehoshafat Kuam-ah hong kuan suk uh hen. Kimkotah a om minam dang khempeuh’ thu a khen dingin Topa ahi keimah, tua munah ka tu ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute gilo mahmah uh ahih manin anlak huna buhsi bangin at gawp unla, leenggahtui dawhna a dim letin a luang, leenggah cilna kuang sunga om leenggah bangin tuancil gawp un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mang 14:14-16,19-20; 19:15"},"14":{"text":"Thukhenna Kuam-ah a tul a thenin om uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua lai munah Topa’ ni hong tung baih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni le kha mialta a, aksite zong taang nawn lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Zion Mual panin Topa hong hawksuk a, Jerusalem panin hong awngkek a, vanpi le leipi a ling damdam hi. Ahi zongin Topa pen ama mite’ belh pa hi a, Israel mite a hu ding hi.","title":"Judah A Kihotkhiatna","ref":"Amos 1:2"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Israel-te aw, ka mual siangtho Zion tungah a teng keimah pen Topa note’ Pasian ka hihna na hong thei ding uh hi. Jerusalem pen a siangtho biakna khuapi hi ding a, gamdang mite in zokik nawn lo ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin mualtung khempeuh leenggui lo hi ding a, mual neute khempeuh tungah bawnghon dim ding a, Judah gam sung khempeuhah tui tampi om ding hi. Topa’ biakinn panin luitui khat hong luangkhia ding a, Shitthim kuamsung khempeuh a kawtsak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Amaute in Judah gam simin, mawhnei lo mite that uh ahih manin, Egypt gam, sehnel gam suakin, Edom gam, gam sia suak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A kithat mite’ phu keimah in ka la ding a, a mawhte ka khahkhong kei ding hi. Judah gamah mi teng tawntung ta ding a, Jerusalem-ah a khangkhangin mi om tawntung ding a, Zion Mual-ah Topa a teng ding hi.” a ci hi.","merge":"21"}}}}},"30":{"info":{"name":"Amos","shortname":"Amo","abbr":[],"desc":"Amos pen Lai Siangtho sungah a thugen a kitam ciamteh masa pen kamsangpa ahi hi. Amah pen Judah gam khuapi khat sunga a piang hinapi-in B.C. zagiatna kimtan pawlin leilu lam Israel kumpi gamsungah thu a hilh hi. Tua hun pen mi a cihtheih mahmah laitak, biakna thu a kihahkat mahmah laitak, leh lungmuang hithiat-a mi a om laitak ahi hi. Ahi zongin tua cihtheihna pen mi tawmno khat bek in ngah a, thuman lopi-in mi zawngte' neihsa suhna tawh a kihau ahihna thu Amos in a mu hi. Biakna thu zuihna pen lungsim takpi tawh hilo a, lungmuan'na zong a taktak hiphalo hi. Pasian in gimna pia ding hi, ci-in lunggimna leh lungsim han'na tawh thu a hilh hi. Thuman thutang luitui luang bangin a luan' zuahzuah ding deih a, tua bang hi leh, “Topa in hih minam a nungta sunte hong hehpih thei kha ding hi,” ci-in 5:l5 sungah a gen hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tekoa khua-a a teng tuucingte lakah Amos a kici mi khat om hi. Uzziah pen Judah kumpi hi-in Joash’ tapa Jeroboam in Israel kumpi a sep laitak, zinlin’ ma kum nih hun laitakin Pasian in Amos tungah hih thute kilangsak hi.","title":"Israel-te’ Kiima Om Minam Dangte tungah Thukhenna","ref":"2Kum 15:1-7; 2Khang 26:1-23; 2Kum 14:23-29"},"2":{"text":"Amos in, “Zion Mual panin Topa hong hawksuk a, Jerusalem khua panin hong awngkek hi. Tua ahih manin lonona gamteng keugawp a, Karmel mualdawn dum dide teng kausan ta hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joel 3:16"},"3":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Damaskas khuamite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in an gawina suang tawh gawizan bangin, Gilead gammite gawigawp uh hi.","title":"Syria Mite"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Hazael innkuante mei tawh ka hal ding a, a meikuang in Kumpi Benhadad’ munmuanhuaite kangtum ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Damaskas khuakulhpi zawlte ka sutan ding a, Aven Kuama teng mi khempeuh le Betheden Kuam sungah a om gam ukte khempeuh keimah in ka susia ding a, Syria mite ahihleh Kir gamah salin kipaipih ding hi.","ref":"Isa 17:1-3; Jer 49:23-27; Zek 9:1"},"6":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Gaza khuamite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in minambup khat sal dingin manin, Edom mite tungah ap uh hi.","title":"Filistia Mite"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Gaza khuapikulh ka kangsak ding a, a munmuanhuai teng a kangtummang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ashdod khuapi-ah a teng mite ka lakhia ding a, Ashkelon khuapi ukte ka beisak ding hi. Ekron khuapi ka sugawp ding a, Filistia mi a omlaite si ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Ezk 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Zefa 2:4-7; Zek 9:5-7"},"9":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Taia khuamite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in minambup khat Edom mite tungah ap uh a, lawmta dinga a thuciamna uh zui lo uh hi.","title":"Taia Mite"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Taia khuapikulh ka kangtumsak ding a, a munmuanhuai teng kangtummang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 23:1-18; Ezk 26:1-28:19; Joel 3:4-8; Zek 9:1-4; Mat 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14"},"11":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Edom mite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a sanggam uh Israel-te namsau tawh delh uh a, hehpihna lungsim nei lo uh hi. A hehna uh damsak ngei lo uh a, a tawntungin heh niloh uh hi.","title":"Edom Mite"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Teman gam sung khempeuh ka kangtumsak ding a, Bozrah khuapi munmuanhuai teng kangtum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"13":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Ammon mite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in huaihamin gam a deihthuah manun Gilead gam simgawp uh hi.","title":"Ammon Mite"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Rabbah khuapikulh ka haltum ding a, a munmuanhuai teng khempeuh kangtum ding hi. Galdo a kikona aw ging ding a, tua kidona awging khuapi huihnung bang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A kumpipa uhleh a uliante uh salin kiman ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Moab mite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leiseek cianna-ah a kizang leikang a zat dingin Edom kumpipa’ guhte a hal uh hi.","title":"Moab Mite"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Moab gam sung khempeuh ka kangtumsak ding a, Kerioth khuapi munmuanhuai teng a kangtum ding hi. Galkapte’ otna le peengkul kitumna lak, galkidona gamlum sungah Moab mite si ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuate lakah Moab gam ukte ka sisak ding a, a uliante ka that ding hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1-16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Ezk 25:8-11; Zefa 2:8-11"},"4":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Judah mite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thukhamte nialin ka thuhilhnate zui lo uh hi. A pu a pate un a na biaksa pasian man lote mah in amaute lam pialsak uh hi.","title":"Judah Mite"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Judah gam sung teng ka kangtumsak ding a, Jerusalem munmuanhuai teng a kangtum ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Israel mite thumvei a khialh khit, a liveina hangin pel loin amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in leiba a loh zawh loh man bekun midik kimlai zuak uh a, khedap bu khat man a loh zawh loh man bekun mi cimawhte sila-in a zuak uh hi.","title":"Israel-te tungah Thukhenna"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in mizawngte’ lutang leivui lakah tuancil uh a, keima min siangtho a ninsak dingin biakinn-a numei paktatte kiangah tangvalte le papite a pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Biakna tau gei khempeuhah amaute lum uh a, sum leitawina hangin a puan kepsakte uh a phah uh hi. Amaute in a Pasian uh’ biakinn sungah leibate kiang pan a laksak uh leenggahzu a dawn uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute ka khualna hangin taamtak sing bangin a sang mahmah, tawsaw kung bangin a khauhtuak mahmah Amor mite amau a dingin ka suksiatsak a, a dawn pan a kipan a zung dongin ka sukmaisak hi.","ref":"Thkna 3:8-11"},"10":{"text":"No ka mihingte, Egypt gam pek panin hong paikhiatpihin, gamlakah kum sawmli sung kong makaih a, note a dingin Amor mite’ gam kong pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tapate uh pawlkhat kamsang dingin ka teel a, na tangvalte uh pawlkhat Nazir mi dingin ka teel hi. Israel aw, tu-a ka gen bangmah hi lo ahi hiam, Topa in kong ci khin hi.","ref":"Gam 6:1-8"},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin note in Nazir mite leenggahzu na dawnsak uh a, kamsangte in ka thu a gen lohna dingun thu na pia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in buhlomte in a pua bawngleeng a netcipsuk bangin note na omna mun uhah kong nengcipsuk ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A tai hatte nangawn suakta zo lo ding a, a thahatte a hatna bei ding a, galhangte in amau’ nuntakna hu zo lo ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Thaltawite nangawn in do zo lo ding a, a tai hatte nangawn kisuahtak zo lo ding a, sakol tung tuangte nangawn in a nuntakna suahtak zo lo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin galhang pente nangawn taimang ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite aw, note’ langkhat a Topa’ thugen, hih thu limtakin ngai un: Egypt gam panin na minam bupun note kong paikhiatpih hi.","title":"Kamsangpa’ Nasep"},"2":{"text":"Leitung minam khempeuh lakah note bek hong thei-in, note bek ka hong don hi. Tua ahih manin na khialhna khempeuh uh hangin note gim ka hong pia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi nih, thukimna om masa lopi-in lampi-ah tonkhawm thei uh ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"A samat ding mu lopi-in, gamlakah humpinelkai mawk hawk ahi hiam? Samat nei lopi-in, a kua sungah humpinelkai khanglai mawk hawk ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Thang antah om lopi-in leilaka thangah vasa mawk awk ahi hiam? A su khat om lopi-in, thang kimawksai ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Khuapi sungah pataukohna gal peengkul a kitum ciangin mite lau loin ommawk thei ahi hiam? Topa’ tunsak lohpi-in khuapi sungah lauhuaina mawk tun ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Topa Pasian in ama nasem kamsangte tungah ama geelna theisak masa lopi-in bangmah hih het lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Humpinelkai a hawk ciangin lau loin ki-om thei ahi hiam? Topa Pasian in thu a gen ciangin kua in ama thu gen loin om thei ding ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Samaria gam munmuanhuai-ah a om mite le Egypt gam munmuanhuai-ah a om mite tungah thu zasak unla, “Samaria-ah hong kikhawm unla, tua lai-a buaina lianpite le kinenniamnate hong mu un,” ci un.","title":"Samaria A Siatna"},"10":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih mite in a manin gamtat ding thei lo uh a, gilo mahmah uh a, mi’ na a suh uh vante tawh a inn lianpipite uh kidimsak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin galte in a gam uh umcihin, a panmun muanhuai teng uh susiagawp ding a, a inn lianpipite uh luhgawp ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Humpinelkai’ nek baang tuu khebom nih ahi a, a bil themkhat bek ahi zongin tuucingpa in a ngah tei mah bangin, tutphah nip kiu khat le lupna themkhat tawh a kibang, Samaria sungah a om Israel mi tawmno khat suakta tei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in ngai un: Jakob’ suanlekhakte hilhkhol un, Vanglian Pasian ahi, Topa Pasian in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amau’ khialhna hangin Israel gim ka piak ni ciangin, Bethel-a biakna taute zong ka susia ding a, biakna tau kite kitanin leilakah kia ding hi.","ref":"2Kum 23:15"},"15":{"text":"Keimah in phalbi le khuakhal innte ka susia ding a, saiha tawh a kibawl inn hoihte zong kisia-in, inn lian khempeuh beimang ding hi, Topa in ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bashan gam bawngpi bangin a thau mahmah, mizawngte nengniamin mi cimawhte a sugawp, na pasalte uh kiangah, “Ka dawn ding bang khatpeuh hong puak in,” ci-in a vaikhak no Samaria numeite aw, hih thu limtakin ngai un:"},"2":{"text":"Topa Pasian a siangtho ahih mah bangin, amah in kamciamna khat bawlkhin a, “Amaute in sikkawi tawh note hong kaihkhiat hun ding, ni khat ni ciangin hong tung taktak ding a, note khempeuh sikkawi-ah a awk ngasa na bang ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Na omna uh tawh a kinai pen kulhvang tawnin, ganhing sisa kaihkhiat bangin hong kikaikhia ding a, ninlom lakah hong kilawnkhia ding hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel mite aw, Bethel-a mun siangtho-ah va pai unla, tua lai-ah khialhna va bawl un. Gilgal-ah va pai unla, va khial semsem un. Zingsang simin biakna va pia unla, ni thum simin sawm-ah-khat pia un.","title":"Pasian’ Gimpiakna tawh Israel-te Hoih Tuan lo"},"5":{"text":"Lungdam kohna-in silngo sawh anlum va pia unla, utthu-a biakpiaknate va pia-in va kisial un. Hihte pawl pen note’ hihnop pawl ahi hi, Topa in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Na khuapi khempeuh uhah kial tungsakin, annek ding nei loin note a hong koihpa pen keimah hinapi-in, keima lamah nong kihei tuan kei uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin anlak hun ding kha thum bek in a sap laitak, lolai-a om ante in guahtui a sap mahmah laitakin guah ka zusak kei a, khuapi khat bekah zusakin a dangte-ah ka zusak kei hi. Lo khat bekah guah zu a, a zuk lohna lote a keutum hi."},"8":{"text":"Dangtak manin thaneemin khuapi nih khuapi thum mite tui zong dingin a khuavengte kiangah pai uh a, ahi zongin tuidawn tawm ding nangawn a kicing om lo hi. Tua hinapi-in kei kiangah nong kihei tuan kei uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Na ankungte uh lung nesakin ka vulsak a, na ankungte uh cinasakin a kang dikdekin ka bawl hi. Na huante uh le na leenggui lote uh a hawmguakin ka koih hi. Na theikungte uh le na oliv kungte uh kauphe in gai khin hi. Tua bang hinapi-in kei lamah nong kihei kei uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt gamah ka hong tunsak bangin note lakah gimna kong tungsak hi. Gal sungah na tangvalteng uh ka sisak a, na sakolte uh kong paihkhiatsak hi. Na giahphual sungte uh a uih mahmahna tawh na nakngek uh kong zensak hi. Tua bang hinapi-in kei lamah nong kihei kei uh hi, Topa in ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah khuapite ka suksiat bangin note pawlkhat kong susia hi. Meikhuk panin a kiteenkhia singkhuah khat tawh na kibang uh hi. Tua bang hinapi-in kei lamah nong kihei kei uh hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite aw, hih bangin note tungah kong bawl ding hi. Hih bangin hong hih ding ka hih manin Pasian’ thukhenna a thuak dingin kiging un."},"13":{"text":"Bang hiam cih leh mualte bawlin huihte a piangsak pa, ama ngaihsutna mihingte tungah kilang sakin, sun nitaang kimlai zanin a bawlpa, leitung khempeuh a ukpa’ min, Topa, Vanglian Pasian ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite aw, kap kawmin kong thugenna, limtakin ngai un:","title":"Kisik ding Sawlna"},"2":{"text":"Nungak Israel puk khin a, thokik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Leilakah lum dildel a, a phongto ding kuamah om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Israel khuapi khat in galkap tulkhat kuankhiasak a, ahi zongin zakhat bek hong ciahkik hi. Khuapi dang khat in galkap zakhat kuankhiasak a, ahi zongin sawmkhat bek hong ciahkik hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Topa in Israel mite tungah hih bangin ci hi: Kei hong zong un; tua hileh na nungta ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A bia dingin Beersheba-ah pai kei un. Bethel-ah kei hong zong kei un; a mawkna suak ding hi. Gilgal-ah zong lut kei un; Gilgal mite, sal a suak ding hi lel hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa zong un; tua hileh na nungta ding uh hi. Amah na zon kei uhleh Josef mite tungah meikuang bangin amah hong kuang ding a, tua mei in Bethel-a om mite kangtumin, tua mei a phelh ding kuamah om lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Thutang lumletin thuman mite lei a denna, note a dingin bangzahin nasia ding ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Vana om aksi Seguk le Zawlzawngte bawlin, khuamial pen khuavak suaksak a, sun pen zan suaksakin, tuipi panin tuite samkhia a, leitungah tua tui a buakhia pa a min pen Topa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 9:9; 38:31"},"9":{"text":"Amah in kulh muanhuaite le munmuanhuaite thakhatin susia thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in thukhen zumah thutang a deih pa na mudah uh a, thuman a gen pa na hua uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Note in mizawngte tuancilin, a an neihteng khempeuh uh laksak na hih manun, suangseek inn na lam hangun tua suang inn sungah na tengkha kei ding uh a, leenggui lo hoih na neih hangun a leenggahzu na dawnkha kei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na khialhna tampite uh le na mawhna tampite uh a vekin ka thei khin hi. Thuman mite gimsakin, sumgolh na la uh a, thukhenna zumah mizawngte’ thu a manin na khen kei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih bang hunsiat hun laitakin thu ngaihsun thei mite, pau loin a om khikhe, lamdang sak ding hi lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Note na nuntak theih nadingun siatna gamta loin, thumanin gamtat ding hanciam un. Tua hileh na gensa uh mah bangin Topa, Vanglian Pasian in note hong ompih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Thusia mudahin thupha deih unla, thukhen zumah a manin thu khen un. Tua hileh Josef minam a suakta sunte tungah Topa, Vanglian Pasian hong thunuam khathei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa, Vanglian Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Mihon omna lamkabom khempeuhah mite in na sa-in thumin tau ding uh a, kongzing khempeuhah kap ding uh hi. Khuaneu a mite a thum dingin kisam ding a, a kah siam mite a kap dingin kicial ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Note gim a pia dingin hong pai ding ka hih manin leenggui lo khempeuhah kahna aw ging ding hi, Topa in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa’ ni hong tun ding a ngaklah note a dingin bangzah takin lauhuai ding ahi hiam? Note a dingin tua ni a hoihna hong om ding ahi hiam? Tua ni pen lungzin’ ni hi a, lungtaii ni hi lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Humpinelkai kihta-in vompi a tuakpa tawh kibang ding hi. Tua ahih kei leh mi khat a inn-ah hong tai a, a kawmah a khut a ngak ciangin gul in a tuk tawh kibang ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa’ ni pen khuavak ni hi loin khuamial ni hi a, maitaina a om lo lungzin’ ni ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Na biakna pawite uh mudahin ka deih kei a, na biak kikhopnate uhah ka lung a kim kei hi."},"22":{"text":"Meihal biakna le an tawh biakna nong paipih uh hangin tuate kong sang kei ding hi. Thunuama biakpiak nadingin na hong paipih uh a thau mahmah ganhingte zong et-in ka nei vet kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:11-14"},"23":{"text":"La sa-in na gamlumnate uh khawl un; na lasakna uh a gingte ka za nuam kei hi."},"24":{"text":"Thutang, tui bangin luangkhiasak unla, thuman, a kang ngei lo tui bangin luangsak un."},"25":{"text":"Israel mite aw, gamlakah kum sawmli na om sungun gan go-a biakna le keima tungah piakna bangmah nong bawl kei uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hinapi tu-in note a dingin na bawltawm uh aksi pasian-te ahi Sakkuth le Kaivuan milimte na biak manun"},"27":{"text":"Damaskas khengin gamdang khatah sal dingin note kong paisak ding hi, Vanglian Pasian min a nei Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:42-43"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel minamte in muanin a hong neih, i minam lakah ulian ahi, Zion-ah nuamtakin a om hithiat, Samaria-ah lungmuang takin a om note a dingin zumhuai mahmah hi.","title":"Israel A Kisuksiatna"},"2":{"text":"Kalneh khua-ah pai unla limtakin va en un. Tua ciangin Hamath khuapi lian ah va paisuak unla, Filistia-te’ khuapi Gath khua dong va paisuk un. Judah le Israel kumpi gamte sangin hoihzaw tuan a, amaute’ gam pen note’ gam sangin lianzaw tuan ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Note’ tungah siatna hong tun ni ding, a kipelh theih nading na hanciam uh a, ahi zongin tua bang na hihnate un, siatna khangsak semsem zawsop hi."},"4":{"text":"Saiha kibawl lupna tungah a lum hithiat, tutphah nip tungah a kizia hiathiat, tuuno sa le bawngno sa, duhduhin a ne note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"David bangin la phuah nuam na sa uh a, lasaknate na tum nuam uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Leenggahzu hai lianpipi-in na dawn uh a, sathau hoihpente tawh na kizut uh hi. Ahi zongin Josef minamte’ siatna hangin themkhat zong na dah het kei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note pen salin a pai masa pente na hi ding uh a, na nopsakna teng uh a beita ding ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasian thupi takin kiciam khin a, Topa, Vanglian Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Israel-te’ kiphatsakna ka hua a, a munmuanhuaite uh ka mu nuam kei hi. Tua ahih manin a khuapi le a sunga a omteng, galte’ khut sungah ka pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Inn khat sungah mi sawm bek nangawn a suakta a om laina a om leh, tuate khempeuh zong a si khin veve ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh a sihna inn panin a vui dingin a si puakhia-in, a behte khatpeuh hong pai ciangin, innsung tawngah a bu mi khatpeuh kiangah, “Hih lai-ah a si dang a om hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Om lo hi; pau kei in. Topa’ min na lawhkhak ding kidawm in,” ci-in kidawngkik ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in thu a piak ciangin inn liante kisatzanin inn neute kisatnen ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Sakolte, suangkeen tungah tai thei ngei a, bawngtalte tawh tuipi tung kikho thei ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in note in thutang, gu na suaksak uh a, thuman, a khial na suaksak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Lodebar khua bang lel na lakzawhna uhah na lungdam uh a, “Eima thahatna tawh Karnaim khua i lazo hi,” na ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa, Vanglian Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: No Israel mite a do dingin minam khat ka khangsak ding a, leilu lamah, Hamath khua lutna ciangka panin, leitaw lamah Arabah lui kikal dong, note hong nuaigawp ding uh hi, a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa Pasian in hih bangin hong musak hi: Kumpipa’ gan an ding lopa a ki-at khit phet, selkik dingin a kisak laitakin Topa in kauphe honpi a piangsak hi.","title":"Suksiat ding Muhkholhna Thumte: Kauphe, Meikuang, le Khaukhai"},"2":{"text":"Kauphe in gam sung lopate a gaih khit ciangin, keimah in Topa tungah ka thum a, “Topa Pasian aw, na mihingte’ mawhna maisak in. Amaute minam tawm hi a, zawngkhal uh ahih manin bangci-in thuakzo ding ahi uh hiam?” ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in zong a lungsim hong kheelkik a, “Tua na muh bangin hong piang nawn lo ding hi,” hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in hih bangin hong musak leuleu hi: Meikuang tawh a mite gim a pia dingin amah hong kithawi a, tuipite keutum sakin leitung zong a haltum dingin a hong kipan hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian kiangah ka thum a, “ Topa aw, khawl dih in. Na mite, minam tawm hi a, zawngkhal mahmah uh ahih manin bangci-in thuakzo ding uh ahi hiam?” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in zong a lungsim hong kheelkik a, “Na muh bangin hih zong hong piang nawn lo ding hi,” Topa Pasian in hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in hih bangin hong musak hi: Khaukhai zangin a kiciang kulh gei khatah, Topa a ding ka mu a, a khut sungah khaukhai khat a tawi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, “Amos aw, bang na mu hiam?” hong ci hi. Kei zong dawngin, “Khaukhai khat mu ing,” ka ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, “En in, ka mi Israel-te a khialhna uh a kitheih nadingin hih khaukhai tawh ka en hi. Amaute gim ka piak ding ka khiakik nawn kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Isaac’ suanlekhakte’ biakna munte kinusiacipin, Israel mite’ siangtho munte kisusia ding a, Kumpi Jeroboam’ innkuante a simgawp dingin gal ka kuansak ding hi,” a hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Bethel-ah a om siampi nasem Amaziah in Israel Kumpi Jeroboam kiangah thu puak a, “Amos in Israel mite lakah nang hong sawm hi. Ama thugen in i gam sung siasak ding hi.","title":"Amos le Amaziah"},"11":{"text":"Amah in hih bangin thu gen a, ‘Gal sungah Jeroboam si ding a, Israel mite amau’ gam panin salin kipaikhiatpih ding hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a khia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Amaziah in Amos kiangah, “Kamsang kineih pa aw, na Judah gamah ciah inla, tua lai-ah na nuntakna ding na semin, thu va gen in."},"13":{"text":"Hih lai pen kumpipa’ biakinn mun, minam bup biakinn mun ahih manin Bethel-ah thu hong gen nawn kei in,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amos in Amaziah dawng a, “Kei pen kamsang ka hi kei a, kamsangte’ ta zong ka hi beek kei hi. Kei pen tuucing ka hi a, theithek huan puah tawh a thuahkhawm ka hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka tuucinna panin Topa in kei hong samkhia a, ama mi Israel-te tungah thugen dingin a hong sawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in Topa’ thugen ngai in. Israel mite’ langkhatah thu ka gen ding na hong kho a, Isaac’ suanlekhakte’ langkhatah thu ka gen ding na hong kham hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaziah aw, tua bangin kampau na hih manin Topa in nang kiangah, ‘Na zi pen khua sungah numei paktat suak ding a, gal sungah na tate si ding uh hi. Na gam kiphelkhamin midang tungah kipia ding a, lawkite’ gam sungah nang na si ding hi. Israel mite, galmatin kipaipih ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin hong musak hi: Seeng sunga kikoih singgah min ka mu hi.","title":"Muhkholhna Lina: Singgah Minsa Seeng Khat"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Amos aw, bang na mu hiam?” hong ci hi. “Seeng sunga kikoih singgah min ka mu hi,” ci-in kei zong ka dawng hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, “Ka mi Israel-te a dingin a bei hun uh tungta hi. Amaute gim ka piak ding ka khawl nawn kei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin kumpi inn-ah lungdam lasakna awgingte, kahna awging suak ding hi. Mun khempeuhah misi dim ding a, mun citengah kipaithangin gamdai ding hi,” Topa in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi cimawhte tuancil gawpin, gam sung mizawngte a susiagawp mite aw, hih thu ngai un:","title":"Israel-te’ Siat Hun Ding Nai"},"5":{"text":"Note in na lungsim sung uhah, “I ante i zuak theih nadingin zumkhak hun bei ding i ngaklah hi. I mangbuhte i zuaktheih nadingin cik ciangin Sabbath ni bei ding ahi hiam? I antehna seu neuseekin sum tampi i ngen nuam a, tawikhaina man lo zangin a hong leite i khem nuam hi."},"6":{"text":"Khedap bu khat man dingin mizawngte sila-in i zuak nuam a, i mangbuh hoih lote sum tampi i khawng nuam hi,” na ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa, Israel Pasian kiciam a, “Na gamtatsiatnate uh ka mangngilh ngei kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin zin hong ling ding a, leitung a om mi khempeuh a kap ding uh hi. Nail Gunpi bangin leitung khempeuh khangto-in kiamsuk ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin sunkim laipi mahin ni ka tumsak ding a, sunkim laipi mahin leitung khempeuhah khua ka mialsak ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu kong gen khin hi."},"10":{"text":"Na lungdam pawite uh dahna ka suaksak ding a, na lasaknate uh kahna awging ka suaksak ding hi. Dahna limin puanhampi na silh ding uh a, na sam uh zong na mettol ding uh hi. A tapa khat neihsun a sihsuah nupa na bang ding uh hi. Tua hun pen a tawp dongin nasia semsem ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Keimah in leitungah kialpi kong tunsak hun hong tung ding hi. Tua kialpi pen anletui duhna kialpi hi lo ding a, Topa’ thu zaknop mahmahna kialpi hi ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu kong gen khin hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte, leilu pan leitaw dong, Topa’ thu kanin vak kawikawi ding uh a, ahi zongin mu zo lo ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin nungakte le tangvalte dangtakin puk ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Samaria milim pasian Ashimah min tawh kiciam a, ‘Dan khuapi pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin,’ le ‘Beersheba khuapi pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin,’ a ci mite pukin thokik nawn lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakna tau gei-ah Topa a ding ka mu a, hih bangin thu hong pia hi: “Biakinn bulpi khempeuh a kilin’ theih nadingin biakinn khuampiluzang nakpitakin satgawp in. Tuate satkham inla, mite’ luzang tusak in. Tua lai panin a suakta teng gal sungah ka sisak ding hi. A taikhia, a suakta, kuamah om lo ding hi.","title":"Thukhenna Kipelh Thei lo"},"2":{"text":"Lei tosukin misite’ omna Leinuai-ah a va tun uh hangin tua lai-ah amaute ka su ding a, vantungah a kahtoh uh hangin zong, tua lai mahah amaute ka su veve ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Karmel mual dawnah a buk uh hangin, amaute zongin ka mankhia ding a, keima kiang panin tuipi tawng sungah bu ta le-uh zong, tuipi gulpite in a tukna ding thu ka pia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Galte in a sal dingin hingmat ta le-uh zong, namsau tawh a thah nadingun thu ka pia ding hi. Amaute’ hoihna ding ngaihsun hetloin, amaute suksiat ding ka sawm hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Vanglian Topa Pasian in leitung a lawn’ ciangin tuisuak a, leitung a om mi khempeuh a kap uh hi. Nail Gunpi bangin leitung buppi khangto-in kiamsuk ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in vantungah a inndeite bawl a, van kuumpi tawh leitung a khuhsuk hi. Amah in tuipi panin tuite samkhia a, leitung khempeuhah tua tuite a sung hi. Hih bangin a bawlpa’ min pen Topa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Israel mite aw, Ethiopia mite tawh a kibangin note ka hong bawl a, Egypt gam panin note kong paikhiatpih bangin, Kaftor gam panin Filistia mite ka paikhiatpih a, Kir gam panin Syria mite ka paikhiatpih hi."},"8":{"text":"Keimah in hih a khial Israel kumpi gam ka encik a, hih leitung panin amaute ka susia ding hi. Ahi zongin a vekpi-un susiamang loin pawlkhat ka sitlai ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Keimah in thu ka pia ding a, anhaihna ciang tawh an a kihaih mah bangin keimah in Israel mite ka lok niloh ding hi. A hoih lo teng a kipaihkhiat theih nadingin minam dangte lakah ka haih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima mite’ sung panin, “I tungah siatna hong tung ngei lo ding hi,” a ci mawhneite khempeuh, gal sungah si ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin inn tawh kibangin a siasa David ukna gam keimah in ka puahkik ding a, a vang teng hu-in, a sia teng ka puahkik ding a, a nidanga a ngeina lui mah uh ka bangsakkik ding hi.","title":"Israel-te A Ngei uh Bangkik Ding"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mite in Edom gam a omlaiteng le keima mi ahi ngei minam khempeuh zo-in ngahkik ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 15:16-18"},"13":{"text":"Topa in hih bangin ci hi: An a kihauh luat manin, anlak a kizawh ma-in lo khawhkik hun tungin, leenggahte, leenggahzu a bawl a kizawh ma-in a suankik hun hong tun ding, hun nuam hong tungta ding hi. Mual lian khempeuh panin leenggahzu khum hong taakkhia-in, mual neu khempeuh tungah leenggahzu a luang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mi Israel-te, amau’ gam ka tunkik ding a, a kisia a khuapite uh hoihtakin lampha kikin a sungah a teng ding uh hi. Amaute in leenggui suanin, huan bawlin, a sunga piangte a ne ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute a dingin ka piak gam sungah amaute ka koihkik ding a, tua ka piaksa gam panin kuamah in amaute lakhia kik nawn lo ding hi, Topa, note’ Pasian in ci hi, a ci hi."}}}}},"31":{"info":{"name":"Obadiah","shortname":"Oba","abbr":[],"desc":"Hih laibu pen B.C. 586 kumin Jerusalem a puk khit, a hun teekteek a kitheilo hun khat-a thupiang ahi hi. Hih hun laitakin leitaw nisuahna lam gamah a om, Judah mite' gal ahi tawntung Edom mite pen Jerusalem a puk ciangin a lungdam bek hiloin, tua bangin amaute' cihmawhna nuamtak sa-in a khuasung luhgawpin, tua khuapi a simte zong a huh uh hi. Tua ahih manin Israel minamte' gal minam dangte tawh Edom in zong gimna ngahin guallel khawm ding hi, ci-in a gen hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Obadiah’ genkholhna: Edom gam tawh kisai-in Topa Pasian in hih bangin gen hi: Minamte lakah kamtai khat kisawlzo a, “Kithawi un! Edom mite a simgawp dingin kuankhia ni,” a cihna thu ka zazo hi.","title":"Edom Mite’ Guallelhna"},"2":{"text":"En un, minamte lakah note kong neusak ding a, nakpitakin hong kisimmawh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lungsim kiphatsakna un note a hong khemzo hi. Note in suang kulhpi beelin mual dawnah na ten manun, “Kua in eite hong puksakzo ding ahi hiam?” ci-in na ngaihsun uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin sangpi-ah leengin, aksite lakah bu na bawl hangun no kong khiasuk veve ding hi, Topa in a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Zanin na kiangah gutate le misuamte hong pai-in supna tampi na thuak hangin a deihteng bek uh hong guksak ding hi lo ahi hiam? Leenggah late in lolai-ah a sangte nusia laitei hi lo ahi uh hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Ahih hangin Esau kibuluh khinzo a, a sum a pai khempeuh a kilaksak zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na pawl teng in nang hong khemzo uh a, gamgi ciang dong hong hawlkhiazo uh a, na pawl teng in a hong zo khinta uh hi. Na ankuang umpihte in na nuai-ah thang hong siah khin uh a, “A pilna koi-ah om ahi hiam?” a hong ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in: “Tua ni ciangin Edom sung pan a mipilte ka susia ding a, Esau’ gamah pilna ka beisak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Teman khua aw, Esau’ gamah mi khempeuh a kithahlup khit nadingin na galhangte a meidawi ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggampa Jakob bawlsia-in na thahna hangin maizumna in nang hong khuh ding a, na khantawnin na mangthang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Namdangte in a neihsateng a puakkhiat ni-in gamdang mite a kongpi sungah a lut ni-in, Jerusalem-a vante hawmna ding ai a san ni-in, nangmah in gal et bek na hih manin nang zong a thukimpih na hi hi."},"12":{"text":"Na sanggamte uh a tuahsiat ni-in mu nuam dah hoh un. Judah mite a kisiat ni-in lungdamin nuam kei un. A kisiat ni-in lungdam kei un. A cihmawh ni-in nuihsan kei un."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite in haksatna a tuah ni-in a kongpi sungah tum kei un. A tuahsiat ni-in a thuaknate uh mu nuam kei un. A tuahsiat ni-in a sum a paite uh laksak kei un."},"14":{"text":"A suakta sunte a khaktan dingin na ding kei ding uh hi. A cihmawh ni-in a hinglai sunteng, a galte’ khut sungah na pia kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezk 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Mal 1:2-5"},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh minam kimte tungah ka thukhenna ding ni a naizo hi. Jakob innkuante in amau’ gam mah luahkik ding uh hi.","title":"Israel Mite’ Gualzawhna"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jakob innkuante mei bang ding uh a, Josef innkuante meikuang bang ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a genzo hi."},"19":{"text":"Negeb gammite in Esau’ gam luah ding uh a, Shefelah mite in Filistia gam luah ding uh hi. Amaute in Efraim gam le Samaria gam luah ding uh a, Benjamin in Gilead gam luah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel mi salin a omte in Kanaan gam Zarefat ciang dong luah ding uh a, Jerusalem mi, Sardis khua-ah salin a omte in Negeb gam khuapite a la ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A gualzo Jerusalem khuamite in Esau’ gam simin uk ding uh a, tua gam pen Topa’ gam ahi ding hi."}}}}},"32":{"info":{"name":"Jonah","shortname":"Jon","abbr":[],"desc":"Jonah Laibu pen Lai Siangtho sungah a om kamsang laibu dangte tawh kibanglo a, Pasian' thupiakna a mang nuamlo kamsangpa' gamtatna teng a kigenna ahi hi. Israel-te' gal kihtakhuai bel ahi Assiria gam kumpi khua Nineveh khuapi-ah a pai dingin Pasian in a sawl hi. Ahi zongin Jonah in ama ngaihsutna-ah Pasian in a tawn'na tawh kizui-in tua khuapi susialo ding hi, ci-in um ahih manin Pasian' thu a gen dingin tua khuapi-ah pai nuamlo hi. Ama pumpi tungah thu lamdang tuamtuam a pian' khit ciangin utlopipi-in va pai sam a, a siatna ding thu a genna a tun' loh ciangin a tawpna-ah a maikhing hi. Ama pian'saksa na khempeuh tungah Pasian a lianpen ahihna thu hih laibu sungah kigen hi. A thu kigen khempeuh sung panin a thupi pen-ah, Pasian pen itna leh hehpihna a nei Pasian hi a, a galte nangawn gim pia-in a suksiat sangin a mawhna uh maisakin a honkhiapa ahihna thu a kilangsak hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Amittai’ tapa Jonah tungah,","title":"Kiang Pan Jonah Taikhia","ref":"2Kum 14:25"},"2":{"text":"“Kithawi inla, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi-ah va pai-in thu va hilh in; bang hang hiam cih leh amau’ gitlohna thu ka za khinzo hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa’ kiang pan Jonah taikhia-in Tarshish khua lamah a taisim dingin a kithawi zawsop hi. Joppa khua-ah paisuk a, Tarshish khua a zuan ding teembaw khat a mu hi. A sap man ding pia-in a tungah kah a, Topa’ kiang pan a taikhia dingin teembaw hawlte tawh Tarshish khua-ah a pai hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahih hangin Topa in tuipi tungah huih nakpi-in nungsak a, huihpi hatlua ahih manin teembaw a kisia dekdek hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin teembaw hawlte lau uh a, a pasian ciat uh’ kiangah a kiko ciat uh hi. Teembaw a zantuam nadingin a sunga vante tuipi sungah a paai uh hi. Tua bang hinapi-in teembaw sungtawng lamah Jonah na lutsukin a na ihmu hithiat hi."},"6":{"text":"Teembaw ukpa in amah a muh ciangin, “Ihmu pa aw, bang na cihna ahi hiam? Tho inla na pasian kiangah thu ngen in. I sih loh nadingin amah in eite hong ngaihsun khathei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin teembaw hawlte in, “Hong pai dih un. Kua’ hangin hih bang gimna ei’ tungah hong tung ahi hiam, cih i theih nadingin ai san dih ni,” ci-in khatlekhat a kikum uh hi. Ai a san uhleh Jonah tung a tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, “Bang hangin hih gimna ei’ tungah hong tung ahi hiam, hong gen in. Na nasep bang ahi hiam? Koi lai pana hong pai na hi hiam? Na gam bang ahi hiam? Kua minam na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in, “Kei pen Hebru mi ka hi hi; tuipi le leitang a bawl, vantungte’ Pasian ahi Topa ka bia hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua mite lau mahmah uh a, “Bang hangin hih bangin gamta mawk na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ kiang pan amah a taikhiasim ahihlam a gen khitsa ahih manin a thei khinzo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, “Ei a dingin tuipi a hong daihtheih nadingin nang bang kong cih ding uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh huihpi lauhuai semsem hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in, “Hong domto unla, tuipi sungah hong khia un; tua hileh no a dingin tuipi a hong dai ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih huihpi na thuakna uh keima hang ahi hi, cih ka thei hi,” ci-in a dawngkik hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bang a cih hangin amaute in teembaw a khawlsak dingin hahkatin lei lamah a hot teitei uh hi. Ahih hangin a hihzo kei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh huihpi a hat semsem hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ kiangah amaute kiko-in, “ Topa aw, hih mipa ka sihsak manun kote hong sisak kei inla, mi that hi, ci-in hong ngawh kei ta in, ci-in kong thum uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah in pha na sak banga na bawl ahi hi,” ci-in thu a ngen uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonah domto-in tuipi sungah a khiat uhleh tuipi a dai pah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua mite in Topa kihta mahmah uh a, Topa’ tungah biakna pia-in thuciamna a bawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahih hangin Jonah a nawmvalh dingin Topa in ngapi khat a geelkholhsa hi a, tua ngapi’ gil sungah Jonah sun thum le zan thum sung a om hi.","ref":"Mat 12:40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonah in tua ngapi’ gil sung panin Topa a Pasian kiangah thu ngen a,","title":"Jonah’ Lungdamkohna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka cihmawhna panin Topa ka sam a, amah in kei hong dawng hi. Sihna gam Sheol panin kong kiko a, nangmah in ka aw nong za hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuipi thuk sungah kei nong khia a, tui in kei hong tuumcip hi. Na tuihualte khempeuh in kei hong tum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, ‘Na omna panin kei hong kihawlkhia hi. Na biakinn siangtho hong koici et kik thei ding ka hi hiam?’ ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tui in kei hong tuamcip a, ka kimkotah hong umcih hi. Tuipi tunga lopate in ka lu hong vialcip hi."},"6":{"text":"Mualte’ bul tuipi taw dong ka va paisuk a, kong hong kikhaknelh tawntungna mun ka tun hangin tua Leihawmpi sung panin a nungta-in nong lato veve hi, Topa ka Pasian aw."},"7":{"text":"Kei ka lung a kiat ciangin Topa kong phawk a, ka thungetna, na biakinn siangtho sung, nangma kiang hong tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lo milim a biate in nangmah hong taisan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin ke’n ahihleh lungdamna aw tawh biakna kong pia ding a, ka ciamsa thu ka tangtungsak ding hi. Topa’ kiang pan hotkhiatna hong pai hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in tua ngapi sawl a, amah in lei keu tungah Jonah a luakhia hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Jonah tungah a nihveina thu gen a,","title":"Nineveh Khua Mite A Kisikna"},"2":{"text":"“Kithawi inla, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi-ah va pai-in kong gensa thu taangko in,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jonah zong kithawi pah a, Topa’ cih bangin Nineveh khua-ah a pai hi. Nineveh khua pen khuapi lian mahmah khat hi a, ni thum sung tak kikantan hi."},"4":{"text":"Jonah zong khuasung lam manawhin kipan a, ni khat sung lam a pai khit ciangin, “Ni sawmli khit ciangin hih Nineveh khuapi kisusia ding hi,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"5":{"text":"Nineveh khuamite kisikin Pasian um uh a, antan’ ding thu thangsakin, a golpen pan a kipan a neupen dongin puanhampi a silh uh hi.","ref":"Mat 12:41; Luk 11:32"},"6":{"text":"Nineveh khua kumpipa in tua thu a zak ciangin a kumpi tokhom tung pan dingkhia-in a kumpi puan suahkhia a, puanhampi silhin vut lakah a tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Nineveh khuasung khempeuhah thu thangsakin taangkosak a, “Kumpipa le uliante’ thu tawh: Mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin, bawnghon ahi a, tuuhon ahi zongin, kuamah in bangmah ciam thei lo ding, an ne thei lo ding, tui dawn thei lo ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing le ganhingte in puanhampi silhin Pasian’ tungah nakpi-in kiko ta uh hen. Mi khempeuh, a khialhnate uh le a gitlohnate uh panin kihei ta uh hen."},"9":{"text":"Eite i sih loh nadingin Pasian kisikin a hehna damsak lo ding hi, kua in ci thei na hi uh hiam?” a cisak hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian in amau’ hihnate mu a, a khialhna uh panin a kihei uh a muh ciangin kisik a, amau tungah hih dingin a cihsa siatna a tungsak nawn kei hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahih hangin tua thu hangin Jonah lungkim hetloin a heh hi.","title":"Jonah’ Lungkim lohna le Pasian’ Hehpihna"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ kiangah thu ngen a, “Kong thum hi, Topa aw; ka gam sungah ka omlai pekin hici mah in teh, ci hi lo ka hi hiam? Hanciamin Tarshish khua-ah ka taisimna zong tua hang mah ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen a hehpih thei Pasian, a hehhak, a migi mahmah, siatna tunsak ding a kisiknuam Pasian na hihna kong thei hi.","ref":"Pai 34:6"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa aw, tu-in ka nuntakna hong la in, ci-in kong thum hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka nuntak sangin sileng kei a dingin a hoihzaw hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:4"},"4":{"text":"Topa in zong, “Na heh ding kilawm sa na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin khuapi pualamah Jonah paikhia a, nisuahna lamah ama a’ ding bukno khat lamin tua lai-ah a tu hi. Tua khuapi bang hong ci ding hiam, cih a en dingin a buk liim nuai-ah tu-in a ngak hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa Pasian in zong Jonah a liah ding le a lungkhamna a tawldamsak dingin umgui khat a tungah a zaamsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua umgui hangin Jonah lungdam mahmah hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahih hangin a zingsang khuavak ciangin Pasian in tua umgui lungno khat nesak ahih manin a keu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni hong suah ciangin Pasian in nisuahna lam panin huih a sa mahmah nungsak a, ni in zong Jonah’ luzang kapsuk veva ahih manin a gim mahmah hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Ka nuntak sangin si leng kei a dingin hoihzaw hi,” ci-in a sih nading thu a ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahih hangin Pasian in Jonah kiangah, “Tua umgui hangin na heh ding kilawm sa na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Jonah in, “Ka heh ding kilawm sa tham loin hehlua-in ka si zongin kilawm ka sa veve hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Nang in na gimpih lohpi, na khansak lohpi, zan khat thu-in hong piangin zan khat thu mahin a si tua umgui pammaih na sa hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahihleh keimah in ganhing tampi tham lo, a taklam khut le a veilam khut nangawn a khenthei nai lo naupang tul za le tul sawmnih sangin a tamzawte’ tenna, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi pammaih sa lo ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dawngkik hi."}}}}},"33":{"info":{"name":"Mikah","shortname":"Mic","abbr":[],"desc":"Kamsang Mikah pen a khan' hun Isaiah tawh a kibang hi a, leitaw lam Judah kumpi gamsung khua khat pan-a piang ahi hi. Amos in, leilu lam kumpi gam in gimna lianpi thuak ding hi, ci-in a gen mah bangin Judah gam in zong tua bangmah thuak ding a, leilu lam mihingte a thumanlohna leh a thutan'lohna hangin Pasian in gimna a piak mah bangin leitaw lam gam in zong thuak ding hi, ci-in Mikah in a thei hi. Ahi zongin Mikah thugenna sungah mailam hunah lametna a omna thu a kicianzaw leh a kitelzaw-in a gen hi. Hih sung panin a ciamtehhuai thute: Pasian' ukna nuai-ah mun khempeuhah kilemna a omna ding thu (4:1-4), David' suan sung panin kumpi lian khat hong piangin Israel minamte' nopsakna a pian'sakna ding thu genkholhna (5:2-4), leh a neu khat bek (6:8) sungah, “Pasian in a kalh thu: Thuman thute sem ding a, itna kip nei tawntungin, kiniamkhiatna tawh Pasian' thu man' ding ahi hi,” ci-in a genna tawh Israel kamsangte' thugen khempeuh a tomin a genna thute ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah gam kumpi Jotham, Ahaz, le Hezekiah-te’ hun laitakin, Moresheth khuami Mikah tungah Topa in thu a pia hi. Samaria le Jerusalem tawh kisai-in Topa in Mikah tungah hih thute a lak hi.","title":"Samaria le Jerusalem Dahpihna","ref":"2Kum 15:32-16:20; 18:1-20:21; 2Khang 27:1-7; 2Khang 28:1-32:33"},"2":{"text":"No minam khempeuhte aw, hih thu za un: Leitungah a teng mi khempeuhte aw, hih thu ngai un: Note’ langkhatah Topa Pasian in teci pang a, a vantung biakinn panin thu hong gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama mun siangtho panin Topa hong pai a, amah in leitung mualsang dawnte hong siksuk ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Meikhuk sungah khuainun a kikoih bangin ama khenuai-ah mualliante tuisuak ding a, mualtung panin tui a luangsuk bangin, guam sungah tua mualte luangsuk ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian’ tungah Israel-te’ mawhna le a khialhnate uh hangin hih thute khempeuh a piang ahi hi. Israel-te’ khialhna kua ngawh ding ihi hiam? Samaria mite ngawh ding ihi hiam? Judah gam sungah milim bia-in a khial kua ahi hiam? Jerusalem mite ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Samaria khuapi, gamlak a ninkholna mun, leenggui suanna mun lel dingin ka bawl ding hi. A khuasunga suangte zong guam sungah ka nilsuk ding a, a khuapi bulpite ka dawksak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A milim manphate khempeuh kisuzan gawp ding a, mei tawh kisusia ding hi. Pasian’ tungah a thuman lohna hangun mihingte in hih milimte nei uh ahih manin, a thuman lohna uh tawh kizui-in tu-in thuakkik ding uh hi, ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kei kapin ka thum ding a, ka dahna thu ka lah nadingin khe guak le guaktangin ka vak ding hi. Gam-ui bangin ka ham ding a, vasa-kalaoh bangin ka tau ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Samaria’ meima kidamsak thei lo hi; Judah in zong tua bangmah a thuak ding ahi ta hi. Ka mite’ tenna Jerusalem khua mahmah, tua siatna in hong ban ta hi."},"10":{"text":"I guallelhna thu Gath khuamite theisak kei unla, na kahna uh amaute musak kei un. Bethleafrah khua sungah na lungkhamna uh langsakin, leivui lakah kikhuk un."},"11":{"text":"Shafir khua-ah a teng mite aw, guaktangin maizumna tawh salin pai un. Zanaan khua-a teng mite, a hingin paikhia ngei lo ding hi. Bethezel khuamite’ kahna le thumna na zak uh ciangin, tua khua sungah belh ding munmuanhuai a om lohna na thei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem kulhpi dongah gimna lianpi tungsak ta ahih manin Maroth khuamite nakpitakin patau uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Lakhish khua-ah a teng mite aw, na sakol galkapte uh a leeng bulh pak un. Note in Israel-te’ khialhnateng zuikha na hih manun, Jerusalem zong a khialsakte na hi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in no Judah mite aw, Moresethgath khua, mangpha khak un. Israel kumpite in Akzib khua panin huhna ngah lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mareshah khuamite aw, note a hong zong ding pa ka hong paisak ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Adullam leihawm sungah Israel kumpipa bu ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Judah mite aw, na it mahmah na tate uh, sal a suak dingin hong kilaksak ding ahih manin, amaute’ hangin na dahna limun na sam uh met unla, musane bangin na lu uh tolsak un."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A lupna tungah lumin gitlohna a geelgeelte in gimna ngah tahen. Zingsang khua a vak ciangin, hihtheih ding hun a ngah phetun, a ngaihsutsa uh gitlohna a semkhia uh hi.","title":"Mizawng A Bawlsiate in Gimna Ngah"},"2":{"text":"Lo deih le-uh, mi-a’ sut uh a, inn deih le-uh, mi-a’ mah sut uh hi. Mite bawlsia-in, a inn le a neihsa uh a sut uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Note’ tungah gimna tunsak ding ka ngaihsun a, tua gimna tawh na kipelh thei kei ding uh hi. Note a dingin hun hoih lo hi ding ahih manin kiphatsakna tawh na gamta nawn kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bang hun hong tun ciangin mite in note’ gim ngahna thugentehna-in zangin, dah la phuakin sa ding uh a, “Eite i sia khin taktak hi. Topa in i gam hong laksak a, ei a hong mante tungah hong piaksak hi,” ci ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ mite lakah leitang a kihawm ciangin, kuamah in leitang na ngah kei ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in kei kiangah, “Tua bang thu hong gen kei in. Tua bang thu gen dingin kilawm lo hi. Tua bangin Pasian in hong minsiasak lo ding hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite aw, “ Topa a lung tom ta a, hihte khempeuh, ama hong bawl mah ahi hiam?” na cih ding uh kilawm lo hi. Ka thugenna kammalte, a thuman mite a dingin a hoih hi lo ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa in hih bangin hong ci hi: Note pen ka mite’ gal na suak uh a, galsung panin a hong ciahkik, lungmuang a a inn-ah a om mite’ puantualpi ngahte na sut uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mihingte’ numeite, amau’ inn nuam panin na hawlkhia uh a, a tate un a ngah ding keima thuphate na taansak paisuak uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in ding unla paikhia un. Na khialhna hangun a lauhuai suksiatna tuak ding na hih manun, hih lai mun pen note a dingin mun nuam hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Zuau genin khemna tawh thu gen kawikawi a, “Note a dingin leenggahzu le khamtheihzu tampi tak hong om ding hi,” a hong ci kamsangte pawl, note’ deih kamsangte ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin no Israel mi a omlaite khempeuh pel hetloin kong kaikhawm kik ding hi. Tuubuk sunga tuu khum bangin, gankhawk sungah tuuhon kaihkhop bangin note kong kaikhawm kik ding a, na gam sung uh, mi tampite’ husa tawh kidimkik ding hi, ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian in note a’ ding lampi hong honsakin hong paikhiatpih ding hi. Lamdang sa-in kam khat zong pau lo ding uh a, hih thu a zakzakna-un a bil uh ngong liang ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in gul bangin leivui namin, a bokvak ganhingte bangin hong awmtal ding uh a, a bukna uh munmuanhuaite panin lau-in a lingsa-in hong pusuak ding uh a, Topa Pasian hong kihta ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa aw, nang tawh a kibang Pasian dang om lo a, a omlai na mite’ mawhna nangmah in na maisak hi. B.C. za sagihna bei kuan lamin Nineveh khuapi a pukna pen a gilo a kihisak minamte tungah Pasian in gim pia-in thu a khenna hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih pen Nineveh khua tawh kisai thu genna hi a, Elkosh khuami Nahum’ maangmuhna a kiciamtehna lai ahi hi.","title":"Phulakna"},"2":{"text":"Topa Pasian in amah a demte koihkhong lo a, amah a langpangte gim pia-in a galte thukkik hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa lungduai mahmah a, a vang zong lian mahmah a, ahih hangin mimawhte khahkhong ngei lo hi. Amah a su peuhpeuh a dingkikzo om ngei lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute, linglom bangin om uh a, zulesa tawh kidiahin a om laitakun ham bangin kihaltum ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nineveh khuapi aw, gitlohna tawh thu vaihawmin, Topa a sawm mite, nang’ sungah om hi lo ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Topa in ama mite tungah hih bangin thu gen a, “Assiria mite thahatin a tam mahmah hangin, amaute kisusia-in maimang ding uh hi. No ka mite na hih uhleh, khatvei lai-in kong gimsak khit hangin tu-in note kong gimsakkik nawn kei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Note’ tungah Assiria mite’ aana neihna ka beisak ding a, note hong khihna sikkhaute ka sutat ding hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Assiria mite tawh kisai-in hih bangin thu pia hi: “Note na cimang ding uh a, na pasian-te uh biakinn sunga om milimte ka susia ding hi. Note siahuai lua na hih manun na hankhuk ding uh a bawlbawl ka hi ta hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"En un, mualtungah kamtai pa hong tai a, gualzawhna ding thupha hong gen ding ahi hi.
