Tua ahih ciangin tuhuna migilote zong hih mipa’ pianzia mah tawh kibang ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua bangin mite kiangah thu genin a om laitakin a pualamah a nu le a naute in Jesuh hopih nuamin a om uh hi.","title":"Jesuh’ Nu le A Naute (Mrk 3:31-35 ; Luk 8:19-21)"},"47":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua lai-ah a om mite khat in Jesuh kiangah, “Na nu le na naute in nang hong hopih nuamin a pualamah om uh hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in tua mipa kiangah, “Ka nu kua bangte hi a, ka naute kua bangte ahi uh hiam?” a cih khit ciangin"},"49":{"text":"a nungzuite lam kawk a, “Hihte pen ka nu le ka sanggamte ahi uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Vantungah a om ka Pa’ deihna bangin a gamta mi peuhmah ka sanggam pasal, ka sanggam numei, ka nu ahi uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni mahin tua inn panin Jesuh paikhia a, tuili gei-ah pai-in thuhilh dingin a tu hi.","title":"Khaici Vawhpa Thugentehna (Mrk 4:1-9 ; Luk 8:4-8)"},"2":{"text":"Ama kiimah a hong kikhawm mi tamlua ahih manin amah gunkuang tungah pai-in tu a, mihonte ahihleh tuili gei-ah a omsak hi.","ref":"Luk 5:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Amah in thugentehna a tuamtuam zangin thu tampi hilhin a genin-ah: “Khaici vawhpa khaici vawh dingin a kuankhia hi."},"4":{"text":"Khaici a vawh ciangin pawlkhatte lo lai lam dungah tu a, vasate hong leengin a ne uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, suang a kitawphahna leidaina mun a tu hi. Lei thuk loin lum ahih manin a khaici popah hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin ni hong sat ciangin ankungte in zung thuk kha zo lo uh ahih manin tua ankungnote vulin a keu hi."},"7":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, lingbulsum a omna mun leilak tu a, lingbulsumte hong selin hong khang ahih manin ankungte a depgawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin pawlkhatte, lei hoihna mun tu-in hong khang hi. Pawlkhatte in a zah zakhat, pawlkhatte in a zah sawmguk, adangte in a zah sawmthum a gah hi,” ci-in a gen khit ciangin,"},"9":{"text":"“Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu na za ta un,” ci-in Jesuh in a thugen a khum hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin nungzuite in Jesuh va naihin ama kiangah, “Bang hangin thugentehna zangin amaute tungah thu gen na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.","title":"Thugentehna A Deihna (Mrk 4:10-12 ; Luk 8:9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Vantung ki-ukna tawh kisai thusim note tungah hong kihilh a, ahi zongin amaute tungah kihilh lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a neisate tungah kipia thuahin hau semsem ding a, a nei lote tung panin a neihsa sunsun nangawn kilaksak ding hi.","ref":"Mat 25:29; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18; 19:26"},"13":{"text":"Amaute in enen napi-in mu thei lo uh a, ngaingai napi-in za thei lo, tel thei lo uh ahih manin thugentehna zangin thu a gen ka hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Kamsang Isaiah’ thugenkholhna, hih thu tawh kisai-ah amau a dingin tung taktak hi. Tua a genna-ah, ‘Na zakzak uh hangin na tel kei ding uh a, na etet uh hangin na mu kei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih mite’ lungsim mawl mahmah hi; a bil uh bingsak uh a, a mit uh a si uh hi. Tua bang hi kei le-uh, a mit uh tawh mu-in, a bil uh tawh za-in, a lungsim un tel ding a, kei lamah amaute hong kihei-in, amaute ka damsak ding hi, ci-in Pasian in gen hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin note’ mit in mu-in na bil un za ahih manin a hampha mahmah na hi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi taktakin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Kamsangte le Pasian’ mi tampite in note’ muhte munuam mahmah napi-in mu lo uh a, note’ zakte zanuam mahmah napi-in za lo uh hi.","ref":"Luk 10:23-24"},"18":{"text":"“Tua ahih ciangin tu-in khaici vawhpa thugentehna thu na ngai un.","title":"Jesuh in Khaici Vawhpa Thugentehna Telgen (Mrk 4:13-20 ; Luk 8:11-15)"},"19":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in Pasian’ hong ukna tawh kisai a lungdamhuai thu za napi-in a thu theitel lo uh ahih manin Dawimangpa hong pai-in amau lungsim sunga a kivawh thu a lakkhiatsak hi. Hih bangte pen lolai lampi dung a tu khaicite tawh kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Suang kitawphah leilak a tu khaicite pen Pasian’ thu a zak ciangun lungdam takin a sangpahte a cihnopna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute sungah thuktum zo lo ahih manin tawlkhat sung bek um uh hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian’ thu hangin haksatna ahi a, bawlsiatna ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh a tun ciangin tawpkikpah uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Lingbulsum omna leilakah a tu khaicite pen Pasian’ thu za napi-in amau nuntakna sung uhah leitung lunghihmawhna le hauh nopnate in Pasian’ thu vuknelh ahih manin bangmah a suakkhia zo lote a cihnopna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Lei hoihna munah a tu khaicite pen Pasian’ thu a zak ciangin a tel mite a cihnopna ahi hi. Tua bang mite a dingin Pasian’ thu in man nei a, pawlkhatte a dingin a zah zakhat, pawlkhatte a dingin a zah sawmguk, pawlkhatte a dingin a zah sawmthumin Pasian’ thu in man a nei hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna dang khat gen a, “Vantung ki-ukna pen bang tawh kibang hiam cih leh: A lo-ah taangci hoih a vawhpa tawh kibang hi.","title":"Taang Lakah Tahum"},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin zan khat, mite a ihmut kalun galte khat hong pai-in taang lakah tahum tang vawhin a paikhia hi."},"26":{"text":"Taangte hong po-in a vuih hun ding ciangin tahum kungte zong hong lianin hong kilang hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin lonei pa’ nasemte ama kiangah hong pai-in, ‘Na lolai-ah na vawh khaici pen taangci hoihte ahi hi. Hih tahumte koi pana hong piang ahi hiam?’ a cih ciangin"},"28":{"text":"amah in, ‘Galte’ vawh ahi hi,’ ci-in a dawng hi. A nasemte in ama kiangah, ‘Tua ahihleh kote va kuanin ka va bot ding uh hiam?’ ci-in a dong uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah in, ‘Va bot kei un. Tahumte bot le-uhcin taang tawh na botkhawm kha ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Anlak hun mateng a nam nihin tuaci om phot hen. Anlak hun ciangin anlate kiangah, “Tahumte bot masa unla, meikhukah khul dingin lomhen un. Ahi zongin taangte la-in ka ansal-ah hong sung un,” ka ci ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna dang khat gen leuleu a, “Vantung ki-ukna pen bang tawh kibang hiam cih leh, mi khat in a lo sungah a vawh ankam tang tawh kibang hi.","title":"Ankam Tang Thugentehna (Mrk 4:30-32 ; Luk 13:18-19)"},"32":{"text":"Khaici khempeuh lak panin ankam tang a neupen ahi hi. Ahi zongin a khankhit ciangin ankung lakah a golpen suak ahih manin vasate in a hiang tungah bu a tomtheihna zah ding ciang hong suak thei hi,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin thugentehna khat mah gen leuleu a, “Vantung ki-ukna pen bang tawh kibang hiam cih leh, nupi khat in annel seu thum dim meek manin silngo sawh a, a vekpi-in silngo in zelin a pawmsak tawh kibang hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Silngo Thugentehna (Luk 13:20-21)"},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thute khempeuh, thugentehna vive zangin thu hilh a, thugentehna zang loin thu khat beek a gen kei hi.","title":"Jesuh in Thugentehna A Zatna (Mrk 4:33-34)"},"35":{"text":"Hih bangin thugentehna a zatna pen kamsang Isaiah in, “Thugentehna zangin thu ka gen ding a, leitung piancil a kipan a kithei lo thute ka gen ding hi,” ci-in a genkholhsakna thu a tun nading ahi hi.","ref":"La 78:2"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihonte lak panin Jesuh paikhia-in inn sungah a lut hi. A nungzuite ama kiangah hong pai uh a, “Lolai-a om Tahum Thugentehna a khiatna hong gen in,” a cih uh ciangin","title":"Jesuh in Taang Lakah Tahum Thugentehna Telgen"},"37":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Taangci hoih a vawhpa pen Mihing Tapa ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Lolai pen leitung hi a, taangci hoih i cih pen Pasian’ ukna sungah a om mite ahi uh hi. Tahumte pen Gilopa tawh a kipawl mite hi a,"},"39":{"text":"tahum tang a vawh gal pa pen Dawimangpa ahi hi. Anlak hun pen leitung bei nading hun hi a, anla nasemte pen vantung mite ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tahumte kikaikhawmin meikhuk sungah a kikhultum mah bangin leitung bei hun ciangin tua bangmahin kihih ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Mihing Tapa in a vantung mite hong sawl ding a, ama ukna sungah a om migilote le mi a mawh nadingin a bawl mi khempeuh kaikhawmin"},"42":{"text":"meikhukpi sungah tua bang mite lawn ding uh a, tua lai-ah amaute kapin a hagawi ding uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin Pasian’ mite ahihleh a Pa uh Ukna sungah ni bangin a taang ding uh hi. Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu na za ta un."},"44":{"text":"“Vantung ki-ukna pen lolai-ah a kiseel sum tawh kibang hi. Mi khat in a muh ciangin limtakin a seelpha hi. Amah lungdam mahmahin a inn-ah ciahpah a, a neih khempeuh a zuak khit ciangin tua lo a lei hi.","title":"A Kiseel Sum"},"45":{"text":"“Vantung ki-ukna pen sumbawlpa in a zon kep hoihpente tawh zong kibang hi.","title":"Kep Hoihpente"},"46":{"text":"Sumbawlpa in a manpha diak pawl kep khat a muh ciangin ciahpahin a neih khempeuh a zuak khit ciangin tua kep a lei hi."},"47":{"text":"“Vantung ki-ukna pen tui sungah kipaai-in ngasa namkim a awkna ngen tawh zong kibang hi.","title":"Ngen tawh Thugentehna"},"48":{"text":"Ngasa tampi tak a awk ciangin ngabengte in tui gei-ah a ngen uh kaikhia-in tusuk uh a, nektheih ding ngasate, paipel sungah guangin, nektheih loh ding ngasate, a lawnkhia uh hi."},"49":{"text":"Leitung hun bei ciangin zong tua bangmah hi ding hi. Vantung mite hong pai-in mihoihte lak panin migilote lakhia-in,"},"50":{"text":"meikhukpi sungah tua migilote a khul ding uh hi. Tua lai-ah kapin a hagawi ding uh hi."},"51":{"text":"“Hih ka thugente khempeuh a khiatna na thei uh hiam?” ci-in Jesuh in a dot ciangin amaute in, “Ka thei uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.","title":"Sumkhol A Lui le A Thak"},"52":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Vantung ki-ukna sungah a hong lut Thukham hilh siate khempeuh pen, a sumkholna panin a thak le a lui, a ut utin a lakhia thei ziauziau sumnei pa tawh kibang uh hi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thugentehnate a gen khit ciangin tua lai panin paikhia-in","title":"Nazareth khua-ah Jesuh Kisang lo (Mrk 6:1-6 ; Luk 4:16-30)"},"54":{"text":"ama khua-ah pai a, kikhopna inn sungah thu a hilh hi. Ama thugen a za mite in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, “Hih mipa in hih bang pilna koilai panin ngah a, bang hangin hih bang na lamdangte bawlthei ahi hiam?"},"55":{"text":"Khutsiam pa’ tapa hi lel a, a nu zong Mary a kici nu hilel hi lo ahi hiam? Ama naute zong James, Josef, Simon le Judas hi lo ahi uh hiam?"},"56":{"text":"A nau numeite zong hih lai mah a om hi lo ahi uh hiam? Tua bang hinapi-in hih mipa in koi lai panin hih bang thuteng ngahthei ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amah a sangzo kei uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Kamsang khat pen, ama khua, ama behte, le ama innsung longal-ah kizahtakin pahtawina a ngah hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joh 4:44"},"58":{"text":"Nazareth khuamite in amah a up lohna hangin tua khua-ah nalamdang tampi a bawl kei hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Galilee gam sungteng a uksawn kumpi Herod in Jesuh’ thu a za hi.","title":"Tuiphumpa Johan A Sihna (Mrk 6:14-29 ; Luk 9:7-9)"},"2":{"text":"Amah in a nuai-a uliante kiangah, “Hih pa pen Johan hi a, sihna panin a hingkik hi ding hi. Tua ahih manin hih bang nalamdang bawlna ding vangliatna nei hi ding hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Herod in a nau Filip’ zi Herodias a tenpihna hangin Johan in Herod kiangah, “Na naupa’ zi na tenpih ding ngeina hi lo hi,” ci-in gen zelzel ahih manin Herod a heh suak a, Johan mansakin, khau khihsakin, thong sungah a khumsak hi.","ref":"Luk 3:19-20; Siam 18:16; 20:21","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Herod in Johan that nuam hi. Ahi zongin mite in kamsangin ngaihsun uh ahih manin mite a kihtakna hangin thatsak ngam lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin Herod’ suah ni pawi bawl hun hong tun ciangin mihonte mai-ah Herodias’ tanu hong laam ciangin Herod lungdam mahmah ahih manin,"},"7":{"text":"“Na hong nget peuhpeuh ka hong pia ding hi,” ci-in a kiciam hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua numei in zong a nu’ ngaihsut piakna zui-in, “Kuangdai khat sungah Tuiphumpa Johan’ lutang, hih lai mahmahah hong pia in,” ci-in a ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa dah mahmah hi. Ahi zongin a kiciamnasa ahihna hang leh a leenglate’ maitang a zahtakna hangin a ngetna a kipiak nadingin thu a pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mi sawlin thongah Johan’ lutang a tansak hi."},"11":{"text":"Kuangdai khat tawh tua a lutang hong kipaipihin numei kiangah kipia a, tua numei in a nu kiangah a paipih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Johan’ nungzuite hong pai uh a, a luang la-in a vui khit uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah hih thu a ko uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in tua thu a zak ciangin tua mun panin kihemkhia-in gamdaihna mun a zuan dingin gunkuang tawh a pai hi. Mite in ama paikhiatna thu a theih uh ciangin a khua ciat panun lei lam tawnin Jesuh nung hong zui uh hi.","title":"Tul Nga Vakna (Mrk 6:30-44 ; Luk 9:10-17 ; Joh 6:1-14)"},"14":{"text":"Tui gei-ah Jesuh a tun ciangin mihon tampi a na om a mu hi. Amaute hehpihhuai sa a, a cinate a damsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni a tum kuan ciangin nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Hih lai mun gamlak hi a, ni zong tum dektak ta hi. Hih kiimnai-a om khuate-ah mite va pai-in a an ding uh a lei nadingun sawlkhia in,” a ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Amaute a paikhiat ding kisam lo hi. Amaute’ nek ding bangkhat peuhpeuh pia un,” ci-in a dawn ciangin"},"17":{"text":"amaute in, “Anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih lobuang bangmah dang om lo hi,” a ci uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tuate hong paipih un,” ci-in a sawl khit ciangin,"},"19":{"text":"lopa tungah mihonte a tut nadingun a sawl hi. Tua ciangin anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih la-in vantung lam ento a, Pasian tungah a lungdamna a ko hi. Tua ciangin anlum balnenin a nungzuite pia a, a nungzuite in mihonte mai-ah a lui uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in ne-in a kham khit uh ciangin a khamvalte uh khawmkik uh a, paipel sawm le nih a dim hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua an a ne mite, numei le naupang simloh, pasal cingteng mi tul nga bang a pha hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in mihonpite a ciahsak laitakin a nungzuite gunkuangah tuangsak a, tuili gal khatah a pai dingin ama mai-ah a ma paisak hi.","title":"Jesuh, Tui Tungah Pai (Mrk 6:45-52 ; Joh 6:16-21)"},"23":{"text":"Mihonte a ciah khit ciangin thungen dingin mual tunglamah a paito hi. Khuamial ciangin Jesuh guakbek gamlakah om a,"},"24":{"text":"ahi zongin nungzuite pen lei tawh gamlapi kihal khinta uh a, huih in amaute lehmut ahih manin gunkuang a kilokgawp hi."},"25":{"text":"Zingsang lam nai thum le nai guk kikal khawng ciangin a nungzuite kiang lam manawhin tui tungah Jesuh hong pai hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin nungzuite in tui tungah hong pai a muh uh ciangin lau mahmah uh a, “Sikha hi,” ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin a lau manun a awng uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute hopihpah a, “Na lungsim uh hangsak un. Keimah ka hi hi. Lau kei un,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter in, “Topa aw, nang na hihtakpi leh, tui tung tawnin nang kiangah kei zong hong paisak in,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hong pai in,” a cih ciangin Peter zong gunkuang tung panin kumkhia a, Jesuh’ omna lam manawhin tui tungah a pai hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin huihpi nung a muh ciangin lau a, tui sungah tum dektak ahih manin, “Topa aw, hong hon in,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in zong a khut tawh Peter zamin len a, “Upna cingtaak lopa aw, bang ci-a hong tuaci muanlah na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Gunkuang tungah a kahtoh khit uh ciangin huihpi nung a dai hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin gunkuang sungah a om nungzuite in Jesuh bia uh a, “Pasian’ Tapa taktak na hi hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tui a kantan khit uh ciangin Gennesaret gamah a tung uh hi.","title":"Gennesaret gamah Jesuh in Cina Damsak (Mrk 6:53-56)"},"35":{"text":"Tua gam mite in Jesuh ahihlam a theih uh ciangin tua gam kiim khempeuhah thu zasak uh a, cina khempeuh Jesuh kiangah a hong paipih uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama puanmongteep beek a lawnkhak theih nadingun Jesuh kiangah ngen uh a, a puanmongteep a lawng mi khempeuh in damna a ngah uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jerusalem khua panin Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate, Jesuh kiangah hong pai uh a,","title":"Khanglui Ngeina (Mrk 7:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"“Bang hangin na nungzuite in tangtawng pek panin a hong kihilh suksuk i pupa ngeinate zui lo uh ahi hiam? Tua a genna-ah,"},"8":{"text":"‘Hih mite in a kampi bek uh tawh kei hong zahtak bawl uh a, ahi zongin a lungsim taktak uh kei tawh kigamla hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihingte’ bawltawm thukhamte, Pasian’ thukham zahin mite tungah hilh uh ahih manin kei hong biak hangun a kimanna om lo hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Isa 29:13"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah mihonte sam a, “Ka thugen na ngai unla, hoihtakin na theitel un.","title":"Mi Hong Ninsakthei Nate (Mrk 7:14-23)"},"11":{"text":"Kam sungah a tumsuk nate in mi ninsak lo a, kam sung panin a pusuak nate in mi a ninsak hizaw hi,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Farisi mite in hih na thugen a zak uh ciangin na a sak mahmahna thu uh na thei hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Vantungah a om ka Pa’ suan ahi lo kung khempeuh kibotkhia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih mite lunghihmawh ngaihsut kei un. Amaute pen mittaw makai ahi uh hi. Mittaw khat in mittaw dang khat makaih leh a nihun hawkguam sungah kiakhawm ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Luk 6:39"},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter in Jesuh kiangah, “Hih thugentehna a khiatna kote hong hilh in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Note nangawn in thei lo a, tel lo na hi uh hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Kam sungah a tumsukte pen gil sung tawnin tua panin paikhiasuak hi lo ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin kam sung panin a pusuakte pen lungsim panin hong kipankhia hi a, hihte in mi ninsakthei hi.","ref":"Mat 12:34"},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh lungsim panin mi thahnopna, mi zi tawh mawhnopna, nungak tawh mawhnopna, guktakna, zuau genna, mi gensiatna, le ngaihsut hoih lo a tuamtuam hong piangkhia hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih bang nate in mi ninsak a, khut sil loin annekna in mi ninsak lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua lai panin Jesuh paikhia a, Taia khuapi le Sidon khuapi gam sung tengah a zin hi.","title":"Kanaan Numei’ Upna (Mrk 7:24-30)"},"22":{"text":"Tua gamah a teng Kanaan nupi khat hong pai-in hong kiko a, “David’ suan, Topa aw, kei hong hehpih in. Tua ciangin a nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Hih nupi i nung zui-in kikoko ahih manin a ciah nadingin sawl in,” ci-in a thum uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tuu bangin a mangthang Israel mite lak bekah kei hong kisawl hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua nupi hong pai-in Jesuh’ mai-ah khukdin a, “Topa aw, kei hong huh in,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tate’ annek ding laksakin ui khawite piak ding kilawm lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"27":{"text":"Nupi in, “Hi mah hi, Topa aw; a topa sabuai tung panin a kia annengte, ui khawite in zong ne buang hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in tua nupi kiangah, “Nupi aw, na upna lian taktak hi. Mualtung lamah kahto-in a tu hi.","title":"Jesuh in Mi Tampi Damsak"},"30":{"text":"Ama kiangah mihon tampi tak hong pai uh a, khebaite, khezawte, mittawte, a pau thei lote, le cina dang tampi, Jesuh kiangah hong koih uh hi. Jesuh in tuate khempeuh a damsak hi."},"31":{"text":"A pau thei lote pau thei-in, khezawte damin, khebaite hoihtakin lam paithei-in, mittawte in khua a muh theihkikna thu mihonpite in a muh uh ciangin lamdangsa mahmah uh a, Israel mite’ Pasian a phat uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite sam a, “Kei kiangah hih mite ni thum bang hong omkhin uh a, amaute in annek ding nei nawn lo uh ahih manin hehpihhuai ka sa hi. Lamkalah cimawh kha ding uh ahih manin gilkialin ka ciahsak nuam kei hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Tul Li Vakna (Mrk 8:1-10)"},"33":{"text":"Nungzuite in, “Mihon hih zah i piak ding, hih gamlakah koi panin an ngah ding ihi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Anlum bangzah nei na hi uh hiam?” a cih ciangin, “Lum sagih le ngasa neu tawm khat om hi,” a ci uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in leilakah mihonte a tut nadingin a sawl hi."},"36":{"text":"Anlum sagih le a ngasate la-in Pasian tungah lungdamna a koh khit ciangin balnenin a nungzuite tungah pia a, a nungzuite in mihonpite mai-ah a lui uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Mihonte in ne-in a kham khit uh ciangin a khamval a neng a themte tawmkik uh a, paipel lian sagih a dim hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua an a ne mite, numei le naupang simloh, pasal cingteng mihing tulli ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh in mihonte a ciahsak khit ciangin gunkuang tungah tuangin Magadan gamah a pai hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh kiangah Farisi mite le Saddusi mite pawlkhat a hong pai uh hi. Amaute in Jesuh a mawhsak theih nading uh a deihna-in Pasian tawh a kipawl ahihna a lah nadingin lim khat a lah ding a ngen uh hi.","title":"Lim Ngetna (Mrk 8:11-13 ; Luk 12:54-56)","ref":"Mat 12:38; Luk 11:16"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Ni a tum khit nitak ciangin, ‘Van san ahih manin khua pha ding hi,’ na ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Zingsang hun ciangin, ‘Van sanin khua niim ahih manin guah zu ding hi,’ na ci thei uh hi. Farisi-te le Saddusi-te’ silngo hoihtakin kidawm un,” a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bangin thu a gen ciangin anlum a kisawh silngo thu a gen hi loin, Farisi-te le Saddusi-te’ thuhilhna a gen ahihlam a phawk pan uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Sisaria Filippi gam a tun uh ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mite in Mihing’ Tapa kei kua hi hong ci uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Peter in Jesuh’ Thu A Genna (Mrk 8:27-30 ; Luk 9:18-21)"},"14":{"text":"Amaute in, “Pawlkhat in Tuiphumpa Johan hi, hong ci uh hi; pawlkhat in Elijah hi, hong ci uh hi; pawlkhat in Jeremiah ahih kei leh kamsang khat peuhpeuh hi ding hi, hong ci uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.","ref":"Mat 14:1-2; Mrk 6:14-15; Luk 9:7-8"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Tua ahihleh note in kei kua hi hong ci na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"16":{"text":"Simon Peter in, “Nang pen a nungta Pasian’ Tapa, Khrih na hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Joh 6:68-69"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Jonah’ tapa Simon aw, hoih mahmah hi. Hih thu, leitung pilna tawh na theihtawm hi lo a, vantungah a om ka Pa in nangma tungah hong hilh ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ke’n kong genin-ah: Nang pen suangneu a cihnopna Peter na hi hi. Hih suangpi tungah ka pawlpi ka lam ding a, sihna nangawn in zo zo ngei lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Vantung ki-ukna sung lut nading tawhtangte, nangma tungah ka hong pia ding a, hih leitungah hoih lo na cihte, vantungah zong a hoih lo hi ding a, hih leitungah hoih hi na cihte, vantungah zong a hoih hi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 18:18; Joh 20:23"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah Khrih ahih lamtak, kuama kiangah a gen loh nadingun a nungzuite kiangah khauhtakin thu a pia hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun a kipanin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Jerusalem khua-ah ka pai ding hi. Nang tungah hih bang piang thei ngei peuhmah lo ding hi,” ci-in a taii bawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh kihei-in Peter kiangah, “Satan aw, ka nungah om in. Hih na ngaihsutnate Pasian’ ngaihsutna hi loin mihingte’ ngaihsutna ahih manin ka lam a hong khaktan ding a suak hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mi khatpeuh ka nungzui a suahnop leh, ama deihna bangin gamta nawn loin, a singlamteh kisuanin hong zui ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:38; Luk 14:27"},"25":{"text":"Hih a leitung nuntakna a hu nuamte in a nuntakna bulpi nangawn tawh suplawh ding a, keima hangin hih a leitung nuntakna a suplawhte in a nuntakna bulpi huzo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; Luk 17:33; Joh 12:25"},"26":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in hih leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin a nuntakna bulpi suplawh leh bang phattuamna om ahi hiam? A nuntakna bang tawh leikik thei nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"A Pa’ minthanna vang le a vantung mite tawh Mihing Tapa hong paikik ding a, mi khempeuh amau’ gamtatna ciat tawh a kizui-in a thuk ding hi.","ref":"Mat 25:31; La 62:12; Rom 2:6"},"28":{"text":"Hih lai-a a om mi pawlkhatte a sih ma-in Mihing Tapa, Kumpi-in hong pai ding ahih lamtak phawkkhial kei un,” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawh ni guk ciangin Jesuh in Peter, James le a nau Johan-te samin mual sang khat dawnah a tuamin a paipih hi.","title":"Mel Kikheelna (Mrk 9:2-13 ; Luk 9:28-36)"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai mun panin amaute’ muhtangpi mahin Jesuh a mel kikheel a, a maitang ni bangin taangin, a puante khuavak bangin a ngo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua lai-ah Moses le Elijah hong omvat uh a, Jesuh tawh a kiho a mu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter in Jesuh kiangah, “Topa aw, hih lai-ah i om, nuam mahmah hi. Hoih na sak leh, nang a’ ding buk khat, Moses a’ ding buk khat, Elijah a’ ding buk khat, buk thum ka hong lamsak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin a pau laitakun meiingo hong kaai vatin amaute hong khuh a, tua meii lak panin aw khat hong ging vatin, “Hih pa pen ka it, ka lung a kim mahmahna ka Tapa ahi hi. Ama thu na ngai un,” a hong ci hi.","ref":"Pian 22:2; La 2:7; Isa 42:1; Mat 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; Thkna 18:15; 2Pe 1:17-18"},"6":{"text":"Nungzuite in hih awging a zak uh ciangin leilakah boksuk uh a, lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh hong pai-in amaute va lawng a, “Tho un, lau kei un,” a va ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute a khuadak uh ciangin Jesuh simloh kuamah dang a mu nawn kei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Mualtung panin amaute a ciahsuk laitakun Jesuh in nungzuite kiangah, “Sihna panin Mihing Tapa a kithawhkiksak matengin hih na muhte uh kuama kiangah gen kei un,” ci-in thu a pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Bang hangin Thukham hilh siate in, Elijah hong pai masa ding hi, ci uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.","ref":"Mal 4:5"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na khempeuh a bawlkhol dingin Elijah hong pai masa takpi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Elijah hong pai khin napi-in mite in amah thei lo uh ahih manin a ututun a bawl uh hi. Tua mah bangin Mihing Tapa in zong bawlsiatna thuak ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mat 11:14"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Tuiphumpa Johan’ thu a gen ahih lamtak nungzuite in a thei uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihonte omna a tunkik uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah mi khat hong pai-in ama mai-ah hong khukdin a,","title":"Jesuh in Dawivei Naupang Damsak (Mrk 9:14-29 ; Luk 9:37-43)"},"15":{"text":"“Topa aw, nong hehpihna-in ka tapa hong damsak in. Meikhuk sungah ahi a, tui sungah ahi zongin a puk zel hi."},"16":{"text":"Na nungzuite kiangah ka paipih hangin amaute in damsak thei lo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Upna nei lo, a ngaihsun khial mite aw, note bang tanvei hong ompih ding a, bang tanvei hong kikholhpih ding ka hi hiam? A naupang hong paipih un,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in tua naupang’ sung panin dawi a paikhiat nadingin thu pia a, a naupang thakhatin a dampah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin amau guak a om laitakun nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Bang hangin kote in tua dawi hawlkhia thei lo ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin"},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na upna uh a cingtaak lohna hang ahi hi. Ahi taktakin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Ankam tang cia bang upna na neih nak-uhleh, hih mual kiangah, ‘Hih lai panin hua lai-ah kin in,’ ci le-uhcin kinkhia ding hi. Na hih theih loh uh khat zong om lo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 21:21; Mrk 11:23; 1Kor 13:2"},"21":{"text":"Thungetna le antanna tawh lobuang, thudang tawh hih bangte kihawlkhia thei lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Galilee gam sungah a om laitakin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mihingte khut sungah Mihing Tapa kipia ding a,","title":"Jesuh in A Sih ding Genkhol Kik (Mrk 9:30-32 ; Luk 9:43-45)"},"23":{"text":"mite in a that ding uh hi. Tua thu a zak uh ciangin nungzuite a dah mahmah uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Kapernaum khua-ah a tun uh ciangin biakinn siahdongte in Peter kiangah, “Na siapa in biakinn siah hamu a piak ngei mah ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin,","title":"Biakinn Siah Piakna","ref":"Pai 30:13; 38:26"},"25":{"text":"“A piak ngei mah ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Innsungah Peter a lut ciangin Jesuh in na paupih masa zaw a, “Simon aw, nang na bangci ngaihsut hiam? Leitung kumpite in kuate tung panin siah kai ahi uh hiam? Amau tate tung panin siah kai ahi uh hiam, tua ahih kei leh midangte tung panin kai ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"26":{"text":"Peter in, “Midangte tung panin siah a kai uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tua ahihleh siah piak ding panin a tate a peng ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin amau’ nasepna a nawngkaisak i suahkhak loh nadingin tuili-ah nga siahna sikkawi va khia inla, a awk masa penpen hong kaikhia in. Tua a ngasa kam sung en lecin dangka tang peek khat na om ding hi. Tua sum la inla, ei tegel a dingin biakinn siah va pia in,” a ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua laitakin Jesuh kiangah nungzuite hong pai uh a, “Vantung ki-ukna sungah kua lianpen ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin,","title":"Kua Lianpen Hiam? (Mrk 9:33-37 ; Luk 9:46-48)","ref":"Luk 22:24"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in naupang khat samin amaute mai-ah dingsak a,"},"3":{"text":"“A man mahmahin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Note kikheelin naupang na bat kei uhleh vantung ki-ukna sungah na lut ngei kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Mrk 10:15; Luk 18:17"},"4":{"text":"Hih naupang bangin a kiniamkhiat mite, vantung ki-ukna sungah a lianpen hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima min hangin hih bang naupang khat a limbawl mi in kei zong hong limbawl ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Ahi zongin kei a hong um hih naupangnote khatpeuh a khialsak mi pen a ngawngah an gawina suang lianpi khat kikhihin tuipi thuk sungah kikhiasuk le ama a dingin hoihzaw thampek ding hi.","title":"Khialh nading Ze-etnate (Mrk 9:42-48 ; Luk 17:1-2)"},"7":{"text":"“Tua bangin mi a khialsak thei ding om ahih manin leitung mite a dingin a dahhuai mahmah thu ahi hi. Tua bang pen a piang tawntung ding hi a, ahi zongin tua bangin khialhna a piangsak mite a dingin dahhuai pha mahmah diak hi."},"8":{"text":"“Na khut ahi a, na khe in ahi zongin hong khialhsak leh sattan inla paikhia in. Meikuang tawntung sungah khut kim khe kimin hong kikhiat sangin nuntakna sungah khut sam khe samin lut lecin nang a dingin hoihzaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat 5:30"},"9":{"text":"Na mit in hong khialhsak leh khelkhia inla paikhia in. Mit kim nei-in hell khuk sungah hong kikhul sangin mit langkhat bek tawh nuntakna sungah lut lecin nang a dingin hoihzaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat 5:29"},"10":{"text":"“Hih naupangnote khatpeuh na simmawhkhak loh nadingun kidawm un. Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Amaute a kem vantung mite pen vantungah ka Pa kiangah om tawntung uh hi.","title":"Tuu Mang Thugentehna (Luk 15:3-7)"},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Mihing Tapa pen a mangthang mite a hon dingin a hong pai ahi hi.","ref":"Luk 19:10"},"12":{"text":"Note in bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam? Mi khat in tuu zakhat nei hen la, a tuute khat mang leh, mualtungah a gamta adang sawmkua le kuate nusia-in tua a mang pen a zong dingin kuankhia ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Tua a mang tuu a muh ciangin a mang lo tuu sawmkua le kuate tungah a lungdamna sangin a mang pen tungah a lungdamna lianzaw hi lo ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Tua mah bangin vantungah a om na Pa un hih naupangnote khat zong a sih ding a deih kei hi."},"15":{"text":"“Na sanggamte uh na tung uhah hong khialh leh pai-in no tegel bek theihin a khialhna va gen un. Na thu uh a hong man’ leh na sanggampa uh a ngahkik na hi uh hi.","title":"Sanggam A Khial pa (Luk 17:3)","ref":"Luk 17:3"},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin na thu uh a hong mannop kei leh, Lai Siangtho sungah, ‘Mi nih ahih kei leh mi thum’ theihna bek tawh mawhsakna khat peuhpeuh man pan hi,’ a cih mah bangin midang khat ahi a, nih ahi zongin tonpih un.","ref":"Thkna 19:15"},"17":{"text":"Amah in tua mite’ thu a mannop kei leh pawlpite tungah a thu ko un. Sagihvei dongtak maisak ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin","title":"Mawhna a Maisak Nuam lo Nasempa Thugentehna"},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Sagihvei ciangbek maisak in kong ci kei hi. Sawm sagih mun sagihvei maisak in kong ci hi.","ref":"Luk 17:3-4; Pian 4:24"},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh vantung ki-ukna zia pen a nasemte in sum bangzah a ba hiam, ci-in a sazian a en kumpipa’ hihna zia tawh kibang hi."},"24":{"text":"Kumpipa in a sum ba sazian a et a kipat ciangin ama sum mak tampi a ba nasem khat hong kipaipih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua nasempa in a sum lohzo lo ahih manin amah a kipan a zi a tate le a neih khempeuh zuakin a leiba a loh nadingin kumpipa in thu a pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a nasempa zong a mai-ah hong bokin thum a, ‘Topa aw, hong ngak lai in; a vekpi-in ka hong loh ding hi,’ ci-in a thum hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in khasiathuai sa ahih manin a leiba teng maisakin a khah hi."},"28":{"text":"“Ahi zongin tua nasempa a paikhiat ciangin ama sum ngun peek zakhat khawng a ba a naseppih dang khat tawh a kituak hi. Tua pa a gawlin manin, ‘Na leiba hong loh in,’ a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"A naseppih pa zong a mai-ah bokin hong thum a, ‘Hong ngak lai in; ka hong loh ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin ama thumna sang nuam lo hi. A leiba a lohkhit matengin thongah a kia dingin a khumsak hi."},"31":{"text":"A naseppih dangte in hih thupiang a theih uh ciangin dahhuaisa mahmah uh ahih manin, a thupiang khempeuh kumpipa kiangah a ko uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in tua nasempa sam a, ‘A gilo nasempa aw, kei kiangah hong thum na hih manin na leiba khempeuh ka hong maisak hi."},"33":{"text":"Nang ka hong hehpih mah bangin na naseppih pa zong na hehpih ding kilawm hi lo ahi hiam?’ a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Kumpipa zong a heh suak ahih manin a leiba khempeuh a lohkhit matengin thong sungah a kikhum nadingin thu a pia hi."},"35":{"text":"“Tua mah bangin note in zong na lungsim uhah na sanggamte uh mawhna na maisaknop kei uhleh vantungah a om ka Pa in note tungah zong tua bangmahin a hong bawl ding ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a thugen a man khit ciangin Galilee gam panin paikhia-in Judea gam Jordan gun galkhatah a pai hi.","title":"Kimakna tawh kisai Jesuh’ Genna (Mrk 10:1-12 ; Luk 16:18)"},"2":{"text":"Mihon tampi in amah zui uh a, tua munah cinate a damsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Farisi mite pawlkhat Jesuh kiangah hong pai uh a, amah a mawhsak theih nading uh a deihna-un, “Thu khat peuhpeuh hangin zi maktheih ding mah ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Lai Siangtho sungah, ‘A kipat cil-in a Piangsak pa in numei le pasal a bawl hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Pian 1:27; 5:2"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin, ‘Hih thu hangin pasal in a nu le a pa nusia-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a, amau tegel pumkhat a bang ding uh hi,’ ci-in na kigelh hi.","ref":"Pian 2:24"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amaute nih hi nawn loin khat ahi ta uh hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian in a gawmsa mite, kuamah in khen kei ta hen,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Farisi mite in, “Tua ahihleh bang hangin Moses in mi khatpeuh makna lai gelh sakin a zi masak thei ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin","ref":"Thkna 24:1-4; Mat 5:31"},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Note, hilhzawhin na om loh manun Moses in hih bangin ngeina a omsak thei ahi hi. Ahi zongin a kipat cil-in tua bang na hi lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Mi khatpeuh in midang tawh a zi a mawhna lobuang, a zi a mak a, numei dang tawh a ten leh numei tunga mawh ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mat 5:32; 1Kor 7:10-11"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Nupa thu tua bang ding ahihleh kiteng vet kei lehang hoihzaw ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Hih ngeina pen mi khempeuh in a zuihzawh ding hi lo a, Pasian in a tuaci dingin a sehte bek in a zuizo ding uh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat a pianpihin gehsa bang om a, pawlkhatte a kigettawm om a, pawlkhatte pen vantung ki-ukna hangin geh bangin a om hi. Geh bangin a omzote om ta hen,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi pawlkhat in a naupangte uh tungah Jesuh in a khut nga-in thu a ngetsak nading deihin a naupangte uh a hong paipih uh hi. Ahi zongin a nungzuite in tua mite na taii uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Naupangnote Thupha Pia (Mrk 10:13-16 ; Luk 18:15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Vantung ki-ukna pen naupangte tawh a kibang mite a’ ding ahih manin, tua naupangte ka kiangah hong paipihsak unla, khaktan kei un,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in naupangnote tungah a khut nga-in thupha a piak khit ciangin a paikhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Khatvei, Jesuh kiangah mi khat hong pai a, “Sia aw, nuntak tawntungna ka ngah nadingin bang gamtat hoih gamta ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a hong dong hi.","title":"A Hau Tangvalpa (Mrk 10:17-31 ; Luk 18:18-30)"},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Bang hangin bang hoih hiam cih thu hong dong na hi hiam? Nuntak tawntungna sungah na lutnop leh thukhamte na zui in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in, “Bang thukhamte ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Jesuh in, “Mi that kei in; numei tungah mawh kei in; mi neihsa gu kei in; zuauthu gen kei in;","ref":"Pai 20:13-16; Thkna 5:17-20"},"19":{"text":"na nu na pa zahtak in; nang na ki-it bangin na vengte na it in, cihnate ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 20:12; Thkna 5:16; Siam 19:18"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin tangvalpa in, “Hihte khempeuh ka zuihsa ahi hi; bang kisam lai ding ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin"},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mi cingtaak na hihnop leh pai-in na neihsate va zuak inla, na sum khotte, mizawngte tungah va pia lecin, vantungah sum na hau ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang ngah ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"28":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Ke’n limtak a kong genin-ah: A hong tung ding hun thak sungah a minthanna tokhom tungah Mihing Tapa a tut hun ciangin kei a hong zui note zong, tokhom sawm le nihte tung mahah tu-in Israel minam sawm le nihte tungah thukhenin na om ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 25:31; Luk 22:30"},"29":{"text":"Keima hangin a inn, a sanggam numei, a sanggam pasal, a nu, a pa, a tate, a leitang, khat peuhpeuh a nusiate in a zah zakhat ngahkikin, nuntak tawntungna zong a ngah ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuhun laitakin a lian mi tampite tua hun ciangin a neu suak ding a, tuhun laitakin a neu tampite tua hun ciangin a lian hi ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 20:16; Luk 13:30"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh vantung ki-ukna sung omzia pen a leenggah lo-ah na a sem ding a cial dingin zing tungin a kuankhia leenggah lo nei pa tawh kibang hi.","title":"Leenggah Lo-ah Nasemte"},"2":{"text":"Ni tha ngeina ngun peek khat piak dingin a kithukim khit uh ciangin a leenggah lo-ah na a sem dingin pawlkhat a kuansak hi."},"3":{"text":"Zingsang nai kua hun ciangin mihon omna sumbukah pai leuleu a, mi pawlkhat bangmah sem loin a mawk om a muh ciangin,"},"4":{"text":"‘No zong leenggah lo-ah va kuan un; a kilawm zah khat ka hong pia ding hi,’ a cih ciangin pawlkhat a kuan uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin sun sawm le nih ciangin pawlkhat cial leuleu a, nitak nai thum ciangin pawlkhat a cial lai hi."},"6":{"text":"Nitak nai nga ciangin mihon omna sumbukah a pai leh mi pawlkhat a mawk om mu ahih manin, ‘Bang hangin bangmah sem loin sunthapai mawk om na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in a dot ciangin"},"7":{"text":"amaute in, ‘Kuamah in nasem dingin hong cial lo hi,’ ci-in a dawng uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, ‘No zong leenggah lo-ah va kuan un,’ a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nitak ciangin lo nei pa in a nuai-a nasem ukpa kiangah, ‘Lo khote sam inla, a kicial nunung pen a kipanin a kicial masa pente dongin a ni tha uh pia in,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Siam 19:13; Thkna 24:15"},"9":{"text":"Nitak nai nga hunin a kipan nasemte ngun peek khat ciat kipia hi."},"10":{"text":"A kuan masa pente, ni tha sang dingin hong pai uh ciangin adangte sangin tam ngahzaw ding ci-in amau kilamen napi-in amaute zong ngun peek khat ciat mah kipia veve hi."},"11":{"text":"A sum a san uh ciangin lo nei pa tungah phun uh a,"},"12":{"text":"‘A nunungte in nai khat sung bek sem napi-in, sunthapai-in nisa thuakin na a sem kote tawh na kikimsak hi,’ a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin lo nei pa in amaute khat kiangah, ‘Lawm aw, nang ka hong khem het kei hi. Ni khat sung nasep thaman dingin ngun peek khat piak dingin na thukimsa hi lo ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Hih na thalawhsa sum la inla ciah in. Nang ka hong piakzah mah, hih a kicial nunungte tungah zong ka pia nuam hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima sum pen keima ut bangin ka zattheih ding hi lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih kei leh kei ka cit manin na heh suak ahi hiam?’ a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a neute lian ding a, a liante neu ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 19:30; Mrk 10:31; Luk 13:30"},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem khua manawhin Jesuh a paitoh laitakin, a paikawmun sawm le nihte tawh tuamtonin thu genpih a,","title":"Jesuh in A Sih ding A Thumveina Genkhol (Mrk 10:32-34 ; Luk 18:31-34)"},"18":{"text":"“Tu-in Jerusalem khua-ah a paito ding ihi hi. Ahi zongin a ni thum ni-in kihing kiksak ding hi,” ci-in a tuamin thu a hilh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zebedi tate James le Johan’ nu, a ta tegel tawh Jesuh kiangah hong pai-in a mai-ah khukdinin hong thum hi.","title":"Nupi Khat’ Ngetna (Mrk 10:35-45)"},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in tua nupi kiangah, “Bang deih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin amah in, “Kumpi-in na om ciangin hih ka tate khat na taklamah, khat na veilamah a tut nadingin thu pia lecin ka ut hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Na nget uh na thei kei uh hi. Ka thuak ding gimna note in thuakzo ding na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, “Ka thuakzo ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Keima thuak mah bangin note in na thuak takpi ding uh a, ahi zongin ka taklam le ka veilama tutding pen kei’ hong piaktheih hi lo hi. Ka Pa in a sehsa mite a’ ding bek ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Nungzui dang sawmte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin hih unau nihte tungah a heh uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute sam a, “Mi a uk Gentail-te in mite tungah aana nei uh a, mi a makai Gentail-te in thuneihna tawh a ukna thu na thei uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin note lakah tua bang hi lo ding hi. Ahi zongin amaute kiko pha semsem uh a, “David’ suan Topa aw, kote hong hehpih in,” a ci teitei uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh khawlin amaute sam a, “Bang ka hong hihsak ding deih na hi uh hiam?” a cih ciangin"},"33":{"text":"amaute in, “Topa aw, ka mit uh khua hong musakkik in,” a ci uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute hehpihhuai sa ahih manin a mit uh lawnsak a, thakhat thu-in a mit un khua a mukik pah hi. Tua ciangin amau tegel in zong Jesuh nung a zuipah uh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khuanai, Bethfage khua a omna Oliv Mual a tun uh ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite nih ma sawl a,","title":"Gualzawhna tawh Jerusalem-a Lutna (Mrk 11:1-11 ; Luk 9:28-40 ; Joh 12:12-19)"},"2":{"text":"“Mai-a a om khua-ah va pai un. Kiniamkhiatna tawh lapi tung le lano tungah tuangin hong pai hi, ci-in Zion khuamite kiangah gen un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Zek 9:9"},"6":{"text":"Nungzui tegel zong Jesuh sawl bangin va pai uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in a la nuta hong paipih uh a, a tungah a puante uh a phah khit uh ciangin Jesuh a tuang hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihon tampite in ama pai nading lampi-ah a puante uh na phah uh a, adangte in nisuh hiangte satin lampi-ah a na phah uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A mai-a pai mihonte le a nunga zui mihonte awng uh a, “David’ suan Jesuh in phatna ngah ta hen! Lai Siangtho sungah, ‘Naungekte le naupangte’ kam tawh a cingtaak phatna na gen sak hi,’ a cihna thu sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"La 8:2"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute nusia a, khuapi sung pan paikhia-in Bethany khua-ah a giak hi."},"18":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin khuapi zuanin hong paikik laitakin Jesuh a gil a kial hi.","title":"Theikung A Kisamsiatna (Mrk 11:12-14 , 20-26)"},"19":{"text":"Lam gei-ah theikung khat mu ahih manin a gei-ah va pai a, ahi zongin a teh simloh bangmah a mu kei hi. Na hong dawn nak-uhleh kei zong kua thu tawh bawl cih ka hong gen ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Johan in tuiphum theih nading thu koi lai panin ngah ahi hiam? Pasian kiang panin thu ngah ahi hiam, ahih kei leh mihingte kiang panin thu ngah ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute khatlekhat kiseel uh a, “Pasian kiang pan hi,” ci lehang, “Bang hangin um lo na hi uh hiam?” hong ci ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin, “Mihingte kiang pan hi,” ci leuleu lehang, mi khempeuh in Johan pen kamsang hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin mihonte i kihta zel hi, kici uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jesuh kiangah, “Ka thei kei uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi. Jesuh in zong amaute kiangah, “Kei zong hih nate, kua thu tawh ka bawl cih ka hong gen kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Note in bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?
