Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Note kiangah a mantak a kong genin-ah: Pasian’ ukna sungah note sangin siahdongte le numei paktatte lut masazaw ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note kiangah Tuiphumpa Johan hong pai-in thuman lampi hong lak napi-in na um kei uh a, ahi zongin siahdongte le numei paktatte in a um uh hi. Hih thu na theih khit uh ciang nangawnin na lungsim uh na kheel nuam tuan kei uh a, na um kei veve uh hi.","ref":"Luk 3:12; 7:29-30"},"33":{"text":"“Thugentehna dang khat na ngai lai un. Mi khat in lo zuanin leenggui suan a, a kimkot umin, leenggah cil nading bawl a, a honna ding tausang khat a lam khit ciangin lo khawhlawhte khawhlawh sakin gam dangah a pai hi.","title":"Leenggah Lo le A Khote Thugentehna (Mrk 12:1-12 ; Luk 20:9-19)","ref":"Isa 5:1-2"},"34":{"text":"Leenggah min hun a tun ciangin ama ngah ding teng a va la dingin lo khawhlawhte kiangah a nasemte a paisak hi."},"35":{"text":"Lo khawhlawhte in a nasemte na manin khat na satgawp uh a, khat na thatin, khat suang tawh na denggawp uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin lo nei pa in a masa-a sangin nasem a tamzaw va paisak leuleu a, ahi zongin a masa-a mah bangin a nasemte a na bawlsia veve uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin ka tapa paisak leng na zahtak ding uh hi, ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin a tapa a paisak hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi zongin lo khawhlawhte in a tapa a muh uh ciangin, ‘Hih pa pen a gamhluah ding pa ahi hi. Hong pai un; amah thatin a luah dingteng eite inla ni,’ a kici uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amah manin that uh a, lo nawlah a paai uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin leenggah lo nei pa hong pai ciangin a lo khawhlawhte bangci bawl ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"41":{"text":"Amaute in, “Tua migilote thatgawp ding a, a hun hunin leenggah a pia ding lo khawhlawh dangte khosak ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Lai Siangtho sungah, ‘Innlamte in a nilkhiat suang pen innkiu suang bulpi suak khinta hi. Hih pen Topa’ bawl hi a, i muh ciangin lamdang i sa hi,’ ci-in a kigelhna sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"La 118:22-23"},"43":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Note pen Pasian hong ki-uksak nawn lo ding a, a kilawmin a gamta ding mite bek Pasian in uk ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Hih suang tungah a kia mi khempeuh kizan gawp ding a, mi khatpeuh tungah tua suang a kiat leh zong dengzan gawp ding hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Siampi liante le Farisi mite in hih thugentehna a zak uh ciangin amaute a cihnopna-in a gen ahihlam a phawk uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh a man dingin kithawi uh a, ahi zongin mihonte in kamsang khatin ngaihsun uh ahih manin mihonte a kihtak manun a man ngam kei uh hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna dang khat zangin thu hilh a,","title":"Mopawi Thugentehna (Luk 14:15-24)"},"2":{"text":"“Vantung ki-ukna zia pen a tapa a dingin mo pawi a bawl kumpipa’ gamtatzia tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Mopawi siim dingin a khohsa mite a sam dingin a nasemte sawl a, ahi zongin kuamah pai lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin nasem dangte sawl leuleu a, ‘Ka khohsaksa mite kiangah hih bangin va gen un: Ka bawngtalte le ka bawngno thaute kigo khin a, nitak an a minsa-in a om banah, na khempeuh a mansa-in om khinta hi. Mopawi an ne dingin hong pai ta un, ci hi, ci-in va gen un,’ a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin a khohsa mite in na thusim lo uh a, pawlkhat in lo na kuansanin, pawlkhat in a sumbukah na paisanin,"},"6":{"text":"adangte in a nasemte manin a na satgawp khit uh ciangin a na that uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa zong heh mahmah a, a galkapte kuansakin tua mi thatte a thahsak khit ciangin a khua a haltumsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nasemte kiangah, ‘Mopawi an a baihsa-in om a, ahi zongin ka sap mite a ne dingin a kilawm lo mi a suak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih manin lamlianpi-ah va pai unla, mi na muh zahzah uh hong sam un,’ a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Nasemte zong lamlianpi-ah va pai uh a, mihoih mi hoih lo ci loin a muh khempeuh uh va kaikhawm uh ahih manin mo pawi bawlna innsung dimin leengla hong om hi."},"11":{"text":"“Kumpipa, a leenglate a en dingin a hong lut ciangin mo pawi siimna puan a silhlo mi khat a mu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama kiangah, ‘Lawm aw, mo pawi siimna puan silhlopi-in hih lai-ah hong bangci luttheih na hi hiam?’ a cih ciangin tua mipa in a cih nading a thei kei hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a nasemte kiangah, ‘A khut a khe hen unla, pualam khuamialna lakah lawnkhia un; tua lai-ah kapin a hagawi ding hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 8:12; 25:30; Luk 13:28"},"14":{"text":"“Bang hang hiam cih leh mi tampi a kisap hangin tawm bek a kiteel hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Farisi mite paikhia uh a, a kampauna tawh Jesuh a mat theih nadingun thu a kikum uh hi.","title":"Sisar’ Tungah Siah Piakna (Mrk 12:13-17 ; Luk 20:19-26)"},"16":{"text":"Amau’ nungzuite le Herod mi pawlkhat, Jesuh kiangah a paisak uh hi. Amaute in, “Sia aw, thu ahi bang a gen tawntung na hihna thu ka thei uh hi. Mite kuamah zahtaktuam nei lo na hih manin midangte’ pau ding bangmah phamawhsa loin Pasian in mite’ gamtat ding a deihna bangin tangtakin thu na hilh tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Rom kumpipa Sisar tungah siah i piak ding kilawm hiam, na ngaihsutna nong gen nadingin ka deih uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in amau’ gitloh geelna thei ahih manin, “Mihoih a kineihkhem mite aw, bang hangin kei hong thangsiah se na hi uh hiam?"},"19":{"text":"Siahin na piak ding uh sum hong lak dih un,” a cih ciangin sumtang peek khat hong paipih uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Hih sum tungah kua lim le kua min om ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"21":{"text":"amaute in, “Sisar’ lim le a min kigelh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Sisar’ nate Sisar’ tungah na pia unla, Pasian’ nate Pasian’ tungah na pia un,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin lamdangsa mahmah uh a, ama kiang panin a paikhia uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni mahin, misite thawhkikna om lo hi, ci-in a um Saddusi mite pawlkhat Jesuh kiangah hong pai uh a,","title":"Thawhkikna Thu Dotna (Mrk 12:18-27 ; Luk 20:27-40)","ref":"Sawl 23:8"},"24":{"text":"“Sia aw, Moses in, ‘Mi khat ta nei loin a sih leh tua a si mipa’ khang a kizop theih nadingin a naupa in a u’ zi luah ta hen,’ ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5"},"25":{"text":"Tu-in kote lakah unau pasal sagih om ngei hi. A u pen in zi nei a, ta nei loin si ahih manin ama zi a naupa in a luah hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua mah bangin a nihna, a thumna a kipan a sagihna dongin ta nei loin a si uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua unau pasal sagihte a sih khit ciangin a numei zong a si hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua unau pasal sagihte in tua nu tenpihkim uh ahih manin, thawhkik hun ciangin a koi pen’ zi hi ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Note in Lai Siangtho thu ahi a, Pasian’ vangliatna ahi zongin thei lo na hih manun na ngaihsunkhial uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh misite a thawhkik uh ciangin vantungah a om vantung mite tawh kibang ding uh a, zinei pasalnei cih om lo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Misite thawhkikna thu tawh kisai-in note tungah a gen thute sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Pasian in, ‘Kei pen Abraham’ Pasian, Isaac’ Pasian, Jakob’ Pasian ka hi hi,’ ci hi. Pasian pen a si mite’ Pasian hi loin a nungta mite’ Pasian ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 3:6"},"33":{"text":"Mihonte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin ama thuhilhna hangin lamdang a sa uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi zongin Farisi mite in, Saddusi mite’ thudotna Jesuh in dongkhakin, Saddusi mite in a cih nading mel uh a theih nawn lohna thu a zak uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah a hong pai uh hi.","title":"Thukham Lianpen (Mrk 12:28-34 ; Luk 10:25-28)"},"35":{"text":"Amaute sung panin Thukham hilh siate khat in Jesuh a thangsiahna-in thu hong dong a,"},"36":{"text":"“Sia aw, thukham khempeuh sung panin bang thukham lianpen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na Topa Pasian na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh, le na pilna khempeuh tawh na it ding hi, cihna ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:5"},"38":{"text":"Hih pen a masapen, a lianpen thukham ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"A nihna pen a masa mah tawh kibang a, nangma pumpi na it bangin na vengte na it in, cihna ahi hi.","ref":"Siam 19:18"},"40":{"text":"Hih thukham nihte tung panin thukham dang khempeuh le kamsangte’ thuhilhna khempeuh a hong meengkhia ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Luk 10:25-28"},"41":{"text":"Tua bangin Farisi mite hong kikaihkhop laitakin Jesuh in amaute kiangah,","title":"David’ Suan tawh kisai Thudotna (Mrk 12:35-37 ; Luk 20:41-44)"},"42":{"text":"“Note in Khrih kua hi ci a, kua’ suan hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, “David’ suan hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Tua ahihleh bang hangin David mahmah in Pasian’ Kha’ sawlna tawh,"},"44":{"text":"‘Topa in keima Topa tungah thu gen a: Na galte, na khe nuai-ah ka koih matengin ka taklamah na tu in,’ ci hi, ci-in thu na gen a, Khrih pen ka Topa ci ahi hiam?","ref":"La 110:1"},"45":{"text":"David in Khrih pen Topa ci ahihleh bang hangin Khrih pen David’ suan hi thei ding ahi hiam?” ci-in thu a dong hi."},"46":{"text":"Kuamah in ama thudotna kamkhat beek dawng thei lo uh hi. Tua hun a kipanin kuamah in Jesuh kiangah thu a dong ngam nawn kei uh hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in mihonte le a nungzuite kiangah thu gen a,","title":"Jesuh in Thukham Hilh Siate le Farisi Mite Mawhsak (Mrk 12:38-40 ; Luk 11:37-54 ; 20:45-47)"},"2":{"text":"“Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite, Moses’ aana a nei-in thugente ahih manun,"},"3":{"text":"amaute’ gen khempeuh zui-in sem unla, ahi zongin amaute pen a gen bangun gamta lo uh ahih manin amaute’ gamtat bangin gamta kei un."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in midangte tungah vangik mahmah suanin khihcip uh a, ahi zongin tua van a puakpih dingin a khutmeno khat nangawn uh a taangsak nuam kei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in a sepna khempeuh uh mite’ muhtheih dingin a hih se uh hi. Amaute in a talsuan le a banbulhte uh a gol pipi-in bawlin, a puanmongteep uh a sau theithei-in a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Mat 6:1; Gam 15:38; Thkna 6:8"},"6":{"text":"Pawi sungah a om uh ciangin uliante’ tutna dinga a kibawl munah tunuam se uh a, kikhopna inn sungah zong uliante tutna tutphah nuampente tungah a tunuam diak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihon lakah mite in hopihin, ‘Sia aw,’ a cih ding uh a ut uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin note pen, ‘Sia,’ na kicih ding uh hi lo hi. Sia khat bek na nei uh a, no adangte khempeuh unau khat na hi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Vantungah Pa khat bek nei na hih manun leitungah kuamah dang, Pa, na ci kei un."},"10":{"text":"Topa dingin Khrih bek nei na hih manun note khatlekhat, ‘Topa,’ na kici kei un."},"11":{"text":"Note lakah a lianpen pa, na nasem uh hi ding hi.","ref":"Mat 20:26-27; Mrk 9:35; 10:43-44; Luk 22:26"},"12":{"text":"A kiliansakte khempeuh in niamkhiatna thuak ding uh a, a kiniamkhiatte khempeuh a lianin kibawl ding hi.","ref":"Luk 14:11; 18:14"},"13":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in vantung ki-ukna sungah mite a lut theih loh nadingin kong na khakcip uh hi. Note lah na lutnuam kei uh a, a lutnuamte lah na lutsak kei uh hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Meigong numeite tungah nuamtak sa-in a neihsa teng uh laksakin na zangmang uh a, mite in mihoih hong saktheih nading na deihna-un thu saupipi na ngen uh hi. Hih bangin na gamtatna uh hangin na gim thuak ding uh nasiazaw kan lai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in mi khat bek nangawn na ngah zawh nading uh na hanciamna un leitung tuitung lumletin khual na zin uh a, na ngahsunte uh zong note zah nihin a siahuai, hell khuk tung ding mi na suah uh hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mittaw a bang lamhilhte aw, note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note in, ‘Mi khat biakinn tawh a kiciam leh phamawh lo a, ahi zongin biakinn sunga a om kham tawh a kiciam leh a kiciamna in len hi,’ na ci uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Note pen mihai mittaw lamlak taktak na hi uh hi. Kham thupizaw ahi hiam, ahih kei leh tua kham a siangtho a suaksak biakinn thupizaw ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Note in, ‘Mi khat, biakna tau tawh kiciam leh phamawh lo a, ahi zongin biakna tau tungah a kipia letsongte tawh a kiciam leh a kiciamna in len hi,’ na ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mittaw mite aw, a kipia nate thupizaw ahi hiam, ahih kei leh tua nate a siangtho a suaksak biakna tau thupizaw ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin biakna tau tawh a kiciam mite pen a tunga a om nate khempeuh tawh zong a kiciam ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Biakinn tawh a kiciam mite pen a sungah a tengpa tawh zong a kiciam ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Vantung tawh a kiciam mite zong Pasian’ kumpi tokhom tawh a kiciam hi a, tua tokhom tungah a tupa tawh zong a kiciam ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 66:1; Mat 5:34"},"23":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in Pasian tungah lengmasel, masala, le kummin sing namtui a kipanin meh namtui nam khempeuh, sawm-ah-khat pia napi-in, thukham sungah a thupizaw ahi thutang, hehpihna, le thumante na don kei uh hi. Adangte nusia tuan loin hih thute na zuih ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Siam 27:30"},"24":{"text":"A makai ding hinapi-in, mittaw bangin bangmah tum loteng thupi ngaihsutin, a thupiteng na nusiakha uh a, tui tawh na dawnkhop khak loh nadingun thovai khaih napi-in kalaoh a nawmvalhkha tawh na kibang uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in hai le kuangte a pualam na siangsak uh a, ahi zongin tuate sungah, thatanghat thu le huaihamna tawh mi-a’ na suh uh nate a om hi."},"26":{"text":"A mittaw Farisi mite aw, a pualam zong a siangtho a suahtheih nadingin hai le kuang sunga a om nate a siangtho hisak phot un."},"27":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note pen leikang tawh a kizut manin a pualam a hoih mahmah tawh kibang napi-in a sungah misi guh le a kihhuai nin nam khempeuh a omna hankhuk tawh na kibang uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:3"},"28":{"text":"Tua mah bangin note zong mite’ muhin mihoih mahmah bang napi-in na sung tawng taktak uhah mawhna le kineihkhemna bek a om hi."},"29":{"text":"“Mihoih a kineihkhem, no Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in a sisa kamsangte’ han, a hoih mahmahin bawlin, a nuntakna uh a hoih, a sisate’ mualsuangte hoihtakin na zem uh a,"},"30":{"text":"‘I pu i pate’ khan lai-in eite a om hi lehang, kamsangte a thah bangun eite in i that kei ding hi,’ na ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Note pen kamsangte a that mite’ suanlekhakte mah na hih manun na zuaupi uh a gen na hi uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahih manin i pu i pate’ maban zomto vet un."},"33":{"text":"Gul a bang mite’ suanlekhak mite aw, hell khuk tun nading thukhenna panin a suakta dingin bangci-in kilamen thei na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Mat 3:7; 12:34; Luk 3:7"},"34":{"text":"Note kiangah kamsangte, mipilte, le siate ka hong paisak ding hi. Note in pawlkhatte thatin, pawl khatte singlamteh tungah khai-in, pawlkhatte na kikhopna uh inn sungah na sat ding uh a, khua khat pan khua khatah a banbanin na bawlsia ding uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua thu hangin, mawh nei lo Abel a kithah hun a kipanin biakinn le biakna tau kikal-a na thah uh, Barakhiah’ tapa Zekhariah hun ciang dongin, mawhna nei lo a kithat mite khempeuh hangin gimna note in na thuak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pian 4:8; 2Khang 24:20-21"},"36":{"text":"Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Tuhuna mite tungah hih gimna hong tung takpi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"“Jerusalem, Jerusalem aw, kamsangte na that a, Pasian’ sawl kamtaite na denglum hi. Akpi in a kha tawh a note a huai mah bangin na mite ka huainuam tawntung a, ahi zongin na ut kei hi.","title":"Jesuh in Jerusalem Khuamite Tamlawh (Luk 13:34-35)"},"38":{"text":"Tu-in na innte kisusiacip ding hi.","ref":"Jer 22:5"},"39":{"text":"Nang kiangah kong genin-ah: ‘Topa’ min tawh a hong pai mipa in thupha ngah ta hen,’ na cih hun hong tun matengin kei nong mu nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 118:26"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinn panin Jesuh a paikhiat laitakin ama kiangah a nungzuite hong pai-in, tua biakinn a thupina zia a lak uh hi.","title":"Biakinn Siat ding Jesuh’n Genkhol (Mrk 13:1-2 ; Luk 21:5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Hihte khempeuh na mu khinta uh hi. Ke’n a mantak a kong genin-ah: Hih inn lamna-a a kiciang suangte a kithuapin a om nangawn a om nawn lo zah dongin kilawnkeek mang ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Oliv Mual tungah Jesuh tu-in a om laitakin a nungzuite guak a tuamin hong pai uh a, “Hih thute cik ciangin hong piang ding a, nang na hong pai ding hun le hun bei nading bang lim hong om ding ahi hiam, hong gen in,” a ci uh hi.","title":"Gimna Kipatna (Mrk 13:3-13 ; Luk 21:7-19)"},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Kidawm unla, mite’ khemsa-in ta kei un."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah a kineih mi tampi hong pai ding a, ‘Kei, Khrih ka hi hi,’ ci-in mi tampi tak umkhialsak ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A nai, a gamla-ah galkidona thu na za ding uh hi. Hihte a piang mah ding hi a, ahi zongin a bei nading hi nai lo ahih manin patau kei un."},"7":{"text":"Gam khat le gam khat, kumpi khat le kumpi khat hong kido ding a, mun tuamtuamah kialpi hong tungin, zin hong ling ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh pen gimna kipat nading hi pan hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ciangin note hong kibawlsia-in hong kithat ding a, keima hangin Gentail mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 10:22"},"10":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin mi tampi in a upna uh khahsuah ding a, khatlekhat kimudahin khatlekhat kilehhek ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsang kineihkhem mi tampi hong piang ding a, mi tampi tak umkhialsak ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Gitlohna khang mahmah ding ahih manin ki-itna hong kiam ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin a bei dongin a thuakzote in hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 10:22"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khempeuh tungah teci ahi dingin Pasian’ hong ukna hangin a lungdamhuai thu, leitung khempeuhah kihilh ding hi. Tua khit ciangin beina hong tung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tua ciangin kamsang Daniel in, ‘A lipkhaphuai zehphitna,’ ci-in a gen pen a siangtho munah hong om ciangin (hih lai a simte in Jesuh’ cihnopna thei ta un),","title":"Gimna Lianpi (Mrk 13:14-23 ; Luk 21:20-24)","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; 12:11"},"16":{"text":"Judea gam a om mite, mualtungah tai hen la,"},"17":{"text":"inn tungah a om mite zong, inn sungah van a la dingin lut nawn kei uh hen."},"18":{"text":"Lo-ah a omte zong puan la dingin inn-ah ciah nawn kei hen.","ref":"Luk 17:31"},"19":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin naupaiite le naungek neite a dingin haksa mahmah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua galtai hun pen phalbi laitak le Sabbath ni ahih khak loh nadingin thu na ngen un."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung piancil a kipan tuhun dong, cikmahin tua bang haksatna a om ngei lo, nidang ciangin zong a om ngei nawn lo ding, tua hun laitakin hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Mang 7:14"},"22":{"text":"Pasian in tua gimna hun a ni khiam lo hileh a suaktazo kuamah om lo ding hi. Ahi zongin ama teel mite a khualna-in a ni a khiam ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tua laitakin mi khatpeuh in, ‘Hih lai-ah Khrih om hi, hua lai-ah Khrih om hi,’ ci-in hong gen leh, um kei un."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih a kineihkhemte le kamsang a kineihkhemte hong piang ding a, ahih zawh leh a teelsa mite nangawn a khem nadingun lim le nalamdang lianpipi hong bawl ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"A hun ma-in hong genkholkhin ka hih manin limtakin kidawm un."},"26":{"text":"“Tua ahih kei leh zong mite in, ‘Gamlakah Khrih om hi,’ hong cih leh zong va paikha kei un. ‘Innsungah Khrih bu hi,’ hong cih leh zong umkha kei un."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Mihing Tapa hong pai ciangin khuaphialep in van mong khat panin mong khat dong a taanzaihsak mah bangin kitheikim ding hi.","ref":"Luk 17:23-24"},"28":{"text":"“Sapul omna peuhah musane kikaikhawm ding hi.”","ref":"Luk 17:37"},"29":{"text":"“Tua gimna hun a tunkhit phetin ni hong mialin kha hong taang nawn lo ding a, vantung panin aksite hong kia ding a, vantung a om nate a pai ngei-in pai thei loin lampialgawp ding hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa Hong Paina (Mrk 13:24-27 ; Luk 21:25-28)","ref":"Isa 13:10; 34:4; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:10,31; 3:15; Mang 6:12-13"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mihing Tapa’ lim vantungah hong kilang ding hi. Tua ciangin leitung minam khempeuh dahin kap ding uh a, vangliatna le minthanna tawh meii lakah Mihing Tapa a hong pai a mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Zek 12:10-14; Mang 1:7"},"31":{"text":"Nakpi takin peengkul hong ging ding a, leitung mun khempeuhah a vantung mite hong paisakin, leimong khat pan mong khat dongin, a teelsa mite a kaikhawmsak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Thei kung tung panin thu phawk un. Thei a hiang hong meengin a teh hong no ciangin khuakhal hun hong naita hi, ci-in na thei uh hi.","title":"Thei Kung’ Thuhilhna (Mrk 13:28-31 ; Luk 21:29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Tua mah bangin hih ka thugente khempeuh na muh uh ciangin Mihing Tapa hong tun ding hun hong nai mahmah ta hi, ci-in na thei un."},"34":{"text":"A mantak a kong genin-ah: Hih lai-a a om mite a sihkhit ma-in hih ka thugen khempeuh hong tung ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Van le lei a maimang zongin ka thugente maimang ngei lo ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi zongin a ni le a nai hun ding pen kuamah in thei lo hi. Vantungah a om vantung mite ahi a, Tapa nangawn in ahi zongin thei lo a, Pa Pasian bek in thei hi.","title":"A Ni le A Nai Hun Kuamah’n Thei lo (Mrk 13:32-37 ; Luk 17:26-30 , 34-36)"},"37":{"text":"Noah hun lai-in up hun lohpi khatin tuiciin a tun bangin Mihing Tapa zong up hun lohpi khatin hong pai ding hi.","ref":"Pian 6:5-8"},"38":{"text":"Tuiciin a tun ma hunin, teembaw sungah Noah a tum ni hun ciang dong, mite in anne zune-in om uh a, mo kipi, mo kikha-in nuntak ngeina bangin om uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuiciin hong tungin tui in mi khempeuh a tupcip hun ciang dong, kuamah in bangmah a theih loh mah bangin Mihing Tapa hong pai ciangin zong kuamah in theikhol lo ding uh hi.","ref":"Pian 7:6-24"},"40":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin lo a kuankhawm mi nih, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."},"41":{"text":"An a sukhawm numei nih, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin bang hunin na Topa uh hong pai ding cih thei lo na hih manun na pilvang un."},"43":{"text":"Ahi zongin na phawk ding uh thu in: Inn nei pa in zan laitakin guta pa a pai ding hun theikhol leh amah in na pangin a inn luhsak lo ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Mihing Tapa zong, note’ upmawh loh hun laitakin hong pai ding ahih manin note zong na kiging tawntung ta un.","ref":"Luk 12:39-40"},"45":{"text":"“A pil a citak nasem i cih a bangcite ahi hiam? A naseppih dangte ukin a hun manmanin amaute’ nekzah ding ciat an a pia dingin a topa in a seh a nasempa ahi hi.","title":"A Citak le A Citak lo Nasem (Luk 12:41-48)"},"46":{"text":"A topa hong ciah ciangin ama sawl bangin na semin a om a muhpa pen mi hampha mahmah khat ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Ke’n kong genin-ah, ama neihsa khempeuh a uk dingin a topa in tua nasempa a koih ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua nasempa nasem hoih lo hi hen la, a lungsim sungah, ‘Ka topa hong ciahhak ding hi,’ ci-in,"},"49":{"text":"a naseppih a lawmte satgawp hen la, zukham thei mite tawh anne zune-in na om leh,"},"50":{"text":"a topa tung dingin a uploh ni hun khatpeuhin a topa hong tung ding a,"},"51":{"text":"a topa in nakpitakin gim pia-in, mihoih a kineihkhemte’ gimthuak dingteng thuaksak ding a, amah kapin a hagawi ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun ciangin vantung ki-ukna zia pen zinei thak pa a uap dingin a meivak uh tawh a pai nungak sawmte tawh kibang ding hi.","title":"Nungak Sawmte Thugentehna","ref":"Luk 12:35"},"2":{"text":"Nungak sawmte sung panin nga pil uh a, nga hai uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua a haite in a meivak sung uhah a tui thunthuah lopi-in pai uh a,"},"4":{"text":"ahi zongin a pil nungak ngate in a dimtakin thunin a pai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Zineipa hong tunghak ahih manin a vekpi-un lusu-in a ihmu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin zankim tak ciangin, ‘Zineipa hong tungta ding hi. Va dawn un,’ ci-in hong kiko hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua nungakte zong tho-in a meivak uh hong puah ciat uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin a haite in a pilte kiangah, ‘Ka mei uh mitta ahih manin na meitui uh hong hawm un,’ a cih ciangin"},"9":{"text":"a pilte in, ‘Hong hawm le ung ko a’ ding tawh kicing nawn lo ding ahih manin no a’ ding va leitawm zaw un,’ ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Meitui lei dingin amaute a paikhiat kal sungin zineipa hong tung hi. A kigingsa-in a om nungakte in zineipa dawnin mopawi bawlna sungah a lutkhawm pah uh hi. Tua khit ciangin kong kikhak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin nungak haite zong hong tung uh a, ‘Topa, Topa aw, kong hong hon in,’ a cih uh ciangin"},"12":{"text":"amah in, ‘Note ka hong thei het kei hi,’ na cihsan hi.”","ref":"Luk 13:25"},"13":{"text":"“Tua ahih manin a ni le a hun thei lo na hih manun na pilvang un.”"},"14":{"text":"“Inn panin khualzin dingin a paikhia mipa tawh zong kibang hi. Amah in a nasemte samin, a neihsateng a nasemte’ kep dingin a ap hi.","title":"Sum tawh Thugentehna (Luk 19:11-27)"},"15":{"text":"Amau’ siamna tawh kizui-in khat tungah tulnga, khat tungah tulnih, khat tungah tulkhat a ap khit ciangin a zinkhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tul nga a ngah pa in sum bawlna-in zangpah a, a meet tulnga mah a ngahthuah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tul nih a ngah pa in zong a meet tulnih mah a ngahthuah hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin tulkhat a ngah pa in leisung to-in a topa’ sum a seelcip hi."},"19":{"text":"“Hun sawtpi khit ciangin tua nasemte’ topa hong ciahkik a, a nasemte tawh a sum thu a siangsak uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tul nga a ngah pa in a dang tulnga mah hong tawithuahin, ‘Topa aw, kei tungah tulnga nong ap hi. Hih lai-ah tulnga mah ka meetsak hi,’ hong cih ciangin"},"21":{"text":"a topa in, ‘Hoih mahmah hi; a hoih a citak nasempa aw, a tawmno na zekna-ah siam na hih manin a tampi tak ka hong zeksak ding hi. Hong pai in; kei tawh nuamsa khawm ni,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin tulnih a ngah pa zong hong pai-in, ‘Topa aw, kei tungah tulnih nong ap hi. Hih lai-ah tulnih mah ka na meetsak hi,’ hong cih ciangin"},"23":{"text":"a topa in, ‘Hoih mahmah hi; a hoih a citak nasempa aw, a tawmno na zekna-ah siam na hih manin a tampi tak ka hong zeksak ding hi. Hong pai in; kei tawh nuamsa khawm ni,’ a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tul khat a ngah pa zong hong pai-in, ‘Topa aw, nang pen na sep loh na bawl lohnapi-ah na a deih, mi genhak mahmah na hihna ka hong thei hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ka hong kihta a, lei sungah na sum tulkhat ka seel hi. Tu-in hih lai-ah na sumzah mah om hi,’ a hong cih ciangin"},"26":{"text":"a topa in, ‘A hoih lo, a thadah nasempa aw, ka sep loh ka bawl lohnapi-ah ka deihlam hong thei na hih leh,"},"27":{"text":"sumkholna-ah ka sum na koihsak lecin hoih ding hi. Tua hileh tu-a ka hong tunkik ciangin a bulpi le a meet ka ngahkhawm ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ama tung panin a tulkhat laksak unla, tul sawm a nei pa tungah piathuah un."},"29":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a neisate kipiathuah ding a, hau semsem ding hi. Ahi zongin a nei lote tung panin a neihsa sunsun nangawn kilaksak ding hi.","ref":"Mat 13:12; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18"},"30":{"text":"Bangmahin a kimang lo hih nasempa ahihleh pualam khuamialna lakah lawnkhia un. Tua lai-ah kapin a hagawi ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Mat 8:12; 22:13; Luk 13:28; Luk 19:11-27"},"31":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa a vantung mite tawh Kumpi-in hong paikhawm uh ciangin a kumpi tokhom tungah hong tu ding hi.","title":"Minam Khempeuh tungah Thukhenna","ref":"Mat 16:27; 19:28"},"32":{"text":"Ama mai-ah leitung minam khempeuh hong kikhawm ding hi. Gancing pa in tuu le keelte a khen mah bangin mi khempeuh khen nihin hong koih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuu a bang mite a taklamah koihin, keel a bang mite a veilamah koih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa in a taklamah a om mite kiangah, ‘Ka Pa in thupha a piak mite aw, hong pai ta un. Leitung piancil a kipanin note a dingin a kibawlkholsa gamnuam hong luah un."},"35":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka gilkial laitakin an nong pia uh a, ka dangtak laitakin tui nong pia uh a, khualmi ka hih laitakin zin nong do uh a,"},"36":{"text":"puan nei loin ka om laitakin puan nong guan uh a, ka cinat laitakin nong veh uh a, ka thongkiat laitakin nong hawh uh hi,’ a ci ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihoihte in, ‘Topa aw, cikin na gilkial hong mu-in an hong pia a, cikin na dangtak hong mu-in tui hong pia ka hi uh hiam?"},"38":{"text":"Cikin khualmi na hih laitakin hong mu-in zin hong do a, cikin puan nei lo na hih laitakin hong mu-in puan hong guan ka hi uh hiam?"},"39":{"text":"Cikin cina na hih laitakin hong mu-in hong veh a, cikin thongkia na hih laitakin hong mu-in hong hawh ka hi uh hiam?’ a ci ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa in amaute kiangah, ‘Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Hih ka sanggamte a neupen khat nangawn na limbawl uh ciangin kei tungah a hong bawl na hi uh hi,’ ci-in a dawng ding hi."},"41":{"text":"“Tua ciangin a veilamah a om mite kiangah, ‘Pasian in a samsiat mite aw, keima kiang panin paikhia unla, Dawimangpa le a nungzuite a dingin a kibawl meikuang tawntung sungah pai un."},"42":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka gilkial laitakin an nong pia kei uh a, ka dangtak laitakin tui nong pia kei uh a,"},"43":{"text":"khualmi ka hih laitakin zin nong do kei uh a, puan ka neih loh laitakin puan nong guan kei uh a, ka cinat laitakin nong veh kei uh a, ka thongkiat laitakin nong hawh kei uh hi,’ a ci ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in zong, ‘Topa aw, cikin na gilkial hong mu a, cikin na dangtak hong mu a, cikin khualmi na hih hong mu a, cikin na puan neih loh hong mu a, cikin na cinat hong mu a, cikin na thongkiat hong mu a, cikin kote in nang hong huh nuam lo ka hi uh hiam?’ a ci ding uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, ‘Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Hih mite a neupen khat nangawn na huh loh uh ciangin kei a hong huh lo na hi uh hi,’ ci-in a dawng ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin tawntung gimthuakna sungah amaute pai ding uh a, mihoihte ahihleh nuntak tawntungna sungah lut ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Dan 12:2"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thute a hilh khit ciangin a nungzuite kiangah,","title":"Makaite in Jesuh Thahsawm (Mrk 14:1-2 ; Luk 22:1-2 ; Joh 11:45-57)"},"2":{"text":"“Na theihsa uh mah bangin tuzawh ni nih khit ciangin Paisan Pawi hun hong tungta ding hi. Tua ciangin singlamteh tungah thah dingin Mihing Tapa kipia ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 12:1-27"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi lianpen Kaiafas inn-ah siampi liante le upate kikhawm uh a,"},"4":{"text":"kuama theih lohin Jesuh simmatin a thahtheih nading uh a vaihawm uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in, “Buaina lianpi hong omkha thei ding ahih manin hih pawi hun sungin hih kei ni,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Bethany khua-a miphak ahi ngei Simon inn-ah Jesuh a om laitakin,","title":"Bethany khua-ah Jesuh Sathau Kinilh (Mrk 14:3-9 ; Joh 12:1-8)"},"7":{"text":"numei khat in a manpha mahmah sathau namtui suangngo thawl a dim khat hong tawi-in Jesuh kiangah hong pai a, Jesuh an ne-in a tut laitakin a lu tungah a buaksuk hi.","ref":"Luk 7:37-38"},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin nungzuite in a muh uh ciangin heh uh a, “Bang hangin hih sathau namtui mawk beisak ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Hih sathau kizuak leh sum tampi tak kikhawng ding a, mizawngte huhna-in kipia thei ding hi,” a ci uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in hih thu phawk ahih manin amaute kiangah, “Hih numei bang nuammawh na hi uh hiam? Kei tungah a kilawm mahmahin amah hong gamta hi."},"11":{"text":"Mizawngte pen note tawh hong omkhawm tawntung ding a, ahi zongin note tawh kei ka hong omkhawm tawntung kei ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 15:11"},"12":{"text":"Keima tungah hih bangin sathau hong buak ciangin ka luanghawm kivui nadingin a hong bawlbawl ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Note kiangah a mantak a kong genin-ah: Keima hangin a piang ding lungdamna thu a kigenna leitung khempeuhah hih numei kiphawkin a gamtatnate kigengen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin sawm le nihte sung panin Iskariot’ tapa Judas a kici mipa siampi liante kiangah va pai a,","title":"Jesuh Lehhek ding Judas Thukim (Mrk 14:10-11 ; Luk 22:3-6)"},"15":{"text":"“Note’ khut sungah amah hong pia leng, note in kei bang tawh hong guai ding na hi uh hiam?” a cih ciangin ngun peek sawmthum a pia uh hi.","ref":"Zek 11:12"},"16":{"text":"Tua hun a kipanin amah a lehhek theih nading hunhoih a zongpah hi."},"17":{"text":"Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a kipat ni-in nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Paisan Pawi annek ding koilai takah hong bawlsak le ung deih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in A Nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi An Ne (Mrk 14:12-21 ; Luk 22:7-14 , 21-23 ; Joh 13:21-30)"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Jerusalem khua sungah va pai unla, tua mipa kiangah, ‘Siapa in, “Ka hun hong naita hi. Na inn-ah ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi an ka hong ne ding uh hi,” ci hi,’ va ci un,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Nungzuite zong Jesuh gen bangin gamta uh a, Paisan Pawi an ding a bawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A nitak ciangin Jesuh le sawm le nihte an ne dingin a tukhawm uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute an ne-in a om laitakun Jesuh in, “Note khat in kei na hong lehhek ding uh hi,” a cih ciangin"},"22":{"text":"amaute dah mahmah uh a, amaute in a banbanin, “Topa aw, kei ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ankuang ka sawk khawmpih pa in kei hong lehhek ding hi.","ref":"La 41:9"},"24":{"text":"Mihing Tapa ahihleh Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhsa mah bangin a si ding ahi hi; ahi zongin Mihing Tapa a lehhek pa in gimna thuak ding hi. Tua mipa pen a piang vet lo hileh ama a dingin hoihzaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh a lehhek pa Judas in, “Topa aw, kei ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin, “Na ci khin hi,” ci-in Jesuh in a dawng hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua bangin an a nek laitakun, Jesuh in anlum la-in lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin balnen a, a nungzuite kiangah pia-in, “La unla ne un; hih pen ka pumpi ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Nekkhawm Bawlna A Pianna (Mrk 14:22-26 ; Luk 22:15-20 ; 1Kor 11:23-26)"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin hai la a, lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin amaute tungah pia-in, “Na vekpi-un dawn un."},"28":{"text":"Mi tampite’ mawhna a mai nadingin a luangkhia, Pasian’ thuciamna a kipsak, ka sisan ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 24:8; Jer 31:31-34"},"29":{"text":"Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Ka Pa’ Ukna sungah note tawh leenggahzu thak ka dawnkik ni matengin leenggahzu ka dawnkik nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin la khat sa uh a, Oliv Mual tungah a pai uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Lai Siangtho sungah, ‘Tuucingpa ka satlum ding a, a tuute kithehthang ding hi,’ ci-in a kigelh mah bangin note khempeuh in tu nitakin kei na hong taisanmang khin ding uh hi.","title":"Peter’ Nial ding Kigenkhol (Mrk 14:27-31 ; Luk 22:31-34 ; Joh 13:36-38)","ref":"Zek 13:7"},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin hong kithawh kiksak khit ciangin Galilee gam sung note mai-ah ka pai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 28:16"},"33":{"text":"Peter in, “Adang khempeuh in hong taisan zongin ke’n kong nusia ngei kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tuzan mahmahin ak a khuan’ ma-in kei, thumvei tak na hong nial ding lamtak phawk in,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter in, “Nang tawh sihkhawm nading ciang dong ahi zongin kong nial ngei het kei ding hi,” a ci veve hi. Tua mah bangin nungzui dang khempeuh in zong a ci ciat uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh a nungzuite tawh Gethsemane a kici munah pai-in amaute kiangah, “Hua lamah pai-in thu ka va nget kal sungteng hih lai-ah na om un,” a ci hi.","title":"Gethsemane-ah Jesuh in Thu Ngen (Mrk 14:32-42 ; Luk 22:39-46)"},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter le Zebedi tapa tegel tonpih a, dahin a lunggim hun ding a kipan hi."},"38":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, “Ka lungsim dahna hangin ka si dektak hi. Hih lai-ah na om unla hong ngak un,” a cih khit ciangin"},"39":{"text":"tawmkhat pai lai-in leilakah bokin thu ngen a, “Pa aw, ahi thei ding ahihleh hih thuak nading tawh hong kipelhsak in. Ahi zongin kei’ deihna bang hi loin nangma deihna bang hizaw ta hen,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"A nungzui thumte kiangah hong paikik ciangin amaute na ihmu uh hi. Amah in Peter kiangah, “Nai khat sung nangawn hong ngakzo lo liang na hi uh hiam?"},"41":{"text":"Ze-etna-ah na puk khak loh nadingun thu ngen un. Jesuh pen a dap ommawk hiloin, na semin aana a nei mi ahihna kilangsak hi. Ama aana neihna pen a thuhilhna, dawite tungah vang a neihna, leh mite' mawhna a maisakna panin a kilang hi. Mark in Jesuh' thu siangtakin limgen a, a thugenna leh a thuhilhnate sangin a nasepnate limgen zaw hi. (Mat 18:1-5 ; Luk 9:46-48)"},"34":{"text":"Kua lianpen ihi hiam, ci-in lampi-ah amau khatlekhat kisel uh ahih manin kuamah in dawng ngam lo uh hi.","ref":"Luk 22:24"},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh tu a, a kiangah nungzui sawm le nihte samin, “Mi khat peuhpeuh a lianpen a suahnop leh a neupen suak photin mi khempeuh’ nasem hi masa ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 20:26-27; 23:11; Mrk 10:43-44; Luk 22:26"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in naupang khat la a, amaute laizangah paipihin a ang-ah tawi a,"},"37":{"text":"“Keima hangin hih bang naupangno khat a limbawl mi in kei hong limbawl hi a, kei hong limbawl mi in kei hong limbawl hi loin kei hong sawl pa a limbawl ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Luk 10:16; Joh 13:20"},"38":{"text":"Johan in, “Sia aw, nangma min zangin dawi a hawlkhia mi khat ka mu uh hi. Tua bangin adang tampi sawl a, pawlkhat na satgawp uh a, pawlkhat na that uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sawltheih ding a it mahmah a tapa khat bek omlai ahih manin, ‘Amaute in ka tapa na zahtakbawl ding uh hi,’ ci-in a nunung penin a sawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin lo khawhlawhte in, ‘Hih pa pen a gamhluah ding pa ahi hi. Pai un; amah va that huan ni; tua hileh hih ama luah ding gamh eima a’ suak ding hi,’ a kici uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amah manin that uh a, lo nawlah a pai uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ahihleh lonei pa in bangci bawl ding ahi hiam? Amah hong pai-in lo khawhlawhte that ding a, a lo, midangte a khawhlawhsak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"‘Innlamte in a nilkhiat suang pen innkiu suang bulpi suak khinta hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih thu Topa’ bawl hi a, i muh ciangin lamdang i sa hi,’ ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.","ref":"La 118:22-23"},"12":{"text":"Hih thugentehna pen amaute a cihnopna a a gen ahihlam Jew makaite in thei uh ahih manin Jesuh a kimat theih nading a hanciam uh hi. Ahi zongin mihonpite kihta uh ahih manin Jesuh bangmah cih loin a paisan uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh ama kampauna tawh a kimat theih nadingin Farisi mi pawlkhat le Herod mi pawlkhat Jesuh kiangah thudong dingin hong kisawl hi.","title":"Sisar’ tungah Siah Piakna (Mat 22:15-22 ; Luk 20:20-26)"},"14":{"text":"Amaute in, “Sia aw, nangmah in thutang genin, midangte’ pau ding phamawh na sak lohna, uliante’ maitang zahtak tuan loin, Pasian in mite a gamtat dingin a deihna thute tangtakin na hilhna ka thei uh hi. Tua ahih manin Rom Kumpipa Sisar tungah siah i piak ding kilawm ahi hiam, kilawm lo ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Pia ding ihi hiam, pia lo ding ihi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in amau lungsimtawng thei ahih manin, “Bang hangin kei hong thangsiah se na hi uh hiam? Ka et dingin dangka peek khat hong la dih un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute in zong dangka peek khat hong paipih uh a, tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Hih dangka tunga om kua’ lim hi a, kua’ min ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Rom Kumpipa Sisar’ lim le a min ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tua ahihleh, Sisar’ neihsate Sisar’ tungah pia unla, Pasian’ neihsate Pasian’ tungah pia un,” a ci hi. Tua ama thudawnna hangin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin, thawhkikna om lo hi, a ci Saddusi mi pawlkhat hong pai leuleu uh a,","title":"Thawhkikna Thudotna (Mat 22:23-33 ; Luk 20:27-40)","ref":"Sawl 23:8"},"19":{"text":"“Sia aw, ‘Mi khat in ta nei loin a zi a sihsan leh tua a si mipa’ khang a kizop theih nadingin a naupa in tua meigongnu tenpih ding hi,’ ci-in Moses in eite a dingin ngeina a koih hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5"},"20":{"text":"Khatvei, unau pasal sagih om uh hi. A u pen in zi nei a, ta nei loin a si hi."},"21":{"text":"A nau in a upa’ zi luah hi; amah zong ta nei loin si leuleu hi. A thumna pa,"},"22":{"text":"le adangte khempeuh, a sagihna dong in tua nu tenpih uh a, ta nei lo vive mahin a si uh hi. A tawpna ciangin tua numei zong a si hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahihleh, hih unau pasal sagihte in hihnu tenpih kim ciat uh ahih manin, mi khempeuh a thawhkik ni ciangin a kua pen’ zi hi ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na khial mahmah uh hi. Lai Siangtho ahi a, Pasian’ vangliatna ahi zongin na theih lohna hang uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Sihna panin mite a thawhkik ciangin vantungah a om vantung mite mah bangin zinei pasalnei cih om lo ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Thawhkikna thu tawh kisai-in ci lehang, Moses’ laigelhna sung sawlpang kuang thu a genna munah Pasian in Moses kiangah, ‘Kei pen Abraham’ Pasian, Isaac’ Pasian, Jakob’ Pasian ka hi hi,’ a cihna mun sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Pai 3:6"},"27":{"text":"Tua bang a cih ciangin Pasian pen misite’ Pasian hi loin mihingte’ Pasian hi, a ci nuam ahi hi. Tua ahih manin na ngaihsun khial mahmah uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua thukidotna a za Thukham hilh siate khat in, Saddusi mite’ dotnate limtakin Jesuh in a dawntheihna a muh ciangin Jesuh hong neh a, “Thukham khempeuh lakah bang thukham a lianpen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Thukham Lianpen (Mat 22:34-40)"},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thukham a lianpen in: Israel mite aw, ngai un: I Topa Pasian bek mah Topa ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Na Topa Pasian uh, na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh, na pilna khempeuh, le na thahatna khempeuh uh tawh na it un, a cihna ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:4-5"},"31":{"text":"A nihna in: Nangma pumpi na it bangin na vengte na it in, cihna ahi hi. Hih tegel sangin thukham a lianzaw a dang om nawn lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Siam 19:18"},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Thukham hilh siapa in, “Sia aw, na gen mah bangin hi ka sa mahmah hi. Topa bek mah Pasian hi a, amah simloh pasian dang kuamah om lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:35"},"33":{"text":"Mite in a lungsim khempeuh, a pilna khempeuh, le a hatna khempeuh uh tawh Pasian itin, amau pumpi a it bangin a vengte a it ding uh ahi hi. Pasian biak nadingin biakna tau tunga gan gawhnate le biakna dang khempeuh sangin hih thukham nihte zuih ding thupizaw takpi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Hos 6:6"},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in hih mipa’ thugenzia hoihsa ahih manin, “Pasian’ Ukna sungah a om dektak mahmah na hi hi,” a ci hi. Tua khit a kipanin Jesuh kiangah kuamah in thu dong ngam nawn lo uh hi.","ref":"Luk 10:25-28"},"35":{"text":"Jesuh in biakinn sungah thu a hilh laitakin, “Bang hangin Thukham hilh siate in Khrih pen David’ suan hi lel hi, ci thei uh ahi hiam?","title":"David’ Suan tawh kisai Thudotna (Mat 22:41-46 ; Luk 20:41-44)"},"36":{"text":"Kha Siangtho’ sawlna tawh David mahmah in thu gen a, ‘Topa in keima Topa tungah thu gen hi: Na galte, na khe nuai-ah ka koih matengin, ka taklamah na tu in,’ ci hi.","ref":"La 110:1"},"37":{"text":"David mahmah in Khrih pen ‘Topa,’ ci hi. Tua ahihleh Khrih pen David’ suan hi lel, cih mawkmawk ding hithei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Mihonte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lungdam mahmah uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh in a thuhilhna-ah, “Thukham hilh sia pawlkhatte na bat khak loh nadingun na kidawm un. Amaute in puantualpi silhnuam uh a, mite lakah mite in a zahtak hopih ding a deih uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Thukham Hilh Siate Mawhsak (Mat 23:1-36 ; Luk 11:37-54 ; 20:45-47)"},"39":{"text":"Kikhopna inn sungah, uliante a dingin a kikoihcing tutphah nuamte tungah tunuam uh a, pawi sungah zong uliante’ tutna mun hoihte bekah a tunuam uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Meigong numeite tungah nuamtaksa-in a neihsate laksakin zangmang uh a, mite in mihoih a saktheih nading uh a deihna hangun thu saupipi a ngen uh hi. Amau’ kineihkhemna tawh kizui-in a gimthuak ding uh lianzaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Biakinn sumpi khiatna kuang gei-ah Jesuh tu a, mihonte in sumpi a khiat laitakun a en hi. A haute in tampipi hong khia uh hi.","title":"Meigongnu’ Sumpi (Luk 21:1-4)"},"42":{"text":"A zawng meigong numei khat zong hong pai a, sumnen tang nih hong khia hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungzuite sam a, “Adangte khempeuh sangin hih mizawng meigongnu in tam khia zaw hi."},"44":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh adangte in a neihval a lamval sung panun a khia uh ahi hi; ahi zongin amah zawng mahmah napi-in ama kivak nading nangawn siit loin a neih khempeuh a khiakhin ahi hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinn panin Jesuh a pusuah laitakin a nungzuite khat in, “Sia aw, hih biakinnte bangzah takin lian a, a suangte bangzah takin gol ahi hiam?” a ci hi.","title":"Biakinn Siat ding Jesuh’n Genkhol (Mat 24:1-2 ; Luk 21:5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hih innte liansa-in thupi na sa mahmah hi. Ahi zongin hih innte lamna-a a kiciang suangte nih bek nangawn a kithuapna a om lo zah dongin a kiphelkek gawp hun hong tung ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Biakinn galkhatah a om Oliv Mual tungah Jesuh tu-in a om laitakin Peter, James, Johan, le Andru hong pai-in amauteng guak a om laitakin,","title":"Gimna Kipatna (Mat 24:3-14 ; Luk 21:7-19)"},"4":{"text":"“Hih na thugen cik ciangin hong tung ding a, hih na thugente khempeuh hong tun ding ciangin bang lim hong om ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Kuamah in hong khem zawh loh nadingin na kidawm un."},"6":{"text":"Keima min pua-in mi tampi hong pai ding uh a, ‘Keimah, Khrih ka hi hi,’ ci-in mi tampi a khemzo ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A gamla a galkidona thute le a nai-a galkidona huging na zak uh ciangin patau kei un. Tuate a piang ding mah hi a, hun beina ding hi nai lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Minam khat le minam khat, kumpi khat le kumpi khat kido ding uh hi. Mun tuamtuamah zin hong ling ding a, kial zong hong tung ding hi. Hihte khempeuh pen gimna kipatna hi pan hi."},"9":{"text":"“Limtakin kidawm un. Note hong kimanin thukhen zumah hong kipaipih ding a, kikhopna inn sungah zong hong kisat ding hi. Ukpite le kumpite mai-ah keima thu gen nading hun na ngah ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin hun beina a tun ma-in mi khempeuh tungah Lungdamna Thu kihilh masa phot ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Note hong kimanin, thusitna a thuak dingin thukhen zumah hong kipaipih ciangin bang gen ding ihi hiam, ci-in ma lunghihmawh kei un. A thugen ding pen note hi loin Kha Siangtho ahih manin a hun tak ciangin na gen dingun a hong kisawl peuhpeuh na gen un.","ref":"Mat 10:17-20; Luk 12:11-12"},"12":{"text":"Unau khatlekhat a sih nadingun kikhia ding uh a, pa in a ta khia-in, ta in a nu le a pate khia-in a thatsak ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima hangin Gentail mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh a, ahi zongin a sih dongun a thuakzote in hotkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 10:22"},"14":{"text":"“Ama om loh nading pi-ah a lipkhaphuai zehphitna a hong om na muh uh ciangin (hih lai a simte in Jesuh’ cihnopna thei ta un!) Judea gam a om mite mualtungah tai un.","title":"Gimna Lianpi (Mat 24:15-28 ; Luk 21:20-24)","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; 12:11"},"15":{"text":"A innkhum zangah a om laitak ahi khate zong, a kumsuk ciangin a neihsate a taipih dingin a la dingin a inn sungah lut nawn kei hen."},"16":{"text":"Lolai-ah a om laitak ahi khate zong, a puan la dingin a inn uh zuan nawn kei hen.","ref":"Luk 17:31"},"17":{"text":"Tua laitakin nupi naupaiite le naungek neite a dingin haksa mahmah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Phalbi laitakin hih thu hong piankhak loh nadingin thu na ngen un."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in leitung a piansak cil a kipanin tuhun dong, cikmahin tua bang haksatna a om ngei lo, nidang ciangin zong a om ngei nawn lo ding, tua hun laitakin hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Mang 7:14"},"20":{"text":"Topa in tua gimna hun a ni khiam lo hileh a suaktazo kuamah om lo ding hi. Ahi zongin ama teel mite a khualna-in a ni a khiam hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua laitakin mi khatpeuh in, ‘Hih lai-ah Khrih om hi; hua lai-ah Khrih om hi,’ ci-in hong gen leh, um kei un."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih kineihkhemte le kamsang kineihkhemte hong piang ding a, ahih zawhleh, a teelsa mite nangawn a khem nadingun lim le na lamdangte hong bawl ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kidawm un! A hun ma-in kong genkhin hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tua haksatna hun khit ciangin ni hong mial ding a, kha hong taang nawn lo ding hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa Hong Paina (Mat 24:29-31 ; Luk 21:25-28)","ref":"Isa 13:10; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:10,31; 3:15; Mang 6:12"},"25":{"text":"Van panin aksite hong kia ding a, vantung a om nate a omngei bangin omthei nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:4; Joel 2:10; Mang 6:13"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mihing Tapa, vangliatna le minthanna tawh meii lakah a hong paisuk kimu ding hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Mang 1:7"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin leitung mun khempeuhah vantung mite sawl ding a, leimong khat pan mong khat kikalah a om a teel mite khempeuh a kaikhawmsak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Thei kung tung pana thupiang panin thu thei un. A hiangte hong meeng a, a teh hong no ciangin khuakhal hun hong naita ding hi, ci-in na thei un.","title":"Thei Kung’ Thuhilhna (Mat 24:32-35 ; Luk 21:29-33)"},"29":{"text":"Tua mah bangin hih thute hong tun ciangin amah hong naita a, hong tung dektak hi, ci-in na thei un."},"30":{"text":"Hih thu limtakin phawk un. Tu laitakin a nungta mi khempeuh a sihkhit ma-in hih thute hong tung ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Van le lei mangthang ding a, ahi zongin ka thugente mangthang ngei lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Ahi zongin tua ni le tua nai hun ding kuamah in thei lo hi. Vantunga om vantung mite ahi a, Tapa ahi keimah in ahi zongin ka thei kei a, ka Pa bek in a thei hi.","title":"A Ni le A Nai Hun Kuamah’n Thei lo (Mat 24:36-42 ; Luk 17:26-30 , 34-36)","ref":"Mat 24:36"},"33":{"text":"Tua hun ding thei lo na hih manun kikemin pilvang un."},"34":{"text":"Mi khat khualzin dingin paikhia a, a dinkhiat ding ciangin amau’ sep ding ciat a nasemte tungah tavuan pia a, kongcing pa in limtakin a cin ding a sawl mipa tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Luk 12:36-38"},"35":{"text":"Inn nei pa, nitak ahi a, zankim ahi a, zingsang ak khuankuan ahi a, zingsang khuavak khit ahi zongin a bang hunin hong tung ding cih thei lo na hih manun ngakin na pilvang un."},"36":{"text":"Tua hikeileh amah thakhatin hong tungin na ihmut laitakun hong tuakkha ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Note tungah kong gen mah bangin mi khempeuh tungah zong, ‘Ngakin na pilvang un,’ ka ci hi,” a ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paisan Pawi le Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a tun ma ni nih ni-in siampi liante le Thukham hilh siate in Jesuh simmatin a thahtheih nading uh lampi a zong uh hi.","title":"Makaite in Jesuh Thahsawm (Mat 26:1-5 ; Luk 22:1-2 ; Joh 11:45-57)","ref":"Pai 12:1-27"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin, “Mihonpite hong buai kha ding ahih manin hih pawi hun sungin hih kei ni,” a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bethany khua-ah, miphak ahi ngei Simon’ inn-ah Jesuh in an a nek laitakin, numei khat in a manpha mahmah nard paknamtui citak suangngo thawl dimin a om khat hong tawi a, a suangngo thawl sukhamin Jesuh’ lu tungah a paknamtui a sungsuk hi.","title":"Bethany khua-ah Jesuh Sathau Kinilh (Mat 26:6-13 ; Joh 12:1-8)","ref":"Luk 7:37-38"},"4":{"text":"Tua lai-a om mi pawlkhat a heh suak a, “Bang hangin hih paknamtui mawk beisak ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Kizuak le ngun peek zathum val kikhawng ding a, a sum mizawngte tungah kipia thei ding hi,” ci-in nakpitakin tua numei a mawhsak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Bangmah cih se kei un! Bang hangin nawngkaisak na hi uh hiam? Amah pen a kilawm a hoihin kei tungah hong gamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mizawngte ahihleh note tawh omkhawm tawntung ding a, na huhnop hun peuhpeuhun na huh thei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin kei pen note tawh kong omkhawm tawntung kei ding hi.","ref":"Thkna 15:11"},"8":{"text":"Amah in ka luang a kivui nadingin paknamtui a hong ma nuhkhol hi a, a hihtheih zahzah ciang a hih khinta ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih thu limtakin phawk un! Lungdamna thu a kihilhna leitung mun khempeuhah hihnu’ thu kiphawkin kei tungah hong sepnate kigengen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua laitakin sawm le nihte sungpan Iskariot’ tapa Judas in amaute tungah Jesuh a piaktheih nadingin siampi liante kiangah a va pai hi.","title":"Jesuh Lehhek ding Judas Thukim (Mat 26:14-16 ; Luk 22:3-6)"},"11":{"text":"Siampi liante in a thu a zak uh ciangin lungdam mahmah uh a, sum tawh kong guai ding uh hi, ci-in thu a ciam uh hi. Tua ahih manin Judas in Jesuh a lehhek theih nading a hunhoih a zong hi."},"12":{"text":"Paisan Pawi an dingin tuuno a kigawh ni, Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi ni masa ni-in a nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Koi lai-ah pai-in Paisan Pawi an ding hong bawlsak ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in A Nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi An Ne (Mat 26:17-25 ; Luk 22:7-14 , 21-23 ; Joh 13:21-30)"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite nih sawlin amaute kiangah, “Jerusalem khua sungah va pai le-uhcin, tuibeel a pua mi khat na mu ding uh hi. Amah zui unla,"},"14":{"text":"ama tumna innteek pa kiangah, ‘Siapa in hih bangin ci hi: Ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi an ka nek nading uh zintun nading inndei koilai ahi hiam, ci hi,’ va ci un."},"15":{"text":"Amah in a baihsa-in a na kikoihsa inndei tungnung a zai khat hong lak ding hi. Tua lai-ah na bawl un,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Nungzui tegel zong khua sungah va pai uh a, Jesuh’ gen bangin a va mu uh hi. Tua lai-ah Paisan Pawi an ding a bawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"A nitak ciangin a nungzui sawm le nihte tawh tua munah Jesuh a om hi."},"18":{"text":"An a nek laitakun Jesuh in, “Tu laitakin kei tawh an a nekhawm mi khat in kei hong lehhek ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 41:9"},"19":{"text":"A nungzuite in lamdangsa uh a, a banbanin, “Kei nong cihna hi kei buangin teh,” a ci ciat uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “No sawm le nihte sung, kei tawh an kuang a sawkkhawmte mah sungpan ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"A kigelhsa mah bangin Mihing Tapa ahihleh si ding a, ahi zongin a lehhek pa’ thuakna nasia mahmah ding hi. Tua mipa a piang ngei het lo hileh ama a dingin hoihzaw tham ding hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua bangin an a nek laitakun Jesuh in anlum la-in lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin balnenin a nungzuite tungah pia a, “Ne un; hih pen keima pumpi ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Nekkhawm Bawlna A Pianna (Mat 26:26-30 ; Luk 22:15-20 ; 1Kor 11:23-26)"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin hai la a, lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin a nungzuite tungah pia a, tua hai panin a dawnkim uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, “Hih pen mi tampite a dingin a luang, thuciamna thak a kipsak keima sisan ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 24:8; Jer 31:31-34"},"25":{"text":"Pasian’ Ukna sungah leenggahzu thak ka dawnkik ni matengin leenggahzu a dawn nawn lo ding ka hihna thu limtakin thei un,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute inla khat a sakkhit uh ciangin Oliv Mual-ah a pai uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “‘Tuucingpa ka satlum ding a, tuute a kithehthang ding hi,’ ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin note in kei nong taisan ding uh hi.","title":"Peter’ Nial ding Kigenkhol (Mat 26:31-35 ; Luk 22:31-34 ; Joh 13:36-38)","ref":"Zek 13:7"},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin hong kithawh kiksak khit ciangin Galilee gam note mai-ah ka pai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 28:16"},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter in, “Adang khempeuh in nang hong taisan ahi zongin ke’n kong nusia ngei kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tuzan mahmahin ak nihvei a khuan’ ma-in thumvei tak kei na hong nial ding lamtak phawk in,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter in, “Nang tawh sihkhawm nading ciang dong ahi zongin kong nial ngei het kei ding hi,” ci-in khauhtakin a gen hi. Tua mah bangin a vekpi-un a ci kim uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua lai panin Gethsemane a kici munah pai-in a tun uh ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Thu ka va nget hun sungteng hih lai-ah na om un,” a ci hi.","title":"Gethsemane-ah Jesuh in Thu Ngen (Mat 26:36-46 ; Luk 22:39-46)"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter, James, le Johan-te paipih lai a, nakpitakin lungkhamin a dahna hong kipan hi."},"34":{"text":"Amah in, “Ka lungsim dahna lianlua mahmah ahih manin ka si dektak hi. Hih lai-ah om unla na ngak un,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Amah tawmkhat pailai-in leilakah boksuk a, ahi thei ding ahihleh hih thuakna hun tawh a kipelh nadingin thu a ngen hi."},"36":{"text":"“Pa aw, na khempeuh na hihthei hi. Hih ka thuak ding gimna tawh hong kipelhsak in. Jesuh van a kahkhit ciangin Khristian upna thu a khan'na leh a kizelhna thu, hih lai a gelhpa mah in Sawltak sungah na gen hi. A nuai-a kigelh Tom Lakna khen nihna leh khen gukna sungah hih laibu sung bekah a om thu pawlkhat kigelh a, tuate pen vantung mite' lasakna thu leh Jesuh a suah laitakin tuucingte' hawhna thu, Jesuh naupang ahih laitakin Biakinn sungah a omna thu, Samaria mihoihpa' thu, leh ta mangthang thute ahi hi. Pate le tate kilemsakkikin, mihoihte’ lungsim bang a neih nadingun thumang lo mite’ lungsim heisak ding a, Topa a dingin a kilawm dingin mite a bawlkhol ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mal 4:5-6"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zekhariah in vantungmi kiangah, “Hih na thugen a manna bangci theih ding ka hi hiam? Kei ka teekta a, ka zi zong lah a teek mahmah ahi hi,” a cih ciangin"},"19":{"text":"vantungmi in dawng a, “Kei pen Pasian’ na a sem Gabriel ka hi hi. Nang kiangah thu hong genin, hih lungdamna thu a ko dingin a hong sawl ka hi hi.","ref":"Dan 8:16; 9:21"},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin, a hong tung ding ka thugen a hun lai-in um lo na hih manin nangma tunga kong thugen a tun matengin pau thei loin na om ding hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun sungteng, mihonte in Zekhariah na ngak uh a, biakinn sungah sauveipi a om manin lamdang a sa uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah hong pusuah ciangin pau thei lo ahih manin, biakinn sungah maang mu hi, ci-in a thei uh hi. Pau thei lo ahih manin a khut tawh a lim a lak hi."},"23":{"text":"Biakinn sungah ama nasep ding hun a bei ciangin a inn-ah a ciah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin a zi Elizabeth gai a, kha nga sung inn panin koimahah a paikhia kei hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tu petpetin Topa in hih bangin kei hong huh a, mi lakah ka maizumna teng hong paihkhiatsak ta hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Elizabeth a gaizawh kha guk a cin ciangin Pasian in Galilee gam Nazareth khua-ah vantungmi Gabriel a paisak hi.","title":"Jesuh’ Suah ding Kigenkhol"},"27":{"text":"Kumpi David’ suan Josef in zuthawl a piaksa Mary tungah thu a gen dingin a sawl ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 1:18"},"28":{"text":"Vantung mi in Mary kiangah, “Na lungdam mahmah ding ahi hi. Topa in nang hong ompih a, thupha lianpi hong piazo hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Mary in vantungmi’ thugen a zak ciangin, bang a cihnopna hi ding ahi hiam, ci-in lamdang a sa mahmah hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantungmi in, “Mary aw, lamdangsa-in lunghimawh kei in. Pasian’ maipha a ngah na hi hi."},"31":{"text":"Nang gai-in tapa khat na nei ding a, a min dingin Jesuh na phuak ding hi.","ref":"Mat 1:21"},"32":{"text":"Amah milian hi ding a, A Lianpen Pasian’ Tapa kici ding hi. Topa Pasian in ama pu David mah bangin kumpi-in bawl ding a,"},"33":{"text":"Jakob suanlekhakte’ kumpi hi paisuak ding a, ama ukna bei hun cih om ngei lo ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:12,13,16; Isa 9:7"},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mary in vantungmi kiangah, “Kei, pasal tawh a lumkhawm ngei nai lopi, hih thu bangci piantheih ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Vantung mi in, “Nangma tungah Kha Siangtho hong tung ding a, nangma tungah Pasian’ vangliatna hong om ding hi. Tua ahih manin a hong suak ding a siangtho naungek pen Pasian’ Tapa kici ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Na behnu Elizabeth zong thei in. A ciing hi, kici napi-in a teek mahmah zawh nungin naupaii a, tu-in a naupaii zawh kha guk pha ta hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in a bawl theih loh khat zong om lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Pian 18:14"},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mary in, “Kei pen Topa’ nasemnu ka hi hi. Na gensa bangin keima tungah hong piang ta hen,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama kiang panin vantungmi a paikhia hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua khit a sawt loin Mary kithawi a, Judea mualtung gam a khua khatah a va paipah hi.","title":"Elizabeth kiangah Mary Hawh"},"40":{"text":"Zekhariah’ inn-ah lutin Elizabeth a hopih hi."},"41":{"text":"Elizabeth in Mary’ hopihna awging a zak ciangin a sunga a naupaii a hong diang hi. Elizabeth zong Kha Siangtho tawh hong kidim a,"},"42":{"text":"nakpitakin kiko-in, “Numei khempeuh lakah thupha ngah pen nu na hi a, na neih ding naungek in thupha ngah ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Ka Topa’ nu kei kiangah hong hawh nadingin, bang hangin hih bang thu lian kei tungah hong tung ahi hiam?"},"44":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nong hopihna awging ka zak phetin ka sunga naungek nuamin a diang hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa in nang tungah a hong gen thute hong tung taktak ding hi, ci-a upna pen nang a dingin a lungdamhuai mahmah ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mary in, “Ka lungsim in Topa phat a,","title":"Mary’ Phatna La"},"47":{"text":"hong Hon Pasian’ hangin ka nuam mahmah hi."},"48":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a neu mahmah a nasemnu, keimah a hong phawk hi. Tu a kipanin a khangkhangin mi khempeuh in thupha ngah nu hong ci ding uh hi.","ref":"1Sam 1:11"},"49":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Pasian in keima a dingin na lianpi hong sepsak hi. Ama min siangtho a,"},"50":{"text":"amah a zahtak mite tungah a khangkhangin hehpihna a lak hi."},"51":{"text":"Amah in a hat mahmah a khut zan a, kiliatsakna lungsim a nei mite a thehthang hi."},"52":{"text":"Kumpi vangliante, a tokhom panun khiasuk a, mineute, milianin a bawl hi.","ref":"Job 5:11; 12:19"},"53":{"text":"Bangmah a nei lote tungah na manpha tampi pia a, mihaute, khuthawm guakin a paikhiasak hi."},"54":{"text":"I pu i pate tungah a kiciamna tungsak a, a nasempa Israel a huh hi."},"55":{"text":"Abraham le a suanlekhak khempeuh tungah hehpihna a piak tawntung ding a phawk hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Sam 2:1-10; Pian 17:7"},"56":{"text":"Elizabeth kiangah kha thum sung bang Mary taam a, tua khit ciangin a inn-ah a ciah hi."},"57":{"text":"Elizabeth a suah ding hun hong tungta a, tapa khat hong nei hi.","title":"Tuiphumpa Johan’ Suahna"},"58":{"text":"Topa in amah a hehpih mahmahna thu a zak uh ciangin a vengte le a behte khempeuh in a lungdampih uh hi."},"59":{"text":"Naungek nipikal khat a phak khit ciangin a vun a at dingin hong pai uh a, a naungek’ min dingin zong a pa’ min mah ahi Zekhariah phuah ding a sawm uh hi.","ref":"Siam 12:3"},"60":{"text":"Ahi zongin a nu in, “Hilo ding hi; ama min dingin Johan i phuak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"61":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Elizabeth kiangah, “Na beh sung uhah hih bang min a nei om nai lo hi,” a ci uh hi."},"62":{"text":"Tua ciangin hih nau min bang phuak ding ihi hiam, ci-in a pa kiangah lim tawh a dong uh hi."},"63":{"text":"Zekhariah in zong laidal khat ngen a, tua tungah, “Ama min Johan hi ding hi,” ci-in a gelh ciangin amaute khempeuh in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi."},"64":{"text":"Tua laitakin Zekhariah hong pauthei kik a, Pasian a phat hi."},"65":{"text":"A vengte khempeuh in lamdangsa-in lau uh a, Judea mualtung gam sung khempeuhah hih thu a kitheithang hi."},"66":{"text":"Hih thu a za mi khempeuh in, “Hih naungek a bangci mi hong hi ding hiam?” ci-in a lungsim sung uhah a ngaihsun ciat uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amah a huhna thu teltakin kilang hi."},"67":{"text":"Tua ciangin Johan’ pa Zekhariah, Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Pasian’ thu gen a,","title":"Zekhariah’ Thugen"},"68":{"text":"“Israel mite’ Topa Pasian phat ciat ni. A mite a huh dingin hong pai-in amaute a suaktasak hi."},"69":{"text":"A nasempa David’ suante sung panin eite a dingin Vanglian Honpa hong pia hi."},"70":{"text":"Amah in tanglai-in a kamsang mi siangthote tungtawnin thu hong gen a,"},"71":{"text":"i galte kiang panin hong hotkhiat nading le hong mudahte’ khutsung panin hong hotkhiat nading thu a hong ciam hi."},"72":{"text":"I pu i pate a hehpih nading le ama thuciam siangtho hong mangngilh loh nading, amah in hong gen hi."},"73":{"text":"I pu Abraham tungah kamciamna kho khat bawl a,"},"74":{"text":"i galte kiang panin eite hong hotkhiat nading le launa om loin amah bia-in,"},"75":{"text":"i khang tawnin ama mai-ah a siangtho, a thumanin i om tawntung theih nading thu hong ciam hi."},"76":{"text":"“Nang, ka tapa na hi a, Lianpen Pasian’ kamsangpa hong kici ding hi. Ama pai nading lampi a bawlkhol dingin Topa’ mai-ah na mapai ding hi.","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"77":{"text":"Na mawhna uh hong kimaisak khit ciangin, hotkhiatna na ngah ding uh hi, ci-in ama mite kiangah na gen ding hi."},"78":{"text":"I Pasian lungnem mahmah a, hehpihna hong nei hi. Eite tungah hotkhiatna khuavak hong taangsak ding a,"},"79":{"text":"sih ding lauhuaina sungah a om mi khempeuh tungah vantung khuavak hong taangsak ding a, nopsakna lampi-ah hong kha ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 9:2"},"80":{"text":"Tua naungek a pumpi le a lungsim siamna hong khang a, Israel mite lakah a kilaak hun matengin sehnel gam sungah a om hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin gam tampi a uk Sisar Augustas in ama ukna gam sung mi a phazah a kitheih nadingin mi khempeuh min sazian a kilak nadingin thu a pia hi.","title":"Jesuh’ Suahna (Mat 1:18-25)"},"2":{"text":"Kuirinias in Syria gam a uksawn hun laitakin hih bangin mi phazah kisimna thu hong piang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amau khua ciatah min pia dingin mi khempeuh a pai uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Josef zong David’ suante khat ahih manin Galilee gam sung Nazareth khua panin David’ suahna khua ahi Judea gam Bethlehem khua-ah a pai hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin min sazian kikhumsak dingin a pai ciangin tenpih dingin zuthawl a piaksa a lawmnu Mary tawh a paikhawm uh hi. A lawmnu naupaii hi a,"},"6":{"text":"Bethlehem khua-ah a tam sungun a nausuah ding hun hong tung hi."},"7":{"text":"Zintun nading mun dang khempeuh mi dim khinta ahih manin ganbukah tung uh a, a tacil ahi ta pasal khat nei-in, puan tawh tunin gan annekna kuang sungah a sial hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin gamlakah a tuuhonte a giahpih tuucing pawlkhat a om uh hi.","title":"Tuucingte le Vantung Mite"},"9":{"text":"Amaute kiangah Topa’ vantungmi khat hong kilang a, Topa’ minthanna vang in amaute hong taan ahih manin a lau mahmah uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin vantungmi in, “Lau kei un. Mi khempeuh a lungdamsak ding thuthak hoih khat note a’ ding ka hong puak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni-in David khuapi sungah, note a hong honkhia ding Khrih Topa a suak hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah na theih nading uh a lim hih bang hi ding hi: Puan tawh kitun naungek khat, gan annekna kuang sungah a kisial na mu ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua khit phetin tua vantungmi tawh vantung mihonpite thakhatin hong omin Pasian phatna la sa uh a,"},"14":{"text":"“Van a sang belna-ah a om Pasian’ min thang hen la, ama pahtak leitung mite tungah nopna om ta hen,” a ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Vantung mite vantungah a ciahkik khit uh ciangin tuucingte in, “Bethlehem khua-ah pai-in, Topa’ hong gen hih thupiang va en ni,” a kici uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute nawhpai mahmah uh a, Mary le Josef le gan annekna kuang sungah a kisial naungek a mupah uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua bangin naungek a muh uh ciangin, vantungmi in amaute kiangah hih naungek tawh kisai thu a gente a gensawn uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih tuucingte’ thugen a za mi khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mary in ahihleh a lungsimah hih thute ciamtehin a ngaihsunsun hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuucingte zong ciahkik uh a, amaute tungah a kigensa bangin a zaksa le a muhsa uh thute hangin Pasian’ min a phat uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Naungek a vun a ki-at ni hun nipikal khat a cin khit ciangin, amah a kipaii ma-in a min dingin vantungmi in a piaksa ahi Jesuh, a min dingin a phuak uh hi.","title":"Vun A Ki-atna le Minphuahna","ref":"Siam 12:3; Luk 1:31"},"22":{"text":"Moses Thukham sungah a kigelhna tawh kizui-in Josef le Mary a kisiansuah ding uh hun hong tung hi. Tua ahih manin Topa tungah naungek a ap dingin Jerusalem-ah a paipih uh hi.","title":"Jesuh, Biakinn-ah Apna"},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ Thukham sungah, “Ta pasal masa peuhmah Topa tungah ki-ap ding hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Pai 13:2,12"},"24":{"text":"Topa Thukham sungah a kigelhna tawh kizui-in biakna-in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin a pia dingin zong a pai uh ahi hi.","ref":"Siam 12:6-8"},"25":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sungah Simeon a kici mi khat na om hi. Amah a thuman, a biakna mi mahmah khat hi a, Israel mite a kihotkhiat hun ding a ngakngak mi khat ahi hi. Kha Siangtho in a ompih mi khat hi a,"},"26":{"text":"Topa’ hong ciamsa Khrih a muh matengin a sih loh nading thu zong ama tungah Kha Siangtho in na genkhin hi."},"27":{"text":"Kha Siangtho’ makaihna tawh biakinn sungah Simeon a pai hi. A nu le a pate in thukham sunga om ngeina bangin Topa tungah naungek a ap dingin biakinn-ah a hong paipih uh ciangin,"},"28":{"text":"Simeon in naungek la-in a ang-ah tawi-in Pasian’ tungah lungdamna ko a,"},"29":{"text":"“Topa aw, na thuciamna tu-in nong tungsak a, na nasempa keima lungsim nong nuamsak hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka mit mahmah tawh nong hotkhiatna ka mukhin a,"},"31":{"text":"minam khempeuh’ muhin nong tungsak a,"},"32":{"text":"Gentail mite in khuavak a muh nading le nangma mi Israel-te a minthan nadingin na vaihawm hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 42:6; 49:6; 52:10"},"33":{"text":"Naungek’ nu le pate in, hih bangin Simeon in naungek’ thu a genna a zak uh ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Simeon in amaute thupha a piak khit ciangin naungek’ nu Mary kiangah, “Hih naungek pen, Israel mite sungah mi tampi in siatna a ngah nading, le mi tampi in hotkhiatna a ngah nading ahi hi. Mi tampi in hih naungek nial ding uh a,"},"35":{"text":"mite’ lungsimtawng a kilatna hong hi ding hi. Dahna lungkhamna in namsau hiam bangin nangma lungsim mahmah zong hong sunkham ding hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua laitakin Asher minamte sung panin Fanuel’ tanu Anna minnei kamsang numei khat a om hi. Amah a khangham mahmah khat hi a, a nungak laitakin a neih a pasal tawh kum sagih sung a tenkhop khit ciangin,"},"37":{"text":"kum sawmgiat le kum li sung meigongin a om ahi hi. Amah pen biakna a nusia ngei lo mi khat hi a, a sun a zanin Pasian bia-in an tangin thu a ngenngen mi khat ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua bangin Jesuh a ki-ap hun laitakin hih kamsangnu hong pai-in Pasian tungah lungdamna ko a, Jerusalem a suahtak nading lamenin a ngak mi khempeuh tungah hih naungek’ thu a gen hi."},"39":{"text":"Amaute in Topa’ Thukham tawh kizui-in hih ding a kisam khempeuh a bawl khit uh ciangin Galilee gam, amau khua Nazareth-ah a ciahkik uh hi.","title":"Nazareth khua-ah Ciahkikna","ref":"Mat 2:23"},"40":{"text":"Tua naupang hong khangin hong thahat hi. Lungpilna tawh kidim a, Pasian in thupha a pia hi."},"41":{"text":"Kumsimin Jerusalem khua-a Paisan Pawi a kibawlna-ah Jesuh’ nu le pa a pai zel uh ahi hi.","title":"Biakinn sungah Naupang Jesuh","ref":"Pai 12:1-27; Thkna 16:1-8"},"42":{"text":"Jesuh, kum sawm le nih a phak ciangin a ngeina bangin tua pawi-ah a thumun a pai uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua pawi vengin a ciahkik uh ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah naupang Jesuh kinusia kha hi. A nu le a pa in a nusiatlam uh thei lo uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Amaute’ honlak mahah a omomin ngaihsun uh ahih manin ni khat lam paikhin uh a, tua ciangin a lawmte le a tanaute lak khawng a zong pan uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Amah a muh zawh loh uh ciangin Jerusalem-ah kileh kikin a zong uh hi."},"46":{"text":"A ciahzawh uh a ni thum ni ciangin biakinn sungah amah mu uh a, siate lakah tu-in a thugen uh ngai-in, thu zong dong zelin a om a mu uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Amah in pilna tawh thu genin a dawnna a za mite khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh hi."},"48":{"text":"A nu le a pa in a muh uh ciangin lamdangsa uh a, a nu in, “Ka ta aw, bang hangin hong hici bawl na hi hiam? Na pa tawh lungkham mahmahin nang ka hong zong uh hi,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh in a nu le a pa kiangah, “Bang hangin kei hong zong na hi uh hiam? Ka Pa’ inn sungah ka om ding lamtak thei lo na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"50":{"text":"Ahi zongin bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, ci-in a nu le a pa in thei lo uh hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a nu le a pa zui-in Nazareth khua-ah ciahkik a, amaute’ thu mangin tua lai-ah hoihtakin a om hi. A nu in hih thu khempeuh a lungsim sungah ngaihsunsun hi."},"52":{"text":"Jesuh a pumpi le a pilna khang a, ama gamtatna in Pasian le mite a lungkimsak semsem hi.","ref":"1Sam 2:26; Pau 3:4"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gam tampi a uk Sisar Tiberius in a ukzawh a kum sawm le ngana, Pontias Pilat in Judea gam ukin, Herod in Galilee gam ukin, a nau Filip in Iturea gam le Trakhonitis gam ukin, Lysanias in Abilene gam uk a,","title":"Tuiphumpa Johan’ Thuhilhna (Mat 3:1-12 ; Mrk 1:1-8 ; Joh 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Annas le Kaiafas in siampi lianpen a sep laitakin sehnel gamah a om, Zekhariah’ tapa Johan’ tungah, Pasian’ thu hong tung hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Jordan Gun kiim gam khempeuhah Johan pai kawikawi a, kamsang Isaiah in Lai Siangtho sungah a gelh mah bangin, “Na mawhna panun kisik unla tui kiphum un. Tua hileh Pasian in na mawhnate uh hong maisak ding hi,” ci-in thu a hilh hi."},"4":{"text":"Isaiah in hih bangin na gelh hi: “Gam sungah mi khat kiko a, ‘Topa’ pai nading lampi bawl unla, a tot ding lampi tangsak un."},"5":{"text":"Kuam thuk khempeuh kivukdim ding a, mual lian mual neu khempeuh kitotam ding hi. Lam kawite kitangsak ding a, a leihumte kinelsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in Pasian’ hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi,’” ci-in a kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 40:3-5"},"7":{"text":"Ama tuiphum ding utin a hong pai mi tampite kiangah Johan in, “Gul bangin ngian a zang note aw, hong tung ding Pasian’ hehna panin na suahtak theih nading uh kua in hong gen ahi hiam?","ref":"Mat 12:34; 23:33"},"8":{"text":"Na kisikna uh a kilat nadingin gamta un. Note khatlekhat in, ‘Abraham’ suante ihi ngawn hi,’ mawkcih kei un. Ke’n kong cihin-ah, Pasian in hih suangte nangawn Abraham’ suanlekhakte-in bawl thei lel hi.","ref":"Joh 8:33"},"9":{"text":"Tu mahmahin sing a bulphuk dingin hei tawh kingimzo hi. Gah hoih a gah lo singkung khempeuh kiphukin meikhuk sungah kikhul ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 7:19"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihonpite in, “Tua bang ahihleh bangci gamtat ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin"},"11":{"text":"Johan in, “Puanak nih a nei mipa in a nei lote hawm unla, annek ding a neite in a nei lote hawm un,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Siahdongte pawlkhat zong tui a kiphum dingin hong pai-in Johan kiangah, “Sia aw, bangci gamtat ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.","ref":"Luk 7:29"},"13":{"text":"Amah in, “Na don’ dingun a kilawm zahval na dong kei un,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Galkap pawlkhatte in zong ama kiangah, “Kote, bangci gamtat ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin, “Zawhthawh thu tawh ahi a, a man lopi-in mawhsakna tawh ahi zongin kuama sum sut kei unla, na khasum ngahzah uh tawh lungkim un,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Thulian khat peuhpeuh hong piang ding hi, ci-in mite’ lawpna hong khang semsem a, hih pa pen Khrih hi kha ding hi, ci-in mite in a lungsim uhah a ngaihsun uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Johan in amaute kiangah, “Keimah in tui sungah note ka hong phum hi; ahi zongin kei sangin nakpitakin a lianzaw khat hong pailai ding hi. Ama khedap khau a sutsak ding nangawnin kei ka kilawmzo nai kei hi. Amah in Kha Siangtho le mei sungah note hong phum ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A buh cilsate a zapsiang nadingin amah in a khut sungah lawhpi tawi a, a takteng ansal sungah koihin, a siteng a mit ngei lo mei sungah a khul ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua bangin a lam tuamtuamin Johan in mite hanthawnin Lungdamna Thu a hilh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi zongin, gam ukpa Herod in ama naupa’ zi Herodias a tenpihna hang le a gamtat hoih lohna a tuamtuamte’ hangin Johan in Herod a taii hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Herod in thong sungah Johan khia a, a gamtatsiatna a behlap lailai hi.","ref":"Mat 14:3-4; Mrk 6:17-18"},"21":{"text":"Mi khempeuh a kituiphum khit uh ciangin Jesuh zong a kituiphum hi. Jesuh in thu a nget laitakin vantung kihong a,","title":"Jesuh A Kituiphumna (Mat 3:13-17 ; Mrk 1:9-11)"},"22":{"text":"vakhu pumpi lim nei-in Kha Siangtho ama tungah hong kumsuk hi.
