Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate un zong tua bangmahin kamsangte tungah a bawl uh hi.","ref":"2Khang 36:16; Sawl 7:52"},"24":{"text":"“Ahi zongin tuhunin a hau note in nopsakna ngahkhin na hih manun gimna na thuak ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuhunin a gilvah note in gilkial gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Tuhunin a lungdam note dahin na kap ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"“Mi khempeuh in note hong pahtakbawl ciangin gimna a thuak ding na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate un zong tua bangmahin kamsang zuaute a pahtakbawl uh hi."},"27":{"text":"“Ahi zongin ka thugen a za note kiangah kong cihin-ah: Na galte uh na it unla, no hong mudah mite tungah a pha na bawl un.","title":"Galte Itna (Mat 5:38-48 ; 7:12a)"},"28":{"text":"No hong phuisamte thupha na pia unla, no hong bawlsiate a’ ding thu na ngetsak un."},"29":{"text":"Na paang langkhat a hong bengte, a langkhat zong na dawhlai un. Na puantungsilh uh a hong sutte tungah, na puansungsilh uh zong na piathuah lai un."},"30":{"text":"A hong ngente peuhmah na pia unla, na na uh a hong laksakte tung panin lakik kei un."},"31":{"text":"Note tungah a hong kibawl ding na deih uh bangin midangte tungah na bawl un.","ref":"Mat 7:12"},"32":{"text":"“No hong itte bek it le-uhcin bang hangin thupha ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Mawhnei mite nangawn in amau a itte a it uh hi."},"33":{"text":"No tungah a hoihin a hong gamtate tung bekah a hoihin gamta le-uh cin bang hangin thupha ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Mawhneite nangawn tua bangmahin gamta uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ngahkik ding na lametna uh mite tung bekah leitawi na piak uhleh bang hangin thupha ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Mawhneite nangawn in zong a piakzah mah uh a ngahkik dingin khatlekhat kileitawi uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua bang lelin note na gamta kei ding uh hi. Na galte uh itin amaute tungah thupha bawl unla, lohkik ding lamen loin leitawi pia un. Tua hileh na thaman uh lian ding a, a Lianpen Pasian’ tate na hi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh lungdamna mel a theithei lo mite le a huaiham mite tungah amah migi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahih manin na Pa un hehpihna a neih bangin note in zong hehpihna lungsim nei ta un."},"37":{"text":"“Midangte’ thu khen kei un. Tua hileh no tungah zong Pasian in thu hong khen lo ding hi. Midangte mawhsak kei un. Tua hileh Pasian in note zong hong mawhsak lo ding hi. Midangte’ mawhna maisak un. Tua hi leh Pasian in note’ mawhna zong hong maisak ding hi.","title":"Midangte’ Thu Khenna (Mat 7:1-5)"},"38":{"text":"Midangte tungah pia un. Tua hileh Pasian in note tungah zong hong pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh midangte na piakna uh tawh kizui-in a henhen, a tahtah, a dimletin Pasian in note tungah hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat zong gen a, “Mittaw khat in mittaw dang khat lam paipih thei lo hi. Paipih zenzen leh a nih tuakun hawkguamah kiakhawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 15:14"},"40":{"text":"Sang naupang khat a siapa sangin lianzaw ngei lo hi; a sin ding khempeuh a theihkhit ciangin a siapa tawh kikim pan bek ding hi.”","ref":"Mat 10:24-25; Joh 13:16; 15:20"},"41":{"text":"“Bang hangin na mit sungah singluang a tang phawkkha loin na lawmte’ mit sunga ninthem tang etsak na hi hiam?"},"42":{"text":"Na mit sunga singluang hong tang nangawn mu lo napi-in, ‘Lawm aw, na mit sunga ninthem tang hong lakkhiatsak ning,’ ci-in na lawmte kiangah bangci gentheih ding na hi hiam? No a kineihkhemte aw, na mit sung uha singluang tang lakhia masa le-uhcin, na lawmte uh mit sunga ninthem tang mu-in na lakhia thei pan ding uh hi.”"},"43":{"text":"“A cidam singkung in gah ginalo gah ngei lo a, a ginalo singkung in gah limci gah ngei lo hi.","title":"Singkung A Gahin Kithei (Mat 7:16-20 ; 12:33-35)"},"44":{"text":"Singkung khempeuh a gah tawh kithei thei hi. Sialtalling kung panin theigah kilo ngei lo a, lingvom kung panin leenggah kilo ngei lo hi.","ref":"Mat 12:33"},"45":{"text":"Mihoih pa in a lungsim sunga thuhoih omteng hong suahkhia a, migilo pa in a lungsim sunga a gitlohna teng hong suahkhia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite pen amau’ lungsim sunga a om bangbang a hong paukhia uh ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 12:34"},"46":{"text":"“Bang hangin, ‘Topa aw, Topa aw,’ hong ci napi-in ka hong gente zui lo na hi uh hiam?","title":"Bulpi Nam Nihte (Mat 7:24-27)"},"47":{"text":"Ka kiangah hong pai a, ka thuhilhna za-in a zuite khempeuh pen kua tawh kibang hiam cih leh,"},"48":{"text":"suang tungah inn lamin, a khuamkua ding suangsung thukpi tak to-in a phut pa tawh kibang hi. Tui a khan ciangin tui in tua inn a nawk hangin limtakin kilam ahih manin susia zo lo hi."},"49":{"text":"Ahi zongin ka thuhilhna za napi-in a zui lote pen bulkip a nei lo, leilak mawkmawkah inn a lam pa tawh kibang hi. Tuikhang in tua inn a nawk ciangin thakhat thu-in siagawppah a, tua inn pen naksiat mahmah hi,” a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in mite kiangah a thugen dingteng a man khit ciangin Kapernaum khua-ah a pai hi.","title":"Jesuh in Galkap bupa’ Nasempa Damsak (Mat 8:5-13)"},"2":{"text":"Tua khua sungah Rom mi galkapbu khat om a, tua bupa in a it mahmah nasem khat a nei hi. Tua a nasempa a ci na-in a si dektak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bupa in Jesuh’ thu a zak ciangin, ama kiangah Jew mi upate pawlkhat sawl a, Jesuh hong pai-in a nasempa a damsak nading a thumsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh kiangah Jew mi upate a tun uh ciangin nakpitakin thum uh a, “Amah na huh dingin a kilawm mahmah mi khat ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in ei minam hong it mahmah a, kikhop nading inn khat zong hong lamsak hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Jesuh in zong amaute sapna bangin a va zui hi. Jesuh a tun madiakin galkap bupa in Jesuh kiangah a lawmte pawlkhat sawl a, “Topa aw, ka inn-ah nong pai nadingin kei kilawm zo lo ka hih manin hong pai dah hoh in."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah tawh a kimu dingin zong kilawmzo kisa lo ka hih manin keima pumpi kong pai kei hi. Thu pia peuh lecin ka nasempa dam lel ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei zong uliante’ khutnuai-ah hong kikoih mi khat ka hi a, keima khutnuai-ah zong galkapte a om hi. Khat kiangah, ‘Pai in,’ ci leng a pai hi. Khat kiangah, ‘Hong pai in,’ ci leng a hong pai hi. Ka nasempa kiangah, ‘Hih na sem in,’ ci leng zong sem hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin lamdangsa mahmah a, amah a zui mihonte lamah kihei-in, “Israel mite lak nangawnah hih bang upna ka mu nai kei hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"A kamtaite, galkap bupa inn-ah hong tunkik ciangin a nasempa a na damsiang khinta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua khit a sawt loin Nain khua-ah Jesuh pai a, a nungzuite le mihonpite in zong a zui uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Nain Khua-ah Meigongnu’ Tapa Hingkiksak"},"12":{"text":"Tua khua kulhkongpi a tun laitakun misi vui-a hong pai mihon tawh a kituak uh hi. A misi pen meigong khat’ tapa khat neihsun hi a, tua khuasung mihon tampite in tua si vuina-ah meigongnu hong zui uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in tua meigongnu a muh ciangin a khasiat suak a, “Kap kei in,” ci-in a khem hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin pai-in a hankuang va len a, si puate zong a khawlpah uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tangval aw, tho in, kong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Misi pa zong hong tuto-in hong paupah hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nu kiangah a ap hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, Pasian min phatin, “Eite lakah kamsang lian khat hong om khinta a, a mite a honkhia dingin Pasian hong pai khinta hi,” a ci uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih Jesuh thu pen Judea gam sung le a kiim gam khempeuhah kizel hi."},"18":{"text":"Johan’ nungzuite in hih Jesuh’ thu khempeuh Johan kiangah a gen uh hi.","title":"Tuiphumpa Johan kiang pan Kamtaite (Mat 11:2-19)"},"19":{"text":"Johan in zong ama nungzuite nih sam a, Topa kiangah amaute paisakin, “Johan in hong pai ding a cih pa mah na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh adang na lamen lai ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong dingin a sawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh kiangah amaute a tun uh ciangin, “‘Hong pai ding ka cih pa mah na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh adang na lamen lai ding ka hi uh hiam?’ ci-in a dong dingin Tuiphumpa Johan in hong sawl hi,” a ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun laitak mahmahin natna a tuamtuamte tampi damsakin, dawivei mite sung panin dawite hawlkhia a, mittaw mi tampi khua a musak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Johan’ kamtaite kiangah, “Va ciahkik unla, na muhsa uh le na zaksa uh thute khempeuh Johan kiangah va gen un. Mittawte in khua muthei a, khebaite lam paithei a, miphakte damkik a, bilngongte in khua zathei kik a, misite kihingsakkik a, mizawngte tungah Lungdamna Thu kihilh hi.","ref":"Isa 35:5-6; 61:1"},"23":{"text":"Kei hong umte pen a lungdamhuai mahmah ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"Johan’ kamtaite a ciahkik khit ciangin Jesuh in mihonte tungah Johan’ thu gen a, “Johan kiang gamlakah na pai uh ciangin bang a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Huih in a mut awn diamdiam lopa kungte a en ding maw?"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih kei leh bang a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Puan hoihnono a silh mi khat a en ding maw? A taktakin ci lehang tua bangin puan hoih silh a, nuamtakin a omte pen inn lianpipi sungah teng uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahihleh bang a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Kamsangpa khat a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Hi hi, kamsangpa a en dingin na pai uh a, kamsang ciang bek hi loin a lianzaw khat na mu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in Johan thu a genna-ah, ‘Hih lai-ah ka kamtai pa om hi. Nangma lampi a hong dingin na mai-ah ka mapaisak ding hi, ci-in Pasian in gen hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"28":{"text":"Johan pen leitung mihing sung khempeuh panin a lianpen ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian’ Ukna sunga a om mi a neupen i cihte nangawn Johan sangin lianzaw lai hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Siahdongte le midangte khempeuh in hih thu a zak uh ciangin Pasian’ deihna zui-in Johan’ khut sungah tui a kiphum uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate in Pasian’ deihna nialin Johan khut sungah tui kiphum ding ut lo uh hi.","ref":"Mat 21:32; Luk 3:12"},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tuhuna mite bang tawh genteh ding a, bang tawh kibang ci ding ka hi hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Mihon omna lamkabomah a tu naupang a kimawlte tawh kibang uh hi. Naupang honkhat in a lawmte kiangah, ‘Lam nading khuang kong tumsak hangun na lam nuam kei uh a, kahna la ka sak hangun lah na kap nuam tuan kei uh hi,’ a cihte tawh a kibang uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Tuiphumpa Johan hong pai a, amah in zu le an tangin a om ciangin, ‘Dawivei hi,’ a ci uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Mihing Tapa hong pai leuleu a, zune anne-in a om ciangin, ‘Zuhai, anhai pa, siahdongte le midangte in a kikholhpih nop loh mite tawh a kikhawlpa,’ ci leuleu uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ pilna a man ahih lamtak, ama thu a zui mite in kilangsak hi,” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Farisi mite khat in a inn-ah an ne dingin Jesuh sam a, Jesuh zong pai-in an ne dingin a tu hi.","title":"Farisi Mi Simon’ Inn-ah Jesuh"},"37":{"text":"Tua khua sungah a paktat numei khat om hi. Farisi mipa’ inn-ah Jesuh in an ne-in a omna thu a zak ciangin paknamtui suangngo thawl a dim khat hong paipihin,"},"38":{"text":"Jesuh’ nungah tu-in kap a, a khitui tawh Jesuh’ khete kawtsakin a sam tawh nulsak a, a khete namin a sathau puak a nuh hi.","ref":"Mat 26:7; Mrk 14:3; Joh 12:3"},"39":{"text":"Jesuh a sam Farisi mipa in a muh ciangin a lungsim sungah, “Hih pa pen kamsang taktak hileh amah a lawng hih numeinu a bangci mi ahi hiam cih thei ding a, ama gamtat hoih lohna teng zong thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Simon aw, kong gennop khat om hi,” a ci hi. Simon in, “Sia aw, bang hong gennuam na hi hiam?” a cih ciangin"},"41":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Lei a ba mi nih om hi. Khat in ngun peek zanga ba a, a khat in sawmnga ba hi."},"42":{"text":"Amau tegel in a loh zawh loh ciangin a batna pa un a nih tuakun a maisak hi. Hih mi nihte sung panin kua in amah itzaw ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Simon in, “Leiba tam a maisakna pa in itzaw dingin ka um hi,” ci-in a dawn ciangin Jesuh in, “Na genna man mahmah hi,” a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei lamah Jesuh kihei a, Simon kiangah, “Hih numei’ gamtatna na mu hiam? Na inn-ah kong pai a, ka khe sil nading tui nong pia kei hi. Ahi zongin amah in a khitui tawh ka khe hong silsak a, a sam tawh hong nulkeusak hi."},"45":{"text":"Nang in napna tawh leengla na hong do kei a, ahi zongin amah in hih lai-ah kong tun a kipanin tu dongin ka khe a nap khawl nai lo hi."},"46":{"text":"Nang in ka lu sathau nong nilhsak kei a, ahi zongin amah in ka khe nangawn sathau namtui hong nuhsak hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin nang kiangah kong genin-ah, ama mawhna tampi tak a omte kimaisak khin ahih manin amah in a itna nakpitakin a lak hi. Ahi zongin tawmno bek a kimaisakte in a itna uh tawmno bek mahin a lak uh hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in numei kiangah, “Na mawhnate hong kimaisak khin hi,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh tawh sabuai-ah an a nekhawm midangte in a lungsim sung uhah, “Mawhna nangawn a maisak hih mipa kua ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in numei kiangah, “Na upna in nang hong damsak khinta hi; lungnuam takin va ciah in,” a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuazawh tawlkhat khit ciangin khuapite le khuaneute-ah a ban banin Jesuh pai a, Pasian’ Ukna hangin Lungdamna Thu hilhin a vak kawikawi hi. Tua a vak kawikawina-ah nungzui sawm le nihte,","title":"Numei Pawlkhat in Jesuh Zui"},"2":{"text":"le a sungpan dawi a hawlkhiatsakte le natna tuamtuam pan a damsak numei pawlkhat in zong a zui uh hi. Tua numeite: A sung panin dawi sagih a kihawlkhiatna Mary (Magdala khuami Mary a kici nu),"},"3":{"text":"Herod’ khutnuai-a ulian Khuza’ zi Joanna, Susanna, le numei dang tampite hi uh a, amau’ neihsa tawh Jesuh le a nungzuite a huh uh hi.","ref":"Mat 27:55-56; Mrk 15:40-41; Luk 23:49"},"4":{"text":"Khua khat khit khua khat panin Jesuh kiangah a hong pai mi hong kibehlaplap a, mi tampi tak hong om ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna khat gen a,","title":"Khaici Vawhpa Thugentehna (Mat 13:1-9 ; Mrk 4:1-9)"},"5":{"text":"“Khaici vawhpa khaici vawh dingin a kuankhia hi. Khaici a vawh ciangin pawlkhatte lampidung tu a, khe tawh kisik gawpin vasate in a ne hi."},"6":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, suang kitawphahna leilak tu a, a po tei hangin leisung a nom tam lo ahih manin a vulkik pah hi."},"7":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, lingbulsum omna leilak tu a, lingte a khan ciangin a deplum hi."},"8":{"text":"Pawlkhatte, leihoihna lak tu-in khang a, a zah zakhat ciang dong a piang hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh nakpitakin kiko a, “Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu za ta un,” ci-in a thugen a khum hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih thugentehna bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, ci-in a nungzuite in a dot ciangin","title":"Thugentehna A Deihna (Mat 13:10-17 ; Mrk 4:10-12)"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pasian’ Ukna thu tawh kisai thusim, note tungah hong kigen hi. Ahi zongin midangte in, en en napi-un a muh loh nading za za napi-un a tel loh nadingun amaute tungah thugentehna tawh thu kigen hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Thugentehna a khiatna pen hih bang ahi hi: Khaici pen Pasian’ thu hi.","title":"Jesuh in Khaici Vawhpa Thugentehna Telgen (Mat 13:18-23 ; Mrk 4:13-20)"},"12":{"text":"Lamdungah khaici a tukna munte pen Pasian’ thu a zate a cihnopna ahi hi. Tuate in Pasian’ thu a zak hangun a thu um loin, hotkhiatna a ngah loh nadingun Dawimangpa hong pai-in a lakkhiatsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Suang kitawphah leilak a tukna munte pen Pasian’ thu a zak ciangin lungdam takin a sangte a cihna ahi hi. Ahi zongin amaute sungah thuktum lo ahih manin tawlkhat sung bek um uh a, ze-etna hun a tun ciangin a puk uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Lingbulsum omna a tukna munte pen Pasian’ thu za napi-in a nuntakna sung uhah leitung lunghihmawhna, hauhna, le nopsaknate in depgawp ahih manin bangmah a suakkhia zo lote a cihnopna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Leihoih a tukna munte pen Pasian’ thu a zak ciangin lungsimtak tawh a thu mangin kip tawntung uh ahih manin amau a dingin man a neite a cihnopna ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Mei a vak khit ciangin lawh a khuh ahi a, lupna nuai-ah a koih ahi zongin kuamah om lo hi. Innsungah a lut uh ciangin mite in khua a muhtheih nadingin meivak koihna kho sangah koih bek uh hi.","title":"Lawh A Kikhuh Meivak (Mat 4:21-25)","ref":"Mat 5:15; Luk 11:33"},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh, thusimin a kikoih peuhmah, khatvei teitei thulang a suak lo ding, a kiselcip peuhmah, khatvei teitei a kipholak lo ding, bangmah om lo hi.","ref":"Mat 10:26; Luk 12:2"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin thu na ngaih uh ciangin limtakin kingaihsun un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a neisa mipa tungah Pasian in piathuah ding a, a nei lo mipa tung panin themkhat nei-a a kingaihsut nangawn lakkhiatsak ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 25:29; Luk 19:26"},"19":{"text":"Tua laitakin Jesuh’ nu le a naute hong pai uh a, ahi zongin mihon kinehlua uh ahih manin ama kiangah pai thei lo uh hi.","title":"Jesuh’ Nu le A Naute (Mat 12:46-50 ; Mrk 3:31-35)"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mi khat in Jesuh kiangah, “Na nu le na naute in nang hong munuam uh a, innpua-ah om uh hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a dawnna-in mihon khempeuh tungah, “Pasian’ thu za a, a zuite khempeuh pen ka nu le ka sanggamte ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Nikhat, Jesuh a nungzuite tawh gunkuang tungah tuang a, amaute kiangah, “Tuili galkhatah pai ni,” ci-in a pai uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Huihpi Daisak (Mat 8:23-27 ; Mrk 4:35-41)"},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin a pai laitakun Jesuh a ihmu hi. Tui tungah nakpitakin huihpi hong nungin gunkuang sungah tui dim dingin hong kipan a, lauhuai mahmah hi."},"24":{"text":"Nungzuite in Jesuh hong naihin phong uh a, “Topa aw, Topa aw, kote ka si dektak uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Jesuh zong tho-in huihpi le tui kilok a daih nadingin thu pia a, a thupiak bangin hong dai dide pah hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Na upna uh koi-ah om khinta ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Ahi zongin amaute lau-in lamdangsa uh a, khatlekhat in, “Hih pa kua ahi hiam? Thu a piak ciangin huihpi le tuihualte nangawn in a thu mang uh hi,” a kici uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Galilee Tuili galkhat, Gadara gam a tung uh hi.","title":"Gadara khuami Dawivei pa Kidamsak (Mat 8:28-34 ; Mrk 5:1-20)"},"27":{"text":"Gunkuang tung panin leilakah Jesuh hong paisuk laitakin tua khuasunga om dawivei mi khat in a na dawn hi. Tua dawivei pa pen sauveipi sung puan silhloin omkhin a, inn-ah zong om loin han lak khawngah om tawntung hi."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh a muh ciangin nakpitakin awngin a mai-ah khukdin a, “A Lian Pasian’ Tapa Jesuh aw, kei bang hong nuammawh na hi hiam? Kei, gim nong piak loh nadingin ka hong thum hi,” ci-in nakpitakin a kiko hi."},"29":{"text":"Hih bangin a cihna pen, ama sung panin dawi a paikhiat nadingin Jesuh in thu a piakna hang ahi hi. Dawi in tua mipa tamveipi tak man a, a khut le a khete sikkhau tawh khihin a kikepcip hangin a sikkhaute peksat a, dawi in gamlakah a paikhiatpih hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Na min bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, ama sungah dawi tampi lut ahih manin, “A Honpi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"31":{"text":"Leihawm thukpi sungah amaute a khiat loh nadingin Jesuh kiangah a thum uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua laitakin tua kiim mualpang to-ah vok honpi khat gamta-in a om hi. Tua vokte sungah a luttheih nadingun dawite in Jesuh kiangah thum uh a, Jesuh in zong amau’ ngetna bangin a pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih manin dawite zong mipa sung panin paikhia-in vokte sungah lut uh a, vokte zong tui gei keen tung khawngah tuaksuk gawpin a vekpi-in tui a kia hi."},"34":{"text":"Vokcingte in hih thupiang a muh uh ciangin amaute tai-in khuasung le gam sung tengah a zasak uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Hih thupiang a en dingin mite hong pai uh a, Jesuh kiang a tun uh ciangin dawi a paikhiatna mipa Jesuh kiangah omin, puan silhin, a pilkikna thu a muh uh ciangin a vekpi-un lamdangsa-in a lau uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua thupiang a mu masa mite in dawivei pa a damnazia thute, amaute tungah a na gen uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin Gadara gam kiima om khempeuh lau mahmah uh ahih manin Jesuh a paikhiat nadingin a sawl uh hi. Jesuh zong gunkuang tungah tuangin a ciah hi."},"38":{"text":"Dawi a paikhiatna mipa in Jesuh kiangah, “Kei zong hong zuisak in,” ci-in a thum hi; ahi zongin Jesuh in,"},"39":{"text":"“Na inn-ah ciah inla, Pasian in nang a dingin bangzah takin na hong sepsak hiam, cihna thu va gen in,” ci-in a sawlkhia hi. A mipa zong ciah a, ama a dingin Jesuh’ sepsakna thu khempeuh, khuasung tengah a gengen hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuili galkhatah Jesuh hong ciahkik ciangin, ama hong ciahkik ding ngakin om niloh uh ahih manin mite na nuam mahmah uh hi.","title":"Jairas’ Tanu le Jesuh’ Puan A Lawng Numei (Mat 9:18-26 ; Mrk 5:21-43)"},"41":{"text":"Tua laitakin kikhopna inn ukpi Jairas a kici mi khat hong pai-in Jesuh’ khe phungah hong khukdin a, ama inn-ah a pai nadingin a thum hi."},"42":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kum sawm le nih a pha tanu khat a neihsun pen a ci na-in a si dektak hi. Jesuh zong tua inn zuan dingin a pai laitakin mihonpite in zui-in a nehcip uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua laitakin kum sawm le nih tawntung siluang natna vei-in, a neih khempeuh siavuante cialna-in a zat hangin kuamah in a damsak zawh loh numei khat,"},"44":{"text":"mihonte lak Jesuh nungah hong pai-in Jesuh’ puanmongteep lawngsim a, thakhatin a siluang a kangpah hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Kua in hong lawng na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Kuamah in, “Hong lawng ing,” a cih loh ciangin Peter in, “Topa aw, mi khempeuh in nang hong umcihin hong nehcip uh hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Ka sung panin vangliatna a paikhiat lamtak phawk ka hih manin mi khat in hong lawng hi,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Numei in amah a kiphawkna thu a theih ciangin a lingsa-in hong pai-in Jesuh mai-ah hong bok a, Jesuh a lawnna thu le amah a dampahna thuteng, tua lai-a om mi khempeuh’ zakin Jesuh kiangah a pulak hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in numei kiangah, “Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang hong damsakzo hi; lungnuam takin na ciah in,” a ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua bangin thu a gen laitakin kikhopna inn ukpa’ inn panin kamtai khat hong tung a, “Na tanu si khinzo ta hi. Siapa gimsak nawn kei in,” a hong ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin, kikhopna inn ukpa kiangah, “Lunghimawh kei in; upna nei peuh lecin na tanu a hingkik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua inn-ah Jesuh a tun ciangin Peter, Johan, le James le numeino’ nu le pa simloh kuamah dang, inn sungah zuisak lo hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua lai-a om mi khempeuh, tua numeino’ sihna hangin kapin, thumin na om uh hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Kap nawn kei un, amah a si hi lo hi; a ihmu bek ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Amah a sihkhitna thei uh ahih manin Jesuh a nuihsan lel uh hi."},"54":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in numeino a khutin lenin, “Numeino aw, tho in,” a ci hi."},"55":{"text":"Numeino zong hingkik a, thakhatin a thopah hi. Tua ciangin numeino’ nek ding an pia un, ci-in Jesuh in a sawl hi."},"56":{"text":"Numeino’ nu le pa in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, ahi zongin hih thupiangte kuama kiangah a gen loh nadingun Jesuh in a kham hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in nungzui sawm le nihte sam a, dawite a hawlkhiat theih nading uh le cinate a damsak theih nadingun vangliatna le aana a pia hi.","title":"Sawm le nihte A Kisawlna (Mat 10:5-15 ; Mrk 6:7-13)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian’ Ukna thu a hilh ding le cinatnate a damsak dingin kuankhia sakin"},"3":{"text":"amaute kiangah, “Tu-a na khualzinna uhah bangmah keng kei un. Ciangkhut ahi a, ip ahi a, an ahi a, sum ahi zongin keng kei unla, puan-ak zong a valin kengthuah kei un."},"4":{"text":"Khua khatpeuhah na lut uh ciangin tua khua panin na paikhiat matengun a inn-ah hong tungsakte’ inn mahah om paisuak un."},"5":{"text":"A inn uhah a hong tunsak nop lohna khua peuhpeuh panin na paikhiat uh ciangin amaute hilhkholhna-in na khe uha leivui bangte sinsan un,” ci-in a vaikhak hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:51; Luk 10:4-11"},"6":{"text":"Nungzuite zong kuankhia uh a, khua khempeuhah pai-in Lungdamna Thu hilh uh a, a paina khempeuh uhah cinate a damsak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Galilee gam sungteng a uk Herod in hih thupiangte a zak ciangin lungmang mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi pawlkhat in, “Johan hong hingkik hi,” ci uh hi.","title":"Herod’ Lungmanna (Mat 14:1-12 ; Mrk 6:14-29)"},"8":{"text":"Pawlkhat in, “Elijah hong kilangkik hi,” ci uh a, pawlkhat in, “Tanglai kamsangte khat hong hingkik hi,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"Mat 16:14; Mrk 8:28; Luk 9:19"},"9":{"text":"Herod in, “Johan a ngawng ka tansak khitsa ahi hi; hih a thu ka zak mipa kua hi ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Jesuh tawh kimuh ding a hanciam hi."},"10":{"text":"Sawltakte a khualzinna panun a hong tunkik uh ciangin a sepna teng uh Jesuh kiangah a gen uh hi. Jesuh in zong amauteng bek a om theih nadingun amaute samkhia a, Bethsaida khua lamah a paipih hi.","title":"Tul Nga Vakna (Mat 14:13-21 ; Mrk 6:30-44 ; Joh 6:1-14)"},"11":{"text":"Mihonte in hih thu a theih uh ciangin Jesuh nungdelh uh a, Jesuh in zong amaute na nolh loin, amaute tungah Pasian’ Ukna thu na hilh a, natna a neite zong a damsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Ni a tum kuan ciangin nungzui sawm le nihte in Jesuh kiangah, “Hih lai mun gamlak ahih manin, hih kiima om khuate-ah mite va pai-in annek ding le giah nading a zon nadingun mihonte sawlkhia in,” a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “A nek dingun nektheih khat peuhpeuh pia un,” a cih ciangin amaute in, “Kote va pai-in hih mi khempeuhte a dingin an va lei ding ka hih kei buang uhleh, anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih cih simloh bangmah dang om lo hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua lai-ah mi tulnga bang a om hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mite sawmnga, sawmnga-in a pawlpawlin tusak un,” ci-in a sawl hi."},"15":{"text":"A nungzuite in zong tua a sawl mah bangin mite a tusak uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih la-in vantung lam nga a, Pasian tungah lungdamna ko-in balnen a, mite tungah a lui dingin a nungzuite tungah a pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in ne-in a khamkhit uh ciangin, a nungzuite in a kikhamval teng khawm uh a, paipel sawm le nih a dim hi."},"18":{"text":"Khatvei, Jesuh guak thungenin a om laitakin a nungzuite zong ama kiangah om uh hi. Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mite in kei kua hi, hong ci uh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Peter in Jesuh’ Thu A Genna (Mat 16:13-20 ; Mrk 8:27-30)"},"19":{"text":"Amaute in, “Pawlkhat in, Tuiphumpa Johan hi, hong ci uh hi. Pawlkhat in Elijah hi, hong ci uh a, pawlkhat in, tanglai kamsangte khat peuhpeuh hong hingkik hi ding hi, hong ci uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.","ref":"Mat 14:1-2; Mrk 6:14-15; Luk 9:7-8"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tua ahihleh note in kei kua hi, hong ci na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Peter in, “Nang pen Pasian’ Khrih na hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Joh 6:68-69"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Hih thu kuama kiangah gen kei un,” ci-in a nungzuite thu a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mihing Tapa in tampi tak thuak ding a, upate, siampi liante, le Thukham hilh siate in amah nial ding uh hi. Amah kithat ding a, a ni thum ni-in kihing kiksak ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesuh in A Sih ding Genkhol (Mat 16:21-28 ; Mrk 8:31-9:1)"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite le mi khempeuh kiangah, “Mi khatpeuh in kei hong zuihnop leh ama deihna bangin gamta nawn loin nisimin a singlamteh pua-in hong zui ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:38; Luk 14:27"},"24":{"text":"Hih leitung nuntakna a hu nuamte in a nuntakna bulpi nangawn tawh suplawh ding a, kei’ hangin a nuntakna a suplawhte in a nuntakna bulpi hu zo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; Luk 17:33; Joh 12:25"},"25":{"text":"Mi khat in leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin a nuntakna bulpi suplawh leh bang phattuamna om ding ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Keima hang le ka thuhilhnate hangin a maizum peuhmah, a Pa’ minthanna vang le a siangtho vantung mite’ minthanna tawh a minthangin hong paikik ciangin Mihing Tapa zong ama hangin a maizum ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, hih lai-ah a om mi pawlkhatte in Pasian’ Ukna a muh khit uh matengin si lo ding uh ahihna phawk un,” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Hih thu a genkhit nipikal khat bang khit ciangin Jesuh in Peter, Johan, le James te sam a, mualtungah thungen dingin a paipihto hi.","title":"Mel Kikheelna (Mat 17:1-13 ; Mrk 9:2-13)"},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in thu a nget laitakin a mel hong kikheel a, a puante zong pakin tee mahmah hi."},"30":{"text":"Thakhat thu-in mihing nih tawh a kiho-in hong omvat hi. Tua mi nihte pen Moses le Elijah hi a,"},"31":{"text":"vantung minthanna vang lim nei uh a, Jerusalem khua-ah pai-in sihna tawh Pasian’ deihna a tunsak nading thu a kikumkum uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Peter le a lawm tegel lusu-in ihmu uh a, ahi zongin amaute hong khanglo-in, Jesuh’ minthanna vang le amah tawh a dingkhawm mi nihte a mu uh hi."},"33":{"text":"A mite, Jesuh kiang panin a paikhiat laitakin Peter in bang gen ka hi hiam, cih mel zong a thei lopi-in Jesuh kiangah, “Topa aw, hih lai-a i om, nuam mahmah hi. Nang a’ ding buk khat, Moses a’ ding buk khat, Elijah a’ ding buk khat, buk thum kong lamsak ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Hih bangin thu a gen laitakin meii hong kai a, a liim in amaute hong liah hi. Meii in a tuamcip ciangin nungzuite a lau uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin meii lakah aw khat hong ging a, “Hih pa, ka Teelsa ka Tapa ahi hi; ama thu na ngai un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 42:1; Mat 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; 2Pe 1:17-18"},"36":{"text":"Tua awging a bei khit ciangin Jesuh guak bek hong om hi. Nungzuite in hih a muhsa uh thu tua hun sawngteng kuama kiangah gen loin a imcip uh hi."},"37":{"text":"A zing ciangin mualtung panin hong paisuk uh a, mi tampi in Jesuh na dawn uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Dawivei Naupang Damsak (Mat 17:14-21 ; Mrk 9:14-29)"},"38":{"text":"Mihon lak panin mi khat hong kiko a, “Sia aw, ka tapa nong etsak nadingin kong thum hi. Amah bek ta a ka neih ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Dawi in amah man a, thakhat thu-in kikogawp hi. A cilphuan a buak dongin kongkawcipsak a, gimsak gawp a, nusia nuam lo hi."},"40":{"text":"Na nungzuite in a dawi hong hawlkhiatsak nading uh ka thum a, ahi zongin hong hawlkhiatsak thei lo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Note in bangzahin upna nei lo a, bangzahin khial na hi uh hiam? Note bang tanvei hong ompih ding a, bang tanvei hong kikholhpih ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a mipa kiangah, “Na tapa hong paipih in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"42":{"text":"A naupang hong pai laitakin dawi in leilakah tuksakin a kongkawcipsak hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in a dawi taii a, naupang damsakin, a pa kiangah a piakik hi."},"43":{"text":"Hih bangin Pasian a vang a liatna hangin mi khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi. Mite in Jesuh’ hihnate khempeuh lamdangsa-in a om laitakin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah,"},"44":{"text":"“Mihingte’ khut sungah Mihing Tapa kipia ding ahihna thu mangngilh het kei un,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesuh in A Sih ding Genkholkik (Mat 17:22-23 ; Mrk 9:30-32)"},"45":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in a cihnopna thei lo uh hi. Amaute in a theihtel loh nading mahun a kibawl hi a, bang a cihnopna hiam, ci-in Jesuh kiangah lah a dong ngam kei uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Kua lianpen ding ihi hiam, ci-in nungzuite lakah kiselna khat hong om hi.","title":"Kua Lianpen Hiam? (Mat 18:1-5 ; Mrk 9:33-37)","ref":"Luk 22:24"},"47":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute’ lungsim ngaihsutna a phawk ciangin naupang khat la-in a gei-ah omsak a,"},"48":{"text":"a nungzuite kiangah, “Keima hangin hih naupang a limbawl mi peuhmah in kei hong limbawl hi a, kei hong limbawl mi peuhmah in kei hong sawl pa zong a limbawl ahi hi. Note khempeuh lakah a neupen pa a lianpen pa ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Luk 10:16; Joh 13:20"},"49":{"text":"Tua ciangin Johan in, “Topa aw, nangma min tawh dawi a hawlkhia mi khat ka mu uh a, amah pen eima pawl sungah a om hi lo ahih manin ka kham uh hi,” a hong ci hi.","title":"No Hong Langpang lote Note’ Pawl Hi (Mrk 9:38-41)"},"50":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in ama kiangah, “No hong langpang lote note’ pawl ahih manin kham kei un,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh vantungah a kilaktoh ding hun a nai kuan ciangin Jerusalem khua manawh dingin a ngaihsun hi. Ama mai-ah nungzui pawlkhat mapaisak a,","title":"Samaria Khua Khat in Jesuh Tungsak Nuam lo"},"52":{"text":"Jesuh a dingin a kisam khempeuh a vaihawmsak dingin Samaria khua khatah a lut uh hi."},"53":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in Jerusalem khua manawh sawm ahih manin tua khuamite in Jesuh na tungsak nuam lo uh hi."},"54":{"text":"A nungzuite sung pan James le Johan in hih thu a theih uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah, “Topa aw, vantung panin meikuang ngenin amaute kangtumsak le ung nong awi hiam?” a ci uh hi.","ref":"2Kum 1:9-16"},"55":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh kihei-in amaute a taii hi."},"56":{"text":"Tua ciangin khua dang khatah a paisuak uh hi."},"57":{"text":"Lampi-ah a pai laitakun mi khat in Jesuh kiangah, “Na paina khempeuhah kong zui ding hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesuh’ Nungzui Ahi Dingte (Mat 8:18-22)"},"58":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ngiate in lup nading kua nei uh a, vasate in zong giah nading bu nei uh hi. Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa in a luptheih nading mun koimahah nei lo hi,” a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in midang khat kiangah, “Kei hong zui in,” a ci hi. Ahi zongin amah in, “Topa aw, kei hong ciahsak inla, ka pa hong vuisak masa in,” a ci hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Misi bang ahi mite in misite na vui tahen. Nang ahihleh va pai inla Pasian’ Ukna thu va hilh in,” a ci hi."},"61":{"text":"Tua ciangin midang khat in, “Topa aw, nang ka hong zui ding hi. Ahi zongin ka inn-ate, mangpha hong khasak masa in,” a ci hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:20"},"62":{"text":"Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Bawng lokhawhna lenkawmin a nunglam a en mi pen Pasian’ Ukna tawh kituak lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Jesuh in ama pai nading khua le mun khempeuhah nih nihin a na pai dingin mi sawmsagih seh a, ama mai-ah a mapaisak hi.","title":"Sawmsagihte A Kisawlna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, “Anlak ding tam mahmah a, ahi zongin mi tawm bek in anlak na sem uh hi. Tua ahih manin an nei pa in a ante a la dingin mi hong sawl nadingin thu ngen un.","ref":"Mat 9:37-38"},"3":{"text":"Note va kuan un. Ngiahon lakah tuuno khah bangin note ka hong sawl hi.","ref":"Mat 10:16"},"4":{"text":"Sum ahi a, ip ahi a, khedap a val ahi zongin keng kei un. Lamkalah mi tawh kimawk hoho kei un."},"5":{"text":"Inn khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin, ‘Hih inn-ah nopsakna hong tung ta hen,’ ci-in hopih masa un."},"6":{"text":"Tua inn sungah nopsakna a ngahthei ding mi a om leh kip paisuak ding a, a om kei leh na hopihna thupha uh na dokkik ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Nasemte in a thaman a ngah ding a kilawm ahih mah bangin na zintunna inn mah uhah omsuak unla, a hong piak peuhpeuh uh na ne un. Na zintunna inn uh kheel themthum kei un.","ref":"1Kor 9:14; 1Tim 5:18"},"8":{"text":"Khua khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin note hong tunsak leh, amaute’ hong lui peuhpeuh ne unla,"},"9":{"text":"tua khuasunga cinate damsak un. A khuamite kiangah, ‘Pasian’ Uk nading hun note a dingin hong naita hi,’ ci-in gen un."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin khua khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin note hong tunsaknop kei leh a khuasung kongzingah pai unla,"},"11":{"text":"‘Na khuasung uha leivui, ka khe tung uhah a hong bangte nangawn, note hilhkholhna-in ka nulkhia uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian’ Uk nading hun a hong naina thu thei ta un,’ ci-in gen un.","ref":"Sawl 13:51; Mat 10:7-14; Mrk 6:8-11; Luk 9:3-5"},"12":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, Thukhen Ni ciangin Sodom khuamite’ thuak ding sangin tua khuamite’ thuak ding haksazaw lai ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24-28; Mat 10:15; 11:24"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Khorazin khuapi mite le Bethsaida khuapi mite aw, gimna lianpi na thuak ding uh hi.
