Hell khuk sungah hong kilawnsuk ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 14:13-15"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Note’ thu a hong zuite khempeuh, kei’ thu a hong zui hi a, note’ thu a hong zui lote khempeuh, kei’ thu a hong zui lo ahi uh hi. Kei’ thu a hong zui lote khempeuh pen kei a hong sawl pa’ thu a zui lo ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:40; Mrk 9:37; Luk 9:48; Joh 13:20"},"17":{"text":"Sawmsagihte lungdam mahmahin hong ciahkik uh a, “Topa aw, nangma min tawh dawite nangawn ka hawlkhiazo uh hi,” a hong ci uh hi.","title":"Sawmsagihte Hong Ciahkikna"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Vantung panin keekkia bangin Satan a kiatna ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in thei un. Gulpi le momaite na sikgawp nading uh le na galte uh na zawh nadingun note tungah vangliatna ka hong piazo a, amaute in note bangmah hong cih zo lo ding uh hi.","ref":"La 91:13"},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin dawite in na thu uh hong manna hangin lungdam kei unla, vantungah na min uh a kigelh manin lungdamzaw un,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua laitakin Kha Siangtho in lungdamna tawh Jesuh kidimsak hi. Jesuh in, “Vantung le leitung Topa ahi ka Pa aw, mipilte le misiamte tungah na ip thute, bangmah a thei lo hih mite tungah lak na hih manin ka nuam hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu pen nangma deihna bang ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesuh Lungdam (Mat 11:25-27 ; 13:16-17)"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Hih nate khempeuh ka Pa in kei tungah hong ap khinzo hi. Pasian simloh, Tapa a thei kuamah om lo hi. Tapa le Tapa in a theihsaknop mite simloh, Pa a thei kuamah om lo hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joh 3:35; 10:15"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin nungzuite lamah kihei a, “Tu-a na muh uh nate na muh manun a hampha mahmah na hi uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, kamsang tampite le kumpi tampite in tu-a note’ muhte a muhnop uh hangin mu ngei lo uh a, a zaknop uh hangin za ngei lo uh hi,” ci-in a tuamin a gen hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh a ze-et dingin Thukham hilh siate khat hong ding a, “Sia aw, nuntak tawntungna ka ngahtheih nadingin bang sem ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Samaria Mihoih pa"},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thukham sungah bang kigelh a, bang sim na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in, “Na Topa Pasian na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh, na hatna khempeuh, le na pilna khempeuh tawh na it inla, nangmah na ki-it bangin na vengte na it in,” ci-in kigelh hi, ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:5; Siam 19:18"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Na dawnna man mahmah hi. Tua bangin gamta lecin nuntak tawntungna na ngah ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Siam 18:5; Mat 22:35-40; Mrk 12:28-34"},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin Thukham hilh siapa amah kitangsak nuam ahih manin Jesuh kiangah, “Ka vengte i cih kuate ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in dawng a, “Jerusalem panin Jerikho khua-ah mi khat paisuk a, lamkalah migilote in na suam a, a neih khempeuh laksakin a satgawp khit uh ciangin nusia uh a, a si dektaksa-in a paisan uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua laitakin siampi khat tua lampi tawnin hong paisuk a, amah a muh ciangin lamnawl lam tawnin a paisan hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi mi khat zong tua mah bangin hong pai a, amah a muh ciangin lamnawl lam tawnin a paisan leuleu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi zongin Samaria mi khualzin khat, tua lai mun hong tungin a liam pa a muh ciangin hehpihhuaisa a,"},"34":{"text":"a kiangah va pai-in a liammate sathau le leenggahzu a nuhsak khit ciangin a tunsak hi. Tua ciangin a la tungah tuangsak a, zintun inn khatah paipihin tua lai-ah a khoi hi.","ref":"2Khang 28:15"},"35":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin zintun inn nei pa kiangah sum peek nih pia a, ‘Hih mipa limtakin na khoi in. Na beina dang khempeuh, kong paikik ciangin kong loh ding hi,’ ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Hih mihing thumte sung panin, a kisuampa a dingin a koi pen a vengpa hi dingin na um hiam?” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Amah in, “A hehpih pa hi ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Nang zong pai inla, tua bangmahin gamta in,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Amaute a pai laitakun khua khatah Jesuh bang a, Martha kici numei khat in a inn-ah na tungsak hi.","title":"Martha le Mary kiangah Jesuh Hawh"},"39":{"text":"Martha in Mary kici nau numei khat nei a, Topa’ thugente ngai-in Mary a om hi.","ref":"Joh 11:1"},"40":{"text":"Martha bek in na semin manlah mahmah ahih manin a heh suak a, “Topa aw, ka naunu in kei bek na hong sepsak niloh phamawh sa lo na hi hiam? Kei hong huh nadingin hong sawl in,” a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa in, “Martha, Martha aw, nang na lunghihmawhna tam hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi zongin a kisam taktak khat bek om a, Mary in tua a kisam na pen a semsem ahih manin, a nasep kikhawlsak lo ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khat vei, Jesuh in mun khatah thu a ngen hi. A thunget a mankhit ciangin a nungzuite khat in, “Topa aw, Johan in a nungzuite a hilh bangin kote zong thungetzia hong hilh in,” a ci hi.","title":"Thungetna thu Jesuh’ Genna (Mat 6:5-15 ; 7:7-12)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Hih bangin na ngen ding uh hi: ‘Pa aw, na min siangtho kizahtak hen la, na Ukna hun hong tung tahen."},"3":{"text":"Nisim khamkhop an hong pia in."},"4":{"text":"Kote tungah a hong mawhte mawh maisakna ka neih bangun ko’ mawhna zong hong maisak in. Ze-etna lian hong thuaksak ke’n,’ ci-in na ngen ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Note khatpeuh, na lawmte uh khat inn-ah zankim laitakin pai-in, ‘Lawm aw, anlum lum thum khawng hong leitawi sak in."},"6":{"text":"Ka lawmte khat zin hong tung a, ka piak ding ka nei het kei hi,’ ci le-uhcin,"},"7":{"text":"amah in a innsung panin, ‘Hong nawngkaisak dah in. Kong ka kalhkhin uh a, ka naupangte tawh ka lum khinzo uh hi. Kong thokhia thei kei a, bangmah kong pia thei kei ding hi,’ ci-in hong dawng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahihleh ke’n kong cihin-ah, a lawm ahihna hangin amah tho tuan loin bangmah a piak loh hangin, a nget teiteina hangin amah tho-in a kisapna teng a pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note kiangah kong cihin-ah: Ngen un; na ngah ding uh hi. Zong un; na mu ding uh hi. Kiu un; kongkhak hong kihon ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a ngente khempeuh in ngah ding a, a zongte khempeuh in mu ding a, a kiute khempeuh a dingin kong kihon ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Note lakah pa ahi mi khatpeuh in, a tapa in ngasa ngen leh ngasa tangin gul a pia ding,"},"12":{"text":"aktui ngen leh aktui tangin momai a pia ding kua om na hi uh hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Note mihoih lo hinapi-in na tate uh tungah a hoih piak ding theithei na hih uhleh, vantung a om na Pa un a ngente tungah Kha Siangtho piazaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in a pau thei lo mi khat sung panin dawi hawlkhia a, dawi a paikhiat khit ciangin a mipa pauthei a, mite in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.","title":"Jesuh le Beelzebul (Mat 12:22-32 ; Mrk 3:19-30)"},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in, “Dawimangpa Beelzebul in dawi hawlkhiat theih nading vangliatna ama tungah a pia ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"Mat 9:34; 10:25"},"16":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat leuleu in amah a ze-etna-in, Pasian’ thukimpihna a kilat nadingin nalamdang a bawl ding a ngen uh hi.","ref":"Mat 12:38; 16:1; Mrk 8:11"},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute’ ngaihsutna thei ahih manin, “Gam khat peuhpeuh, a gammite kiphelkhamin pawlkhat le pawlkhat kido le-uh tua gam sauvei kip lo ding a, innkuan khat peuhpeuh a mite kiphelkhamin kido le-uh kikhenthang ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Satan ukna sunga om mite zong khatlekhat kido le-uh a ukna bangci kip ding ahi hiam? Kei pen, Beelzebul’ vangliatna tawh dawi hawlkhia hi, nong ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ke’n Beelzebul’ vangliatna tawh dawi hawlkhia ka hih leh, na mipihte un kua’ vangliatna tawh hawlkhia ahi uh hiam? Na ngaihsut khialhna uh amaute in hong langsak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Note’ ngaihsut bang hi loin, ke’n Pasian’ vangliatna tawh dawite hawlkhia ka hih manin, note kiangah Pasian’ Ukna hun hong tungta ahihna phawk un."},"21":{"text":"“Mi thahat khat in a hiam neih khempeuh tawh ama inn a cin ciangin a neihsa khempeuh suakta hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah sangin a hatzaw mi khat in amah simin a zawhgawp khit ciangin, ama muan a hiam khempeuh laksakin a pawlte tawh a hawm hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei hong pawlpih lo peuhmah keima lang hi uh a, tuute hong kaihkhoppih lo peuhmah tuute a thehthang gawpte ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mrk 9:40"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Mi khatpeuh sung panin dawi a kihawlkhiat khit ciangin a ten nading mun keuna zongin a vak kawikawi hi. A om nading mun a muh loh ciangin, ‘Hong kihawlkhiatna inn mahah lutkik ning,’ ci hi.","title":"Dawi Hong Lutkikna (Mat 12:43-45)"},"25":{"text":"A hong tunkik ciangin hoihtakin kiphiat siangin a hoih linlianin a mu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah paikhia kikin, amah sangin a siazaw dawi sagih hong paipih a, a sungah lutin a teng uh hi. Tua mipa’ pianzia pen a masa sangin hong siazaw hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thu a genkhit ciangin mihon lak panin numei khat hong paukhia a, “Nang hong paii numei, a nawi na teep numei, mi hampha mahmah ahi hi,” a ci hi.","title":"Hamphatna Taktak"},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Pasian’ thu za-in a zuite hamphazaw lai hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"29":{"text":"Mihonte in Jesuh hong neh semsem uh a, Jesuh in zong a thugen zomlai-in, “Tuhun mite gilo mahmah uh hi. Amaute in lim lamdang ngen uh a, ahi zongin Jonah lim simloh a dang kipia lo ding hi.","title":"Tuhun Migilote in Lim Khat Ngen (Mat 12:38-42 ; Mrk 8:11-13)","ref":"Mat 16:4; Mrk 8:12"},"30":{"text":"Nineveh khua mite a dingin kamsang Jonah pen lim khat ahih mah bangin tuhun mite a dingin Mihing Tapa zong, lim ahi ding hi.","ref":"Joh 3:4"},"31":{"text":"Thukhen Ni ciangin leitaw lam gam pana hong pai Kumpinu hong dingin tuhun mite mawhsakna thu hong gen ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Solomon’ pilna thu a za dingin leimong khat panin amah hong pai a, ahi zongin Solomon sangin a lianzaw khat hih lai-ah om hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:1-10; 2Khang 9:1-12"},"32":{"text":"Thukhen Ni ciangin Nineveh khuamite hong dingin note mawhsakna thu hong gen ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Jonah’ thuhilhna a zak uh ciangin a mawhnate uh kisik uh a, ahi zongin Jonah sangin a lianzaw khat hih lai-ah a om hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Joh 3:5"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Kuamah in meivak a vakkhit ciangin a munbu ah koih lo a, lawh zong khuhlo hi. Innsungah a lut mi khempeuh in khua a muhtheih nadingin meivak koihna tungah a koihzaw hi.","title":"Pumpi Khuavak (Mat 5:15 ; 6:22-23)","ref":"Mat 5:15; Mrk 4:21; Luk 8:16"},"34":{"text":"Na mittang uh note’ pumpi a dingin meivak tawh kibang hi. Na mit uh ciim leh na pumpi khempeuh un hoihtakin mu thei a, na mit uh maang leh na pumpi uh a dingin khuamial ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin na pumpi sung uha om khuavak pen khuamial ahih khak loh nading limtakin kingaihsun un."},"36":{"text":"Tua bang hi peuh leh, meivak a taan ciangin khua na muh uh mah bangin na pumpi uh a dingin khuamialna mun om loin a vekpi-in a taangkim ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh in a thugen a mankhit ciangin Farisi mi khat in an nekpih dingin Jesuh a sam hi. Amah zong pai-in an ne dingin a tu hi.","title":"Jesuh in Farisi Mite le Thukham hilh Siate Mawhsak (Mat 23:1-36 ; Mrk 12:38-40 ; Luk 20:45-47)"},"38":{"text":"Jesuh in khut sil masa loin an a neklam a muh ciangin Farisi mipa in lamdangsa mahmah hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, “No Farisi mite in hai leh kuangte a pualam na siangsak uh a, ahi zongin note na lungsim sung uhah huaihamin na gi kei uh hi."},"40":{"text":"No mihaite aw, a pualam a bawlpa in a sunglam zong bawl hi lo ahi hiam?"},"41":{"text":"Ahi zongin na hai leh na kuang sung uhah a omte pen itna tawh mizawngte tungah pia le-uhcin, note a dingin na khempeuh hong siang ding hi."},"42":{"text":"“No Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in Pasian tungah lengmasel, thuambuak a kipan anteh theipuam dongin sawm-ah-khat pia napi-in, mite tungah thuman ding le Pasian it ding na donkha kei uh hi. Hihte khempeuh na hihkim ding uh hi a, paihkhiat na neih ding uh hi lo hi.","ref":"Siam 27:30"},"43":{"text":"“No Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Kikhopna inn sungah tutphah nuampen ah na tunuam uh a, mihon lakah hong kizahtak hopih ding na ut uh hi."},"44":{"text":"A kiciamteh lo hankhuk, mite in a theih loh manun a va sikkhakna munte tawh na kibang uh hi,” a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ciangin Thukham hilh siate khat in Jesuh kiangah, “Sia aw, hih bang thu na gen ciangin kote zong a hong ko bawl na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh in, “No Thukham hilh siate in zong gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in a puak hak mahmah ding van, mite tungah na suan uh a, ahi zongin tua van a puakpih dingin na khutmeno khat nangawn uh na tangsak nuam kei uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Na pu na pate un a thahsa kamsangte’ han a hoihin na bawl uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ahih manin na pu na pate uh gamtatnate a thukimpih, a tecite na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kamsangte thatin, note in a han na bawl uh hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua thu hangin Pasian’ Pilna a kici laibu sungah, ‘Amaute kiangah kamsangte le sawltakte ka sawl ding a, amaute in tua mite pawlkhat bawlsia-in na that ding uh hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ahih manin leitung piancil a kipan kamsang a kithatte khempeuh hangin tuhuna mite gim kipia ding a,"},"51":{"text":"Abel a kithah a kipan biakna tau le siangtho mun kikalah a kithat Zekhariah a sihna ciang dong, tua mi thahna hangin gimna a thuak ding uh hi. Ke’n kong cihin-ah, hih thute khempeuh hangin tuhuna mite gim hong kipia taktak ding hi.","ref":"Pian 4:8; 2Khang 24:20-21"},"52":{"text":"No Thukham hilh siate in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in pilna ngah theih nading konghonna tawhtang nei napi-in a sungah note na lut tuan kei uh a, a tum dingin a paite zong lah na khaktan uh hi,” a ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua mun panin Jesuh a paikhiat khit a kipanin Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in nakpitakin Jesuh mawhzon ding kipanin thu tampi tak dong uh a,"},"54":{"text":"a kampau khialhnate a mattheih nadingun thangsiahin a hanciam uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi a tul tampite hong kikhawmin khatlekhat a kisikkha gawp dongin kinehcipin a om laitakin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah thu gen masa a, “Farisi mite’ kineihkhemna ahi, a silngo uh limtakin kidawm un.","title":"Kineihkhemna thu Hilhkholhna","ref":"Mat 16:6; Mrk 8:15"},"2":{"text":"A kiseelte khatvei teitei kimu ding a, thusimte khatvei teitei thulang suak ding hi.","ref":"Mrk 4:22; Luk 8:17"},"3":{"text":"Zan khuamial sunga na gente uh sun khuavak sungah kigenkik ding a, innsung tawngah na kihuau simnate uh mi khempeuh in theithang ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Lawmte aw, note kiangah kong genin-ah, pumpi a thahkhit ciangin a siazaw a hihthei nawn lote na kihta kei un.","title":"Kua Kihta Ding (Mat 10:26-31)"},"5":{"text":"Kuate kihta ding na hi uh hiam cih leh, mite in a thah khitsa mipa pen hell khuk sungah a khiathuah theilai Pasian na kihta un."},"6":{"text":"Gitta nga ciangin hamu-in kizuak lel hi lo ahi hiam? Tua bang hi lel napi-in Pasian in gitta khat beek mangngilh lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lutung uha om na sammal zah ciat nangawn uh Pasian in thei khin hi. Note lunghimawh kei un. Gitta tampi sangin na manphazaw ciat uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Note kiangah kong cihin-ah, keima mi ahihna mi’ theihin a genkhiate, Mihing Tapa in zong Pasian’ vantung mite’ mai-ah, keima mi hi, ci-in genkhia ding a,","title":"Khrih Mi Hi’ng, ci-in Mi’ Theihin Genna (Mat 10:32-33 ; 12:32 ; 10:19-20)"},"9":{"text":"ahi zongin keima mi ahihna mi’ theihin a genkhia nuam lote, Pasian’ vantung mite mai-ah zong keima mi hi, ci-in Mihing Tapa in genkhia nuam lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing Tapa a langpangte a mawhna uh kimaisak thei ding a, Kha Siangtho a langpangte a mawhna uh kimaisak lo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 12:32; Mrk 3:29"},"11":{"text":"Thusitna a thuak dingin kikhopna inn-ah ahi a, hausa zumah ahi zongin hong paipih uh ciangin bang gen ding a, bangci kihut ding ka hi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a hun a tun ciangin Kha Siangtho in na gen dingteng uh hong hilh ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 10:19-20; Mrk 13:11; Luk 21:14-15"},"13":{"text":"Tua laitakin mihon lak panin mi khat in Jesuh kiangah, “Sia aw, ka pa un a hong sihsan gamh pawlkhat tawh ka u in kei hong inntuan nadingin hong gensak in,” a ci hi.","title":"A Hau Mihai pa Thugentehna"},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in a mipa kiangah, “No unau’ gamh a hawm dingin kua in kei hong seh ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute khempeuh kiangah, “Hoihtakin kidawm unla, na huaiham loh nadingun kikem un. Bang hang hiam cih leh bangzahta-in mi khat a hauh hangin a neihsa tawh a nuntakna taktak kicing zo lo hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a, “Mi hau pa khat’ lo-ah an tampi a piang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a lungsim sungah, ‘Ka an khempeuh ka koih nading mun kicing lo ahih manin bangcih ding ka hi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih bangin ka gamta ding hi: Ka ansalte phelin a lianzaw ansalte ka lam ding a, tuate sungah ka ante le ka neih khempeuh ka seng ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in: Mi hampha mahmah ka hi hi. Kum tampi sung ka khom ding annek tuidawn le na hoih tampi ka nei hi. An ne, zu ne-in, a nuam theithei-in ka om hithiat ding hi,’ ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in ama kiangah, ‘Mihai pa aw, tuzan mahmahin na si ding hi. Hih na neihsa teng kua’n zang nawn ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a thugen a khupna-in, “Tua mah bangin amau a’ ding bekin a kholcipte pen Pasian’ muhna panin mihau hi lo uh hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Tua ahih ciangin note kiangah kong genin-ah: I nuntak nadingin bang ne ding a, i pumpi tungah bang silh ding ihi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un.","title":"Lunghihmawh Kholhna (Mat 6:25-34)"},"23":{"text":"Nuntakna pen an sangin thupizaw a, pumpi pen puan sangin thupizaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Vasate ngaihsun dih un: Amaute in khai tuh lo uh a, anlak cih zong nei lo uh hi. Amaute in beemlepang zong nei lo napi-in Pasian in annek tasamsak lo hi. Vasate sangin note nakpitakin na manphazaw uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Note na lunghihmawh manun na nuntak hun uh nai khat sung bek a sotto thei kua om na hi uh hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Tua bang a themno khat nangawn hih thei lo na hih uhleh bang hangin adangte lunghimawh se na hi uh hiam?"},"27":{"text":"Gamlak a paakte ngaihsun dih un. Tuate in a nek ding uh na sem lo uh a, a silh ding uh puan zong gan lo uh hi. Ahi zongin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Bangzahin a hauh hangin Solomon nangawn, hih paakte khat zahin a hoihin kizem zo lo lai hi.","ref":"1Kum 10:4-7; 2Khang 9:3-6"},"28":{"text":"Upna neu mite aw, tuni-in om a, zing ciangin keutumin meikhuk sungah a kikhultum lopa kungte, Pasian in puansilh guan ahihleh note hong guanzaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahih manin bang ne ding, bang dawn ding, ci-in lunghimawhin om tawntung kei un."},"30":{"text":"Gentail mi khempeuh in hih nate lunghihmawh penin nei uh hi. Hih nate na kisap lamtak uh zong na Pa un hong thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian’ Ukna ngaihsutin nei masazaw un. Tua hileh hih na kisapna dangte uh zong Pasian in hong piathuah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tuuhon tawmnote aw, lau-in lunghimawh kei un. Na Pa un ama Ukna sungah ukna thu a nei dingin a hong sehsa ahi hi.","title":"Vantungah Sumkholna (Mat 16:19-21)"},"33":{"text":"Na neihsa uh zuak unla, mizawngte tungah tua sumte na pia un. Note a dingin a sia thei lo sumkholna na bawl unla, gutate in a luh zawh lohna, leikha in zong a nek zawh lohna, cikmahin a kiam ngei hetloh nading mun vantungah na sumte uh na khol un."},"34":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na sum uh a omna munah na lungsim uh om tawntung ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Na kawng uh gakin, na mei uh vakin a kigingsa-in om unla,","title":"A Kiging Nasemte","ref":"Mat 25:1-13"},"36":{"text":"a topa uh mopawi simna panin hong tungin kongkhak a kiuh ciangin thakhatin kong a honpah theih nadingun a topa’ ciah ding a ngak nasemte bangin om un.","ref":"Mrk 13:34-36"},"37":{"text":"A topa hong ciah ciangin a kigingsa-in amah ngakin a om uh a muh nasemte pen mi hampha mahmah ahi uh hi. Note kiangah kong genin-ah, a topa zong hong kithawi-in a nasemte an vak dingin tusak ding a, amahmah in a nasemte an thukin na a sem ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Zankim laitak ahi a, zingsang khuavakkuan lam ahi zongin a hong ciah hun peuhpeuh ciangin amah ngakin a om a muh nasemte pen mi hampha mahmah ahi uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahi zongin na phawk ding uh thu khat om hi. Mi khat in guta pa’ hong pai ding hun theikhol leh a inn luhsak lo ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Mihing Tapa zong na upmawh loh uh hun laitakin hong pai ding ahih manin note zong a kigingsa-in om tawntung un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 24:43-44"},"41":{"text":"Peter in, “Topa aw, hih thugentehna ko bek nong cihna ahi hiam, ahih kei leh mi khempeuh a’ ding na cihna ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"A Citak le A Citak lo Nasem (Mat 24:45-51)"},"42":{"text":"Topa in, “A pil a citak nasempa i cih a bangcite ahi hiam? A naseppih dangte ukin a hun manmanin amaute’ nekzah ding ciat a pia dingin a topa in a seh nasempa ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A topa hong ciah ciangin hih ama sawl bangin a sem a muh nasempa pen mi hampha mahmah ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, a neihsa khempeuh a uk dingin a topa in tua nasempa koih takpi ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua nasempa in a lungsim sungah, ‘Ka topa hong ciahkik hak ding hi,’ ci-in ngaihsunin a naseppih numei le pasalte satgawp hen la, zukham ankhamin ommawk leh,"},"46":{"text":"tua nasem pa’ topa pen ama upmawh loh ni, a theihkholh loh hunin hong tung ding hi. A topa in nakpitakin amah gim pia ding a, a thumang lo mite tawh a kibangin a thuaksak khawm ding hi."},"47":{"text":"A topa’ deihna thei napi-in a topa’ deih bangin a gamta nuam lo nasem pa pen nakpitakin kisat ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi zongin a topa’ deihna a theih lohna hangin satthuak nading a gamtakha nasem pa pen kidamsat zawdeuh ding hi. Tampi a kipiakna pa tung pan tampi kikal ding a, a tamzaw a ki-apna pa tung pan a tamzaw kikal ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Leitungah meikuang a khah dingin a hong pai ka hi a, tu mahmahin a meikuang kipan khinta hileh ka ut hi.","title":"Jesuh, Kikhenna A Piangsak pa (Mat 10:34-36)"},"50":{"text":"Gimna sungah ka kiphum nading khat om a, tua thu a kikhit matengin ka lungsim a nuam thei kei hi.","ref":"Mrk 10:38"},"51":{"text":"Leitungah kilemna a omsak dingin a hong pai hong sa na hi uh hiam? Hilo hi. Ke’n kong cihin-ah, kikhenna a omsak dingin a hong pai ka hizaw hi."},"52":{"text":"Tu a kipanin innkuan sungah mihing nga a phate, a langah thum, a langah nihin kikhenin kido ding uh hi."},"53":{"text":"A pa in a tapa do-in, a tapa in a pa do ding a, a nu in a tanu do-in, a tanu in a nu do ding a, a teeknu in a monu do-in, a monu in a teeknu do ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mik 7:6"},"54":{"text":"Jesuh in mihonte kiangah zong, “Nitumna lamah meiipi hong kai na muh uh ciangin, ‘Guah hong zu ding hi,’ ci-in thakhatin na genthei pah uh a, tua mah bangin guah hong zu takpi hi.","title":"Hun Theihna (Mat 16:1-4 ; Mrk 8:11-13)"},"55":{"text":"Leitaw lam panin huih hong nun’ ciangin, ‘Ni hong sa ding hi,’ na ci uh a, tua mah bangin ni hong sa takpi hi."},"56":{"text":"No a kineihkhem mite aw, vanlelei na et uh ciangin a piang ding thu thei na hih uhleh, tuhun thute bang hangin theithei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Bang hangin na gamtat nading uh a manin khen thei lo na hi uh hiam?","title":"Na Langte uh tawh Kilem Un (Mat 5:25-26)"},"58":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in na tungah thu hong bawlin zum-ah hong paipih leh, zuma thukhente mai-ah hong kaigawpin, thukhente in palikte kiangah hong apin, palikte in thong sungah a hong koih loh nadingin, na lang pa uh tawh na thu uh a siantheih nadingin na siam tawpun lamkalah hanciam un."},"59":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, tua bangin gamta kei le-uhcin, na liausum uh na piak khit matengun thong panin na suakta kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua laitakin tua lai-a om mi pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah, Galilee mite in Pasian kiangah biakna pia-in a om laitakin Pilat in a thah mite’ thu a gen uh hi.","title":"Kisik Ding, ahih kei leh Si Ding"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Tua bangin hih Galilee mite kithat ahih manin, Galilee midangte khempeuh sangin hih a kithat mite a mawhna uh lianzaw hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Hilo hi. Ke’n kong cihin-ah, na mawhna panun na kisik kei uhleh amaute mah bangin note zong na si ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih kei leh, Siloam Tuibeem gei-a tausang a puk lai-in a denlup mi sawm le giatte bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam? Hih bangin a sih manun Jerusalem khuasunga a teng midangte sangin a mawhna uh lianzaw hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Hilo hi. Ke’n kong cihin-ah, na mawhna panun na kisikkik kei uh leh note zong amaute mah bangin na si ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a, “Mi khat in a lolai-ah theikung khat a suansak hi. Theigah a lo dingin a pai ciangin bangmah na gah lo hi.","title":"A Gah lo Theikung Thugentehna"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amah in a lokho pa kiangah, ‘A beisa kum thum sung theigah lo dingin ka pai zelzel a, ahi zongin gah lo hi. Tua ahih manin phuk in. Bang hangin lo sung mawk nawngkaisak ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin lokho pa in, ‘Topa aw, tu kum sung zong hih bangmahin omsaklai phot in. A phung kimkot to-in eklei ka sung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kum kik ciangin hong gah leh a hoih hi pah ding hi. Ahi zongin hong gah kei veve leh i phuk ding hi,’ ci-in a dawng hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Sabbath ni khatin Jesuh in kikhopna inn khat sungah thu hilhin a om hi.","title":"Sabbath Ni-in Nungkul Numei Khat Kidamsak"},"11":{"text":"Dawivei numei khat tua lai-ah om a, tua dawi in kum sawm le giat sung tua numei cina sakin a nung kulsak a, dingtang thei hetloin a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh in tua numei a muh ciangin a kiangah sam a, “Lawm aw, na natna panin na damta hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei tungah a khut nga a, thakhat thu-in amah dingtang thei-in Pasian a phatpah hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in Sabbath ni-in cina a damsakna hangin kikhopna inn ukpa a heh suak a, mite kiangah, “Na a kisep theih nading hun ni guk sung om hi. Tua hun sungin hong pai-in kidamsak unla, ahi zongin Sabbath ni-in hong pai kei un,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 20:9-10; Thkna 5:13-14"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in amah dawng a, “No a kineihkhem mite aw, note in Sabbath ni mahin zong na bawngte uh ahi a, na late uh ahi zongin a buk panin na khihna khaute uh sutin, tui pia dingin paipih hi lo na hi uh hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Satan in Abraham’ suante khat ahi hih numei pen kum sawm le giat sung hencip hi. Hih a kihencipna panin Sabbath ni-in hih numei khahkhiat ding kilawm hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih Jesuh’ dawnna in alangte khempeuh maizumsak a, Jesuh’ sep hih na lamdangte khempeuh hangin midang khempeuh a lungdam mahmah uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Pasian’ Ukna bang tawh kibang a, bang tawh genteh ding ka hi hiam cih leh:","title":"Ankam Tang Thugentehna (Mat 13:31-32 ; Mrk 4:30-32)"},"19":{"text":"Mi khat in a lo-ah a vawh ankam tang khat tawh kibang hi. Tua ankam tang hong khangin kung golpi hong suak a, vasate in a hiang tungah bu a tom thei uh hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Pasian’ Ukna bang tawh genteh leuleu ding ka hi hiam cih leh:","title":"Silngo Thugentehna (Mat 13:33)"},"21":{"text":"Nupi khat in annel lom sungah a sawh silngo tawh kibang hi. Tua silngo in a annel lom khempeuh a pawmsak hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin khuapite le khuaneute nawkin Jesuh paisuak a, Jerusalem khua manawhin a paikawmin thu a hilh hi.","title":"Kong Kawcik (Mat 7:13-14 , 21-23)"},"23":{"text":"Tua laitakin mi khat in, “Siapa aw, hotkhiatna a ngah mi tawmno khat bek hi ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Kong kawcik tawnin na lut nadingun hanciam un. Note kiangah kong genin-ah, mi tampi tak in lut ding a hanciam uh hangin lut zo lo ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Inn nei pa hong tho-in kong hong khak ciangin, note kong pualamah dingin kongkhak na kiu ding uh a, ‘Topa aw, kote zong kong hong hon in,’ na ci ding uh hi. Amah in, ‘Note koilai panin a hong pai na hi uh hiam kong thei kei hi,’ ci-in hong dawng ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Note in, ‘Nangmah tawh anne tuidawn khawmin i om a, ka khuasung uhah thu nong hilh hi,’ na ci ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah in, ‘Note koi panin a hong pai cih kong thei kei hi. A giloin a gamta note khempeuh aw, kei kiang panin paikhia un,’ hong ci ding hi.","ref":"La 6:8"},"28":{"text":"Pasian’ Ukna sungah Abraham, Isaac, Jakob, le kamsangte khempeuh a omna mu napi-in, note a pualamah hong kihawlkhiat ciangin tua huna na kahna uh le na ha gawina uh bangzah takin nasia ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Mat 22:13; 25:30"},"29":{"text":"Nisuahna le nitumna, leilu le leitaw lam panin mite hong pai-in Pasian’ Ukna sung sabuai kiimah tukhawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Mat 8:11-12"},"30":{"text":"Tua hi a, tuhuna mineute tuahun ciangin milian hi ding a, tuhuna miliante tuahun ciangin mineu hi ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 19:30; 20:16; Mrk 10:31"},"31":{"text":"Tuahun laitakin Farisi mi pawlkhat hong pai-in Jesuh kiangah, “Herod in nang thah hong sawm ahih manin hih lai panin mun dang khatah paikhia in,” a ci uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Jerusalem Khuamite Tamlawh (Mat 23:37-39)"},"32":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pai unla, ngia bangin ngian a zang tua Herod kiangah hih bangin va gen un: ‘Tuni le zing ciang sung dawi hawlkhia-in cina ka damsak ding a, thai ciangin ka nasep ka man ding hi, ci hi,’ va ci un."},"33":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuni, zing le thai sungteng ka ma nawtsuakin ka pai ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Jerusalem khuasung lobuang mun dangah kamsangpa a kithah ding kilawm lo hi."},"34":{"text":"“Jerusalem, Jerusalem aw, kamsangte na that a, Pasian’ hong sawl kamtaite na denglum hi. Akpi in a kha tawh a note a huai mah bangin na mite ka huainuam tawntung a, ahi zongin na ut kei hi."},"35":{"text":"Tu-in na innte kinusiacip ding hi. ‘Topa min tawh a hong pai mipa, Pasian in thupha pia ta hen,’ na cih hun hong tun matengin kei nong mu nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 118:26"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni khatin Farisi mi upa khat’ inn-ah an ne dingin Jesuh pai a, mite in amah encik uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Cibawk Mi Khat Damsak"},"2":{"text":"Tua laitakin a khut le a khe a bawk mi khat Jesuh kiangah hong pai a,"},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in zong Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite kiangah, “Sabbath ni-in cina damsak ding i Thukham in hong hiam, khak hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin kuamah in dawng loin omcip uh hi. Jesuh in zong tua mipa samin a damsak khit ciangin a ciahsak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Note khatpeuh’ tapa ahi a, na bawngtal uh ahi zongin tuikhuk thukpi sungah Sabbath ni-in kia leh, Sabbath ni hinapi-in kaikhia veve ding hi lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 12:11"},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin kuamah in hih thu dawng thei lo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua annekna ah a kisam mite pawlkhat, uliante’ tut nading munah a tutnopna uh a muh ciangin amaute kiangah thu khat gen a,","title":"Innteek le Leenglate’ Theih ding Thu"},"8":{"text":"“Mopawi khatpeuhah hong kisap ciangin uliante’ tut nading munah tu kei un. Tua pawi siim dingin a kisamte lakah note sangin a ulianzaw khat hong omkha thei ding a,"},"9":{"text":"innteek pa in note kiangah, ‘Hih lai-ah amah tusakzaw ni,’ hong ci ding hi. Tua ciangin minautangte’ tutna munah maizumpi in na tusuk ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Note pen tua bangin a hong kisap ciangin minautangte’ tutna munah na tuzaw un. Innteek pa hong pai-in, ‘Lawm aw, hih tutphah nuamah hong tuzaw in,’ hong ci ding hi. Tua bangin leengla dangte khempeuh lakah hong cih ciangin nang a dingin angtanhuai mahmah hi.","ref":"Pau 25:6-7"},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a kiliansakte khempeuh in niamkhiatna thuak ding uh a, a kiniamkhiatte khempeuh a lianin kibawl ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 23:12; Luk 18:14"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a innteek pa kiangah, “Sun-an nekna-ah ahi a, nitak-an nekna-ah ahi zongin mi na sap ciangin, na lawmte ahi a, na sanggamte ahi a, na behte ahi a, mihau na vengte ahi zongin sam kei in. Amaute in zong an ne ding mahin nang hong samkik ding uh a, hih bangin hong sapna hangin na anvakna thaman a ngahkik na hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin anvakna pawi na bawl ciangin mizawngte, khezawte, khebaite, le mittawte sam in."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong thukkik zo lo ding uh ahih manin nang a dingin a lungdamhuai hong hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna panin mihoihte a thawhkik hun ciangin Pasian in nang tungah hong thukkik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"An ne-a a tutpih mite khat in hih thu a zak ciangin Jesuh kiangah, “Pasian’ Ukna sungah an ne-a a tu mite bangzahin mi hampha ahi uh hiam?” a ci hi.","title":"Pawi Lianpi Thugentehna (Mat 22:1-10)"},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Khatvei mi khat in pawi lianpi khat bawlin mi tampi a sam hi."},"17":{"text":"Annek ding hun ciangin a nasempa sawl a, ‘Tu-in na khempeuh a baihsa-in omkhin ahih manin hong paita un,’ ci-in a khohsa mite a samsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahih hangin a khohsa mite in a pai theih loh nading uh paulap zong ciat uh hi. A masa pen pa in, ‘Lo khat ka lei a, ka va et ding kisam ahih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Adang khat in, ‘Bawngtal kap nga ka lei a, a va sin ding ka hih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Adang khat leuleu in, ‘Ka zi ding a kila khin phet ahih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a nasempa hong ciahin a topa kiangah hih thute hong zasak hi. Tua ciangin innteek pa a heh suak a, a nasempa kiangah, ‘Khuasung kongzing khempeuhah va pai inla, mizawng, khezaw, mittaw, le khebai mite hong paipih in,’ ci-in a sawl leuleu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khit a sawt loin a nasempa in, ‘Topa aw, na cih bangin ka sam khin a, ahi zongin om nading mun omlai hi,’ a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin a topa in a nasempa kiangah, ‘Gam sung lamliante le lamneute-ah va pai inla, ka inn-ah mi a dim theih nadingin mi khempeuh hong paipihmang khin in."},"24":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, ka sap masak mite khat beek in ka an ciamkha lo ding uh hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi tampi tak in Jesuh hong zui uh a, Jesuh zong kihei-in amaute kiangah,","title":"Nungzui Suahna Dingin Thuakna"},"26":{"text":"“Kei kiangah a hong pai mite peuhmah in a nu le a pa, a zi le a ta, a sanggam numeite le a sanggam pasalte, le ama pumpi mahmah a nial ngam kei leh keima nungzui suak thei lo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:37"},"27":{"text":"Ama singlamteh mah puatawmin ka nung hong zui lote, keima nungzui hi thei lo hi.","ref":"Mat 10:38; 16:24; Mrk 8:34; Luk 9:23"},"28":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in inn lianpi khat lamding a sawm le, ka zozo ding hiam cih a theih nadingin a bei dingzah tuat masa hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua bangin tuat masa kei leh tua inn a khuampite a phuhkhit ciangin zawh lohpi-in khawl ding a, tua inn a kizo lo a mu mite khempeuh in amah nuihsan ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"‘Hih mipa in inn lamding kipan napi-in zozo lo hi,’ ci ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Galkap tul sawm a nei kumpi khat in galkap tul sawmnih tawh a hong kuan kumpi khat do dingin a kithawi leh, tua kumpipa a dozo ding mahin i hat takpi hiam ci-in ngaihsun masa ding hi."},"32":{"text":"A zozo ding ahih vet kei leh, tua kumpipa a hong tun ma, a gamla-ah a om lai-in, ama kiangah kamtaite sawl ding a, kilem nading thu gensak ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua mah bangin mi khat in a neih khempeuh a piakkhiat ngam kei leh keima nungzui suak thei lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Ci hoih hi; ahi zongin a alna bei leh i al kiksak theih nading lampi om lo hi.","title":"A Allo Ci (Mat 5:13 ; Mrk 9:50)"},"35":{"text":"Lei hoihsak nadingin kizang thei lo a, eklei dingin zong kibawl thei lo ahih manin paihmawk a kul hi. Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in za ta un,” a ci hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei, Jesuh’ thugen a ngai dingin siahdongte le mawhneite tampi tak a hong pai uh hi.","title":"Tuu Mang Thugentehna (Mat 18:10-14)"},"2":{"text":"Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate phun uh a, “Hih mipa, mawhneite tawh kikhawlin an nangawn nekhawm hi,” a ci uh hi.","ref":"Luk 5:29-30"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a,"},"4":{"text":"“Note sung panin khatpeuh in tuu zakhat nei-in, tua sung panin khat mansuah leh bangcih ding ahi hiam? Lopa ne-in a gamta tuu sawmkua le kuate nusia-in, a muh matengin tua a mang tuu khat a zong dingin kuankhia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A muh ciangin lungdam mahmahin a liangko-ah pua-in ciahpih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Inn a tun ciangin a lawmte le a vengte samin, ‘A mangsa ka tuu mukik ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi. Lungdamna pawi bawl ni,’ a ci ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mah bangin kisikkik ding a kisam lo mihoih sawmkua le kuate tungah lungdamna sangin mawhnei mi khat a kisikna hangin vantungah lungdamna lianzaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in tua ahih kei leh zong, “Numei khat in sum peek sawm a neih sung panin khat mansuah leh bangcih ding ahi hiam? Meivak vakin, a innsung teng phiatin, a muh matengin mun khempeuh limtakin zong ding hi.","title":"Sum Mansuah Thugentehna"},"9":{"text":"A muh ciangin a lawmte le a vengte samin amaute kiangah, ‘Ka sum mansuahsa mukik ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi. Lungdamna pawi bawl ni,’ ci ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mah bangin mawhnei mi khat a kisikkikna hangin Pasian’ vantung mite lungdam mahmah uh hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna khat gen leuleu a, “Mi khat in tapa nih a nei hi.","title":"Tapa Mangthang Thugentehna"},"12":{"text":"A nauzawpa in, ‘Pa aw, neihsa kei’ ngah ding tangteng tu-in hong pia in,’ a ci hi. Tua ahih manin a pa in zong, a ta tegel a hawmsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni tawmkhat khit ciangin a nauzawpa in ama neihsateng zuakin a sum tawh inn panin a gamlapi-ah paikhia a, a sumte a phengzat gawp hi."},"14":{"text":"A sum neih khempeuh a zatmang khit ciangin tua ama omna gamah kialpi tung a, ahi zongin amah in bangmah nei nawn lo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua gammite khat kiangah nasem dingin va pai a, a innteek pa in vokcing dingin ama lo-ah a sawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Vokte’ begap nekte nangawn a duhgawh ciang dongin om a, ahi zongin kuamah in an pia lo hi."},"17":{"text":"A tawpna-ah thu ngaihsun thei a, ‘Ka pa’ nasemte khempeuh in gaih zawh lohin an khamval nei uh a, tu-in hih lai-ah gilkialin a puksi ding ka hita hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei kithawi-in ka pa kiangah ka ciah ding a, “Pa aw, Pasian tung le nangma tungah ka khial khin hi."},"19":{"text":"Na tapa cih dingin zong kilawm nawn lo ka hih manin na nasemte khat bangin hong bawl lel in,” ka ci ding hi,’ a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amah kithawi-in a pa kiangah a ciahkik dingin a pai hi. Ahi zongin inn a tun ma-in a pa in na galmuh a, hehpihhuaisa mahmah ahih manin va delhin, a tapa ngawng kawi-in a nam hi."},"21":{"text":"A tapa in, ‘Pa aw, Pasian tung le nangma tungah ka khialkhin hi. Na tapa cih dingin zong ka kilawm nawn kei hi,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin a pa in a nasemte sam a, ‘Hong manlang un. Puan hoihpen hong la unla silhsak un. A khutme-ah zungbuh butsak unla, a khe-ah khedap zong bulhsak un."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin i bawngno limcipen hong go unla, lungdam pawi bawl ni."},"24":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka tapa a sisa hong nungta a, ka tapa a mangsa hong tungkik hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ahih manin lungdamna pawi bawl a kipan uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tua laitakin a tapa uzaw pen lo kuan hi a, vaiciah inn hong tun kuan ciangin lamna le lasakna gingte a za hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in zong nasemte khat sam a, ‘Bang thu om ahi hiam?’ ci-in a dong hi."},"27":{"text":"‘Na naupa hong tungkik hi. Cidamin hong tungkik ahih manin na pa in i bawngtalno limcipen go hi,’ ci-in a nasempa in a dawng hi."},"28":{"text":"A ta uzaw pen a heh suak mahmah ahih manin inn sungah zong hong tum nuam lo hi. Tua ahih manin a pa va pusuakin, a ta hong sungtumna dingin a zol hi."},"29":{"text":"A tapa uzaw in, ‘Tu a beisa hunsung khempeuh, nasemte khat bangin nangma a dingin na ka sem a, na thu zong kong nial ngei het kei hi. Tua hinapi, kei bang hong pia ngei na hi hiam? Ka lawmte tawh pawi ka bawl nadingin keel khat nangawn nong pia kei hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih na tapa in na neihsa khempeuh numei paktatte tungah zangmang khin a, hong ciahkik ciangin bawngtalno limcipen na gawh lai hi,’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"A pa in, ‘Ka ta aw, nang pen hih lai-ah kei tawh a omkhawm tawntung na hi a, keima neih khempeuh nangma a’ ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tu-in na naupa a sisa hong hingkik a, a mangsa hong tungkik ahih manin lungdamin pawi i bawl ding ahi hi,’ ci-in a pa in a dawng hi,” a ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Sum hau pa khat om a, a neihsateng a uk dingin ama khutnuai-ah mi khat a koih hi. Tua a neihsateng a uk dingin a koih mipa in a topa’ sumteng phengzat gawp hi, ci-in kikhia hi.","title":"A Diktat lo Sumkem pa Thugentehna"},"2":{"text":"A topa in zong amah sam a, ‘Na gamtatna ka zak a bangci thu ahi hiam? Keima neihsa a uk dingin hong koih thei nawn lo ding ka hih manin a beisa hun sungah ka neihsate na zeekna sazian a kimtakin hong pia in,’ a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nasempa in lungngai a, ‘Ka topa in ka nasepna panin hong tawpsak ding ahih manin bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam? Thatang nasep lah ka ngap kei a, nektawm ding mi kiangah nget ding lah ka maizum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu’n ka gamtat nading ka theita hi. Tua ka ngaihsut bangin gamta leng, ka nasepna panin ka tawp ciangin lawm nei-in, amaute in a inn-ah kei hong tungsak ding uh hi,’ ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a topa’ sum a bate khat khatin sam a, a masa pen pa kiangah, ‘Ka topa tungah bangzah ba na hi hiam?’ a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Sathau tambong zanih dim ba ing,’ ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, ‘Na leibatna lai va la in,’ ci hi; tua ciangin, ‘Na leiba om lai sathau tambong zakhat hi. Tu mahmahin tusuk inla, tambong za khatin ciamteh in,’ ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin adang khat pa kiangah, ‘Nang bangzah ba na hi hiam?’ ci-in a dot ciangin, ‘Mangbuh seu zakhat ba ing,’ ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, ‘Na leibatna lai va la in,’ ci hi; tua ciangin, ‘Na leiba om lai seu sawmgiat hi. Seu sawmgiat, ci-in ciamteh in,’ ci hi."},"8":{"text":"A diktat lo nasempa pen ama ngiansiamna hangin a topa in a pakta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian thu a zui mite sangin leitung mihingte pen a nasepna uhah ngiansiam zaw uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Note kiangah kong genin-ah, hih na leitung sum uh a bei ciangin tawntung nuntakna inn-ah hong kilutsak theih nadingin lawm zonna-in hih leitung sumte na zang un."},"10":{"text":"“A tawmno-ah a diktatte pen a tamah zong diktat uh a, a tawmno-ah a citak lote pen a tamah zong citak lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih leitung sumte-ah na cihtak kei uhleh kua in no tungah vantung sum hong ap ngam ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Midangte’ neihsa tungah na cihtak kei uhleh, kua in no tungah nomau gamhluah ding hong ap ngam ding ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"“To nih’ na a semkhawmzo nasem kuamah om lo hi. A to khat mudahin khat it ding a, khat beelin khat a simmawh ding hi. Pasian’ na le leitung sum na na semkhawmzo kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 6:24"},"14":{"text":"Sum a deih phadiak Farisi mite in hih thute a zak uh ciangin Jesuh a nuihsan uh hi.","title":"Thukham le Pasian’ Ukna"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Mite in note a man penin hong ngaihsut theih nadingin na om uh a, ahi zongin Pasian in na lungsimtawng uh a hong thei hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihingte in a manpha mahmahin a ngaihsutte pen Pasian in bangmahin sim lo hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuiphumpa Johan’ hun ciang dong Moses Thukham le kamsangte’ thugente pen zuih belin kinei a, ahi zongin Pasian’ Ukna hangin Lungdamna Thu a kihilh hun a kipanin hih thu-ah mi khempeuh hong kituhteh uh hi.","ref":"Mat 11:12-13"},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin Thukham a neupen themno khat nangawn a maiman’ ding sangin van le lei a manthan ding olzaw lai hi.","ref":"Mat 5:18"},"18":{"text":"“Pasal khat in a zi ma-in numei dang a tenpih leh tua numei tawh a mawh hi a, a kima numei a tenpih pasal zong numei tawh a mawh mah ahi hi.","title":"Kimakna Thu Jesuh’ Genna (Mat 19:1-12 ; Mrk 10:1-12)","ref":"Mat 5:32; 1Kor 7:10-11"},"19":{"text":"“Khatvei, mihau mahmah khat om a, nisimin puan manpha nono silhin, anlim nono ne-in a om hi.","title":"Sum Hau pa le Lazaras"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pumtangin meima a vei, Lazaras a kici mizawng khat zong, mihau pa’ kongbiangah hong kikoih a,"},"21":{"text":"mihau pa’ sabuai tung panin a kia annengte nenuamin a ngak hi. Tua bangin a om laitakin uite hong pai-in a meima hong liahliah sak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin mizawng pa hong si a, vantung a Abraham kiangah a om dingin vantung mite in a paipih uh hi. Mihau pa zong hong si leuleu-in a kivui hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin hell khuk sungah gimna thuakin a om hi. A khuadak leh, gamlapi mun khatah Abraham le Lazaras a omkhawm a galmuh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih manin nakpitakin kiko a, ‘Pa Abraham aw, kei hong hehpih in. Meiphual sungah omin nakpitakin gimna thuak ka hih manin Lazaras in a khutme dawn tui diahin ka leii hong votsak nadingin hong sawl in,’ a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin Abraham in, ‘Ka ta aw, leitungah na nuntak laitakun nang nopsakna namkim na ngah laitakin Lazaras in haksatna namkim a thuak hi. Ahi zongin tu-in amah in hih lai-ah nopsakna a ngah laitakin nangmah in haksatna a thuak na hi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua tham loin, i kikalah kuam thukpi khat om a, hih lai panin nang kiangah hong pai nuamte kuamah pai zo lo a, nangma omna panin hih lai-ah zong kuamah hong pai zo lo hi,’ ci-in a dawng hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihau pa in, ‘Pa aw, tua bang ahihleh zong, ka inn uhah Lazaras nong sawlsak nadingin ka hong thum hi."},"28":{"text":"Inn-ah nau pasal nga ka nei lai a, ke’n gim ka thuakna hih lai munah hong tunkhak loh teitei nadingun kei’ gamtat bangin a gamtat loh nadingun hong hilhsak hen,’ a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi zongin Abraham in, ‘Na sanggamte a hilh dingin Moses le kamsangte om uh ahih manin tuate’ thugen na ngai ta uh hen,’ a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihau pa in, ‘Pa Abraham aw, tua nong gen zong a kicing khin hi mah hi. Ahi zongin a sisa mi khat hingkikin amaute kiangah va paikik leh a mawhna panun ka naute kisik hamtang ding uh hi,’ a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi zongin Abraham in, ‘Amaute in Moses le kamsangte’ thu a mannop kei uhleh, mi khat hong hingkikin amaute kiangah a va gen hangin umsakzo tuan lo ding hi,’ ci-in a dawng hi,” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, “Mite a puktheih nading ze-etna hong piang hamtang ding hi. Ahi zongin tua puk nading a piangsak mipa in gimna ngah ding hi.","title":"Khialh nading Ze-etnate (Mat 18:6-7 , 21-22 ; Mrk 9:42)"},"2":{"text":"Hih naupangno khat a khialh nading a piansak sangin a ngawngah an gawina suang lianpi khat khihin tuipi sungah kikhia leh ama a dingin hoihzaw thampek ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Note hoihtakin kingaihsun un. Na sanggampa uh no tungah hong khialh leh amah taii unla, a kisik leh a mawhna maisak un.","ref":"Mat 18:15"},"4":{"text":"Nikhat sungin sagihvei ciang dong hong khialh hangin zong, a sagihvei mahin no kiangah hong pai-in, ‘Ka kisik hi,’ hong cih nakleh na maisak khin ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Nikhat, sawltakte in Topa kiangah, “Ka upna uh hong liansak in,” a ci uh hi.","title":"Ka Upna uh Hong Liansak In"},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Ankam tang cia a pha upna nei le-uhcin, hih nailung kung kiangah, ‘Kizunglot inla tuipi sungah va po in,’ ci le-uhcin na cih bangun piangzo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Note khatpeuh in na lo uh hong khawhsak ahi a, na tuu uh a hong cinsak ahi zongin nasem khat nei le-uhcin, inn-ah a hong tun ciangin, ‘Hong pai inla na an ne pah in,’ na ci uh hiam?","title":"Nasempa’ Tavuan"},"8":{"text":"Na ci kei uh hi. Ama kiangah, ‘Ka nitak-an ding hong bawl inla, na puan silhin ka annek sungteng hong vil in. Ka man khit ciangin na ne thei ding hi,’ na cizaw uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua bangin a sawlteng a sepna hangin a nasempa tungah, ‘Ka nuam mahmah hi,’ ci tuan lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mah bangin note in zong hong kisawlteng na sepkhit uh ciangin, ‘Nasem mawkmawkte mah ihi a, i tavuanteng bek mah a sem khin ihi hi,’ na ci uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem khua manawhin Jesuh a pai laitakin Samaria le Galilee gam kikal tawnin a pai hi.","title":"Jesuh in Miphak Sawm Damsak"},"12":{"text":"Khuaneu khatah a lut dektak laitakin miphak sawm in a dawntuah uh hi. Jesuh tawh a kigamla munah ding uh a,"},"13":{"text":"nakpitakin kiko-in, “Topa Jesuh aw, kote hong hehpih in,” a ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute a muh ciangin, “Pai unla siampite va kivelsak un,” a ci hi. Amaute a va pai uh ciangin lamkalah a dam uh hi.","ref":"Siam 14:1-32"},"15":{"text":"Amaute sung panin a damlam a kitheih ciangin khat hong lehtai kik a, nakpitakin Pasian a phat hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh’ khe mai-ah bokin a lungdamna a ko hi. Hih mipa pen Samaria mi ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh hong paukhia a, “Mihing sawm kidamsak hi lo ahi hiam? Adang kuate koi lai-ah om ahi uh hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Bang hangin hih gamdang mipa bek Pasian’ tungah lungdamna a ko dingin hong kileh ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Tho inla ciah in. Na upna in nang hong damsak hi,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Khatvei Farisi mite pawlkhat in, cik ciangin Pasian’ Ukna hun hong tung ding ahi hiam, ci-in Jesuh dong uh a, Jesuh in, “Pasian’ Ukna pen mit tawh muhtheihin hong tung lo ding hi.","title":"Pasian’ Uk Hun hong Tunna (Mat 24:23-28 , 36-41)"},"21":{"text":"Hih lai-ah om hi, hua lai-ah om hi, cih bangin kuama gentheih hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note lakah Pasian’ Ukna hong om khinzo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in nungzuite kiangah, “Nikhat ni ciangin Mihing Tapa nikhat sung bek nangawn na muhnop hun uh hong tung ding a, ahi zongin na mu kei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Mite in, ‘Hih lai-ah om hi,’ hong ci ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amau’ cihna mun a en dingin paikhia kei un."},"24":{"text":"Amah hong pai taktak ciangin khuaphialep in van mong khat pan mong khat dong hong taanzaih mah bangin kitheikim ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah in gimna tampi tak thuak masa ding a, ama huna mite in amah nial ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Noah hunin up lohpi-in tuiciin a tun bangin Mihing Tapa zong uploh hun khatin hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Pai 6:5-8"},"27":{"text":"Teembaw sungah Noah lutin Tuiciin in mi khempeuh a sihsak ni ciang dongin tua huna mite in anne zune-in om uh a, mo kipi mo kikha-in a om uh hi.","ref":"Pian 7:6-24"},"28":{"text":"Lot huna mah tawh zong hong kibang ding hi. Tua hun lai-in zong anne zune-in om uh a, sumlei sumzuak, lokho, inn lamin a omom laitakun,"},"29":{"text":"Sodom panin Lot a paikhiat ni-in van panin kaat leh meikuang hong kiasuk a, amaute khempeuh a kangtum hi.","ref":"Pian 18:20-19:25"},"30":{"text":"Mihing Tapa hong kilat ni ciangin zong tua mah tawh hong kibang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“Tuani a hong tun ciangin a innkhum zangah a om mipa in a innsunga a om a neihsate a la dingin kumsuk kei hen. Tua mah bangin lo-ah a om mipa zong a inn-ah ciahkik kei hen.","ref":"Mat 24:17-18; Mrk 13:15-16"},"32":{"text":"Lot’ zi na phawk un.","ref":"Pian 19:26"},"33":{"text":"A nuntakna a hu nuamte in a nuntakna bulpi taanlawh ding a, a nuntakna a taanlawhte in a nuntakna bulpi huzo ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:39; 16:25; Mrk 8:35; Luk 9:24; Joh 12:25"},"34":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, tuahun laitakin zanin lupna tungah a lumkhawm mi nih sung panin khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."},"35":{"text":"An a sukhawm numei nih, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Lo a kuankhawm mi nih, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, “Topa aw, koi laitakah tua thute hong piang ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin Jesuh in, “Sapul omna peuhah musane a om mah bangin mi omna peuhah hong piang ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in thu ngen tawntungin a lungkiat ngei loh nading uh a hilh nopna-in Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah thugentehna khat gen a,","title":"Meigongnu le Thukhen pa Thugentehna"},"2":{"text":"“Khuapi khat sungah Pasian a zahtak lo, mi zong a don lo thukhen mang khat a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua khuasung mahah meigong numei khat zong om a, ama kiangah hong pai tawntungin, ‘Ka thu uh hong khensak in,’ ci-in a thum tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Tawlkhat sung thudon loin om a, ahi zongin a nung ciangin, ‘Pasian zahtak loin, mite zong ka donnop kholloh hangin,"},"5":{"text":"hih meigongnu in hong nawngkaisak niloh ahih manin, a thu khensak kei leng, hong pai nilohin hong lunggimsak ding hi,’ ci-in ngaihsun hi,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in, “Hih mihoih lo thukhen pa’ kampauna ngaihsun un."},"7":{"text":"A sun a zanin ama tungah a thumthum ama mite’ thu a manin Pasian in khensak lo ding ahi hiam? Amaute a huh ding kizekaisak ding ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, amaute’ thu a manin manlang takin khensak ding hi. Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa hong pai ciangin leitungah amah a um mi a mu ding hiam?” ci-in a genthuah hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute hoih kisa mahmahin, midang khempeuh a simmawhbawl mite tungah Jesuh in zong thugentehna khat gen a,","title":"Farisi Mipa le Siahdongpa Thugentehna"},"10":{"text":"“Thungen dingin biakinn-ah mi nih a pai uh hi. Khat pen Farisi mi hi a, a khat pen siahdongpa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Farisi mipa dingin thu ngen a, ‘Pasian aw, kei pen midangte bangin a huaiham, a thuman lo, numei tungah a mawh mi ka hi kei hi; hua lai-a siahdongpa bang hi lo ka hih manin nangma tungah ka nuamna kong pulak hi."},"12":{"text":"Nipikal khatin ni nih sung an ka tang a, ka ngah khempeuh sung panin sawm-ah-khat nang tungah kong pia hi,’ a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin siahdongpa pen a gamla simah ding a, vantung lamah zong dak ngam loin a dip humin kuncip a, ‘Pasian aw, kei mimawh mi khial pa hong hehpih in,’ ci-in a ngen hi."},"14":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, hih mipa pen Pasian tawh a kilemsa-in a inn-ah ciah a, a khat pa pen tua bangin ciah lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a kiliansakte pen kiniamkhiatsuk ding a, a kiniamkhiatte pen a lianin kibawl ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 23:12; Luk 14:11"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in thupha a piaksak ding a deihna-un mi pawlkhat in a naupangnote nangawn uh Jesuh kiangah hong paipih uh hi. A nungzuite in hih thu a theih uh ciangin amaute na taii uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Naupangte Thupha Pia (Mat 19:13-15 ; Mrk 10:13-16)"},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in naupangnote sam a, “Naupangte hong pai ding khaktan kei un; ka kiangah hong paisak un. Bang hang hiam cih leh naupang a bang mite pen Pasian’ Ukna sungah om thei bek hi."},"17":{"text":"Ke’n kong cihin-ah, naupang bangin Pasian’ Ukna a mang lo peuhmah Pasian’ Ukna sungah om thei lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Jew mi ulian khat in Jesuh kiangah, “A dik siapa aw, nuntak tawntungna ka ngah nadingin bang hih ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Ukpa ahi A Hau Mipa (Mat 19:16-30 ; Mrk 10:17-31)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Bang hangin kei midik hong ci na hi hiam? Pasian simloh kuamah a diktatzo om lo hi."},"20":{"text":"Numei tungah mawh kei in; mi that kei in; mi’ neihsa gu kei in; zuauthu gen kei in; na nu na pa zahtak in, cihna thukhamte thei lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.","ref":"Pai 20:12-16; Thkna 5:16-20"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, “Ka neutung a kipanin hih thukhamte khempeuh ka zuihsa ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin ama kiangah, “Na khat na kisam lai hi. Na neihsa khempeuh zuak inla, mizawngte tungah na sum khotte pia in. Tua hileh vantungah na hau ding hi. Tua khit ciangin ka nung hong zui in,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua mipa in hih thu a zak ciangin amah hau mahmah ahih manin a dah a suak hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in ama dahna a muh ciangin, “Pasian’ Ukna sungah mihaute a lut ding bangzah takin haksa ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Pasian’ Ukna sungah mihau khat a lut ding sangin phim bilvang sungah kalaoh khat a lut ding baihzaw lai hi,” a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua thu a za mite in, “Tua bang ahihleh kua in hotkhiatna ngahzo ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Mihingte’ hih zawh loh pen Pasian in hihzo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter in, “Ko zong ka inn ka lo uh nusia-in nang ka hong zui uh hi,” a cih ciangin"},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “A mantakin kong genin-ah, Pasian’ Uk ding a deihna hangin a inn a lo, a zi a ta, a nu a pa, ahih kei leh a sanggamte a nusiate in,"},"30":{"text":"tuhunin a zah tampi, le hong tung ding hunah nuntak tawntungna a ngah lo ding kuamah om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in nungzui sawm le nihte a tuamin paikhiatpihin amaute kiangah, “Tu-in Jerusalem khua-ah a pai ding ihi a, kamsangte in Mihing Tapa’ thu a gelh khempeuh, tua lai munah a hong tung ding hi.","title":"Jesuh in A Sih ding A Thumveina Genkhol (Mat 20:17-19 ; Mrk 10:32-34)"},"32":{"text":"Pasian in Gentail mite’ khut sungah amah ap ding a, amaute in zahpihin, simmawhin, cilphih ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah satin that ding uh a, ahi zongin a ni thum ni-in hingkik ding hi,” a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi zongin nungzuite in hih ama thugente tel zo lo uh hi. Hih bang thute a hong piang masa ding mah hi a, ahi zongin bei nading hong naita hi, a cihnopna hi nai lo hi,” a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a thugen zomlai a, “Gam khat le gam khat hong kido-in, kumpi khat le kumpi khat hong kido ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mun khempeuhah nakpitakin zin hong lingin, kialpi le pulnatna zong hong tung ding hi. A kihtakhuai a tuamtuamte le lim lianpipi vanah hong kilang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin hihte khempeuh hong pianma-in keima hangin note hong kimanin hong kibawlsia ding hi. Kikhopna innte-ah thusitna thuakin thongah khiat dingin hong ki-ap ding a, ukpite le kumpite mai-ah hong kipaipih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih hun sung pen note in Lungdamna Thu na gentheih nading uh hunhoih ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin eite in bangci gen ding cih lunghihmawhin nei kei un."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh tua hun ciangin note’ gen ding thu le pilna kong guan ding a, na galte uh khat beek in note’ thugen hong nialzo loin, zong hong sel zo lo ding uh hi.","ref":"Luk 12:11-12"},"16":{"text":"Na nu na pate, na sanggamte, na behte, le na lawmte mahmah un note hong khia ding a, note pawlkhat in thahna na thuak ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in keima hangin note hong mudah ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin na samzang khat nangawn uh mangthang lo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hih bangin thuakzo le-uhcin nuntakna taktak ngah ding na hih manun kiptakin om un."},"20":{"text":"“Galkapte in Jerusalem khuapi a umcihna na muh uh ciangin tua khuapi a siat nading naita hi, ci-in na thei ding uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Jerusalem Siat ding Genkhol (Mat 24:15-28 ; Mrk 13:14-23)"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Judea gam sunga omte mualtungah tai un. Jerusalem khuasunga omte zong taikhia unla, gam sung khuaneu-a om mite, Jerusalem khua sungah lut nawn kei un."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, ‘Gim Piak Ni,’ ahi hi.","ref":"Hos 9:7"},"23":{"text":"Tua huna naupaiite le naungek neite a dingin haksa mahmah ding hi. Hih leitungah gimna lianpi hong tung ding a, Pasian in hih mite gim a pia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat, namsau tawh kithat ding a, pawlkhat, galmatin gam dangah kiciahpih ding hi. Tua ciangin Gentail mite’ uk hun a bei matengin Jerusalem khuapi a siacipin om ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ni, kha, le aksite tungah lim hong om ding hi. Tuipi ging le tuihual liante kihtakna hangin leitung mi khempeuh lau-in lunggim ding uh hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa Hong Paina (Mat 24:29-31 ; Mrk 12:24-27)","ref":"Isa 13:10; Ezk 32:7; Joel 2:31; Mang 6:12-13"},"26":{"text":"Leitungah tu-in bang hong piang ding, ci-in a ngaihsut kawmun mite lau-in sibup ding uh hi. Vantunga om nate a pai ngei bangin pai nawn loin lampial mangkhin ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mihing Tapa hong kilang ding a, minthanna le vangliatna tawh meii lakah hong pai ding hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Mang 1:7"},"28":{"text":"Hih thute a pian ding hong kipat ciangin, note hong kihotkhiat ding hun hong naita ahih manin, dingin nuamna lungsim tawh khuadak un,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a, “Thei kung a kipan singkung khempeuh en dih un.","title":"Thei Kung’ Thuhilhna (Mat 24:32-35 ; Mrk 13:28-31)"},"30":{"text":"A teh hong no na muh uh ciangin khuakhal hong naita hi, ci-in na thei uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua mah bangin hih thute hong piang na muh uh ciangin Pasian’ Ukna hun hong tungta ding hi, ci-in na thei ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Hih lai-a om mite a sihkhit ma-in hih thute hong piang ding ahihna phawk un."},"33":{"text":"Van le lei a mangthang zongin ka thugente maimang ngei lo ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Limtakin kidawm un. Thakhat thu-in tua Ni hong tung kha ding ahih manin zune anne le leitung nuntakna lunghimawhin thamang kei un.","title":"Vil Ding Hanthawn"},"35":{"text":"Theihkholh lohin thang kisai bangin leitung mi khempeuh tungah hih thu hong piangvat ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Hih thupiang khempeuh thuakzawh nading thahatna na neih nading uh, le Mihing Tapa mai-ah na dintheih nadingun a tawntungin thu ngenin vil niloh un,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua sungteng nisimin Jesuh in biakinn-ah thu hilh a, nitak ciangin paikhia-in Oliv Mual tungah a giak zel hi.","ref":"Luk 19:47"},"38":{"text":"Ama thuhilhna a ngai dingin mi khempeuh zingsang simin biakinn-ah hong pai baih uh hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Paisan Pawi a kici Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi hun hong naita hi.","title":"Jesuh Thah A Kisawmna (Mat 26:1-5 , 14-16 ; Mrk 14:1-2 , 10-11 ; Joh 11:45-57)","ref":"Pai 12:1-27"},"2":{"text":"Siampi liante le Thukham hilh siate in mihonpite kihta uh ahih manin kuama theih lohin Jesuh a kithah theih nading lampi a zong uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin sawm le nihte sung panin Iskariot tapa Judas sungah Satan hong lut hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Judas va paikhia a, siampi liante le biakinncing palikmangte tawh va kiho uh a, amaute’ khut sungah Jesuh a piaktheihna dingzia a kikum uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute na nuam mahmah uh a, sum tawh guaih dingin thuciam a na pia uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Judas zong thukim a, mihonte’ theih lohin amaute’ khut sungah Jesuh a piaktheih nading lampi zon ding a kipan pah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi hun sungin Paisan Pawi an-a nek ding tuuno gawh ni hun hong tung hi.","title":"Jesuh in A Nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi Annek ding Vaihawm (Mat 26:17-25 ; Mrk 14:12-21 ; Joh 13:21-30)"},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in Peter le Johan kiangah, “Va pai unla, eite’ Paisan Pawi annek ding va vaihawm un,” ci-in a sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"“Koi lai-ah va bawl le ung hong deih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in, “Jerusalem khuasung na lut uh ciangin tuibeel a pua pasal khat na mu ding uh hi. Ama lutna inn-ah zui unla,"},"11":{"text":"a innteek pa kiangah, ‘Siapa in: Ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi an ka nektheih nading uh inndei koi lai hiam, ci hi,’ ci-in va dong un."},"12":{"text":"Amah in a baihsa-in a na kikoihsa inndei tungnung a zai khat hong lak ding hi. Tua lai-ah a kisam khempeuh a baihsa-in na koih un,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amau tegel zong pai uh a, Jesuh’ gensa bang teekteekin va mu uh a, tua lai-ah Paisan Pawi annek ding a bawl uh hi."},"14":{"text":"A hun a tun ciangin Jesuh zong sawltakte tawh sabuai-ah a tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Sihna ka thuakma-in note tawh hih Paisan Pawi an i nekkhop ding ka ut mahmah khat ahi hi.","title":"Nekkhawm Bawlna A Pianna (Mat 26:26-30 ; Mrk 14:22-26 ; 1Kor 11:23-26)"},"16":{"text":"A mantakin kong genin-ah, Pasian’ Ukna sungah a cingtaak Paisan Pawi hun hong tun mateng, Paisan Pawi an ka ne ngei nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in a hai sang a, Pasian’ tungah lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin, “Hih hai hong sang unla, na vekpi-un na gual dawn un."},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ Ukna hun hong tun mateng, tu a kipanin leenggahzu ka dawn nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin anlum la-in Pasian tungah lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin amaute tungah pia a, “Hih pen note a dingin a hong kipia keima pumpi ahi hi. Keimah nong phawk nadingun na ne un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua mah bangin an a nekkhit uh ciangin amaute tungah hai pia a, “Hih leenggahzu pen note a dingin a luangkhia, Pasian’ thuciamna thak a kipsak ka sisan ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31-34"},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin kei hong lehhek ding pa’ khut in sabuai-ah kei tawh an a sawkkhawmna thu thei un.","ref":"La 41:9"},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ sehsa bangin Mihing Tapa si ding a, ahi zongin amah a lehhek pa in gimna thuak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin hih bangin a gamta ding eite lakah kua hi ding ihi hiam, ci-in amaute khatlekhat a kidong uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Nungzuite lakah kua a lianpenin kingaihsun ding, ci-in kiselna thu hong piang hi.","title":"Kua Lianpen ding cih Kiselna","ref":"Mat 18:1; Mrk 9:34; Luk 9:46"},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Gentail mi hih leitung kumpite in a mite uh tungah ukna aana zang uh a, tua bangin mi a uk Gentail-te in amaute pen, ‘Mite’ nopsak nadingin nasemte,’ a kicih ding deih lai uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin note lakah tua bang hi lo ding hi; a lianpen pa a neupen bangin om ding a, a makai pen pa a nungzui nunungpen bangin om ding hi.","ref":"Mat 23:11; Mrk 9:35; Mat 20:25-27; Mrk 10:42-44"},"27":{"text":"Anne dingin sabuai-ah a tupa le an a piapa kua lianzaw ahi hiam? Anne dingin a tupa lianzaw mah hi. Ahi zongin kei pen note lakah anpia-in na a sempa bangin ka hong om hi.","ref":"Joh 13:12-15"},"28":{"text":"“Gimna ka thuak sung khempeuh note in kei nong ompih uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka Pa in uk nading aana kei tungah hong piak mah bangin kei zong note tungah ka hong pia ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima Ukna sungah anne tuidawnin sabuai kiimah na tu ding uh a, Israel minam sawm le nihte tungah thu a khen dingin thukhenna tokhom tungah na tu ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 19:28"},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Simon, Simon aw, lokho pa in buhhum a haih bangin note khempeuh hong ze-et nadingin Satan in thu a ngah khitna thu phawk in.","title":"Peter’ Nial Ding Kigenkhol (Mat 26:31-35 ; Mrk 14:27-31 ; Joh 13:36-38)"},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin, Simon aw, na upna na khahsuah loh nadingin nang a dingin thu kong ngetsak khin hi. Kei kiangah nong kiheikik ciangin nungzui na lawmte na hanthawn in,” a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter in, “Topa aw, nang tawh thong a kiakhawm ding le a sikhawm dingin a kigingsa-in ka om hi,” ci-in a gen hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Peter aw, ke’n a mantakin kong genin-ah, ‘Amah ka thei kei hi,’ ci-in thumvei nong nialkhit matengin tuni-in ak khuang lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, “Note in sumbawm, ip, le khedap keng loin kong sawlkhiat lai-in kitangsapna na nei uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Bangmah ka kitangsapna uh om lo hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.","title":"Sumbawm, Ip, le Namsau","ref":"Mat 10:9-10; Mrk 6:8-9; Luk 9:3; 10:4"},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Ahi zongin, tu-in ahihleh, sumbawm ahi a, ip ahi zongin a neite in keng unla, namsau a nei lo peuhmah in na puansilh uh zuak unla khat lei un."},"37":{"text":"Bang hangin hih bangin hong gen ka hi hiam cih leh, Lai Siangtho in, ‘Mawhneite lakah amah kihelsak hi,’ ci-in keima thu a genna pen hong tung ding hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 53:12"},"38":{"text":"Amaute in, “Topa aw, en in; hih lai-ah namsau nih om hi,” ci-in a gen uh ciangin Jesuh in, “Tua ahihleh phazo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh a pai ngei zel bangin, khuasung nusia-in Oliv Mual tungah pai a, a nungzuite in zong a zui uh hi.","title":"Huan sungah Jesuh in Thu Ngen (Mat 26:36-46 ; Mrk 14:32-42)"},"40":{"text":"Ama painopna mun a tun ciangin amaute kiangah, “Ze-etna na tuahkhak loh nadingun thu ngen un,” ci-in a gen hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kiang panin suanglot khat tan bang pailai a, khukdinin thu ngen a,"},"42":{"text":"“Pa aw, nangma ngaihsutna bang ahihkhak leh hih ka thuak ding gimna tawh hong kipelhsak in. Ahi zongin kei deihna bang hi loin nangma deihna bang hi ta hen,” a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung panin ama kiangah vantungmi khat hong pai a, Jesuh’ tha a hatsak hi."},"44":{"text":"Lunggim mahmah ahih manin nakpitakin thu ngen semsem a, leilak a si mal gol taak bangin a khua-ul a taak hi."},"45":{"text":"A thungetna panin dingin a nungzuite kiangah paikik a, amaute a dahna hangun gimin ihmu-in a om a mu hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Bang hangin ihmu na hi uh hiam? Tho unla ze-etna-ah na pukkhak loh nadingun thu ngen un,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua bangin thu a gen laitakin mihonpi khat hong pai a, sawm le nihte sung panin Judas a kici mipa hong makai-in Jesuh a nam dingin hong naih hi.","title":"Jesuh a Kilehhekna le a Kimatna (Mat 26:47-56 ; Mrk 14:43-50 ; Joh 18:1-11)"},"48":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Judas aw, napna tawh Mihing Tapa lehhek na hi hiam?” a na ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh’ kiima om mite in a thupiang ding a muh ciangun, “Topa aw, ka namsau uh tawh ka sat ding uh hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Amaute khat in siampi lianpen pa’ nasempa sat a, a taklam bil a satkhia hi."},"51":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Tua bangin gamta nawn kei un,” ci-in a mipa’ bil lawnsakin a damsak hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in amah a man dingin a hong pai siampi liante, biakinncing palikmangte, le upate kiangah, “Namsau le molhtum tawh kei hih dingin nong kuan nadingun kei pen gal le sa ka hi hiam?"},"53":{"text":"Nisimin biakinn-ah note tawh ka omkhawm a, bangmah nong cih kei uh hi. Ahi zongin hih hun pen nomau’ hun hi a, khuamial sung a uk Satan’ vangliat hunsung ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Luk 19:47; 21:37"},"54":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh manin paikhiatpih uh a, siampi lianpen pa’ inn a tunpih uh hi. Peter in zong a kihalin nungzuih hi.","title":"Peter in Jesuh Nial (Mat 26:57-75 ; Mrk 14:53-72 ; Joh 18:15-18 , 25-27)"},"55":{"text":"Inntualah meiphual kicih a, tua meiphual kiima tute lakah Peter zong a kihel hi."},"56":{"text":"Mei awi-a omte lakah Peter a omlam, nasem numei khat in a muh ciangin limtakin Peter en a, “Hih pa zong Jesuh tawh a kikhawlte khat hi,” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter in, “Ka nau aw, amah ka thei kei hi,” ci-in a nial hi."},"58":{"text":"Tua khit a sawt loin midang khat in amah hong mu leuleu a, “Nang zong amaute tawh pawlkhat na hi hi,” a ci hi. Ahi zongin Peter in, “Lawm aw, ka hi kei hi,” a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Tua khit nai lang bang ding ciangin midang khat in, “Hih mipa Galilee mi ahih manin amah zong Jesuh tawh a kipawlte hi taktak hi,” hong ci teitei hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter in, “Lawm aw, na thugen ka thei kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua bangin a pau laitakin thakhatin ak hong khuang hi."},"61":{"text":"Jesuh zong kihei-in Peter hong en a, “Tuni-in ak a khuan’ ma-in thumvei nong nial ding hi,” ci-in Topa’ kampauna thu Peter in hong phawkvat hi."},"62":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter paikhia-in nakpitakin a kap hi."},"63":{"text":"Jesuh a cingte in simmawh bawlin a sat uh hi.","title":"Jesuh Kisimmawh Bawlin Kisat (Mat 26:67-68 ; Mrk 14:65)"},"64":{"text":"Puan tawh a mit tuamsak uh a, “Kua’n hong sat ahi hiam, thei dih in,” a ci uh hi."},"65":{"text":"Amah simmawh bawlna kam tampi a pau uh hi."},"66":{"text":"Khua a vak ciangin upate, siampi liante, le Thukham hilh siate hong kikhawm uh a, uliante mai-ah Jesuh hong kipaipih hi.","title":"Jesuh, Uliante Mai-ah (Mat 26:59-66 ; Mrk 14:55-64 ; Joh 18:19-24)"},"67":{"text":"Amaute in, “Khrih na hi hiam, hong gen in,” ci-in a dot uh ciangin Jesuh in, “Kong gen hangin nong um kei ding uh a,"},"68":{"text":"thu kong dot hangin zong nong dawng kei ding uh hi."},"69":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu a kipanin a Vanglian Pasian’ taklamah Mihing Tapa tu ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"70":{"text":"Tua ciangin a vekpi-un, “Tua ahihleh Pasian’ Tapa na hi hiam?” a cih uh ciangin, “Pasian’ Tapa hi, nong ci uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"71":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, “Thudang bangmah kisam nawn lo hi. Ama kam mahmah panin i za khinta hi,” a ci uh hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin a vekpi-in ding khia uh a, Pilat mai-ah a paipih uh hi.","title":"Jesuh, Pilat Mai-ah (Mat 27:1-2 , 11-14 ; Mrk 15:1-5 ; Joh 18:28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai panin amah mawhzon ding kipan uh a, “Hih mipa in ka mipihte uh lam khialsakin, kumpipa tungah siah piak loh dingin thu gen a, amahmah zong Khrih ahi kumpi khat ahihna a kigenna zong ka za uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pilat in, “Nang, Jew mite’ kumpipa na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Nang zong tua mah nong ci hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pilat in siampi liante le mihonte kiangah, “Hih mipa mawhsak nading thu bangmah ka mu kei hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in nawhsa takin nakpau semsem uh a, “Amah in mite a buai nadingin thu hilh a, Galilee gam pan hong kipanin Judea gam sung khempeuhah hong hilh a, tu-in hih lai mun hong tungta hi,” a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Pilat in hih thu a zak ciangin, “Hih mipa Galilee mi ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Jesuh, Herod Mai-ah"},"7":{"text":"Jesuh pen Herod’ ukna sung mi ahihlam a theih ciangin, tua laitakin Herod mah zong Jerusalem-ah om ahih manin ama kiangah a paisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Herod in Jesuh’ thu zaza a, amah a muhnop sawt mahmah khinta ahih manin Jesuh a muh ciangin a nuam mahmah hi. Jesuh in nalamdang a bawlte a mu dingin kilamen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Herod in thu tampi tak dong a, ahi zongin Jesuh in kam khat beek dawng lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Siampi liante le Thukham hilh siate in hong neh uh a, Jesuh mawhsakna thu nakpitakin hong gen uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Herod le galkapte in Jesuh zahko-in simmawh bawl uh a, kumpi puantualpi a silhsak khit uh ciangin Pilat kiangah a puakkik uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih hun ma-in Herod le Pilat kilem loin kigalbawl uh a, ahi zongin tua ni mahmahin amau tegel kilem kikin kipawlbawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Pilat in zong siampi liante, upate, le mihonpite sam khawmin","title":"Jesuh a Si dingin Thu Kikhen (Mat 27:15-26 ; Mrk 15:6-15 ; Joh 18:39-19:16)"},"14":{"text":"amaute kiangah, “Hih mipa in i mipihte lam khialsak hi, ci-in mawhsakin kei kiangah nong paipih uh hi. Note khempeuh mai mahah amah thu ka sit a, amah na mawhsakna uh thute khat beekah a mawhna ka mu kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Herod in zong ama mawhna mu lo a, eite kiangah amah hong puakkik hi. Hih mipa in sihna a thuak nadingin ama gamtatna bangmah om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amah satna tawh thuhilhin ka khah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"(Paisan Pawi hun simin Pilat in amaute’ deih thongkia khat a khah ding ahi hi.)"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin mihon khempeuh kiko uh a, “Amah that in! Barabbas hong khahsak in!” a ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Barabbas pen khua sungah mi a buaisakna hang, le mi a thahna hangin thong sungah a kikhum ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pilat in Jesuh khahnuam ahih manin mihonpite tungah khatvei a genkik hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin mihonpite in, “Singlamteh tungah that in, singlamteh tungah that in,” ci-in a kiko uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute tungah a thumveina thu gen a, “Amah in bang mawhna bawl ahi hiam? Sihna a thuak nadingin ama gamtatna bangmah ka mu kei hi. Tua ahih manin amah satin ka khah ding hi,” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin a aw neihzah uh tawh amaute awng semsem uh a, singlamteh tungah Jesuh a thah nading gen uh ahih manin a tawpna-ah a zo uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amaute’ ngetna bangin piak dingin Pilat in thu a khen hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi buaisakna le mi thahna hangin thong sungah a kikhia mipa amau’ ngetna bangin khah a, amau’ deihna bangin a bawl dingun Jesuh a piakhia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Jesuh paikhiatpih uh a, gam sung panin khuapi sungah a hong pai, Sairin khuami Simon a kici mi khat tawh a kituak uh hi. Hih laibu sungah a gen mah bangin hih lai a simte in Jesuh pen Honpa dingin a hong kiciam kholsa Pasian' Tapa ahihna a uptheihna ding uh leh amah a muan'na uh hangin nuntakna a ngah theihna dingun hih Lungdamna Thu a kigelh ahi hi (20:31). A thupatna-ah a kip tawntung Pasian' Thu in Jesuh hi, ci-in a gen khit ciangin, Jesuh pen Honpa dingin a hong kiciam kholsa, Pasian' Tapa ahihna thu a kilangsak na lamdang tuamtuamte a gen hi. Tua khit ciangin tua na lamdangte in a lahkhiat thute a gentelna tawh na kizomto hi. Mi pawlkhat in Jesuh umin a nungzui suak uh a, mi pawlkhat in nialin a up noplohna thu, hih khawk sungtengah kigen hi. A lian 13-17 sungah, Jesuh a kimat nitak zanin a nungzuite tawh a kilim kholhna leh singlamteh tungah a kithah ding nitakin a nungzuite hanthawnin a kigin'kholhnate kiciamteh hi.
