Pasal tawh a mawh laitakin a kiman numei thu pen (8:1-11) mi pawlkhat in nusia a, pawlkhat in mun dangah koih a, ngaihsutna kibanglo ahih manin a kual tawh ki-umin kiciamteh hi. Johan in Khrih hangin a kingah nuntak tawntungna letsong limgen pha hi. Tua nuntakna letsong pen tu mahmahin hong kipan pah a, Jesuh pen lampi, thuman, leh nuntakna hi, ci-in a sang mite tungah tua nuntakna hong tung hi. Johan' thugen zia a tuam pian'na panin, kha thu tawh kisai thu taktakte a lahna dingin nisimin i theihtheih thu mawkmawk ahi tui, anlum, khuavak, tuucingte leh a tuute, leenggui leh a gah cihte na limzat mahmah hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kipat cil-in Thu na om a, tua Thu, Pasian tawh na omkhawm a, tua Thu, Pasian ahi hi.","title":"Thu, Mi Hong Suak"},"2":{"text":"Tua hi a, a kipat cil a kipanin Thu le Pasian na omkhawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian in Thu tawh na khempeuh piangsak a, a kipiangsak na khempeuh, Thu tawh loin a kipiangsak khat beek om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei khempeuh in tua Thu tung panin a nuntakna uh ngah a, tua nuntakna in mi khempeuh tungah khuavak hong tunpih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khuavak pen khuamial lakah taang a, khuamial in tua khuavak a zo kei hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in Johan kici mi khat kamtai dingin hong paisak a,","ref":"Mat 3:1; Mrk 1:4; Luk 3:1-2"},"7":{"text":"mi khempeuh in ama thugenna za-in tua khuavak a uptheih nadingun tua khuavak thu a gen dingin a hong pai ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua Johan mahmah pen khuavak hi lo a, khuavak thu a gen dingin a hong pai ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama gen khuavak taktak pen zong leitungah hong tung khin a, mi khempeuh a taan khin hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah, leitungah om a, amah tawh leitung a kibawl hinapi-in leitung mite in amah na thei kha lo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A khua le a tui-ah va pai a, ahi zongin a khuapih a tuipihte in ama thugen na ngai lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bang hitaseleh ama thu ngai-in amah a um mite khempeuh tungah Pasian’ tate suahtheih nading thu a pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin Pasian’ tate suahna pen leitung ngeina nute pate sung panin suahna tawh hi loin Pasian sung panin suahna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua Thu mihing hong suakin kote lakah hong om a, itna nei-in citak mahmah ahih manin Pasian’ pianzia a neihna ka mu cian uh hi. Amaute in, “Sia aw, koi lai-ah om na hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hong pai unla, ka omna mun hong mu un,” a na ci hi. Tua hun pen nitak nai li hun pawl ahih manin ama kiangah a giak uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Johan kampauna za-in Jesuh a zui nihte sung panin khat pen Simon Peter’ naupa Andru ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"A zing ciangin a u Simon zongpahin ama kiangah, “Messiah ka mu zo uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua pen Khrih a cihnopna ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh kiangah a u Simon a paipih hi. Jesuh in amah enin, “Nang pen Johan’ tapa Simon na hi hi. Tu a kipanin Sifas hong kici ding hi,” a ci hi. Sifas pen Peter tawh a kibang hi a, suangtum a cihna ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A zing ciangin Jesuh in Galilee gamah pai ding ngaihsun hi. Filip tawh kituak a, ama kiangah, “Hong zui in,” a ci hi.","title":"Jesuh in Filip le Nethanel Sam"},"44":{"text":"Filip pen Andru le Peter’ tenna Bethsaida khuami mah ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Nethanel tawh a kituah ciangin Filip in, “Moses in Thukham laibu sungah a gelh mipa, le kamsangte in zong a gelh mipa ka mu khin uh hi. Amah Jesuh hi a, Nazareth khuami Josef’ tapa ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Nethanel in, “Nazareth khua panin bang hong piang peuhmah ding ahi hiam?” na cihsan hi. Ahi zongin Filip in, “Hong pai inla, hong mu dih in,” a ci hi."},"47":{"text":"Jesuh in ama kiangah Nethanel hong pai a muh ciangin, “En un, hih mipa, Israel mi taktak hi a, a lungsimah zuauthu om het lo hi,” a ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Nethanel in, “Kei hong bangci theih na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Jesuh in, “Filip in nang hong sap ma-in theikung nuai-ah na om laitakin ka hong mu hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nethanel in, “Sia aw, nang, Pasian’ Tapa na hi hi. Israel mite’ Kumpi zong na hi hi,” a cih ciangin"},"50":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Theikung nuai-ah ka hong mu hi, ka hong cih manin Pasian Tapa le Israel mite Kumpi ka hihlam hong um na hi hiam? Hihte sangin a thu lianzaw na mu lai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Ke’n a mantak kong genin-ah, vantung a kihong na mu ding uh a, Mihing Tapa le vantung kikalah Pasian’ vantung mite a kumsuk a kahto na mu ding uh hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Pian 28:12"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawh ni nih khit ciangin Galilee gam Kana khua-ah mo pawi om a, Jesuh’ nu zong tua pawi-ah a om hi.","title":"Kana Khua-ah Mopawi"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh le a nungzuite zong tua pawi-ah a kisam hi."},"3":{"text":"Leenggahzu a bei ciangin Jesuh’ nu in, “Leenggahzu om nawn lo hi,” ci-in Jesuh kiangah a gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Nu aw, bang hangin na lunghihmawhna hong ko zenzen na hi hiam? Keima hun tung nai lo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh’ nu in nasemte kiangah, “Ama hong gen bangbangin gamta un,” a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Jew mite in amau biakna ngeina-ah kisilsiang nading ngeina nei uh ahih manin tua lai-ah tui tambong guk tambong sagih bang a ta thei thambelpi guk a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh in nasemte kiangah, “Tua thambelpite sungah tui a dimin koih un,” ci-in a sawl mah bangin a dim sitsetin tui a koih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Tu-in tui pawlkhat suak unla, zuphung pa kiangah va paipih un,” a ci hi. Amaute in zong tua mah bangin a va paipih uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Zuphung pa in leenggahzu a suak tui a ciap ciangin, (tui a sung nasemte in a theih hangin) koi panin kingah ahi hiam, ci-in thei lo ahih manin zinei tangvalpa samin,"},"10":{"text":"“Midangte in leenggahzu khumte hawm masakin nei uh a, mite in a khamgawp khit uh ciangin a ngeinate hawm pan uh hi. Ahi zongin nangmah in a khum pen teng tu dong na sitlai hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in nalamdang a bawl masak pen Galilee gam Kana khua-ah hih bangin Pasian’ pianzia a neihna kilangsak a, a nungzuite in zong amah a um uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Jesuh le a nu, a sanggamte le a nungzuite, Kapernaum khua-ah pai-in tua lai-ah ni tawmkhat a taam uh hi.","ref":"Mat 4:13"},"13":{"text":"Jew mite’ Paisan Pawi hun hong naita ahih manin Jerusalem khua-ah Jesuh a pai hi.","title":"Biakinn Siansakna (Mat 21:12-13 ; Mrk 11:15-19 ; Luk 19:45-48)","ref":"Pai 12:1-27"},"14":{"text":"Biakinn huangsung a lut ciangin bawng, tuu, le kawl vakhu zuakte mu a, sumkhekte zong a sumkhekna sabuai-ah a tu mu hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in zong khauteep bawlin biakinn huangsung panin tuu le bawng a kipan ganhing khempeuh hawlkhia a, sumkhekte’ sabuai zong sawnpaih sakin a sum khempeuh a thehthang sak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin kawl vakhu zuakte kiangah, “Na kawl vakhute uh hih lai panin paikhiatpih un. Ka Pa’ inn pen sumzuakna inn phualpi-in nei kei un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih bangin a gamtatna hangin, “Nangma inn ka deihluatna in ka lungsim hong uklah sak hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhna thu, a nungzuite in a phawk uh hi.","ref":"La 69:9"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah a om Jew uliante Jesuh kiangah hong pai uh a, “Hih bangin na gamtat theih nading thu na neihna bang lim tawh hong lakthei ding na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hih biakinn susia le-uhcin ni thum sungin ka dingsakkik ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mat 26:61; 27:40; Mrk 14:58; 15:29"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jew uliante in, “Hih biakinn kum sawmli le kum guk sung a kilam ahi hi. Ni thum sungin dingsakkikzo ding na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in biakinn a cih ciangin ama pumpi a cihna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin sihna panin amah a kithawhkiksak ciangin a nungzuite in Jesuh’ thugen phawkkik uh a, Lai Siangtho le Jesuh’ thugente a um uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Paisan Pawi hun laitakin Jerusalem khua sungah Jesuh a om sungin Jesuh in vangliatna tawh nalamdang a bawlte mu uh ahih manin mi tampi in amah a um uh hi.","title":"Jesuh in Mi Khempeuh Thei"},"24":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in mi khempeuh limtakin theitel ahih manin amaute muang lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in mite’ lungsimtawng dong thei ahih manin mite a bangci mi ahi hiam cih thu midangte in ama kiangah a gen ding kisam lo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikodemas a kici Jew mi ulian khat om a, amah pen Farisi a kici mite pawl ahi hi.","title":"Jesuh le Nikodemas"},"2":{"text":"Khatvei zan khuamial laitakin Jesuh kiangah va pai a, “Sia aw, mi khat peuhpeuh Pasian in ompih lo hileh hih na lamdangte kuamah in bawl thei lo ding ahih manin nang pen Pasian’ hong sawl siapa na hihna ka hong thei uh hi,” a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “A mantakin kong genin-ah, mi khatpeuh a suahkik kei leh Pasian’ Ukna sungah lut thei lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nikodemas in, “Mi khat a teek khit ciangin bangci suahkik thei ding ahi hiam? A nu’ sungah lutkikin suakkik thei ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in, “A mantakin kong genin-ah, mi khatpeuh tui le Kha Siangtho tawh a suahkik kei leh Pasian’ Ukna sungah lut thei lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing sung panin a suakte mihing mah hi bek a, Kha tawh a suakte pen kha mi ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin, ‘Na suahkik ding ahi hi,’ ka hong cihna hangin lamdangsa kei in."},"8":{"text":"Huih zong a utna peuhpeuhah nung a, a huging na zaktheih hangin koi lam panin hong nung a, koi lamah nung ahi hiam, cih na mu thei kei hi. Kha tawh a suak mite zong tua mah bang ahi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nikodemas in, “Hih thu bangci piantheih mawk ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Israel mite’ sia hinapi-in hih thu theithei lo na hi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"A mantakin kong genin-ah, kote in ka theihsa uh thu bek genin, ka muhsa uh thu bek teci a pang ka hi uh a, ahi zongin note kuamah in ka thugente uh nong um nuam kei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih leitung thute tawh a kisai thu kong gen ciangin um lo na hih uhleh vantung thute ka hong gen ciangin bangci up mah ding na hi uh hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Vantung panin a hong paisuk Mihing Tapa keimah simloh vantungah a paito ding kuamah om lo hi,” a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Moses in gamlak khuam tungah sumngo gul a khai mah bangin Mihing Tapa zong hong kikhai ding a,","ref":"Gam 21:9"},"15":{"text":"amah a um mi khempeuh nungta tawntung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian in leitung mite hong it mahmah ahih manin ama Tapa a um mi khempeuh si nawn loin a hin tawntung theih nadingun a Tapa neihsun a hong piak dongin a hong itna a hong lak hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian in leitungah a Tapa hong sawlna pen mawhsakna thukhen dingin a hong paisak hi loin, leitung mite a honkhia dingin a hong paisak hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah a um mite in mawhsak thukhenna thuak lo ding uh hi. Amah a um lote pen Pasian’ Tapa neihsun um lo uh ahih manin mawhsak thukhenna a thuak khinta uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua bangin mawhsak thukhenna a thuakna uh a hang in: Leitungah khuavak hong tungkhin napi-in a gamtatna uh hoih lo ahih manin leitung mite in khuavak sangin khuamial deihzaw uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A gamtat hoih lo mite in a siatna uh a kilatkhak ding ut lo uh ahih manin khuavak deih lo uh a, khuavakah pai nuam lo uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin thumanin a gamta mite ahihleh a gamtatnate uh Pasian’ deihna tawh kituak hi, ci-in a kilatsak theih nadingun khuavak sungah a pai uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih thute khit ciangin Jesuh le a nungzuite Judea gamah pai uh a, tua gamah a nungzuite tawh omin mite tui a phum hi.","title":"Amah Lian Semsem Ding Kei Neu Semsem Ding"},"23":{"text":"Tuiphumpa Johan zong thong kia nai lo hi. Tua hi a, tui tampi omna Salim khua kiang Ainon kici munah Johan in mite tuiphum a, ama kiangah mite hong pai-in tui a kiphum uh hi.","ref":"Mat 14:3; Mrk 6:17; Luk 3:19-20","merge":"24"},"25":{"text":"Tua laitakin biakna vai-in kisian’ suahna tawh kizomin Johan’ nungzuite le Jew mi pawlkhat thu kiseel uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Johan nungzuite a kiangah hong pai uh a, “Sia aw, Jordan Gun galkhatah na om khawmpih ngei pa, ama thu na genna na phawk lai hiam? Tu-in amah in mi tuiphumphum a, mi khempeuh in amah zuan uh hi,” ci-in a gen uhleh"},"27":{"text":"Johan in, “Pasian in hih theih nading thu pia kei leh kuamah in bangmah hih thei lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Kei pen Khrih ka hi kei a, ama mai-ah a hong kisawlpa ka hi lel hi, ci-in ka genna thu note mahmah in na zaksa uh ahi hi.","ref":"Joh 1:20"},"29":{"text":"Mo pen zinei ding tangvalpa a’ ding bek ahi hi. Zineipa kiangah a ding a lawmpa in ama kampau ding bek ngai a, ama awging a zak ciangin nuam mahmah hi. Tua mah bangin tu-in ama hangin ka nuam a, keima lungdamna kicingta hi."},"30":{"text":"Amah lian semsem ding a, kei ka hih leh ka neu semsem ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“Vantung pan hong pai pa pen adang khempeuh sangin lianzaw hi. Leitung panin a piang mi pen leitung mi hi a, leitung thute bek mah a gen hi. Tua ahih manin vantung panin a hong pai pa ahihleh adang khempeuh sangin a lianzaw ahi hi.","title":"Vantung Pan Hong Pai pa"},"32":{"text":"Amah in a muhsa leh a zaksa thu a gen hinapi-in kuamah in ama thugen um lo uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama thugen a umte pen, Pasian’ thugen man hi, ci-in a um ahi uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasian in a sawl mipa tungah ama Kha a kicingin pia ahih manin a sawl mipa in Pasian’ thugente mah a gen ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Pa in Tapa it ahih manin ama khut sungah na khempeuh a pia hi.","ref":"Mat 11:27; Luk 10:22"},"36":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Tapa a um mi peuhmah nungta tawntung ding a, Tapa’ thu a mang lote in nuntak mu lo ding a, amaute tungah Pasian heh tawntung ding hi,” a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in Johan sangin mi tam ngahzaw in a tuiphumna thu Farisi mite in a za uh hi.","title":"Jesuh le Samaria Numei"},"2":{"text":"(A taktakin Jesuh mahmah in tui phum loin a nungzuite bek in a phum ahi hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in tua thu a phawk ciangin Judea gam panin paikhia-in Galilee gamah a paikik hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua a paina-ah Samaria gam a nawk ding kisam hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin a nawk ciangin Samaria gam sungah Saikhar a kici khua khat a tung hi. Tua khua gei-ah Jakob in a tapa Josef a piak lo khat om hi.","ref":"Pian 33:19; Josh 24:32"},"6":{"text":"Tua lo sungah tuikhuk khat om a, a khualzinna-in Jesuh gim ahih manin a tuikhuk gei-ah a tu hi. Jesuh in tua numei kiangah, “Na tui hong dawnsak in,” a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua laitakin khua sungah an lei dingin Jesuh nungzuite paikhia khin uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Jew mite in buah tang uh a, Samaria mite’ na zatte zanglo uh ahih manin, Samaria numei in Jesuh kiangah, “Bang hangin nang Jew mi in kei Samaria numei kiangah tui hong ngen na hi hiam?” a ci hi.","ref":"Ezr 4:1-5; Neh 4:1-2"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pasian’ hong piaktheih dingte le tuidawn ding hong ngen pa theitel hi lecin, ama kiang pan tui a ngen ding na hizaw a, amah in nuntakna tui nang hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in, “Sia aw, tuikhuk thuk mahmah a, ahi zongin tui khai nading bangmah na nei kei hi. Koi panin tua nuntakna tui ngah thei ding na hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Tua tham loin, i pupi Jakob sangin lianzaw ding na hi hiam? Amah a kipan a tate le a ganhingte in a nek hih tui sangin a limcizaw koi-ah ngah ding na hi hiam?” a cih ciangin"},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hih tui a dawn khempeuh dangtak kik ding uh a,"},"14":{"text":"ahi zongin keima piak ding tui a dawn khempeuh dangtak kik nawn lo ding uh hi. Tua ka piak tui a dawnte sungah nuntakna tuinak piang ding a, a nungtasak paisuak ding hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in, “Sia aw, tua bang ahihleh ka dang a tak nawn loh nading le hih lai-ah tuitawi-in ka pai nawn loh nadingin kei zong tua tui hong pia in,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Va ciahin na pasal va sam inla, hih lai-ah hong paikik un,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Numei in, “Pasal ka nei kei hi,” a cih ciangin Jesuh in, ” ‘Pasal ka nei kei hi,’ na cih pen man mahmah hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasal nga na nei khin ngei a, tu-a na ompih zong na pasal hi lo hi. Tua ahih manin na thugen man mahmah hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in, “Sia aw, nang pen kamsang khat na hihna thu ka hong thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ko Samaria mite’ pupite in hih lai mualtungah Pasian bia uh a, ahi zongin no Jew mite in Pasian biakna mun pen Jerusalem khua ahi hi, na ci uh hi,” a cih ciangin"},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Lawm aw, hih ka thugen ding hong um in: Mite in hih mualtung hitaleh Jerusalem hitaleh ah Pa Pasian a biak nawn loh hun hong tung ding hi."},"22":{"text":"No Samaria mite in na theih taktak lohpi uh na bia uh a, ahi zongin ko Jew mite tungtawnin hotkhiatna thu hong pai ahih manin kote in ka theih uh a bia ka hi uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian a bia taktakte in Pasian’ Kha’ lamlahna le thuman tak tawh a biak hun hong tung ding a, tu-in zong a hong tung khinta ahi hi. Pa Pasian in tu-a bangin amah i biak ding a hong deih ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasian pen Kha ahi hi; amah a biate in tua Kha’ lamlahna le thuman taktak tawh a bia ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in, “Khrih a kici Messiah hong pai nading thu ka thei hi. Amah hong pai ciangin thu khempeuh hong gen ding hi,” a cih ciangin"},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tu-a nang tawh a kiho keimah pen tua na gen pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua laitakin Jesuh nungzuite hong tung uh a, ahi zongin kuamah in, “Numei aw, bang deih na hi hiam?” cihna ahi a, “Bang hangin tua numei tawh kiho na hi hiam?” cihna ahi zongin dong ngam lo uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in a tuibeel nusia-in khua sungah ciah a, a khuapih mite kiangah,"},"29":{"text":"“Hong pai un. Ka gamtatnasa a hong thei pa va en ni. Amah Khrih hi kha ding hi,” a va ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a khuapihte zong Jesuh kiangah a va pai uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Mite a hong tunma hunsung tengin a nungzuite in, “Sia aw, an ne in,” ci-in a kun uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Note in na theih loh uh nek ding an ka nei hi,” a na ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a nungzuite khatlekhat kiho-in, “Mi khatpeuh in an na puak khin hi ding ahi hiam?” a kici uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Keimah hong sawl pa’ deihna bangin na semin, sep dingin hong piak nasep zawhna pen ka nuntakna an ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Note in na paunak uhah, ‘Khai tuh khit kha li ciangin anlak hun hi,’ na ci uh hi. Tu-in note khuadakin lote en un. An khempeuh min khinta a, lak ding bek in sam hi."},"36":{"text":"Khaituh pa le anla pa a lungdam khawm theih nadingin anla pa thaman a kipiak mah bangin anla pa in zong a nungta tawntung dingin mi a khawm ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ahih manin, ‘Khat in khai tuhin, adang khat in a an la,’ ci-in paunak a om pen thuman mahmah hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note in na khawh loh uh lo-ah an a la dingin ka hong sawl hi. Midang in tua lo na kho a, note in a lak bek a si na hi uh hi,” a ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Ka gamtatnasate khempeuh hong thei hi,” ci-in a thugenna hangin tua khuasunga om Samaria mi tampi tak in Jesuh a um uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Jesuh kiangah Samaria mite a va tun uh ciangin amaute’ khua-ah a taam nadingin kun uh a, Jesuh zong tua khua-ah ni nih a taam hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua numei’ thugenna hangin Jesuh a um mi tampi tak kibehlap hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua thu um mite in tua numei kiangah, “Nangma thugenna hangin a um ka hi nawn kei uh a, komau mahmah in a thugen za-in, leitung mite a Honkhia ding pa taktak hi, ci-in thei ka hih manun a um ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua lai-ah ni nih a taam khit ciangin Galilee gamah a pai hi.","title":"Jesuh in Ulian Khat’ Tapa Damsak"},"44":{"text":"Jesuh mahmah in zong, “Kamsang a kuamah peuh ama gamah kipakta ngei lo hi,” ci-in a gen ngei hinapi-in,","ref":"Mat 13:57; Mrk 6:4; Luk 4:24"},"45":{"text":"Paisan Pawi hun laitakin Jerusalem-ah Galilee mite va pai-in, tua pawi sungah Jesuh’ septe khempeuh mu khin uh ahih manin, Jesuh a tun ciangin Galilee mite in na limbawl mahmah uh hi.","ref":"Joh 2:23"},"46":{"text":"Tui, leenggahzu a suahsakna Galilee gam Kana khua-ah Jesuh paikik hi. Tua laitakin Kapernaum khua-ah kumpi nasem ulian khat om a, a tapa a ci a na hi.","ref":"Joh 2:1-11"},"47":{"text":"A tapa gim mahmahin si dektak ahih manin, Judea gam panin Galilee gamah Jesuh hong paina thu a zak ciangin ama kiangah va pai a, Kapernaum khua-ah Jesuh hong pai-in a tapa a damsak nadingin a va thum hi."},"48":{"text":"Jesuh in ama kiangah, “Note in lim le nalamdang lian ka bawl na muh kei uhleh Topa ka hihna thu na hong um kei ding uh hi,” a cih ciangin"},"49":{"text":"ulianpa in, “Sia aw, ka ta a sih ma-in hong pai ta peuh in,” ci-in a thum hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Va ciah in. A hiang pen a gui tawh kizom kei leh gah a gah theih loh mah bangin note zong kei tawh na kizop kei uhleh gah na gah thei kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Kei pen leenggui ka hi a, note pen a hiang na hi uh hi. Note in kei tawh loin bangmah hih thei lo ding na hih manun kei tawh a kizomte in gah tampi na gah ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei tawh a kizom lo mite pen leenggui hiang bangin kipaai khia-in keutum hi. Tua bang hiangte meikhuk sungah kilawnin a kangtum hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei tawh na hong kizop uh a, note sungah ka thu a om nakleh na deih peuhpeuh uh hong ngen le-uhcin hong kipia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gah tampi gah le-uhcin ka Pa’ minthanna a kilangsak na hi ding uh a, keima nungzui na hihna uh kilang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka Pa in kei hong it zahin note hong it ka hih manin keima hong itna sungah om un."},"10":{"text":"Ka Pa’ hong thupiakte zui-in ama itna sungah ka om mah bangin note in zong ka thupiaknate na hong zuih uhleh ka itna sungah a om na hi ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Note hangin kei ka lungdam theih nading le note’ lungdamna a cingtaak a suahtheih nadingin hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Note tungah ka hong piak thu in: Note ka hong it zahin note khatlekhat na ki-it un.","ref":"Joh 13:34; 15:17; 1Joh 3:23; 2Joh 5"},"13":{"text":"Lawmte’ tang ding sih ngamna sangin lawmte itna a lianzaw om nawn lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka hong thupiak bangin na gamtat uhleh ka lawmte na hi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Nasemte in a tote’ nasepna bangmah thei lo ahih manin note pen nasemte ka hong ci nawn kei ding hi. Ka Pa’ tung panin ka zak thu khempeuh note kiangah hong genkhin ka hih manin note, lawm, ka hong ci zaw ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Note in kei na hong teel kei uh a, ahi zongin keimah in note ka hong teel a, note va pai-in a kimang tawntung ding gah a gah dingin ka hong seh hi. Tua ahih manin keima min suangin Pa kiangah na nget peuhpeuh uh hong pia ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hi a, note ka hong thupiak in: Khatlekhat na ki-it un, cihna ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"“Leitung mite in note hong muhdah leh kei a hong mudah masa ahihna thu na thei un.","title":"Leitung Mite’ Muhdahna"},"19":{"text":"Hih leitung mite tawh a kipawl hi le-uhcin leitung mite in amau pawlte hong it ding hi. Ahi zongin hih leitung mite lak panin note ka hong teelkhia a, amaute tawh kipawl nawn lo na hih manun a hong mudah ahi uh hi."},"20":{"text":"‘Sila pen a topa sangin lianzaw lo hi,’ ci-in ka hong thugenna phawk un. Amaute in kei hong bawlsiat uhleh note zong hong bawlsia ding hi. Ka thugente hong zuih uhleh note’ thugente zong hong zui ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:24; Luk 6:40; Joh 13:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in kei hong sawl pa thei lo uh ahih manin keima mi na hihna uh hangin amaute in hih bangin hong bawl ding uh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Kei hong pai kei-in amaute tungah thu a gen lo hi leng amaute in mawh pualo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh a mawhna thu uhah kiphel nading a paulap ding uh bangmah om nawn lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei hong mudahte in ka Pa zong a mudah ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Kuamah in a bawl ngei loh na lamdangte amaute lakah a bawl lo hi leng amaute in mawh pualo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in ka nalamdang bawlte mu khin uh ahih manin kei le ka Pa a hong mudah khawm uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute’ Thukham sungah, ‘Thu om lopi-in kei hong mudah uh hi,’ ci-in a kigelhna thu a tuntheih nadingin a hici mah ding ahi hi.","ref":"La 35:19; 69:4"},"26":{"text":"“Ahi zongin Thuman a hong lak ding Huhpa ahi Kha Siangtho ka Pa kiang panin ka hong sawl ding hi. Amah hong tun ciangin keima thu hong gen ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A kipat cil a kipanin kei tawh omkhawm na hih manun note in zong keima thu na gen ding uh hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Note na pukkhak loh nadingun hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi."},"2":{"text":"Amaute in a kikhopna uh innte panin note hong hawlkhia ding uh hi. Note hong that mite pen Pasian’ nasemin a kingaihsut ding uh hun hong tung ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in ka Pa ahi a, kei ahi zongin hong thei lo uh ahih manin tu-a bangin note a hong bawl ding uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih bangin a hong gamtat hun uh hong tun ciangin ka hong gen thute na phawk theih nadingun a hong genkhol ka hi hi. “Note tawh hong omkhawm ngawn ka hih manin a kipattung lamin hih thute ka hong gen kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in ahihleh kei hong sawl pa kiangah a ciahkik ding ka hi hi. Tua hinapi-in, ‘Koi-ah pai ding na hi hiam?’ ci-in kuamah in na hong dong kei uh hi.","title":"Kha Siangtho’ Nasepna"},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih thute ka hong gen ciangin na lungsim uh dah mahmah hi."},"7":{"text":"A taktakin ci lehang, kei paikhia kei leng note hong Huh ding pa hong pai lo ding a, kei paikhia leng note hong Huh ding pa hong sawl ding ka hih manin kei va paikhia leng note a dingin hoihzaw tham hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah hong tun ciangin leitung mite tungah mawhna thu, thuman thu leh thukhenna thu laktel ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong uploh manun a mawhna uh lak ding a,"},"10":{"text":"Pa kiangah pai ding ka hih manin kei na hong mu nawn kei ding uh hi, ka cihna thu a manna lak ding a,"},"11":{"text":"hih leitung a ukpa pen thukhenna a thuakkhin ahihna thu zong lak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ka hong gen ding tampi tak omlai hi; ahi zongin hong gen lai leng note a dingin tamlua ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin thuman hong lak ding Kha Siangtho hong tun ciangin thu khempeuh a manin hong hilh ding hi. Ama ngaihsuttawm thu hong gen ding hi lo a, ama tungah a kigen thute le a hong tung ding thute a hong gen ding ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in keima gen ding thute note tungah hong gen ding ahih manin Pasian’ pianzia ka neihna hong kilangsak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka Pa’ neihsa khempeuh keima-a’ suakkhin ahih manin keima gen ding thute le a gen dingin ka sawlteng Kha Siangtho in note kiangah hong gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mu nawn kei ding uh a, tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mukik ding uh hi,” a cih ciangin,","title":"Dahna, Lungdamna Suak Ding"},"17":{"text":"a nungzuite pawlkhat kidong uh a, “Tawlkhat khit ciangin kei na hong mu nawn kei ding uh a, tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mukik ding uh hi, a cihna le Pa kiangah a ciahkik ding ka hi hi, a cihnate bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?” a kici uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tawlkhat a cihcih pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, i thei kei hi, a kici uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in amaute’ theihnop lamtak phawk ahih manin amaute kiangah, “Note khatlekhat na kidot uh, ‘Tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mu nawn kei ding uh a, tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mukik ding uh hi,’ ka cihnopna a kidong na hi uh hiam?"},"20":{"text":"A taktakin ka hong genin-ah, note dahin na kap ding uh a, ahi zongin leitung mite lungdam ding uh hi. Note na dah ding uh a, ahi zongin na dahna uh lungdamna hong suak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Numei in a ta a suahhun a tun ciangin na sa ahih manin a dah hi. Ahi zongin a ta a suahkhit ciangin leitungah naungek khat a piangsak khin ahihna hangin lungdamin a natna teng a mangngilh ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Note zong tua mah tawh na kibang ding uh hi. Note zong tu-in na dah uh hangin note tawh kimukik ding ihih manin na lung uh dam mahmah ding a, tua na lungdamna uh kuamah in hong beisak thei lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tua hun ciangin kei kiangah bangmah nong ngen nawn kei ding uh hi. A mantakin kong genin-ah, keima min suangin na nget peuhpeuh uh Pa in hong pia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuni ciang dong keima min suangin bangmah na ngen nai kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin ngen le-uhcin hong kipia ding ahih manin na lungdamna uh hong cingtaak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tuhun ciang dong hih thute thugentehna zangin ka hong gen hi. Ahi zongin thugentehna ka hong zat nawn loh hun hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin a teltakin Pa Pasian’ thu ka hong gen ding hi.","title":"Leitung Nate Ka Zo Khin Hi"},"26":{"text":"Tua hun hong tun ciangin, Pa Pasian kiangah ka hong ngetsak ding hi, ka hong ci nawn kei ding a, nomau mahmah in ka min suangin Pa kiangah na ngenpah ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note in kei hong itin, Pa kiang panin a hong pai ka hihna thu um na hih manun Pa mahmah in note hong it ahihna hang ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Pa kiang panin hong pai-in leitung a hong tung ka hi a, tu-in leitung nusia leuleu-in Pa kiang a zuankik ding ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungzuite in, “Tu-in thugentehna zang nawn loin a kitel takin thu na hong gen hi."},"30":{"text":"Tu-in na khempeuh na theihkhitna thu ka phawk uh a, ka theihnop uh thute kote in ka hong dot ding uh zong kisam nawn lo ahih manin Pa kiang panin a hong pai na hihna thu ka hong um uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tu-in hong umta na hi uh hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Note khempeuh kithehthangin na inn ciat uh zuanin kei bek na hong nusiat ding uh hun a hong tung ding hi bek loin tu-in a hong tung hita hi. Ahi zongin kei guak a hong kinusia hi lo a, Pa in kei hong ompih hi."},"33":{"text":"Keimah tawh na hong kipawlna uh hangin lungnopna na neihtheihna dingun hih thu a hong gen ka hi hi. Leitung gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Ahi zongin keimah in leitung nate zo khinta ka hih manin lungnuamin om un,” a ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in hih thute a genkhit ciangin vantung lam ento-in, “Pa aw, a hun hong tungta ahih manin na Tapa in na pianzia hong kilatsak theih nadingin tu-in na Tapa’ pianzia hong kilangsak ta in.","title":"A Nungzuite a’ ding Jesuh’ Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Tapa tungah na piak mi khempeuh tungah Tapa in nuntak tawntungna a piaktheih nadingin mi khempeuh tungah ukna aana a neih nadingin Tapa tungah na hong piaksa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang bek a man Pasian na hihna thu le nangmah in na hong sawl Jesuh Khrih hong theihna pen amaute a dingin nuntak tawntung ngah nading lampi ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah in sep dingin na hong piak nasep khempeuh sem khinta ka hih manin leitungah na min a thangsak ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Pa aw, leitung a kipiansak ma-in nang tawh i neihkhawm na pianzia mah tu-in nangma omna munah hong pia ta in."},"6":{"text":"“Leitung mite sung panin keima khut sungah na hong piak mite tungah nangma min ka pulak khinzo ta hi. Tua mite in nangma thu mangin nangma mi hi uh a, ahi zongin keima khut sungah amaute na hong pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in amaute in keima neih khempeuh nangma hong piak ahihna thu a thei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh gen dingin na hong sawl thu khempeuh amaute kiangah ka gen ciangin um uh a, nangma kiang panin a pai ka hihna thu hong thei uh a, nangma hong sawl ka hihna thu zong hong um uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Amaute a dingin thu ka hong ngetsak hi. Leitung mite a dingin a hong ngetsak hi loin keima khut sungah na hong piak mite nangma mi ahih manin tua mite a dingin a hong ngetsak ka hi hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima neih khempeuh nangma a’ hi a, nangma neih khempeuh keima-a’ ahih manin, tua mite’ hangin nangma pianzia ka neihna hong kilang hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in nangma kiangah kei a hong paita ding ka hih manin leitungah ka om nawn kei ding a, ahi zongin amaute a omlai ding uh ahi hi. Tua ahih manin a Siangtho ka Pa aw, nang le kei pumkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong pumkhat ahih nadingun na vangliatna tawh hoihtakin na kem in."},"12":{"text":"Amaute tawh ka omkhawm hun lai-in nangma hong piak na min vangliatna tawh amaute ka kem hi. Amaute ka hu a, a maimang ding pa simloh khat zong ka kisamsak kei hi. Tua a maimang pa lah Lai Siangtho sung thu a tun nading ahi hi.","ref":"La 41:9; Joh 13:18"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in nangma kiangah a hong paita ding ka hih manin keimah bangin amaute in lungdamna cingtaak a neihtheih nadingun leitungah ka om lai-in hih thute a gen ka hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute tungah na thu ka gen khin hi. Ahi zongin keimah bangin amaute zong hih leitung mite tawh kipawl lo uh ahih manin leitung mite in a mudah uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitung panin amaute na lakkhiat ding a hong ngetsak ka hi kei a, a Gilopa’ bawlsiat nading panin na kep ding a hong ngen ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hih leitung tawh kei ka kipawl loh mah bangin amaute zong a kipawl lo uh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma thuman hilhna tawh amaute a siangtho nangma zat dingin na bawl in."},"18":{"text":"Leitungah kei na hong sawl mah bangin kei zong leitung mahah amaute ka sawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma tungah thuman takin amaute zong hong ki-ap theih nadingun amaute ka khualna-in nangma tungah kei ka hong ki-ap hi."},"20":{"text":"“Hih mite a’ ding bek thu a hong ngetsak ka hi kei a, amaute’ thugenna hangin kei hong um mite a’ ding zong a hong ngetsak ka hi hi."},"21":{"text":"Pa aw, amaute khempeuh pumkhat a suahtheih nadingun ka hong ngetsak hi. Nangmah in kei na hong sawlna thu leitung mite in a uptheih nadingun ei tegel pawlkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong eite tawh pawlkhat hong hi tahen."},"22":{"text":"Nang le kei pumkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong pumkhat a suah theih nadingun keima tungah na hong piak pianzia mah amaute tungah ka pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Leitung mite in kei na hong sawlna thu a theih nading le kei na hong it mah bangin amaute na itna thu a theihna hangun amaute pumkhat a suah taktak theih nadingun amaute lakah kei ka om a, kei tawh nang na hong omkhawm hi."},"24":{"text":"Pa aw, leitung a pianma pekin kei na hong itna hangin na hong piak pianzia a mu dingin keimah na hong piak mite zong ka omna-ah a hong pai theih nading ka deihsak hi."},"25":{"text":"A Thuman ka Pa aw, leitung mite in nang hong thei lo uh hi. Ahi zongin keimah in nang ka hong thei a, kei na hong sawlna thu hih mite in zong a thei uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Kei na hong itna zah itna mah amaute sungah omin, amaute tawh kei ka omkhawm theih nadingin amaute tungah nangma min ka gen khin a, mai lamah zong ka gen lailai ding hi,” ci-in thu a ngen hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in tu-a bangin thu a nget khit ciangin a nungzuite tawh Kidron lui kantanin a pai hi. Tua lai-ah huan khat om a, tua huan sungah a nungzuite tawh a lut hi.","title":"Jesuh a Kilehhekna le a Kimatna (Mat 26:47-56 ; Mrk 14:43-50 ; Luk 22:47-53)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh le a nungzuite tua munah pai zelzel uh ahih manin Jesuh a lehhek Judas in zong tua mun a thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Judas zong, siampi liante le Farisi mite in a sawl galkap honkhat le biakinncing palik pawlkhat tawh hiam tawi-in lalcin leh meilah de-in tua huanah a hong pai uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in zong ama tungah a piang ding thu khempeuh theikhin ahih manin hong paikhia-in amaute kiangah, “Kua zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in, “Nazareth khuami Jesuh a zong ka hi uh hi,” a ci hi. Jesuh a lehhek Judas zong tua mihonte tawh hong dingkhawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Keimah ka hi hi,” a cih ciangin amaute nungkinin a puk uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Kua zong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dotkik ciangin amaute in, “Nazareth khuami Jesuh a zong ka hi uh hi,” a ci leuleu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Keimah ka hi hi, ci-in ka hong gen khinzo hi. Kei hong zong na hih uhleh hih adangte khah lel un,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih bang a cihna pen, “Kei na hong piaksate khat zong ka kisamsak kei hi,” ci-in a thugenna a tun nading ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Simon Peter in namsau kuah ahih manin a namsau dokin siampi lianpen pa’ silapa a sat leh a taklam bil a satkhia hi. Tua silapa’ min Malkhus ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in Peter kiangah, “Na namsau a paai-ah siat in. Ka Pa in thuak dingin a hong piak thu thuak lo ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.","ref":"Mat 26:39; Mrk 14:36; Luk 22:42"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih manin galkapte le a bute le Jew mi palikte in Jesuh manin hen uh a,","title":"Siampi Lianpen pa Mai-ah Jesuh Kipaipih (Mat 26:57-58 ; Mrk 14:53-54 ; Luk 22:54)"},"13":{"text":"tua kumin siampi lianpen a sem Kaiafas’ sungpa Annas kiangah a paipih masa uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihonte’ tangin mi khat a sih ding kilawm zaw hi, ci-in Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante kiangah thu a gen pa Kaiafas ahi hi.","ref":"Joh 11:49-50"},"15":{"text":"Simon Peter le a nungzui dang khat in zong Jesuh a zui uh hi. Hih a nungzui dang khat pa le siampi lianpen pa kithei uh ahih manin siampi lianpen pa’ inntual dongah Jesuh tawh a lutkhawm hi.","title":"Peter in Jesuh Nial (Mat 26:69-70 ; Mrk 14:66-68 ; Luk 22:54-57)"},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter ahihleh kong pualamah a khawl hi. Tua ahih manin siampi lianpen pa tawh a kithei nungzui dang khat pa zong va pai kikin kongcing numei a hopih khit ciangin Peter zong a tumpih hi."},"17":{"text":"Kongcing numei in Peter kiangah, “Hih mipa’ nungzuite khat hi lo na hi hiam?” a cih leh, “Ka hi kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"18":{"text":"Khua dam mahmah ahih manin nasemte le palikte in meihol cih a, tua mei awi-in a kiimah ding uh ahih manin Peter zong va pai-in mei awi-in amaute tawh a dingkhawm hi."},"19":{"text":"Siampi lianpen pa Annas in Jesuh kiangah ama nungzuite thu le a thuhilhna tawh kisai thu a dong hi.","title":"Siampi Lianpen pa in Jesuh Thu Dong (Mat 26:59-66 ; Mrk 14:55-65 ; Luk 22:66-71)"},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mi khempeuh’ theihin thu ka gen tawntung hi. Jew mihonpi a kikhopna innte le Biakinn sungah thu ka hilh a, thu ka sim genna om ngei lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin bang hangin kei kiangah hong dong se na hi hiam? Ka thugen a za mite kiangah dong lecin ka genteng amaute in hong genthei ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih bangin Jesuh a pau ciangin biakinncing palikte khat in Jesuh beeng a, “Bang hangin hih bangin siampi lianpen pa tungah kampau ngam na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “A man loin kampau khial ka hih leh ka khialhna hong lak in. Ka thugen a man ahih manin bang hangin hong beeng zenzen na hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Annas in Jesuh a kikhihsa mahin siampi lianpen pa Kaiafas kiangah a puak hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua bangin mei awi-in Simon Peter a din laitakin a kiima om midangte in, “Nang, hua mipa’ nungzuite khat hi lo na hi hiam?” a cih uhleh Peter in, “Ka hi kei hi,” ci-in a nial leuleu hi.","title":"Peter in Jesuh Nialkik (Mat 26:71-75 ; Mrk 14:69-72 ; Luk 22:58-62)"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa’ nasem, Peter in a bil a sat khiatsak pa’ behte khat in, “Huan sungah amah tawh na omkhawm lai-un hong mu hi lo ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin,"},"27":{"text":"Peter in nialkik leuleu a, tua khit phetin ak a khuang hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kaiafas’ inn panin gam ukpa Pilat’ omna kumpi inn-ah Jesuh a paipih uh hi. Tua hun pen zingsang tung ahi hi. Jew mite ahihleh Paisan Pawi annekna sungah kihel nuam uh ahih manin biakna vai-in a siang a suahtheih nadingun kumpi inn huang sungah lut lo uh hi.","title":"Jesuh, Pilat Mai-ah (Mat 27:1-2 , 11-14 ; Mrk 15:1-5 ; Luk 23:1-5)"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amaute kiangah Pilat hong pusuakin, “Hih mipa na mawhsakna uh bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin"},"30":{"text":"amaute in, “Hih mipa a gamtat a sialo hileh nang kiangah ka hong paipih kei ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pilat in, “Jerusalem khua-a om no Jew mi uliante mah in paikhiatpih unla, nomau Thukham tawh kizui-in ama tungah thu khen un,” ci-in a gen ciangin Jew mite in ama kiangah, “Kote in mi thahtheih nading thu ka nei kei uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"32":{"text":"(Jesuh in ama sihna dingzia a gensa thu a tuntheih nadingin hih bangin a piang ahi hi.)","ref":"Joh 3:14; 12:32"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpi huang sungah Pilat ciahkik a, Jesuh samin, “Nang Jew mite’ kumpi na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot leh"},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nang’ lungsimah a piangtawm hong dong na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh midangte in keima thu hong gen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi."},"35":{"text":"Pilat in, “Kei, Jew mi hong sa na hi hiam? Na Jew mipihte le na siampi liante un kei kiangah nang hong ap uh hi. Bang gamta khial na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Keima ukna pen hih leitung gam hi lo hi. Keima ukna hih leitung gam hileh Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante’ khut sungah hong kipiak loh nadingin ka nungzuite in a do ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin keima ukna pen hih leitung tawh kizom lo hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pilat in, “Tua ahihleh nang kumpi hi lo na hi hiam?” a cih leh Jesuh in, “Kumpi hi, nangmah in na hong ci hi. Hih thuman tawh a kizom mi peuhmah in keima thugen hong zui uh hi,” a cih ciangin"},"38":{"text":"Pilat in, “Thuman na cih bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ke’n ama khialhna ka mu kei hi,” a cih ciangin"},"7":{"text":"Jew mihonte in, “Amah Pasian’ Tapa-in kigen ahih manin a kithah theih nading Thukham ka nei uh hi,” ci-in a genna uh"},"8":{"text":"Pilat in a zak ciangin a lunghimawh semsem hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kumpi inn huang sungah lutkikin Jesuh kiangah, “Koi lai panin a hong pai na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Kumpi hi’ng, a ci khempeuh pen gam khempeuh a uk Kumpipa a langpang ahi hi,” a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Pilat in hih bangin mite’ kikona a zak ciangin Jesuh paikhiatpih a, Hebru pau-in Gabbatha a kici Suangphahpek tunga thukhenna tokhom tungah a tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ni pen Paisan Pawi hun ding Kigin’ ni hi a, sunkim laitak hun ahi hi. Kei hong mu lo napi-in hong umte a dingin lungdamhuai mahmah zaw ding hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in a nungzuite’ muhna-ah nalamdang lian tampi bawl a, ahi zongin hih laibu sungah a kigelh lo tampi tak omlai hi.","title":"Hih Laibu’ Deihna"},"31":{"text":"Hih laibu sungah a kigelh thute pen Jesuh, Pasian’ Tapa, Khrih ahihna thu na uptheih nading uh le ama min hangin tua upna tawh nuntakna na ngahtheih nading uh deihna tawh a kigelh ahi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin a nungzuite omna Tiberias Tuili gei-ah Jesuh kilang leuleu a, a thu pianzia hih bang ahi hi:","title":"Nungzui Sagihte tungah Jesuh Kilang"},"2":{"text":"Simon Peter, Unau Peeng minno a nei Thomas, Galilee gam Kana khuami Nethanel, Zebedi’ tapate, le nungzui dang nihte mun khatah a omkhawm uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Simon Peter in a lawmte kiangah, “Kei, ngasa bengin kuan ning,” ci-in a gen leh a lawmte in, “Ko zong hong kuan nung,” ci uh ahih manin, amaute kuankhia-in gunkuang tungah a tuang uh hi. Amah pen Topa ahih lamtak thei uh ahih manin, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a nungzuite khat beek in dong ngam lo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh hong pai-in anlum la-in amaute tungah pia a, tua mah bangin ngasa zong a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih pen sihna panin Jesuh a kithawhkiksak khitzawh nungzuite tungah a kilah a thum veina hita hi."},"15":{"text":"An a nekkhit uh ciangin Jesuh in Simon Peter kiangah, “Johan’ tapa Simon aw, hih adang khempeuhte’ hong it sangin kei na hong nak itzaw hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin amah in, “Topa aw, ka hong itzaw hi. Nang ka hong itna na thei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Ka Tuute Kem In"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesuh in, “Ka tuunote na kem in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nihveina dong leuleu a, “Johan’ tapa Simon aw, kei na hong it hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Topa aw, nang ka hong it a, ka hong itna thu na thei hi,” a cih ciangin, “Ka tuute na kem in,” a ci leuleu hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in a thumveina dong leuleu a, “Johan’ tapa Simon aw, kei na hong it hiam?” a cih ciangin, “Kei na hong it hiam?” ci-in thumvei tak a dotna hangin Peter zong a dah suak hi. Tua ahih manin, “Topa aw, nangmah in na khempeuh na thei a, nangmah ka hong itna thu zong na thei hi,” ci-in a dawn ciangin Jesuh in, “Ka tuute na kem in."},"18":{"text":"A mantakin ci lehang, na khangno lai-in na kawnggak gakin na utna peuhah na pai zialzial thei hi. Ahi zongin na khangham ciangin na khutte na zan ding a, midangte in na khutte hong henin na ut loh napi ah hong paipih ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"(Hih bangin a thugenna pen Peter a sih nading zia le Pasian’ min a thansak nading thu a gen nopna ahi hi.) Tua ciangin Jesuh in Peter kiangah, “Hong zui un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Peter a kihei ciangin, nitak an a nek lai-un Jesuh’ gei-ah tu-in, “Topa aw, nang kua in hong lehhek ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong, Jesuh’ it a nungzui pa ama nungah a om a mu hi.","title":"Jesuh’ It Nungzui pa","ref":"Joh 13:25"},"21":{"text":"Peter in amah a muh ciangin Jesuh kiangah, “Topa aw, hih mipa bangci ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot leh"},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka hong paikik mateng amah a nungta dingin ka deih nakleh nang bang phamawh sa na hi hiam? Nangmah in ka nung hong zui peuh in,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih nungzui pa si lo ding hi, ci-in a nungzuite lakah a kigen hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Amah si lo ding hi,” a ci hi loin, “Ka hong paikik mateng amah a nungta dingin ka deih nakleh nang bang phamawh sa na hi hiam?” a ci bek ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in tua a cih nungzui pa pen hih thute genin lai sungah a gelh pa hi a, ama thugente a mantaktak hi, ci-in ka thei uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh in a sep thute tampi tak omlai hi. A sep khempeuh a ban banin laibu sungah a kigelh hileh a laibute pen leitungah ta zo lo ding hi, ci-in ka um hi."}}}}},"44":{"info":{"name":"Sawltakte Tangthu","shortname":"Swt","abbr":["Sawltak"],"desc":"Sawltakte Tangthu pen Luka Gen Lungdamna Thu tawh a thu a kizomto ahi hi. A ngimna bulpi in, Kha Siangtho' makaihna tawh Jesuh' nungzui cilte in ama hangin a kingah Lungdamna Thu, “Jerusalem khuasung, Judea gamsung, Samaria gamsung khempeuh, leh leimong dongin,” a kizelhsakna ziate a gennopna bulpi ahi hi (1:8). Tua thu pen Jew mite lakah Khristian thu a kipat khiatna leh a thu hong paisuakin, leitung mi khempeuh' upna a hong suahna thu ahi hi. Hih thu a gelhpa in Khristiante pen leitung ki-ukna thu-ah Rom kumpi gam a siasak ding mite hiloin, Khristian upna pen Jew biakna a kicingsak ahihna thu, hih lai a simte in a theihding a deihna bulpi ahi hi. Sawltakte Tangthu pen khen thum bang kisuah thei a, Jesuh' hanga Lungdamna Thu a kigenna hong zai semsemin, pawlpi a kiphuhna thute ahi hi. 1. Jesuh a vankah khit ciangin Jerusalem khuasungah Khristian thu hong kipat khiatna. 2. Tua banah Palestine gamsungah a kizelhna. 3. Tua banah Mediterranean Tuipi khengin Rom ciangdongah a kizelh laina thu ahi hi. Hih thupiang hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian phat uh ahih manin hih mite gim a piak nading uh a thu mu thei lo uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh hih nalamdang a kibawlna mipa pen a khan kum sawmli val a pha khinsa mi khat ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Peter le Johan a kikhahkhiat khit phetin a lawmte uh kiangah pai-in siampi liante le upate in amaute tungah a thugente khempeuh a zasak uh hi.","title":"Thu Umte in Han nading Thu Ngen"},"24":{"text":"A lawmte un hih thu a zak uh ciangin a vekpi-un lungsim kikhatin Pasian’ kiangah thu ngen uh a, “Van le lei, tuipi tuineu le a sunga om khempeuh a piangsak Topa aw,","ref":"Pai 20:11; Neh 9:6; La 146:6"},"25":{"text":"kote’ pupi, na nasempa David tungah na Kha Siangtho tawh thu na gen a, amah in, ‘Bang hangin Gentail mite heh mahmah a, a tangtung lo dingpi vaihawm uh ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Topa le ama Khrih a do dingin leitung kumpite kithawi uh a, gam ukte kikaikhawm uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"La 2:1-2"},"27":{"text":"A cih mah bangin Herod le Pontias Pilat in hih khuapi sung teek mahah Gentail mite le Israel mite tawh kikupna nei uh a, nangmah in Khrih dingin na bawl, a siangtho na Nasempa Jesuh thah dingin a vaihawm uh hi.","ref":"Luk 23:1,7-11; Mat 27:1-2; Mrk 15:1; Joh 18:28-29"},"28":{"text":"Nangmah in na deihna bangin a piang dingin na vangliatna tawh na khensatsa thu khempeuh a sem dingin amaute kikhawm uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Topa aw, amaute in kote hong tawnnate thei inla, nangma nasem kote in lungsim han’ mahmahna tawh nangma thu ka gentheih nadingun hong huh in."},"30":{"text":"Cinate damsak theih nading vangliatna hong pia inla, a siangtho na Nasempa Jesuh’ min tawh nalamdang kibawl ta hen,” a ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua bangin thu a nget khit uh ciangin amaute’ kikhopna mun hong kilinggawp hi. Amaute khempeuh Kha Siangtho tawh kidim uh a, hang takin Pasian’ thu gen ding a kipan uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Thu um mi khempeuh a lungsim uh le a ngaihsutna uh kikhat uh a, kuamah in ama neihsa kei-a’ tuam ci loin, a neih khempeuh uh a neikhawm ciat uh hi.","title":"Na Khempeuh Neikhawm","ref":"Sawl 2:44-45"},"33":{"text":"Topa Jesuh’ thawhkikna thu, sawltakte in vangliatna tawh teci pang uh a, Pasian in amaute khempeuh tungah thupha tampi a pia hi."},"34":{"text":"Inn ahi a, lo ahi zongin a neite in zuak uh a, a sum ngahte uh sawltakte kiangah a ap uh hi. Mi khempeuh tungah a kisapna bang ciat un a sumte hawm uh ahih manin amaute lakah sum kitangsam kuamah om lo uh hi.","merge":"35"},"36":{"text":"Tua hi a, Saipras tuikulh-a suak, Levi mi Josef, sawltakte in Barnabas (Hanthawn Siampa a cihnopna) min a phuah pa in,"},"37":{"text":"ama neih a lo zuak a, a sum hong paipihin sawltakte khut sungah a ap hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi zongin Ananias a kici pasal khat le a zi Sapfira a kici, nupa kop khat om uh hi. Mite a khem hi loin Pasian a khem na hi hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ananias in hih thu a zak phetin thakhatin si-in puksukpah a, hih thu a za mi khempeuh a lau mahmah uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin tangvalte hong kipanin puan tawh a luang tun uh a, puakhia-in a va vui uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua khit nai thum bang ding ciangin a zi hong pai a, ahi zongin tua lai-a thupiang bangmah thei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Peter in tua nu kiangah, “Nang le na pasal in na lo zuak man uh sum pen a vekpi-in hih zah mah ahi hiam, hong gen dih in,” ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, “Hi hi, tua zah mah hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter in tua nu kiangah, “Bang dingin na nupa-un Topa’ Kha Siangtho ze-et ding thukim khawm na hi uh hiam? Tua khit ciangin thong panin sawltakte va kai-in uliante mai-ah a hong paipih nadingun palikte a sawl uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin thongah palikte a va tun uh ciangin sawltakte na om lo hi. Ahi zongin amah kithatin, a nungzui khempeuh kithehthang a, ama vai beita hi."},"37":{"text":"Hih thu a pian’ khit ciangin, mi bangzah pha hiam, ci-in gam sung mi khempeuh a kisim laitakin Galilee mi Judas a kici mi khat hong khang leuleu a, amah in zong nungzui mihonpi mah a nei hi. Jerusalem khua sungah thu um mi tampi tak hong kibehlap a, siampi tampi tak in zong Lungdamna Thu a hong um uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian in Stefen’ tungah thupha tampi tak pia-in vangliatna lianpi neisak a, amah in mite lakah lim le nalamdang lianpipi a bawl hi.","title":"Stefen A Kimatna"},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in Stefen langpan’ uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute hong pai-in Stefen man uh a, uliante mai-ah a hong paipih uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin zuauthu a gen dingin mi pawlkhat hong paipih uh a, “Hih mipa in a siangtho i biakinnpi le Moses Thukham gensia tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih Nazareth khuami Jesuh in biakinnpi phelgawpin, Moses tung pek panin a hong kipan ngeina khempeuh khelmang ding hi, ci-in a thuhilhna ka za uh hi,” a cisak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ulian kikhopna sunga a kihel mi khempeuh in Stefen en uh a, a maitang pen vantungmi maitang tawh kibang hi, ci-in a mu kim uh hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa in Stefen kiangah, “Tu-a amaute’ gen bang takpi mah ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin","title":"Stefen A Kihutna"},"2":{"text":"Stefen in, “Ute pate aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. Moses zong lau-in linggawp a, en ngam lo hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, ‘Na dinna mun pen a siangtho leitang ahih manin na khedap suah in."},"34":{"text":"Ka mite in Egypt gamah bawlsiatna a thuaknate teltakin ka mukhin hi. Amaute’ tauna awging ka za a, amaute a honkhia dingin a hong paisuk ka hi hi. Hih lai-ah hong pai in; Egypt gamah nang ka hong paisak ding hi,’ na ci hi.","ref":"Pai 3:1-10"},"35":{"text":"“Moses pen Israel mite in deih loin, ‘Kote a hong uk ding le thu a hong khen dingin kua in hong koih ahi hiam?’ a cih pa uh ahi hi. Ahi zongin Moses pen sawlpang kuang sung pan ama kiangah a kilang vantungmi’ huhna tawh ukpa le honkhia pa ahi dingin Pasian in a sawl pa ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 2:14"},"36":{"text":"Amah in Egypt gam le San Tuipi-ah lim le na lamdangte bawlin, Egypt gam panin Israel mite paikhiatpih a, gamlakah kum sawmli sung amaute a makaih hi.","ref":"Pai 7:3; 14:21; Gam 14:33"},"37":{"text":"Hih Moses pen Israel mite tungah, ‘Pasian in kei hong sawl mah bangin, i mipihte sung mah panin note a’ ding kamsang khat hong sawl ding hi,’ a ci pa ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:15,18"},"38":{"text":"Amah pen Israel mite tawh gamlakah a om pa hi a, Sinai Mual tunga ama kiangah thu a gen vantungmi le i pute tawh a kikhawlpa ahi hi. Eite tungah hong gensawn dingin Pasian kiang panin a tul ngei lo thu a ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 19:1-20:17; Thkna 5:1-33"},"39":{"text":"“Ahi zongin i pute in ama thu na mang nuam loin, amah na nawlkhin uh a, Egypt gamah ciahkik nopna lungsim na nei uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amaute in Aaron kiangah, ‘Egypt gam panin eite a hong paikhiatpih tua Moses tungah bang thu piang hiam cih thei lo ihih manin, eite’ mai-ah i paisak ding milim pasian pawlkhat hong bawlsak in,’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Pai 32:1"},"41":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amaute in bawngno tawh a kibang lim khat bawl uh a, ganhing tawh tua milim bia-in, amaute’ bawltawm pasian hangin lungdamin pawi a na bawl uh hi.","ref":"Pai 32:2-6"},"42":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kamsangte laibu sungah, ‘Israel mite aw, gamlakah kum sawmli sung, gan go-in biakna na piakte uh kei tunga nong piak uh hi lo hi. Note in na puak uh puanbuk pen Molok pasian milim puanbuk le note’ aksi pasian Refan’ puanbuk ahi hi. Tuate pen na biak dingun note’ bawltawm milim ahih manin Babylon khuapi khen pekah salin ka hong paisak ding hi,’ ci-in a kigelh mah bangin Pasian in amaute nungngat a, vana om aksite a bia dingin amaute a sawlkhia hi.","merge":"43","ref":"Amos 5:25-27"},"44":{"text":"“Gamlakah a omlai-un i pute in Pasian’ ompihna puanbuk nei uh a, Pasian in Moses tungah a gensa, a lim ding a lahsa bang teekteekin a kibawl ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 25:9,40"},"45":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin i pute in amau’ pate tung panin a ngah uh tua puanbuk pen amau’ ten nading gam a la dingin a kuan uh ciangin na pua uh a, Pasian in amaute’ mai-ah tua gam mite hawlkhiatsak ahih manin tua gam a luah uh ciangin a puanbuk zong a na tunpih uh hi. Tua ahih manin David’ hun ciang dong tua puanbuk na om hi.","ref":"Josh 3:14-17"},"46":{"text":"David in Pasian’ maipha ngah ahih manin, Jakob Pasian a dingin biakinn khat a vaihawm sak nadingin Pasian kiangah a ngen hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:1-16; 1Khang 17:1-14"},"47":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian a dingin biakinn a lamsak pen David hi loin a tapa Solomon ahi hi.","ref":"1Kum 6:1-38; 2Khang 3:1-17"},"48":{"text":"Ahi zongin kamsangpa in, ‘Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung pen keima tokhom hi a, leitung zong ka khe ngakna mun ahi hi. Kei a’ ding bang biakinn hong lamsak thei ding a, ka om nading koi lai mun hi thei ding ahi hiam? Hih nate khempeuh keima bawlsa hi lo ahi hiam, ci hi,’ ci-in a gen mah bangin mihingte’ lamsa inn sungah a Lianpen Pasian a teng hi lo hi.","merge":"50","ref":"Isa 66:1-2"},"51":{"text":"“Na lungsim uh khauh mahmah a, lawki lungsim paii-in, Pasian’ thu-ah bilngong na bang uh hi. I pu i pate mah bangin Kha Siangtho thu na mang nuam kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 63:10"},"52":{"text":"I pu i pate in kamsang a bawlsiat loh khat beek om lo hi. Pasian’ deihna bangin a gamta a Nasempa a hong pai nading thu a genkhol Pasian’ kamtaite na that uh a, tu-in note in tua nasempa lehhekin na that leuleu uh hi."},"53":{"text":"Note in vantungmi tungtawnin Pasian’ hong piak thukham ngah napi-in na mang nuam kei uh hi,” a ci hi."},"54":{"text":"A kikhawm uliante in Stefen’ thugen a zak uh ciangin nakpitakin heh uh a, a ha uh gawisan uh hi.","title":"Suang tawh Stefen a Kidenna"},"55":{"text":"Ahi zongin Stefen ahihleh Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin vantung lam ento a, Pasian’ minthanna vang le Pasian’ taklamah Jesuh a ding mu ahih manin,"},"56":{"text":"“En un! Vantung kihong a, Pasian’ taklamah Mihing Tapa a ding ka mu hi,” a ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in a bil uh humsanin nakpitakin kiko-in Stefen bawhhuan uh a,"},"58":{"text":"khua pualamah kaikhia-in suang gol pipi a khiat uh hi. Hih thu-ah teci pangin Stefen a deng mite in a puantungsilh uh suahin Saul a kici tangval khat kiangah lawnin a kemsak uh hi."},"59":{"text":"Tua bangin suang a khiat thuahthuah laitakun Stefen in thu ngen a, “Topa Jesuh aw, ka kha hong la in,” a ci hi."},"60":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah kunin nakpitakin kiko a, “Topa aw, hih mite’ mawhna na maisak in,” a cih khit ciangin a si ta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih Stefen thahna thu-ah Saul in zong thukimpih hi. Tua ni a kipanin Jerusalem khua-a om pawlpite in nakpitakin bawlsiatna thuak ding kipan uh hi. Sawltakte simloh, thu um midang khempeuh, Judea gam le Samaria gamah kithehthang gawp uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Thu um mi pawlkhat in Stefen vui uh a, nakpitakin dahin a kap uh hi.","title":"Saul in Pawlpi Bawlsia"},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin Saul in pawlpi suksiat ding hanciam a, inn khat pan inn khatah pai kawikawi-in, thu um numei le pasalte kai-in thong sungah a khia hi.","ref":"Sawl 22:4-5; 26:9-11"},"4":{"text":"Tua bangin a kithehthang mite pai kawikawi-in thu a hilh uh hi.","title":"Samaria Gamah Lungdamna Thu Kihilh"},"5":{"text":"Filip zong Samaria gam khuapi-ah pai-in Khrih thu a hilh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihonte in Filip’ thugen le a nalamdang bawlte a muh uh ciangin a thugen khempeuh limtakin a ngai uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi tampite sung panin dawite nakpitakin kiko-in paikhia uh a, khutzaw khezaw mite zong kidamsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua khuapi sunga om mite lungdam mahmah uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua khua sungah Simon a kici mi khat om a, amah mitphial bawl siampi hi a, Samaria mite in lamdangsa mahmah uh hi. Amah milian mahmah khatin kigen a,"},"10":{"text":"tua khuasunga om milian mineu a om khempeuh in a thu limtakin ngai-in, “Vang Lianpa,” a kici Pasian pen amah ahi hi, a ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in sauveipi sung mitphial bawl a, mite in lamdangsa mahmah uh ahih manin a thu a um uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ Ukna Lungdamna Thu le Jesuh Khrih thu, Filip’ gente a up uh ciangin, numei pasal a um khempeuh tui a kiphum uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Simon mahmah in zong um a, tui a kiphum khit ciangin Filip zui tawntung a, lim le nalamdang lianpipite a bawl a muh ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah hi."},"14":{"text":"Samaria mite in Pasian’ thu a sankhitna uh, Jerusalem-a om sawltakte in a zak uh ciangin amaute kiangah Peter le Johan a paisak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute a tun uh ciangin tua lai-a om thu um mite in Kha Siangtho a ngah nadingun thu a ngetsak uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen Topa Jesuh min tawh a kituiphum hi pan bek uh a, amaute khat beek in Kha Siangtho ngah nai lo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Peter le Johan in amaute lu tungah a khut uh a ngak khit uh ciangin Kha Siangtho a ngah uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Sawltakte in amaute tungah a khut uh a ngak ciangin Kha Siangtho a ngahna uh mu ahih manin Simon in Peter le Johan kiangah sum pia a,"},"19":{"text":"“Kei zong ka khut ka ngakna mi peuhpeuh in Kha Siangtho a ngahtheih nadingin hih bang vangliatna kei zong hong pia un,” a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin Peter in, “Pasian’ piakkhong na pen sum tawh lei theih dingin ngaihsun na hih manin na sumteng tawh sikhawm in."},"21":{"text":"Pasian in na lungsim man hong sa lo ahih manin kote’ nasepna-ah nang nong kihel thei kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin na ngaihsut hoih lohna panin kisikkik inla, hih bang na ngaihsutna thu-ah na mawhna hong maisak theih nadingin Topa kiangah thu ngen in."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in enluatna lungsim nei-in, mawhna in hong valhcip mi khat na hih lamtak ka hong thei hi,” a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Simon in Peter le Johan kiangah, “Tu-a na thugente uh kei tungah khat beek hong tun loh nadingin thu hong ngetsak un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in Jesuh Khrih thu a theihte uh genin Topa’ thugente a hilh khit uh ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahkik uh hi. A ciahkik kawmun Samaria khuaneu lampite-ah Lungdamna Thu a hilh uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa’ vantungmi khat in Filip kiangah, “Kithawi inla, Jerusalem khua panin Gaza khua paina lampi zuan dingin leitaw lam manawhin pai in,” a ci hi. (Tua lampi tu-in kizang pha nawn lo hi.)","title":"Filip le Ethiopia Mangpa"},"27":{"text":"Filip zong kithawi-in a pai hi. Lampi-ah Ethiopia mi mang lian khat tawh kituak hi. Tua mangpa pen Ethiopia kumpinu Kandeis khutnuai-a mang lian khat hi a, kumpinu neihsa khempeuh a ukpa ahi hi. Jerusalem khua-ah Pasian bia dingin a va pai hi a,"},"28":{"text":"inn zuan dingin leeng sungah a tuan kawmin kamsang Isaiah laibu a sim hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua laitakin Kha Siangtho in Filip kiangah, “Pai inla tua leeng mai-ah va om in,” ci-in a sawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Filip zong ama kiangah va tai a, kamsang Isaiah laibu a simna za ahih manin, “Na laisim a khiatna na thei hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in, “Mi khatpeuh in hong hilhtel lohpi-in bangci theih ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in dawng a, ama leeng tungah Filip a tuang dingin a sam hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua a sim Lai Siangtho mun pen, “A kigo dingin a kikai tuuno ham lo a, a mul a kimeetsak tuuno a ham loh mah bangin, amah kam khat beek pau lo hi."},"33":{"text":"Mite in amah simmawhbawl gawp a, amah a huh kuamah om lo hi. Ama nuntakna leitungah bei ahih manin, a suan a khakte’ thu, ci-a gen ding om lo hi,” ci-in a kigelhna mun ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 53:7-8"},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin mangpa in Filip kiangah, “Hih kamsangpa in amah a kicihna ahi hiam, tua ahih kei leh midang khatpeuh a cihna ahi hiam, hong gen dih in,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Filip zong a kam ka-in thugen ding kipan a, tua a Lai Siangtho simna mun a kipanin Jesuh thu ciang dong a gen hi."},"36":{"text":"Lampi-ah a pai laitakun tui omna mun tung uh a, mangpa in, “Hih lai-ah tui om hi. Tui kiphum nuam peuh leng kua’n hong kham thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Filip in, “Na lungsim takpi tawh na up nakleh tui na kiphum thei ding hi,” a cih ciangin, “Jesuh Khrih pen Pasian’ Tapa hi, ci-in ka um hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin a leeng a khawlsak nadingin mangpa in thu pia a, Filip tawh a nihun tui phualah pai-in Filip in amah a tuiphum hi."},"39":{"text":"Tui sung panin a paikhiat khit uh ciangin Topa’ Kha Siangtho in Filip paikhiatpih hi. Mangpa in Filip mu nawn lo hi; ahi zongin lungdam takin a lampai a zom hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin Filip pen Azotas khua-ah a om ahih lamtak amah kiphawk a, tua khua a kipanin Sisaria khua a tun dongin khua khempeuhah Lungdamna Thu a hilh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun sungteng Saul in Topa’ thu a um mite thah dingin a hanciamna zomlai hi. Siampi lianpen pa kiangah pai a,","title":"Saul A Kikheelna (Sawl 22:6-16 ; 26:12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ thu a zui mi numei pasal a muh peuhpeuh manin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahpih theih nadingin Damaskas khua-a Jew mi kikhopna inn ukte kiangah a lah dingin lai a ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Damaskas khua a zuan dingin pai a, a tun dektak ciangin thakhat thu-in van panin ama kimkotah a hong taangzaih khat a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Saul, leilakah puksuk a, tua laitakin awging khat in ama kiangah, “Saul, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Saul in, “Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Nangmah in na hong bawlsiat Jesuh ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin tho-in khuapi sungah lut in; tua lai panin na gamtatna dingteng hong kigen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Saul tawh a tonkhawm mite in a awging a zak uh hangin kuamah mu lo uh ahih manin lamdangsa lua-in pau thei lo liangin a om uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Saul zong leilak panin thoto a, a mit a hah hangin khua mu thei lo hi. Tua ahih manin a kikholhpihte in a khutin lenin Damaskas khua-ah a paipih uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni thum sung khua mu thei loin, anletui zong a ne kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua laitakin Damaskas khua-ah Ananias min nei thu um mi khat a om hi. Amah in maang mu a, a maang sungah Topa in, “Ananias aw,” ci-in a sam hi. Ananias in, “Topa aw, ka om hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in Ananias kiangah, “Kithawi-in Kongzing Tang gei-a Judas inn-ah va pai inla, Tarsas khuami Saul min nei mi khat va kan in. Tua Saul in thu ngen a,"},"12":{"text":"khua a muhkik theih nadingin Ananias min nei mi khat hong pai-in ama lu tungah a khut a ngakna thu, a maang muhna sungah a mu hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin Ananias in, “Topa aw, hih mipa in Jerusalem khua-a om nangma mite a bawlsiatna thu khempeuh, mi tampi tak in kei tungah hong gen khinzo uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in zong nangmah a hong bia mi khempeuh a mattheih nadingin siampi liante tung panin thu a ngahkhit ciangin Damaskas khua-ah a hong tung ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa in Ananias kiangah, “Gentail mite, kumpite, le Israel mite tungah keima min a kitheisak ding, keima na a sem dingin teelkhin ka hih manin ama kiangah va pai in."},"16":{"text":"Keima hangin a thuak ding thu khempeuh zong, kei mahmah in ama tungah ka gen ding hi,” a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Ananias zong pai a, inn sungah a lutkhit ciangin Saul lu tungah a khut nga a, “Sanggam Saul aw, hih lai-ah nong pai lai-in nangma tungah a hong kilang Jesuh mahmah in kei hong sawl hi. Nangmah in khua muthei kikin, Kha Siangtho tawh na kidim theih nadingin nangma kiangah a hong paisak ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua laitakin Saul’ mit panin ngasalip tawh a kibang na pawlkhat kia a, khua a mukik thei hi. Saul zong tui kiphumpah a,"},"19":{"text":"an a nekkhit ciangin a tha hong hatkik hi. Damaskas khua-ah a om thu um mite tawh tawlkhat sung a omkhawm hi."},"20":{"text":"Kikhopna innte-ah va pai-in, “Jesuh pen Pasian’ Tapa ahi hi,” ci-in thu hilh ding a kipan hi.","title":"Saul in Damaskas Khua-ah Thu Hilh"},"21":{"text":"Ama thuhilh a za mi khempeuh in lamdangsa uh a, “Pasian a bia mi peuhpeuh, Jerusalem khua sungah a that pa hi lo ahi hiam? Hih lai-ah zong thu um mite manin siampi liante kiangah a ciahpihkik dingin a hong pai hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin a thuhilhna-ah Saul hong siam semsem a, Jesuh pen Khrih hi, ci-in teltakin lakthei ahih manin, Damaskas khua-a om Jew mite in a nial nading uh om thei lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuazawh ni tampi khit ciangin Jew mite kikaikhawmin Saul thahsawm uh a,","title":"Jew Mite Kiang Panin Saul Suakta"},"24":{"text":"ahi zongin Saul in amah a kisawm lamtak na phawk hi. Jew mite in Saul a thahtheih nadingun a sun a zanin khua kongpi-ah a pang uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin Saul’ nungzuite in zanin khuakulh tungah kahtohpihin kulh pualamah bawm tawh a khaisuk uh hi.","ref":"2Kor 11:32-33"},"26":{"text":"Jerusalem khua-ah Saul pai a, thu um mite tawh kipawl dingin a vaihawm hi. Ahi zongin amaute in Saul pen thu um dingin na ngaihsun zo lo uh ahih manin na kihta mahmah uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem Khua-ah Saul Pai"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Barnabas in Saul hong huh a, sawltakte kiangah Saul a va paipih hi. Lam a pai laitakin Saul in Topa a muhna thu, Topa in Saul kiangah a thugennate, le Damaskas khua-ah Saul in hangtakin Jesuh’ min tawh thu a hilhnate khempeuh sawltakte kiangah a gensak hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Saul zong sawltakte tawh kikhawl a, Jerusalem khua sungah vak kawikawi-in, Topa’ min tawh hangtakin thu a hilh hi."},"29":{"text":"Grik pau a zang Jew mite tawh zong thu genkhawmin kisel uh a, amaute in Saul thah dingin a vaihawm uh hi."},"30":{"text":"A lawmte in hih thu a phawk uh ciangin Sisaria khua-ah Saul paipihsuk uh a, tua lai panin Tarsas khua-ah a ciahsak uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Judea gam, Galilee gam, le Samaria gam sunga om pawlpite in bawlsiatna thuak nawn loin nuamtakin om uh a, Topa zahtakna tawh gamta uh ahih manin Kha Siangtho huhna tawh a mi khangin a kibehlap uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Peter khualzinin pai kawikawi a, khatvei Lydda khua-a teng Pasian’ mite kiangah a hawh hi.","title":"Aineas Kidamsak"},"33":{"text":"Tua khua a tun ciangin a khutlekhe a zaw, kum giat sung tawntung lupna ngakin a om, Aineas kici mi khat a mu hi."},"34":{"text":"Peter in tua pa kiangah, “Aineas aw, Jesuh Khrih in nang hong damsak hi; tho-in na lupna zial in,” a ci hi. Amah zong thakhatin thoto pah hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua khua-a teng mi khempeuh le Sharon zanglei-a teng mi khempeuh in Aineas mu uh ahih manin Topa a um uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Joppa khua-ah Pasian’ thu a um, Tabitha min nei numei khat a om hi. (Tua nu’ Grik min pen Dorkas hi a, sakhi a cihnopna ahi hi.) Tua nu a tawntungin a hoihin gamta-in mizawngte a huh hi.","title":"Dorkas Kihingsak Kik"},"37":{"text":"Tua laitakin amah a ci na-in a si hi. Amah a silkhit uh ciangin inndei tungnungah a sial uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Joppa khua le Lydda khua kigamla lo ahih manin, Joppa khua-a teng thu um mite in Lydda khua-ah Peter om hi, ci-in thu a zak uh ciangin Peter kiangah mi nih sawl uh a, “A manlang theithei-in ko kiangah hong pai in,” ci-in a samsak uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Peter zong kithawi-in a samte tawh paikhawm pah a, tua khua a tun ciangin inndei tungnungah a na paipihto pah uh hi. Tua lai-ah a na om meigong numei khempeuh in Peter na umcih uh a, Dorkas a hin lai-in amaute a dingin a bawlsak puanakte le puantungsilhte, a kahkawmun Peter kiangah a lak uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Peter in innsung panin amaute khempeuh a pusuahsak khit ciangin khukdinin thu a ngen hi. Tua ciangin misi nu lamah kihei a, “Tabitha aw, tho in,” a cih ciangin a mit hong hak a, Peter a muh ciangin a tuto hi."},"41":{"text":"Peter in a khut khakin a dingtosak hi. Tua ciangin thu um meigong numeite a kipanin thu um khempeuh samkikin amaute kiangah Dorkas a nungta-in a lak hi."},"42":{"text":"Joppa khuasung khempeuhah hih thu kitheikim a, mi tampi in Topa a um uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Joppa khua-ah ni tampi sung Peter tamlai a, savunnim nasepin a nei Simon a kici mipa tawh a omkhawm hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sisaria khua-ah Kornelias a kici mi khat om a, Rom galkap honte sung panin “Italy Galkapte,” a kici sungah galkapbu a sem ahi hi.","title":"Peter le Kornelias"},"2":{"text":"Amah biakna a hahkat mahmah mi khat hi a, a innkuan bupun Pasian bia uh hi. Amah in Jew mizawngte huh nadingin nakpitakin na sem a, Pasian kiangah thu a ngen tawntung mi khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Khatvei nitak nai thum pawlin maang mu a, Pasian’ vantungmi khat hong pai-in ama kiangah, “Kornelias aw,” ci-in a sapna teltakin a thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in zong laukawmin vantungmi en a, “Topa aw, bang thu ahi hiam?” a cih ciangin, “Pasian in na thungetna hong za a, mizawngte na huhna zong hong thei-in nang hong phawk hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Joppa khua-ah mi sawl inla, Simon Peter a kici mipa samsak in."},"6":{"text":"Tua mipa pen, tuipi gei-a teng savunnim nasepin a nei Simon inn-ah zin tungin a om ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin ama kiangah thu a gen vantungmi paikhia a, Kornelias in zong ama innsung nasemte nih le biakna a hahkat mahmah, ama sawltakin a neih galkapte khat sam a,"},"8":{"text":"a thupiang khempeuh amaute kiangah a genkhit ciangin Joppa khua-ah a paisak hi."},"9":{"text":"A zing ciangin Joppa khua-ah amaute a tun dektak laitakun, thungen dingin sun laitakin innkhumzangah Peter a kahto hi."},"10":{"text":"Peter a gil kialin an duh mahmah hi. Na nuntak sungun note lakah ka sepkhiat ding uh thu pen mi khatpeuh in hong gen hileh na up hetloh ding uh thu ahi hi,’ ci-in a gen uh thute, note tungah hong pian’ khak loh nadingin kidawm un,” a ci hi.","merge":"41","ref":"Hab 1:5"},"42":{"text":"Kikhopna inn panin Paul le Barnabas a ciah ding uh ciangin, Sabbath ni kik ciangin hih thute mah hong gen lai un, ci-in mite in a vaikhak uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Kikhopna inn panin a ciahkhiat uh ciangin Jew mi tampite le Jew biakna a zui Gentail mi tampite in Paul le Barnabas zui uh a, amau tegel in zong tua mite hanthawnin, Pasian’ hehpihna suangin kiptakin a om nadingun a gen uh hi."},"44":{"text":"A Sabbath ni kik ciangin Pasian’ thu a ngai dingin a khuazang phialun hong kikhawm uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Jew mite in mi tampi tak a hong kikhawm a muh uh ciangin Paul le Barnabas haza uh ahih manin Paul’ thugente a man lopi hi, ci-in Paul a gensia uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ciangin Paul le Barnabas in hangtakin thu gen uh a, “No Jew mite tungah Pasian’ thu kong gen masak ding mah uh ahi hi. Tua mipa in damna a ngahzawh nading zahin upna nei hi, ci-in Paul in a muh ciangin limtakin amah en a,"},"10":{"text":"“Na khe-in dingto in!” nakpitakin a ci hi.
