Na cidam ta un,” ci-in kigelh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua bangin amaute paisak uh a, Antiok khua a tun uh ciangin thu um mi khempeuh khawmin amaute tungah a lai puak uh a pia uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Mite in tua laikhak a sim uh ciangin a thu kigelhte hangin amaute thanuamin lungdam mahmah uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Judas le Silas zong kamsangte mah hi uh a, thu um mite tawh sauveipi thu kikum uh a, amaute’ lungsim thanuam sakin a thahatsak uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua lai-ah tawlkhat a taam khit uh ciangin thu uppih lawmte in lungdam takin Judas le Silas, amau a sawlte kiangah a ciahkik sak uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi zongin Antiok khua-ah Paul le Barnabas taam lai uh a, midang tampite tawh kopin Topa’ thu a hilh uh hi.","merge":"35"},"36":{"text":"Tawlkhat khit ciangin Paul in Barnabas kiangah, “Topa’ thu i hilhnasa khua tuamtuama i sanggamte kiangah va hawhkikin bang a cici uh hiam cih va en ni,” a ci hi.","title":"Paul le Barnabas Kikhen"},"37":{"text":"Tua bangin a pai ding uh ciangin Barnabas in Johan Marka tonpih nuam a,"},"38":{"text":"ahi zongin Johan Marka in a khualzin masakun a tawp dongin zui loin Pamfilia gam panin ciahsan ahih manin Paul in hoihsa lo hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:13"},"39":{"text":"Hih thu hangin amau tegel nakpitakin kinial uh ahih manin kikhenlawh uh a, Barnabas in Johan Marka zawnin Saipras tuikulh gam a zuan dingin teembaw tawh a pai hi."},"40":{"text":"Paul in zong Silas teel a, thu um mite in Topa’ khut sungah a ap khit uh ciangin,"},"41":{"text":"Syria gam le Silisia gam nawkin pai-in pawlpite hanthawnin a thahatsak hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul paisuak lai-in Derbe khua tung a, tua panin Lystra khua a tung hi. Tua Lystra khua-ah Timoti a kici thu um mi khat om a, a nu zong thu um Jew mi hi a, a pa pen Grik mi ahi hi.","title":"Timoti in Paul le Silas Pawm"},"2":{"text":"Lystra khua le Ikonium khua-a om thu um mite in Timoti pen a zahtak mahmah uh mi khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in Timoti tonpih nuam ahih manin a vun a atsak hi. Tua gam a om Jew mi khempeuh in Timoti’ pa pen Grik mi ahih lamtak theikim uh ahih manin tua bangin a atsak ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Thuhilhin a paina uh khua khempeuha thu um mite kiangah Jerusalem khua-a om sawltakte le upate in zuih dingin a khensat uh ngeinate gen kawikawi uh a, tua ngeinate a zuih nadingun a hanthawn uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin pawlpi mite a upna uhah kip semsemin, a nini-in mi a kibehlaplap hi."},"6":{"text":"Asia gam sungah thu a hilh ding uh Kha Siangtho in phal lo ahih manin Frigia le Galatia gam sungtengah a zin uh hi.","title":"Paul in A Maang ah Masedonia Mi Mu"},"7":{"text":"Mysia gamgi a tun uh ciangin Bithynia gam sungah lut dingin kithawi uh a, ahi zongin tua gamah a pai ding uh Jesuh’ Kha Siangtho in phal lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Mysia gam nawkin pai uh a, Troas khua-ah a tung uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Troas khua-ah a tunni zanin Paul in maang mu a, Masedonia gammi khat in ama kiangah, “Masedonia gamah hong pai inla, kote hong huh in,” ci-in a thum hi."},"10":{"text":"Paul in maang a muhkhit phetin, tua lai-a om mite kiangah Lungdamna Thu a hilh dingin Pasian in eite hong sam hi, ci-in ngaihsun ka hih manun Masedonia gamah a pai dingin ka kithawi pah uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Troas khua panin teembaw tuangin Samothrasia tuikulh ka tung uh a, a zing ciangin Neapolis khua ka tung uh hi.","title":"Lydia A Kikheelna"},"12":{"text":"Tua khua panin khe tawh pai-in Masedonia gam sunga om Rom mite a tenna Filippi khua ka tung uh a, tua khua-ah ni tampi sung ka taam uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A Sabbath ni ciangin Jew mite’ thungetna mun om ding hi, ci-in ka upna uh khua pualama gun gei-ah ka pai uh a, tua lai-ah tu-in a kikhawm numeite tungah thu ka hilh uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ka thuhilhna uh a za mite lakah Thiatira khuami, a manpha mahmah puansan a zuak, Lydia kici numei khat a om hi. Tua nu pen Pasian a bia numei khat hi a, Paul’ thugente a sangthei dingin Pasian in a lungsim a honsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah le a innsunga om mi khempeuh tui kiphum uh a, “Topa thu a um mi taktak hi, ci-in na hong ngaihsut nak-uhleh hong pai unla, ka inn-ah hong tung un,” ci-in hong samin a hong zol hi."},"16":{"text":"Nikhat, thungetna mun a zuan dingin ka pai laitakun mailam thu a genthei dawivei nasem numei khat in kote hong dawntuah hi. Tua numei in mailam thu a genna tawh a tote a dingin sum tampi a ngahsak hi.","title":"Filippi khua-a Thongkiatna"},"17":{"text":"Tua numei in Paul le kote hong zui-in, “Hih mite, A Lianpen Pasian’ nasemte ahi uh hi. Note a hong kihotkhiat theih nading thu a hong gen uh ahi hi,” ci-in a kiko hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua bangin ni tampi sung awng ngitnget ahih manin a sawtna ciangin Paul in nawngkaisa ahih manin kihei-in a dawi kiangah, “Hih numei sung panin na paikhiat nadingin Jesuh Khrih min tawh thu kong pia hi,” a cihkhit phetin, tua numei sung panin dawi a paikhia pah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua numei’ tote in a sumngah nading uh beita hi, ci-in a phawk uh ciangin Paul le Silas man uh a, thukhente omna sumbuk tualah a kai uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Rom ulian thukhente kiangah paipih uh a, “Hih mite, Jew mi hi a, i khua sungah nawngkaina hong piangsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute in kote’ ngeina tawh kituak lo thute hong hilh uh a, kote Rom mi ka hih manun amau thugente ka sang thei kei uh a, ka zui thei kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihonte in zong amau tegel vuakpih ngeingai uh a, uliante in Paul le Silas’ puan balkeksak uh a, tua mi tegel a sat nading uh thu a pia uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Nakpi takin a kisat khit ciangin thong sungah koihsak uh a, limtakin tawh a kalh nadingin thongcing pa kiangah thu a pia uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangin thu a ngah ciangin thongcing pa in thong sung tawngnungah amaute koihin, singkol lianpi sungah a khe uh a gakcipsak hi."},"25":{"text":"Zankim laitakin Paul le Silas in Pasian kiangah thu ngenin la sa uh a, thongkia dangte in amau’ thungetna le lasaknate a ngai uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Thakhatin nakpitakin zin hong ling a, thonginn a bulpi dongin a lokgawp hi. Thakhatthu-in thong kongkhak khempeuh kihong a, thongkiate a kikhihna sikkhau khempeuh a kiphelkhia hi."},"27":{"text":"Thongcing pa zong khanglo a, thong kongkhakte a kihong a muh ciangin thongkia mi khempeuh taikhia mangkhin hi, ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin a namsau dokin amahmah a kithat dingin a kithawi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin a aw neihzah tawh Paul kiko a, “Bangmah kicih kei in! Ka vekpi-un kim ung!” a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Thongcing pa in zong meivak a la dingin mi khat sawl a, thong sungah tai-in laukawm lingkawmin Paul le Silas khe kiang va kidenna-in a va boksuk hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute pusuahpih a, “Tote aw, hotkhiatna ka ngah nadingin bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi."},"31":{"text":"Amaute in, “Topa Jesuh um in. Tua hileh nang le na innkuanpihte in hotkhiatna na ngah ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in amah le a innsunga om mi khempeuh tungah Topa’ thu a hilh uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua zankim laitakpi mahin thongcing pa in amaute’ liammate sawpsiangsak a, amah le a innkuanpih mi khempeuh a kituiphum pah uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin a inn-ah amaute ciahpihin an a pia hi. Tu-in Pasian thu um uh ahih manin amah a kipan a innkuanpih khempeuh a lungdam mahmah uh hi."},"35":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin Rom thukhen uliante in palikbute samin, “Tua mite va khah un,” a ci uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahih manin thongcing pa in zong Paul kiangah, “Thukhen uliante in nang le Silas kong khah nading uh thu hong piakhin ahih manin lungnuam takin na ciahkhia theita ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi zongin Paul in palikbute kiangah, “Kote in khialhna bangmah gamta lo napi-in mihon mai-ah hong kisatgawp hi. Kote pen Rom gammi hi ung! Hong kisat khit ciangin thong sungah hong kikoih lai hi. Tu-in kuama theih lohin kote hong khahsim nuam ahi uh hiam? Tua bang mawk hithei peuhmah lo ding hi. Rom thukhen uliante mahmah hih lai-ah hong pai uh hen la, kote hong khahkhia ta hen,” a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Palikbute in zong Rom thukhen uliante kiangah hih thu va ko uh hi. Paul le Silas pen Rom gammi ahih lamtak a phawk uh ciangin lunghimawh uh a,"},"39":{"text":"amau mahmah va pai-in a va thum khit uh ciangin thong sung panin khahkhia uh a, tua khua panin a paikhiat nadingun a thum uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Paul le Silas zong thong panin paikhia-in Lydia’ inn a zuan uh hi. Tua lai-ah thu um mite tawh kikhawm uh a, hanthotna kam a genkhit uh ciangin tua khua panin a ding khia uh hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amfipolis khua le Apollonia khua nawkin amaute zin uh a, Jew mite kikhopna inn a omna Thesalonika khua a tung uh hi.","title":"Thesalonika khua-ah Buaina"},"2":{"text":"A pai ngei zel mah bangin Paul zong kikhopna inn-ah pai a, Sabbath ni thum sung Lai Siangtho siksanin mite tawh thu kikum a,"},"3":{"text":"Khrih in sihna thuakin, sihna panin a thawhkik ding a kisam ahi hi, ci-in a laktel hi. Tu-a note kiangah kong pulak Khrih pen Lai Siangtho sunga kigen Khrih ahi hi, ci-in Paul in a gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in a thugen uh man sa uh ahih manin Paul le Silas pawlpih uh a, tua mah bangin Pasian a bia mi tampi tak le uliante’ zi tampi mah in zong a pawlpih uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua bangin mi tampi in Paul’ thugen a up uh ciangin Jew mite thangpai uh a, kongzing lakah a vakvai migilo honkhat kaikhawmin a pawlmat uh hi. Khuasung khempeuh buaisak henhanin, mihonte lakah Paul le Silas a kaihkhiat theih nadingun Jason’ inn a va simgawp uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua inn-ah Paul le Silas a muh loh uh ciangin a innteek pa Jason le midang pawlkhat kaikhia-in uliante kiangah paipih uh a, “Hih mite in mun khempeuhah buaina piangsak uh hi. Tu-in i khuasung hong tung uh a,"},"7":{"text":"Jason in a inn-ah amaute tungsak hi. Amaute in gam khempeuh a uk Kumpipa’ thu palsat uh a, Jesuh kici kumpi dang khat om hi, ci-in gen uh hi,” ci-in a awnggawp uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih thu a zak uh ciangin mihonte le khuasung uliante heh mahmah uh a,"},"9":{"text":"Jason le a lawmte a kitat nading uh sum a piaksak khit uh ciangin tua khuasung uliante in amaute a khah pan uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zan ciangin thu um mite in Berea khua-ah Paul le Silas a paisak uh hi. Tua khua a tun uh ciangin Jew mite kikhopna inn-ah a pai uh hi.","title":"Berea khua-ah Mi tampi in Paul’ Thugen Um"},"11":{"text":"Thesalonika khuamite sangin Berea khuamite in mipi lungsim neizaw uh hi. Amaute in lawp mahmahna tawh Paul’ thugente ngai uh a, Paul’ thugente man taktak hiam ci-in a theih nadingun nisimin Lai Siangtho a sim uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi tampi in Pasian’ thu um a, tuate sungah a cithei Grik numei tampi le Grik mi pasal tampi a kihel uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Berea khua-ah zong Paul in Pasian thu a hilhna a zak uh ciangin Thesalonika khua panin Jew mite hong pai-in Berea khua-ah zong mite hong holhthawh gawp uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin thu um mite in tuipi gei-ah Paul paikhiatpih uh a, ahi zongin Silas le Timoti pen Berea khua-ah a taam lai uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuipi gei-ah Paul a paipih thu um mite in Athen khua ciang dong a va zui uh hi. Athen khua panin Berea khua-ah hong ciahkik uh ciangin, Silas le Timoti in a manlang theithei-in hong delh uh hen, ci-in Paul’ kam vaikhak thu a hong pua uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Paul in Athen khua-ah Silas le Timoti ngakin a om laitakin tua khua sungah milim a dimin a om lamtak mu ahih manin a lungsim ommawk thei lo hi.","title":"Paul in Athen khua-ah Thu Hilh"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian a bia Jew mite le Gentail mite tawh kikhopna inn sungah thu kikupna nei uh a, mihon kikhopna munah hong pai mi khempeuh tawh zong nisimin a kikum uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Epikuras thu ngaihsutzia le Stoik thu ngaihsutzia a um mite pawlkhat, Paul tawh thu kinial uh a, “Hih mi kipilsak thu mawk gengen pa in bang gennuam ahi hiam?” cihsan uh a, pawlkhat in, “Minam dangte’ pasian thu a gen tawh kibang hi,” a ci uh hi. Paul in Jesuh thu le a thawhkikna thu hilh ahih manin hih bangin a gen uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amaute in Paul samin, Areopagas mualbo-ah paipih uh a, “Tu-a na gengen thuthakte ka theinuam uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu-a na gengen ka zak uh thu pawlkhatte, ko a dingin a lamdangpi khat hi a, a thu a cingin ka theinuam uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"(Athen khuamite le tua khua-a om gamdang mite in thu thak la thak ngaihsunin kikup ding simloh thudang ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi.)"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Paul zong kikhopna mun Areopagas a kici mualbo tungah dingin, “Athen khua mite aw, biakna a hahkat mahmah mite na hihna uh ka thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Na khuasung uhah ka pai kawmin na biakna munte uh ka et ciangin, ‘A Kithei lo Pasian a’ ding,’ ci-in biakna tau tungah lai a kigelh nangawn ka mu hi. Tu laitakin kei’ hong pulak Pasian pen, thei lo napi-in na biakbiak uh Pasian ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua Pasian pen leitung buppi le a tunga om khempeuh a piangsak Pasian hi a, van le lei a uk Topa ahih manin mihingte’ lamsa biakinn sungah teng lo hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah pen mi khempeuh tungah nuntakna le na khempeuh a piapa ahih manin mihingte in ama a dingin na khat peuhpeuh a sepsak ding a kisam ahi kei hi.","ref":"1Kum 8:27; Isa 42:5; Sawl 8:47"},"26":{"text":"Mihing khat tung panin leitung minam khempeuh hong piangsakin, leitung khempeuhah a omsak hi. Amah in mihingte a piansakma pekin, mihingte’ nuntak tanvei ding le a ten nading uh mun a sehsa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hih bangin a hihna pen mite in amah zongin a muhtheih nading uh a deihna ahi hi. Ahi zongin eite kiang panin Pasian gamla om het lo hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi khat in, ‘Pasian hangin eite piangin, hingin i gamtang hi,’ ci-in gen a, note sung panin laphuah siampa khat in zong, ‘Eite zong ama tate ihi hi,’ na na ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Eite pen Pasian’ tate ihih manin, mihing khutsiamte in bawlin a zep ngunte, khamte, suang milimte tawh a kibang dingin Pasian i ngaihsun kei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Pasian in mihingte’ theih loh hun lai-a a gamtatnate uh phamawh a sak loh hangin, tu-in mun khempeuha om mi khempeuhte a gamtat siatna panun a kihei nadingun thu a hong pia khinzo hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in leitung mi khempeuh thu a mantakin ama teel mipa a hong khensak nading ni a sehkhol khinzo hi. Tua a ngaihsutna a man taktak hi, ci-in mi khempeuh tungah a hong lah nadingin a teel mipa, sihna panin a hingkiksak zo hi,” ci-in thu a hilh hi."},"32":{"text":"Sihna panin thawhkikna thu Paul in a gen a zak uh ciangin mi pawlkhat in zahpihbawl uh a, ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in, “Hih thu khatvei zakik nuam lai ung,” a ci uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua kikhopna panin Paul a paikhia hi."},"34":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in thu umin Paul pawlpih uh a, tuate lakah Areopagas mualbo a thu vaihawm pawl sungah a kihel Dionisias, le Damaris a kici numei khat, le mi pawlkhat ahi uh hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Athen khua panin Paul paikhia-in Korin khua-ah a tung hi.","title":"Paul in Korin khua-ah Lungdamna Thu Hilh"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai-ah Pontas gam a suak, Jew mi Aquila a kici mi khat tawh a kimu hi. Gam uk Kumpipa in Jew mi khempeuh Rom khua panin a taikhiat nadingun thu pia ahih manin Aquila le a zi Prisilla pen Italy gam panin Korin khua a hong tun uh a sawt nai lo ahi hi. Tua nupate tawh a kimu dingin Paul zong a inn uhah va hawh a,"},"3":{"text":"tua nupate mah bangin Paul zong puanbuk bawl nasep tawh a nungta ahih manin amaute tawh omkhawmin na a semkhawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Sabbath ni simin kikhopna inn-ah limtakin thu gen a, Jew mi le Grik mite in thu a up nadingun a hanciam hi."},"5":{"text":"Masedonia gam panin Silas le Timoti hong tun ciangin Paul in a hun neih khempeuh thuhilhna-in zang a, Jesuh pen Khrih ahi hi, ci-in Jew mite kiangah teltakin a gen hi."},"6":{"text":"Jew mite in ama thuhilhna nialin a gensiat uh ciangin Paul in a puan tunga leivui bangte sinsanin, “Pasian tawh kikhenin siatna na tuah uhleh nomau khialhna hi a, kei nong ngawh nading uh om lo hi. Tu a kipanin Gentail mite kiangah thu ka hilh ding hi,” a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Paul in tua Jew mite nusia-in Pasian a bia Gentail mi Titus Justas’ inn-ah a tung hi. Tua mipa’ inn pen kikhopna inn gei mahmah ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kikhopna inn ukpa Krispas le a innsunga om mi khempeuh in Topa thu um uh a, Korin khua-a om midang tampite in zong thuhilhna ngai-in um uh a, tui a kiphum uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Zan khat, Paul in maang mu a, a maang sungah Topa in, “Lau kei in. Lungkia kei inla, na thugen zom in."},"10":{"text":"Hih khua sungah keima mi tampi om a, nang hong ompih ka hih manin kuamah in nang bangmah hong cih lo ding hi,” a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua khua-ah kum khat le alang sung omlai-in mite kiangah Pasian thu a hilh hi."},"12":{"text":"Rom khutnuai-ah Akhaia gam sung a uk dingin Gallio a kikoih ciangin Jew mite hong kikaikhawm uh a, Paul manin zumah a paipih uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in, “Hih mipa in ngeina om lopi-in mite in Pasian a biak nadingin zol ding hanciam hi,” a ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Paul in a kam ka-in thugen dingin a kipat laitakin Gallio in Jew mite kiangah, “Hih thu pen gamtat khialhna ahi a, gitloh tatna ahi zongin a gamtatna hang hileh no Jew mite’ thugente limtakin kong ngaih ding a kilawm mah ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih thu pen kam zatzia, min le na ngeina uh a kituh na hih manun nomau mah in khentawm un. Tua bang thute keimah in ka hong khen kei ding hi,” a cih khit ciangin,"},"16":{"text":"zum panin amaute a hawlkhia hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in kikhopna inn ukpa Sosthenes manin, zum mai-ah satgawp uh a, ahi zongin Gallio in themkhat zong phamawh sa lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Korin khua-ah ni tampi sung thu um mite tawh Paul omkhawm lai a, tua khit ciangin amaute mangpha khakin Syria gam a zuan dingin Prisilla le Aquila tawh teembaw a tuang uh hi. Paul in Pasian tungah thuciamnasa nei ahih manin teembaw a tuan ma-un Korin khuapi teembaw khawlna Kenkhrea munah a sam a metsak hi.","title":"Antiok khua-ah Paul Ciahkik","ref":"Gam 6:18"},"19":{"text":"Tua bangin a pai uh ciangin Efesa khua tung uh a, Paul zong kikhopna inn-ah pai-in Jew mite tawh thu a kisel uh hi. Tua khua-ah Prisilla le Aquila-te nupa a taam lai nading Paul in a gen hi."},"20":{"text":"Thu um mi pawlkhatte in ni tampi sung Paul a taam nadingin gen uh a, ahi zongin amah taam nuam lo hi;"},"21":{"text":"a dinkhiat ding ciangin, “Pasian deihna ahih nakleh note kiangah ka hong hawhkik ding hi,” ci-in vaikhakin, Efesa khua panin teembaw tawh a ding khia hi."},"22":{"text":"Sisaria khua a tun ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah pai-in pawlpite va hopih a, tua ciangin Antiok khua-ah a pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Antiok khua-ah tawlkhat a taam khit ciangin Galatia gam le Frigia gam sungah pai-in thu um mi khempeuh a va thakhauhsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Alexandria khuami Apollos a kici Jew mi khat, Efesa khua-ah hong pai hi. Amah thugen siam mahmah a, Lai Siangtho zong a thei mahmah khat ahi hi.","title":"Apollos in Efesa khua-ah Thu Hilh"},"25":{"text":"Amah in Topa’ zia thei a, lawp mahmahna tawh Jesuh’ thu a mantakin a hilh hi. Amaute a kithawisa-in om uh a, nangma thupiak ding bek a ngak uh ahi hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in tangvalpa kiangah, “Kei kiangah hih thu nong kohna thu kuamah theisak kei in,” ci-in a vaikhak khit ciangin a ciahsak hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in galkapbute nih samin, “Sisaria khua-ah a pai ding galkap zanih sam unla, sakol tung tuang galkap sawmsagih le teitawi galkap zanih tawh zong pai unla, tuzan nai kua hunin ding khia un.","title":"Gam uk Menzipa Feliks kiangah Paul Kipuak"},"24":{"text":"Paul’ tuan nading sakol pawlkhat zong keng unla, Menzipa Feliks kiangah hoihtakin va tunpih un,” a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in hih a nuai-a bangin lai khat gelh hi:"},"26":{"text":"“A Lian Menzipa aw, Keimah Klaudias Lysias in hopihna lai ka hong gelh hi."},"27":{"text":"Jew mite in hih mipa manin that dektak uh hi. Tu-in hih mipa thu sit lecin, ka mawhsakna uh thu khempeuh nangmah in na thei ding hi,” a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jew mite in zong panpih uh a, hih a gen khempeuh a man mah ahi hi, ci-in a gen uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Paul in thu a gen nadingin menzipa in a khut tawh a lah ciangin Paul in, “Hih minamte tungah thukhenin sauveipi na omkhitna thu ka hong thei hi; kei hong kimawhsaknate nangma mai-ah pheltheih nading hun ngah ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi.","title":"Feliks mai-ah Jew mite’ Mawhsaknate Paul in a Phelna"},"11":{"text":"Nangmahmah in na theih ding mah bangin, Jerusalem khua-ah Pasian bia dingin ka paina pen ni sawm le ni nih khawng pha pan hi."},"12":{"text":"Biakinnsung ahi a, kikhopna innsung ahi a, khuasung mun khat peuhpeuhah ahi zongin mi khat peuhpeuh tawh ka kitotna ahi a, mihon in thusia a bawl nadingin ka hanthotna ahi zongin, hih Jew mite in hong mu het lo ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-a kei hong mawhsaknate uh zong a manna thu hong lakthei het lo ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin nangma kiangah kong pulaknop thu in: Amaute in man lo hi, a cih uh tua Thu zui-in kote’ pu le pate’ Pasian ka bia hi. Nangmahmah in zong teltakin na theih ding bangmahin Jew mite tungah bangmah siatna ka bawl kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Thukham palsatin sihna thuak nading thu khat peuhpeuh a gamta hi leng, suahtak nading thu ka gen het kei ding hi. Gam uk kumpipa tungah a zu ka khan hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Festas in, “Gam uk kumpipa tungah a zu khan khin na hih manin ama kiangah na pai ding hi,” a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawh tawlkhat khit ciangin gam uk kumpipa’ khutnuai mahah a uksawn Agrippa le a sanggamnu Bernis, a hong tung thak Festas kiangah a hawh dingin Sisaria khua-ah a hong pai uh hi.","title":"Festas in Agrippa kiangah Paul’ Thu Gen"},"14":{"text":"Tawlkhat a taam khit uh ciangin Festas in tua kumpipa’ kiangah Paul’ thu gen a, “Feliks in thong sunga a na nusiat mi khat hih lai-ah a om hi."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem khua-ah ka va pai ciangin Jew siampi liante le upate in amah a mawhsakna uh thu tampi gen uh a, amah mawhsakin thu ka khen nading hong gen uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin ke’n ka dawnna-ah, ‘Mi khat peuhpeuh in mawhsakna a thuak ciangin, mawhsakna a thuak pa le a mawhsakte maitang kimu-in thu kisel a, mawhsakna a thuak pa in amah a kiphel theih nading thugenna hun a ngah matengin, mawhsak thukhenna piak ding pen Rom ngeina hi lo hi,’ ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka cih mah bangin hih lai-ah amaute a hong tun uh a zing ciangin thukhenna tokhom tungah tu pahin, a mipa hong kipaipih nadingin thu ka pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Alangte hong ding uh a, a mawhna a lianpipi hong gen ding uh hi, ci-in ka up leh, tua bang hong hi lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Amau’ thu kituhna pen amau’ biakna thu, le a si khinsa hinapi-in Paul in, ‘Hing hi,’ a cih Jesuh’ thu peuh na hi lel hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih bang thu ka kankhiatna dingzia thei lo ka hih manin Paul kiangah, ‘Hih thute tawh kisai-in thu kisit dingin Jerusalem-ah va pai lecin na ut hiam?’ ci-in ka dot leh amah ut lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in a zu khan a, thong mahah kikoih lai-in gam uk kumpipa in ama thu a khensak nading a ngen hi. Tua ahih manin gam uk kumpipa kiangah ka puakkhiat theih mateng thong sungah a khum nadingun thu ka pia hi,” a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Agrippa in Festas kiangah, “Kei mahmah in hih mipa’ thugen zanuam ing,” a cih ciangin, “Zing ciangin na za ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a zing ciangin a thupi takin lian bawl mahmahna tawh Agrippa le Bernis hong pai uh a, galkapmangte le khuasung uliante tawh kikhopna inn lianpi sungah a hong lut uh hi. Tua ciangin Festas in Paul hong kitumpih nadingin thu a pia hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Festas in, “Kumpi Agrippa le hih lai-a om mi khempeuh aw, hih lai khua hitaleh Jerusalem khua-ah hitaleh Jew mi khempeuh in kei tungah amah mawhsakna thu hong gen uh hih mipa na mu uh hi. Hih mipa hinkhawi ding kilawm lo hi, ci-in amaute awnggawp uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin sihna thuak nadingin ama gamtat khialhna bangmah ka mu het kei hi. Amahmah in gam uk kumpipa tungah a zu khan khin ahih manin kumpipa kiangah puak dingin ka ngaihsutsa ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin kumpipa tungah bangteng taktak gelh ding cih ka thei kei hi. Tua ahih manin ama thu a kikan khit ciangin ka gelh ding thu ka theih nadingin note mai-ah, a diakdiakin kumpipa Agrippa mai-ah amah kong paipih hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ama mawhna hih bangteng hi, ci-in gentelna om lopi-in thongkia mi khat, kumpipa kiangah ka puak ding, a thu kicing ka sa zo kei hi,” a ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Agrippa in Paul kiangah, “Tu-in thugen theih nading hun na nei hi,” ci-in a gen ciangin Paul in a khut zanin a kiphel nading thu hong gen a,","title":"Agrippa’ Mai-ah Paul’ Kiphelna"},"2":{"text":"“Kumpi Agrippa aw, Jew mite in kei hong mawhsakna thu ka kiphelna dingin nangma mai-ah tuni-in hun ngah ka hih manin hampha ka kisa mahmah hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in Jew mite’ nuntakzia le amau’ thu kituh theihna thute khempeuh limtakin na theih khitsa ahih manin hampha ka kisa diak hi. Tua ahih manin lungduai takin ka thugente nong ngaih nadingin ka hong thum hi."},"4":{"text":"“Jew mite khempeuh in ka neutung a kipan, keima pianna gam le Jerusalem khua-a ka omzia khempeuh hong thei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kote’ biakna sungah a hahkat phadiak Farisi pawl a kicite sunga ka om cil a kipanin ka nuntakzia khempeuh, a gennop nak-uhleh hong genthei ding uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:6; Fil 3:5"},"6":{"text":"Ko Israel minam sawm le nihte in Pasian’ thuciam ngah ding lametna tawh a sun a zanin Pasian ka biabia uh a, ka pu ka pate uh tungah Pasian in a thuciamna ngah ding lamenin ka omna hangin hih lai-ah thusitna thuakin a ding ka hi hi. Kumpipa aw, hih thu ka lametna hangin Jew mite in kei hong mawhsak ahi uh hi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Bang hangin no Jew mite in Pasian in misite a thawhkik sakna thu um thei lo na hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"“Nazareth khuami Jesuh’ min a siattheih nadingin langpangin nial ding hi, ci-in kei mahmah in ka ngaihsun ngei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Jerusalem khua sungah ka sempah a, siampi liante tung panin thu ngahna tawh Pasian’ mi tampi thong sungah ka khum hi. Tua mite a sih nadingun thu a kikhen ciangin zong a thukimpih pawl ka hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Kikhopna inn khempeuhah amaute gim ka thuaksak zelzel a, a thu upnate uh ka khawlsak hi. Amaute tungah hehlua mahmah ka hih manin gamdang nangawnah pai-in thu umte ka bawlsia hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4-5"},"12":{"text":"“Hih thu hang mahin siampi liante tung panin thu ngahna lai tawh Damaskas khua-ah ka va pai hi.","title":"Paul in A Kikheelna Thu Gen (Sawl 9:1-19 ; 22:6-16)"},"13":{"text":"Tua hi a, kumpipa aw, Damaskas khua ka tunma sun laitakin kei leh ka tonpih mite’ kiimah sun sangin a taangzaw khuavak khat vantung panin hong taangzaih hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka vekpi-un leilakah ka puk uh a, tua laitakin kei kiangah Hebru pau tawh thu hong kigen a, ‘Saul, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam? Bawngtal in a hawlte’ ciangzum peek le na a sakzawk bangin kei’ thu nong nial manin nang a dingin nazaw hi,’ hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"‘Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?’ ci-in ka dot ciangin Topa in, ‘Na hong bawlsiat Jesuh ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in tho-in na khe-in ding in. Keima na a sem dingin a hong sawl dingin nang tungah a hong kilang ka hi hi. Tuni-a kei nong muhna thuteng le nang tungah ka hong lah lai ding thu khempeuh, midangte tungah a gen ding na hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel mite le Gentail mite lakah nang kong sawl ding a, amaute in nang hong suksiat loh nadingun ka hong kem ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasian’ teel mite’ omna mun a amau om nading mun sanah hong om theih nadingun keimah hong upna uh tawh a mawhna uh a kimaisak theihna dingin Satan’ khutsung panin Pasian’ khut sungah a heikhia ding le khuamial panin khuavak lamah hei-in a mit uh khua a musak ding pa na hi hi,’ a hong ci hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tua bang hi a, kumpi Agrippa aw, ka maangmuhna sunga vantung pana hong pai pa’ thugen ka mang hi.","title":"Jew mite le Gentail mite tungah A Thuhilhna Paul in Gen"},"20":{"text":"Mite a mawhna uh panin kisikin Pasian kiang a zuat nading uh le a kisikna uh a kilatsak nadingun a gamtat ding uh a masa-in Damaskas khua-ah thu hilhin, a zomin Jerusalem khua-ah, tua ciangin Jew mite omna gam khempeuh le Gentail mite lakah thu ka hilh hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:20,28-29"},"21":{"text":"Hih bangin ka thuhilhna hangin biakinn sungah ka om laitakin Jew mite in hong manin thah hong sawm uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in tuni ciang dong hong huh ahih manin milian mineu, a kuamah peuh tungah thu a hilh ka hi hi. Keima thuhilhte pen kamsangte le Moses in hong tung ding hi, ci-in a gen thute mah ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua thu in: Khrih pen sihna thuakin a hingkik masa pa hi ding a, Jew mite le Gentail mite tungah hotkhiatna khuavak thu a hong gen pa hi ding hi, cihna thu ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 42:6; 49:6; 1Kor 15:20"},"24":{"text":"Hih bangin amah kiphelna thu Paul in a gen ciangin Festas in, “Paul aw, mihai na hita hi. Na pil sinnateng in mihai hong suaksak ta hi,” ci-in nakpitakin a kiko hi.","title":"Agrippa in Thu a Up nading Paul in Zolbawl"},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin Paul in, “Menzi Festas aw, mihai ka hi kei a, lungsim pilin thuman a gen ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawn khit ciangin,"},"26":{"text":"“Kumpi Agrippa aw, hih thu khempeuh na theihsa ahih manin nangma mai-ah hangtakin thu ka gen ngam hi. Hih thu pen kuama theih lohna munsimtham a thupiang hi lo ahih manin, a vekpi-in theikhin dingin ka hong um hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpi Agrippa aw, kamsangte’ thugente um hi lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Agrippa in Paul kiangah, “Hih hun tomno sungin Khristian hong suaksakzo dingin kingaihsun na hi hiam?” a cih ciangin"},"29":{"text":"Paul in, “Nangmah a kipan tuni-a ka thugen a za mi khempeuh hun tomno sung ahi a, hunsau sungin ahi zongin, hih bangin sikkhau hong kikhihna simloh, keimah nong batkim nadingun Pasian kiangah thu ka ngen hi,” a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpi Agrippa le menzi Festas hong ding uh a, Bernis le a tutpih midangte zong hong ding khia uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Amaute a paikhiat khit uh ciangin, “Hih mipa in thongkiat nading ahi a, sih nading ahi zongin a thuak nadingin bangmah om lo hi,” a kici uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Agrippa in Festas kiangah, “Gam uk kumpipa Sisar’ tungah a zu na khan khin hikeileh khah ding hi lel hi,” a ci hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Italy gamah teembaw tawh ka pai ding uh thu a khenkhit uh ciangin Paul le thongkia dangte pawlkhat, “Kumpipa’ Galkapte,” a kici Rom galkapte a uk bu Julias’ khut sungah a ap uh hi.","title":"Rom khua Zuan dingin Teembaw tawh Paul Kipaipih"},"2":{"text":"Adramittium khua teembaw khawlna panin Asia gam lam manawh dingin a kithawi teembaw-ah tuangin ka ding khia uh hi. Masedonia gam Thesalonika khuami Aristarkhas in zong kote hong zui hi."},"3":{"text":"A zing ciangin Sidon khua ka tung uh a, Paul tungah bu Julias dik mahmah ahih manin a lawmte tawh a kimu ding le a lawmte in a kisapnate a piaktheih nadingin a paikhiasak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua lai panin ka ding leuleu uh a, huih in hong maiphut ahih manin Saipras tuikulh pang beelin ka pai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Silisia le Pamfilia gam tawh a kizom tuipi kantanin ka pai uh a, Lysia gam Myra khua ka tung uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua lai panin bupa in Alexandria khua pan Italy gam a manawh ding teembaw khat hong mu ahih manin tua teembaw tungah kote hong tuangsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua lai panin ni tampi sung damdamin ka pai uh a, haksapipi-in Nidas khuapi santak ka tung uh hi. Tua lai panin ka paisuaknop uh hangin huih kiphuzo nawn lo ahih manin Krete tuikulh beelin ka sukpai uh a, Salmone leidawk gei tawnin ka paisuak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuipi gei neh cintenin ka pai uh a, Lasia khua tawh a kigamla lo, Khawlmun Nuam a kici khua khat, haksapipi-in ka tung leuleu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua lai-ah ni tampi sung taam ka hih manun Mawhmaisak Ni hun nangawn khengkhin ahih manin teembaw tawh pai lai ding lauhuai ta hi. Tua ahih manin Paul in amaute kiangah,"},"10":{"text":"“Lawmte aw, tu-in teembaw tawh khualzin ding lauhuai ta a, teembaw le a vanpuakte a siat gen loh, mihing mahmah in zong i sihlawh ding lauhuai hi,” ci-in a ngaihsutna a gen hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin galkap bupa in Paul’ thugen sangin teembaw ukpa le teembaw nei pa’ thugen umzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Phalbi hun sungteng tua ka khawlna mun uh belh dingin hoih lo ahih manin, mi tampite’ ngaihsutna-ah, paikhia-in ahih theih le Foenik teembaw khawlna ciang tunzawh nading hanciam ding hoihsa uh hi. Tua lai mun pen Krete tuikulh-ah teembaw khawlna khat hi a, khang nitumna pan sak nitumna lam a nga teembaw khawlna ahih manin phalbi hun sungteng nuamtakin tua lai-ah a ki-om thei ding ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Leitaw lam panin huih hong nun’ hiauhiau ciangin ei’ deihna bang hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin teembaw khihna sikkawipi kaikhiato uh a, Khawlmun Nuam panin Krete tuikulh a kineh thei zahzahin nehkawmin ka pai uh hi.","title":"Tuipi tungah Huihpi Tuahna"},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin a sawt kihal loin, “Leilu Nisuahna Huihpi,” a kici huihpi hat mahmah khat tuikulh lam panin hong nung hi."},"15":{"text":"Teembaw hong mutgawpsak ahih manin nangzo nawn lo a, cih nading kithei nawn lo ahih manin ama hong mutna tuipi lamah ka zui lel uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Kauda tuikulh leitaw lampang san ka tun uh ciangin tua tuikulh in huihpi tawm khat hong dal ahih manin, teembaw tawh a kikhihkhawm gunkuang a siatloh nadingin haksapipi-in ka huzo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Teembaw tungah gunkuang a koih khit uh ciangin, teembaw a kitapkhak leh cihna-in a kimkotah khauhual tawh a gak uh hi. Libya gam tui daina sehnel lakah awk kha ding, ci-in lau uh ahih manin teembaw puanzaak khiasuk uh a, huih mutna tawh damdamin a paisak uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Huihpi dai thei tuan lo ahih manin a zing ciangin teembaw puak vante tui sungah a lawnkhia uh hi."},"19":{"text":"A thai ciangin teembaw vanzatte pawlkhat, a khut mahmah uh tawh tui sungah khia leuleu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ni tampi sung ni ahi a, aksi ahi zongin mu loin huihpi nakpitakin hong nung tawntung ahih manin suahtak zawh nading lametna peuhmah om nawn lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Teembaw hawlte an ne loin sauveipi a omkhit uh ciangin amaute mai-ah Paul hong ding a, “Lawmte aw, keima thugen hong mangin Krete tuikulh panin a paikhia lo hi lehang, hih siatna le supna khempeuh tawh i kipelh ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in note lunghimawh kei un. Teembaw sia bek ding a, mihing a si kuamah om lo ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kei tawh a kipawl ka biak Pasian’ vantungmi, tuzanin ka kiangah hong pai a,"},"24":{"text":"‘Paul aw, lunghimawh kei in. Gam uk kumpipa mai-ah na ding ding a, Pasian in nang hong hehpih ahih manin nang le na khualzinpihte khempeuh na suakta ding uh hi,’ hong ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih manin lawmte aw, kuamah lunghimawh kei un. Kei tungah hong gen bangin hong piangsak ding hi, ci-in Pasian ka muang hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuikulh gei khat peuhpeuhah huih in hong tun hamtang ding hi,” a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua bangin huihpi’ mutin Mediterranean tuipi tungah teembaw tawh ka laam zawh uh a zan sawm le li zankim laitakin lei tawh kinaita hi hang, ci-in teembaw hawlte in a ummawh uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Khau mongah sik khihin tui thukna a teh uh ciangin pi za le sawmnih thuk a, a den zek ciangin teh leuleu-in pi sawmkua a thuk hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka teembaw uhleh suang a kitahkhak ding lau uh ahih manin teembaw nunglam panin teembaw khawlsakna sikkawipi li khiasuk uh a, khuavak ding ngakin ka om uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Teembaw panin teembaw hawlte taikhiat sawm uh ahih manin teembaw tung panin gunkuang khiasuk uh a, teembaw mailam panin a khawl nading sikkawipi a khiasuk ding kineih uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi zongin Paul in galkap bupa le galkapte kiangah, “Teembaw hawlte teembaw tungah hong om nawn kei leh na suaktazo kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahih manin galkapte in gunkuang a kikhihna khau sattatin a khahkhia uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Khua a vak kuan ciangin mite in an a nek nadingun Paul in hanthawn a, “An ne lo tui dawn loin lungkhamin na omzawh uh tu-in ni sawm le li a phak ni hi ta hi."},"34":{"text":"An na nek nadingun ka hong thum hi. An ne loin na nungta zo kei ding uh hi. Tutungin bangmah na ci peuhmah kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Hih bangin thu a gen khit ciangin Paul in anlum la a, amaute khempeuh mai-ah Pasian tungah a lungdamna ko-in a anlum balnenin ne dingin a kipan hi."},"36":{"text":"Amaute khempeuh zong a lungsim uh hong nuam a, an a ne ciat uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua teembaw sunga om mi a vekpi-in zanih le sawmsagih le guk ka pha uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in an a kinek khit ciangin teembaw a zan nadingin a sunga mangbuhte a lawnkhia uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Khua hong vak ciangin koi lai gam hiam, cih teembaw hawlte in thei tuan lo uh hi. Ahi zongin tuidawk le a gei-a leilak mu uh a, ahih theih leh tua lai-ah teembaw khawlsak dingin a ngaihsun uh hi.","title":"Teembaw Siatna"},"40":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin teembaw khihna sikkawipi khaute sattatin tui sungah khiasuk uh a, teembaw heina a kizang sing peekpi khihna khaute zong a sut uh hi. Tua ciangin huih in hong mutin tui gei lamah ka pai theih nadingun a mailam a teembaw puan a sang khai uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahi zongin teembaw in sehnel hong phukha-in a tum hi. Teembaw mailam lei sungah tumin taang thei nawn lo a, teembaw nunglam pen tuihual in hong satkham gawp hi."},"42":{"text":"Thongkia mi khempeuh tui peekin a taimang ding uh lau uh ahih manin galkapte in thongkiate thah a sawm uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Ahi zongin galkap bupa in Paul suaktasak nuam ahih manin tua bangin a thah ding uh a kham hi. Tua ahih manin tuipeek thei khempeuh in teembaw panin a nawlah tui va peekin,"},"44":{"text":"adangte in teembaw sing kitamte lenin a om nadingin thu a pia zaw hi. Tua bangin ka vekpi-un tui gei-ah ka suakta uh hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leilak ka tunkim khit uh ciangin tua mun pen Malta tuikulh ahihna thu ka thei uh hi.","title":"Malta Tuikulh-ah Paul’ Tuahkhak Thu"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai-a teng mite ko tungah hong nuam mahmah uh hi. Guahzu-in khua dam mahmah ahih manin meiphualpi hong cihsak uh a, limtakin zin hong do uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in singkang pawlkhat khawmin meipi tungah hong koih a, a mei sa sa ahih manin gul khat hong taikhia-in Paul’ khut a vial hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua lai-a teng mite in Paul’ khut tunga gul kivial a muh uh ciangin, “Hih mipa pen mi that hi takpi ding hi. Ahi zongin sauveipi enenin, Paul tungah thu lamdang a piang bangmah a muh loh uh ciangin a lungsim uh kikheel a, “Hih mipa pen pasian ahi hi,” a ci leuleu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua lai panin a gamla lo mun khatah tua tuikulh hausa pa Publias’ lo a om hi. Amah in limtakin kote zin hong do a, ni thum sung ama zinin ka om uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Publias’ pa cisa nat leh gilsan thuahin cina-in lupna tungah a lum hi. A zing ciangin leitaw lam panin huih nun ding hong kipan a, ni nih sungin Puteoli khua ka tung uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua khua-ah thu um mi pawlkhat tawh ka kimu uh a, nipikal khat sung hong taam un, ci-in hong kho uh hi. Tua bang danin Rom khua ka tung uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Rom khua-a om ulenaute in kote’ thu na za uh ahih manin pawlkhat in, “Appias Sumbuk,” ciang dong hong dawn uh a, pawlkhat in “Ansai Thumna,” ciang hong ban uh hi. Paul in amaute a muh ciangin Pasian tungah a lungdamna ko a, a lungsim hong nuam mahmah hi."},"16":{"text":"Rom khua ka tun khit uh ciangin Paul pen ama ututna-ah a om theih nadingin thu kipia a, a taikhak loh nadingin galkap khat bek kicingsak hi.","title":"Paul in Rom khua-ah Thu Hilh"},"17":{"text":"A tunzawh ni thum khit ciangin Paul in Jew makaite sam a, amaute hong kikhop ciangin amah in, “Ute naute aw, i mipihte tung ahi a, i pu i pate’ ngeina tawh kisai-in ahi zongin khialhna bangmah nei lo napi-in Jerusalem khua-ah hong kimanin thongah hong kikoih a, Rom kumpite’ khut sungah hong ki-ap hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei thu hong sit uh ciangin sihna ka thuak nading thu bangmah om lo ahih manin hong khahkhia nuam uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi zongin kei hong kikhah ding thu-ah i Jew mipihte a lungkim loh uh ciangin i mipihte tungah mawhsak nading thu bangmah ka neih loh hangin gam uk kumpipa Sisar tungah a zu ka khan loh hong phamawh hi.","ref":"Sawl 25:11"},"20":{"text":"Israel mite in a lamet uh mipa’ hangin sikkhau khihna thuakin thongkia mi ka suak hi. Hih thute khempeuh note kiangah hong gennuam ka hih manin a hong samsak ka hi hi,” a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in, “Judea gam panin nangma thu tawh kisai-in lai bangmah ka ngah kei uh a, tua gam panin a hong pai i mipihte tung panin zong nang hong kimawhsakna kam ahi zongin bangmah ka za kei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-a nangma kipawlna mite’ thu pen a koimah peuhah mi khempeuh in gensia uh ahih manin nangma ngaihsutna taktak ka zanuam uh hi,” a ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Paul tawh a kimuh nading uh a ni khat seh uh a, tua a kiciam ni-un Paul a zintunna munah Jew mite tampi tak a kikhawm uh hi. Paul in zingsang a kipan nitak dongin amaute tungah Pasian’ Ukna thu gentel a, Jesuh’ thu man hi, ci-in a uptheih nadingun Moses Thukham le kamsangte’ laigelhte siksanin a gen hi."},"24":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in Paul’ thugente um uh a, ahi zongin pawlkhat in um lo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Paul in, “Kha Siangtho in kamsang Isaiah tungtawnin na pu na pate uh tungah a thugen man mahmah hi. Tua a genna-ah, ‘Pai inla, hih mite tungah hih bangin va gen in: Thu na ngaihngaih uh hangin na tel kei ding uh a, na etet uh hangin na mu kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite lungsim mawk a, a bil uh humcip uh a, mitsicip uh hi. Tua bang hi kei le-uh, a mit un khua mu ding a, a bil un khua za ding a, a lungsim un thu mu thei ding hi. Tua bang hileh kei lamah hong kihei ding uh a, keimah in amaute ka damsak ding hi,’ ci-in a gen hi,” a cih khit ciangin amaute khatlekhat kithutuak loin a paikhia uh hi.","merge":"27","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Paul in, “Tua ahihleh tu-in Gentail mite tungah Pasian’ hotkhiatna thu kigen ta ding hi. Amaute in um ding uh hi. Hih thu hoihtakin thei un,” ci-in a thugenna a khum hi."},"29":{"text":"(Paul in hih thu a gen khit ciangin Jew mite khatlekhat kitawng gawpin a ciah uh hi.)"},"30":{"text":"Paul kum nih sung ama saptawm inn sungah amah bekin om a, ama kiangah a hawh khempeuh tawh thu a kikum hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in Pasian’ Ukna thu le Topa Jesuh Khrih’ thu, hangtakin a ututin genin a hilh hi."}}}}},"45":{"info":{"name":"Rom","shortname":"Rom","abbr":[],"desc":"Rom Khua Khristiante Tungah Paul' Laikhak pen Rom khua-a a om pawlpite kiangah hawhsawm ahih manin Paul in a gelh ahi hi. Ama gelna pen, tua lai-a a om Khristiante lakah tawlkhat na a sep khit ciangin amaute' huhna mah tawh Spain gamah paisuak lai ding ahi hi. Khristian upna thu leh tua upna pen Khristiante nuntakna-ah a kizatna zia dingte ama theihna tawh kizui-in a gentelna dingin a gelh ahi hi. Paul' thugen a thupiteng khempeuh hih laibu sungah a cingtakin a om hi. Rom khua-a om pawlpite hopihna leh amaute-a' ding thu a ngetsaknate a gen khit ciangin a laikhak a ngimna bulpi ahi, a kipata kipan a tawp dongin upna hangin mite, amah tawh a kipawl thei dingin Pasian in hong bawl hi (1:17), cihna thu Paul in a gen hi. Tua ciangin Paul in a thu bulphuh a kicingin a gen hi. Jew mi leh Gentail mi, mi khempeuh a kibangin mawhna khutnuai-ah om ahih manin Pasian tawh a kipawlkik theih ding kisam hi. Mite in Jesuh Khrih a upna uh hangin Pasian tawh kipawlkik thei uh hi. Tua ciangin Pasian tawh kipawl thakna hangin Khrih thu sungah nuntak thakna thu a gen hi. Thu um mite, Pasian tawh kilem uh a, mawhna leh sihna khutnuai panin Pasian' Kha Siangtho in a suaktasak hi. A lian 5-8 sungah Pasian' Thukham a deihna leh thu um mite' nuntakna-ah Kha Siangtho in vang a neihna thu zong Paul in a gen hi. Tua ciangin mihingte-a' dingin Pasian' gelna sungah Jew mite leh Gentail mite a lutkhawm theihna dingzia a gen hi. Jew mite in Jesuh a nialna pen Jesuh Khrih' hangin Pasian' hehpihna thupha in minam khempeuh a battheihna dingin Pasian' gelna ahihna, leh Jew mite in a tawntungin Jesuh a nial paisuak lohna ding a upna thu tawh a khum hi. A tawpna-ah Khristiante bangci nuntak ding, a diakdiakin itna thu tawh kisai-in midangte tawh bangci kizop ding cih thu Paul in a gelh hi. Pasian' nasepna ding thu, Khristiante a hong uk kumpite tung leh khatlekhat tungah tavuan a neihna uh, leh eima lungsim-ah man i sak pen bangin i gamtat ding thute a gen hi. Tua ciangin ama aituam thugenna leh Pasian phatna thute tawh a laigelh a khum hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian kiang panin a hong pai Lungdamna Thu a hilh dingin Pasian’ teelna tawh sawltak ahi, Jesuh Khrih’ sila keimah Paul in lai ka hong khak hi.","title":"Hopihna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian in kamsangte tungtawnin hih Lungdamna Thu a gensa hi a, Lai Siangtho sungah a omsa thu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua thu pen eite’ Topa Jesuh Khrih ahi ama Tapa’ thu ahi hi. Tua Tapa pen leitung silesa lam panin David’ suan hi a,"},"4":{"text":"Kha Siangtho thu lamsangah ci lehang misite lak panin vangliatna tawh a thawhsakkikna hangin Pasian’ Tapa ahihna thu Pasian in a kilangsak hi."},"5":{"text":"Minam khempeuh in ama thu umin a zuihtheih nadingun Khrih hangin sawltak nasep sep theih nading hamphatna thu Pasian in Khrih’ na sep nadingin kote a hong pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian’ sapna za-in Jesuh Khrih tawh a kipawl Rom khua-a a om note khempeuh zong tua minamte sungah a kihel na hi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in hong it a, ama mi dingin a hong sap, no Rom khua-a a om Khristiante khempeuh tungah lai ka hong khak hi. I Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen."},"8":{"text":"Jesuh na upna thu uh leitung mi khempeuh in gen belin nei uh ahih manin tua Jesuh hangin Pasian tungah ka lungdamna thu koh belin ka nei hi.","title":"Rom khua-ah Paul A Painopna"},"9":{"text":"Ama Tapa hangin Lungdamna Thu ka lungsim khempeuh tawh hilhin a na ka sep Pasian in hih ka thugente a man taktak ahihna thu hong thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Thu ka nget simin note ka hong phawk tawntungna le ama deihna ahih nakleh khatvei teitei ciangin note kiangah ka hong paitheih nading ka utna thu Pasian in a thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Kha thu-ah note na thahat theih nadingun Pasian in a hong piak thuphate hong genpih nuam ka hih manin note tawh kimuh ding ka ut mahmah hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bang ka cih ciangin kei’ upna in note hong thakhauh sakin, note’ upna in zong kei hong thakhauh sakin, phattuamna i ngah tuak theih nading ka deihna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Khrih sungah sanggamte aw, Gentail midangte lakah thu um mi ka ngah mah bangin note lakah zong ngah ding lametna tawh note kiangah pai ding tam veipi ka geel zel hangin ka hong pai theih lohna thu nong theih ding uh ka ut hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"14":{"text":"Nuntakna sang mite le nuntakna niam mite, mipilte le mihaite, a kuamah peuh ka huh ding ka tavuan ahih manin,"},"15":{"text":"Rom khua-a a om note tungah zong Lungdamna Thu hilh ding ka lawp mahmah hi."},"16":{"text":"Lungdamna Thu ka muang mahmah hi. Tua thu pen a masa-in Jew mi, tua zomin minam dangte, thu um mi khempeuh a honkhiazo Pasian’ vangliatna ahi hi.","title":"Lungdamna Thu A Vangliatna","ref":"Mrk 8:38"},"17":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah, “Pasian a upna hangin amah tawh pawlkhat ahi mite nungta ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin Pasian in amah tawh a kipawl theih nadingin mite a bawlna zia, lungdamna thu in hong kilangsak hi. Tua pen, a patna panin a tawp dongin upna hang bek tawh ahihna thu hong laktel hi.","ref":"Hab 2:4"},"18":{"text":"Mihingte in a mawhna le a gitlohna hangun Pasian’ thuman seelcip uh ahih manin van panin a hehna hong kilang sakin a gimpiakna dingzia hong kilangsak hi.","title":"Mi Khempeuh Mawh"},"19":{"text":"Pasian mahmah in amaute tungah limtakin laktel ahih manin Pasian’ thu teltakin a theih khit uh ciangin a gamtatna uh ahih manin Pasian in gim a pia ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasian in leitung a piansak cil a kipanin a kimu thei lo ama pianzia ahi tawntung vanglianpa le Pasian ahihna thute ama bawlsa nate tung panin teltakin hong kilang hi. Tua ahih manin, “Thei kei ing,” ci-in paulap a zontheih nading uh om lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian thei napi-in a zahtak dingun a kilawm bangin zahtak loin, a tungah a lungdam dingun a kilawm bangin lungdam lo uh hi. Amaute in thuhoih ngaihsun nuam lo uh a, a ngaihsutnate uh a mawknapi a suak hi.","ref":"Efe 4:17-18"},"22":{"text":"Amaute pil a kisak mahmah uh hangin a hai mahmah uh ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"A hing tawntung Pasian bia loin, mi, vasa, ganhing, ahih kei leh a bokvak ganhingte tawh a kibang limte a bia zawsop uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:16-18"},"24":{"text":"Mihingte tua zahta-in hailua uh ahih manin amau ututin a gamtat theih nadingun Pasian in khahkhong vet a, a zumhuai mahmahpi-in a gamta uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in a man ahi Pasian’ thu um nuam lo uh a, a tawntungin phat dingin a kilawm a Piangsak pa bia loin, Pasian’ bawlsa nate bia-in a zui uh hi. Tu-a bangin hi takpi uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih manin amau utna bangin a zumhuaipi-in a gamtat theih nadingun Pasian in a khahkhong hi. A numeite un pasal tawh lupkhop ngeina zang loin a numeipihte mah uh lunggulhin lumkhawm uh a,"},"27":{"text":"a pasalte uh zong numei tawh lumkhawm loin pasalte mah lunggulhin lumkhawm uh a, a zumhuaipi-in a gamta uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute’ gamtatsiatna tawh kituakin Pasian in gim a pia hi."},"28":{"text":"Mite in a man ahi Pasian’ thu ngaihsutin nei nuam lo uh ahih manin amaute’ ngaihsut hoih lo bangin a gamtat theih nadingun Pasian in a khahkhia hi. Tua ahih manin a gamtat dingun a kilawm lopipi-in a gamta uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Siatna nam khempeuh ahi, hoih lohna, huaihamna, khatlekhat kisiatsak nopna, hazatna, mi thahna, kitotna, khemna, a sialam bekbek ngaihsutna, zuau genna,"},"30":{"text":"mi gensiatna, Pasian muhdahna, midangte a heh theih a maizum theih nadingin gamtatna, kiphatsakna, kisialhna, thusia bawlna, nu le pate’ thu man lohna,"},"31":{"text":"gamtatsiatna, ciampelna, midangte khual lo, hehpihna nei loin, a sia namkim a gamta uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua bangin a gamtate in sihna thuak ding hi, ci-in Pasian’ thukhenna thei napi-in, tua bangin amaute a gamtat uh banah, tua bangin a gamtate pakta-in a awi zawsop lai uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin midangte’ thu a khen note pen kuakua hita le-uh cin na suakta tuan kei ding uh hi. Midangte na mawhsakna uh thute mah note zong gamta veve na hih manun, no zong a mawh mah na hi uh hi.","title":"Pasian in Mi Khempeuh’ Thu A Manin Khen","ref":"Mat 7:1; Luk 6:37"},"2":{"text":"Tua bang mawhna a gamtate, Pasian in gim a piak pen a man mah ahihna i thei ciat hi."},"3":{"text":"Midangte a mawhna hangin thu khenin, no zong tua amau mawhnate mah na bawl veve uh ciangin Pasian’ thukhenna tawh kipelh tuan dingin ki-um peuhmah na hi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Pasian migi-in thu a diah hithiatna pen na kisikkik theih nading uh a deihna ahih lamtak phawkkha loin, a migitna, a lungduaina, a hong thuaknate neu ngaihsutkha na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Lungsim khauhin na kisik nop lohna hangun Pasian’ hehna le a manin a thukhenna a hong kilat Ni ding ciangin na gimthuak ding uh a nasia semsem dingin a bawl na hi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in mi khempeuh a gamtatna uh tawh kizui-in thukkik ding hi.","ref":"La 62:12; Pau 24:12"},"7":{"text":"Pahtakna, minthanna, le hin tawntungna deihin a gamtat hoih tawntung mite tungah Pasian in nuntak tawntungna pia ding a,"},"8":{"text":"ahi zongin ama deihna bek zui-in, a gamtat dingin a kilawm bangin gamta loin, a man loin a gamta mite tungah Pasian in ama hehna hangin gimna tungsak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Jew mi a kipan Gentail mi dongin a gamtat sia mi khempeuh in gimna le lungkhamna thuak ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Jew mi a kipanin Gentail mi dongin a gamtat hoih mi khempeuh in minthanna, pahtawina, le nopsakna ngah ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in kuamah deidan loin mi khempeuh tungah a kibangin thu a khen hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"12":{"text":"Moses Thukham a nei lo Gentail mite a khialh uh ciangin thukham nei lopi mahin siatna thuak uh a, Moses Thukham a nei Jew mite a khialh uh ciangin tua thukham tawh kizui-in amaute tungah thu kikhen hi."},"13":{"text":"Thukham zakna bek hangin Pasian tawh kipawlna a piang hi lo a, thukham sunga Pasian’ genna bangin a gamtate bek Pasian tawh a kipawl thei ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Gentail mite in thukham a neih loh uh hangin amau’ ngaihsut tawmna tawh thukham’ deihna bang a gamtat uh ciangin tua thukham’ deihna a zui uh hi a, thukham a neih loh uh hangin a gamtat dingun a kilawm amau mahmah in a thei tawm uh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Amau’ lungsim sungah thukham’ deihnate omkhin ahihna thu a gamtatna un hong kilangsak hi. Amau mahmah zong khat veivei hoih kisa, khat veivei sia kisa uh ahih manin, amau’ lungsim sungah thukham’ deihnate theihna omkhin ahihna thu, hih amau’ kiphawk tawmna lungsim in nakpitakin hong kitelsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in mihingte lungsim sunga a ngaihsutnate uh, Jesuh Khrih thu a khensak Ni ciangin, tu-a ka hong gen bang teekteekin a hong piang ding ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in Jew mi ka hi uh, a ci note in thukham suan belin nei-in Pasian na theihna uh na kisialhpih uh hi.","title":"Thukham in Jew mite A Sukkhakna Zia"},"18":{"text":"Thukham thei na hih manun Pasian’ deihnate na thei uh a, a man le a man lo na khenthei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mittawte lam a lak ding, khuamial sunga om mite khuavak a musak ding,"},"20":{"text":"mihaite a hilh ding, naupangte a hilh dingte ihi a, thukham sunga om thu khempeuh thei-in i gen khempeuh man mahmah hi, ci-in na kimuang uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Midangte a hilh note in, nomau mah kihilh lo ding na hi uh hiam? “Guta kei un,” ci-in mi hilh napi-in nomau mahmah guta hi lo na hi uh hiam?"},"22":{"text":"“Numei tawh mawh kei un,” ci-in mi hilh napi-in nomau mahmah mawh hi lo na hi uh hiam? Milimte mudah napi-in milim biakna inn sunga nate gu hi lo na hi uh hiam?"},"23":{"text":"Note in thukham kisaktheihpih napi-in thukham palsatin Pasian’ min na daisak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah, “No Jew mite’ hangin Gentail mite lakah Pasian kigensia hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 52:5"},"25":{"text":"Thukham zui le-uhcin na vun atna uh man nei takpi mah hi. Ahi zongin thukham na zuih kei uhleh na vun atna uh a mawkna a suak ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih manin vun ki-at lo Gentail mite in thukham a zuih nak-uhleh Pasian in vun at mah bangin ngaihsun ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih manin thukham nei-in vun ki-at napi-in tua thukham a zui lo no Jew mite pen vun ki-at lo thukham a zui Gentail mite in thu hong khen ding hi lo ahi uh hiam?"},"28":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a pualam beka Jew mi hihna le a pualam vun ki-atna lel bek in Jew mi taktak suaksak zo lo hi."},"29":{"text":"Jew mi taktak i cihte pen, a sunglamah Jew mi ahite ahi hi. A vun ki-atna uh lungsim vun atna hi a, kha thu tawh a kisai ahi hi. Thukham zui-in pumpi tung vun atna pawl hi lo hi. Hih bang mite pen mihingte in phat loin Pasian in phatin a pakta hi.","ref":"Thkna 30:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Jew mite in Gentail mite sangin bang hamphatna neizaw a, vun ki-atna in bang phattuamna nei ahi hiam?"},"2":{"text":"Lam tampi-ah a phattuamna a om hi. A masa penin, Pasian in Jew mite tungah ama thute a gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin Jew mi pawlkhatte in Pasian’ thuciamna zui lo uh hi. Hih mi pawlkhatte’ thu palsatna hangin Pasian in a thuciamna maimangsak dingin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Tua bang hi het lo hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, “Thu na gen peuhmah ciangin a man na genna thu mite in hong thei ding uh a, mite in nang hong mawhsakna na genkik ciangin na kiphellah ding khat beek om lo ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin mi khempeuh in zuau a gen zongin Pasian in thuman gen veve ding hi.","ref":"La 51:4"},"5":{"text":"Pasian a manin gamta ahihna eite’ gamtat khialhna in kilangsak semsem ahih ciangin eite in bang gen ding nei nawn ihi hiam? Pasian in eite gim a hong piak ciangin a thuman lo ahi hiam? (Hih bangin thu ka gen ciangin leitung mihingte’ kammal zat ngeite a zang ka hi hi.)"},"6":{"text":"Gim hong piakna-ah a thuman lo hi het lo hi. A thuman lo hi zenzen leh bangci-in leitung mi khempeuh’ thu khenthei ding ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Keima zuautatna in Pasian a thumanna kilangsakin a min thangsak semsem ahihleh bang hangin mawhnei-in kei hong kiseh lailai ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Thupha a pian nadingin gamtat sia gamta ni, ci ding ihi hiam? Mi pawlkhatte in tu-a bang teek mahin gen hi, ci-in hong mawhsak uh a, ka heh theihtheih nadingin kam a pau se uh hi. Tua bang mite in amau thuak dingin a kilawm gimna a thuak ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Gentail mite sangin ko Jew mite hamphazaw ka hi uh hiam? Bangmah hamphatna nei tuan lo hi ung. Jew mite le Gentail mite a kibangin mawhna khut sungah om uh hi, ci-in ka gen khinzo hi.","title":"Kuamah A Manin Gamta Tawntung Zo lo"},"10":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah zong, “Pasian’ muhna-ah mi man kuamah om lo a,"},"11":{"text":"a man a thei kuamah om lo a, Pasian tawh kipawl ding a hanciam kuamah om lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Kuamah in Pasian ngaihsutna nei lo uh a, na-a kimang kuamah om lo a, a hoih gamtat kuamah om lo hi.","ref":"La 14:1-3; 53:2-4"},"13":{"text":"A kam uh tawh mi that uh a, a kam uh tawh zuauthu gen uh a, a kampaute uh gulgu tawh kibang hi.","ref":"La 5:9; 140:3"},"14":{"text":"A kam uh tawh mi samsia uh a, gitlohna bek tawh a kidim uh hi.","ref":"La 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Mi that pakpak uh a,"},"16":{"text":"a paina khempeuh uhah lungkhamna a piangsak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Nopna a pian nadingin gamta ngei lo uh a,","ref":"Isa 59:7-8"},"18":{"text":"Pasian zahtak ding ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.","ref":"La 36:1"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kuamah in paulap a zon theih loh nading le mi khempeuh in Pasian’ thukhenna a thuak theih nadingin Thukham a nei mite khempeuh in tua Thukham a zuih ding uh ahihna thu i thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Thukham in mihingte a mawhna kilangsak thei bek ahih manin thukham zuihna hangin kuamah in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ngah zo lo hi.","ref":"La 143:2; Gal 2:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in thukham zuihna hang hi loin thudang khat hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theih nading lampi hong kilangzo a, Thukham le kamsangte in zong hih thu-ah teci a pang uh hi.","title":"Pasian’ Tawh Kipawl Theih Nading"},"22":{"text":"Tua thu in: Jew mi le Gentail mi kuamah a kilamdanna om loin Jesuh Khrih upna hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna a ngah hi.","ref":"Gal 2:16"},"23":{"text":"Mi khempeuh mawh ciat uh a, a hong honkhia Pasian tawh kigamla uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in a hong hehpihna hangin Khrih Jesuh tawh hong tatkhiat manin amah tawh i kipawlthei kik hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama hong sihna hangin mawhna a kimaisak theih nadingin Pasian in Jesuh hong pia a, amah a umte in mawhmaisakna a ngah uh hi. Amah tawh i kipawl theih nading zia hong lahna-in hih bangin Pasian a hong gamta ahi hi. Pasian a lungduaina hangin a beisa hunah i mawhnate hong en khong phot hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuhun ciangin Jesuh a um mi khempeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theih nading le amah thuman ahihna a kilatsak nadingin mihingte’ mawhna tawh kisai-in na hong sem hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahihleh mihingte in i kisialhpih ding bang om ahi hiam? Bangmah om lo hi. Bang bulphuh ding ihi hiam? Thukham zuihna bulphuh ding ihi hiam? Hi lo hi. I upna a bulphuh ding ihi hi."},"28":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theihna pen Thukham zuihzawhna hang hi loin upna hang hi, ci-in i genzo hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian, Jew mite’ Pasian bek hi a, Gentail mite’ Pasian hi lo ahi hiam? Gentail mite’ Pasian zong hi veve hi."},"30":{"text":"Pasian khat bek hi a, a upna uh hangin Jew mite amah tawh a kipawl thei-in a bawl mah bangin Gentail mite zong a upna uh hang mah tawh amah tawh a kipawl thei-in a bawl hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:4; Gal 3:20"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahihleh hih upna thu i gen ciangin Thukham a phiat ihi hiam? Hi lo hi; a kipsak semsem ihi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in eite’ pianna i pupi Abraham’ thu ngaihsun ni. Ama tunga thupiang hih bang ahi hi:","title":"Abraham in Upna A Thupina Hong Langsak"},"2":{"text":"Abraham in a sepna hangin amah tawh a kipawl dingin Pasian in sang hileh Abraham in kisialhpih ding thu a nei ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian’ mai-ah Abraham a kisialh nading bangmah thu om lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah, “Abraham in Pasian um a, tua a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a sang hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Pian 15:6; Gal 3:6"},"4":{"text":"Na a sem mipa a sep thaman kipia hi. Tua a nasepna thaman pen a thalawhsa ahih manin piakkhongin kingaihsutsak lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ maipha ngah nadingin nasepna suang loin upna a suang mipa pen Pasian in mimawh kimlai midik hi, ci-in sang ahih manin, amah tawh a kipawl theih nadingin Pasian in tua mipa’ upna thupi san hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin nasepna hang tawh hi loin Pasian in mi khat midikin a sanna hangin David in zong a lungdamna thu na gen a,"},"7":{"text":"“Pasian in a mawhnate maisakin a khialhnate a seelcipsak mite thupha ngah ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in a mawhnate a ciamtehsak loh mipa, thupha ngah ahi hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 32:1-2"},"9":{"text":"David in a gen hih thupha pen vun ki-atte bek in ngahthei ahi hiam? Hi lo hi; vun ki-at lote in zong ngahthei uh hi. Lai Siangtho in, “Abraham in Pasian um a, tua a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a sang hi,” ci hi, ci-in i gen khinzo hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih mihoihin a san bang hun ahi hiam? Abraham a vun a ki-at ma ahi hiam, a ki-at zawh ahi hiam? A vun a ki-at khit hi loin a ki-at ma ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Abraham a vun a ki-at ma-in a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a sanna lahtel nadingin a vun a kinung-at ahi hi. Tua ahih manin vun a ki-at loh hangin a upna uh hangin mihoihin a kisang mite khempeuh a dingin Abraham pen kha thu lamah pupi ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 17:10"},"12":{"text":"A vun a ki-at ma-in i pupi Abraham a upna hangin a gamtat mah bangin a gamta, a vun a ki-at mite a dingin zong Abraham pen pupi mah ahi hi. Tua pen vun ki-at lelna hang hi loin upna hang ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Abraham le a suan a khakte in leitung luah ding hi, ci-in Pasian in thu a ciamna pen Abraham in Thukham a zuihna hang hi loin, a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a sanna hang ahi hi.","title":"Upna Hangin Pasian’ Thuciamna Kingah","ref":"Pian 17:4-6; 22:17-18; Gal 3:29"},"14":{"text":"Thukham zuihna hangin Pasian’ thuciamnate a kingah ding hileh mite’ upna pen a kimanna om loin, Pasian’ thuciamnate zong a mawkna suak ding hi.","ref":"Gal 3:18"},"15":{"text":"Thukham in Pasian’ heh nading piangsak hi. Ahi zongin thukham om kei leh thukham zui lo cih zong om thei lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Abraham’ suanlekhakte khempeuh tungah Pasian’ hehpihna piakkhong a suahtheih nadingin Thukham a zuite bek in ngah loin, Abraham’ up bangin a umte in zong a ngahtheih nadingun upna bulphuhin thuciamna kipia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Abraham pen kha thu lamah eite khempeuh’ pupi ahi hi.","ref":"Gal 3:7"},"17":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah zong, “Minam tampite’ pupi dingin ka hong bawl khin hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi. Tua hi a, bangmah a om nai lopi a thupiakna tawh a omsak thei, a site a hingsak thei, Abraham in a up Pasian’ muhna-ah hih thuciamna kipin a kizang ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 17:5"},"18":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah, “Na suanlekhakte aksi zahin tam ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin tua bang a piantheih nading lametna a om nai lopi mahin Abraham in umin lamen ahih manin minam tampite’ pupi a suak hi.","ref":"Pian 15:5"},"19":{"text":"Abraham kum zakhat bang pha dektak ta a, a si dektak ta ahihna le a zi Sarah a ciinna thute a theih hangin a upna kiam tuan lo hi.","ref":"Pian 17:17"},"20":{"text":"Amah in Pasian’ thuciamna muanlah dingin ngaihsun lo a, a upna khahsuah het lo hi. A upna hangin thakhauh semsemin Pasian a phat hi."},"21":{"text":"Pasian in a thuciamsa tungsakzo taktak ding hi, ci-in a muang hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin, “A upna pen hoihna-in Pasian in a sang hi,” ci-in kigelh hi."},"23":{"text":"“A upna pen hoihna-in kisang,” ci-in a kigelh ciangin ama a’ ding bekin a kigelh hi lo hi."},"24":{"text":"Sihna panin i Topa Jesuh a hingsak pa a um eite khempeuh zong i upna hangin mihoihin hong kisang ding hi, ci-in eite a dingin zong a kigelh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Eite’ mawhna hangin a si dingin Jesuh kipia a, Pasian tawh eite i kipawl theih nadingin kihingkiksak hi.","ref":"Isa 53:4-5"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in upna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl khinta ihih manin i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin Pasian tawh a kilemkik ta ihi hi.","title":"Pasian tawh Kipawl Khinta"},"2":{"text":"Ama hangin upna tawh tu-a i omna Pasian hehpihna sungah a tung ihi a, Pasian tawh minthanna ngahkhawm ding, ci-in lamen ihih manin i lung a dam hi."},"3":{"text":"Haksatna i thuak laitak nangawnin i lungdam veve hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh haksatna in thuakzawh hatna piangsak a,"},"4":{"text":"thuakzawh hatna in Pasian’ pahtakna hong ngahsak a, ama hong pahtakna in lametna lianpi hong neisak ahihna thu i thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian in eite tungah a hong piak a Kha Siangtho tawh eite sungah ama itna hong guang ahih manin hih lametna in eite hong lungkiasak ngei lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Eite cimawhin i om laitakin Pasian’ hoihsak hunin ei mi gilote a dingin Khrih hong si hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihoih khat a dingin a si ngam a omkha ahi zongin thukham zuizo mipa a dingin sih ngam nading a thu haksa mahmah khat ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin eite mawhna nei ihih laitakin eite a dingin Khrih hong si ahih manin Pasian in eite hong it mahmahna thu hong lak khin hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama sihna hangin tu-in Pasian tawh kipawlthei ihih manin Pasian’ hehna hangin gimna panin zong hong suaktasak zaw kan lai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian tawh eite i kilangneih laitakin ama Tapa’ sihna hangin amah tawh hong kilemsak ahihleh tu-in Pasian tawh kipawl khinta ihih manin Khrih nuntakna in eite hong honkhiazo zaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Tuateng bek hi lo lai a, Pasian tawh hong kilemsak i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin Pasian tungah i nuam mahmah hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi khat hangin leitungah mawhna hong om a, tua mawhna hangin sihna hong piang hi. Mi khempeuh mawh uh ahih manin tu-a bangzia-in mi khempeuh tungah sihna hong tung hi.","title":"Adam le Khrih A Kilamdanna","ref":"Pian 3:6"},"13":{"text":"Thukham a om mapekin leitungah mawhna na omkhin a, thukham a om lohna munah Pasian in mawhna a ciaptehna laibu nei lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin Adam hun a kipan Moses hun dongin sihna in mite uk a, Adam in Pasian’ thupiak a man loh manin a khialh bangin a khial nai lo mite nangawn sihna khutnuai mah hi veve uh hi. Adam pen a hong pai lai ding mipa’ lim ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ hong piak letsong pen Adam’ mawhna tawh kibang lo ahih manin tua tegel tehkak theih ding hi lo hi. Tua mi khat a khialhna hangin mi tampi a sihna pen a man mah ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian’ hong itna le hong hehpihna nakpitakin lianzaw lai a, mi khat ahi tua Jesuh Khrih’ hehpihna hangin mi tampi tak tungah hong kipia letsong lian mahmah hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian’ letsong le mi khat’ mawhna a hatna zia kilamdang hi. Khialhna khat a om khit ciangin, “Mawh hi,” ci-in thukhenna kipia a, ahi zongin khialhna tampi tak a om khit ciangin a kilawm lopi mahin, “Dik hi,” cihna piakkhong thupha a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khat bek’ mawhna hangin sihna in hong uk ahihleh mi khat mah ahi Jesuh Khrih hangin nakpitakin a lian Pasian’ hehpihna le mihoih-a sanna a ngah mite nungta-in thahatzaw kan ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi a, khialhna khat in mi khempeuh tungah thukhenna tungsak ahih mah bangin gamtatna hoih khat mah in mi khempeuh khahin nungtasak hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi khat in thu a man loh manin mi tampi mimawh a suahsak mah bangin mi khat in thu a manna hangin mi tampi in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna a ngah ding uh ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Khialhna a tam semsem nadingin thukham hong kipia hi. Ahi zongin khialhna a tamna munah Pasian’ hehpihna hong lianzaw zel hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mawhna thahatin hong sihsak mah bangin, i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin Pasian’ hehpihna thahat zaw lai a, mihoihin hong sangin nuntak tawntungna sung a hong tunpih hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Pasian’ hehpihna a liattheih nadingin mawhna bawlbawl ding ihi hiam?","title":"Mawhna Thu-ah Si, Khrih Sungah Hing"},"2":{"text":"Tua bang hi dek lo ding hi. Mawhna thu-ah a si eite in bangci-in mawhna bawl thei nawn ding ihi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh tawh i kipawl theih nadingin ama sungah a kiphum eite pen ama sihna mahah zong a sikhawm ihihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam?"},"4":{"text":"I Pa’ vangliatna tawh sihna panin Khrih a kithawhkiksak mah bangin eite zong nuntakna thak i nuntak theih nadingin tui i kiphum ciangin amah tawh kiphum khawmin a sikhawm ihi hi.","ref":"Kol 2:12"},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ama sihna-ah sikhawmin pawlkhat i suah leh amah a thawhkikna-ah zong pawlkhat suakin i thokhawm ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mawhna khutnuai-ah eite i om nawn loh nadingin mawhnopna lungsim i neihnateng i sucip a, singlamteh tungah Khrih a sih laitak mahin i ngeina luiteng a sisak khawm ihihna thu i thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khat a sih ciangin mawhna vangliatna panin a suakta ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin Khrih tawh i sihkhawm leh amah tawh ei zong i hingkhawm ding hi, ci-in i um hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna panin Khrih kihingkiksak khin a, si kik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Ama tungah sihna in vangliatna nei nawn lo hi, ci-in i thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama sihna pen mawhna thu tawh kisai-a sihna hi a, sih kikkik kul loin a kuamah peuh zong khatvei bek a kisi ahi hi. Tu-a a nuntakna pen Pasian’ thu tawh kisai-a nuntakna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua mah bangin note zong Khrih Jesuh tawh kipawlin mawhna thu-ah si-in, Pasian’ thu-ah a nungta-in na kingaihsut ding uh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin na pumpi uh deihna na zuih loh nadingun na pumpi uh, mawhna na uksak nawn kei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mawhna gamtat nadingin na pumpi nate uh khat beek na zang nawn kei ding uh hi. Note pen misi hinapi-in a kihingkiksak mite bang na hih manun, a hoihin a hong zattheih nadingin na pumpi bup uh Pasian’ tungah na piazaw ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Note pen thukham’ sawlna hangin nasem hi loin Pasian’ hong lah thuhoihte’ hangin nasem na hih uh manin mawhna’ sawlna mangin na gamta nawn kei un."},"15":{"text":"Eite pen thukham’ uk hi loin Pasian’ hehpihna in hong uk ahih manin mawhna i gamta kei ding hi.","title":"A Manin A Gamta Dingte Hi Hang"},"16":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh’ thu a mang dingin ama khut sungah na kipiak uh ciangin a thu na mante uh’ sila na hi uh hi. Mawhna na bawl uhleh sihna a thuak ding na hi uh a, thumangin na om uhleh Pasian tawh pawlkhat a suak ding na hi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Nidangin silate bangin mawhna’ thu a mang hinapi-in, tu-in note tungah a hong kipia thuhilhna kipte, na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh zui na hih manun Pasian tungah i lungdam mahmah hi."},"18":{"text":"Mawhna’ vangliatna panin na suakta khinta uh a, a manin a gamta ding mite na hita uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Note’ theihtheih nadingin nisim nuntakna ziate tawh a hong genteh ka hi hi. Nidang lai-in hoih lohna le gitlohna a gamta dingin na pumpi uh na buppiak uh mah bangin, tu-in a man nate a sem dingin na pumpi uh buppiak unla, nuntakna siangtho nei ta un."},"20":{"text":"Mawhna khut sungah na om laitakun Pasian’ deihna bangin na gamtat ding uh kisam lo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin, tuhunin gamtat dingin zumhuai na sakte uh, tuahun lai-in na gamtat manun bang thaman ngah na hi uh hiam? Tua na gamtatna thaman uh sihna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in mawhna bawlnopna panin suakta-in Pasian’ khutsung mi na hita uh hi. Tua thu hangin na ngah uh na pen Pasian a dingin a kipia khin nuntakna hi a, a tawntung nuntakna tawh a kizom ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mawhna in thaman hong piak pen sihna hi a, ahi zongin i Topa Jesuh tawh i kipawl manin Pasian’ hong piakkhong pen nuntak tawntungna ahi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lawmte aw, note khempeuh in thukham thei na hih manun tu-a kong gen dingte na tel mahmah ding uh hi. Mi khat a nuntak sungteng bek thukham in uk thei hi.","title":"Nupa Tawh Gentehna"},"2":{"text":"Gentehna-in, pasal nei numei khat pen a pasal a nuntak sungteng bek, tua thukham in a pasal tawh lencip hi. Ahi zongin a pasal a sih ciangin tua a pasal tawh a lencip thukham panin a suakta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a pasal a nuntak hun sungin pasal dang tawh a lupkhop leh mi tawh a mawh kici hi. Ahi zongin a pasal a si hileh thukham tawh kisai-in a suakta hi a, pasal dang a tenpih hangin mi tawh a mawh hi lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note zong tua mah tawh a kibang na hi uh hi. Khrih tawh pumkhat na hihna uh hangin thukham tawh kisai thu-ah a sikhin na hi uh a, Pasian’ nasepna-ah eite a man nei i suahtheih nadingin sihna panin a kithokiksak Khrih tawh nupa na hi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"I leitung lungsim tawh i nuntak laiteng, thukham hangin i hihnop semsem mawhnopnate i gamta a, tuate khempeuh sihna tawh a kizom ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin nidangin a hong lencip thukham panin Pasian in eite hong suaktasak khin ahih manin tua thukham tawh kisai-ah eite a sikhin ihi hi. Lai sungah a kigelh thukham lui sungah nungta nawn loin, Kha Siangtho’ hong piak nuntakna thakah a nungta ihi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Thukham mahmah pen a siahuai ahi hiam? A sia hi lo hi. Mawhna bang hiam cih Thukham in hong theitel sak hi. Thukham in, “Hazatna lungsim nei kei in,” ci-in gen lo hileh, haza i cih bang ahi hiam, ci-in ka thei kei ding hi.","title":"I Sunga Om Mawhna","ref":"Pai 20:17; Thkna 5:21"},"8":{"text":"Thukham a omna hangin mawhna in nuamtak sa-in hazatna a tuamtuam ka neihtheih nading hong piangsak hi. Thukham om kei leh mawhna in bangmah sem thei lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Thukham ka theih ma-in mi nungta ka hi ngei a, thukham ka theih ciangin mawhnopna lungsim hong khangin kei ka si hi."},"10":{"text":"Nuntak ngah nadingin a kibawl thukham pen keima a dingin sihna hong hi zawsop hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thukham a om manin mawhna in nuamtaksa a, kei hong khemin tua thukham tawh a hong that hi.","ref":"Pian 3:13"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Thukham mahmah hitaleh thupiaknate hitaleh hoihin man a, siangtho hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahihleh a hoih na khat in kei’ sih nading hong piangsak ahi hiam? Hi lo hi. Tua sihna pen mawhna’ nasepna hi a, mawhna pianzia bangci bang taktak hiam, cih a kitheih nadingin a hoih na khat zangin kei tungah sihna a hong piangsak ahi hi. Tua ahih manin thukham a om manin mawhna a siahuai mahmah ahihna hong kilangzaw kan lai hi."},"14":{"text":"Thukham pen i kha thu tawh kisai hi, ci-in i thei hi. Ahi zongin kei pen leitung pumpi tawh a nungta mi ka hi a, mawhna thu mangin a sal a suak ka hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka hihnopteng hihkha loin ka hih nop loh tengkeek mah hih zawsop ka hih manin keima gamtatna mahmah zong ka tel thei kei hi.","ref":"Gal 5:17"},"16":{"text":"Ka hih nop lohteng ka hih veve ciangin Thukham a deihhuai khat hi, ci-in ka ngaihsutna hong langsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tua bangin a gamta taktak pen kei hi loin ka sunga om mawhna hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka leitung pumpi sungah a hoih na khat beek om lo hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Ka sungah a hoih gamtatnopna lungsim a om hangin ka hihzo kei hi."},"19":{"text":"A hoih ka gamtatnop teng gamta loin, ka hihnop loh siatnate ka gamta zawsop hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka gamtat nop lohteng ka gamtat veve ciangin tua a gamta pen kei hi nawn loin ka sunga om mawhna a gamta ahihna a hong kilang hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a hoih gamta nuam hinapi-in a sia bekbek a gamtakha ka hihna ka thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka lungsim tawng taktakah Pasian’ thukham hoih ka sa hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin kei’ deih loh thudang khat in ka lungsimah na hong sem hi. Tua ka sunga na hong sem pen in mawhna thu-ah kei hong mancip hi."},"24":{"text":"Kei pen a lungkham mi ka hita hi. Kei a hong sisak ding hih lungsim lui panin kua in kei hong honkhiazo ding ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"I Topa Jesuh Khrih in hong honkhiazo ding ahih manin Pasian tungah ka lung a dam hi. Kei’ omzia taktak ahihleh: Ka lungsim tawh Pasian’ thu ka zui a, ka pumpi in mawhna a piangsak thu a zui hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh Khrih Jesuh tawh kipawlin a nungta mite pen mawhna thukhenna tawh kipelh hi.","title":"Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ Deihna tawh Nuntakna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih Jesuh tawh a hong kipawlsak Kha Siangtho in mawhna le sihna a piangsak thukham panin kei hong suaktasak khinta hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte thahat lo ihih manin Thukham in ahih zawh loh thute Pasian in a hihzo hi. Mawhna a beisak theih nadingin mihingte sunga om mawhna tungah thu a khenna-in ama Tapa hong sawl a, amah pen mihingte’ mawhna lungsim mah a nei-in a hong pai hi."},"4":{"text":"Eite’ deihna bangin nungta loin Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ deihna bangin a nungta eite sungah Thukham’ deihna teng a kicin theih nadingin Pasian in a Tapa a hong sawl ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amau pumpi deihna bangin a nungtate, amau pumpi deihna in a lungsim uh a uk hi; Kha Siangtho deihna bangin a nungtate, Kha Siangtho in amau lungsim a uk hi."},"6":{"text":"I ngaihsutna, i pumpi deihna uksak lehang sihna tawh kizom hi; i ngaihsutna, Kha Siangtho uksak lehang nuntakna le nopsakna tawh a kizom hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in ama pumpi deihna a ki-uksak ciangin Pasian’ thukhamte zui lo ahih manin Pasian’ gal suak a, a zuihnop hangin zong zui thei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Amau pumpi deihna bangin a gamtate in Pasian lungdamsak thei lo uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Note sungah Pasian’ Kha Siangtho hong om nakleh nomau pumpi deihna bangin gamta loin Kha Siangtho deihna bangin na gamta ding uh hi. Khrih lungsim a nei lote Khrih tawh kipawl lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin note sungah Khrih hong om leh mawhna hangin na pumpi uh a si veve ding ahi zongin, note pen Pasian tawh kipawlkhin na hih manun note a dingin Kha Siangtho pen nuntakna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Sihna panin Jesuh a thokiksak Pasian’ Kha Siangtho note sungah hong om leh sihna panin Khrih a hingkik sakpa mah in note sungah a om ama Kha Siangtho mah tawh a sithei pumpi a hong nungtasak ding hi.","ref":"1Kor 3:16"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin lawmte aw, i pumpi deihna bang zui-in gamtat ding a kiphamawh hi lo hi."},"13":{"text":"Na pumpi uh deihna zui-in na gamtat uhleh na si ding uh a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho huhna tawh na mawh gamtatnate uh na sihsak uhleh na nungta ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian’ Kha Siangtho in a makaih mite, Pasian’ tate ahi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Note tungah Pasian in a hong piak a Kha Siangtho in note na lau nadingun sila-in a hong bawl hi lo a, Kha Siangtho in Pasian’ tate a hong suaksak ahi zaw hi. Tua Kha Siangtho mah in Pasian pen, “Pa aw, Pa aw,” hong ci theisak hi.","ref":"Mrk 14:36; Gal 4:6"},"16":{"text":"Eite, Pasian’ tate ihihna thu eima lungsim bek in a gen hi loin Pasian’ Kha Siangtho in zong hong genpih hi."},"17":{"text":"Eite pen ama ta ihih manin mite a dingin a koih thuphate i ngah banah Khrih a dingin a koihte zong i ngahkhawm lai ding hi.
