Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih in a thuak mah bangin i thuak nakleh amah a minthan’ mah bangin ei zong i minthang ding hi.","ref":"Gal 4:5-7"},"18":{"text":"Tuhuna i thuaknate pen Pasian in a hong piak ding minthanna tawh ka ngaihsut khawm ciangin gentham ka sa het kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian’ bawlsa khempeuh in Pasian’ tate a hong kilahkhiat hun ding lawp mahmahin a ngak uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasian’ bawlsate, amau utthu tawh hi loin siatna a thuak dingin Pasian mahmah in a ngaihsutsa ahi hi. Ahi zongin lametna omlai hi.","ref":"Pian 3:17-19"},"21":{"text":"Pasian’ bawlsate, nikhat ni ciangin muattheih nading thu panin suakta-in Pasian’ tate tawh a nuam suahtakna a ngahkhawm ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuhun ciang dong Pasian’ bawlsa khempeuh nupi nausuak ding bangin na sa-in a tauna uh i thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian’ bawlsa nate bek hi lo a, Pasian’ hong piakkhong Kha Siangtho maleep a ngah eite mahmah nangawn in zong, Pasian in ama tate-in hong bawlin i buppi-in a hong suahtaksak ding i ngakkawmin thumin tau-in i om hi.","ref":"2Kor 5:2-4"},"24":{"text":"Hih bangin lamenin i upna in eite hong honkhia khin hi. Ahi zongin i lamet pen i muh ciangin tua pen lamet hi nawn lo hi. Kua in a muhsa nate lamen nawn ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"I muh lohte i lamet ciangin lungduaitakin i ngak thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih manin eite bangzahin ginalo hitalehang eite a hong huh dingin Kha Siangtho a hong pai hi. Eite in a kilawm bangin thunget ding nangawn i thei kei a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho mah in tauna tawh eite a dingin a hong thumsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Kha Siangtho in Pasian’ deihna tawh kizui-in Pasian’ mite a dingin hong thumsak ahih manin mihingte’ lungsimtawng thu a thei Pasian in Kha Siangtho’ ngaihsutna a thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama deihna bang a sem dingin Pasian in a hong sap, amah a it eite a dingin na khempeuh a hoihlamin piangsak hi, ci-in i thei hi.","title":"A Gualzo Pente"},"29":{"text":"Pasian’ Tapa mi khempeuh lakah a upa pen a suahtheih nadingin Pasian in a teelkholhsa mite, a Tapa tawh a kibang dingin a sehsa ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ama sap mite a sehsa hi a, a sap mite amah tawh a kipawlin bawl a, amah tawh a kipawlin a bawl mite ama minthanna zong a hawm hi."},"31":{"text":"Hih teng bang ahih khit ciangin bang gen ding om nawn ahi hiam? Pasian in eite hong koppih peuh leh kua in eite hong zozo ding ahi hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Ama Tapa nangawn siit loin eite khempeuh a dingin hong piakhia ahih manin, na dang khempeuh zong hong piazaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?"},"33":{"text":"Pasian in mawh lo hi, ci-in a gen khitsa ahih manin, Pasian’ teelsa mite tungah kua in mawhna guanthei nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"34":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kua in amaute tungah thu khenthei nawn ding ahi hiam? Eite a dingin a hong thumsak pa pen Pasian’ taklamah a tu, a sih khit ciangin sihna panin a kihingkiksak Khrih Jesuh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"35":{"text":"Tua ahih manin bangin Khrih’ itna tawh hong kikhensakzo ding ahi hiam? Haksatna, lungkhamna, bawlsiatna, gilkialna, zawnna, lauhuaina, sihnate khat peuhpeuh in hong khenzo ding ahi hiam?"},"36":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah zong, “Note hangin sunthapai-in siat nading lauhuaina ka thuak uh a, gawh ding tuu bangin a hong kibawl hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.","ref":"La 44:22"},"37":{"text":"Eite a hong it pa’ hangin hih thu khempeuhah a gualzo pente ihi hi."},"38":{"text":"Bangmah in ama hong itna tawh hong kikhensakzo het lo ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Sihna, nuntakna, vantung mite, vantung vangliatnate, tuhun nate le a hong tung ding nate,"},"39":{"text":"leitung a om nate, leinuai-a om nate, Pasian’ bawlsa nate khat peuhpeuh in i Topa Khrih Jesuh hangin Pasian in eite hong itna tawh hong khenzo het lo ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei, Khrih tawh kipawl ka hih manin zuauthu ka gen thei kei hi. Kha Siangtho lamlahna tawh, ka lungsim kitheihna-ah zuau gen hetloin a mantakin ka gen thu in:","title":"Pasian in Israel Mite A Teelna"},"2":{"text":"Leitung silesa ah ka mipihte a dingin nakpitakin dahin ka lunggimna a khang hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi thei ding hileh amaute’ hoih nadingin keimah in Pasian’ samsiatna thuakin Khrih tawh kikhen nading ciang dong nangawnin amaute ka huhnuam hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute pen Pasian’ teel Israel mite hi a, Pasian in ama ta-in bawlin a minthanna a hopte, amaute tungah thuciamna bawlin Thukham a piakte, a man taktakin biaktheihna nei-in thuciamna a ngahte,","ref":"Pai 9:4"},"5":{"text":"le a thupi pupite’ suanlekhakte hi uh a, leitung silesa tawh kisai-in Khrih zong amau minam sung panin a piang ahi hi. Hih thute hangin mi khempeuh in na khempeuh a uk Pasian phat tawntung ta uh hen! Amen."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ thuciamnate a mawkna a suak hi sam lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mi khempeuh Pasian’ teel mi hi khin lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Abraham’ suanlekhak khempeuh zong Pasian’ tate hi kim lo hi. Pasian in Abraham kiangah, “Na ta Isaac’ suanlekhakte bek nangma suanlekhakin kisim ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 21:12"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin leitung ngeina tawh a suak tate pen Pasian’ ta hi lo a, Pasian’ thuciamna tawh kizui-a a suakte bek suanlekhak taktakin a kisim pan hizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in hih bangin thuciamna bawl a, “A hun a tun ciangin kong paikik ding a, Sarah in tapa khat a nei ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 18:10"},"10":{"text":"Tua bek zong hi lo lai hi. Rebekah in eite’ pupi Isaac tawh tapa nih nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian’ teelna pen a teel mite’ nasepna hang hi loin Pasian’ sapna tawh kisaizaw hi, ci-in a kilat nadingin a tate a sia a pha a gamtat theihma, a suahma pek mahin"},"12":{"text":"Rebekah kiangah Pasian in, “A uzaw in a nauzaw’ na sem ding hi,” na ci khinzo hi.","ref":"Pian 25:23"},"13":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Lai Siangtho sungah, “Jakob ka it a, Esau ka mudah hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Mal 1:2-3"},"14":{"text":"Tua bang ahihleh Pasian thutang lo hi, a kici thei ding hiam? Kici thei lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Moses kiangah, “Ka hehpih nopte ka hehpih ding a, ka khasiat nopte ka khasiat ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pai 33:19"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mite’ utna le sepna tawh kisai lo a, Pasian’ hehpihna bek tawh kisaizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah Pasian in Faro kiangah, “Ka vangliatna lah nading le leitung khempeuhah ka min a kitheih nadingin kong zatnop manin kumpi a hong suaksak ka hi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pai 9:16"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in a hehpih nopte hehpih a, a paupeensak nopte paupeengsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Note in, “Tua bang ahihleh bang hangin Pasian in mi mawhsak thei ahi hiam? Pasian’ cihsa kua in kheelzo ding ahi hiam?” na cinuam kha ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Lawmte aw, ahi zongin kua in Pasian’ thu nialngam ding na hi uh hiam? Beel in amah a seekpa kiangah, “Bang hangin tua bangin hong seek na hi hiam?” ci ngei lo hi.","ref":"Isa 29:16; 45:9"},"21":{"text":"Beelseek pa in tungman lomkhat sung panin hun thupi diakin zat ding beel le zat mawkmawk ding beelin a ututin seektheih nading thu a nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Pasian in zong a beisa hunah siatna a thuak dingin a kilawm mite susia loin a ki-ipipna mite tungah a hehna le a vangliatna a lahtheih nading thu a neih mah bangin,"},"23":{"text":"ama minthanna a lahtheih nadingin ama minthanna a ngah dingin a hong sehsa eite tungah zong ama hehpihna a hong piaktheih nading thu a nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bangin a hong sap eite pen Jew mite sung bek pan hi loin Gentail mite sung panin zong ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hosea Lai Siangtho sungah, “Keima mi a hilote, ‘Keima mi,’ ka ci ding a, ka it loh mite, ‘Ka itte,’ ka ci ding hi.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"26":{"text":"‘Ka mite hi kei uh teh,’ a kicihna leitang teekteek mahah, ‘A nungta Pasian’ tate na hi uh hi,’ kici ding hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Hos 1:10"},"27":{"text":"Isaiah in Israel mite’ thu a genna-ah, “Israel mite, tuipi gei-a sehnel zahin a tam hangin mi tawmno khat bek suakta ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in leitung mite thu hong khen baih ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Isa 10:22-23"},"29":{"text":"Hih thu pen Isaiah mah in, “Vanglian Topa in eite’ suanlekhak ding hong siitsak lo hileh Sodom khua le Gomorrah khuamite i bang ding hi,” ci-in a genkholhsa thu ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 1:9"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Pasian tawh kipawl theih nading hanciamna a nei lo Gentail mite pen upna hangin Pasian tawh kipawlthei a,","title":"Lungdamna Thu, Israel Mite a’ ding Zong Ahi Hi"},"31":{"text":"Pasian tawh a kipawl theih nadingin thukham zuihna tawh hanciam napi-in a zuih zawh lohna hangun Israel mite kipawl thei lo ahihleh a bangci thu ahi hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Amaute in upna suang loin nasepna a suan hang uh ahi hi. Amaute pen Lai Siangtho in a gen mah bangin, “Puk nading suang,” a kici tungah a pukkha uh ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Lai Siangtho in, “En un, keimah in Zion-ah mite a muktuk theih nading, mite a puktheih nading suang khat ka koih hi. Ahi zongin amah a muang mite khempeuh tavai cih om ngei lo ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Isa 28:16"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, i mipihte in hotkhiatna a ngah nading deihsakin lungsim takpi tawh Pasian kiangah thu ka ngetsak hi."},"2":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian a kin mahmah lamtak uh thei-in teci-in ka pang ngam hi. Ahi zongin amaute in a man lampi tawh kin kha lo uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian tawh kipawl theih nading lampi man thei loin amau theihtawmna tawh hanciam kha uh ahih manin amah tawh kipawl theih nadingin lampi a khun’ zui kha lo uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh upna a nei mi khempeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theih nadingin Khrih in Thukham a beisak hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses in a laigelhna sungah, “Thukham deihna bangin a gamtazo mi khempeuh a nungta ding hi,” ci-in Thukham zuihna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theih nading thu a na gen hi.","ref":"Siam 18:5"},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin upna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna thu a kigenna-ah, “Vantungah kua va paito ding a,” ci kei unla, “Leinuai-ah kua va paisuk ding ahi hiam?” zong ci kei un, ci hi. Tua a cihna pen vantung panin Khrih a lasuk ding le sihna panin a thosak ding cihna ahi hi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Tua bang a cih ciangin, “Pasian’ thu pen nai mahmahin note kam sung le na lungsim sung uhah om hi,” a cihnopna ahi hi. Tua Pasian’ thu pen kote’ hilhhilh, “Pasian um un,” cihna thu ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 30:12-14"},"9":{"text":"Jesuh pen Topa hi, ci-in mite kiangah genin, Pasian in sihna panin amah hingkiksak zo hi, ci-in na lungsim sung uhah na up taktak uhleh hotkhiatna na ngah ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh i lungsim ah i up taktakna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna kingah a, i kamin i genna hangin hotkhiatna a kingah ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Lai Siangtho in, “Amah a um mi peuhmah tavai lo ding hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Isa 28:16"},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Jew mi le Gentail mi a kideidanna om lo ahih manin Topa pen mi khempeuh’ Topa hi kim a, ama kiangah a ngen khempeuh tungah thupha tampi tak a pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Lai Siangtho in zong, “Topa tungah huhna a ngen khempeuhte in hotkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Joel 2:32"},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin a up loh pa uh tungah kua in thu ngen thei ding ahi hiam? Ama thu za ngei kei leh kua in a thu um thei ding ahi hiam? Ama thu kigen kei leh kua in za thei ding ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"A gen dingin kisawl kei leh kua in a thu gen thei ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah, “Lungdamna thu a hilh dingin a hong pai mite hangin kinuam mahmah hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin Isaiah in, “Topa aw, ka thugente uh kua in um ahi hiam?” a cih mah bangin Lungdamna Thu a za mi khempeuh in um kim lo uh hi.","ref":"Isa 53:1"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin zakna panin upna hong piangthei a, Khrih thu up nading pen hilhna panin hong piangthei pan hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahihleh amaute in thu za lo uh ahi hiam? Lai Siangtho sungah, “Amau’ awgingte leitung khempeuh ah kizel a, a thugente uh in mun khempeuh a ban hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin amaute in thu za khinzo uh hi.","ref":"La 19:4"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Israel mite in a thei uh hiam? Moses mahmah in Pasian’ min tawh thu na gen a, “Keima mi pawl a hilote thupha pia-in, note’ hazat dingin ka bawl ding a, tua mihaite’ hangin note na heh nadingun ka hong bawl ding hi,” a cih mah bangin Israel mite in a thu a thei lo uh hi lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:21"},"20":{"text":"Tua banah Isaiah in Pasian’ min tawh hangtakin thu na gen a, “Kei hong zong lo mite in kei hong mu uh a, kei hong kan lo mite tungah ka kilak hi,” ci-in na gen hi.","ref":"Isa 65:1"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mite tawh kisai-in, “Ka thu a mang lo, kei hong langpang mite tawh ka kilemkik theih nadingin a tawntungin ka hanciam hi,” ci-in a na gen hi.","ref":"Isa 65:2"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahihleh Pasian in ama mi Israel-te nialin nusia mangkhin ahi hiam? Tua bang hi dek lo hi. Kei mahmah zong Abraham’ suan Israel mite ka hi a, tua sung panin Benjamin’ suan ka hi hi.","title":"Israel Mi Tawmkhat Omlai Tei","ref":"Fil 3:5"},"2":{"text":"Pasian in tanglai panin a teelsa mite nusia lo hi. Elijah in Israel mite mawhsakin Pasian kiangah nakpitakin thu a genna Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh thei lo na hi uh hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Tua sungah, “Topa aw, Israel mite in na kamsangte thatin nangma biakna taute phelin susiagawp uh a, kei bekbek ka omlai hi. Kei nangawn thah hong sawm lai uh hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:10,14"},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in, “Baal milim a bia nai lo mihing tulsagih ka nei lai hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"1Kum 19:18"},"5":{"text":"Tua mah bangin tuhunin zong Pasian in ama hehpihna tawh a teelsa mi tawmkhat omlai hi."},"6":{"text":"A teelna ah mite’ nasepna bulphuhin a teel hi loin ama dikna hangin a teel hizaw hi. Pasian in mihingte’ nasepna bulphuhin a teel hileh Pasian’ dikna pen dikna kici thei lo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A thu omzia taktak hih bang ahi hi. Israel mi a tamzaw in a hanciamciam uh ngah lo uh hi. Pasian’ teel mi tawmkhat bek in ngah uh a, adangte in Pasian’ sapna thudon lo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah, “Pasian in thu a ngaihsun thei lo, khua a phawk thei loin amaute bawl a, amaute in tuni dongin khua mu thei lo, khua za thei loin a om uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.","ref":"Thkna 29:4; Isa 29:10"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in zong, “Amaute in a pawi bawlnate uh awklawh uh hen la, kiat lawhin gimna ngahlawh uh hen!"},"10":{"text":"Khua a muh loh nadingun a mit uh taw hen la, lungkhamna vangik lelin awn tawntung ta uh hen!” ci-in a gen lai hi.","ref":"La 69:22-23"},"11":{"text":"Jew mite a puk uh ciangin sia paisuak ahi uh hiam? Sia paisuak lo uh hi. Amau’ mawhna hangin Gentail mite in hotkhiatna ngah uh hi. Gentail mite in hotkhiatna a ngah pen Jew mite in enna lungsim a neihtheih nading uh deihna ahi hi.","title":"Pasian in Gentail mite Honkhia"},"12":{"text":"Jew mite’ mawhna pen leitung khempeuh thupha ngahna suak a, amau’ gitnat lohna pen Gentail mite’ hamphatna suak ahihleh Jew mi khempeuh in hotkhiatna a ngahkim uh ciangin bangzahin hoihkan ding ahi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in no Gentail mite tungah thu ka hong gennuam hi: No Gentail mite a dingin sawltak ka sep sungteng ka nasep a thupi mahmahin ka ngaihsun ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mipihte in note hong entheih nading uh piangsak thei-in, tua manin amaute pawlkhat in hotkhiatna a ngah nading uh piangsakzo kha dingin ka kilamen hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute a kinialna hangin Pasian tawh leitung mi khempeuh kipawl theihna piang ahihleh amaute a kisan’ hun ciangin a sisate nangawn a hinkikna hong hita ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Anlum a ki-em masa sung panin a themkhat Pasian biakna-in a kipiak ciangin a anlum buppi zong Pasian-a’ mah hi pah a, singkung khat’ zung zong Pasian a kipiak ciangin a hiang khempeuh zong Pasian-a’ mah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"A kiciing oliv kung a hiangte kisatkhia-in gamlak oliv hiangte tawh kipeh hi. No Gentail-te pen tua gamlak oliv hiangte tawh a kibang na hi uh a, Jew mite’ hamphatna teng a ngahkhawm na hi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih manin oliv hiang a kisatkhia tawh a kibang Jew mite simmawhbawl kha kei un. Note na kiphatsak theih nading uh a thu om lo hi. Note pen a hiang tawh a kibang lel na hi uh a, note in a zungpi a hingsak hi loin, a zungpi in note a hong hingsak ahi zaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Note in, “Eite tawh hong kipeh theih nadingin a hiangte a kisatkhia ahi hi,” na cinuam ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua pen thuman ahi hi. Amaute in a up lohna hangun a kisatkhia hi a, note in na upna hangun amaute’ munah a om na hi uh hi. Tua ahih manin kiphatsakna lungsim nei kei unla, lamdangsakna tawh om khikhe zaw un."},"21":{"text":"Pasian in oliv hiang ngeite dawm lo ahihleh note hong dawm tuan lo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih thu-ah Pasian a migit mahmahna le a khauh mahmahna i mu hi. A khial mite tungah khauh mahmah a, ama migitna a kizop paisuak theih nadingin na up paisuak nak-uhleh note tungah hong migi mahmah hi. Ahi zongin na zop paisuak kei uhleh note zong hong kisatkhia ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jew mite in zong a lungsim uh kheelin Pasian a up uhleh Pasian in a pehkik theih nading vangliatna nei ahih manin amaute zong amau’ mun ngei mahah pehkik ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Note pen na pianngei uh gamlak oliv kung panin hong kisatkhia-in note’ pianngei ahi lo a kiciing oliv kung tungah hong kipehthei ahihleh a kiciing oliv kung panin a kisatkhia tawh a kibang Jew mite pen Pasian in amau omna ngei-ah a pehkik ding olzaw mahmah lai ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note in na theih dingun ka deih thusim khat om hi. Thei le-uhcin, “A pil mahmah hi hang,” na kici nawn kei pah ding uh hi. Tua thu in: Israel mite in a up nop lohna pen a tawntung ding thu hi lo hi. Pasian kiangah Gentail mite a pai dingzah in Pasian a zuat hun ciang dong ding bek ahi hi.","title":"Israel Mite A Ngei A Batkikna"},"26":{"text":"Tua hi a, Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin Israel mite khempeuh in hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi. Lai Siangtho in, “Zion panin Honpa hong pai ding a, Jakob’ suanlekhakte sunga om gitlohna khempeuh maisak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 59:20"},"27":{"text":"Amaute’ mawhna ka maisak ciangin hih ka thuciamna ka pia ding hi,” ci-in gen hi.","ref":"Isa 27:9; Jer 31:33-34"},"28":{"text":"Jew mite in Lungdamna Thu um loin Pasian’ gal ahihna pen no Gentail mite’ hamphat nading hi a, ahi zongin Pasian’ teelna tawh kisai-in a pupite uh tungah a thuciamna huhau-in Pasian’ pawlte mah hi lai veve uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in a teel mite le thupha a piak mite tawh kisai-in a thu dokkik lo hi."},"30":{"text":"No Gentail mite in a beisa hunah Pasian’ thu na mang kei uh a, ahi zongin Jew mite’ thuman lohna hangin tu-in Pasian’ hehpihna na ngah uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua mah bangin amaute’ thuman lohna hangin note in Pasian’ hehpihna na ngahna uh pen Jew mite in zong Pasian’ hehpihna a ngahkik theih nading uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in mi khempeuh tungah hehpihna a piaktheih nadingin a thuman lohna hangun mi khempeuh thongkia a bangsak hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian’ hong hehpihna nakliat mahmah a, a pilna le a thu theihnate nakthuk mahmah hi. Ama thukhennate kua’ gentheih ding hi lo a, a nasepna ziate kua’ telzawh ding hi lo hi.","ref":"Isa 55:8"},"34":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho in, “Kua in Topa’ lungsim thei ding a, kua in ngaihsutna va pia thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 40:13"},"35":{"text":"Amah in hong thukkik theih nadingin kuamah in ama tungah thupha va bawl ngei lo hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Job 41:11"},"36":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na khempeuh ama piansak hi a, na khempeuh ama hang le ama minthan nading bekin a om ahi hi. Mi khempeuh in Pasian phat tawntung ta hen! Amen.","ref":"1Kor 8:6"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, Pasian in eite tam veipi tak hong hehpih ahih manin ama lungkim nading le ama nasep nadingin nomau mahmah a hingtangin Pasian tungah na kipiak nadingun ka hong thum hi. Tua banga kipiakna pen Pasian biakna man taktak ahi hi.","title":"Hingtangin Kipiakna"},"2":{"text":"Leitung mihingte’ gamtat bangin gamta kei unla, na lungsim uh kikheelin Pasian kipuahphasak un. Tua hileh a hoih nate bang hi a, bangte in amah lungkimsakin, bangte a kicing hiam ci-in thei-in Pasian’ deihna na phawk thei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian in kei tungah hehpihna hong piakkhongna hangin note tungah kong gennop thu in: Note tawh a kituakzah valin kilian ngaihsutzaw kha kei un. Pasian in note tungah upna hong piakzah tawh kizui-in kingaihsun bek zaw unla, a kilawm ciang khat bekin kingaihsun un."},"4":{"text":"I pumpi tungah zong na tampi i nei a, tua nate’ nasep a tuamtuam ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mah bangin eite mi tampi ihih hangin pumkhat ihi a, pumpi nate bangin khatlekhat a kizom ciat ihi hi.","ref":"1Kor 12:12"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in hehpihna hong piakkhongna tawh kizui-in i siamna a tuamtuamte zang ciat ni. I siamna pen Pasian’ thu gentheih nading siamna ahih leh i upna neihzah tawh kizui-in gen ni."},"7":{"text":"Nasep nading siamna a nei ihih leh na sem ni. Hilh nading siamna a nei ihih leh hilh ni."},"8":{"text":"Midangte hanthot theih nading siamna a nei ihih leh midangte hanthawn ni. Midangte hop theih nading a nei ihih leh citna taktak tawh hawm ni. Makaih theih nading siamna a nei ihih leh hoihtakin na sem ni. Midangte hehpih theih nading a nei ihih leh maitai takin hih ni.","ref":"1Kor 12:4-11"},"9":{"text":"Na ki-itnate uh lungsim takpi tawh hi sak unla, a siate mudahin a hoihte lenkip un.","title":"Khristiante’ Nuntakzia Ding"},"10":{"text":"Unau ki-itna lungsim nei unla, khatlekhat kizahtak bawl ding lamsang kidem un."},"11":{"text":"Thadah kei unla, nakpitakin na sem un. Lawp mahmahna lungsim tawh Topa’ na sem un."},"12":{"text":"Lamet na neihna hangun lungdamin om tawntung unla, lungkhamna na thuak uh ciangin lungduai-in thu na ngen tawntung un."},"13":{"text":"Na Khristian pihte uh a kisapna bangin na neihsate uh na hawm unla, zin le leengla do a siam mite na hita un."},"14":{"text":"No a hong bawlsia mite, Pasian in thupha a piak nadingin thu ngetsak unla, tua bang mite samsia loin thupha piazaw un.","ref":"Mat 5:44; Luk 6:28"},"15":{"text":"A lungdam mite lungdampih unla, a dah mite dahpih un."},"16":{"text":"Mi deidan loin a kibangin en un. Kiphasak loin mineute tawh kikhawlthei unla, kipilsak se kei un.","ref":"Pau 3:7"},"17":{"text":"Midangte’ gitlohnate thukkik kei unla, mi khempeuh in hoih hi, ci-in a ngaihsut ding bangin gamta un."},"18":{"text":"Ahih theih laiteng mi khempeuh tawh na kilem nadingun hanciam un."},"19":{"text":"Lawmte aw, na hehna uh kuama tungah thukkik kei unla, Pasian’ thukkik dingin koih lel un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah, “Keimah in amaute tungah ka thuk ding a, midangte a gimsak bangun ka gimsak ding hi, Topa in ci hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:35"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah, “Na galte uh a gil a kial leh an na pia un. A dang a taak leh tui na pia un. Tua bangin na gamtat uhleh amaute’ maizum nadingin a bawl na hi uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh bangin gamtazaw un.","ref":"Pau 25:21-22"},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin gitlohna kizosak kei unla, a pha gamtatna tawh gitlohnate a zo na hi ta un."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kuamah peuh in hong ukte’ thu na mang ciat un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ thukimpih lohin kuamah in ukna thu nei lo hi; ukna thu nei i cih mite pen Pasian’ koih mite ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ukna thuneite a nialte pen Pasian’ koihsa mite a nial suak a, tua bang mite in thukhenna a thuak ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh gam uk mite pen a gamtat hoih mite’ kihtak ding hi lo a, mi tatsiate’ kihtak ding hi bek hi. Ukna thu a neite kihta loin na omnop uhleh a hoihin gamta un. Tua hileh amaute in note hong pakta-in hong phat ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ukna thuneite pen note’ hoih nadingin Pasian’ nasemte ahi uh hi. Ahi zongin a sia-in na gamtat uhleh gim hong pia taktak ding uh ahih manin na lau ding uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen Pasian’ nasemte hi a, a sia-in a gamta mite tungah Pasian’ hehna bangin gim a pia dingte ahi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian’ gimpiak ding kihtakna hang bek hi loin, ahi ding thu mah hi, ci-a theihna tawh ukna thu a neite’ thu na man’ ding uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ukna thu a neite in amau’ sep dingteng a kimtakin a sep uh ciangin Pasian a dingin na a semte hi uh ahih manin tua thu hang mahin zong mangmu a pia na hi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin phiangsiah piak dingte tungah pia-in, mangmu piak dingte tungah pia-in, zahtak dingte zahtak bawlin, pahtawi dingte pahtawi ta un.","ref":"Mat 22:21; Mrk 12:17; Luk 20:25"},"8":{"text":"Khatlekhat ki-it ding cih lohbuang, kuama tungah leiba nei kei un. Midang a itte in Thukham deihna teng a zuikhin ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thukham sungah, “Nulepa mawhna bawl kei in, mi that kei in, guta kei in, hazatna lungsim nei kei in,” cihna le adang khempeuhte pen, “Nang na ki-it bangin na vengte na it in,” cihna thu in huam khinmang hi.","ref":"Pai 20:13-15,17; Siam 19:18; Thkna 5:17-19,21"},"10":{"text":"Midangte a it mi peuhmah in amaute tungah siatna bawl het lo ahih manin itna i neih ciangin Thukham buppi a zui khinta ihi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuhun pen bang hun hita ahi hiam, ci-in theita na hih manun tu-a bangin na gamtat ding uh ahi hi. Tu-in note in khua phawkin na khanlawh ding uh hun hita hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Jesuh Khrih i up cil lai hun sangin tu-in Pasian in leitung haksatna panin eite hong hotkhiat ding hun hong naizaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Zan khuamial bei dektak a, sun khuavak hong tung dektak ta hi. Khuamial sunga gamtatnate khawlin khuavak sunga nazatte zam ta ni."},"13":{"text":"Sun khuavak sunga om mite bangin a kilawmin gamta ni. Gualnopna le zukhamna, mawhna le thangtatna, kitotna le kihazatnate-in i hun beisak kei ni."},"14":{"text":"Kidal nadingin, Topa Jesuh Khrih’ hong piak galhiamte zang unla, na pumpi uh deihna bangin gamtat nading hun omsak nawn kei un."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upna neu mite pawlbawl unla, na ngaihsutna uh a kituah kei leh zong mawhsak kei un.","title":"Na Khristianpihte uh Mawk Mawhsak Kei Un"},"2":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in na khempeuh ka nektheih ding hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi; ahi zongin upna neute in anteh bek ne ngam uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a ne mite in a tang mite simmawhbawl kei hen la, a tang mite in zong a ne mite simmawhbawl kei hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ne mite zong Pasian in a san mite mah ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khat’ nasemte tungah kua in thu khen thei ding na hi uh hiam? A gina le a ginalo a khen ding pa pen amau’ Topa ahi hi. A Topa un hoih hi, a cih leh a kipsak zawh nading vangliatna nei ahih manin a kip hi lel ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte in ni khatpeuh adang sangin thupi zaw hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh a, pawlkhatte in ni khempeuh kibangkim hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Tua ahih manin a kuamah peuh in amau’ hoihsakna thu ciantakin thei ta uh hen."},"6":{"text":"Ni khatpeuh thupi diak hi, ci-in a tang mite in Topa a pahtawina-in a tang ahi uh hi. An khempeuh a ne mi in zong Pasian’ tungah lungdamna ko-in ne uh ahih manin Topa a pahtawina mahin a ne uh ahi hi. Nek dingin kilawm lo hi, ci-in a ne lo mite in zong Pasian tungah lungdamna mah ko ahih manin Topa a pahtawina mahin a ne lo uh ahi hi.","ref":"Kol 2:16"},"7":{"text":"Ama a’ ding bekin kuamah nungta lo a, ama a’ ding bekin kuamah si lo hi."},"8":{"text":"I nuntak leh Topa a dingin a nungta ihi a, i sih leh zong Topa a’ ding mahin a si ihi hi. Tua ahih manin i si a, i hing zongin Topa a’ ihi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih thu hangin Khrih pen a site le a hingte’ Topa ahih theih nadingin hong si-in hong nungtakik hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahihleh bang hangin na Khristianpihte uh tungah thu khen a, bang hangin simmawhbawl thei na hi uh hiam? Thukhenna a thuak dingin Pasian’ mai-ah eite khempeuh a ding ciat ding ihi hi.","ref":"2Kor 5:10"},"11":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah, “Kei pen a nungta ka hih mah bangin ka mai-ah mi khempeuh hong kun ding a, Pasian ka hihna thu mi khempeuh in pulak taktak ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 45:23"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a kuamah peuh in i gamtatna ciat Pasian’ mai-ah a va kigentel ciat ding ihi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin khatlekhat kimawhsakin thu kikhen kei unla, i Khristianpihte i puksak khak loh nading, a dongtangsak ihih khak loh nadingin ngaihsun ciat ni.","title":"Na Khristianpihte uh Puksak Kei Un"},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesuh tawh kipawlin a lungsim ka theihna tawh, na khat peuhpeuh ama thu-in a dawizek om het lo hi, ci-in teltakin ka thei hi. Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in dawizek hi, ci-in a ngaihsut leh ama a dingin a dawizek hi pah hi."},"15":{"text":"An khatpeuh na nekna uh hangin na Khristianpihte’ lungnopmawhna na piansak uhleh itna lungsim tawh a gamta na hi nawn kei uh hi. Na an nekna uh tawh, Khrih in a sihlawh mite’ siat nading piangsak kei un."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin note in hoih na sak uh thute, midangte in a sia-in a genkhak loh theih nadingun na gamta un."},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ Ukna pen nekledawn tawh a kisai thu hi lo a, Kha Siangtho hangin i ngah Pasian’ deih bangin gamtatna, kilemna, lungdamna, cihte hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih bang danin Khrih’ na a sem mite in Pasian lungdamsak a, mite zong a lungkimsak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mi tawh kilem theih nading le kha thu-ah khatlekhat thahatna i kipiak theih nading thute hanciam ciat ni."},"20":{"text":"Annek huhau-in Pasian’ sepsa thute susia kei ni. An khempeuh a kine thei ding ahi hi; ahi zongin tua nekna hangin mi khat peuhpeuh a pukding ahihleh a khial ihi hi."},"21":{"text":"Midangte in a puklawh theih annekna, zunekna, le na khat peuhpeuh i kikep ding a man pen ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih thu-ah no’ upna le no’ ngaihsutnate, Pasian tawh note’ kikal thu hisak un. Amau lungsim sungah man a sak bangun a gamta zote pen a lung uh nuam mahmah hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin lunghimawh pipi-in a ne a om leh, a upna uh tawh kizui-in a gamta hi lo uh ahih manin Pasian in tua bang mite a mawhsak ding hi. I upna bangin gamtat lohna peuhpeuh mawhna ahi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upna lamah a thahat eite in upna zawngkhalte’ ginat lohna i thuakpih ding kilawm hi; eima ut bangin i gamta kei ding hi.","title":"Midangte’ Lungdamna Dingin Gamtazaw Ding"},"2":{"text":"Midangte a upna uh hong khangin, mihoih hong suahtheih nadingun i gamta ciat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih zong ama nopsak theih nadingin gamta lo zaw hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, “Note hong kisimmawhna thute kei tungah hong tu hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.","ref":"La 69:9"},"4":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah a om thu khempeuh pen eite hilh nading, eite in lametna nei-in i thuakzawh nading, le i thahat theih nadingin a kigelh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Note in lungsim kikhatin i Topa Jesuh Khrih’ Pa ahi Pasian na phatkhawm theih nadingun Pasian in thuakzawhna le thahatna hong pia hen la, Jesuh Khrih deihna bangin gamta-in khatlekhat kithutuak takin hong omsak tahen.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Khrih in note hong san mah bangin midangte in Pasian a phattheih nadingun note khatlekhat na kisang un.","title":"Gentail Mite in Zong Lungdamna Thu Za"},"8":{"text":"Hih banga kong genna pen, Pasian thuman hi, ci-in a kilat nadingin pupite tungah Pasian’ thuciamna a tungsak dingin, Jew mite hoih nading,"},"9":{"text":"le Gentail mite in zong ama hehpihna hangin Pasian a phattheih nadingun Khrih a hong paina hang ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah, “Tua ahih ciangin Gentail mite lakah ka lungdamna nang tungah ka hong ko ding a, nangma min phatna late ka sa ding hi,” cihna le","ref":"2Sam 22:50; La 18:49"},"10":{"text":"tua ciangin, “Gentail mite aw, ama mite tawh lungdam khawm un,” cihna le","ref":"Thkna 32:43"},"11":{"text":"tua ciangin, “Gentail mi khempeuh aw, Topa phat un; mi khempeuh aw, amah phat un,” cihna le","ref":"La 117:1"},"12":{"text":"tua ciangin Isaiah in, “Jessi’ suante khat hong khang ding a, Gentail mite a uk dingin milian hong suak ding a, ama hangin Gentail mite in lamet lungmuanna nei ding uh hi,” cihnate a kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 11:10"},"13":{"text":"Kha Siangtho’ huhna tawh note’ lametna a khan semsem theih nadingin, lametna a hong piathei Pasian in, amah na upna uh hangin lungdamna le nopsakna tawh note hong kidimsak tahen."},"14":{"text":"Thu upna sungah sanggamte aw, note mihoih hi-in, bangci gamtat ding cih thei-in, khatlekhat zong a kihilhthei dingin kong muang mahmah hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih kong laikhakna sungah note’ phawkkik dingin thu ka hong genna pawlkhatte-ah kong telkheh mahmah hi. Tua bangin ka hong telkhehna thu pen,"},"16":{"text":"Gentail mite tungah na a sem dingin Khrih Jesuh sawltak hih theih nading hamphatna lianpi Pasian in kei a hong piakna hang ahi hi. Gentail mite pen Kha Siangtho in Pasian’ tungah a piak, ama santheih biakpiaknate a suahtheih nadingin Pasian kiang panin a hong pai Lungdamna Thu ka hilhna-ah siampi bangin na ka sem hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Khrih tawh kikopin Pasian a’ ding na ka sepna-ah kei ka kisathei mahmah hi."},"18":{"text":"Kha Siangtho’ vangliatna tawh lim le na lamdangte zangin, Gentail mite in Pasian thu a zuihtheih nadingun Khrih in ka thatang le ka kam ka muk a zatna thute bekah hangtakin genin ka telkheh ding hi. Tua ahih manin Jerusalem khua panin Illyrikam gam ciang dong ka zinna khempeuhah Jesuh Khrih hangin Lungdamna Thu ka hilh khinzo hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"A tawntungin keima tup thu in: Mi khatpeuh in a patsa nasep maban, oltakin zomin a sem mi ka suahkhak loh nadingin Khrih thu a kizak ngei nai lohna munte bekah Lungdamna Thu hilh ding keima utna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah zong, “Ama thu a kigen ngei nai lohna mite in mu ding uh a, ama thu a za ngei nai lote in teltheih ding uh hi,” na kici hi.","ref":"Isa 52:15"},"22":{"text":"Note kiangah ka hong paipak theih lohna pen tu-a kong genna thu hang ahi hi.","title":"Rom Khua-ah Paul Hawh Sawm","ref":"Rom 1:13"},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih gam kiimteng a ka nasepna man khinta ing a, note tawh ka kimuhnop zong kum tampi tak pha khinta ahih manin,"},"24":{"text":"tu-in note tawh kimu theita dingin ka kilamen hi. Spain gam ka paikawmin note kiang ka hong nawk nuam a, note tawh tawlkhat i kikholh khit ciangin Spain gam ka paina dingah nong huh ding uh ka ut hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu laitakin ahihleh Jerusalem khua-a Pasian mite a kihuhna a puak dingin ka va pai masa ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Masedonia gam le Grik gam sunga om pawlpite in Jerusalem khua-a om Pasian’ mi a zawngte huh nadingin sum piak ding amau thu-in a vaihawmtawm uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 16:1-4"},"27":{"text":"Hih pen amau ngaihsut tawmna tawh lawptakin a huh uh ahi hi. A taktakin ci lehang hih mizawngte a huh dingun a kilawm mah ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Jew mite in kha thu tawh kisai nate Gentail mite hawm uh ahih manin Gentail mite in zong leitung nate tawh Jew mite a huh dingun a kilawm khat ahi hi.","ref":"1Kor 9:11"},"28":{"text":"Amaute a dingin a kikaikhawm hih sumte a cingin amaute tungah apin, hih nasep ka man khit ciangin Spain gam manawh dingin ka hong paikhia ding a, note kiangah kong baang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Note kiang ka hong tun ciangin Khrih kiang panin thupha tampi tak ka hong puak ding lamtak ka thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Lawmte aw, kei a dingin Pasian kiangah thu na hong ngetsak nadingun i Topa Jesuh Khrih i upna hang le Kha Siangtho in a hong piak itna tawh a hong thum ka hi hi."},"31":{"text":"Judea gam sunga a om thu um lo mite in kei hong gimsakkhak loh nading le Jerusalem khua-a a om Pasian mite a dingin nasepnate lungdam takin a hong santheih nadingun thu hong ngetsak un."},"32":{"text":"Tua bangin thu hong ngetsak le-uhcin, Pasian’ deihna ahih nakleh note kiangah lungdam takin ka hong tung ding a, note tawh nuamtakin i kimu ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Nopsakna a hong pia Pasian in note khempeuh hong ompih tahen. Amen."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kenkhrea khua-a om pawlpite lakah na a sem, thu upna sungah i sanggamnu Foebe pen mihoih mahmah khat ahihna thu note’ theih dingin ka deih hi.","title":"Aituam Hopihnate"},"2":{"text":"Amah pen keimah a kipan mi tampi a dingin lawm hoih mahmah khat ahih manin, Pasian’ mite in a hih dingin a kilawm ahih mah bangin Topa’ thu sungah mihoihin na sang unla, note’ huh ding a kisapna khempeuhah hoihtakin na huh un."},"3":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh sungah na ka sepkhoppih Prisilla le Aquila na hopih sak un.","ref":"Sawl 18:2"},"4":{"text":"Amaute pen kei a dingin a si ngam uh ahi hi. Amaute tungah a lungdam kei guak bek zong hi loin, Gentail pawlpi mi khempeuh zong a lungdam ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amau’ inn-a kikhawm pawlpi mi khempeuh zong na hopih sak un. Asia gam sungah Khrih thu a um masa pen pa ahi ka lawm it mahmah Epainetas zong na hopih sak un."},"6":{"text":"Note a dingin nakpitakin na a sem Mary zong na hopih sak un."},"7":{"text":"Jew mipih ahih banah ka thongkiatpih ahi Andronikas le Junias zong na hopih sak un. Amaute pen kei’ Khristian suahma pekin a na suak khinsate na hi uh a, sawltakte khempeuh in a theihkim uh mite ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa thu sungah ka lawm it mahmah ahi Ampliatas zong na hopih sak un."},"9":{"text":"Khrih nasepna sungah na ka sepkhoppih uh ahi Urbanas, le ka lawm Stakhus zong na hopih sak un."},"10":{"text":"Khrih tungah mi citak mahmah ahi Apelles zong na hopih sak un. Aristobulas innkuanpih mite zong na hopih sak un."},"11":{"text":"Jew mipih Herodion le Narsissas innkuan sunga i Khristian sanggamte zong na hopih sak un."},"12":{"text":"Topa’ na a sem Trifana le Trifosa, le Topa a dingin na tampi tak a sem ka lawm it Persis zong na hopih sak un."},"13":{"text":"Topa’ nasepna sungah a kikhai mahmah Rufas, le ta bangin kei a hong bawl tawntung ama nu zong na hopih sak un.","ref":"Mrk 15:21"},"14":{"text":"Asinkritas, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, le amaute tawh a kikhawm khawm Khristian sanggamte zong na hopih sak un."},"15":{"text":"Filologas le Julia, Nereas le a sanggamnu le Olympas le amaute tawh a kikhawm khawm Pasian’ mi khempeuh zong na hopih sak un."},"16":{"text":"Sanggam ki-itna taktak tawh note khatlekhat kinamin na kihopih un. Khrih pawlpi khempeuh in zong hopihna kam hong khak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Lawmte aw, note’ theihsa thute gensia langpangin, mite’ upna nawngkaisakin pawl a kikhensak mite kidawm un. Tua bang mite tawh kikhawl vet kei un."},"18":{"text":"Tua bang mite in i Topa Khrih’ na a sem hi loin, gilpi vai bek a sem uh ahi hi. Amaute in mite phatin kamkhum nono zang uh ahih manin mihoih pawlkhat a khemzo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Lungdamna thu tawh kisai-ah na cihtakna uh mi khempeuh in thei ahih manin hih thu-ah kong lungdampih mahmah hi. A hoih bang hiam, ci-in theih nading pilna nei-in, a sia peuhmah tawh na kizopkhak hetloh nading uh kong deihsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hileh eite tungah nopsakna a hong pia thei Pasian in Satan tuancilin note’ khenuai mi hong hisak baih ding hi. I Topa Jesuh Khrih hong hehpihna thupha, note tungah om tahen."},"21":{"text":"Ka naseppih Timoti in note hong hopih a, Jew mipih Lusias, Jason, le Sosipater-te in zong hong hopih uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"22":{"text":"Hih lai a gelhsak keimah Tertias in zong upna kikhat ihihna tawh ka hong hopih hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima zintunna pa le pawlpite’ kikhopna inn nei pa zong ahi Gaias in zong hong hopih hi. Ka omna khuapi sumkem pa Erastas le i Khristian sanggam Kuartas in zong hong hopih uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:29; 1Kor 1:14; 2Tim 4:20"},"24":{"text":"(I Topa Jesuh Khrih hehpihna thupha note khempeuh tungah hong om tahen. Amen.)"},"25":{"text":"Eite khempeuh in Pasian phat ni. Keima hilh Jesuh Khrih thu ahi Lungdamna Thu le tanglai-in a ki-imcip, tu-in a kipholak thu-ah, amah pen note’ upna a hong kipsak thei pa ahi hi.","title":"Pasian Phatna tawh Thukhupna"},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in Pasian umin a zuihtheih nadingin tu-in kamsangte’ laigelhnate le a nungta tawntung Pasian’ thupiakna tawh tua thu ki-imcip pen a hong kipholak ta ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Thu khempeuhah pilna a nei, amah bek ahi Pasian in Jesuh Khrih hangin a tawntungin phatna ngah ta hen! Amen."}}}}},"46":{"info":{"name":"Korin Masa","shortname":"1Kr","abbr":[],"desc":"Korin Khua Khristian-te Tungah Paul' Laikhak Masa pen, Paul in Korin khua-ah a pian'sak pawlpi sungah Khristian nuntakna leh upna thu tawh kisai-in thu nawngkai a piangte a huhna dingin a kigelh ahi hi. Tua hun laitakin Korin khua pen mi namkim a omna Grik khuapi khat hi a, Rom kumpite' ukna sungah a om Akhaia gamsungah kumpi khua ahi hi. Tua khua pen sumbawlna lam, minam nuntakzia kisaktheihpihna lam, nulepa thangtatna lam, leh biakna namtuam tampi a omna lam tawh kisai-in a min a kiza mahmah khuapi khat ahi hi. Sawltak Paul in a lunghihmawh a thupite in: Pawl kikhenna, pawl sungah nulepa thangtatna, nupa thu, lungsimah man i sak bangin gamtatna, pawl sungah paizia, Kha Siangtho hong kipiakna, leh thawhkikna thute ahi hi. Amah in thuthuk a muhna tawh hih thu tuamtuamte tawh kisai-in Lungdamna Thu in a kilawm a kituakin gen ding a neihkimna a lak hi. A lian 13 sungah, Pasian in a mite tungah a hong piak letsong lakah itna a lianpen ahihna thu kilak a, hih laibu sung panin hih sung a kilim theihpen mun khat hi khasop ding hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh’ sawltak dingin Pasian in a hong teel keimah Paul le thu upna sungah i sanggam Sosthenes in,","title":"Hopihna"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih tawh kipawlna hangin Pasian’ mi suakin, Pasian’ mi siangtho cihna a ngah, Korin khua-a om Pasian’ pawlpi mite le eite’ Topa bek hi loin, amaute’ Topa zong ahi, i Topa Jesuh Khrih tungah thu a ngen, mun khempeuhah a om mite tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:1"},"3":{"text":"I Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak hiam cih leh Khrih tawh na kipawlna hangun, thugen siamna le thu theihtel siamna a kipan siamna nam khempeuh na neikim uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Note sungah Khrih thu kiptakin om ahih manin,"},"7":{"text":"i Topa Jesuh Khrih hong kilatkik ding ngakin na om hun sungun thupha na ngah loh uh khat beek om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama hong kilatkik hun ciang dong, a tawp dongin mawhna le kisuanna nei loin na om nadingun i Topa Jesuh Khrih mah in note hong huh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama Tapa ahi i Topa Jesuh Khrih tawh a kikhawl dingin a hong sam Pasian pen a citak Pasian hi a, a gensa bangin a hong tungsak takpi ding ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note khatlekhat kithutuakin, pawl kikhenna omkha loin, na lungsim, na ngaihsutna uh le na ngimna uh na kikhatsak nadingun i Topa Jesuh Khrih min tawh ka hong thum hi.","title":"Pawlpi Sungah Kikhenna"},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sanggamte aw, note lakah kitot kiselna a omna thu, Khloe’ innkuanpih mite in kei kiangah hong gen uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bang ka cih ciangin note pawlkhat in, “Kei, Paul’ pawl ka hi hi,” cihna ahi a, pawlkhat in, “Kei, Apollos’ pawl ka hi hi,” cihna ahi a, pawlkhat in, “Kei, Peter’ pawl ka hi hi,” cihna ahi a, pawlkhat in, “Kei, Khrih’ pawl ka hi hi,” cihna ahi zongin na kampaunate uh ka cihna ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:24"},"13":{"text":"Note in Khrih na phelsuah zenzen uh hi. Note a dingin Paul in singlamteh tungah khaina thuak ahi hiam? Note, Paul’ nungzui dingin tui kiphum na hi uh hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Krispas le Gaias cih simloh note khat beek hong tuiphum lo ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:8; 19:29; Rom 16:23"},"15":{"text":"Tua bang hikeileh keima min tawh a kiphumin na kigen kha ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"(Eh! Stefanas-te innkuan zong ka tuiphum mah hi. Tuate cih simloh kuamah dang ka tuiphum lam ka thei kei hi.)","ref":"1Kor 16:15"},"17":{"text":"Khrih in tuiphum nasep a sem dingin kei hong sawl lo a, Lungdamna Thu a hilh dingin a hong sawl bek ahi hi. Tua bang hi kei hen la, pilna le gen siamna a nei hi leng, Khrih in singlamteh tunga a thuakna thu in vangliatna a neihna hang kisa lo kha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna a thuak mite a dingin singlamteh tungah Khrih sihna thu pen a haihuai thu ahi hi. Ahi zongin hotkhiatna a ngah eite a dingin Pasian’ vangliatna ahi hi.","title":"Khrih pen Pasian’ Vangliatna le Pasian’ Pilna"},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah, “Mipilte’ pilna ka susia ding a, miteite’ teina ka heikhiatsak ding hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 29:14"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tuhuna mipilte, miteite, le thusel a siamte, bangin kimang ahi hiam? Hih leitung pilna pen haina a suahsak khitna kilang khinzo hi.","ref":"Job 12:17; Isa 19:12; 33:18; 44:25"},"21":{"text":"Pasian in ama pilna hong zang a, mihingte in amau’ pilna tawh pasian a theih zawh loh nadingun a bawl hi. Leitung mite’ hong muhna panin note a tamzaw, mipil na hi kei uh a, mi vanglian zong na hi kei uh a, mi thupi zong na hi kei uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in mipilte a maizumsak nadingin mihaite hong teel a, mi thahatte a maizumsak nadingin mi thaneemte a hong teel hi."},"28":{"text":"Leitung mite in thupi a sakte uh a suksiat theih nadingin Pasian in leitung mite’ simmawh a niamte, bangmahin a ngaihsut loh uh mite a teel hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian’ mai-ah mite a kisaktheih nading thu om lo hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in Jesuh Khrih hangin note tungah nuntakna hong pia a, tua Jesuh Khrih pen eite’ pilna, Pasian tawh i kipawl theihna, Pasian’ mi siangtho suakin, hotkhiatna i ngah theihna ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah, “A kisathei mite, Topa’ hang bekin kisathei ta hen,” ci-in na kigelh hi.","ref":"Jer 9:24"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Pasian’ thu hilhin note kiangah kong pai lai-in, mipilte’ zat kam thukpipi le pilna kamte ka zang kei hi.","title":"Singlamteh tungah a Kithat Khrih’ Thu Gen"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note kiangah ka om laitakin singlamteh tungah Jesuh Khrih a sihna thu simloh thudang peuhmah ngaihsut loh dingin ka ngaihsutsa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note kiangah kong pai lai-in thaneemin, launa tawh ka ling a,","ref":"Sawl 18:9"},"4":{"text":"thu ka hong hilh ciangin zong leitung mipilte’ zat kammalte le siamnate ka zang kei a, Pasian’ Kha Siangtho vangliatna tawh thu ka hong hilh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note’ thu upna pen mihingte’ pilna hang hi loin, Pasian’ vangliatna hangin a um na hi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin kha thu lamah a khangham mite tungah pilna thu ka gen hi. Tua ka gen pilna pen tu-in a maimang kuankuanta ding hih leitung mite’ pilna le vangliatna thu hi lo hi.","title":"Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ Lahna"},"7":{"text":"Tua ka gen pilna thu pen mite’ theih lo dingin Pasian in a ipcip Pasian’ pilna thusim hi a, eite’ minthan nadingin leitung pianma pekin Pasian in a na koihsa thu ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih leitung a uk mite kuamah in hih pilna thu thei lo uh hi. Thei hi le-uh, a minthang Topa pen singlamteh tungah na that lo ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah, “Kuamah in a muh ngei loh, a zak ngei loh, piangthei dingin zong a ngaihsut loh uh thu pen Pasian in amah a it mite a dingin a bawlkholh saksa ahi hi,” ci-in na kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 64:4"},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in a Kha Siangtho tawh eite tungah tua thusim a hong langsak hi. Tua Kha Siangtho in na khempeuh kankhia a, Pasian’ ngimna a ki-imcip a thutawng dongtakin a kankhia hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing khat’ ngaihsutna pen ama lungsim bek mah in a theih mah bangin Pasian’ Kha Siangtho bek mah in Pasian’ thu a cingin a thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Eite’ ngah lungsim pen leitung mite’ lungsim hi lo a, Pasian in eite tungah a hong piak na khempeuh i theih nadingin Pasian’ hong piak Kha Siangtho lungsim ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih bangin thu ka hong gen uh ciangin zong, mihingte’ hong hilh pilna kamte a zang hi loin, Kha Siangtho a nei mite tungah kha tawh kisai thu ka gen uh ciangin Kha Siangtho in a hong hilh kammalte zangin a gen ka hi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin Kha Siangtho a nei lo mite in Pasian’ Kha Siangtho in a hong piak nate sang thei lo uh hi. Kha Siangtho a nei mite bek in theithei uh ahih manin amaute in tel thei lo uh a, amau a dingin a haihuai thu khat ahi lel hi."},"15":{"text":"Kha Siangtho a nei mite in na khempeuh theithei uh a, ahi zongin leitung mite in bangmah thei lo uh ahih manin a lungmang uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho in, “Kua in Topa’ lungsim thei a, ama gamtat nading lam lak thei ahi hiam?” na ci hi. Ahi zongin eite in Khrih lungsim i nei hi.","ref":"Isa 40:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, a taktakin ci lehang, kha nuntakna a nei mite tungah thugen bangin ka hong gen thei kei hi. Leitung mite tungah thugen bang le Khrih upna sungah naungek a bangte tungah thugen bangin ka hong gen ding kisam hi.","title":"Pasian a’ ding Nasem Khawmte"},"2":{"text":"Note in antak nezo nai lo na hih manun nawitui ka hong tulh hi. Tu mahmahin zong nawi bek mah tulh ding a kisam lai na hi uh hi.","ref":"Heb 5:12-13"},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ deihna bangin gamta loin, leitung lungsim deihna bangin gamta lai na hih manun upna sungah naungek bang ahi lai na hi uh hi. Note khatlekhat kihaza-in kitawng kiselin na om uh ciangin hih leitung mite mah a bang lel na hihna uh hong kilang hi."},"4":{"text":"Pawlkhat in, “Keimah, Paul’ pawl ka hi hi,” ci-in, pawlkhat in, “Apollos’ pawl ka hi hi,” na cih uh ciangin leitung mi mawkmawkte mah bangin a gamta na hi uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 1:12"},"5":{"text":"A taktakin ci lehang, Apollos i cihte, Paul i cihte, bangpi hi zenzen ka hi uh hiam? Note in thu na uptheih nadingun Pasian’ nasemte ka hi lel uh hi. Topa in kote’ sep dingin a hong piak nasep tuak a sem ka hi lel uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima nasep pen khaici vawh hi a, Apollos’ nasep pen tuibuah hi a, ahi zongin a khangsak pa ahihleh Pasian ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:4-11,24-28"},"7":{"text":"Khaici vawh pa le tuibuak pa a thupi hi lo a, a khangsak Pasian a thupi hi bek hi."},"8":{"text":"Khaici vawh pa le tuibuak pa a kizakim ahi hi. Pasian in komau sepna tuak tawh kizui-in thaman hong pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kote pen Pasian a dingin na a semkhawm mite ka hi uh a, note pen Pasian’ lo na hi uh hi. Note pen Pasian’ inn zong na hi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian in kei tungah a hong piak siamna zangin, innlam siamte’ nasepteng semin, a khuam thupiteng ka phut a, Apollos in tua khuam phuhsa tungah innlam a zom hi. Tua khuam tungah inn a lam pa a kingaihsut mahmah ding kisam hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima phuhsa khuam thupiteng ahi Jesuh Khrih cih simloh kuamah dang in khuam thupi dang phutthei nawn lo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua khuam tungah kham, ngun, suangmanpha, sing, bi, lopa, a nam tuamtuam kilam thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua a kilam nate mei tawh a kize-et ding Ni hong tung ding a, tua nasepnate a bangci hiam, ci-in mei in ze-et ding ahih manin a lam mite’ nasep ciat hong kilang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in tua khuamte tungah a lam nate bangmah a cihzawh kei leh a nasep thaman a ngah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi khat in a lam nate a kattum leh amah a sum hi ding hi. Tua nate a lam pa ahihleh meikat nading panin a suakta bang keekin a suakta bek ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Note pen Pasian’ biakinn na hihna uh le note sungah Pasian’ Kha Siangtho a teng ahih lamtak na theihsa uh ahi hi.","ref":"1Kor 6:19; 2Kor 6:16"},"17":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in Pasian’ biakinn susia leh Pasian in tua mipa susia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ biakinn a siangtho hi a, note zong tua biakinn siangtho na hi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Note khatpeuh hih leitung ngeina-ah a pilin na kingaihsut uhleh a pil taktak na hih theih nadingun a hai na suak phot un."},"19":{"text":"Hih leitung mite in pilna hi, ci-in a ngaihsutte, Pasian a dingin a haihuai thu ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in, “Mipilte amau’ ngian mahah awksak hi,” a na ci hi.","ref":"Job 5:13"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin, “Mipilte’ ngaihsutna a mawkna hi, ci-in Topa in a thei hi,” ci-in zong na gen lai hi.","ref":"La 94:11"},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kuamah in midangte’ siamna kisialhpih kei un. A taktakin ci lehang na khempeuh nomau a’ hizaw hi."},"22":{"text":"Paul, Apollos, Peter cihte ahi a, hih leitung, nuntakna, sihna, tuhun le mailam hun, cihte a kipan na khempeuh nomau a’ ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Note pen Khrih a’ na hi uh a, Khrih pen Pasian a’ ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kote pen Khrih’ nasem, le Pasian’ thusim a zeekte-in nong ngaihsut ding uh ahi hi.","title":"Sawltakte’ Nasepte"},"2":{"text":"Nasem i cih mite pen a topa uh tungah citakin a thuman ding uh kisam hi."},"3":{"text":"Note na hi uh a, leitung mite in ahi zongin kei tungah mawhna hong zongin thu nong khen uh hangin bangmah phamawh ka sa kei hi. Kei mahmah zong kimawhsakin thu ka kikhen kei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka kisuan nading thu bangmah ka thei het kei hi. Ahi zongin tua pen ka dik hi, cihna hi pah lo hi. Keima thu a hong khen ding pa pen Topa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a hun a tunma-in kuamah mawhsakin thu khen kei un. Topa hong pai ciangin a tawpna thukhenna hong om ding a, amah in thusimte hong pholakin, mihingte in a lungsim sung uhah a ipcip uh thute hong telkheh ding hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in amau’ ngah dingin a kilawm phatna, Pasian’ kiang panin a ngah ciat ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note a’ ding ka ngaihsutna-in hih thu khempeuh Apollos le keima pumpi tungah ka zat uh thu ahi hi. “A khengvalin gamta kei un,” cihna thu na theih nadingun ko tegel, etteh dingin ka hong zang hi. Note in mi khatpeuh kisaktheihpihin mi khatpeuh na simmawhbawl kei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Note in bang kisaktheihpih na hi uh hiam? Tu-a na neih khempeuh uh Pasian’ hong piak hi lo ahi hiam? Tua ahihleh hong kipiasa bek ahih manin a bang kisaktheihpih na hi uh hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Na deih khempeuh uh neikhin na kisa uh a, haukhin na kisa uh hi. Kote’ om loh kalin kumpi a suak khinin na kingaihsun uh hi. Note tawh kumpi hikhawm ding ihih manin kumpi taktak a suak takpi na hi le-uhcin ka ut mahmah hi."},"9":{"text":"Ko sawltakte pen vantungmi le leitung mi khempeuh in a et dingin mipi’ mai-ah thahna a thuak dingin thukhenna a kipia mi bangin Pasian in a zaneu penin hong koih tawntung tawh kibang ka sa hi."},"10":{"text":"Khrih hangin mite mai-ah kote mihai ka suak uh a, ahi zongin note pen Khrih sungah mipil na kisa uh hi. Kote ka thaneem uh a, ahi zongin note a hat na kisa uh hi. Kote hong kisimmawhbawl a, ahi zongin note hong kizahtakbawl na kisa uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni ciang dong gilkial dangtakin puansilh ding nangawn nei loin ka om uh hi. Inn le lo zong nei loin hong kinotsuk hong kinotto kawikawi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kote’ nektawm ding ka thatang mahmah uh tawh nakpitakin ka sem uh hi. Hong kisamsiat ciangin thupha ka lehpiak uh a, hong kibawlsiat ciangin ka gumthuak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:3"},"13":{"text":"Zahpihna kam tawh hong kihopih ciangin kamkhum tawh ka dawng uh hi. Mite’ muhna-ah tuni ciang dong ninbulom le leivuithem bang bek ka hi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih bangin lai ka hong gelh ciangin na maizum nading uh ka deihna hi lo a, ta itte thuhilh bangin a hong thuhilh ka hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Khrih thu hong hilh ding mi a tul a za-in na nei uh ahi zongin pa-a na neih ding uh kei bek a om ka hihna thu na phawk un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note kiangah lungdamna thu ka hong hilhna hangin Jesuh Khrih sungah nomau’ pa ka suak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin keima gamtatzia na hong zuih nadingun ka hong thum hi.","ref":"1Kor 11:1; Fil 3:17"},"17":{"text":"Tua thu hangin note kiangah, ka it mahmah, Topa thu sungah a citak mahmah, ka tapa Timoti ka hong paisak hi. Amah in, Jesuh Khrih thu sungah ka nuntakna ziate le pawlpi a tuamtuamte kiangah ka thuhilhte khempeuh, note tungah hong hilh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Note kiangah kei hong hawh lo ding, ci-in ngaihsun kha uh ahih manin mi pawlkhat a kiphasak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa in hong thukimpih nakleh kei ka hong hawhbaih ding a, tua a kiphatsak pau mawkmawkte in bang ciang taktak a hihzo ngap uh hiam, cih thu keima pumpi tawh ka mu ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian’ Ukna thu i cih pen kampi bek tawh genna hi lo a, Pasian’ vang tawh nungta-in gamtatna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note taii-in gim a hong pia dingin ka hong pai ding le itna le lungnemna lungsim tawh ka hong pai ding koi deihzaw na hi uh hiam?"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lakah numei tawh paktatna nasia mahmahin, lawkite nangawn a gamtat lohte na gamtatna uh hong kigen a, mi khat in ama nukik nangawn a luppihna thu ka za hi.","title":"Numei tawh a Mawhte tungah Thukhenna","ref":"Thkna 22:30"},"2":{"text":"Tua bang kimlai bangci kisaktheih ding na hi uh hiam? Note na dah mahmah ding uh hizaw a, tua bang mite pen note lak panin na hepkhiat ding uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Note tawh ka pumpi-in ka hong omkhop loh hangin note tawh ka lungsim hong omkhawm a, ka pumpi-in note tawh a hong omkhawm zah mah bangin tua bang a gamta mite tungah i Topa Jesuh’ min tawh mawhsakna thu ka khen khinzo hi."},"4":{"text":"Note na kikhop khawm uh ciangin i Topa Jesuh Khrih vangliatna in eite hong ompih ahih manin, note tawh ka lungsimin ka hong omkhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa’ Ni hong tun ciangin tua bang mite’ kha in hotkhiatna a ngahtheih nadingin Satan in amau pumpi a gimsak dingin na piakhia ta un."},"6":{"text":"Note lakah hih bang gamtatna om napi-in na kisaktheih uh dahhuai mahmah hi. Silngo themkhat in annel lompi a pawmsak theih lamtak thei lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Gal 5:9"},"7":{"text":"Note na siangtho theih nadingun mawhna silngo luite na paikhia un. Tua hileh silngo sawh loh annel lom thak na hi ding uh a, zong ahi takpi mah na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam ci leh i Paisan Pawi hun hong tungta a, eite’ Paisan Tuuno ahi Khrih kigo khinzo ta hi.","ref":"Pai 12:5"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin mawhna le gitlohna ahi silngo lui a kisawh anlum tawh Paisan Pawi bawl loin, silngo a kisawh lo, sianthona le thutakna tawh bawlzaw ni.","ref":"Pai 13:7; Thkna 16:3"},"9":{"text":"Lai ka hong gelhna sungah, numei tawh a paktat mite tawh na kikholh loh nading uh ka hong gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua bang ka hong cih ciangin numei tawh a paktat, a huaiham, a guta, milim a bia lawkite tawh na kikhawl kei un, ka cihnopna hi lo hi. Tuate tawh kikhawl lo ding ci lehang, leitung panin paikhia un, cihna suak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ka hong laigelhna sungah ka cihnopna pen, thu upna sungah unau khat hi hang, ci napi-in numei tawh a paktat, a huaiham, milim a bia, mi gensia, zukham, ahih kei leh a guta theite tawh kikhawl kei un, cihnopna ahi hi. Tua bang mite tawh an ne ding nangawnin zong na tukhawm kei un."},"12":{"text":"Tua bang a pualam mite mawhsakin thu ka khen ding kei’ nasep hi lo hi. Pasian in amaute’ thu khen ngawn ding hi. Ahi zongin note in na pawlpih uh mite tungah thu na khen ding uh ahi hi. Lai Siangtho in, “Note lak panin migilo pa na lakhia un,” na ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 13:5; 17:7","merge":"13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note khatlekhat thu na kineih uh ciangin Pasian’ mi siangthote khensakzaw loin lawki thukhente’ mai na kitun ngam uh hi.","title":"Thu Um lote’ Mai-ah Kikhiatna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian’ mite in leitung mite’ thu a khensakzaw ding ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam? Note pen leitung mite’ thu a khensak ding na hih uh ciangin tua bang thu neute khen thei lo lawmlawm na hi uh hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Eite pen vantung mite’ thu nangawn a khensak ding ihih lamtak thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih manin hih leitung a no’ thu neuneute leltak na khentheih zawk kan ding uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bang hinapi-in hih bang thu themthem hong pian ciangin pawlpi sungah bangmahin a kisim lo mite’ mai kitun ding na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Note a dingin zumhuai mahmah hi. Note khatlekhat na kithuneihnate uh a khenthei ding note lakah mipil khat beek om buang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua hinapi, khatlekhat thu kineihin zum na kitun uh a, lawki thukhente na khensak tazen uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Note khatlekhat zum na kitut mahmah uh zong a gina het lo na hihna uh hong kilangsak hi. Bang hangin thuakzaw mai lo a, sum ngamzaw mai lo na hi uh hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Note khatlekhat kisu-in, khatlekhat na kisut zawsop uh a, na sanggamte teekteek nangawn uh tawh thu na nei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Migilote, Pasian’ Ukna sungah a lut hetloh nading thu na thei uh hi. Note kihaibawl kei un. Numei tawh a paktatte, milim biate, mi zi ahih kei leh mi pasal tawh a mawhte, pasal le pasal a khialte,"},"10":{"text":"a gutate, a huaihamte, zukhamte, mi gensiate, ahih kei leh mi’ na a sutte khat beek, Pasian’ Ukna sungah lutthei het lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Note pawlkhat, tua bangin na gamta uh hi. Ahi zongin note pen i Topa Jesuh Khrih le i Pasian’ Kha Siangtho hangin mawhna panin a hong kisiangsak khinsa, Pasian’ tungah a kipiasa, Pasian tawh a kipawlsa mite na hi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ka ut peuhpeuh ka hihtheih nading thu om hi,” a ci omkha ding hi. Ahi zongin na khempeuh hih ding kilawm lo hi. Kei zong ka ut khempeuh ka hih theih hangin tua bang gamtatna khat peuhpeuh’ sila ka suak nuam kei hi.","title":"Pasian’ Minthan nadingin Pumpi Zang Ding","ref":"1Kor 10:23"},"13":{"text":"“An pen i gilpi a’ ding hi a, gilpi zong an a’ ding mah hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci zong omkha ding hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in tua tegel a beisak hun hong tung ding hi. Pumpi pen paktatna-in zat ding hi lo a, Topa’ na sepna-in zat ding hizaw hi. Topa in pumpi a’ ding na hong sem hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian in sihna panin Topa thokiksak hi. Tua mah bangin eite zong ama vangliatna tawh hong thokiksak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na pumpi uh, Khrih pumpi nate khat ahih lamtak thei lo na hi uh hiam? Khrih pumpi nate khat la-in numei tawh paktatte’ pumpi nate khat suaksak ding ihi hiam? Tua cih ngei ding hi peuhmah lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Numei paktat tawh a pumpi a kizomsak pa pen tua numei tawh pumkhat sakhat a suak ahih lamtak thei lo na hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in, “Tua mi nihte pumkhat a suak ding uh hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Pian 2:24"},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa tawh a kizomte pen kha thu tawh kisai-in amah tawh pumkhat ahi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Numei tawh mawhna na pelh un. Mi khat in a bawl mawhna tuamtuamte in ama pumpi sukha lo hi, a ci om hi. Ahi zongin numei tawh a mawhte, ama pumpi tungah a khial ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Na pumpi uh, Pasian in a hong piak, note’ sungah a teng Kha Siangtho’ biakinn ahih lamtak thei lo na hi uh hiam? Note’ pumpi, nomau’ neihsa hi lo a, Pasian a’ ahi hi.","ref":"1Kor 3:16; 2Kor 6:16"},"20":{"text":"Note pen Pasian in a hong leisa na hih manun na pumpi uh Pasian’ minthan nadingin na zang un."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in nong laigelhna uh thu tawh kisai-in: Pasal in zi nei kei leh hoihzaw lo ding ahi hiam, na ci uh hi.","title":"Nupa Thu"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin numei tawh paktatna tamlua ahih manin pasal in ama zi tuam nei hen la, numei in ama pasal tuam nei leh hoih hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal in a zi a luppih dingin a kilawm zahin luppih ding a, a zi in zong a pasal a luppih dingin a kilawm zahin a luppih ding ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Zi in ama pumpi a ut bangin zangthei nawn loin a pasal’ zat ding hi a, tua mah bangin a pasal in zong ama pumpi a ut bangin zangthei nawn loin a zi’ zat ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Thungetna-in hun na zattheih nadingun tawlkhat sung tuam om ding thukim khawm masa lopi-in lupkhop ding kinialkha kei un. Tua bangin tawlkhat sung na tuam om khit uh ciangin note’ pumpi’ deihna hangin Satan’ ze-etna sungah na pukkhak loh nadingun a ngeina bangin lupkhop ding kipan kik un."},"6":{"text":"Hih bangin kong gen ciangin a hoihpen hi, ci-in thugenna hi lo a, note’ pianzia tawh kizui-in hithei tei hi, cihna lel ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khempeuh keimah bangin om ciat le-uh hoih ka sa hi. Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in Pasian’ piak hihzawhna a tuamtuam nei a, khatlekhat kibang lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasal nei nai lote le meigongte pen keimah bangin tanggawl om paisuak le-uh hoih ka sa hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin a pumpi uh a ki-ukzawh kei ding uhleh pasal nei le-uh hoihzaw hi. Nei nuampipi a neih loh tentan sangin pasal neih hoihzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"A neisate tungah, kei’ ngaihsutna hi lo, Topa’ ngaihsutna ka gennop thu in: Zi in a pasal ciahsan kei tahen."},"11":{"text":"A ciahsan leh zong pasal nei loin om paisuak hen. A om paisuakzawh kei leh a pasal ngei mah zuankik hen. Pasal in a zi ma kei tahen.","ref":"Mat 5:32; 19:9; Mrk 10:11-12; Luk 16:18"},"12":{"text":"Adangte tungah, Topa’ cih hi lo, keima ngaihsutna ka gennop thu in: Mi khatpeuh in thu um lo mi khat zi-in a neih leh, pasal mahin neih ding a zi a lungkim ahih nakleh ma kei tahen."},"13":{"text":"Numei khat in thu um lo mi khat pasalin a neih leh, zi mahin neih ding a pasal a lungkim ahih nakleh ma tuan kei tahen."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thu um lo pasal pen a zi’ hangin thu um mi suakthei ding a, thu um lo zi pen a pasal’ hangin thu um mi suakthei ding hi. Tua bang hileh a tate uh thu um mi suakthei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin tua bang hi kei le-uh a tate uh thu um mi suakthei lo ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin thu um lo zi in ahi a, thu um lo pasal in ahi zongin kikhen ding a ut leh kikhen ta uh hen. Tua bang thute-ah thu um zi ahi a, thu um pasal ahi zongin a awk nading thu om lo hi. Pasian in nuamtakin a nungta dingin a hong sap ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Thu um zi in, “Ka pasal honkhiazo kei ning,” bangci-in cithei ding a, thu um pasal in, “Ka zi honkhiazo kei ning,” bangci-in cithei zenzen ding ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Mi khempeuh, Pasian in amau’ nuntak nadingin a sehna, le Pasian in a sap laitakin a omzia bangbangun nungta uh hen. Hih bangzia-in om ding pen pawlpi khempeuhah hilhin ka neih ngeina khat ahi hi.","title":"Pasian’ Hong Sehsak Nuntakna"},"18":{"text":"Vun ki-atsa mi khat Pasian in a sap leh, a vun ki-atna lim phiat tuan kei tahen."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh vun atna le vun at lohna a thupi hi lo a, Pasian’ thupiakte zuih ding a thupi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a kuamah peuh, Pasian in a sap laitakun a omzia bangbangun a om paisuak ding uh ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Sila ahi mi khat Pasian in a sap leh phamawh lo hi; sila mahin ki-om thei veve hi. Ahi zongin suahtak theih nading lampi a om leh tua hunhoih hamphatna zang tahen."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a sap sila ahi mi pen Topa a dingin mi suakta hi a, tua mah bangin Khrih in a sap a suakta mi pen Khrih a dingin sila ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Note pen Pasian’ hong leisa na hih manun mite’ sila suak kei un."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, hong kisap laitakin na omzia uh mah bangin Pasian’ sungah na om paisuak un."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in a nungak lai a tangval laite thu tawh kisai-in: Topa kiang panin thu ngahna ka neih loh hangin Topa’ hehpihna tawh a muantaak ahi keima ngaihsutna ka hong gen ding hi.","title":"Nungak-tangvalte le Meigongte Thu"},"26":{"text":"Tu laitakin a om bangun om paisuak leh hoihzaw ding hi, cihna thu tawh kisai-in, tu laitak a lungkhamhuai thu ka ngaihsut ciangin tu laitakin a om bangun om paisuak leh hoihzaw mah dingin ka ngaihsun hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi zongin zineite in kikhen ding ngaihsutin nei kei tahen. Nungak lai tangval laite in lawm zong kei tahen."},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin pasal in zi a neih hangin a khial hi lo a, numei in zong pasal a neih hangin a khial hi lo hi. Ahi zongin zi nei, pasal neite in leitung lungkhamna tampi thuak uh ahih manin tuate tawh kipelhzaw le-uh hoih ka sa hi."},"29":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tua bang ka cih ciangin a kiseh hun hong nai mahmah ta hi, ka cihnopna ahi hi. Tua ahih manin zi neite pen zi nei lo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la,"},"30":{"text":"a dahte pen a dah lo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la, a lungdamte pen a lungdam lo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la, na a leite pen bangmah a nei lo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la,"},"31":{"text":"leitung na nuamtakin a zangte pen a zang lo mah bangin kingaihsun ta uh hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih leitung pen sauveipi kip nawn lo ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Note, lunghihmawhna tawh na kipelh ding uh ka hong deihsak hi. Zi a nei lote in Topa a lungdamsak theih nadingun Topa’ thu bek kinin nei uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi zongin zi neite in a zi a lungdamsak theih nadingun hih leitung vai kinin nei uh a,"},"34":{"text":"a ngaihsutna uh khen nih pha hi. Pasal a nei lo numeite in a lungsim le a pumpi uh Topa a dingin zangnuam uh ahih manin Topa’ nasep bek kinin nei uh hi. Ahi zongin pasal a nei numeite in a pasal uh a lungdamsak theih nadingun hih leitung vai kinin nei uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Hih bangin ka hong gen ciangin note’ haksat nading deihna hi loin note’ hoih nading ka deihna ahi hi. Note a kilawm a kituakin gamta-in, lungsim le thatang siit nei loin Topa’ na na septheih nading uh ka hong deihsakna ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tenpih dingin lawm dongkhin napi-in kiten nawn loh ding a ngaihsunte’ thu panin: Tenpih kei leng a numei tungah a thuman lo hi ding cihna ahi a, zi a deihna lungsim a lianlua ahi a, tenpih ding mah hoih hi, ci-in ngaihsutna ahi zongin a neih leh a lungkimna bangun gamta-in tenpih uh hen. Tua thu-ah bangmah khialhna om lo hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi zongin kuama sawl hi loin zi nei lo dingin a lungsimah khauhtakin khentatin, a lungsim ki-ukzo taktakin a ngaihsutsa ahih nakleh a neih loh hangin phamawh lo hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a neite zong hoih a, a nei loin a kikem zote hoihzaw lai hi."},"39":{"text":"Pasal a nei numei pen a pasal a nuntak laiteng suakta lo hi. A pasal a sih leh a deih peuhpeuh tawh kitengthei ding a, ahi zongin thu um mi bek tenpih ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahi zongin keima ngaihsutna-ah pasal a neihse sangin tuaci om leh lungdamzaw dingin ka um a, Pasian’ Kha Siangtho’ ngaihsutna mah zong hi-in ka um hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in milim biakna sa tawh kisai thu panin: Amaute in, “Ka thei uh hi,” a cih mah bangin eite khempeuh in theihna i neih ciatna thu i thei hi. Tua bang theihna in mite kisatheisak a, ahi zongin itna in mite kipsak hi.","title":"Milim Biakna Sa"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat in thu a thei-in a kingaihsut leh a taktakin a theih dingin a kilawmzah a thei nai lo ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khat in Pasian a it leh Pasian in tua mipa a na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih manin biakna sa tawh kisai thu panin: Milim i cih pen bangmah a om lopi khat lim dingin a kibawl na hi a, Pasian khat bek a om ahihna thu i theih ciat ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Leitung le vantungah pasian le topa a kici tampi a om ahi zongin,"},"6":{"text":"eite a dingin Pasian khat bek, Pa khat bek a om hi. Ama a dingin i nuntakna pa, na khempeuh a piangsak pa ahi hi. Eite tungah nuntakna a hong pia, na khempeuh a piangsak Topa Jesuh Khrih khat bek a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in hih thu theikim lo uh hi. Mi pawlkhatte, milim biakna thu-ah kingeinaseh lua khin uh ahih manin tuhun mahmahin zong biakna sate a nek uh ciangin tua milim tawh kisai sa mahin ngaihsunsun lai uh hi. Amaute lungsim thaneem uh ahih manin tua sate a nek uh ciangin a zehphi mahin kingaihsun uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua i nek ante in Pasian tawh i kizopna hong hoihsak tuan lo hi. I nekloh hangin siatna om tuan lo a, i nek hangin zong phatna om tuan sam lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin note’ utbangin gamtat theih nading thu na neihna uh hangin upna a neu laite a puksak na suahkhak loh nadingun hoihtakin kidawm un."},"10":{"text":"No thuthei-a a kineite, milim biakna inn sungah milim biakna sa na neklam uh, hih thu tawh kisai-ah a lungsim hatzo nai lote in hong mukha zenzen leh milim biakna sa nek ding a hanthawn na suakkha ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note’ thutheihna hangin, Khrih in sihna a thuakpih, thu upna sungah i sanggamte a siasak na suak ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bangin lungsim thaneemte gimsakin, thu upna sungah na sanggamte uh tungah na khialh uh ciangin Khrih tung mahmahah a khial na hi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin nekna in thu upna sungah ka sanggamte khat a khialsak ding ahihleh, amah a pukkhak loh nadingin milim biakna sa ka ne ngei het kei ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei pen sawltak ka hi a, mihingte’ khutnuai-a nasem ka hi kei hi. I Topa Jesuh tawh a kimu mi ka hi a, Topa a dingin na ka sepna hangin note pen thu um a suak na hi uh hi.","title":"Sawltak Khat’ Ngahtheihte"},"2":{"text":"Midangte in sawltakin hong ngaihsun ta kei le-uh, note in sawltakin na hong ngaihsut uh a kul ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa sungah na omna uh pen sawltak ka hihlam a kilatna ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mite in kei hong mawhsak uh ciangin ka gen thu in:"},"4":{"text":"Ka nasepna hangin annek tuidawn hong kipiak ding mah ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Sawltak dangte, Topa’ naute, le Peter mah bangin ka khualzinna-ah thu um mi ka zi a tonpih thei ding ka hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei le Barnabas bek, nektawmzon tawh a thuah ding ka hi zenzen kei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kuamah in ama sum bei-in galkap na sem lo uh hi. Leenggui suan napi-in a leenggah a ne lo kuamah om lo hi. Tuu cing napi-in a tuunawi a ne lo kuamah om lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih ka hong gente pen mihingte’ zat ngeina hi a, Thukham in zong a tuaci ding mahin a gen thu ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses Thukham sungah, “Buh a cil bawngtal a muk na tuam kei in,” ci hi. Hih bang a gen ciangin Pasian’ lunghihmawh pen bawngtalte hi zenzen lo hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:4; 1Tim 5:18"},"10":{"text":"Hih bang a gen ciangin ei mihingte hong cihnopna hi a, eite a dingin a kigelh thu ahi hi. Lo a khopa le an a lapa in amau’ ngah dingin a kilawm an a ngah dingin lametna tawh nasem ahi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Note lakah kha thu tawh kisai khaici hong vawh ka hih manun, note tung panin leitung nate ka ngah uh hangin a lianlua hi lo hi.","ref":"Rom 15:27"},"12":{"text":"Midangte in note tung panin ngahtheih nading thu nei uh ahihleh ko ka nei phazaw lai uh hi. Ahi zongin note tung panin ngahtheih nading thu a om hangin bangmah ka hong la kei uh a, Khrih hangin Lungdamna Thu a dongtangsak ka suahkhak loh nadingun na khempeuhah ka thuak tentan uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Biakinn-ah nasem dingin a kicial mite in biakinn mah panin an ngah uh a, biakna tau-ah na a semte in biakna sa mah a ngahna uh thei lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Thkna 18:1"},"14":{"text":"Tua mah bangin lungdamna thu a hilhte in tua nasepna mah panin nuntakna a ngah nading uh Topa’ thupiak ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 10:10; Luk 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih ngahtheih ding hamphatnate khempeuh ka la kei a, tu-in zong ka ngahtheih nadingin hih lai a hong gelh ka hi kei hi. Hih ka kisialhna teng a mawkna a suah ding sangin ka si nuamzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Lungdamna thu ka hilh hangin kisialh nading thu bangmah om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua thu a hilh ding mahin a hong kisawl ahi hi. Tua ahih manin lungdamna thu hilh kei leng kei a dingin a dahhuai mahmah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima utthu tawh a sem hi leng sep thaman ka lamen ding hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in a sem dingin hong sawl ahih manin ka sep ding nasep a sem ka hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahihleh ka sep thaman bang ahi hiam? Ka thaman pen, lungdamna thu tawh kisai ka sepna-ah thaman ngen loin, a khongin Lungdamna Thu hilh ding hamphatna ka neihna ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Kei pen kuama khutnuai mi hi loin a suakta mi hinapi-in, mi a tam theithei ka ngahzawh nadingin mi khempeuh’ khutnuai mi-in ka kibawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Jew mite lakah na ka sep ciangin amaute ka ngahzawh nadingin Jew mite khat mah bangin ka gamta a, Moses Thukham ka zuih ding a kisap loh hangin a zuite ka ngahzawh nadingin amaute lakah na ka sep ciangin amaute mah bangin ka gamta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Jew mite’ Thukham in a huam loh Gentail mite lakah na ka sep ciangin amaute ka ngahzawh nadingin Gentail mite bangmahin ka gamta hi. Hih bangin ka gen ciangin Pasian’ thukham a zui lo, cihna hi loin Khrih’ thukham zui-in a gamta ka hi hi."},"22":{"text":"Upna neu mite lakah na ka sep ciangin amaute ka ngahzawh nadingin amaute mah bangin ka gamta hi. Tua ahih manin ahih theihna lam peuhpeuhah mite ka ngahzawh nadingin mi khempeuh’ ngeina ka zui hi."},"23":{"text":"Hih bangin ka gamtatna pen amaute tungah Lungdamna Thu ka tuttheih nading le keima nasep hoihtakin ka septheih nading ka deihna ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tai kidemna-ah mi khat bek in thaman a ngah ding hinapi-in a vekpi-un tai veve uh hi. Tua ahih manin thaman na ngahzawh nadingun na tai un."},"25":{"text":"Kimawlna sungah a kihel mi khempeuh in thu khempeuhah a pumpi uh uk ciat uh hi. Amaute pen a kisiathei pak a ngah nadingun a hanciam uh hi a, eite pen a kisia thei lo i ngah nadingin a hanciam ihi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ngimna nei lopi-in a mawktai ka hi kei a, huihlak khawng a mawktuptup ka hi kei hi."},"27":{"text":"Kimawlna sungah midangte a kihel dingin a sam hinapi-in tua kimawlna-ah a kihel zo lo mi ka suahkhak loh nadingin ka pumpi seekin hoihtakin ka ki-uk hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Moses a zui i pu i pate tungah a piang thu na phawk ding uh ka deih hi. Meiipi in amaute khempeuh na hu a, a vekpi-un nuamtakin San Tuipi na kantanzo uh hi.","title":"Milim Biak loh ding Hilhkholhna","ref":"Pai 13:21-22; 14:22-29"},"2":{"text":"Meiipi sung le tuipi sungah ama nungzui a suak dingin Moses sungah amaute na kiphum uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A vekpi-un kha tawh kisai an ne uh a,","ref":"Pai 16:35"},"4":{"text":"a vekpi mahun kha tawh kisai tui na dawn uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute a tonpih, kha tawh kisai suangpi panin tui na dawn uh a, tua suangpi pen Khrih ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 17:6; Gam 20:11"},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute a tamzaw tungah Pasian lungkim lo ahih manin gam sung tengah amaute’ luanghawm kithehzak hi.","ref":"Gam 14:29-30"},"6":{"text":"Amaute tungah a piangte khempeuh, eite a dingin hilhkholhna ahi hi. Amaute bangin a sia nate i deih kei ding a,","ref":"Gam 11:4"},"7":{"text":"amaute pawlkhat in a biak bangin milim i bia kei ding hi. Lai Siangtho in, “Anne zune dingin mite tu uh a, tua khit ciangin a lam dingin a ding uh hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Pai 32:6"},"8":{"text":"Amaute pawlkhat bangin numei tawh paktatna i gamta kei ding hi. Nikhat thu-in mi tul sawmnih le tulthum a si uh hi.","ref":"Gam 25:1-18"},"9":{"text":"Amaute pawlkhat bangin Topa i ze-et kei ding hi. Gul in amaute na tulum hi.","ref":"Gam 21:5-6"},"10":{"text":"Amaute pawlkhat bangin Pasian i phunsan kei ding hi. Vantung mite in amaute na sulum hi.","ref":"Gam 16:41-49"},"11":{"text":"Leitung beikuan hun sungah a om eite a dingin hih thupiangte i etteh ding thu hi a, eite hilhkholh nadingin lai sungah a kiciamteh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Lungkip takin ka omzo hi, ci-in a kingaihsun mite a pukkhak loh nadingun kikem uh hen."},"13":{"text":"Na tuah uh ze-etnate khempeuh pen mite’ tuah ngeingeite mah ahi hi. Pasian in citakin a thuciamna lenkip ahih manin note’ thuak zawh loh ding ze-etna hong tuaksak lo ding hi. Ze-etna na tuah hun uh ciangin zong na thuakzawh nading uh thahatna hong guan ding ahih manin na suahtak zawh nading uh lampi hong honsak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin lawm itte aw, milim biakna pelh un."},"15":{"text":"Thu ngaihsun thei mite tungah thugen bangin a hong gen ka hi hi. Ka thugente nomau mah in na ngaihsun tawm un."},"16":{"text":"Nekkhawm bawlna-ah leenggahzu hangin Pasian tungah lungdamna ko-in i dawn ciangin Khrih sisan hangin thuphate eite in zong a ngahkhawm cihna hi lo ahi hiam?
