I balnen anlum i nek ciangin zong Khrih pumpi hangin thuphate mah a ngahkhawm cihna hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Mat 26:26-28; Mrk 14:22-24; Luk 22:19-20"},"17":{"text":"Anlum khat bek hi a, eite mi tampi hinapi-in tua lum khat bek mah nekhawm ihih manin eite pumkhat bek mah ihi hi."},"18":{"text":"Israel mite’ thu ngaihsun dih un. Biakna sa a ne khempeuh pen biakna tau tungah Pasian biakna thu-ah a kipawl hi lo ahi uh hiam?","ref":"Siam 7:6"},"19":{"text":"Hih bang ka cih ciangin bang ka cihnopna ahi hiam? Milim ahi a, milim biakna sa ahi zongin thupi hi, a cinuam ka hi kei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka cihnopna pen, lawkite in gan a gawh uh ciangin dawi a biakna uh hi a, Pasian a biakna uh hi lo hi. Dawi biakna-ah note na kihel ding uh ka hong deih kei hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:17"},"21":{"text":"Note in Topa tawh nekkhawmna hai sung pan le dawi tawh nekkhawmna hai sung panin na dawnkhawm thei kei ding uh hi. Topa tawh nekkhawmna an leh dawi tawh nekkhawmna an zong na nekhawm thei kei ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"A nih tuakah kihelkhawm lehang Topa a heh nadingin a gamta ihi ding a, eite pen Topa sangin i hatzaw het kei hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:21"},"23":{"text":"“Ka ut peuhpeuh ka hihtheihna ding thu om hi,” a ci omkha ding hi. Ahi zongin na khempeuh ka hih ding kilawm lo hi. Na khempeuh hihtheih nading thu a om hangin a kihihthei khempeuh hihna in midangte’ hoih nading piangsak lo hi.","title":"Na Khempeuh, Pasian’ Minthan nadingin Hih Ding","ref":"1Kor 6:12"},"24":{"text":"A kuamah peuh in note’ angsung ding bek zong kei unla, midangte’ phattuam nading zongzaw un."},"25":{"text":"Na lungsim uhah kisuanna a om loh nadingin sa zuakna-ah a kizuak sa peuhpeuh bang sa ahi hiam, ci-in dong se loin na ututun na nethei ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in, “Leitung le a sungah a om khempeuh pen Topa a’ ahi hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"La 24:1"},"27":{"text":"Thu um lo mi khat in an nekpih dingin hong samin tua an ne dingin na pai leh, na lungsimah kisuanna a om loh nadingin bang sa ahi hiam, ci-in dong se loin ne lel in."},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in, “Milim biakna sa hi,” hong cih leh, tua a hong gen mipa na khualna le nangma lungsim nopmawhna a om loh nadingin ne kei pah in."},"29":{"text":"Nangma lungsim nuam lo ding cihna hi loin a hong gen pa’ lungsim nuam lo ding ahih manin ne kei in, a ci ka hi hi. Mi pawlkhat in, “Bang hangin kei’ gamtat nading mite’ ngaihsutna in hong khaktan thei ding ahi hiam?"},"30":{"text":"Keimah in Topa tungah lungdamna ko-in ne ka hih manin tua ka lungdamkohna thu-ah bang hangin hong kimawhsak thei ding ahi hiam?” cithei kha ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih manin keimah in ka hong gennop thu in: Na hihna khempeuh uh, nekna dawnna-ah ahi zongin Pasian’ minthan nadingin na hih un."},"32":{"text":"Jew mi ahi a, Gentail mi ahi a, Pasian’ pawlpi mi ahi zongin na lungnopmawhsak loh nadingun na gamta un."},"33":{"text":"Mite in hotkhiatna a ngahtheih nadingin ka sepna khempeuhah keima angsung ngaihsun loin mi khempeuh phattuam nading hanciamin, a kuamah peuh a lungkim nadingin ka gamtat mah bangin note zong na gamta un."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keimah in Khrih gamtatzia ka zuih mah bangin note in zong keima gamtatzia hong zui ta un.","ref":"1Kor 4:16; Fil 3:17"},"2":{"text":"Note in kei hong phawk tawntungin ka hong hilh thu khempeuh zui na hih manun ka hong phat mahmah hi.","title":"Numeite in Lu A Khuhna Ding Thu"},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin na theih ding uh ka deih thu in: Mi khempeuh’ lutang pen Khrih hi a, numei’ lutang pen pasal hi a, Khrih’ lutang pen Pasian ahihna thu ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasal khatpeuh in mihon biakna sungah a lukhu lakhia lopi-in thungen ahi a, Pasian’ thugen ahi zongin a om leh Khrih’ min a daisak ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mah bangin mihon biakna sungah numei khatpeuh in a lu khuh lopi-in thungen ahi a, Pasian’ thugen ahi zongin a om leh a pasal’ min a daisak hi a, a lu a met numei mah tawh a kilamdanna a om lo ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Numeite in a lu a khuh kei ding uhleh a sam uh met vet uh hen. Tua ahih manin numeite in a sam uh a met ding a zumhuai mahmah khat ahih mah bangin a lu uh khuh ta uh hen."},"7":{"text":"Pasalte pen Pasian’ lim le a minthanna a kilangsak ahih manin a lu uh a khuh ding uh kilawm lo hi. Ahi zongin numeite pen pasalte’ minthanna a kilangsak ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 1:26-27"},"8":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh numei tung panin pasal kipiangsak lo a, pasal tung panin numei kipiangsak zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Numei hangin pasal a kipiangsak hi lo a, pasal hangin numei a kipiangsak hizaw hi.","ref":"Pian 2:18-23"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin a pasalte uh ukna nuai-ah a om ahihna a lah nadingun vantung mite’ muhna-ah numeite in a lu uh a khuh ding uh kilawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin Topa thu sunga i nuntakna-ah numeite pen pasal tawh loin a tangdinzo hi lo a, pasalte zong numei tawh kop loin a tangdinzo hi tuan lo hi."},"12":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh numei pen pasal tung panin a kipiangsak hi a, pasal pen numei sung panin a suak ahi hi. Tua hi a, na khempeuh, Pasian kiang panin a hong pai ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih thu nomau mah in ngaihsun tawm un. Numeite in a lu uh khuh lopi-in mihon biakna lakah Pasian kiangah thu a nget ding uh kilawm ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"I pianpih ngeina mahmahah zong pasalte in sam sau a khawi pen amau a dingin a zumhuai thu ahihna,"},"15":{"text":"le numeite in samsau a neih pen a minthanna uh ahihna thu hong kilangsak hi lo ahi hiam? Numeite’ samsau pen a lu uh a tuam nadingin a kipia ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hih thu a nialnuam a omkhak zenzen leh eite a kipan Pasian pawlpi mi a kuamah peuh in tu-a ka hong gen ngeina lobuang adang a thei om lo hi, ci-in gen ding lobuang bangmah dang om lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin a nuai-a thu tawh kisai-in note ka hong pakta kei hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh pawlpi kikhopna na neih uh ciangin phatna sangin siatna na piangsakzaw uh hi.","title":"Nekkhawm Bawlna Zatkhialhna (Mat 26:26-29 ; Mrk 14:22-25 ; Luk 22:14-20)"},"18":{"text":"A masa penin, pawlpi na kikhop uh ciangin note lakah pawl kikhenna om hi, ci-in ka za hi. Hih ka zak thu a manna omkha dingin ka um hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kuateng pawlpi mi citak ahi hiam, ci-in a kilat nadingin kikhenna a ommah ding ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Nekkhawmna a bawl dingin note na kikhop uh ciangin Topa’ Nekkhawmna a ne dingin na pai kei uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh nekkhawmna ne dingin na pai uh ciangin pawlkhatte amau’ an tawh na tung masa-in ne pah uh ahih manin, pawlkhatte a kham mahmahin na om uh hangin pawlkhatte gilkialin a om uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih bangin na gamtat uh, anletui na nek nading uh inn nei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih kei leh Pasian’ pawlpi simmawh bawlin pawlpi mizawngte na maizumsak nopna uh ahi hiam? Hih thu tawh kisai-ah hong pakta ding nong sak uhleh note ka hong pakta het kei hi."},"23":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note kiangah ka hong gen thu pen Topa kiang panin ka ngah thu hi a, tua thu in: Topa Jesuh a kilehhek ding nitakin anlum la-in,","title":"Nekkhawm Bawlna A Pianna (Mat 26:26-29 ; Mrk 14:22-25 ; Luk 22:14-20)"},"24":{"text":"Pasian tungah lungdam a kohkhit ciangin balnen a, “Hih pen note a dingin a hong kipia keima pumpi ahi hi. Kei na hong phawk nadingun na ne un,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua mah bangin nitak an a nekkhit uh ciangin hai la a, “Hih hai sunga om leenggahzu pen keima sisan tawh a kikipsak Pasian’ thuciamna thak ahi hi. Hih bangin na dawn simun, kei na hong phawk nadingun na dawn un,” ci hi.","ref":"Pai 24:6-8; Jer 31:31-34"},"26":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh hih bangin anlum ne-in hai sung panin leenggahzu na dawn simun, Topa a hong paikik matengin ama sihna thu a gengen na hi uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a kilawm lopi-in Topa’ anlum ne-in, a hai panin leenggahzu a dawn mi peuhmah pen Topa’ pumpi le a sisan a mindaisak hi-in a mawh ahi uh hi.","title":"A Kilawm Lopi a Nekkhawmna"},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a kuamah peuh ki-entel masa phot uh hen la, tua khit ciangin Topa’ anlum ne-in a hai panin leenggahzu dawn pan tahen."},"29":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa’ pumpi a khiatna thei lopi-in anlum ne-in hai panin leenggahzu a dawn mi pen amahmah mawhsak thukhenna a kipiatawm ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua bang mawhna hangin note tampi tak cina-in na zawngkhal uh a, pawlkhat zong na si uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Eite hoihtakin ki-entel masa peuh lehang Pasian’ mawhsak thukhenna i thuak kei ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin eite in hih leitung mite tawh mawhsakna i thuakkhawm loh nadingin Topa in eite hong thuhilhin gim hong pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, nekkhawm ne dingin na kikhop uh ciangin kingakkim dimdiam un."},"34":{"text":"Tua bangin na kikhop uh ciangin Pasian’ thukhenna na thuakkhak loh nadingun a gilkial na om uhleh zong na inn uhah an ne masa un. Thu dangdangte ahihleh ka hong pai ciangin ka hong gen ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Kha Siangtho’ hong piak siamna a tuamtuamte tawh kisai thu na theih loh khak ding uh ka deih kei hi.","title":"Kha Siangtho’ Hong Piak Siamnate"},"2":{"text":"Lawki na hih lai-un a pau thei lo milimte’ thu-in na gamta uh a, na lungsim uh tua milimte in hong zo mahmah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Kha Siangtho in lam a lah mite in, “Jesuh in samsiatna ngah ta hen,” a cih lohna, le Kha Siangtho in lamlak kei leh kuamah in, “Jesuh pen Topa hi,” a cih theih loh nading thu na theih ding uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in siamna a nam tuamtuam om a, ahi zongin a hong pia Kha Siangtho a kibang ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nasepna a nam tuamtuam om a, ahi zongin a na i sepsak Topa a kibang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Nasep nading siamna a nam tuamtuam om a, ahi zongin septheih nading siamna a hong pia Pasian a kibang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khempeuh a dingin phattuamna a omtheih nadingin Kha Siangtho’ hong ompihna a nam tuamtuamin hong kilang hi."},"8":{"text":"Kha Siangtho in mi khat tungah thuthuk pilna hong guan a, tua Kha Siangtho mah in adang khat tungah thugen siamna hong guan hi."},"9":{"text":"Adang khat tungah upna hong guan a, adang khat tungah cina damsak theihna hong guan hi."},"10":{"text":"Adang khat tungah nalamdang bawl theihna, adang khat tungah Pasian’ thu hilh ding siamna, adang khat tungah Kha Siangtho piak siamna ahi leh ahi lo khentheih nading siamna, adang khat tungah pau lamdang pau theihna, adang khat tungah tua pau lamdang tuamtuam paunate a khiatna gentheihna hong pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih siamna a tuamtuamte a hong pia pen Kha Siangtho a kibang khat bek mah hi a, mi a tuamtuamte tungah ama hoihsak bangin a hong piak ahi hi.","ref":"Rom 12:6-8"},"12":{"text":"Pumpi pen khat bek hinapi-in na a tuamtuam a nei hi. Pumpi in na a tuamtuam tampi a neih hangin pumpi khat bek mah ahih veve mah bangin Khrih zong pumpi na a tuamtuam a nei pumpi khat ahi hi.","title":"Vekpi-in Pumpi Khat’ Nate","ref":"Rom 12:4-5"},"13":{"text":"Jew mi ihi a, Gentail mi ihi zongin, sila ihi a, sila ahi lo ihi zongin, eite minam tuamtuam ihih hangin Kha Siangtho khat bek mah in Jesuh’ pumpi a suak dingin ama sungah hong phum a, eite khempeuh tungah a hong kipia pen tua a kibang Kha Siangtho khat bek mah ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pumpi in na khat bek nei loin nam tampi tak a nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Khe in, “Kei, khut hi lo ka hih manin pumpi tawh ka kizom kei hi,” a cihmawk hangin pumpi na khat ahihna a bei hi tuan lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Bil in, “Kei, mit hi lo ka hih manin pumpi tawh ka kizom kei hi,” a cihmawk hangin pumpi na ahihna a bei hi tuan lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pumpi khempeuh mit suakkhin leh bang tawh khua za ding ahi hiam? Pumpi khempeuh bil suakkhin leh bang tawh a gimnam thei ding ahi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-a i neih bang tektekin, Pasian in ama deih bangin pumpi na a tuamtuam a hong bawlsak hi."},"19":{"text":"A vekpi-in pumpi na nam khat bek hi khin leh a pumpi ding koi-ah om nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-a i neih bangin pumpi khat bek om a, na tampi a nei hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mit in khut kiangah, “Nang ka hong kisam kei hi,” ci thei lo a, lutang in zong khe kiangah, “Nang ka hong kisapna om lo hi,” ci thei lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Pumpi na a ginalo tawh a kibangte a kimanna lian mahmah zawsop a,"},"23":{"text":"pumpi na bangmah gentaak lo i sakte pawl limtakin kep kul zawsop hi. I pumpi na hoih i sak khollohte pen,"},"24":{"text":"pumpi na hoih i sakte i lim et ding a kisap kholloh bang hi loin, limkep diak peuh kulzaw se hi. Ahi zongin i pumpi na thupi i sak khollohte limtakin i kepdiak ding a kisamin i pumpi a na bawl se hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahih manin i pumpi nate khatlekhat kithutuak lo cih om loin a vekpi-in a kilemkim uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Khat in natna ngah leh a vekpi-un thuakkhawm uh a, khat in pahtakna ngah leh a vekpi-un lungdam khawm uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tu-in note khempeuh pen Khrih pumpi na hi uh a, na vekpi-un a pumpi na khat ciat na hi uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in pawlpi sungah mi khempeuh ama panmun ciat dingah a hong bulh hi. A masa-in sawltakte, a nihna-ah kamsangte, a thumna-ah laihilhte, tua ciangin nalamdang bawltheite, cina damsak theite, midang a huhtheite, thu vaihawm a siamte, le pau lamdang a pau theite ahi uh hi.","ref":"Efe 4:11"},"29":{"text":"A vekpi-un sawltak hi lo a, a vekpi-un kamsang zong hi lo uh hi. A vekpi-un laihilh, thuhilh hi lo uh a, a vekpi-un nalamdang zong bawl lo uh hi."},"30":{"text":"A vekpi-un cina damsak nading siamna nei lo uh a, a vekpi-un pau lamdang pau thei lo uh a, a vekpi-un tua pau lamdangte a khiatna gen thei lo uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian’ hong piak siamna a hoihpente deih belin na nei ta un. Tu-in a hoihpen thu khat ka hong gen ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keimah in mihingte pau a tuamtuamte le vantung mite’ pau nangawn ka pautheih hangin itna ka neih kei leh a bil-aphuai zam le daltuah kitum tawh a kibang lel ka hi hi."},"2":{"text":"Thuhilh siamna nei-in, thusim khempeuh thei-in, na khempeuh thei-in, mualte kinsak zawh nading upna ka neih hangin itna ka neih kei leh ka kimanna bangmah om lo hi.","ref":"Mat 17:20; 21:21; Mrk 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Ka neih khempeuh midangte tungah pia-in, Pasian’ nasepna hangin kihaltumna ka thuak ahi zongin itna ka neih kei leh ka phattuamna bangmah om lo hi."},"4":{"text":"Itna neite a lungduai-in migi hi. Itna neite in hazatna lungsim nei loin, zong kisathei lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Itna neite a kilawm loin gamta lo, heh pakpak lo, mite’ mawhna ciamteh lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Thuman lote-ah lungdam ngei lo uh a, thumante bekah lungdam uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Itna neite lungkia cih om ngei lo hi; a upna, a lametna, lungduai takin a ngaknate uh a mawkna cih om ngei lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Itna pen a tawntungin a kip ahi hi. Thuhilh siamna a om tei hangin tawlkhat sung bek kimangin, pau lamdang pautheih siamnate a om hangin bei ding a, thutheih siamna a om hangin maimang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh eite’ neih thutheih siamnate le i thuhilh siamnate a kicing hi lo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi zongin a kicing thu hong tun ciangin a kicingtaak lo thuteng maimang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Naupang ka hih hun lai-in naupang mah bangin kampau-in, thu ngaihsunin, ka gamta hi. Ahi zongin tu-in khangham ka hih manin naupang vaite ka zang nawn kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Dal limlang sunga et bangin tu laitakin a kitel pha loin i mu milmial a, ahi zongin mai lamah maitang kituahin i mu ding hi. Tu laitakin i theihnate kicing lo a, ahi zongin mai lamah Pasian in eite hong theih mah bangin a kicing takin amah i thei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu laitakin a omlai thu thumte pen upna, lametna, le itna hi a, tua thumte sung panin itna mah a thu lianpen ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na deih lianpen uh ki-itna na hisak un. Kha Siangtho’ hong piak siamna a tuamtuamte sung panin thuhilh siamna neih ding na hanciam phapen un.","title":"Pau Lamdang Pauna le Thuhilhna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh pau lamdang a paute pen mite’ tungah thugen hi loin Pasian’ tungah thugen ahi hi. Amaute’ pau kuamah in thei lo a, Kha Siangtho’ vangliatna tawh Pasian’ thusimte a gengen ahi uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ thu a hilhte pen mite tungah thugen hi a, mite tungah huhna, hanthotna, le hehnepna a pia ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Pau lamdang a paute pen amau mahmah a phattuam nadingin a pau hi a, Pasian’ thu a hilhte ahihleh pawlpi’ phattuam nadingin nasem ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Note khempeuh pau lamdang na pautheih ding uh kong deihsak hangin Pasian’ thu hilh ding siamna na neih ding uh ka hong deihsakzaw hi. Pawlpi in phattuamna a ngahtheih nadingin note lakah a khiatna a genthei pah ding om ahih kei buang leh, pau lamdang a paute sangin Pasian’ thu a hilhte a lianzaw ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note kiangah hong pai-in pau lamdang tawh thu hong gen leng, bangin kimang ding ahi hiam? Note-a’ in Pasian’ thu theihna, pilna le siamna a hong piansak kei leh a kimanna themkhat zong om het lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei lo tamngai le harp lasaknate nangawn, a aw a kitelin ging sensen kei leh bang la kisa ahi hiam, ci-in kua in theithei ding ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Galdo nading peengkul a tum pa in a aw a kitelin tum kei leh galdo dingin kua kithawi thei ding ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Tua mah bangin na thugenna uh kammal kitel sinsen kei leh kua in note’ thugen theithei ding ahi hiam? Na thugen uh huihlakah a maimang suak lel ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Leitungah pau nam tampi om a, ahi zongin khiatna a nei lo khat beek om lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin a kipau paunam thei kei leng, kei pen a pau pa a dingin mi namdangpi ka hi ding a, a pau pa zong kei a dingin mi namdangpi khat hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Note in zong Kha Siangtho’ hong piak siamnate deih belin nei na hih manun pawlpi a dingin phattuamna taktak a piangsak ding siamnate mah nget belin na nei ta un."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin pau lamdang a paute in, amau paute a khiatna a gen theih nading uh siamna a neih nadingun thu ngen ta uh hen."},"14":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh pau lamdang tawh thu ka nget ciangin lungsim takpi tawh thungen ka hih tei hangin bang ngen ka hi hiam cih ka ngaihsun thei kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahihleh bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam? Ka lungsim tawh thu ka ngen ding a, ka ngette ka theih nading tawh zong ka ngen ding hi. Ka lungsim tawh la ka sa ding a, ka sakte ka theih nading tawh zong ka sa ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na lungsim bek tawh Pasian tungah lungdamna na koh ciangin kikhopna sungah a om midangte in bangci-in nang’ thungetna, “Amen,” hong cihpih thei ding ahi hiam? Nangma thungette a theihtheih nading uh bangmah om lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian tungah lungdam ko-in na thungetna a hoih mahmah hangin midangte in bangmah phattuamna ngah het lo hi."},"18":{"text":"Note khempeuh sangin pau lamdang pau theizaw ka hih manin Pasian tungah ka lungdam hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi ta zongin pawlpite’ biak kikhopna sungah pau lamdang kam tul sawm bang ka pau sangin midangte’ phattuam nadingin a theih ding uh kammal nga bek ka pauzaw ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, na thu ngaihsutnate uhah naupang bang kei un. Gitlohna lamah naupang bang unla, ahi zongin thu ngaihsutna-ah a khangham hi ta un."},"21":{"text":"Lai Siangtho sungah, “A lamdang kampau tawh amaute hopihin, minam dangte’ pau tawh thu ka gen ding a, tua bang nangawnin hih mite in keima thugen hong ngai lo ding uh hi, ci-in Topa in a gen hi,” ci-in na kigelh hi.","ref":"Isa 28:11-12"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin pau lamdang pen thu um mite a’ ding hi loin, thu um lo mite in a uptheih nading uh lim ahi hi. Tua mah bangin Pasian’ thuhilhna pen thu um mite a’ ding hi a, thu um lo mite a’ ding hi lo hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahih manin pawlpi mi khempeuh na kikhopna uhah na vekpi-un pau lamdangin pau-in, mi mawkmawkte ahih kei leh thu um lo mite in hong mu zenzen leh, note pen mihai hontang hi, hong ci ding hi lo ahi uh hiam?"},"24":{"text":"Ahi zongin na vekpi-un hoihtakin Pasian’ thu na gen laitakun mi mawkmawkte ahih kei leh thu um lote hong pai leh, a zak uh thute hangin a mawhna uh kiphawkin a hoih lohna uh kithei ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"A lungsim sung uhah a ipcipte uh kipholak ding a, khukdinin Pasian bia-in, “Hih mite lakah Pasian om taktak hi,” ci ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, ka hong gennop thu a tomin: Pasian bia dingin note na kikhop uh ciangin khat in la sak ding nei, khat in Pasian’ thu a gen ding nei, khat in pau lamdang tawh thugen ding nei, khat in tua a kigente a khiatna gentheih nading nei cih bangin na om ding uh hi. Hih a tuamtuamte khempeuh, pawlpi’ phattuam nading ahih ding kisam hi.","title":"Na Khempeuh A Kilawm A Kituakin Hih Ding"},"27":{"text":"Pau lamdang tawh thugen nuam a om leh zong, nih bang, ahih kei leh a tam penin thum bang in gen bek ding a, tua bangin a gen uh ciangin zong khat a man khit ciangin khat in a banbanin gen ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin a khiatna a genthei ding a om kei leh zong, kikhopna sungah pau lamdangin a pau nuam pa gamdai takin om ding a, amah le Pasian tawh kikal bekah kigen ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian thu gen ding a neite sung panin nih le thum bang bek in a banbanin gen ding uh a, adangte in limtakin na tel ngaih ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"A kikhawm mite sung panin mi khatpeuh in Pasian thu gen ding hong neih leh tua a thugen lai pa khawl phot ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Na vekpi-un a thu thei-in thahatna na ngahtheih nadingun no thugen ding a neite khempeuh in khatkhatin thu na ban gen ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Pasian in eite ahi zelzul dingin a hong sam hi lo a, hoihtak nuamtakin a om dingin a hong sam ahih manin Pasian’ thu gen ding lawpna lungsim pen a gen ding pa a ki-ukzawh ding a kisam ahi hi. Pasian’ pawlpi mite khempeuh lakah a kizang ngeina ahih mah bangin,","merge":"33"},"34":{"text":"mihon biak kikhopna sungah numeite pau loin om uh hen. Numeite a kiniamkhiat nading thu Jew Thukham in a gen mah bangin amaute in mihon lakah thu a gen ding uh kiphal lo hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaute in a theihnop uh thu a om leh, inn panin a pasalte uh dong ta uh hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihon lakah numeite kam a pau ding zumhuai hi."},"36":{"text":"Note kiang bek panin Pasian’ thu hong kipan a, note tung bekah a hong tung sa zenzen na hi uh hiam?"},"37":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in Kha Siangtho hong piak siamna a nei, Pasian thugen ka hi hi, ci-in a kingaihsut leh hih lai ka hong gelhte pen Topa’ thupiakna tawh a gelh ka hihlamtak a phawk ding kisam hi."},"38":{"text":"Hih ka thugente a don kei leh amah zong don kei pah un."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, Pasian’ thu hilh ding ngaihsut lian penin na nei unla, ahi zongin pau lamdang a paute na kho dah hoh un."},"40":{"text":"Na khempeuh a kilawm a kituakin na hih un."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note kiangah ka hong hilh, note in hong sangin kiptakin na let uh thu, na phawkkik ding uh ka deih hi.","title":"Khrih’ Thawhkikna"},"2":{"text":"Kei’ hong hilh thu pen lungdamna thu ahi hi. Note in kiptakin tua lungdamna thu na let nak-uhleh hotkhiatna a ngah na hi uh hi. Tua hikeileh na upna uh a mawkna ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Kei tungah a hong kihilh a thupi pen note tungah ka hong gensawn a, tua in: Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin eite’ mawhna tang dingin Khrih hong si-in","ref":"Isa 53:5-12"},"4":{"text":"kivui a, Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin a ni thum ni-in Pasian in hingkiksak hi.","ref":"La 16:8-10; Mat 12:40; Sawl 2:24-32"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Peter kiangah kilang a, a zomah sawltak sawm le nihte kiangah kilang hi.","ref":"Luk 24:34,36; Mat 28:16-17; Mrk 16:14; Joh 20:19"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin thu um mi zanga val tungah thakhatin kilang hi. Tua mi zanga valte, pawlkhat a sih khit tei hangin a tamzaw nungta lai uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin James tungah kilang a, tua banah sawltak sawm le nihte tungah kilang leuleu hi."},"8":{"text":"A tawpna penah, kei pen a ngeina bangin a suak lo naungek tawh a kibang hinapi-in kei tungah zong hong kilang hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:3-6"},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Pasian’ pawlpi a bawlsia mipa ka hih manin sawltak cih dingin zong a kilawm lo zah dongin sawltakte lakah a neupen ka hi hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3"},"10":{"text":"Tua bang hitaseleh Pasian’ hehpihna tawh tu-a ciangah ka om a, kei tungah a hong piak ama hehpihna a mawkna suak lo hi. Sawltak dangte khempeuh sangin na nakpitakin ka sem zawsop hi. Tua ka sepzawhna pen keima hatna hang hi loin Pasian’ hong hehpihna hang ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kei ka hi a, sawltak dangte in ahi zongin hong hilh thu pen Khrih’ thawhkikna thu mah hi a, note’ up zong tua thu mah ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in gen penin a kinei thu in: Sihna panin Khrih kihingkiksak hi, cihna thu ahih manin, bang hangin note pawlkhat in, misite thokik lo ding hi, ci thei na hi uh hiam?","title":"Misite’ Thawhkikna"},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin misite a thokik lo hileh Khrih zong a kithokiksak lo hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Khrih a kithokiksak lo hileh kote’ thuhilhna a mawkna hi ding a, note’ thu up zong a mawkna mah suak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua bek zong hi lo lai-in, misite a kihingkiksak lo ding hileh Pasian in Khrih hingkiksak hi, ci-in teci pang ka hih manun, mite kiangah Pasian’ thu a man lopi-in a gen ka suak ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh misite a kihingkiksak lo ding hileh Khrih zong kihingkiksak lo ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khrih a kihingkiksak lo hileh note’ upna a mawkna hi ding a, na mawhna sung mah uhah note a omlai na suak ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Khrih thu a um, a sisa mite zong a mawkna mah hi lai ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khrih hangin i lamet thu pen hih i leitung nuntak sung thu ding bek hi takpi leh leitung midang khempeuhte sangin a hehpihhuai zaw ihi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin a thuman taktak ci lehang, a sisa mite zong hingkik takpi ding hi cih a kitel theih nadingin sihna panin Khrih kihingkiksak khinzo hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khat hangin sihna a om mah bangin mi khat hang mahin misite zong hinkikna om hi."},"22":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Adam tawh a kizop manin mi khempeuh si a, tua mah bangin Khrih tawh a kizom khempeuh zong kihingkiksak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua hinkikna pen ama hun tawh kizui-in a banbanin hi ding hi. A masa penin Khrih hi a, Khrih hong paikik ciangin ama pawlte khempeuh hingkik ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Khrih in ukna, vangliatna, aana a nei ama galte khempeuh a zawhgawp khit ciangin Pa Pasian tungah ukna aana ap ding a, tua ciangin hih leitung hun beina hong tung ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in a galte khempeuh zo-in a khenuai-ah a koihkhit hun dong mateng Khrih in uk ding hi.","ref":"La 110:1"},"26":{"text":"A tawpna-ah suksiat ding a gal nunung pen in sihna ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in, “Pasian in na khempeuh ama khenuai-ah koih hi,” na ci hi. “Na khempeuh,” a cih ciangin Khrih’ khutnuai-ah na khempeuh a koih Pasian mahmah simloh a vekpi-in a huamkhin ahihna kitel hi.","ref":"La 8:6"},"28":{"text":"Khrih’ khutnuai-ah na khempeuh a kikoih ciangin ama khutnuai-ah na khempeuh a koihsak Pasian’ khutnuai-ah Tapa mahmah zong om ding a, Pasian pen na khempeuh le a kuamah peuh tungah a lianpen hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin thu khatah, a sisa mite’ tang dingin tui a kiphum mite in bang a deihna uh ahi hiam? Misite kihingkiksak het lo ding ahihleh bang hangin a sisate’ tang dingin tui kiphum ahi uh hiam?"},"30":{"text":"A site hinkikna om lo ding hileh bang hangin kote in nisimin gimna le sihna zah dong dingin lauhuaina thuakin na sem nuam ding ka hi uh hiam?"},"31":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesuh Khrih thu-ah note hangin ka kisaktheih zah mah bangin nisim mahin sihna a thuakthuak ka hi hi."},"32":{"text":"Hih leitung a phattuam nading bekin ngaihsun ni ci lehang, sahang tawh kilai bang keekin Efesa khuamite tawh ka kihihna uhah gim thaman bang ngah ka ahi hiam? Misite hinkikna om lo ding hileh, “Zing ciangin si kha ding ihih manin i duhduhin an ne zu ne-in nuamtakin om ni,” ci-in paunak a om bangin gamtat lel ding ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 22:13"},"33":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, mi’ khemsa-in ta kei un. Kikholhpih hoih lote in mi siasak thei hi."},"34":{"text":"Hoihtakin thu ngaihsun phakik unla, mawhna gamta nawn kei un. Note pawlkhat in Pasian thei het lo na hih manun maizumhuai mahmah hi."},"35":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte in, “A sisa mite bangci thawhkik ding a, bang pumpi tawh thokik ding ahi hiam?” cikha thei hi.","title":"A Thokik Pumpi"},"36":{"text":"Tua bang ngaihsutna haihuai mahmah hi. Khaici na tuh uh ciangin a muat lopi-in hong po thei lo hi."},"37":{"text":"Mangbuhci ahi a, khaici dang khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin na tuh uh ciangin hong po-in a khankhit ciangin a kung omzia dingteng tawh a tuh na hi kei uh a, a khaici bek a tuh na hi uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in ama hoihsak bangin a kung ding na pia a, khaici nam tuamtuamte a’ ding kung nam tuamtuam a guan hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua mah bangin sa a nei nuntakna nam khempeuh zong a sa kibang kim lo hi. Mihing sa, ganhing sa, vasa sa, ngasa sa, cih bangin a nam tuamtuam a om hi."},"40":{"text":"Vantung pumpi om a, leitung pumpi zong om hi. Vantung pumpi a hoihna a tuam khat hi a, leitung pumpi a hoihna zong a tuam khat mah ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Ni a hoihna a tuam khat hi a, kha a hoihna a tuam khat hi a, aksite a hoihna a tuam khat mah ahi hi. Aksite nangawn a hoihna a tuamtuamin omlai hi."},"42":{"text":"Misite a thawhkikna zong hihte mah tawh kibang hi. A kiphum pen a muat thei hi a, a thokik pen a muat thei lo ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A kiphum laitakin hat loin melsia a, a kithawhkiksak ciangin thahatin a melhoih hi."},"44":{"text":"A kiphum laitakin leitung pumpi hi a, a kithawhkiksak ciangin kha pumpi ahi hi. Leitung pumpi a om mah bangin kha pumpi zong a om ding ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho in, “A masa Adam pen leitung nuntakna a nei mihing hong suak hi,” na ci hi. Ahi zongin a nunung Adam pen nuntakna a pia thei Kha ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 2:7"},"46":{"text":"Ahi zongin kha pumpi a om masa hi loin leitung pumpi a om masa hi a, leitung pumpi a omkhit ciangin kha pumpi a omthei pan ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"A masa Adam pen leitung leivui tawh a kibawl hi a, a nunung Adam pen vantung panin a hong pai ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Leitung tawh a kipawl mite pen lei tawh a kibawl mite tawh a kibang hi a, vantung tawh a kipawl mite pen vantung panin a hong pai mipa tawh a kibang ahi hi."},"49":{"text":"Eite in lei tawh a kibawl mite’ lim i puak mah bangin vantung panin a hong pai Mipa’ lim zong a pua ding ihi hi."},"50":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note kiangah ka hong gennop thu in: Pasian’ Ukna sungah hih leitung silesa pumpi lut thei lo ding a, a siathei pumpi pen a siathei lo pumpi suak thei lo ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Kuamah kim in a theih loh thusim khat na ngai un. Eite khempeuh a si khin ding ihi kei a, thakhatthu-in a kikhelvat ding ihi hi."},"52":{"text":"Peengkul nunung hong gin’ ciangin mitphiat kikal sungin i kikhelpak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh peengkul hong gin’ ciangin misite a sithei nawn lo dingin hong tho ding a, i vekpi-in i kikheel ding hi.","ref":"1The 4:15-17"},"53":{"text":"A muatthei pumpi pen a muat thei lo pumpi-in hong kikheel ding a, a sithei pumpi pen a sithei lo pumpi-in hong kikheel ding hi."},"54":{"text":"A muatthei pen a muat thei lo hong suakin, a sithei pen a sithei lo hong suah ciangin Lai Siangtho thu hong tung taktak ding hi. Lai Siangtho in, “Sihna maimangin gualzawhna in khuplet hi.","ref":"Isa 25:8"},"55":{"text":"Sihna aw, na gualzawhna koi-ah om a, midangte na suksiat zawh nading na thahatna koi-ah omta ahi hiam?” na ci hi.","ref":"Hos 13:14"},"56":{"text":"Sihna a pianna mawhna hang hi a, mawhna a kitheihna Thukham hang ahi hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahi zongin i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin gualzawhna a hong pia Pasian tungah i lung a dam hi."},"58":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin ka hong it sanggamte aw, Topa’ hangin na nasepnate uh a mawkna hi ngei het lo hi, ci-in na theih uh mah bangin Topa a dingin a tawntungin na sem unla, ling hetloin lungsim kiptakin na om ta un."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Judea gam a om Pasian mite huh nading sum kaihkhop nading thu tawh kisai-in: Galatia gam a pawlpite in a hih ding zia uh ka gen bangin note in zong na hih un.","title":"Thu Uppih Mite Huh nading Sumpi","ref":"Rom 15:25-26"},"2":{"text":"Kei ka hong pai ciangin sumpi kaihkhop tawm a om loh nadingin na ngahna uh tawh kizui-in Nipi simin na tuamkoih unla, na na khol un."},"3":{"text":"Kei ka hong tun ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah na huhna uh sumte a puak dingin hoih na sak uh mite sawlin, lai tawh i paisak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei mahmah zong ka va pai ding hoih i sak leh amaute tawh ka va paikhawm ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Masedonia gam nawkin khualzin sawm ka hih manin tua gam sung ka zin khit ciangin no kiangah ka hong pai ding hi.","title":"Khualzin nading Geelna","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"6":{"text":"Note kiang panin mundang ka zin nading peuhpeuhah kei na hong huh theih nadingun note kiangah tomno sung bek hi loin phalbi hun sung tawntung bang ka hong taamthei kha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hong thukimpih nakleh khualzin kawmin a hong nawk bek hi loin, note kiangah hun hoihkhop khat ka om nuam hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin hih Efesa khua mahah Pentekos Pawi hun ciang dong ka om ding hi.","ref":"Siam 23:15-21; Thkna 16:9-11"},"9":{"text":"Hong langpang tampi a om tei hangin limtakin na septheih nading lam tampi tak a om hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:8-10"},"10":{"text":"Note kiangah Timoti hong pai zenzen khak leh, amah pen keimah bangin Topa’ na a sem ahih manin nuam a sak theihtheih nadingin na bawl un.","ref":"1Kor 4:17"},"11":{"text":"Kuamah in na simmawhbawl kha kei unla, kei kiang a hong tunkik theih nadingin nuamtakin a khualzin a hong zoptheih nadingin na huh un. Thu uppih i sanggam dangte tawh kei kiangah a hong pai dingin ka lamet ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"I sanggam Apollos ahihleh, thu uppih sanggam dangte tawh no kiangah hong hawh nadingin ka hanthot zel hangin tu tadihin hong hawhpah ding lungtungzo nai lo hi. Ahi zongin hunhoih a ngah peuhpeuh ciangin hong pai ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kiging tawntungin na upna uhah kip unla, thahatin hang un.","title":"A Tawpna-ah Thumna le Vaikhakna"},"14":{"text":"Na sepna khempeuh uhah ki-itna tawh na gamta un."},"15":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Stefanas-te innkuan pen Akhaia gam sunga thu um masa pente ahihna le Pasian’ mite a dingin nasem dingin a kipia mite ahihna thu na thei uh hi.","ref":"1Kor 1:16"},"16":{"text":"Tua bang mite le amaute tawh tua bangmahin na a semkhawm mite’ thu na man nadingun ka hong thum hi."},"17":{"text":"Stefanas, Fortunatas le Akhaikas-te hong paina hangin ka nuam mahmah hi. Note tawh ka kimuh mah tawh hong kibangsak a,"},"18":{"text":"note hong lungnopsak mah bangin kei zong ka lung hong nuamsak hi. Hih bang mite, limtakin na phawk ding uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Asia gam a om pawlpi a tuamtuamte in note hopihna kam hong khak uh hi. Aquila le Prisilla-te in zong amau’ inn-a kikhawm pawlpite tawh Topa’ hangin lungsim taktak tawh hopihna kam hong khak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:2"},"20":{"text":"Hih lai-ah a om thu upna sungah i sanggamte khempeuh in zong hopihna kam hong khak uh hi. A siangtho kinapna tawh note khatlekhat na kihopih un."},"21":{"text":"Keimah Paul in ka hong hopih hi, cihna kamte ka khut mahmah tawh ka gelh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa a it lo mi peuhmah in samsiatna ngah tahen. I Topa hong pai tahen."},"23":{"text":"Topa Jesuh hong hehpihna thupha, note tungah hong tung tahen."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih sungah note ka hong itna, note tungah hong kip ta hen. Amen."}}}}},"47":{"info":{"name":"Korin nihna","shortname":"2Kr","abbr":[],"desc":"Korin Khua Khristiante Tungah Paul' Laikhak Nihna pen Korin khua-a om pawlpite tawh a kizopna-ah thu haksapi a tuahkhak laitakin a gelh ahi hi. Pawlpi mi pawlkhat in nakpi takin Paul na dobawl uh hi. Ahi zongin Paul in a kilemkik theihna ding uh a lunggulhna thu na gen a, kilem kikna a hong om ciangin a nuam mahmahna thu a gen hi. Paul in a laikhak a masa lamah, Korin khua pawlpite tawh a kizopnasa thu gen a, pawlpi sungah kilangbawlna leh kikobawlna thute hangin khauhtakin thu a genna a hang leh tua bangin a khauhtatna in kisikna leh kilemna piangsakkik ahih manin a lungdamna thu a gen hi. Tua ciangin Judea gama om Khristian cimawhte a huhna ding uh citna lungsim tawh a piakna dingun pawlpite kiangah a thum hi. A tawpna lamah, Korin khuasungah mi tawmkhatte in, kote sawltak mantaktak hizaw ung, Paul pen sawltak kineihkhem hi lel hi, ci-in a mawhsakna uh thu tawh kisai-in, sawltak taktak ahihna thu a laktel hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih’ sawltak ahi dingin Pasian in a hong seh keimah Paul le thu upna sungah i sanggam Timoti in, Korin khua-ah a om Pasian’ pawlpi mite le Akhaia gam sungah a om Pasian’ mite khempeuh tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi.","title":"Hopihna","ref":"Sawl 18:1"},"2":{"text":"I Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note khempeuh tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen."},"3":{"text":"Eite’ Topa Jesuh Khrih’ Pa ahi, hehpihna a nei Pa, i kisapna khempeuhah a hong huh Pasian in thupha ngah tahen.","title":"A Thuak Khit Ciangin Paul’ Lungdam Kohna"},"4":{"text":"Amah in kote’ haksatna khempeuhah hong huh ahih manin, kote in zong Pasian’ tung panin ka ngah uh tua huhna mah zangin haksatna a nam tuamtuam a thuakte ka huhsawn thei leuleu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Khrih hangin gimna tampi ka thuak uh mah bangin amah in zong kote tungah huhna tampi mah a hong pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote in gimna ka thuak uhleh note’ phattuam nading le hotkhiatna na ngah nading uh ahi hi. Kote in huhna ka ngah uhleh zong, note zong a hong kihuh hi a, kote’ thuak bang gimnate na thuak uh ciangin lungduai takin na thuakzawh nading uh thahatna a hong kipia ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Note ka hong muanna uh kiam tuan lo hi. Kote’ thuak bangin na thuak uhleh Pasian in kote hong huh mah bangin note zong hong huh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Asia gam sunga ka thuaknate uh na hong phawkpih ding uh ka deih uh hi. Ka thuakna uh lianlua mahmah ahih manin nuntak zawh nading lametna om lo hi.","ref":"1Kor 15:32"},"9":{"text":"A si ding taktak hi ta hang, ci-in ka kingaihsun uh hi. Ahi zongin tua zahin ka thuakna uh pen kote’ thatang kimuang loin sihna panin misite a hingkiksak Pasian ka muantheih nadingun a piang ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zahin a lauhuai sih nading panin hong honkhia khinzo a, zong hong honkhia lai ding hi. Mailam hunah zong hong honkhia kikkik ding hi, ci-in amah ka muang uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Kote a dingin thu hong ngetsak un. Tua hileh mi tampi in kote a dingin thu a hong ngetsaknate uh Pasian in a hong piakna hangin mi tampi mah in kote’ tang dingin Pasian tungah lungdamna ko thei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kote’ kisialhpih thu in: hih leitung a ka gamtatnate uh le a diakdiakin note tungah kong gamtatnate uhah, mihingte’ pilna a zang hi loin Pasian hehpihna vang tawh, Pasian’ deihna bangin lungsim takpi tawh a gamta hi ung, ci-in ka kitheihna lungsim uh ahi hi.","title":"Paul’ Hawh ding a Hun Kisot"},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note in simthei-in a thu na theihtheih dingte bek uh a hong gelh ka hi uh hi. Tuhunin a cingin na theih lohte uh zong,"},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesuh hong paikik Ni ciangin a cingtakin thei ding na hih manun note hangin ka kisialh uh mah bangin note zong kote hangin na kisial ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-a bangin piang taktak ding ci-in teltheih ka hih manin note in hamphatna nihvei na ngah nadingun ka geel a,"},"16":{"text":"Masedonia gam ka pai ciangin hong nawk masa-in, Masedonia gam panin ka kilehkik ciangin zong Judea gam a ka paina dingah nong huh theih nadingun hong nawk leuleu dingin ka ngaihsun masa phot hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"17":{"text":"Hih bangin ka ngaihsutna pen a mawkkheel themthum hong sa na hi uh hiam? Leitung mihingte bangin angsung phattuam nading a om kei leh a gensa thu a kheel themthumte bang hong sa na hi uh hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Pasian a thuman a citak ahih mah bangin note tungah ka hong gente uh zong a kheel themthum ka hi kei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Silvanas, Timoti, le keimah in note lakah a thu ka hong hilhhilh uh Pasian’ Tapa Jesuh Khrih pen hih ding a cihte hihlo ding ci-in a thu a kheel themthum pa hi lo a, hih ding a cihte hih ding mah hi pah hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:5"},"20":{"text":"Pasian’ thuciamte khempeuh a hih pa pen amah ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Jesuh Khrih hangin Pasian phatin, “Amen,” i cihna zong hih thu hang mah ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Khrih sungah kote le note a hong kipsak pa, le nasem dingin kote a hong sawl pa pen Pasian ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in eite pen ama a’ ihihna ciaptehna eite tungah hong bawl a, ama a’ ihihna le eite tungah a hong piak ding na khempeuh a hong pia takpi ding ahihna a kitel nadingin eite’ lungsim sungah Kha Siangtho a hong mapiak hi."},"23":{"text":"Note kiangah kong pai lohna pen note ka hong dopna hizaw hi. Hih thu hong theihpih ka teci pen Pasian ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Hih bangin um un, ci-in thatanghat thu tawh a hong gen ding ka hi kei uh hi. Note na upna uhah kipkhin na hih manun note’ lungdam nadingin note tawh na a semkhawm ka hi uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hong pai leng note’ dah nading hong piang ding ahih manin ka hong pai loh nadingin ka lungsim ka khensat hi."},"2":{"text":"Kei a hong lungdamsak ding note ke’n hong dahsak leng, kei kua in hong lungdamsak nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Kei lungdam leng note khempeuh zong a lungdam ding na hihna uh teltakin thei ka hih manin, kei a hong lungdamsak ding note in kei’ dahna nong piansakkhak loh nading uh ka deihna tawh kei hong pai loin tua lai a hong gelh ka hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua lai ka gelh laitakin, note’ dah nading piangsakkha loin note ka hong it mahmahna na phawk nading uh ka deihna tawh ka gelh hi a, lungkham sinkhamna le khitui naptui kai-in a gelh ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in heh nading a piansak ciangin kei bek a hong hehsak hi loin note khempeuh zong a hong hehsak ahi hi. Tua ahih manin tua bang mi tungah khauhtat lua nawn kei un.","title":"A Khialte Maisakna"},"6":{"text":"Note’ gimpiaknasa pen kicing khinzo ka sa hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a mawhna maisak ta unla hehnemzaw un. Tua hikeileh dahlua-in siatlawh kha ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah na itkik ding uh ka hong thumna thu zong amah na theisak un."},"9":{"text":"Note in ze-etna bangzah ciang thuakzo-in, ka thugente na hong mangzo uh hiam cih ka theih nadingin tua lai a hong gelh ka hi hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in mawhna na maisak uh ciangin kei zong a maisak ka hi hi. Mawhna maisak ding om ahihleh zong, mawhna ka maisak ciangin Khrih hang le note’ phattuam nadingin a maisak ka hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mawhna maisak kei lehang Satan in nuamtaksa-in eite tungah hong gualzo kha ding ahih manin mawhna a maisak ihi hi. Satan’ nasepna zia a thei lo ihi kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Khrih hangin lungdamna thu a hilh dingin Troas khua ka tun ciangin tua lai-ah nasep theih nadingin Topa in lampi hong honsakna thu ka mu hi.","title":"Troas khua-ah Paul’ Lunghihmawhna"},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua lai-ah i sanggampa Titus na om lo ahih manin ka lungsim om thei nawn lo hi. Tua ahih manin tua lai-a om mite nusia-in Masedonia gamah ka paisuak hi.","ref":"Sawl 20:1"},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian tungah lungdam mahmah nading thu a om hi. Khrih tawh ka kipawlna hangun gualzawhna tawh Khrih a paina khempeuhah Pasian in kote hong zuisak hi. Mun khempeuhah paknamtui a kizelh bangin Khrih thu theihna a kizelsak dingin Pasian in kote hong zang hi.","title":"Khrih Hangin Gualzawhna"},"15":{"text":"Hotkhiatna a ngah mite le a ngah lo mite lakah kote pen Khrih in Pasian tungah a piak paknamtui tawh ka kibang uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua a nam pen, thu um lo mite a dingin mi a sisakthei a nam khauh mahmah hi a, hotkhiatna a ngah mite a dingin mi a hingsakthei a namtui mahmah ahi hi. Hih nasep a sem dingin kua kilawm ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin kote pen, van gina tum lo a zuak mite tawh a kibang ahi, Pasian’ thu a gen mawkmawk midangte bang ka hi kei uh a, Pasian in a nasem dingin kote hong sawl ahih manin Khrih nasem hihna tawh ama mai-ah lungsim takpi tawh thugente ka hi uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih bangin thu ka gen uh ciangin koleko a kiphattawm ka bang zel uh hiam? Midang pawlkhatte bangin note kiangah lah ding mihoih hihna lai ka kisam kei uh a, note in zong kote nong lah ding uh mihoih hihna lai a kisam na hi kei uh hi.","title":"Thuciamna Thak Nasemte"},"2":{"text":"Note mahmah pen mihoih ka hihna uh lah nadingin kote’ lai na hi uh a, mi khempeuh in simin a theih nadingun kote’ lungtang tungah a kigelh lai na hi uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Hih lai pen Khrih mahmah in gelhin kote a hong puasak ahihna thu kitel mahmah hi. Laidal le suangpek tungah laitui le laikung tawh a kigelh hi lo a, mihing lungtang tungah a nungta Pasian Kha Siangtho tawh a kigelh ahi hi.","ref":"Pai 24:12; Jer 31:33; Ezk 11:19; 36:26"},"4":{"text":"Khrih hangin Pasian muang ka hih manun hih bangin a hong gen ka hi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih bang sepzawh nadingin kote in siamna nei ung a ci hi loin, sepzawh nading siamna pen Pasian hong piak ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Thuciamna thak nasem thei dingin kote tungah siamna a hong pia hi. Tua hong piakna pen lai-a kigelh thukham tawh hi loin Kha Siangtho tawh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh lai-a kigelh thukham in sihna piangsak a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho in nuntakna hong pia hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31"},"7":{"text":"Thukham pen suangpek tungah a kigelh laimal hi a, a kipiak hunin Pasian’ minthanna tawh hong tonkhawm hi. Moses’ maitang a taang mahmah pen mualkhin tei napi-in, nak taanlua mahmah ahih manin Israel mite in Moses’ maitang en zo lo lai uh hi. Sihna a piangsak thei bek Thukham hong kipiak ciangin tuazah minthanna vangtaang tawh hong kizui ahihleh,","ref":"Pai 34:29"},"8":{"text":"nuntakna a pia Kha Siangtho nasepna bangzahin minthanna lian tawh hong kizuizaw kan ding ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Mite mawhsakin thukhen nasepna-ah tuazahin minthanna vangtaang om ahihleh mite dik hi, ci-in genkhiat nasepna-ah a minthanna vangtaang lianzaw kan lai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuhunin a taang phazaw minthanna vang hong omta ahih manin nidangin minthangin a vangtaang mahmah i cih pen a bei hong suak mai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tawlkhat sung bek a kimang na in minthanna nei ahihleh a kip tawntung na in minthanna lianzaw nei kan ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih bang lametna nei ka hih manun hangtakin a om ka hi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A maitang panin a vangtaang a beilam Israel mite in a muhkhak ding uh a deih lohna-in Moses in a maitang puan tawh a liah bangin a gamtate ka hi kei uh hi.","ref":"Pai 34:33"},"14":{"text":"Amaute’ lungsim khauh ahih manin tu dongin bangmah thei tuan loin om uh a, thuciamna lui laibu a sim uh ciangin puan tawh liah bangmahin bangmah mu thei lo, theithei lo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh Khrih tawh a kipawl ciang bekin a muhtheih nadingin a kiliahna puan a kilakhia pan ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuhun dongin amaute in Moses Thukham laibu a sim uh ciangin liahna puan in a lungsim uh a liah lai hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi zongin Lai Siangtho in, “Topa’ mai-ah Moses a pai ciangin a kiliahna puan a lakhia hi,” a cih mah bangin Topa lamah mi khatpeuh a kihei ciangin a liah puan kilakhia hi.","ref":"Pai 34:34"},"17":{"text":"Hih lai munah Topa a cih pen Kha Siangtho hi a, Topa’ Kha Siangtho a omna mun peuhpeuhah suahtakna om hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih manin eite khempeuh i maitang hong kiliah nawn loin Topa’ minthanna vangtaang i kilangsak hi. Topa kiang panin a hong pai Kha Siangtho ahi tua minthanna vang in amah tawh a kibang dingin eite hong bawlpha a, minthanna khat panin minthanna sangzaw-ah hong omsak hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian in hong hehpihna tawh hih nasep hong pia ahih manin ka thaneem hetkei uh hi.","title":"Leibeel sunga Kikoih Kha tawh kisai Na"},"2":{"text":"Ka thuhilhna uhah mite khembawl loin, Pasian thu zong a man lopi-in ka gen kei uh a, tua bang a zumhuai simtham tatnate ka zang hetkei uh hi. Pasian muhna-ah a langtangin thuman takin ka gamta uh a, mi khempeuh a lungkim theih nadingin ka hanciam uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Lungdamna thu ka hilhte uh kitel lo ahihleh zong siatna a thuak mite a’ ding bekin a kitel lo hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua bang mite pen hih leitung pasian gilote in a lungsim mit uh tawsak ahih manin um lo uh a, Pasian tawh a kibang teekteek Khrih minthanna hangin amaute tungah a hong taang lungdamna thu khuavak mu thei lo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh kote’ hilh thu pen komau’ thu hi lo a, Khrih Jesuh pen Topa ahi hi, ci-in a hilh ka hi uh a, hi."},"13":{"text":"Lai Siangtho in, “Um ka hih manin ka gen hi,” a cih mah bangin kote in zong um ka hih uh manin a gen ka hi uh hi.","ref":"La 116:10"},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesuh a hingkik sakpa in hehpihna in mi tam ban semsem leh mi a tam semsem mah in Pasian’ minthan nadingin lungdam ko-in thu ngen ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua thu hangin ka lungkia tuan kei uh hi. Kote’ leitung pumpi in damdamin muatlam ding a manawh ahi zongin ka kha nuntakna uh a nini-in thaksuak semsem hi.","title":"Upna tawh Omna"},"17":{"text":"Tuhun laitakin tomno sung lungkhamna ka thuakte uh in ka thuakna uh sangin nakpitakin a lianzaw tawntung minthanna sung hong tunpih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a kimuthei nate a mitsuan ka hi kei uh a, a kimu thei lo nate a mitsuan ka hi uh hi. A kimuthei nate tomno sung bek kimang a, a kimu thei lo nate a tawntungin a kip ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh hih ka tenna ka leitung pumpi uh a sih ciangin mihingte bawl ahi lo, Pasian in a kip tawntung dingin kote a dingin a hong bawlsak inn, vantungah a nei ding ka hihna uh ka thei uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Tu laitakin ka vantung inn uhah ka omnopna uh lianlua mahmah ahih manin ngaklahin ka khuisasa uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Vantung inn-ah ka om uh ciangin pumpi nei loin guak om ding ka hi kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih leitung pumpi tawh ka om uh laitakin lungkhamin ka khuisasa uh hi. Khrih mahmah zong mihing lungsim ngaihsutna zia tawh ka et ngei uh hangin tu-in tua bangin ka ngaihsun nawn kei uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin mi khatpeuh, Khrih tawh a kipawl ciangin mi thak suak a, a mi lui ngeina bei-in a mi thak ngeina a neita ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih thu khempeuh Pasian’ vaihawm hi a, eite pen Pasian’ gal hinapi-in Khrih hangin amah tawh a kilem mi hong hisak a, kote tungah tua kilem nading nasep hong pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahih manin kote’ thugen bulpi in: Pasian in mite’ mawhnate ngaihsun nawn loin, Khrih hangin leitung mi khempeuh le amah a kilemin hong bawl a, tua kilemna thu a gen dingin kote hong seh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin kote pen Khrih tangin nasem ka hi uh a, Pasian in kote zangin note tungah thu a hong gen ahi hi. Pasian tawh kilemin pawlkhatin na om nadingun Khrih tangin a hong thum ka hi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Khrih tawh i kipawlna hangin eite zong Pasian tawh a kibangin midik i suahtheih nadingin mawhna a nei lo Khrih pen eite’ tang dingin Pasian in mawhnei mi a suaksak hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua bangin Pasian tawh na semkhawmin om ka hih manun Pasian’ hong hehpihna thu a mawkna na suahsakkhak loh nadingun ka hong thum uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in, “A hunhoih a tun ciangin note’ hong ngetna ka hong ngai a, kong hotkhiat ni ding ciangin note ka hong huh hi,” na ci hi. Tua hi a, tuhun pen a hunhoih hi a, tuhun pen hotkhiat ni hun hita hi.","ref":"Isa 49:8"},"3":{"text":"Ka nasepna uhah mite in mawhna hong zon ding uh ut lo ka hih manun kuamah ka nawngkaisak khak loh nadingun ka hanciam uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ka sepna khempeuh uhah Pasian’ nasemte ka hihna uh ka kilangsak uh a, lungduai takin gimna, haksatna, lungkhamnate ka thuak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kote hong kisatin, thongah hong kikhia-in, mihonpi in hong hihgawp uh hi; nakpitakin na semin, an ne lo, ihmu lo liangin ka om uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:23"},"6":{"text":"Siangtho takin nuntakna, thu theihna, lungduaina, migitna, Kha Siangtho’ huhna, itna taktak neihna,"},"7":{"text":"thuman genna, le Pasian’ nasemte ka hihna uh, Pasian’ vang tawh ka kilangsak uh hi. Kote in kihut nading le galsim nadingin hiamin thuman ka zang uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kote hong kipahtawi-in hong kimindaisak zel a, hong kisimmawh bawlin zong hong kiphat zel hi. Kote’ ngaihsut bangin note in zong hong ngaihsun unla, na lungsim uh hong taanzausak ta un."},"14":{"text":"Thu um lo mite tawh na na semkhawm kei un. Midik le mimawh bangci-in kipawlthei ding a, khuavak le khuamial bangci-in omkhawm thei ding ahi hiam?","title":"A Nungta Pasian’ Biakinn"},"15":{"text":"Khrih le Dawimangpa bangci-in kithutuak thei ding a, thu um mi le thu um lo mi bangci-in a ngaihsutna uh kibang thei ding ahi hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Pasian’ biakinn le lawkite’ milim bangci kilem theih ding ahi hiam? Tua hileh note ka hong ngai ding hi.","ref":"Isa 52:11"},"18":{"text":"Kei pen note’ Pa hong hi-in, note, keima tate na hi ding uh hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"2Sam 7:14; 1Khang 17:13; Isa 43:6; Jer 31:9"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ka hong it lawmte aw, pumpi le lungsim a ninsak theite khempeuh panin kisiansuahin, Pasian zahtakna tawh nungta-in siangtho sinsenin om ni."},"2":{"text":"Kuama tungah kote hong khial lo, kuamah hong siasak lo, noptaksa-in kuama tungah hong gamta lo ka hih manun na lungsim uh hong pia un.","title":"Pawlpite’ Kisikna Hangin Paul’ Lungdamna"},"3":{"text":"Hih bang ka hong cih ciangin note mawhsak nopna tawh thu a hong gen ka hi kei hi. Tua na dahna uh Pasian in a hoihlamin hong zang ahih manin note a dingin siatna a hong piangsak ka hi kei zaw uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua na dahna uh hotkhiatna ngahtheih nadingin na lungsim uh na kheel nadingun Pasian in hong zang ahih manin dah nading bangmah om lo hi. Ahi zongin hih leitung dahna lelte in ahihleh sihna piangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih note’ dahna pen Pasian in a hoihlamin hong zatsak ahih manin mawk om nawn loin lungsim takpi tawh kinna na nei uh a, hoih lo hi, ci-in ka hong gente lunghimawhin siansak nopna lungsim na nei uh hi. A thupiangsate hangin lau-in lunghimawhin a hoih lote gim na pianuam uh hi. Hih thu khempeuhah note na paubaan nading uh a om lo hong suaksak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bangin lai ka hong gelh hangin a khial pa ahih kei leh a thuak pa ngaihsutna tawh hong gelh hi lo zaw-in, Pasian’ thu sungah kote’ thu bangzahin na hong mang uh hiam cih a kitheih nadingin a hong gelh ka hizaw uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tu-in ka lung uh nuam mahmah hi. Kote’ lungsim hong nuamsak bek hi loin, Titus lungsim a noptheihna dingin ama tungah na gamta na hih manun ama lungdamna in zong kote’ lungdamna hong behlapto sawnsawn hi."},"14":{"text":"Titus mai-ah note ka hong kisialhpih ngei a, note in ka kisialhna thu-ah kei na hong zahhuaisak kei uh hi. Note tungah thuman bekbek a hong gen ka hih mah bangun Titus tungah ka kisialhna uh zong a kisial khial ka hihlohna uh hong kilang hi."},"15":{"text":"Note in ama thu mangin, launa le linna tawh amah na zindona uh a ngaihsut ciangin Titus in note hong itna khang semsem hi."},"16":{"text":"Note hong muang mahmah ka hih manin ka lungsim a nuam hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Masedonia gam pawpite-ah Pasian’ hehpihna hangin a piang thute ka hong theisak nuam uh hi.","title":"Cit Piakna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in haksatna a tuamtuam phukha-in nakpitakin ze-etna thuakin, amaute zawng mahmah hita se le-uh lungdam mahmah uh ahih manin piakna lamsangah cingh thei mahmah uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in amau ngahna tawh kituak bekin a pia hi loin, a piak zawhzah dingun a kilawm sangin a tamzaw a piakna uh ka thei taktak uh hi. Kuama sawl hi loin amau lungsimah a uttawmna uh tawh,"},"4":{"text":"Judea gam a Pasian mite, ko zong hong huh sak un, ci-in hong thumthum uh hi.","ref":"Rom 15:26"},"5":{"text":"Hih bangin a gamtatna uh kote’ lamet sangin sangzaw pek hi. Amaute pen Topa tungah kipia masa uh a, tua ciangin Pasian’ deihna bangin kote tungah zong a hong kipia uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua mah bangin Titus in zong hih bang nasep nading hong pat khit ahih hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih thu tawh kisai-in keima ngaihsutna panin: Note in ni kumin hih bang nasep ding utna lungsim a nei bek hi loin a pankhia masate na hih uh mah bangin na tangtut ding uh hoihpen hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin na patsa uh thu a bei dongin zomsuak unla, na geelsa uh na tangtunsak theih nadingun na neihsa uh tawh lawptakin na sem un."},"12":{"text":"Piaknopna lungsim na neih nak-uhleh na neih lohnate uh siksan hi loin na neihna uh tawh kizui-in na piak uh Pasian in hong sang ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih bangin ka hong gen ciangin midangte in noptuamna a ngah nadingin note in haksapi-in tuam gimpih ding ka cihna hi lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu laitakin note cithei na hih manun amau cihmawhnate-ah huh le-uhcin, note in haksat na tuah hun uh ciangin zong amaute in hong huh zawng lua tuan lo hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Pai 16:18"},"16":{"text":"Kote’ hong kin zahin Titus in note hong kin nadingin Pasian in lungsim guan ahih manin Pasian tungah ka nuam mahmah uh hi.","title":"Titus le A Kithuahpihte"},"17":{"text":"Amah in kote hong sawlna a hong mang ciang bek hi loin, amah in note huhnopna lungsim neitawm ahih manin note kiangah pai ding hong ngaihsun
