Tua lungdamna thu mah keimah Paul in hilhin ka sepbel hi a, leitung mun khempeuhah a kihilh lungdamna thu mah ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in ka pumpi-in ka thuakna tawh Khrih in ama pumpi ahi pawlpi a dingin a thuak ding a kisam laiteng a kitangcingsak suak ka hih manin note a dingin ka thuakna thu-ah ka lung a dam hi.","title":"Pawlpite a’ ding Paul’ Nasepna"},"25":{"text":"Pasian’ thu a kicing takin note’ phattuam nadingin a hilh dingin pawlpi nasem dingin Pasian in kei a hong bawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua thuhilh ding pen a beisa hunah a ki-imcip thu hi a, ahi zongin tu-in Pasian’ mite tungah a kipholak ta ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Pasian in mi khempeuh a dingin a koihcing hih a thupi a deihhuai a thusim pen ama mite tungah pholak ding a sawm ahi hi. Tua thusim in: Khrih tawh a kipawlte in Pasian tawh minthanna ngahkhawm ding hi, cihna ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a milip tungah Khrih’ thu ka hilh uh a, Khrih tawh a kipawlna uh hangin a milipin a khangcingin Pasian’ omna-ah ka tunpih theih nadingun a milip tungah hilhin ka genkhol uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Hih bang a tangtun theih nadingin Khrih in kei tungah a hong piak ka thahatna khempeuh zangin, nakpitakin na semin ka hanciam hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note a kipan Laodisia khuamite le kei a hong thei ngei nai lo mi khempeuhte a’ ding nangawnin hahkat takin na ka sem hi."},"2":{"text":"Note, lungsim hanna tawh kidimin, thu a man taktakin na theihna hangun lungkip takin omin, itna tawh pumkhat na suahtheih nading uh ka deihna ahi hi. Tua hileh Pasian’ thusim ahi Khrih mahmah na thei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Khrih pen Pasian’ pilna le a thuthuk khempeuh a kitheihtheih nading ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Kuamah in note a hong khem zawh loh nadingin hih bang thu a hong gen ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note tawh ka hong omkhawm loh hangin ka lungsimin note tawh ka hong omkhawm a, Khrih na upna uh hangin kiptakin na omkhawmna uh ka theih manin ka nuam mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Note hong honpa dingin Topa Khrih na sansa uh ahih mah bangin amah tawh hoihtakin kipawlin nungta un."},"7":{"text":"Note tungah a hong kihilhsa bangin ama sungah zungthuk kha unla, ama deihna bangin nungta-in, na upna uhah khauh semsemin, lungdam takin om un."},"8":{"text":"Khrih thu tawh a kituak lopi-in, tangthu tuanthu ahi a, huihlak a ukte’ thu siksanin ahi zongin, bangmahin a kimang lo leitung pilna tawh mite’ khemsa-in sila na suahkhak loh nadingun kingaihsun un.","title":"Khrih sungah Kiptakin Nuntakna"},"9":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mihing hong suahna sungah Khrih in Pasian’ pianzia khempeuh a kimtakin nei a,"},"10":{"text":"Khrih tawh na kipawlna hangun nuntakna kicing na nei uh hi. Huihlak a ukte le aana neite khempeuh tungah amah a lutangpi hi lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah tawh na kipawlna uh hangin mihingte in pumpi vun a at uh bang hi loin, Khrih’ vun-atna ahi mawhnopna lungsim tawh kipelhna a ngah khinta na hi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note tui na kiphum uh ciangin Jesuh tawh kiphum khawmin, misite’ lak panin Khrih a thosak Pasian’ vangliatna na up manun Khrih mah tawh tuiphumna panin a thokhawm leuleu na hi uh hi.","ref":"Rom 6:4"},"13":{"text":"A beisa hunah na mawhna uh hangin kha thu tawh kisai-in misi na hi uh a, Gentail mi na hih manun Thukham nei lote na hi uh hi. Ahi zongin Khrih hangin Pasian in note hong hingsak a, i mawhna khempeuh hong maisak khinta hi.","ref":"Efe 2:1-5"},"14":{"text":"Eite a dingin a hoih lo, i mawhna a kiciamtehna khempeuh, hong phiatsak a, tuate khempeuh singlamteh tungah kilhcipin a beisak ta hi.","ref":"Efe 2:15"},"15":{"text":"Amah in huihlak a ukte le vangliatna a nei khempeuh, singlamteh tungah zogawp khin a, galzote in a sal matte a kaih uh bangin mi khempeuh muhin a gualzawhna a lak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahih manin annek tuidawn, biakna pawite, Khadet pawi, le Sabbath ni tawh kisai-in kuamah in ngeina zuih ding bawl kei un.","title":"Vantung thute Hanciam Un","ref":"Rom 14:1-6"},"17":{"text":"Hihte pen mailam ah a hong piang ding nate’ lim hi lel a, ahi zongin tu-in a taktak ahi Khrih hong omta hi."},"18":{"text":"Maang a muhna hangun a thupi diakin kingaihsunin, a kilawm lo zah dongin kiniamkhiat nading le vantung mite biak ding a hong hanthawn mite’ khemsa-in ta kei un. Bang hangin ngeina a tuamtuamte,"},"21":{"text":"“Lawng kei un, ciam kei un, su kei un,” cihte zuihin nei na hi uh hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Hih nate pen i nek, i zat khit ciangin a maimang hi lel a, mihingte’ bawltawm thuhilhna le ngeina hi lel hi."},"23":{"text":"Hih bang gamtatnate pen a tungthamin i et ciangin limtakin biaknopna lungsim a piangsak ding, kiniamkhiatna a piangsak ding, pumpi ki-ukzawhna a piangsak ding tawh kibang hi. Ahi zongin a taktakin hihte khat beek in pumpi ki-ukzawhna piangsak zo lo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note pen Khrih tawh a thokik khinte na hih manun, Pasian’ taklam a kumpi tokhom tungah Khrih a tutna mun vantung thute ngaihsutin nei un.","ref":"La 110:1"},"2":{"text":"Vantungah a om thute ngaihsutin nei unla, leitungah a om thute ngaihsutin nei kei un."},"3":{"text":"Note a sikhin na hi uh a, note’ nuntakna pen Khrih tawh Pasian’ sungah a kiseelkhawm ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Note’ nuntakna taktak Khrih ahih manin amah hong kilat ciangin note zong amah tawh hong kilang khawmin amah tawh na minthang khawm ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin nulepa mawhna, a kilawm lo gamtatna, hukna lanna, a hoih lo lunggulhna, le milim biakna nam khat ahih manin huaihamna ahi note sungah a om leitung lungsimte na sisak un.","title":"Nuntakna Lui le Nuntakna Thak"},"6":{"text":"Ama thu a mang lo mite tungah hih bang gamtatna hangin Pasian’ hehna hong tung ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Note pen hih bangin gamta-in a nungta ngeite na hi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in hehna, thangpaihna, muhdahna, gensiatna, kam hoih lo pauna cihte nei nawn kei un."},"9":{"text":"Ngeina lui le gamtatna lui khempeuh a beisakkhin na hihna uh kithei-in khatlekhat tungah zuauthu kigen nawn kei unla,","ref":"Efe 4:22"},"10":{"text":"ngeina thak tawh kituakin gamta un. Pasian in kuamah deidan loin amau’ gamtatna bang ciatin thu a khen ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17; Efe 6:9"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tote aw, note in zong vantungah To khat na neihna uh phawk unla, na silate uh a kilawm a kituakin bawl un.","ref":"Efe 6:9"},"2":{"text":"Lungsim takpi tawh thu ngen tawntung unla, kidawm kawmin lungdamna tawh thu ngen un."},"3":{"text":"Mite kiangah Khrih’ thusim hilhtheih nadingin Pasian in kote tungah hunpha hong piaktheih nadingin thu hong ngetsak un. Amau tegel in hih lai-a thupiang khempeuh note kiangah hong gen ding uh hi.","ref":"File 10-12"},"10":{"text":"Kei tawh thong a kiakhawm Aristarkhas in note hong hopih hi. Vun-atna a zang Jew mi Khristian a hong suakte lak panin hih mi thumte bek, Pasian thu-ah ka naseppih lakah a hong kihel ahi hi. Ka nasepna-ah amaute in nakpitakin hong huh uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih nasem, note’ makai Epafras in zong hong hopih hi. Pasian’ deihna bangin note nungta-in, lungsim khanghamin kiptakin na omtheih nadingun amah in thu hong ngetsak tawntung hi.","ref":"Kol 1:7; File 23"},"13":{"text":"Amah in note-a’ ding a kipan Laodisia khua le Hierapolis khua mite a dingin nakpitakin na a sepna thu ka thei hi."},"14":{"text":"I it siavuanpa Luka le Demas in zong hong hopih uh hi.","ref":"2Tim 4:10-11; File 24"},"15":{"text":"Laodisia khua-a om i sanggamte le Nymfas le ama inn-a a kikhawm pawlpi mite na hopihsak un."},"16":{"text":"Hih ka hong laikhak na sim khit uh ciangin Laodisia khua-a om pawlpite zong na simsak unla, Laodisia khua pawlpite kiang pan hong pai ding lai zong note in na sim hamtang un."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Arkhippas kiangah, “Pasian a dingin nasepna nang tungah hong kipia pen hoihtakin na zo in,” ci-in na gen un.","ref":"File 2"},"18":{"text":"Keimah Paul’ khut mahmah tawh, Note ka hong hopih hi, cihna lai ka gelh ahi hi. Sikkhau khihna ka thuakna thu mangngilh kei un. Note khempeuh tungah Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hong tung tahen."}}}}},"52":{"info":{"name":"Thesalonika Masa","shortname":"1Te","abbr":[],"desc":"Thesalonika khua pen, Rom kumpite' ukna Masedonia gamsungah kumpi khuapi ahi hi. Filippi khua panin a paikhiat khit ciangin Paul in hih khua-ah pawlpi a phut hi. Ahi zongin Jew ngeina hoih a sa Gentail mite lakah Paul in Khristian thu a hilh ciangin mi tampi in um ahih manin, Paul' mavan'na a haza Jew mi pawlkhat in amah hong langpan hi. Thesalonika khua panin Paul a paikhiat ding phamawh ahih manin Berea khua-ah a paisuak hi. Tua khit ciangin a naseppih Timoti tung panin Thesalonika khua-a pawlpite' pian'zia a genna laikhak khat Paul in a ngah hi. Tua ahih manin tua lai-a Khristian-te hansuahin a thakhauhsakna dingin Thesalonika Khua Khristian-te tungah Paul' Laikhak Masa a kigelh ahi hi. Amaute in upna leh itna a neihna uh hangin a lungdamna thu genin, amaute tawh a omkhawm lai-a ama nuntaknazia a phawksak hi. Tua khit ciangin Khrih hong paikikna ding thu tawh kisai, amau pawlpi sungah thudotna a omte a dawng hi. Tua dotnate in: Khrih hong paikik ma-in a si thu um mite in ama hong pai ciangin hong puak ding nuntak tawntung a ngah ding uh hiam? Cik ciangin Khrih hong paikik ding ahi hiam, cihte ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Paul in a laigelhna-ah, Khrih hong paikik ding lametna tawh a ngakkawmun pauloin na a sep paisuakna ding uh a gen hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keimah Paul, le Silas, le Timoti in Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih sungah a om Thesalonika khua-a om pawlpi mite tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi. Pasian in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen.","title":"Hopihna","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"2":{"text":"Note khempeuh hangin Pasian tungah lungdamna ko tawntungin, ka thungetna uhah note ka hong phawk tawntung uh hi.","title":"Thesalonika khuamite in Upna A Neihna le Etteh Hoih Ahihna"},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh i Pa Pasian kiangah thu ka nget simun note’ upna hangin na nuntakziate uh, itna na neih manun nakpitakin na nasepnate uh le i Topa Jesuh Khrih hong paikik ding lametna na neih manun kiptakin na omnate uh ka phawk tawntung uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Pasian in note hong itin ama mi dingin a hong teel khitna thu ka thei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note kiangah Lungdamna Thu ka hong hilh lai-un kam bek tawh a hong gen hi loin, Kha Siangtho’ vangliatna le Lungdamna Thu a man taktak hi, ci-in theihna tawh a hong pai ka hi uh hi. Note kiangah ka om laitakun note’ phattuam nadingin ka sep ka bawlna khempeuh uh na thei uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote le Topa’ gamtat bangin note na gamta uh a, note in gimna nakpitakin thuaklawh napi-in Kha Siangtho’ huhna tawh lungdam takin thu umin na om uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:5-9"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Masedonia gam le Akhaia gam sung khempeuhah thu um mi khempeuhte a dingin etteh hoih na suak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Note’ gamtatna ziate’ hangin Masedonia le Akhaia gam sungteng bekah Topa’ thu a kithei hi loin, note in Pasian na upna thu uh mun khempeuhah kiza ahih manin kote’ gen ding bangmah kisam nawn lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Note kiangah ka hong pai lai-un kote na hong limbawlna thu uh, le a nungta a man Pasian’ thu zui-in a bia ding le,"},"10":{"text":"a hong tung ding Pasian’ hehna panin eite a hong honkhia, sihna panin Pasian in a thawhsakkik a Tapa Jesuh, van panin a hong pai ding ngak dingin milim paisanin Pasian’ lamah na kiheina uh thute mi khempeuh in gen belin a nei uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note kiangah ka hong painasa thu a mawkna a suahlohna thu nomau mahmah in na thei uh hi.","title":"Thesalonika khua-ah Paul’ Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Note in na theihsa uh mah bangin Thesalonika khua ka hong tun ma-un Filippi khua-ah simmawh bawlna le maizumna ka thuak uh hi. Tua bangin nakpitakin hong kilangbawlna hangin Pasian kiang panin a hong pai Lungdamna Thu note kiangah gen ngam nadingin i Pasian in kote sungah lungsim hanna a hong guan hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:19-24; 17:1-9"},"3":{"text":"Kote in thu ka hong hilh uh ciangin thuman lo, ngimna hoih lo le khemnopna lungsim tawh a hong hilh ka hi kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian in kote hong thei-in Lungdamna Thu a hilh dingin kilawm hong sa ahih mah bangin mite’ lungdam theih nadingin thu a hilh hi loin kote’ lungsim ngimna a hong thei Pasian’ lungkim nadingin thu a hilh ka hizaw uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin note in na theih uh mah bangin mite’ lungdam theih nading phatna kamte ka zang kei uh a, kote’ phattuam nading ngaihsutna tawh zong bangmah ka sem het kei uh hi. Hih bang ka hihna uh Pasian in hong thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Khrih sawltakte ka hihna uh hangin phatna ka ngah ding uh a kilawm hinapi-in note le midangte, a kuamah peuh’ hong phat ding a zong ka hi kei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Note kiangah ka hong om lai-un nupite in a tate uh itna tawh a bawl bangin note ka hong bawl uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Note hong it mahmah ka hih manun Pasian kiang panin a hong pai Lungdamna Thu bek hong gen loin, kote’ nuntakna mahmah zong note a dingin a pia ngamin ka om uh hi. Tua ahih manin kote’ hong muhna-ah note a manpha mahmah na hi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, ka nasep ka silbawlnate khempeuh uh note in na thei uh hi. Pasian kiang panin a hong pai Lungdamna Thu note kiangah ka hong hilhna hangun note in themkhat beek na gimlawhkhak loh nadingun a sun a zanin nakpitakin na ka sem uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in hih thu na theih uh mah bangin Pasian in zong hong thei hi. Thu um note tungah kong gamtatnate uh siangtho-in thuman a, paubaan nading bangmah om het lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Pa in a tate a bawl bangin note ka hong bawlna uh na thei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note hong hehnemin ka hong hanthawn uh a, amah tawh ukna le minthanna a ngahkhawm dingin a hong sam Pasian’ lungkimna bangin na gamtat theih nadingun ka hong gengen uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Note kiangah Pasian’ thu ka hong gen uh ciangin no thu um mite sungah ama thu tawh kisai-in Pasian in na hong sem ahih manin kote’ thugente pen Pasian’ thu taktak ahih mah bangin kote’ thugenna na zak uh ciangin mihing’ thu bangin ngaihsun loin Pasian’ thu taktak mahin hong sang na hih manun, hih thu hangin zong Pasian’ tungah ka lungdamna uh ka ko uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, Judea gam sunga om, Khrih Jesuh thu a um, Pasian’ mi ahi mite in a thuak bangin note in zong a thuak na hi uh hi. Amaute in Jew mite’ bawlsiatna a thuak uh mah bangin note in zong note’ gam mite mah’ bawlsiatna na thuak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:5"},"15":{"text":"Tua Jew mite in Topa Jesuh le kamsangte that uh a, kote zong hong bawlsia uh hi. Pasian’ lungkim loh nadingin gamta uh a, mi khempeuh langbawl uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:23,29; 13:45,50; 14:2,5,19; 17:5,13; 18:12"},"16":{"text":"Gentail mite tungah hotkhiatna thu ka gen ding uh hong khaktan uh ahih manin amau’ mawhnasate a behlap niloh a suak uh hi. Ahi zongin a tawpna-ah Pasian’ hehna amaute tungah a tungta hi."},"17":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, kote ahihleh no tawh i lungsim a kikhen loh hangin tawlkhat sung i pumpi a kikhen sungin note ka hong phawk mahmah uh a, note kiangah hawhkik ding nakpitakin ka hanciam uh hi.","title":"Pawlpite kiangah Paul a Hawhkik Nopna"},"18":{"text":"Note kiangah hong hawhkik nuam ka hih manun note kiangah hawhkik ding ka hanciam zelzel hangun kong pai ding uh Satan in hong khaktan hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua banga kong painopna uh pen, note bek mah kote’ lamet, ka lungdamna uh le kote’ gualzawhna lukhu na hi uh a, Topa Jesuh hong pai ciangin ama mai-ah kong kisialhpih ding uh na hi uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Kote’ thupi suahna le lungdamna pen note bek mah na hi takpi uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tawpna-ah ka thuakzawh nawn loh uh ciangin Athen khua-ah kei le Silas omin,","ref":"Sawl 17:15"},"2":{"text":"Khrih Lungdamna Thu hilhna-ah Pasian a dingin kote tawh na a semkhawm i sanggampa Timoti hong paisak le-ung hoihpen ding hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun uh hi. Amah in note hong hanthawnin na upna uhah hong kipsakin,"},"3":{"text":"hih bawlsiatna hangin note khat beek na puk loh nading uh deihna tawh a hong paisak ka hi uh hi. Hih bang bawlsiatna pen i thuak ding mah hi, ci-in note in zong na theih uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note tawh kong omkhawm lai-un zong, na theihsa uh bangin tu-a na thuak bangte teekteek mah uh a thuak ding hi hang, ci-in ka hong genkholhsa uh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ka thuakzawh nawn loh ciangin note’ upna zia a thei dingin Timoti ka hong sawl hi. Dawimangpa’ ze-etna in note hong puksakkha-in, kote’ nasepna a mawkna suakkha ding hi, ci-in ka lunghimawh uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in note kiang panin Timoti hong tungkhin a, note’ upna le nong itna uh thute a hong gen hi. Kote na hong lim ngaihsutnate uh le kote in ka hong muhnop uh mah bangin note in zong kote na hong muhnopna uh thute khempeuh a hong gen hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:5"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, note’ upna thu ka zak uh ciangin lungkham sinkhamna ka thuak laitakun ka tha uh hong hatsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa’ thu-ah kiptakin om na hih manun tu-in ka husang theita uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in note hangin Pasian tungah ka lungdamna uh ka ko theita uh a, note hangin ka lungdamna khempeuh uh, Pasian tungah ka ko uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian in eite maitang kimu-in hong omsak theih nading le note’ upna ka hong kicinsak theih nadingun a sun a zanin lungsim takpi tawh thu ka ngenngen uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in eite’ Pa ahi Pasian le i Topa Jesuh in note kiangah ka hong paitheih nading uh lampi hong honsak tahen."},"12":{"text":"Kote in note ka hong it zahun, note khatlekhat na ki-itna uh le mi khempeuh na itna uh, hong liansak semsem tahen."},"13":{"text":"Tua hileh i Topa Jesuh a mi siangthote khempeuh tawh hong pai ciangin eite’ Pa ahi Pasian’ mai-ah kisuanna om hetloin lungsim siangtho takin na om thei ding uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in sanggamte aw, Pasian’ deihna le ama lungkim nadingin bangci nuntak ding cih thu kote kiang panin na theihsa uh thute tawh kizui-in na nuntaksa uh ahih mah bangin a kicingzaw semsemin na nuntak nadingun i Topa Jesuh min tawh hong thumin ka hong hanthawn uh hi.","title":"Pasian’ Deih Nuntakna"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Jesuh min tawh ka hong thuhilhnate uh na theihsa uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Note a siangtho-in nungta-in numei tunga mawhna tawh na kipelh siangtho nading uh Pasian in hong deih hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian a thei lo dawibiate in kilunggulhna hang bek tawh a pumpi uh a zat bang hi loin, note in a kilawm a siangtho-in na pumpi uh bangci zat ding cih thu na theih ding uh hong deih hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Hih bang thute-ah kuamah in Khrih sungah na sanggamte uh tungah na khialh loh nading uh le na khasiatsak loh nading uh hong deih hi. Pasian in hih bangin a gamta mite gim pia ding hi, ci-in khauhtakin note kiangah ka hong genkhol khinzo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Eite a thanghuai gamtat dingin Pasian in a hong sam hi lo a, a siangtho-in a nungta dingin a hong sam ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih thute a thudon lo mi in mite a thudon lo hi loin, note tungah ama Kha Siangtho a hong pia Pasian a thusim lo ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin thu uppih mite it ding tawh kisai-in bangmah gelh ding na kisam nawn kei uh hi. Khatlekhat na ki-it nading uh Pasian in note tungah hong hilh khinzo hi."},"10":{"text":"Masedonia gam sunga om thu um mi khempeuh na it khin takpi uh hi. Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, itna na neih semsem nadingun ka hong thum uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu ma-a ka hong gensa uh mah bangin kamtam nuam se loin hoihtakin om hithiatna, no tawh a kisai thu bek ngaihsutna, le note’ nuntak nading na na sep nading uh hanciamin nei un."},"12":{"text":"Tua bangin gamta le-uhcin thu um lo mite in note hong zahtak ding uh a, mite’ neihsa na duhgawh kei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, lametna a nei lo mite bangin na dahluat loh nadingun a sisa mite’ omzia ding thu na theih ding uh ka deih hi.","title":"Topa Hong Pai Ciangin A Si le A Hingte’ Omzia Ding"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh si-in thokik hi, ci-in i up mah bangin Pasian in Jesuh hong paipih kik ciangin amah umin a si mite zong hong tonpih ding hi, ci-in i um hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa’ thugen note kiangah ka hong gen uh thu in: Topa hong paikik ni ciangin a nungta lai eite pen a sisa mite tawh i kimuh ma-in Topa tawh i kimu kei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian’ thupiakna awging lianpi, vantungmi mangpa’ thugenna, le Pasian’ peengkul hong ging ding a, vantung panin Topa mahmah hong paisuk ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua hun laitakin a nungta lai eite pen vankim lai-ah Topa a dawn dingin amah a um a sisa mite tawh hong kilakhawm ding a, Topa tawh i omkhawm tawntung ding hi, cihna ahi hi.","ref":"1Kor 15:51-52"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin note khatlekhat hih thu tawh na kihehnem un."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, hih thu hong pian ding hun tawh kisai kong gelh ding uh kisam lo hi.","title":"Topa Hong Pai Ding Kiging Un"},"2":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa hong pai ding Ni pen zan a gutate bangin theihkholh lohin hong tung ding hi, ci-in note in teltakin na theihsa uh ahi hi.","ref":"Mat 24:43; Luk 12:39; 2Pe 3:10"},"3":{"text":"Mite in, “Thu khempeuh a hoih laitak hi a, bangmah patauh nading om lo hi,” a cih laitakin thakhatthu-in amaute tungah siatna hong tungvat ding hi. Nausuah natna bangin gimna thuak ding uh a, kuamah suakta lo ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, note ahihleh khuamial gamtatnate gamta lo na hih manun guta bangin tua Ni hong tunvat ciangin lamdang na sa kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh note khempeuh, khuavak gamtatna a nei, sun khuavak mite na hi uh a, eite pen khuamial gamtatna a nei, zan khuamial mite ihi kei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin midangte bangin eite mawk om hithiat loin khua phawkin pilvang ni."},"7":{"text":"Zan khuamial pen mite’ ihmut hithiat hun le zukham hun ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin eite pen khuavak gamtatna a nei sun khuavak mi ihih manin pilvang ni. Awmdal bangin upna le itna bulhin, siklukhu bangin i lamet hotkhiatna khu ni.","ref":"Isa 59:17; Efe 6:13-17"},"9":{"text":"Pasian in ama hehna a thuak dingin eite a hong teel hi lo a, i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin hotkhiatna a ngah dingin a hong teel ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah a hong paikik ciangin a hing ihi a, a si ihi zongin amah tawh i omkhawm theih nadingin eite a dingin amah a hong si ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin tu laitakin na omzia uh mah bangin khatlekhat kihanthawnin na kihuh ciat ta un."},"12":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, Topa in note lam a hong lak ding le a hong makai dingin a seh, note lakah na a hong sem mite, a kilawm a kituakin zahtakbawl un.","title":"A Tawpna Hanthotna le Vaikhakna"},"13":{"text":"Amau’ nasepna hangin amaute nakpitakin itbawlin zahtak un. Note khatlekhat kilem takin na om un."},"14":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, a thadah mite hilh unla, a meidawite hanthawnin, a zawngkhal mite huh unla, hih bang mite ngongbawl kei un."},"15":{"text":"Gitlohna lamsang kuamah kithuk loin, note khatlekhat tung le mi khempeuh tungah a pha kibawl ding ngaihsutpi-in na nei un."},"16":{"text":"Lungdam tawntungin,"},"17":{"text":"thu ngen niloh unla,"},"18":{"text":"bangbang hong piang taleh na lungdamna uh Pasian tungah ko tawntung un. Khrih Jesuh tawh kipawlin na nuntakna sung uhah hih bangzia-in na om ding uh Pasian in a hong deih ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Kha Siangtho nasepna dongtangsak kei unla,"},"20":{"text":"thuhilhnate simmawhbawl kei un."},"21":{"text":"Thu khempeuh entel pha unla, a hoihte kemin,"},"22":{"text":"a sia lamsang peuhmah pelh un."},"23":{"text":"Nopsakna a hong pia Pasian in na khempeuhah sianthona le kicinna hong pia hen la, na kha uh, na nuntakna uh, le na pumpi uh hoihtakin hong kem hen la, i Topa Jesuh Khrih hong pai ciangin mawhna khat zong a nei het lo dingin hong bawl tahen."},"24":{"text":"Note a hong sam i Pa Pasian a thutak hi a, a thuciamte khempeuh hong tungsak taktak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, kote a’ ding thu hong ngetsak un."},"26":{"text":"Thu uppih mi khempeuh khatlekhat a siangtho ki-itna lungsim tawh kinamin na kihopih un."},"27":{"text":"Thu um mi khempeuh’ zak dingin hih lai na sim nadingun Topa’ min tawh ka hong thum hi."},"28":{"text":"I Topa Jesuh Khrih hehpihna thupha note tungah hong tung tahen."}}}}},"53":{"info":{"name":"Thesalonika Nihna","shortname":"2Te","abbr":[],"desc":"Khrih hong paikik ding lametna tawh kisai buaina in Thesalonika khua-a pawlpite lakah thu nawngkai hong piangsak hi. Thesalonika Khua Khristian-te tungah Paul' Laikhak Nihna in Topa hong paikik khinta hi, ci-in upna thu tawh kisai a gen hi. Paul in, Khrih hong paikik ma-in Khrih a langpang, “Gilopa,” a kicipa' makaihna tawh gitlohna leh siatna lianpi hong om masa ding hi, ci-in a genna tawh tua ngaihsutna omsa a manlohna a lak hi. Lungkhamna leh buaina a thuak uh ahi zongin a upna uhah kiptakin omin, Paul leh a kikholhpih mite mah bangin a nuntakna dingun na semin, gamtat hoih a neih paisuakna ding uh a kisapna thu, sawltak Paul in a laikhak a simding mite kiangah a limgen hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keimah Paul, le Silas, le Timoti-te in: Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih sungah a om, Thesalonika khua-a om pawlpi mite tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi.","title":"Hopihna","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"2":{"text":"Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen."},"3":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note’ upna nakpitakin khang a, note khatlekhat na ki-itna uh lian semsem ahih manin Pasian tungah lungdamna koh ding a kilawm ahih mah bangin, note hangin ama tungah lungdamna ka ko tawntung uh hi.","title":"Khrih Hong Pai Ciangin Thukhenna"},"4":{"text":"Bawlsiatna le gimna na thuakna khempeuh uhah na upna uh khahsuah loin thuakzo paisuak na hih manun midangte kiangah Pasian’ pawlpi ka na kisialhpih uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-a na thuaknate uh hangin Pasian’ Ukna sungah a om dingin a kilawm mi suak na hih manun Pasian’ thukhenna a man ahihna hong kilangsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in a manin na sem ding ahih manin note a hong gimsak mite tungah Pasian in gimna pia ding a,"},"7":{"text":"tu-a gimna a thuak note le kote tungah zong nopsakna hong pia ding hi. Vantung panin Topa Jesuh le a vanglian a vantung mite, meikuang tawh hong kilat ciangin,"},"8":{"text":"Pasian a thei lo mite, le i Topa Jesuh tawh kisai Lungdamna Thu a um lo mite tungah gimna a tungsak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama mite khempeuh le thu um mite khempeuh hangin minthanna le pahtawina a ngah dingin Topa hong pai Ni ciangin a noptuak mahmah Topa’ minthanna huamsung panin amaute kihawlkhia ding a, tawntung suksiatna dan a thuak ding uh hi. Ahi zongin note in ka hong gen uh thute um na hih manun tua nopna sungah na om ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:10","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin ama hong sapna tawh a kilawm a kituak nuntakna na nuntak theih nading uh le ama vangliatna tawh a hoih na hihnop khempeuh uh hihzo-in, na upna uh hangin na khempeuh na zawhtheihna dingun Pasian kiangah thu ka hong ngetsak tawntung uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hileh, eite’ Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih hong hehpihna hangin note in ama tung panin minthanna ngahin, ama min zong a thangsak na hi ding uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesuh Khrih hong pai nading thu le amah a dawn dingin eite i kikhop nading thu tawh kisai-in note kiangah kong thum nopna uh panin:","title":"A Gilopa","ref":"1The 4:15-17"},"2":{"text":"Topa’ hong pai ding ni hong tung khinta hi, ci-a thu kigenna hangin lunghimawhin lungmangin om kei un. Thuhilh khat peuhpeuh in hih bang thu hong genkha thei ding a, tua thu pen kote’ gen leh gelh hi, ci-in zong genkha ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin kuama khemsa-in ta kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh nakpitakin Pasian langpanna lianpi le hell khuksung a tung ding ahi A Gilopa hong kilat matengin tua Ni hong tung lo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua A Gilopa in mite’ biak pasian a kici khempeuh le na khempeuh nialgawp ding hi. Tuate khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in a kingaihsut banah, Pasian ka hi hi, ci-in Pasian’ biakinn sung mahmahah pai-in va tu ding hi.","ref":"Dan 11:36; Ezk 28:2"},"5":{"text":"Note tawh ka hong omkhawm lai-in hih thute khempeuh hong genkhin ka hih manin na phawk lai ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu laitakin tua bang a pian loh nadingin a kham khat om ahihna thu na thei uh hi. A hun a tun ciangin A Gilopa hong kilang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Kuamah kim in a phawk loh Gitloh Gamtatna kigamta khinta a, ahi zongin hih thu a pian ding a khamcip pa a kilakkhiat khit matengin a hong piang ding thu hong piang nai lo ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A khamcip pa a kilakkhiat khit ciangin A Gilopa hong kilang ding a, Topa Jesuh hong pai ciangin tua A Gilopa mutlum ding a, vanglian minthangin hong kilatna tawh a maimangsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:4"},"9":{"text":"Satan’ vangliatna tawh A Gilopa hong pai-in, lim le nalamdang a tuamtuamte hong bawl ding a,","ref":"Mat 24:24"},"10":{"text":"gitloh khemna a nam tuamtuam zangin, siatna a thuak ding mite a khem ding hi. Tua bang mite in a suahtak nadingun thuman sang nuam lo, deih lo uh ahih manin siatna a tuak uh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Pasian in amaute lakah nasem dingin zuau thahatna paisak ahih manin amaute in a man lo thu um uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih manin thuman um loin, mawhna sungah nuam a sa khempeuh in mawhsak thukhenna thuak ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, Topa in note hong it a, Kha Siangtho vangliatna hang le note in thuman na upna uh hangin ama mi siangthote na suah nadingun nopsakna a ngah masa dingin Pasian in note hong teel ahih manin note hangin Pasian tungah lungdamna ka ko tawntung uh hi.","title":"Nopsakna A Ngah Dingin Kiteel"},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesuh Khrih tawh minthanna na ngahkhawm theih nadingun note tungah ka hong hilh uh Lungdamna Thu tawh hih nopsakna ah Pasian in note a hong sam ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, kam tawh ahi a, lai tawh ahi zongin ka hong hilh uh thumante limtakin zui unla, kiptakin om un."},"16":{"text":"I Topa Jesuh Khrih mahmah leh, eite hong itin, a hong hehpihna tawh thakhauhna le lametna a hong pia tawntung eite’ Pa Pasian in"},"17":{"text":"note lungsimah thakhauhna hong guan hen la, a hoih thu khempeuh genin a semzo dingin na tha uh hong hatsak tahen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, tu-in note lak mah bangin mun dangah zong Topa’ thu manlang takin kizel pakin lungdam takin a kisan’ theih nadingin kote a’ ding thu hong ngetsak un.","title":"Kote a’ ding Thu Hong Ngetsak Un"},"2":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in thu um nai lo uh ahih manin a gilo a siahuai mite panin Pasian in kote hong hotkhiat nadingin zong hong ngetsak un."},"3":{"text":"Note ahihleh, Topa citak mahmah ahih manin hong thahatsak ding a, A Gilopa kiang panin hong honkhia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Note kiangah ka hong gen uh thute a kipat cil a kipanin na zuih uh mah bangin zui paisuak taktak ding, ci-in note muanna lungsim kote sungah Topa in hong guan hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian bangin itna nei-in Khrih thuak bangin na thuakzawh nadingun Topa in note lungsim hong bawlsak tahen."},"6":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesuh Khrih min tawh kong sawlnop uh thu panin: Note tungah ka hong hilhsa uh thute a zui lo, a thadah gamtat thu uppih mite tawh na kikhawl kei un.","title":"Na Sep ding Phamawh"},"7":{"text":"Kote’ gamtatzia bangin a gamta ding na hihna uh teltakin na thei uh hi. Note tawh ka hong omkhawm lai-un ka thadah om kei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kuama an a khongin ka ne kei uh hi. Note khat peuhpeuh in nong suplawhkhak loh nadingun a sun a zanin hahkat takin na ka sem uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih bangin ka gamtatna uh pen note’ hong piakte a khongin ne-in a zang dingin a kilawm mah hinapi-in, note’ etteh ding gamtatzia a hong lak ka hizaw uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Note tawh ka hong omkhawm lai-un, “Na a sem nuam lo mi peuhmah an nesak kei un,” ci-in ka hong gen uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih bangin thu ka hong genna uh pen note lakah mi pawlkhatte thadahin na sem nuam lo uh a, midangte’ nasepna va nawngkaisak zawsop hi, ci-in ka zakna hang uh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu-in tua bang mite in kuamah nawngkaisak nawn loin man manin na sem hiathiatin amau’ nuntak nadingun na a sep nadingun Topa Jesuh Khrih min tawh hanthawnin thu ka hong pia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, note in a hoihin gamtat ding na cimtak ngei het kei ta un."},"14":{"text":"Hih lai sunga ka hong gente uh a zui nuam lo mi khatpeuh a om leh tua mipa limtakin ciamteh unla, amah a maizum theih nadingin kikholhpih nawn kei un."},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin amah galbawl kei unla, thu uppih mi khat hihna tawh hilhbawl zaw un."},"16":{"text":"Eite tungah nopsakna a hong pia thei Topa in note tungah a tawntungin nopsakna hong pia hen la, amah in note khempeuh hong ompih tahen.","title":"Thupha Piakna"},"17":{"text":"Keimah Paul in kong hopih hi, cihna kammal teng keima khut tawh ka hong gelh ahi hi. Keima laikhak khempeuh hih bangzia-in ciamtehin ka hih ngeina ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"I Topa Jesuh Khrih hong hehpihna thupha note khempeuh tungah hong tung tahen."}}}}},"54":{"info":{"name":"Timoti Masa","shortname":"1Ti","abbr":[],"desc":"Asia Minor gam pan a piang Khristian khangno Timoti pen a nu Jew mi hi a, a pa Grik mi ahi hi. Paul in Pasian' thu hilhin a khualzin nasepna-ah a kikholhpih leh a huhpa a suak hi. Timoti tungah Paul' Laikhak Masa in thu thum gen a, tuate in: 1. Pawlpi sungah thuhilhna manlo a om tawh kisai-in hilhkholhna ahi hi. Hih thuhilhna manlo pen Jew mite' ngaihsutna zia leh Jew mi a hilo mite' ngaihsutna zia a kihelzau hi a, hih leitung siahuai mahmah ahih manin mite in a tuam vilvelin thuthuk theihna leh an pawlkhat tan'na leh zilepasal neihlohna tawh hotkhiatna kingah thei bek ding hi, ci-in upna ahi hi. 2. Pawlpi ki-ukna zia leh biakna zia hilhna leh pawlpi makaite leh huhpate' gamtat pianzia ding hilhna ahi hi. 3. Timoti pen Jesuh Khrih nasem hoih ahihna ding leh thu um mi pawl tuamtuamte tungah tavuan a neihna thu a hilhna ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Eite a hong Hon Pasian le eite’ lamet Khrih Jesuh’ thupiakna tawh Khrih Jesuh’ sawltak ahi keimah Paul in,","title":"Hopihna"},"2":{"text":"Thu upna sungah ka tapa taktak ahi Timoti tungah lai ka hong khak hi. Pa Pasian le eite’ Topa Khrih Jesuh in dikna, hehpihna le nopsakna thupha, nangma tungah hong tungsak tahen.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"3":{"text":"Masedonia gam lam manawhin ka pai lai-in Efesa khua-ah na om ding ka hong sawl mah bangin tu-in zong tua khua mahah na omlai inla, thu upna man lo a hilh mite, a thuhilh a khawl nadingun thu na pia in.","title":"Upna Man lo tawh Kisai Hilhkholhna"},"4":{"text":"Phuahtawm tangthute le min tampipi kizom deudau-a khangsimnate in upna tawh i ngahtheih Pasian’ vaihawmnate tangtungsak loin, khatlekhat kitotna piangsak lel ahih manin, tua bang thute a manlahpih loh nadingun na gen in."},"5":{"text":"Hih bangin thupiakna pen, upna taktak le kisuanna om hetloin lungsim siangtho taktak tawh ngaihsutna panin a hong piangkhia ki-itna a khantheih nading deihna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte, hih bang ngaihsutna panin peukhia-in bangmahin a kimang lo thu kikupna tawh nitum uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Thei kisa ngelin a gen kankan uh thute le amau kampauna mahmah zong bang gen ka hi hiam cih a thei het lo hinapi-in amaute pen Pasian’ thukhamte a hilh dingin utzaw lai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thukham pen a kizat nading a kilawm ciang ah zangthei lehang a hoih thu khat hi, ci-in i thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin i phawk dingah, mi hoihte a dingin thukham a kibawl hi lo a, thukham zui lote, thumang lote, Pasian’ deih bangin a gamta lote le mawhneite, biakna lungsim a nei lote le kam kilawm lo a paute, nute pate a thatte, midang a thatte,"},"10":{"text":"nulepa mawhna a gamtate, palepa mawhna a bawlte, mi a gute, zuauthu a gente, mite’ siat nading thu a gente, le thuman tawh a kilehbulhin a gamta mite a dingin thukham a kibawl ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Thuman ka cih pen thupha tawh kidimin a minthang Pasian in ka hilh dingin kei tungah a hong piak Lungdamna Thu ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih bangin na sepzawh nadingin thatang hatna a hong pia i Topa Khrih Jesuh tungah ka lungdam hi. Ama nasem dingin kei hong muangin hong seh ahih manin ka nuam hi.","title":"Pasian’ Hehpih Manin Paul’ Lungdamna"},"13":{"text":"A beisa hunah amah gensia-in, simmawh bawlin, ama mite a bawlsia pa ka hih ngei tei hangin ama thu ka up nai loh manin theih lohna tawh a gamta ka hih manin Pasian in kei hong hehpih hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 9:4-5"},"14":{"text":"Pasian in genzawh lohin kei hong hehpih a, Khrih Jesuh tawh kipawlna hangin i ngahtheih upna le itna a hong guan hi."},"15":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh, mawhneite a honkhia dingin leitungah hong pai hi, cihna thu a man hi a, a uphuai a sanhuai thu ahi hi. Keimah zong tua mawhnei mite lakah a mawhpha bel ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"A mawhnei pha bel ka hihna thu hang mahin, nidang ciangin amah umin nuntak tawntungna a ngah ding mite’ etteh theih dingin Khrih Jesuh in a lungduaina cingtakin kei tungah hong lahtheih nadingin Pasian in kei a hong hehpih ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah bek Pasian ahi, a kimu thei lo, a si ngei lo, tawntung Kumpipa in minthanna le pahtawina ngah tawntung tahen. Amen."},"18":{"text":"Ka ta Timoti aw, tanglai pek a kipanin nang bang mite a dingin a kigensa thu tawh kizui-in nang tungah a thu ka hong ap hi. Hoihtakin gal na dozawh nadingin galhiamin tua thute zang inla,"},"19":{"text":"na upna le lungsim kisuang loin na omna thu kiptakin len paisuak in. Mi pawlkhatte in a lungsim kitheihna uhah man a kisakna bangun gamta lo uh ahih manin a thu upna uh a mawkna a suah uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bang mite lakah Hymenaias le Alexander kihel uh a, Pasian gensiat nawn loh nading thu a phawktheih nadingun Satan’ khut sungah amaute ka ap hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A masa penin kong gennop thu in: Mi khempeuh a dingin Pasian tungah ngetna, thungetna, thumna le lungdamkohna na neih ding uh ahi hi.","title":"Pasian Biak Ding Zia Hilhna"},"2":{"text":"Eite nuamtakin omthei-in, biakna lungsim nei-in a kilawm takin i nuntak theih nadingin kumpite le uliante a dingin thu na ngetsak un."},"3":{"text":"Hih bang gamtatnate pen eite hong Hon Pasian’ muhna-ah a hoih a kilawm thu ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in hotkhiatna ngahin, thuman a theihkim ding Pasian in deih hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian khat bek om a, Pasian le mite a hong kilemsakkik thei Khrih Jesuh khat bek om hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi khempeuh a tankhia dingin tua Jesuh hong kipiatawm a, a hun lian laitakin a hong kipiakna pen Pasian in mi khempeuh a hotkhiat nopna thu a kilatna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hih ka gen thu pen zuau ahi lo, thu taktak a gen ka hi a, Gentail mite lakah upna thu le hih thuman a gen dingin sawltak na semin thu a hilh dingin kei a hong kisawl ahi hi.","ref":"2Tim 1:11"},"8":{"text":"Mun khempeuhah a om pasal khempeuh in kuamah tawh kitotna le lungsim kinopmawhna nei hetloin, lungsim siangtho tawh a khut uh lamin thu a nget ding uh ka deih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua mah bangin numeite zong a kilawm a kituak bekin kizemin kipuahin, sam khawng a uanglua-in bawl loin, a khengvalin kizepna a tuamtuamte zang loin,","ref":"1Pe 3:3"},"10":{"text":"biakna lungsim neite a dingin a kilawm ahih mah bangin gamtat hoih a neih ding uh ka deih hi."},"11":{"text":"Numeite in gamdai takin kiniamkhiatna tawh thu ngai-in a sin ding uh ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Numeite in pasalte tungah aana nei-in thu a hilh ding ka phalkei hi. Gamdai takin a om ding uh ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh a masa-in Adam kipiangsak a, tua ciangin Eve kipiangsak pan hi.","ref":"Pian 2:7,21-22"},"14":{"text":"Adam in khemna thuak masa lo a, numei in thuakin a khial masa a suak hi.","ref":"Pian 3:1-6"},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin numei in a kilawm a kituakin upna, itna le sianthona thu-ah kiptakin a om nakleh nausuah gimna sihpih lo ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh, pawlpi sia nasep a ut leh a hoih mahmah ahi hi, a cihna thu a man ahi hi.","title":"Pawlpi Sia dingte’ Pianzia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahih manin siate pen paubaanna a nei lo mi, zi khat bek a nei mi, lungsim hoih hithiat mi, thu a ngaihsun thei mi, a kilawm a kituakin a gamta mi, zin le leengla do a siam mi, thuhilh a siam mi,"},"3":{"text":"zu a kham lo mi, a ngongtat lo mi, lungsimnem mi, kitot a uk lo mi, sum a deihlua lo mite hi ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A innkuan sung hoihtakin a ukzo mi, a tate thumangsak thei-in, na khempeuhah a kilawm a kituakin a gamtasak thei mi hi ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh in a innkuan sung ukzia ding a theih kei leh Pasian’ pawlpi kem thei lo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Khristian a suaktungte zong hi lo ding hi. Tua bang mi thakte kiphasak thei a, Dawimangpa mah bangin thukhenna a thuak mite hikha thei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Pawlpi mi ahi lo midangte in zong a zahtak mite hi ding hi. Tua hileh mindai kha lo ding a, Dawimangpa’ thangah awk kha lo zawdeuh ding hi.","ref":"Tit 1:6-9"},"8":{"text":"Pawlpi upa dingte zong a gamtat hoih, a lungsim citak, leenggahzu tam a ne lo, sum thu-ah a huaiham mi hi lo ding uh hi.","title":"Pawlpi Upa dingte’ Pianzia"},"9":{"text":"Lungsim kisuanna a om lo, upna thu-ah a kip mite hi ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"A masa-in kize-et phot ding a, paubaanna a om kei leh sem thei pan ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A zite uh zong a gamtat hoih mi hi-in, mi gensiat a hat lote hi ding uh a, lungsim citak, thu khempeuhah a thuman mi hi ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Upate pen zi khat bek a nei mi, a tate le a innkuansung hoihtakin a ukzote hi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Pawlpi upa hoihtakin a semthei mite pen mite in zahtak uh a, Khrih Jesuh a upna thu uh kisuanna om hetloin hangtakin gen ngam uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Nang kiangah hong pai-in nang tawh kimu baih ding cih lametna tawh hih lai a hong gelh ka hi hi.","title":"I Biakna a Thuthukna"},"15":{"text":"Ahi zongin ka hong zekai khak zenzen leh thuman thutak khuampi le bulpi, a nungta Pasian’ pawlpi ahi Pasian’ innkuan sungah bangci gamtat ding cih na theih nadingin hih ka hong laikhak in lam hong lak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"I biakna pen a thuthuk a thulian taktak ahihna thu hih bangin i thei hi: Mihing lim pua-in amah hong kilang a, a man taktak ahihna thu Kha Siangtho in kilangsak a, vantung mite in a mu uh hi. Mi khempeuh tungah ama thu kihilh a, mun khempeuhah ama thu ki-umin, vantungah amah kilato hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nidang ciangin a upna panun mi pawlkhat pialin, zuauthu gente le dawi thu a kigente a zuih nading uh Kha Siangtho in teltakin a gen hi.","title":"Upna Pial A Om ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Tua bang zuau thuhilhnate pen zuau genin mi a khem, sik emsa tawh tatgawp bangin a lungsim un a hoih le a hoih lo a khenthei nawn lote’ kam panin hong gingkhia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua bang mite in zi neih le pasal neih ding le an pawlkhat nek ding hoih lo hi, ci uh hi. Ahi zongin thu umin, thuman thutak a thei mite in lungdamna ko-in a nek dingin Pasian in tua ante a bawl ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian’ bawlsa na khempeuh a hoih hi a, nial loin, lungdamna pulakin san ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian’ thu le thungetna hang tawh tuate a hoih a suak ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang in na zuihsa upna thu le thuhilhna man na zuih kawmin hih ka hong thugente, i sanggamte kiangah na gen nakleh Khrih Jesuh’ nasem a hoih khat na hi ding hi.","title":"Khrih Jesuh’ Nasem Hoih"},"7":{"text":"Pasian’ thu tawh a kituak lo, a haihuai tangthu phuahtawmte ngaihsutin na nei vet kei in. Pasian’ deihna tawh a kituakin na nuntak zawh nadingin na kisin in."},"8":{"text":"Pumpi kisekin kisinna manpha hi. Ahi zongin kha thu-ah kisekin kisinna pen tuhun laitak le a hong tung ding hunah nuntakna hong piathei ahih manin manphazaw lai hi,"},"9":{"text":"ci-a kigen pen a man taktak thu hi a, umin sin dingin a kilawm thu ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"A diakdiakin ei thu umte in mi khempeuh a Honkhia, a nungta Pasian muangin lamen ihih manin nakpitakin hanciamin na a sem ihi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka hong gensa thute na hilhsawn in."},"12":{"text":"Khangno lai na hihna thu hangin mite’ simmawh dingin na om kei inla, kampauna, gamtatna, itna, upna, le sianthona-ah thu um mite’ etteh dingin na om in."},"13":{"text":"Kei ka hong pai matengin mipi mai-ah Lai Siangtho simna, a khiatna genna, le hanthotnate-ah tavuan na la in."},"14":{"text":"Kamsangte’ thugennate le upate in na tungah a khut uh nga-in thu hong ngetsakna ahi nangma hihtheih siamnate na valkhongsak kei in."},"15":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in na khantohna hong muhtheih nadingin hih thute limtakin ngaihsun inla, hahkatin na sem in."},"16":{"text":"Na gamtatna le na thuhilhnate-ah hoihtakin kidawmin om lecin nangmah a kipan na thugen a za mite a dingin phattuamna om ding ahih manin na nasepna-ah hoihtakin om in."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang sangin a uzaw mite taiibawl kei inla, na pa bangin ngaihsunin hanthawn in. Nang sangin a nauzawte na nau bangin bawl in.","title":"Midang tungah Tavuante"},"2":{"text":"Nang sangin a uzaw numeite na nu bangin bawl inla, nang sangin a nauzaw numeite, lungsim siangtho tak tawh na nau numei bangin bawl in."},"3":{"text":"Meigong taktak ahi numeite zahtakbawl in."},"4":{"text":"Meigong numei khatpeuh in tate ahi a, tute ahi zongin a neih leh innkuan sungah biakna tawh kisai-in tavuan a neihna uh hilh inla, a nu a pa, a pu a pite a huh nadingun gen in. Hih bang gamtatna pen Pasian’ muhna-ah a hoih thu ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A kem a khoi ding a om lo meigong taktak ahi numeite in Pasian bek mah muan le suanin nei-in, a sun a zanin Pasian’ huh ding deihin thu ngen tawntung uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin a pumpi uh deihna zui-in a gamta meigong numeite pen a pumpi uh a nuntak hangin kha thu-ah a sikhin ahi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute paubaanna a om loh nadingin hih ka hong thupiaksate amaute tungah gensawn in."},"8":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in a beh a phung, a diakdiakin a innkuansung mite a vak nop kei leh a upna a nusia hita a, thu um lo mite sangin siazaw lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Meigong numei khat peuhpeuh a khan kum sawmguk a cingsate, le pasal khatvei bek a nei ngeite bek, meigong sazian sungah koih in."},"10":{"text":"Tua banah a gamtat hoihna a kitheite, a tate hoihtakin a khansuahsate, a inn-ah zin le leengla do a siam mite, kiniamkhiatin Pasian’ mite’ khe a silsakte, a lungkham mite a huhte, le thu khempeuhah a hoih gamtat mite hi lai ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A khangno lai meigong numeite, sazian sungah hel kei in. A pumpi uh deihna zui-in pasal a neihkik nop uh ciangin Khrih taisan uh ahih manin,"},"12":{"text":"a thuciam masak uh palsat uh ahih manin a mawh a suak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bek zong hi loin, bangmah sem loin inn khat pan inn khatah vak kawikawi-in a hun uh mawk beisak uh a, a vakmawk uh tawh maisak loin mi gensia kawikawi-in midangte va nawngkaisak uh a, a gen lohpi ding teng uh genin va nei uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahih manin, i langte’ hong gensiat nading a om loh nadingin, a khangno lai meigong numeite in pasal nei-in, ta nei-in, amau innkuansung ukin a om ding uh ka deihzaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh meigong numei pawlkhat, Satan’ nung a zui dingin kipan khinta uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Thu um innkuan sungah meigong numei a nei a om leh pawlpite in a kisam meigong taktakte a huhtheih nadingin pawlpi tungah tavuan hong guan kei hen la, amau’ meigong numeite na huh ta uh hen."},"17":{"text":"Pawlpi sungah ukna le makaihna siamin, thuhilh le thugen hahkat tawh a thuah upate pen thaman a zah nih piak dingin kilawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in, “Buh a cil bawngtal muk na tuam kei in,” a cih banah, “Nasempa in a thaman a ngah ding a kilawm ahi hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:4; Mat 10:10; Luk 10:7"},"19":{"text":"Upa khat peuhpeuh a mawhsak mi nih le thum a om kei buang leh thu-in na sim kei in.","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"20":{"text":"A khial takpi upa a om leh upa dangte a lautheih nadingin a lawmte mai-ah tua a khial pa taii-in thuhilh in."},"21":{"text":"Hih ka hong gen thute na zatna-ah kuamah guptuam paihtuam nei hetloin hoihtakin hong mangin na zat nadingin Pasian, Khrih Jesuh, le a siangtho vantung mite’ muhna-ah limtakin a hong gen ka hi hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa’ na a sem dingin kipsakna-in khut nga-in thungetna pen kuama tungah zang mengmeng kei in. Midang a khialte tawh khialkhawm kha kei inla, siangtho takin na omtheih nadingin limtakin kikem in."},"23":{"text":"Na gil sung natna le na nat mun zelzelna hangin tui bek zang nawn loin leenggahzu tawmtawm na zang in."},"24":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte’ khialhnate kimu pahpahin mawhsakna thuakpah uh a, pawlkhatte’ khialhna pen damdamin hong kinung theih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua mah bangin gamtat hoihnate zong kilangin, kimu-in, a kithei pah kei zongin ki-imcip suak thei lo hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kuamah in Pasian’ min le i thuhilhnate hong gensiatsak lohna dingin sila khempeuh in a tote uh zahtakbawl ta uh hen."},"2":{"text":"Thu um mi to-in a nei silate in upna sungah sanggam khat hi hang, ci-in ngaihsutna tawh a tote uh zahtakbawl loin omkha kei uh hen. Amaute’ nasepna hangin hamphatna a ngah mite pen thu um mi le a it uh mite ahih manin a hoihzaw-in a sepsak ding uh a kilawmzaw ahi hi. Tu-a ka hong gen ding thute mi khempeuh tungah hilhin gen in."},"3":{"text":"Topa Jesuh Khrih thu tawh a kituak lo, i biakna paizia tawh a kilehngatin thu tuamdang a hilh mite pen,","title":"Pasian Biakna-ah Lungkimin Nopsakna"},"4":{"text":"a kiphasak mawkmawk hi uh a, bangmah a thei het lo ahi uh hi. Tua bang mite in thu kisel thu kinial cihte ut belin nei uh a, hazatna, lungsim kituah lohna, kizahkona, a sia lamin ki-upmawhnate piangsak uh a,"},"5":{"text":"thuman thutak zui loin, a lungsim paizia uh a man nawn lo, biakna pen hauhtheih nading lampi bekin a ngaihsun mite in a tawntungin kitot kiselna a piangsak uh ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian biakna hangin a neihsateng tawh a lungkim mite pen biakna in mihau a suaksak takpi mah ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A taktakin ci lehang, leitungah mihingin i suah laitakin sumlepai tawh i suak kei a, i sih ciangin zong leitung panin bangmah i keng thei tuan kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin annek tuidawn, nikten puansilh i neih nakleh a phazo ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin a haunuam mite in ze-etna a tuamtuam thuak a, duhhopna, huaihamna a haivai thute-ah awkcipin, haksatna le siatna a tuahlawh uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Sum deihluatna in siatna namkim piangsak hi. Mi pawlkhat in sum deihlua liang uh ahih manin a upna panun pialkhia-in gimna lungkhamna tampi a thuaklawh uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ mi ahi nangmah in tua thute khempeuh pelh inla, thuman thutak, Pasian’ deih bangin nuntakna, upna, itna, kipna, le lungnemna na neihzawh nadingin hanciam in.","title":"Upna thu-ah Hoihtakin Nawksuakna"},"12":{"text":"Upna thu-ah hoihtakin nawksuak inla, mi tampi’ zakin na pulaksa, Pasian in nangmah a hong piak nuntak tawntungna lenkip in."},"13":{"text":"Na khempeuh tungah nuntakna a pia Pasian, le Pontias Pilat mai-ah hangtakin thu a gen ngam Khrih Jesuh’ mai-ah nang ka hong thupiakna in:","ref":"Joh 18:37"},"14":{"text":"I Topa Jesuh hong kilatkik Ni dongin paubaanna le mawhsakna om hetloin nang hong kipia thute na zui in."},"15":{"text":"Kumpite’ Kumpi, topate’ Topa, thupha ngahin amah bek a lianpen ahi Pasian in hun a sak khatpeuh ciangin Jesuh hong kilangsakkik ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua i Pasian bek mah a si thei lo hi a, khuavak pha mahmah sungah om ahih manin kuamah in a kiang neh thei lo hi. Kuamah in amah mu ngei lo a, zong mu thei lo hi. A tawntungin amah kipahtawi hen la, vanglian tawntung tahen. Amen."},"17":{"text":"Tuhuna a hau mite kisatheikha loin, a kip lo hauhnate muan le suanin neikha loin, eite in nuamtakin i zat theih dingin citna tawh a hong pia Pasian a muan a suan nadingun na hilh in."},"18":{"text":"A hoih nate semin, gamtat pha-in, citna lungsim nei-in midangte a hopnop nadingun na hilh in."},"19":{"text":"Tua hileh mai lamah amaute’ nuntak nading bulpi taktak ahi neihsate, amau a dingin a khol mite ahi ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Timoti aw, nang tungah a hong kipia thute hoihtakin na zui in. Mi pawlkhatte in, “Thu theihna,” ci-in a ngaihsutkhak uh, Pasian’ thu tawh a kituak lo, thu kihai selnate na pelh in."},"21":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte in tua bang pilna a nei-in kingaihsun uh a, upna thu bulpi khahsuahna-in a nei uh hi. Note khempeuh tungah Pasian’ dikna thupha hong tung tahen."}}}}},"55":{"info":{"name":"Timoti Nihna","shortname":"2Ti","abbr":[],"desc":"Timoti tungah Paul' Laikhak Nihna pen a khangno lai, a naseppih leh amah a huhpa ahihna hangin ama pumpi tung thuhilhna ahi hi. Timoti in citakin Jesuh thu a gen paisuakna ding, Lungdamna Thuhilhna man leh Thuciam Lui thu len cintenin, bangzahin kilangpangin gimna thuak ta se leh thugenna leh thuhilh nasep a sep teiteina dingin thuhilhna leh hanthotna ahi hi. Thungai mite' phattuamna ding a piangsaklo, siatna bek a piangsak, bangmah theilopi-a thu kihai selna-ah kihelkhak ding a lauhuaina thu, a diakin lim hilhkhol mahmah hi. Hih a thugenna khempeuhah, bawlsiatna leh gimna a thuak laitakin hih lai a gelhpa' nuntakzia leh a ngimna — a upna, a lungduaina, itna a neihna, leh a thuak tentannate khempeuh a etteh dingin a phawksak hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh tawh i kipawlna hangin hong kipia ding nuntakna thu a gen dingin Pasian’ deihna tawh Khrih Jesuh’ sawltak nasep a sem dingin a hong kisawl keimah Paul in","title":"Hopihna"},"2":{"text":"Ka it ka ta Timoti tungah lai ka hong khak hi. Pa Pasian le i Topa Khrih Jesuh in dikna, hehpihna, le nopsakna thupha nang tungah hong tungsak tahen.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"3":{"text":"A sun a zanin ka thungetna-ah nang ka hong phawk tawntung a, ka pu ka pate’ sep mah bangin kisuanna lungsim om hetloin a na ka sep Pasian tungah ka lungdamna ka ko hi.","title":"Maizum Lo Ding"},"4":{"text":"Na khitui luannate phawk ka hih manin ka lung a dam theih nadingin nang tawh kimu nuamin a sun a zanin ka ngaihsun tawntung hi."},"5":{"text":"Na pi Lois le na nu Eunis in a neih upna bangte pawl mah, lungsim takpi tawh na upna thu ka phawk a, tu-in zong nang sungah tua bang upna om hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahih manin nang tungah ka khut nga-in thu ka hong ngetsak lai-in nangma tungah Pasian in hong piak siamna na sosuah nadingin ka hong phawksak hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in eite tungah meidawina lungsim hong guan lo a, thahatna, ki-itna, pumpi ki-ukzawhna lungsim hong guan hizaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin i Topa’ thu gen nading thu-ah ahi a, ama thu hangin thong a kia keima thu-ah ahi zongin maizum het kei in. Pasian in nangma tungah thahatna hong pia ahih mah bangin Lungdamna Thu hangin thuakna-ah zong a thuaknuam hizaw in."},"9":{"text":"Eite’ sepzawhna hang hi loin ama ngimnasa bang leh a dikna hangin Pasian in eite hong honkhia-in ama mi dingin a hong sam hi. Pasian in leitung a pianma pekin Khrih Jesuh tungtawnin tua dikna a hong piak hi a,"},"10":{"text":"tuhun ciangin eite hong Honpa Khrih Jesuh tungtawnin a dikna hong langsak ta hi. Tua Jesuh in sihna beisak a, lungdamna thu hangin sih nawn lohna thu a hong kilangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih a thak Lungdamna Thu hilhin a taangko ding le sawltak na a sem dingin kei a hong kikoih ahi hi.","ref":"1Tim 2:7"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahih manin hih bangteng a thuak ka hi hi. Ahi zongin ka up pa ka thei a, ama tungah ka apte tua Ni dong hong kepsakzo ding hi, ci-in thei ka hih manin ka maizum het kei hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima tung panin na zaksa a man thute zui inla, Khrih Jesuh tawh i kipawlna hangin i ngah upna le itna thu-ah kiptakin om in."},"14":{"text":"Eite sungah a hong teng Kha Siangtho in a hong ap thuhoihte limtakin kem in."},"15":{"text":"Na theihsa bangin Asia gam sunga om mi khempeuh in kei hong nusia uh a, tuate lakah Figelas le Hermogenes-te zong kihel uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Onesiforas in tamveipi kei hong lungnuamsak ahih manin Pasian in a innkuan bupun hehpihna thupha pia tahen. Ka thongkiatna hangin amah maizum lo a,"},"17":{"text":"Rom khua hong tun ciangin kei hong muh matengin hong zong pah hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in tua Ni ciangin ama tungah hehpihna thupha pia tahen. Efesa khua-ah ka omlai-in nakpitakin kei a hong huhnate khempeuh na theihsa ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta aw, nang na hih leh Khrih Jesuh tawh i kipawl manin i ngah hehpihna hangin thahatin om in.","title":"Khrih Jesuh’ Galkap Hoih"},"2":{"text":"Mi tampite’ theihin ka thuhilh, na zaksa thu khempeuh, midangte a hilhsawn thei dingin a citak mite tungah hoihtakin a zuih dingun na hilh in."},"3":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh’ galkap hoih hihna tawh thuak dingin a kisam khempeuh na na thuak in."},"4":{"text":"Galkap a semlai mipa in ama tungah a om bupa a lungkimsak theih nadingin na sem ahih manin tualsung mite’ nasep tawh thuahkhawm lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Kimawl kidemna-ah a kihel mi khatpeuh in kimawlna ngeina zui lopi-in gualzawh pahtawina ngah thei lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Hahkat takin lo a khopa in anlak hun ciangin a tampen a ngah dingin a kilawm ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in thu khempeuh na theih nadingin hong huh ding ahih manin hih ka thugente khempeuh limtakin na ngaihsun in."},"8":{"text":"Lungdamna Thu ka hilhna sungah ka gen mah bangin David’ suan, sihna panin a kithosak Jesuh Khrih na na phawk in."},"9":{"text":"Ama hangin a kingah Lungdamna Thu ka hilh manin gimna ka thuak a, mithat bangin sikkol hong kibulh hi. Amah i nial leh amah in zong eite hong nial ding hi.","ref":"Mat 10:33; Luk 12:9"},"13":{"text":"Amah le amah kikhem thei lo ahih manin eite i citak kei zongin amah citak veve ding hi,” ci-in a kigenna thu man mahmah hi."},"14":{"text":"Na mite thu kinialin a kitot loh nadingun Pasian’ mai-ah thupi takin na hilhkhol in. Tua bang thu kinialna in a za mite phattuamna ngahsak loin a siasak bek ahi hi.","title":"A Kipakta Nasempa"},"15":{"text":"Pasian’ thuman a mantakin hilhin, na nasepna-ah maizumna thuak loin, Pasian’ pahtakna na ngahtheih nadingin na siam tawpin hanciam in."},"16":{"text":"Pasian tawh mite a kigamlasak semsem thei thu ginalo, a haihuai thu kikup thu kiselnate na pelh in."},"17":{"text":"Tua bangin amau’ thugennate in mite siasak a, tua banga thugente lakah Hymenaias le Filetas a kihel uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Thuman lampi panin amaute pialkhin uh a, thawhkikna thu pen a beisa thu hi ta hi, ci-in thu um mi pawlkhat lungmangsak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in a phuhsa sutpi kilokzo ngei lo ding hi. Tua sutpi tungah, “Topa in ama mi kua teng hiam cih thei hi,” cihna le, “Topa tawh kipawl ing, a ci peuhmah in mawhna sukhalo ding hi,” cihna kigelh hi.","ref":"Gam 6:5"},"20":{"text":"Inn lian khat peuhpeuh sungah umlebeel a nam tuamtuam a om hi. Pawlkhatte ngun tawh kibawl a, pawlkhatte kham tawh kibawl a, pawlkhatte sing tawh, pawlkhatte tungman tawh kibawl hi. Pawlkhatte a thupi diakin zattheih ding, pawlkhatte nisimin a mawkmawkin zattheih ding ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh a hoih lo na khempeuh panin kikemin a siangtho takin a om nakleh na hoih nam khempeuh a sem dingin a Topa tungah ki-apin, a Topa tungah a manpha suak ahih manin a thupi diakte-ah amah kizang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahih manin khangno lunggulhna hoih lote pelh inla, lungsim takpi tawh Topa tungah huhna a ngen mite tawh thuman thutak, upna, itna, kilemna na neihtheih nadingun hanciam khawm un."},"23":{"text":"Thu kihai seelna, thei lo pi-a thu kinialnate na pelh in. Tua bangte in kitotna a piansak lamtak na theihsa ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa’ na a sem mite, kitot a hatte hi lo ding a, mi khempeuh tungah lungsim nemin, thugen siamin, thuakzawhna nei-in,"},"25":{"text":"thunem tawh a langte’ hoih lohna a puahtheite hi ding hi. Tua bang hileh Pasian in amaute kisiksak thei ding a, thuman thutak hong thei-in,"},"26":{"text":"Dawimangpa in ama deihna bangin a gamta dingin a mat khit hangin ama thang panin amaute suakta khathei ding uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nitawp ni hun pen a lauhuai hun ahih ding lamtak phawk in.","title":"Nitawp Ni Huna Mihing Pianzia"},"2":{"text":"Tuahun ciangin mite in amau angsung ding bek ngaihsunin, huaihamin, kisialin, kihisakin, mi zahko-in, nu le pate’ thu mang loin, lungdam theihna mel nei loin, biakna lungsim nei loin,"},"3":{"text":"mi khual loin, hehpihna nei loin, mi gensia-in, ngongtatin, kihtakhuai-in, thuhoih deih loin,"},"4":{"text":"ciampelin, thu khual loin, kiphasak gawpin, Pasian don loin pumpi nopsakna bek deihin,"},"5":{"text":"biakna thu a puathamteng zui napi-in biakna hangin vangliatna thu a omte deih lo ding uh hi. Amah in a tawntungin minthanna ngah tahen. Note khempeuh tungah Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hong tung tahen."}}}}},"56":{"info":{"name":"Titus","shortname":"Tit","abbr":[],"desc":"Titus pen Gentail mi Khristian a suak hi a, Paul in a thuhilh nasepna-ah a seppih leh a huhpa a suak ahi hi. Titus Tungah Paul' Laikhak pen pawlpi nasep a van dingin Krete tuikulh-ah a nusiat, amah a huh a khangno mipa tungah a kigelh ahi hi. Hih laikhakna sungah a lunghihmawh thu thum om a, tuate in: 1. Krete tuikulh-a om mi tampi a gamtat uh sia mahmah ahih manin pawlpi makaite' gamtatna ding ziate Titus kiangah kiphawksak hi. 2. Pawlpi sungah a om mi pawl tuamtuamte a hilhna ding zia Titus kiangah kigen a, tua a hilh ding mite pen: Pasal khanghamte, numei khangnote a hilhsawn dingin numei khanghamte, tangvalte, leh silate ahi uh hi. 3. Khristian gamtat ding zia gen a, a diakdiakin mi tawh kilemin kipawltheih ding a kisapna, leh kimuhdahna, kitot kiselna, leh pawlpi sung kikhennate khempeuh a pelhna dingun a kigen hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian’ sila, le Jesuh Khrih’ sawltak ahi keimah Paul in, Thuzuau a gen ngei lo Pasian in tangtawng pekin thu hong ciamin, a hunhoih a tun ciangin thuhilhna tawh a hong kilatsak nuntak tawntungna thu lametna tawh, Pasian’ teel mite’ upna le thuman thutak a theihna uhah biakna thu tawh kituakin a khan semsem nading thu a hilh dingin eite hong Hon Pasian’ thupiakna tawh nasep hong kipia ahih manin,","title":"Hopihna","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Thu upna-ah ka ta taktak ahi Titus tungah lai ka hong khak hi. Pa Pasian le eite hong Hon Khrih Jesuh in nangma tungah hehpihna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen.","ref":"2Kor 8:23; Gal 2:3; 2Tim 4:10"},"5":{"text":"Krete Tuikulh gam sung tengah a manin puahphat ding a kisam lai a omte a sem ding le khua simah pawlpi upa a koih dingin tua gamah a hong nusia ka hi hi. Nang tungah ka hong gensa thute hoihtakin na phawk in:","title":"Krete Tuikulh Gamah Titus’ Nasepna"},"6":{"text":"Upate pen paubaanna a om lote hi ding a, zi khat bek nei-in, a tate zong thu um mi hi-in, a thumang lo, a phengtat gawpte hi lo ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Pawlpi siate pen Pasian’ nasem ahih manin paubaanna a om lo, a kiphasak lo, zukham thei mi ahi lo, a ngongtat lo, a huaiham lo,"},"8":{"text":"zinleleeng do a siam mi, thuhoih a deih mi, a pumpi a ki-ukzo mi, a thutang mi, a siangtho mi, le a kisekzo mi hi ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Upna bulpi tawh a kituak thute limtakin lenkip ding uh hi. Tua hileh thuhilhna man tawh midangte hanthawn thei ding uh a, thuman a nial mite’ khialhna zong laktel thei ding uh hi.","ref":"1Tim 3:2-7"},"10":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh thu a mang lo, thu a mawk gengen, mi a khem thei, a diakdiakin Jew ngeina bangin vun-at nading thu a gen tampi tak a om uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Sum ngahtheih nading bekin a kilawm lopi-in thu hilhin biakna innkuan buppi nawngkaisak uh ahih manin thu a gen nawn loh nadingun khaktan ding ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Amau Krete gam mite sung panin a kamsang uh khat in, “Krete gam mite a zuauthei tawntung, ganhing bangin a gilo, a thadah a uisan mi ahi uh hi,” na ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih ama thugen a man mahmah ahi hi. Tua ahih manin thu upna man nei thei-in,"},"14":{"text":"Jew mite’ tangthu phuahtawmte ahi a, thuman a nial mite’ thupiaknate ahi zongin a don nawn loh nadingun khauhtakin taii-in na thuhilh in."},"15":{"text":"Lungsim siangthote a dingin na khempeuh a siang hi a, ahi zongin thu um lote a lungsim ngaihsutnate uh siakhin ahih manin amaute a dingin a siang bangmah om lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian a thei-in a kigen uh hangin a gamtatnate uh tawh kilehbulh hi. Amaute a muhthadahhuai, a thumang lo, na hoih sem dingin a kilawmna a om lo mite ahi uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi zongin nangmah in upna man tawh a kituak thu na hilh in.","title":"Upna Man Thu"},"2":{"text":"Pasal khanghamte a kilawm a kituakin a omtheih nading, thu ngaihsun thei mi ahih nading, a kikemzo mite ahih theih nading, upna man a neihtheih nading, itna man a neihtheih nading uh le a manin lungkipin a thuakzawh nadingun na gen in."},"3":{"text":"Tua mah bangin mite in Pasian’ thu a gensiatkhak loh nadingun numei khanghamte zong a gamtat a khuahek uh a zahtakhuai ahih nading, mi gensiate ahih loh nading, zunek kiphamawhte ahih loh nading, thuhoih thupha hilhin,"},"4":{"text":"amaute sangin a nauzaw nupite in a pasalte uh le a tate uh a it nadingun a hilh ding,"},"5":{"text":"thu ngaihsun thei, a gamtat siangtho, inn nasep a kizen, a migi, le a pasalte uh thu a mang thei mi ahih nadingun na gen in."},"6":{"text":"Tua mah bangin khangnote zong amau pumpi a ki-ukzawh nadingun na hanthawn pha in."},"7":{"text":"Nangma pumpi mahmah gamtat hoihna a kipan thu khempeuhah etteh hoih dingin na om in. Lungsim takpi tawh mite’ zahtaktheih dingin thu na hilh inla,"},"8":{"text":"mite’ mawhmat theih loh ding kamhoihte na zang in. Tua hileh i langte in hong gensiat theih nading mu loin a mai uh zum lel ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Silate in zong a tote uh thu mangin, thu khempeuhah a tote uh a lungkimsak nading, a tote uh thu seelloin,"},"10":{"text":"a guktak loh nading, a tawntungin hoih gamtatin a cihtakna uh a kilatsak nadingun na hanthawn in. Tua hileh eite hong Hon Pasian’ thu a hoihna a kilangsakte ahi ding uh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh in hotkhiatna a ngahtheih nadingun Pasian in ama hehpihna hong lak khinzo hi."},"12":{"text":"Eite in i lamet, a lian Pasian le eite hong Hon Jesuh Khrih a vangliatna hong kilatkik ding hun ngakin i om laitakin i biakna tawh a kituak lo thute le leitung nate deihna phiatin, lungsim hi hithiatin omin, thutangin, hih leitungah Pasian’ deihna bangin i nuntak nadingin tua hehpihna thu in eite hong hilh hi.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"I mawhna khempeuh panin hong honkhia ding le ama neihtuam i suahtheih nadingin Jesuh amahmah hong kipumpiak a, eite pen gamtat hoih gamtat ding a lawp mahmah ihi hi.","ref":"La 130:8; Pai 19:5; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; 1Pe 2:9"},"15":{"text":"Hih ka hong thugente hilh inla, mite taii-in na hanthot ciangin na aana neihteng khempeuh zang kawm in. Mite’ simmawhin om kei in."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na mite in hong uk kumpite le aana neite’ thu mangin, thuhoih khempeuh a sem dingin a kigingsa-in a om ding uh phawksak inla,","title":"Gamtat Hoih Zomsuak Ding"},"2":{"text":"kuamah gensia loin, mite tawh kilemin kikhawl thei-in, lungsim nemin, mi khempeuh tungah a dik nading uh na gen in."},"3":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh eite zong nidangin haitatin, thumang loin, vakvai-in, duhna deihna a tuamtuamte thuaklahin, thusia le enna lungsim tawh a gamtate, mite in hong mudahin, eite khatlekhat zong a kimudah ngeite ihi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin eite hong Honpa ahi Pasian’ itna le a migitna thu hong kilat ciangin,"},"5":{"text":"amah in eite hong honkhia hi. Eite in na hoih i sepzawhna hangin hong honkhia hi loin eite tungah suahtakna le nuntakna thak a hong pia Kha Siangtho in hong sawpsiangna hangin a hong hehpihna tawh a hong honkhia ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in eite hong Hon Jesuh Khrih hangin eite tungah a kicing takin Kha Siangtho hong pia ahih manin,"},"7":{"text":"ama hong hehpihna hangin Pasian tawh kilemin i lamet nuntak tawntungna a ngah thei ihi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih ka thugente a man mahmah ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian’ thu a um mite in gamtat hoih a neihtheihna dingun hih ka hong thugente na lim ngaihsut ding ka deih hi. Ka hong thugente a hoih hi a, mite a dingin a manpha vive ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin a haihuai thu kiselna, min kigual deudau khangsimna, kitotna, thukham kitotlawhna cihte na pelh in. Tuate a kimanna a om lo, a mawkna thu hi lel hi."},"10":{"text":"Kitot, kikhen nading a piangsak mite pen khatvei nihvei bang na hilh khit ciangin kisukha nawn vet kei in."},"11":{"text":"Tua bang mite a kisiakhin hi a, a mawhna un a khialhna uh a kilangsak ahihna thu na thei in."},"12":{"text":"Artemas ahi a, Tikhikas ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh nang kiangah ka hong paisak ciangin, Nikopolis khua-ah phalbi sung omsawm ka hih manin, kei omna tua khua-ah nong paitheih nadingin hong hanciam in.","title":"Pumpi tung Thugenna","ref":"Sawl 20:4; Efe 6:21-22; Kol 4:7-8; 2Tim 4:12"},"13":{"text":"Sitni Zenas le Apollos-te a khualzinna uh manlang takin a paisuak theih nadingun na hihtheih bangin na huh inla, lamkalah kisapna bangmah a neihkhak loh nading uh zong na thei in.","ref":"Sawl 18:24; 1Kor 16:12"},"14":{"text":"I mite ommawk loin, thu kisam a phamawhte huh thei-in, na hoih na phate a septheih nadingun na hilh in."},"15":{"text":"Kei tawh a om mi khempeuh in nang hong hopih uh hi. Thu upna sungah ei hong itte khempeuh na na hopihsak in. Note khempeuh tungah Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hong tung tahen.","title":"Thupha Piakna"}}}}},"57":{"info":{"name":"Filemon","shortname":"Fil","abbr":[],"desc":"Filemon pen Khristian ulian khat hi a, Kolose khuapi mi khat hi ding hi. Amah in Onesimas min nei sila khat nei hi. Hih silapa pen a topa kiang panin taikhia-in, thongah a om Paul tawh kimu kha hi. Paul' hangin Onesimas, Khristian a suak ahi hi. Filemon Tungah Paul' Laikhak pen a silapa tawh a kilemkik theihna dingin thumna ahi hi. Paul in Filemon kiangah tua silapa sawlkik a, a sila ngeina bang bek hiloin, Khrih hangin sanggam bangin a na san'kikna dingin a genna ahi hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh hangin thong a kia keimah Paul le i sanggampa Timoti in, Ka hong it uh, ka naseppih uh ahi Filemon,","title":"Hopihna"},"2":{"text":"le na inn-ah a hong kikhawm pawlpite le i sanggamnu Apfia le thu upna-ah galkap khawmpih Arkhippas-te tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi.","ref":"Kol 4:17"},"3":{"text":"I Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen."},"4":{"text":"Pasian’ mite khempeuh na itna thu le Topa Jesuh na upna thu na zakhin ka hih manin Pasian kiangah thu ka nget simin nangmah hong phawkin Pasian tungah lungdamna thu ka ko tawntung hi.","title":"Filemon in Itna le Upna A Neihna","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Thu umte ihihna hangin Khristian sungah eite i kikholh manin, Khrih hangin i nuntakna sungah i ngah thupha a hoih khempeuh na theihna a kicin semsem nadingin thu ka ngen hi."},"7":{"text":"Sanggam aw, nangma hangin Pasian’ mite in lungnopna ngah uh ahih manin tua bang itna na neihna hangin ka lungdamin ka tha a nuam mahmah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Khrih hangin unau khat ihihna tawh hih dingin a kilawm bangin na gamtat nadingin thu ka hong gen ngam hi.","title":"Paul in Onesimas a’ ding Thumsak"},"9":{"text":"Hih bangin ka hong genna pen itna i neihna hang ahi hi. Tu lai takin Khrih taangmi ahi keimah Paul zong, Khrih Jesuh hangin thongkia-in a om ka hi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahih manin Khrih hangin ka ta ahi Onesimas a dingin ka hong thumsak hi. Thong sungah ka om sungun kha thu tawh kisai-ah ama pa ka suak hi.","ref":"Kol 4:9"},"11":{"text":"Nidangin nang a dingin amah a kimanna bangmah om lo a, ahi zongin tu-in ei tegel a dingin mi manpha mahmah ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima pumpi zahin ngaihsutna tawh nang kiangah amah ka hong puakkik hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungdamna Thu hangin thongkia-in ka om sungin nangma tangin kei a hong huh dingin ka kiangah ka omsak nuam hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi zongin nangma nasep hoihna pen keima hong kalh hi loin nangma uttawmna tawh na sep a suahtheih nadingin nangma lungkimna om masa lopi-in bangmah ka hih nuam kei hi."},"15":{"text":"A tawntungin nang kiangah amah hong om paisuak theih nadingin tawlkhat sung nang kiang panin Onesimas a paikhia zong hi khathei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu-in amah sal bek hi nawn loin sal sangin a thupizaw, Khrih hangin i sanggam hong hita hi. Kei a dingin amah a manphat mah bangin sal hihna le Topa thu sungah sanggam hihna tawh nang a dingin zong hong manphazaw kan ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahih manin nasepna-ah pawlkhat taktakin kei na hong ngaihsut nakleh kei na hong limbawl ding zahin amah na limbawl in."},"18":{"text":"Nang tungah hong khialh a, leiba thangba hong neih leh zong keima khialh, keima batin na seh in."},"19":{"text":"Keimah Paul in ka hong loh ding hi, cihna thu keima khut mahmah tawh a lai ka gelh ahi hi. Nangma nuntakna bulpi mahmah zong keima hang ahihna thu gen kullo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahih manin sanggam aw, Topa’ hangin hih ka hong thumna hong pia in. Khrih sungah unau khat ihih manin ka lungsim hong nuamsak in."},"21":{"text":"Ka hong genna sangin a hoihzaw a phazaw-in na gamta ding, ci-in muan mahmahna tawh hih lai a hong gelh ka hi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua banah, Pasian in note khempeuh’ thungetna hong pia-in, note kiangah kei hong paikik thei dingin kilamen ka hih manin ka om nading inndei zong a baihsa-in na bawl un."},"23":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh hangin thong ka kiatpih Epafras a kipan,","title":"Vaikhakna","ref":"Kol 1:7; 4:12"},"24":{"text":"ka naseppih Marka, Aristarkhas, Demas, le Luka-te in hong hopih uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Kol 4:10,14; 2Tim 4:10,11"},"25":{"text":"Topa Jesuh Khrih hehpihna thupha, note tungah hong tung tahen."}}}}},"58":{"info":{"name":"Hebru","shortname":"Heb","abbr":[],"desc":"Hebru Khristian-te Tungah Laikhak pen, mite' langpan'na a liat semsemna hangin Khristian thu upna a nusiatkhak ding uh a lunghihmawhhuai Khristian honkhat tungah a kigelh ahi hi. Hih laikhak a gelhpa in Jesuh Khrih pen Pasian a hong kilatna a man taktak leh hong kilat tawpna hi, ci-in genna tawh amaute a upna uhah a kipna dingun a hanthawn hi. Hih bangin a honthotna-ah thuman bulpi thum bulphuh a, tuate in: 1. Jesuh pen Pasian' ta a nungta tawntung hi a, gimna a thuakna tawh a pa' thu a mang taktakpa ahihna a kilangsak ahi hi. Jesuh pen Pasian' tapa ahih manin Thuciam Lui hun lai-a kamsangte, vantung mite, leh Moses mahmah sangin zong a lianzaw ahi hi. 2. Jesuh pen tawntung siampipa hi, ci-in Pasian in genkhin a, Thuciam Lui hun lai-a siampite sangin lianzaw hi. 3. Jesuh hangin mawhna, launa, leh sihna panin thu um mite kihonkhia hi. Jesuh pen Siampi Lianpenpa ahih manin hotkhiatna man taktak a hong ngahsakpa hi a, Hebru mite' gan gawh biakna leh a ngeina tuamtuamte in ama pian'zia dingte a limin a lakkhol bek ahi hi. A lian 11 sungah a kigelh, Israel mi a minthang pawlkhatte' upnate gentehna-in zang a, a laigelh a sim mite citakin a omna dingun a hanthawn hi. A lian 12 sungah, bangzahin bawlsiatna leh gimna thuak ta le uh Jesuh mitsuanin a tawp dongin citakin a thuak paisuakna ding uh a limgen hi. A laibu pen ngaihsut piakna leh hilhkholhna thute a genna tawh a khum hi."},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A beisa hunah Pasian in kamsangte zangin i pupite tungah a lam tuamtuam tawh a khen khenin thu na gen ngeizo hi.","title":"Pasian in A Tapa Zangin Thu Hong Gen"},"2":{"text":"Ahi zongin tuhun nunung ciangin leitung vantung na khempeuh a bawlin a zat, a tawpna-ah na khempeuh a luah dingin a seh a Tapa zangin eite tungah thu hong gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua Tapa in Pasian’ minthanna vang hong taangkhiasak a, Pasian’ lim taktak mah hong pua-in, ama kampauna tawh leitung vantung buppi pai-in a kip hi. Mihingte a mawhna panun a siansak khit ciangin Vanglian pipa Pasian’ taklam, vantungah a tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantung mite’ ngah minthanna sangin Tapa tungah Pasian in a piak min a liatzawk mah bangin vantung mite sangin Tapa lianzaw thampek hi.","title":"Vantung Mite Sangin Tapa Lianzaw"},"5":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in vantungmi khat peuhpeuh tungah, “Ka Tapa na hi hi. Tu ni-in na Pa ka suak hi,” ci ngei lo hi. Tua mah bangin, “Kei, ama Pa ka hi ding a, amah, ka Tapa ahi ding hi,” ci-in zong kam pau ngei lo hi.","ref":"La 2:7; 2Sam 7:14; 1Khang 17:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua banah, Pasian in leitungah a Tapa neihsun hong paisak ding ciangin, “Pasian’ vantungmi khempeuh in amah bia ding uh hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:43"},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin vantung mite’ thu a gen ciangin, “Pasian in a vantung mite huih bangin bawl a, a nasemte meikuang bangin bawl hi,” na ci hi.","ref":"La 104:4"},"8":{"text":"Ahi zongin Tapa’ thu a gen ciangin Pasian in, “Pasian aw, na kumpi tokhom khang tawntungin kip ding a, thuman thutang tawh na gam sung na uk ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuman na deih a, khialhna na mudah hi. Tua ahih manin nangma Pasian in nangmah hong teelin, na lawmte tungah a piak sangin a lianzaw, a lungdamhuai pahtawina nang hong pia hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"La 45:6-7"},"10":{"text":"Tua banah, “Topa ahi nangmah in a kipat cil-in leitung na piangsak a, na khut tawh vantungte na bawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua nate khempeuh mangthang ding a, nang na hih leh na om paisuak ding hi. Tua nate puan bangin luisuak thei ding a,"},"12":{"text":"puan khep bangin na khep ding a, tua nate khempeuh kikhelkhel ding uh hi. Ahi zongin nang na kibang tawntung ding a, teek hun cih na nei ngei kei ding hi,” na ci lai hi.","ref":"La 102:25-27"},"13":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian in ama vantung mite kiangah, “Na galte na khenuai-ah ka hong sikcipsak matengin ka taklamah hong tu in,” ci ngei lo hi.","ref":"La 110:1"},"14":{"text":"Vantung mite pen Pasian’ na a sem, a kimu thei lo khate hi uh a, hotkhiatna a ngah ding mite a huh dingin Pasian in a hong sawl ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahih manin i zaksa thuman thutakte i khahsuahkhak loh nadingin kiptak khotakin i letkip ding kisam hi.","title":"A Thupi Mahmah Hotkhiatna"},"2":{"text":"Vantung mite in hong gen thute thuman hi a, tua thu a palsatte in a kilawm bangin gim thuak ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahih manin a thupi mahmah hih hotkhiatna thudon loin i om leh suahtakna om thei ngei lo ding hi. A masa-in Topa mahmah in hotkhiatna thu hong pulak a, tua thu a za mite in thuman ahihna thu eite tungah hong gen leuleu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute’ thugenna banah Pasian in vangliatna lim, le nalamdang a tuamtuamte bawlna tawh hong genbeh lai hi. Tua banah ama hoihsak bangin Pasian in Kha Siangtho zong hong hawm lai hi."},"5":{"text":"Eite in genbelin i neih a hong tung ding leitung pen Pasian in vantung mite’ khut sungah koih lo hi.","title":"Hotkhiatna Thuah A Makai pa"},"6":{"text":"Lai Siangtho mun khatah a kigenna-ah, “Pasian aw, nangma ngaihsut tham dingin mi pen bang hi a, na phawk tham dingin mihing’ ta bang hi lel ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin vantung mite sangin a neuzaw deuhin na bawl a, minthanna le pahtawina na guan a,"},"8":{"text":"na khempeuh na uk sak hi,” na ci hi. “Pasian in na khempeuh a uk dingin bawl,” a cih ciangin na khempeuh a huamkhin hita hi. Mihing in na khempeuh a uklam i thei nai kei hi.","ref":"La 8:4-6"},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian’ hehpihna hangin mi khempeuh a dingin Jesuh a sih theih nadingin tawlkhat sung vantung mite sangin a neuzaw-in a kibawlna i mu a, sihna a thuakna hangin minthanna le pahtawina a ngahna thu i thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Na khempeuh ama a dingin a piangsak Pasian in tate tampi minthanna a ngahsak theih nadingin a thuakna tawh hotkhiatna thu-ah a makai dingin Jesuh a bawl ding a kilawm mah ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mawhna panin mite a siangthosakpa le sianthosakna a ngah mite in, Pa, a kibang a neikhawm uh hi. Tua hi a, Jesuh in mite, “Sanggam,” a cih ding zum ngaihsut lo ahih manin,"},"12":{"text":"“Pasian aw, ka sanggamte kiangah nangma thu ka gen ding a, mi khempeuh mai-ah nangmah ka hong phat ding hi,”
